description: After exhausting all her magical powers, Bing Yuanzi was seized by her treacherous female disciple. Seeing her own disciple, whom she had raised with great effort, plotting against her, the master drank the last remaining elixir of transformation, intending to erase her own existence. Unexpectedly, this instead turned her into a legendary natural seductress, with her allure and beauty skyrocketing to the max. Meanwhile, the next words from her disciple sounded behind her: "Master, you wouldn't want your loss of magical powers to be known by your enemies, would you?"

title.romaji: Dalao Ni Tou You Diao Le

description:
As we all know, you can level up by killing monsters, and I am... that monster. As the only zombie on earth that can turn around and not die, I concealed my identity and kept a low profile as a zombie in order to protect myself. However, I was worried about my sick ex-girlfriend, so I secretly protected her. I didn't expect that my ex-girlfriend had become a female warrior who killed zombies without blinking an eye, and I was discovered by her? I wanted to escape, she wanted to chase me, we struggled and fell in love, and in the end you told me that the whole world had to die? Okay, I won't pretend anymore, I am actually a vaccine.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: Bloodbath of the Fallen: The Reborn Hero Gron

description:
The mighty hero died in a final battle with the Demon Emperor. Five years later, he awakens in the demon camp, reborn as the weakest of their kind. But his soul triggers the ancient Serpent God’s power hidden within his body. Once a hero feared by villains, he now walks the world in a demon’s body. And this time, the bloodbath he unleashes will shake both sides of the war.

(Source: WebComics)

Ardour is the biggest pop group there is right now. All of the members are hot guys that all the girls are going crazy for nowadays. Lian is a normal student who sorta watches MTV from time to time. But she has a father who works for a broadcasting company and now her friends who are big Ardour fans are asking her to go to her father and try to get autographs from the members of Ardour. But the thing is, she has no idea what these guys even look like.

Haruka’s father is the owner of one of the largest media companies in Asia. She is beautiful, rich and popular so she is considered as a modern-day princess. Even though Haruka is being railroaded into an arranged marriage by her mother, our princess is in a secret relationship with the famous male singer Kage, who is represented by her father’s company. Working at her father’s company is Ten, an errand boy with dreams of becoming a songwriter, who also happens to adore Haruka. The trio’s lives are entangled when a unexpected death happens.

Tsubomi's mother left the world of sprites for the human world long ago. Tsubomi has always wanted to know why she chose to stay there and not return. When an accident strands Tsubomi in the human world, will she be able to find out what happened to her mother and return home?
(Source: Aria)

During the chaos and confusion at the end of the Eastern Zhou Dynasty, Wu Zixu and Sun Zi leave their native land of Chu for the land of Wu after their parents are killed. They take an oath of allegiance to fight for King Helü of Wu. The story portrays the life of Sun Zi and the superior art of war that he develops during the two year conflict between Wu and Chu.

The new 192 page graphic novel covering all 5 Fsc titles and over 50 pages of additional stories. H'eofigendlic Lodrung covers the last six years worth of stories by Fsc and also unpublished works that have only been available until now. Some of these hard to find stories were published in very small runs years ago in Singapore and China and have now been translated into the English language.

(Source: Neko Press Comics)
A meeting on the bus to the underworld. Fate… Responsibility… To face it all or to run away?

Wen Ming is accidentally transmigrated into a world of high martial arts, where he finds himself engaged to the ruling Empress, Wu Xin. His grand plan? To live the easy life as her kept man and coast through life on her dime. Unfortunately, he manages to annoy the Empress, and his dream of a lazy life goes up in smoke.

Unsure if he truly has feelings for her, Empress Wu Xin comes up with a plan: she sends her beautiful best friend, Tao Sisi, to seduce Wen Ming. It's the perfect way to test his loyalty while seeing if she gets jealous.

Wen Ming's reaction?
"You're going to use this to test a public official? What kind of official would fail such a test?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.english: Angelina - Sketches of this Messenger's Journey
title.native: 信使安洁莉娜漫游手记

description:
Messenger Angelina receives a request from Rhodes Island: Recover the data from the infection monitors of all the Rhodes Island operators that have been out in the field. And so she embarks on a journey that will cover almost the entire land of Terra. During her travels, she will have all sorts of encounters. Whether they are joyous, emotional, or troublesome, Angelina will not back down from the challenges. As they are what propels her on her journey.

(Source: Official site, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Yige Shen Hao, Dang Zha Nan Hen Heli Ba
title.english: My Billionaire Life: Just a Playboy
title.native: 我一个神豪，当渣男很合理吧

description:
Caleb wakes up reborn... with a Tycoon System. Every second that passes, his wealth increases-automatically. As the system levels up, his fortune explodes at an insane rate. Status, power, influence-everything starts coming to him. After a lifetime of regret and restraint, he makes one decision-this time, he plays by no rules. If fate is handing him everything...he's going to enjoy every second of it.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Fanpai Ta Bei Po Dang Tuan Chong

description:
A car accident transported Bai Zi'an into the world of "The Ruler of the Empire," an interstellar novel. There, System 66 told him that, in order to return to reality, he would have to play a dumb villain who frequently gets crushed by the novel's main character. Bai Zi'an is supposed to be cannon fodder, but somehow the Prince, the General, and even the main character are all falling over themselves just to woo him. Unbeknownst to him, Bai Zi'an is becoming a beloved character in the novel's world.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Yong Jirou Chengba Xiu Xianjie

description:
Shocking! Top-Tier Powerhouse Defeated by a Set of Broadcast Calisthenics! Today's Immortal News Fists strike the mighty, feet kick the immortal cultivators. Without spiritual roots, unable to wield spiritual energy yet he ascends to the pinnacle of immortal cultivation through sheer muscle alone.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In order to prevent the villainous princess from bringing doom upon this world, Jiang Xu—who transmigrated into her imperial sister-in-law—does her very best to nurture Her Highness into a virtuous and well-behaved ruler, despite her own frail health. However, when she grew up, the haughty yet alluring princess unexpectedly pins Jiang Xu down onto the bed.

"If you can love my brother, why not me, too? Won’t you have a look my way, my dear sister-in-law?"

Jiang Xu: …If you think I’ve lived long enough and want to drive me mad, just say so!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zu Huaixuan, a child raised in an orphanage, signs a contract with Yi Yang Shigong to travel into the underworld and to become a Bai Wuchang (a good spirit cop) in the god’s army in order to save a teacher who is very important to him. This story takes place in the spirit world that does not only feature Taiwanese and Chinese spirits, but spirits from other cultures as well.

A series of suspenseful, creepy stories that'll make you think about human nature. A hair raising series by Zhu Gengfu, entitled "Evolution". Shhh… Don't be scared…

(Source: Webnovel)

In the 14th year of the Tianbao Era (CE 755) An Lushan, a military governor with ties to the Knights Templar, leads his elite corps to rebel against the Tang Dynasty, and the ill-prepared Tang Empire falters under the threat. The two capitals Luoyang and Chang’an fall and China falls under the oppression of the cruel An Lushan. As the Tang dynasty starts to crumble, Li E, a shady Assassin trained by the Hidden Ones in the far West, teams up with Tang loyalists to turn the tide and save both the dynasty and the country from this crisis.

(Source: Mana Books)

title.romaji: Wo de Choudi Chengle Wo de Dao Lu
title.native: 我的仇敌成了我的道侣

description:
The Empress Dowager who ruled on behalf of the emperor, the pure and flawless Saintess of the Demonic Sect, the one-armed sword master ranked ninth in the world, the emotionless Celestial Maiden of Mount Taihua, and the chivalrous yet tender-hearted Sword Master of the Spring and Autumn Period… Danger lurks everywhere. In a past life, they were my mortal enemies. In this life, they are my concubines. They once all tried to kill me. So now, they have all submitted to me in shame and humiliation.

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Weishenme Hougong Nan Zhu De Wo Pao Daoliao Baihe Manhua
title.english: Why Did I, the MC Of Gal Game Jump Into A World Of Yuri Comic?
title.native: 为什么后宫男主的我跑到了百合漫画

description: The one who possesses all key points that makes a harem comic male lead unexpectedly match couples of girls.

title.romaji: Gunainai San Sui Ban, Peng Naiping Suanming Quanwang Chong
title.english: This Toddler Is A Fortune Teller
title.native: 姑奶奶三岁半，捧奶瓶算命全网宠

description:
Prepare for cuteness overload with Su Mianmian, a three-and-a-half-year-old metaphysics wonder! Cradling her milk bottle, she's a fortune-telling sensation, adored by the nation's wealthiest family. Whether she's exposing scandals live on air, banishing evil, or revealing hidden fates, she's a force to be reckoned with. Villains beware: one flick of her wrist and a well-placed talisman will put you in your place! This pint-sized powerhouse, with a thousand years of cultivation, dishes out epic comebacks and spreads joy. The internet is obsessed, demanding new chapters: "The ultimate adorable badass? Sign me up!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The spoiled daughter of a grand general, Xiao Yan suddenly lost her family overnight. But because of her lineage, she was caught up in the political infighting between the Emperor and the Prime Minister, and the seven-year old girl was taken into the emperor's harem, becoming the "queen" in name only. In the palace full of intrigue, can one lone girl save herself and affect the course of history?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Li Lingtong was the pampered daughter of the Prime Minister, until she suddenly became the daughter of a corrupt criminal overnight. She lost her position as the crown prince's finacee, and she was demoted to work as a scullery maid at a distant relative's estate. Betrayed and forced to endure bullying, her childhood friend exiled to the frontier, her father imprisoned, and her brother lost without a trace, it only got worse when she was sold to the infamous eunuch that controlled palace affairs. She thought she would be abused by the wicked eunuch, but he treated her with doting kindness instead. All he wanted from her was a sip of her blood once in a while…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Alpha Dalao De Jin Si Da E
title.english: Transmigrated as an Omega Who Snags His Alpha

description:
Quinton Lewis was once a ruthless mafia boss until a fatal gunshot ended his life. When he reopens his eyes, he wakes up in a stranger's bed, dressed in lingerie. Acting on instinct, Quinton attempts to attack the stranger only to uncover a shocking truth: he's transmigrated into an omegaverse world as a pampered Omega and the stranger turns out to be his supposed Alpha lover, Cain Lloyd. Trapped in a body and role he never chose, Quinton must navigate power, desire, and danger once again.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Xuanhuan: Wo de Nüdi Tudi Yao Heihua
title.native: 玄幻：我的女帝徒弟要黑化

description:
This novel absolutely does not bully the protagonist—the system is just a tool!

After transmigrating into a xuanhuan world, Su Changge becomes the master of the future Female Emperor—right before her infamous descent into darkness. His once-abused little disciple suddenly notices something strange: her master has grown gentle, incredibly powerful, and increasingly soft-hearted beneath his stern words…

Su Changge: “You damn system—I refuse to be a despicable villain!”
System: “Born to be trash, destined to be the antagonist!”

Feng Wanqing: “I’ve fallen for my own master… What should I do? I’m going to have a sweet, earth-shattering romance with him—no matter what!”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Ling Yufei, a commercial pilot, finally sees some hope of becoming the Captain. However, a sudden turn of events shattered his dream of becoming a Captain in a flash. To his surprise, the new Captain is younger than him! On top of that, he’s an ex-paratrooper!? And so, Ling Yufei is forced to operate the “Romantic Airline” together with his new “boss”.

What interesting stories will await us onboard? Fasten your seat belts, SkyHawk's Romantic Airline is about to take off…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In 1668, our city earned the title of “The Safest Place in the Country.” I had a lot to do with that. How? Because I was arrested.

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

Whenever a man lies to Haohao, he turns into a dog in her eyes. One day, she meets a shapeshifter who takes the shape of a dog. The only way he can lift the curse is to marry her.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: When the Dragon King Falls for the Loli Alchemist

description:
Zhui Yu, an elite mercenary, transmigrated to another world as the unwanted daughter of a family of alchemists, trampled, and bullied by everyone. Nonetheless, Zhui Yu decided to live strong in place of her body's original owner and destroy every person who ever bullied her!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Tīng Wen Taihou He Taihou Shi Zhen De?!
title.native: 听闻太后和太后是真的？！

description:
Jiang Shu is a graduate student in the History Department. When she accidentally travels back in time to the Qi dynasty, she remembers exactly how the history went. She knows that Qi Changning is a famously tyrannical queen, regarded as a villainess in the history books. Jiang Shu was content to play along and act like an obsequious lap-dog in order to survive. However, as she spends more time with the queen, she discovers details hidden from the history books. The "demon queen" doesn't seem to be as bad as what she had read…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Pei’s mother, a goddess of the royal empire, was sentenced to death by the King for the cause of natural disasters. While she survived, she felt the cold injustices of the King and was left to be exploited. Now she must find out the truth behind her mother’s unjust death in order to change the attitude of others.
While treated with indifference by the crown prince, Pei will work hard to reveal the empire’s secrets!

"You just use your mind to play games for learning." When this golden sentence used by parents all over the world to teach children became a reality to Rue Shane, a prodigy in a computer games was at the top of his gaming life suddenly struck by will to learn.. to learn it all! His enthusiasm for games is converted into an obsession to learn and study. A super learner who is extremely eager for knowledge to become stronger is born.

“Do not love beautiful people, love learning. Don't play games, just ask questions! I love learning, learning makes me happy!” Rue says.. and his adventure begins!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Kongjianxi Laoliu, Moshi Xian Tun Yiwandun Zhrou
title.english: Stockpiling Ten Thousand Tons of Pork During the Apocalypse
title.native: 空间系老六，末世先囤一万吨猪肉

description:
In the post-apocalyptic wasteland, the Void Sovereign Chen Luo outlasted all others by hiding with his special powers. But as the only remaining survivor in this zombie-infested world, he lost all hope and took his own life.

But he found himself reawakening back to one month before the apocalypse, and he retained the power to manipulate spatial dimensions from his past life. No time to talk, got to stock up on a billion goods! Chen Luo decided he will do things differently this time. He will build a safe haven and become the leader to survive the apocalypse!

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

title.english: The World Isn’t as Beautiful as You

description:
I, Shen Jiang, an unknown, simple-minded thief, somehow became the princess of the Wei Empire! I'm not a princess! More importantly, I'm a man! What is this? And I have to marry the regent, Xiao, also known as the soldier of the night!!! Wait, he's a man too, right?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo De Xixie Gege He Langren Nanyou
title.native: 我的吸血哥哥和狼人男友

description:
That year, I lost my father. The brother who always loved me suddenly started acting like a stranger. And then, that strange man appeared in my life…… but why does my brother treat him like an enemy? Father, brother, butler and that man….. each concealing his own secrets. I just want to uncover the truth, so I can move on and live my own life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Laozu Hen Mang Zhi Qilin Chi

description:
What is it like to be seduced by the disciple you raised with your own hands? The Chaos Master of the Immortal and Demonic Worlds accidentally took in the king of the qilin tribe as his disciple, and now his favored disciple is treating him like his own true love? But he has the duty to save heaven and earth, much too busy to fall in love!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Riley, a wandering artist disguised as a maid, gets caught stealing at Hilland Manor. As guards whip her, the lady of the manor, Yasmin, unexpectedly shields her. Riley couldn’t believe her luck at the noble’s kindness until Yasmin tended her wounds and revealed hidden desires and schemes. This "rescue" was a trap all along!

Set in the futuristic world, humans are facing a crisis like never before as immortal cultivators continue to invade their homes. Teenager Wu Ran, notoriously known as a loser, almost loses his life while trying to save his goddess. Through that near-death experience, he awakens a strange die system by chance. But the catch is, every skill he acquires solely depends on luck. Watch how an underdog finally turns his life around and rises to the top.

(Source: WebComics)

In a futuristic world of hope and despair, there is an underground city riddled with crime and corruption. A cruel and ruthless cyborg. A plan to shake the world, based on a faith for revolution. Betrayals, traps, conspiracies, and deceptions. Let’s see how Leng Zhe, the top assassin of the Xi He organization, will take on the whole world in search of bloody revenge for his past lover, Ah Miao!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The unlucky female lead, Xiao Ai Ai, had mistakenly dated a cheating player, and even tragically passed away from getting struck by lightning. Unexpectedly, her soul traversed to ancient times and she became the pampered noble lady of the Marquis mansion. From there, she began her life of battling her vicious relatives while teasing the handsome war god Prince…

(Source: WebComics)

Lin Mu is a young man imbued with an invincible sword-body, and then he happened upon the rarefied martial art tome Nanhuajing. From there, he would defeat all comers, on his way toward the zenith of cultivation. Watch him defend his family, learn from masters, take on his own apprentices, and woo beauties, as he becomes the greatest cultivator of this generation!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The Soul Pearl, coveted by humans and demons alike, is unexpectedly reincarnated as a man. When the man meets a powerful demon, they form a codependent relationship, as they work together to revolve the conflicts of his past incarnations.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Being the most arrogant killer in the 21st century, she travels to the mainland of the ancient time after getting killed to be a half-witted lady. But never mind, she will still open the eyes, crawl out of the pond first, and throw the woman who hurt her into a bath!

(Source: WebComics)

Before the deification after the War of the Shang and the Zhou, Jiang Ziya fell asleep accidentally. One thousand years had passed when he woke up. To complete the deification, Jiang Ziya started looking for god-to-be in the modern world to once again fight with the enemies from a thousand years ago. The enemies were ready, but the modern gods were busy enjoying their lives and refused to be deities...

(Source: Coolmic)

Min Gan, a student director with bipolar disorder, has shown great artistic potential with his acute observations and emotional sensitivity. But as he was preparing to make his short film, his mental condition worsens... Can he pull himself together and get out of the downward spiral in time?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on Weibo starting 2020-01-01. It won silver prize in the Kuaikan 2020 Manhua Awards and was picked up for serialization.

A comedy about the daily life of the cute (but dumb) older sister 22, and the little sister 33, who is blessed with an amazing amount of knowledge and ability.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

With the help of the invincible ancestor who time-travel here, Yan Wo and his partners are committed to reviving sect, upgrading and expanding their power in cultivation, breaking the monopoly of the old sects, and dismantling the huge conspiracy that has been laid out in the cultivation circle for 300 years.

(Source: WebComics)

"Unbelievable". When I wake up, I realized that I've traveled into an embarrassing novel I wrote in my teenage years. Now I'm the infamous first miss in the house of Prime Minister. According to the plot I wrote, the female lead was a flirtatious girl who had only one interest in the world -- flirting with handsome guys. However, her ending wasn't a good one, or to say it is tragedy would be more accurate. But I'm not going to accept the ending as it is. Time for me to tame my lovers!

(Source: MangaToon)

In the year 2035, the terrible aftermath caused by the alien invasion five years ago is still lingering. The active genes of the alien creature "X" were spread around the world due to the explosion, and the breeding alien creatures are lurking everywhere on Earth.

(Source: bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Zhang Shang Meng Qi Siyang Shouce

description:
Jiang Xiaoyu, a witch, steps into Fu Jingsheng's villa while chasing a killer. She ends up get cursed and shrunk to a size of 8cm. Although Fu Jingsheng knows nothing about magic,his supreme destiny holds great secrets of the magical world...

(Source: Daycomics)

Twenty-first-century yin yang master Zhao Mingyue dies in a fierce battle to reclaim the sacred treasure Taiyin Lingxi from villains. Her soul, meant to dissipate, is suddenly summoned to another world, where she revives in the body of a freshly buried girl. But just as she emerges, she narrowly escapes being killed by a ghost-masked man.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

To confess to his crush Meng Suli who is addicted to the Internet, tech geek Jiang Tingxian designs a game for her. The game, however, is later infected. The NPCs become self-aware and begin to make a pass at her, one after another. Now that they are trapped in the game with three other guys, can he win her over?

(Source: Webcomics)

A light-hearted everyday story of a group of people fighting with a group of gods.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

When the tier-seven assassin Ye Banxia was reborn into the 21st century, she was determined to live this life to the fullest. But her dreams of a happy and peaceful life were shattered on her very first day of college. What? That incredibly handsome boy was actually the reincarnation of the chief detective who tormented her in her past life? Well, I swear that in this life I won't be your plaything anymore!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In search of his beloved, the master plays host to all manner of guests, assisted by his devoted servant. What secrets lie behind the seemingly unremarkable everyday life? While the guests get their wishes granted, will the master and his faithful companion see their wishes come true?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Friend with the God of Wealth

description:
Tang Feng, born and raised in a village, has been a poor and pathetic loser and burdened himself with a usurious loan to cure his parents. With back against the wall, he scans a mysterious QR code, and surprisingly makes friends with the gods! The God of Wealth makes him rich and the Matchmaker takes care of his love relationships. His life is now looking up!

(Source: WebComics)

When he was young, Yin Qi was sent to the neighboring kingdom as a hostage, where he became obsessed with the handsome crown prince. After many years, Yin Qi incited insurrection and conquered kingdoms to finally accomplish his goal. Now when two emperors collide, who will be the conqueror and who will be the tamed?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

After the war, the humans who struggled to survive on the devastated planet suddenly gained two powers. People used these powers to regain their strength, but they knew very little about its origin. 12 years later, Noah, received his first mission to find the truth about these powers. During his journey, he was accidentally caught in the attack of the messenger "Black Thunder", what will await him?

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

With the advent of the apocalypse, the clan killer Mu Chang had his life trajectory changed and Miss Bai, whom he vowed to protect, turned into a zombie after an accident… Being desperate, Mu Chang planned to give up and end his life. However, the apocalypse system was activated in him in the nick of time. He not only acquired a brand new right arm but also gained an exceptional superpower. More surprisingly, he could use the mechanical arm to control and connect with Miss Bai?!

(Source: WebComics)

Have you ever wondered where people who disappeared go? University student Su Anni accidentally fell into a crack in space-time and found herself in a dangerous and illogical land. In that place, she has to stay alive and find out what happened. Who will survive the place where time has stopped and space-time doesn't work like how it’s supposed to as everyone fights to their death?! Who will work together in Chaos Lands?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Reincarnated in another world, but as the lowest form of life—a slime mold! From decomposing twigs to devouring ferocious beasts and mighty dragons, it rises step by step!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Who says chefs aren't important? I'll start a harem with a bottle of soy sauce, and I'll take on the world with a cleaver! What, a cooking prodigy transmigrated to another world!? In this world, the only way to eat meat is by hunting down monsters, what's a gourmet to do! Watch me sweep up girls with my left arm as I cut down monsters with my right. I'll kill the toughest beasts, then cook them up into unforgettable meals!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

What?! I only have three months to live?! What the hell is that?! The officer from hell will work as my body guard?! Oh my! This hell is so different! Could you please send another guy here?!!

(Source: Webnovel)
To those wistful spectres: if you can survive all of the 18 challenges, I will grant you a chance of rebirth!

A strange twist of fate led the highly acclaimed actress, Ye Zhen, to be reincarnated as the empress of a distant land and time. When she thought that things could not have gotten worse, she found herself in another dilemma–she and the emperor had suddenly switched bodies! She became the master of a glorious nation, not to mention the royal harem, while the emperor became one of her many lovers. "Well then, I'll rule the country while you deal with those ladies in the palace. Hold on… Why is there so much work to do? Do I have to go through all these paperwork?!"

Shen Zhongyi, an ordinary high school student, accidentally discovered that the girl he liked was an alien and also a staff member of the Galaxy Customer Service Department. The department responds to various incidents caused by tourists (aliens living on the earth), and "solve" the problem with the people who now are involved (delete memories, tamper with memories, and even destroy their bodies). In order to avoid being wiped out and losing the memory of getting along with her, Shen Zhongyi started a job career in the customer service department of the Galaxy, which came with a lot of danger.

In the year 2001, in the world of an MMO, Lin Jia and his friends were just getting started in the game when they found themselves as the cause of various incidents, from their IDs turning red from killing too many players, opening hidden treasure maps, all the way to unlocking the ultimate equipment: Trident. Their reputations were well known throughout the MMO and the rare equipment they harvested were sold for a pretty penny at the auction. However the good days did not last long. Lin Jia’s equipment was destroyed one day, and when he quickly retrieved it, a newbie tried to rob him only to get robbed by Lin Jia. This resulted in an ultimate equipment, one that would denote just how bad his luck was now, the much revered suit of a toad.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When Ren Fei arrives in a different dimension and conveniently obtains Mighty Brick, the most powerful artifact in the realm, it earns him the label of "the largest villain on the continent." He cultivates on the run and eventually finds himself tangled in a huge conspiracy, which seems to have something to do with his past life.

(Source: WebComics)

All players are suddenly trapped in the VR game world, and the formerly happy game becomes a death game. In order to save his sister, Li Dongyang resolutely logs in the criss-riddled game. Accidentally he gets the superpower that only he can use, and sets foot on the road to overcome the obstacles, seize treasures, save his sister, and challenge the gods...

(Source: WebComics)

You were the shooting star that streaked across the zenith of my sky.

After getting rejected in high school, Chang Le ran into her old crush, Song Yumei, once again in college. It was a little awkward at first, but she couldn't help feeling a little thrilled by the encounter. As they spent more time together, buried feelings sparked back to life, and emotions could no longer be suppressed…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: This Love is Like A Song

description:
Ling Yun Ge fought to gain power over the country for the one she loved, helping him obtain the Crown Prince title - only to be met with lies and betrayal. Desperately heartbroken, she suffered from complete exile. Upon her return, she was determined to make those who had harmed her pay... Finally, after the revenge is complete, she at last laid eyes on the one who had always stayed by her side to protect her. But who would have thought everything was within his calculations. Is this truly what the truth of the story is?

(Source: WebComics)

Abnormality in his physical exam, a delay in cognitive function, missing memories, Lu Chen was enveloped by mysteries. Just as he was ready to return to the top after unlocking a special role, another twist of fate emerged...

(Source: Webnovel)

The genius artist Lu Zhiyun was raised in neglect since childhood, until she finally returned to the capital. Already past prime marriageable age, she throws herself into various matchmaking parties amongst the nobles of the capital, as arranged by her parents. But Pei Chongjin, commander of the imperial guards, secretly does everything he can to make sure that he'll be the only man for Lu Zhiyun.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Why am I trapped in a novel as a monk while others get to be emperors and princes? And far from being unstoppable, I'm stuck with a dumb system and rebellious disciples with a bunch of deities hot on my tail!

(Source: WebComics)

Xia Zhi, a she-devil everyone feared in the apocalypse in her previous life, is connected to a time-travel system as a full-time empress. She comes to different alien worlds, fights vicious women and love rats to become the empresses, and flirts with men! She aims at stopping Helens of Troy from destroying the countries to clear the sins she committed in her previous life and to come back to life!

(Source: Webnovel)

Gu Yunyun, a high school student, is transported and wakes up to find that she has become a one-year-old Empress named Edith, who is in charge of a huge empire and blessed by gods. But it is no small feat be an infant monarch. Her seemingly prosperous empire is on the verge of collapse, and her own little life is in the hands of a mysterious church. On the bumpy road of ruling a country, she is approached by a boy called Crollo, whose soul seems to be something else...

(Source: Webcomics)

This collection of short stories by Wu Ya is a series of wonderfully suspenseful love stories with fantasy elements.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When a mysterious heartbeat is detected under the seas of Japan, Luminous, Caesar Gattuso and Johann Chu, (also known as the Ace Team of Cassell College) get sent on a mission to Tokyo, where they must cooperate with Cassell's Japanese branch, led by the conflicted Chisei Gen.
After an unexpected turn of events, the trio will find itself in the middle of a hybrid mafia war.

After traveling into a historical BL novel, the actor Lin Yan gains a special ability: fast-traveling through a skill called [Escape Death]. His first mission? To secretly orchestrate an attack on Prince Qi Zhen, which leads to the prince becoming the villain. Lin Yan’s first identity in this world is none other than Lin Shou Yan, the prince’s foolish fiancé. But as he plays his role, he accidentally captures the prince’s heart, and his fake death turns out to be the key reason Qi Zhen becomes a ruthless tyrant! A cold, overthinking tsundere prince and his scheming, perverted fiancé—chaos ensues!

(Source: KuiaKan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Jintian Ye Zai Na Ming Gonglüe Fanpai ne
title.native: 今天也在拿命攻略反派呢

description:
My adversary has tormented me a thousand times over, but I treat him with the tenderness of a first love. After dying at the hands of Ji Chi 99 times, Si Xu is resurrected again and finally finds the best strategy to win over Ji Chi is through love?! In order to return home from the cultivation world, Si Xu decides to bear humiliation and offer himself... The effect is quite obvious. Ji Chi is very pleased. The whole Mirror Light Realm knows that Si Xu is a great lover. Si Xu: "(Bitterly) After being reborn, it turns out that the most cunning one is me?"

(Source: MangaToon)

What does a marriage mean? Happiness? Not always. "Jing Qiao, you should never expect happiness!" "Anya died because of you. You need to atone for your crime for the rest of life." That man becomes her husband, her judge, and her executioner. Yet in this ridiculous marriage, who's the one get tamed?

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Moshi Bu Za Xiang Ni

description:
Idiot Alien Tourist x Earthling Workaholic: You XueChun is 3 years into an internship, having never used a vacation day. On the cusp of becoming an official employee, BOOM! Her manager turned into a zombie. Zhang HuoFen sat on the galactic bus for 100 years to finally tick earth off her bucket list. The bad news is, the zombie apocalypse is here. The good news is, no lines at the tourist destinations!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Wan Zongcai Chan Shang Wo: Tianjia Hunyue
title.native: 亿万总裁缠上我：天价婚约

description: She lost her family, her loved ones passed away, and a series of blows destroyed her world. In order to pay off her huge debts, she had no choice but to sell her own marriage. She did not expect to marry the next day. Six years passed, and her fate whirled around, causing her to once again fall into his hands...

When Tianxia No. 1 and Tianxia No. 1 fall in love, what will happen to the world? This is a story about martial arts and a troublesome girl, routine and being dealt with routinely, acting like a prick and the reverse. This is Tianxia. Do you dare to ask "Tianxia No. what?"

title.romaji: Bieren Lian Ji Wo Xiuxian, Gou Dao Dacheng Zai Chushan
title.native: 别人练级我修仙，苟到大乘再出山

description:
Three years ago, Su Xing transmigrated to a high-martial world. This world is home to extraordinary experts known as "Professionals," but Su Xing awakened the sole hidden class—a Cultivator. However, he soon discovered that it's impossible to cultivate and level up in this world! Finally, Su Xing obtained his "golden finger": the Life Simulator! On one hand, he secretly grows stronger within the simulator—planting spiritual herbs and refining elixirs! On the other, he brings the spoils from his simulations into reality, quietly increasing his power!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A 22-year-old worker, Ren Zheng, reunites with his old friend during graduation season. A moment of light-hearted banter is taken seriously by the god of reincarnation, who sends Ren Zheng and his friend into a fantastical world as part of their graduation. The two are reincarnated as an [Angel] and a [Demon] respectively, and embark on a series of funny and thrilling adventures.

title.romaji: Neishi Meitian Du Xiang Li Huangshang Yuan Dian
title.native: 内侍每天都想离皇上远点

description:
I became a eunuch as soon as I transmigrated? Fine, a eunuch it is, I'll climb my way up to the top and find a way to wear modern clothes and become a normal man again. My mind is a tangled mess, and I'm going crazy... Suddenly, someone interrupts my hopes and dreams: "Mister Xie, tonight the Emperor will sleep with you."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Yo Baojun: Wo De Yingzi Neng Wuxian Jinhua
title.english: Shadow System: Harnessing Shadow Power Become the Ultimate Hunter
title.native: 异狱暴君：我的影子能无限进化

description:
In a world overrun by alien invasions, only one in a thousand can awaken as a Vanguard. Burdened by debt and left behind by society, Li Yi survives at the very bottom until a brutal attack leaves him on the verge of death. There, he awakens the Shadow System. With an endlessly evolving shadow at his command, Li Yi finally gains the strength to fight back and carve out a future in a world that never gave him a chance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Honghuang Zhi Kaiju Shou Minghe Zuo Ganguinü
title.native: 洪荒之开局收冥河做干闺女

description:
Yang Li transmigrates from our modern world to a primordial world. He thought he was just an ordinary guy. However, he unexpectedly outwits immortals and saints. Eventually, he will subdue the Three Maidens, the Six Saints, and the Twelve Witches, save the world from a primordial crisis, and become the greatest sage that the world has ever seen.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Zhang Bao, the strongest Qi master, is unwillingly transported to a world of sword-and-sorcery. There, the entire continent has been ravaged by mindless but dangerous automatons called Cursed Armors. To return to his own world, Zhang Bao must battle against these monstrosities….

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When I was ten, I fell from a tree and hit my head. After I woke up, my world had changed. I could see people's emotions. The mood values appear visually, and are even color coded. Pink is love and red is anger. Green means embarrassment and blue, sadness. Yellow signifies lust… During my summer break, I met Yan Kongshan, a guy nine years older than me, on Green Plum Island. The enigmatic, handsome, and somewhat pensive hottie was the object of desire for all girls on the island. I felt the same, so I wanted his emotions to turn pink for me... But they became yellow instead. Even with that above his head, there wasn't the slightest change in his expression.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extras.

He Qinian and Sheng Xinghe were part of the high jump team at T College. Together, they advanced from the school team to the national team and found fame and success.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

He had been waiting in the orphanage when his biological father found him and decided to take him back to England. He thought he would live a blissful life with a family, but who knew his biological father only took him back in order to sell him off and pay his debt. He was sold off to his new and young adopted father who was a big shot known for his ruthlessness. While putting up an act with his "father," he also learned about his sorrowful past. Quite the shits and giggles will happen between this fake father-son pair.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

This is a story about a malicious shopkeeper playing demons! A young devil from the western areas encounters an evil and mysterious shopkeeper for the aromatics shop. Will the shopkeeper take him in good faith or for any other purpose?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes four extras.

I never knew that the boys' bathroom in the abandoned school building stood on the grounds of an old temple, let alone that it's being haunted by a ghost, Nie Xiao Qian. She lost her original form and is now a loli, and as the latest reincarnation of her lover Ning Cai Chen, I'm obliged to restore her original form!?

(Source From: MangaUpdates)

Formerly esteemed as a prince, Yong Qi got accused of a crime and was used to stage his brother's way to the throne. But what they don?t know is that this brother of his actually has strong feelings for Yong Qi.

Will this story turn out to be yet another fight for the throne or will it be romantic just like a poem?

Human beings have always thought that they are the only intelligent lifeforms around, but they couldn't be more wrong. There are many things that happen in the history of humans that cannot be explained by science nor history within the human world. Feral humans are appearing, they look human but they are a threat to the human species, they have been named " Sha / Evil ". Normal human beings are totally unable to deal with these "Sha/ Evil" so before "sha/Evil" was found out by the public a group of mysterious individuals formed an enforcement department - Song of the black night.

He took her first kiss but she saw his naked body. He obstructed her from courting boys but she framed him teasing by boyish girls. With wisdom and courage, they struggled. Who will win? Let's wait and see...

(Source: Mangatoon)

Yuan Xiaojia's fiance died on duty two years ago, and when she was packing, she found an old mobile phone belonging to him. Late one night, the phone without a SIM card suddenly received a message... It turns out that this mobile phone can contact her fiance of ten years ago...

(Source: WebComics)
A girl whose beauty is like goddess asks a guy to marry her, he says to ask someone else, please don’t marry me.

At day, she's a dazzling actress, who is being pursued by a possessive CEO. At night, she's just an average Jane, who is engaged to a dandy. As if this isn't enough to deal with, she's trapped in a super complicated situation: The dandy, who is the nephew of the CEO, loves the "day-time actress" and ignores the night-time average Jane, as he doesn't know they are the same person. The CEO, who keeps teasing the "day-time actress" while keeping an eye on the "night-time Jane," seems to have noticed something about her double life...

(Source: Mangatoon)

When death is broadcast live. What's going to happen to your life? She is a nameless rookie anchor. Beacause she happens to broadcast a suicide and thus becomes popular. Standing at the top of the pyramid, she sees the ugliest side of capital, and is disfigured for refusal to be pushed around. After reaching a revenge agreement with him, she signed a revenge contract with him. After a plastic surgery, "reincarnate" as the other she starts to take revenge.

(Source: Webcomics App)

title.romaji: Yayi Jiejie Zong Xiang Liao Wo

description:
Cai Tongan finally went to have her wisdom tooth extracted when the pain became intolerable. That was when she met the kind and beautiful dentist Xie Ruanqing. And then she found out that Xie Ruanqing was the senior girl she had a crush on in college…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Jiang Xiaoman, a university student and online writer, inherits a mysterious job from her father. Working as the archdemon Qin Lan's assistant, she begins to tackle strange cases with Qin Lan. As the two clashing personalities band together to solve each bizarre yet heart-rending case, they develop special feelings towards each other.

title.romaji: Quan Min Yu Shou: Kai Ju Shanhaijing, Heng Sao Quan Qiu
title.native: 全民御兽：开局山海经，横扫全球

description:
In this world of beast summoners, the Kingdom of Xia was weakened due to their lack of powerful summoners, having lost their cultural history. Until Yang Yang transmigrated into this world with the powerful manual known as Shanghaijing, and now all the legendary beasts of the seas and mountains are his to command! With terrifying power and skill, he will lead the Xia to sweep across the globe and crush every nation in his way. Amazed by his power, people realized that he is not just an ordinary beast tamer, but the heaven-conquering "Beast Master"!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Guifei Jintian Ye Yao Yi Shen Si Di
title.native: 贵妃今天也要以身饲敌

description:
"I swapped bodies with my rival, and she's pregnant?!" Now Princess Qiao is forced to go on the run while carrying Lady Ning's baby, and she's mad as hell about it. What's even more outrageous is that lying bitch Lady Ning seems to have a crush on the princess?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

I knew you were up to no good!

Huang Yun'er, a D-list actress, deliberately tries to seduce the CEO Ou Chenxi, hoping to investigate the Ou-clan's involvement in her cousin's death. Ou Chenxi sees through Huang Yun'er's scheming right away, but she feels like she's in control of the situation, and Huang Yun'er looks like just her type, so she doesn't reject her potentially dangerous advances. At the same time, she also wants to find out Huang Yun'er's true motives.

One is plotting a seduction but falling in love for real, while the other is irresistibly captivated despite the danger... These two cunning ladies fall for each other, even while fully aware, parrying each other's moves while desperately trying to suppress their growing feelings. As they struggle with their emotions, they gradually uncover the truth behind the secrets from the past.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhan Chuyi, who has been spoiled by her wealthy family for two decades, finally decides to work seriously to build a career, in preparation for taking over the family business. She sets her sights on a nearly bankrupt entertainment company as her training ground. It just so happens that her new neighbor is the top actress of this company, so naturally, she tries to help her out as much as possible.

Need a dress? Wear mine.
Need an investor? Take my money.
Need a famous guest? Sure, I'll go!
Need someone to… take the cat to the vet? Well, I guess I could do that, too.

The acquisitions turned out great… so successful that she even acquired a girlfriend in the process.

(source: Billibilli, translated)

In a world with only the sky and the sea, there exist two opposing tribes. After Iona from the winged sky tribe meets Helen from the scaled water tribe by happenstance at the water's edge, a deep bond starts to form between the two.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Jiejie Neng You Sheme Huai Xinsi

description:
Selina is a celebrated movie director while Phoebe is the richest woman in Hong'ao City. Selina developed feelings for Phoebe, while Phoebe took an interest in her as soon as she saw her. But with Phoebe's friends and family opposing her relationship with Selina, will their bond last?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Nai He Gongzhu Tai Fu Hei

description:
Chu Qitong thought that she would spend her whole life in the palace plotting shady schemes, until she met Ning Zhuangyan. That girl in the red dress broke into her heart like a ray of light from the scorching sun, and she realized that in this world, love can be more important than power.

Chu Qitong: In the past, I schemed to help win the throne for Aze, but now everything I do is so you can live a peaceful life.

Ning Zhuangyan: My sweetheart is the most beautiful woman in the kingdom. She can't buy me jewels and gowns, and she won't be taking me away on a high horse. But on that day at the Golden Luan Hall, when she took my hand with all eyes on her, I realized that she meant more to me than any man in this world.

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

The girl group Mystyle, which has had a tepid career so far, announces on their third anniversary that they're going to split up in two. One team will be continue to be led by the original leader, the hot and sexy Windy. While the other team will be led by the cute and energetic newcomer Wang Shu. Wang Shu seems like a well-behaved girl, and she tries hard to get along with Windy day-to-day. But in fact, she seems to more than just friendly feelings for her senpai...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Su Zhiqing is blessed with great beauty, but she did not take advantage of it to gain power in the palace harem. She resigned herself to a neglected corner of the palace, until she met her soul mate that night. For that person, she will give up her position and become a mere maid, just to stay by her side. That was how Xiao Wuchen found the beautiful young girl by the gate of the abandoned palace hall. Such a beautiful girl, with eyes as bright as the moon, her slender waist barely a handful under the palace robes, her soft skin and delicate limbs the stuff dreams are made of…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Xiao Zhou, a fledgling photographer's assistant, felt captivated when she saw the model Lan Shan at a bar. Lan Shan doesn't get angry when she notices Xiao Zhou taking pictures of her surreptitiously, but instead, she is struck by the aura that comes out in the photos. They fall deeply in love at first sight, as their destinies become intertwined.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A high school boy died and was reborn as a chomper.
He originally thought he could bask in the sun, drink water and lie down every day, but he discovered that as a plant from another world, he was in danger of being eaten by monsters or poached by hunters to refine medicine at any time.
Fortunately, he has his own "flower" system, which continuously integrates the characteristics of other plants, and eventually evolved into the guardian immortal plant of the Giant Continent.

(Source: Iqiyi, translated)

What should I do if I cross the fantasy world and become the son known as the great traitor of the human race? Don't worry, looking at his infinite epiphany system, all Bai Mo needs to do is make others jealous of him! No matter what kind of exercises or secrets, as long as someone is jealous of him, Bai Mo can open an epiphany and let himself cultivate it to perfection in an instant. So, Bai Mo has a lot of villains around him and occasionally teases them—he liked to watch his enemies jealous and resentful of him, but they couldn't do that themselves!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

In a world of Eastern fantasy, there are thousands of different species, each with their own cultivation path towards immortality. Lin Huanhuan sought a shortcut towards immortality by simultaneous cultivating on seven different paths. If she could combine their powers and purify her bloodline, she would become the youngest immortal ever. Lu Yunting was an ordinary guy transmigrated into this world. It turned out that he had a purifying body, the perfect vessel for mutual cultivation. The story began as she found Lu Yunting, and pushed him down on an icy bed...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Tang Ruoyao won the Best Actress title at only 22 years old. The next day, she was all over the news, being praised as "the next Qin Yinong.".

A gossip reporter tried to ask each of them about their impressions of the other.

Qin Yinong smiled like a fox: "I don't know her."

Tang Ruoyao replied politely: "Ms. Qin is an actress that I respect very much, and I hope to have the opportunity to work with her some day."

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

title.romaji: Xiao Huang Shu VS Xiao Huang Shu
title.english: Little Black Book vs Blue Blood

description:
All of a sudden, I traveled through time and space to be a Little Black Book, bearing the mission to grant Prince Kang a baby, and only after that, could I travel back. It's a journey to get him back on the road! But it's technically difficult to help a delicate but handsome man learn how to flirt with the beauties. Follow my lead, let's set out on a magical time travel!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Xixuegui Qian Nanyou Bie Liao Wo

description:
The ex-boyfriend Mo Tianji, who has been missing for many years, suddenly appeared in front of Ye Weiwei, and actually asked to make it up with her! Regardless of how resolutely she refused, Mo Tianji persist in showing his sincerity, and finally moved her. But later Ye Weiwei found another identity of him- the vampire...

(Source: Mangatoon)

He is the dark emperor! At first sight, she poured red wine on him! Meet again, he sent her to jail with the sin of seduce! Finally... It turned out that this marriage is just a conspiracy for your revenge...
(Source: Mangatoon)

Linlin is a fashion design student, upon touching the tree spirit “Ye”, the two agreed to help each other out. Linlin turned from an ordinary student to the talk of the school due to Ye’s power and her life changed drastically. Ye slowly fell in love with Linlin and with Linlin’s help, Ye finally found his long-dead sister’s body but he must face love, affection, and deception...

(Source: Manga Rock)

title.romaji: Junfa Laogong Zei Huai: Hen Hen Bazhan Ni
title.native: 军阀老公贼坏：狠狠霸占你

description:
The female boss of the beautiful nightclub Lan plays the fool for the sake of getting a divorce appointed husband. During the daytime she is the ugly wife of Chu’an whom he hates and at night she was the most attractive singer. While her plan is proceeding, her husband’s young handsome remote uncle Sir Qin, a warlord, seems to have found her secret just by chance and falls for her gradually when he gets to know her more and more. Where will this relationship go?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Prince Wants to Consummate: The Seduction of the Consort

description:
I must conquer you, woman! The wise and cruel prince was about to have sex for the first time. This is a story of a time-traveling agent and an awakening genius. ​It is also a story of a horny prince and a tricky princess.

(Source: MangaToon)

A series of short stories from the Republic of China era (1912-1949). Enjoy adventurous settings, ingenious plots, mind-blowing foreshadowing, and surprising plot twists. This series will leave you calling 'encore' a thousand times over. For those of you who enjoy logic and deduction, this is one manhua you don't want to miss!

Note: Chapter count includes 8 extra chapters.

Between the mountains and the seas, there was a war with the beasts for survival. A man, named Bo Yi, discovered that drinking the beasts blood would grant him powers. Bo Yi traveled the world, recorded these beasts, and wrote the "Shan Hai Jing", he also established «Shang Hai Jing» city, to promote the idea of eating beasts to gain the power to hunt them. But when relations with other countries soured, Bo Yi had disappeared. Since then «Shan Hai Jing» started the pursuit of fame and profit.

A young man is a slave at «Shan Hai Jing», however, he has an astonishing ability. The battle with the beasts changed the fate of both this young man and the entire world.

I was originally the son of the shrine official for the Year of the Tiger in the Immortal Realm. Since I underwent tribulations, I had to come down to the Mortal Realm to search for the one who can help me get through the immortal tribulations to advance in rank as an immortal.
Who knew that my power would be sealed and that I would turn into a kitten!
The one who can save me also turned out to be an extreme cat-lover, h-he pulled my tail, rubbed my belly, a-and even touched my balls!?

title.english: I Swapped Bodies with My Idol!

description:
Xiu Xiaotao, an ordinary girl who is tone-deaf, swaps bodies with her idol, the super popular singer Ling Xi. After all kinds of chaos, accidents, and misunderstandings, she begins to crush various male idols, becomes a successful, multi-talented star, and starts on a trip to the very top of the entertainment world!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Dear Boy, You Dropped Your Integrity!

description:
I, Pei Zhuopei, direct disciple of the Beggar Sect's elder managed to enter the Ace Detective Court with my extraordinary acting skills. I swore to seek vengeance but... hey, hey, that pretty boy senior with the sarcastic mouth over there, who are you calling a scrap-collecting beggar? I will fight you!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

title.romaji: Zhaohuan Zhi Zhu! Dang Yi Bian Jianglin Renjian
title.native: 召唤之主！当异变降临人间

description:
When the Players from beyond the stars turned the peaceful Blue Star into their personal slaughterhouse, all hope seemed lost. But the system made a fatal error, unlocking the ultimate hidden class for Lin Yuan: the Necro Hunter. He's the glitch they never saw coming—an NPC who came back from death with the power to hunt the mighty Players. The game for Blue Star's survival is about to be rewritten, and he's leading the charge with vengeance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yang Yu is an unlucky loser who chokes just drinking water. In despair, he decided to commit suicide but he failed at even that. Finally he vented his rage upon the sky and was killed by a stroke of lightning. Yang Yu was reborn as the prince of the Xia state. Given a powerful system to support his quest, nothing will stop him, not even gods or the Buddha himself. He will build the Xia into a great empire and become its ruler!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Liao Tingyan, the newest and lowest-ranking disciple, unexpectedly managed to subdue the terrifyingly powerful demon of Gengchen Immortal Palace, sparking widespread debate among everyone.

Some asked her, "Sister Liao, how did you manage to do that?"
Liao Tingyan: "...By relying on the instincts of a slacker?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

She was a female imperial general who unexpectedly crossed into the modern world. Kidnapped by a trash system, she was forced to do tasks to become a top star. Assertive and beautiful, she pedals forth into the entertainment industry with her high sense of self-discipline and strong temperament. Each one of her unrestrained and unconventional methods were pieces that attracted her a large number of diehard fans, even grabbing the attention of the viral emperor of the internet Gu Beihuai. With successive and rigorous training, she climbs all the way to top.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In this life, Yang Yan is the reincarnation of the Wenchang Star. Yang Yan lived a poor and destitute life, until he met a fox spirit and they set out on an adventure together. Will the two be able to find happiness in this life…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Mori Jianglin: Baibei Bao Lu Dao Dao Bao Wuzi
title.native: 末日降临：百倍爆率刀刀爆物资

description:
Lin Ziluo was reborn and returned to the day before the apocalypse game was about to descend, betrayed by his girlfriend, bonded the “apocalypse game cheat system”, got the 100% item drop rate, and embarked on the road of revenge!

But… this apocalypse seems to be different from what he thought…?

title.romaji: Nin De Yi Wan Shouxi Qing Qianshou

description:
Zhe Bai drown his sorrows at a bar after his boyfriend of 4 years dumped him. He mistakenly flirts with a young president who turns out to be his ex-boyfriend's brother. From a misunderstanding begins a new romantic tale between a sweet dummy and a stoic boss.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Buxing Jicheng Yeye de Yigui He Nü Gui
title.native: 不幸继承爷爷的衣柜和女鬼

description:
Plagued by bad luck since childhood, Jiang Yao was struggling to make it alone in the big city. Disaster struck when he was laid off, followed immediately by a mysterious fire in his rental apartment. After draining his life savings to cover the damages, he was left completely penniless. ​Unable to afford rent, Jiang Yao moved into the dilapidated ancestral home left by his late grandfather. While cleaning the crumbling house, he was terrorized and chased by Shen You, a female ghost guarding the property. In his panicked escape, he accidentally flung open the bedroom wardrobe. Suddenly, both he and his spectral pursuer were sucked into a world hidden behind the wardrobe, beginning his "Infinite Flow" adventure.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Tudi Xiaoxin Hao Xiang Bian Zhi Le
title.native: 我的徒弟孝心好像变质了

description:
"Dear disciple, the nights are quite chilly, and your master is afraid of the cold. How about you stay with me for a while?"

Lu Chuan had transmigrated into the world of a cultivation game, where he could earn mission rewards by kissing up to his female master. Eventually, Lu Chuan noticed a change in his lady master's attitude. Lu Chuan said, "My lady... I mean, Master, we are still master and disciple, right!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The obedient Yin Lian finally mustered up the courage to confess to her childhood sweetheart, but received an ambiguous answer. However, not long after this fruitless confession, another sudden high-profile confession completely shattered Yin Lian's peaceful life! The man who caused that apocalyptic catastrophe had openly appeared in her life as an ordinary student…

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Libie de Dao, Chongfeng de Dao

description:
Giving up her top job to live alone on the island, the writer Elly meets her younger schoolmate Rhea, thus their story starts... Check out how the scheming junior courts her reserved dream lover!

(Source: Webcomics)
In the mysterious female boss Lu Mansheng's spice shop, occurs many unquestionable fantastical stories of the vicissitudes of life.

title.english: Reborn to Sleep with a Star Actor

description:
“You must fulfil her wish if you want to be reborn.”
What is her wish?
“To be with the star actor!”

(Source: WeComics)

Su Xueshen, the 34th Queen of Nine Tails Fox tried to break through her demon body and ascend to immortality. However, Zongbo the Qiongqi, the demon that was refused by her many times, sabotaged her plan at the last tribulation. To recover her cultivation by using the prince's Loong Qi, Su Xueshen agreed to be his temporary princess consort. A story between a resourceful "weak" prince and a distrait princess consort.

(Source: Webnovel)

All things created in this world have their own purpose. For some, their true purpose can only be served in death. A person's treasured possession can have a soul and take the form of a human, but what if they were to be abandoned? A masterless Object Spirit can only wander the earth until eventually they too turn to dust in the wind...

Since starting high school, Xiao's super cute childhood friend Qing has started receiving a lot of attention from boys. Xiao works hard to prevent any unsuitable boys from being by Qing's side, but it's not long before she begins to question why exactly she's so concerned. A sweet story about the realization of romantic feelings between childhood friends.

What Chu Chi faced on the wedding day was not happiness and desired future, but the murder of her sister and the heartlessness of her fiancé. Pushed down from the roof, Chu Chi clearly saw their ferocious smiling faces. After rebirth, returning to the place where the plot just begin, how will Chu Chi changer her destiny?

(Source: Webcomics)

Reborn in college. Zhou Yuwen knows the importance of personality. In this life, Zhou Yuwen is labeled as mature and talented!

"I am a traditional person. I think that when you fall in love, you must be responsible, so you must be cautious in love."
"Zhou Yuwen, remarry me!"
"Get out! I have a girlfriend!"

He runs away, she chases him! He can't escape even if he has wings!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
When the boy's soul enters the body of a girl, but what about he's able to destroy the demons in order to protect the world? A work of Jiu Ye has officially launched.

title.romaji: Rang Ni Dang Shou Shi Ren, Ni Kaiju Jiepou Liao Qian Nüyou
title.native: 让你当收尸人，你开局解剖了前女友

description:
It started in anatomy class. The corpse on the dissection table... it was my ex-girlfriend.
Ever since that day, I've been pulled into a world of incomprehensible horrors.

A decommissioned bus that only lets passengers on, never off, on a one-way trip to the bottom of the reservoir.
An ancient, thriving tree in the hospital courtyard that devours people, leaving not even the bones behind.
A giant carp by the river, begging for help night after agonizing night.
And a deadly brothel draped in human skin, a place that never, ever closes its doors.
A ceaseless, vicious cycle... a nightmare that seemingly has no end...

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.english: Return of the Drama Queen Mommy

description:
Being framed and fell into the the lows of life, she returned to the entertainment circle with six genius babies a few years later. Let see how the movie queen comeback with the ceo and babies! This time, she is no longer being slaughtered, and is poised to step on the b*tches, climbing to the peak of showbiz!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Na Yi Ke, Xiang Wen Ni

description: A collection of characters kissing one another on a whim.

title.romaji: Bing Ruo Meimei Zong Shi Xiao Xiang Wo

description:
Xu Yulian is the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, smart and beautiful. Her life should've been a smooth ride, until she ran into a stumbling block named "Xu Wenjiao." Her sister came out of nowhere and became the person she hates the most. When she was a child, the frail Xu Wenjiao occupied all of her mother's time and attention. After she grew up, Xu Yulian had a crush on the neighbor girl who had just returned from studying abroad. But before she could get up the courage, she saw the girl confess to Xu Wenjiao instead. In this house, it's going to be either her or Xu Wenjiao, one or the other. Xu Yulian got so angry that she actually packed her bags to leave home, but her sister, who always seemed so weak and frail, suddenly grabbed her by the wrist wrist and pushed her into the corner. Xu Wenjiao looked at her jealously and whispered in her ear: "Sister, why do you like her but not me?" Xu Yulian blushed, "Xu Wenjiao, are you crazy? Have you been reading too many bad romance novels to be acting this way?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Once the closest of lovers, Ji Lingyue and Lan Wu, were forced apart by their identities as human and demon. Lan Wu, the mermaid princess, chose to leave Ji Lingyue, subjecting her to countless days and nights of agony. When they reunited at a cultivation gathering, Ji Lingyue swore never to let Lan Wu leave again.

One is an ambitious actress who dreams of starring in showbiz. The other is an up-and-coming fashion designer known as “a gentle flower” due to her delicate beauty. One sees through the cool facade to sense the thirst for success, the other recognizes the desire for something real behind the grand ambition. When one advances, like the wind brushing a rose, the other retreats, like a moonbeam on the edge of her skirt. Their back and forth is a seductive dance taken to the limit. Until finally she becomes the rose that blooms in her blood, and they reach the pinnacle of success together.

Tang Wanting: “I will pluck the moon out of the sky for you.”
Shang Yi: “You are the moon I want.”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

While in middle school, Zhou Chaohai accidentally took in a baby octopus. Years later, they meet again—only for the octopus to confess to him?! Outer God, Chaos, Whispers, the Abyss... Entanglement, complications, turmoil, demands... Ahem, shhh~~ Buried in debt, Zhou Chaohai finds himself forcibly bound, sinking deeper into the entanglement with each step.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"After one year, we'll divorce and never speak again."

Ji Yi agreed to He Jichen's fake marriage proposal because she was certain he would never truly love her. From pretending to be married to the real thing, a year later, separation wasn't even an option—they couldn't even bear to be apart in bed. Unable to handle the situation, why not just run away??

(Source: Webnovel)

“The ambition to pursue freedom is because I don’t want to marry into the tyrant’s family. I’m escaping from them and when I am surrounded by people, a mysterious young man rescues me. Who is he exactly?!”

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

title.romaji: Leng Ku Zong Cai De Xia Tian

description:
Accidentally destroyed several valuable photos, company's newbie Gu YIxin lost her way in the hands of the bossy boss Qi Xinchen...

(Source: MangaToon)

The fist night after moving in a villa near her college, Yu Jian, the 20-year-old girl experiences a ghost press, i.e. a sleep paralysis, during the night. This reminds her of the childhood nightmares when a ghost always haunts her dreams and claims to marry her when she grows up. To chase away the ghost, she goes to seek help from a fortune-teller and somehow bumps into a handsome guy named Hao Xuanyuan who claims to have ghost eyes that can see all the ghosts in the world...And one other night, that childhood ghost finally descends in the villa and deducts Yu Jian to the wedding in the Hades mansion...

(Source: Mangatoon)
The story of the encounter of two ladies - one of them a DJ and the other a successful businesswoman. As they live within this vast city, do they watch as bystanders or become lost within the maze?

After an incident, Ye Limei, a student of the department of sculpture, finds herself haunted by a resentful spirit possessing in a sculpture. Supernatural events start to unstoppably occur one after another... After Ye Limei discovers the secret behind the sculpture, she starts using the power to her own advantage and kills those she had long held a grudge against. With the satisfaction, her mind slowly gets consumed by the spirit of enmity...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes Prologue + 8 extras.

College student Sean Hanks has been cheated by his first ever girlfriend. Shocked, he accidentally slips down the cliff, fell down directly to the container that seals a powerful being, Now that the entity inside the container has been released, What fate awaits Sean?

Xie You has been protected by thousands of evil spirits since he was born...but the blessing of such spirits is not always good for humans. By the terms of the ancient contract, Xie You is forced to live life as a blind cripple. Under such circumstances, five families are asked to fulfill a marriage contract. If one family fails to fulfill the marriage contract, Xie You will become truly blind.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: I Became The Attendant Of The Villainess

description:
Upon traveling into a novel world full of plot mishmashes, Xu Beiwang couldn't help but comment, ""Why is everyone else in the spotlight after space travel, playing the hero, or at least a king of some sort, while I'm stuck being an attendant for the villainess?"" But he soon realizes that it feels pretty good to lord it over others, especially when the blame gets pinned on the villainess. And so, Xu Beiwang is going further down the path of using power to oppress others...

"I BECAME THE ATTENDANT OF THE VILLAINESS"

(Source: Webnovel)

In her past life, before a plane crash, she was a genius in both medicine and poison. In this life, she is the legitimate daughter of a noble family whose fiancé has been snatched by her illegitimate sister.

Right after entering her new life, she finds herself already infected with a serious case of body odor. The younger sisters of the original host's body scorn her, and she has found out that the original host died because she hit her head against the railing when her fiancé slapped her. Now that she has replaced the previous host, she will not allow these despicable villains to continue opressing her.

Why does the Cold-faced Prince, known as the War King of Hell, seem so different from the rumors? Regardless, whoever that insults her, frames her, or tries to assassinate her must die!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Paohui Mo Zun? Dan Wo Shi Quan Gonglüe Zhubo
title.native: 穿成炮灰魔尊？但我是全攻略主播

description: The top gaming livestreamer suddenly wakes up as a powerless Demon Lord with zero combat ability! Want to unlock cheat powers? First, he has to defeat his own subordinates. But with no strength — not even enough to beat a chicken — how can he turn the tables and survive in this brutal world?

title.romaji: Moshi Jianglin, Wo Chong Shengcheng Baojun
title.native: 末世降临，我重生成暴君

description:
Luo Hao was betrayed by superpowered beings during the chaos of the monster-infested apocalypse. As he lay dying, filled with regret, he miraculously awoke—back to the day before the end of the world began. This time, however, he has a weapon: a limitless Evolution System capable of making him stronger without end. Armed with foresight and ruthless resolve, Luo Hao swears he will take revenge on those who wronged him, and build an unbreakable fortress amid the ashes of civilization.

But the world isn’t the same as before—superpowered beings awaken earlier than expected. A shadowy force lurks behind the apocalypse. The Evolution System itself seems to be pushing Luo Hao into something darker… and irreversible. As power twists his mind and fate spirals out of control, can Luo Hao truly build his empire in the ruins, or will he become the very monster he once feared?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The weakest awakened one, Chu Mingxuan, is swallowed by a giant beast. On the brink of death, he unexpectedly inherits a system, thus embarking on a long journey of continuous strengthening towards godhood. But how are awakened ones formed, and where does the system come from? Beneath the calm surface, undercurrents surge, and the world’s bloody great revolution is about to begin.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Humanity's world was destroyed by the Demon Kings. Stripped of everything, Awakener Ash Si sacrificed himself in a devastating explosion to drag Demon King Voralune, The Glutton, down to hell. Instead of death, he opens his eyes ten years in the past, long before the tragedy occurred. He discovers his powers have awakened early, and surprisingly, he also possesses Voralune’s power of Gluttony. Armed with this advantage, Ash decides to act in advance. With his return, everything in the world seems to be changing...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lin Yin and Xing Yu are childhood playmates who promised to be together forever under the starry sky, however their innocent wishes were temporarily frozen by reality. Many years later, Lin Yin transferred to Xing Yu's school and on her first day she unexpectedly became wrapped up in a situation that left her at a loss for words. Amidst this chaos, Lin Yin meets up with Xing Yu again... But the embarrassment of not knowing each other makes Lin Yin hesitate to approach him. Can these two small planets reconnect in a new and exciting world?

(Source: Aquarium Tourmaline)

Mixing cocktails at a level beyond anyone else in the world, a sommelier, the one known as the liquor god Li Jie Dong. He died at the age of thirty in order to taste the recently excavated wine from the Han Dynasty.

When he awoke, he found himself in the world of the Five Element Continents as Ji Dong the little beggar. In this place, there was a special occupation known as the Yin Yang Spiritual Masters who control the the 10 elements of the sexagenary cycle. These bizarre 10 elemental techniques could make anyone gasp in amazement. Each and every Yin Yang Spiritual Master has their own Ying Yang crown that is condensed by one’s own attribute.

Due to the abundant love the people held for their wine and liquor, bartenders gradually gathered together to form a guild. This guild is named the Bartender Guild, and is respected by all.

Right after she awakens, a former wage slave becomes the villainess side character with a suspicious black reputation, a rebellious and neglectful younger brother, and a cruel and ruthless male lead! Hey! Even if the one you love is the beautiful heroine, you don't have to treat me like a tool?! Good thing I still have a handsome master who always consoles me from time to time... Back to the topic~ Observe how the wage slave protagonist crosses into another world and survives through the hurdles.

Liao Xi is a firm believer in the ideal perfect love. As a "Love Appraiser", she exposes men's lies for her clients. Is she safeguarding 'true love' or destroying it? Is she exposing lies or creating tragedies? Using lies to verify the truth— is the "truth" obtained this way real or fake?

Her world shifts when she meets the "perfect man" Bei and falls deeply in love. One of Bei’s close friends, Gong, a comic artist, happens to be one of her clients’ unfaithful partners and is deeply in love with 'Jiang Yifan', a character played by Liao Xi; and he makes Liao Xi question her beliefs about love.

Meanwhile, Bei’s rowdy friends— Xiu, Luan, and Sen— are also experiencing their own joys and struggles with love and marriage, wrestling with their beliefs about love.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: A One on One, Your Highness

description:
When a modern girl time-travels to the ancient times and finds herself trapped in the body of a deserted concubine, Yun XiangChang, and bullied by other concubines in the Prince Qin's Residence, her strong modern personality bursts out and overturns the entire harem.

(Source: MangaToon)

“XueMi”, the popular account created by our heroine Mei Huan, was carried off and being bullied. But Mei Huan then unexpectedly limelighted again and successfully counterattacked! ? What golden finger did she get? How did she make it? Let's see how the unlucky heroine come back and turn the tide!

(Source: WeComics)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

“Give your life to me, and I’ll help you forget a person.” As a result, countless people go for it and use part of their life to exchange for a peaceful life. Heartbroken past is hidden in the hairpin of the imperial noble consort and the spiritual sword of the stylite. “Don’t you even have someone that you want to forget?” “Yeah, but I’ve already forgotten him.”

(Source: Webcomics)

I’m Meimei Tang, a hustler, a black widow who can lure you in with a few sweet words. I’ve spent my life perfecting the ‘art of the con,’ and I’m proud of what I do. Why shouldn’t I be? The hustle is the only thing that’s real in this world full of deceptions.
