So when you, Xiaoqing Xia, try to steal my biggest mark from me, with your pink frills and long lashes… Well, let’s just say I’m not one to go down without a fight. Game on.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The first time they met, she stripped him, put his clothes on and went home. The second time they met, she stripped herself, threatening him: “Leave or I’ll shout out!” The third time they met, she smirked to him: “Just strip. You will get used to it. Come on!”

He would say: he has never met such a shameless girl.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Emo Di Du Chong Tian Qi

description:
Xin Lan and Tingyu Lei were married. Two months later, Tingyu Lei suddenly asked for a divorce! Xin Lan was full of anger while signing the contract. However, is what happened a trick played by the scheming boss?

(Source: Webcomics)

Overnight, Huang Zixia went from being a lady detective famous for her genius at solving cases, to a murderer accused of poisoning her entire family, a wanted fugitive. She tried to escape to the capital to plead her case, but accidentally ran into the Kui Prince, Li ShuBai, instead. By pretending to be a eunuch in the prince's household, she must investigate the mysteries surrounding her case, even as the outlook seems dark and cloudy. Huang Zixia and Li Shubai will follow the scattered clues across land and sea, north to south, from palace to village. At the end of the trail, the shocking truth might be enough to overthrow an entire dynasty…

(Source: ZYMK, translated)

Her family went bankrupt and her fiance broke up with her. On a snowy night, she met the guy who changes her whole life. In order to save the family, she gave up her dignity and pride. She thought everything would be better after that night, but the truth was... "You did all these on purpose!" He looked at her coldly, "Meeting you is the biggest mistake of my life." It turned out that he had never loved her...

(Source: MangaToon)

You need to know one thing about Mia Chen: she hates surprises. New foods, new people, dates…she has a single priority in life: her work as a director for a top fashion magazine. And keeping her superpowers under wraps, that too. When a handsome but half-dead man emerges from a magical portal and witnesses her powers, she has no choice but to help him recover. When her magazine sales begin rapidly declining, she has no choice but to use him as their top model?! The biggest surprise in Mia’s life? True love.

(Source : Tapas)

As an aspiring actress, Wanwan Tang knows how to fake her feelings. But when it comes to superhot, superstar, actor Jian Ning she can’t hide her true feelings about him: she hates his guts! Whether sabotaging Wanwan’s lines or outright ignoring her existence, Jian has been nothing but rude to her. Yet, much like the movies they star in, there’s more to Jian behind the scenes. Is he really this rude? Or is it all just an act?

(Source: Tapas)

Wang Jian's younger sister is seriously ill but they can't afford her treatment. In desperation, Wang Jian unexpectedly obtains an app called Immortal Realm Trading System, which not only saves his sister's life but also grants him multiple super abilities. However, as time passes, Wang Jian discovers that he is not just some ordinary guy with cheat abilities.

(Source: WebComics)

Mian’s world is torn asunder by a brutal attack on the people of Ba. She is helpless to protect those she loves, but this tragedy awakens the chaos and power of the rare black dragon within her. To aid her safe transformation, she becomes dragonbound with the mysterious Qianyi. Joined by their hopes for a new world and an imperial kill order against their lives, together they embark on a journey to elevate their dragon powers and to defeat the evil and corruption around them.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Quan Fei Zhi Di Yi Fenghua

description: She is a Chinese forensic medical expert, reincarnating into the only daughter of a family. He is the Emperor's grandson, aloof and carrying a debt of blood. A banquet allows her elegance and talent to bloom, additionally forming the bonds of love between them. For her, he paved a beautiful path to living up to her absolute brilliance. For him, she conspired against the world to help him on the path to the throne... A forensic medical expert, reincarnating and counterattacking, encountering the Emperor's grandson...achieving being together for the rest of their lives.

One is a unrestrained spoiled heiress, the other a bastard child with a difficult life. The two became entangled in a nasty inheritance battle. When a mysterious antagonist pushed them through death's door, they were reborn into one body. Now the two-faced heiress will set out on the road for vengeance!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Tiancai Jun Zhu De Cheng Huang Zhi Lu

description:
Lin Miaoke's life consists of sucking up to others. At a young age, she stuck to her grandfather, the Emperor. After he passed, she latched onto her uncle. In the end, she became someone for others to suck up to. Follow her story in this flourishing world.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

In the eye of the brother, the young sister is a hassle, but eventually, he became a sister - con.

In the eye of the sister, the image of the older brother was a respectful figure, but soon degenerates into something worse, she thinks her brother is a big idiot.

A pair of siblings, two pairs of childhood friends, acting the love-hate relationship and trying to do each other in slapstick comedy, all for your enjoyment and fulfillment.

Working at a café seemed like the perfect job for Ziqi. It’s cute, pays the bills, and best of all… FREE FOOD! But there’s a problem: it’s a cat café and she’s terrified of cats! This isn’t your usual café though, here the cat’s help too... sometimes. Together with her kitty coworkers Boss the Persian, Luna the Siamese, Jury the tabby, Coco the munchkin, and Mimi the mixed stray, how can she pawssibly survive?! Welcome to Cafe Schrödinger!

(Source: Tapas)

Shen Ying, a foodaholic girl with no sense of direction from the modern world, came to another world through time travel. She had no money and couldn't get out of the spirit world. Incredibly talented as a martial arts master but also easily neglected, Shen Ying is like a bug in a video game.
Shen Ying took Yi Qing, an upstanding swordsman, as her disciple although, at first, she only wanted him to cook for her.
Yi Qing, a man of integrity and conscience, was defeated in a fight with a demon and fell into the yard of Shen Ying who later became his master through serendipity.
However, Shen Ying and Yi Qing always talked past each other. Later they entered Xuantian Clan and with Shen Ying's simple explanations and his own imagination, Yi Qing gradually became an unbeatable swordsman in the world.
This is a funny story about cultivation featuring two characters with strikingly different dispositions: an upright, gentle disciple and a hilarious but powerful master.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo de Tongxue Dou Hen Qiguai

description:
Just an ordinary female high school student Liao Yuqing bumped into a Prince Charming classmate on her way to school?! At the same time, the center-of-attention rabid American exchange student Ryan and infamously scary devil student Chu Feng met. Surrounded by these four, the ordinary girl and her strange and unique classmates have had a hilarious campus life ever since.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

The snake spirit Yi Mo and a scholar Shen Qingxuan met each other over a cup of tea. After Shen finally left with regret, Yi Mo realized that he counldn't live without him, so he pursued Shen in his next lifetime… Can a mortal and a snake spirit fall into a romantic relationship?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

An Juan, 20 years old, dreams of being a cartoonist. This year she finally achieved her dream of being accepted to the studio of the cartoonist she admired the most. But she didn't expect the teacher to be the anti-fan she argued with a few days back?! Ji Nian and An Juan have a long road ahead of them. What kind of sparks will fly between the lively and honest assistant and the cold veteran cartoonist?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Sarah Lindberg's world turned upside down fast. By her side was her suddenly-mutated boyfriend, and outside her window was the scorching doomsday.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Shenbian Quan Shi Chouren Youzai
title.english: Getting Even By Being Friends With My Enemies' Offspring
title.native: 重生后身边全是仇人幼崽

description:
Princess Stefanie spent her life one step from the throne, only to be murdered just before her coronation by those she trusted most. Reborn as an infant in a remote border town with all her memories as a princess, she discovers her killers have seized the empire and risen to ultimate power. Worse, she finds herself surrounded by the children of her very betrayers. She may be trapped in a helpless baby's body, but she still has her sharp mind. Now, Stefanie must carefully plot her revenge while growing up among the offspring of those who had destroyed her.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Moshi: Renhuang Fan Youqing Gewei Nü Tu Ruzuo
title.english: Apocalypse Throne: All Disciples, Answer My Call
title.native: 末世：人皇幡有请各位女徒入座

description:
On the brink of ascension, Su Bai is betrayed by his own disciples. When he opens his eyes again, he’s no longer a god on the verge of transcendence, but an ordinary man in a modern world overrun by zombies. His only weapon is the Staff of Souls, a relic so weak it's nearly worthless. Or so it seems. As the staff awakens, a sliver of hope emerges: a path back to his original world. And then comes the real twist: the disciples who betrayed him have been dragged into this world too.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Baojun Yijia Kao Ting Ta Xinsheng Xuming
title.native: 暴君一家靠听她心声续命

description:
After being unfairly crushed to death, Jiujiu ends up in the underworld, bickering with Yama. In a bid to silence her endless rambling, he reincarnates her into a novel—as a princess. But not just any princess—she’s an exiled royal trapped in the infamous Cold Palace! One day, thanks to the scheming heroine of the novel, Jiujiu’s biological father—the tyrant emperor—flies into a rage and prepares to beat her to death! Burning with fury and injustice, Jiujiu cries out in her heart: “With a cruel, ruthless tyrant completely blind to right and wrong, it’s no wonder the Western Chu Kingdom will fall in ten years! It’s a miracle it could even last that long!” To her surprise, the emperor suddenly freezes—he can hear her thoughts! With her mind exposed, has Jiujiu just sealed her fate—or changed her destiny forever?!

(Source: WebComics)

Mature, steady, and cold little captain × pure yet flirtatious, poor little pitiful one.

Sui Yi said that not a single word from Ning Lan's mouth was true. Later, he would realize that even the sentence "I don't like you" was a lie.

He must have been crazy to think this person was inherently good, just because his smile was innocent and pure, and his eyes were clear and clean, so much like that person.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 2 extra chapters.

Yuan Xiang Wei was the County Princess of Duan Ning in her past life, although she was forced to marry four times, she still considers herself to be modest and upright.
It just had to be that after her death, all four of her ex-husbands became influential figures. She considers it to be her running into bad luck. After rebirth she finally made up her mind, what is femininity or female virtues? She wants the center position to abuse the scums, and to surpass everything below the heavens!
But she didn't expect that all four of them were also reborn, and each of them all had one same wish ——in this life, she will only be mine!

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

To investigate a kidnapping case, Xue Zhao, a profiler, went deep into a village of a foreign race, but was haunted by the villager's worship of [Him]. The pale face of Ji Li was looming, and his cold and wet long hair followed him like a shadow. Is the grace He bestowed a gentle killing intent or a bloody love word? The sacrifice He demanded was Xue Zhao's arrogant mind or his cold heart? Is the ghost you... or me?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

My name is Jiang Ziling, I am, oh no, was a take-out deliverer. When I was delivering milk tea, I encountered a Demon, and she evoked the power within me. Now, I am an awaker, I hunt demons... “Death is not the termination anymore, the seal is about to break, terror will once again reign the earth! But I am the light to perish all of them!”

(Source:MangaToon)

Wendy was taken back to the palace by the king of Babylon... However, she doesn't want to spend an extra second with this tyrant of history! “I just want to go home!” Wendy began to fight back in this mysterious country of Babylon and the rumored tyrant...

(Source: Mangatoon)

Hunt, or be hunted.

High-schooler Youge is lamenting his dull life when he has a vision of the near future: his classmates become beasts, and the world he knows is no more. Now part of a virtual world, Youge must decide whether to accept his fate and be hunted by other players, or to become a real monster.

(Source: Manta)

What could a mechanical repairman do？What could a special scout do? What could a military staff do? A person who could combine three professions, and even master psychology tricks and assassin camouflage, however, was a wretched，despicable and fat man.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Liehuo Kuang Fei: Shouxing Wangye Yingyao Chong
title.native: 烈火狂妃：兽性王爷硬要宠

description:
After a tragic death, Shen Qingdai was reborn as a talented cultivator and is no longer the worthless trash anymore! Mastering all six elements, rich in prime elixir and with ancient mythical creatures begging for allegiance, she is now the proud queen capable of everything! If this is the Heaven’s Will, she doesn’t mind going against it!

(Source: Webnovel)

As a shy and insecure manga artist, Xiang Queque encounters a cool, aloof classmate in college who makes her a bit nervous. By a twist of fate, he becomes her script consultant, and she soon uncovers a surprising connection between him and her net friend—Mr. Tree Hole.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

title.romaji: Sang Luo Zuì Zai Nan Feng Li

description:
The first kiss was just an accident. But if all of those accidents were put together, you can hardly call it an accident. She sweared to conquer this arrogant man who ignored her yet saved her again and again until she found out his secret. Love comes so fast like the rising tide, yet he never noticed it until she was gone. This time, no matter the cost, he will not let her go, cuz' he has fallen all in her.

(Source: Mangatoon)

Xinwen was just a history major student until she’s caught in a fire at the library. Before she passes out, she sees a vision of a woman and then wakes up in a different world. Now she must live as Princess Wenxin Li, the only imperial magic user of the Flower Nation, sent to The United Realms for a political marriage. Treated as an outsider and challenged to use magic that she doesn’t know, she must fend off rivals seeking to bring about her downfall… while also figuring out why the former queen speaks to her in her dreams.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Mojun Bachong: Tiancai Meng Bao Fu Hei Niang Qin
title.english: A Genius Baby with a Dark Mother
title.native: 魔君霸宠：天才萌宝腹黑娘亲

description:
Lin Yunxi was forced to sleep with a man as soon as she crossed over to the new world, and then tragically fell off a cliff. Six years later, she was reborn from the ashes wiser and stronger, and all demon kings were her suiters. Then, a certain man became jealous. He blocked Lin Yunxi in the corner and said domineeringly, "These children are mine, and you are mine too!"

Two little kids came to her defense, "If you want our mother, you'll have to get past us first!" After such a successful attack, his face was full of indignation: "These kids don't fight fair!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Pianzhi De Langman, “Ganxie Ni Shi Ai Wo De”

description:
Some girls live their lives in fear, afraid of taking risks. Some girls reject whimsy, preferring to be stubbornly practical. Some girls may be stuck in their sorrows and other girls may just be stuck up. But no matter the girl, the season of love waits just around the corner. Four sweet love stories about four different girls that shows us it doesn’t matter whether you’re the coward, the queen, the sad, or the skeptic, there’s always someone who will embrace your flaws and love you as you are.

(Source: Tapas)

Formerly a genius hunter, Bai Mu is now a third-rate celebrity. In a moment of carelessness, he was captured by his childhood playmate who turned out to be a vampire. From then on, he found it impossible to get away from his aggressively possessive childhood friend.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ai Shi Yi Chang Jing Xin Dong Po De Mou Sha
title.native: 爱是一场惊心动魄的谋杀

description: After finding out that my boyfriend was cheating on me with my little sister, I announced our break-up in a fit of rage. But never could I have imagined that the two of them would commit double suicide. Even the police believes that this was just an accident... But I felt that things weren't that simple. Since my university days, anyone who had a conflict with me would all perish in unnatural deaths...

title.romaji: Shi Ming Jujue Zuo Monü [Chuan Youxi]
title.english: Who Said I Want To Be a Witch?
title.native: 实名拒绝做魔女[穿游戏]

description:
How does one dodge an accursed destiny as villainess-slash-witch? Adelia’s got a plan. She’ll just maintain a low profile, suppress her witchy side, and avoid the hero like the plague. Easy, right? Wrong. Reality had other plans though. The game system pushes her into the role she desperately tries to avoid and into the direction of Siegfried Scarborough, the merciless hero. In this game of cat and mouse, she must outwit the game to rewrite her destiny and snag a happily ever after.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Da Xiaojie Neng You She Me Huai Xin Yan Ne
title.native: 大小姐能有什么坏心眼呢

description:
"To revenge is one thing. To conquer the bossy president is another."

Tong Yue has witnessed her mother's death in childhood. The nightmare still hunts her over years. This time she comes back to the Tong's mansion and swear she will take what belonged to her back. However, Han Tianlin, the most wealthy man in Long City, appears in her life. Tong Yue considers it a great idea to make use of him. But smart as Han Tianlian, would he be played around? What would he do when he finds out the plan of his tricky mademoiselle?

(Source: Mangatoon)

Are you a lover for cats? Welcome to this strange cats hotel! Meow~

Heaven or hell is just within a flash of decision. From living together to being homeless, say goodbye to playboys and be in love with a cute guy who is also fond of cats!

Being betrayed by her boyfriend, and driven out by the landlord. How should Chu Tingting and her cat start from anew in this unfamiliar city? A strange rental advertisement actually turned her world upside down. Cute guy, now that we both have cats. Shall we be in love first?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: This Love is Not For Sale

description:
A kind girl who had just fallen in love was forced to become a gangster's mistress for five years to pay her parents debts. When she tried to escape, she was beaten and abandoned in an alley, where a mysterious man saved her. But she didn't know the rich and handsome stranger only saved her because she looks just like his lover who disappeared long ago...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Shu Hou Wo Qiang Le Nan Pei De Xi Fen
title.native: 穿书后我抢了男配的戏份

description: A submission to the KK Creative Content Contest.

title.romaji: Wo De Nanyou Ke Shi Yong

description:
I have no money, no car, no work, my life seems to be at it's tip... "God! Please please give me a hottie and take me to the climax of my life!!" ——As if the summon was heard upon, a boy fell from the ceiling and the cake loving Zhen Tian’s greeting was surprisingly...the taste(a)of (French) the(kiss) lips!!? What do you mean it doesn't taste good?!! Hmph!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

I only made a wish on my 25th birthday. Why did I wake up to be the princess and bride of the vampire tribe? And all these handsome men want to be my fiance? It's so hard to choose the one? Well only a kid would choose just one, I'm going to charm all of them! See how an unwanted girl jumped to a world of vampires and became the blood queen!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

She was deeply hurt by a scummy guy. In her deep despair, perhaps the goddess sympathized with her, so she is getting a second life as another person. "From now on, I'm not just Wang Xueqi, I'm Leng Yue, too! I will not only live for myself, but live a life for the both of us!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After being set up, Dimo is on the run alone and comes across Zhang Yiran, a young man that he rescued and took care of before. As the bear everyone is afraid of moves into the small apartment, how should Zhang Yiran deal with it?

(Source: Webnovel)

Rong Xiaoqiang is a photographer of a vlog team that specializes in shooting haunted events. The team is nameless and creates gimmicks through fraud. However, he got a DV player that could shoot ghosts, and what was captured in the viewfinder became treacherous and dangerous that ordinary people could not imagine. This camera has brought huge traffic to vlog, and due to the desire for money and popularity, the team members ignored the danger, followed the evil spirit’s grave, and went all the way to death.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

The poor Duan Jiaze inherited a private zoo after graduation and was forced to bind a "rogue" app called "Lingxiao Hope Project", which ushered in bizarre "animals" such as Lu Ya, Daji, Bai Suzhen, and Black Bear Spirit. The app regularly released business-related tasks. Jiaze would be punished if he failed to complete them. In this way, Jiaze the director was forced to begin his joyful journey of worldwide fame and controlling goblins.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Win the Crown, I'm the King

description:
Yuan Wu, a college sophomore with a terminal illness was caught up in an accident and was granted a supernatural system that could cure him but in exchange, he has to defeat nine people with great superpowers. He accepted the task and later found out that the system has provided him with the skill "Domination", which forces his defeated enemies to obey one command from him, no matter what!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: You Ge Mimi Guan Yu Ni
title.english: There is a Secret About You

description:
Song Xue, a white-collar woman, has been caught in a series of strange incidents, and the legendary serial killer, Tooth Fairy, was killed by the police. So this time, whether it was a copycat criminal or someone else. As Song Xue drew closer to the truth, the answer was too much for her to accept.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Chu Xingyue woke up with pain in her chest. She found herself being carried by an unknown man in ancient Chinese clothing. " Keep silent, Chu Bingyue!" the man was angry but still protected her well from the assassins. "Chu Bingyue?" at that moment Chu Xingyue realized she had time travelled and entered the body of an ancient woman. What will happen next in Chu Xingyue's story and can she return to her original time?

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Shen Yi Du Fei Tai Xiaozhang

description:
A miracle-working medic is reborn into a fantasy world to help a poor soul seek revenge. There, she activates the face-slapping system, refines pills, practices cultivation, fights against monsters, and conquers the strongest man on the continent. Watch how fortune smiles upon her as she reaches the peak of her life!

(Source: Webnovel)

It was late at night. Bai Yimeng the drama actress went to a ramen restaurant for dinner after a toilsome rehearsal. At that time the news about Wu Suowei was being broadcast on television. All guests present took strong interest in this star of the police force and talked about him. What everyone didn’t know was, Wu Suowei himself was drinking beer in silence alongside Bai Yimeng. Just a story about solving a case, Oh No! This is where the romance begins.

(Source: Wecomics)

When a haughty and spoiled lady died, her body was taken over by the soul of a 21st-century medical genius. With her modern smarts and medical knowledge, she'll take on unfriendly in-laws, uncaring husband, and jealous concubines. In the warlord's mansion, armed with just her scalpel, she confronted the scheming women and easily saw through their tricks. As she won over the household, the husband who treated her like an annoying fly started taking her seriously, and came back to her promising to be a loving couple. Even as another playboy heir had become her willing lapdog, who comes and goes as she commands...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Cai Buhui Bei Nühaizi Qifu Ne
title.native: 我才不会被女孩子欺负呢

description:
What the hell? That menace who bullied me since I was six years old, actually became a pretty girl after three years of living apart? And she even ran to our agreed duel location to confess to me, hoping that I can become her boyfriend?! This is a plot against me! There’s definitely an enormous conspiracy behind this! I won’t be fooled by you! Even if you tear up and act all pitiful, I will still disregard you and humiliate you, until you’ve have completely paid back all my childhood grievances! What’cha lookin' at? There are very reasonable grounds for bullying a girl!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Quan Shao, Ni Laopo Yao Pao Le

description:
On the eve of the wedding, her fiancé cheated on her, her father went to jail, and his mother died. Within just one day, This young lady from a rich family lost everything she had. In despair, she met Quan Yuchen, the most popular man in G City. "I can help you get back everything that once belonged to you and save your father!" the man said proudly, "Just marry me and have a baby for me!"

(Source: WebComics)

One is a carefree playboy who loves to play games, the other is cool and experienced and won't let emotions get over his head. A relationship that began as a fun fling became a contest of psychological warfare. Even as they probed and tested each other, pushing the bottom line, they started to sink real feelings into the relationship. In the end, they found themselves more and more caught up with each other. Who was taking it seriously, and who was just playing?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Bao Fu Ba! E Long Xiansheng
title.english: Let's Get Rich! Mr. Evil Dragon

description:
How does a gold-eating dragon survive in the modern human world? Transform into a human, of course, to earn money! He needed to expand and widen his business empire for him to earn to earn the coveted dragon throne, thus he had no choice but to hire a secretary, and was even willing to sign a contract for the secretary to become the dragon’s knight. From then onward, they will protect each other and fight together. Turns out the secretary is a dragon slayer?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In the year 1620, Taichang Emperor died a mysterious and sudden death. That had caused terror and rumors to spread among the palace’s inhabitants. Every night since the Emperor’s death, strange gale howled in the city center, followed by a series of fire and murder mysteries… People believed that was the act of ‘The Wicked’...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Gongzhu de Yibai Zhong Xunguo Fangshi
title.native: 公主的一百种殉国方式

description:
The night before her girl group debut, Yu La was pushed by someone and transmigrated to the mysterious ancient kingdom of Atlantis, and entered the body of the infamous princess with her same name. Based on the history book that she had read, Yu La recalled the cause of the kingdom's fall was related to the princess' evil deeds, and the princess died with the fall of the kingdom. So now she either changes the course of history, or she will die! On a course towards destruction, see how this girl will turn the tide in Atlantis!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

What are you gonna do after getting reborn? Getting payback from my enemies, of course! Two-timer? Evil wench? I won't let anyone go! Handsome rich guy? I... won't let him go either!

(Source: Webcomics)

Ye Rongyin was set up by her boyfriend Ling Jiyan. It turned out that this man approached her only to coax her kidney for her sister Ye ming zhu. At her last breath, she saw Fu Jingsi, the man who she had been running away from all the time. He chose to die with her. Ye Rongyin was regretful that she had been so indifferent and aloof to him... Open her eyes, and Ye Rongyin finds herself reborn at the age of 20. This time, she will protect the one who truly loves her! However, Fu Jingsi clearly feels uncomfortable about her caring attitude. "She must be pretending it. But... it still satisfies me as long as she is by my side." "Fu Jingsi, stop being possessive! I'm not your toy!" "No, you are not my toy. You are my sweet little devil.

(Source: MangaToon)

This is a story of Cinderella who meets a bad-tempered prince.

We all want to live a wonderful life. and we may never ask for a life that is so gorgeous and charming, or a love that is so exciting. All we ask for is to exist in peace and security, and that is an indispensable part of a wonderful life. The momentary fragrance is just a blink of an eye, and so is love.

(Source: MangaToon)

Su Mu, the fourth son of the Su family, was disowned and driven out because of a failed investment. Through a coincidence, he wedded into the Chen family as a son-in-law, but he was looked down by everyone. His status was lower than the dog. However, a tiger must roar and a dragon must fly. One day, he will roar and fly up like the tiger and the dragon, and those who insulted him will kneel before him and beg for forgiveness…

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Fuhei Xie Wang Chong Ru Gu

description:
She was a top secret agent of the 21st century. Once she transmigrated, she actually became the ugly, stupid, and cowardly Fifth Princess of Eastern Yue. He was the regent of a foreign country who could manipulate any situation with a flip of his hand. He was extremely hand, cold, and cruel. When they first met, she was schemed against by her scumbag fiancé who drugged her with an aphrodisiac. Somehow, this led to her accidentally bumping into him, who was seriously injured and unable to move. Who knew that one thing would lead to another, and that a silly comedy would unfold? The mysterious woman must have been sent by the heavens to take him in.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The Queen of Hell travelled through time and space and took position of a human's body!
What?! I'm the weak Princess Royal? Not any more!
For those who bullied "me" before, go to hell! I mean... literally.
And for handsome who won't bow to me?! Alas, it won't happen! I am the Queen of Hell. I always get the man i want even if he is so dead!

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Enü Wei Pei: Lie Ai Kuangxiangqu
title.english: To Match a Villainess: Love Hunting Rhapsody

description:
In her past life, everyone knew her as the villainess of Nan City, but they didn’t know that she was just a reckless support-character. After she was set up, lost all her reputation, and died in the streets, she returned through reincarnation. In this lifetime, she decided to embrace the identity of the villainess that they believed her to be. She would not let the real villains get off scot-free!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.romaji: Renwu Shibai Jiu Yao Tan Lian'ai

description:
As a professional villain, Mei Yuan has to be an intimidating foe. But he also has to act like a mother figure, watching over the protagonist at all times, changing roles left and right, all to make sure the protagonist will barely win out. The final battle should've grand clash between good and evil. Instead, the protagonist confessed his love for the villain! Is he going to fail his mission at the 99% completion mark?! This villain is very confused, when did the protagonist fall for him?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Lil Yu saved a wolf-race teen named Zuoyi while strolling in the mountains one night, and accidentally unlocked a metal element ability that only belongs to alpha wolves. Her days of peace and bliss are short lived as dangerous incidents begin to flood into her life after this, even dragging in her close friends and family. Just how will Zuoyi and Lil Yu navigate these tough situations? Will a human be able to coexist with a wolf?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Consort and Her Celestial Vine

description:
A beautiful president spends five billion to acquire a mysterious ancient vine which unexpectedly sends her to another magical dimension! She finds herself weak and incapable of cultivating. Additionally, she's constantly bullied by her cousin! Nevertheless, with the ancient vine with her, she becomes capable of absorbing Heaven and Earth’s energy to tame magical beasts! ‘Hmm? I’m so powerful, which guy dares to…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Clara is a renowned romance witch. When the crown prince fell into a perpetual sleep, people speculated that she cast a spell on him because of jealousy. But she never even touched him! It was the crown prince who fell in love with her at first sight when she snuck into the palace, and insisted on marrying her! So one day, the crown prince led his troops into the forest: “Clara, I’m here to take you home.”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Lin and Zhan were best friends back at police academy, but after the fallout of a controversial case, they grew distant. Now Zhan is back, but only to threaten Lin away from one of 'his' investigations. What caused their relationship to grow so cold? Lin doesn't know, but he's determined to find out.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: The Widowed Empress Needs Her Romance

description:
Our Female Lead was forced to replace her sister's place and become concubine to an elder Emperor. However, on her first night at the palace, the Emperor drops dead from poison, right at her feet! The Emperor's son witnesses this and strikes a deal with her, asking her to claim that his father's last wish was to pass the throne to him, and he will allow her the seat of Empress Dowager! Shocked and confused, our MC enters this deal with the new Emperor, and must find her own way to survive the Palace!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

It's her against the world.

She's a martial arts world champion. He's a top celebrity. But when she's accidentally reincarnated as his fiancée, she becomes the most hated girl by his fans who's shrouded by a dark past! Even if the world is against her, Lin Fan vows to never give up.

(Source: Manta)

Wan Tang is a police officer who possesses magical eyes that can hear the sounds of birds and beasts. Strange cases in small cities are frequent. Black cats send fingers, while Orange cats send babies. The strange cat group seems to be in charge of the whole city's crime, and the black hand behind the scenes is hiding in the police station?

Will a super policewoman & sand sculpture detective, hand in hand, find out beasts in disguise and crack a murder mystery?

(Source: Inkr)

As Gao Chang was dying, he was full of guilt and regret for having abandoned his dog. After Gao Chang got the chance to relive his life, he decided that this time he would take care of his dog Rhubarb, only to then discover that Rhubarb was the descendant of celestial canines! What kind of perks come with being buddies with a divine dog? Cultivation, naturally. But Rhubarb says that his people's cultivation methods were not to be taught to outsiders, and if Gao Chang wanted to learn, then they would first have to get married.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

What happens if you find your enemy cute? Bai Lin, who is the Lord of the Underworld in a cultivation game, was destined to be killed by an evil sword master, until he awakened his free will and decided to fight back. To his surprise, he found that not only was his enemy not evil at all, but he was actually very... cute? But the Lord Of The Underworld won't be fooled by a pretty face! "I must severely punished you in this life, so I'll start by becoming your master!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Si Long, the empress of a matriarchal world, is reborn as the empress of a patriarchal world. While her only goal is to be a good monarch and rule the empire, all her ministers want is for her to get married and have children as soon as possible. Here, she encounters Tan Zhuo, the Imperial Preceptor, who benevolently provides her with all the support she needs. However, when Si Long decides to marry Tan Zhuo and make him her consort, he wants her to vow to only love him...

(Source: WebComics)

"In 2019, our city witnessed a serial murder case that claimed seven lives. You were the seventh victim."

In 2019, a major serial murder case occurred in Jielu City, resulting in seven deaths. Years later, Li Yunshan, a survivor of the case, remains haunted by the tragedy. His beloved girlfriend was the seventh victim. By chance, he obtains a phone capable of bridging past and future, and unexpectedly connects with Xu Sixian before her 2019 murder. To prevent the tragedy from repeating and save innocent lives, the two embark on a time-spanning pursuit to track down the killer.

(Source: Shanghai Literature, translated)

title.romaji: Nüdi? Wo Zhi He Niangzi Tan Lianai
title.native: 女帝？我只和娘子谈恋爱

description:
Gu Ning, a love novice and galgame loser, travels to a supposedly hardcore court intrigue game called "Above the Empress," becoming the perverted commander of the Jinwu Guard. She knows she must protect Empress Jiang Yuelin and conquer the lands to unify humanity. Despite possessing a system and knowledge beyond her time, she's still terrified because this wacky intrigue game actually has options, and whenever she chooses, she always picks the wrong one!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jin Dan Shi Hengxing Ni Guan Zhe Jiao Xiu Xian?
title.native: 金丹是恒星，你管这叫修仙？

description:
Others walk their pets, either spirit creatures or lapdogs, but I, Qi Yuan, walk a kitchen knife. Everyone in the sect thinks I'm insane, but unexpectedly, my eyes can see hidden messages in them. Having traveled to this world of cultivation, I've discovered that all foundation-building techniques transform practitioners into sustenance for a certain entity. So, to build my foundation, I created my own techniques and collected spiritual objects, solely to build the foundation for the Heavenly Dao!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

100 years ago, a dimensional doorway was opened for reasons unknown, and the world has been plagued with disasters ever since. A group of extraordinary individuals who have been dubbed the heroes are sworn to save the world.

(Source: WebComics)

A story about the growth of a cute fox, a cute manga of healing and growth, a girly series.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Despite loving music, Xiaochao avoids playing the piano because bad things happen whenever she does. One day, however, she gives into temptation and plays the piano at her school. Not only does her melody shatter a window, but it also attracts two boys, Michael and Tod... who happen to be an angel and a grim reaper! Xiaochao learns that they're both on a mission to restore the shattered genesis piano, a powerful treasure of the cosmos that keeps the world moving. What's more, her music has the power to awaken the genesis piano's keys that have scattered throughout the world and lie dormant in people. Both Michael and Tod want Xiaochao's help in restoring the piano, but Xiaochao isn't sure she wants the crazy responsibility of saving the cosmos. Will she decide to step up to the keyboard, even if it means attracting superhuman enemies in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)

She destroyed her evil adoptive sister's life and drove her out of the Song family. She stripped her evil stepmother of the key position in the family business. She told the scumbag, who was her boyfriend in her previous life, to get lost. She founded her own business empire at the age of 20, achieved billions of wealth, and lived her life to the fullest. However, Mr. Mu said, "Have you had enough fun? When are you going to make babies with me?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Chuanyue Egypt: Chengwei Wang De Xinniang
title.native: 穿越埃及：成为王的新娘

description:
Under Black Cat Yuya's plan, Nefertiti Erza transmigrates back to Ancient Egypt and finds herself living out the fate of a princess from Mitanni who is being married to faraway Thebes. Set on finding a way back to the future, she ends up catching the eye of Akhenaten, the future pharaoh of Egypt…

(Source: Webcomics)

"Miss Loser" transmigrated to a different realm and started her revenge with the young master of the demon clan. A story about a domineering female lead. Who will be the winner in this nip-and-tuck tug of war in love. A destined loser? A push-over? An ugly girl? She was an ace bounty hunter in my previous life, but she transmigrated into a weak girl’s body. Hell no! She fights villains, punishes scumbags and kicks the butt of her enemies. Boys are crazily attentive to her. The male is so angry that he even gives her a last warning: Hey, you’ve accepted the bride price from me. Try flirting with other boys if you dare!

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Mojun Daren, Furen You Baozou Le
title.native: 魔君大人，夫人又暴走了

description:
She, an infamous fool in the capital, a loser in everyone's eyes, is set up by her vicious elder sister and perishes. When she wakes up, a modern girl's soul is reincarnated in her body. From then, she is no longer the pushover but becomes "the avenger". Her vile-hearted sister and heartless fiancé… must kneel before her and beg for their lives!

(Source: Webcomics)

Kate is a detective who investigates monsters. He lives in a weird city - A robot's smile creeping in the darkness of a laboratory, a mysterious shadow appearing on the balcony, a black hole that tears open the space around the corner of a street...

Seeing more and more these weird phenomenons appearing, people were on the verge of madness, yet only detective Kate is enjoying the adventure. As he approaches the dark, the monster that lays within is creeping towards him...

(Source: INKR)

The silly zombie Lord who enjoyed peeling garlic fell in love with a dummy-sweet vampire who hates garlic the most. And their biggest habit is lying next to each other in a coffin? This sweet romance will brighten up your world!

(Source: Webnovel)

I was open with you when I didn't care about you. But when I fell in love with you I became guarded with my emotions.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

The Northern warlords were at war. Various foreign forces colluded with one another to set their eyes on the Chinese cultural treasure, resulting in the destruction of numerous cultural relics and heritage artifacts lost at sea. The last generation of the tomb masters in the Cao family, Cao Nanwu, stepped up and led Feng Shui slave Xia Kuxue, stele servant Wengzhong and tomb beast Ami to protect the national treasure. Fighting ruthless battles with mysterious organisations such as the Never Night Lights, the Hall of Longevity, and the Black Cicada Society...

What the hell?! Sese Yan was murdered thanks to her evil step-mother and her fiancé. But guess what? She wakes up in the past, with a second chance at life, revenge… and even love! She’s got a decade's worth of knowledge (beware, crime lords!) and a newfound fighting spirit. Sese even finds unexpected help from the handsome and rich Jinchen Fu. Can Sese and Jinchen stop history from repeating itself? Will she get upgraded to the good life or will death catch up to her once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 7 extra chapters.

title.english: I'm in Love with My Foe

description:
Jiang Mi's life never was one to envy. Overworked and stressed, she suddenly dies of a heart attack at work and transmigrates into her favorite novel! Unfortunately, she's inhabited the body of Olive Vias, the villainous daughter of the duke destined to die before the novel concludes. That is, unless Jian Mi can leverage her love for the novel to survive and finally live a life worth living!

(Source : Tapas)

title.romaji: Jiuming, Wo De Nan Piao Shi Yaoguai!
title.english: Save Me, My Boyfriend is a Devil!

description:
A car accident made Fang Yinyin into a cat. As well as being a full-time nurse for three kittens, she also has to deal with an overbearing president. "From today on, you're my cat, remember this in your head." "You damn stray cat, so ugly and yet you're still trying to entice me." "It's so troublesome being so dazzling all the time. Being my cat, you also feel tired, right?"

(Source: Webcomics)

After taking revenge on her abusive ex-boyfriend, she died and transmigrated into the heroine of the popular otome game "Rose Spiral". She found out that all the men in the game had bad intentions, and pursued the female lead only to use her for their own purposes. The cold heart of the reborn girl burned with hatred, and a plan for revenge slowly unfolded. Even as she schemed and seduced these men, will she ever learn to love and be loved again?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Sheng Chong Yi Fei Zhi Yao Guang Zhuan
title.english: Spoiled Medical Princess - Legend of Yaoguang

description:
“We shall fight till there's only one of us left standing!”

"Have you ever experienced the feeling of being pushed into the abyss by the love of your life? " Nangong Yue was from a famous and noble famous in her previous life. She was an excellent doctor. She helped him ascend to the throne but in turn, her family was slaughtered at his orders. The first-born daughter is back and she's coming back to get even! I thought I wouldn't let anyone in my heart again. But a man changed everything...

(Source: Comikey)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Youxi: Zhege Huangzi Buhao Yang
title.english: The Prince in Game Is Hard to Raise
title.native: 重生游戏：这个皇子不好养

description:
A girl found herself in the world of an otome game where she is Hill Augustine, a young noble girl. Her goal is to take care of Prince Xiulin who will become the future emperor of the game's world. However, she mustn't act out of character or else she will fail the game and her life will end!

(Source: IKNR)

From underdog to Sword Master!

Jiang Kelan surprises everyone when she's named Master of the Sword Pavilion. With neither the training nor the talent, Kelan faces the scorn of the spirit swords, jealous peers, and the constant criticism of her master. Will the pavilion's wild card be able to reveal her true powers?

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Shicao Lao Long Bei Guanyi E Long Zhi Ming - Chushan Rushi Pian
title.native: 食草老龙被冠以恶龙之名-出山入世篇

description: A 5000-year old vegan dragon was living peacefully when one day a young girl showed up in his cave. She offered herself as a sacrifice in order to gain favor for her village. He played along as the great "Evil Dragon, the Demon Lord's Army Leader" in order to get rid of her. However, his little white lie awoken her hidden powers and his peaceful life suddenly ended.

title.romaji: Wo Ba Nan Zhu He Fanpai Dou Yang Waile
title.native: 我把男主和反派都养歪了

description:
Fu Sang, a resentful character, time-travels into a Mary Sue novel. Bound to a system, her mission is to make the male protagonist and villain popular without them turning against each other because of the future heroine. However, Fu Sang is consumed by resentment and believes raising children only nurtures more resentment. Despite this, she embarks on a journey to raise the two kids, discovering it may not be as simple as she thought.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

My King, why was I being put to the sword? If everything could start over, would my knight protect me until the end once again? Even if I was born only to be punished by God, eventhough I knew that my fate was written in the stars, I still couldn't stop myself from falling deeply in love with the world, the sunlight, the desserts, the King, the dresses, and my beloved knight.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Chengle Hei Hua Fanpai De Bai Yueguang
title.native: 成了黑化反派的白月光

description:
By day, Xia Lin is a formidable PR queen, mastering the art of persuasion in the corporate world. By night, she's lost in "Water You with Love," a medieval romance novel. Captivated by Anthony, a prince doomed by a dark prophecy and a tragic fate, Xia dreams of saving him. Suddenly, reality merges with fantasy as she awakens within the novel, not as Xia but as Emilia, a minor character. Determined, Emilia embarks on a mission to alter Anthony's destiny, challenging fate itself.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: English versions are completed with 76 chapters.

Emilia was a botanist who had no interest whatsoever in romance. Her only focus was researching rare plants. One day, she headed out on an expedition to the snow-covered mountains and fell off a cliff. But when she woke up, she found herself in another world. She was no longer a scientist but a goddess sent from the heavens, destined to save a nation. And the emperor she'd just engaged to, Adrian, threatens her that she must never leave but fulfill her god-given duty. Determined to return to her lab, Emelia finds ways to escape her fate. But slowly, she finds herself drawn to her fiance. What will become of Emelia? Will she be able to return to her old life?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

I just wanted to sneak into the mortal realm for a vacation and maybe find my soul-mate along the way. But why do they have to make it so difficult QAQ...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: This Sweet Online Date is a Disaster!

description:
I was helping my sister win the heart of the game's top-ranked player, but it turned out to be a total disaster! I was even ridiculed by that gaming master!!! I guess no one can defy Murphy's Law! Just as the game was loading... Ding! Notice: Your husband is now online!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Jiuzhou Tiankong Cheng Zhi Fenghuang Zhen
title.english: Sky City: The Formation of Phoenix

description:
Human tribe made peace with wing tribe for the time being. A quick-witted girl looks so much like the princess of human tribe. So she was asked by the emperor to go to wing tribe to have a royal marriage as the substitute for the princess. Yet, she is hiding some secrets also. Bearing a grudge for her tribe and family, can she make a huge difference?

(Source: Mangatoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a Valentine's Day extra.

Transmigrated into a wuxia otome game, Li Zhenzhen instantly became Luxian Peak’s most popular disciple. Practicing the sword with the boys, chatting into the night with the girls, helping out and solving everyone’s problems… No matter what the NPC's personality may be, Li Zhenzhen always tried to get along with them in order to survive. But she never thought of what would happen if she raised everyone's affection rating to the max…!

(Source: Manman, translated)

For a thousand years, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth coalesced to form the Chaos Pearl. The Heavenly Emperor refined it into the Demon Stone and the Spirit Pearl.

Shen Gongbao stole the Spirit Pearl, just before it was going to be reincarnated in Nezha's body, and gave it to the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea. And that was how the Third Prince Aobing became the reincarnation of the Spirit Pearl. The curtains rise on the story of Aobing's life, and the war that is coming to the Dragon Tribe.

(Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes preview, prologue, and extra.

Ye Ziqiu, a webnovel writer, thinks she is forced into marriage because she looks like her sister. But Yan Mengjun, her husband, married her because she has something that belonged to his lover. He only sees her as his past lover, but will she be able to make him love her as herself?

(Source: INKR, edited)

Life can be so much harder than you imagine.
The fear of an unknown future can feel like falling into the abyss.
As Lin Rufan neared graduation, those feelings of frustration, guilt, and helplessness were threatening to consume her. But then a small miracle granted her the courage to face life head-on.

(Source: Dongman, translated)

Bubbly Ying Yin joins her dream university and unexpectedly meets her former first love, the now grumpy and aloof Yuchuan Ji. A comical mishap sparks a sham romance, bringing mayhem to his structured world and reawakening his heart. Amidst their laugh-out-loud misadventures and hidden secrets, will their pretend love transform into a genuine tale of passion and dreams? Get ready for a rollercoaster of sweetness, chaos, and romance in this captivating journey of rediscovery and affection.

(Source: Tapas)

No cultivation, no jobs, no apprentices, and no money. Those were the Four No's Chu Bai inherited from the master of the Siwu Sect. His only companion was Xiao Guo, an eight-month-old girl who's supposed to become his fiancee in an arranged marriage. In order to restore his sect (and make some money), he will set out an a hilarious demon-hunting adventure!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The twelve animals of the Chinese Zodiac represents the twelve months. But they also represent twelve guardians, the twelve heirs of the zodiac bloodline, each with its own special powers, who have watched over the East in secret. The Kirin is the mythical beast which ruled the East. When the one with kirin's blood is born into the world, he will rule over the twelve zodiacs, and they will devote their lives to defend the East.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Juese Nüyi: Taizi Ni Jiu Congle Wo
title.english: Ravishing Physician: Yield To Me, Your Royal Highness
title.native: 绝色女医：太子你就从了我

description:
Never mind if I became a peerless beauty, but I, a modern female doctor, actually traveled back in time and transmigrated into the body of a beggar that everyone scorns after getting into a car accident. Not long after, I’m brought to a brothel, where I accidentally found out that the brothel’s owner is actually the crown prince. The physician who saved me, on the other hand, is an ascetic person. A two-faced tsundere? A gentle and warm-hearted physician? Watch how I conquer them! Adapted from the original novel “The Medical Consort’s Realm."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Lihun Hou Qianfu Cheng Le Wo De Zhong Quan
title.english: My Loyal Husband After Our Divorce
title.native: 离婚后前夫成了我的忠犬

description:
A stroke of the pen on the divorce papers, and she was left with nothing. No money, no home, and too old to be attractive. But Xia Xinghe will fight back one day, by becoming a top-notch computer hacker, she will build a new fortune for herself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Hou Gong Dang Da Lao

description:
Once upon a time, in a kingdom far, far away, there was an emperor who had it all - a handsome face, the highest authority, and a harem with three thousand beauties. But there is one thing missing from his seemingly enviable life - an heir. This was when Yun Mian, a fertility fairy from the celestial court, came in handy. To get a promised promotion for herself in the celestial court, Yun Mian descended to the mortal world determined to help the emperor carry on the royal bloodline. But things became a little tough when the emperor claimed to be impotent...

(Source: WebComics)

Yu Sheng doesn't want friendship, romance, or any social interaction. All she wants is to write horror fiction. That is until her new neighbor, a sports major freshman from her school, begins to chase after her all day long and her life begins to change drastically!

(Source: Manta)

Love is divine.

Miso Lee lives an uneventful life. Then one day, a man drops down from the heavens before her and claims to be a god. He also insists that Miso has a ring… one he had given to his lover centuries ago. Is he telling the truth? And if he is, does that mean Miso is the reincarnation of his old lover?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Although originally a Korean work, the first publication in an eligible country of origin was the Chinese translation.

Yu Luna was an average employee who died suddenly due to working overtime too much. She was lucky enough to be given a chance to return to the real world⁠—but the prerequisite was to successfully capture all the male leads in a Western fantasy otome game! As long as she becomes the heroine, it doesn’t matter if she hadn’t played otome games before, right? But instead of being the heroine, she became a useless, wealthy noble lady that bullies the main character!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue chapter.

In the game World of Cultivation, disgruntled players gather, form an alliance sealed with blood, and vow to make the villain perish.
At once, all sides rally and excitement spreads like wildfire, as everyone sees a rosy tomorrow.
Except for Lu Bei. He is the so-called villain.
"Calling me a villain? Blaming me for screwing you over? Come on, I'm just an NPC. How on earth can I pull that off? That's how cultivation is!"

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

title.romaji: Gu Zong, Ni Laopo Tai Neng Da Le
title.english: Fight to Win My Prince Charming

description:
On the day Tang Chi won the MMA title bout, she was dumped by her younger boyfriend because his mother was afraid of her bullying him. Depressed, she passed out drunk at a KTV and woke up to find herself transmigrated into another body from two years earlier. Now she's the newlywed wife Gu Linzheng, the heir to the richest family in the city. But she was told that it was only a contract marriage and they'll be divorced after one year! One year to seduce the cold-hearted heir, or try to become a champion fighter again? She'll do both, of course!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Long Feng San Bao: Liye De Xinjian Qi
title.native: 龙凤三宝：厉爷的心尖妻

description:
After being framed and getting pregnant, she was kicked out of her own home by her evil stepmother and half-sister. Years later, she returns to take back what's rightfully hers. And she isn't alone. Her allies are her genius twin children, and a cute kid whose life she saved. What's more, the kid's father happens to be a handsome CEO who married her stepsister...

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Die Ni Jintian Dushu Le Ma

description:
When Zhou Qing transmigrated, not only did she lack any sort of superpower, even her father has been replaced by a useless wastrel from historical times! They're used to eating chicken, not having to work on a farm and raise pigs themselves. They're totally unqualified to be country folk! In order to become rich like those other isekai heroines, Zhou Qing will have to convince her father to study for the imperial exams! One moment it's a heartwarming father-daughter relationship, the next moment it's a big fight! Hey guys, if you want to court this lady, you'll have to help your future father-in-law to study!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

You Lu, who was about to start a new job at an animation studio, tore off the skirt of a man disguised as a woman at the comic con. When she showed up at the studio the next day, she found out that the cross-dresser she exposed was her new boss!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

The nine starry rivers in the sky are filled with billions of stars. The cultivators can commune with the constellations, awaken their spirits, and gain their power. According to legend, the most powerful cultivators can open a star gate with each level's breakthrough, until they ascend to the stars gain immorality at the ninth level. The young man Qin Wentian had to reform his body and start his cultivation from nothing. But he will rise to the heavens and become the brightest star in the sky!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ta You You You Shang Re Sou La

description:
After completing her mission to an alternate dimension, Xiang Yi thought she could retire and enjoy the rest of her life. However, she didn't expect that her body had been possessed by someone else while she was away! Now her reputation is in ruins, she's been relegated to the bottom rung of the celebrity ladder, and she's even been blacklisted for "sleeping with" with a famous actor? Even her family has broken ties with her! But the clever Xiang Yi is undaunted. She starts live-streaming her own variety show online, showing off her skills with a machete! And surprise! She'll hack her way back to the top of the Hot Topic list, again and again!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A genius bored with the modern world is reborn into a world where respect is only for the strong. He becomes the son of the strongest spiritual masters in the world. What kind of adventures await him?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

These strings shall sound the notes of a soul.

(Source: Arknights)

title.romaji: Yingdi Ta Ying Yao Dang Wo Jin Zhu
Wo Bu Ke Neng He Zhi Pian Ren Tan Lian Ai
title.native: 我不可能和纸片人谈恋爱

description:
When a BL comic artist transmigrated into the princess of Liao, she went right back to doing her old job... but then her main character came out of the book and told her to stop it with the gay stuff! Threatened with a sword at her neck, will she surrender or resist? What's worse, the plot seems like it's out of her control; who's the mysterious villain acting behind the scenes?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Nanzhu He Hougong Dou Shi Wo De Le
title.native: 男主和后宫都是我的了

description:
Li Xiu, an honor student, complained to the author of the manhua Solo Demon-Hunter that he ruined the supporting character with the same name. He received a reply from the author: "If you think I wrote the story badly, then you come and do it! You can be Li Xiu, Li Xiu will be you." Trying to frame the protagonist? Tortured to death, resurrected by demons, only to be cut down by the protagonist again? Someone as awesome and as cool as you shouldn't end up this way! This time, let Li Xiu rewrite Li Xiu's destiny!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xuyan Zuqu: Li Jian Yin Feng

description:
The silver edge is unsheathed and Karlan takes its first steps.

(Source: Arknights)

title.romaji: Li Hun Hou Ji Cheng Le Yi Wan Jia Chan
title.native: 离婚后继承了亿万家产

description:
In order to marry Fu Yechuan, Su Nan changed her name and gave up her inheritance, but she was treated like a gold-digger and bullied by her mother-in-law, neglected by her husband, and challenged by his other woman... Depressed and frustrated, she finally sought a divorce. Her father and brother took her home, and she regained her rightful inheritance to instantly become the richest woman in town. Soon she'll be stomping those conniving bitches and lying cheats under her feet!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Bing Jiao Fu Jun Ying Shang Gong
title.english: My Yandere Husband Is Forcing Himself on Me

description:
Si Kongji licked the corner of Ming Ruoxie’s lips with satisfaction and narrowed his eyes, "If I'd known earlier that my darling is also a yandere, then I wouldn’t have acted so innocently…"

(Source: Bilbili Comics)

title.romaji: Cong Chengwei Ni De Gonglüe Duixiang Kaishi
title.native: 从成为你的攻略对象开始

description:
An ordinary college student, Lin Chao, accidentally got trapped in a game world. The system told her that she could only return to the real world if she wins over the female protagonist with maximum affection level. Unfortunately, the system assigned her the role of a villainess who would be eliminated by the protagonist right at the start.

“I better think of a way to get in with the protagonist, fast…”

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Upon returning to his hometown, he realizes that many changes have occurred. The village is no longer what it used to be. A journey that takes him back to past memories.

Through this manhua, Zuo Ma tells the story of his childhood, experiences in the village and his dream of becoming a comic artist. In ten tales that are intertwined to form a complete story, this manhua is not only sweet but also cynical.

1. Walking Alone (独自散步)
2. Catboy (猫男)
3. Park People (公园里的人)
4. Niu Niu the Evil Hound (恶犬妞妞)
5. Iwana Bouzu
6. The Train (火车)
7. A Small Bamboo Gun (小竹枪)
8. The Beetle and the Girl (甲虫少女)
9. A Story of Fireworks (烟花的故事)
10. A Walk (散步)

title.romaji: Yao Ding Qianfu Bu Fang Song
title.english: Never Let Go of My Ex-Husband

description:
Shi Weiyi, the second elder daughter of the Shi family, abandoned her husband and stepson and ran away with another wicked man, but was in the end murdered by the wicked man and her half sister. When she came to her senses again, she found herself reincarnated and had a vague memory of being locked up by a silver-masked man. Who is this silver-mask? How was she murdered in her previous life? Why couldn't she like her stepson and who is his mother? In this life, she will figure these all out and seek her own vengeance.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Wo Chu Qian Ni Chu Ming, Wo Liang Yiqi Shenjingbing
title.native: 我出钱你出命，我俩一起神经病

description:
I, Luo Yinyou, am a three-year-old cutie-pie who has just descended from heaven. I've already lived two ridiculous lives (the second one barely even counts). In this third life, I've been hit with a vicious curse that won't let me live past the age of three. Luckily I have the help of a System, and I also have a “dad” who seems to be very powerful. Surely this will be the start of a happy (chaotic) life for me!

(Souce: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

After stealing a divine carrot from the Heavenly Emperor’s garden, rabbit spirit Ling Qi is punished with endless reincarnations across three thousand mini-worlds. His mission? To play the role of twisted cannon fodder, obsessive villain, or dark antagonist. And all for one mission, and one mission alone, to be the thorn in the relationship between the main protagonists. He swears never to resort to seduction— but often fails. After lifetimes of chaos and performances, one truth finally comes to light, was it all just part of the Heavenly Emperor’s grand plan from the start?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Xie Youzai Zha Fan Qianfu Jia

description:
After five years, Vivian Summer makes a triumphant return with her daughter. No longer the miserable girl blinded by love, she crushes both her ex-husband, who came begging for reconciliation, and his former flame when she came to provoke her. Yet even as her heart is filled with glee, she finds herself hounded by a magnate, and her own baby girl keeps calling the man daddy…

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Mozun Nüdi Chuanyue Cheng Wo Shangsi
title.english: The Demon Queen Is My Boss
title.native: 魔尊女帝穿越成我上司

description:
When my overbearing boss collapses in front of me, I’m left with a dilemma—save her, or let her be? If I help, it feels like an insult to my grueling 996 work schedule; but if I don’t, who’s going to approve my expense reports? With a sigh, Lu Youwei picks up his boss, only to discover that she’s woken up claiming to be the Demon Empress of the Dark Sect. Now, she insists on teaching him the ways of cultivation. Has she lost her mind, or is this the start of a very strange apprenticeship?

(Source: Webnovel)

The lure of monetary benefits makes Jessica Yan's adoptive family force her into an engagement with a rich young man. She is scheduled to meet her fiance at a hotel, but sheer coincidence leads her into the room where her fiance's uncle is staying. Her encounter with that renowned and powerful man is merely the beginning of a complex web of interactions…

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Gao Leng Zhihui Guan Zai Wo Huai Li Ku Jiji
title.english: Captain Levi is Cold As Ice
title.native: 高冷指挥官在我怀里哭唧唧

description:
The commander of the Federal Empire, Ying Yu, is a cold, domineering, and difficult man. This is the impression that Gu Weilan has always had of her boss. Until after an interstellar battle, as the ship's doctor Gu Weilan treated his wounds, and she encountered Ying Yu's vulnerable form... In his vulnerable form, Commander Ying shows the characteristics of an incubus, and his temperament changes drastically, becoming like a clingy puppy in desperate need of comfort and companionship. What's going on with this sudden change?! I can't stand it!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Boqing Zongcai De Zhuanshu Xiao Nai Bao
title.native: 薄情总裁的专属小奶包

description:
The genius hacker Gu Chu was reincarnated into the world of a tragic romance novel as a cute five-year old girl. Her mother is the doomed heroine who will suffer a bad ending. Her father is an arrogant corporate CEO who is oblivious to their troubles. They are surrounded by scheming relatives, like the two-faced auntie and many other conspirators. So it's up to Gu Chu to stand up for her mother. Nobody would suspect a five-year old child? She's just trying to protect her mother, while fighting for a billion-dollar inheritance.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When Ji Xuan broke up with her boyfriend, Song Zhaoli appeared like fate itself, perfectly timed, as if he’d been waiting. When they finally married, the world called her a social climber who had struck gold. But the truth? She loved her first. He engineered every "accidental" meeting. He cut through every rival, every obstacle, until she had no choice but to be his.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Cecelia de An Hun Xun Lü

description:
May the fireworks of home light your way back.

(Source: Official Site)

title.romaji: Qian Yi Zongcai Du Chong Tishen Jiaoqi
title.native: 千亿总裁独宠替身娇妻

description:
An ugly, inferior maid during the day and a real stunner at night. When Aisha's secret is out, the ill-wishers are genuinely surprised that Drew's intense feelings for her remain unchanged. A story about two people who get caught up in a tangled web of love.

(Source Webcomics)

Famed psychologist Zhao Yiming was unexpectedly pulled into a supernatural game world and forced to complete horrifying missions, but he has become a terrifying presence himself, one that makes all the ghosts and spirits tremble in fear! For Zhao Yiming, "I'm just a being careful, that's all."

For the ghost of domestic violence, "I was just going to the hospital for an appendectomy, but by the time I got out, an appendix was all I got left."

For the crying ghost, "I was suppose to be just a side quest, but he went and chopped off my head!"

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

Sometimes people ask me, what kind of man was my father? This is his story.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I am Karne Pivoine Feian, a poor and pitiful princess in hiding. Due to some unfortunate circumstances, I’m currently residing in the house of a Baroness under a hidden identity. I promised I’d do anything they asked me. But I didn’t think I’d be asked to do things that would put my life in danger! As expected, freeloading in someone else's house is no easy feat. I've got no choice. I have to find a way to reclaim my identity!

One day, a handsome man approached me to offer a deal.
"I’ll give you an unimaginably great reward if you bring me what I ask of you."

I think I've already found my reward, though! I've not only gained money, but an absolute hottie as well. Will I finally be able to walk down a path of happiness?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: Son, Put Your Father To The Test

description:
Qin Chuan transmigrated into a mysterious fantasy world. Not only did he gain a son, Qin Zi, for free, but also a cheatcode - a system that made him stronger every time his son caused trouble. After discovering that Qin Zi was a weakling with immense plot armor, Qin Chuan started on an endless journey to troll his son…

(Source: Webnovel)

Two boy-band members who can't stand each other are suddenly trending all over social media because of a fan-video! Younger puppy-dog boy X Older cool dude?! The shippers are going feral over this pairing! They've never gotten along ever since their debut, but they're now stuck with each other in a fan-pleasing fake relationship…

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Xu Qian found himself in a fantastical realm where he could form contracts with spirit beasts. With the title of "corrector," he awoke a special system and bonded with his initial spirit beast, one of space-time essence. Understanding the duties tied to being a "corrector," Xu Qian embarked on a mission to thwart interdimensional threats, utilizing the system to resolve conflicts and empower both the system itself and his growing array of spirit beasts.

(Source: INKR)

title.english: Indestructible Body Of Vajra Of The Village Leader

description:
As a player in a metaverse martial arts game, I was reborn as an NPC in the game. I not only retain the memory of my last life but also become a super negative NPC because I can actually kill creeps, level up, and acquire treasures like a player! In this life, I’ll strive to be the king of the village!

(Source: Webnovel)

Li Hao discovered that his family and friends around him died one after another according to the order mentioned in the lyrics of an old ballad, and that he would be the next one to die! As he delves deeper into his investigation, everything appears to be related to the ancient ruins of Constellation Door, where supernatural abilities were awakened decades ago...

(Source: Webnovel)

Ojun is a ten-year-old boy who found himself waking up 100 years later in an ancient tomb. He finds that the future is full of conflicts between clansmen and other chaos. An action-packed series following a young boy and his friends in a dangerous and chaotic world!

(Source: INKR)

Imperius Auld is a college student who's found himself on the wrong side of a deal, but he found himself inadvertently opening a shop for Heavenites to buy mortal possessions with the help of his immortal grandfather! He's gone from hiding from debt collectors to becoming a neo-immortal merchant that slides between both worlds!

(Source: Webnovel)

Qi Yu was an ordinary boy with "one rune" who both went to school and worked to support his little sister. His life was difficult, but he's still optimistic.

One day, he was attacked by monster and was saved by a mysterious girl. At the critical moment, the "rune" on Qi Yu's forehead turned into a vertical eye, resonating with the girl's "rune." He was able to ultilize her power, enhance it and defeat the monster.

After that battle, Qi Yu's life completely changed with his new mysterious power and companions.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Baojun De Fan Chuanyue Da Lianmeng

description:
The Heavenly Black Bird descended, giving rise to the Great Shang. Emperor Xin, the descendant of the Black Bird, ascended as the ruler of the Great Shang, shouldering its destiny. He mastered martial arts effortlessly and conquered the world swiftly. However, just as Emperor Xin conquered Xiqi, feeling accomplished and even a little bored, he suddenly found himself transported to the modern world—he had time-traveled! Discovering a startling fact, he realized he was a character from a novel in this world!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Re Sou Shua Ping! Ben Yu Tang Ping De Wo Yi Ye Hei Hong
title.native: 热搜刷屏！本欲躺平的我一夜黑红

description:
Tied to a Massive Popularity System, she will die if she doesn't become popular? Gu Xiangyi was planning to play the sycophant, riding the coattails of the big star to popularity. But what she got instead was a screenful of haters, who accused her of being a blood-sucking parasite. That was when the beautiful idol pulled in Gu Xiangyi by her waist, bit her playfully on the neck, and whispered in her ear.

“Don’t listen to their nonsense.”
“I'm the one who wants to suck your blood."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Yang Chengle Yige Bingruo Huangzi
title.native: 我养成了一个病弱皇子

description:
Ever since she was young, Su Xi led a good life without any worries. Not only did she have excellent grades, but she was the triple threat girl everyone liked. Ever since he was young, Lu Huan was exiled and led a life of hardships. He was barely surviving and suffered from humiliation before he became the emperor. One day, Su Xi played a game. She never thought the little boy in the game would actually be a prince from another dimension. Meanwhile, Lu Huan also didn’t know that his long, lonely journey would involve a female bodhisattva coming to guide him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Hei Xue, Bai Yue, Yongsheng Hua

description:
For what reason, do they continue to live? For what reason, do they continue to eat? They put on the most beautiful masks and commit the cruelest acts. White moon, Black snow, Withered maiden, Eternal blossom. Vicious X Evil, Tyrant X Unhinged, Maiden X Maiden, Hunter X Prey. This is a poem of self-reflection, or a stimulating speech for this numbing world...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Chengwei Wang Jue De Weixian Wanwu

description:
Once betrayed and tortured to death, she has now been reborn with a thirst for revenge. After being reborn, she's sacrificed as a blood slave. Then, she reaches up a handsome and powerful vampire and seeks vengeance against the murderer of her past life.

(Source: Webnovel)

Shooting an arrow to the sky and it flies all the way to the sun!? All the adventures start with Johnny's silly move.His arrow defies all the principles of physics and runs straight to the sun. But now, he has not realized his special ability…

(Source: Webnovel)

Xiao Che is thrust into a ruthless cultivation world with only a mysterious sign-in system to help him survive. Each new location unlocks powerful weapons and rare skills, but the enemies he faces are just as fierce. With dark forces closing in, he must use every advantage to dominate or be crushed.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Roubo Wudi De Buliang Shaonian Zai Youxi Zhong Que Xiang Dang Naima
title.native: 肉搏无敌的不良少年在游戏中却想当奶妈

description:
I just wanted to be a priest and heal others, so why did I become the strongest warrior instead?! I just wanted to enjoy playing the game, but why have I crossed over into the game world instead?! I created a priest character, but I'm now being forced to resolve my problems through brute force. Can't you just let me focus on being a healer?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The male antagonist is a Demon Sovereign with the power to destroy the heavens and the earth. If he conquers the final city, the entire continent will fall under his control. The heroine of this final city is just as formidable, having also reached the brink of godhood.

On this fateful day, their battle shook the heavens and the earth. But suddenly, countless thunderbolts descended from the sky. In an instant, the entire continent—and even the entire planet—was reduced to a post-apocalyptic wasteland.
