When the male lead awakens, he discovers that his cultivation has been halved, dropping him to the Foundation Establishment stage. Left with no choice, he embarks on a journey of scavenging in the ruins, slowly rebuilding his strength step by step.

title.romaji: Baitian Bei Taohun Wanshang Bei Nai Xiong Zhihui Guan Qiu Bao Bao
title.native: 白天被逃婚晚上被奶凶指挥官求抱抱

description:
In the Third District of the Federation, Su Wan is all set to marry into the prestigious Su family with pomp and ceremony, only to have the groom run off! With no groom in sight, Su Wan is left stranded, but fate has other plans. Wandering near a street corner, she encounters a man with rugged stubble, sharp eyebrows, and piercing eyes, staring at her intently. Su Wan makes a snap decision—she’s getting married anyway! But when she arrives at the ceremony, she’s shocked to discover that this man is actually the country’s top officer! Su Wan, panicked, decides to make a run for it.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Love in Balance: Sacrifice for Revenge

description:
Maeve, a top-tier beauty with a trove of hidden identities, was betrayed by her fiancé and best friend, losing her fortune, her reputation, and her life. Now, reborn as Claret, a spoiled socialite in Briarwood, she faces an even crueler twist: a forced marriage to a dying tyrant. Can she reclaim her past glory, or will this new life be her ruin?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: I Work Undercover in the Demon World

description:
Tang Chuan, a dissolute immortal, is required by the Immortal Emperor to work undercover in the Demon Realm. From then on, he's fitted in there like a fish to water. Surrounded by various gorgeous girls, he gets promoted again and again. Three years later, Tang Chuan says to the Immortal Emperor, "If you still don't close the net, I'll become the Demon King."

(Source: Webnovel)

Modern science has resurrected 16 of the greatest warriors in history to determine who is the strongest! Is it the martial-god Guan Yunchang, or Xiang Yu, the warrior-king of the Western Chu? The one-man-army Lv Fengxian, or Manchu's top champion Ao Bai? One-on-one battles to the death, until there is only one winner, who will receive one wish!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jushuo Wo Shi Fanpai Da Xiaojie

description:
I worked as a manhua artist, then died from pulling an all-nighter. I woke up as the villainess "Emi Morwen" from my webcomic! Emi was an alluring yet cruel character who departed from the story by ending her own life. However, I’m not the real Emi!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Top actor Lu Yi and rising star Gu Jiangyuan were known as rivals, until Lu Yi died in an accident. He wakes up 3 years later in the body of a shamed idol. Reborn, he discovers a shocking truth, Gu Jiangyuan has been in love with him all along. But things take a darker turn when ghost-hunting missions begin, and Gu Jiangyuan, cloaked in shadows and secrets, might be the one keeping him alive… or trying to end him for good.

(Source: Webnovel)

Yu Yang had never thought that there were evil babies in the world. His fate changed because of meeting Zhang Cheng. This person who took care of him in every way turned out to be his greatest enemy in this life. Should he kill him?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The high school delinquent Wu Haotian secretly followed his crush Yan Yu to a mysterious temple one day, only to accidentally awaken the power of a jade stone that imbued him with the soul of a mighty Three Kingdoms general. The battle for the 81 Nine-by-Nine Jades has begun.

Spells, Taoist magic, and big swords, other people use three magic weapons to catch monsters and demons, but I, Lu Ziye, raise a bunch of evil gods to catch monsters and demons. A mysterious research institute, imprisoned evil gods, studied evil spirits, Lu Ziye woke up from the mystery. Facing the hostility of evil spirits and endless strange events, in order to survive, Lu Ziye must become stronger. By chance, Lu Ziye met Xiao Huan, a zombie girl with a coffin, and Lu Ziye's road to becoming stronger quietly...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

As the heir of an incredibly wealthy family, Xiao Lin became destitute overnight. Since tragedy comes in threes, he is thrown into a string of misfortunes and is mistakenly killed by the end but manages to activate the contract system. Twelve extremely beautiful and talented women... each one an elite goddess of their field and possessing unparalleled beauty... Xiao Lin must form contracts with them in order to extend his life! Thus, he is forced to embark on the path of hunting for these goddesses!

(Source: Webnovel)

Lanai, a travel blogger with a taste for adventure, loves her RV trips. But her latest exploration of a Nordic castle takes a wild turn when she accidentally touches a wolf statue. Ouch! Those teeth are sharp enough to scratch! Next thing she knows, she’s in a whole new world, surrounded by dangerously handsome men. All Lanai wants is to find a way back home.

But when the full moon rises, things get hairy. Someone’s transforming, and it’s about to get wild! Awoooo~~~

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chong Sheng Feng Shen Youxi Zhi Zui Qiang Sanren
title.english: Reborn in the Investiture Game as the Strongest Freelancer
title.native: 重生封神游戏之最强散人

description:
To save his comatose father, Liu Nian ventures alone into the microcosm of the Investiture game, only to discover that he’s the reincarnation of King Zhou, Di Xin, beginning his journey accompanied by a stunning demoness. In this world, not only do players compete in the Investiture contest, but legendary figures like Nezha, Erlang Shen, and Grand Preceptor Wen showcase their powers! At the same time, real demons from Journey to the West infiltrate this realm. Facing relentless crises, Liu Nian vows to overturn fate and rise to the top in this epic battle of the gods!

(Source: Webnovel)

Ouyang Jianing, a fiercely rebellious girl, beat up her date on a matchmaking session. As punishment, her father sent her to work at a housekeeping company to learn humility. The housekeeping company, on the verge of bankruptcy, adopted the policy of "we'll do anything, as long as it's not illegal." And so Ouyang Jianing is forced to take on a series of crazy slapstick jobs, all for the sake of her personal growth…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wu Fa Tong Kuang de Lianai

description:
I finally see my childhood friend again after years of separation! However... He has become... No! This must be a bad dream!

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

title.romaji: Wo De Hougong Kao Chou Ka
title.english: From Zero to Hero: My Gacha Harem Saga

description:
A genius student transmigrates to another world and becomes a loser? Not for long! With the power of card draws, he embarks on a journey to reclaim his scholarly prowess and build an epic harem. Witness his incredible comeback now!

(Source: Webnovel)

Wen Xian went into the forbidden area by accident and was suspected of poaching. Wait, Mr. Lu, how can you strip a girl naked the first time you meet her?! Lu Xiao looked at the bold woman in front of him, thinking what else she could do after coming to his room at night, forcing a kiss on him, and seducing him. And there was a rich guy, Wen Xian's admirer, who somehow helped Wen Xian when she pursued Lu Xiao. However, during their fight for justice, the threat of evil loomed...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qing Yong Yuehui Zheng Jiu Shijie

description:
Since we don't know when, our world is being invaded by an alien power. It seeks to magnify and manipulate the dark desires that lurks in the souls of the people in this world, by taking over the bodies of eight beautiful and talented young women. The girls gained supernatural powers, even as their souls are being consumed by lust. By coincidence, all of them have set their sights on the bright and handsome boy Wu Se! Now Wu Se must protect himself and find a way to fight back while being "surrounded" by these powerful girls!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In a world of immortal cultivation fraught with peril, Su Jin strictly adheres to the principles of caution and steady progress, diligently avoiding disaster. His path changes dramatically when he gains the ability to traverse different worlds. "A realm where martial arts reigns supreme? My immortal techniques will overpower all and sweep aside any opposition. I will expand my harem and seize the world's essence transforming it into fuel for my own cultivation! I may be greedy, selfish, lustful, and sometimes murderous... but I am a benevolent immortal! My name is — Su Jin!

(Source: Webnovel)

In this multiverse, an infinite number of parallel worlds coexist. People and things are exactly the same in every world. But the same “person” has a different identity in each world. He can be one of the nouveau riches, a hobo, a national leader, or a wanted criminal… When one day you arrive in another parallel world, where another “you” are a tycoon, you can take his place and enjoy an extravagant lifestyle! No one will notice that because you have the identical fingerprints, iris patterns, and DNA....

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Nu Zhu Chongsheng Hou Meitian Du Zai Heihua
title.english: Come Back a Deliciously Evil Woman
title.native: 女主重生后每天都在黑化

description:
After being betrayed by her adoptive family, Alexa Herring is forced to be a plaything of many showbiz tycoons. When she is given a second chance at life, she vows to make her adoptive parents and their daughter pay, one by one.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Di Sha Qi Shi Er Bian

description:
The hero Li Changan was sent back to the ancient world by a magical yellow book. Every time he killed a demon, he gained a magical power. When he killed hundreds of demons and drew his sword to look around, he found that all this was just a small wave before the rolling tide.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Kaylen's Vengeance and The Fox's Redemption

description:
Kaylen came across a major setback in her life and headed back to the countryside to run away from all of this, one day she rescued a fox when she wandered around in the forest after she got drunk. But she didin't know that she will meet this "fox" again soon!

Kaylen's works were taken away by the powerful men, so she tried to take her revenge through her new novel. Just when her revenge was blocked, she met her strongest alliance, a little dumb and beautiful man with a strong and a smuggling body! Wait, why does he look so familiar?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

The powerful protagonist Shang Ye left his secluded hideout in the mountains to come to the big city, full of beautiful women, and started working as a bodyguard to investigate an secret affair from ten years ago.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Can the movie queen who was framed and disfigured succeed in revenge?! Forced to sign an indenture for a new face, what will be her fate?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Ruguo Wo Kandao Le Ni De Shijie
title.native: 如果我看到了你的世界

description:
When psychrometric Xia Chuntian meets Dr. Xie Linyi, a psychiatrist, she chances upon a historical artifact deal that is connected to him and a Qin Dynasty antique in which she sees herself.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bu Sishen Wang Xiu Xian Iu

description:
An alien meteorite fell to earth, declaring the beginning of the battle on the immortal divine scale. A sick and weak boy was possessed by the king of the divine scales, which reversed his destiny to become the Undead King. Ever since then, he has been playing dumb while slaughtering his enemies, and killing monsters while dating girls. That's how he began his journey to his throne!

(Source: Webnovel)

Yuan Shuai is taken to Pear Blossom Spring, an isolated kingdom of women, and he is made the Queen's manservant. Even though he is surrounded by beautiful women, Yuan Shuai hates his life at Pear Blossom Spring, and all he thinks about is how to escape this place…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Mou Tian Chuan Cheng Edu Huanghou
title.english: One Day I Became the Villainous Queen

description:
Game developer Chi Qian was betrayed by her boyfriend while working on a romance mobile game. Amid an argument, she was pushed onto the game server and suddenly found herself transmigrated into the game world as the main antagonist - Queen Catherine, the villain.

Now, Shen Chi Qian must navigate the challenges of seducing the king and avoiding detection by the princess. Desperate to escape the game, she purposely provokes the princess in hopes of meeting a swift demise. However, her plans are foiled by unexpected twists and turns.

(Source: Webnovel)

Sun Xian was born under the ominous sign of “Yinghuo,” the Calamity Star.

Her life was forever marked by tragedy— Her parents, manipulated by the mysterious power known as “Imperial Throne”, committed atrocities that led to the deaths of hundreds of thousands.

At just twelve years old, Sun Xian was branded a threat to humanity and imprisoned by a secret organization known as The Dark Zone.

There, she was subjected to horrific experiments— altering her body and mind, and awakening within her a terrifying power: “To slay rulers and destroy thrones.”

Five years later, she uncovers the truth: The Dark Zone doesn’t protect peace. It profits from chaos, and it framed her family to cover its crimes— even driving her parents to suicide.

Enraged, Sun Xian escapes. No longer the child who was caged, she becomes the executioner, bent on vengeance.

In a simulated age of war and collapse, the girl once called a harbinger of doom will become the blade that severs corruption.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Haiwang Cong Liang Hou Xian Ru Le Wudengfen Xiuluochang
title.native: 海王从良后陷入了五等分修罗场

description:
The promiscuous playboy is reborn back to the day before he died while "doing four guys in one day." Trying to survive this time, he leaves breakup letters for them and runs away instead. However, his exes all comes looking for him, trying to get him back. Looking for help, he sought shelter with the local "big-shot," but even that guy is starting to look at him with an increasingly smoldering eye, too?! Even a playboy is at a loss for what to do. How does he deal with all these boyfriends?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: This Divine Human Is Way Too Serious

description:
Having transmigrated into an ancient world of immortal cultivation, Wu Wang goes on a quest to find a cure for his curse against approaching women. Along the way, he will meet kings and emperors, spirits and youkai, until he finally reaches immortal nirvana.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Congbu Chushou De Wo Hun Chengle Tian Bang Dalao
title.english: Without Making a Move, I Became The No.1 Master
title.native: 从不出手的我混成了天榜大佬

description:
Pay attention, this man's name is A-wei! He thought he had transgressed into the body of the [Number One Villain] in the martial world, but he actually turned out to be a super weakling with a combat strength of [Zero]! A-wei, who fancied himself a wolf but was more like a husky, advanced by leveraging his extraordinary confidence to cut through challenges effortlessly. Concealing his identity, building his power base, reclaiming his former beautiful subordinates, and training his cute and clever apprentice... did he really become the [Number One] in the martial world?!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Meitain Du Xiang Rang Jiao Wangzi Shesi
title.native: 每天都想让病娇王子社死

description:
Big crisis for the face-chasing lover! Sunny local dog Jiang Jiaojiao (straight man) fell in love with Zhong Minyu (male) at first sight! An accident turned the originally unattainable cold-faced nobleman into a spoiled and fragile "Lin Daiyu", and used his beauty to win the other party's favor!! But as they got to know each other better, Jiang Jiaojiao gradually discovered Zhong Minyu's yandere nature, and the huge secrets hidden behind his family and two generations...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Rehuo Kuang Fei: Wangye Fangsi Chong

description:
“Do not worry, chop him on the road.”

Su Liu'an was tossed aside by a scumbag, whom she took with her to the grave. But instead of dying, she woke up to find that she had become another person and was forced to get married!

(Source: Comikey)

Li Jian, the adopted son of a mob boss, has been forcefully locked up in a cemetery by Min Zhao, the son of a deranged killer.

“Are you after some ransom money? Just call my wife, she’ll pay whatever you ask.”

“To the rest of the world, you’re already dead. I can do whatever I want with you.”

Li Jian raised his hands and struck Min Zhao. Wincing in pain, Min Zhao retaliated by slapping Li Jian across the face.

“Do you really hate me this much? I saved your life, and this is how you thank me?”

“Do you expect me to be grateful, you psycho?!” Li Jian fires back.

“No matter what, you’re not leaving me. You’re safer here.”

(Source : Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Dalao Xiashan: Kaiju Chengwei Nan Mi
title.english: BOSS SECRETARY: The Mountain Master's Office Game
title.native: 大佬下山：开局成为男秘

description:
When Meng Hao—Tianshui City’s most powerful tycoon—lay dying, a penniless stranger appeared out of nowhere. With miraculous medical skills, the young man pulled him back from the brink.But the real shock came after.Meng Xiner, his gorgeous, wealthy granddaughter, never expected her grandfather’s first decree upon waking: "Marry him."And if that wasn’t humiliating enough? The old man insisted the "country bumpkin" become her "personal" secretary—stick to him like glue. Now, this ice-cold heiress must tolerate her new "fiancé" shadowing her every move... while hiding the secret that he’s anything but ordinary.

(Source: Mangatoon)

The Lu family, a wealthy and powerful household, has become the laughingstock of town, after discovering their pampered and cherished daughter, they'd raised for over a decade, was an imposter! The new arrival, Huo Yao, swiftly packed her things to part ways with the real heiress - each returning to their rightful homes. However, when she saw the unlimited-amount black card her biological father handed her, not to mention those influential brothers, she remained silent. What happened to being impoverished and her brothers being the freeloaders they were described as? Even their neighbor who used to drive a junk car... The all-around Huo Yao chose not to speak.

(source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Choudi Zhizi Zongshi Liao Wo Zenmeban?
title.native: 仇敌之子总是撩我怎么办？

description:
Guided by the goddess of love, Alice and Ethan from opposing countries fell in love, but with it came hatred, curses, and conspiracies…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I Woke Up in the Wrong Story

description:
As a modern-day wage slave, Cuihua Wang thought the worst thing in life was overtime. Then she wakes up inside a web novel as Wanyin Yu, the infamous consort destined for a tragic end. Panic is a luxury she can’t afford, but as she braces for the tyrant’s famous temper, she notices something off. He isn't acting like a monster. He looks as out of place as she feels. Turns out, he’s hiding the same secret she is. To survive this nest of vipers, they form a fragile alliance. It should have stayed practical, but amid ruthless court politics, trust grows, and feelings soon follow. Then the truth surfaces: She wasn't sent here by accident. She came for one reason only—to save the tyrant.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Quanshu Fanpai Tingjian Wo Xinsheng Hou
title.native: 全书反派听见我心声后

description:
I’m Zhu Yuzhi. Five minutes ago, I transmigrated into a novel. The good news? I’m the daughter of a prince. Barring disasters, life should’ve been a breeze. The bad news? Disaster struck. I’m about to die tonight. The worse news? My mother and brothers are the story’s ultimate villains. But as Zhu Yuzhi roasts her way through this mess, she discovers something shocking—the villainous family is defying fate?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

Joshua, who was backstabbed in-game, transmigrated into a world filled with swords and magic after he died, and that world was based on the game he was currently playing. Based on his in-game experience as well as depending on an innate System, Joshua fought against a rebellion, took in female servants, acquired divine weapons, and became the Territory Lord of the Empire’s Northern Lands in one go. However, his actual challenge—which included the mysterious Dark Tide in the northern Black Forest, various bloodthirsty monsters, and the chaotic forces behind all this—had yet to begin. What would Joshua do?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: Married His Brother and Now He's Obsessed

description:
How lucky can one girl be? The cure to my illness is to marry a handsome duke, and I don’t even mind his half-demonic bloodline. I love his family, my family loves me, and once society gets to know the Blightons, I’m sure they’ll love them, too. Now, if I remember the novel's storyline correctly, all I have to do is stop his little brother from getting bullied and make sure he meets his one true love… and then we’ll all get our happily ever after, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Teenager Chen Xing forges a pact with Lily, the prophesied "Sovereign of Destiny" from the Crystal Beast Realm. This makes him the very first Awakener to contract a humanoid Crystal Beast, granting him a unique power: the ability to transform these beasts into gorgeous girls! Now, he sets out on an epic quest of combat and power-ups to claim the title of "Strongest Crystal Beast Master."

Jealous? For me, an army of beautiful beast girls is just the beginning!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Did a very important dragon (VID) just fall in love with me? Despite being nobility, Pearl was ostracized for being 'cursed' and was sold off to a neighboring liege. But she was kidnapped on her journey there, and by none other than Eric, the beautiful, yet callous sole heir of the Great Dragons. And the first thing he demanded was for Pearl to say she loved him…?

(Source: WebComics)

For a thousand years, they have walked the earth, undying: a Jiangshi, a Mummy, and a Vampire. Now, these three ancient immortals, each for their own reasons, desire the same thing: to become young again and experience one complete, ordinary human life. But such a wish comes with a price. They must raise a human baby girl together... and once she comes of age, they must...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Mowang Jiao Ni Zenme Zuo Ren

description:
The hapless salaryman named Gu Qianwang was chosen by the Demon Lord to become his human vessel in our world. He was intimidated by his newfound powers, but they also opened new opportunities for him. As he became the center of attention for the women at his company, he realizes that his workplace might not be as simple as it seemed. With the help of the Demon Lord and his women, Gu Qianwang tries to uncover the mystery hidden deep within his company.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Hart Bolton, the legendary first duke of House Bolton, has haunted his estate for over a century as a ghost. For the last five years, he's watched over Dolly Lopez, the head housemaid. When Hart wishes they could be together forever, fate grants his desire unexpectedly. After the current duke is poisoned at a ball, Hart awakens in his body. Now possessing the same face but a different soul, Hart must navigate this second chance at life while hiding his true identity from the woman he loves, who assumes his sudden interest is merely a passing whim.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Mori Gouhuo: Zhanglang Gei Wo Die Buff
title.english: Buffed by Bugs: The End of the World

description:
After an ordinary adventurer, Zion, was betrayed and eaten by a monster, his final regret was being "no better than a cockroach." The Cockroach God took his lament seriously! Now, Zion is reincarnated—as a tiny, six-legged roach in a world full of terrifying monsters and superpowers. Stripped of his strength, this former human must use his new, disgustingly resilient body to scratch, skitter, and survive against impossible odds. His action-packed quest for revenge starts small, but his rage is immense!

(Source: Webnovel)

Hong Zheng, a genius blessed to have the "Ancestral Blood" running in his body, was flamed by his childhood sweetheart and tortured by a friend to death. Ten years later, he resurrects with none of his talents left. Much to his surprise, he later on discovers that he is able to absorb the energy of a dragon skeleton after a spider-like monster enters his body. With the energy growing within him, he is ready to retaliate his old enemies and punish those who wronged him!

(Source: WebComics)

Lin Yuxi thought Zhou Yanjing loved her, but in the end, she realized it was just a self-deceptive joke. The one he truly loved had always been someone else. When their three-year marriage contract ended, she took off her wedding ring and chose not to linger. Everyone believed their divorce was inevitable. However, instead of hearing news of their separation, people were shocked to witness the aloof and untouchable Young Master Zhou kneeling before a woman, his voice hoarse as he pleaded: "Lin Yuxi, can you love me one more time?"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Princess Martina of the Moran Empire met her fitting end as everyone expected, losing everything from her throne to her precious daughter Lily, a sacred guardian beast key to the empire's power. Reborn with a second chance, this former villainess faces an impossible quest: collecting kisses from heroes across her realm to protect everything she holds dear. But these heroes have their own agenda, asking to become the father of her child. Between plotting revenge and navigating messy romance, this bloodthirsty princess will stop at nothing for her daughter and revenge.

(Source: Tappytoon)

When a young woman finds herself accidentally transported to a strange new world, she's shocked to meet a powerful, aloof man who claims she is his "sister-in-law." He demands she perform a ritual to revive his elder brother - an unusual request that binds their fates together. As they navigate this bizarre situation, the two must grapple with the twisted circumstances that have intertwined their lives. Can they find a way to break free of this otherworldly predicament?

(Source: WebComics)

The story happened at the dawn of the Tang dynasty. Nobody knew the peaceful and prosperous capital Chang An had a really experienced demon fox, Duan Mu Ming De for its biggest brothel's owner. The shounen onmyouji Bai Yu Mu, the best onmyouji among the younger generation of his onmyouji family, masterful at slaying demons and being vengeful, was forced to reside in this demon nest. There, he got acquainted with a seductive fox, a cold and distant wolf, a tsundere gold crow, a Virgo hedgehog and a two-faced weasel…at the same time, a larger conspiracy is brewing in the dark, in the capital that never sleeps, in which fires are lit every night. Meanwhile within the prosperous Chang An, the Rebellion of Anshi threatens to erupt..

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

The immortal cultivator Yi Genqing (the male protagonist) failed to ascend and mistakenly entered the interstellar world. He, the female protagonist Alex, and the captain of the guard Lei were swallowed by a huge and vague mysterious alien. The three woke up in a place similar to a prison and found that many strange people were imprisoned there. In order to escape, they teamed up with the perverted robot, the crazy and thrill-seeking Irlin with telekinetic ability, and the autistic but defensive Tolby. In the contradictions and conflicts, they began to be unreliable.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Yi Shijie Dang NPC

description:
Hundreds of years ago, Emperor Molong led his demonic horde to crush every hero of this fantasy continent. In desperation, the Ximei Elf Clan activated the Noah Project, sealing away the greatest heroes and vital resources within the colossal Noah Tree.

Gu Bingjie, a delivery rider from modern Earth rushing to earn money for his mother’s medical treatment, dies in a traffic accident—and awakens in this very world. Discovering the Noah Tree, he ingeniously transforms the entire realm into a game-like system, enabling consciousnesses from Earth to be transmitted into the bodies of the sealed heroes.

Taking on the role of an NPC, Gu Bingjie issues quests and guides these “players” to build powerful city-states and forge a mighty empire—ultimately preparing them to stand against and eradicate the demonic forces once and for all.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia She Chong You Zai Yan Wo

description:
Feng Wuyou is raising a snake. It is that those of the Snake Tribe are cunning and sinister, and the lowest of the low amongst all the spiritual races. They truly aren't fit to be kept as pets! Feng Wuyou stroked her pet snake, and while smiling, she said, "Little snake has no fur! Little snake is the cutest!" Chu Feichi took her words to heart. During the day, he maintains his original form and tries to win her over. At night, he takes his human form, waiting for an opportunity to seek revenge. After repeatedly failing to get his revenge... Chu Feichi just can't do it anymore! Who on earth said that Feng Wuyou was innocent and cute instead of scheming?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In order to rebel, Jiu Jin sneaked into the marriage team from the Western Regions to the Central Plains, and her identity was exposed on the first day. But what is gratifying is that the marriage princess seems to be a fake? For their own purposes, the two relied on each other while being hunted by multiple forces. In close contact, they gradually developed a love for each other.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xiuzhen Cong Zhong Chu Yao Zu Nüdi Kaishi
title.native: 修真从种出妖族女帝开始

description:
Tian Yuan loved growing flowers, so transmigrating to a cultivation world to raise Spirit Plants should have been a natural fit for him, but after he unexpectedly awakened a Gardener System, things got weird… How did this seed end up growing into a Flower Demon Empress?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Ning Bei suffers a family tragedy when he is a little boy. To survive, he flees to the North alone. For thirteen years, he has honed his skills and become an invincible war god, protecting his country with a saber. One day, Ning Bei returns to Loong City, a place of love and hatred. He then embarks on a path of revenge.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Tian Jiang Meng Bao: Huo Ye Qing Qianshou
title.english: Sign for Your Ten Babies, Mister!

description:
She had swallowed her pride for love throughout her marriage, only to be met with his divorce papers in the end. Did he really think he could walk away without paying any price? She's dead set on becoming the one woman he'll never forget-if she can't keep him, she'll keep his child-and that's final!

(Source: Webcomics)

After an accident, Russel Reeve finds himself in a mysterious dimensional space where he's given the chance to choose one “Talent” from a selection of five to survive Mustard City. Expecting a weak ability and an easy mission, he picks what appears to be the weakest option. His task? Finish reading a specific novel.
However, things take a turn when he realizes the novel is incomplete, and worse, it’s based on real murders committed by an uncaught serial killer in Mustard City. Desperate to return to his real life, Russel tracks down the novel’s author, only to learn that the story can’t continue unless the real killer is caught. Now, to complete his mission and survive, Russel must dive into a dangerous game of cat and mouse, where fiction and reality blur, and the final chapter is yet to be written…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Dizi Chao Shen Wo Tangping, Zong Men Huimie Wo Wudi
title.native: 弟子超神我躺平，宗门毁灭我无敌

description:
What kind of trash system is this?! If I destroy my own sect, I become invincible—but if I try to strengthen it, the system wipes me out!
And right at this moment, the Sect Master insists I take on a disciple?
Hmph… Fine, I’ll accept a disciple—but who says I have to *teach* them properly? If my disciple ends up wrecking the sect for me, that still counts!
Solving inequalities has never been this fast! Beautiful female disciples, come to me at once!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"He wished for beauty… and fate delivered chaos."

"Continue being the warrior king."

"No."

"I comes with a raise and a promotion."

"No."

"Then what do you want?"

"A pretty girl."

It never occurs to Nanfeng Lu that while his dream may come true, well, the beauty…

(Source: Comikey)

title.romaji: Ba Nüdi Quan Beipan, Chongsheng Hui Dao Changduan
title.native: 八女帝全背叛，重生悔到肠断

description:
Lu Ye—once hailed across the realms as the Nine-Lives Celestial Venerable. Yet on the very day he ascended… the eight Empresses he had raised, protected, and trusted turned on him. Nine Heavens Sword Maiden: “Because of you, the world sneers at me as nothing but a Sword Slave!” Fairy Hong Ling: “If not for you, I would’ve become his divine companion long ago! You deserve to die!” Vermilion Bird Demon Empress: “You warned me they’d hurt me… but the only one who truly wounded me was you!” But fate rewinds, granting Lu Ye a second life. And this time, he refuses to walk the same doomed path. He won’t sacrifice everything for them again. Let the eight of them fend for themselves.

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

title.romaji: Toutai Hou Wo Bei Chouren Ke Cheng Wudi
title.native: 投胎后我被仇人氪成无敌

description:
In this cruel world, I was just trying to survive with my sisters. But the rich and powerful treated us like worthless ants. Upon my death, I awakened the power of Reincarnation. Now I'll be reborn into my enemy's family, let them spend their money to raise me, and then destroy them from the inside!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Stunning and pure, she is like the camellia at night. Insensitive to romance, she fell for her bodyguard after many turns and twists. He was the boy who she considered her enemy 12 years ago. What's worse, he was her senior whom she once flirted with…

(Source: INKR)

I was forcibly kissed by a handsome guy, twice! But it wasn't cool. Who do you think you are? Am I a girl you can kiss at will? Huh? You said you want to marry me? No way! I ran away from my home exactly because I don't want to get married! But here's a handsome guy says he must marry me? Why are all these guys all into me...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Quanmin Zhuanzhi: Wuzhi de Wo Zhong Jie Le Shenming!
title.english: The Jobless Guy Who Has Come to Slay
title.native: 全民转职：无职的我终结了神明！

description:
Facing a calamity that left chaos and destruction in its wake, mankind's survival was hanging in the balance. The only solution? Get a job and get good! Some became mages, other summoners. However, Cloud, a promising student with a great future ahead of him refused to get a job! Being jobless is his true calling!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Shou Tu Yiwan Fanhuan: Wei Shi Wudi Shijian
title.native: 收徒亿万返还：为师无敌世间

description:
Bai Yu wakes up to find that he has transmigrated and become the head of the Baiyu Sect. He soon discovers that any items he gifts to his disciple will be returned to him by the system in a hundredfold, thousandfold, and even more. With the help of this system, Bai Yu gradually earns the respect of those who once looked down on him.

(Source: Webnovel)

As an impaired Omega, Yin Ran had assumed he’d live out his remaining years in peace. Unfortunately, he was suddenly kidnapped one day... and the abductors turned out to be his underclassmen from high school! Beside being shocked, his dormant scent gland — which was damaged and numbed for years — was stimulated under the double-dose of pheromones, reawakening his long-slumbering heat cycle…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The Pretty Houseboy in the Attic

description:
Liu Yijun, a celebrity manager working for MCN Entertainment, was blackmailed by Xia Yang, a university student injured in a traffic accident. Since then, Xia Yang moved to her place. Never did she expect this good-looking, honey-mouthed boy to be an excellent cook of Sichuan cuisine. Hence, she decided to make him a live streamer specializing in Sichuan cuisine. Without realizing it, she was falling deeper and deeper into the boy's love trap.

(Source: Coolmic)

A young man named Xia Tian suddenly acquired X-ray vision, and from then on, he made his great comeback. He studied under a martial arts master and made friends with antiques appraisers... He kept getting stronger and became a versatile martial arts ace step by step!

(Source: Webnovel)

At the end of Yinguo Alley was the Triduum Pawnshop. Just like its name, there was a three-day deadline for the antiques to be reclaimed. The young girl Dong Xiaoxia who looked after the shop alone had powerful empathetic abilities. Not only could she see the "Spirit" formed from the spirit fragments in the antiques, but she could also hear their stories and their obsession. She could even accept their requests. And once she completed the antiques' wishes one by one, the Ivy Lock on Xiaoxia's chest would also glow softly. What kind of past was sealed behind the golden lock once all the ivies had receded…

(Source: Coolmic)

Reality and game worlds merge as "Apocalypse" engulfs the Earth. Zhang Yi, an avid gamer, experiences betrayal leading to his demise after 8 years in-game. Karma favors him with a second chance, allowing him to regress but now equipped with knowledge and experience from his past life. Armed and ready, he seeks vengeance, leveraging his insights for an upper hand. Yet, as revenge nears, he stumbles upon a conspiracy far greater than he anticipated, hinting at battles beyond personal vendettas.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Wo Cai Bu Zuo Fan Pai De Bai Yue Guang!
title.english: I Won't Be the Villain's Only Lover
title.native: 我才不做反派的白月光！

description:
Belle’s been reborn into a romance novel. Not as the heroine or the villainess, no, Belle has simply transmigrated into a pretty background character… at the exact moment the villain is about to kill her! Is her romantic new life over before it’s even begun?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Fanpai Tu Er Ni Jiu Fangguo Shi Zun Ba
title.native: 反派徒儿你就放过师尊吧

description:
With striking beauty and terrifying power, are my five top Disciples actually an infamous harem of Demon Goddesses? And, when they find out that I’ve accidentally killed their true Master and been forced to assume his role, will their wrath be turned against me?

(Source: WebComics)

Shi Yuner, used to be a rich young lady, was forced by the creditor to take nude photos to mortgage the 260 million debts she could not repay after her father went bankrupt and went missing. In a moment of crisis, the heir of the richest family, Li Shuo appeared to save Shi Yunson. She thought she can escape from the abyss, but she didn't know that there was another vortex...

(Source: WebComics)

He, like a bright shooting star, descend to this world, but will eventually perish. He comes to me to fulfill my wish, but I just want to seize his bright light and keep it for a longer time. I don't have any wish. I just want you.

title.romaji: Bei Beipan De Wo Pianyao Xiang Diguo Fuchou
title.native: 被背叛的我偏要向帝国复仇

description:
Klein, who fell from the throne of the King of Knights, was betrayed by his comrades and sentenced to be burned at the stake. In his final moments, Klein scoffs at the foolishness of this world and his past self. Now, having returned from hell, Klein has gained unparalleled power. He will make those who betrayed him pay the price...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Yige Ren Kan Fan Luanshi

description:
How to survive in a chaotic world overrun by zombies? Let’s learn from Lin Fan: obey the law, work to earn money, strive to buy a car and house, and be an outstanding citizen who single-handedly flips the chaotic world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wujia Bianzhi Bai Wan Shen Hao Guilai
title.native: 物价贬值百万神豪归来

description:
Yifan activates a system by chance with a pop-up telling him that everyone in this world will lose 1,000,000% in purchasing power except for him. The following day, the market crashes. Luxury cars only cost 1 yaro each and mansions 5 yaros each. With hundreds of thousands in his account, Yifan suddenly becomes a rich man with enough money to buy everything on Earth!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Chuyu Hou, Zhen Qianjin Sha Feng Quan Haomen
title.english: After Prison: The Real Heiress Claps Back
title.native: 出狱后，真千金杀疯全豪门

description:
Orphaned and alone, she thought she'd hit the jackpot when a wealthy family claimed her as their long-lost daughter. Instead, she walked into a nightmare. Her parents ignored her, her brother tormented her, and when push came to shove, they threw her in prison to save their beloved adopted daughter. Big mistake. She's back with deadly new skills and zero patience for their games. Her so-called family is about to learn what happens when they mess with the wrong girl.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Man Ji Lucha Chuan Cheng Xiao Kelian
title.english: High-Level Manipulator Transmigrates into a Poor Defenseless Girl

description:
"SHE’S A DEMON!"

Lin Feilu was a "green tea girl"—bright and lovely on the surface, but bitter and calculating, outing f-boys for sport. Then, she awoke as a cute little princess of the Lin Dynasty! Feilu is the emperor’s fifth daughter, born to Lady Lan of the imperial harem. She, her beloved mother, and her twin brother are bullied nearly to death by the emperor’s other wives and children because her brother is different. But Feilu will protect her family since she’s a cunning mastermind!

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Bu Ganxin Bei Choudi Xiao Shu Xunfu
title.native: 不甘心被仇敌小叔驯服

description:
Since childhood, Ling Luxiao had been raised under the abusive care of his father's killer, his uncle-in-law, Ling Ye. Every scar etched into his body were a reminder of his resolve for revenge. As an adult, he finally launches his retaliation against his uncle... only for his uncle to effortlessly handle him. Ling Luxiao, wanting to use the opportunity to humiliate his uncle, gradually discovers his own submissive nature through his uncle's repeated punishments. He eventually becomes his uncle's loyal lapdog. Between the hatred for his father's murderer and the family ties they share, Luxiao is left lost and confused. And just as he decides to give up on everything, he discovers that things weren't as simple as he initially thought...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

What to do when starting a post-apocalyptic game with only one shelter? No big deal, I can persuade players to work for me -- I am Chu Guang, the lead game planner and customer service for Wasteland ONLINE. Since I've traveled into a post-apocalyptic wasteland in the future and unexpectedly activated a high-tech shelter, why not recruit players as my companions, leveling up together and expanding our territory? Witness how I establish the strongest city-state in a world infested with mutant creatures!

(Source: Webnovel)

Ten years after a brutal alien invasion, humans have evolved mutant abilities to survive. While the world fights on the frontlines, Kaihas chooses a path of shame. Labeled a coward for refusing to serve, he stays in the shadows to cultivate a secret power. Drawing on memories from a past life, he masters five primary talent trees rooted in his soul. As the war reaches a breaking point, Kaihas quietly upgrades his skills to face the nightmarish alien monsters. Will the boy they once ridiculed become the savior they never expected?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Beipo Chengwei Kaigua de Wudi Shengnü
title.english: Forced to Be an Invincible Saintess
title.native: 被迫成为开挂的无敌圣女

description: The true identity of the saint that is worshipped by all the people in the kingdom is actually an average boy? With the beautiful priest, the big breasted knight, and the loli doctor at the side, the road of a saintess is really difficult...

title.romaji: Tianyuan Guilai: Wo Ji Shi Tian Zai
title.english: Abyssal Return: I Am the Calamity

description:
The Xian Emperor's family was wiped out overnight, and the young master Li Chen was thrown into the most mysterious and dangerous Abyss! Eight years later, he emerges from the Abyss, with a Female Emperor in his left hand and divine demons in his right. Wherever he goes, destruction follows; wherever he treads, fear spreads. He is the world's apocalyptic disaster!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

In the late Northern Song Dynasty, the Jurchen people rose to power in the north and established the Jin Dynasty. Subsequently, the Song and Jin Dynasties joined forces to destroy the Liao Dynasty, reclaiming part of the territory of the Sixteen Prefectures of Yan Yun. Yet while the Song court and people reveled in the joy of reclaiming their ancestral lands, the Jins were already eyeing the Song with predatory intent. Taoist priest Jiang Feixiong, following his master's orders, descended from Mount Kunlun to the capital. Emperor Huizong commanded him to head the “Bureau of Deified Spirits,” bestowing upon him the title “Golden Gate Immortal.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: I Sell Phones in the Three Realms

description:
The connection between humans and gods had long been destroyed, until smartphone salesman Li Xinghe accidentally came across an app called "Heaven's Secrets." From then on, he starts happily selling his phones to the gods. Luckily for him, the gods are friendly and are fascinated with smartphones from the mortal realm!

(Source: Coolmic)

Terminal illness patient Lu Cha accidentally obtains a mysterious account and transmigrates to a different world called "Extremely Evil Game" to forcibly extend his life. Upon arrival, he becomes the top of the Extremely Evil List and is publicly wanted. In order to escape capture, he randomly jumps into a dungeon only to discover that. as a newbie, he is immediately facing the most dangerous "Ferocious" level trial a high-stakes tug-of-war with an extremely evil monster girl group... Since I'm already here, why not play it big! Isn't this the joy of being alive?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Ouxiang You Dian Bu Dui Jing

description:
Fang Minzhu is a small-time show-biz agent. She is introduced to the popular idol, Liang Youxi, to be a gopher for her. But Liang Youxi specifically asked to have a man for the position. Minzhu, desperate for work, gritted her teeth and applies as a man to win the job, but Liang Youxi still treats her warily. "I wanted a man so I can keep you out of my private life." It's such a strange thing for a star actress to say. By accident, Minzhu found out Liang Youxi's secret — it turns out Liang Youxi is actually…

(Source: Bilibili, translated))

Can people rise from the death? Yang Ni ran into robbers on his way to the hospital and was killed with hatred, then he woke up to find himself in the underworld. Knowing he had a chance to be reborn in real life, Yang began his thrilling adventures with friends.

(Source: Webcomics)

Wu Ruo only saw their true colors just before he died. The family and friends he valued had been taking advantage of him, while his neglected husband was the only one who tried to save him at the last moment. God's mercy gave him a second chance at life, but he was reborn into his most wastrel, despicable, and overweight state. At that time, he was unable to cultivate, and even though he was a man, he was forced to get married to another man by his family... In his second life, he realized that the man he married actually treated him pretty well. This time, he wants to take revenge on those who wronged him, and repay the kindness of those who were good to him.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Lian Qi 3000 Ceng: Kaiju Shou Nüdi Wei Tu
title.native: 炼气3000层：开局收女帝为徒

description:
Ye Kong traveled through another world, and he could break through a realm every day he fished. In the past ten years, he has broken through to more than 3,000 levels of Qi training. He thought his life would be dull, roasting white tigers and catching phoenixes, but one day, the empress was reborn and came to worship him as her master. Ye Kong: Hey, disciple, can you please stop worrying about me? Empress: No way, no way, my master is practicing Qi, he is just pretending, he can never be a peerless master!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The young master Tan Shao has never been in love in his twenty years, until he fell in love at first sight. To pursue to his love interest, Tan Shao tried to get to know the cold Pei Anwu, not realizing that Pei is the "girl" that he fell in love with. As they spend more time together, their relationship began to change…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 14 extras.

title.romaji: Bai Yueguang Ta Dui Wo Xiashoule

description:
Valentina Jiang had a long-standing crush on Levi Bo. One day, she woke up in a hotel room and found him sleeping right next to her. And just like that, she became Levi’s fiancee. No one in her family had a reason to tear her down now. Thistlewood’s elites respected and fawned all over her as Levi showered her with all the love and attention in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 公爵小姐和逃犯闪婚了

description:
The blind Duchess regained her sight—only to witness her fiancé cheating on her that very day. Determined to take revenge on the scumbag and reclaim her family title, she made a bold move at the wedding—swapping grooms and marrying the infamous, devilishly handsome fugitive instead! Thus begins the tale of a Duchess and a wanted man, where marriage comes first and love follows later.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In order to protect his crush, [Cake] Zhuang Cheng, [Fork] Qinghe, who usually lurks around in the dark, follows him one night. Unexpectedly, he discovered his true face—

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Shouxi Meng Bao Mai Yi Song Yi

description:
Framed by her own sister, Serena found herself in a one-night stand with a total stranger...and she got pregnant! After a terrifying, near-fatal delivery, she watched helplessly as they took her baby away. Years later, she returns home, a gorgeous little girl holding her hand. Suddenly, a handsome man grabs her arm and snarls, "How could you steal my child?" The little girl shoves him away, sticking out her bottom lip. "You can't touch my Mommy! Not unless you agree to be my Daddy!"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Lao Zuzong Ta You Mei You Sa

description:
Bai Chuwei had to wait 5,000 years before catching up to the plot of the book she transmigrated into. When she left her mountain hideout, she found that she's already become the most revered ancestor of them all. Money? She's the richest person in the world. The Eight Great Families? Nothing more than servants for her. While everyone else was kowtowing trying to flatter her, the fourth-son of Haicheng City's Duan clan swept her into his arms. Who knew! She was just trying to borrow a little life force from the little boy she watched growing up. She didn't know that she'd lose her heart in exchange…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ni Xi Gui Lai: Wo De Feichai Laopo
title.native: 逆袭归来：我的废柴老婆

description:
Being punished and humiliated by her family, Zhang Yu feels despair thinking about the rest of her life. One day, she saves Gu Dongyang’s son, and the little boy starts to get attached to her, even wanting her to become his mother?! How will a cute little boy and his domineering CEO daddy save our "Cinderella" from her strict grandmother and evil sister?

(Source: WebComics)

Johnny works for a food magazine "Heartbeat! Cuisine" as a reporter and that's the reason why he meets his Mr. Heartbeat Zac who is a famous baker in neighborhood nearby. So we draw "Endless" to depict to show that how great and sweet the couple is, just like cakes Zac makes.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo You Wu Ge Dalao Baba

description:
Ji Anruan lived in a monastery until she was five, when the nun who raised her took her from the monastery to meet her five dads. With her cuteness, she made a good impression on the first dad they met, Mu Shen. He thought he didn't like kids and he would never have kids of his own. But as Mu Shen spent more time with Ruan-Ruan, he found himself being won over by her and becoming the stereotypical doting father. But that was when Mu Shen found out that he's not the only one who would be Ruan-Ruan's guardian...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Xu Sheng x Tang Zhi Using all of one's brain power and pawning away one's life.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Zhi You Liang Qian Wu Bai Sui

description:
Su Ye lived for 2,500 years, finally arriving to the modern day when he was 22 years old and transmigrated back to the ancient past. With his previous self gone, he took over his original identity as an ordinary college student. And now he could relive his life in the best way possible. He was learned in all the arts, and expert in all the skills. “I just want to live well for this one hundred years. Don’t you dare with mess with me, or else!”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Rang Chu Tianfu Hou, Wo Chengle Mofa Jie Tuan Chong
title.native: 让出天赋后，我成了魔法界团宠

description:
Quinna, a genius girl, had her talent taken by her family, but was given another chance because of the system she awakened. Give away her precious talent to get 100,000 times the return?

The eldest daughter of the Campbell family is reborn as a great gold talent! She didn't expect to get a talent that would let her stand next to the Divine Son of the Empire!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

As a photographer, he never thought that he would be betrayed by a model one day! And the other party is actually his boss?! Gao Wenrui protected his chest with both hands: "Boss, don't do it!!"

Long-haired green tea beauty boss x social animal straight male photographer subordinate

996 is a blessing today, too.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: "996" refers to a Chinese practice of working from 9am to 9pm, 6 days a week. Jack Ma, China's richest man, commented that the culture of 996 is a "blessing", although there was swift backlash against this view from the public and the government.

title.romaji: Quan Yuzhou Du Xiang He Wo Tie Tie

description:
Jiang Zhao traveled through the interstellar era. However, in this era, all the beastmen were born through genetic modification and became beastmen with powerful combat capabilities. However, the defects of genetic modification caused the beastmen to be threatened by mental riots from birth, and finally became completely controlled by the beast. However, as the only pure ancient human in the universe, Jiang Zhao could find peace and comfort in his spirit as long as he was close to him. Jiang Zhao said: Isn't it just petting furry beasts?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Jia Ke, an ordinary university student, is raising a very strange cat, but kitty is super cute.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

When Lu Chen entered the world of the quantum-neural VR game "Empyrean God Realm" — he found himself stripped of his human character, instead he became the weakest monster in the game, a "Gnoll Weakling." Faced with player characters who are ready to kill him to level up, Lu Chen must take up his broken gnoll club and fight to level up, starting from a Level 1 Gnoll. As Lu Chen keeps on killing more and more types of monsters, he gains new talents and level them up, and his powers keep getting stronger. Normal, Strong, Mighty… Pretty soon, he will...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Legend has it that on the last day of every year, demons and evil creatures would create havoc. People named this as "Nian". On one snowing day of this day, a pretty young man with long silky hair picked up an abandoned baby and named her as "Xue".

15 years later, Xue has grown up to be a young lady. One day, a young man appeared and told Xue with a gentle voice that could melt the coldest ice, "I've been searching for you.. for so long.."

title.romaji: Shou Shi Zhong Tian: Fan Pai Zai Zai Chao Zhan Ren
title.english: Beast World: I Became the Little Villain’s Mommy
title.native: 兽世种田：反派崽崽超粘人

description:
Si Yan, once a fearsome powerhouse with dual abilities in the apocalypse, dies in an explosion, only to wake up in a primitive beast world. To her shock, she has become the notorious villainess and the mother of four little snake cubs! But this mother was so cruel that the moment Si Yan opens her eyes, her children are already plotting to assassinate her. Now, she has to find a way to win back the hearts of her villainous cubs, farm and survive in a strange new beast world.

(Source: Webnovel)

After going a little bit to far catching cats for a report, Yue Cheng is lead into a land of cats, who are ready to punish her for her mistreatment of them. Luckily, one cat finds her to look awfully familiar...

This young girl is often mistreated by her family, being called ugly and useless. One day, she meets the new wife of the Yee family, which changes her life forever. The woman adopts her into her wealthy family, and now she lives with 3 other boys around her age. But for what purpose? Even though this is a miracle, the girl plans to leave the luxurious lifestyle once she turns 18. So see how she survives more than 10 years of her life.

(source: MangaJouhou)

Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is a dramatic manga set in ancient China.

Based on the fourth novel of the series Crane Iron Pentology by Wang Dulu

In a small kingdom where chivalry exists and heroes are living legends, an extraordinary adventure awaits a young princess--Nan-Fan, Princess of Tang: young, naïve, and strong willed.

On the eve of her arranged political marriage to the brutal "Battle Demon" of the rival Li Kingdom, she escapes from the imperial palace to seek her true fate. On this journey, she begins to understand the joys and hardships of the common people and realizes that living outside the palace can teach a young princess how to become a person of strength and character.

Thus, undaunted by the unknown, Princess Nan-Fan forges ahead, reshaping the myths and legends of her own destiny. (Source: DramaQueen)

Since ancient times, the Kusanagi clan opposes the Yagami, each one of them controlling the capacity of the divine flames. The rising generation does not make departures from the rule with Kyo Kusanagi and Iori Yagami. Formerly, these two with Chizuru Kagura formed the "three instruments" who made it possible to overcome Yamata Orochi, a demon being that prevailed in time in the shape of a giant snake. The Corsican business when a called secret organization NESTS unloads clones of Kyo. The survival of humanity is once more threatened...
Based on the novel.

Yi Xiamo and Luo Xi are orphans, both having met each other at their adoptive parents’ home. Because of the shadows remaining from their childhood, they are both shrouded in the midst of wariness. However, when Yi Summer and her brother meet an embarrassing situation during a singing competition, Loshii helps them out, and the iciness that separates both of them gradually melts. Seeing what has happened, as well as in an attempt to break both of them up, Ozen, who deeply loves Yi Summer and is the heir to the company that founded their school, sends Loshii off to England to study…

Five years later, Loshii has become a superstar, with countless number of fans to his name. Yi Summer, having become an orphan once again as her adoptive parents died the year Loshii left, is a new artiste of a records company, and meets Loshii. Ozen, on the other hand, having lost his memory of Yi Summer five years ago due to a car accident, also sees Yi Summer once again as well. With all three main characters back on the scene and their disputes of love and hate, what will happen between them then? Who will Yi Summer pick in the end?

(Source: Sherbet Lemon)

This is based on a legend in Ancient China:

Luuzhu (Green Pearl) is a beautiful pearl gatherer from a small Southern village in Ancient China. Due to her family's poverty, she was sold by her parents to be the mistress of the wealthy but abusive and old Lord Hong. However, Fate is not so cruel to the gentle Luuzhu. Just before her marriage to Lord Hong, Luuzhu met a young handsome nobleman named Jilun on the beach at night. Dazzled by Luuzhu's grace, Jilun purchased her from Lord Hong for ten bushels of pearl (a most generous amount at the time). It turned out that Jilun is one of the richest man in Ancient China! However, Lord Sima Lun, who usurped the throne, now desires Luuzhu for her legendary beauty. He is even willing to go to war with Jilun for her! Will Luuzhu become just another plaything for the rich and privileged, or will she avert from that terrible fate? Or perhaps, will her celestial beauty bring woe upon her and her loved ones?

There was a legend about a blind goddess who fell in love and was left heartbroken... "Why did you leave me? I vow this life and every life after I don't want to ever hear your voice again! I will forever take you as my enemy..."

A hot blooded part time hunter with a sense of justice, Yan Zi Ying, working everyday for the sake of maintaining the peace between devils and the human race. One day the hunter headquarters tells her grandfather that the seal is going to be broken very soon. In order to reseal the seal, Zi Ying and a fat parrot Xiu Shou charges straight to the devil’s head, vampire, Yu Wen Hao’s home in order to take away the sacred book by force, not expecting Yu Wen Hao to easily give the sacred book to her. (Source: Shoujo Crusade)

Wi-Lan is a poor girl that was born in a poor fisherman family. She yearned to go to that high standard private high school. When she received the entrance letter, she was so happy, but then she became the laughter of the whole school for being the poorest kid in the school. She was teased and pranked. Until a few weeks ago, a new student transfered to their school, San-Yue. Wi-Lan had a crush on him along with the rest of the girls. When she confessed to him, he ran off without saying anything... Apparently, he and his family are hiding a dark secret...

Tiem Sum accidently sees a cute silver fox turning into a guy. He confronts her and tells her that she has to marry him since she saw him naked. He is also looking for his lost brother while trying to woo Sum.

Lin is an average high school girl who has a huge crush on Daiwen, a popular TV host. Super Pop singer Gonjieh, who is Daiwen's enemy, transferred 6 months ago to Mushroom College. Phoebe and Jia are Lin's best friends and luckily end up in the same class. Unfortunely for them, Lienze, the no.1 delinquent in her school and who scares the living daylights out of Lin, also happens to be in her class. To make things worse, Lin's uncle appears, who she says is the root of all trouble. How will Lin survive?
(Source: Shoujo Manga Maniac)

The Song Dynasty:
Shan Yu Mu, an artist who can see and paint the future, is driven out of his village as a heretic… Haunted by visions of countless disasters, he wanders and encounters the innocent and spirited young lady, Chuei Ying Shuang! After a terrifying prophecy, these two who were strangers step on a path toward an uncertain future. Will their path be blessed or cursed? The only certain thing is that they will walk that path together…

(Source: Shoujo Manga Maniac)

Volume 5 contains 2 side-story chapters.
The crown prince of dragon clan from the deep blue sea comes to the human world to look for his bride. But he doesn't know that his bride is a twin...

Hui-Dong, a high school girl who wanted to lose weight so badly because Dai-Xi always teased her about it. But Dai-Xhi just teased her because he likes her and he never thought she would take it seriously.

Hui-Dong took many kinds of diet pills but none of them worked. So she ate this kind of pill that is so strong that it was against the law to eat. And because of extreme running and the pills, she died of a weak heart.

But somehow her soul never went to heaven, instead she stayed in the living world. Until she met an angel that put her soul into Daishi's doll. But Daishi soon found out about it and he...?

Yashi has wandered with her father for fourteen years, and only now has she discovered that her own mother is actually Bocinia’s current queen. To see her mother, from whom she was separated when she was just an infant, she and her father enter the palace, but she never thought she would accidentally run into the Princess of Bocinia, and then become her bodyguard by mistake...

Coming of age during the Cultural Revolution in China, sixteen-year-old Ma Xiaojun yearns to rebel against the system. But while he manages to get into plenty of trouble with his friends, he also nurtures a more solitary side, a mysterious obsession with keys, and the desire to achieve greatness. When maturity yields a newfound interest in the opposite sex, Xiaojun finds himself intrigued by the untouchable Mi Lan. Will he ever find the key to unlock her heart?

(Source: Yen Press)

Meet the handsome prince Zelos and royal maid Ana, two 15-year-olds from two very different kingdoms. This unlikely pair have Found themselves bound together by a magical curse, reducing them each to onLy 10 years of age. When Ana laughs or zelos cries, they can each return to their original age of 15…. but at the cost of knocking the other down to a mere 5 years old!

Now, on the run from the villain who cursed them, can these two stop bickering long enough to find a cure for their condition… and maybe even save both their kingdoms from disaster?

(Source: Udon Entertainment)

title.romaji: Xing Gui Shi Tian Kong De Dao Lu

description:
Kaphisilia Ailide is the daughter of a noble duke. Ever since the disappearance of her elder brother, her parents have put all their pressure on her. Everyday she has to have sword fighting and etiquette class. Days before her father's birthday, she went to a forest of her family's confer territory to get him a present. All of the sudden a death wolf leaped out and tried to kill her. And then this strange guy...

(Source: Sherbet Lemon)
A simple, wordless oneshot about a man being hitted on by a woman in his dreams.

title.romaji: Han Lu Duanpian ji 1: Baroque Jian

description:
On the sixth night, in the rose garden that was filled with loneliness and misery, I met my dead lover. He awakened me with those pale and lifeless lips of his, saying

"Do you love me" ?

"Yes, I love you"

A collection of stories portraying the cruel and twisted nature of love, lust and desire -- and the misery it brings to all those involved.

title.english: Love's Out, Boy Band Fandom's In

description:
Yun Shang is reborn, back to the time before the debut of her ultimate favorites, the members of the idol group Crown. She finds herself in the despised role of the "vicious supporting character," Lu Youyou, the daughter of the Lu family. What she thought were weak, pitiful, and helpless cuties turn out to be ruthless, silent big shots, stabbing her in the heart. To change her and her idols' tragic fate, Lu Youyou, with a heart gradually changing from a doting mother fan, surrenders to the idols...

(Source: Webnovel)

A really unfashionable working class girl, Chen Xin Yi, desires to tie down her handsome boyfriend to be with her. during a trip on a love cruise, but ends up sick and drowsy due to the medicine, which causes her to enter Ji Cun Xi's room instead of her own. Cun Xi is the sole male heir to his family's company and has been in love with his girlfriend, Anna, for a long time. He planned to propose to Anna on the boat, but she didn't turn up. An island owner added drugs into Cun Xi's drink, and Cun Xi became disoriented and returned to his room. Xin Yi and Cun Xi end up having a one night stand. Xin Yi later finds out that she's pregnant, and Cun Xi's grandmother forces them to get married. Will a couple forced to marry for the sake of their unborn child find love with each other?

On the day Yun Li decided to give up on Fu Shize, she deleted all of his contact information with tears in her eyes. Some time later, after they got together, Yun Li, who wasn't good with people, was debating if she should block a guy who had expressed interest in her. Fu Shize lazily leaned back on the couch and gave her that look. He let out a chuckle before telling her coldly, "Do it."

Yun Li looked up, "?"

"Just like how you deleted my WeChat back then."

"..."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
Betrayed by his own sworn brother….what can be more surprising? Being reborn into the body of his little sister! A story of revenge and rebirth.

title.romaji: Tuihun Hou Dalao Ta You Mei You Sa
title.english: She Becomes Glamorous After The Engagement Annulment
title.native: 退婚后大佬她又美又飒

description:
Once mocked as an unattractive, overweight fiancée, Su Nanqing was heartlessly dumped over an unexpected pregnancy, but her stunning transformation silences everyone who once scorned her. Now dazzling and fearless, she turns heads everywhere. Her regretful ex is shut out for good, while the world proves him wrong: a pop star idolizes her, a top surgeon pursues her, and even the ruthless underworld boss will stop at nothing to claim her back and the future they lost. With beauty, power, and a line of admirers, Su Nanqing is ready to write her own legend and no one can stand in her way.

(Source: WebNovel)

Yan Qinghe, an emperor teacher, was struck by lightning and was transmigrated to a modern studio as an actor. Thanks to his previous experience as a national teacher, he gets to play his ancient self in the movie. And, to his surprise, his co-star just happens to be the reincarnated king...

(Source: INKR)

A sudden imperial decree binds the esteemed scholar Song Liqing in marriage to the enigmatic Crown Prince Jun Qiyu. But on their wedding night, Jun Qiyu cruelly spurns Song Liqing, spending it with another. Unwavering in his loyalty to their cherished past, Song Liqing suffers the humiliation in silence. Yet Jun Qiyu's callousness only deepens, culminating in an act of shocking brutality that leaves Song Liqing broken - both physically and spiritually. With nothing left to lose, Song Liqing resolves to cast aside everything, determined to forge a new life free from Jun Qiyu's shadow.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: 11 chapters were published on Kuaikan before the series page was deleted.

The female lead Yue Qingtao was born into poverty. When she was forced to live on the street, she got picked up by a mysterious man who had known her in her past lives. Though he knew she's no longer the same person, he still couldn’t help getting close to her, maybe for the last bit of hope he had guarded for so long…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

I, Ji Qing, crossed into the Gaowu version of the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period. You have a sword, I can't die! You have the magic of the world, I can't die! You have a nearly-godlike move, I still can't die! An ordinary person who can't die no matter what, how will I fare in this war-torn world of rigorous battles?

As the most popular member of super idol group FLY, Yusen was soaring high until a joke goes horribly awry. Every day he’s now top of the news for some new social media disaster. Yelling at flight attendants, beating children, cursing on live TV, he tries his best but haters gonna hate and the news gonna fake. Even as the news misinterprets his every move, he refuses to quit for those fans who stand by him no matter what. Top Headline: Super Idol Yusen is off his rocker or is the pop star just misunderstood?

(Source: TAPAS)

Mimi is a young woman in her first year of high school who completely fell in love with the seductive Gongyi, who is also a student in the same fashion school. He dreams of becoming a renowned model stylist.
At first, it seems the young man completely ignores Mimi. But by some strange circumstances, Mimi will become the ideal model to wear Gongyi's creations. This discovery brings the two young people closer. So much so that Mimi can finally begin to believe she can make Gongyi fall for her.

title.romaji: Bing Jiao Wangye Kao Wo Xu Ming

description:
In an event of transmigration, Su Ye became the evil female supporting character of a novel, who was infamous for her extreme tyranny and her countless hired male companions. To stay alive, she would have to keep a great distance from the cruel yandere lord. However, the yandere lord’s hand interlocked with hers as he coughed, “Do you like me, my savior?” Su Ye was starting to feel nervous under his intense stare so she hastily nodded. “I do. I like you very much.” What could the unlucky female supporting character do after meeting this troublesome lord? Let him have his way, of course!

(Source: Webnovel)

Placed on the back of the neck, iMood can easily control emotions by pressing it lightly. In the short period of 20 years after iMood was born, the society seems to be in harmony, but the hidden crisis is the collapse of human emotions. Yu Qing Le is a police officer who also has an iMood addiction. The overture of a serial killer started from a dead woman nailed to the ceiling...

(Source: WebComics)

The girl who was adopted by two mothers met her soulmate⁠—another girl, when she was sixteen years old. After dating for ten years, she decided to give herself to a man... because she did not want to live this "abnormal life". Only after leaving her, did she finally understand the true meaning of love during those countless days and nights. However, can they still go back to the way things were?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)
In the virtual game, experience the brilliance and darkness of human nature. When the player's game journey reaches the end, what is waiting for them...

The cute and clever "eunuch" was discovered to be pregnant and unexpectedly became the Crown Prince's personal attendant?! The Crown Prince is rumored to be erratic, two-faced and aloof... And yet he keeps indulging her despite her testing his bottom line again and again. Why would she disguise herself as a man after crossing over and insist on staying beside him? "It's my turn to face all these hardships for you in this world!"

The moment she woke up, she found herself transported back in time to Prince Xuan’s bed, and inexplicably became his servant. The romantic Prince Xuan expressed love to her every day, but all of a sudden he turned his back to her and allowed other women to frame her adultery, disfigure her appearance, put her in the pig cage and throw her into the river. When she opened her eyes again, there was no time travel, only that she was reborn with a completely new look. Learning from the past, instead of being vulnerable, she seized the initiative and indulged herself in money, wine and handsome men, and that man who told only lies should show his deep love for her?

(Source: Webcomics)

A lighting engineer master boarded a train and prepared to start his first trip after his eyesight was restored. It's bound to be an extraordinary journey. The university student he met when he was blind, this time, he really wants to see him for himself. A blind lighting engineer who strives for his dreams, and a dispirited university student who has no pursuit of any dreams, meet and change each other's lives.

The popular boy band seems peaceful, but the members had already broken up with each other privately. After an accident, the members traveled back to ten years ago when they just made their debut. Being given a second chance, how much effort does he need to spend to save his relationship with Meng Yilan and other members? This is a story about dreams and love!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Pi Zhe Lang Pi de Yang

description:
“The funny love between the gentle, black-hearted Sheep King and the funny, straightforward Wolf tomboy girl has just begun.”

There exists a website where you just pay a few dollars and set a keyword, then you can easily enter the world of novels to personally run around and venture. After every time you enter, the experiences that occurred will automatically become parts of the novels. A new novelist, Lan Pi, saw such an introduction, mouse-clicked it, closed her eyes, and entered the VR world.

(Source: Comikey)

After being cheated on by her fiancé, Claire has a one night stand with a random but undeniably handsome man. The next morning, she wakes only to discover he is the CEO of her company! Not only that, the two share an unexpected and intimate past. Can the cocksure CEO be more than a boss? Or will the two just have to go back to work...

The Pinnacle Doctor – He is an ordinary caregiver, and no one expected that he would have a special skill. Let’s watch the teenager step on the enemy, embrace the beauty, and play in the bustling city!

In the year 2030, the end of the world happened with many people dying mysteriously, while the lone survivors were controlled by an app named “81 Fatal Questions”. After answering various questions and clearing the instance dungeons, survivors will be rewarded through the app. By competing against Death, only the ultimate winners will have a chance to survive. The genius heroine who has had a “bad luck debuff” since birth, takes her comrades with her on her journey. Can she clear the game and survive until the end?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

The useless boy Li Xiang was dropped into a dark school which helped them break addiction to internet because he was addicted to online games. Living like he was dying, he recognized the premature and black-hearted student Meng Jin. In order to escape, they overcame all the difficulties in the way with their intelligence and braveness…

(Source: Webnovel)

Thought they could be lovers again like old times, who knows he already had a child?! — See how this overbearing boss gets his subordinate man’s love back!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: You Yao Lai Zhi Xue Yu Mo

description:
Z-list celebrity Mo Ji meets Shen Yi who looks almost the same as him in Jiang Nan Club, the largest club in Hong City. A misunderstanding happens between them when they first meet. Shen Yi thinks this good-looking boy wants to seduce him, while Mo Ji thinks this rich old man wants to take advantage of him. This is a love story that starts with a misunderstanding.

(Source: Webnovel)

Once a student, now a master.

(Source: Toomics)

The excellent game player is a part-time model in real life?! The senior he respects most is his hard-core fan?! His double identity is going to be exposed... What should he do? Admit it or guard the secret with his life?

(Source: Webnovel)

A rich and handsome young man was killed on the road after having a scuffle with an angry woman.

He awoke to a magical world only to find out that he's suddenly getting married to the god of magic.

Hesitant at first, but the handsome young man couldn’t help but give in to the god’s advances.

(Source: INKR Comics)

One was an influential boss in entertainment business, and the other was a young innocent idol. As each other's rival in love, they never got along, but were forced to be a popular "super couple" because of a "special deal".
