The false gradually became the truth—love started to grow between them. However, conspiracies and danger also tailed after...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 16 extra chapters.

title.english: My MMO Wife Is a Cultivator

description:
All it took was one meet-up, a simple meet-up with his MMO wife and suddenly he was dragged into the world of urban cultivation. Thus he believed that he would begin his journey as a cultivator in this urban world and live a life of overbearing dominance. However...why is life as a cultivator so hard and so impoverished? How come everyone's still playing the MMO even though they're piss poor? Wait a minute...playing the MMO is part of cultivation too?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The daily lives of middle and high school students.

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

Dai Yi is a female geography teacher who has just transferred to a new high school. She has a crush on her colleague, the popular female teacher, Zhang Guo, and now she has the chance to get closer with her crush. However, Zhang Guo unexpectedly announced that she was getting engaged.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

I can only offer you, someone so far away whom I shall never meet, my most deeply held secrets, these feelings that make me toss and turn.

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

title.romaji: Xi Wang Ni, Zhen De Hen Kuaile

description:
The recent graduate Yu Zhou has just joined the workforce, when she runs into the cool lady Su Chang at the hospital. The two immediately hit it off, and after some teasing and flirting, they eventually come to recognize their feelings for each other. But what Yu Zhou doesn't know is that Su Chang isn't only beautiful and well-off, she's also a highly acclaimed voice actress. How will the self-proclaimed ordinary girl "Xiao Zhou" ever be able to bridge the distance to the "Bright Moon"?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

When I was eighteen years old, I thought that love is the courage to fight against the whole world for you. At the age of twenty-five, I discovered that love gives you the confidence to embrace the whole world. If you say that young love is as unpredictable as the wind, then I would like to spend the rest of my life in your arms.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Yue Ling and Chong Yao both train under Tai Shang Xian Jun, and they get along well until Chong Yao inherits the throne of the Emperor. Everything seems to changed after that...

Vicious but loyal Emperor X Gentle water god

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shangsi Ta Dui Wo Tu Mou Bu Gui

description:
On the first day of her internship, Xu Nian has already annoyed her boss Jiang Zhi — what terrible luck! Fortunately, Xu Nian has a cute, gentle, and considerate online girlfriend who is helping her with advice on how to deal with her devilish boss. But… why?! How did her online girlfriend and her devilish boss turn out to be the same person?! So Jiang Zhi scolds her waifu to tears during the day, then turns around to comfort her at night, and she even has to pretend to get mad at herself! When she discovered the truth, Jiang Zhi couldn't help but facepalm and let out a long sigh.

(Souce: Bilibili, translated)

One is the unloved 1st prince, the other is the 2nd prince who is the heir to the throne with high hopes. They are the royal family of the Wim Kingdom and destined to be incompatible with each other. However, a letter changed their relationship. To hide the secret, he doesn't hesitate to make himself his partner, and he is willing to sacrifice everything to gain his love.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Lin Hao, a seemingly high school student who keeps his actual age a secret, was abducted by an enigmatic ancient god along with another five thousand humans. From that day forward, they embarked on a journey as the ancient god's warriors, traversing through new and extraordinary worlds with the missions of survival, exploration, and relentless self-improvement. As the protagonist, Lin Hao possesses unique talents such as the "Invigorated Man", "Kept Man", and "Game Player". Join him on his journey as he overcomes daunting challenges and witness how he harnesses these powerful talents to become the ultimate warrior of the ancient god.

(Source: Webnovel)

The story, centered around Ah Men's daily life, always has unexpected endings - sometimes healing, sometimes funny, sometimes passionate, sometimes touching. The joys and sorrows of life are all worth savoring. "What you encounter is what you possess." Let the adorable raccoon take you through the seasons, experiencing the little moments of happiness in the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Li Shiyi, the leader of the Northern sect of tomb raiders, along with her companion Little Tu, found a baby girl during their expedition. The coffin contained a single character "Jiu," and so they named the girl Song Shijiu and took her with them, and that's the start of this story. She didn't know that their relationship extend back to a time long ago… You knock on a coffin three times. Once to ask where it's from, once to ask where it's going, and a third time to ask if it would like to stop and have a drink before leaving?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: 404 Shijian bu-30 Miao Hou Shijie Mori

description:
A young man named Hope lived a life without hope. Unemployment, break up, unimportant, family debt... When he was finally pushed by the despair in life to jump off a building and end his life, his phone strangely received a 30 seconds countdown timer. When the countdown finished, strange things happened...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A sanatorium famous for its psychiatric patients hides at an inhabited area 6000 meters below sea level. Rumors has it that those so-called madmen are entities beyond mortals. The life of mortals are equated to fireworks while theirs are closer to an atomic bomb. At Eastern Zhou, 307 B.C. — 2300 years ago.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 8 extras.

title.romaji: Shui Zhong Piao Ling Zhi Xing

description:
After an awkward encounter on her vacation, Wei Lan swapped bodies with a boy named Bai Yuan! Is this heaven's plan, or a trick of fate? Their strings of destiny follow the drifting star in the water.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In a post-apocalyptic world, Ye Fan'ou gained the power of the Super Takeout System. Twisted zombies? Mutant beasts? Anyone who wants to mess with his deliveries will have to get past his frying pan first!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ta De Chulian Duixiang Shi Wo

description:
After a big fight with his family, Xia Ke heard a song whose gentle melody comforted his frustrated soul. So he became a devoted follower of that music streamer. And then suddenly the streamer became his classmate! "I want to be friends with him!" Now in addition to the college entrance exam, Xia Ke's life as a senior has one more goal. The daily school life of a small-time musician and his little fanboy.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The police who don't want to be criminal investigators are not good movie stars -- the workaholic police officer Zhang Jiaming’s hope of being promoted as a criminal police was dashed when he offended Gu Nuo, a privileged young man from a rich family. He resigned in a fit of anger.

After losing his job, Zhang Jiaming happened to become an actor and fell in love with the industry. However, his career didn’t take off and he had to keep playing nobodies in different films. Once again, he ran in to Gu Nuo, who had already become a popular idol after being released from prison. What kind of sparks would they get when they meet each other on the narrow road again?

(Source: WeComics)

Xie Xi always has unnaturally good luck, meaning that clearing games is a piece of cake for him, but it also meant games are no longer entertaining. Until one day, the words "Game Loading" appeared on his screen, and he transmigrated into a dating sim called "Way to Love: Left or Right?"! And that, marked the end of his good luck. Should he choose left or right? Should he say yes to the vampire's invite? Either way, he has to stay alive!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Rong Jing is the type of guy who goes with the flow despite the circumstances. After stumbling into the story of a book, he tries his best to avoid his doomed ending as cannon fodder. Without provoking the protagonist, he quietly becomes the lovable charmer within his circle.

The protagonist is a mesmerizing heartthrob. His captivating pheromones make all the biggest hotshots kneel at his feet. Nevertheless, due to his poor financial background, he has to hustle to keep his family afloat. Despite his natural good looks and Midas touch, his career is the only thing in his heart.

Since Rong Jing had not gotten to the end of the book, he has no clue that it would turn out to be a plot-twist murder story. On top of that, the protagonist is a...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Fang Qi, an alchemist in the modern world, time traveled to a new world ruled by monsters because of an accident during pill refining. He decided to use monsters as materials to refine pills. However, after he woke up, he found himself sitting on the bed like a blushing bride. The "bridegroom" he's waiting for turned out to be a little monster boy called Yuying, and then something really weird happened. The monster boy, always known as a sickly, teeny tiny little kid, suddenly transformed into an adult with really strong manhood.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qing Zai Liming Zhiqian Huhuan Wo

description:
A romantic love story between police officer Kai and special agent Shouyue.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Tiantang Fuben Kan Wo Gonglüe Nan Shen
title.english: Heaven Instance Dungeon - Steal the Handsome Guy’s Heart
title.native: 天堂副本 看我攻略男神

description:
A super star soul-travelled into the body of Bragi, the most gorgeous angel in heaven. To gain power and avenge himself, he travelled through worlds of dramas to capture men's hearts. All kinds of attractive men fell for him. Bragi would take back what he deserved!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Nüe Zha Nan Cong Xianzai Kaishi

description:
After seven years together, Xiao Ye starts to get bored of Zhao Xianghai. The latter is too proud to get dumped and so breaks up with Xiao Ye. Now he is feeling bitter.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

The newbie police officers Fang, Beagle, and Kroos were ordered to go to the slums of the Infected in the trading city of Tkaronto to do an internship. Although initially they had problems because of the crowdedness and other conflicts, they get accustomed to this and make friends with the Infected. While the end of their half-year internship, that would make them proper police officers, is nearing, a Catastrophe is quietly approaching the city of Tkaronto...

(Source: Official Site, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue and two bonus chapters.

title.english: The Tail and Tale of a Snow Leopard

description:
When it’s anxious, this particular snow leopard has a habit of biting its own tail. When said snow leopard was delivered to the snow wolf's bedroom, it was shaking with its tail in its jaws. Snow Wolf King: " It's not like I'm gonna devour you. Why are you so scared?" Snow Leopard: " But you might violate me…" Snow Wolf King: " Well, that's too bad. That's exactly what I planned to do." Snow Leopard: " I thought only another snow wolf has the right to be your queen…?" Snow Wolf King: " Was there such a rule? Let me consult with my experts." That marked the beginning of our love story…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo De Zuzong Shi Ben Shu

description:
All things have spiritual power. Those who have the talent can absorb the qi of heaven and earth, yin and yang, and strengthen their own spiritual body. They can use their spiritual talent, in combination with energy of yuan-yang or yuan-yin, to shape the power of heaven and earth, which is the art of spiritual cultivation. Wang Ze, the only heir of the Wang family bloodline, has a very strong talent for spiritual cultivation. Under the guidance of his grandfather, his power awakened as he entered the spiritual world...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A mysterious person who claims to be the gatekeeper of the underworld suddenly joined the class WeChat group of high school students. This person started posting tasks to the group and rewarded those who completed them with money. At the start, the students were thrilled to receive rewards for completing the tasks. However, it did not take long for them to learn that failure to complete their task would lead to sudden death. Eventually, the entire class became playthings of the “underworld gatekeeper”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

After being strangled to death, Lin Yaxi wakes up to find herself back to five years ago - just an hour before the car accident which would change her fate. Bearing a grudge against her evil sister and scumbag fiancé, she swears to never let history repeat itself. However, her fiancé's brother, Chen Yi - a two-faced man, seems to be paying extra attention to her...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jia Ru Wangfu De Wo, Zhi Xiang Gao Qian
title.english: The Prince Consort Only Wants The Money
title.native: 嫁入王府的我，只想搞钱

description:
Ji Ziyang , an all-round talented assassin of the 21st century, accidentally transmigrated and became a useless waste that everyone could bully . It doesn't matter what his current background is. What's important is that the greedy him has now become penniless. His patience is really on the edge. What?! He has also been arranged to marry that sickly, tyrannical prince who's paralyzed on the bed? Okay! Bring it on! Let's see how he will embezzle the prince's wealth and take over the royal assets after his husband breathes his last. It's a story of 'The Greedy Young Master & The Tyrannical Royal Highness”!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When that monster you fed and cared for breaks free of its chains. Will it cuddle you, or will it tear you apart?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.native: 神明时代：世界变成了网游

description:
The world is facing the attack of beasts, and all mankind awakens extraordinary power by believing in the blessings of gods. When Ye Bei was laughed at for not being an Awakener, no one knew that the whole world was just an online game for him, and he was the only player!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Xia Shicheng dressed up as a guy to join the boy band Zebra, which became an overnight sensation right away. The new group's popularity even overshadowed the established star Gu Lan. As the boy band seemed well on their way towards stardom, Xia Shicheng found herself targeted by Gu Lan, as her true identity teetered on the edge of exposure…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After a great battle, the weakened demon tribe resurrected the ancient demon lord Dongfang Qingcang, whom they thought would lead the demon tribe to victory over the heavenly realm. Unfortunately, the might demon lord accidentally swapped bodies with an inexperienced flower-spirit girl. What should've been an epic war of destruction between the three realms became a slapstick romantic comedy that will create an uproar in the realms instead.

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

He had always kept his mouth shut about his mysterious life and the mastermind hidden in the dark, but it causes his lover to be dragged into a huge conspiracy. How will they get out of this? When the truth comes out, can their lives return to normal?

(Source: WebComics, edited)

Noah, who was once an S-rank hunter, sealed his extraordinary powers after he accidentally killed his best friend. Since then, he has been serving as an obscure doctor in a small town. A chance encounter with another hunter, Xia Zuo, leads him to discover that his best friend may not necessarily be dead. Together, Noah and Xia Zuo embark on a journey to unveil the mysteries of the past.

title.romaji: Dalao Shiyi Hou Zhi Jide Wo
title.english: Hey Boss, I am Your New Wife

description:
"You can't remember your own wife?"

Even with a second chance at life, Wen Qiao could only watch her crush, Fu Nanli, from afar.

One day, an alarm goes off in her head, warning her that in order for her to survive, she had to keep Fu Nanli alive too.

During a sudden accident, she saves Fu Nanli, but he wakes up with no memories of his past.
Determined to stay with him and keep him safe, she starts an ultimate ruse: They are a married couple!

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

A modern assassin transmigrated into the body of a weakling in ancient times, but she was unexpectedly blessed with beast-taming powers. She immediately began to fight her way to the top, tearing through the scumbags of the martial arts world. In the meantime, she'll find romance and collect fierce beasts for pets. As she grew in power, she has her sights set on taking over Yunmeng Ze!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

What if you can kiss the front page of an autographed book and get teleported to your favorite author? Anle got a book signed by the mysterious writer "Bai Yuan" from a regular customer at the coffee shop she works for. A miracle happened when she was fangirling holding the book in her arms: she actually teleported to him! Surprisingly, the regular customer who gave her the book turns out to be the author himself!

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Suzhu Ta You Zai Beng Juqing

description: Yu Yao, a student, was transported to another world after an accident. A System tasked her with playing the villainess role in creating scenarios for the male character to fall in love with a woman. If she succeeds in making the main character live happily ever after, she will be brought back to life in the real world. However, Yu Yao is in love with a cripple and some scenarios do not match the plot...

An ordinary teenager's left eye experiences a sudden transformation. He then starts gambling on precious stones and treasures and begins to get surrounded by beautiful women. He proudly laughs as he starts living a dashing life in the city.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

He's an elite member of the student council, she's an underperforming student. He always wants to be at the top of the class, she's basically given up on trying. Despite their differences, he seems to take a special interest in her. Their story begins as she joins a study group that he leads...

title.romaji: Bei Po Chengwei Fanpai Zhuixu Zhi Bing Xue Nüwang
title.native: 被迫成为反派赘婿之冰雪女王

description:
The wastrel of a husband returned from hell to help his lady become a goddess. In a world full of demons, monsters, and dangerous enemies, trying to defend her people against an oppressive enemy tribe, the girl's latent powers finally burst forth. Riding on wings of snow and wielding a spear of ice — the Frost Queen is reborn.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shangsi Shi Qian Nanyou De Gege

description:
Qu Qi went out with Tang Xia in college, but they broke up years ago. Now starting at a new job, she finds out her new boss is Tang Xi, her ex's older brother. The situation and the way Tang Xi treats her is all very awkward, and Tang Xi even confesses to her. What's worse is that she seems to be developing feelings for Tang Xi, too.

Tang Xi had fallen in love with Qu Qi at first sight, but he had to keep his feelings hidden when she became his brother's girlfriend. Until they met once again. This time, he'll take advantage of the opportunity and won't let her go so easily.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Breaking! Award-winning superstar actress bullies newcomer idol!
Chu Yan: We hardly even know each other.
Yuan Qiuyu: I'm looking forward to working with Chu Yan sensei.
(OMG I'm up close to my goddess. She's gorgeous! She's amazing! *screams*)

Shocking! Famed actress hooks up with rising star as romantic sparks fly?
Chu Yan: No I didn't, it's not like that…
Yuan Qiuyu: No comment, I'm busy.
(Busy dreaming up fanfics)

Breaking! The well-known celebrity couple is having relationship issues?
Chu Yan: ……
Yuan Qiuyu: LOL

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ni Ku Qi Lai Zhen Hao Kan

description:
The crybaby Xiao Yu and the emotionally repressed delinquent girl Xiao Xiao, two girls with issues find comfort in each other.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Hei Yue Guang Wen Na BE Juben (Chang Yue Wu Jin)
title.native: 黑月光拿稳BE剧本（长月无烬）

description:
Yandere demon lord born of darkness x righteous phoenix saint born of light, in a tragic romance that spans centuries.

Tan Taijin is a man who has never cried. Even when his eyes were cut out and his limbs torn, he never weakened or wavered. Until that one unforgettable day, the witnesses recall, when they saw him beg pitifully and cry tears of blood, dripping down.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A masterpiece of the Beast-Taming! In a wasteland where mutant beasts run rampant, human survival space is rapidly shrinking. Su Huan, a genius teenager, accidentally obtains the Old Era Dragon Manuscript that combines Old Era knowledge and magic, thus embarking on a path to the fantasy world. Hatch pet-taming eggs to activate advanced bloodlines that surpass those attainable by ordinary people, and enlighten their skills to create unprecedented top-tier combat power. There is also the "Dragon Transformation Secret Technique" that allows the tamed beasts by his side to transcend their mortal forms and become colossal dragons!

(Source: Webnovel)

On the Shenqi Continent, spiritual energy revives, releasing rampant demons. Countless forces crumble and disasters sweep across the continent, leading to the decline of the human race and an impoverished life for the people. Qin Feng, a god-level alchemist who has fallen into the status of a martial arts waste due to a frame-up, reverts back to his youth. Based on his experience in his previous life, he uses the advantages of alchemy to promote his martial arts cultivation. In this life, he vows not to let history repeat itself. He is determined to protect those he loves, eliminate all the evil and reach an unprecedented pinnacle!

(Source: MangaToon)

Zuo Ying, a well-known crime-solving expert from Huanyang University, is accused of a crime by her own daughter Zuo Yang. On the verge of a death sentence, the court suddenly commits Zuo Ying to an asylum instead, while Zuo Yang is promoted highly for solving this case. Then, a series of mysterious murders occur in the city. Unable to solve the case, Zuo Yang is forced to ask her mother for help. Facing her once-loving mother with complicated feelings, her cheeks dripping with sweat. "My precious daughter, all you have to do is ask nicely, why don't you?" Zuo Ying looks at the newspaper in her hands and smiles. The handcuffs conspicuously shackle the prisoner, but who is the real caged bird here?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The young wolf cub and his bad-tempered sect founder have an improper monastic life. The wolf cub is very upset because his sect founder, a male mother, flirts with him every day. What should he do?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Mini is a “Scum Detective,” and her latest job is from a rich girl who wants to test her boyfriend’s loyalty. However, her boyfriend, Zhao Yueming, acts like a straightforward gentleman, and Mini’s usual methods don’t work on him. This turns out to be a little tricky for Mini, who is more used to dealing with scummy "playboys." This game of back-and-forth between the womanizer and the one who understands them best is about to begin. Who will fall into the love trap first?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Gu Qingying and Fu Shiyu are a couple of girlfriends, the duo are studying in a dance academy, Gu Qingying is known as a genius dancer, but also in school during the professional dance troupe, she is such a perfect pair of lovers, but Gu Qingying one day without saying goodbye to declare a breakup, from then on, for four years, Fu Shiyu has been looking for Gu Qingying until one day, on the dark stage of the bar, she saw a big change in style, it is a dance sexy and hot! Gu Qingying...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Nan Mo is the top boudoir photographer in the country. She has photographed all sorts of celebrities and stars, but Jiang Yudai is the only one she dreams about late at night. Jiang Yudai was only 18 years old when she became a award-winning actress, and she is still a superstar ten years later, with her irresistibly seductive looks and intimidating beauty. No one knows that she actually lurks online, leaving all sorts of crazed fangirl comments on Nan Mo's SNS accounts, hoping that Nan Mo will cover every inch of her body with her camera some day.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The retired police officer Zhou Nan is troubled by his peculiar ability to touch an object and feel the history and emotions associated with it. This causes him to become involved with all sorts of supernatural incidents going on in this mysterious city. Behind each outlandish urban legend is a surprising secret. As the door to a strange and mysterious world slowly opens…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: She Ding Yao Qiu Wo Ai Ni

description: This deep desire to please her master, could it simply be implanted programming?! A face deliberately designed to resemble her master’s first-love, is it part of the conspiracy or just the bait? But! Wu Qing doesn’t care about these complications, she only wants to make her master happy! Even in a plague-ravaged, post-apocalyptic wasteland, she just wants to stay and serve her master.

Urban legends have become reality. The world is now ruled by demons and hunters. Li Xiaohei, a college student whose only wish is to survive, finds his world turned upside down. When he gains a mysterious system that lets him see ten minutes into the future, everything changes. Suddenly, he can predict deadly encounters, control the demons, and navigate the horror game that reality has become. But as Xiaohei grows stronger and the bodies pile up, he starts questioning everything. In a world where trust kills and mercy is weakness, who is the real demon?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Nin Wanquan Bu Jiemi Shi Ma?
title.english: You Don’t Decrypt at All, Do You?

description:
Zhu Wen, one of the unlucky players, faces an unforgiving system: no second chances, no restarts, and absolutely no hints. Armed with just a matchstick, he must unravel the game’s sinister puzzles to survive. As he ventures deeper, haunted NPCs and treacherous landscapes await, each step more perilous than the last. Will Zhu Wen crack the cryptic codes and outsmart the game, or will he fall victim to the lurking horrors?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Nu Gui Xiaojie, Jinzhi Tie Tie!

description:
Lanting, a Taoist priest, was trying to exorcise a thousand-year-old female ghost when she inexplicably formed a love-bond with her! Now the girlie ghost hugs and kisses her every day and tells Lanting that she smells nice? What's going on, a Taoist priest is letting a ghost molest her every day?! Aren't Taoists suppose to be above worldly affections? Is it really okay to be so affectionate with a ghost?

Lanting: Why are you running away? Aren’t you coming to bed with me?

Jiang Si: I thought you said that humans and ghosts have separate destinies and can't be together?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhong Shen is a young member of the Zhong family tasked with subduing demons roaming the human realm. However, he is only an illegitimate disciple who can only cultivate at the lowest level. In a world on the brink of war, Shen must prepare himself to fulfill his mother's last wish.

(Source: INKR)

After being betrayed and murdered by his fiancée, the gang's young leader, Charles Ji, accidentally time-traveled back thirty years, ending up in the body of a 19-year-old boy. This fallen young Alpha is then rescued by a gentle, kind-hearted young Beta. Yet this angelic savior bears the exact same face as the fiancée who murdered him in his past life...

(Source: WebComics)

A hot-tempered Taoist priest finds himself entangled with an arrogant vampire, drawn into a whirlwind of love and hatred fueled by karmic ties from their past lives. In the present day, he’s barely scraping by, working odd jobs on a film set. But one day, he senses a powerful, ominous energy. When he looks up, he’s shocked to find that the source is none other than the nation’s biggest movie star, Shen Zhuo?! The charming and sophisticated actor the world admires—is actually a thousand-year-old vampire?

“You’re not getting away from me this time!”

Kang Ha-Ru is a poor college student who works many part-time jobs to support his younger sister and pay off family debt. One day, while making a delivery, he's given a card that says "Puppy Wanted." Misunderstanding, Ha-Ru finds a dog and brings it up to the hotel room Min Do-Woon is staying in, but he is shocked to see Do-Woon having sex with someone. Ha-Ru runs away, but Do-Woon happens to become a visiting professor at his university. Do-Woon hires Ha-Ru as his secretary and the line between work and professional begins to blur. However, Do-Woon's abusive ex Jang Hyuk makes it hard for him to love again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Zhi Wei Jiekai Ni De Jiasuo

description:
Captain Shen and her team member Gu Xu have a very close relationship. During a mission, Gu Xu was caught in an accident and became a zombie with no memory. Captain Shen refuses accept this, and still treats Gu Xu like the person she once was. Can Gu Xu ever recover her humanity?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A story about a pretty, ditsy ghost and a cold guy. But wait, how is their first meeting in a bathtub?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Qin Huang Guilai! Wo Wei Qiangu Xian Di
title.native: 秦皇归来！我为千古仙帝

description: Emperor Qin Ying Zheng was unable to overcome the tribulations in the immortal world. He was reborn in the city, where the spiritual force was restored. With his sword, he vanquished the strong men from outside the realm, conquered the ladies in the harem, and called forth the fierce warriors and fierce generals with his hands to conquer the entire world! He held the title of Emperor of the Immortals during his previous existence. He pledged to return to the immortal realm and reach the pinnacle of immortality in this life!

title.native: 炮灰她不爽剧情很久了

description:
This is a hilarious quick-transmigration comic. Lily's mission is to shuttle through various novel worlds and fulfill the wishes of small potatoes, like helping them get rid of bad romances or changing their miserable fates. Wait, her boss is an aloof guy in ancient-style attire, and he's kind of attractive!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan Xitong: Fanpai Dalao Buhaore
title.english: Don't Mess With This Villain: Rapid Training System
title.native: 快穿系统：反派大佬不好惹

description:
Ling Qingxuan, the goddess as well as the manager of planes dies in an accident. To resurrect herself and retrieve her memory, she must go to different planes and stop the antagonists on the planes from being demonized. Let's see how the beautiful and strong heroine fights the bad characters and completes the tasks!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Dai Chaoshi Chuan Dao Gudai Yang Chengxiang
title.english: I Bring A Mart to Feed My Ministerial Husband
title.native: 我带超市穿到古代养丞相

description:
Luo Yunqi gets stuck in a historical novel as an abandoned wife. With her magical supermarket cheat, she plans to make bank and disappear. But her survival system binds her to her mortal enemy. Now she has to bribe the empire's coldest official with snacks just to stay alive. But this move accidentally turns the ruthless male lead into a clingy puppy who just won't let her go. Facing red wedding candles and locked doors, Yunqi throws the script aside and yells, "We agreed on going our separate ways! But this guy's totally off-script!"

(Source: WebComics)

My ex-boyfriend is sitting across from me right now, which is the craziest thing of all! This is a blind date gone wrong! Can it be any more awkward? Is there a kind of fate at work, or is there something funny going on?

(Source: WebComics)

Long Nanxiao was devastated when his grandpa died and his inheritance went to his second uncle. Knowing that his second uncle was behind his grandfather's death, he swore revenge on him.

With the power of a mysterious ring, he becomes a Demon Lord and collects subjects to become strong!

(Source: INKR)

title.english: The Godly Son-in-Law of the Nation

description:
After completing his training as a descendent of the first Qimen sect, Chu Chen’s return to the big city was spoiled by a freak accident that left his True Spirit sealed deep within an unbreakable amulet for five years. In the aftermath of the tragedy, Chu Chen gained a beautiful wife – who vowed to help him recover from his injuries – but became the laughing stock of her prestigious family. Now that his True Spirit has been restored, those who belittled and bullied him over the past half-decade are about to learn that they messed with the wrong “fool”!

(Source: WebComics)

The rich boy You Gan encounters a strange black rain, which instantly turns all of his 200 servants into monsters and thrusts the whole planet in unprecedented danger. Food is scarce, rescue is not in sight and money has gone from his hands… But You Gan finds an exclusive virtual shop and is using it to face the apocalypse head on. Now he is buying like a madman to return the world to its former glory!

(Source: WebComics)

Me: "Hey, you ate me! The least you can do is give me some compensation, right?"
Dragon King: "Fine! I'll give you a cultivation technique on an advance. You get the knowledge now, and you can complete the training later!"
Me: "How is that enough? I had to smell your rancid breath! That's double the mental damage!"
Dragon King: "Then what do you want!?"
Me: "From now on, we're two immortals sharing one HP bar. You're going to tank all the damage!"
Dragon King: "Fuck! You lunatic! Why does the health bar for this majestic, sovereign body of mine feel a little short all of a sudden? Looks like it's time to go out and get a job!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Bei Caiyuan Hou Huo Yiwan Xitong, Wo Duzi Shengji
title.native: 被裁员后获亿万系统，我独自升级

description:
His company was acquired, and he was "optimized" right out of a job. To make matters worse, the game-loving nerd Ye Fei just got dumped by his girlfriend. Will he fall into despair or just throw his life away?

Ye Fei shakes his head: "I refuse to choose either!" His salvation arrives in the form of a stunning AI beauty, bringing with her a billionaire system. The rule is simple: the more he spends, the more he earns! His new cheat power is on its way, and it's bringing a whole harem of beauties with it! Navigating the dual rules of wealth and love, he dives into an adrenaline-fueled corporate battlefield. In this high-stakes game, who will become the final diamond ring to grace his finger?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Kaiju Wanyi Wu Zi, Nushen Houhui Liao
title.native: 开局万亿物资，女神后悔了

description:
Constantly slapping faces is constantly satisfying. Holding trillions in resources, slapping the faces of terrible women, conquering goddesses, Chen Yu is bound to the Scumbag System, sweeping away all powerful enemies in the apocalypse, and subduing countless otaku goddesses!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yu Shou: Wo Neng Kanjian Jinhua Quan Tujian
title.native: 御兽：我能看见进化全图鉴

description:
On awakening in a desperate situation, Li Wenxuan, an ordinary college student, was pushed into the era of fantasy beast masters by fate. Starting from the lowest level fantasy beast, he groped forward in revenge and protection, pursuing his own power and beliefs. This is a golden age where fantasy beasts and humans coexist, and Li Wenxuan is destined to embark on a unique path of rise.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xiu Xian Gui Lai Zai Xiao Yuan Di Er Ji
title.native: 修仙归来在校园 第二季

description:
The most powerful cultivator of the immortal realm has descended to the city. He will beat down the Japanese snake, defeat the Western pantheon, restore spiritual power with a snap of his fingers, and open the gate to heaven with a wave of his hand! Those who looked down on me in the past will now kneel and beg for forgiveness!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Having been betrayed by her scumbag boyfriend, Zoey Nan impulsively made a move on Hugo Fu, the tycoon of the business world. Her ex witnessed it all, yet could only boil with rage, powerless to act due to his fear of Hugo Fu’s status. Zoey had thought this was merely a mutually beneficial deal. But as workplace crises piled up and her ex-boyfriend made relentless advances, she found herself cornered at every turn. The man who'd promised to keep things purely physical and emotionless kept coming to her rescue, shielding her with extreme protectiveness. What began as a game of revenge gradually spiraled out of control...

(Source: WebComics)

Chu Mu, a young man from the Chu family, encounters betrayal from his soul pet, leading to his family’s downfall. Pursued by enemies, he is captured and bound to Nightmare Island, forced to serve as a slave feeding the terrifying White Nightmare within him. Any misstep could result in his soul being devoured with no burial ground. To survive and seek revenge, Chu Mu must grow stronger.

Fortunately, Chu Mu forms a contract with a mutated Moonlight Fox soul pet, naming it Mo Ye. With Nightmare Island as his starting point, Chu Mu will script the tale of the strongest soul pet master.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Chen Wan, a smooth-talking person, infiltrated the princeling clique through his meticulous and reliable approach. Wherever he's around, even the humidity is just right. His efforts aren't about hoping Zhao Shengge will like him. Chen Wan doesn't leave his name or take credit. Zhao Shengge doesn't even need to know him personally; just a chance encounter or two in the same circle is enough. A friend is disappointed: What do you want? "Nothing," Chen Wan smiled, his unwavering secret love creed unbreakable. "If you must say, just that my presence makes him feel a little happier and more comfortable."

Zhao Shengge is a favored child, holding a high position of power. Chen Wan is self-aware and doesn't harbor any illusions about the impossible, nor does he believe his actions are flawless. When they met at an auction, Chen Wan would hide in the crowd and greet others respectfully; when he picked up someone's belongings, he would ask his friends to pass them on; when someone came over and wanted to make connections, he would apologize and tell them that they didn't know him. He really thought so. Until on the cruise ship, the other person bit his cigarette, stared at him quietly and slowly said: "Chen Wan, I don't have a lighter."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Lipu! Wo Zhen Mei Xiang Kai Nüdi Peixun Ban!
title.native: 离谱！我真没想开女帝培训班！

description:
Lu Li, An Ordinary Teacher With Amnesia, Managed To Turn His Three Female Students Into A Queen Of Killers, A Queen Of Medicine, And A Queen Of Business?! It Turns Out His True Identity Is An Ancient Immortal Who Lost His Memory And Fell To The Mortal World. Now That He Has Regained Everything, He Decides To Defy Fate With His Disciples And Reclaim His Former Glory!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Fenshen Shi Yuzhou Chong Wang

description:
In the future, humanity has successfully left Earth and colonized various star systems, evolving into a new breed of humans who are taller and possess incredibly long lifespans. Meanwhile, Earth, the once-thriving mother planet, has been reduced to a nuclear wasteland due to over development and severe pollution. The original inhabitants still living on Earth now face an average lifespan of just 40 years, leading to widespread discrimination from the new humans. The protagonist is one of these Earth natives, but unlike others who have succumbed to despair, he works hard to become a mechanic even more skilled than the new humans. Just when he thought he could finally live a better life, he is met with betrayal and treated as cannon fodder when the cosmic insect race attacks a human outpost. However, with a burning desire for revenge, the protagonist discovers that he has been reborn as one of the cosmic insects!

(Source: iQIYIi, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Yao Guo Dang Wodi
title.english: I Am An Undercover Agent In The Demon Country

description:
By a twist of fate, Roland is chosen to become an undercover agent, tasked with infiltrating the mysterious demon country to obtain critical intelligence. To stay hidden, he draws close to Bai Ling, a powerful and alluring fox demoness and ends up joining a faction made up entirely of seductive demonesses. As the only man in a world of monsters, temptation, and hidden danger, he walks a razor’s edge between predator and prey. Is he truly the one manipulating the game or is he being devoured by it?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Quanmin Yu Shou: Kaiju Juexing Shenhua Ji Tianfu
title.native: 全民御兽：开局觉醒神话级天赋

description: A soldier reincarnated into another world. Would he be able to reach the top, would he be left behind as others move forward or would his arrogance cause his destruction?

Fang Wanjie took a risk and entered the “door” in order to save money for his girlfriend’s medical expenses. Unexpectedly, the high reward was a trap from the beginning. He was teased, humiliated, and beaten by his companions. He struggled to support himself, but was hunted down by tens of thousands of monsters. , gnaw. On the verge of death, he awakened his talent to save the day. When he was about to leave the ‘door’ to take revenge, he discovered that the key to the ‘door’ had been destroyed and he was trapped in the ‘door’ full of monsters. He wants to live! He wants to fight! He wants to become stronger! Even if he turns into a dead spirit, he will make life worse than death for these bastards!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Fanpai Dadi, Jie Hutian Ming Zhi Zi
title.native: 反派大帝，截胡天命之子

description:
In his past life, Xu Tian was the one and only ultimate villain—betrayed, ganged up on, and brutally killed by countless "chosen ones." Well, if they won’t play fair, don’t blame him for snatching everything they hold dear! Now reborn and bound to the **Interception System**, Xu Tian travels the world hijacking heaven-defying treasures, stealing fate-altering opportunities, and even recruiting those so-called "chosen ones" to farm gold for him. Leering with a devilish, minotaur-like grin, he declares:

“Your little sister is quite lovely… She’s mine now.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zhuansheng Monu Yangcheng Le Shengdian Qishi
title.native: 转生魔女养成了圣殿骑士

description:
Nielis Glarelle wakes up as the feared witch in a revenge novel. Once revered for her magic, she met her end after unleashing destruction on those who exploited her. Given a second chance, she grows weary of hatred and chooses a peaceful, carefree life. Her plans fall apart, however, when she saves Harvey Augusta, the very paladin who killed her. A moment of pity becomes a lifetime of chaos, and now she has one burning question: Why is the once cold and ruthless Harvey so clingy in this life?!

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Xihuan Ye Meiyong, Meiyong Ye Xihuan
title.english: Love You for Who You Are
title.native: 喜欢也没用，没用也喜欢

description:
Song Zhiyang, a college student who temporarily switched majors to pursue a design postgraduate program, meets the model he has always admired. However, he discovers an unwritten curse in the Experimental Arts Department that forbids romantic relationships. As he gets to know aspiring trainees and faces challenges from fans, his bond with the model deepens. Will they be able to break the curse and uncover the truth behind it?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo You Yi Zuo Maoxian Wu

description:
"So Chen Ge started exploring forbidden places to collect materials, incorporating elements from the scenes into his haunted house"

Chen Ge inherited a haunted house from his missing parents, but the business was failing until he stumbled upon a mobile phone while tidying up the haunted house. This changed everything. The haunted house could be repaired or even expanded by completing daily tasks of varying difficulty assigned by the phone. So Chen Ge started exploring forbidden places to collect materials, incorporating elements from the scenes into his haunted house. With visitors screaming in terror, the haunted house quickly became popular. However, as the mission brought more benefits, hidden dangers began to emerge, and even the clues to his parents' disappearance seemed to be related to it...

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Majia Da Lao De Meimei
title.english: Trapped as a Villainous Fake Sister

description:
One minute, she's inheriting a fortune; the next, she's trapped in a twisted rich family drama. And not as a darling, either. She's the villainess who just framed the heroine and turned the story's big bad into her personal blood bank. Basically, she's ticked off everyone. To survive this mess, she's gotta pull a complete 180, win over the heroine, and grovel to the villain. Watch as she goes from scheming brat to devoted little sister, all while trying to avoid a very messy end.

(Source: Webcomics)

When the dust settles, the Elite emerge.

(Source: Official Site)

title.romaji: Qing Ni Lianai Tai Nan Le!
title.english: It's Hard To Make You Fall in Love

description:
"Oh, no! Sounds like a heartbeat…"

A long-time-single fashion designer refuses all kinds of matchmaking! But unexpectedly, a young pup shows up in the middle of the road. ”Take me, Miss! I beg you, please.” "Hey! Don't get so close to me, you big bad wolf!" Can she stay single this time?

(Source: Comikey)

The human world was dominated by unknown terror. To survive, a group of awakened people chose to fight back. Yi Lin, an unlucky guy who hadn't had the chance to be the hero, was betrayed after he managed to kill the final boss. But he gets reborn with the abilities of a villainous boss. The once ordinary man becomes the mortal enemy of countless gods and demons. Hey, you guys over there, it's too late to kneel now.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qian Zhai Yi Wan, Wo Bei Po Chengwei Xieshen Dagong Ren
title.native: 欠债亿万，我被迫成为邪神打工人

description:
Overworked corporate drone Zhou Chen has his soul transmigrated into a magical metropolis—only to inherit the crushing burden of a dying teenager’s hundreds of billions in high-interest debt! As if that weren’t bad enough, the original owner failed to summon an evil god, forcing Zhou Chen to sign a literal indentured contract: he must work for the evil god and fulfill 999 wishes, or face total annihilation—body and soul.

His only lifeline is a talking book known as the “Notebook of the Gods.” Watch how this modern-day grind king survives in a world where strength and capital rule supreme—using corporate survival tactics, insane work ethic, and extreme cultivation to defy fate and rewrite his destiny.

This evil god’s employee? Absolutely not lying flat!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Mori Zaibian, Chongsheng De Wo Rang Quanjia Bian Chengle Da Lao!
title.native: 末日灾变，重生的我让全家变成了大佬！

description:
Reborn into another life, the apocalypse looms! In his previous life, not a single family member survived. This time, Zhou Zhuo refuses to let tragedy strike again! Leading his family, he battles relentless zombies, shelters survivors, expands the Zhou family estate, and builds a self-sufficient stronghold. Together, they fight the undead and help survivors awaken extraordinary powers!

(Source BiliBili, translated)

title.romaji: Jingshenbing Mianqian, Gui Dongxi Suan Ge Qiu
title.native: 精神病面前，鬼东西算个球

description:
Chen Zhuo is a patient at Qingshan Psychiatric Hospital. The system failed to cure him successfully.

System: Let him be. I only provide technical support.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhuang Nainai has returned to the Gu Group. However, her new family demands that she woos and wins the heart of the Dihao Group's CEO, Si Zhengting, with her adoptive mother at stake. Yet, not only was Si Zhengting promised to her in an arranged marriage when they were young, but he was also her first love, five years ago. How will Zhuang Nainai solve Si Zhengting, given their history, while under pressure from her family? Can she see where her heart is leading her?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Shou Shen Jueqi: Chongsheng Wei Guaishou Shenme Gui 2
title.english: Reborn As A Monster 2: Beast God’s Rise
title.native: 兽神崛起：重生为怪兽什么鬼2

description:
Lin Yuan, once a top assassin betrayed and killed by his own organization, is reborn as an ordinary high schooler with the weakest E-Rank Lizard Beast Soul. When he unexpectedly gains the Monster Evolution System, he can evolve his beast soul and earn treasure chests through battles. From then on, Lin Yuan’s rise begins, fighting monsters, conquering realms, and vowing to stand at the very peak of the world!

(Source: Webnovel)

A global mutation occurs, and games descend into reality, unleashing a rampage of magical disasters. To resist all this, everyone must plan their careers and level up frantically. Lin Ye awakens a god-level talent from the start, reversing fate, and starts speed-running top-tier dungeons. Think priests are weak? A single cast of my healing spell might kill you!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

Three years ago, the Supreme Bone was stolen, and Jiang Yu fell to the status of a lowly disciple, spending his days chopping firewood and fetching water, enduring constant scorn. Three years later... “Congratulations, Host, the Supreme Bone has been reborn, and you have awakened the strongest constitution across all worlds!” Upon hearing this, Jiang Yu smashed the carrying pole with a single strike! The system has finally activated!

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

Her Highness the Princess inexplicably became Empress... Her Highness the Princess inexplicably met her end by the executioner's blade... Her Highness the Princess inexplicably reincarnated back to age six... Her Highness the Princess Lv999... This time, Her Highness the Princess will slaughter all in her path! Who says only heroes can restart their lives?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan: Fan Pai Tai Chong Tai Liao Ren

description: Sheng Nuan, a game developer who dies in an accident and has a chance to be resurrected if she completes enough missions. She has to travel to different worlds as a disposable secondary character who has to stop the villains from turning evil. However, she discovers that all these supposedly cold-blooded villains are getting all flirty and trying to seduce her in various ways. She will have to deal with the hilarious and dangerous situations that arise in each world, as well as her own feelings.

In an apocalypse overrun by monsters, where everyone lives in fear… I possess a system that lets me capture them!” “A seductive spider demoness, a city-sized behemoth, even the legendary Black and White Wuchang—all have become my pets!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Shuihu Shijie Zhi Zuiqiang Wu Dalang
title.native: 重生水浒世界之最强武大郎

description:
Ruo Li receives a mysterious gift from his brother, Rou Ji: a severely injured red fox. He tenderly cares for it, which surprisingly transforms into a human once healed. This human, named "Bai Ye" reveals he is a fox spirit training for ascension but was subjected by his master to three earthly trials— resentment, separation, and unfulfilled desires-to achieve celestial transcendence. What Ruo Li doesn't realize is that he is not just Bai Ye's caretaker, but also his destined trial.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

On his 20th birthday, Li Xianyu inherits his father's legacy: a house, some cash, and a magical pearl. Thinking it might grant him powers, he swallows it whole. Instead of becoming a god, he gives birth to his great-grandmother.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Mori Xuanhuan Shijie Wudile
title.native: 我在末日玄幻世界无敌了

description:
In a world overrun with deathwalkers, the factotum disciple, Chen Yuan, accidentally awakens a Universal Extraction System after getting attacked by some lowlifes. The System can extract cultivation, cultivation methods, spirit energy and so on from all non-living things. With the aid of the System, Chen Yuan begins to level up by killing monsters. But unbeknownst to him, hidden behind his ordeals is a giant conspiracy targeted at him...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: My Sexy Legion In The Apocalypse

description:
I might have done wrongdoings, but I'm still a good guy! My priority is to save all these homeless beauties. For the others, the doomsday is like hell, but for me, it is heaven indeed!

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Wo Zhuansheng Jiu Chao Shen, Hai Bian Cheng Xinyun 666 De Tianming Gongzhu
title.english: I Was Reincarnated Into a Super God, but Also Become a Lucky 666 Princess of Destiny
title.native: 我转生就超神，还变成幸运666的天命公主

description:
In the beta test of a video game, the Super God player is forced to turn into a beautiful woman. The beautiful woman also happens to be the Lucky 666 Princess of Destiny. Don't get in my way of becoming a super god!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Kaiju Shenhua Tianfu, Yi Jian Zhan Shen!
title.native: 我开局神话天赋，一剑斩神！

description:
Su Ming was once the world’s number one assassin, a hero who saved billions of his fellow humans and was honored as one of the Ten Great Powerhouses of the Dragon Nation. Yet, he was betrayed by the woman he loved and the brother he trusted, dying with hatred in his heart and buried within the S-class dungeon known as the Death Cavern.

Unexpectedly, he is reborn, returned to his high school days, on the very day of the awakening ceremony. This time, he gains a myth-grade talent upon awakening!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A heroic princess vs an adorable prince, a scheming version of the prince is on the way... Can she reverse her fate after dying for three times?

As a girl from the modern world, I transmigrated to the ancient times and acquired a superpower. You might imagine a story of the invincible female lead in your head, but the story didn't go as you thought. I died at the very beginning of the story! But it's okay, I was given a second chance to be reborn. I fulminated against the royal family, punished the wicked, and conquered the harem! But I met the man who killed me in my last life. In this life, he was so clingy to me...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

In the year 2035, in the modern era of highly developed AI, unemployment has reached a staggering 40%. This has given rise to the virtual game "GOLDGAME," a form of entertainment for the upper class. Winning the game offers a chance to reclaim vast wealth and transform one's life. Unemployed AI researcher Chen Mo, driven by a desire to find his missing sister, survives this cannibalistic game time and again, transforming himself into a god.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A collection of three stories.

Summary of story 1 from Selene Scans:

A light-hearted shoujo that is beautifully presented by a Taiwanese mangaka named Huang Jia Li.

The manga is divided into three episodes: The Myth of the Laurel Tree, The Eden Garden Fantasia, and Midsummer Night's Fantasy.

The Myth of the Laurel Tree:
The story makes references to the story between Apollo and a nymph he met in Greek mythology, although this information is not required to enjoy the it.

Laurel (*hint, hint) and her younger sister are supposed to go to Egypt for another one of her "stone-collecting" vacations.

However, things take an unexpected turn as soon as she meets a young man named Apollo (*hint, hint) who, in many girls eyes, may be too beautiful for words. For example, instead of being on a plane to Egypt, as she originally planned, the plane is hijacked by two odd terrorists to change course to Greece--even though that is already the intended destination!

To makes things even weirder, the two hijackers' names are Cupid and Pan. What's going on?

(Source: MU)

In the early Song Dynasty (AD 960-1127), at the western border of the Tangut Empire - a pivot point of the Silk Road - furious battles were being fought. Brave warriors of the Tangut and a strange religious army from the west battled for a rumoured sacred item. Conflicts, conspiracies, and religious struggles - moving in the heart of the battlefield, the "untouchable war painter" Tao Hui paints nothing but the truth!

The predecessor of Dragon Tiger Gate was originally called Little Rascals, created by Hong Kong comics master Wong Yuk-long. Founded in 1970, he created the brothers Wang Xiaohu and Wang Xiaolong, while Shi Heilong was the protagonist of his other famous comic, Judo Devil Boy. The story begins with Wang Xiaohu, who arrives in Hong Kong from mainland China to search for his family. He befriends four young warriors, then battles a villain, ultimately defeating good, and this cycle continues. This cycle continues until the "Tsuen Wan Fifteen Wolves," where the story begins its long-running arc. The leader of the Tsuen Wan Fifteen, the Great Wolf King, is revealed to be a deadly demon who was a disciple of the Rakshasa Cult, Japan's leading yakuza. This leads to the Rakshasa Cult campaign, with the protagonists breaking out of Hong Kong and embarking on an expedition to Japan. This was a significant breakthrough at the time, and with the 99th issue, Little Rascals officially changed its name to Dragon Tiger Gate. The three emperors, Dragon and Tiger, are each handsome and imposing, captivating countless young women. But most of the beautiful women who admired them met tragic end. True to their beauty, beauty often leads to tragic fates. Today, let's discuss Wang Xiaolong's ill-fated love. Wang Xiaolong was a solitary and impulsive person, and his only true love in life was Yu'er. Yu'er, the daughter of a sword demon, cultivated the Jade Maiden Heart Sutra and Jade Maiden Finger. She fell in love with Wang Xiaolong at first sight and remained devoted to him until her death. Unfortunately, her beauty attracted the coveted Fire Cloud Evil God, who ultimately raped her and committed suicide. Her devotion to Wang Xiaolong is truly admirable! After Yu'er's death, Wang Xiaolong felt almost heartbroken. Coupled with his disfigurement, he suffered from extreme self-esteem and abandoned any desire for romance. Later, in Japan, he met Lingzhi, the daughter of Nangong Yizhi, one of the five great families of the alliance. The two fell in love, but due to complex circumstances, their feelings remained vague and elusive. Later, in an attempt to help Xiaohu regain his power, Lingzhi was forced into marriage by the evil monk Jinzhong, and was subsequently abducted and raped... Wang Xiaolong was very anxious when he learned that Lingzhi had been abducted. It was then that he realized that Lingzhi's position in his heart was no less than Yu'er's. Unfortunately, Lingzhi also followed Yu'er's footsteps...
The main character tries to make a wish of a certain child come true, but she almost breaks his childhood fantasies...

When a devastating meteor struck Earth, Earth's guardian angel Lyu was so tortured by guilt that she killed herself. Mo Ye, the demon who was in love with Lyu, is determined to find her again. Has he found Lyu's reincarnation in the human Xiao Tian Nu?

An old folk legend tells that hideous beings are born out of the union between a woman and a ghost, and are forced into a sad fate of solitude.

In the present, on the shores of China, lies a remote village in extreme poverty where a mysterious young man named Ya San lives. Found abandoned on a beach twenty years ago, he lives just like the rest of the population in fear of a strange disease that makes you avoid the light. Murders, suspicious deaths, incurable diseases and mysterious disappearances. The village has resigned itself to its cursed fate. Ya San wants to make an end to this when his young friend Xiao Hua mysteriously drowns in the canal... He embarks on a risky investigation to the only factory in the area - deep in the heart of the Forbidden Zone - where he discovers the unspeakable.

"Ya San" is a story that combines old Chinese legends and folktales, the environment, fantasy and science-fiction into one. "Ya San" ventures deep into the human soul.

(Source: Gantz_Waitingroom)
A strange reunion, a strange toy store, a life-changing night...

Kuini and Yilou must travel to Tyzzer, an unknown village, to prevent a nameless threat, or the world will end in 80 days. Along the way, they team up with the apprentice artist Lang, who is also traveling to Tyzzer to find the mythical dragons. The way to Tyzzer is filled with danger, mystery, mischief, and… fatal hilarity.

Will they ever get to their destination?

Follow the man with hat in his undefined travels... Where does he go? He does not really know himself, but every place he crosses gives him the opportunity to meet different people, each of them looking for happiness, love, or simply himself. A set of intimist short stories, painted by these young Chinese girl with an amazing style, full of colours.

Volume 1: Tonglei (同类, Similiar)
 1. Wuhou (午后, Afternoon)
4. Chuxia (初夏, Early Summer)
5. Xiatian (夏天, Summer)
4. Tonglei (同类, Similiar)
5. MY WAY (MY WAY, MY WAY)

Volume 2: Midland de Chenxing (米特兰的晨星, Midland's Morning Star)

A bustling city, crowded streets... But always would the night fall... And when it does, in those dark corners, who is staring out unnervingly? Who is laughing hauntingly? How many secrets, how many tears are silently echoing in this endlessly lonely void?

Source: Manga Updates

In the late 90's, in China, Tu Xiaoyi, an high school student, takes no interest in marks and prefers to play video games with his friend nicknamed "Peanut." One day, he was chosen by his teacher to become the class representative with Yao Zhetian, a very cute girl. He will experience his first love and disappointments.

The series follow the adventures of Ho-nam (Andy) Chan in his triad life, from being a mere 49er (the lowest position in a gang) to being promoted to a Red Pole (enforcer) within three years, to finally being the Dragon Head (leader) of the Hung Hing Gang. It explores the deep bonds of loyalty and brotherhood in underground Chinese society, and has since been a trademark in defining Hong Kong culture.

In 2012, marking the 20th anniversary of this manhua, the main character Ho-nam Chan ranked 15 out of the 24 Classic Comic Characters of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong Avenue of Comic Stars and a (shirtless) monument of him is up in Kowloon Park.

An ordinary tour has become a nightmare in the city. The endless death, the endless madness, the horrible memories, the black past, the cold water pool... In the darkness, who is watching the beings?

(Source: MangaToon)
Lighthearted stories of stick figures (until the plot kicks in).

Live-streaming is the new, popular creative outlet for young women, and it seems like an easy way to become famous. In front of the camera, these internet celebrities may appear cute and innocent while making a good living. But behind the scenes, there are many stories that nobody knows…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

It's a story about snatching and bully. Her aunt brought a daughter to seek shelter in her family, but it turned out her cousin sister shared the same father with her and even snatched her lover. It's a story about rebirth and revenge. After rebirth with her previous memory, she intended to take revenge on every one who hurt her in the last life.

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Includes 8 extra chapters

Tong Qian lost her family when she was very young, and the same person kept showing up in her dreams in the following ten years. Is it fate? Or just a part of a bigger secret? The gentle boy from her dream, the indifferent foster brother, and the frank colleague from the police force, which one would be the love of her life?

(Source: Web Comics)

Includes 2 extra chapters

An Emotionless and strange girl named Yuejin, whose adopted parents went missing one years ago, only left a name card as a clue. Yuejin determined to find her parents by approaching Yan Shen whose name in that name card. However, a ghost who claimed to be her loyal servant of Yuejin popped up from her balcony begging to stay wither her. What life would Yuejin have with this cheeky ghost and a talk cat as pet? Would she meet her parents again?

(Source: MangaToon)

The story begins with the marriage of Qing Wu and Jing Yu.
At the end of the ceremony, Li Huo arrives, pretending to be Qing Wu's husband.
To understand the situation, let's go back 20 years, the day Qing Wu was sent to find work by her adoptive mother, deeming her too lazy.
She returns hired as a sky sweeper for Jing Yu ... but wouldn't she have other hidden talents ...?

(Source: QQ, translated)

Tong Xi met her childhood playmate Nan Yi when she was back in town, but what had happened in childhood has made them strangers. All the smiles, pains, secrets and the delicate love that we’ve experienced during adolescence are also happening right in this beautiful small town...

(Source: WebComics, edited)

title.romaji: Good Luck, Demon King The Millennium Chapter

description:
The Demon King Franwoids (Xiao Fu) decided to teach magic to Salamander who is the Great Mage of humans.
This series is about 1000 years prior to the season 1 of Good luck, Demon King!

When he was sent to another world, he just wanted to be the Hero so he could easily pick up girls. But he was bamboozled by a black-hearted angel. He got his wish to have all sorts of beautiful women throw themselves at him. But he wanted to be able to get it on with those women, he didn't want to be transformed into a loli! And he didn't ask to be involved with all that troublesome plot, either! Why is this so hard!!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Saturn's Toy Shop is a place in the city for exorcists to purify earthbound spirits. Jiang Xiaoya is an ordinary girl, except she has the ability to see earthbound spirits. Gu Yu is a gaming prodigy but a hopeless navigator, and he is also a "spirit exorcist." These two are destined to meet at the mysterious Saturn's Toy Shop…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: I Would Rather You Destroy the Earth

description:
The different-dimensional demon king invaded the earth and encountered the greatest natural enemy-human Shen Xia! Shen Xia said: Who can tell himself what the hell is that black dumpling with tentacles! ? Devil: Stupid earthlings, it is your blessing to be regarded by me! Shen Xia: Get out!

(Source: INKR)

Zhang Gong is a little apprentice pharmacist from Mount Shu. One day he entered the mountain to gather herbs and met an Immortal Hero who was slaying a demon. He accidentally got involved in a demonic battle. After going through a soul-stirring adventure, he finds out about his hidden background, and thus becomes embroiled in the strife of the Three Realms.

(Source: MangaToon)

An accidental encounter during his childhood made the newly coronated emperor unable to forget the sorcerer he met, A'Luo. When they meet again, can the youthful emperor capture A'Luo's heart? A beautiful fantasy romance is unrolling.

Jiang Jiusi, a strong female general, woke up to find that she had changed into a beautiful woman. Faced with the emperor's favor, she only wants to fight on the battlefield, defending the country. But she is not as strong as she used to be; so how could she possibly fight?

(Source: INKR)

On the eve of her wedding, Bai Qiandu received word of her fiancé, Zhongli's death. This shocking revelation turned Qiandu's life on its head and she learns from others that he suffered from severe depression. Was it an accident that Zhongli died or pre-mediated suicide? In order to uncover the true circumstances behind Zhongli's death, Qiandu sets out on a journey to retrace his steps. And the unexpected truth she ends up finding out is...

A bright young girl fell for the boy with silver hair after being saved by him. But when they meet again years later, the boy is no longer the kind, angelic person he once was. To others, he is awfully selfish. What will happen after the girl comes back into his life?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and one extra.

title.romaji: Huai Huai Mei Qi Tian Tian Chong

description:
Her meticulous machinations got her in bed with Yan Beitang, said to be the most dangerous man in the imperial capital - all in the name of revenge, to make the man who murdered her mother and younger sister pay the price. And yet, the man said to be cold and aloof started to cling to her.

"When are you going to marry me, Jun Siluo? I don't mind that you're using me."

(Source: Webcomics)

RanK is a popular idol group in the country, RON(Qiu ChenYu) goes with the handsome-cool-guy route, but KIMI(Yu Lang) is set up as a noisy comic character. However, Yu Lang’s real character is not like that. His childhood friend Ying Yue always watches him silently from behind, hoping her best friend can break through this situation as soon as possible...

title.english: A Proper Lady Taken as Wife

description:
When the innocent young lady tang youer accidentally barges in the commander cheng hanyu’s blind date, she instantly becomes his romantic target.With not much effort, she is taken as his wife, but good days never last for long, after being deserted by hanyu, tang youer learns what life is truly about and becomes a real proper lady. One day she comes back with a lovely daughter…

(Source: Mangatoon)

During the Wu Zhou dynasty, peasant Chen Shi went to the capital Luo Yang in search of his brother, but accidentally became the servant to vice chairman of the Da Li Shi (supreme court). This vice chairman is a giant cat that can speak. Through him, Chen Shi meets different public servants of the Da Li Shi and creates a bizarre tale with the vice chairman.
A die-hard fan of a game climbed into the Boss's bed through a guide.

After Pangu created the sky, the overflowing divine power spilled into the world and formed divine weapons, becoming instruments of bloody conflict in the underworld. The arrows that shoot through walls, the umbrella that summons giant whales, and the spear that can turn a snowy mountain into a lake of lava... Li Cangsang and his son must defeat the masters who possess these powerful weapons, in order to find his family's true enemies and break the centuries-old family curse.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

After losing his wife Yusheng, Heling was utterly devastated.

But somehow he found a girl who is a mirror image of Yusheng, but has the memories of someone named Wenning. Even worse, some guy who claims to be her childhood sweetheart hangs out around her everyday nonstop!

How will Heling find his way back into her memories again?

And how will he find the girl he loved before?

A magician, a female doctor, a gangster, an archaeology professor, a policewoman, a drug dealer, a businessman... Such a random group of people find themselves trapped on a desolate island when they wake up from sleep one day. They are surrounded by primitive tribes, mutant viruses, and countless life and death situations on this mysterious island. What will they do to survive and escape?

A girl is afraid of confessing her feelings to the boy she likes until she finds a book called "Love Practice" in a mysterious shop. Using the book, the girl creates a confession look-alike in order to practice love...

As two girls with completely different personalities meet each other, their share of interests resulted in them coming together. However, both of them face a hard journey ahead by being in different cities and having difficult parents...

After moving into her new home, college senior Eva Qiao finds a stray cat in her basement. Rusty is your normal kitty boy. He sleeps a lot, purrs when pet, and he's also a half-human hybrid?! Abandoned by his owner as a failed experiment, Eva decides to adopt him and quickly learns she’s going to need more than nine lives to handle him.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Wo Yuanlai Shi Ge Bing Jiao

description:
Just before his wedding, the tyrannical CEO, Yun Gu, died in a car accident caused by his best friend. His soul reincarnated in LingXi Tang, the youngest daughter of the Tang family who'd died at a young age over 10 years ago. He must use his new identity to protect his teenage self, investigate the reason behind his best friend's backstabbing behavior, and expose his wife-to-be's true personality.

(Source: WebComics)

Qin Ze only wanted to be a quiet handsome man, but unfortunately he was transformed into a cross-dresser by his sister who spares no effort to entrap him! He thought that this misplaced life would end soon, unexpectedly, his peaceful university life was turned upside down by her elder sister... Facing the various unspoken rules of the entertainment world, what will be Qin Ze's reactions?

(Source: WebComics)

Cong Li is a world-famous screenwriter and superstar actor Ming Gu is her superhot husband…in her dreams that is. In reality, Cong is just a poor college student who ghost writes manuscripts without receiving any credit. After a long night writing, she wakes up the next morning…in Ming’s body?! With control of Ming’s body, Cong has money, fame, and the ability to accomplish her wildest dreams. Just one problem: Ming has control of Cong’s body too. Slowly sabotaging each other’s lives, they have to work together: with Ming as Cong’s assistant. And they say this kind of stuff only happened in the movies…

(Source: Tapas)

An irreparable painting and a young auxilium whisk an archeology major into the fantastical world of deities who protect culture. "If everything about you disappears, then let me be the last one to remember you."

(Source: WeComics)

Xu Wang belongs to the secret top combat force of the Z country-the Snow Wolf team, being the only one who maintains 100% win rate in the history of the Snow Wolf team, he was given the title of Snow Wolf, which was an exception. After retiring, Xu Wang was forced to be the fiance of the perfect female president Bai Feifei, who, however, looked down on him. Let's see how Xu Wang will rule the world and start an extraordinary life as a single soldier!

(Source: WebComics)

Sally was just a normal girl who enjoyed skipping classes and eating late night snacks with her best friend... Until the time came for her to save the world!

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Senior Brother, Please Act According to the Script

description:
Suddenly transmigrating into deep forest, only to run into a superstar actor?! Wait, isn't this the plot of the TV drama that I just watched?

Wang Xiaoyu, an ordinary girl who loves watching TV dramas, found herself crossing into the world of the TV show. Now she's accidentally messed up the plot progression and caught the attention of the protagonists…

Wait! Senpai! Please follow the original script!

(Source: Tencent, translated))

Step into the wild terrain, where nature blazes with fervor! Picture this: two souls, worlds apart, cross paths on the untamed savannah of Africa. What epic saga will they script amidst Africa's pulsating heart?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ni Suo Bu Zhidao de Wo

description:
"Some thoughts can't be spoken, so we can only let them rot in our hearts and bear it alone." Faced with a repressed life, debt that falls upon him out of nowhere, and the confused feelings between two teenagers... How will the youthful them face all of this? This is the other side of youth, the story you don't know.

Childhood friends Seyun and Yoojin struggle to maintain their friendship as their lives take them down different paths. But when old feelings start resurfacing, a bitter tug-of-war starts, with hearts in the balance, secrets in the closet, and twists that nobody sees coming!

While out shopping, Mo Xiaoxia runs into her high school sweetheart, Lin Han, on the street. A series of chaotic yet heart-racing memories slowly begins to surface in Mo Xiaoxia's mind -- the story of the two girls.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Duibuqi Wo Chou Dao Ni le
title.english: Sorry if My Ugly Face Offends You

description:
Yi Feng is a diligent girl in her studies on science and engineering, and a person who believes in the power of ones own strength. Until one day, she could suddenly see that everyone had a score on their heads, and this score seemed to be related to the value of ones beauty. Finally, Yi Feng, who was able to distinguish between beauty and ugliness, found out that all kinds of troubles come with being ugly. Then, a male beauty appeared in front of her. Will he be the start of Yi Feng’s new hope? But this path to becoming a CEO goddess and marrying Gao Shuaifu does not seem to be an easy one…

(Source: Manga Bilibili, translated)

I tried so hard to graduate from college. Now you are telling me that i have to relive my high school life! And do everything all over?! Heavy homework, a lover that doesn't love me, troublesome puberty... Hey, leave that boy alone, I'm his real wife!!!

(Source: WeComics)

Chen Jiayan received news on her birthday that she was diagnosed with a terminal illness. Later, she witnessed a car accident that caused the death of her sister. After losing everything, she stepped on the path of revenge - to destroy her enemy's life. It turns out that her enemy is…

(Source: Web Comics)

There's an ancient saying in the Great Ruins, a place abandoned by the Gods, "Don't go outside when it's dark". In Great Ruins, the old, ill, weak, and disabled elders of Disabled Elderly Village picked up an infant by the riverside and named him Qin Mu. They raised him up with blood and sweat. That day, when the night fell and the darkness shrouded the Great Ruins, Mu left home...

"Be a villain undulating in the spring breeze!" The Blind told him. This marks the beginning of Qin Mu's journey of becoming a villain!

(Source: Webnovel)

Xiao Yiyan, a bad boy, always fought with others. One day when he faced a lot of gangsters, he failed and tried to escape, but met a female ghost by chance…

(Source: Webnovel)

It is another beautiful day, yet Zheng Lang, son of the strongest Fighter Zheng Long, time-travels to another world and becomes an ant, or rather a king of several hundred ants. Skilled in martial arts, he ropes in Rodent King and Crow King as his sidekicks and apprentices himself to a Demigod Summoner. The Divine Artifact obtained and the Divine Beast's blood awakened, Zheng Lang is leading his underlings to evolution from pissants.

(Source: Webnovel)

Godly Figurines descend, and those who obtain the figurines will obtain the power of the gods! This is a story of a young boy who has death premonitions. After obtaining the weakest Shrimp Soldier figurine, he climbs towards the summit step by step!

(Source: Webnovel)

A nuclear explosion resulted in the awakening of the mutants, unfolding the exciting story of fighting for peaceful coexistence!

(Source: Webnovel)
