Above the Jia Kong mainland, a dragonborn young girl appeared. Possessing the ability to manipulate the elements, her body contains a mysterious form of power - Heat Haze's Breath. This power doesn't just reduce her life to a mere two years, it also causes her loved ones to be afflicted by various diseases! In order to change her fate, she embarks on a journey, a dangerous one that will take over a year, but what will happen on this journey? Will she find the solution she's looking for?

(Source: Webnovel)

A lively girl, Tao XiaoYao has traveled through time and become a runaway bride of the cruel Prince Regent. However, her attempt to runaway is stopped by the Prince, and she is sent to the royal academy to be disciplined. Why am I the only consort that needs to be disciplined while other consorts are pampered? As someone who slacks in her studies, Tao XiaoYao complains about her fate. Nevertheless, she knows she must conquer both her studies and her love life.

(Source: Coolmic)

At the height of the Ming Dynasty, Beijing seemed like a prosperous city by day. But in the darkness of the night, creatures of ancient myth like demons, fairies, ghosts and monsters appear, mixed amongst mortals. The reappearance of the Potion of Immortality has drawn out the gods, demons and even the royal guards... And the young girl Min Ruyue, carrying the secret of the potion, is caught in the fight for the potion between heaven and earth. Is the sudden appearance of a companion beside her a friend or foe? Will she be able to control her own destiny?

(Source: Manman Comics, translated)

The former general of the nation who is now a wanted man accidentally falls into a trap set by a hunter long ago. Wait! Isn't the hunter the little angel who always stayed with him before? The angel has turned into a cruel man and uses his means to convert the former strongest Alpha to an Omega with a sweet pheromone a day after they meet again. Xia Yusheng: "Qi Wangzhi, I swear I will kill you!"

(Source: Webnovel)

A young Chinese woman moves to Paris and finds herself confronted with a culture that's foreign to her. Accompanied by two friends, one French and the other Japanese, she discovers the City of Light, the city of arts and love, which becomes the peaceful backdrop for reflections on differences, life, and youth.

(Source: Urban China, translated)

A muscular boy who grew up deep in the mountains thought he had finally found love in high school. She's beautiful and popular, too! But the reality wasn't as simple as the muscle-head boy thought...

(Source: Dongman, translated)

The helpless woman became a feared mercenary, then she was transported back in time to face her wicked relatives. This time she won't be bullied so easily and she'll finally have her revenge! But as she drove off those "wolves", the change of fate brings along an even more dangerous "tiger"!

(Source: QQ, translated)

Since ancient times whoever inherits the divine power would inherit the world. But who would have thought that one day the Divinity Clan would be wiped out and the divine powers passed on to a girl? Thus, a female emperor ascended the throne to rule and protect the world. Surrounded by people who always spoke flattering words, yet harbored ill intent, and constantly faced with the skepticism the people who were supposed to be close to her - how can a woman stand such hardship? How will this female Emperor deal with this unjust and patriarchal society?

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua)

The ‘Sleeping Beauty’ who falls asleep during the day is not just the princess, but also the immortal witch who tried to curse the princess. The witch, Chen Xi, has been punished by God to sleep during the day, to wake up only when night falls. In order to break the curse, she and a young man will collect light. As their collection increases, the reasons for Chen Xi's punishment by God are gradually revealed.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Bu Chi Tiandian Jiu Hui Si

description:
Just one day without sweets will cause my heart to become weaker to the point of nearly stop beating; until I met someone who could help my vitality last stronger and longer ーa patissier named Xia Shi! But after his girlfriend's death, he wouldn't make desserts anymore and opened a café instead, selling the bitterest coffee ever. So, to save my own life, I'll have to make him return to making desserts again! Please, oh please...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Fourteen-year-old Little Mo was bullied and called Godzilla by her classmates. Many years later, Mo realizes that life cannot be changed. What happens, happens. The things she had cared about when she was fourteen make herself look childish in her own eyes, and have become something to laugh at. The things that made her sad and hurt when she was fourteen still invoke a dull ache in her heart today. By reading the notebook of fourteen-year-old little Mo, the Mo of present-day begins to speak and console herself silently. This is a story about growing up and how children become adults.

Luo Luo lost her memory in a jarring car accident, but she was rescued by something not quite human. Her fantastical journey so begins...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A new neighbor in the haunted house next door? He's actually a mangaka who doesn't have to do homework... The girl with the overactive imagination couldn't hold back her curiosity any longer and rushes straight into a place where her dream begins! There are manuscripts on the floor, ink splattered everywhere, and oversized bug-eyes. Oh my god! From now on, the young girl and the overworked mangaka will go on a wild journey together in pursuit of their dreams!

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

The vast steam continent contains seven intelligent species and six major civilizations. After a mining accident killed her adopted father, the human girl Arno and her companion Bu found an ancient artifact in the abyss. As she embarks on a journey for the truth, covetous eyes will be watching her: The bird country filled with hidden dangers, the cat country sealed by ice, the rabbit country shook by political crisis, and the lion country troubled by drought... Where will be the end of Arno's journey?

(Source: U17, translated)

On the battlefield where the Shang Dynasty confronted the barbarians, a female general who had just won victory was accidentally bitten by a demon, and she will be faced with a story of everlasting love and vengeance.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

She's a human girl who became a spiritual fox. This little fox cultivates herself into a human, and slowly conquers the heart of a handsome man from the past! What's going on with that stern-faced Prince, anyway? He thinks our little fox friend eats too much and has gotten too chubby – but maybe that's his thing? That's ridiculous - she's got a temper too, you know! See how this modern girl, who was transformed into an imperial spiritual fox, cultivates herself to a higher level and stands tall as a fox spirit!

(Source: WebComics)

A catastrophe known as “Data Crash” struck the earth in 2020. Survivors rule the game, and losers are erased. Jacob Wei, a senior player, happened to fail despite surviving many rounds. Surprisingly, he was taken back to the beginning of the crash and was reborn with the incredible Self-Destruction System. Now he earns points from his stupid acts, triggering self-destruction in order to be reborn. Each revival makes him stronger. Thus unfolds the story about how he starts over and makes his way to the top.

It’s not good to have too many vices. You may not know this, but there’s a limit to the vices you can commit. Once you’ve exceeded that limit… You’ll be labeled by the system as a “sinner” and receive punishment from the supervisors!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Chounü Qiyue: Lie Huo Chunqing Yao Shao
title.native: 丑女契约：猎获纯情妖少

description:
Luo Jinmian, an ordinary-looking high school student, accidentally made a contract with the domineering but meticulous Book spirit, Ba. In order to obtain freedom, Ba put in a lot of effort to fulfil Luo Jinmian's wish. However, Luo Jinmian always refused to say her wish. After experiencing all sorts of things, the love between the two of them gradually appeared…

(Source: MangaToon)

Dayan's richest woman, Wen Jiu, struggled her entire life to make her fortune. However, she was betrayed by a devious childhood friend, which cost her both her money and her life. When she woke up, she found herself back at 15 years old again, just as an old enemy was coming to claim her for marriage with his fifth brother! Knowing that the handsome man in front of her will one day become the powerful regent, Wen Jiu decided to play nice with him: I'll make money to support our family, elder brother please be at ease!

But in the bedroom on her wedding night Wen Jiu was stunned to find... elder brother? What are you doing here in the wedding chamber!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Time Travel: The Mighty Crown Princess

description:
Zhou Mengdie, a taekwondo student, has been around by bad luck recently. Accidentally, she travels back to ancient times and becomes Qin Yidong, the daughter of the Grand Preceptor. The next day she is dragged into the palace to for the imperial concubine selection... This Qin Yidong knows nothing about music, chess, calligraphy or painting, so she has to split bricks in public. But because of this, the prince thinks she is silly with no threat, so he selects her to be the crown princess. After getting married, they ignore each other until the prince finds that this woman may come from the same place as his mother who has disappeared years ago...

(Source: Tapread)

title.english: The Phoenix in a Turbulent World

description:
Phoenix rises in turbulent ages. As a famous and clever doctor in the precarious Zhou Dynasty, Qiu Xiluo met two lords and was involved in endless bloodshed. Yan Lang, a gentle and powerful marquis, although never stopped fighting for his kingdom, was willing to die for protecting her. Song Si-ren, a handsome and unrestrained young master of Han Kingdom with great aspiration, went through all the hardships and dangers. When they fought against each other and had to choose between love and power, who could be her knight?

(Source: Webnovel)

She is the most respected daughter of prince Rong yet she is so timid and weak that every one can humiliate her. But a strong soul of a female killer from the modern time takes control of her body and everything begins to change…she takes revenge on those who bullied her not only because she is powerful enough but also that she has the most wealthy man at her back…

(Souce: Mangatoon)

Accused of seducing cruel tycoon Gu Moyan and using him to gain fame, third-rate model Su Nian’an was warned never to show her face before Gu Moyan again. Despite the injustice behind the accusation, Su Nian’an was determined to avoid Gu Moyan at all cost. The Universe, however, had other ideas. By some cruel twist of fate, Su Nian’an ran into the tycoon at a dinner party. What would become of Su Nian’an? Would she face the dire consequences of a crime she’d never even committed? Or would she be able to thaw the cold heart of Gu Moyan and change her life forever?

I'm an outstanding white-collar worker called Zhao Tianqi. I got poisoned after going back in time. I even had to become a weird man's concubine. Alas, forget it.

When I get the chance, I will try my best to show you how smart I am. Besides excellence in work, I can also handle the harem issue. If I play my cards right, I can turn from a concubine into the mistress.

Become a concubine in another world? Her target is of course to get divorced and become single again.

(Source: Webcomics)

A sudden blizzard swept over the earth. What should have been a blazing hot summer has turned into extreme winter cold. Everywhere, it looked like the end of the world. Even worse, fearsome and deadly creatures hide beneath the thick snow... they are the Snowmen...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Paohui Nüpei Gai Zenmeban
title.native: 穿成炮灰女配该怎么办

description:
A girl is treated like an outcast because of a prophecy. After an injury, she awakened memories of a past life as an office worker, and she decided to leave behind her original family to find someone more worthy of her love. But her twin sister was still bound by the prophecy to stay with her original family for life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Lang Yu Hu De Lianai Gonglüe

description:
The fierce and powerful carnivore Fu Hualan has a secret, she has a crush on the gentle and reliable herbivore Shi Zitian. But her secret is discovered by the arrogant loudmouth Li Heilang!

"If you want me to keep the secret, you better do what I say..."

Looks like Fu Hualan's school life won't be so peaceful now! Will she be able to succeed in her studies and love, too? Come to the animal academy see a different kind of love among the beasts!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Monika, the eldest daughter in Viscount Wodehouse’s family, inherited her Indian mother’s exotic beauty and combined with her good manners, made her greatly admired amongst the local aristocrats. But unbeknownst to all, the proper lady Monika has a secret identity as a writer of erotica! During a charity ball after the end of the Great War, a certain someone appeared to turn her life upside-down, and Monika was dragged into the murder case of an aristocrat. In order to protect all that she cherished, Monika will have to track down the clues and unravel the conspiracy to find the truth behind the death of a baron!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Shi Renlei, Geng Shi Xixiegui
title.english: I’m a Human, but More So a Vampire

description:
With the arrival of a mysterious pair of “Teeth”, the chosen “Human Vampire” was born. After wrongfully killing his biological mother, he was beheaded by his own father, a Punisher. When it seemed like things have come to an end, the cold and wretched nightmares of this world had only just began…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Does he love me? But he doesn't even know who I really am. The closer I am to him, the bigger chance to expose everything I'm hiding. I'm going to break his heart; I know the risks, but I can't force myself to stay away. Will we lose it all when I reveal what's beneath this mask?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zhengjiu Shijie De Hua Xuyao Henduo Mengmeng Da
title.native: 拯救世界的话需要很多萌萌哒

description:
Super cute sister and brother got transported to the magic world to save mankind?!
Down in the depths of the parallel world outside of Earth, there were twelve magic seals sealing away ancient demons. One day, the twelve magic fairies guarding the seals were trapped and badly hurt by the evil vassal king. The king even cursed the fairies and turned them into babies with hardly any magic. Only by finding twelve children selected by fate could the fairies regain their powers and save the world. The story begins here...

(Source: Webcomics, edited)

title.romaji: Wo De Tudì Shì Zhi Zhu

description:
After wishing on a falling star that she wanted to become a cute piggy girl, who would've thought Ye Chu would really become a pig?! In order to return to her human form, she tread the immortal pathway and became the disciple of an outstanding master. Then, she lived a carefree life by relying on cute coquetry and shamelessness? Tsk, how can life be this carefree...

(Source: WebComics)

When he opened his eyes one day, Yuyu found that he had entered a strange game world filled with monsters, and if you die, your death is broadcast live. To survive, you must beat the game. Fortunately, Yuyu meets the game's cold-mannered god, Yunze. Caring more about his life than his image, Yuyu clings to Yunze for help.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The couple who were deeply in love cut off their relationship and became strangers. Ten years later, when they met each other again, one of them was promoted to a scheming and ruthless general from a nobody, the other one was reduced to a humble slave from a noble Crown Prince. What happened ten years ago to Ji Ning entirely? He loves Bai Qingyan deeply yet hates him in the meantime.

(Source: Webnovel)

You Zhao, OMEGA, rose-like appearance, hot pepper-like personality, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives himself an injection when he is in heat. Qu Jing, ALPHA, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, sandalwood-like fragrance, black ink-like heart, workplace elite, young CEO, born with too high a concentration of pheromones, afraid of losing control, carries inhibitors with him every day, and gives an injection to anyone who is in heat. You Zhao and Qu Jing, usually spend 99% of their time and energy on work, not love but money. Until one day, they got married.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Guai Ge Guizu Shaoye Dang Nanyou
title.english: Cajole a Childe Into Being My Boyfriend

description:
Saint Vincent High School, which has always been known as the Nunnery, suddenly got two super handsome boys transferring in at the same time! After accidentally discovering their secret, Le Taotao formed a weird relationship with them on the first day of school. But she was just trying to teach them a lesson, what's with the heartfelt confessions?! And proposing marriage, too?!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

With her intimidating looks, people often treat Ji Xiongxiong like a delinquent gang member, when she was just a poor girl and a big softie. One day, trying to make some extra money, she got involved with Ling Ruobai, the school prince. Ling Ruobai has been cursed since childhood to occasionally fall asleep and his soul randomly attached to a nearby item. To help protect him and his secret, Ji Xiongxiong was recruited to become Ling Ruobai’s personal bodyguard, and hijinks ensued...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Lady Yang Is In The Special Forces

description:
A special forces soldier has transmigrated into the body of Lady Yang, destined for greatness on the Imperial throne! Her future husband, Li Longji, is actually a devastatingly handsome and clever man, despite his young age. Watch as the couple plays the fool to gain advantages. Their goal? To have the Great Tang Dynasty wrapped around their fingers.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

She was a prim top student in her previous life, and her best friend is a skank who stole her man. After being reborn, she's still the top student, but this time she will become a beautiful woman! She will get the man she couldn't get in her previous life!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Laogong Wo Yao Chi Kua Ni!
title.english: Honey, I Want to Eat Up Your Money!

description:
Only kids should have to choose! I'm going to eat my fill and have my man, too!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zui Qingai De Liu Yu'an

description:
Yu Xingchui got rich overnight because she inherited money from one of her relatives, so she bought a luxury flat, and she found out that Liu Yuan, the real estate agent who sold her the flat, is living next door to her. She hates the man she has to run into every day, but she didn't expect this man to have another identity. When fate always makes you meet someone you hate, do you fight with it or compromise?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

To save her father from financial ruin and escape jail time, Chu Ci was forced to marry Helian Lanruo, the weak and sickly young master of the Helian family. Rumor has it that his life hangs in the balance and that he could kick the bucket at any time. Some even said that the young master is impotent. Despite being married, Chu Ci is a living like a widow. Helian Lanruo is the husband who disappears during the day and only comes to bed late at night...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Xu Ni Yichang Fan Hua Si Jin

description:
When I first met Ge Yan, I ran away in embarrassment and didn't dare say anything about what had happened. The next time I saw Ge Yan, I forced him to marry me in exchange for my kidney. Since then, our destiny was tied to each other. When one of us took the initiative in the relationship, the other will take a step back. I refused to be the loser in this relationship and in the end, I won his heart.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Shentou Wangfei: Wojia Wangye Re Bu Qi
title.english: Princess of Thieves: Don't Mess With My Prince
title.native: 神偷王妃：我家王爷惹不起

description:
She is a master thief from the modern century who transmigrated into the body of the useless daughter of the Prime Minister's first wife! Since she died in her previous life, she is determined to make them experience a crushing defeat in this life! "I've lost my memories? What a joke. I'll blind you with my dazzling wit and courage! I'll fight the Prince of Chen, defeat the Crown Prince, and make them all bow and kiss my feet! Do I really look like a useless thing to you, Second and Third Sister? The most beautiful man, the powerful god of war, was humiliated by a gay man who even touched his...'thing'? Don't you dare run away. I will catch you even if I have to scour heaven and earth!"

(Source Bilibili Comics)

The tea people from Pentagram are the main life forces of the eighth nebula and have a history of over 3,000 years. Invaded by the Insects, the various races united amidst the chaos of war and revitalized the Tea Kingdom. The protagonist, Coleen, is a young girl with the attribute of a Millennial Tea Person among the young generation in the kingdom. Can she lead the tea leaf girls of the new generation in bringing more life force to the Tea Kingdom and get the opportunity to live in harmony with the different planets and races...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

I now pronounce you... roommates?!

Wedding planner Muran has finally moved into her own apartment, but she gets so swept up in the excitement that she ends up spending all her money on decorations. Now, she finds herself in desperate need of a roommate. What will happen when her coworker suggests her younger brother, Sachung?

(Source: Manta)

The mysterious witch doctor of the East reemerges!

A masterful witch doctor, Sun Dawei, comes down from the mountains to adopt a new life in the modern world. He has no ambitions, but just wants his family to live a healthy and happy life and for himself to make a living out of treating patients. Troubles, however, keep coming his way. Let's see how this "wolf in sheep's skin", through all the temptations and hardships, makes witch medicine great again.

Beautifully-drawn series with a feel-good story about a gigantic loser's counterattack!

(Source: INKR)

Jun Aofeng, the top female cultivator, was reborn into the body of the betrayed and murdered daughter of the Feng family. Her identity stolen by her maid, she will show them what a real lady can do. She'll have revenge on all those who betrayed her, while breaking a few kneecaps in the process! Just as she finally earned everyone's respect, she ran into the prince who is just as strong as her. What will happen when they butt heads?

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

In her previous life, Yi Ruoshui, born in a rich family, was a typically obedient girl who was fond of music and adept at playing piano. At that time, being an innocent and unsophisticated girl, she never doubted anybody, nor did she ever guard against her friends or lover, which, however, brought her only constant disasters. Many years later, being blindsided again, Yi Ruoshui died in the fire, with the help of death, she was reborn and returned to the day of the piano competition. Just like the nirvana of phoenix, Yi Ruoshui achieved her own nirvana — mature and intelligent. She plays her own cards right and steps on a road of revenge which is filled with love, hatred, happiness and sadness.

(Source: Webcomics)

The great demoness Bai Youling lost control of her powers on her wedding day, and had to be put down by her lover with a sword through her heart. She found herself reborn into the body of the spoiled daughter of the Bai family. Now she'll fight back against those who betrayed her, as she tries to regain her cultivated powers, even if she has to become a disciple of her former lover. Just wait, all you fake do-gooders. "Especially you, Xu Xiyuan, as I will make you feel what it's like to die by your lover's hand!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Hei! Buyao Dong Wo De Nailuo
title.native: 嘿! 不要动我的奶酪

description:
Xie SiZhe was once everything for Bai Xi, she could do anything for him. However, his betrayal ruined her whole family…Time-traveling to the past, how can she rewrite her life and take revenge? And is the little fatty who always pays for her silently her true love?

(Source: Mangatoon)

This story takes place in the Alstrauss Empire, where humans and demons are sworn enemies, ever at war with each other. The protagonist, Ninita, is the daughter of the land’s ruler, Lord Hunt. An innocent girl with outstanding magical talents, the people hope she will become the Saint Priestess, a powerful human guardian the likes of which haven’t been seen in a millennium. However, she ended up falling in love with Jeff, a wolf demon, and next in line to become the king of his people.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

An unlucky girl tangled with curses is secretly in love with the prom king. When the "lord angel" she waited for ages finally came to her, he took her first kiss and is interested in floating in the air and tearing her sheets! Is it "gene mutation"?

(Source: Mangatoon)

Treacheries, lies and humiliation, no one knows what she’s been through. She thought she was in her worst nightmare, but it was just a beginning. Nightmares came one after another and the world seemed so unreal… Will fate break her heart again?

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Chun Bai De Mingyun Zhi Lun

description:
Thousands of years ago, the white witch, Hillis, who was engaged to marry King Solent of the Dawn Kingdom, suddenly disappeared. After a millennium of searching, the human girl Xia Li, appeared to Solent with Hillis's Tarot powers. Embark on a fantastic romantic adventure, as unknown conspiracies loom...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: The Demon of the Mansion & Me

description:
“So the best way to become the owner of that house is… to marry rich!” After the deed to Jojo’s late grandfather’s mansion is deemed invalid, a demon appears, declaring her the mansion’s true owner and him its guardian spirit! He even has a plan for her: marry one of the current occupants! But Jojo’s never been in a relationship and needs all the help she can get. Will she get the key to the mansion and the heart of a future husband? Or will she discover there’s more hidden between these walls?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Wo Song Kuaidi You Shen Hao Jiangli

description:
After graduating from college, Su Ning worked as a courier for 99 days, which unlocked the Delivery Super System! Now he can win super prizes for completing deliveries!
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win 10 million dollars!"
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win a Lamborghini!"
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win a meal at a three-star Michelin restaurant!"
"Ding! You just completed a special delivery, you win..."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A syndicate led by female kingpin Gatling has taken the city by storm.

Qiao Anle was captured and subjected to inhumane tests that saw her inadvertently being given a superpower to control and manipulate vines. Swearing to avenge her slain family, she declared war on the wicked sisterhood of superpower beings that created her. But little did she realize that she could not secure her first victory without the help of an undependable scientist...

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

This is a virtual shop that sells desire. Whatever the customer wants, the black business card will be there like a promise, and the shop will deliver the appropriate item with magical effects. However, no one really knows what it costs to use these items. The urban legend of the “Strange Store” is swirling around the city. “The next business card…will it appear by your side?”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The beautiful young girl awakened the ancient sword, and became its slave? She was just trying to cultivate her swordsmanship, but instead she was forcefully transformed and imbued with its techniques. There's actually such a perverted practice?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Feng Gui Chao: Leng Wang Sheng Chong Fayi Fei
title.english: Phoenix Returns: Apathetic King and His Doctor Consort
title.native: 凤归巢：冷王盛宠法医妃

description:
She’s a famous doctor in the 21st century, but an accident thrusts her into a lost dynasty in ancient China, becoming the daughter of a chancellor who’s about to be decapitated by the emperor’s order for a crime she didn’t commit. Now, she must fight for her life with the help of a powerful prince with a hidden agenda. Will she survive? Will she finally be able to take revenge on those who hurt her?

(Source: WebComics)

Lilith, a 500-year-old vampire, is determined to leave her harem of pretty boys behind! She is going to take on the human world by herself? Will she be an overpowered dominating queen? Or will her innocence get her into trouble?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The thousands of strange and bizarre worlds gave birth to all kinds of amazing species. The honored heir of a famed Taoist family broke through numerous obstacles to compete with all the prodigies of the multiverse. He will drag down the high and mighty saints and dump them into the mire. He will witness the miracles of the universe, and fulfill his desire to gain immortality!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

As Zhang Tianling played his favorite game, he was transmigrated into the game world as the founding father of the game's sect. But he was faced with a sect poor and destitute, and the cultivation world all in chaos. To build up his sect in this dangerous world, he will have to start to grind quests for cultivation, and level-up scientifically.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The invincible warrior was reborn into the body of a weakling. See how he will recover his powers and show the world, "I am the grand saint!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Ran Wuyang dressed up like a man to join the army. During a mission, she was blessed by the Goddess System. She didn't trust the system at first, but over the course of many battles, the System gave her perfect advice and provided awesome powers, until she slowly began to accept it. She finally decided to take full advantage of the System's help to strengthen herself, in order to protect her dear brother Yunting…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Being framed, Yunfei had a one-night stand with a mysterious man. After being kicked out of the house by her family, she gave birth to her daughter Zoe abroad. Three years later, Yunfei came back and ran into Yefeng, but little did she know that Yefeng was Zoe's father, and Zoe is helping Yefeng to become her father.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Ning Shu had dropped dead. But fortunately, she became an agent to help poor cannon fodder characters overcome their fate. So Ning Shu played different kinds of life roles in alternate universes, encountering all sorts of troublesome characters like transmigrated or reincarnated protagonists. Ning Shu has to painstakingly recover each character's dignity in one world after another.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In a vast and wild world, the martial arts culture was still in its formative stage. Yi Yun accidentally transmigrated with a purple crystal that could quickly absorb the "energy" of cultivation. With his arrival in this world, the legend of the True Martial Art will begin.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Di Huang Zhi Sheng Yi Qi Fei
title.english: Rebel Princess: The Divine Doctor Outcast

description:
A modern military doctor accidentally time-travelled during her mission. She became Feng Qingchen, the daughter of the late general of the ancient Tanglin Kingdom, and found herself in a bandit’s den. With her life endangered, Feng Qingchen grabbed a scalpel from the medical system and killed a few bandits. When she left the bandit’s den and was about to wander the world free and unfettered, Wanyin, the servant girl of the owner of her body suddenly appeared to stall her. Feng Qingchen’s fiancé, Prince Luo, rushed over with his army just to find Feng Qingchen in dishevelled clothes. Doubting her chastity, he ordered her to commit suicide.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The reckless "summoning" by the girl links up two completely different worlds! The Ghost Immortal Qin Fengqin who was attacked during the trial unexpectedly breaks through to another Realm! The clash of the two civilizations ignites a brilliant spark, igniting the girl's path to become stronger.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: "Pinqiong Youxi", Wei Le 5000 Wan Tan Lianai

description:
Jia Fugui is a girl who became impoverish after her mother died, leaving her homeless on the streets. She suddenly gets invited to play the "Poverty Game" where she pretends to be rich and find love. As Jia Fugui experiences the life of luxury in a prestigious school, her mission for love begins.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Wangye Shi Zhi Da Nao Fu
title.english: The Prince is a Big Tiger

description:
Yun Caiwei was transmigrated into a fantasy world just like those trendy stories. Unfortunately, she took on the body of a weak and cowardly girl. What's worse is that her love interest is a tiger? When the he's in human form, he tries to flirt, pamper, and possess her. But when he becomes a tiger, he lies down in front of her and like a big pussy cat?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The invincible young man faced the raging wind and waves with a pounding heart and infinite possibilities. Across the continent under the sky, a ray of light pierced the heavens from the swordmaster of Qingshan Mountain! After Grandmaster Jing Yang ascended, the young man Jiu Jing left his mountain home to head for Gushan Mountain. Famed for his handsome looks and lazy attitude, Jiu Jing took a different path for his cultivation, always looking for shortcuts. There were many suspicious signs behind Jing Yang's ascension. What could be hiding in the fog that surround the peaks of Qingshan Mountain?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Chihan Wangye De Chong Qi Gonglüe

description:
In the 23rd Century, Ye Wanwan was willing to take out a loan to buy a spaceship to save her friend, by flying it through a wormhole to another universe to find treasure. But a navigational error caused her to be thrown into a pretty boy's bathtub! To help find the treasure, she married him thinking it would be a marriage of convenience. But who knew the guy was such a pervert!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Suxing was a world-renowned actress before she was framed and implicated in bogus scandals that ruined her reputation. Since then, it’s been one tragedy after another: her boyfriend cheats on her, her family breaks apart, and her friends betray her. Despite losing everything, though, she vows to start again and claw her way back up from rock bottom. Along the way, she discovers the truth behind the scandals and takes revenge on everyone who wronged her!

(Source: Comikey)

What's the deal with becoming a cat after transmigrating? Wait, something's wrong with this story! Why is everyone chasing after a cat and trying to kill her? An accidental kiss with the crown prince turned her back into a human. What kind of conspiracy is behind all of this? Crown prince, please save me, meow!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A poor boy who is often pitied travels over to the Magic Continent and is sent to the palace as the reincarnation of the former queen. In his previous life, he had a family with a husband who spoiled him, but he was also used to being the ‘vicious stepmother’ of his “children”.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.english: My Muse is Older Than Me

description:
Eight years in love and she thought they were a match made in heaven, only to find out she had fallen into a carefully designed trap. When time was rewound to the past, what should the reborn Xia Ruoxi do? Will she make a successful career for herself this time? Or should she find herself a pretty boy to stave off bad relationships? She's only 30, still at the peak of life!

(Source: Yunduan Manhua, translated)

Bai Migao thought that she will have the best summer vacation until she gained a magical brother. Her magical little brother has the power to grant wishes which leads her to unbelievable adventures. However, Bai Migao must be careful what she wishes for or it will direct her to certain danger!

(Source: INKR)

The genius neuroscientist Bai Yuekui tried to save hermentor by transplanting his brain into the body of a death-row inmate. At the same time, geological disasters started occurring all over the place. Jones stole the Angel Serum and caused a series of mutations, as Jiuchuan City became hell on earth. The dust has not yet even settled yet, when the final apocalypse came...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the old town, there is a century-old restaurant called Shi Er. It looks ordinary on the outside, but it contains a vast fantasy world inside, where a mysterious creature resides. The restaurant's handsome owners serves up delicious bait to lure customers in, before turning them into food to feed the mystery creature. Until one day, when a stoic young girl came to the restaurant...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Huangzimen Naozhe Yao Qu Wo
title.english: Phoenix Soars Back To The Sky
title.native: 重生后皇子们闹着要娶我

description:
She was once a favored princess, but she was betrayed on the eve of her wedding and killed herself by self-immolation. While her betrayers live a happy life, she was reborn as the bullied and unloved youngest daughter of an aristocratic family. But now she will rise up like the phoenix and find revenge, taming magical beasts, cultivating her powers, and mastering potions and poisons, to control life and death itself! She swears that she will pay back those who betrayed and humiliated her a hundred-fold!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Yin Ni Er Dong De Shaonü Xin
title.english: My Heart That Beats For You

description:
Who says that girls must be innocent, cute and sweet? And who says that quiet and cool guys can’t have the heart of a maiden?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A hundred years ago, the ghost king Jiang Yiwei brought the evil spirits of hell to ravage the six realms, causing all beings to be wiped out, all things killed, yin and yang reversed, the six reincarnation gates crumbling, and the ten kings of hell offered sacrifices to save the underworld. Jiang Daoli, the King of Hell in the Tenth Hall, survived by chance. In order to maintain the stability of reincarnation, he lived incognito in the world and worked several jobs to earn spiritual energy. Tang Xiuyuan, the male Meng-in-law whom she finally recruited, still has to rely on her to support her! With the elimination of demons and disasters along the way, the remaining nine palaces of Hell also have traces one after another. The bond between Tang Xiuyuan and Jiang Daoli, a rambunctious male mother-in-law, formed a thousand years ago also began to slowly surface.

(Source: Bilibili, Translated)

title.romaji: Yongzhe Ailisi De Shehuixing Siwang Chuanshuo
title.english: The Legend of the Hero Alice's Social Death
title.native: 勇者爱丽丝的社会性死亡传说

description:
I, Alice, an ordinary traveler from another world, accidentally became the Hero, and somehow became known as the Demon Lord... Now I'm forced to become a double agent between the human and the demon worlds, constantly living in fear being found out. Fine, for the sake of world peace and to be able to go home, I have to shamelessly steal PANTSU from all the cute girls? What? Why does my ultimate power rely on PANTSU?! Help! I'm going to become socially ostracized!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After dying a tragic death, she finds herself reborn, reborn into a body with cultivation ability that defies the natural order. An arrogant queen, the favored consort of the King: This world is cruel and dangerous, so I will make the world my enemy. Fate is hard to defy, so I will start by defying the here and now!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I’m a Captive in the Realm of Demons

description:
The demons invaded and the humans were defeated. The male protagonist Ichiya and his childhood friend Taozi, became prisoners and were escorted to the devil’s lair, where humans were used by demons as laborers, experimental tools, and even food. With his witty mind, Yi Ye dealt with the four major demon masters and got the protection of the demon queen Monqier, but on the condition that he must fall in love with the demon queen and date her???

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Sai Ren Na De Dingzhi Rensheng

description:
Medea, the witch novelist, was about to die from staying up late writing too often. Before her death, she specially tailored a novel for herself, intending to transmigrate into the book to live a perfectly scripted life. But — her perfect loving prince became a perverted killer; her loyal knight became a misogynistic homosexual; and her doting older brother became the villain's lapdog. She was supposed to be the perfect heroine, but she became the evil villainess instead! In order to survive, Medea had to marry… no, form an alliance… with the despised Demon Lord!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The deadliest female assassin of the 21st century dies in an explosion and later wakes up to find herself in the body of the namby-pamby daughter of an ancient dynasty's Prime Minister. The Prime Minister uses her as a pawn in his political game by setting her up with the King's grotesque, no-good brother. When she realizes her soon-to-be husband is so much smarter than he lets on, she strikes a deal with him to take down their enemies!

(Source: WebComics)

Huo Xinyang was so tired of being heartbroken, over and over again, that she set out to teach a lesson to those two-faced men who promised so much but never delivered. She got so carried away by her so-called 'mission' that she did not realize how her role had become her second nature. But what will happen when an innocent-looking boy challenged her preconceptions? Will she toy with him like all the other guys she had ruined?

Sentinel: Hey, you know what? I got here through reincarnation.
Guide: Oh... it was transmigration for me. We're in the fictional world of a novel where you're the villain, and I'm the cannon fodder. Here, have a look.
Sentinel: (Skimming through) Oh, so that's how my second life ended... Psh, Planet X's rebels were utter trash, and Y Nation's government was so weak. Did the leader of Planet Z's bandit gang go soft in the head? How could he become traitor for the sake of love?
Guide: You've been reincarnated more than once? Wow!
Sentinel: Yeah, I'm in my third lifetime now. I never thought I'd get reincarnated again and be lucky enough to meet you...
Guide: So what if you meet me?
Sentinel: Now that I've met you, you've inspired me... to clean up my act.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Five years ago, the star designer An Zhisu was framed to be the perpetrator in an accident. Five years later, starting from scratch and completely on her own, will she redress her grievances and return to the fashion stage where she belongs?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Hua Kai Hou Bai Hua Sha

description:
In her previous life, she was a palace insider, the consort of the fifth prince, famed for her haughty beauty. But overnight, her whole family was slain by order of the Emperor. As she died with hate in her heart, she was reincarnated as the daughter of the Shen clan, the ruler of the northwestern territory. Now she will use her cheat-like knowledge and looks to scheme and charm her way to the top! She is noble, beautiful, and cold, as she looked down on all before her. Nothing and no one will touch her heart in this life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Cheng Xuezu Zongcai De Xiao Tiandian
title.native: 重生成血族总裁的小甜点

description:
In school and in the workplace, Xue Momo was always at the center of attention, as she took down bad men and tore up lying women. Now she's set her sights on that stone-cold thousand-year old vampire CEO...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The story revolves around the lives of eight current college students. Their different personalities and interests represent a microcosm of life on the modern college campus. They couldn't imagine that four years of college life together will also expose their personality flaws, as they find themselves through their daily interactions.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Buzhi Xihuan Ni You Qian
title.english: It's Not Just About the Money

description:
"Hi, Mr. Yang, are you interested in investing? Or perhaps dating?"To save her employed company from the brink of bankruptcy, smart and capable Shi Fei wants to secure the copyright of an author's works, hoping she can reverse her misfortune. The person she has to persuade to be the company investor is a man who got super-rich from land acquisition compensation, Yang You. And they happen to stay under the same roof. The biggest problem is that Yang You is unambitious and slothful. Hence, the story of Shi Fei trying all the means just to persuade Yang You begins...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Chu Yu is invited back to her hometown by her childhood friend Xin Qing. After saying goodbye to her boyfriend, she reunites with her first love, Wei Lai. All three join Da Sheng's manga studio to create a manga called "The Heart of the Forest". Wei Lai confesses to Chu Yu, and Chu Yu is caught between choosing her boyfriend or Wei Lai...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: Warlord Husband: Shenshen is Gonna be the Winner

description:
Her fate has been turned upside down for saving him by accident. He already has 27 women, how can I be the special one? I even gave him a baby! A commander? Warlord? But what of that! He wants to marry me? Fine, clean up his mess first, and then throw these women out! Or don’t even think about that!

(Source: Webnovel)

A young girl who is cursed by a black butterfly has met with all kinds of mishaps, but every time gets saved by a white butterfly. This time the curse of the black butterfly strikes once more, but along with the white butterfly that came, was unexpectedly a long haired, beautiful man with wings! "Could it be that an angel came to save me?" "No, he is not an angel! He is... a beast!"

Reincarnated as the superstar actress Su Xin'er, she thought she would have an easy life at the top of the world. But the moment she opened her eyes, her CEO husband wanted to divorce her! Every day, the headlines were filled with scandalous news about her, as the entire Internet seemed to want her out of the entertainment business. This new life is turning out to be awful! Now she has rally herself from nothing, starting as a trainee, gain popularity, seduce a male idol, and rely on her own abilities to turn the haters on the net into fans!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Bu Xihuan Zhe Shijie, Wo Zhi Xihuan Ni
title.english: All the Things I Like About You
title.native: 我不喜欢这世界，我只喜欢你

description:
Joey and her husband, F, couldn’t be any more different. Joey is bubbly and charming while F is quiet, elusive, and downright cold sometimes. When Joey’s company assigns her to work on a project that’ll inspire people to reminisce on their youth, she decides to write a book about her own, and it turns into a memoir of her and F’s love story. As Joey looks back on how she met F, it’ll take her on a memorable journey through her life, first love, and how the “Ice Man” became the warmest person she knows.

(Source: Tapas)

I'm the daughter of the leader of Lingji Sect, a top killer organization. Though I'm not good at killing people, one day a strange man came to me and asked me to complete a mission for him. Strangely enough, he said I was the only one who can do the job. That is, to steal a secret letter from the man himself! Only it was the "him" from 10 years ago. Who exactly is this man? What does his future have to do with me...

(Source: MangaToon)

She was the princess of rich family, but disasters stoke her one after another. Her father died from a car accident. Her stepmother drove her away. Her best friend and boyfriend betrayed her. What’s worse is that she messed up with the heir of Song’s Group, Eryn Song. She couldn’t afford the debt, so she was forced to be the lover of Eryn Song. But life never got easier. The death of her child made her leave Song’s Family. Many years later, when she came back again, she had changed her name and had become the regional director of V.N Group.

(Source: WebComics)

My name is Shen Yao. I am the envy of all the ladies in the imperial capital, because I grew up as the childhood friend of the royal family, and I'm engaged to become the Crown Prince Consort. But in reality, I don't like the Crown Prince at all, and I wished I could break off the engagement. The Fifth Prince is moody and unpredictable, and he has always messed with me since we were young. The Crown Prince seemed fine and I liked him at first. But as we grew up, he started to act strangely, like he’s a different person. Then suddenly out of nowhere, he wanted to break off the engagement! Fine, palace intrigue is so complicated, let's get out of here!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Tianji Shen Shu Shi: Wangye Xianggong Buxin Xie
title.native: 天机神术师：王爷相公不信邪

description:
A master of divination, Ling Xiangruo was struck by the lightning and sent to another world as punishment for revealing too much of the divine will. There she met a prince who didn't believe in the supernatural. The more he refused to believe, the more Ling Xiangruo wanted to make him see! She helped the prince investigate and solve all sorts of strange and supernatural cases, until finally the prince was convinced. But his capitulation didn't go like how she imagined it...... The prince smiled at Ling Xiangruo, as he leaned over her in bed, "Girl, if you're so good at fortune-telling, can you tell that I'm the one thing you're missing in life?"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: My Boss Won't Stop Loving Me

description:
Hao Jiamei is an ordinary employee who aspires to thrive in her career. After a drunken night, she wakes up next to a handsome stranger, and she pays him for the night. To her surprise, the stranger turns out to be her new boss, and he can't seem to leave her alone.

(Source: INKR)

An ordinary high school girl woke up one day and found a strange man lying beside her. The monstrous man claimed to be her destined prince...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A modern medical doctor and kickboxing trainer was reincarnated in the body of an 11-year-old girl as the eldest daughter of the Xie family. In order to survive, the little girl waged a battle with her closest family members. After the bloody war, she was informed of her wedding contract with a handicapped person who was no different from a eunuch. All that was hidden from her by her father, which led to the little girl’s demise in the wilderness, where the reincarnation took place.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

An 18-year-old teenager woke up one day to find herself seven years older and married. One minute she was just starting college, the next minute she became a go-getter CEO and someone’s wife! To add to her surprise, her husband happened to be Jiang Jingyan, the “underachiever” at school, with whom she never saw eye to eye.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In addition to human beings, this world also contains fairies, spirits, ghosts, and monsters, the supernatural and the strange. When Zhang Quan, a man with the ability to see "demons" encounters Shen Qing, who's being harrassed by a "demon"... A rowdy, day-to-day excorcism begins!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Zhege Wangye Ta Ke Fu, De Pan!

description:
A 21st century, talented Feng Shui expert, reincarnates into a frail body in ancient times. The original good-for-nothing host is not only ugly, but her birth father favors the concubine more than the wife, birth mother was framed with adultery and stripped of her rank, twin brother was poisoned by her second mother, her fiancé and concubine-sister hooked up and worked together to bring about her tragic death. After Xiao Lingyun is reincarnated, she uses secret techniques of Feng Shui to get back at those who had previously ridiculed and abused her. From the lowest of low to the highest peak of cultivation, she flies towards the immortal realm.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Xihuan De Nüsheng, Jiu Xiang Shuimitao
title.native: 喜欢的女生，就像水蜜桃

description:
Memories of youth, dreams, and other inconsequential things.

(Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

Included Stories:
Xihuan De Nüsheng, Jiu Xiang Shuimitao (喜欢的女生，就像水蜜桃)
Butterfly
Beats!

title.romaji: Wu Liang Kuang Hou Huo Jun Xin
title.english: The Mad Queen and the Lord's Heart

description:
In her past life, Ye Jinsu had no money, no boyfriend, and nobody cared when she died. In a twist of fate, she was reincarnated as the pampered daughter of a rich family. She thought that she would finally be able to live a happy and carefree life, until she realized that despite her station and her talents, she was actually lonely and unloved? Ye Jinsu told herself, "...at least there are still some perks. I have money and I can have any man I want. There's even this one guy wouldn't stop pestering me."

That man asked her, "My lady, I would offer a thousand taels of gold for your hand. Will you marry me?"
"No way."
"Then how about this entire empire for your dowry?"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After dying in her first life, Mu Hexi finds herself as the host to the "Anti-Pretentious System", a system that levels her up the more she embarrasses the female leads of the novels she is transmigrated into. And once she's told she can be reborn in her world once she reaches the max level, her goal becomes clear: Reach the top level and leave a trail of weeping female leads in her wake!

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Tiancai Shuang Bao: Ao Jiao Qianqi Bao Hui Jia
title.native: 天才双宝：傲娇前妻抱回家

description:
She became pregnant after an unexpected encounter with a stranger, and gave birth to a brilliant pair of twins. To help pay for her incapacitated brother's medical care, she signed a contract to marry a mysterious CEO sight unseen. Five years later, the CEO notified her that he wanted a divorce. When she finally met him for the first time, she realized that he looked remarkably like her kids. The twin kids tugged on Mr. CEO's sleeves and asked, "Hey Mister, we think you just might be our daddy, how about let's go take a paternity test?"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

She had just transmigrated and hadn't even gotten used to her new identity yet, before she was immediately forced into an arranged marriage. What? I have to marry that blind cripple the Third Prince, and get ambushed along the way?! She is a strong, independent woman. See how she overcame the concubine, brought the servants to heel, and flirted with her handsome new husband. Living in the past won't stop her from making waves!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In the entertainment industry, there’s a certain profession called “professional fans”. Professional fans earn their living through chasing stars. When a novelist Zhu Xiaotong who lost her direction in life met a singer Li Xixing who managed to fulfill her dreams, Zhu Xiaotong decided to become a “professional fan” for Li Xixing and her shield. This time, Zhu Xiaotong will use her own ways to lead everyone onto the correct path of chasing a star, creating this chaotic Li Xixing support squad!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The legend says that Gu Qingcheng was once the wife of Prince Yongjun, but was divorced by her husband. Her whole family was beheaded, and she herself nearly became food in the belly of the beast in the colosseum. She was once the most beautiful woman in the Great Xia Empire, now she's taken away by Prince Sheng. After a year, she's ready to make her comeback, and make the man who destroyed her family pay the price!

(Source: MangaToon)

Gu Yao had it all: a wealthy background, beauty, loving parents, and an outstanding boyfriend. Everything about her seemed perfect. That was, until one day, a man called Xu Shuo told her another version of the story…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Lin Jing was a teenage girl with a mysterious background. A human, vampire, or an angel? Which is her true form?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Wu Weiwei's mother passed away, but instead of grief, she feels anger towards her father. Due to the Wu family abandoning them, she wants revenge by being engaged to Ye Group's CEO. As she schemes to bring the Wu family to ruin, romance unexpectedly blooms for her.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Wo Yang Le Liang Ge Hei Hua Mofashi
title.native: 我养了两个黑化魔法师

description:
A witch found two abandoned kids by accident and adopted them. With time passing by, both kids started to grow feelings for her, which led to a tragedy. Chen Xuanming, the elder one, was incited by a mysterious man to kill his younger brother Dugu Chenfeng, but he got Zhixi, his foster mother, killed by accident. Hundreds of years later, Zhixi's soul awakened in the body of Dugu Chenfeng's ex-wife. Meanwhile, Chen Xuanming also showed up...

(Source: Webnovel)

Yin Mo, the daughter of the chairman of the Yin Group, was reborn back to the age of 17 after being tortured to death by her stepmother and stepbrother. The reborn young lady vowed to beat the odds and change her fortune. She will make those who hurt her and her family pay the ultimate price…!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

【Clingy Tsundere School Bully Who Always Blows His Own Horn (but is secretly cute) X Cold, Obsessive, Possessive Top Student】

Yu Yang thought he'd charmed a cool and shy little girl online. However, when they finally met in person, his online sweetheart turned out to be a towering school bully from the new campus! What's worse, this bully was the very nemesis who had witnessed his numerous embarrassing moments!

Yu Yang: I treated you like my mortal enemy, but you want me?

When the two school districts merged, their long-distance online relationship became a next-door classroom situation. Yu Yang would head to the restroom as soon as class ended, pretending to casually pass by his boyfriend's classroom window next door.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The Way Back to the Palace

description:
Her parents and baby died a brutal death. Her kindness earned her nothing but the vicious schemes of her husband and eldest sister. The hatred can only be returned in blood! When she resurrects in her new life, her former husband becomes a tough enemy for hers! Who will she choose? The aloof prince who is scheming, the young aristocrat who shares lots in common, or the young general who has had a crush on her since childhood? In this life, she wants to kill her enemies with her own hands, and also enjoy a bright future.

(Source: WebComics)

The rookie entertainment reporter Wen QiaoQiao is accidentally sucked by the popular star Bai Ye. As a result, Bai Ye is a member of the modern vampire who strives to succeed in the entertainment circle. In order to keep a secret, she is left by Bai Ye with a contract of cohabitation. And as an entertainment reporter, Wen also secretly plotted to uncover the secret behind Bai Ye…

(Source: MangaToon)

Life is cruel and full of challenges for everyone. In the urban forest full of hurt and lies, we walked together, looking for a glimmer of light.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Jia Gei Yi Ge Si Taijian

description:
Chen Hui has transmigrated into the body of a girl, who committed suicide by bashing her head against a pillar out of reluctance to get married to a eunuch.

The eunuch is insidious and cunning, enigmatic in every way. He's cannon fodder, just like the eunuchs depicted in the average TV drama series. In order to ensure her survival, Chen Hui was left with no choice but come up with various schemes to get close to the stupid eunuch, understand him, and gain his favor...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes seven bonus chapters.

One is an immortal who’s been yearning for death; the other is a destined short-lived jinx who’s been yearning for survival. When these two totally contrast people meet each other, what will be the fate awaits them? Will they become each other’s saviors or disasters? Keep up with Li Chen and enjoy the story about the thousand-year beautiful youth and the scheming jinx.

(Source: Webnovel)

Billie once basked in the spotlight as an internet singer-songwriter—until her fame faded and her songs drew only harsh criticism. Urged by her father to give up her “star dream,” she fled home in a storm of emotion. Three years later, she wakes up and discovers she was found unconscious on the street, and has no memory of her disappearance, clinging to a sketchbook filled with evocative drawings of Hong Kong's streetscapes. As Billie retraces the vivid locations within her sketches, she embarks on a profound, otherworldly journey through memory and place—seeking not just what she has lost, but who she has become.

(Source: Nakama Press)

Note: Silver Award winner in the 16th Japan International Manga Award.

title.romaji: Man Chao Wangye Yi Guo Duan
title.english: Bring It On, Your Royal Highnesses

description:
A female doctor runs into huge trouble and gets swept into political and harem issues when she transmigrates into another world and castrates a royal jerk. Not only does she have to take care of her useless disabled husband, she has to deal with the vicious two-faced royal princes as well. From eliminating the royals to plotting wicked schemes and flaunting her medical skills, she stuns everyone with her amazing abilities and knowledge. “Who says my husband is useless? From now on, I won’t forgive anyone who insults him!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes five extras chapters.

In the near future, all orphans are provided with a robomom. Sinbell, a hot headed teenager, was raised by a robomom, but he's convinced that his real mom is still alive and out there in the world. He runs away from home on a journey to search for his birth mother. Out of love for Sinbell, his robomom follows him and will do whatever it takes to protect Sinbell and insure his happiness. But their journey will be difficult and full of challenges...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Winner of the Best Story category in the 2004 Golden Dragon Awards.

title.romaji: Wo Zai Xianxia Shijie Jiaban NPC

description:
Qin Ran transmigrated into a world of immortal cultivation. With the help of "Tiandao", he was able to establish his own sect by recruiting disciples from Earth, and turn the world of cultivation into a world more resembling an online game!
Diligent and hard-working disciples ( x )
Out of control like a natural disaster (√ )
Helping adventurers like a good NPC ( x )
Working behind the scenes to become the Big Boss (√ )

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jian Yu Yuan Zheng: Po Xiao Yang Yan

description:
Esperia's Obsidian Finch clan was wiped out by a Hypogean, with Talene the only survivor. In the Solaran Furnace, Talene obtained her human form and the power of her ancestors. Seeking to avenge her kind, she followed the culprit of the massacre into the Dark Forest, who is surrounded by swirling demonic flames. The time has come: the strength of the shielding flame against the force of an insidious all-consuming blaze!

(Source: INKR)

As the supervisor system, when System 067 found 13 other Systems who have gained self-awareness, it assigned each of them to the world of a different novel. Their task is to change the course of the plot of the main character. If the self-aware System succeeds, then the System may become a "real human."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Everything happened because of a coffin that emerged from the river… I thought it was an unexpected fortune for me, but alas, it was an untimely disaster. After prying this coffin open, I instantly felt that something unpleasant had followed me back to my home. As my daughter started acting increasingly weirder, she—as a three-year-old—started hitting puberty!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Hei Hua Wangye Chao Nan Hong
title.english: The Dark Prince Is Hard To Please

description:
Ever since novelist Qiao Xiaoqi changed the ending to her novel, she was cursed to isekai into her own story as the female lead who gets killed by the male lead! When the personality of the male lead, Jun Mojue, grows more and more twisted due to constant persecution, Qiao Xiaoqi tries to stop him from going down this dark path. At first, she just wanted to decrease his darkness percentage so she could go home, but soon she started to have real feelings…

(Souce: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Bilibili Comics originally titled this work "The Malevolent Prince is Hard to Please" (as can still be seen in early chapters), before renaming it "The Dark Prince Is Hard To Please".

Turn suffering into oranges and reach for the stars with courage!

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

title.english: Don't Forget to Save the Data

description:
Save your journey in an odd way!

I'm a Hero appointed by the king! Before I embark on the journey, a guy suddenly comes to tell me that I have to be kissed by him to save the data of the adventure. I can't believe it! As a straight man, I have to ask, "Why must we save the data this way?!"

(Source: Manta)

The hacker Bai Yuan "accidentally" joined a mysterious ritual to "pray to find true love at the time of your birth." And she did meet a mysterious boy right at 7:30, the time of her birth. But this is no romantic fairy tale, as she's about to get pulled into a corporate war for the company president position!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter.

My new roommate is obsessed with me... but she's a ghost?!

(Source: Toomics)

What a lousy power, it only makes me invincible within a small area?! I have to cultivate to increase its coverage?! In this world full of dangerous villains and monsters, there's no way I'm leaving this mountain unless I absolutely have to. Hey girl, stop causing trouble! I'm trying to cultivate here! Unless… you can lure them up the mountain to me?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the Northern Song era, when Lu Dongbing was cultivating at the Yellow Crane Tower, he transformed the yellow crane that Fei Yi made from an orange peel, and took it on as a disciple. After Lu Dongbing attained enlightenment and ascended to immortality, the crane stayed behind to watch over the Yellow Crane Tower and continue the Daoist teachings, while awaiting his master's return.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

You use studies to get me, I use love to get you.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

He was the boy I loved; the one who walked with me through my salad days and our beautiful, fleeting years.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Bixu Huo Xia Qu De Liyou

description:
Have you ever felt like your life is boring and meaningless? Would you still feel the same way if you have to live in an apocalyptic world, where you are unclothed and starving? When Li Jinnian was buried alive because of an earthquake, she unknowingly discovered a path to escape the rubble. However, what lied ahead on that path wasn't light, but endless deception and killing. In a dog-eat-dog world, will Li Jinnian find a way to keep living?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Chen Yueli used to be color blind when she was young until she met a vampire named Feng Yilu. Her family was murdered, and ten years later it still haunts her, only remembering the color red. Chen Yueli thought that she won't see Feng Yilu again, until he arrived at her boarding school.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Chongsheng, Wo Cai Shi Yule Tianwang
title.english: Rebirth, I am the King of Entertainment

description:
Lin Ce, a show-biz big-shot, is transported to a parallel universe, only to find that his superstar girlfriend was dumping him. Little did she know that Lin Ce's head is now filled with endless pop culture knowledge from another world!

Zhao Siman: Lin Ce, I am a star now, and you are just an ordinary guy. We're not right for each other, so let's split up and don't contact me any more!

Lin Ce: Hey girl, you don't even know what you're missing!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yao Hu Zaizai Jintian Ye Hen Guai?

description:
Nan Qingsei raised a fox-spirit cub with maximum stats in every beauty-related category in the game "Youkai Bestiary." She made Bai Huai cute and cuddly, with a gentle, angelic personality. But one day, she saw an online video in the game forums featuring her cute little cub destroying ferocious wolf demons in hand-to-hand combat. That was when Nan Qingsei realized what the frail cub she raised was actually like…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: The Tale of the Chinese Zodiac

description:
Monkey see, monkey do.

Sixth grader Xiao Yu finds herself in a tight spot when she runs into trouble with local delinquents. A mysterious boy steps in just in the nick of time and sends the bully flying — literally. When Xiao Yu asks about the source of his superhuman strength, he says he isn't human! So just what is he?

(Source: Manta)

Chen Xin and Lin Anyun were looking up at the sky at the same time on an ordinary night after work. They both saw three shooting stars pass by at the same time and made their respective wishes. When they woke up the next day, the two found that their souls have switched bodies, the beginning of a wondrous journey. During this time, the everyday things they overlooked, the things they didn't realize because of their personalities, the things they wanted but couldn't have, and the things they had to settle for… every problem seemed to miraculously resolve themselves. The two women meet and they immediately felt a mutual attraction. They grew together as a couple, and became inseparable companions. On a night when three shooting stars pass by once again, will they be returned to their original state?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wu Xian Tao Li: Wo De Kongbu Lianren
title.native: 无限逃离：我的恐怖恋人

description:
The "God Game" proclaims that whoever completes the game can have a wish come true. However, players of the game have been mysteriously disappearing. The headstrong paranormal investigator Bai Zhen started looking into the game when her partner Gu He disappeared, too. Entering into the God Game herself, Bai Zhen found herself being romantically pursued by every psycho-killer boss on each level. How is she going to get herself out of this?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Ye He Nügui Ying Peng Ying

description:
Contains illogical plot, vulgar language, black humor, and bad jokes. Disengage your brain before reading!

What would you do if you see a female ghost?
Normal people: “Run away.”
Onmyoji: “Exorcise them.”
Monk: “Send them to the afterlife.”
B Comic reader: “Date her!”
Huo Zhe (our protagonist): “I'll punch her in the face and grab her by the hair to make her admit that there are no such thing as ghosts before scattering her ashes to the winds!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

As the heroine of a romance novel, Shen Yu eventually gained self-awareness. After experiencing countless reincarnations, she discovers that another female character seems to have developed self-awareness, too. In order to uncover the truth about their world and escape from this endless time loop, Shen Yu did everything she could to protect the other girl, until finally —— the girl confesses love to Shen Yu!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

This is an anthology of short comics. It documents all of the fantastical thoughts I’ve had about this city. Even if it's just an idea or a rumor, I tried my best to make them seem interesting. I hope you’ll like it.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.native: 吸血鬼小姐的欺负游戏

description:
The ancient vampire Elena transformed herself into a gothic loli to keep an eye on her blood prey, the cursed bounty hunter Chelsea. Elena pretended to be Chelsea's fiancee, but ended up forming a binding contract with her instead. Elena thought she would have to force her to obey, "Bow down before me and become my blood slave, Chelsea…" But her attitude turned out to be more like, "My little angel, I beg you, please bully your Chelsea." Now Elena is all confused. What to do with her masochistic fake fiancee?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Pullan Gwen is an engineer framed as a traitor after an energy crisis. In order to prove his innocence, he flees and comes across a mysterious mech. The journey of Pullan Gwen as he goes from place to place gathering allies and enemies.

(Source: INKR)

In troubled times, the bladesmiths would emerge, and they would offer a suitable blade to those destined to wield it. No payment is required, but the bladesmith will leave a cryptic prophesy behind. Only when the prophecy is fulfilled will the smith return to collect the "blade price." Shu Yu, a boy born into the lowest caste, meets the bladesmith Tang Dao and receives the sword named "Muzheng." He was told his prophecy and gained extraordinary power. From that moment, his life will never be the same…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Years later, Tao Anzhi is glad that she went ahead and opened that door. It was like a blessing from god, for her to meet Yan Xi, grow up with her, and fall deeply in love with her. Yan Xi never thought she'd feel this kind of love, especially not with the girl she grew up with. Even though they live in different timelines, their lives are inextricably bound together over the years. Even when they were so young, they were so in love, without even realizing.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Wo Chengle Quan Chen de Zhang Zhong Jiao
title.english: After Rebirth, I Became a Powerful Ministers Beloved
title.native: 重生后我成了权臣的掌中娇

description:
Nan Baoyi was born into a well-off family, but she married poorly, and died destitute. When she was reborn, she set her sights on a lowly adopted boy, knowing that the unwanted young man has a bright future ahead of him. But he seemed uninterested in all of her advances. Just as she was about to give up and find herself another man, now that he is a powerful minister, he suddenly annulled her arranged marriage, and called her to his silken bed, "come here baby, I'm all yours…"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zhe Ci Zhen De Pan Ming Le

description:
Zhong Chuanming has been working as a comic assistant for many years, until he finally decides to quit his job to concentrate on drawing his own comic. Along the way, he was forced take on the rookie artist Zhang Shan as an assistant to help him finish the work.

(Source: The Box Studio, translated)

Note: Winner for Best Comic Story at the first annual HK Comics Support Programme awards.

In 1970s Hong Kong, a mischievous and clever cat-masked boy ventures into the lawless Kowloon Walled City to retrieve his lost report card before his mom finds out.

Tiger is a seven year old boy, growing up in 1970’s Hong Kong. He prefers being clever to working hard, gets terrible grades in school, and dreams of being a superhero. One day, his world is turned upside down when his report card somehow ends up in one of the most dangerous areas of Hong Kong: Kowloon City! Armed only with his homemade cat mask and determination in his heart, Tiger must dive into the twisting chaos and shadowy streetcorners of the Walled City to recover the document.

Can Tiger and his streetwise new friend Dragon find his report card before his mom calls him home for dinner? Or will he be lost in the dangerous maze of Kowloon forever?

Cat Mask Boy is a kinetic journey into another time, full of cultural flavor, warm-hearted humor, and nostalgic urban realism. This thrilling coming-of-age graphic novel explores themes of friendship, self-discovery, and growing up with a touch of retro whimsy.

(Source: Nakama Press)

A living mannequin with a sunflower through its heart. A tomboyish girl who embarks on misadventures. A struggling, but prideful, artist. Set in Arles, a small town in France. Welcome to a gorgeous tale where art comes to life.

Jiang Shishi, a zombie living quietly in the human world, was forced to move in with Christine, a beautiful vampire girl, as part of a supernatural assessment. Shishi found out that in addition to her examiner Christine, there is also a little human girl living there. What kind of strange family is this going to be?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Di Biao Zui Qian Huangijin Shen
title.english: The Strongest Golden Kidney on the Planet

description:
Ye Yun, a teenage boy who sold his kidney to buy an iPhone, is transported to a martial arts world on Cang Yan Continent. This hapless boy finds that he is not only a martial arts failure, but also has an evil second uncle who killed his father, and is threatening him to practice black magic kung fu. He then has no choice but to save himself by participating in the Ye family's test to determine who leads the family! When he finds himself in this helpless situation, he discovers that his kidney can help him make magical elixirs and even functions as a smartphone...

(Source: Webcomics)

In the ruins of the city, the post-apocalyptic JK Candy pilots her mecha to battle monsters. However, behind the human-turned-monsters lies a even more terrifying conspiracy... Each faction has its own ulterior motives, and the story will unfold around the young man Naiicca, as a vicious war breaks out over his "goods"!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Xu Yan, who was bullied to death, is reincarnated as college student Shen Xing. She discovers she can see the malice in others and is determined to use this ability to find her murderer and change her future!

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Shenmi Zhenbianren: Boss, Jie Ge Yun

description:
Determined to tear down the fake angelic bitches and the homewreckers, Shen Yugui, a professional returning from overseas, master hacker, and elite martial artist, will do all she can to play dumb, win the heart of the icy CEO, and climb toward the summit of her life!

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

title.romaji: Haomen Qianjin Chong Sheng Hou Sha Feng Le
title.native: 豪门千金重生后杀疯了

description:
The raging fire showed her the true nature of the people around her. In this reborn life, she's going to reverse her unfortunate fate! Fighting off her wicked sister, breaking things off with her family, that Bai girl is acting crazy! Why's she acting this way, they wondered? Genius medical student, black-hat hacker, math prodigy… they're all just disguises. In the end, she's still that Xingchen in the heart of Master Lu.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Gouxiewen Nüpei Ta Bu Gan Le

description:
Jiang Moli, an ordinary woman working part-time jobs, finds herself transmigrated into a trashy novel as the story's villainess.
