The story's System actually wants her to give up her own life to help the main characters get together. So Jiang Moli tries to finish her missions by doing as little as possible, but for some reason this is making the Boss Villain look at her kinda strange? See how the doomed villainess seduces the man by being lazy!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Straight-A student Yu Chu finds herself in the world of a fiction novel with her consciousness transmitted into the body of its antagonist, Zhong Ruan. Tasked with creating a new fate for the character, she is soon thrown into a romantic comedy as she begins to attract some male attention.

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.romaji: Chong Sheng: Hui Dao 1983 Dang Fuweng

description:
Chou Yufeng, the CEO of a listed company, is unexpectedly sent back to the year 1983. Seeing his teary young wife and his despondent younger siblings who have just lost their parents, Chou Yufeng vows to make his mark in this new era!

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan: Suzhu Ta Yi Xin Qiu Si

description:
She is the cold-hearted and good-for-nothing senior sister in the Cloud Immortal Sect. She looks calm and gentle, but in fact she carries the system's missions and kills people like flies. She is the real culprit behind the sect's serial murders. He is the sect leader's most promising disciple, a genius in cultivation, aloof and ascetic. Ordered to investigate the sect's murder case, he's never expected that his heart would race inexplicably when facing her. As the long-sealed secrets of the sect gradually revealed, the bloody truth is finally uncovered, and he has to make a choice.

(Source: Mangatoon)

Betrayed by her fiancé, Bai Pu seduces her fiancé’s uncle Lu Zhaohe and sleeps with him to get revenge. But what was meant to be a game of revenge slowly develops into true love…

(Source: WebComics, edited)

Qin Niannian, the SSSSS-tier mercenary queen, became the ruler of the underworld after her death— The Empress of Hell! She is smart, cruel, and totally ruthless. With her cute pet, Tangyuan, she will transmigrate into thousands of worlds to punish the wicked!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Furen Ta Bei Guan Huai Le

description:
Reborn as the heiress of a powerful Dijing family, Scarlett Xia becomes Stella Leng—a name that commands respect. With parents who run a business empire and grandfathers who hold untouchable influence, her world is one of privilege and power. Protected by a cold yet formidable ally, Stella has one goal: to crush the scumbag who betrayed her in her past life and deliver justice for her grandfather. Revenge has never looked this glamorous!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Dalao De Xingan Chuan Hui Lai Le

description:
June Qing finally traveled back to her original space-time, but she found that her body had been occupied by other travelers for two years. Her crush, whom she had been cautiously building a relationship for many years, now treated her coldly. Cleaning up after the mess of the other traveler while winning back the heart of her crush, June Qing declares: This won't get me down!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The Celestial Phoenix of Mount Taixuan and her first disciple Lin Zhaoyu went on a quest to stop Yan Shiluo, a leader of a fire cult, and his Rite of Holy Flames. Any form of corruption must be purged.

(Source: Honkai Impact 3rd)

title.english: Lucky Adventure in the Survival Game

description:
Unknown danger is lurking in the inexplicable harbor. A text popped out and told Fu Anan that this was a survival game. She thought it was just a dream, but the game told her that if she didn't follow the rules, she would die and that if she didn't survive the game for more than thirty days, she would also die. Facing the unknown and dangerous cruise ship and floods that swallow everything, how would Fu Anan survive various natural disasters and schemes at the resource-strapped situation?

(Source: WebNovel)

title.romaji: Chong Hui Laogong Dang Xiaocao De Na Nian
title.native: 重回老公当校草的那年

description:
Better to chase after my future husband than to chase after idols! Bai Yaoyao, who traveled ten years back in time, decided that she was going to get a head start on married life by seducing the future tycoon (and the cutest guy in school) right now!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras and 26 side story chapters.

title.romaji: Zhangguan, Ni De Weiba Cang Bu Zhu Le
title.native: 长官，你的尾巴藏不住了

description:
A war has upended the world's strict social order. The beast-woman Qing Shilun, a former high-ranking military officer, now finds herself banished to the lowest caste, given to her long-time rival Shen Xilan as a plaything. Everyone thought that Qing Shilun will be tortured and humiliated, but the game is just beginning, to see who will be the master and who will be tamed…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

This is the Interstellar Age in which warships are the symbol of the utmost violence. It's the cruelest age, but it's also the most prosperous age! Wang Dou traveled through time and went back to 20 years ago... Now he's ready to meet countless unknown civilizations, harvest their source points, and strengthen himself! And what makes him even more invincible is his system! Others get random warships and modules, but Wang Dou gets to choose! He has a second life and a system! There's no way anyone else could compete with him! He will use the most powerful warship in the universe to crush anyone who refuses to bow!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wei Le Fuhuo Anlian De Shizun Wo Bei Po Kai Le Hougong
title.native: 为了复活暗恋的师尊我被迫开了后宫

description:
Hua Yingying transmigrated into the body of a poor orphan girl. When her life was hanging by a thread, an immortal master descended from the heaven to save her from danger. So Hua Yingying teased and flattered her master day and night, until she finally melted the master's icy heart. As soon as her master could overcome her final tribulation, they can be together for mutual cultivation and other naughty things… But who could have imagined that the master would fail the tribulation and crumble into dust! Now in order to resurrect her master, Hua Yingying must search the seven mirror realms to find the seven shards of her master and make love with each of them! Hua Yingying clenches her fists in frustration, "I'm only forming a harem so I can save my master!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

After a tragic accident, the queen of the architecture industry, Enfei, found herself reincarnated as Queen Eleanor of the Ghana tribe. Expecting a timeless romance with all kinds of prince charming, she instead discovered she's destined to be buried alongside the king at the royal funeral! In the Ghana tribe's tradition, upon the king's demise, his harem transfers to the prince who ascends the throne. Yet, the eldest prince refused her, leaving her condemned to a fiery fate! To make matters worse, she's accused of witchcraft! Death is not an option! Let's join the journey and witness Queen Eleanor's struggle in this magical realm as she strives to defy the odds and rewrite her destiny...

(Source: Webnovel)

He ended up in another world with a mythical tree that bears countless magical fruits. Those fruits will bring him many kinds of magical objects and even gods and demons. In that bizarre and scary world, he will lead the human race to survive and climb to the pinnacle of his life.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Xuyuan Hou, Tian Jiang Cheng Jing De Xingxing
title.native: 许愿后，天降成精的星星

description:
What do I do if I like girls? I wished upon a shooting star, not expecting it to be granted straight away… so why did a spirit suddenly appear before me?

(source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jisu Wo shen Zhege Yi Shengren Buhaore
title.english: Living with an Aberrant Lifeform in My Body
title.native: 寄宿我身，这个异生人不好惹！

description:
One day on his way to work, Lucas Qin is caught in a subway attack by an aberrant lifeform and takes a fatal blow. When he regains consciousness, every part of his body feels wrong, and his reflection in the train window reveals a terrifying truth: he is still alive, but no longer himself. He has become an aberrant lifeform himself. Teetering between humanity and monstrosity, Lucas must learn to coexist with a parasitic spirit within him while surviving a society that fears what he has become.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Sheffield lets his emotions take over him when he hears that his stepfather's illegitimate son, Randol, wants to reunite with the family. On a whim, he decides to give his "big brother" a little welcome "gift" - spending a passionate night with him...

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Baobiao You Dian Meng

description:
Ye Yao changed her name to Bai Fei and dressed as a man to infiltrate the Ling clan, the most powerful family in A City. Bai Fei became the trusted right-hand man for the Ling family's unruly heir Ling Ye, and he treated her like a brother-in-arms. Until during an undercover mission where Bai Fei was forced to dress up as a woman, and Bai Fei couldn't help herself and kissed Ling Ye after getting drunk.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Chinese traditional fashion will connect the lives of two young women across the millenia.

One day, Bai Tang, a freshman in university, accidentally "picked up" a girl named Zhu Lian, a girl dressed in Tang-dynasty attire who claims to have come from more a thousand years ago... From the moment she met Zhu Liang, Bai Tang's ordinary life takes a wild turn.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The protagonist, Gu Jiao, could have grown up as a noble lady but ended up as a poor peasant girl for the mix-up at birth. No one would take her when she was finally old enough to marry. People believed she was an ugly and stupid girl who got her parents killed. However, life wasn’t altogether harsh for Gu Jiao. The man she randomly chose to marry became the chief minister of the state. The young monk she adopted became a powerful general. The old lady she rescued turned out to be the mother queen. Her husband loved her so much that he would imprison anyone who tried to bully her. The general also promised that he would conquer each place Gu Jiao chose to go to. The mother queen was so fond of Gu Jiao that she would force her son to abdicate for bullying her.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Fu Hei Wang Ye: Re Bu Qi De Xia Tang Qi
title.native: 腹黑王爷：惹不起的下堂妻

description:
“An assassin from modern times, was killed and went back in time to Ancient China.”

In the modern world, she was an assassin. In an accident, she traveled through time and became the eldest rightful daughter of the General's Mansion. But! She was bullied by the concubine and her half-sister! She would definitely get back at them! Also, her fiancé was just a scumbag hooking up with her half-sister. And now, this cunning and scheming man appears...

(Source: Comikey)

“The most important thing? Keep fighting!”

An aspiring street basketball player longs to go pro. To fulfill his dream, he joins a team of street basketball players. What challenges will await him as he battles in the streets? Will he be able to make his dreams of going pro come true?!

(Source: Comikey)

On the first snow of that year, Shan Xianchun was asked by her roommate to be a photographer for a cosplay shoot. Unexpectedly she captures a girl with long hair and green dress through her camera. The girl looked at her with complex and affectionate eyes and Shan Xianchun felt as if her heart was scratched...

"May you live forever, and never miss spring".

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: More Than A Toy to Vampire Lord DeWitt

description:
While fleeing from mercenaries, Linde ends up in a seemingly abandoned ancient castle. However, she soon finds herself face-to-face with vampires. To make matters worse, the vampire king who killed her father is not only obsessed with playing twisted, intimate games, but he also believes she is his fiancée. After surviving life-or-death situations and captivity, her determination to avenge her father’s death keeps her alive and somehow lands her in a private room within the castle. But is this newfound "freedom" truly freedom?

(Source: Webnovel)

The day after their wedding, her husband went to war. Five years later, her husband returned in triumph, but he rode with a strange woman in white. He didn't care who he married five years ago. She didn't care who she married five years ago too, while she just wanted a place to live.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Dujia Zhanyou: Ji Shao De Fu Hei Jiaoqi
title.native: 独家占有：姬少的腹黑娇妻

description:
A compelling and romantic feel-good comic about a strong woman's revenge after her rebirth!

(Source: WebComics)

In the year 235AD, the Three Kingdoms signed an agreement, ending the war and set up a common capital at Tianji Hall in Xiangyang, bring peace to the land. Two-hundred years later, grand marshal Zhuge Yongyu, the direct descendant of Zhuge Liang himself, dies suddenly in Xiangyang, only to find himself miraculously "resurrected." However, the government seems intent on eliminating him, and he is forced to escape with his comrades on a desperate search for the truth. Meanwhile, there seems to be a strange soul sharing his body. Suspicious events swirl around the wars in the northwest, as the powers in each of the nine provinces plot their moves. The foretold events in Wuhou Prophesies seem to be coming to fruition…

(Source: New Star Press, translated)

title.romaji: Hei Hua Monü Zhi Hao Cheng Wei Fanpai Le
title.english: The Corrupted Witch Has No Choice But to Become a Villain
title.native: 黑化魔女只好成为反派了

description:
Once a powerful and kind sorceress, Sera's life is turned upside down when she is betrayed and cursed, causing her magic to turn dark and twisted. Forced into the role of a villain, Sera must navigate a treacherous world filled with enemies and scarce allies. As she battles her inner demons and external threats, Sera discovers that embracing her darker side may be the only way to reclaim her destiny and uncover the truth behind her curse. Join Sera on her journey of transformation, betrayal, and redemption in this captivating manhua.

(Source: Webnovel)

Gao Yang is an orphan who, at the age of six, crossed over to a "parallel world" and has since lived in a warm family of five. At the age of eighteen, Gao Yang accidentally discovers the truth of the world: it is not a parallel world at all, but a mysterious realm where all the relatives and friends around are terrifying "beasts"!

(Source: Webnovel)

After falling from the top, being banished from the main family, and severely bullied, no one expected him to rise from the ashes like a phoenix. His awakening was extremely earth-shattering. As he stood at the peak, everyone looked up and realized..."he" was actually a woman!

(Source: Webnovel)

This is a world where beast-taming is the norm. Animals, plants, elements, spectres, robots… the nine-tailed flame fox, tree of life, thunder cloud fairy, skeleton lord, robotic fleet maiden, and even antique blades that cultivated spirits can be kept as pet beasts. The humans who form a contract with, nurture, and tame them are known as tamers. Shi Yu, a mythologist and archaeologist, found himself transmigrated to this world. In search of a missing past and a forgotten legend, he embarks on a journey of unconventional taming…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Shexie Buhaore: Qi Hou Ye Yaorao
title.native: 蛇蝎不好惹：弃后也妖娆

description:
Banished into the Cold Palace, robbed of her newborn daughter, stripped of her status... She wants to avenge her husband now that she’s lost everything. She is his Queen, but she is also the one person that he wants to get rid of the most. She’s his disgrace and he’s her grudge. She rises like a phoenix from the ashes, renounces herself from love and returns full of hatred. After a few battles she says with a smile: “Only one more step. Sadly, you’ve fallen in love with me!” After several showdowns he says in an angered tone: “Even in hell I want you to stay with me!”

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Guifei Meitian Zhi Xiang Dang Xianyu

description:
Xiao Xixi travels back to the ancient times and becomes one of the concubines of the crown prince. It is supposed to be the beginning of imperial harem struggles, but she just wants to muddle along. To compete with others to win favor with the crown prince? No! Letting it be is the way of survival and enjoying food is the true meaning of life!
However, the cold crown prince falls in love with her!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Kaiju Jiangli Yi Yi Tiao Ming
title.english: Starting With A Reward Of 100 Million Lives

description:
Transcending to a mysterious world, Jiang Cheng gained 100 million lives at the beginning. As long as he's killed, he could resurrect and gain the random abilities to defeat the opponent. From then on, all he hoped for was to be killed. "Brother, come and kill me!" "Kill me!" Opponent boss: Jiang Cheng, you little jerk, since you're courting death eagerly, I'll satisfy you!
[Ding, host, you resurrect...]

(Source: Webnovel)

Banxia, the legitimate daughter of the Marquis, was murdered by her stepsister and her beloved Crown Prince. When she woke up again, she was reborn a few days before returning to the capital. With the memories of her past life, she tore apart the facade of her wicked stepsister and hypocritical stepmother. People called her “stupid”? Fine. Then she would let everyone know that she would get back at those who had messed with her.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jin Tian Zongcai Gai Le Mei
title.english: Did the Male Lead Change Today?

description:
Struggling with a severe case of writer's block, web novelist Han Xiaoxiao collapses from a stroke and falls into a coma. Just then, the "God of Plot Twists" appears and offers her a chance to recover.

The mission: She must enter the world of her own story, "reform" its tyrannical CEO male lead, and turn her unpopular webnovel into a chart-topping hit — all within one month.

If she succeeds, she lives. If she fails, her real-world self dies for good.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The sacred heavenly gate looms high in the boundless sky, while the abyss of time and space wreaks havoc upon the world. As twelve spiritual springs rise from the earth and the moon slips beyond humanity’s grasp… where will our destiny lead? The realm of gods? The domain of demons? No, this is a world that belongs to humanity! I will claim the crown that no one else dares to bear and rise as the king of a new era. My name is Ren Jie, and to live is to be extraordinary!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

I'm an illegitimate daughter who can't be seen in the light. i've lived a peaceful life with my mother since l was a child. An explosion accident made me lose all my relatives, However, this was not an accident but a murder!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

When the sadistic heroine travels through time and space to the body of the puppet princess of a fallen nation in a 18+ novel... Can she keep herself unscathed in a den teeming with hungry wolves?

"Wait... Didn't they say this is a pure love story? Why are there so many perverted male protagonists?!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Why Blue Carp Town sank? Was there anything to do with The Lord of the River? Why Cait Ching strayed into the underwater city? Is it a coincident or fate? When crisis strikes, should we be satisfied with the existing state as they are? Caiting Ching found the question. Hope she can find the answers as well.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bei Feng Gou Faxian Wo Jing Shi Tonglei
title.native: 被疯狗发现我竟是同类

description:
A masochistic seme who embraces his true nature × a sadistic uke who suppresses his inner self.

Two individuals, one indifferent to life and the other fearless of death, both possessing unique physical conditions and psychological abnormalities, cross paths in a special unit under the criminal division of the prosecution agency: the Door Hound Unit.

Ye Yu traveled to the Tianxuan Continent, a land of hundreds of races and power, and accidentally awakened his burial system. He became invincible in the world, overlooking the rise and fall of all people. His junior sister, Shi Xinshui, could hear Ye Yu's inner thoughts and knew that he was generous on the surface but cruel in reality. So she warned everyone, "Don't mess with the senior brother."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Once lauded as the best medical examiner of her team, a woman finds herself inhabiting the body of Yancy Lisbeth, a princess neglected by the matriarch for her lunacy. Now armed with the medical knowledge of her past life, she's determined to rebuild her credibility and stay in the queen's good graces. Of course, Yancy's sisters are sure to make things difficult for the newly sane princess.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Mo Shi Yi Shi Lu Aixia De Jiushu
title.native: 魔石异世录——艾莎的救赎

description: A young lady has been cursed and parasitized by a magic stone. She became an indescribable killing machine. All of this was just the price of her witch mother seeking revenge against the gods. But the young lady didn’t surrender herself to fate. She vowed to use her own determination to find redemption and undo the cycle of the curse.

title.romaji: Bu Laobusi De Wo Qule Ge Xie Shen Laopo
title.native: 不老不死的我娶了个邪神老婆

description:
The eternally young and immortal transmigrator Lin Ze summoned the tentacled eldritch god as a wife for companionship throughout an endless life...

but will how their own motives impact this supposed life of serendipity?

The famed erotic novelist, Duan Jinghong, had a secret: with just a touch, he could foresee the intimate encounters of others. He avoided physical contact at all costs—until the notorious General Shen Tinglan, a man he’d never met, appeared uninvited at his door, demanding to share his bed.

To Duan Jinghong’s horror, his vision revealed an impossible future: tangled in passion with none other than the general himself… the same man betrothed to a royal princess.

(Source: MangaToon)

After the loss of someone she loved, Vivian drifts between memory and reality, mistaking another person with the same name for the one she mourns. A tender, melancholic portrait of grief, unexpected connections, and gradual healing.

title.english: Raise A Mink As My Wife

description:
A lovely spirit animal from heaven is forced to marry a man? Travelling into another world, the girl actually became an adorable spirit animal and she even offended the cold and kindless prince who wanted to marry her! She thought she put herself under the patronage of a higher-up, it turned out that the new world is filled with danger and conspiracies...

(Source: WebComics)

Chen mo is an invisible student. He longed to keep low-key but unexpectedly made acquaintance with dynamic girl and Prince Charming... From then on, his peaceful life ended.

(Source: WebComics)

The protagonist kindly rescued a cat, but he didn't expect that he would turn into a tough man when he returned home? A magical idea unfolds.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The malevolent energy born from humanity's collective despair has corrupted the divine. These tainted deities descend to the mortal realm, possessing human hosts to wreak havoc, feeding upon the despair of mankind. Upon discovering this plight, a coven of sorcerers formed the Divine Hunters' Council, dedicated to slaying these rebellious gods.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After being bullied and consequently dying in a tragic car crash, Lin Yuan, an ordinary high school student, finds himself in a parallel world where he becomes a Godzilla-like monster. Aiming to become the most powerful creature in this brand-new world, he will check in with a system to gain "Evolution Points" to cultivate himself to realize his maximum potential.

(Source: WebComics)

Beneath the freezing skies of Titan, Saturn’s sixth moon, a team of extraterrestrial researchers and their AI companion uncover something that shouldn’t exist: a strange black sphere that defies all known laws of physics, plunging the team into a whirlwind of confusion and fear, and forcing them to confront a force beyond their comprehension.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Musui Xiantan: Zhei Shi Pingfang Rensheng
title.english: Sui's Daily Slices: Mundane Mortal Life
title.native: 暮岁闲谈：这是平凡人生

description:
Three meals today, posterity tomorrow, all in reverie.

(Source: Official Site)

"Before me array the soldiers, line up to fight". This protection spell in traditional Chinese culture includes nine characters, each contains enormous energy of a different kind. With the power of the nine characters of truth, Ye Xuan is reborn from his fall. The power in the nine words was thus drained. In order to regain the power of revenge, Ye Xuan embarked on the road to reboot the nine characters of truth.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Bang Ding Duotai Xitong, Wo Nanie Shou Shi Xiuluo Chang
title.english: Taming The Beasts With Multi-Pregnancy System
title.native: 绑定多胎系统，我拿捏兽世修罗场

description:
To fulfill her deepest wish, Su Yan enters the realm of beasts, only to wake up as a tiny white mouse, bound to a multi-pregnancy system. To level up, she must tame one beastman after another: a battle-scarred leopard warrior, a fierce rabbit beast, and more. Each is terrifyingly strong in beast form and impossibly handsome as a man, and each one hits her right in her soft spots. With a swelling harem and a system that keeps pushing her deeper into this wild love battlefield, Su Yan’s poor heart is about to explode. But she just might turn the tables, seize control of this savage game, and tame the entire realm of beasts for herself.

(Source: Webnovel)

"Shenanigans and lively days ensue as Caicai works for her favorite company as a flower farmer!"

Caicai Luo is a young lady who got accepted to her dream company that makes her favorite plushies. But she didn't expect to work in the countryside where she meets interesting characters.

(Source: Comikey)

The devil leader who lives on human desires accidentally tied his fate with the spy girl "Pearl", and the cold devil had his only weakness. In this sweet and dangerous love chase, the two opened up the most painful forbidden areas in each other's hearts and learned about each other's unknown past. At this time, a deeper conspiracy and danger are approaching them...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After his death, college student Xingye gained the ability to fully possess others. Yet he unexpectedly possessed a corpse that had been reanimated. This reanimated corpse had once been the holder of a system. Its death and transformation into a reanimated corpse were entirely caused by its own system. This system would assign suicidal missions regardless of the host's level. But Xingye discovered that, as a reanimated corpse, he and this death-defying system actually worked surprisingly well together?

Hahaha, I'm already dead. What's there to fear about courting death?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Quanqiu Yi Neng: Wo Zhangkong Suoyou Yuansu
title.native: 全球异能：我掌控所有元素

description:
Qin Feng travels to a parallel universe and finds that the Earth has changed and elementalists have become the masters of humanity. Relying on the awakened system, Qin Feng embarks on the path of escalating from the bottom to becoming a god!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

It's 3 oneshots linked by the common theme of gashapon and some of the characters being friends with one another and/or attending the same school.

• Love Gashapon
On the first day that Yuhan moved into her new home, she discovered a window in her room that looks across directly at a neighbor's window. From that neighbor's window a mysterious shadow lurks...

• Love Capsule Toy - Welcome, First Love
YanZhu is a very shy girl, who has always liked her senpai but didn't have the courage to confess. It isn't until Valentine's Day eve, after she bought a toy at Monmon's shop, that she finally got up the courage to confess, who knew...

• Love Capsule Toy - A Prince without the Glass Slipper
Zhou ZiYu is a playboy who has never refused anybody, so he has countless number of ex-girlfriends. He is this kind of guy, yet he meets his soulmate at a masque ball? This is the longest of the stories, has 3 parts.

In a post apocalyptic world an invisible monster sucks its victims bone dry, only those about to die are able to see it.

Winner of the Best Art Award at the Asia Issued Comics Summit in 1999.

title.romaji: Da Xi You: Mo Fei Zheng Zhuan

description:
500 years after the original Journey to the West, Sun Wukong is reincarnated as a boy named Bokuhi!

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)

He Wei lived a peaceful life in this border town with his good friend Wanjun. But suddenly two boys moved in from the big city who don't fit in: He Qiuzhan, the step-brother who caused He Wei to leave home, and Bai Lin, the childhood friend who had a crush on him. Their arrival will change He Wei's life forever, as all the secrets gradually emerge......

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

In previous life, he was her most loyal bodyguard, but miss each other in that life forever because of a misunderstanding. In this life, he seeks her track, changes into a lovely boy, and becomes her most intimate "trouble"?! The road to love is never easy... Who was the princess in his dreams...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Fu Hei Shaoye Liao Shang Wo

description:
She was set on getting to the bottom of her father’s death. As she dug deeper, she found out that it was a murder case committed by a huge corporation. Along the way, her paths crossed with a cold, arrogant, and two-faced young master. The most impetuous female lead of the century meets the two-faced young master of the universe. What flirtatious melody will the two of them produce?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Originally, I just wanted to live like an ordinary girl. What the hell is going on with the Ghost King? Why should I take the responsibility for our one night stand, which was totally accidental. Jesus! The King: Stop complaining. It was all your fault! Poor Me: Yes, Ghost King! That's fine... Boohoo...

(Source: Webcomics App)

"Lisa, do you think that you can get rid of me by pretending not to know me? You know what? That's impossible! You're not going to leave me until I'm dead!" "I want to have a baby, our baby." A rom-com between a cold-hearted CEO and a beautiful girl is about to unfold.

(Source: Webcomics App)

title.romaji: Shouxi Zongcai De Gao Leng Jiao Qi

description:
To pay for her mother's medical fees, she found a nightclub and sold herself at a high price. But when she found herself in the big luxurious bed and faced the ugly middle-aged bald men, she regretted her choice and ran away...

(Source: Webcomics App)

title.romaji: Badao Xiao Cao De Zhuai Yatou

description:
He fell in love with her at first sight. To win her heart, He had changed himself from a playboy to a good student and her personal cook. He even helped her dying ex-boyfriend who she never forgot…He had basically given her all he had and done all he could do for her…but, in the end, he still couldn't win her heart...

(Source: Webcomics)

An ordinary student coincidentally ran into a vampire, and somehow, they ended up being neighbors. Moreover, who knew that this coincidence would lead to even more mysterious stories! How would you know if people around you weren't really human?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Mi Tao Xiao Qingren Zhi Lie Ai Zhixia
title.native: 蜜桃小情人之烈爱知夏

description:
An accident designed by her ex-boyfriend changed her life dramatically and her father's being put in prison make her to find someone powerful to help. And price she offers is herself. What she doesn't know is, that cold and bossy man she sells herself for falls in love with her at first sight. Once a young rich lady, nowadas a puppet, she tries to flee and he tries his best to make her stay. As the wheel of fortune started, where will they go.
(Source: Webcomics)

In order to help out her best friend, Yasmin Lin pretended to be the mistress in a relationship and went head-to-head with the legal wife. Unfortunately, she mistakenly smashed Ji Group's president Laurence Ji's luxury car. In exchange, Yasmin is forced to become Laurence's fiancée in revenge against his father...

(Source: Webcomics)

Zhu Jinyu is an eighteen-year-old girl who died from overeating and finds herself in the afterlife Her death was a mistake, and to make things right, she was sent to another world as a chubby fairy Reborn as Chichi, she gets to enjoy a new life in a new world where she might possibly find love

(Source: INKR)

Because of a superstition, I was deceived by my beloved to dedicate my wedding night to the King of Yama (king of hell, who masters the life and death people in mortal world), and my parents were sent as sacrifice to the God of River. Although my parents were fine after that, I could not escape from the control of the king of hell...
(Source: WebComics)

A magic app forces Xia Shi to abandon her normal life and become a delivery girl across time and space. Upon completing her final multidimensional delivery, she’s swept away to another world. A world of god-like beings known as celestials, a world of demons and ginormous winged kitty cats? What the heck kind of world is this?! Can Xia convince one of these celestials to take her home? And why does their leader, the Grand Master, seemingly despise her?

(Source: Tapas)

A workplace romance in a bustling city, this is the story of busy people, leading equally busy lives. Between rookie Yang Xiaoyang, ‘leftover woman’ Qiao Wenwei, cool-headed Du Zhong, and outgoing Zhang Yu, will they be able to find love?

Being fair-skinned, pretty and rich, Ruirui seems has everything others are longing for but the only thing she wants as well as she lacks is a boyfriend. After a series of failing relations with her dates, Ruirui’s uncle hires a ‘love tutor’ for her. It seems like this young, handsome and skillful tutor who’s also gay is really useful. Will he help Ruirui out and find her a true love?

(Source: MangaToon)

Beautify your selfie with a Facelift Game APP, and your face will appear more beautiful in real life. However, every change comes at a cost, which may hurt your friends, lovers, and family. Even if you already knew it, would you use such an app?

(Source: INKR)

Note: Second season of Beauty Game.

"Will an interracial romantic relationship work out?! Aren't vampires what killed my parents?" I start to think about this when I met the harmless white-haired vampire? He seems different. He could kill me at the very beginning yet he didn't do anything but help me get out of troubles." Instead, why the one I trust most advise me again and again not to get myself involved in that vampire-hunter task anymore? I know there is something hiding from me, but what should I do to find it out?

General Heyan met her end through betrayal, only to be reborn as a frail maiden. Vowing to reclaim all she lost, she returned to the barracks and took up arms once more under a new identity, determined to earn a marquis title and strike fear into the Nine Provinces. Along the way, she reunited with her formidable foe from a past life—a wolfish young general. Hand in hand, they marched onto the battlefield together, forging the legend of the Twin Generals. Amidst tangled threads of love and hate, and the treacherous web of power struggles, witness how this woman of valor earns her marquis title and strikes fear into the hearts of all under heaven.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Gonglüe Duixiang! Ni Ren She Waile a!
title.native: 攻略对象！你人设歪了啊！

description:
"Why can’t you like me…brother?"
"Don’t call me brother, it’s disgusting."

…So now that we’re in a dating game, why is this non-capture target who looks like my brother always pestering me?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

They are not compatible, but somehow they became partners. A handsome and flustered guy asks, "What? Who says two good-looking guys can't appreciate each other? We are also going to develop feelings for each other..." "You want to solve cases with psychology?" "Someone who only knows how to solve things with their fists like an animal." A SWAT officer bites his ear lightly and says, "Do you want to know how animals do it?"

(Source: Webcomics)

I, the empress, who is rumoured to sit upon the world, who is tyrannical, who snatches men and forces them to be concubines, have met my retribution... Those from my past have turned their backs on me, and I ended up falling into my 'enemy's' hands!

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Xue Ba Gege Bie Peng Wo

description:
What? On my first day as transfer student, I got a forced kiss by the top student!? I, who has a special ability and identity, enrolled into a prestigious school with the only purpose of searching the person that framed my family, but isn’t this picture is a little wrong!? A violin prince? A handsome drama club boy? Please stop pestering me! I won’t pay any attention to you!

(Source: WebComics)

A dark chronicle of intrigue and betrayal set in the royal palace of a crumbling kingdom. A chronicle that will make you laugh the second before dropping you into a pit of despair. A chronicle without pretense, a strike straight to the heart.

Gentle, considerate, handsome—according to Shannon Cui—these are the qualities of the ideal boyfriend. If only she could get one. 26 and rapidly approaching "un-dateable" territory, Shannon has been waiting for the perfect someone to sweep her off her feet. Problem is, he's not showing. Date after failed date, she can't help but ask if he exists or worse...is she too old for a boyfriend?!

(Source: Tapas)

The surgeon, Tang Xiaoli never thought that she had time traveled one day! When she opened her eyes after the time-travel, she saw a handsome guy was looking at her and said, "My empress, wasn't I good to you?"

(Source: Webcomics)

Strangely resurrected, Su Wu uses his grandfather's watch to connect to the perfect life simulator—What? I'm going to die next week? What?? The week after next, the whole world is strangely resurrected? Watch me use the simulator to find a perfect path to a perfect life in the strangely resurrected apocalypse!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Our protagonist and his family of five, along with some people bitten by mutant flies, set out on the bench-seats of train X47, on the way home for Chinese New Year. As the train headed north, the temperature dropped to -13C, and the people bitten by the flies suddenly mutated into monsters...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Bai Ri Lian Ai Ji Hua

description:
If you're asked to be in love with someone within 100 days, will you accept it? Due to system error, Qing Leng is forced to form LC Love Counseling with three boys and teach everybody how to love, during which process, however, entanglements appear in this team... Supposed to be sweet campus love story, it finally turns out to be a huge and secret plan which even threatens their lives...

(Source: Webcomics)

After signing a lucrative movie contract, popular actress Bai Dingding heads off into the mountains for filming. However, she never thought that what would await her was a giant prank -- "The Inn of Deceiving Stars (Qi Xing Inn)," a reality show that involves a historical-style inn that was specifically designed to deceive Dingding into thinking she's traveled to the ancient past. Having fallen for the ruse, Bai Dingding is forced to diligently manage the shady Seven Stars Inn (also read as Qi Xing Inn) in order to survive. Will Dingding be able to see through the program's directors and their meticulous plans? What kind of "new life" will begin to play out within the mountainous wilderness?

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

Qin Xiaoqing, a pretty female vampire, was cursed by another jealous vampire and sent to another realm. There she met the king of the vampire who's got a hot face and a six-pack that no girl can resist. However, the curse she got made men think that she was ugly. Then how could she seduce the hot vampire king?

(Source: WeComics)

What would the experience of being simultaneously chased by 4 god-like men with weird personalities be like? An ordinary high-school girl, Mo Li, is confessed to by 4 unfamiliar men. When she finally pulls herself together, she finds that these 4 'unfamiliar' men have unexpectedly integrated themselves into her life somehow. So then how will she make her decision on who to choose?

It's a world ruled by cards. Chen Mu is a one-star card maker and he got a precious card in a second-hand store by chance. By learning card making theory during the day and studying the precious card at night, he makes rapid progress on card making, and his card is valued by the top student from Dongwei Academy. His life is going through changing without being noticed!

(Source: Webnovel)
A girl who can't see dreams meets a boy who dreams a lot, the two get along and started to see each other frequently.

title.romaji: Xiao Hui Li De Lian Ai Shou Zhang

description:
The fox demon Qiao Lian and her brother are running a small fortune telling house-the Fox's. Those who go to the Fox's shall exchange something with Qiao Lian to get an answer they want. Actually, Qiao Lian runs the fortune telling house to wait for her destined lover to reincarnate. During a case of finding the sister of a cat demon, she saved a boy…

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.english: Forbidden Love over A Thousand Years

description:
The naïve low-level disciple of Zongtian residence, Zhan Yunchang, has been suffering from her unrequited love for Lang Guichi, her eminent senior brother for six full years before she finally acts on her impulse driven by alcohol and bared her heart to him. However, she gradually discovers that Lang Guichi’s gentle demeanour is in fact harbouring aloofness which resulted from his unbearable past. Before long, Zhan Yunchang makes acquaintance with another senior brother, Cang Yan, who is free-spirited and uninhibited by nature. Nevertheless, he seems to be hiding his mysterious past as well.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.romaji: Si Chong Tian Xin Bao Bei

description:
Suffering from terminal disease, the unknown actress Lin Xia who just starts her career is at the same time abandoned by her boyfriend. When she finally gives in to the man who is with supreme power and money out of helplessness, the man replies with his eyes half-closed, “I never do good deeds unless you devote yourself to me!” Looking at her angry back, the man...

(Source: Webcomics)

She is the War Goddess. She is the Death. She is the soul of hundreds of troops. She fought for country, but her mom was framed up and got killed. She swore to revenge, however, she found a dreadful plot behind it. He is a swordsman. He is a miracle doctor. He is also a perfect-pretended spy. He is gentle and loyal. He came to her with his intention, but healed her all wounds and fell in love with her unconsciously.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: I Will Never Be Into You Again

description:
“Qiao Yu, if I'm unable to avoid meeting you again, this time, I'll make sure to protect my heart and not fall in love with you!”

After Xiao Qing walks in on his boyfriend of ten years with another man, he storms out, only to meet his end. But when Qing reincarnates and travels to a time before he meets Qiao Yu, he vows to protect himself against his former love. How will he change his fate?

(Source: Comikey)

In order to protect her family, the female agent Lou MiYin, finally obtained file No.0 after repeated failures. Just as it seemed like the whole situation was turning out for the better for her family, she ended up been targeted by the eldest young master of the Mu family! The adaptive female agent versus the cruel and arrogant young master, a thrilling battle of love and murder begins. The corner of his lips lifted, “We meet again, Miss Lou.”

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

She's a rich family's daughter. Centre of the stage and living without worry. When her best friend and boyfriend betray her, she even lost her virginity. After one night with a random stranger, she fled in sorrow. Five years later, she's back again with a cute little boy in hand...

(Source: Webcomics)

Luna Wu, a modern killer who is skilled in special effects make-up, accidentally time travels to an ancient time and become the Premier's youngest daughter who is retarded. Faced with a number of bitchy girls, strange family members, a troublesome prince and a cunning lord, she overcomes all difficulties by using her special effects make-up and self-made props, and finally becomes the empress.

(Source: Webcomics)

A woman is murdered then reincarnates as the born-again Kungfu Lady. A story of revenge, moving into adulthood, romance, and ambition...

(Source: Webcomics)

When vampire prince falls in love with a normal human girl, this was supposed to be a legendary interracial love story. But hardly do we really know the schemes and fights between different vampire clans. What follows is a story of a cat and mouse chase between mortals and supernatural beings and the answer to the most fundamental question of the story: whether true love will prevail and overcome the age-old hatred between two species at war, humans and vampires.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Guaren You Ji Qi Ming Xiangsi
title.native: 寡人有疾 其名相思

description:
I just wanted to have a husband, but who knew that I'm a jinx to my future husband. Alright, no one has the courage to marry me. I could be doomed to a life of solitude. But, dear Imperial Uncle, may I have a discussion with you? Next time you come to my room, could you come in through the door? "No way, we're dating secretly. Climbing through the window makes me feel better."

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Wo De Tian Tian Xiao Baomu
title.english: Throw Myself On My Sweet Maid

description:
There's nothing more concerning than that attracting a man and vowing to marry him when being a drunken chaotic mess! Bai LiangChen got drunk at a bar, and somehow became the bride of a family... That's not right, well to say it exactly, Lian JiaYun's personal maid. In any case Lian JiaYun is the chairman of a huge company, but is also a pervert who's always teasing her?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: My Horse Is A Fox Spirit?

description: The super dedicated emperor that “only loves his kingdom and dislikes beauties”, and the unfortunate vixen that “decided to use beauty to ruin the kingdom”. Hu Xiaocha, a vixen who wants to seduce the emperor of the Qian Kingdom, transformed into horse to sneak into the imperial palace. When she’s a horse, the emperor, Bai Liang, treats her with much love. However, when she transform back into a human, Bai Liang turns a blind eye on her... Hey, hey! A vixen also needs to preserve their reputation, okay?!

title.romaji: Mommy Laixi: Daddy Qing Jie Zhao

description: She, the sexy hot superstar, is 100% black-hearted. He, the sole heir of the Ye family's century-old wealth, monopolizes the brilliance. Their encounter, doomed to spread like wildfire. Ye Jinze: "Keke, you promised you would be responsible for me seven years ago." An Keke: "You believed me?"

Su Keke, a quick learner who devotes to study, encountered a fortune teller on her way home and was transformed into someone with enchantment. As a result, her life changed drastically. All the boys became her fans and she received various confessions every single day, which greatly impeded her study! All those who try to stop me from studying, go to hell!! Don't love me, or die!!

(Source: Webcomics)

To find the truth of her brother's death, young girl Chu Ye is accidentally involved in a fantastic world of oil painting, in a world ruled by vampires, humans are nothing but meals. Accidentally saved by the vampire hunter Edward, Chu Ye finds that he is actually a vampire?! Then why does he stand by humans' side? Why is Chu Ye's brother missing? This is a different love story between a human and a vampire!

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Chang Le Tongxue Ling Wo Wufa Gaobai
title.english: Unable To Confess To Chang Le
title.native: 常乐同学令我无法告白

description:
Man Qian is a university student who has quite the crush on Chang Le, a boy from the comedy club. She tries her best to convey her feelings, but can't confess to him without laughing. Her journey of trying to confess her feelings begins with a busy college life and nonstop laughter.

(Source: INKR)

The palace chief of the zodiac is finding his lost pet fox, but due to him being playful, he wanders into the human world. Unexpectedly, after 100 years, his lost pet suddenly appear in front of him, but that's not all, his lost pet fall into a hundred year slumber due to eating elixir resulting in amnesia?

A thousand years ago, Deity Yuxu was killed by the Demon King in order to save the cat demon Yingwan, sending his soul into the cycle of reincarnation. A thousand years later, Yingwan finds Yuxu's reincarnation in the city and tries to pick up where they left off. However, Yingwan is already on the brink of death... Can the two of them survive all the odds and end up together again?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

She allied herself with hostile power for her own country, but ended up killed by her brother after suffering from years of humiliation. When she wakes up, she finds herself back to her young age with the only ambition to avenge herself on those who turn their back on her, especially her royal brother. To her surprise, she's not that cold-blooded to murder the young brother before her...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Shengshi Nüyi: Leng Wang Chong Fei

description:
Being transported back in time, she became Liu Jinglan, a girl who disguised as a man. All right! To fulfill the wish of that girl, she stayed in the military camp. But how should she... take a bath?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Yi Fei Qingcheng: Wangfei Yao Xiu Fu

description:
Transporting back in time, she almost met her death because of a bowl of heart blood! What’s worse, the playboy and the basic b*tch tortured her together, not only her body, but also her heart, and they even tried to refine her into medication to cure the basic b*tch. Damn it! I’m a sleeping tiger, not a sick cat! Fighting the playboy and getting back at the basic b*tch, I’ll make them know who I am step by step. But... why does the His Royal Highness climbs onto my bed every night?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: I'll Make the Scumbags Cry Their Hearts Out

description:
Upon her death, Ning Shu becomes a mission-taker who helps poor souls exact revenge on their behalf. She therefore jumps from one world to another, playing various roles and meeting various scumbags. She snarls, "You scumbags, I'm only here to exact revenge. Don't be a hindrance, or I'll torture the hell out of anyone who obstructs me from completing the mission!"

(Source: Webnovel)

I've time-traveled to be the most vicious empress in the world? Author, this character setting isn't right! Since I've been forced to accept the label being the No. 1 vicious empress, look what you made me do!

(Source: WebComics)

Huang Yue, an auspicious cloud thousand years ago, died because he wanted to be together with Xia Ying, the Yinglong Dragon and thus suffered the Thunder Trial. Xia Ying tried his best to keep Huang Yue's soul, so Huang Yue could have another life. And in this life, Huang Yue reincarnated as God of Marriage. Because of his poor performance, he was kicked to the mortal world to match the unattached and encountered Xia Ying. Fate brought them together again. They began to deal with those love affairs together and came to know the truth of their previous life.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 9 extras.

As a loser protagonist, he has a shocking name of "Gao Fu Shuai(Rich, Tall and Handsome)," despite facing employment issues he also experiences a series of incredible events. As the gears of destiny quietly turns, he challenges the apex of power and continues towards the peak of life.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

A human baby was born to be the Ghost Bride, but it turns out to be a boy! He's told repeatedly that his marriage is destined by fate, but it's actually a means by which his husband satisfies his own insatiable desire for love. He seizes every chance to escape and his ghost husband, who just latches onto him, keeps chasing.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and one extra.

What kind of sparks will fly between an angel and a devil? What is the feud passed down through generations of vampires and werewolves? How does a mermaid and a fairy date? On a continent where many races coexist peacefully, any kind of gay romance is possible!

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

Coffee is a cash crop, too bad Declan doesn’t have any money. Terribly in debt, he plans to sell his family’s countryside coffee plantation. His father agrees…if he can master the trifecta of coffee: bean variety, brewing technique, and latte art. He has a month to make the perfect blend and Liam, the cool, attractive, barista will teach him.

How do you like your coffee? At The Cat’s Meowcchiato, it’s always hot.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Zongcai Daren de Shuangmian Chong Qi
title.english: Then Spoiled Wife with a Different Face

description:
She was manipulated by her scumbag ex and offered as a gift to the CEO. What she had thought to be a nightmare turned out to be the beginning of happiness, as this man cherished and loved her. Faced with his dominant and forceful advances time and time again, she eventually surrendered her body and soul to him completely... However, due to an accident, she changed her appearance and had to part ways with him. When they met again, would the man be able to recognize the person in front of him as the woman he once deeply loved?

(Source: Webnovel)

Zheng Ling Xi didn’t want to get married but wanted a baby of her own, so she went to the bar to seek for the baby’s father, but didn’t want to mess with her immediate boss. Do you want to run away after teasing me? Dream on! She has been facing the evil president’s internal and external troubles. Finally, Zheng Ling Xi couldn’t bear it and ask: “What do you want?” The president laughed: “Let’s get married!”

(Soure: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Yuer Le is determined to investigate the mysterious disappearance of her best friends from two years ago. She enters a casino to find the heir of a noble family, her prime suspect. However, she is unexpectedly forced to dance for him, and this leads her into a more complicated scheme. The nature of friendship and love remains puzzling as she tries to unravel the conspiracy.

(Source: INKR)

The female leads who reincarnate into another world are usually both smart and brave, and possess special skills as the main characters. They avenge the original heroine who died a tragic death, then win over handsome men and conquer the world. But what would happen if a useless loser reincarnated as the female lead of a harem story?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
Carry forward the positive energy and act now!

I was just walking down the hotel corridor when I first met the overbearing CEO. This beautiful stranger forcibly adopted me, saying that he has some weird sickness and I am his only cure. In order to shake off his headache, he has locked me up in a corner; but I was never the obedient type...

(Source: Webnovel)

I have been searching for you for a thousand years. Now that I’ve found you, I won't let you leave.

Triangle love! Bossy yet devoted vampire x Gentle and handsome CEO, who will you choose?

There is a lonely creature in the world. People call them Vampires. They feed on human blood. They are immortal and powerful. Only their beloved brides can grant them death. When Kyla San woke up from coma, a handsome guy wanted to kiss her. After explanation, she knew that he is a doctor. But what she doesn’t know is that he is actually a vampire who has recognized her last life as his bride and he sees her as his personal belonging...

(Source: Webcomics)

Season 1: 73 chapters
Season 2: 82 chapters
Season 3: 31 chapters

title.romaji: Shi Guang He Ni Dou Hen Mei

description: Lin Jiage has only ever wanted two things in his life — Shi Yao, and time spent with Shi Yao. Starting from many, many years ago, Lin Jiage has had something he wanted to tell Shi Yao. However, it isn't until many years later that he finally has the good fortune to say it to her: There is nothing in this world more beautiful... than my beautiful time with you.

title.romaji: Kao Jin Ni Hui Diao Ci

description:
Here you can find any type of lovable couple you like!

Welcome to a world where plants can come to life! A cactus that loses his spikes when he's embarrassed x A tumbleweed that always runs away after whining. At the botanic academy for humanized plants, there is an ultimately adorable and funny story every day!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Nan Yi Qi Chi De Jiechu

description:
Does rebirth really exist? Do people have a soul after their death?

The comic tells stories between a cold psychic and a super lucky college student. Will Shi Chenhua bring luck to Xia Ke who has been surrounded by trouble? An exciting but unmentionable part-time job; the spirits-dispelling rites that can touch souls; the destined encounter... and someone hiding in the darkness.

After going through all the trouble, Xia Ke says to Shi Chenhua:" Would you like to be my lucky charm?"

(Source: Webnovel)

Legend has it that an invasion of foreign enemies during the last years of Daqi disrupted the people's peaceful life. Aspiring men rushed to join the army to protect the country. The tall and handsome Liu Yan was no exception. Meanwhile, noble-born Ye Qinxue joined the army in search of Liu Yan. When they meet again, Liu Yan is strangely affected by Ye Qinxue...

"I'm really not silly!" The new emperor felt it necessary to justify himself! But no one believed it. "I am the Son of Heaven. It should be whatever beauty is available at my fingertips. Yet why I feel a little lonely..." He murmured. That is the reason that he starts his way to hook up beauties all the time... Note: "Beauty" is widely used for praising the appearance of both men and women in ancient China

(Source: Webcomics)

Ke suddenly finds herself transported back in time and becomes the maid of the famous Yuan Yuan. But when Yuan Yuan elopes with her lover, Ke is forced to pretend to be the beautiful courtesan. Follow Ke as she seeks her true love to return to her own time while pretending to be Yuan Yuan!

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Yingxiong Lianmeng Zhi Yingxiong De Xinyang
title.native: 英雄联盟之英雄的信仰

description:
The former LoL prodigy, once known as the "World's Number One Midlaner", returns to the e-sports stage as a coach, leading a team of hot-blooded youths to the top.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Xin Jin Shang Xian Fu Shen Jun

description:
Human prayed, Gods were born. This is how "Yaoi" God came to us. The Moon God believes in marriage between men and women, but Yaoi God says that gender can not determine loves. What will happen after the collision between the new mind of Yaoi and the conservative mind of Moon?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Zui Hao Zhui Xu, Long Wang Dian

description:
To others, I am a good-for-nothing. My mother-in-law doesn't like me because I live off my wife. In addition, there are a bunch of scums that are hungrily eyeing for my wife! Who said a live-in son-in-law can't soar high into the sky? I will protect Ji Xueyun from now on!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Chongai Nan Tao: Pianzhi Gu Shao Gao Leng Qi
title.native: 宠爱难逃:偏执顾少高冷妻

description:
He is a young general from a distinguished family; she is a married woman, betrayed countless times by her husband. The sinful relationship of a few years ago… The years of searching… And the reunion.

(Source: Webcomics)

On the orders of the Emperor, the disabled general Chu Pingyun was to marry the princess. However, the one delivered to him on his wedding day was not the princess, but the good-for-nothing prince—Li Jiu! While Chu Pingyun and Li Jiu masquerade as a loving couple to navigate political strife and battlefields, will their fake relationship turn into something real?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an extra; several chapters are also split into parts.

There are two men who will start fighting once they see each other. They won’t be friends anyway. So what kind of relationship will they have? The cold and proud high-class boy meets with a rebellious and edgy lad. They got an unsolved grudge during high school. Just when they thought they would never see each other again, they became neighbors who would meet every day at university! What will happen to them this time? What stories will they create?

(Source: Webnovel)

Tang, a charming noble, almost met his end at the hands of a sleazy prince. Luckily, he awakens to find himself in the home of Cheng, the stunning stranger-turned-bandit who saved him! While recovering in the mountains, the unlikely pair form a bond, but they eventually go their separate ways. Even so, they can’t stop thinking about each other... is there a happily ever after for them, or will their conflicts tear their love apart?

(Source: Tapas)

Fang Ziyu, a BL comic artist, was looking for reference material for his next work. He found inspiration in an art student Nan Gongzhi who became his model. They became drawn to each other in the process, but both have secrets they can't tell. Will they be able to help each other...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 14 extras.

A foolish and stubborn little servant girl has to serve this Lord day and night. This lord is not only crafty, unruly, and handsome, but the most most important thing is that he’s super lazy! He plays with his little servant girl all day long, but he cannot resist. What will they do?

On his first day after being promoted to CEO, Gu Qingpei is tasked with taking care of the Chairman's son - an arrogant and unruly military guy who seems to clash with him. But if Gu Qingpei couldn't handle this unruly child, how could he expect to lead his employees? Days go by with tension and conflict between the two. However, their relationship begins to evolve in an unforeseen manner…

(Source: INKR, edited)

All Beru wants is a friend, but being a vampire means he's forever alone. After venturing out one Halloween, however, he meets a ghost named Aki. Their worlds collide, and they begin to form a bond like no other.

(Source: Manta)

A sweet and seductive demon x angel couple! The two races were meant to be like fire and water, yet the head general of the demons, Wei Zou, secretly holds a crush on the head general of the angels, An Si. To earn the angel's affection, Wei Zou will try everything to trick the naive angel to come closer to him. In the process, An Si, who disliked demons, started to find himself gradually warming up to Wei Zou.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count Includes a prologue.

The first-year high school girl Ai Xin fell in love with her classmate Cheng Xu after being rescued by him. Although her confession was rejected, she wouldn't give up so easily. With the support of her friends, she did her best to pursue the hopeless relationship. Because he was a robot with an artificial intelligence, there was a series of misunderstandings and mishaps, even as he became a world-saving superhero while going to school. But as he spent more time with Ai Xin, he learned more and more about human emotions, and became more like a normal boy...

(Source: Weibo Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Wu Ge Gege Shi Nan Shen

description:
Xia Yumo has 5 brothers. Big brother is haughty (pervert). The second brother is kind (gentleman). The third brother is rebellious (delinquent). The fourth brother is beautiful (cross-dresser). The fifth brother is cute (cunning). What are they gonna do to her?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Xu Chaomu was born in a peaceful and prosperous age as an aristocrat, beloved by the Emperor and spoiled by the Empress Dowager... In short, she had plenty of reasons to be smirking. "Ah... This is the life!" Then, an imperial decree was issued, naming the Protector-Princess the new Crown Princess. Xu Chaomu was taken aback. "So... Who's the Crown Prince?" The Crown Princess had been selected before the Crown Prince. Did the Emperor want her to choose a husband? Xu Chaomu's response? "The country is filled with handsome, eligible bachelors, and the Imperial Princes are outstanding too." Who am I supposed to choose? "Uncle! Don't run away!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A one-night stand with my real husband? Being entangled by evil women? The first lover returns? Even though you're a president, you can't do whatever you want! Tang Zechen, don't forget you have a wife.

(Source: Webcomics)

Garam is the biggest bully in the worst school in the city, but he’s bored of slacking off and wants to change for the better. Ahnseung is a nerdy transfer student from a prestigious high school hoping to stay invisible until graduation. Like water and oil, the two shouldn’t mix. Yet Garam’s new ambition requires a model student to guide him toward success, and Ahnseung is the perfect match. Can these two extremely different boys reach a mutually beneficial compromise?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: The chapter count includes 5 extra chapters.

The triennial Candy Star competition is coming again. In order to fulfill his mother's last wish to obtain the Candy Star honor, Meng Tai, the owner of MR. CANDY, asked his childhood partner Ning Te to develop new candy together. However, the process of developing the new candy was not as smooth as expected. Meng Tai was frustrated for a while and ran out of the store. Just when Meng Tai was in distress, a fairy appeared in front of him, claiming that he could use magic to help him make delicious candies. In order to prove that "you can make delicious candies without relying on Ning Te", will the angry Meng Tai agree to the temptation of the fairy...?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Once upon a time, there was a make-up artist, whose talent drew crowds, and his beauty was second to none. But he had a terrifying secret, —he was a straight man. Once upon a time, there was a closet gay man that pretended to be straight. He was formerly the god of esports, and currently a superstar. He is explosive, and likes to silently curse at people in crowded places. What will happen when a male make-up artist “becomes entangled” with an explosive idol? Just what kind of fireworks will emerge from this drama?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Yu Ta Zhengmian Duijue De Rizi
title.english: Facing Off Against the Scumbag Top

description:
Yu Baoyuan bared his soul for five years but still ended up being driven away by the scumbag. Was he defeated? Impossible. Even if his entire life was a mess, Brother Yuanbao still insisted that he—the dauntless, stubborn and foxy man—was the chosen one. Hence, Brother Yuanbao did not waver when the scumbag poured his heart out to ask for forgiveness. Yuanbao stroked his cat as he drank tea and casually commented, “The weather has turned chilly, some men should be trained…"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

One is a beauty with bewitching eyes who hides the secrets of the dragon clan, and the other is an orphan who has infiltrated the government, who was used and betrayed by his master.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters

title.romaji: Luan Zhi Du, Xue Zhi Yao

description:
A dangerous journey gave Gu Ming the chance to meet the warm light that once existed in his heart -- Li Shuo. But now known as Wei San, he has already lost all memories about Gu Ming and is now an assassin. Mutual destruction or mutual redemption await the two...

A world ravaged by a mysterious organization, and a chaotic city filled with violence and madness. For the sake of revenge, and for the sake of saving Li Shuo from a cruel fate, Gu Ming will have no hesitation, even if he has to fall into a deep swamp of darkness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: The Rise of the Frivolous Emperor

description:
Is the emperor in control or being controlled?

Wen Zhao, the prince of Qinghe, is the self-proclaimed number one playboy in the capital. After being forced to become Emperor he is brutally assassinated but miraculously comes back to life. Deciding to make an unexpected comeback, he uses all sorts of dirty tricks to make his entrance.

(Source: Manta)

A heartbeat sizzles like lightning and fizzles like a lemon. A chemical reaction occurs between the campus beau who is busy with his career and the top student who is busy with his academics. Qin Weihang X An Ning

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes one bonus chapter.

Because an ordinary girl is a fanatical fan of a male idol group, she was judged by an alien technology piggy bank as the best candidate for "loving many people at once". Bao Xiaofan is coerced into signing a travel agreement to go to a different world to collect LOVE coins.

As a result, she transmigrated into a female hooligan who threatened the male protagonist. And that stupid piggy bank actually made a request for her to quickly make the male protagonist fall in love with her, get the LOVE coins and run!

Tell the truth! Is it possible? ! !

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Cong Zhu Tian Wan Jie Guilai

description:
After three years in jail, he will emerge with the seven strongest bloodlines under heaven, twelve peak professional skills, thirty-six sets of supreme martial arts, seventy-two strongest mystical techniques, and 108 top-level chaos mantras! But with his maxed out martial powers, it turns out his spirit animal is a pig?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Let an elementary school boy show you how to flirt with girls! A cute slice-of-life story between a stone-faced but sweet-talking boy and a girl who's easily teased and gets a bit jealous sometimes. This is what childhood friends are all about! Follow the younger brother from "no words", as the brothers will make you swoon!

(Source: Manman, translated)

title.romaji: Bingjiao Tudimen Dou Xiang Tuidao Wo
title.native: 病娇徒弟们都想推倒我

description:
In order to survive his trial of calamity, the crafty old master Ji Baitai should have slept for ten years. But he woke up early, and his female apprentices who were vying to "sleep with him" have disappeared. When he found them again, there's the sexy demon, seductive catgirl, cute loli, haughty swordswoman, and gorgeous twins all over him, trying to get into his pants! And then he found out another shocking secret, he can only choose one between immortality and women!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Xiuzhen Nüxiao: Meizi Dou Xiang Pu Dao Wo
title.native: 修真女校：妹子都想扑倒我

description:
Wang Po slept for three thousand years. When he woke up, he got a job as the dormitory custodian of the Cultivation Girls' School. Now he can freely enter the girls' dormitory, as rich heiresses throw themselves at him and demon girls fall for his charms. See how a little dorm custodian use his powers to carry these girls to new heights of cultivation!

(Source: Kuaikan,translated)

A story about the eunuch Army Inspector Huai En and the General Hua Shichen as they fight traitorous court officials, battle the northern barbarians, guard the frontier, and make their love and ideals a reality.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Bei Xìtong Tuo Guan Le

description:
Many ordinary people become meta-humans after a fireball. And among them is Fang Ning, who gets a system. Thanks to this all-powerful system, he goes from a couch potato to a top meta-human. The man and the system bicker a lot during the trip but still stand up for each other when things happen.

(Source: Webnovel)

A cross species, angsty love story that features a beautiful snake demon and a human girl.

(Source: WebComics)

The amateur author Bai Zixi transmigrated into her own novel, becoming the innocent heroine, due to be seduced and abused by the handsome CEO. But she didn't mind being teased, after all the CEO is amazing and handsome, just like how she wrote it! Every word she wrote has come true so far. But what she didn't realize was that even her typos and mistaken words will be taken literally and come true, too!!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Darling Ka Bug Le
title.english: My Hubby’s Trapped in a Game

description:
When a game development mishap traps Dalton’s very consciousness within the virtual realm, his lover James boldly defies medical advice and enters the game to find him. As James navigates the labyrinth of interconnected game narratives, each conquest peeling back another layer, he gradually glimpses the authentic, complex soul of the man he thought he knew. But the deeper James delves, the more the truth of Dalton’s existence is called into question. Now, with the full reality revealed, will James’s love prove strong enough to overcome the chasm between their worlds?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ji Du Jin Yue Zui Gong Liu

description:
In her previous life, Lin Yaoyue was framed by her lover and relatives. After dying in vain, she woke up to find that she was reborn in her youth. Lin Yaoyue vowed to make the villains pay for what they’ve done, but what she didn't expect was that Murong Jin, her enemy in her previous life, had become her lover in this life...

(Source: WebComics)

Evaline Archibald would never have imagined that she'd run into the interviewer making out with someone right before her interview. To make things even more awkward, she also discovered his unspeakable true identity – a demon. Now that she knows the guy's secrets, she is given two choices: to die or to stay by his side.

(Source: WebComics)

The all-rounded top student, Ji Hongyu, joins "Demon Palace" while pursuing her dream of comics. She works at a nightclub, transforming into the "Paragon Sister" and, together with the "Knights" of the Demon Palace, navigates between humans and demons in search of coexistence. Together, they fight against evil to protect the world.

(Source: Mangatoon)

Although Hao Kongtong was a bandit leader, he was a useless cripple with severed spiritual roots, allowing him to live freely only because he had five highly skilled brothers. Due to his excessive closeness with his brothers, his romantic luck declined, and he couldn't find a wife for a long time, becoming a single dog destined to lack women. Hao Kongtong made a wish, "Heavens! Let me get close to beautiful women!" In the darkness, a fox spirit heard his wish and granted it – turning all five of his brothers into girls!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Since ancient times, the path of cultivating immortals has been controlled by the Xuanmen family, and it is not something that ordinary people can covet. Zhang Yan from the apocalyptic world received the help of a mysterious residual jade, but he wanted to fight against the enemy with the body of a mortal, vowing to step out on a road of longevity that belongs to him!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After transmigrating to the modern world to become an idol for three years, Orphea, the princess of the Nariel Empire, wakes up one day and finds herself back in her original world. However she has become known as an infamous playgirl! The kind and gentle priest, the happy and hearty paladin, and the richest heir of the kingdom have all become fishes in her personal pond! There are even rumors of her doing unsavory things with her own brother! Because of all that, her first love, Halls, has slowly drifted away from her friendship. It turns out that her trip to the other world may have been a calculated plot…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: She Will Not Kiss up to the Prince

description:
When a modern girl wakes up after falling into a lake, she realizes she has traveled into the novel she was reading and became Wu Yulin, the princess consort of the lord of East Lin City, Song Wei. After Yulin discovers that the lord's thumb ring is the key to coming back to the real world, she tries her best to obtain it. But before she succeeds, the lord seems to have fallen for her.

(Source: WebComics)

The struggling actress Mo Xiaoxiao was down on her luck, until she ran into a god! It turned out the god was a god of love, and he was eager to introduce her to potential matches. But she laughed at his suggestion, "I have the worst luck with men, no one even looks at me." Mr. Love God used his power to attract all sorts of men to her, as Mo Xiaoxiao tried to fend them off... Maybe it was all ordained by fate?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The protagonist Xiaobai has always been troubled by her weight. Her struggle can be described a series of battles and defeats. After seeing a friend shed weight and successfully transform herself into a "goddess", Xiaobai was determined to become a "goddess," too. This time, Xiaobai's "fancy" weight loss regime will involve the "poisonous tongue" of her male friend and the "controls" of her fitness coach, as her new slapstick weight-loss life begins.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title.romaji: Shou Shi Kuang Fei: Bu Dang Yijie Nühaiwang
title.english: Wild Consort in the Beast World
title.native: 兽世狂妃：不当异界女海王

description:
Ji Mo transmigrated into a world of beast-men, filled with half-naked males wearing animal skins, some of whom could even fly. She instantly became the most desirable female on the entire continent. Every male wanted Ji Mo to bear his offspring. Ji Mo shouted, “No! Let go of me! I'm not here to just lay down and breed!”, as she struggled in the arms of the handsome beast-man.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The National Magic Academy that teaches the traditional crafts is open to new admissions! The lazy girl Ada was selected into the fiercely competitive Baigongtang to hone her craftsmanship. But can the girl who just wants to fly kites in the sun really pass the July entrance exam and become an apprentice at the school? If she failed the exam, she would never see the cute Baigong faeries again?! And who is the person who would miss Ada the most if she had to leaves school...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

I was just an ordinary girl looking for some excitement, so I became an underworld courier. The Dream Emporium offered everything I wanted, except for money. Every delivery is a scary tale: a wailing well, an old man in disguise, a decapitated head, ghosts popping out of the TV... each putting me on the edge of life and death. And behind all of this, there is a ghostly man who wants me badly...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Hei Hua Nüzhu Cong Paoqi Kaishi

description:
My sweetheart betrayed me, my childhood friend left me. From now on, I don't want a kind gentleman or innocent boy. All I want is him, the arrogant and narcissistic overbearing president Luo Jingming.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Despite being blessed with abundant fortune and luck, Everly Acheson screws up in all of her past nine lives. On the day she's supposed to marry the darling of the country, Jax, and get rich overnight, she chickens out and runs away.
