A Heavenly Messenger, driven to desperation, decides to step in and help Everly patch things up with Jax by turning her into Jax's hamster. Only Everly is not happy about this, at all.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jintian Ye Yao Nuli Dang Zhi Mao

description:
I'm a superstar in the making but somehow got turned into a cat. What's worse is that I fell into the hands of my nemesis! Being ignorant of the situation, he petted me, kissed me, and hugged me. Whatever. I'll forgive him for that. B-but it looks like he's after my body too! Despicable! Someone, please come and save me!!!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zui Qiang Shenhuang De Feichai Chongzhi Rensheng
title.native: 最强神皇的废柴重置人生

description:
Chen Xu was the most powerful god-emperor in heaven and earth, but his body was disintegrated by the combined attack of four other god-emperors. His soul could only escape by reincarnating into the body of a weak young master. As a once nearly invincible being, he wasn't about to put up with being bullied in this life. Chen Xu swore he will regain his powers and have his bloody revenge, but he had to start his immortal cultivation with an incomplete technique manual. Little did he realize, that this incomplete manual is about to make his road to immortality a lot more interesting.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An obscenely rich girl with crazy dreams has a family with quite some secrets. After finding her grandmother's book on witchcraft, she hatches a plan to get the boy of her dreams. She uses the book to create the guy of her dreams, but the unexpected result came with a fish tail!

(Source: INKR)

“Young Master Chi, I doubt you’ll help me unconditionally. Am I right?”
“You’ll find out soon enough what this deal entails. Now, all you need to do is to give me an answer. Do you want this opportunity or not?”
“Yes, I do.”

Chi Mingyao made a deal with an actor who was brave enough to block him because of a car accident. He only wanted to tease the little actor at first, but eventually, he genuinely wanted to befriend Li Yangxiao and pass on his good luck to Li Yangxiao—just so Yangxiao can chase after his dreams without a care in the world.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Dang Dalao Cong Hua Qian Kai Shi
title.english: Becoming A Boss Starts With Spending Money

description:
Chu Zheng was bound to the money-squandering system by accident and traveled to another world. She'd die unless she squandered money there. Her missions were to spend money, to avenge on those who used to be bad to her, and even to make sure the innocent hero was healthy both physically and mentally. All this drove Chu Zheng crazy—She'd never heard of such missions... But there was nothing she could do with the powerful system. Therefore, by completing those missions, she proved a truth to us: Becoming a boss in another world starts with spending money!

(Source: Webnovel)

Monsters roamed the land, ghost rose out of the ground, and the people were destitute and desperate. To deal with these spirits, the emperor appointed official "exorcists." They traveled all over to dispel the evil spirits in unique ways. As night falls and the bells toll, they will guard the ghost fire until it fades.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Buyao Chi Diao Wo De Xiao Binggan

description:
The male protagonist was just an invisible nobody working in a state-owned enterprise. He certainly did not want to be forced by his mother to go on a blind date at the park on his very own birthday! ...Wait a minute, is this big scary thug also here for a blind date? Not only did the thug mistakenly eat the male protagonist's cookies, but they somehow magically cured his incurable disease too?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

For love, Xia Ruoshui followed her boy friend to the Magic Capital and found an apartment on No. 44 West Street. In the same building lived a girl Luo Zheng and her strange mother Lü Luo. Luo Zheng was known as "The Reaper", because the rumors said that anyone who came in contact with her would mysteriously disappear. Xia Ruoshui got caught up in a lovers dispute and was badly hurt, but Luo Zheng was there and infused her own blood into Xia Ruoshui to save her from death...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extras chapters and 4 side-story chapters.

title.romaji: Wu Rao! Baozao Shenguan Zhiqin Zhong
title.english: Do Not Disturb! Grumpy Priest Is On Duty

description:
What should I do if my sweet childhood friend became a simp? An Weilin, a recently promoted priest, ran upon Chi Xiao, one of his boyhood buddies he hadn't seen in years, during the shapeshifter hunting operation. He had no idea that his childhood pal had turned into the subordinate of his Family's Murder! What's worse, Chi Xiao had gone from sweet and gentle to strong and paranoid! An Weilin had to cope with Chi Xiao who had changed drastically while looking for the truth about his parents's murder. What he didn't expect was that all the clues would lead back to himself!!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Mama, I don't want to be a princess anymore. I'm going to become a strong ruler, just like you.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

My perfect, handsome fiancé is suspected of being gay? We can't get married??

Oh, watch me disguise myself as a man and sneak into the school to seduce you!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Seven years ago, Tang Xu met a boy dressed in rags and covered in scars. Even though he wasn't a nice gentleman filled with compassion, he still took the boy's hand before leaving.

"I'll give everything I have to protect you for the rest of my life."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and two extras.

31-year old Lu Sheng received an anonymous package near Chinese New Year time. She opened the package to find a little fairy inside?! The fairy told Lu Sheng that she can help her "make a wish come true." Lu Sheng should feel lucky to be the chosen one, as she went out and not only made a new friend for life, but also met the man who could be her soul mate…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Yan Jin is the young prince of the underworld, known as the Little Demon because he was so unruly. The Little Demon was influenced by all the TV he watched into thinking of himself as brave, heroic, smart, cute, and invincible. He thought he would have a harem of girls at his command. But then our four-year old Demon Lord met that three-year old girl, and he found himself putty in the palm of her hand. The domineering but innocent young Demon Lord is about to learn a lesson about love!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In order to avenge the destruction of his family, the youth Jin Wuwei has been lurking in the number one underworld gang for 10 years. When he accidentally enters the most powerful Wudang Xianxia Academy in all of Central China to cultivate, he secretly begins to develop his grand plot for revenge. A young gang leader who is hiding his identity, a senior brother who is extraordinarily powerful but a timid crybaby, a mysterious assassin, and an unreliable alcoholic master... Watch how the four join forces to start a sect and climb to stand at the peak of imperial power!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Xiao Yiyi got married two years ago, yet she has never met her husband. After cheating on him, she confesses her affair to her mysterious husband and shockingly discovers that he is the man she slept with...

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title.romaji: Wo Cai Bu Jia Fanpai Huangzi

description:
The fierce warrior-prince Yan Xi ruthlessly crushed a neighboring kingdom and brought back the kingdom's young princess Tao Xiaowei. The cute five-year-old princess ran around the palace and forced Yan Xi to care for someone for the first time. After many years of war and conquest, Yan Xi finally returned home and found that the little princess girl had grown into a peerless beauty. Ever since then, Yan Xi has had eyes for no one else. He will fight off her suitors like he destroys enemy kingdoms.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Because of her engagement with Qi family, Jane was sent to an exclusive school. She not only lived in a luxury dormitory, but also lived together with the one to whom she was engaged. What is even more frightening is that there are more than one fiance candidates and fiancee candidates, and all of them were gathered to choose the best couple from them.

(Source: Webcomics)

After being betrayed twice, she transmigrated with her vengeance in hand. Her new body was weak and she had to rely on the imperial physician to stay alive. In front of others, he looked like the heir apparent that did not have long to live but possessed a genius intellect and photographic memory; in the dark, he was as cunning and strategic as they came. He was biding his time and accumulated influence and strength in the shadows. A trashy male lead and a trashy female lead both transmigrated together. She needs someone to rely on in this world, and he is her “chance.” In fact, the fates have long foretold their love for each other, like a curse that stretches across millennia, these two will always find each other in every lifetime.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The story of a beautiful warrior, strong and violent like an iceberg, and a cute, effeminate, and talkative little princely heir.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

After the prince killed the emperor and usurped the throne, the empire fell into chaos, as demons roamed the land and the people suffered. The beggar boy Xu Han wanted to help the innocent. So he left the assassins guild Senluodian behind, and set out with his group of friends to overthrow the tyrant and restore peace to the land.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

On the first day of school, Wu Niannian learned that her childhood friend, who was repeating a grade, was going to be her classmate. He had even caught her drawing a boy's love comic. It was embarrassing for her. Nianian had been longing for a fresh start. But she realized it was not as simple as she had imagined. Besides the stress of her studies, she had to deal with a classmate's harsh criticism. What choices should Niannian make at this crossroads in her life?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

title.romaji: Zheng Jiu Wo De Gaoyi Ba Ban

description:
After the high school entrance exams, the rebellious Cao Qingjun and her best friend Zen Jingjing were lucky enough to get into the same high school, and even ended up in the same class. There, she met the gentle Lu Jia, the lively Si Qiyang, and the shy Tong Haiwen. Each young person has their own insecurities: the fear of being misunderstood, left alone, or rejected... This is her youth, as well as his. Luckily, I will have you on this journey with me.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: You Benshi Ni Zai Xiong Yige?

description:
The school bully, Shen Yichen, picked a fight with the genius student, Ji Yuming?! Despite their paths never crossing before, their lives were suddenly entangled due to a particular "diary". As Shen Yichen continued to goad Ji Yuming, he realized that this top student didn't seem like someone who would do "such a thing" to his younger cousin. Meanwhile, Ji Yuming gradually mastered how to calm down Shen Yichen after he observed this school bully who got angry easily...

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 11 extras.

title.romaji: Wo Huaiyi Yingdi Zai Diao Wo
title.english: I Suspect the Actor is Fishing for Me

description:
Jiang Yutang, a struggling actor plagued by scandals, finds his life turned upside down after save Yu Sinian, the nation’s top heartthrob, from drowning, . What starts as a simple act of kindness quickly escalates into a series of unexpected events, leading to an unusual cohabitation. As Jiang Yutang gets closer to the seemingly perfect Yu Sinian, he begins to question the superstar’s true intentions. Is Yu Sinian genuinely altruistic, or does he have a hidden agenda?

(Source: Webnovel)

Ruan Lingxing and Ruan Lingyue are beautiful twin sisters who live in the picturesque Wushan Village. Because the family is poor and their father is sick, the elder sister has to work from morning to night, but the younger sister just wants to live off of others' hard work.

One day, the elder sister Lingxing rescues a handsome young master. Later, the man's family come to propose marriage, but the younger sister has a wicked thought...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

Perhaps it was fate that drove the protagonist, Ruoming, to enter the legendary Cloud Realm, and meet a classmate who can foretell the future? Is it magic? By the time she realizes it, Ruoming is already a part of this strange world, and her adventure begins, without knowing how it will end.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Twenty-one-year-old waiter Ron has always dreamed of reclaiming the family home he once shared with his late mother. Working tirelessly on a cruise ship, he quietly saves money, completely focused on his goal. However, his tranquil life is disrupted when Charles, the charming heir to the business empire that owns the cruise line, unexpectedly proposes a contractual marriage. Although surprised, the reserved Ron politely declines—he yearns for a genuine, loving relationship rather than an arranged one. Undeterred, the wealthy heir decides to board the cruise himself, determined to win Ron over with his charm within a week...

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Xihuan Ni De Chun Xia Qiu Dong

description:
Lin Ning has to transfer to a new school every time her parents change their jobs. This time she is transferred to Dongjiang Middle School, where her cousin Lin Bai is also in. Lin Ning's parents temporarily entrust Li Ning to the Lin Bai's family. Lin Ning, who is already numb to this so-called new life, is led by Lin Bai into the new school. She also met Xue Sen, a shining boy who makes Lin Ning extremely excited…

(Source: MangaToon)

This is a FORK & CAKE setting. People with FORK trait, although possessing unusual abilities, have lost all their sense of taste. While people with CAKE trait, are like a walking dessert in the eyes of people with FORK trait. CAKE trait people's saliva, sweat, skin, etc. are rich in sweet taste... And our protagonist, a soft moe FORK fox god, is dead set on chasing after the bride he has spotted, a strong CAKE who can win a 1-v-5.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Fu Li, a female high school student, dreams of becoming a great cartoonist. The Immortal Meow, who caught a glimpse of her dream, uses a spell to transform Fu Li's two cats into beautiful, handsome boys, hoping that their influence will help her create a world-class comic. But Fu Li's ordinary life starts to be disrupted by the cat boys...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the new galactic era, the Alliance's last general Lin Jinheng was assassinated and killed. Five years later, on the ragged and defeated Eighth Star System, people live in fear of the Black Hole Four. Only that Principal Lu is crazy enough to dare harass them occasionally. A mysterious chip is the start of the chaos, two people left Beijing ß at the same time for different reasons, not knowing it was about to be reduced to ashes by space pirates bent on revenge. Centuries of peace is obliterated in an explosion of fire and blood. And this is only the beginning.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In this world, does there really exist the steadfast love which is never affected by external factors? Su is arranged by the destiny (actually destroyed by the editor), and encountered all sorts of romantic plot, idol, bossy president... Can she still stand firm her love for him?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

"No one in this world can disclose my weakness, except you.” A kind of frenzied virus comes down to the world again. It makes people furious, variant and turns them into monsters who hate everything in the world. The darkness which is covered by the calm days will be out of the water like the tip of the iceberg.

I will be watching you in the darkness

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Yingdi Laopo You Gao Kua Zongyi La!
title.native: 影帝老婆又搞垮综艺啦！

description:
Gong Jiu, a lady warrior from a post-apocalyptic world, transmigrates into the body of a disrespected minor starlet. On the first day in her new body, she happens to rescue the aloof superstar Bo Yibai! Now the fierce, straightforward actress will team up with the cool nationally-known heartthrob. Working together from dramas to variety shows, Gong Jiu’s arrival stirs up a storm in the entertainment world! After Gong Jiu and Bo Yibai go public with their relationship, his fans exclaim, “Help! Our idol's new girlfriend is going to ruin everything!”

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Weilai Nüdi Men De Zhuan Shu Lu Ding
title.native: 未来女帝们的专属炉鼎

description:
Sometime in the past, men lost the ability to cultivate, no longer able to concentrate their spiritual power, and cultivation became an exclusively female affair. Even worse… there seems to be something seriously wrong with the standard of beauty for men in this world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A mysterious serial killer could be hiding in the darkness, silently observing their prey! Or, they could be completely indifferent, passing by innocent civilians... They might greet you with a friendly smile, but then suddenly swing a knife! Or another possibility is... that you are the one who's the killer...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Based on the tale of the Journey to the West, the Demon-Slaying Chronicles are a retelling of the story, reimagining them as dedicated demon slayers instead of pilgrims for sacred texts. The author interprets the story as the four main protagonists fighting for justice freely, not fearing power and status, and neither doing so for the "greater good". From the White Bone Spirit, Sea Spirit, Nine-Headed Beast, Azure Lion, White Elephant, Great Peng, to the battle to the death with the Hundred-Eyed Demon Lord, all of it was done for the sake of justice, and not as trials and tribulations in the way of acquiring sacred texts. A clear distinction between being pilgrims and demon-slaying is made, where the former is for an intangible "greater good", while the latter is easier to grasp. Between the both, the four choose the latter, and to quote what Jiang Liu'er says to the Buddha: "I am but a simple monk, and our paths simply do not coincide."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A handsome man has just emerged in Ji Kerr's room! As it turns out, he's actually a long-time guardian of the Ji family who comes all the way from the Ming dynasty. And he comes with a warning: her family is in dire trouble. But he'll show her how to save her family, as long as she shows him what it means to fall in love?! Time travel, a hot guardian deity, and romance await in this adventure-filled webtoon!

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Chapter count includes two bonus chapters.

Qiao's Group is on the verge of bankruptcy, and Qiao Yu, the youngest daughter of Qiao's family, is ordered to become a social animal in danger! He did not hesitate to use himself and Lu Nancheng, the president of scheming, to make a deal, but he did not expect the two to pretend to be true and form a preference for each other. Crisis!! The love that is actively in business is cracked due to the grudges between the fathers, and Qiao Yu is gradually disheartened by Lu Nancheng due to the malicious and serious injuries of his rivals. I don't know if the president will stage a wife-chasing crematorium!

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Tun Xia Moshen Hou Wo Kaishi Jinhua
title.english: I Evolved After Devouring the Demon God
title.native: 吞下魔神后我开始进化

description:
He accidentally entered forbidden territory and gained the "Devour" ability. Now that he's become a "monster," how will he fulfill his childhood sweetheart’s last wish? Carrying this demonic “curse," he begins a hot-blooded adventure across the mysterious continent…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

One day, eight players were pulled into a mysterious online space called the Judgement Hall. An angel, with the power over life and death, tells them to "Find my murderer." Their investigation will be live-streamed to the entire internet. Stuck in the virtual world, unable to log out, the eight suspects are forced to look for answers, and eventually uncover the truth...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wu Fa Yu Nü Sheng Cheng Wei Peng You

description:
Liang Xiaoxiao has continually found herself surrounded by her band of merry men – a bunch of male good friends – despite her yearning for some friends of the same gender. Hardly the most dependable sort, the boys have tried every trick in the book to help her to make some girl friends, including enlisting the help of a fashion stylist who could give her some pointers on dressing up.

But would they succeed in helping Xiaoxiao? Follow them on their bizarre and hilarious adventures to make her dream come true!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Kaiju Taigu Yaosheng Na Wo Dang Lu Ding
title.native: 开局太古妖圣拿我当炉鼎

description:
The first step of cultivation is to make a contract with a demonic familiar. He was untalented and unwanted, until he runs into an ancient demon lord, who happens to take the form of a sexy girl with a tail! She tells him that his foundations are strong and his bloodline is powerful. But this demon is just too alluring, and everyone wants take her away from him. It's up to him to protect his own demon!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Shouren Jiaoqi Hou Wo Huang Le
title.english: How to Tame Your Beast Husbands
title.native: 穿成兽人娇妻后我慌了

description:
During an all-night programming session, Yin Zhu suddenly died and was transmigrated into a world of beastmen. She found out that the original owner of her body had drugged Teng Xiao and XX'ed him. Facing the suspicions of her tribe, she claimed to be uninterested in love and only wanted to work. Starting with the food, she will use her System to lead them out of the wilderness to become the strongest tribe in the land. But even as her actions slowly changed the culture of the tribe, all these beastmen keep coming on to Yin Zhu crying for her to give up on her work and become their mate instead??

(Source: Tencent, translated)

On the isolated Sun Moon Island, the powerful monster tribe hunted the beast tribe. The beast tribe remained strong and united to fight for their survival against the monsters, in a war that has lasted for more than a hundred years. The beast tribe, tired of being beaten down in this unequal struggle, slowly gathered a group of heroes into an organization known as the "Zodiacs"…

(Source: TAPIR, translated)

An adaptation of Ling Hua's novel. This is the story of the blossoming youth of two teenage singers, linking the past to the future. They grow up to become the people they want to be and sing their favorite songs. Both travel through time and space to meet and become the stars that guide them to each other.

(Source: Creative-comic, translated)

title.romaji: Chong Sheng Hou Wo Jia Gei Le Canji Dalao
title.native: 重生后我嫁给了残疾大佬

description:
In her previous life, Ruan Hanxing was just a girl from the slums, weak and powerless, and she died quietly without a trace. After being reborn, Ruan Hanxing is determined to make a strong comeback and get her revenge. She will help her husband, the fallen tycoon Huo Chen, to get back on his feet. The couple will join forces to defeat anyone who stands in their way, together on a path to glory.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Yongshi De Yizhi: Di Er Ji
title.native: 勇士的意志 第二季

description:
Based on the video game DNF, this is the planet Arad, a world torn apart by wars and cataclysms. Innumerable adventures await, weaving together the fates of the past, present, and future into an unforgettable story. Let us witness the will of fighters!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ershixiong Shi Ge Fanren Que Hen Qiang
title.native: 二师兄是个凡人却很强

description:
Chengzi said, "They ascend during the day, but I can't sleep at night."

The junior girl asked, "Why can't you sleep if others ascend?"

The prefect interjected, "Because he helps other people to ascend to immortality, while he himself is still mortal."

A moment later, Chengzi helped the prefect pass his final trial, and sent him on his way to immortality.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When I woke after after transmigrating, I found out that my girlfriend wants to eat me?! No condiments required!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xiuxian, Cong Zhong Pan Qin Li Kaishi

description:
The genius cultivator Lin Xiaoxiao had extraordinary talents but lacked emotional intelligence and made too many enemies. In the end, he was betrayed by everyone he cared about and died tragically. Fortunately, he found a way to survive, reincarnating into a modern world without martial arts or spiritual power, where he became an honor student at college. That was when he discovered that he could still cultivate in this world, and furthermore, he could cross into another cultivation realm to gain resources from there.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Hao Hao who grew up in an orphanage, welcomed great changes in her life on her 15th birthday. From a mysterious elite private school, to a random fiance, all this took Hao Hao's confused heart by suprise, and signaled the beginning of a battle to escape her fate.

(Source: Webnovel)

On August 8, 1961, China mourned the death of one of its most popular artists: Mei Lanfang. This singer of the Beijing Opera, who moved various audiences to tears with his interpretations of female roles, began his career in 1904 at the age of ten. For hours on end, he trained his voice, learned dance, and rehearsed acrobatics until reaching a level of refinement that propelled him not only in China but also onto the international stage. Yin Ling delicately traces the life and career of this extraordinary figure, offering us a glimpse into the magical and lesser-known world of the Beijing Opera.

title.romaji: Zhan Shuang Pa Mi Shen: Jian Zhang Jiuwen

description: Constructs, too, were once children of men. This is their story, before committing themselves to a long struggle that may never end.

For years, the Celestial Empyrean defended the lands against Honkai hordes but she always refused to join the Springfest celebrations. Can her little companion find a way to return warmth to her heart?

(Source: Honkai Impact 3rd)

Su Chengcheng, a broke girl, worked so hard to make a living, but life didn't treat her well. She got bullied by her classmates and cheated by her boyfriend, even her boss tried to harass her... When she hit bottom, a mysterious man showed up and claimed to be her personal butler. He told her that she was actually the heiress of the Su family, the richest family in the world?! In that case, she vows to get back at those who once humiliated her!

(Source: WebComics)

While tracking down the thief Queen of Hearts, Cen Jing was accidentally handcuffed to a pole dancer in a bar. When she was in a state of panic, she discovered that the sexy and charming dancer was actually Ji Shuangrong, a simple girl whom she had once supported. In order to "lead the little sister back to the right path", Cen Jing went deep into every aspect of Ji Shuangrong's life. The seemingly simple Ji Shuangrong was the thief that Cen Jing was tracking down - the Queen of Hearts. There are more secrets behind her...

(source: Billibilli, translated)

Fifteen years ago, the evil spirits rose up, and the human world became hell on earth.
Fifteen years later, a strange manifestation signals the start of the chaotic battle between good and evil!
When demons rule, who will be the champion of heaven? Among the thousands of souls, who will rise up to be the one?

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Benti Luo Ru Siduitou Shouzhong Hou
title.native: 本体落入死对头手中后

description:
Helian Che’s family was destroyed by the demon tribe when he was young. He wanted to kill all the demon tribe, and the demon tribe was terrified of him. The fox demon Xiao Moyu finally cultivated into human form, but accidentally let his original body, which had the same five senses as his own, fall into the hands of the other party. Synesthesia is not a big deal, he can just endure it, but the problem is that if he loses his original body, he will die too!

Feeling the touch of the air falling on him, watching his original body being ravaged in the hands of the other party, Xiao Moyu could only disguise himself and blend in with the other party. Unexpectedly, this person became even worse, doing all kinds of strange things to his original body, tormenting Xiao Moyu so much that he couldn't sleep at night. Xiao Moyu endured the humiliation and finally took back his original body and got away. Unexpectedly, not long after he escaped, he was grabbed by the scruff of the neck and locked up by Helian Che. This time, it was not just the original body that was tormented...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The first time Lu Jingyan met Sheng Xian was at a bar, she had no signal on her mobile phone, so she asked him to borrow the internet, and asked him what was his hotspot password? Sheng Xian told her, "It's your birth date." Lu Jingyan felt that Sheng Xian must like her to be using her birthday as a password, so she began to try to seduce Sheng Xian overtly and secretly. It wasn't until half a year later that she accidentally discovered that Sheng Xian's WiFi hotspot password was actually…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ni Shi Shijian Zui Meihao De Secai
title.native: 你是世间最美好的色彩

description:
Zhou Rucheng is an eighth-grade student with a passion for drawing and few, trusted friends. The last year of middle school is psychologically intense, in China, because final exams determine the quality of high school one will be able to enter. A first step into adult life that can have fundamental consequences, for a person. Add to that the first beatings, the bullying of an older bully who humiliates boys and the feeling, which never leaves Zhou Rucheng, that he is destined for nothing good because he is not good enough even at the thing he loves most. Golo Zhao, one of the foremost exponents of the contemporary Chinese graphic novel, creates a coming-of-age novel with clear autobiographical echoes, one that makes you root for its little protagonist and gives such precise emotional descriptions that it seems to fish in the adolescent experience of those reading the story. A long book, but one that you will wish would never end.

(Source: Bao Publishing, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Shu Hou, Heihua Nan Zhu Men Chao Chong Wo
title.english: After Transmigrating, The Corrupted Male Leads Pamper Me
title.native: 穿书后，黑化男主们超宠我

description:
Ding! Congratulations, Host Zhu Yumeng! You’ve transmigrated into the novel called ’The Murville Family’s Rose‘ and became the female lead in this tragic story. The four male leads are either insane or sick in the head, and all of them have heart-rending endings. Your way of survival is to use the physicological knowledge provided by the system to completely reset the corruption percentage of all four male leads. Wishing you the best of luck!” Zhu Yumeng: Hold on! All four of them???

(Source: Webnovel)

Murdered in her previous life, she vowed to take double revenge on those who hurt her. But the past turns out to be more complicated than she thought. Did the cruelty against her actually have anything to do with the crown prince, or was it all just a conspiracy? How will they handle this love-hate relationship? Can they let go of the past to start anew?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Jiuming! Chuanyue Shou Shi She Fu Chao Chong Wo!
title.english: Help! My Beast Husband Pampers Me Too Much!
title.native: 救命！穿越兽世蛇夫超宠我！

description:
Deerling transmigrated into the beast world novel she’d been reading before bed, becoming a cannon-fodder deer-beast supporting character. In the current plot, Deerling has just accepted ‘mating’ request of Serpens, planning to use him as her fiancé to survive the winter. However, after transmigrating, she can’t bear to let Serpens experience betrayal and abandonment again. Despite knowing that his departure might ruin her winter survival plan, Deerling decides to ‘break off the engagement,’ but each attempt is interrupted.

(Source: Webnovel)

One day, Bai Xiaoxiao finds herself transported back in time into the body of a fat girl? People thought the general's daughter is soft and easy to bully. Well, she'll show them! After a few days, she's seducing pretty boys and fighting off bitchy girls… when the tsundere prince comes calling? What's this about mutual cultivation? Step aside, Mr. Prince, and let me show you what a trained poison expert can do in ancient times!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Chuan Xiu Xianjie Xiyou Wuzhong
title.native: 我穿成了修仙界稀有物种

description:
A modern person named You You transmigrates into the world of cultivation, where women are born noble and hold a higher status than men. Among many women, heavenly maidens who can activate people’s spiritual roots and achieve immortality descend upon the world. You You becomes one of these rare heavenly maidens and takes on the responsibility of founding the Zhenyan Sect. She leads the entire sect as they fight monsters, level up, and embark on a path of growth, all the while seeking her significant other along the way.

(Source: Webnovel)

Games of love and lust play out between men and women under the bright lights of the big city. The women who call themselves "the devil squad" are vigilantes who punish the scumbags guys who prey on women beyond the reach of law. As "the devil squad" becomes increasingly famous, its founder Lin Mo takes on legendary status among the women of the city. But beneath the tumultuous waves, what kind of dark mystery hides her true face?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Dianxia Yao Gua Le
title.english: My Highness is Going to Die

description:
Before meeting Dong Li, Song Jingyan wanted a hardworking man with a car, a house, and well-built body. Once she met Dong Li, there was only one thought on her mind — how to bed Dong Li!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Queen's Life Was At Stake

description:
A young woman awakes in the body of Guinevere, a princess in an obscure book who is to become queen of the Twilight Kingdom. However, the wretched King sentences her to death, which should have put an end to her story. But an unknown man rescues Guinevere and gives her the chance to rewrite the book's entire plot. This poor little princess won't take the abuse any longer - Guinevere is determined to take the throne that she deserves! But who is this mysterious "prince charming" who saved her? And could he be the key to Guinevere's quest to become queen?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Taizifei Chao Xiong Di

description:
Qiao Mu died a tragic death, but she was given a new beginning through rebirth. She appears like a little kid on the outside, but she actually possesses incredible cultivation ability and intellect. In this life, she will take revenge on the culprits who had left her ruined and orphaned! But in this lifetime, she also runs into a silly but cute Crown Prince. Not only does he keep on shamelessly bringing her equipment for beating up the baddies with, but he even wants her to become his consort? Wait, something seems to have gone wrong!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Sect Headmaster is Only Eight

description:
Feng Chiyin is an eight year-old who suddenly became a sect leader after his grandfather passed away.
Due to his young age, the sect doesn't believe his capabilities, forcing them to leave.
With only two subordinates left on his side, Chiyin must show the martial arts world his strength.

(Source: INKR)

Facing the miserable end of her life on the street, Alice extinguished the last candle and went back to when everything started to fall apart. Alice was timid and not good with words all her life until she witnessed the sinking of the giant ship Norton with her own eyes. She then realized that when disaster strikes, no one is spared. Alice would do everything in her power to guide her family in making amends.

(Source: Webnovel)

To solve the family crisis, Li Weiyin had no choice but to marry Xu Yimo, the young master of the Xu family, whose IQ equals that of an eight-year-old child. On the first day after they got married, her cute husband was clingy to her and said, "Weiyin, I'll be a very good boy. You must love me very much." On the second day, however, her husband became aloof and didn't care about her, saying, "Relax. I'm not interested in that blockhead's wife." On the third day, her husband became a gentleman wary of her and asked, "Who are you? Why are you in my room?" On the fourth day, her husband acted frivolously and made eyes at her, saying, "Tell me, which of the three of them married you?" Li Weiyin finally realized that her husband was more a man with a multiple personality disorder than a blockhead.

(Source: Webnovel)

Domineering demon King × cute funny imagination girl の fatalistic taboo love! Cross the primeval universe, intertwine past lives and this life! The fusion of eastern fantasy and western magic, break the barrier of different dimensional race!!

(Source: Webcomics)

She accidentally witnessed the president murdering his secretary. “Become my secretary, or die!” With one contract, he sealed her fate. She became his personal secretary and arranged everything from his appointments to ghosting lovers. In the past, her boyfriend had sold her virginity to the highest bidder, drugging her in the process so she could not resist. He’s an affluent boss, while she works multiple jobs... As nothing more than just a tool to him, how will she live out this contract relationship?!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Zhanggongzhu Ta Mei Tian Dou Xiang Zaofan
title.english: The Princess Wants to Make Trouble Every Day
title.native: 长公主她每天都想造反

description:
Princess Chengping, a spoiled seductress who was infamous for her bossiness and imperiousness, fell into a coma during an accident. Ten years later when she woke up, she found the world was the same no more. Her father, the former emperor who pampered her unconditionally, just passed away. The one who acceded the throne thereafter was her sworn enemy Noble Consort Xiao’s son. Though Xiao used to be at her mercy, she’s now become the Empress Dowager who possessed the real power. And the handsome principal graduate she once abducted as a kept man has also become a high-ranking, powerful official. A love story between an evil-natured princess and a priggish, scheming scholar.

(Source: Webnovel)

A movie queen from the modern world accidentally traveled to be the unwelcome young lady in an noble mansion. They wanted her to sacrifice as a pawn in the court fight, but she was no longer a cowardly young lady who would take bullies without fighting back! For those who bullied her and insulted her, she would make them pay tenfold! Let's see how she made the tables turn after being reborn!

(Source: WebComics)

After Jessie broke the school principal's beloved autographed CD from the famous singer Virginia, she teams up with Erin and Bertha, her equally mischievous schoolmates, and goes to a talent audition in order to obtain another autographed CD. But things get out of hand when their band is selected to participate in a reality television talent competition.

(Source: WebComics)

A pretty otaku girl leaves the virtual world and meets a CEO?!! He's so gay the first time I see him! This is too thrilling. I'd better get away from him...

(Source: WebComics)

For a new reality show, twenty famous actresses are transmigrated back to an ancient kingdom's imperial harem! In this era full of intrigue and betrayal, see how the disgraced "fairy star" will use her smarts and skills to overcome the crowd and take the crown!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Stubborn girl Zhang Feifei became the same table with high-cold gangmaster, Fu Yifan? Is she facing heaven or hell?!

(Source: WebComics)

The boy I've had a secret crush on for four years kissed me in my dream... Is it true that my family members have dreams that predict future events? Four characters, entangled relationships, and clashing desires. When it comes to their future and love, how will they make choices in the final year of school?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Ye Huang was summoned by the Goddess Association to the Lanling Empire for execution after her family was destroyed by a scumbag. Luckily, she was rescued by Ji Wuyan. After that, the two of them started their adventure where they joined hands to get rid of the enemies and rise to the top.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chuan Shuhou Wo Lian Nü Pei Dou Bushi
title.native: 穿书后我连女配都不是

description:
After her college entrance exams, Su Yao's sister frantically recommended a smutty novel called [Coincidentally, I Like You Too.] Driven by a noble pursuit of knowledge, a desire to explore the unknown, and a thirst for academic innovation, Su Yao decided to peruse this work one dark and stormy night. The result? She transmigrated directly into the book.

She became a nameless, faceless background character—and thank god for that! If she had been anyone with even a remote connection to the plot, she would have died from pure disgust. After all, who in their right mind would want a starring role in a smut fic?!

Her new rules for survival: The Male Lead? Stay far, far away. The Female Lead? Never, ever offend her. A fellow Background Character? Now that's a safe bet. And so, Su Yao—now living as Lin Zhinian—confidently befriends another "background character," Shen An.
Everything is going perfectly until the day she personally hears the novel's original male lead call Shen An...
"Brother"

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Hou Shizun Na Ming Qiu he

description:
Xie Jincheng had been a selfless and kind person his whole life, but in the end, he was betrayed by his friends and family and met a tragic end. After being reborn, Xie Jincheng declared: “As long as my heart, liver, spleen, and lungs are all rotten, no one can bully me anymore!”

Yun Rong had waited for a hundred years, finally seeing Xie Jincheng return. However, in this life, Xie Jincheng no longer regarded him as his beloved.

title.romaji: Kai Luo Si Shan De Shi Xie Hua
title.english: Dynastic Marriage: The Fallen and The Crowned

description:
Princess Alexandra of Elazar, raised in the quiet peace of a convent, becomes a political bride to Prince Aurelio of El Pagne. Her enigmatic husband, rumored to be indifferent to women, offers her only a cordial partnership and never love. Alone in a hostile palace as an unwanted consort, Alexandra struggles to find her place while Aurelio keeps his distance. Yet as she begins to bloom despite the thorns around her, a question lingers. Can their marriage of convenience turn into something neither of them expected?

(Source: Tappytoon)

When a newly opened beta game is invaded by a mysterious AI, the once carefree adventure world turns into an inescapable loop. The AI-affected, self-aware Final Boss resolves to protect its game and restore it to its original form!

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

Nai Xinhuan, who was cheated on by her boyfriend of many years decided to change her lifestyle and become a playgirl. She vowed to flirt with every cute boy she meets but seems to have met her match, the indifferent and slightly gloomy Ren Xiaobei. When Ren Xiaobei couldn’t hold it in any longer, he finally tells the boy-obsessed Nai Xinhuan what he was really thinking, "Miss, you’re kinda weird!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Jujue Juan Shen, Wo Chengle Qianren De Xiao Jiuma
title.english: Meet My Ex Again As His Aunt
title.native: 拒绝捐肾，我成了前任的小舅妈

description:
Nelly once believed love meant sacrifice. She donated her kidney to support her husband Ron's dreams, only to be repaid with betrayal and heartbreak. After her tragic death, she awakens ten years in the past, moments before signing away her future. Faced with the same choice, she finally understands her worth and refuses to sacrifice herself again. As she steps away from Ron, an encounter with Ivan, Ron’s uncle, changes the course of her story. Revenge may have brought her back, but love may complicate things.

(Source: Tappytoon)

After nine failed blind date, Wanwan Mo suffered from the phobia of blind date, and the tenth one directly leads to a flash marriage. Before their marriage, Wanwan Mo said that my annual salary was 300,000, you can rely on me after we married. After the marriage, Yanting Mo got the invoice of his custom handmade business suit to apply for reimbursement. But that business suit was equal to her annual salary! The man used his deep voice and appeared in the dark, my dear, didn’t you promise to afford me? Wanwan Mo was angry and wanted to divorce after a year... Hmm...

"Hehe, how could you divorce me when you are unable to afford me?"

(Source: WebComics)

An accidental shooting task made her the object wanted by him?! She thought she had escaped him, as a result, she put her neck into the noose, whatever approaches she tried, it seems she couldn't get away from him... what's more, getting along with him, she gradually lost herself...

(Source: WebComics)

Xiang Wan, who travels from ancient times to the modern era, enters the voice acting industry on the advice of Yu Zhou, who takes her in. Here, she meets Chao Xin, a gentle yet resilient senior. Starting with a chance invitation, the two grow closer and develop more ambiguous feelings for each other.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

While the noble ladies of Tianxuan Kingdom engage in mere political struggles, Mu Qingmeng, a hostage from an enemy nation, faces additional bloody national and familial hatred. To protect herself, she navigates the power struggles of the harem, forced to scheme against the seemingly fair and benevolent Song Xinghe for temporary protection. Unexpectedly, in this precarious daily life, Song Xinghe's gentleness and kindness become her only salvation. Thus, Mu Qingmeng encounters something more terrifying than death.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Zongcai Jiushi Zheme Meng

description:
In turbulent Shanghai, the domineering young marshal meets his ex-lover. He hopes to get back together with her, only to be involved in one conspiracy after another. Warfare, revenge, love and hatred, happiness and sadness... At this time of turmoil, can their hard-won love be secured?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: My Own Love Only Belongs to Me

description:
Magic love story happening in mages’ club makes your heart dokidoki. Who is who’s only belonging?

(Source: WebComics)

An ordinary girl transmigrates to a fairy-tale-like world filled with children. She becomes the only “grown-up” among the “little people” at a hotel. They are asked to help overcome the crisis at the hotel. But the problem is, the kids here are neither innocent nor happy. Instead, they are full of hostility towards her for some reason.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Lu Miao, a time traveler, is tasked with rescuing a pitiful and unloved villain from a book. She transmigrates to the villain's childhood, only to discover that the young villain is a well-behaved, sensible, and affectionate little devil. However, to outsiders, he appears to be a ruthless and insane tyrant.

"What kind of vet can't even save the dying and injured?!" Faced with the threat of having her graduation certificate revoked, veterinary student, Jocelyn Ju decided to rescue a little cat. But, to her surprise, a simple CPR procedure ended up flipping her world upside down! Thanks to a 'magical kiss', Jocelyn gained the ability to switch between human and parrot form, launching herself into a warm and touching love adventure with Javen Xuan, a visitor from the Fairy Realm, who could switch between the form of a human and a black cat!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Meng Hu Chongsheng: Jiangjun Daren Yao Baobao
title.native: 萌虎重生：将军大人要抱抱

description:
Bai Ying was once a war tiger that belonged to the ever-victorious general Song Huaiying, but was framed to death alongside her owner. When the tiger wakes up again, she is back to three years ago. Everything is familiar except that she has turned into Bai Qingyin - a human girl who is betrothed to the general. Knowing that the villain will kill the general in three years, she swears to protect him at all costs. However, the general seems to detest the girl very much...

(Source: WebComics)

To escape her violent, alcoholic foster father and the precarious life in the slums, maid Sheila Godwin volunteered to become the countess's body double. She journeyed to the bitterly cold North to become the fourth stepwife of the lecherous Duke of Alcott, intending to poison him on their wedding night to avoid the same fate as his previous wives—tortured to death. Yet barely into the North, Sheila found herself trapped in a snow cave in dire peril. Her rescuer was none other than the Duke's second son. Was this a stroke of luck, or...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Condescending from a princess to a Cinderella and falling down from the cloud all of a sudden, Tong Xin Wan had no choice but to ask her fiance for help. Unfortunately, she was not only refused, but also failed to meet the so-called fiance... Anyway, she indescribably came across her fiance’s uncle, and there should be a taboo love between them. What’s going on?! Tong Xin Wan: "I really need to slow down..."

(Source: WebComics)

Shelly Natsu is a girl who suffered too much from school bullies' torment and died when she fell off a school building. After her death, she actually reincarnated into her classmate, the tall, rich, and handsome Ewan Duncan. While she begins her counterattack and takes revenge, she also begins an ambiguous relationship with Ewan's best friend, who was previously Shelly's secret crush. The most motivational story of all begins!

(Source: WebComics)

Lin Qingchun never expected her fiancé and best friend's betrayal a night before her betrothal. Even more surprising, she was reborn! Her life came back again, and the first thing she decided to do was to leave that scumb*g. He who lives next door keeps on saving her out of trouble repeatedly, he was even willing to help her get revenge?! They were just friends at the beginning, but then they started to grow closer.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Fuma Jing Yao He Wo Chao CP

description:
After taking her own life for her country, the ancient princess traveled to a costume drama set in the modern world. What a strange place! The man, with short hair looked exactly like her Prince Consort! Chu Yao, a popular actor, was accidentally killed after declining the hype plan designed by his company. Unexpectedly, he found he was reborn back to a few months before his death, facing the same hype plan choice again. However, if he declined to cooperate with the strange woman, would he somehow die?! One for true love in the previous life, the other for surviving, the couple have to get close to each other and carry out the hype plan...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Xie Wang De Jueshi Du Fei

description:
Travelling back, the secret service was forced to get married! It is said that her husband will bring misfortune to her, and his mistresses are everywhere!? Someone bring those bitches here! I’ll tear them into pieces and divorce my husband!!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Kaiju Song Gua: Bu An Taolu Xiuxian
title.native: 开局送挂：不按套路修仙

description:
"Care to buy a cheat code, Young Man?" "I heard Systems are all the rage recently. Give me a System." All my attributes were channeled toward strength after I bought a system cheat code by chance. Thus began my path to prove myself to the world using strength! Fierce, ancient beasts? Kill 'em with a punch! Monastic powerhouses? Kill 'em with a punch! I'll conjure up some miracles! Illness? I'll just destroy it with a punch! I'm Daniel, and I'm a living miracle!

(Source: WebComics)

After his sister's death, Row, who was said to be a freeloader, becomes an explorer to investigate the cause of his sister's death. When he nearly loses his life in the dungeon, he acquires the ability to disassemble monster corpses, supplies, and skills. Row becomes stronger by disassembling various things. And the mystery of his sister's death slowly begins to unravel...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Lang Jun Xiang Dui Wo Fu Ze

description:
Fang Li was marked incompletely by a beastman as a child, and has been troubled by his heat periods and pheromones. Years later, a wolf, Karnal, came forward to take responsibility. Fang Li immediately recognizes and fears Karnal as the culprit who often appears in his dreams. An evil ravenous beastman from his dreams or a fervently loyal doggo, which one is the real him?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Low self-esteem, timidity, and severe decision-making difficulties make Ye Xiaomu's life unhappy. After a failed confession to her crush, Xiaomu is shocked to discover she has the ability to travel to parallel worlds. In those worlds, her crush loves her, she lives happily, and everything is perfect. Immersed in that world, Xiaomu gradually uncovers a shocking secret…

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

The red monster (a great demon) sealed for eight hundred years regained its freedom, intending to dominate the world. Yet it was effortlessly subdued by the cute demon-hunting girl Tang Jie, and the two embarked on a wondrous adventure.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Liu Xian, the world's leading master of Chinese cuisine, is accidentally transported to a world of martial arts. Here, the culinary arts are non-existent--everyone just eats medicinal pills all the time! Eager to share his gifts with the people of this new world, Liu Xian instead falls prey to one possessive beauty after another, all of them wanting nothing more than to greedily devour all he has to offer them. Sounds like the dream come true of any man? Not this man—Liu Xian has an acute phobia of women!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Weiceng Zhixiao de Na Yi Ri

description:
What happened that day was their worst nightmare...A boy escaped from home with his adopted younger sister. From then on, they were known as the children of a murderer and depended on each other to live. Growing up with each other's company, the two start harboring feelings for each other on someday that nobody ever knew...

(Source: WebComics)

Several years have passed and my parents were gone, it's he who, the man of no kinship with me, was appointed the only successor of my parents' company and real estate. Samson: Till the day she is 18 years old. I won't be her guardian any more. According to her father's will, all will be over. And I will become her legal husband.

(Source: Webcomics App)

Who ever said that if your life is too fortunate, you have to marry an ugly person?!
Because of a fortune teller’s silly prediction, Yang Mimi suffers with awful suitors. The faces of the men her father bring home grow more and more startling...
Does Mimi really have to give up her happiness in this way? As if she’ll let that happen!
If Mimi is to find happiness, she’ll have to find her own husband! It doesn’t matter who, as long as his face doesn’t make her gasp!
Do you want to understand the meaning of life? Do you really want to live?

From Shiroyukineko Translations:
The Soaring Dragon Continent is a world of summons, you can only become strong if you become a summoner! Yue Yang, an average high school boy, was suddenly sucked into a wormhole and brought to the Soaring Dragon Continent. When he woke up, he was greeted with a lot of worried faces and found out that he had assumed another person's identity. Turns out he's the good-for-nothing son of the Yue Family, who had just recently drowned himself because of a failed engagement. Mysteriously, Yue Yang succeeded in summoning a monster on his first try, even when his previous self couldn't summon a single thing for eighteen years. Monsters simply listened to his orders and agreed to form contracts with him.

Thus begin the journey of the summoning prodigy.

So tell me what's the exact connection between you self-proclaimed Soloman's descendant and me, a normal college student? Don't explain something fiction-like to me, please. Wait, wait, wait. You have been my classmate for a year and I don't even know you? How could that be? And what's the red stamp on my neck? I have so many questions... OK first, why my roommate wants to kill me now?!

(Source: WebComics)

Millie is thrown to Barry, the son of her mother's best friend in the name of helping her with her poor grades . She is totally at a lost while Barry is ponder over how to drive her away. In this way, the two who do not know each other and are different in characters are forced together for a long time to come. Kabedon? Sleep in the same bed? Isn't it a simple co-living for tutoring?

(Source: Webcomics App)

The story began with a big adventure game. He got drunk and accidentally broke into her room and left her money before leaving the next day..."Hey you pervert! What kind of person you regard me?!" "What?! You are the one who set me up in this "trap" to scheme me!"

(Source: MangaToon)

In this world, there are a group of masters known as “Death God’s Enemy”. Those masters can withstand all kinds of diseases, disasters, and even death itself. As long as you have the right qualifications, you may even employ them to free you from the Death God’s grip.

(Source: ReadManhua)

Experienced an unexpected death, Qi Yan was forced to bind a fast time travel system which enables him to time travel across various different worlds to win the targets' hearts. For Qi Yan, this is just a task that has to be accomplished. It is just a game that does not involve emotion and feelings. He is confident that he can withdraw unscathed and unemotional. But the experience in every task is so real, even if he tells himself over and over that it's all illusions, he still can't completely isolate himself from those feelings...

(Source: WebComics)

Strange events are popping up all over Earth. Desert rainstorms, sudden floods, and the appearance of supernatural abilities... When Xu Nan touched upon the power of the Prometheus World, he awakened the "Mage" class and saw a vision of the Earth being invaded. However, he can only level up through "shameful" deeds. The young mage sets forth on the Path of Shame...

(Source: WebNovel)

Terence, an ascetic national idol of millions of fans, has a freaky unknown hobby. After a period of treatment, he thought that he was totally cured, until he met Jewel, a makeup girl with gorgeous hands, at the shooting site...

(Source: WebComics)

Zhao Dongting was betrayed and killed by his lover, but he came back to life in Dynasty Song South and become emperor. He stepped on the dead sea and set foot on the throne, and turned the madness to the side, and helped to build the kingdom, and become the legend of the supreme emperor!

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

In the chaotic period of the Republic of China, Chen Qiming, an opera actor in Peking Opera Association, was entangled by a new warlord, Yan Ci, at the first sight. Circulating between the support and threat of warlord forces, involving in the competition and grudges of opera association, Chen Qiming gradually found another side of Yan Ci under his military uniform. Who would have thought that the enmity between them had begun from childhood, and destined by this chaotic period.

(Sorce: WebComics)

Jack of All Trades，just as its name implies，means a man qualifies for any occupations. Dabao Zhang is a loser as well as a jack of all trades, but he is short of money recently. This day a beautiful woman harassed by a pervert asks Dabao Zhang for help. Since then, the loser starts a wondrous journey......

title.romaji: Fu Bao San Sui Ban, Ta Bei Ba Ge Juijui Tuan Chong Liao
title.native: 福宝三岁半，她被八个舅舅团宠了

description:
The innocent, cute, and smart Snowpea was on the verge of being beaten to death by her foster father when she heard her master's voice. It guided her to call her youngest uncle, which led to her eight bigshot uncles arriving with a vengeance! Now, living a new life, Snowpea just wants to be fed, but unexpectedly, her eight uncles all want to spoil her! And in the end, her powerful CEO real daddy descends like a god from the heavens to treat her like a little princess, making her the envy of the entire world.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Ye Hu Li Yu Gao Ling Hua Shei Hui Xian Diao Ma?
title.native: 野狐狸与高岭花谁会先掉马？

description:
Cang Yu hid her female identity and lived as the second son of the Cang family. She wants to go to the capital to find her mother's family roots, but she is ambushed by her family into becoming a candidate for the princess's consort instead. This princess is said to be extremely beautiful but cursed to bring misfortune to her partner. You better stay away from her, if you want to live! Cang Yu wants to get away from the husband-choosing contest as soon as possible, but she didn't expect to discover the princess's shocking secret... It turns out that the "princess" is not a princess at all! And Cang Yu is having trouble keeping up her own disguise...!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Picking up a has-been robot idol, who has attacked on human beings and taking him home is the crazy thing our MC has done. Faced with this situation, MC decides to help him return to his idol's life. So let's start from being a cross-dress streamer. (Isn't there anything wrong?)

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Chuan Yue Dao Mei Ge Shi Jie Cheng Wei Ni De Hei Lian Hua
title.native: 穿越到每个世界成为你的黑莲花

description:
The story between a crazy wolf-like general and a powerful femme-fatale in an omegaverse (ABO) parallel world. She's a cool and domineering person who transmigrates to different worlds to teach scumbags a lesson.
Now in this world... is she going to fall in love?
A love that might risk her life and leave a mark.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The prequel of "Xixing Ji", a story about the independence of the Asura tribe and the eight Dragon Gods. It tells the journey of the young Asura King who reigned over the Three Realms. Youyu, who was born with brittle and easily broken bones, met his sister who treated him as family and joined the Cast-Iron tribe, but the tribe was wiped out by a mysterious Asura, and Youyu was forcibly taken away. What will his fate be...?

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

Changning Xiao, the beautiful grand princess of the imperial dynasty, was suddenly married off... to a eunuch?! The empress dowager has held control ever since Changning’s parents died and promised her to this leader of an enemy faction, in a plot to both humiliate her and get a pawn on the inside. It’s already bad enough that Changning used to make fun of him in the past, but with the powerful empress dowager on one side and the infamously cold and bloodthirsty (yet handsome!!) eunuch on the other, will Changing make it through and survive?

(Source: Tapas)

Just as she was about to enter high school, Moli was struck by lightning and transmigrated to another world. What!? This is a chibi world? So cute boys aren't even worth it! At least everyone has beast-ears. Hey, maybe I can still make something of this!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Xiaojiejie Bushi Ni Xiang De Nayang
title.english: Miss, It's Really Not What You Think
title.native: 小姐姐不是你想的那样

description:
Caring third-rate comic artist and handsome first-rate video game streamer become roommates and form a new bromance through laughs and squabbles, but thanks to the gold-digging landlady's wild imagination, a series of hilarious misunderstandings ensue. Miss, our relationship is really not what you think!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: My Little Secret With the Demon Lord

description:
"Aunt, when I grow up… will you marry me?" No… No way! The kid was already thinking about making her his wife, but she is a minor immortal from the Immortal Yin World. She could not get together with a young human boy, no matter how ordinary she was. Yet, 500 years later, she was sent to congratulate the Yang Demon World’s young lord, Li Ye on his wedding. Wait a minute, the young lord looks familiar. Also, that woman he’s marrying is the physical body she left behind in the human world. To make things worse, he did not recognize her, and was trying to get her killed… Should she tell him the truth and clobber the brat’s handsome and immaculate face?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Dominating the Pugilistic World With My Detective Skills

description:
Ye Weiming, a smart and clear-headed young man, enters the game 'Eternal Justice' and gets 'fooled' into becoming a constable of the Divine Constable Bureau. Armed with the unique skill of finding clues through post-mortem and on-site investigation, his attributes rise quickly and he becomes one of the top martial arts master in this pugilistic game world. However, to maintain his position, more challenging missions await him...

(Source: Webnovel)

Yu Ni, a man with a few prospects, bought a husky and embarked on a journey to find himself and grow his abilities by slaying monsters across Asia. The beautiful cooking prodigy Wuzai accidentally ate monster-meat one time and was amazed at its taste. She was determined to create an entire cookbook based on monsters. Watch them get together for an incredible monster-hunting culinary adventure!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Mi Xi Yao accidentally meets the young and vivacious Pharaoh while time traveling to 3100 BC, using the identity of his fiancee. Drawn into the tide of history in the mystical age of myths and legends, Mi Xi Yao witnesses Egypt's unification under Menes's rule. Though Menes loves Bernier, she is not the real Bernier. Will Menes discover Bernier's true identity? Is it their destiny? Will the changes they make in the past alter history forever?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Jingjiren Tai Nan Liao
title.english: Why Is My Manager So Straight!

description:
Jing Tao has been secretly in love with Lu Yi Zhou for ten years, but it's just so hard to make Lu get the hang of it! Just when Jing Tao was about to give up, Lu Yizhou started to woo him. "Wait! Didn't you see me as a brother?" "Just because we're close as brothers, I'm discussing with you about something deeper~"

(Source: Mangatoon)

In order to help his little brother who’s in debt, Li Zhao has to marry into another family. As luck would have it, Li Zhao was struck by lightning, awakening memories of his past life. With a lifetime of secrets to longevity and unrivaled healing abilities, these memories from his past have Li Zhao seeking greatness.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Su Yu has a secret. For more than ten years, he's been having nightmares of being pursued by murderous monsters. When he became 18, he saw his own father die in battle with those monsters from his dreams. A few years later, he will become the killer of those monsters.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ying You Chang Feng Yi Bi Yuan

description:
Due to a bowl of ‘Xiangsi (lovesickness) soup’, Biyuan was abducted to a royal mansion by the butler to cook for the royal lord. During her escape, she broke the lord’s precious soup bowl but to find that it was poisoned. The secret led her to be trapped in danger. The lord decided to investigate this case and destroy the conspiracy behind the poison and the Xiangsi soup, so as to protect Biyuan. What’s going to happen next?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.romaji: Chao Shen Cong Ling Qu Liu Ge Jiejie Kaishi
title.native: 超神从领取六个姐姐开始

description:
Ye Luo's six sisters are all masters of their fields. The eldest sister is a mighty warrior and a great general. The second sister is a peak cultivator, a generational talent. The third sister controls innumerable magical beasts, the master of her own sect. The fourth sister is a kind and talented doctor who can revive the dead. The fifth sister is an ingenious trap-maker who no one dares to confront. The sixth sister… Wait! Even the young daughter of the evil mastermind wants to get with me?

Ye Luo: My life is… so hard! This is too difficult… wahahahaha!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shen Di Jianglin: Wo You Yi Wan Shuxing Dian
title.native: 神帝降临：我有亿万属性点

description:
Yi Qingtian reincarnated with trillions of attribute points and endless magical treasures, but he was reborn with the fate of divine punishment. In order to save his family, he transformed himself to ascend and defeat the heavenly hosts, but he was cursed with the Nine Dao Destruction Seal. In order to break the curse, he must find the nine heavenly tomes and consult the nine great sages. So, he must embark on a journey against the Heavenly Way, in order to defy fate itself…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Shi Si Ru Gui Wei Junzi
title.english: Gentleman Wei Who Sees Death as a New Beginning

description:
Wei Jun knows that he will become invincible after he is killed in this life, so he starts to seek death like a madman. But then he found out the whole world was toxic. Wei Jun beat up a debauched wastrel, only for him to compliment Wei Jun for doing the right thing, and asked for another slap in the face. When Wei Jun spewed bloody insults at the tyrannical emperor, the tyrant actually swore to protect him for all time. Wei Jun groped the heaven-defying lady bounty hunter, only for her to promise herself to him.

Wei Jun: Stop it! I just want to die. Why is it so hard?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

One, the ultimate weapon—Goddess! Two, magic weapons and martial arts are outdated! To live a mighty life is to rely on girls! Three, wanna save the world? Let the Goddess out! Four, our beautiful Goddess can warm up the sheets and fight in the streets! Five, a true warrior should be able to be a kept man for his Goddess boldly! Six, what will save the crumbling world? A warrior with a Divine Weapon? No, that will be me, Dongfang Ye, and my Goddess!

(Source: Webnovel)

The office lady Qiao Xiyi found out that her boyfriend has been cheating on her. Heartbroken, she hooked up with a gigolo at a bar, but she didn't know that the gigolo was actually Song Yifan, the president of her company, and the uncle of her ex-boyfriend.

(Source: Kuaikan, Translated)

Gu Beicheng, a secret agent, was struck by lightning in order to protect the imperial jade seal, but he strangely traveled back in time to the early Tang Dynasty. In this treacherous era, he managed to realize the dream of all modern men: to destroy Tubo, subjugate the Turkic Khaganate, conquer Goryeo, suppress the warlords, and unify China with Emperor Taizong of Tang! How will the return of the Omnipotent Agent to the Tang Dynasty stir up trouble and disrupt the martial world? Let's follow him as he opens the bizarre scrolls, enjoy the beauty of Tang, and expand territory!

(Source: Wecomics)

title.romaji: Na Motou Juben De Wo Xiuwei Quan Wu, Hai Bei Nütudi Zhui Sha?!
title.native: 拿魔头剧本的我修为全无,还被女徒弟追杀?！

description:
Wang Bai wakes up one day to find himself transmigrated into a fantasy world, lying in a coffin! Recovering the memories of this body, he realizes that this is the evil master of the demonic sect, who has committed unspeakable crimes and made numerous enemies.

Worst of all… he has lost all of his cultivation. And his past disciples, who harbor ill intent towards him, have all become powerful people, like the Queen Of Poison, the Demon Lord, the Taoist Master, etc… Maybe he should just go back to sleeping in the coffin?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Zhenmosi Yi Shen Si Mo

description:
When an overworked salaryman transmigrated to a fantasy world, he just wanted to live a quiet, peaceful life. But then he awakened the "Get Stronger When Demons Attack You System." And all of a sudden those fearsome demons started to seem very attractive to his eyes?!

"Oh please, whip me again, baby!"

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

Ye Zi'ang is an unsuccessful lingerie designer who died in an accident and reincarnated into a fantastical world! Here, men can transform into battle-suits for women to wear and grant them powerful combat abilities. Ye Zi'ang doesn't know what to feel about his situation. "When other people transmigrate they become all-powerful beings with a harem of girls. But here I am just a piece of clothing for the girls to wear?!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The comet virus ravages the earth, and most of the world's humans are infected and become zombies. The remaining humans live in an underground city called the Shire. Xiao Yan, a rookie researcher, longs for a stable and lazy life. During a mission, he is saved by Hai Yin, a famous figure in the special mission force. Xiao Yan is deeply attracted to Hai Yin, and Hai Yin also begins to think about how to ensnare the rookie researcher...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Na Nie Le Qi Yun Zhi Zi

description:
Ye Chuyun transmigrated into a fantasy world with no talent, no friends, and no opportunities. After struggling for three years, he was about to be expelled from his sect when he finally activated the Life Panel System.

"You say you are the Chosen One, the true son of destiny? Very well, from now on, all your opportunities belong to me!"

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Bu Xiao Xin, Ming Chui Qian Shi

description:
When Tu Ye transmigrated into the body of a young emperor, he just wanted to live life as a spoiled king and let his kingdom die out so he could go back home. But all the "tyrannical" things he did ended up helping somehow. Step by step, the originally doomed Kingdom of Gan is on the way to becoming the most powerful empire in the world…!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Clumsy Beasts, You’ve Crossed the Line!

description:
Bai Yue, a girl who has been confined in a sanatorium since childhood, unexpectedly escapes and finds herself transported 2,000 years into the future, into a world dominated by beastmen. She is bought by a powerful and handsome beastman named Lang Xiao, who treats her with great care, even enlisting a “bear nanny” to help look after her. However, as she starts to enjoy her life as a pampered “pet,” she begins to notice that her master’s affection may be crossing some boundaries. Her struggles to maintain her dignity while navigating this bizarre new world make for an intriguing and humorous story.

(Source: Webnovel)

Lu Chi is easy to get along with girls, while it's only normal with men when she first meet them. Blind to men's faces and see everyone is the same look. She basically remember men by their clothes. But now, a different man has appeared.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wangyou Zhi Zui Qiang Suanmìng Shi
title.english: I Got Assigned A Hidden Profession!

description:
My name is Qin Yue. I was never anything special, but after I got the equipment to play a fully immersive virtual-reality online game called "Free World", I finally thought I could make a change. As soon as I entered the game, I ended up falling into an NPC's trap which forced me into taking a hidden job. 1My name is Qin Yue. I was never anything special, but after I got the equipment to play a fully immersive virtual-reality online game called "Free World", I finally thought I could make a change. As soon as I entered the game, I ended up falling into an NPC's trap which forced me into taking a hidden job.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Guanyu Wo De Shen Gun Shifu

description:
A youth from Northwest China Zhang Mo lived his life suffering from the effects of a curse until his fateful encounter with a mysterious girl Bai Zhizhi that knocked his life upside-down.
She took him hostage and brought him into the mountains where they summoned Mu Cha, an unknown stranger who had been asleep inside the rockface of a cave.

Only after that did he finally experience a world that varied greatly from the modern society he knew. All he needed to do was to learn how to be a priest just like Bai Zhizhi and Mu Cha and he could defeat his sickness. But...

(Source: Webnovel)

After illegal human replication services begin spreading through the underground, tragedy strikes, a plane crash takes the life of his newlywed wife. Consumed by grief and temptation, he faces an impossible question:
Should he bring her back by copying her? But when memory, identity, and love can all be replicated, one unsettling doubt remains, is the person who returns truly her, or just a perfect imitation?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Kaiju Yi Ju Xiao Jiangshi, Xiu Xian Quan Kao Zhong Zhiwu
title.native: 开局一具小僵尸，修仙全靠种植物

description:
I crossed over, my gold finger became Plants vs Zombies and I’m the zombie…

“Sunflowers produce one grain of sunlight a day and they also contain the qi of the entire body during the Qi Refining Period? With 54 squares planted, isn’t this…”

“A pea from the Pea Shooter is comparable to a full strength blow from someone from the Qi Refining Stage?”

“Oh my god, is this a Squash? A Great Foundation building master was killed in one sitting!”

“This Nascent Soul Elder, this spirit plant I offered is called the Doom-Shroom…”

“Eh? How come these two plants can be hybridized…”

“Zombie illustrated book? Open it.”

“The zombie body can be upgraded and different zombies can be replaced as the main body…quickly bring me the Dacheng Holy Body covered with green hair!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Ninhao! Guiren Xitong Wei Nin Fuwu
title.native: 您好！贵人系统为您服务

description:
Jiang Ruo, who specializes in giving gold coins to the sons of destiny, is facing the biggest challenge of his career. All his support for the protagonist has been misinterpreted as love...

I only gave money, not people!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Liu Chengfeng, an elite of the modern world wakes up to find himself reincarnated as the notorious leader of the Wicked Valley in the cultivation world. But wait a minute, as the bad guy, he has a system that requires good deeds to level up?!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jiu Xiang Yao Ge Nu Pengyou

description:
Kawaii girl? Cougar? Party queen? Which type is your dish? Stop worrying about not having a girlfriend and join us to find your sweetheart.

(Source: WebComics)

A special forces soldier, Lin Yuntian was assigned on a mission searching for the ancient jade. During the mission, his soul accidentally broke free from his body and travelled through the multiverse and embodied in another body. The owner of the body was previously set up by his opponents and ended up losing everything he had.

(Source: WebComics)

Have you ever skipped studying to play video games? Unfortunately for high school senior Yu-Sin Lee, the stakes are a little higher than flunking, as he finds himself trapped in a VR-based MMORPG. Yu-Sin was selected to beta test the game, only to be forced to fight for his life in a seemingly endless loop.
