So when a love affair between the young star and a mysterious figure threatens the livelihood of their company, it is up to Yeong-Woon to track his client down and put an end to their risky romp. But the truth may be too much for him to bear, as the other party turns out to be top model—and Yeong-Woon's first love—Han Seo-In. As Yeong-Woon struggles to reconcile his unresolved feelings for Seo-In with his sense of duty toward his work, the two fall into a intricate web woven of unanswered questions and lingering emotions that changes the trajectory of their lives forever...

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Modern-day alpha male Tae-Ok Lee wakes up in a novel as Tae-Yang Baek, a bully from a novel. Just then, a glowing status window appears before his eyes.

"Have sex with the girls, or you will die."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Getting ghosted is the worst way to break up, no contest. After years of heartbreak, Eun-Kyo finally gets to enjoy a quiet life running a café with her best friend. But peace shatters when Jae-Heon, their new basement tenant, barges into her life. Wild, handsome, and maybe a bit of trouble, he begins to test Eun-Kyo's resolve to swear off dating.

(Source: Manta)

Evil mage Fiona Green was destined to die at the hands of the protagonist couple in “The Emperor and the Saint.” That is, until the story’s author became Fiona herself! Though mistreated, cast out by her pompous family and thrown into the battle at Heylon, Fiona is determined to use her magic for good. But things take a rather unexpected turn when she rescues the male lead, Siegren, turning him from foe to friend… Will she successfully rewrite her fate without changing the story’s happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Scholar Woon Hyun enters the palace after passing the Imperial Examination. Though he soon comes to lament his poor and miserable life of having to deal with the Crown Prince's hobbies, despite that, he doesn't give up and tries his best to learn martial arts. But Woon Hyun suddenly picks up his brush to conquer the Murim?! The hidden story of the scholar who passed the Imperial Examination at a young age begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: A Child Who Looks Like Me

description:
A surprise pregnancy sends Jeong-o, a college junior, into a panic. Her supportive boyfriend Jiheon plans a loving proposal, but a car accident erases his recent memories, including their romance. Seven years later, they reunite unexpectedly—but Jiheon has no recollection of Jeong-o or the fact that they share a precious daughter between them.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After I-Han Jeong’s mother and brother died in a car crash when she was just 9 years old, she was raised by Chi-O Han and his parents, who lived next door. Now about to attend university, I-Han suddenly finds herself living with Chi-O under one roof, and she realizes that she feels more than just familial affection for her brother figure. While trying to deal with her trauma and the awkwardness of freshman life, I-Han meets Yu-Jin Seo, a champion judoka at their university who is the spitting image of her late brother. And now he's moving in next door?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

When lifelong criminal Seung-Ji finds herself betrayed by her old boss, she joins an upstart smuggling business to lay low. Her goal is to find the opening to take advantage of the business to score cash and flee the city, but a wrench by the name of Yeong-Won is thrown into her plans. Inexperienced and naive, Yeong-Won is working in her aunt’s stead as Seung-Ji’s superior. Falling in love is a luxury for people in their line of work, but Seung-Ji’s desire for financial gain might be changing into a desire for something that she can’t afford...

(Source: Tappytoon)
Second season of Cheese in the Trap.

A Catholic school where everything seems tranquil and fine. But for Ayeon, a day doesn't pass without getting bullied until one day, Yeonhwa steps in against the bullies. Ayeon is grateful for Yeonhwa but what she doesn't realize is that there seems to be something more than just good intentions behind that beautiful smile.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After twelve years, a former teammate—no, a thorn in his side—suddenly reappears. Eun-San isn’t thrilled to be working with Ian again, having long buried both his ice hockey past and any memories of him.

Unlike Eun-San, who hopes their meeting will be a one-time thing, Ian insists on keeping him around with an offer he can’t refuse. With his beloved younger sibling caught in the middle, Eun-San reluctantly agrees, but he can't shake the feeling that Ian has an ulterior motive.

Why does Ian keep pulling him closer? There’s no way this guy actually has feelings for him…right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The S-Class Hunter’s Peaceful Life with Monsters

description:
Chimera hunter Number 17 has spent decades hunting monsters. On his latest mission, he’s ordered to ensure the human hunters’ escape and never return to base. In other words, he’s meant to die. As his body dissolves, his life flashes before him: kidnapped as a boy, forced into endless battles, reduced to a mindless weapon. But against all odds, his body reforms into his human form. No longer Chimera Hunter Number 17, he stands before a vast open land on his own two feet as Do-un Cheon, a human, ready to start his life anew, making friends out of monsters and building the family he never had.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Erkin, a young pharmacist from the north, was orphaned from the war between the Northern Nations and Mormeratta. After making a name for himself in Mormeratta, he is summoned to treat a mysterious “master of the castle” whom no one has ever seen. He reluctantly agrees, hoping it will bring him one step closer to finding the infamous Witch of the Sun who killed his parents during the war. Little does he know, on his quest for vengeance, the witch may have been by his side all along. What will Erkin do when confronted by his sworn enemy turned friend?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

As the newest hire of a game dev studio, beautiful Seong-Ji draws all the attention of her coworkers — but it's her bossy and blunt team leader Su-Min that intrigues her. Love is a whole new game for Seong-Ji, and with company president Se-Ju breaking (or was it laying?) down the rules, this new girl’s got her work cut out for her if she wants to win. Will she be able to give Su-Min what she wants?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

title.english: I'm a Part-Timer for the Gods

description:
When areas called “Dungeons” started appearing, individuals with Abilities also emerged. Dam-Deok Yu believed that these Abilities would catapult mankind to greater heights until he realized he wasn’t given any! Dam-Deok loathed his situation so much that he cursed the gods, and the gods seemed to have heard him since he was struck by lightning. When he woke up, a system window appeared, telling him the gods were waiting for him…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: The Goddess of Abundance and Her Troublemaker Apostle

description:
Earth’s life force is depleted, and it’s dying. Humanity’s only hope lies with Dispatchers, heroes sent to otherworldly realms to retrieve energy for survival. Chan-Su Oh is one of them, but despite his legendary father, he has zero talent. However, things change when Chan-Su is sent to the Block-Style Territory Expansion World as the Apostle of a forgotten, weakened Goddess of Abundance. Armed with nothing but a modified harvesting skill and a desperate drive to find his parents, Chan-Su must reclaim his territory block by block. From wretched outcast to genius apostle, the hunt to restore his Goddess begins now!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!

description:
Who was that guy that once said, “An army marches on its stomach”? When hapless agricultural science student Jangcheol Kim starts playing the fantasy MMORPG “Paladins of Blood” to escape the stress of school life, he never imagined he would end up inside the game, much less as its final boss. How can a ruthless demon overlord win over his subjects? Perhaps with potatoes.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jang Baek-Hee is counting the days until he can escape Gicheon before his deadbeat father is released from prison. But then Yang Il-Woo arrives: a delinquent transfer student with a cheap perm, brassy hair, and a loneliness that mirrors Baek-Hee’s own. Slowly, their uneasy friendship deepens into something tender. But Il-Woo came to Gicheon with a secret that could shatter the fragile comfort they've both found in each other. And when the past comes calling, can two broken souls survive the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Little Rabbit and the Big Bad Leopard

description:
Vivi is a... wererabbit?! As a creature that’s supposed to transform into a human, Vivi is a failure, demonized as cursed and sent off to her doom. Luckily, her demise is cut short as Ahin of the Black Leopard Clan saves her. But with every threat and command this temperamental heir tosses at Vivi, she’s questioning her safety (and sanity). Surrounded by carnivores and their strong pheromones, she'll try to survive the chaos while stuck in her rabbit form. Will she figure out how to transform and tap into the power within her cute, furry self?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 56 extra chapters.

One day, a girl awakens as 6-year-old St. Priscilla, the heroine of her most cherished novel. The catch? She is destined to suffer with an abusive adoptive family! To avoid this, she adopts her ultimate bias, the ruthless Emperor Melkiades, as her father instead. Although spending her days fangirling and redeeming her bias's tarnished name seems like a dream come true, with so many foes still lurking in the shadows, can this young saint protect Melkiades and find happiness for them both?

(Source: Tapas)

Mun Geon-U’s first love comes crashing into him smelling like the sweetest cookie around! After learning he’s a new bakery owner in town named Yu Ha-Jin, Geon-U asks him for a part-time job in the hopes of winning over his heart. Unfortunately, his plan is doomed from the start as Ha-Jin is completely done with relationships now. But a little pushback is hardly an issue for the ace judo athlete Geon-U. He’s prepared to do anything to make Ha-Jin fall for him, even if that means letting the baker squeeze his hot buns...!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Edele Lancaster is the perfect noble lady who has been groomed for the job. But when her husband whom she married reluctantly commits treason, she is branded a traitor and becomes a slave. Distraught, she tries to kill herself to preserve honor as a noble lady, but her new master, Count Laslo Krissus prevents her from doing so. Will Edele be able to find freedom and happiness in her new life as Count Krissus’ maid?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Barbarian's Adventure in a Fantasy World

description:
Ketal the Barbarian never imagined that his dream of fantastical magic, epic kingdoms, and grand quests would start in the freezing, monster-filled White Tundra. After battling snow and fierce beasts, he reaches the wider world, only to find everyone is baffled by such a polite barbarian who asks too many questions and sends foes flying like ragdolls. Ketal just wants the adventure he's always wished for. But can a world that expects a brute handle a barbarian who refuses to be one?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Ian the Illegitimate Son Was an Emperor

description:
Betrayed and on the brink of death, Ian Verocian, a mage and the emperor of the Variel Empire, is sent a hundred years back in time by a forbidden spell. He wakes up as Ian Vratz, a margrave's illegitimate son, and soon learns he's about to be sent off to a desert tribe as part of a political treaty. Now, Ian must use his wits and powerful magic to gather allies and figure out the plots lurking around him. The question is... can this young mage change his fate before time runs out once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Beautiful and intelligent, So-Myeong Gil has tirelessly strived to fulfill her mother's vision of the perfect daughter. However, when her less-than-perfect younger brother is tragically found drowned in a river, doubts plague So-Myeong's heart. She begins to suspect that their mother might be responsible for the unspeakable act. From then on, her paramount goal becomes escaping her mother's grasp, while all her mother wants is for So-Myeong to experience the perfect life she herself was denied. Will So-Myeong ever truly find her freedom?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Luke is having a rough time in college, and his breakup with his girlfriend Stacy is not helping. This is all because of that nerdy stud, Andrew! If only Stacy didn't obsess over Andrew's dorky charms, then Luke wouldn't have had to break their relationship off! To make matters worse, Luke is then forced to live in the same dorm room as Andrew! But with nowhere else to go and no money to his name, Luke resolves to make it his project to befriend Andrew, whether the nerd likes it or not!

(Source: Tapas)

Jeong Sejin knows full well that his life doesn’t have anything good in store for him. As an adoptive son riddled with nightmares of a strange assault, Sejin sometimes finds himself wondering if there could ever be someone out there for a person as broken as him… With his family’s company teetering on the edge of financial ruin, Sejin knows a happy-ever-after is further away than ever. So when the second son of the thriving Seonho Group, a handsome alpha named Kwon Ido, requests his hand in marriage, Sejin goes into it with low expectations. Yet, something strange happens the moment their eyes meet. How could someone he had just met look at him with such pain and tenderness? And how does Ido know all of his preferences? Could there be something more to this seemingly arranged marriage…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Genius Grandson of the Loan Shark King

description:
Mu-Hyeok Kim, grandson of the legendary "Loan Shark King," has done all of the family's dirty work for 30 years, only to be betrayed and killed by his uncle's orders. Mysteriously, he wakes up in 1990, in his first year of high school, just in time to save his grandmother on his father's side from a heart attack. Now in need of money to pay for her hospital bills, Mu-Hyeok goes to his mother's family to ingratiate himself with the Loan Shark King, but this time, he plans to take his money and get revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the quiet village of Feltham, Eloise Surbiton leads a peaceful life far from the hubbub of the city, tending to geese and secretly fawning over dashing war hero Lt. Col. Ryan Wilgrave from afar. When her father mentions that a certain military man named Ryan will be moving to the nearby town of Cambourne, Eloise is thrilled — only to have her hopes dashed when she meets her new neighbor Ryan Thornton, a gruff soldier who is the opposite of the Ryan Wilgrave she knows. Little does she realize, there may be more to Ryan than meets the eye…

(Source: WEBTOON)

While livestreaming about his struggles, Si-Woo receives a donation with a strange request. He agrees, only to discover it came from Limen, the goddess of Eden, who has suddenly tasked him with defending her world from seven demon rulers. Ten years later, Si-Woo returns to Earth as the pope of Eden, only to find it overrun by monsters. The demon rulers show signs of reappearing, and to maintain his divine power, he must spread Limen’s faith across Earth. Can Pope Si-Woo complete his holy mission?

(Source: Tapas)

Nina the cat lost the Zodiac Race by one spot, and she's held a grudge for millennia. When she forces a divine do-over, unlucky student Cosmo Lee becomes the reluctant referee. His mission? Gather twelve Zodiac Spirits for the ultimate competition. The catch? They've all possessed girls from his school. Can an ordinary boy survive refereeing an extraordinary battle between Heaven-sent superpowered heroines?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sun is determined to make a good impression at her new job. The only problem is, her boss is an old classmate from high school - the notoriously stuck-up Do-Yeong - and he’s making her life hell. But the tables turn when Sun discovers her boss’ scandalous secret. After all, if word got out about Do-Yeong’s night time naughtiness, it could ruin his career. Will Sun make him get on his knees and beg for mercy? Or will they come to a steamy agreement?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Thrown into the ruthless world of gangsters as a prostitute, Geom has seen all the ugliest sides of humanity. After a brutal eight years of being off the grid, he reunites with Wooyeon, the man he once loved, to congratulate him on his upcoming marriage. Recognizing Wooyeon as a light within a very deep, dark abyss, Geom finds himself being drawn to him all over again. But with each of his ankles shackled by the twisted Rieder and the obsessive Prosecutor Lee, is there truly any hope of salvation?

(Source: TappyToon)

The protagonist, who had worked himself to the bone at the Murim Alliance, finally retires and heads back to his hometown to fulfill his dream of becoming a sect leader. Due to his meager savings, he ends up purchasing a manor that was suspiciously cheap, and rumored to be haunted. But then, an unfamiliar system suddenly appears before him. Though startled at first, the protagonist soon begins to use the system to efficiently recruit disciples and manage the sect’s finances and resources. In time, with the help of the system, his sect grows rapidly, so much that it starts drawing the attention, wariness, and hostility of other Murim factions…

(Source: Naver, translated)

"If you wrote me, then you can give me the throne!"

Yoonsoo is the successful author of a popular fantasy series. Just as she's about to start work on a new series, Imperial Prince Kyte Einzen, the worst villain she created has kidnapped her into the world of her own story?! Can she mold this nightmare into a story that will turn both their fates around? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

The path to greatness begins… tomorrow! It’s always a day too early for a great procrastinator like Yeonho Wi to start training. So how did someone as lazy as him become a great warrior renowned for his virtue, benevolence, and might? Follow the historian’s journey to uncover the hidden secrets of the lazy master of martial arts.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Villainess Just Wants to Live in Peace!

description:
I quit my terrible job and set off on a trip, only to die in a plane crash! I woke up to find myself reincarnated as Tanasia Breloff, the villainess of a novel I once read. Tanasia was scheming to harm her sister out of jealousy, but I’m not interested in villainy; I’m content being a beautiful, wealthy noblewoman! But wait… don’t I eventually get killed in the novel? I must prevent my death—so I can live the peaceful life I’ve dreamed of! This series contains themes regarding abuse and may not be suitable for all readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A pleasant and mysterious daily life created by a young couple in the forest and an unidentified child who one day came to them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Sa-Ra, a high school senior who failed her exams, starts receiving tutoring from Seo-Won, her older brother's friend. Sa-ra becomes fascinated by Seo-Won, a student at a prestigious university with incredible social skills, but feels frustrated that he likely sees her as just a kid...

A high school senior's unrequited love story, filled with hesitation and anxiety as she struggles to approach the tutor she admires.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I possessed the body of my favorite character’s former wife, the one who dies young, in my all time favorite novel.

“I didn’t have any lingering regrets from my past life anyway, so whatever. Since it’s come to this, I might as well enjoy stanning my favorite to my heart’s content.”

That was what I thought, but I survived because a power that never existed in the original story awakened within me. On top of that, somewhere along the way, I ended up winning over my in laws far too easily.

“You are probably the only person who would risk their life for Akid’s favourably more than for a commission.”

My free spirited, utterly dysfunctional father in law even helps support my fangirling.

“Then you should not have been born so cute. There are plenty of vicious criminals in this world who prey on children as adorable as you.”

My mother in law, once known as the Mad Dog of Heint, does not treat me coldly at all. Instead, she goes to extremes to protect me. And then there is my husband, who used to be nothing but innocent, suddenly starting to flirt with me at every opportunity.

“Roena’s hair is just like cotton candy.”

“My hair is a bit frizzy, though.”

“Not at all. I meant it is so soft that I want to keep touching it.”

All this time, I thought I was someone dangerous to him. But then…

“Roena, do you have any idea now who is more dangerous?”

Could it be that my Akid, whom I thought was only pure and naive, was actually a genius at flirting all along?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.romaji: Debut Mot Hamyeon Jungneun Byeong Geollim
title.native: 데뷔 못 하면 죽는 병 걸림

description:
After a night of drinking, aspiring civil servant Ryu Gunwoo passes out, only to awaken three years in the past in the body of a young man named Park Moondae. Before he can even assess the situation, he's given a mission: Debut or Die! Now, Moondae has one year to debut as an idol or face his doom. Luckily, he's able to snag a spot on the famous survival program "Idol Inc.", but with his skills so low and the competition so high, does Moondae stand a chance at becoming a shining star?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

“What will people call him?”

Someone asked. But no one could answer. A transcendent being appeared in the world. Creating a new history in the film industry.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Return of the 8th Class Mage

description:
As a powerful 8th class mage, Ian Paige took countless innocent lives under the orders of Emperor Ragnar, a close friend and ruler of the Greenriver Empire. Yet despite their closeness, Ragnar views Ian as a threat and subsequently poisons him. Using time magic, Ian saves himself and returns 30 years to the past. Now a young boy, Ian joins an elite order of mages to hone his abilities once again. This time, he’ll get revenge on the emperor who betrayed him and reclaim glory as an 8th class mage!

(Source: Tapas)

Because of a difficult family background, Ji-U enters college later than most of her peers. Quiet and reserved, she keeps to the edges of campus life, always feeling one step out of sync with everyone else. There is one person she cannot help noticing, U-Yeon, a boy who seems to shine wherever he goes. He stands at the center of every group, laughing easily, drawing people in without effort. Compared to him, Ji-U feels invisible, and so she hides her feelings, nursing a silent crush she believes will never reach him. To Ji-U, U-Yeon appears flawless, someone untouched by hardship or pain. But one rainy day, that illusion shatters. Ji-U stumbles upon U-Yeon standing alone in the downpour, tears mixing with rain as he cries with heartbreaking beauty. In that moment, Ji-U realizes that even the brightest people carry unseen scars. And perhaps her quiet presence could become a place of comfort for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Everything is cloaked in mystery with "The Thief Princess". In reality, she is Lucian, the princess of the kingdom. With the wedding to her betrothed Hebron drawing near, Lucian concocts a daring plan to sabotage the ceremony and flee. Under the cover of the night, she sneaks into the prince's chamber while he sleeps. But after he unknowingly ingests a strange potion, Hebron captures her. Convinced the events are nothing more than a dream, Hebron kisses Lucian... Can Lucian truly steal what is most precious to him?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

High school student San-Ho, blessed with extraordinary intuition, finds himself caught in a battle between monsters only he can see, nearly losing his life. He awakens in a world where monsters keep humans as pets. Now trapped as a pet himself, San-Ho desperately searches for a way to escape and return home. Will he be able to find his way back home?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Stacy and I have a mutual agreement... to "help" each other when in need... What could possibly go wrong... right?

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Peaceful Camping Life in Another World

description:
Star chef Lee Kang-Hyeon, who has lost his sense of taste, retreats to a peaceful countryside to escape the public eye. In his grandfather's rural home, he stumbles upon a portal to another world. Taking advantage of his escape, he decides to enjoy a relaxed camping life in this new world. However, the inhabitants of this world keep showing interest in him. Will Kang-Hyeon be able to live a peaceful life?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Kim Chung-ah has been living in a single room for two years, with money borrowed from her boyfriend. She works part-time at a convenience store to slowly pay off her debt, but it’s barely enough to cover living expenses. She thought she had escaped her abusive father, but… I want to quit my part-time job and leave my boyfriend, but don’t have the courage. Will I ever be able to leave without any worries?

“I told you already, stop thinking about your boyfriend.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

Jin and Junghyeok are childhood friends, but they have been in a cold war for years! What happens when their souls swap? One day, both of them found their old name tags from middle school and went to bed with old memories in mind... to wake up in the body of the one that they hate the most! How will they deal with day to day life? Is there a way back?

title.english: When the Villainess is in Love

description:
When a young girl wakes up in the body of her favorite character, villainess Princess Libertia, the very first thing she decides to do is... fangirl her heart out! And why not? In a novel where all of her favorite characters are doomed to die, this is her chance to give them all a happy ending. But will the story play out as she expects when people start to see Princess Libertia in a new, forgiving light? One fangirl's love might be what it takes to turn this villainess into a heroine!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six side story chapters.

Ever since the discovery that she was not the emperor's real daughter, Daphne has lived a lonely life as a maid at the imperial palace. Amidst the daily bullying and mockery she suffers from others, her sole solace is Asherad, the Crown Prince. He is the only one who treats her with warmth, and she can't help but fall for his kindness. However, Asherad's kindness is merely a cloak for his cruelty and possessiveness. When Daphne discovers his true nature, she resolves to leave his side… But will she be able to outrun Asherad's obsession with her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The female diver, Somyeong, has an unexpected encounter with Yeo-Hae, a merman, in the depths of the sea. While wielding a sickle, she accidentally strikes him. In the chaos, Somyeong loses consciousness, only to later awaken and discover that Yeo-Hae, despite the injury, had saved her life. Stricken with guilt for causing him harm, Somyeong decides to bring the injured merman back to her home, hoping to tend to his wounds and make amends. However, as she begins to treat him, she finds herself swept up in Yeo-Hae's rut. What started as a rescue soon transforms into an unexpected and irresistible encounter.

Note: Part of Lezhin's Sunaemul Danpyeonseon (순애물 단편선) Collection.

Hyun-Jae Moon, a beta, has been in a loving relationship with alpha Shin-Hoo Lee for seven years. But all this changes when Shin-Hoo sacrifices himself to save Hyun-Jae from a terrible accident. When Shin-Hoo wakes up in the hospital, he doesn’t recognize Hyun-Jae or have any memories of their time together. All Shin-Hoo wants now is a man who can handle his intense desires, but does a beta have the stamina to keep up with him? With their relationship in shambles, how can Hyun-Jae win Shin-Hoo back?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: There's No Such Thing as a Bad Lady

description:
Raised in the slums of Ebelstein, Derek knows all too well that magic cannot bridge social divides. Through harsh lessons and hard-earned discipline, he rises to become a second-tier mage, scraping by as a mercenary. Life takes a different turn when he is appointed as a magical tutor to Diella Duplain-- the temperamental youngest daughter of a noble house, unable to wield magic despite her lineage. Though Derek is her last resort before exile to a convent, Diella clashes with him from the start. Together, will they be able to prove that there’s no such thing as a “bad” lady?

(Source: WEBTOON)

“How did I end up doing a strip show in front of a classmate I barely even know?”

Baek Han-Yeong has lived his whole life as a perfectly ordinary No-Namer, someone without the fated mark of destiny. That is, until he gets to college and meets Ryu Cheong-Hyeon, a bold Namer with the name “Baek Han-yeong” etched right across his neck. Cheong-Hyeon, convinced fate is at play, starts tailing Han-Yeong everywhere, fascinated by the uncanny coincidence. Exhausted and desperate to prove he’s just a plain old No-Namer, Han-Yeong blurts out the wildest challenge imaginable… and ends up undressing right in front of him. Regret hits immediately.

“If I could go back in time, I’d never throw out a stupid suggestion like that to this lunatic…”

But now that the line’s been crossed, will fate keep dragging them back together, or was this one outrageous mistake just the beginning?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The laws of the world have changed!

In an instant, the world turned into a hell for the strong because of the god Kashita. At the end of the slaughter test given by the gods, Yu Do-Hyeok became the “Great Emperor”, the strongest of mankind, and defeated God.

However, the pleasure of victory is short-lived, and everyone returns to the first day of the trial with their memories of what happened. With the exception of Yu Do-Hyeok.

Instead of helping each other, people rush to take the place of the strongest one by killing the Great Emperor. In a world crazier than his previous life, can Yu Do-Hyeok kill God and restore peace?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

A medical mission turns fatal as Dr. Jin’s life slips away. Miraculously, he wakes on a battlefield. Instinct takes over. He tends to patients before realizing that this is the martial arts world of The Reigning Heavenly Demon! He’s reincarnated as a child with mastery of modern medicine and soon his skills draw notice. From the renowned White-scaled Doctor to the infamous Gongson Family, everyone sees his potential. But how much is Dr. Jin willing to sacrifice before risking death again?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Heavenly Demon Wants a Quiet Life

description:
After a lifetime of bloodshed, the Heavenly Demon longs for peace. In his final moments, he uncovers the truth about his power and yearns for a different life. He wakes up in the body of Tae-San Byeok, the frail second son of a powerful merchant family, barely clinging to life. Using his knowledge from his life as the Heavenly Demon, Tae-San must navigate a world of temptation and corruption to survive. As his martial arts reputation grows, new enemies emerge to disrupt his quiet life. Yet, Tae-San is determined to live on his own terms, despite the chaos around him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Reborn as the Forsaken Baby Princess

description:
Killed by her most trusted comrade, Assassin Agent Black is reborn as the baby princess of a historical novel. Immediately, she faces repeated assassination attempts and is even forsaken by the king when he refuses to give her a name, but she won't let anyone get her this time. As she uses her assassin skills to survive, she starts making allies, saves the prince's life, and even catches the king's interest. But with a target still on her, will that be enough to keep this little princess alive?

(Source: Tapas)

Kim Yoo-Young is sick of playing the nice, boring lawyer and daughter. So when her overbearing mother books her a hotel room the night before an arranged blind date, she steps out of character and spends the night with a seductive stranger from the hotel bar. Only this stranger turns out to be none other than Cha Ji-Hoon, her blind date and the hotel's high-class owner! Yoo-Young will do anything to keep their "bad deed" a secret... but can she really marry her first one-night stand?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue and five side story chapters.

Betrayed and killed by his fellow Ninestar guild members, the powerful necromancer Cha Jinhyuk resorts to a daring soul transference. A decade later, he awakens in a new body, devoid of his former powers. With the support of his new comrades, Spirit Master Balkan and hobgoblin Haryu, he embarks on a quest for vengeance, scaling the mysterious tower once again. Only this time, he possesses the overpowered abilities of an "All-Master," enabling him to master all the occupations within the tower!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Youngest Must Become an Idol

description:
Taeyoon Bong is a webnovelist infamous for writing the most tragic endings for his characters. Taeyoon believes this is due to what happened five years ago--back then, he was an idol trainee ready to debut with his hyungs. That all changed when a drunk driver ran into their car and shattered their reality. Taeyoon was the only survivor. One night, he answers a mysterious call from a hyung he long thought dead, throwing him back to that fateful night...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: A Ranker's Guide to the Good Life

description:
In a world filled with towers, dungeons, and monsters, some people have awakened with special powers. While these hunters risk their lives in battle and climb the world rankings, Jio Gyeon is happy to just sit back and enjoy a simple life of leisure. But Jio has a secret—she’s the strongest hunter in the world. But when a time traveling stranger warns her of humanity’s bleak future, will Jio finally take action? And what enemies are waiting for her to reveal her true identity?

(Source: Tapas)

After three regressions spent as a sacrifice for the “true child of destiny,” LeBlain decides that her fourth life will be different: she will escape. To fund her exile, she chooses adoption—only to be taken in by a notorious villain family. What begins as a desperate survival plan slowly transforms into something far more unexpected: a child who tames villains with kindness, resolve, and an unshakable heart. A healing romance fantasy about growth, redemption, and finding love in the most unlikely place.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Mu-Yeong spent his childhood under his stepfather’s oppressive rule, a life that felt like living in hell. A mysterious voice in the living hell showed him the way to survive.

“Live someone else’s life instead of yours.”

That’s how his acting journey began… Was it a survival instinct? Even when he did well, he excelled too much. Through acting, Mu-Yeong gained a new life. This is the story of Mu-Yeong, the overwhelming acting genius, embarking on a challenge in the entertainment industry!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Terminally ill Miena Sidus has the ability to enter other people's dreams. Knowing her time will be up soon, Miena decides to use her power to gather money for her loving parents as a last gesture of gratitude. But as she navigates the dreams, she finds herself involved with a mysterious boy, a young lord, and a great dragon. Moreover, they all seem to need her help and are intent on saving her as well. Will these new relationships change Miena's fate and give her a ray of hope in life?

(Source: Tapas)

Earth has long become accustomed to the strange and frightening phenomenon of “dimensional gates” that suddenly appeared over a hundred years ago. These gates brought on many new changes including the birth of heroes called “hunters” who could fight back the monsters that came out of the gates. However, because these hunters were specially chosen by transcendent beings called “sponsors,” the hunters began to call themselves “gods” and organized a new world order called “Eden.” Unfortunately, the people who were not chosen became slaves to the hunters and these self-proclaimed gods. Now, in the present, Junkyung Lee, a powerless ordinary person, is training hard so that he can get sponsored to be a hunter. However, in the middle of his training, he and his mentor, Sungkoo, suddenly get attacked by the ruler of Eden. Before Junkyung gets killed, Sungkoo manages to send Junkyung back a hundred years into the past with the task of changing the course of history and the fabric of society.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: How to Retire as the Disaster-Class Necromancer

description:
Enslaved by an archmage in another world for thirty years, Jihyeok is finally sent home to Earth with a pile of treasure. But when his riches disappear in transit, he’s left with nothing but his necromancy powers and a lazy attitude. Even worse, while he was away, Earth was invaded by monsters pouring out of gates. Posing as an Awakened, he summons armies of skeletons—not to hunt in the gates, but to start a business and earn his retirement funds with as little effort as possible!

(Source: Tapas)

Many people fantasize about switching partners and embarking on wild amorous adventures, but sometimes it’s easier said than done! Ju-yeong and Mina are in a somewhat “happy” relationship, but things are just bland… until a magic dice comes into play! The dice’s power changes the couple’s chemistry together and adds zest to their love life. Just one toss and a whole new Mina emerges! Maybe those fantasies can be fulfilled after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Cheong-Myeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheon-Ma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheong-Myeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheon-Ma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheong-Myeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After a brutal battle, magical girl Ruby is torn into two separate bodies. Can Ruby reunite with herself before darkness wins?

(Source: Toomics)

Rolicia Roba’s world is turned upside down when her mother tragically passes away. And not only does her long-lost father come to fetch her, but he turns out to be the renowned Count Roward. Thrust into noble society as an illegitimate child, Rolicia is determined to secure her own future without relying on her newfound father. But her cunning stepmother and selfish half-sister are standing stubbornly in her path… and so is Lockhart Caidel, the wartime savior of the second crown prince. With razor-sharp wit and a will of steel, Rolicia refuses to go down—or fall in love—without a fight!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seo-Woo Yoon, the secret daughter of a politician, hides a bold nature beneath her obedient facade. Eun-Hyuk Kim, heir to WM Group, tries to control her—but her quiet rebellion draws him in. Their clash deepens into love, and when she breaks free, they begin a strange yet sweet married life.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Girl That Got Stuck in the Wall

description:
Jieun is smart and witty, but she's got a penchant for running late. Luckily, she's got a few tricks up her sleeve, like a quick shortcut to help her get to work on time. Jisoo, on the other hand, is trying to find his first corporate job while nursing old wounds. Everyday's the same boring routine, to the library and back home where he lives alone. At least, until one day when he takes a wrong turn down an alley and discovers Jieun... stuck in a wall.

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: The Girl That Wet the Wall

description:
Life is good (if not a bit boring) for Jun-Gyu, who works as a part-time receptionist at a local youth center. One day, a young personal trainer joins the gym... only she’s the girl who took his virginity 6 years ago!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Graduate student Kim Jihoon's life is turned upside-down when the long-lost daughter he didn't know he had turns up on his doorstep. After he takes in his daughter Chaerin at her mother's request, Jihoon's life takes a surprising turn for the better. Things start going his way at school, and even his eyesight improves. Although parenting a precocious 7-year-old is a handful, Jihoon loves his little girl, and life is better than ever. It's almost as if there's some magical force at work...

(Source: Tapas)

Saet-Byeol, a sharp-tongued Omega hiding his secondary gender, has no intention of ever finding a mate. But everything changes when he discovers that his classmate Yul, an emotional Alpha with a fate complex, is his destined pair. The catch? Yul believes Saet-Byeol is a Beta and mistakes his feelings for simple friendship. Determined to ignore his growing attraction, Saet-Byeol keeps his distance. When Jae-Young, an openly dominant Omega, transfers into their class and immediately captures Yul’s attention, Saet-Byeol finds it harder and harder to keep his own heart frozen.

A cold-blooded secret, a one-sided fate, and a love triangle that defies logic. How long can they keep their true desires buried before everything starts to melt?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After surviving a car accident that left him in a months-long coma, Lee Soo-Han wakes up with no memory of his past. Standing by his side is a mysterious man who claims to be his husband—Jo Yeon-Seo. Although they’re supposedly married, the emotional distance between them feels insurmountable. Soo-Han grows wary of Yeon-Seo, yet he can’t help but be drawn to the man’s steadfast devotion. Just as Soo-Han begins to feel a connection, Yeon-Seo shatters his expectations with a shocking revelation: he’s ready to give Soo-Han a divorce—for his own good. The more his young husband pulls away, the more genuine Soo-Han’s feelings become. Determined to break through Yeon-Seo’s guarded heart, Soo-Han takes matters into his own hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Girl That Lingers in the Wall

description:
After losing all his savings in a rental scam, Sulki miraculously finds a brand new apartment at a price too good to be true. Little does he know the place is haunted by a ghost who's hell bent on sucking out his energy - whether it be by playing tricks on him with dirty dreams or possessing other people in his life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Nal Bogo Gayo: Byeog-e Sum-eun Yeoja
title.english: The Girl Hiding in the Wall

description:
Na Bomi is your typical office worker…with a secret. A chronic exhibitionist, she yearns to roam around naked, showing everyone what she has to offer. When a particularly risky escapade leads to an unfortunate accident, she undergoes an out-of-body experience. As a bodyless soul, she can parade around butt naked with no fear of getting caught! Is this her chance? Will she be able to indulge in her repressed desires?

(Source: Lezhin)

Taeseong, an actor past his prime known for playing gangster roles, accidentally switches places with a real-life gangster named Mun-gil. Taeseong’s life suddenly turns into a scriptless scene filled with dangerous thugs! One wrong move could mean the end for him. Will Taeseong be able to make it out alive in this world of real gangsters?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kim Gitae looks like your typical college student—aside from his killer looks and strangely eerie vibe. But there's one thing that sets him apart: he can see ghosts. Spirits swarm him day and night, desperate to possess his body, and the only way he can fend them off... is by jerking off every night. Yeah, it’s as exhausting as it sounds. All Gitae wants is a normal life—but things take a wild turn when a naked ghost named Lee Serin suddenly appears with an offer he can’t ignore. If he agrees to sleep with her, she’ll use her powers to protect him from other spirits. A ghostly hookup for a shot at peace—what could possibly go wrong? Gitae’s not-so-average college life just got a whole lot weirder.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Brave New World is a virtual reality MMORPG with the most expansive world in gaming history--one big enough that its users can earn a living in it. Looking to earn some cash, Tae-Sung Han pours his heart and soul into playing, even becoming master of a strong guild. All is well until a rival guild, Genesis, annihilates them and hunts Tae-Sung down. On the verge of getting caught, a mysterious old man rescues Tae-Sung and presents a new way forward...

(Source: Tapas)

"Gamemaster," a high school streamer, dedicated his life to beating the supposedly unbeatable game "Hero's Destiny." Finally succeeding after ten years, the realization that he's wasted his life is short-lived, as the game asks him to keep playing—only for him to wake up inside the game after he agrees, in the body of Callix Szcecin, the meek young son of a count. Together with Lyla, the maid and assassin hired by his stepmother who failed to kill him, Russel, the loyal knight, and Kraut, a young knight with much potential, Callix must survive the game again, in person.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

At 4, Groo is undoubtedly the youngest S-ranked awakened in the country. But as her kindergarten class's (self-proclaimed) ace, she can take a challenge! So when her first quest window tells her to find a grown-up who'll take her in, she marches down to the top guild in Korea and demands to be recruited. Sensing that this overpowered orphan shouldn't fall into the wrong hands, the guildmaster has no choice but to adopt her. But he has no idea this tiny girl is about to turn his life upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

The very last moment before the novel was about the end... The strongest villain met a pitiful fate. But that wasn't the end.

"So, this is how I die."

I, who was once the author, woke up as the fox-eyed villian who was never once understood. A fallen family. A life thrown away for revenge. A future sealed in tragedy. I'm going to rewrite it all. This villain's end... will be reversed.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Lokheun’s name means "happy morning," but her life takes a tragic turn when her mother is murdered and her father becomes a fugitive after exacting revenge. To save him, Lokheun devotes her life to Garyun, the dashing emperor who’s committed to right the wrongs of his father. Believing Lokheun to be a boy, Garyun is determined to mold her into an unsurpassed martial artist, even if it means sending her to hell. Their strained relationship turns into something more as Lokheun searches for the one thing she’s never had: a life befitting her name.

(Source: Tapas)

My husband is hot on my trail!

Eloise, a fugitive with a dark past, and Lord Johannes, the temple’s relentless hound, enter a marriage built on lies. With one year to live, Eloise must steal the Stone of Time from Johannes without revealing her identity. Can she survive this deadly game of deception?

(Source: Manta)

After being reborn for the umpteenth time, 7-month-old Lee Seojun finally gets the chance to fulfill his original dream of becoming a superstar actor! Using magic abilities from his past lives, baby Seojun captivates his playmates and becomes an overnight sensation with a viral mukbang video that helps fussy kids eat. Soon, he's shooting a baby food commercial, and his uncle's entertainment company is knocking at his door... but will Seojun be able to keep up the magic to match the demand?

(Source: Tapas)

Verden, a first-tier mage with a genius intellect but no innate magical talent, is condemned to life as a secret test subject after a devastating betrayal at the Magic Tower. Driven by a thirst for revenge and survival, he develops the "Theory of Celestial Reversal," unlocking limitless potential. But with the tower’s dark forces still looming and mysterious organizations entwining with his fate, will Verden’s quest for vengeance and self-discovery lead to triumph, or will he be shackled once more by inescapable limitations?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After easily beating the Abyss of the Maze on its highest difficulty, Kaleb faces a new challenge…surviving his favorite video game for real! Even as a powerful mage, Kaleb learns things won’t be as easy as foes pretend to be friends, allies need rescuing, and danger is always a turn away. Armed with an insider’s knowledge and a magic hourglass that allows him to plan devastating attacks, Kaleb must save his friends and prepare for a battle with the Maze Master if he ever wants to get home!

(Source: Tapas)

Nuri hasn’t changed much since she was in elementary school. She still has a temper, she still lives in the same house, and she’s still tragically short. Her childhood friend Homil, however, has changed a lot. Several years after he moved away, Homil returns as Nuri’s neighbor and high school classmate. Now, he’s not quite the same boy Nuri used to know. Sure, he’s still an idiot and a good friend, but something feels different, and Nuri is all too aware of it in a more-than-friendly way. She might not be growing any taller, but maybe some weird feelings about Homil are growing inside of her…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Shi-Hu Lee has logged 20,000 hours playing Let's Kill the Demon Lord! for the past 5 years. But when the game takes a turn he doesn't like, Shi-Hu cancels his pre-order of the DLC in anger, only to find himself sucked into the game! Now in the body of Julian Kreipart Prason, the villain, he has to play the part perfectly to survive the many enemies around him while unable to use the moonlight blade, Julian's signature ability. Under the watchful eye of Eileen, the genius gold mage, and his family members who want him gone, can Julian make it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Wuseong Dan, the man who ruled over the martial world with his fists alone. After unexpectedly losing a duel against two practitioners of the Demonic Way, he’s reborn into the body of the wild child heir apparent of the affluent Silver River Merchants. Not one to leave debts unpaid, be they to his benefit or detriment, Wuseong sets out on his path of revenge in the body of Jineon Lee. Using his knowledge of martial arts from his past life and the wealth of his current life, he only has one goal: get stronger and kill those who killed him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A thirst for revenge drags Raymond into a sinister game at his new boarding school, as he finds himself the mouse within a dorm of twisted cats who wish to devour and defile him in the worst ways imaginable.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ha-Neul and Mincheol have been childhood friends for all of their lives, but their relationship takes on a whole new dynamic when they undergo a series of unexpected events. Although they vowed that they'd never be romantically attracted to each other, they just might be proven wrong... especially when things start to escalate and neither can predict where they'll end up.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Born into a cursed noble family, Claude Ambrosia grows up to become the villain who destroys the empire in the novel “Flower of Darkness.” Enter Sarah Millen, the writer of this story, who is determined to change Claude’s tragic ending as his new nanny. Though cold to her at first, Claude slowly opens up to Sarah, who encourages the young boy to see his distant father, Duke Ethan Ambrosia. Can Sarah help this father and son heal? Or will the curse that haunts this family spell doom for them all?

(Source: Tapas)

For Paula, not a single day passed by without a reminder of her ugliness. But it was her hideous face that spared her from being sold to a brothel or dying tragically like her sisters. So when Paula's father sells her off to work at an esteemed nobleman's mansion, she realizes that peasant girls are a disposable resource. However, she finds the young Count Belunita tucked away in an annex, shamefully hidden from the curious eyes of the public. And as Paula struggles to appeal to her tyrannical master's whims, she must also embrace her role as his secret maid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo’s small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae’s first love surely can’t be Jeongseo himself, since he’s a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ha-Neul has a secret hobby: taking photos of his crush, Chan-Il. But when Hyeon-Un stumbles upon Ha-Neul's cloud storage with its impressive collection of Chan-Il's photos, things escalate pretty quickly. At first confident his secret is safe with Hyeon-Un, Ha-Neul continuously finds himself in compromising situations, making him question Hyeon-Un's true motives.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Following a momentous battle against giants for the fate of the world, Ronan emerges victorious as the last man standing of the imperial army. As he laments this hollow victory with his dying commander, Grand Marshal Adeshan, they quickly learn that the war is far from over and an overwhelming force of giants descends from the heavens. Fearing the worst, yet seeing hope in the courageous Ronan, Adeshan uses her last time slip to send him back to the past, so that he can enroll in the prestigious Phileon Academy and become the strongest swordsman the empire has ever seen!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Tang Mujin, a young physician hailing from the Tang Family Clinic of Sichuan, had a strange dream... one where he became the legendary blacksmith Ou Yezi and ascended to the heavens.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Return of the Disaster-Class Hero

description:
Humans call them “calamities”—the unknown, destructive creatures that suddenly appeared on earth. To challenge these calamities, the zodiac gods awakened 12 humans known as saints. But there was one more that awoke—unchosen but the greatest hero of all: Geon Lee. His allies betrayed him and left him for dead, but now, 20 years later, he’s more powerful than ever and ready to teach his fellow “saints” a lesson they’ll never forget.

(Source: Tapas)

How long is too long to spend in space? When astronaut Webber Jones returns to Earth after a 20 year mission, he brings with him an interesting problem. Due to spending the last two decades with nothing but an AI robot dog as company, he’s lost the ability to tell the difference between dogs and people. Of course, excitable psychiatrist Benjamin rogers isn’t expecting this case to be easy, but he encounters an unexpected problem in the fact that the handsome, mature Webber is exactly his type! The things is, it’s hard to treat a man who thinks of you as nothing more than his four-legged friend, and soon Benjamin realizes he may have bitten off more than he can chew…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads

description:
After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos?

(Source: Tapas)

Dr. Han Jinsoo always tried to live a righteous life, but in return, he got fired, swindled by a conman, and killed by his own professor. Luckily, a mysterious being offers him a second chance at life because of all the good deeds he had performed. The only problem is... he comes back to life as as Hua Tuo, the legendary Chinese physician, in the turbulent period of the Eastern Han Dynasty! Will he be able to survive in this era of wars and heroes as a surgeon without so much as a scalpel?

(Source: Tapas)

Neglected by her family, Kitt develops a silent affection for Edwin, a man she encounters in a library, yet she never reveals her feelings before he tragically dies. Haunted by this loss, Kitt miraculously awakens in a time prior to the fatal event. As she attempts to save Edwin, she finds out he has lost his will to live a long time ago, caught in a cycle of death and time reversals. Undeterred by Edwin's cold demeanor, Kitt persists in her efforts. Could she hold the key to his salvation?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

“This version allows you to take direct control of the team and train the players. Would you like to install it?”

A secret training session begins between the underdog professional women’s volleyball players and their junior staff.

(Source: DAYcomics)

The greatest martial artist on the continent and the supreme Martial Emperor who unified the martial world—Suhyeok. He had achieved everything, yet a lingering emptiness in his heart remained unfulfilled by his yearning for family... In the end, he crossed dimensions using the power of sorcery, but what lay before his eyes was...

"I was in a coma for five years in a hospital!? And what's with this system window floating in front of me!? Black Sage, you big-mouthed bastard! You said you'd send me back to my world! Why the hell is everything so messed up!?"

During the five years he lay unconscious, his family had been struggling to pay his hospital bills... "For my family's sake, I need to make money—fast and a lot of it." The strongest Martial God of the Hwan Continent, Suhyeok! Now Awakened, he begins his journey to level up.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

All Jeong wants is a second chance – for revenge! His grandfather’s gruesome death has transformed him into the bloodthirsty and ruthless Scythe Demon. He will stop at nothing until he has killed the man responsible. Yet rage and determination alone are not enough. He must train in martial arts if he ever wants to stand a chance against such a formidable foe. Will he succeed in his revenge on the murderer of his grandfather?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Reborn as the Overpowered Genius Lord

description:
When war-orphan-turned-warrior Agrick dies on the battlefield, his last regret is that he never got to fully develop his talents. The next moment, he's reborn... into a family of geniuses! Now, as Dane Sogress, he has to choose to be a spearman like his father, an assassin like his mother, or a summoner or mage like his sisters. But instead of picking, Dane decides to learn it all! Can Dane finally become the master of skills he was meant to be? Or will his take two at life end in failure again?

(Source: Tapas)
Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

This college's drama club puts on huge productions. And the audiences they draw rival Broadway. But I don't know if these guys are showing up for the plays. It might be for the big-titted goddesses putting them on...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Maeng-Ho is a college baseball player who lost his parents in an accident and is recovering from an injury. However, his life changes when he meets a ghost who used to be one of the most skilled MLB players of all time. Now, he is a god-like player ready to conquer all the girls and even the pro league!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Da-Woon's ordinary life is turned upside down when he is summoned into the Dungeon, where he must play a deadly game, outlasting dangerous monsters and life-threatening traps. To make matters worse, he's only a mere crafter with zero combat abilities. But after Da-Woon falls into a trap and survives after a glitched reset, he's gained random but oddly helpful skills. He'll need to get creative to clear the game and return home, with a bloodthirsty assistant and an adorable ground squirrel along for the ride. Now that the rules no longer apply to him, what possibilities await in the tunnels below?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Trapped in the gaming world of Elix, Sehyun’s once mode of solace is now his prison. Here, one must conquer empires or be conquered. What’s more, dying in-game means dying in real life. Stuck in a perilous reality, Sehyun must save his empire while facing the effects of his corrupt past. To do so, he must regain the trust of his Grand Duke, Ruhak. But since he has so much resentment toward Sehyun, the only way to appease Ruhak is to succumb to his needs, no matter how immoral or carnal they are.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Will Become the Villain's Poison Taster

description:
After dying in a car accident, an office worker finds herself reincarnated as Giselle Rozevin, a villain doomed to be poisoned while awaiting a death sentence. Although many assassins try to poison her, they all end up failing! In fact, the poisons Giselle ingests actually taste… good?! Can Giselle leverage this ability to survive her new surroundings?

(Source: Tapas)

In 2018, monsters swarmed Seoul, and heroic “players” saved the city. Fast forward a decade, Hyukjin Kim, stuck in a seven-year rut after failing to become a player himself, gets a do-over. Zapped back to 2018, Hyukjin seizes his chance to rewrite history. With knowledge from the future and his re-awakened player talents, Hyukjin battles beasts and conquers dungeons in a pulse-pounding quest for redemption and survival!

(Source: Tapas)

Heroes of Gauri, conquer this world!

The most glorious name in this land, Gauri. He who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor! Go Jin-Cheon, the last general of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo). At the moment of defeat, he and his elite unit, the "Mukapguima Squad," are cast into another world. It is an unfamiliar land inhabited by various races, including elves, orcs, dwarves, and wizards. If he cannot return, he has no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jin-Cheon raises his flag once again to conquer the continent.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Lady Rosentine Arzen was born with the ability to see ghosts, an offense punishable by death under imperial law, and something which threatens to ruin her family. So when Rosentine learns of a plot to poison the imperials, she goes undercover as a vagabond sorcerer to save Prince Charteris Kartazen, who promises to protect her family should she solve the mystery. But who would want to harm the prince? The palace teems with danger, but it’s Rosentine’s own secret that could prove fatal to her.

(Source: Tapas)

In a wasteland where the dead hunt the living, Jay Lee’s only light is Won. For seven years, they have wandered together, bound by a love that Won has carefully kept hidden. When a single night of intimacy finally breaks the tension, it feels like a new beginning. Instead, it is the beginning of the end. When a sudden crisis exposes Won’s true identity, it triggers a violent separation that neither saw coming. In a world defined by hunger, the most dangerous thing Jay ever did was lose his heart to a mystery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A state-of-the-art operating room with pristine surgical equipment? No can do; just a rusty bone saw in front of a jeering crowd for you! Sound like a waking nightmare? Well, that’s the best that the finest 19th century British medicine has to offer Taepyeong Kim, a young student from Joseon who retains the memory of his past life as a surgeon in modern-day Korea. For Taepyeong, London’s supposedly cutting-edge medical education is nothing but one barbaric display of malpractice after another, and he vows to drag the profession kicking and screaming into the modern age.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Shin Min-Cheol is the hero of Angeles, a world where he used his powerful mana to defeat an evil king. His arms full of gold, he returns to modern-day Korea to live the dream of being rich and unemployed. However, his peaceful days are shattered when gang activity hits a little too close to home. Before he knows it, Min-Cheol's powers are recognized, and he gets swept up in international intrigue that brings him face-to-face with some heavy hitters. Is Min-Cheol really as invincible as he thought?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

After waking up in the middle of the woods, on a rainy night, and in the body of a novel's villainess, Ophelia Lizen just wants one thing... a divorce! But she is married to Duke Sylvester Lizen, who genuinely seems fond of her and lets her do anything her heart desires — even if that's stalking the crown prince. Wanting to shed her wicked ways, Ophelia tries to turn over a new leaf, but how can she when Sylvester's one divorce condition is for her to seduce the crown prince who despises her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Reincarnation of the Hero Party's Grand Mage

description:
The warrior Lista heard the rumors about the great magician Rin, hailed as a genius for becoming the youngest 4-star mage. Lista recruited him to join her party to fight the forces of the void but, right before the final battle, Rin’s body succumbed to the void’s dark poison. As he drew his last breath, Rin cast an immortality spell, encasing his body in ice and promising Lista that he would return. Rin kept his promise and returned after 300 years--but reborn in the body of a noble boy.

(Source: Tapas)

Is infinite regression a blessing– or a curse? For Eunhyeon, it is a fate that he desperately wishes to escape. Seven beings fall into the world of cultivators. Each has rare talents, but Eunhyeon appears to have none and struggles to survive in this strange world. Yet after his death, he finds himself back at the start of it all, realizing that his talent is the ability of infinite regression. Here begins Eunhyeon’s relentless struggle to break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ju Seo-Cheon, a man who survives the age of war through sheer luck and becomes the elder of the Hwasan faction, only to live a life full of regrets and doubts. As he lies on his death bed, waiting for the inevitable, he is returned to the past...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Hyeong-Sik has one problem: The size of his dick. But he can't say no when he's offered a mysterious series of missions that promise to boost his size. With each challenge growing harder and hotter, will he be able to become a legend?!

"Take a peek at the landlord's wife's naked body."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

A world where everything has been lost. A boy and a girl alone together. A spark of hope kindled between them. All they can do is move forward. But against broken adults and devastating despair, how long will they be able to keep going...?

(Source: Yen Press)

After dropping out of high school, Daegun Kwon is working part-time at a convenience store while preparing to get his GED. After being harassed by a group of punks during work and teaching them a lesson, Daegun is approached by a woman from the Education Foundation about a project called “Designated Bully”. After being offered another chance at a normal life, Daegun accepts the offer and attends school to perform his one duty as the designated bully: To take down the other bullies, and restore order to the school.

(Source: WEBTOON)

“I’m considering sending you to join the female soldiers.”

Jae-Jun is a participant in the -Mixed Gender Operation Pilot Program-. He ends up transferring to a military base comprised entirely of female soldiers with himself as the sole male… Will he be able to complete his military service in a base where temptation lurks around every corner?!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

To most people, being called “cute” is a compliment…but to U-Ju, it’s just about the worst thing imaginable! Haunted by his adorability even in adulthood, U-Ju puts up a barrier pretending to be a badass so that he won’t have to hear the dreaded ‘C’ word any longer. But this facade can only last so long when Koh Han-Gyeol asks him to prove just bad he can be - in the bedroom!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I'm Not Your Fated Guide, But...

description:
With a 92% match rate, the highest in the Center’s history, Esper Gye Joon-Min and Guide Won Yoo-Gyul were supposed to be the perfect pair. Instead, they clash relentlessly from their very first meeting. For years, Yoo-Gyul struggled with his unrequited feelings for Joon-Min, believing the esper could never be his unless he forgot the guide he had imprinted on nine years ago. Yet, as time goes by, he begins to realize that perhaps hope is not lost. Will Yoo-Gyul and Joon-Min ever experience the kind of tender, heartfelt guiding that other pairs take for granted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Tired of the yoke of the Divine Justice Alliance, master assassin Cheon Ha-Jin attempts to flee, only to be confronted by martial artists of all allegiances, both orthodox and deviant. Succumbing to the wounds of his ferocious struggle for freedom, he awakens in the body of Seo Ryang, a prince of the notorious Heavenly Demon Cult who suffers from a disorder that prohibits him from the use of qi. In order to survive in his new life, Ha-Jin must contend with the many dangers and enemies that lurk within the cult.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Seong-Yun Han was just a boy when his parents were killed by monsters unleashed during a mysterious calamity called the “Dungeon Break.” Seven years later, Seong-Yun is devastated to find that his grinding efforts to become a Hunter – fierce warriors who seek out and destroy monsters – are entirely in vain, as his fighting attributes have not increased at all. Seong-Yun’s world flips on a dime when he accepts an invitation to join the Tower of Trials, an otherworldly realm where challengers must overcome trials that pit them against monsters and humans alike.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, completely against his will, Kim Namju finds himself hexed by a sparkly fairy named Seobi—and just like that, he becomes the unwilling mascot of a team of magical girls. Their mission? To defeat the Demons of Desire, monsters born from the collective lust of humanity, who are now plotting to take over Earth. So far, so weird—but then comes the kicker. To truly purify these lust-fueled demons, Namju has to help the magical girls and monsters fulfill their wildest desires. Yes, all of them. Cue awkward moans, questionable missions, and Namju screaming,

“This is NOT what I signed up for!”

Now stuck between sparkles and sin, Namju must somehow save the world, preserve his sanity, and—if possible—not die of embarrassment. Saving Earth has never been this extra.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Leverticia Celsiear, a wisecracking noblewoman-turned-knight is used to taking care of herself and her younger brother. But she never expected to add the eight-year-old duke, Caius Baltail, to her protection list--until the emperor arranged their marriage. Meanwhile, she’s also got an eye on her nemesis, rival knight Anthody Everett, is tracking down the truth about her parents’ death, struggling to get out of debt, and even gets stuck in a time-distorted dimension! Whew! Good luck Leverticia!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Demon King of the Royal Class

description:
Upon dying, the author of "The Demon King is Dead" is given two choices: go to hell or be reborn in his novel and survive till the end. The problem? He's reborn as Baalier Junior, a weak demon prince, after his realm was conquered! To make things worse, his attempt to escape somehow gets him enrolled as a student of the Royal Class in Gradias Temple, a prestigious human school. In the midst of plotlines and political schemes, can this author keep his identity a secret and reach a happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Excellent grades, good looks, above average fighting skills, and a sense of justice.
A first grade model student, Kim Hyunsung was pushed off a rooftop just before his graduation and became a vegetative patient. For ten years, he endured hellish days with only his hearing and consciousness intact, yet unable to die, he suddenly returns to the day when the bullying began.

(Source: Naver, translated)

You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jaerim, a.k.a. the “Executioner”, the most fearsome villain of all, is about to marry his civilian girlfriend! But before they can say “I do”, he has to survive life with her family, who just so happen to be the most powerful superhero clan. Can he keep his identity a secret and convince them that he’s the perfect son-in-law?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I-Yeon wanted a quiet life as an arborist—but hidden upstairs is a comatose killer who once tried to murder her. When he wakes with no memory, she panics… and lies: "I'm your wife."

Can she survive the man who doesn’t remember her—or what he did?

(Source: Manta)

After being killed by the obsessive male lead Killian, Ines finds herself back in the real world as Sum. Determined to live differently this time, Sum resolves to finally claim a happy ending. But to her shock, she meets Haewon Lee, a school celebrity who looks exactly like Killian. As Sum grows confused by Haewon’s kindness-- so unlike the arrogant and violent Killian she once knew-- Haewon hides his true intentions, carefully shaping himself into someone Sum would love. What awaits them in the future?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Tyrant of the Tower Defense Game

description:
"Protect the Empire" was considered unbeatable for over a decade until streamer extraordinaire "Mr. Gamer Geek" comes along and defeats the game on its hardest mode. But just when he's about to rest on his laurels, he's sucked into the world of the game by some mysterious figure and thrust into Prince Ash's body! Ash now realizes that every click and command he had mindlessly sent out had real, gruesome costs - including his teammates' lives that he sacrificed for the sake of victory. To make up for his previous actions, Ash promises to keep his whole team alive this time while using his wits and knowledge to survive the hellish onslaught of monsters. But who brought him to this world in the first place, and why? Ash may soon find the answers to these questions - if he can survive the bloody battlefield first!

(Source: Tappytoon)

In the Era of Adventure kickstarted by the spawning of Gates, marked by absolute hopelessness, destitute, desperation, and despair, everyone had given up their hope and lost their courage to continue fighting - except one adventurer that refused to go down until his last breath. "You are the only one left, Last Adventurer Elpam." As the history of adventurers was forced to come to an end, the Last Adventurer returned to where this story all began.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sung Ho’s not the kind you’d typically expect to settle down in the countryside. He’s in his late 20s, ex-military, and…a single father with a year-old baby his ex-girlfriend pawned off on him. Jobless and without any prospects but a house, Sung Ho hopes the peaceful Nuldongmae village will make a good new home for him and his daughter. Rumor has it that the head of the village, despite his young age, is a real jerk… But he won’t have to deal with that, will he? But on the very day he moves in, Sung Ho clashes with a tall, good-looking guy who’s got quite the temper and accuses Sung Ho of stealing from his store. This new guy really gets on his nerves, but he does seem to know a lot about the village… Sung Ho’s always been a bit of a lone ranger wherever he goes, so will he be able to let someone else in his life for sunny days up ahead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seventeen years ago, the world was saved from destruction by the Seven Heroes. But it came with the sacrifice of the strongest one among them, Seomun Yeop. Now that there is peace, beings like the Seven Heroes known as “espers” no longer have use for their supernatural powers. That’s where Battle Field comes in, an action VR game specifically created to allow espers to showcase their skills. Unfortunately, Korea hasn’t been doing so well in the recent tournaments, making it hard to believe that it was once home to the greatest esper in history. But just when all hope seems lost, Seomun Yeop miraculously returns! Will the legendary hero be able to save his people yet again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Forced to live as a high school student due to his stepfather’s gambling debt, Jeong Hui-Jae flees to a remote island to live with his grandmother so he can escape the pursuit of loan sharks. But just when he thinks he’s safe, Hui-Jae runs into trouble in the form of the local gangster squad: Bowlcut, Hatchet, and Cha Beom-Joon. But when Hui-Jae becomes Beom-Joon’s errand boy, the two find themselves stuck not only on the island, but in a complicated love affair that leaves them both stranded in love…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

“I’ll kill you… Demon God!”

Because of the demons, humanity was thrown into a battle they could not refuse. The people dragged into Helacion hunted monsters in a desperate struggle to survive. To escape and take revenge against the Demon God, they must endlessly grow and become even stronger!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Romance, flowers, and dates-- once upon a time, that was the perfect description of Hae-Su and Min-Cheol. Now, all Hae-Su has is the ashes of their marriage and a mountain of debt. But her world shatters completely when Min-Cheol cheats on her with a young coworker. Hurt and betrayed, Hae-Su finds herself drawn to Tae-Ha, a young man who seems desperate for her affection… and may be hiding more than he shows.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
