Do-Hoon Suk was leading a normal life after overcoming his traumatic past at high school. One day, he finds out his high school bully is his boss's daughter. It's finally time for revenge.

"First, I'll start by taming your mother my way."

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Cheong Shim (a.k.a Cheongi (Cheong-i)) threw herself into the sea of Indangsu! What will happen when she wakes up in a lazy dragon's dungeon? Meet many cute monsters while living a delicious, symbiotic life!

Among the numerous emblems to exist, only one is said to be cursed with the fate of ruin—the Emblem of Asura. After a man who serves an unseen will reduces Vahn’s life to ashes and casts him into a timeless abyss, Vahn endures 999 long years of torment before awakening the true power of ruin. Reborn as vengeance incarnate, his retribution begins.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The mighty Leon has long ruled over Dark Fall. But when he mysteriously loses his powers, his obedient followers turn into dangerous enemies. And it isn’t simple revenge that they’re after. Instead, they want him to bear a new king of Dark Fall in his womb, while becoming their plaything in the process. Soon, Leon’s budding libido is stimulated for this very purpose, and Dark Fall’s once-great ruler is brought to his knees.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Editor's Comment: This comic contains violent sexual content that some readers may find uncomfortable.

On her wedding day, Hana Gu realizes her relationship lacks love and flees the ceremony. During her escapade, she runs into her ex-boyfriend, Gawi Nam who helps her by using his mysterious ability to time travel into the past. Determined to erase her unwanted marriage, she uses this ability to try and change her fate, but the future proves less malleable than expected. Amid repeated failures, she finds solace in Gawi, who is also trapped in the past, facing similar struggles. As they fight fate together, old feelings from their first love resurface, making Hana question -- does she truly want to change her fate?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

After an unexpected family tragedy, a reclusive high school student is forced to leave his home -- only to face something much scarier: a reality where monsters are trying to wipe out humanity. Now he must fight alongside a handful of reluctant heroes to try and save the world before it’s too late.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Sung Moon High is fields one the country's top 5 high school baseball teams. On the field, players hit hard, run fast, and pull their weight to strive towards victory. Off the field, competition is fierce with students vying for position - and affection. Some might play for love of the game, others are just in it for love.

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: I Woke Up as the Villain

description:
Yu-Seong’s an ordinary office worker, reincarnated as a web novel’s foolish side character of the same name. Born into the wealthy Haesung Group conglomerate, hated by his family, and prone to violent tantrums, the character’s fated to be manipulated and killed. To escape his doom, the new Yu-Seong finds a way to become one of the Awakened, those gifted with supernatural powers. He’ll try to level up and climb the ranks, defeating monsters in different dimensions… and his enemies at the same time.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Han-Eul, self-proclaimed campus flirt, has big dreams of landing a relationship in college. But one day, he stumbles upon a grim-looking man in what seems to be a shady drug dealer—and bolts in terror. Fate, however, has other plans. Han-Eul runs into the supposed drug dealer, Choi Da-Jeong, once again in a club he only joined to follow his crush. But before he knows it, he ends up at his place! A fluffy, sweet whirlwind romance between the slightly airheaded Han-Eul and the unexpectedly charming Da-Jeong unfolds!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Regression of the Yong Clan Heir

description:
Hwalin Yong, once the shattered heir of a fallen martial sect, is thrust back in time-- but he isn’t alone. A monstrous darkness lingers at the edges of his mind, constantly whispering, waiting to claim him. Can Hwalin resist its pull, or will he surrender to the shadow? As the battle within intensifies, he uncovers a dormant power that could reshape his destiny and the fate of his sect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Is my cursed husband's fate up to me?

Madelyn's husband Ian was left broken after the war, and in turn, made her life a living hell. Fleeing her doomed marriage, she meets a tragic end. But when she opens her eyes, she finds herself at 17 again. The war has yet to start, and Madelyn can still change her fate. But what about Ian?

(Source: Manta)

In a world where people's memories are manipulated to prevent them from experiencing unhappiness, a young man lives as a "memory manipulator." One day, after growing accustomed to this fabricated reality, he discovers that innocent people are being sacrificed to maintain the system's law. Should he preserve this artificial peace or fight to save the innocent? He now begins his stand against the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Eight participants, 100 days, and a shared pot of money amounting to 44.8 billion won (around 38 million USD). This is Money Game, a reality TV show, where participants try to spend as little as possible to walk away with as much as they can. Marooned in a specially designed TV set with nothing but a set of clothes and a rule book, every item they purchase is 1,000 times the original price. How much money will the participants manage to keep?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Your Majesty, Please Spare Me This Time

description:
Following the emperor’s unjust massacre of her family and her own miserable death, Laliette Bellua wakes up to find that she is in the body of her 12-year-old self. She immediately sets her sights on a single goal: suck up to Emperor Rupert Edgar Laspe Vellelum and save her family. Laliette’s plan is foolproof, except for one tiny detail… In her present timeline, the future emperor is still masquerading as a princess named Rapertte! With only a single suitcase and some change in her pocket, she sets out for the capital to become the princess’s closest and most beloved attendant. Can Laliette prove her ability to keep a secret? And more importantly, will she be able to win the favor of the cruel and sadistic Rapertte?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

Lucas Sylvia. A college student. One morning, he wakes up in a room with three girls. What happened, and what should he do now?

(Source: Toomics)

An intricate story revolving around Han Bi Kwang, as he follows a hero's journey. Just throw in a historic setting, ancient weapons, and a riveting plotline, and you have one of the most highly-acclaimed manwha, a definite must-read.

Bi-Kwang and Hwa-Rin try in vain to shake off Sang Pil "Gold Cobra" Jin and his men, but, ultimately, they are forced to defend themselves. Unfortunately, Bi-Kwang and Hwa-Rin lose, and the Sword of the Flowers is taken from them.

Bi-Kwang and Hwa-Rin regroup, pursuing Sang Pil Jin in an effort to retrieve the sword, but then Sang Pil and his men learn that Bi-Kwang and Hwa-Rin aren't the only ones after them. Sang Pil's superior, Master Yoo, has learned that Sang Pil planned to keep the sword for himself, and has approached Shi-Yun, leader of the Black Serpents, for help.

The lives of Bi-Kwang, Hwa-Rin, Sang Pil Jin, and his men are all in danger, as Master Yoo and the Black Serpents join forces and search for the sword together.

Note: This manhwa was made into a MMORPG.

Actually, I didn't want to be a teacher. I gave up my dream and was about to take responsibility for the path I chose, when a cocky boy said, "Would you like to lend me a light?". My life as a teacher seems to be going awry as I get entangled with this cocky kid who has genius talent, overflowing wealth, and fame. A story about school life intertwined with dreams, talent, and love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After the fall of the Kingdom of Jarthewer, Princess Lisselotte and her maid, Hannah, escape to the Grand Duchy of Ralus, home of the princess’s fiancé, Vincent Ralus. Though Hannah has lost her memory after nearly drowning, she stays strong, enduring Lady Charlotte’s daily abuse in hopes of a better future. But everything changes when Vincent asks her to pose as Princess Lisselotte for the 10th-anniversary ceremony of the Jarthewer Republic. Returning means certain death both for her and the princess, but if they can pull off the deception, it may be their only chance at freedom. Stuck between the handsome but cold Vincent and his mischievous and buff guard, Diego, can Hannah succeed in her dangerous role?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I'm a zillionaire in a gacha game!
Obsessed with the clicker game Infinite Diamonds for over a year, Jae-Hee finally reaches the ultimate in-game achievement — only to suddenly find herself in the RPG gacha game Terrarium Adventure! Why was she pulled into the game, and how can she get out? For now, she has no choice but to explore!

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.english: Disaster is Always By My Side

description:
Everything seems perfect in Da-Mi Yun's life. Her career prospects look bright, and her childhood crush Ho-Won even moved back to Korea to confess to her. But her world turns upside down when an anonymous letter leads her to a mysterious house, where she ends up trapped for three hours… except in the outside world, a decade has passed and Da-Mi has been declared dead! Can Jae-Nan, the mysterious, surly god and owner of the home, help her navigate this chaos? Why does disaster strike wherever she goes? And why is this unhelpful god having prophetic dreams about them being together?!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Tae-Ho is in charge of Se-Jun, a newbie at the construction site. Tae-Ho warns him to be careful because the site is dangerous, and he's worried about the strangely over-eager Se-Jun. To top it off, he is troubled by Se-Jun, who keeps sniffing him and following him around. No way... is he fully aware and doing it on purpose...?

"Hyung... Are you in heat?"

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must learn to communicate and survive in this strange new world, and find a way to stop an apocalyptic comet set to destroy his new home.

(Source: WEBTOON)

All Cheol-Su ever wanted was a home, preferably one with a lovely little garden. But inflation is at an all-time high thanks to the zombie apocalypse, and Cheol-Su must now slash his way through 7,900 zombies to earn just enough for the house of his dreams. Will Cheol-Su rise from the slums and beat the zombie housing crisis?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

“Please help! I’ve been kidnapped by this man. Please call the police!” Just like any other night, Hye-Seong spends his time playing games with an online friend, Nana. But when Nana goes AFK and accidentally leaves his mic on, Hye-Seong hears the voice of a panicked girl crying for help, saying she’s been kidnapped. Once Nana gets back, he sounds suspicious of Hye-Seong, even asking questions that sound like he’s trying to gauge Hye-Seong's reaction. Despite Hye-Seong trying to act as natural as possible, Nana insists on meeting IRL…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: Warrior Grandpa and His Supreme Granddaughter

description:
A fallen clan, a lone survivor, and a warrior grandfather. Jinsan Yu, once a legendary martial artist, swears to the heavens he would survive until Seol, a child with an extraordinary gift, comes of age. Through fate’s hand, they encounter allies and enemies alike from the unlikeliest of places, and unearth deep conspiracies concerning the Yu Clan’s downfall. “I’ll protect you, Grandpa!” The supreme cry of his youngest granddaughter ignites a dying warrior’s spirit.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Disloyal Subject Saves The Country

description:
All the disloyal subject wanted was to take advantage of the kingdom’s fall to pocket the royal treasure. But instead… he took an arrow for the queen and ended up dead. He is awoken in an afterlife by an apostle of god who mistook him for a faithful subject and tells him his job is to restore the fallen kingdom by reliving the historical moments that shaped it. Will he manage to rebuild the kingdom to its most glorious day and go down in history as the true loyal subject or… will his greed get in the way?

(Source: Tapas)

Ianna and Arhad had much in common. They both only cared about themselves, and were madly obsessed with each other. The difference is one wanted the other's warmth, and the other wanted submission.

Though Ianna's life ended in a heated battle against Arhad, the Kingdom's emperor, she is reincarnated into the same life for reasons unknown.

Two people who faced misery in their previous life now have a chance to meet again. Will the same tragedy repeat itself, or can Ianna change the course of history?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Geu Gyeolhon, Ibeon Saengen Jega Halgeyo
title.english: I'll Take That Marriage This Time
title.native: 그 결혼, 이번 생엔 제가 할게요

description:
Adored by her noble family, Saina Devof had a perfect life until one night ruined her societal debut, her family’s honor, and her future in one fell swoop. Determined to fix her mistake, she chooses to marry the man from that night, only to find herself trapped in a nightmare that ended with her lonely death. Then, she woke up. 18 years old again with a second chance at life, Saina swears off marriage for good. But her plans change when he appears:

“I want to be your choice.”

Enter Duke Constantine—the man determined to rewrite her destiny.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Transmigrating into the main character of your favorite book sounds like a dream come true, but knowing Viola Vellatoux grows to be disappointed in her ending, Arin Han sets out to rewrite the story. However, her adoptive family will not hesitate to assassinate one another in their fight for control. The new Viola needs to use her wits to convince everyone that she has what it takes while remaining true to her goal. Further complicating her schemes, the male lead looks eerily familiar and has a strange effect on her when she gets too close.

(Source: Tapas)

Welcome to a world where artificial intelligence can drive your car, look after you when you’re ill, and solve all of your problems. But all of this convenience comes at a price. AI can pose a threat when it no longer has humanity’s best interests at heart. Can humans learn to coexist with AI?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

Gi-Ju is highly competent, but when it comes to love, she always seems to choose the wrong guy. This time, she thought things would be different. But again her faith is betrayed, and during a heated argument, she ends up falling down a flight of stairs. When she awakens in the hospital, she starts seeing suspicious ‘relationship reviews’ of others! ‘Love reviews written by their former exes…?’

Could this strange phenomenon be able to save Gi-Ju’s love life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

Can a princess's food save a kingdom?
Luana is reborn as an illegitimate princess inside a book. Resigned to her fate, she decides to spend her days cooking. Not long after, the cursed Duke Legion arrives and sacks the kingdom, but instead of falling for the princess, he's bewitched by Luana's food. He orders her to cook for him or die!

(Source: Manta)

Sol, a college student, returns home for the first time in three years, only to find her mother Mi-ae living with a young guy named Romi Oh. At first, she thinks he’s Mi-ae’s boyfriend, but it turns out they’re just housemates. Sol somehow ends up living with them, although she doesn’t like Romi at all. She believes he’s too brazen and carefree. However, in time, she finds herself inexplicably drawn to him…

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Kubera loses her entire village on her 16th birthday, her salvation comes in the form of the magician, Asha. Together they journey through a world of Gods and Suras, magicians and pure-bloods. Intent on solving the mystery behind her past, Kubera may also hold the key to changing the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In these times, if you're too good or bad at something or simply too beautiful, you're called a witch. But there also exist magical beings called witches, who have the power to travel through both time and different dimensions, and sometimes do in the pursuit of love with human beings.

Up against twists of fate and time, an outcast young boy and a mysterious witch, shunned because they're different from what's considered normal, one due to his imperfection and one due to her perfection, will need more than just magic spells and incantations...they'll need each other.

(Source: ABLAZE)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue, seven side story chapters, and four special chapters.

"Am I the only one still alive?" A boy wakes up to find himself in a building full of dead people, and Gangnam is shrouded in complete darkness. No cars, no electricity and no stars in the sky… Not only Gangnam but the entire city seems deserted.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

In a world of abilities known as fortunes, Seo Gang-Rim brings misfortune to those around him. Despite his low rank, people fear his power to steal fortunes from the dead. After his entire sect is annihilated by an assassin, Gang-Rim returns to the past, desperate to prevent its grisly end. He intends to make a difference this time but realizes that even fortunes aren't set in stone. Will Gang-Rim be able to save his comrades from their unjust deaths, or will he only bring doom to them all again?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Jae-Hee has a terrible history with dating in the office, so she intentionally remains single to focus on her work. But things get complicated when she starts having risqué dreams about her boss, Mr. Seo, and nothing she does can quell the intoxicating fantasies.

While trying to balance work and these impure thoughts, Jae-Hee happens upon a mysterious old woman that swears a cheap-looking bracelet will protect her from the incubus haunting her dreams. But if what she says is true, then is Mr. Seo really a lustful incubus? It would explain why Jae-Hee can’t control her physical urges around him. Are these symptoms a reflection of her inner desires or is she simply under her boss’s spell?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

One day, Kyung-min, whose self-esteem has hit rock bottom from being bullied by his friends, suddenly receives an invite to "DeathCord," a chatting room where you can kill people through voting. Anonymous death penalty vote in the chat room! Anonymous participants invited to the chat room are keen to kill people for their own reasons. However, one of the chat participants becomes the target of the death penalty, after that, the participants in the "DeathCord" chatroom start struggling to identify each other... A murder game that won't end unless they kill each other!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Eun-Seo Lee and Si-Hwa Kang have been friends all their lives. One day, Eun-Seo shatters their comfortable relationship by asking Si-Hwa out, and Si-Hwa moves away soon afterward. Eun-Seo tries her best to forget him until they meet in a college class six years later. He seems to know about her unrequited love for him, and to make matters worse, he moves in with her family after running away from his hostile home environment. Can Eun-Seo cope with his sudden reappearance in her life? And is it possible that Si-Hwa loves her back?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Every second counts when you're a first responder. But what if you could see a glimpse into the future? Hosu is a firefighter with the supernatural ability to do just that. There’s just one catch. It only works when he feels extreme stress under pressure. Will knowing what will happen ahead of time help Hosu extinguish fires before they completely destroy homes and lives? And will he learn to wield his ability when he needs it most?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I Will Take the Easy Way Out

description:
After the tragic fates of her first three lives, Serena is determined to cruise through her fourth one. But to Serena's dismay, she's been reincarnated as a villainess hated by everyone, including her husband! Serena just wants to get a divorce and quietly start fresh, but with a talking bunny doll begging her to save the world and her husband suddenly acting more caring, nothing seems to be going to plan. When life has her cornered, will Serena be able to take the easy way out?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Jugeun Geon Nande Yongsanimi Michyeo Beoryeotda
title.english: I'm the One Who Died, but the Hero Went Crazy
title.native: 죽은 건 난데 용사님이 미쳐 버렸다

description:
Happy to die for the sake of her friends, Aryn the sorcerer succumbs to the poisonous breath of the evil dragon Kuntern. 80 years later, through the divine powers of The World Tree and her former adventuring companion Zephyr, Aryn finds herself reborn. Upon her awakening, she learns that her childhood best friend, Elkinas Pontiac, went insane after her death. Once the leader of their expedition, El is now a tyrant ruler, raising a child hatched from Kuntern’s egg. Will Aryn be able to save him?

(Source: Tapas)

Sa-Rang Yu, a second-year in high school, has never really fit in. She isn’t exactly bullied, but her classmates keep singling her out, even pushing the dares from their humiliation games onto her. No one says it out loud, but everyone senses something seriously off about her as the games take on a darker, more unsettling edge. Will these games help Sa-rang finally find acceptance among her peers, or will the escalating dares reveal the twisted side everyone suspects is already there?

(Source: WEBTOON)

One finger in exchange for one hint -- this is the price to pay to solve the puzzle. Eight creators of an entertainment news app find themselves in a locked room after a drunken party to celebrate their success. They’re given a puzzle to solve by 7 AM the next morning, or else everyone dies. However, solving the puzzle isn’t easy. They’re desperately in need of hints, but at the cost of cutting off their fingers. Who is their mysterious assailant and can they escape in time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lim Tae-San, the second-in-command of the Waryong Association, clings to life after a traffic accident and possesses the body of Prosecutor Kang Ba-Run, who lies in a coma. Upon awakening, Tae-San discovers suspicious circumstances surrounding his own death. Using his connections and combat skills from his past life, along with his present intellect and wealth, he sets out to uncover the hidden conspiracy behind his death….

(Source: Naver, translated)

I was pushed around by others in my previous life. So this time, I will do whatever I want. When I see a pretty girl, I am going to fuck her. I will conquer every female I see!

(Source: DAYcomics)

The Holy Sword is the only weapon that can defeat the Demon King… and Knight John Forkinstrong lost it. From the desolate Forgotten Fortress to the eldritch hellscape of the Super-Huge Cursed Ravine That You Can Never Leave Once You Enter, John has searched high and low for decades, but to no avail. And the only thing that continues to fuel John's unwavering willpower... is the fact that it's literally embarassing that he lost his own forking sword.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Struggling streamer Do-Yeon Choi downloads a mysterious dating sim game, Heart-Racing Ghost Dating Sim, only to find himself trapped in a deadly loop-- where the love interests are real-life ghosts with unresolved deaths. From haunted highways to murder cases, Do-Yeon must navigate a world where romance, horror, and mystery collide. Every wrong move could cost him his life...again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: To My Rude Darling with Multiple Personalities

description:
Life has never been easy for Monica Orphen. She spent her childhood at an orphanage before becoming a war nurse. During the war, she met a soldier named Sol, whose face she never forgot. Years later, by a stroke of luck, she runs into Sol again...except he says his name is Louis? But then the next time she runs into him he’s Garcia, then after that… Enrique? Monica isn’t sure what’s going on, but she isn’t going to give up until she finds out who this man really is!

(Source: Tapas)

Two twin brothers. Two opposite lives. In a world where loyalties are tested, alliances crumble, and moral ambiguities plague every decision, an elite HID agent discards his identity, becoming his twin brother - the boss of a major syndicate in Seoul. Gear up and step into the boots of Agent Baek and explore the twists in his gripping tale of blood and vengeance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Noa has struggled with hearing unsettling voices since she was a child. But when a mysterious murder takes place, the voice in Noa’s head urges her to uncover the killer. With the police skeptical and her sanity on the line, Noa must navigate a web of fear and suspicion, guided by a ghost, to catch a ruthless killer before she herself becomes the serial killer. Will Noa uncover the murderer, or will her own mind betray her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Nae Dongsaeng Geondeulmyeon Neohuineun Da Jugeun Moksumida
title.english: Touch My Little Brother and You're Dead
title.native: 내 동생 건들면 너희는 다 죽은 목숨이다

description:
One day, I woke up as Rosalite, the older sister of Asterion in the novel, “Asterion of the Twilight.” I may not be the main character, but it’s not so bad. Rosalite’s little brother, though, is fated to die in the story at 20 and that just seems really unfair after all the drama he’s been through (did I mention his story is a BL?). Now that I’m Rosalite, I decide to save him. But no matter how hard I try, he just keeps dying and every time he dies, I turn back into 16-year-old Rosalite. Ten or so deaths later, I’m more determined than ever to save him. Rich, royal, or sexy foreigner: whoever touches my little brother will die!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Grace, a girl who lost her parents and even her family, has held only one thing in her heart for 13 years: revenge. And then there’s Ares, who lost everything to the same enemy. Seeking revenge, Grace proposes a fake relationship with him, and the two enter into a cold pact. However, the feelings that sprout in the flames of revenge gradually blossom into love, and she fears that these feelings will become an obstacle to her revenge. Caught between revenge and love, what choice will these two make as they race towards the end?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The world discovered the essence of the human soul, Ideia, and found a way to materialize it. The stronger one's Ideia, the more power one has. In a society where hierarchy is determined by this power, F-rank Park Jinsung has always been his school's punching bag. In reality, though, he is an S-rank with extreme bloodlust, which he has been hiding to keep others safe. With only two years left of high school, will Jinsung be able to hide his killer side and prove rank isn't everything?

(Source: Tapas)

Stigmata—bodily scars that appear on the same places where Christ was wounded. Rescued from his old village that underwent a terrible massacre of the residents, Sion suffers from memory loss. It seems Sion's troubles have come to an end now, with him living his days out peacefully as an apprentice priest. But things take another turn when he's accused wrongly of taking something from "the Holy King" Siennas Del Mayee, and dies a gruesome death...only to be reborn in the body of the king himself. Now Sion must navigate his way through living as royalty with only Pavel at his side, the very handsome but rather untrustworthy high priest...

(Source: Lezhin US)

While running for his life in the woods, bullying victim Gyu-Hwan stumbles upon a shotgun and just enough shells for his classmates. It’s a recipe for disaster. But fate takes an unexpected turn when he returns to find his classmates under attack by brain-eating creatures. Now, the only thing that stands in the way of their ravenous feast is a boy with a shotgun.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Flynn is an upbeat fox selling homemade beverages to make money. While he’s looked down upon as a petty vendor from a cunning species, Flynn is determined to live an honest life while searching for his long-lost brother. However, when he catches the eye of the wealthy dragon Hugo, Flynn finds himself forced to become a pawn in a game of political chess where his brother’s life is on the line. Now, Flynn must give up his honest life and trick Hugo into a sweet trap… But can he really outfox the skeptical dragon?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In Herera, neuro-tech is the norm and immortality is just a body swap away. As head of Herrera’s military, Finlay Eckstein has always had reason to watch the closed-off Prime Minister, Kiaran Bedoya, but not much reason to take an interest. That is, until Finlay comes across a rather…special video. It shows a Kiaran of decades earlier, standing in an S&M club with his eyes fixated on the scene before him. But it’s not the Prime Minister’s presence at a raunchy location that intrigues Finlay - no, it’s the look in Kiaran’s eyes. Lust. Desire. Jealousy. One thing is clear to Finlay, and it’s that the cold and aloof Prime Minister wants nothing more than to be turned into a pleasure slave and Finlay himself is more than happy to oblige. But with these two men both holding positions at the top of Herera’s political hierarchy, could their entanglement have consequences far bigger than mutual satisfaction?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"We teach sex- Self Defense".

Seong-Hyeon is a Master of a failing Hapkido studio. One day, he acquires a mysterious program. It says his studio will become a success if he completes the quests. However, the quest is... [Quest] Make a female member cum.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

title.english: Please Assist with This S-Class Mission

description:
After a decade stuck as an E-Class hunter, Hara is suddenly hit with an S-Class Awakening Quest: date the nation’s beloved news anchor, Seheon. There’s just one problem—he’s tied to an embarrassing event from her past she’d rather forget. Still, the promise of S-Class power is too tempting to ignore, so Hara proposes a contractual relationship to Seheon. What starts as a desperate deal for “Official S-Class Mission Assistance” quickly turns into a strange, unpredictable romance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Yul finds himself dropped into a BL novel, reincarnated as a stuffed toy that has ended up in the hands of an obsessive, tyrannical duke, he's sure he is done for. If the truth gets out, Yul will be burned at the stake! Can he find a way to get back to his real body or is he doomed to be stuck in this fantasy land?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

In a sleepy rural village, the local piano academy is a picture of peace...until the sun sets. Seonwu Jin is the academy’s exhausted instructor, living as the "wife" of the charismatic village head, Goh Hui-Jae. But the domestic bliss is a deadly front. Jin is an undercover cop on a high-stakes surveillance mission, and Hui-Jae is the ruthless mob boss who vanished after a bloody power struggle. By day, Jin plays the perfect partner; by night, he does power to ensure he isn't made. But as the organization closes in, the lines between his cover and the truth begin to bleed.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A bodybuilder gets transported back to the Joseon dynasty. Surely, he couldn't change history with weight lifting... or could he?

(Source: Toomics)

Feeling out of place in the countryside, high school dropout Nina Iseri moves to Tokyo. After a rough first day and getting locked out of her apartment, she meets her favorite guitarist, Momoka Kawaragi. The two put on a street performance together and decide to start a band with three other girls. While each girl faces her own struggles, their passion for music keeps their dreams alive.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

Seonghyeon Han is a victim of a violent crime that left him with impaired legs and a fear of the outside world. Now, he faces an even greater challenge: while he gained the power to create clones, he has just 24 hours before being sent to another dimension. As the countdown ticks down, Seonghyeon makes a desperate move -- he sends his clone through the interdimensional portal, and discovers his real body can remain safe at home. Thus begins the epic tale of Seonghyeon's... clones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seo Han-Jun and Cho Yu-Jae have been best friends since they were young. Han-Jun has secretly been in love with Yu-Jae for a long time but doesn't dare to confess his feelings since he knows they won't be reciprocated. As long as Yu-Jae stays his best friend, that is all that Han-Jun needs to be happy. But as the university entrance exams approach and Yu-Jae becomes more open about his feelings, Han-Jun begins to wonder if it would be okay to reach for that star he thought he could never have.

(Source: Tapas)

A legendary martial artist, after countless reincarnations, awakens in the body of Jin-Ho Seok, the neglected bastard of a powerful merchant family. Once downtrodden and suicidal, Jin-Ho transforms into an unstoppable force, stunning his family with unmatched martial arts skill. As his reputation soars, Jin-Ho’s newfound strength sets him on a path to reshape his destiny and claim his place in a world that once cast him aside.

(Source: Tapas)

Jun-Won, a perfect man, and Ju-I, a woman who knows her abilities and charms, strike an unusual deal: they will date with one strict condition—no falling in love. What starts as a simple arrangement soon becomes complicated as unexpected feelings begin to surface. Can they stick to their promise, or will emotions get the better of them? Dive into a world where love is both the goal and the enemy, and find out if their hearts will follow the rules or break free.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

Abducted from her mother at a young age and tortured for her incredible power, Evanna knew nothing but agony her whole life. That is until one day, she is rescued and returned to the father she never knew, the Duke of Vicente. But as Evanna’s very existence brings back painful memories for the Duke, he must learn how to love her, while Evanna must come to trust her father and heal her trauma. But with Evanna's power highly coveted, can these two overcome their thorny pasts for a rosier future?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Little Sister is the Demon Lord!

description:
After their parents' sudden passing, Gyeon-U finds himself in the role of caregiver to his younger sister, who harbors a startling secret—she's the Demon Lord with plans for world domination! Undeterred, Gyeon-U is committed to nurturing his sister with love and guidance. Join them in this unique tale as they navigate everyday life amid their extraordinary circumstances.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Psyche, an imprisoned royal, emerges after years in a tower to find his kingdom destroyed by rebellion and his family’s rule condemned as cruel and corrupt. Grieving his brother Michele, Psyche is seized by the Liberation Army that is led by Anteros, who proposes marriage to exploit an oracle and “destroy the kingdom” completely. Forced into this dangerous marriage, Psyche hides his hatred and plots revenge… But soon he discovers that perhaps his resentment is aimed towards the wrong man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Sharks don't have lungs, but they do have to breathe oxygen to survive. Instead of breathing air, though, sharks get oxygen from the water that surrounds them. So they have to move around, if they stop moving for a while, they sink into the water and die, So Sharks have to move and move constantly from birth to death. The same goes for you. If you want to survive, keep moving, then you will be the best hunter... like a shark.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Jeong-Min is a loner in high school being bullied by the Queen Bee, Ju-Hyeon. The two were friends in elementary school before their friendship ended because of Ju-Hyeon’s demand that Jeong-Min should only be friends with her. Ju-Hyeon uses this “betrayal” to fuel the classmates' insults and isolate Jeong-Min in misery. Jeong-Min has only one way to escape, through lucid dreams. One day, a mysterious man enters her dreams and offers to help her get revenge on Ju-Hyeon…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

Her favorite character's fate is in her hands.

A woman's dream comes true when she transmigrates into the body of Rachel Agnes, sister of Liz Agnes — her favorite story villain. Her mission? Ensure that Liz goes down a better path. Yet, things become more complicated than expected, especially when a notorious archduke is thrown into the mix...

(Source: Manta)

A man’s hobby is sleeping with female employees and making them quit one by one. He targets a new woman in the office for the same game, but when an unpredictable, insane girl starts messing with his plans, things spiral out of control.

(Source: Toomics)

To Hui-Won’s dismay, the BFF she crushed on and her other BFF are now dating! Seriously bummed, Hui-Won decides to go wild just one time, and find solace with a handsome stranger. A very satisfying one night affair has now turned into more — she’s pregnant! Fate brings them together again, and now the regimented Du-Jun is determined to do the right thing and marry her. But they’re basically strangers! Except... their bodies have been very intimately acquainted. What’s this mother-to-be to do?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

title.english: Hiding a Warehouse in the Apocalypse

description:
Imagine you are stuck inside a warehouse while the world is experiencing an apocalypse. That’s exactly what’s happening to Jeong-gyeom, except he suddenly awakens a very odd but powerful ability to store anything in a parallel dimension, giving him the tools to defeat the creatures wreaking havoc on the world. But as he ventures into the ravaged city of Seoul, he realizes there is more to this apocalypse than meets the eye as he encounters other survivors and mysterious monsters on his quest to find his family.

(Source: WEBTOON)

It seems my brother’s fiancée is having an affair with a coworker. Determined to stop the wedding within two months, Ian goes undercover, taking a job as the personal secretary to the CEO of the company where her future sister-in-law works.

"Do you think boundaries exist just to be crossed?"

Unfortunately for her, that CEO is Cha Jeonghan, a man as strikingly handsome as he is utterly unbearable. With his cutting remarks and infuriating composure, he makes it his personal mission to provoke Ian at every turn.

"Yes. Boundaries exist to be crossed."

With nothing to lose, not even her job, Ian decides to trample over Jeonghan’s carefully drawn lines whenever she pleases. And slowly, the once-arrogant man who never deigned to look down from his lofty pedestal begins to falter.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yeong-Do, a poor woodcutter living alone who longs for a family. And Imugi, who must kill its companion to become a dragon. Yeong-Do hears a rumor that if he throws an axe into a mountain pond, the mountain spirit will turn it into a golden one. He throws his axe to prepare for his wedding. But what emerged from the pond was Imugi, enraged beyond measure by the humans who kept hurling axes at it. Imugi, intent on killing the human before it, becomes drawn to the scent emanating from Yeong-Do and gradually fixates on him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

If the name “Tiny” brings to mind a diminutive rogue befitting the name, think again: Tiny is a headstrong, muscle-bound warrior who would rather smash his way through obstacles with his trusty warhammer than use his brain. When Tiny and the legendary Ten Knights of Asran are defeated by the Demon Beastlord Gluttony, he is given a second chance at life as he is magically sent back to the past. Relying on his knowledge of the future, the young Tiny must right the wrongs of the past and prepare for the upcoming battle!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The descendant of a once great wizarding family, Elric Mervinger is unable to perform magic due to a rare medical condition. While attempting to cure his disease, he stumbles upon the demon Mephistopheles, who tries to possess Elric to free himself from a dragon’s trap. But when Elric ends up absorbing Mephisto instead, the two become bound together. With Mephisto by his side, will this new power allow Elric to restore his family to its former glory? Or will he just end up being devoured?

(Source: Tapas)

Director Gu, leader of Sales team 3 at Yeong-rong Corporation, is very adamant about keeping his personal life and his private life separate. At the office, he’s a notoriously no-nonsense boss who can’t stand sloppy work, especially from employees who got into the company using personal connections. When he’s off the clock, he becomes Yeong-Jo; the college aged, regular customer at S&M lounge bar who loves being degraded and abused in the bedroom. On a night out, he hooks up with an alluring, extremely wealthy party boy who turns out to have sadistic sexual tendencies. After thoroughly enjoying a night filled with pain and pleasure, he returns to work the next day to find a nightmare situation awaiting him. Who knew the sales team 3 latest recruit would be the company CEO’s son. And to make matters worse, he’s the same man from the night before who had Yeong-Jo crying out and moaning the word “hyung…”

(Source: Lezhin US)

People live their lives hiding their personal desires and circumstances in silence, but deep down, they all long to bloom one day.

"Let me strip away your skin, your sweat... your scent, and every breathy moan."

(Source: TOPTOON)

title.english: The Serpent in the Empress’s Chamber

description:
Despite devoting her body and soul to Emperor Laxus and helping him rise to power as an illegitimate son, Empress Lenisha loses her family and is cast out of the palace due to the Emperor’s paranoid suspicion that she might betray him. Now, Lenisha has only one goal: to bring him down. To do so, she chooses a new husband and ally in Kassius, a war hero brimming with fiery vitality. And so begins their tale of revenge… and perhaps love.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: A Very Naughty Girl

description:
Despite being a pretty and talented film student, Yeo-Woo is brutally rejected after flirting with her cocky underclassman, Jin-Yeong. As if that wasn't humiliating enough, Jin-Yeong accidentally sees Yeo-Woo's racy video of herself wearing a dog collar when they're exchanging files for a film project! What Yeo-Woo doesn't expect is for this to turn on Jin-Yeong's dominant side and spur a series of secret BDSM hookups between them. And Yeo-Woo soon finds out that there's more to their relationship than their heated master-dog dynamic...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Fangs That Pierce the Heart

description:
Born as the illegitimate second son of Loxollum’s king, Iblonde is sacrificed by his pagan mother to ensure that one day, he sits on the noblest seat in the kingdom. A few years later, Iblonde has started a new life as Abel, a serf of a baron’s domain. Aside from his tragic past, Abel harbors many secrets, including the fact that he is actually a girl. But the greatest secret of all is that Abel’s resurrected body is now occupied by Belial, the seventh king of hell, who has come to slowly plague the land...

(Source: Tappytoon)

After twelve years devoted to baseball and a failed confession to his first love, Kim Min-Seong drifts through life with nothing left to chase. Hoping for a fresh start, he sets out on a cross-country bike trip, only to be stopped by monsoon rain and an accident. Stranded, he reunites with Park Hyeon-Min, his former junior from the high school baseball team, and ends up staying at his place until the weather clears. Full of awkward proximity, lingering heat, and emotions that won’t stay buried. Even when summer ends, some feelings refuse to let go.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.romaji: Appa, Na I Gyeolhon An Hallaeyo!
title.english: Father, I Don't Want this Marriage
title.native: 아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!

description:
Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she’s about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father’s love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he’ll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father’s student.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Kim Do-Gi, the ace driver of the revenge agency "Rainbow Taxi," is brutally murdered by his family, colleagues, and lover due to the conspiracy of Park Ui-Cheol, the real owner of Rainbow Taxi. Left alone in the blaze, Do-Gi's only hope is revenge against Park Ui-Cheol... But Park Ui-Cheol has established a new company, "Rainbow T," and it's become even more powerful. Kim Do-Gi, far from seeking revenge, finds himself being hunted by Park Ui-Cheol's new taxi drivers. In a moment of peril, Do-Gi is saved by the mysterious taxi company "Doremi Taxi." He follows them to a call girl he once missed, a former colleague who had supported the Rainbow Taxi drivers. He learns that Doremi Taxi was actually a revenge agency founded by survivors who lost everything to Park Ui-Cheol. Kim Do-Gi resumes driving under a new company! A revenge even more intense than the original story begins!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: The Rogue Producer Survives as an Idol

description:
Seo Hoyoon, the genius producer of a popular idol survival show, is infamous for his sharp tongue and coldheartedness. Cursed by a trainee for it, he wakes up as a member of a flop idol group called "The Dawn." To avoid being stuck in this parallel world forever, Hoyoon must make his group top-tier... but with the competitive industry and challenging tasks, it won't be easy. With his wits, know-how, and a little help from those around him, will this producer-turned-idol make it big?

(Source: Tapas)

Su-a, a college freshman in Creative Writing, struggles to understand and express her emotions, leaving her isolated from those around her. When she meets Taeyang, a second-year Sports Coaching student who can sense emotions through touch, their unexpected connection sparks a journey of discovery. Paired for a class assignment that involves a "date," their bond deepens. This is a story about a man who feels too much and a woman who feels too little, and their journey toward emotional growth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

[Welcome to Murim Online, the world where the strongest reside.]

[Your device has malfunctioned, and logging out failed.]

[Would you like to attempt to disconnect once more?]

[Yes or No]

When he tried returning to virtual reality, the place he logged into was instead the “real Murim.” A once-in-an-era psychopath fell into the Murim due to the Grim Reaper’s mistake. Dong Bongsu's merciless fangs cast a shadow over Murim, which is rife with schemes and malice.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Duke's Obsession With His Wife

description:
Anriette may look like an average noble, but she's actually a human who's been transported into the world of her favorite novel, cursed by its author for writing fanfics critical of the original ending. And as Anriette, her fate is to be slain by the very male lead she wrote her fanfics about! Can she use her inside knowledge to craft the ending she always dreamed of for her favorite lead?

(Source: Tapas)

L.A.G, an unknown space where humans use abilities or skills through awakening, monsters appear on each floor and room, and missions are given accordingly.

The goal here is to reach the bottom. The protagonist repeats death and life countless times in the unknown space L.A.G. However, in this life, he has the ability to own unlimited passive skills and finally has a chance to escape there.

However, unlike what he has been through so far, he will not know an inch of the future as L.A.G continues to change. This is a desperate survival story in which no one can be trusted and continues to survive the hellish L.A.G, where there is no end in sight, and fights for escape from the bottom.

Another lifetime, another hard life—Letitia’s misery continues as her uncle sends her off to the “Monster Lord” to fulfill an old pledge. Imp attacks! The three witches! A hideous masked devil hunter husband! Terrifying is an understatement. But as she becomes the lady of Halstead, the rumors fall apart. Lord Erden is caring, he likes bunnies, and that *gasp* perfect face under the mask! How can he not know he’s HOT? Can she help protect the castle from devils and help Erden see his true self?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Duke's Family Is Not My Problem

description:
After being cast out as a child over suspicions of illegitimacy, Perrianne was adopted by the queen of the neighboring kingdom and has been her loyal spy ever since. She's very happy with her new life when she suddenly hears perplexing news: Duke Exer's long-lost daughter has finally returned... except that's supposed to be her! Tasked with unmasking the imposter posing as herself, she's determined to just get the job done and get out of there. But will her family let her go so easily this time?

(Source: Tapas)

Aaron Hunter’s got it all. Looks, talent, and he just won the award for best actor. He does have one issue though: trouble sleeping. The only thing that’ll get him to fall asleep is a certain song by a certain someone. And when they finally meet, this is Aaron’s chance to get him to write a new song. But will the mysterious singer accept this deal? And will past traumas become illuminated by their newfound relationship…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Becoming A Family With The Duke and His Dear Son

description:
After being transmigrated as Ibellia the Villainess, Soyoon strives to twist the plot in order to survive in her favorite web novel. Her plan is to break off the engagement with Duke Cassis Adelhardt and live a quiet life on her own. However, the Duke and his young son Lucius would not let her go so easily.

“Lady Ibellia... Will you be Lus’ mommy?”

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Between looming war, fighting nobles, and an overbearing father, Prince Yuri Briol has a lot on his shoulders. He's also carrying knowledge of his past life while trying to change the course of history. This cast of characters includes a famed assassin, a powerful mage, a loyal maid, and a lazy knight among the character-filled kingdom of Briol. Yuri may be the third-born prince, but he could also be the most important factor in his family and kingdom's survival.

(Source: Tapas)

Mysterious black towers have appeared all over the world. Inside them are monsters, danger, and the promise of power and fame. Only a select few are chosen to enter as players. Everyone calls it a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity, but 25-year-old Ju-Hyeok Bong calls it a death sentence. He is a timid, anxious self-proclaimed “wimp,” perfectly content with staying under the radar… That is, until he is named as a player. Will he risk everything by entering the tower, or keep running from the one chance that could change his life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once the finest instructor in the Blood Cult, Suryong Baek is killed, only to wake up in the body of someone who teaches martial arts at a small rural academy. His new body may be weak, but he knows how to fix it, and it’s not the first time that he’s found himself in a body that can’t access its inner power. Curing his body requires money, however, and Suryong decides that becoming the greatest instructor at a top academy is the best way to do it. Since he’ll be up against tough competition, Suryong will have to use everything he’s got to become a teaching superstar.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Byul, a popular alpha and a first-year high school student, once trained to be an idol but has since left that path to attend school like a regular kid. His world takes an unexpected turn with the sudden birth of a younger sibling, introducing new challenges to his daily routine. Byul's childhood friend, Siwoo, has secretly harbored feelings for him for years. However, both being alphas, Siwoo has kept his emotions hidden.

As the two navigate their growing closeness after a period of time apart, Byul faces adolescence head-on, grappling with friendships, family relationships, and his sense of identity. Along the way, he rediscovers his passion for music and begins to mature through these transformative experiences.

(Source: Lezhin)

Lee Ho-Jae had given up his life as a pro gamer, until one day he received a mysterious message:

“Congratulations! You’ve been invited to the Tutorial World.”

Intrigued, he enters the game and confidently chooses “hell” difficulty, but soon learns that he is trapped there. With a mere 0.01% survival rate, Ho-Jae must somehow overcome the game’s agonizing challenges to figure out the real reason he was invited. This tutorial may be tough, but its secrets are what’s truly hellacious.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The young Cheolwoo from Korea goes on a trip to the beautiful vacation spot, Tomorrow Island, only to lose his important belongings not long after he arrives. As an omega, Cheolwoo needs his inhibitors so he immediately starts a part-time job… Then his fateful meeting with Dylan happens, and he gets to experience what it’s like to be in the middle of a whirlwind of pheromones.

Steel Emperor Hyeonuk Lee, the last savior of humanity, has died. The place he returned to in order to change the future is... the military?!! Why here of all places?! Corporal Hyeonuk Lee's steel eating show begins as he rapidly grows to get revenge!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yong-Bi is a bounty hunter without fear or reproach. Especially without fear, actually. Despite his greed and his penchant for drinking (fortunately shared by his faithful horse) and women, Yong-Bi is still a charming young man. And when a boy carrying a medallion, source of much envy, finds himself under the protection of the adventurer, those who cross their path must prepare for the worst!

After a former art student wakes up as an art mage in the world of a novel, she realizes that she's now villainess no. 4, Shaye — and she's about to be sold at a slave auction! Luckily, Archduke Lacius de Schubeiden saves her, but for his own reasons. Lacius plans to generously pay Shaye to pose as his jealous wife so that his stalkers will stay away from him. And even though Shaye readily accepts his offer, it's anyone's guess as to whether or not they can pull off this fake marriage.

(Source: Tapas)

Only a swordmaster can slay another. Arhan believed the tales of Liam Karavan, the founding father of his house, were nothing more than legend, until a deadly swordmaster slaughtered everyone dear to him. In his darkest hour, Liam comes to him as a guiding spirit, revealing the true power of their bloodline--the power to devour blades and inherit the strength and memories held within. With each sword consumed, Arhan draws one step closer to vengeance. To avenge his loved ones and restore House Karavan to its former glory, he must survive the perilous path to becoming a swordmaster.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I Became a Ruined Character in a Dark Fantasy

description:
Ian Hope was once a normal gamer who downloaded the latest dark fantasy game, Aquilonia. The problem is he downloaded it illegally, which he believes is why he was transported into the game's world! Now, as his game character, he has to survive this cutthroat place full of corruption and betrayal. But that won't be easy since his character has already been ruined with skills that won't help him as the game progresses toward an apocalypse. Will he survive this dark fantasy? Or is all hope lost?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Night with My Mother and Sister

description:
In my mom's arms, in 3 years, I love the smell of her skin. While hugging me, though, she starts to see the man in me...

"I can give you everything, my son."

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: Do or Die: Work On Hold

description:
Ahn Si-Young has waited for years for the day he becomes old enough to ask out his crush, Seo Do-Hyun. That day finally comes when Si-Young starts interning at Do-Hyun’s company, albeit with a strange mission: “Have sex with your crush in the office, or you will die.” Even though this is Si-Young’s long-awaited chance at love, is this really the right way to go about it...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.

You’ve got the raw talent. Or you’re the underdog. But do you have the heart? Do you have what it takes? Let’s see what you’re made of. The real fight starts now!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 30 extra chapters.

Han Yisu’s proud of himself for winning over Kang Jihyung, the perfect partner. Not only is Jihyung incredibly rich and handsome, he’s also turned gay just for Yisu and Yisu alone. For Jihyung, Yisu’s willing to move in with Kang Jungman, Jihyung’s father and president of Cheonbong Corporations, and be the daughter-in-law that Jungman so seems to want. So just imagine his surprise when Jihyung suddenly brings home a woman and declares her his fiancee. And not just any woman, but Jungman’s mistress from his favorite bar. Enraged, Jungman chases his own son out of his home and vows to cut him off. Meanwhile Yisu, heartbroken and confused, wants to move out, but Jungman insists that Yisu needs to “take my son’s place.” Yisu’s always considered himself tough, but all this family drama is too much even for him… Just what is he to the house of Kang? Son-in-law, daughter-in-law, stepson, or maybe…all of the above?

(Source: Lezhin US)

An ordinary middle schooler, Lee Seong-Min, is summoned to a world called "Eria". He endures dozens of years with no skills or powers, and makes it through all kinds of hardships to survive, but dies miserably in the end.

However, before he dies, he gets sent back to the past after obtaining the ‘Stone of the Past Life’ by chance, and gains the opportunity to start his life anew.

Yet, he still lives a life without any talents; nothing. Although he can’t approach the powerful people around him due to the "wall" surrounding them, he moves forward step by step with firm determination, never giving up.

"No matter what, I’m going to live a better life than my previous one even if I have to struggle!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Unseon Kang’s master has been killed before his very eyes – and now he is the only one alive who knows the secrets that his master wrote about. Anyone he meets could be an enemy who will stop at nothing to gain those secrets. Now he must try to navigate a world in which he can trust nobody while trying to obtain martial arts skills that will help him grow stronger. Will he be able to keep his secrets out of enemy hands and avenge his master’s death?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kyuhyun accidentally comes out when he unintentionally sends a photo of himself kissing his (ex-)boyfriend to a group chat. Panicked, he thinks, "I'm screwed. Someone already saw it." Unable to sleep properly and filled with fear, he walks into the lecture hall, only to meet Kibum’s intense gaze. "Hey, what time does your class end today?" That simple question marks the beginning of more frequent encounters between them. As they spend more time together, Kyuhyun’s fear gradually turns into excitement, and the atmosphere between them starts shifting in an unexpected direction. "Go out with me. I'll become the person you love."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

"How much do I cost?"

Tim was an average office worker until the crypto he had stashed away skyrocketed in value. Soon he discovers that his coins can be used to purchase more than just objects!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: In the House of the Damned

description:
Albert Blake has lived with just one purpose: to avenge his father by killing the master of the cursed Valdez mansion. But when Albert infiltrates the mansion as a new servant, he begins to see through his father’s lies. Master Asha Valdez is nothing like the hideous monster his father portrayed him to be, but rather an immortal vampire whose beauty captivates Albert at first glance, just like it had for his father. As Albert soon finds out, he is far from the first Blake to come to Asha, as his blood has been drawn to the master for generations...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Surviving as the Dang Clan's Handmaiden

description:
An ordinary woman who once dreamed of the Martial World awakens as Dang Sohye, a lowly handmaiden serving the Sacheon Dang Clan, a house notorious for its poison techniques. She thinks she’s possessed a doomed extra, but this body is anything but ordinary. As the clan’s fearsome grand elder takes her in and a young swordsman from the Namgung clan notices her, she’s swept into a deadly power struggle. Can she master the Dang Clan’s techniques and survive the schemes closing in from within?

(Source: Tapas)

After the fall of his noble family, Damon drifts from place to place until he hears of an open position as a private tutor for a sheltered young heir named Eden. From their very first meeting, Eden blushes easily and wears his emotions openly, a lonely young master who seems far too easy to manipulate. Damon convinces himself that if he plays his cards right, he can settle here comfortably for the rest of his life. But life in the mansion takes a turn Damon never expected, and he begins to suspect that his arrival was part of a carefully laid trap.

As Eden longs for beauty and Damon clings to what never changes, the walls of the mansion close in, and the truth behind their bond slowly comes to light.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Reborn as the prince and princess of a fantastical land, Arienne Yuriana and her twin brother, Arhen, should have been living a life of luxury… But instead of beautiful palaces, magical adventures, and attentive servants, the twins are left by the emperor to live with their abusive mother in a rundown castle full of cruel maids. However, after a freak accident suddenly leaves them without a guardian, their father reappears, saying that now he wants them to live in the palace! Thrown into an unfamiliar world of royals, can the twins forgive their neglectful dad and make the most of their new life with him? Or will this world prove too dangerous for the two of them to survive?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yong-joon is all set to spend an uneventful summer vacation at his college friend Deok-hee’s place. So, he was not prepared for how hot Deok-hee’s mom, Mrs. Park, is. Blown away by her beauty, Yong-joon is increasingly drawn to her. He knows it’s wrong… but she is like a fine bottle of wine he wants to gulp down in a go. Fate works in Yong-joon’s favor when he finds himself escorting an injured Mrs. Park to the doctor’s office. Alone with Mrs. Park, the young, hot-blooded Yong-joon can no longer control himself and makes his move. But will Mrs. Park give in, or will he be rejected?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After spending his childhood in the countryside with his grandmother, Ji-Ho finally moves to the city to attend his dream university. Just one month into campus life, he accidentally walks back into a lecture hall to grab his forgotten wallet - only to stumble upon two men in the middle of a heated encounter. Hoping to slip away unnoticed, Ji-Ho is caught by one of them: the enigmatic upperclassman Yeong-Won. Ji-Ho tries to brush it off and return to normal, but Yeong-Won seems to have other plans…

Why won’t this guy leave him alone? And what exactly does he want from Ji-Ho?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ever since Helga Yutrit found out that she was switched at birth with her half-sister, she has tried her best to shake off the stigma of being a fake by building up her reputation as the perfect daughter of House Yutrit. Helga's efforts all go to waste, though, when her half-sister Hillianne is discovered alive. Now that the real daughter has returned to take her rightful place, Helga is plotting her revenge on the family that never appreciated her and the half-sister who is stealing her life.

(Source: Tapas)

When you have good brains and ever better looks, life can be pretty cushy. Jang Wooseong knows this all too well, and he soon finds himself leaving country life behind and heading to the big city for university. A family friend even offers to take him in, and before long he’s living in a house filled with smokin’ hotties! Between the temptations at home and the plethora of eye candy on campus, Wooseong is truly living his best life. But when you have the pick of the bunch, choosing just one almost seems unfair! You see, Wooseong is a ladies’ man through and through, and he’s not going to leave a pretty girl disappointed. After all, college is all about the experiences, right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Red Knight Seeks No Reward

description:
After dying at the hands of her backstabbing superior, money-grubbing Judith learned the hard way that bounty is never worth bloodshed. When she somehow finds herself alive and well, six years prior to her death, she decides to use her second chance at life to abandon her greed and become a genuine knight. She begins by accepting Captain Kaillou Lewalmeigh’s offer to join the honorable Order of Red Knights. Will Judith be able to redeem herself by overcoming the wrongdoings of her past?

(Source: Tapas)

Reincarnated as the heroine of a dark fantasy novel who meets a tragic end, Ibelin is determined to avoid her fate. After being forced into a marriage with the cold and indifferent Dyffrin, she resolves that, no matter what, she would divorce him in two years, taking a hefty alimony with her in the process. However, as she begins to put her plans to take control of her destiny into action, controlling one’s feelings proves harder than expected for both Ibelin and Dyffrin as their relationship takes an unexpected turn.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A hungry tree, a shapeshifting rat, and a forgotten boy... These are just three of the 100 curses that haunt Illeston Manor. House Illeston thinks they'll be plagued by their curses forever until Simone the necromancer shows up to break them. All she asks for in return is a lavish life and protection from anyone who might harm her. But with every ghoul she defeats, Simone realizes that the true dangers lie within the manor itself. Can Simone save House Illeston? Or will she die trying...?

(Source: Tapas)

I died a lonely virgin after being used by women all my life. But guess what? The God of Losers, the protector of virgins like myself, gave me another shot! Will I make it through this survival game where the only way to live is by hooking up with female friends?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Kim Hana is reincarnated as Wilhelmina, a fallen noblewoman whose fate takes a turn when she's married off to the wealthy House Layton. But there’s a catch—her husband is already dead, leaving her to become the Dowager Duchess. Younger than her new stepson and his wife, she must navigate the treacherous waters of high society and a daughter-in-law determined to make her life miserable. Will she find a way to remedy this family drama or be unfairly painted as the monster-in-law she’s not?

(Source: Tapas)

After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Ji-Yong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. As he confronts criminals who slip through the cracks of the legal system without proper punishment, Ji-Yong begins to question the rules of vigilante justice he once set for himself. While pursuing the scam’s ringleaders, the four vigilantes receive a threat from someone who knows their true identities and begin to sense the looming presence of a far greater evil.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Joon-Hyuk’s only happiness in life is good food. So when, one day, he loses all taste he begins to wonder just what he has to do to fix things. When his sleazy colleague, Yoon Ji-Hoon slides over one day and tells him he knows what’s going on, Joon-Hyuk finds himself following blindly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The world is destroyed by a demon invasion and Bigang Sa is forced to serve in the demon army for centuries. After a failed human uprising, Bigang transports himself back into his body, ten years before the arrival of the demons. Can he use his centuries of demon warrior training to create a new class of murim fighters powerful enough to ward off the coming invasion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Chi-Ho has been unlucky his whole life, but he was actually born with a rare, most auspicious destiny. It’s just that his mother, who is a shaman, decided to share his energies with seven girls in their neighborhood to help them overcome their cursed fates. But now that Chi-Ho has become an adult, it’s time for him to retrieve his energies. And the way to do that is… through touch?!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 epilogues.

[Begin intimacy - Analyzing sexual orientation...]

"Smartwatch" that can satisfy any woman in no time. This watch from a stranger flips Seung- gwan's life upside-down...!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.english: The Skeleton Soldier Failed to Defend the Dungeon

description:
Meet the Skeleton Soldier, a meager but fiercely loyal fighter who serves to protect its master, Lady Succubus. Its dream of a peaceful life with her is shattered when they're both brutally murdered by a group of warriors one day. But what would’ve been a pathetic end to an unremarkable soul sparks a new beginning: when the Skeleton Soldier opens its eyes again, it has traveled back 20 years in time! “I must warn Lady Succubus of all the things to come!” But with no special combat skills and a history of failure and defeat, how can it stop the horrible events from unfolding again? Follow the Skeleton Soldier as it faces the most challenging quest of all—rewriting the ending to its own story.

(Source: TappyToon)

What would you do if you came back home, only to see a girl living there? Cool... Now what the heck should I do?!

(Source: Toomics)

Ho Kim, an avid enjoyer of the RPG "Dragon Slayer Academy", is the single most powerful support in the game. After spending countless hours, he eventually manages to reach the major milestone of raising 1,000 heroes to S-rank and is presented with a hidden quest. Tempted by the possibility of raising his S-rank heroes to the more powerful EX-rank, he accepts the quest without a second thought, only to find himself trapped inside the game world...

(Source: WEBTOON)

After a disastrous office romance, Hyojun quits his job in a fit of rage and opens a café…only to find himself serving more dust than drinks. Business is dead, and desperation sets in; with no other option, he decides to sell the matching couple ring from his ex. The sale goes through quickly, but on the day of the meetup, something unexpected happens: the café is suddenly packed. It turns out the buyer is a stunningly handsome student, and word of his looks has drawn a crowd. Watching people fawn over the mystery heartthrob, Hyojun makes a snap decision that will change his life forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Pizza Delivery Man and the Gold Palace

description:
U-Won is a pizza delivery guy down on his luck, and Seo-An is wealthy man suffering from panic attacks and social phobia. You wouldn’t think these two would have any reason to get to know one another, but one small kindness leads to a series of encounters that bring the two men closer together than either of them anticipated. Maybe they can find the solutions to their problems together…or perhaps they don’t need solutions, but simply each other.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A young aspiring chef suddenly finds himself in a world of war, dragons, and magic. These two worlds couldn’t be further apart... or could they? Who says you can’t open a restaurant in a fantasy realm? I mean, what could possibly go wrong? A perfect series for fantasy, magic, and food lovers.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jung Hyunwoo is just an unlucky gamer barely making ends meet in the VR game "God Wars." He even ends up losing access to his game account due to a horrible accident and is forced to create a new character. In the process, he discovers that he has an ability that allows him to see hidden information in the game, which leads him to become a Grand Warlock. Now equipped with a mind-blowing skill and a legendary class, all that's left is for him to level up and go from zero to hero...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Villainess Is Too Busy Baking Bread!

description:
After overworking myself in my past life, I reincarnated as Rachel Leseltein, the villainess in a novel. I had no regrets, but I never got to chase my dream of opening a bakery. Unfortunately, every business the original Rachel touched crumbled, and she was ultimately destroyed by the story’s heroine. But this time, I’m changing my fate! My father and brother don’t support my idea, but I’ll whip up sweet recipes, knead my way to success, and maybe attract a handsome duke with a sweet tooth.

(Source: Tapas)

When Melody discovers she's a villainess in someone else's story, being a slave dealer's daughter only adds to her guilty conscience. After her mother kidnaps Loretta, Duke Baldwin's long-lost child, Melody tries to comfort the scared little girl and forms a sisterly bond with her. So when the duke finds them, he takes both of them home because now they're inseparable! As the rest of House Baldwin becomes enamored with Melody's warm heart, will she ever learn that she deserves to be loved too?

(Source: Tapas)

Kang Min-Hyuk suffers from a rare disorder that makes it impossible for him to stop eating. Despite strict diet and exercise, Min-Hyuk's weight is now life-threatening. As a last resort, his doctor recommends a unique treatment—Athenae, a VR game where one can eat as much as they want without consequence. Crispy fried chicken! Scrumptious samgyetang! Inside Athenae, all food tastes real, but earning it is no cakewalk. In order to live, Min-Hyuk must go on the ultimate fantasy gourmet adventure!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

An ordinary guy looking for a new place to live meets a mysterious ghost who used to be a legendary male escort. The ghost teaches him a special ability that reveals the status of all the girls, and the quest to become the king of the night begins.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Despite growing up together, these childhood friends have grown apart.

Seo Hae-Bom was seven years old when his parents died in an accident. With nowhere else to go, he moves in with the family of his childhood friend Jo Tae-Sung, who suddenly grows cold and distant, destroying their friendship. Now it’s their senior year of high school and, after years of barely speaking to each other, Hae-Bom and Tae-Sung are in the same class for the first time. Hae-Bom struggles to make friends and is plagued by bullying, but after the handsome and popular Tae-Sung fends off his most persistent bully, everything changes—they sit together at lunch and begin to act like friends again. Hae-Bom is unsure what to make of the shift, but this could be his last chance to mend their relationship.

(Source: Inklore, edited)

Note: After season two the series is rated R19.

300 years ago, the invincible warrior Hyeon-Oh Kim brought down the Tower of the End, preventing the world’s demise. Though he should have died the moment the Tower of the End collapsed, Hyeon-Oh is reborn 300 years later in the body of a 17-year-old boy named Ju-Hyeok Kim. Meanwhile, he discovers the existence of the Constellations, who were once his disciples 300 years ago but were born during the time when he did not exist in this world. Will he be able to find them again and train them?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Asta Chronicles, the cornerstone of MMORPGs, has surged into the stagnant gaming market like a blazing comet. On the day of the highly anticipated 'Mythic' difficulty raid update, the largest in recent memory, JJA (Sung Chahyun), the leader of the renowned guild 'Haste'—ranked first across all servers and boasting the most first clears—is thrilled. However, his excitement is dashed when he logs in to find that his partner healer is enlisting in the military that very day! Unable to tackle the new raid without his crucial partner, JJA posts a recruitment notice for new team members. Yet, is able to pass the most difficult requirement of them all: a one-on-one interview. After a day of meticulously managing his block list and flooding the chat with ♡♡s, a surprising newcomer appears—a perfect partner seemingly sent from the devs themselves! Can JJA nurture this adorable newbie, HealTeaser, into a raid-ready healer?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jung-Woo is a Tamer in the MMORPG Karel's Hymn. While selling off items after deciding to quit, he meets a newbie, "Charongrong," who swears loyalty even if "she" becomes popular. He thought it was just a brief, passing connection—but he shouldn't have taken those words lightly.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: Bought by the Demon King Before the Ending

description:
I betrayed the hero and the job welfare is much better in the demon king's army! Succubus maid, the demon king's daughter, furry, dragon... It's time to get busy!!!

(Source: DAYcomics)

The world is submerged, and sea monsters rule the earth. Will Bota and his family ever make it to safety and escape this aquatic hell? And who in the world is Kana?!

(Source: Toomics)

Notes:
- Includes six extra chapters.
- Originally published on Toomics where chapters 1-3 were subsequently combined to form chapters 1-2 on Naver.

As a new transfer in his second year of high school, Gu Do-Hun faces relentless bullying for no clear reason—but his eyes are set on only one person: his quiet classmate, Jeong Yu-Won. Yu-Won tries to keep his distance, but Do-Hun’s strange, unreadable pull draws him in until a sudden, devastating incident rips them apart. Years later, they reunite as team leader and subordinate.
