Yu-Won tries to keep things professional, but the past refuses to stay buried...and neither does Do-Hun’s gaze. Something about him feels familiar yet entirely different. Has he changed…or was he always like this?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Eui-Hyun is an omega at his limit. After living a life of troubles and owing an unpayable debt that isn’t even his, he’s ready to give up. Hoping to spare himself and his little brother a life of more pain, he opts to walk into the cold depths of the sea. With his escape in reach, it seems like everything will be over soon—until someone catches him. Yeo Tae-Ju, a sadistic alpha who seems to take pleasure in other’s pain, gives Eui-Hyun the choice to pay off his debt with his body but when the omega refuses, Tae-Ju proves he has no other choice.

Still desperate for escape, Eui-Hyun tries to plan his next attempt while doing restaurant work. But with a sorry paycheck that barely covers his interests and his little brother to care for, will Eui-Hyun have to sell his body after all just to survive? And, is it even worth surviving if this is what his life is meant to be?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

A blinding flash of light, and his village was gone. Lowe vows to reach the floating Island of the Gods, but first, he must venture into a world ruled by a ranking system and claw his way to the top. Trained by the world’s strongest knight, he embarks on a quest to become the top ranker, battling fearsome beasts and ruthless rivals to uncover the truth and save his loved ones.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once the greatest mage and Grand Magus of the White Tower, Oscar Sage dies in a war against The Demon Emperor—only to awaken twenty years later as the disgraced noble, Oscar Crusian. The once-mighty White Tower lies in ruins, and rival factions hold control over military and resources. With his mana circuits sealed and former allies now enemies, Oscar must rebuild the White Tower, seek vengeance, and reclaim his power before the Mage Council exiles him for good. Will magic rise again or will it be buried forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Demonic Frontline: The 13th Flying Dragon Company

description:
Once an embarrassment to his clan, Jin Seonu starts a new life after being sent to the frontlines, only to be killed years later by his very own brother! But what’s this? He wakes up only to find himself back where he was 10 years earlier? Armed with his knowledge of the future, he returns to the frontlines once again to prove himself for real this time!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Tim Owelly always showed an interest in the occult, though nothing he's ever reported on as an occult blogger has convinced him the supernatural actually exists. But when strange and paranormal reactions to the horror movie star Johnathan McStars begin bubbling up online, Tim's curiosity gets the better of him and sends him down a disastrous road towards the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

He thought he escaped his high school bullies once he entered college. That is, until he met someone from his past... What would you do to hide your past?

(Source: Toomics)

I was enjoying an ordinary life in college when a girl claiming to be a succubus just showed up and tried to fuck me. However, now she's telling me that I've taken her abilities, and now I have to get energy from women?!

"Your scent is driving me crazy... Hurry up and put it in"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Welcome to Wellenberg, Meuracevia at the turn of the 19th century. The fate of Serenity Hotel, an opulent hotel in the nation’s capital, hangs by a thread as its headstrong heiress Serena and her stern husband Eiser struggle to turn its fortune around. Their loveless marriage of convenience takes a twisted turn following Serena’s jealous attachment to her stoic and handsome servant, Frederick. At a time when happiness takes a back seat to one’s sense of duty, will Serena be able to protect her love and ensure the survival of her family and her business?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The legendary con artist in the pleasure city of Ardel, Sue Rolanne, is hired by an aloof duke to pull off the ultimate grift: deceive the king. To infiltrate high society, the pair stage a sham marriage and what began as a “contract couple” turns into a high-stakes, kingdom-wide con.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jun-Seok moves to the city to attend college, and what welcomed him were the breasts of her mother's friend. Living with Mi-Yeong, he finds it hard to control his urges whenever he's with the mature, sexy lady.

(Sourte: TOPTOON+, edited)

title.english: You Can Pay With Sperm Pay

description:
An ordinary college student Jin-Woo finds out that he can use a mysterious retro phone to pay for things with sexual acts, and they get naughtier as the transaction amount increases... How far will he be able to go with this amazing payment system?

"Sir, please put it in to make your payment."

(Source: DAYcomics)

Cheol-Su is a loser in life and a loser in-game... until he’s suddenly promoted to Goblin Summoner. He’s shocked when he discovers that his goblin summon is a hideous, max-level monster capable of obliterating any foe with a single attack! There’s just one catch, though--his new buddy can’t be unsummoned, and it draws way too much attention. Now stuck with an overpowered pet following him everywhere, he has to get crafty and channel his inner goblin to manipulate and claw his way to the top in pursuit of greatness and riches.

(Source: WEBTOON)

I used to be a ruthless warrior, hated by many and feared by all. My bloodthirsty rampage comes to a life-shattering halt during a fierce battle with a monk, and now I’ve been reincarnated as Junwoo Hwang, the eldest son of the revered Lord of Suzhou. My new dad wants me to become a great scholar but no amount of studying can take away my love of martial arts and my itch for danger. Will I get to be the powerful warrior I was born to be or will my studies change me from callous to noble?

(Source: Tapas)

When middle schooler So-Ri Lee stood up for her friend against their entire class, she never expected to become their new target—but that’s exactly what happens. So, when her friend decides to transfer schools, So-Ri decides to wipe the slate clean and does the same. Luckily, someone seems to be looking out for her this time, and on her first day, she finds a mysterious letter taped to the bottom of her desk inviting her on a scavenger hunt! So-Ri follows the trail of clues to try and uncover the identity of her benefactor, and as she explores all the curious and wonderful people and places around the school, begins to open her heart once more...

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

title.english: Surviving the Game as a Barbarian

description:
After spending nine years on Dungeon and Stone, the role-playing game that no player has ever beaten, Han-Su Lee finally reaches the dungeon of the final boss. As soon as he opens the gate, however, he suddenly sees a message that says his tutorial has been completed and finds himself in the body of Bjorn Yandel, a real barbarian within the game. An exciting adventure awaits him as he endeavors to abide by the laws of the fictional world!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

There are a few unusual things about Cafe Goyo. Number one, their coffee sucks. Number two, their customers never order off the menu. And number three, Yohan, the cafe manager, is deaf. So when Soohwa joins as a part-timer, though he is not expected to learn how to make good coffee, he is asked to expand his sign language vocabulary beyond the words, “higher,” “pay,” and “please.” But when Yohan offers to give him private lessons, Soohwa is reluctant. Not because he doesn’t want to study, but because he has a “hard” time around Yohan. Like, literally. He gets hard. Whenever he hears Yohan’s deep, sexy voice.

(Source: Lezhin)

The dark blade Gruhorn, constant companion to heroes throughout the ages. Knights, rebels, and slayers—all became legend wielding this sentient blade. But, centuries after being claimed by the first hero, Gruhorn winds up in the clutches of his descendant: a greedy, greasy, bratty lout of a first prince. Even worse: when the prince falls onto the blade, Gruhorn becomes him! But is this new body a prison, or a chance for the legendary blade to become a hero himself?

(Source: Tapas)

Jungwoo's perfect life ended when his wife's needs killed him. Reborn as Dohoon, a hot guy in his 20s, he can now choose to have what he didn't have in his old life, so, the things that made her lose interest in him. What will Jungwoo do as Dohoon, chasing women and fulfilling missions?

(Source: Toomics)

Heilo Lee is a vampire hunter who hasn't slept well since his family was killed in the middle of the night. Determined to discover the identity of the assailant, Heilo accepts an undercover mission in which he must kill Harace Rivera, president of the Rivera family business. But when Harace takes an interest in Heilo and makes him his secretary, he begins to fall for the man he’s supposed to kill. Will Heilo complete his mission, or will his feelings for Harace drive a stake through his plans?

(Source: Tapas)

From childhood friends to lovers! Se-I Yun and Jae-Ha Kim are model high school students who form an alliance to escape the prying eyes of their strict parents. They used to be childhood friends until something caused them to drift apart. Will this fake alliance be able to bring them back together?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

It was on a fateful day when ordinary guy, Lee Seon-Ung, found himself transported to a mysterious new world. Initially excited to make his fantasy adventure debut, his hopes are quickly dashed when he discovers he was granted no special powers or blessings. Although Seon-Ung is devastated by the news that he’ll have to navigate this no man’s land without any cheat codes, he soon realizes the term “no man’s land” means something more literal around these parts, and he has something special attached to him that no other inhabitant does...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Lee Jain has existed on Earth for 3.5 billion years, dying and being reborn as countless animal species. Now in his final life, he is reborn in South Korea as a human, his most hated species. Having inherited all the animal superpowers from his past lives, Jain is determined to survive and wipe out humanity. But when a sudden car accident erases his memory, Jain crosses paths with new beings that force the question: is humanity worth saving, or is it bound for extinction?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Women are just as driven by desire as men, but they suppress their instincts for different reasons. I specialize in breaking through such stubborn blockages.

“If you leave this hole as it is, you’ll be in big trouble.”

(Source: DAYcomics)

After the gods dropped her in the world of her favorite fantasy romance novel, Lithera was quick to realize that happily-ever-afters were never easy to get. Given another shot at happiness, she is now determined to avoid the mistakes of her previous life, starting by meeting the sweet and caring Grand Duke she spent years exchanging letters with… Another typical female lead, with another typical Duke, promised to Wed. Will this story go the typical path we all expect?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

After years of being holed up in his room, Cheol-Jin finally attends his first college outing, and by chance, he discovers a lewd secret hobby of his gorgeous classmate.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Yongjin is a struggling orphan–a blunt realist with no time or money to spare on superstitious nonsense. But on his 16th birthday, he finds his life taking a dramatic turn when his classmate Huisu, whom he had never interacted with before, suddenly asks to be his girlfriend. For the first time, Yongjin isn’t alone–but his new company isn’t exactly the kind he had always wished for, as he finds himself being chased by spirits instead! Though this wasn’t quite the sweet sixteen he had in mind, Yongjin must now navigate through a new world he never thought existed.

(Source: WEBTOON)

As Yuria takes her dying breath, she realizes she had just lived through the events of a novel she read in her past life. She laments that she didn't remember early enough to change her fate, so when she wakes up having returned one year in the past, Yuria vows she won't meet the same end again. This time, she will expose the female lead of the novel, her half-sister Lilica, for the true two-faced villainess she is! Will Yuria be able to outsmart Lilica? Or will she lose everything once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Hwayoon, one of the few players who entered the final dungeon, finds himself among the players who regressed back to the past with their memories intact.

[System Error!]

[Searching for Special Skill...]

[Special Skill search completed.]

[Please check the status window.]

[(Butterfly Effect Lv. 1) To the only one who did not regress, bonus points will be awarded for actions of yours that change the future.]

(Source: Webnovel)

Earth had been invaded by creatures from another dimension, and it has been a few years since peace was restored, thanks to the help of various supernatural humans that revealed themselves during this invasion. Gwangik Yu, our protagonist, was born between two supernatural parents. His father is an immortal while his mother is a transformer with exceptional physical abilities along with the power to transform into beasts. Neither parent, however, is aware of each spouse’s power and both want Gwangik to follow in their footsteps.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After his brutal death at the sword of a rival head merchant, Seoho Eun finds he’s been given a new opportunity when he reawakens in his younger body, decades earlier! Now armed with years of learned wisdom and first-hand knowledge of future events, the young master is determined to use this chance to right his wrongs, make better choices, and give himself, his guild, and especially his family, everything they deserve!

(Source: Tapas)

Chiu Kang, known online as Kang Chi, is one of the best players in DC. To him, the real world feels dull and inefficient, so he pours everything into mastering the game. Yet... even at the top, life feels hollow. That all changed one day on his way home from the internet café. After a sudden accident, he wakes up not as Chiu Kang—but as Kella Caldern, the Demon King’s son.

(Source: Tapas)

Princess Ariana de Secramise knows that becoming the first-ever empress of the Arbezela Empire will be no small task. That’s why she collects five beautiful “jewels” -- talented, handsome men from all across the lands -- to help her reach her goal. Can Ariana maneuver her way through court politics to become the empress, and can these jewels help her shine?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Min Joon thought studying abroad in Japan would mean the beginning his fabulous gay life. But instead, he’s scammed by his boyfriend, loses his passport and is basically screwed. What’s worse, a kid comes up to him calling him “Mama” and before he knows it, he’s being kidnapped by the yakuza. Then the hot yakuza boss makes him an offer he can’t refuse… so now it’s either be “Mama” to his little kid or to not live at all. What to do, what to do? And this yakuza boss is just too hot for his own good…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kasia Del Roman is a soldier crafted to become an assassin. She lost her human emotions long ago and lived her life as a simple tool, just to be thrown away in her final moments. She couldn’t even die a proper death as she opened her eyes to a battlefield of a different world. Will she live the same life she did in her original world?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

When someone is aesthetically pleasing, people usually say things like... "She looks absolutely divine," "He looks like a million bucks," and "They're glowing." Of course, it doesn't mean that they're literally glowing... But I know someone who is like that! That's right. My friend is so stunning that his face literally shines.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

He's the perfect man- except when it comes to a certain crucial aspect. One day, an unexpected significant enhancement changes everything.

(Source: Toomics)

“Death is only the beginning.”

Truer words were never spoken for young Leon von Marbas, the heir to a once-great house of necromancers. Forced to execute his own father by the lord of a rival house, Leon suddenly finds himself the leader of a declining clan under threat from enemies within and without. The only way to restore the glory of his house? Leon must strike a pact with the demon Marbas, the original source of the powerful necromancy that House Marbas was once known for…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Once hailed as the Murim Alliance leader, Hoo Gong suddenly awakens in the body of Beom Hang, the disgrace of the Cheonhwa Family. Broken in mind and body, Beom Hang had no future... But things are different now. With the power from his discarded life, he will teach the martial world that true strength never dies.

(Source: Tappytoon)

What if your worst enemy turned out to be your sister? Dark loner Hae-Ra and golden child Ri-On have always been arch rivals, competing to be the best in their arts high school. Of course, Ri-On always seems to win, with the support and privilege provided by her wildly wealthy, world-famous sculptor mother. Then again, Ri-On has dark secrets of her own, and there’s just something about Hae-Ra -- her authenticity and vision. Will Hae-Ra and Ri-On ever make peace? After all, there can only be one when it comes to the real deal.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

Despite the war raging between the North and South, Margaret is a northerner who holds an unwavering love for her southern lover, Squall... until he cruelly betrays her and pushes her off a seaside cliff. Just when she's about to drown, the voice of a mysterious witch offers her a second chance at life. However, this chance only comes to her seven years later, when she rises from the ocean in a new body without a voice. Although Margaret receives help from a local apothecary named Jack, the other southern villagers aren't as eager to let an outsider into their fold...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 epilogue chapters.

When Han Ina wakes up as game villainess Tulia Frasier, with absolutely trash stats and a garbage personality, a status window tells her she must reach Rank A or die. Determined to succeed, she starts making strategic moves, striving to gain the recognition of her grandfather, the grand duke, and earn the affection of the male leads in order to rank up and ensure her survival. But with members of her own family plotting to take her out, can Tulia clean up her act before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Devoured: The Serpent and the Pomegranate

description:
In the blessed land of Trastasa, Na-in is the cherished companion of Amon, the great and omnipotent god. Though Amon treats him with apparent tenderness, his cruel and indifferent ways haunt Na-in's every moment. When a striking servant with rare pink features called Rhan Gwen arrives, Na-in expects to lose Amon's attention. Instead, he discovers something unsettling… Rhan Gwen shows no interest in Amon, only in Na-in himself. As this mysterious yet beautiful man offers the gentle understanding Na-in has always craved, he faces an impossible choice between familiar darkness and uncertain warmth.

(Source: Tappytoon)

“You can’t run away. I’m going to eat you up from now on.”

That night when I witnessed my sister and my boyfriend’s inappropriate relationship, it was just an impulsive one-night stand I chose to soothe my troubled heart…

“I’m Managing Director Kang In-Ha.”

We’re going to meet again as the boss I have to serve from now on. But this man… Doesn’t he remember me? He seems to be used to one-night stands, so I try to control my emotions as he acts calm, but his eyes, his lips, his gestures keep bringing back memories of that day.

“I wondered why she provokes me every time I see her, but it turns out she’s already a woman I’ve fallen for.”

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

As the poor, illegitimate son of the king, the only way for Raymond to have a decent life is to become a healer. However, his healing ability is abysmal, and it looks like he's doomed to a life of hardship. Until one day, Raymond finds himself receiving information about something called "medical science," which can cure things that healing can't! With this revolutionary knowledge in hand, can Raymond overcome the prejudice against him and his methods in order to achieve his dreams of fame?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Mangnae Gongnyeoui Chongaereul Dokchajihaetdeoni, Modu Naege Jipchakanda
title.english: Diana's Dearest Is the Family's Favorite
title.native: 막내 공녀의 총애를 독차지했더니, 모두 내게 집착한다

description:
After traveling back in time, Lia finds herself in the orphanage where she spent her childhood just before Diana, the lost daughter of Duke Ellad, arrives. Remembering with regret how she once ignored Diana's mistreatment in the orphanage, she vows to protect her until her family finds her. The two grow close, and she sees her life unfolding in an unexpected way as she is welcomed into House Ellad with Diana. Will Lia find happiness in her second life, surrounded by love she's never known?

(Source: Tapas)

How would you win over an enemy who just won't stop killing you? Laila thought she had escaped death by figuring out how to turn back time, but her assassin finds her again... and again... and again! All because her sadistic villain of a father had to murder his entire family... When all her evasion plans fail, there's only one option left: coddle her enemy through his childhood and hope he'll spare her when he comes back to exact his revenge. But why is this wacko so pigheaded?!

(Source: Tapas)

“Would you really let them have their way with you?”

The sweet scent and gentle touch of my first love, the one who once comforted me… And now, that very person is standing here, wearing nothing underneath her shirt?

(Source: DAYcomics)

By day Bo-Ram Eom is a secretary, but by night she’s secretly a children’s storybook author under the pen name Bo-Ram. Too talented to be just an office worker, she created The Child with A Mask to escape her terrible boss, Se-Hu Kwon. Sure, he’s attractive, intelligent, but he’s also super rude! And now, he wants to find the creator of the book. How long can she keep her identity secret? And why does her boss want to meet her…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

After his wife leaves, a man moves in with his mother-in-law and sister-in-laws, where tensions start to rise.

(Source: Toomics)

Seong-Un Choi is the top-ranked player in the game "Lost World," being the only player to have completed all its achievements. However, his triumph is short-lived as a mysterious message transports him to the real "Lost World," transforming him from a mere gamer to a contender for godhood. Amidst others vying for divinity, will Seong-Un be able to achieve true godhood and reign supreme in this new realm?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Taeryang wakes up in a world where men are treated as commodities. Could the power of his "thrust" be enough to save him?

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: I Failed to Oust the Villain!

description:
Reborn as the daughter of a count she read about in a novel, Lady Valeta knows the story ends in tragedy at the hands of her lowly house pet, Reinhart. Having never wanted him in the first place, Valeta tries but fails to oust him from her house. But when Reinhart’s powerful magic is awakened one day, he kills all those around her, and it is now Valeta who is at his mercy. Though the tables have turned, Reinhart can't shake his attachment for Valeta. He lets her live, but only within his grasp.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes:
- The side stories are rated R19.
- Includes 41 extra chapters.

title.english: A Tipsy Marriage Proposal for the Emperor

description:
Whether it's beauty, status, or a Ph.D, Elliere has it all. But one thing she doesn't have is luck with men, which she discovers when her prideful fiance dumps her for "being a know-it-all." Enraged, Elliere storms to the bar and drunkenly rants about her troubles to a mysterious stranger, whose good looks inspire her to ask for his hand in marriage. Unfortunately for her, the man is none other than the cold-blooded Emperor Ropherce, who actually accepts her proposal! Poor Elliere has a feeling she'll need more than liquid courage to survive as the tyrant's unlucky new empress...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Dahye and Dawoon are siblings that live together with their parents. Their relationship is a bit rocky since Dawoon has always been their parents’ favorite and Dahye holds some resentment towards him. Dawoon, who is a high school dropout, is always in his room playing games. Dahye starts noticing that he’s acting weird, and after finding a disturbing story in her brother’s computer, she starts fearing him and what he might be capable of doing. So she enlists the help of her aunt and best friend to try and find out what is wrong with Dawoon.

(Source: Lezhin)

Zhu Yunwen, who barely survived the Jingnan campaign received the souls of two of the world's strongest martial artists. The First Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Cult and Huineng, the Sixth Patriarch of the Shaolin Temple in his body and was reborn as a Pacheon.

This is where the story of the Heaven Destroyer's journey toward absolute supremacy begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Han Garam’s roomate is rude, inconsiderate, and…okay, totally his type. But after overhearing him talking about how much he hates gay people, Garam knows he needs to seek revenge, and what better way than by getting off to gay porn in the other man’s bed! It would have been the perfect plan, if only he hadn’t been caught in the act by the raging homophobe himself, Yoon Jaehyuk. Jaehyuk is disgusted by what he sees but, with the RA refusing to let him switch, he has no choice but to try and force Garam to move out himself. An achievable goal, it seems, until one unexpected night of passion throws Jaehyuk’s world into disarray. Sure, he definitely still wants Garam to leave, but…why can’t he stop thinking about it?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Step into a world where no fantasy is off limit, and no desire too delusional... Follow stories of guys getting exactly what they want, however they want it, whoever they want it with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Once a rising martial arts master, Ja-Gak Yang is known as the Ten Strike Finisher due to his ability to defeat any opponent within ten moves. Ja-Gak is also the son of the leader of the Great Martial Alliance, an organization of virtuous martial arts sects. His future leadership over the martial arts world seems all but assured -- that is, until he is assassinated by jealous rivals! Ja-Gak is reincarnated into the body of Cheon-So Ma, the playboy second-in-command of the evil Shining Light Cult. Can Ja-Gak remain true to his principles despite his new life on the dark side?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

No one was prepared when the massive towers known as dungeons appeared, crawling with monsters and threatening calamity for the entire world. After she receives extraordinary culinary powers, the quiet and humble Ji-Eun is compelled to join some of the most skilled monster hunters in the world, seeing things and going places she never dreamt of before! Now, she’s making friends, having exciting adventures, and cooking up some of the tastiest dishes the dungeon has to offer!

(Source: Tapas)

When the manger brought in a dusty-looking board game, no one knew that... this is one game you can't escape.

(Source: Toomics)

In a world where names mysteriously appear on skin, pianist Do-Hwa "Eden" Ye-On finds Tristan Locke's name etched on his body. But after tracking the reclusive nobleman to a forest manor, Eden learns his name isn’t on Tristan. As his life ebbs without Tristan's touch, Eden clings to a man who stubbornly rejects him.

(Source: Manta)

Suffering from a thirst that can't be quenched with a one-off encounters, I'm still hooked on these dirty confessions.

(Source: TOPTOON)

When junior knight Roselyn is rescued from the bottom of a cliff after an ambush by an enemy kingdom, her brother Calix is relieved – that is, until he learns that she's lost her memory. Now, she behaves like a child, eats like a horse, and wields unbelievable strength. But something's not quite right...

(Source: Manta)

After years in the criminal underworld, Dao Tongda faces death with nothing to show for his life except a handful of coins. But the heavens grant him an impossible miracle when he wakes up in the body of his 18-year-old self. Reuniting with old friends at the Guanghua Road Fixer Agency, he sets out to claim the power and wealth that once escaped him. But in a world ruled by blood and betrayal, can Tongda rewrite his fate and claim the throne of the night? Or is history doomed to repeat itself?

(Source: Tapas)

Branded a heartless and cruel sovereign, Emperor Herace of the Tevente Empire has lost three empresses to betrayal and murder. Into his life steps Eleanor Snow, the fearless daughter of House Snow, offering herself as his new empress to protect her family from ruin. In a world of assassins, treachery, and political unrest, their alliance is forged out of necessity but eventually tempered by trust. Together, they will fight to defend the empire… and each other.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After 30 years in the other world and defeating the demon lord, Cheolho Kang finally returns to Earth-- only to find it overrun with monsters and hunters. Tired of endless battles, he opens a small restaurant and wishes to live in peace. With dishes to make and a baby dragon to raise, a heartwarming tale where every visitor brings a story is set to begin.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyunmoo Kang is a miner scraping by in a world where those with the right talent can make millions as hunters in dungeons. One day, he inherits a mysterious hearthstone that magically transports him to a place called Hell, where he quickly dies—only to regenerate. In Hell, he hones his skills, builds talent, and hoards items that pay handsomely in his world. As Hyunmoo spends more time in Hell, he starts to wonder how this place came to be and most of all... how it connects to his own world.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue.

Donghyuk's been missing his late wife terribly ever since she passed. But someone who looks just like her seems willing to take her place.

(Source: Toomics)

Appointed as a saint merely to secure political power for the crown prince, Ariel Celestin knows certain death awaits her if she’s ever found out to be a fraud. Desperate to avoid this fate, she comes up with a plan: secretly flee the temple with the help of the gods who dote on her! But when her actions accidentally draw the attention of the crown prince, the pope, and a powerful merchant, Ariel soon discovers that asking the gods to help might not be a big enough miracle to save herself...

(Source: Tapas)

“Paradise Villa” is located in a residential area near Guro Digital Complex Station, where many office workers commute. From the semi-basement up to the 4th floor where the landlord lives, the villa may look ordinary at first glance, but its tenants are anything but. Other than the fact that they live in the same building, they have nothing in common—different jobs, different relationships with those around them, and even different sexual preferences. From car-poor workers to sexless married couples, and even cohabiting partners… Their overflowing desires come to the surface.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"Sleep with the women living in this building- whether through blackmail, seduction, or even force."

Lee Han accepts the sweet but dangerous offer that could turn his miserable life upside down...

"Apartment 301, the married woman Su-Jin Han. I need to find this woman's weakness fast!"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

By day, Jin Ho-Rang works as a janitor. By night, he picks up extra shifts at a club, scraping by while doing his best to stay cheerful. So when he suddenly receives a marriage proposal from the parent of his high school crush, Cha Ah-Jo, he can hardly believe it. Back then, Ah-jo was a beautiful omega who seemed to shine like a flower. Ho-Rang is told that Ah-Jo’s health declined after a single reckless night the two once shared, and that this is why the family is pushing for the marriage. Expecting a fragile and delicate figure from his memories, Ho-Rang goes to meet him again. Instead, he finds a towering, wildly different man who barely resembles the gentle Ah-Jo he once knew. Caught between nostalgia, shock, and an unexpected new dynamic, Ho-Rang is pulled into a whirlwind engagement that is nothing like what he imagined, turning his quiet life into a chaotic and heartfelt romantic comedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ara and Graham are childhood friends who used to have a sibling-like relationship. When they are finally placed in the same class (since the age of 8) as they enter their 2nd year of high school, their situation begins to change towards an unexpected direction. Will they be able to cross the line of dating, or not?

On his deathbed, the supreme dark leader is given an ironic second chance at life. He’s reborn as Jin-Mu, a young disciple of his rival clan, the righteous Mudang. Determined to make the best of a bad situation, he resolves to plunge the clan into corruption and debauchery by becoming their master disciple. Oblivious to this nefarious scheme, the Mudang begin to fall for Jin-Mu's audacious approach to life and martial arts. Will Jin-Mu be the Mudang Clan’s downfall or just the kick in the pants it needs?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Reincarnated as the daughter of a disgraceful marquis, she works hard to fix her father’s mistakes and earns the respect of her grandfather, only to find herself entangled in a web of obsession.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Jiseok hardly does any work, playing hooky and sleeping with the whole office. That is, until the new intern arrives...

(Source: Toomics)

Here, try this sword. Jun-Seo Shin is a master weapon creator doing menial jobs to keep a low profile in a world teeming with monster dungeons. But his habit of lending weapons to those in need exposes him to mega guilds and covert figures out to kill budding heroes from his past life. Can Jun-Seo craft his way out of trouble and uncover the conspiracy that followed him to this life?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes one prologue.

Leaving only black soot and dead bodies in his wake, Kang Chan, the “God of Blackfield,” struck fear into the hearts of his enemies. But one day, in the chaos of battle, his life was abruptly snuffed out. “I’ve been shot… but the bullet came from behind me!” Revived three years later, this “god” is now a wimpy high schooler with major problems—savage bullies, shady business dealings, and even girls. Revenge seemed like a straight shot, but high school is a battlefield all of its own!

(Source: Tapas)

Two childhood friends, one coin on a string and a lot of pent up wishful thinking.

(Source: Toomics)

I became the first son of the Demonic Heaven clan—one of the Six Great Clans of the Heavenly Demonic Cult—Jin Yeomyung. I was ready to enjoy a sweet life with a silver spoon in my mouth, but thanks to that damn Murim Alliance, the Heavenly Demonic Cult was destroyed. But in my final moments, Cult Leader Cheon Yura turned to me and said...

“Would you mind seducing me?”

(Source: Naver, translated)

A landlady offers her friend's younger brother a tempting deal. But when more people enter the picture, things get more complicated.

(Source: Toomics)

Flashing lights, adoring fans screaming your name, the exhilaration of being on stage…

Gyeol-Namu, also known as Gyeo-Wool, knows that he was born to be a star. And he’s more determined than anyone to follow the path that was destined for him. But regardless of all of Gyeo-wool’s efforts, the enormous amount of pressure he puts on himself as the leader of his new idol group, “Pale Green,” causes him to spend his days wallowing in anxiety and self-doubt. That is, until one day, Gyeo-Wool discovers a gentle hand repeatedly helping him from the shadows. A hand that belongs to “Gyeol,” an experienced idol belonging to the massively popular group, “Kimberly.” Although Gyeo-Wool is grateful for his reliable and handsome sunbae, he can’t help but wonder… Why is Gyeol treating him like he’s special?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

After throwing up on Ye-Eun, she's been treating me like her slave. Until I found the switch to her secret toy!

(Source: Toomics, edited)

title.english: I Will Divorce the Female Lead's Older Brother

description:
After transmigrating into her favorite novel as Ethel Wallace, she realizes how ridiculous everyone is to fawn over Riena Cassius, her sister-in-law and the original female lead who regressed in the story. Ignored by the family and unable to endure the nonsense any longer, she is determined to divorce her husband and turns toward the marquis, Riena’s future enemy, for help. Will Ethel escape House Cassius? Or will regression trump transmigration? And why does the marquis seem… like a gentleman?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Naega Mandeun Segye Sok Gwangjeonsaga Doeeotda
title.native: 내가 만든 세계 속 광전사가 되었다

description:
A young man, struggling to support his ailing mother, continues to write unsold web novels. Then, one day, he enters a mysterious contract and finds himself transported to the world of his own creation, "The Legend of the Overlord." Not as the protagonist, but as a supporting character, Attila! In this harsh alternate world, Attila, alongside his father, Munjuk, the chieftain, overcomes his tribe's crises and distinguishes himself on numerous battlefields. Using the author's knowledge, Attila embarks on a journey to find clues to return to his home world. He leads a band of mercenaries he meets along the way, and they triumph in countless fierce battles. He ultimately faces off against the original protagonist, Charles, and his reputation soars. However, the aftermath of this encounter erodes the narrative of the novel. Will Attila ever return to his home world? And where will his epic tale end? A 100% satisfying alternate world battle fantasy depicting his growth with his companions and his struggle with destiny begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Having lived in poverty all his life, Brian gets a second chance when he is offered the role of the sole heir to a conglomerate family's enormous fortune.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: A Good Day to be a Dog

description:
Ha-Na (Hae Na) has made every effort to avoid an inevitable family curse... of turning into a dog after her first kiss. Worst of all, the only way for her to break the curse is to get a second kiss. How will that work when Ha-Na’s first kiss is with a guy who is deathly afraid of dogs?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: Crawling My Way to the Top!

description:
With money, looks, and a successful career, Seongguk has it all. That is, until he dies and is reborn as a baby! To make things worse, his new parents are dead broke. However, alongside his new loving family, Seongguk soon learns that perhaps some things are better than money... not! He's going to have loving parents and money in this life, and there's no better time to start than now. Armed with an adorable face and the skills of a business tycoon, can Seongguk take his new family to the top?

(Source: Tapas)

In the game world of Pangaenia, Hyeon-Myeong is known as “the Phantom,” an anonymous legend admired by players. In real life, however, he is jobless and still getting over his recent breakup. When his character is killed and permanently deleted, his only remaining goal to become the first gamer to beat Pangaenia is shattered. Soon, however, Pangaenia begins to merge with the real world, and Hyeon-Myeong gets a chance to start over--this time, with 13 hidden traits.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kang Geon-woo, a genius major leaguer who has achieved wealth, fame, and everything. Even he could not continue his happy married life with his wife. Feeling the void left by his wife, he regrets it and returns to the past with the power of a mysterious ring. Will he be able to win love this time, having become a high school student during his innocent love days?

(Source: Naver, translated)

A strong coach challenges her boss, sparking passion and revealing a shocking connection to a past he can’t recall.

(Source: Toomics)

A fateful mix-up brings an unexpected twist to a student's life at a cram school. When a mysterious package meant for his star lecturer, who shares his name, lands in his hands, an unusual relationship begins to unfold between them —one that blurs the lines between student and teacher.

(Source: Toomics)

My name is Yu Il-Sin, a third-rate web novel author. I discovered a strange gaming app and was judged to be a G-rank hunter. You save the world in the game and gain divine powers you can use in real life. It's a little bit strange, somehow? My follower count and the number of quests keep increasing. In the midst of this, when should I write my web novel? It's suspended for personal reasons... No, I'm starting the serialization.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Jung Sookja's grandson, Gwon Yonghee, is her entire world. But everything comes crashing down after he ends up in a coma. The culprits behind it, the infamous Black Star Mob, are set free despite all evidence. Then one day, two men suddenly appear in front of Mrs. Jung, telling her they will train her so she can enact revenge on her grandson's assailants and take down the mob once and for all. Hesitant at first, she decides to work with them and begins to hunt down her prey one by one.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

When the xenoterran invasion began, the only ones who stood between us and the monstrous creatures were the superhumans. But while some chose to use this power for good, others had more sinister intentions. Kang Lim is a high school student with a secret - he's the vigilante superhero known as the White Cap, fighting back the mysterious monsters whenever he can. But the world he protects isn't what it seems -- there is more to the emergence of the xenoterran than meets the eye, and strange forces are at play in the shadows.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Princess's Guide to a Perfect Life

description:
After a fatal accident, Sia is transported into a historical drama as the baby princess of a lowly concubine. All she wants is to live peacefully with her new mother, but Sia's strength and intelligence gain her the favor of the crown prince and the king. Soon, she becomes a pawn in the hotly contested selection of the new queen. With the competing head concubines and their sons using her in their race to the throne, can baby Sia save herself from falling prey to this royal charade?

(Source: Tapas)

Mu-Ryoung, a prodigy exorcist born into a famous family, begins taking small jobs in high school. But when he meets Hwan-Young, a classmate cursed with misfortune, their bond drags him into a dangerous exorcism unlike any other.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: A Tactical Genius on the Field

description:
If there is one thing that Ma Jung-Woo is good at, it's football. Although he is a genius strategist, others look down on him because of his lack of education and debt. But things seem to turn around when he finds out he has just inherited his late grandfather's British football team. He plans to sell the team and start fresh, only to find out the team has massive debt! Left with no other choice, Jung-Woo must use his tactical genius to help this team rise from the ashes and be number one!

(Source: Tapas)

In a crazy turn of events, Sera, an office worker, is stranded on a remote island and captured by a native tribe. A mysterious Tarzan-esque man rescues her, but it turns out he’s also on the run. As they flee the tribes that are after them, Sera develops a special power she can’t quite understand. She also feels attracted to the strange man...

(Source: Manta)

The world is in constant turmoil, with constant wars breaking out between Heroes and Villains. Gifted with supernatural abilities, one lone girl sets out on a bloody path for revenge against the injustices of the world she lives in. With the constant clashes between titans, no one is safe. If no one is willing to protect the innocent, who are the real heroes, and who are the real villains? What truly separates one from the other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Yueon Ttaemun-e Jugneun Geon Jamkkan Milwossseubnida
title.native: 유언 때문에 죽는 건 잠깐 미뤘습니다

description:
Death delayed due to scheduling difficulties.
Chaeyoon, once a famous hero, now lives as an unknown hunter, fulfilling the odd dying wishes of ex-colleagues before he can end his own life. Haunted by the past and drawn to Jihan, a skilled hunter he meets, Chaeyoon questions whether fulfilling last wishes and finding his own solace is possible.

(Source: Manta)

During the early years of the hottest MMORPG called Arena, the world’s top-ranker Meleegod vanished after setting every possible record in the virtual world. In the real world, this deathly melee damage dealer was the happy-go-lucky Kang Hyeon-U, who simply deleted his character and quit his hobby to finish mandatory military service and inherit his father’s company. This rosy future dissolves within two years when a business rival makes his father go bankrupt. Hyeon-U struggles to make ends meet with a string of part-time jobs, but his best friend has a better idea. He urges Hyeon-U to conquer the Arena once again and earn a cushy living as a gaming celebrity. Vowing to strike it rich and avenge his father, the former Meleegod returns to the Arena as a newbie. Only this time, he’s out for blood!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

title.english: Married to a Duke Called Beast

description:
Nadia Lancaster is the youngest daughter of a humble baron, and a proposal from the infamous Duke Staton was the last thing she was expecting. Afraid to refuse such a powerful man in the empire, she is forced to accept despite the chilling rumors that swirl around him. Before she knows it, it’s their wedding night and her mind is filled with nothing but anxiety. Will Nadia be able to look past the rumors and give her new husband a chance, or does she found out that he really is a bloodthirsty beast and live out the rest of her marriage life in constant fear?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Echineacea Roaz is graceful, beautiful, and impeccably dressed, even on the dueling grounds. Yet beneath the lace gloves and silk hats is a deadly swordsman with a dark secret. As the Demon of the Cursed Sword, she once slaughtered all she loved, including Captain Eurien, the one man who believed in her. Granted one chance to rewrite fate, she turns back time and joins the knighthood to protect those she once failed. Can this elegant swordsman bloom anew, or will she cut everything down again?

(Source: Tapas)

Dowon chose to be a freelance guide for the freedom to do other things, but his cold and demanding esper, Kwonwoo, calls him for guiding every day without fail. Although he thinks he has his hands full already, he's proven wrong when Kwonwoo loses eight years of his memories and his powers due to an accident on the job. Now it's up to Dowon to restore both by giving the mentally 20-year-old Kwonwoo the kind of intimate guiding he always refused before. But surprisingly, this cheery and affectionate Kwonwoo seems all too eager to take things to the next level...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Potential Husband of The World Tree

description:
I fucked a sexy tree stuffed with tofu on a mountain before dawn... and that tree turned out to be a World Tree from Another World!! Now I am stuck in another world, and the only way for me to survive is to acquire the skills needed to be the Husband of the World Tree?!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.romaji: Ji Hui-Jin-gwa Ji Hyeon-U-neun Dasi Mannaseo

description:
Ding-dong, ding-dong-ding-dong, ding, dong. Ding-dong, ding-dong-ding, dong-ding, dong. It was late at night. An old-fashioned doorbell rang out ominously in the old building. Ji Hui-Jin cautiously opened the front door, wondering what was going on, worried that her neighbors would be bothered by the annoying sound.

“Who is it...”

“Sister. Long time no see.”

Ji Hui-Jin and Ji Hyeon-U, who had been step-siblings for five years due to their parents’ remarriage, were reunited after five years. Hyeon-U, who had returned home in glory as a successful medical student, approached a drunken Hui-Jin and whispered to her that this time, they should become a family as a married couple, not as siblings…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The Mad Demon, Ja-Ha Lee, dreams of becoming the God of Martial Arts. Unfortunately, his dreams are dashed after he falls off a cliff while running from the Demonic Cult for stealing the Jade of Heaven. Yet this is not the end for Ja-Ha -- he awakens from the fall to find himself back in his 20s. With his knowledge of the future and of martial arts, he now has a chance at revenge and at getting life right this time. Will he be able to fulfill his dream this time around, or is he doomed to face the same fate yet again?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Reincarnated as the Grand Duke’s Third Son

description:
Born at the bottom of society, Jake survives by leading Sabertooth, a mercenary group loyal to him. Yet he is ultimately betrayed and killed by the nobles he served. But instead of death, he awakens to a new life with soft, frail hands and the title of the third son of House Valdek, the most powerful family in the empire, rivaling even the crown. Surrounded by wealth and splendor, Jake realizes he has been granted a second chance to fulfill his ambition. So he sets off, determined to rise as high as possible. Look out, world, here comes Lucian Valdek!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Juyeong is in a juvenile detention center for the attempted murder of his father, Gang-ryong. He clings to hope, dreaming of a future in Seoul with his childhood friend, Dayeon. But everything shatters when Dayeon is tragically killed by a rogue truck, and the devastation deepens when Juyeong learns that his father was behind the wheel. In a cruel twist, Gang-ryong regains consciousness and offers Juyeong an ultimatum: “If you want revenge, become the king of this detention center!” Now, Juyeong must navigate the treacherous world of prison politics, determined to rise to power and avenge his friend.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, Jun-Hyeon finds out that his female coworkers have been making bets about him. So, he begins getting his revenge on his female coworkers pulling lewd pranks on him.

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

The naïve Yvona is ready to do anything for her amazing fiancé! Summon magical beasts and let him take the glory? Sure! Wreck her body for a powerful spell and die for him? Yes! Watch him secretly embrace her trusted cousin Tristan with passion and deride her openly? Oka— wait. What? Just then, Yvona dies... and wakes up a year in the past with a burdened heart. Armed with her knowledge, Yvona's ready to fight for herself. And hmm, maybe form an alliance with the coldhearted Duke of Azentine...

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

title.english: The Iron- Blooded Necromancer Has Returned

description:
Hela, a world of relentless killing, war, violence, and murder.

Kang Hyuk awakened as a necromancer in this world. He did not know why or what had caused it. Was it because he had encountered death too many times?

(Source: Webnovel)

Sang-u, an average sophomore in college, always dreamt of having multiple versions of himself—one for study, another for play. One day, he awakens with a skill called “cloning,” and Sang-u thinks his dream has come true. But will cloning really steer his life in the direction he had hoped for, or does fate have other plans in store?

(Source: WEBTOON)

"I'll change your future!"

A chance to turn your life around, a guaranteed service promised by a voice phishing scam! Kang Juhyuk, a once beloved national actor who has fallen from grace and into poverty, lives in a dark, single-room apartment in misery. One day, an unidentified smartphone is sent to Juhyuk, leading to a series of events that will completely change his life.

"The voice phishing calls I'm getting... are they selling the future?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

After years of fighting for survival on planet Alphen, Kang Woojin had become a fearsome necromancer and ruler of his own territory. But now that he’s finally found a way back to Earth, he’s nothing more than a low-level player clearing dungeons for cash. Soon enough, though, Woojin’s undeniable skills have major guilds vying for his attention. And just in time, because with Woojin’s old enemy threatening invasion, those skills might be the only thing standing between humanity and destruction!

(Source: Tapas)

Tensions are brewing under the seemingly calm surface of the Vasilios Empire, a kingdom ruled by the Imperial Family and the Temple. Lady Medea Solon has lost her place next to Crown Prince Eros, but resolves to do whatever it will take to win back what's rightfully hers. Will she reclaim her throne?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jae-Bok moves to the city from his country home when his step-sister Hyang-A makes an offer. He starts to work as her in-laws' family driver and slowly develops secret relationships with the city women...

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: The Advanced Player of the Tutorial Tower

description:
After being trapped for 12 years in a tower full of regenerating monsters, Hyeon-U Kim is more powerful than just about any human or monster on Earth. Now that he’s free, he’s determined to find out who was behind his imprisonment, even if that means he has to kill hordes of monsters — and inadvertently save the world — along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Identical twins Joo Baek-Hee and Joo Baek-Naa share everything, including their obsession with one person: Jung Hae-Yoon, a seemingly ordinary friend caught between them. To one, Hae-Yoon is a precious toy; to the other, an irreplaceable treasure. As the twins’ twisted desires begin to blur the line between love and possession, can Hae-Yoon escape from their beautiful but dangerous grasp?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"Welcome to Another World. Exciting adventures with millions of other users await you!"

Or at least, that's what Jiseok was promised when logging in. Instead, he finds himself alone with nothing but an ordinary shovel to fend off ferocious beasts, evil dragons, and... some dude in tighty-whities? Now, Jiseok's only got two choices - dig or die.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seoyu is an extremely recessive omega who can’t believe his luck when he meets an extremely dominant alpha named Sunghoon Choi. This alpha has it all, even if he might be a gang leader! Seoyu intends to enjoy their fling for as long as he can because that’s all it is, right? Sunghoon can’t possibly be interested in being Seoyu’s boyfriend. However, he does boyfriend-like things, like having meals delivered to Seoyu’s apartment and constantly worrying that Seoyu is too cold… but surely this is just temporary!

(Source: Tapas) Note: Chapter count includes 3 side story.

Infamous jailbreaker Rosen Walker is finally being transferred to the Isle of Monte, the most notorious maximum security prison in the world. Her guard? It’s none other than the beloved war hero of the empire himself — Ian Connor. Now Ian must unravel the truth. Did Rosen really commit the murder? Or is there more to the story?

(Source: Manta)

Commoner orphan Julia Arte is cursed with repeatedly dying and being reborn on the same snowy mountain trail. Now on her ninth life, she is determined to break the curse by getting revenge on her former lover Vasily Marjoram, who not only left her to die but sent assassins to kill her. After becoming the second lady-in-waiting to House Marjoram's sworn enemy, Prince Lewisia Ortega, Julia pulls out all the stops to take down Vasily. But will her scheming bring more trouble than she bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

Actress Lee Sia hasn't just been haunted by ghosts for years, she's also been plagued by dreams of a girl named Camilla Sorphel dying repeatedly at the hands of her stepfather and stepbrother. Despite her efforts to ignore the dreams, when an accident at work makes her wake up as Camilla, she's forced to seek the help of various ghosts to win over her family and avoid getting killed. But can this former actress play the part of a loving daughter and sister to her future executors?

(Source: Tapas)

“When the apocalypse comes, the world will be ridden with bloodshed and screams of anguish. In the end, none but ashes will remain.”

He has been locked up in an underground prison his whole life. He does not know his name. He does not know when the world will end, nor if the world really even will end. The only thing he knows is that he has been imprisoned... by his own father.

(Source: WEBTOON)

To regain his peace, Gangchan must welcome his blood-curdling, smoking neighbor and her housemates into his home.

(Source: Toomics)

Minjun wished for the world to end-- until it did. When a zombie appears at his door, the bullied teen chooses to fight for survival. Teaming up with Yena, his sassy yet charming classmate, he flees the collapsing city. Hunted by the infected and haunted by enemies old and new, they discover that in a world without rules, trust may be their only chance at survival.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Teen angst in full swing.

U-Jeong's hopes for a normal sophomore year are dashed after a run-in with Se-Ra, a foul-mouthed troublemaker, who has a few choice words for him. What starts out as a simple accident snowballs into a big misunderstanding, and now U-Jeong finds himself tangled up with a bunch of depressed juniors!

(Source: Manta, edited)

title.english: The Martial God Who Regressed Back to Level 2

description:
Earth lost the fight for survival in the BattleNet system and humanity now faces eradication. However, Jihan Seong is given another chance. He has returned three years into the past before BattleNet became a life-or-death game. With his knowledge of the future, he’s determined to become the strongest player. Will Jihan be able to change the fate of humanity? And more importantly, can he protect the ones he loves from those who want him to fail?

(Source: Tapas)

Theo Ragnar, the 31st son of the mighty Grand Duke of Ragnar, was born without the legendary Ragnar Gift—a fatal flaw in a family where might is right. Labeled the “Ragnar Defect,” he and his mother were betrayed, meeting a brutal end at the hands of those they trusted. But death was only the beginning. Reborn at 17, Theo awakens not only with the Ragnar Gift, but with powers far beyond imagination. Fueled by vengeance and a second chance, he sets out to claim the glory he was once denied.

(Source: Tapas)

The spunky Lady Dillion didn't realize she was the villain of a romance novel until she encounters Marquess Cedric. Seeing him jogs a dormant memory of the novel's plot, in which her beloved younger sister dies in childbirth after marrying Cedric. Determined to prevent this, Dillion marries him herself, but what fate awaits her when she knows he's meant to fall in love with the real female lead later? In this marriage of convenience, it seems nothing turns out quite how either of them expects...

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

Oh Kangwoo the Demon King has had it with ruling over Hell and wants to return to Earth. But when he finally gets there, not only are his powers sealed, but the Earth he once knew has turned into an MMORPG free-for-all. Dimensional gates have appeared all over the world, and "players" enter them to make a living by hunting monsters. If Kangwoo wants to survive in this dangerous game, he's going to have to level up, and fast. But for this demon king, hell on earth might be worse than Hell itself!

(Source: Tapas)

Se-Chan has always been grateful to Daniel, his foster father for helping him after his own father passed. One day, two women barge into his house, claiming to be Daniel's daughters. Unaware of their impure intentions, Se-Chan gets tempted by their gorgeous looks and ends up crossing the line.

"You've been staring at my body the whole day."

(Source: DAYcomics)

After being brainwashed by the emperor, Yahn has served him as his loyal puppet. Upon finding out that he has been played by the emperor, Yahn vows vengeance, but he falls to the mighty emperor’s powers. However, instead of dying, Yahn opens his eyes to find that he has gone back in time, to when he used to be a soldier in training. Will he now seek vengeance on the emperor, or will he go look for his family? The choice is now in his hands.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Though gifted with an ability to bring her drawings to life, Karina Leopold spent her years in the shadow of her famous siblings, forced to be the good daughter her parents wanted. But when she’s told that a deadly disease will kill her in a year, she offers a deal to her fiancé, Milian Pastellio, with the goal to live the remainder of her days far from her family’s reach. Much to her surprise, their encounter proceeds to change them both in a way she never imagined…

(Source: Tapas)

A world in which Korea is the global capital of combat sports. At Nam-Il High School where the best and most talented students of martial arts reside, Jiu Ji-Tae suddenly finds himself thrust into their midst despite being a total weakling.

By neutralising his physical shortcomings through jiu-jitsu, can he rise to the top of the fight classes?

Did you not wish to see me, My Lord…? I’ve taken over a man’s body in the world of murim, and to make things even more complicated, it’s the body of an extra in a world where everything is determined by strength and skills. There’s only one way to survive and make it out of this place. Women? Power? I will take everything away from the original protagonist and rewrite the novel!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

When brawler Kang Ji-Hwan is forced to transfer schools, the last thing he expects is to rely on the top student in class. But after accidentally tearing model-student Han Yu-Seong’s uniform, and discovering the fierce tiger tattoo hidden on his back, Ji-Hwan offers a deal: he’ll keep Yu-Seong’s secret if Yu-Seong becomes his tutor. To push Ji-Hwan away, Yu-Seong turns up the heat with bold, intimate teasing… but the closer he gets, the more Ji-Hwan finds himself drawn in. Between hidden claws and rising tension, two boys with tiger hearts may be getting far too close for comfort.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.

The revered Swordmaster Hoss sets out to defeat the formidable Shell Dragon! But when people find his cold dead body amidst the remains of a fierce battle, they make a shocking new discovery. Now, with monster hunters discovering new ways to utilize their spoils for more private (?) pleasures, a bizarre sexual hype sweeps through the lands - and Cheong, as innocent as she is, must make her way through this mess. Join Cheong as she embarks on her raunchy new adventure!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I Became the Tyrant's Dishonest Adviser

description:
A customer service employee one moment, then an adviser to the tyrannical emperor, Cardan Zeon, the next. Our heroine was suddenly transmigrated into the body of Duchess Erina Valois, a side character who dies a tragic death at the emperor’s hands in a novel she was reading the night before. So despite all the confusion and chaos, one thing is for sure. If Erina is to survive under this tyrant, she will have to get her act together ASAP! Though, strangely enough, she gets a sense that there is more to their relationship than what was described in the novel...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Love History Caused by Willful Negligence

description:
Woo-Yeon is one of the brightest rising stars as a nationally beloved actor. Nobody is capable of hating such a talented and sweet man with his blessed looks. Or, well, that’s what people who don’t know the real Woo-Yeon think. In reality, Woo-Yeon is manipulative, cold-hearted, and dangerous. But his new manager In-Seob is his biggest fan, and he’s determined to stick by Woo-Yeon’s side no matter what. Except…remember how nobody in the know is capable of hating Woo-Yeon? Well, In-Seob just might know more than he lets on…

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Speràdo family line possesses a secret: shadow magic. But it’s been 100 years since someone last wielded it. When Marquis Speràdo tries to sacrifice Leslie for her favored sister Ellie, little does he know that this awakens the power of darkness in her instead. To escape her family’s greed and abuse, Leslie’s out to make a deal with the Monstrous Duke: adopt her, and her powers will be at the duke’s disposal. Will Leslie escape her parents’ cruel grip, or succumb to their evil exploits?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 20 extra stories.

As a so-called "half-noblewoman," Shurya Littenheim was shunned by all in high society except her husband, Grand Duke Kardi Esperand. So when the powers Kardi inherited from his family start to slowly kill him, Shurya gladly makes a deal to sacrifice her own life instead. Upon her death, she's reborn as her younger, single self, and this time... she's doing it all over again! Shurya's on a mission to make Kardi her hubby once more, but is there any hope of avoiding yet another tragic ending?

(Source: Tapas)

When the war between the aboveground and underground ended, humanity was joined by so-called "dungeon babies," those gifted with supernatural abilities and an obsession with the labyrinths below ground. Despite being a dungeon baby, Kim Jin-U suppressed his instincts, choosing to live an ordinary life as a guide and caring for his family. But when an expedition goes wrong and he somehow ends up becoming the new owner of a labyrinth, he discovers that he cannot ignore his instincts forever...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Life sure is ruff, especially when you’re Gyeon Hui-Seong. Abandoned by his pack of fellow dog shifters, he is forced to become a drug runner for a gambling ring. For his final job, he comes face to face with Savage Fang, the ruthless Wolf Den enforcer Yun Chi-Young. Everything goes (nearly) according to plan, but on his way back he is attacked and forced to return to his fearsome(?) true form…a little white cottonball of a puppy! After Chi-young finds Hui-Seong struggling on the streets, he takes him in, believing him to be nothing more than a stray. Will Hui-Seong be able to escape the ruthless, terrifying outpour of love Chi-Young showers him with and escape his criminal past? Or will he be forever leashed to a life of kibble and kennels?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.romaji: Idol Harem-eul Mandeureotseumnida. Choemyeoneun Nahante Georeonneunde
title.native: 아이돌 하렘을 만들었습니다. 최면은 나한테 걸었는데

description:
Sejin works as a road manager for a female idol group. One day, he happened to get his hands on a hypnosis app, but thought he shouldn't commit any crimes using it, so he decided to only use it on himself as a means of stress relief. When he regained his senses, he realized that he was having sex with one of the idols he was in charge of...

"What on earth happened?"

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

“Maybe Inner Gods can never defeat Outer Gods…” so thought Yu-Won Kim, a plucky, high-ranking warrior, after a bitter defeat. But Yu-Won is too tenacious to give up. His loss becomes the dawn of a new journey as a returnee. With renewed determination, Yu-Won starts back from where he began, smashing monster after monster and relearning his skills before taking on the Tower once again. But can he fight his way through the tutorials and level up once more, or will his conquest crumble before him?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The silence is over. Now his fight begins!

One day, Ji-Jun, a transfer student who never speaks, overpowers the bullies in his class with overwhelming skill. Because of this fight, Ji-Jun becomes the center of attention of the bullies inside and outside the school. And another silent female student begins to watch Ji-Jun.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yijae Kang seems to have the worst luck. She’s an orphan, can see ghosts, and can’t go near water. To make matters worse, she reincarnates as Hailey Duncan, a noblewoman who took her own life before her marriage to King Rodrick of Kaien--who happens to have evil spirits attached to him! To help ease his burden, Hailey's days are spent exorcising these spirits. The more they spend time together, the better Rodrick seems to feel…could he be falling for her?

(Source: Tapas)

Once the bullies target you, it’s game over. The school is run by tyrants whose favorite hobby is tormenting the weakest kids in class. But then Gray arrived. This mysterious new student threatens to dismantle the established order. He may be small in stature, but his calculative and brutal fighting leaves unsuspecting opponents lying on the floor begging for mercy. Now the school's toughest bullies have to scramble to take down this new and unusual hero.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hyeon-Ho joins a study group to get closer to the pretty senior that he has crush on. But this study group is out of the ordinary...! A SPECIAL lesson for him begins!

"Here, Hyeon-Ho. Grab my butt like this!"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Army veteran's last go at the obstacle course turns lethal after a simple fall. A goddess presents an opportunity at new life as a hero! The protagonist ain't having any of it, he was supposed to retire and become a civilian. The arrogant Goddess drops him down to survive while having her own evil schemes. How will his new life progress after encountering another Goddess, a spy and his past life's junior?

This is not a fairytale. No, this is a story of what lurks beyond the “happily ever after.” Once upon a time, Elena assumed the role of Princess Veronica, married the crown prince, and lived happily... until her dutiful knight plunged his sword into her back and the true Veronica stepped out of the darkness. Now, Elena finds herself at the beginning of her cautionary tale. However, this time she intends to do more than play the star of the show. This time, Elena will direct the downfall of everyone who played a part in wronging her.

(Source: Tapas)

Lavis Vindica, son of the Great Demon King who rules the Demon Realm. He exterminated an entire demon clan that had defied him, earning the punishment of being banished to the human world. While living as an ordinary student, he discovers that his forbidden demonic energy reacts to ‘evil’. Gradually grasping how to wield this power, he sets out to find a way back to the demon realm.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Blondina is living a real-life Cinderella story. After growing up poor and enduring a difficult childhood, she discovers that she is a princess of the Ates empire. However, her estranged father and half-siblings give her the cold shoulder when she moves into the palace, and Blondina must keep a low profile. That all changes when she befriends Amon, a cat-like creature with mysterious intentions. For years, creatures like Amon and humans have struggled to live in harmony. Can Blondina and Amon’s friendship bring peace, or will it deepen the rift between their people?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Yu-Jin is an F-ranker overshadowed by his little brother, an S-ranker. All he does is get in his brother’s way, causing trouble wherever he goes. When a seemingly routine dungeon raid goes wrong and costs Yu-Jin his brother’s life, Yu-Jin decides to use the wish granted by clearing the dungeon to reset his timeline. The plan was to lead a quiet life from now on… but now it turns out he can help other people become S-rankers?! Maybe this is Yu-Jin's chance at building his own entourage of powerful metahumans… but it may be easier said than done.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Where does one find the top shamans and the most reliable fortune tellers in the country? Welcome to the stock exchange, where one prediction could make or break billions. This is their all-star match, world series, medal of arts, and olympics all rolled into one. Follow the story of Jiseung Cheon, as he breaks into the world of occult and finance, one shamanic ritual at a time.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A story full of mean girls and violence. A young boy trying to rise above his surroundings, and a rich girl trying to stay on top. Will the Queen be able to keep her throne?

(Source: DAYcomics)

After devoting his life to the crime organization, Glory Club, Peter retires his status as a legendary killer and spends his remaining days running a quiet used bookstore. But after being ambushed and nearly killed one day by the very organization he dedicated his life to, Peter finds his body magically reverted back to its teenage years. Now that Peter was back to his peak physique, he sets out to settle the score with Glory Club.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The so-called “Lighthouse of the North,” the prosperous trading town of Schoarra, hides a dark underbelly: seedy slums ruled by five ruthless crime bosses. When streetwise orphan Vlad finds the brothel he works for decimated by a disgraced knight, he turns to the path of the blade, pledging himself to the pursuit of power by sword. Blessed with the ability to seek wisdom from his sentient sword, Vlad embarks upon a journey of growth and peril as swordsman in service to the powerful House Vayezid.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, Seung-Hyeon Kang woke up to find himself in an unfamiliar world, on the continent of Azeul. At that moment, a status window pops up: Your class is Healer? Wait, but he doesn’t have a single healing skill? He wonders how he is supposed to heal with no healing skills. And so begins the life of a quack Healer who can’t cast Heal as he struggles to find a way back to his home.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Can a single night with a single person change your life forever? Hyeon-oh’s answer to this question is yes. Ever since a night he spent with Seo-hyun, he’s clung onto the memories of it to keep himself going in the dark world of the yakuza. Years later, Seo-hyun appears in his life once more. Could it be a sign that dawn is here to chase the darkness away once and for all?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters

"Wow... my sister is insanely cool!"

A Duke who can’t take his eyes off me. A dazzling, flawless older sister. I thought I’d been reincarnated as the youngest daughter of a ducal family in a sweet childcare romance fantasy, a cozy world where everyone dotes on me.

"...Wait. This isn’t a childcare story at all!"

Turns out, the novel I possessed isn’t a heartwarming family story, it’s a revenge story. And worse, the person I’ve possessed is the villainous younger sister, destined to be destroyed by her older sister, the very woman I once killed in a past life.

"Uh... sister?"

If I want to survive, there’s only one rule, stay on my sister’s good side at all costs. And live as quietly, invisibly, and harmlessly as possible.

"I just picked it up on the way."

But... my sister is acting kind of strange.

"If you ever get cast out of the family, I’ll take you in."

And wait, who is this now?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Did you just imprint with me?!
After dying from overwork, Noa ends up possessing the body of Eleanora, the villainess from a novel. Noa simply wants to lead a peaceful life and tries not to interfere with the original story. That is, until a baby dragon that's meant to imprint with the heroine imprints with her instead...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I'm Not That Kind of Talent

description:
A talented individual who is respected by many and welcomed anywhere? Not at all! A bloodthirsty battle fanatic who knows no defeat? Couldn’t be further from the truth! In reality, Deon Hardt is a sickly human who coughs up blood from receiving the tiniest bit of stress and gets sunburns from standing in the sun for ten minutes. But due to an unfortunate misunderstanding, he becomes “Demon Arut,” the notorious 0th corps commander of the demon army and the demon king’s joker. Caught in a war between humans and demonkind, Deon must find a way to survive!

(Source: Tappytoon)

As a fellow aspiring saint with healing powers, Belze spent her whole childhood being compared to the ever-so-perfect Diana. So when offered the chance to expose her rival's family for treason, she doesn't think twice... But it all turns out to be a trap that only gets herself and her benevolent sponsor framed and executed! Luckily, she's given a second shot: She wakes up at the age of 5 again, determined to repay her benefactors this time. But turning a new leaf is easier said than done...

(Source: Tapas)

Not all job classes are created equal! Marnac was pulled into a game while trying to play as one of its worst job classes, cleric of decay. Now he’s the only cleric of the Order of Decay, serving a goddess who’s been reduced to an animated hand that repeats the word “MURDER!” Will the Order’s last cleric become powerful enough before the prophecy of “the end” comes true?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After two decades of battling extradimensional monsters and protecting the world, Dae-in Lim is finally ready to retire and enjoy a peaceful life. However, the morning after his retirement party, he wakes up to find himself back in time… before he even gained his powers. Armed with knowledge of the future, Dae-in is determined to secure his fortune and retire again, but this time within three years.

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)

title.english: I Stole the First Ranker’s Soul

description:
Moa Son, an ordinary office worker, wakes up in a dungeon in the middle of the night and awakens as a collecting hunter. After barely making it out alive, she falls into the same dungeon but gets rescued by the first-ranked hunter, Jihan Seo, and becomes bound up with him. Now he’s offering to make her strong on this one condition --

"Promise me you will do your best to kill the bosses of all the dungeons that exist in the world.”

Come again?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Sold off by her mother, a young girl winds up in the house of the empire’s most feared duke, Ein Castielo.
