Given the name Estelle, she must come to terms with her family, demon-lineage, and new standing in high society. But what will happen to the innocent Estelle when the enemies of the duke learn of her existence? Does she really have what it takes to be a child of the great and powerful Castielos?

(Source: Tapas)

They thought they were inseparable. A terrible tragedy kept them apart. Forever? Unhappiness always strikes when you least expect it. And when it leaves a gaping void in the heart, how can we continue to live as if nothing had happened?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Navier Ellie Trovi was an empress perfect in every way -- intelligent, courageous, and socially adept. She was kind to her subjects and devoted to her husband. Navier was perfectly content to live the rest of her days as the wise empress of the Eastern Empire. That is, until her husband brought home a mistress and demanded a divorce. “I accept this divorce… And I request an approval of my remarriage.” In a shocking twist, Navier remarries another emperor and retains her title and childhood dream as empress. But just how did everything unfold?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yong-U, a tiger-superhuman working as an actor in the superhuman community, rescues a cat abused on a film set for being an unlucky black cat and takes it in. He names it Dodong and grows attached to it, but one day, when he wakes up from a nap, Dodong has vanished without a trace. He's even robbed Yong-U of his wallet and valuables! The media is abuzz with reports that Yong-U abandoned his cat, and to quell the controversy, Yong-U proposes a roommate to Hae-Dong, the cat-superhuman who tricked him into thinking he's a cat...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Lee Myeong-Jun, Vice Chairman of Hyundo Group, lost his daughter to the Iljin group. For revenge, he adopts Yoon Ga-Ram, a psychopathic North Korean defector. She is a sadistic human weapon born after North Korea's drug experiments. A psychopath girl who killed everyone at the lab and escaped North Korea alone. Yoon Ga-Ram has just been released from a juvenile detention center in South-Korea.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

After a stalking incident, Yoon Ji-gu has become understandably wary of strangers. So when an odd man moves in next door, he immediately suspects the worst. Little does he know, Yeowoon is just a regular guy trying to land a job and enjoy his free time—until he finds himself dealing with a hostile neighbor. As their real-life misunderstandings escalate, the two unknowingly team up in their favorite online game, forming an unexpected duo. Get ready to log in to a new adventure full of hilarious mix-ups, a distrustful tsundere, and an unwitting flirt with a heart of gold.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19

A series about a hyper-realistic fantasy game!

"Sargent Ha, you crazy bastard. You shot another full round of bullseyes?"

The sharpshooter Ha Lee-Ha simply wanted to be a part of the army forever. However, due to an unfortunate accident, he became paraplegic and was tossed back into society. The revolutionary VR game [Middle Earth] presented a new life to him. Money obtained in [Middle Earth] has real-world value! Yet, he ruined his chance by selecting the lowest-tier character!

"I'm not like the others. This is all I have."

Black gunpowder, iron balls, and ramrods... I'll show you all what a real 'musketeer' is!

It’s Baekyoung’s 10th day as a succubus and she’s hangry for a meal. As a matter of fact, she’s getting downright desperate. Of course, a gourmet meal would be preferred but at this point any man will do, she just needs some sustenance. Ah, that guy right there! He looks a little nerdy but he’ll do for now. But it turns out that this meal will be much juicier than Baekyoung ever anticipated and now she can’t get this human off of her mind. The ravenous succubus has found her perfect meal, now she just has to make him all hers!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one special and seven side story chapters.

title.english: I'll Give You the Most Rotten One

description:
Ten years of relationship go down the drain when Haeru discovers that her loving boyfriend, Se-o, spent the night with another woman. What begins as a series of small misunderstandings snowballs into something much bigger as the college sweethearts wade through love, temptation, and workplace drama. Well, what better way to get back at her cheating boyfriend than to take the most rotten revenge ever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

[Will you join the game?] Giyoung's suddenly thrown into a game of life and death. Not only that but he's also the player with the lowest stats. Still, he's got one skill on his side: the ability to read other players' status! He finds the opportunity of his life when he discovers that Hyunsung is a returner to this world. Now all Giyoung has to do is stick next to Hyunsung and game his way out of this tutorial.

(Source: Tapas)

The real world is suddenly ambushed by rifts that threaten to spill out monsters from the VR game “Chronicles of Arcana.” These rifts can only be closed by “players,” people who have awakened as their in-game characters with all the same stats and skills. Unfortunately for protagonist Lee Ho-Yeol, his awakening is the opposite of cool as his avatar happens to be the one he made during the height of his awkward phase in middle school, giving him all the mannerisms and speech of an absolute cringelord. Just how will he go on to become the hero humanity needs most?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Noblewoman Hillis Inoadenn has had many lives so far (seven, to be exact) but she has always been regarded the same in all of them: meek, submissive, and a pest. But in her eighth resurrection, she no longer bends to the nobles that encircle her, nor does she continue to live in the shadows of her wicked brother and half-sister. With a sacred power passed down from her lineage and the title of Family Head, she sets out for revenge and to change the grave destiny that awaits her.

(Source: Tapas)

Choi Jae-Seung has spent years indulging in one-night stands with BDSM partners, always as a willing masochist. But during a model casting, he suddenly comes face-to-face with the very person who awakened that desire in him: his high school senior, Min Ho-Yeon. After 13 years, Ho-Yeon has returned as Eli, a mysterious top model from the U.S. - and he wastes no time forcing his way back into Jae-Seung’s body and life. What begins as unwanted contact spirals into a dangerous reunion where desire, power, and old wounds collide.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Latna Saga: Survival of a Sword King

description:
After being recently discharged from military service and just drifting through life, Hanbin Ryu is suddenly transported to another world. However, his “guide line,” the system bestowed upon him to help with his survival and growth, was filled with errors, causing him to be stuck in the tutorial stage for over 20 years. When he is finally released from this personal hell, he finds everyone has turned against otherworlders like him. Just how will this low-level, super-tutorial newbie survive?

(Source: Tapas)

As the eldest daughter, I've always yielded to the whims of Meldor, my little brother and the future Duke Elton. But one day, memories of my previous life started flooding my mind, and I realized this wasn't my first time sacrificing everything for a younger sibling... That was my breaking point. Enough! I've done my time! Starting today, I'll meticulously reclaim everything I was ever forced to surrender to Meldor, and I'll give that spoiled brat a good lesson while I'm at it. Just you wait!

(Source: Tapas)

Baek Woo-Jin is the youngest son of a renowned swordsman family who has neither talent in swordsmanship nor an impressive Aura, despite trying harder than anyone. Although he was dishonored by his own family and killed, he reincarnates as the owner of a Magic Sword. His only goal is the destruction of his own family.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Doyun followed his high school crush Hosu to university! Hosu gets drunk at the welcoming party, and Doyun tries to help him get home, but Hosu's so drunk they end up having to stay at a Motel. Doyun picks up a condom he randomly found, but Hosu just so happens to wake up at that moment...! Will Doyun be able to confess to Hosu despite his shyness?

When an interdimensional portal appeared and released countless monsters across the world, humanity didn’t take the threat lying down. Mankind fought back, defeating the monsters' Demon King and creating a new way of life as "hunters." But when Taekyung Jin, a struggling, low-ranked hunter, accidentally logs into a game on a beat-up VR console, he finds himself trapped in an all-new world, unable to log out.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Reborn Young Lord is an Assassin

description:
Cyan Vert, illegitimate son of the Duke and the empire's greatest assassin, is betrayed by the righteous brother whose shadow he's always lived in. But just before the fatal blow strikes his throat, Cyan awakes to find he's just a boy again. The young lord has been reborn, and this time, he's not going to live in anyone's shadow!

(Source: WEBTOON)

After sleeping a total of 10,000 hours inside Idea, the hottest online game around, Lee Hyunsung becomes one overpowered player! He's given an exclusive hidden class with an array of unique skills, and one of which allows him to fight in his sleep! He's slowly making his way up to the top, and everyone from the developers to other players are starting to take notice of this odd rookie. Will Hyunsung eventually become the top ranker in Idea? Or is this all just a dream that's too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

Faced with imminent defeat and certain death, would you choose to run – or continue to fight for a doomed world? When mysterious towers appear across the world, summoning monsters that prey on mankind, this is the choice presented to the Tower Walkers – adventurers with special powers to fight the monsters. On the brink of death, they can choose to use a “regression stone” to return to the past for a second chance, though this decision places them in a separate timeline forever. Stubborn Tower Walker Jae-Hwan rejects this choice, choosing to fight for the original timeline, and learning shocking secrets about the Tower along the way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Gyerin decides to leave behind her ill-fated first love with Doona and start anew. She quickly meets a woman who looks like her ideal type from head to toe... Is Juyeon, full of armor-piercing amounts of charm, her fortune or woe?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

“If I were given another chance...”

10 years after the apocalypse began on Earth, while he faced imminent death, Yoohyun was filled with regret. Just then, a bright light descended upon him. When he opened his eyes, he was greeted by an unfamiliar scene. Not only had he reincarnated as a non-human race called “Teller,” but he had also traveled back in time by 10 years!

“Now that it has come to this, I’ll live my best life this time! ”

Unlike his previous life, where he was solely focused on survival, he is now determined to lead a successful life. In this new life he has gained, will Yoohyun truly be able to become the protagonist?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Best friends, household pet, or just charity case? Hayoon has no idea what she is to Minju after all these years. She's grateful Minju's family took her in despite her being nothing but a lowly recessive omega, but her relationship with Minju sure is confusing. Minju does seem to like her, whispering sweet nothings in her ear and helping her out when she's in her heat, but who can tell? Ever the stereotypical rich alpha, Hayoon knows for a fact that Minju gets bored easily, that she loses all interest once she gets what she wants. Unable to tear herself away from Minju's grip, Hayoon unwillingly comes to harbor affection, albeit spiteful affection, for her friend...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I Became the Mother of the Evil Male Lead

description:
The newly reincarnated Sheriel learns she has become the mother of Karthizel Roperam, the male lead of a dark romance fantasy novel. All the neglect Karthizel faces as a child leads him to become a crazy and obsessive man who’s willing to kill anyone to get what he wants, even his own mother! Then the only way for Sheriel to keep herself alive in this timeline is to have him be raised right under loving parents, which means she’ll also need to make amends with her cold, estranged husband. Will Sheriel be able to save herself and this broken family?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Chase feels uncomfortable at home because his foster family hates him, but not everything is what it seems.

(Source: Toomics)

There's a new student at my university who's always surrounded by guys... the only problem is, that's my mom!!

(Source: Toomics)

Adopted by the abusive Count Zackary, Hailynn is imprisoned for over a decade but a tragedy sets her back in time and she’s now eight years old again! Eager to escape the horrors of her previous life, Hailynn runs away and crosses paths with a brave boy and the protective Duke Callisto. When a magical potion reveals she belongs to the powerful Callisto bloodline, the chaste Duke swears she can't be his! What is the secret behind Hailynn’s birth? And will she ever find a family that’ll love her?

(Source: Tapas)

Do-Won has a problem. His neighbor, Beom, seems awfully rude, but he’s infuriatingly gorgeous. And the completely ridiculous cherry on top? Beom turns out to be Do-Won’s all-time favorite camboy, which only adds to the (sexual) frustration. Beom is a metaphorical pain in Do-Won’s ass, and Do-Won would like to return the favor physically, thank you very much. So, Do-Won has a problem—in his pants. The question is, how is he going to solve it? You’ll find out the answer if you crank the volume up, and watch very, very closely…

(Source: Lezhin)

Han-Sol, a 24-year-old kindergarten teacher, has one ultimate goal in life: to snag a wealthy Prince Charming. Enter Yu-Shin—the tall, handsome, and successful father of one of Han-Sol's students. After an awkward first date, the two are soon caught up in a fairytale romance with a kinky twist!

(Source: Manta)

Workaholic Tae-Sung Kim quits his corporate job to drive a taxi. After helping his first passenger catch her cheating husband, he turns his cab into a makeshift detective agency. That's when gangster Jin-U Hwang gets in, seeking help to find his unfaithful missing boyfriend.

(Source: Manta)

When Sahui’s quiet life at Yeonghwadang, a secluded shaman house where she spent her whole life, is disrupted by imposing CEO Tae-eon Jeong, she wants nothing more than to keep her distance. Scarred by abandonment and a childhood accident, she has no interest in love. Yet Tae-eon’s arrogance, charm, and relentless attention begin to break through her defenses, stirring emotions she thought she had buried for good.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Do you know the pain of a small penis? Well one young man has lived his entire adult life being mocked and belittled by women. Now he's had enough and signed a deal with a devil to get what he wants...No matter the cost.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Sun Mooyoung, a struggling fake fortune-teller, cons clueless chaebol heir Lee Jaeyi, who’s never dated, into a bogus love reading and rakes in big cash. But when Jaeyi realizes he’s been scammed, he sues Mooyoung for the fraudster he is! As if that’s not bad enough, Mooyoung’s boyfriend bails on him after hearing about the lawsuit. Now broke and desperate, Mooyoung hatches a ridiculous plan: make Jaeyi's fake love fortune come true to get the charges dropped. Can this hapless con artist pull off a miracle—or just dig himself deeper?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chi-Woo’s got issues. Upon returning to school after the “incident” last year, he vows to keep to himself and stay out of trouble until graduation. Easier said than done: his bad boy reputation has made him the talk of the school, and Kyu-Jin - class president and model student - won’t stop being friendly. Trouble arrives soon enough in the shape of Ji-Hyun, a tattooed hunk from Chi-Woo’s dark past. It’s gonna be a tough year…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born to inherit a hotel empire, Woo Myeong-Seong was raised like a "perfect creation" by his controlling father. To the outside world, he has it all: brains, looks, wealth. But behind closed doors, he’s slowly burning out from a lifetime of pressure and expectation. One day, while listlessly going about his routine, he runs into Do Jeon-Su, a high school classmate now working as a chicken delivery guy. Cheerful, awkward, and hopelessly inexperienced in love, Jeon-Su is everything Myeong-Seong isn’t. On a whim, Myeong-Seong offers to teach Jeon-Su the art of dating, but the lessons begin to blur as curiosity turns to something deeper.

"Kiss me... I taught you last time. Let's see if you remember."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Wang Dam left his hometown and came to Seoul without a plan. In order to receive settlement funds, he had to be the top student in his entire school! However, the school he was transferring to was a so-called 'hard-working' school filled with the worst students who only bothered him when he studied... Will Wang Dam be able to become the top student in his entire school in the worst environment?

(Source: Naver, translated)

I’m stuck on a remote island with the male leads in an R-19 novel. I possessed Margaret, the villainess destined to be killed by the male leads after tormenting the female lead. So to survive, I have to run away from the male leads…… “Marga…… ret?” The 1st male lead’s hand grabbed my ankle as I was about to run away. From the very beginning, my plans were ruined. *** A lot has changed after I went through the twists and turns on the remote island with the male leads who hated me.

“Don’t get away from my side, it’s dangerous.”

“Please let me help you. I’m going crazy for fear of what’s going to happen to you.”

“Look at me, okay? Can you look at me, too?”

The crazy male leads who were supposed to be obsessed with the female lead started to obsess over me. I just want to survive safely! Moreover, this strange tropical island seems to have a deep secret that we have not yet realized.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ci Yunye is an unruly yet clever servant at the Gansu Xie Clan. Xie Xiufan, the eldest son, is the only one he respects and fears despite their differences. But when the clan head's new wife schemes to take over the house and harm their loved ones, the two set out to gain power and get revenge on her. As they strive to do so, they find themselves on the Heretical Path, away from orthodox martial arts. Their skills may be called evil and demonic, but Yunye and Xiufan will bring justice with them!

(Source: Tapas)

Na-kyum is a talented artist who excels in painting beautiful gay erotica, though he does so under a pseudonym. Yet recently, he has given up painting, vowing never to create lewd art again. But the notoriously lust-driven nobleman Seungho Yoon didn’t get the memo—nor will he accept it—and forces Na-kyum to become his in-house painter, demanding the artist create his erotic works just for Seungho to enjoy. Can Na-kyum endure being Seungho’s personal painter of the night or will the late-night activities be too much for him?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes epilogue.

After getting revenge on the Thulcaan Empire, Jack Valantier took his last breath. But just when he thinks it's all over, he finds himself transported back to when he was 14! From his negligent and wicked family to his loyal servant and caring sister, it's all just as he had remembered. But this time, Jack is armed to the teeth with decades of experience from his previous life! He's ready to give them hell, and those that have wronged him will pay dearly. Because this time, he's invincible.

(Source: Tapas)

Zephyr is the last human fighting evil in a world abandoned by the gods. When he is killed in battle by Tartarus, the god of destruction, all hope for humanity seems lost. But Zephyr’s fate is not sealed — the gods who find his battles entertaining have gifted him a second chance at life, as he is sent ten years into the past, back to when he was a slave instead of the most powerful human alive. Can Zephyr get his revenge against Tartarus and save the woman he loves, or is he doomed to repeat the past?

(Source: WEBTOON)

U-Yeon has come to in a very compromising position in front of the people he loves. How is this possible? What’s going on? And why is his brother, U-Jin, whom he detests, here? This isn’t right, it has to stop. But who’s in control here? Is this all a dream? This is no ordinary family dinner…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.english: This is a Campus Romance Series

description:
My name is Ha-Yun Lee, and I'm an ordinary college student. I decided to go on a spontaneous trip before school resumed and met this guy named Kang-On. He asked me out on the first day we met, but of course, I rejected him. I thought I'd never see him again, but guess what? I ran into him during the school club recruitment event! And wait… What? Even Ji-Il, the president of the student club "You," also has a crush on me?! I swear I'm not delulu. I swear!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

Song Ye-eun is a bright and cheerful junior associate on the legal team at LX Pharmaceuticals, hiding a secret that has kept her from ever having a real relationship. When her colleague, the charming company lawyer Jeong Jaemin, accidentally discovers her most private insecurity, Ye-eun braces herself for humiliation.

But instead of mocking her, Jaemin, who has always seemed like the perfect gentleman, makes an unexpected offer to help “fix” it. What starts as an awkward, impulsive promise quickly turns into something neither of them can control. Beneath Jaemin’s polite smile is a possessive, determined man who’s willing to tear down every wall Ye-eun puts up to win her heart and claim her completely.

This sizzling office romance follows two people as lust becomes love, secrets turn into confessions, and a woman learns to trust a man’s gentle hands and unwavering devotion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

"I'll be your friend."

A chilling ghost boy, Hae-Su Lee, visits the outcast, Eun-Ha Ju. The moment she accepts this dangerous friendship, unexpected events unfold around Eun-Ha...

Will this hand offered by her mysterious friend be salvation, or a curse?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Deserting the battlefield, Enoch Rubinstein flees with his newborn daughter Lilith to a small village to raise her disguised as James Brown, a regular, doting single father. But when the order of knights returns to drag Enoch back to the capital, Lilith finds that her father was secretly one of the empire's greatest heroes. As her father's daughter, she also discovers that she holds great potential. Will Lilith be able to keep her family safe? Or will the secrets lurking ahead overpower her?

(Source: Tapas)

"What kind of person do you think I am?”
"…A stranger."

Lee Su-Ha, who has been locked up in an unidentified facility for a long time, is dragged out by strangers one day. He meets a man and starts living with him, before discovering he himself is an Omega who was sold to an Alpha.

"Alright, be like that. Just know that what kind of person I become from now on is up to you.”

He is concerned about the fact he has no heat cycle and is unable to conceive due to his abnormal physical condition, but the man doesn't seem to care that Lee Su-Ha is not fulfilling his role as an Omega.

"You hate it when I treat you kindly. That's why I'm doing my best to accomodate you."

What the man's true feelings are, the hatred he feels towards him, the feelings of déjà vu... Lee Su-Ha becomes more and more confused as the number of inexplicable things keeps increasing...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Legendary SSS-rank hunter Kang Tae-Ha finally met his end. But just as he prepares to enter eternal sleep, he awakens once more in… imperial China?! Now, he must live as Liu Xinyun, the delinquent heir to a powerful company. All he wants to do is put his hunting days behind him, but in order to survive his new power-hungry relatives, Xinyun must hone his skills again, starting from level one. Can his own unique blend of necromancy and martial arts take him from useless bum to ultimate boss?

(Source: Tapas)
With no savings, average qualifications, and a bank balance consistently below 10,000 won, can the Backbone Breaker Gye Baeksun really escape unemployment?

When Yunseol wakes up as Laila el Este in the novel, “Bird Cage,” she is horrified. Though Laila may be beautiful, her beauty is the reason the three male leads obsess over her and make her life a living hell. As such, Laila decides to use her professional makeup skills to become high society’s infamous ugly duckling. But out of nowhere, she receives a marriage proposal from Duke Montefeltra, a fellow outcast who is ostracized for his unattractive looks. Will this turn of events help Laila escape the novel’s bad ending once and for all?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: I Grabbed the Leash of the Blind Beast

description:
When an average twenty-something wakes up in the battered body of a nameless extra from a romance novel, all she wants is to go home. But first, she’ll have to see the story through as Rona, the maid of Grand Duke Ileon, the novel’s hero who was blinded by poison. She just has to make sure the heroine restores his sight with a special flower so they can have their happy ending -- easy enough, right? With a plot gone awry, Rona’s dangerous past, and the grand duke’s affections, can Rona stick to the story?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: How to Survive in a Horror Game

description:
Suddenly thrust into her favorite mystery murder game, our protagonist embodies Arviche Green, a supporting character doomed to bite the dust. Compounding the chaos, she wakes up in the house of the prime suspect, Duke Leikas Learmond, as the in-house tutor to his niece and nephew! Convinced of the Duke's guilt, she juggles evading the main storyline while also uncovering the truth. With her virtual lives dwindling, can Arviche game her way out, or is a game-over fate sealed?

(Source: Tapas)

National Intelligence Service black ops agent Suhyeok is tasked with assassinating Nanayama, the Yakuza leader heading a drug trafficking organization in Korea. To his surprise, the target is a captivating woman named Anna, who appears disconnected from any violence. Sensing something amiss with his mission, Suhyeok embarks on a path of vengeance against both the National Intelligence Service, which has betrayed him, and Nanayama, who massacred his comrades.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Every night at 10, Dong-Gyun locks himself up in his room, grabs a box of tissues, and watches a live cam boy show hosted by Alex, a BJ (broadcast jockey). Timid Dong-Gyun admires not only Alex’s ripped body, but his candor in sharing his sexual experiences with viewers. One night, Dong-Gyun downs too many drinks at a school networking event and passes out. When he wakes up, he’s in bed staring up at a shirtless hunk. A hunk who looks an awful lot like... Alex.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

After a prophetic dream foretells her sister’s death in a political marriage, Arasilla Hugo takes matters into her own hands and marries in her place. Her groom? Demian Vandermeer, the knights’ captain and the brother of her sister’s former betrothed. The only problem is that mages and knights are sworn enemies, and their sharp tongues and stubborn hearts turn every situation into a competition. Arasilla races to save her sister from a tragic fate, while Demian fights for the dukedom. Will their rivalry stay just that? Or will their contractual marriage burn into something more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baek Seung-Hyun has lived in the shadows his whole life, nothing more than the deadly right hand of yakuza boss Shin Jae-Il. But now, Jae-Il is married. And Seung-Hyun, for the first time in years, is left behind. Drifting through empty streets on the night after the wedding, Seung-Hyun crosses paths with Yuta, a delicate ghost from his time in Japan. But what should have been a quiet reunion over a drink turns sharp fast. Yuta’s sweetness curdles, his words cut deep, and before Seung-Hyun can make sense of it everything begins to burn. Uninvited and unrelenting, Yuta storms into his life, dragging with him the weight of the past and something far more dangerous. Seung-Hyun begins to fear that dawn, when it comes, won’t bring light. Only fire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Se-Yun Jung, a 20-year-old rabbit beastfolk, starts college while facing pressure from her family to marry the last dragon beastfolk so they produce offspring. Driven by love, she rejects the push from her mother and vows to find love at university. She soon falls for a senior fox beastfolk while a mysterious senior snake beastfolk keeps appearing whenever she tries to get close to her fox-love.

(Source: Tapas)

Always doing her best to avoid any connection to internal powers in the company until she retires, Mo Taehee. 
Cha Soohyeok, the general manager who has overcome all kinds of obstacles, finally finds his way to be the CEO. 
The love and shameful(?) story of a young man and woman, who spent one night in a secluded cottage with their own secrets, unfolds!

After binge-watching beauty videos online, a shy comic book fan masters the art of makeup and sees her social standing skyrocket as she becomes her school’s prettiest pretty girl overnight. But will her elite status be short-lived? How long can she keep her real self a secret? And what about that cute boy who knows her secret?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 33 side stories.

Jun Yu, a WBA lightweight champion, gets dumped by his girlfriend, then gets hit by a car… and wakes up in a dating simulation game as Yu-Jun Russell, the adopted DAUGHTER of a noble family! The game tells Jun that he can be reincarnated, but only after playing to win over the love of his target characters. Determined to see his ex-girlfriend again, he eagerly accepts the challenge. Will Jun be successful in winning the hearts of his suitors, and manage to return to the world he came from?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Baek Ji-Hwan is used to being alone. Gay, kinky, and unapologetically himself, he never fit anywhere easily. When Seo Jae-Rim enters his life, Ji-Hwan thinks he’s finally found the perfect partner. Until the truth comes out: Jae-Rim is straight, has a girlfriend, and wants Ji-Hwan’s help learning BDSM for her sake. Ji-Hwan rejects him immediately, but Jae-Rim keeps coming back.

Unseen by everyone else, Jae-Rim becomes the one presence Ji-Hwan can’t ignore… his invisible partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Consumed by the flames of a burning castle, an aged butler is reincarnated as the younger version of his incompetent master, Duke Aaron of Brahn. Suddenly finding himself in a position of real power, equipped with his past expertise in estate management, the “new” duke sets out to rule Brahn the “right” way. Will the young Duke Aaron be able to save Brahn and its people from destruction at the hands of his uncle, the evil Emperor Zeron? How will he balance being an effective leader with the ruthlessness required to survive? Only time will tell!

(Source: Tapas)

“Remember? I promised to ruin your life.”

When Leah, a devoted princess, faces a tragic downfall, she plots one final revenge against the royal family by becoming an impure bride. Later, when her one-night stand unexpectedly appears, Leah finds herself unable to resist him as he brings madness into her once orderly life.

(Source: Manta)

5-year-old palace maid Charlie knows that in this world, she will be murdered out of jealousy by the villainous empress at a young age. Her only sources of hope are her plan to escape the palace as soon as possible, and her best friend Rose, a fellow maid who's like a big sister to her. However, when Charlie discovers that the kind-hearted Rose is actually the empress in disguise, her plans come crashing down around her. Can Charlie stay close enough to the empress to make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas)

A crowded subway full of people, and a hand that enters from beneath the skirt. The fear of being seen by others, and the pleasure from his touch, gets the girls addicted.

"I can't believe I came, what's happening to me?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Being popular is nothing new for Hyeok Ji-Seung. He’s always had admirers, and Tae Eon-Ho is just another one, aside from the whole being a guy thing. Ji-Seung found it Eon-Ho's terrible attempts at hiding his crush amusing…until Eon-Ho took things a step too far. Cute is one thing. Breaking into his room and hiding in his closet? That’s another story.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Gaming geek Su-Hyeon Kim hates school, and the dislike is mutual. Every day he faces relentless bullying from his classmates, leading him to wish his life was more like the RPG quest games he plays. Su-Hyeon’s wish is granted when a quest prompt pops up in real life with an easy quest and an enticing reward. With nothing to lose he takes the chance, and one quest soon leads to another. As the stakes get higher and the rewards get bigger, Su-Hyeon soon finds he’s gone from being an ostracized nobody to the top of the school. Just how far will Su-Hyeon take his quests, and how far will he fall if he refuses to participate?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Beta Ji-Han, who had a close relationship with his childhood neighbor and younger sibling, Yun-Seo, ended up in a relationship with her by accident. Afterwards, Ji-Han learned of the sudden pregnancy and that he had manifested as an Omega. The father of the child was undoubtedly Yun-Seo, an extreme alpha, but Ji-Han decided to terminate the pregnancy for the sake of Yun-Seo's future as a college student. However, Yun-Seo readily confessed that both Ji-Han's pregnancy and his trait change were part of his own scheme...

“You were always my omega, you've always been mine.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

"I'm gonna live a normal life!"

Cho-Eun, the heir to the powerful underground clan, Hongsal, has entered university. Her only wish? To make lots of friends and enjoy a peaceful, ordinary college life. But who are these four mysterious guys constantly hanging around her?

"Are you my enemy? My ally? Or... do you like me?"

Thrown into a whirlwind of emotions at twenty, can Cho-Eun finally achieve the campus life she's always dreamed of?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Even a Wild Man Wants to Love!

description:
All Jung Hyun-Do wanted was a steady job, but he faced constant rejection. Determined to toughen up, he goes to Gwidu Mountain to improve his stamina, only to wind up hopelessly lost. In the midst of Hyun-Do's despair, a shaggy-haired man suddenly emerges from the shadows and whisks him away! The wild man introduces himself as Woo Jae-Chang, and a wary Hyun-Do knows this might be his only chance to escape. Will Hyun-Do and Jae-Chang make it off the mountain, or will it be their final resting place?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Life isn’t always perfect, but love certainly makes it better. The exciting tale of young love continues a year following the story “Seasons of Blossom.” Bo-Mi and her university classmate Pu-Reum’s lives center around a new place, “Cafe Blossom & Nemone Art Studio,” as they navigate the joy and hardships of university and professional life.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Harry has fallen hard for his boss, Susan. He knows they can't be together, but their body's think otherwise.

(Source: Toomics)

When squirrel-shifter Beaty Aslan tells her fiancé, Prince Retter, that she plans to flee her abusive aunt, he unexpectedly kills her with his snake fangs. Upon opening her eyes, she finds herself in the past, before she met that rotten prince. With her knowledge of the future, she sets off to her father's duchy to strike a deal and change her fate, but is surprised to find her lion family welcoming her with open arms. Will the stars be on her side so she can rewrite history and get her revenge?

(Source: Tapas)

The moment I gave up on dating in this lifetime, not one but 7 hot guys and girls have appeared?!

Q: Can I flirt with a different person every day?
A: Yes, you can!

(Source: Naver, translated)

A smart, kind boy heads to Seoul to attend college, and lives with his mom's friend and her daughter. A professor at his college is also his mom's friend. Sorry mom, but your friends are really hot! I'll get to know them a bit better...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Sit back and take in this romantic tale of an angelic heroine and her devoted suitors as they vie for the depths of her love... or not. This story’s about to go through some edits! After an accident, a modern-day college student awakens as the story’s villainess, Melissa Foddebrat. She’s far from anyone’s favorite, but she IS the daughter of the duke. Determined to live it up, this new Melissa is doing things her way — antiquated society, be damned! All idiots, prepare to step aside or perish!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 52 extra chapters.

"I... got a boner" is what Ji-Hyun blurts out the first time he lays eyes on Yo-Han's handsome face... It's easy to get laid when you're a pretty, sassy bartender working at a popular gay bar. This lifestyle suits Ji-Hyun just fine since he loves casual hookups without any intimacy… That is until he meets Yo-Han—his big, scary-looking classmate who's actually a pure-hearted sweetie. Can Yo-Han's simple love help commitment-phobic Ji-Hyun heal from the traumas of his past?

(Source: Tapas)

When Mr. Joo and Mr. Young tried to have sex, things went awry due to Mr. Young being too big down there. Eventually, Mr. Joo gave him a second chance due to how besotted Mr. Young seemed to him. The meticulously prepared Master's Lesson is finally starting!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

Delivery driver Kang Han-Gil has spent every waking moment trying to save his father, who has turned into a zombie. Poverty and exhaustion weigh on him, but he refuses to give up. Then someone from his past reappears, Shin Mi-Dum, a man Han-Gil hoped never to see again. Calling himself a “zombie caretaker,” Mi-Dum claims he can cure Han-Gil’s father with a new experimental drug. But there is a price, and his demand is unsettlingly simple, he wants Han-Gil in his bed. Before Han-Gil can decide whether to accept, disaster strikes. His zombified father escapes, the apartment complex collapses into chaos, and the entire building becomes a nest of the undead. Trapped together, Han-Gil and Mi-Dum have no choice but to rely on each other.

With personal grudges simmering and survival on the line, can these two men escape the nightmare closing in on all sides, or will the past consume them before the zombies do?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where warriors are chosen to wield a holy sword and defeat the Demon Lord every hundred years, Kariel is only a guide, bound to support others from the sidelines. He dreams of rising beyond his rank, but the Demon Lord of this era has already been slain. Despite this, the world begins to unravel instead of heal. Monsters grow unpredictable, a mysterious knight hunts champions, and secret organizations move in the shadows. Traveling with his childhood friend Reina, Kariel is drawn into a dangerous mystery that may determine the fate of the world.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Detective Yoon Yeoul tries to catch a groper on a crowded train, he instead nabs Jeon Tae-Heon, a prosecutor at the Seoul District Prosecutor's Office. After a rocky first meeting, they hope to never see each other again, but are then unexpectedly made the faces of a PR collaboration between the police and prosecutors. As they navigate their new roles, all kinds of tension flare between them. With sparks flying and their pride at stake, can Yeoul and Tae-Heon put aside their differences and unravel the mystery behind their puzzling new assignment?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The perfect influencer life. Having a date with the girl you like. Only confession remains, but I got caught up in an absurd terrorist incident?!

"It's not an obsession, we really...! If we break up, we die!!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note:
- Includes five extra chapters.
- Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

A righteous prosecutor, life reset, punish the villain!!!!
A hot-blooded prosecutor, Kim Hi Wu, was murdered and sunk into the ocean while chasing the tyrant who controlled korea. But, Kim Hi Wu, meets a grim reaper who gives him a chance to relive and sends him back to when he was 18 years old. As a high schooler, Kim Hi Wu, prepares to punish the tyrant Jo Tae Sup.
“To get the devil, you have to become one”

Single father, company manager, and former black-ops member, Mr. Kim lived an ordinary life until his daughter, Minji, went missing. After discovering his daughter could be dead, Mr. Kim turns merciless and sets out for information. He will rescue his daughter by any means necessary, even if it means destroying everything and everyone standing in his path.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A college freshman and a gym rat, Ga-Won decides to join the cartoon club with his childhood friend Na-Eun, because he fell in love with Da-Yung, who was handing out forms. When he gets rejected from Da-Yung, he goes to Na-Eun for comfort... but her methods are sexy!

"They say when you do it once, you feel better. Want to fuck me?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: All About Lust: Where We Started

description:
Wooseung, an art student who's only now delving into the dating scene, falls head over heels for Sunjin, the ever-so-charming upperclassman. Imagine Wooseung dreaming up classic romantic scenes, only to find out Sunjin's idea of a relationship is... let's just say… more physical. And it’s not Sunjin's fault! He can't help it when Wooseung is just so freaking cute. From picture-perfect romantic dreams to Sunjin's hands-on approach, Wooseung's in for a wild ride!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: includes 20 extra chapters. This work was first serialised in Lezhin before it got discontinued and moved to Series Naver. There is an adult version and a non-adult version.

Humanity's greatest gym rat Hansol, lost consciousness during a deadlift. When he opened his eyes, he arrived at a different world. Monsters appeared in front of him, and all that he could see was protein...? "I'll flip this world by working out!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

All Margo wanted was some peace and quiet, even if she had to kill her husband to get it. She thought she’d gotten away with it too. She never expected the snowstorm or to be trapped in her house with suspicious eyes watching her every move. Margo’s fate lies in the hands of a strange maid, Peggy, who catches her in the act of destroying evidence. But what will Margo do when the touch of those hands makes her tremble with pleasure? Will she find her respite, or be forced to kill again?

(Source: Tapas)

The human garbage dominant alpha Lee Woo-Hyuk, whose life motto is to cross both legs and be like an octopus, opens his eyes tied to a bed in a cheap motel room. The kidnapper who appears in front of him sets up a camera and places various adult products in front of him, saying that the customers want to see Woo-Hyuk being abused…

"Purpose? To eat the trash dominant alpha pups?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.

Rumor has it that Ba-Ram Oh had an affair with her married art professor. It’s been four years since that debacle, and now she’s back at campus to try and enjoy her college life. But she’s not the only thing who’s returned: there’s rumors of a water ghost roaming the halls, and it just might be following her around.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After saving little Amber from an abusive foster parent, hitman Tennessee gains someone worth protecting for the first time in his life. But the older Amber gets, the more his obsessive love for Tennessee grows, despite his rescuer still seeing him as the same little boy from years ago. It isn’t until Tennessee gets into an accident that leaves him with face blindness that the lines between them begin to blur. Tennessee knows in his head that this is still Amber, but his impairment makes both the younger man’s face and Tennessee’s own feelings for him unrecognizable...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Terminal Teacher in the Doomed Duke's House

description:
Livia Plington is out of luck. Not only was her fortune stolen, but she's caught a fatal disease, and the only thing that can save her is the mysterious heirloom of House Mercedes. Livia's solution? Infiltrate Mercedes Manor as the young lord's private tutor and find the heirloom herself! But as Livia plays teacher, she comes to care for her student and even the tragic Duke Mercedes too. Can she heal the hearts of this family as well as heal herself? Or is this terminal teacher doomed to die?

(Source: Tapas)

When Diana le Pereshte is convinced that sacrificing her vision will restore her daughter's lost eyesight, her blindness reveals the hidden truth of her home—her "daughter" is her husband's and best friend's lovechild. Cast aside and left to question the fate of her real daughter, she succumbs to her death only to find she's woken up in the past, her vision now restored. With a second chance, can Diana find her real daughter and exact revenge, or will she find herself lost in the dark once more?

(Source: Tapas)

As if being framed by her love for plotting a murder weren’t enough, Rinette learns that her stepsister, Kanna, is the true mastermind behind it all. As she’s burned at the stake, Rinette makes a desperate wish for another chance…and wakes up as her younger self. Determined to change her fate, she vows to stop Kanna’s schemes and protect her family this time around. But rewriting the past is far from simple. Each choice she makes brings unforeseen consequences—some more devastating than she could imagine. Can Rinette escape the shadows of her past, or will they consume her once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: What Happens When You Mess With the Original Novel

description:
After possessing a piteous side character in a novel who is fated to die, Seraphie doesn't waste any time lamenting her fate. Instead, she sets out immediately to change the original plot and save herself from an untimely end at the hands of her abusive father. She'll stop at nothing to save herself from any bit of suffering, even if it means messing with the lives of the main characters. But is it really that easy to change a story's plot? Or are some things just destined to happen?

(Source: Tapas)

With a warm family that showered her with love, Iyanelle’s life was a bed of roses. That is, until the day she found herself bleeding out on the ground beside her dead father. The culprit? Her beloved brother, Crown Prince Agris de Roahim. Heartbroken and betrayed, Iyanelle could only accept her impending death. However, it seems fate has other plans for her… Next thing she knows, she’s been reborn as a divine fox! In her new form, will she be able to bring her ex-brother’s conspiracy to light?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
Final season of Cheese in the Trap.

It is my cursed destiny to be reborn endlessly. A king, an archmage, a slave, a saint, a witch... I’ve done it all in my thousand years of life, and frankly, I need a break! My goal now is simple: to live like an absolute sloth. Unfortunately, I am Rubia, the daughter of a grand duke with a demanding family and a fiancé to boot. To live my dream sloth life, I’m running away from it all... except no matter where I go, nobody will leave me be! I just want to nap, but being lazy is hard work!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Possessed a Villainess, but I Wanna Raise Cats!

description:
Seo Eunsu was only looking for her lost cat when she was hit by a truck. The next thing she knows, she's in the body of Lewayne Rarsel, a villainess from a novel! She's the cruel paramour of the emperor and has nothing but contempt for therianthropes, people with animal forms. Now, the only way to avoid her fate of becoming the emperor's consort is to marry Duke Dimitri de Blua, a feline therian. But can the duke forget her notorious reputation and realize that Lewayne just wants to raise cats?

(Source: Tapas)

What does it take for an animal to live and survive? What would it choose to die for? A T. rex, washed ashore and stranded on an island for over 20 years, waits for the day he can take his final breath. But just when that moment seems near, hope arrives.

A collection of stories about the great creatures that have roamed the Earth before us.

(Source: WEBTOON)

1-19. Gaji Aneun Gil (가지 않은 길, The Road Not Taken)
20-28. Pokgun (폭군, The Tyrant)
29-40. Manghyang (폭군, Nostalgia)

Laranora Ador gets more than she bargained for when she rescues a young boy from being sold off in an infamous auction house. The boy is actually Eskal Van Dyck, the "Crazy Marquess," in disguise! Unaware of his violent and heartless true nature, Laranora takes Eskal under her wing. Determined to raise him with utmost care and respect, Laranora grows deeply attached to Eskal… and in return, the true Eskal begins to fall in love with her. Unfortunately, Eskal is often targeted for his powerful magic and ruthless ways, which leads to a tragic event that separates the two. But Eskal is determined to find her again as his true self. Will Laranora be able to accept who he really is? And more importantly, what will happen when something fishy brewing in the Imperial Palace may involve them both?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Taking lunch orders and cleaning up after your coworkers is all part of the rookie experience. But Jieun takes it all in stride, and as the newcomer at Rendezvous Cosmetics, she’s excited just to learn the ropes while earning a modest wage. But this office is far from sunshine and rainbows, and the company’s president, Ma Seongjun, is a venomous terror within its walls. After she makes a mortifying love confession in his presence, Jieun is caught in Mr. Ma’s web of torture. But that confession wasn’t meant for him! It was for her true love--Mr. Kang from the department over! Unfortunately for Jieun, there’s no turning back once the boss sets his sights on her. Will Mr. Ma eventually sink his fangs into Jieun? Or is there actually a gentle soul hidden underneath her boss’s cruel exterior?

(Source: TappyToon)

The maniac who was crazy about all kinds of fields, such as military and steampunk, had been reincarnated. However, his father was King Se-Jong the Great. The mania-wise king and his crazy maniac son. Along with the ministers and countless humans who were getting exploited. Even today, the night of Joseon was filled with the light of overtime.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

For years, Ho-Yeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction. Then one day, Tae-Bum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence. Ho-Yeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully. But Tae-Bum, already prepared, meets him without fear and gives himself over completely. Fine. If he wants to play that game, then Ho-Yeon will take him to the very end. Let him see if he can handle it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kang Geon, 17, transfers to a prestigious high school for only the top 0.1% of South Korean students. Raised as a secret agent in North Korea since the age of five, he is a genius and a human weapon. He is tasked with infiltrating South Korea's upper class and building connections. However, making friends proves to be a much bigger mission. This spy action drama follows Kang Geon, who lives as a fake family with his hacker father, who is under international surveillance, and his legendary assassin mother, and finds true happiness!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: Noble in Name, Vulgar at Heart

description:
Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. On her 28th birthday, she was tragically killed, yearning for a love that never came. Perhaps out of pity, a mysterious force sent her back to when she was 16. Reflecting on her painful past, she makes a vow:

"I shall beg for love no longer. I will never love nor be loved again."

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jobless and down on his luck, stock trader Jang Taesan was wandering aimlessly when he saw a speeding car racing toward a child. Though he saves the child’s life, he dies in the process. Reborn 14 years in the past, Taesan is a high schooler again, but he still remembers everything, including every top stock! With his family’s finances in tatters, it’s up to him to use his market foresight to change their fate. He may have failed in his past life, but this time his success will be legendary!

(Source: Tapas)

Jin is the most perfectly beautiful man Matthew’s ever seen. He’s also a high-ranking and violent criminal full of frustrated ambitions and equally frustrated appetites. But Matthew, a sculpture student prodigy, can only see the beauty—not the darkness. One way or another, Matthew will pay the price for his muse, with his body... or with something far more costly.

(Source: Tapas)

Yun Ha-Jun, who struggled to pursue his musical career despite his iffy talents and ended up sacrificing his own family along the way.

"If only I could turn back time...! "

One day, after living with regrets and alcohol for a while, he woke up and found himself had returned to the past. Just then, it dawned on him.

The fact that my younger sister is a musical genius...! Now is the time to turn my life around, by producing my younger sister into becoming the best singer!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Why I Quit Being the Demon King

description:
Demiurgos DCLXVI, or Deus, is the 666th resurrection of the Demon King, fated to battle a warrior of the Pure Blood clan every 100 years to liberate his fellow demons from hell. But instead of waiting, Deus escapes 20 years early to forge a new identity among the humans.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The night before Lee Jun is set to open his own animal hospital, his childhood pet Pebble visits him in a dream, giving him a mysterious gift. Jun successfully treats his first patient, but when the dog thanks him for saving his life, Jun realizes he can speak to animals! Word about the vet who can understand them spreads quickly among the four-legged residents of the neighborhood, and they come flocking to Jun’s hospital. With his new ability, will Jun be able to save all these furry friends?

(Source: Tapas)

Hello, viewers! Welcome to the world of monsters, where certain people are awakened with specific characteristics and can become hunters. But our MC, Si-U, was awakened with absolutely no characteristics. How useless! Just when he'd lost hope... Ding! “Subscribe to gods' channels and get god-like characteristics.” Now, with the skills of the gods, Si-U, a used-to-be nobody, is making his name heard throughout hunter society. Like and subscribe to see if he’ll be able to pull this off!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Yeon-woo can’t help stumbling into pervy situations. What a creep would call a blessing is her curse. Case in point: going through an alley one night, she walks in on a couple making out. Except this time it’s worse—the couple is actually a vampire and her victim! The vampire, Hayang, is willing to let it slide… for some of Yeon-Woo’s blood! Could this be the start of a bloody good time?

(Source: Tapas)

Being hated at work is one thing. Getting falsely accused of peeping is another. Driven to the edge, one man has finally decided to stand up for himself, and get revenge on his female coworkers. They'll all fall eventually.

 (Source: TOPTOON+)

When Hazel Mayfield is sent to live with the Martins as a child, she falls in love with rural life and vows to have a farm of her own one day. Eleven years later, she receives an unexpected windfall as her grandfather hands her the deed to a plot of land in the middle of the capital. Ecstatic, Hazel sets out to realize her longtime dream of becoming a farmer. There’s only one problem: Her new farm is right next to the imperial palace! And it seems the emperor himself has his eye on her land…

(Source: Tapas)

Ryugeom Cheok, a loyal Goryeo warrior, throws himself off a cliff with his enemy to protect his master—only to be frozen in ice for 900 years. Awakened in the modern era, the greatest swordsman of Goryeo begins his journey of vengeance…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seo Hyunsoo is sure of one thing: people are scum and they will always disappoint you. Sure enough, at his very first company dinner after his transfer to a new department, he finds his coworker, the obnoxiously upbeat Baek Youngchan, performing an unsavory deed in the men's bathroom. As much as Hyunsoo would like to avoid Youngchan from that point on, Youngchan seems intent on not letting him out of his sight... Will Hyunsoo be able to evade the encroaching chaos of his new work neighbor? Or will these two clashing coworkers find that opposites really do attract?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

It all started with a retirement. A legend in the underworld of killers and assassins, Sihyeok Cha, otherwise known as “The Red Shirt,” leaves a life of violence behind for his loving wife Miju and their unborn child. Little did he expect, however, that bonds made in blood cannot be so easily erased. When tragedy strikes, Sihyeok is dragged back into the deadly struggle between mob factions… and the fight is far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Marrying your childhood best friend and first love may sound like a dream come true – but not for Renee. After marrying into a contract marriage with Alexander, Renee faces all sorts of trouble, but none can match her own husband’s cold shoulder. However, a magical wish might change everything. Can a simple wish save Renee’s failing marriage?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After flunking the civil service exam, Kim Youngsoo spends his days working part-time at a pork cutlet restaurant, struggling to make ends meet. He plans to give the exam another shot down the line, but for now, his small moments of happiness in his mundane life come from treating the cute guy who drops by the restaurant to pork cutlets every now and again. Amidst the routine of his simple and peaceful life, an unexpected disruption arrives in the form of his neighbor, Lim Joongdo: a rude and conceited jerk who hurls insults at Youngsoo from the moment they meet. Frustrated and disheartened, Youngsoo chooses to just ignore Joongdo completely. But then...out of the blue, Joongdo does a complete 180 and starts acting all sugary and sweet. Did Joongdo genuinely have a change of heart, or is he sugarcoating his words to hide a bitter motive?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 26 extra chapters.

As an illegitimate princess, Anastasia Entimos has died in just about every way imaginable. Every time she dies, she is brought back to the moment of her birth and forced to relive her tragic fate. It is only in her 10th life that she discovers her father is the esteemed knight and war hero, Paeon Parschel! Determined to escape her miserable fate once and for all, Anastasia vows to use her aloof father as a stepping stone to freedom. Will the 10th time be the charm for this ill-fated princess?

(Source: Tapas)

Yun-Oh has only one person in the world who he can rely on: his hyung, Hae-Won. For years, Yun-Oh has harbored a secret, unrequited love for Hae-Won, who is not only someone he considers family but also his sole protector. As a beta, Yun-Oh believes a future with Hae-Won, an alpha, is impossible, so he keeps his feelings buried deep and stays quietly by his side. But when Hae-Won unexpectedly goes into rut, Yun-Oh is caught up in the whirlwind, and his carefully hidden emotions are laid bare.

What will become of their fragile bond when Hae-Won discovers the truth Yun-Oh has tried so desperately to conceal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The human world is on the verge of destruction after the attack of the Demon King Erodin. After the fight against the Demon King, the Gold Dragon Exigar is reincarnated as Kain Logdel, a human who is a lout that knows nothing about magic. While trying to escape from his sword-crazed family’s duties to stay at the training camp by hiding his sword skills, Kain is on the verge of being exiled because of the unexpected message from his Family Head... Amidst all of this, the Demon King, with her new appearance, is also looking forward to reuniting with him?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

When Dae-Ho was a child his parents were killed in a tragic accident. Afterwards, he was taken in by his late father’s friend Mr.Cha and was raised with love and care. Now, at age 20, Mrs. Cha realizes that Dae-Ho hasn’t been properly taught about growing up into a man. He keeps having wet dreams and she feels he needs someone to show him how to relieve his urges. She takes it upon herself to show him how it’s done...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Do-hee Woo and Hae-Gyung Kim are both young and single, each with a history of broken relationships in their past. They meet one day while trying to dine alone at the same restaurant and they soon become friends who eat together every week. But with each meal, their friendship grows deeper as they help each other heal from the heartbreak they have suffered and soon they must redefine what they mean to each other.

(Source: Spottoon)

“I’ll repay that 450 thousand for you…but in exchange, you’re mine.”

Due to the debt left behind by his father, alpha Seo Taeyoon is at the mercy of Park Jae-in, a mob boss with a penchant for violence. But when Taeyoon is able to identify Jae-in as an omega by scent alone, the ruthless criminal is taken aback – because nobody should be able to smell his pheromones.

Seeing this as his opportunity to regain what once was lost, Jae-in offers to pay off Taeyoon’s father’s loan in exchange for a life of servitude. Now Jae-in holds the key to both the physical and metaphorical locks around Taeyoon’s neck. And so begins their relationship as master and slave...but there's no telling how it will end.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 25 extra chapters.

The lives of two men are thrown into chaos when the sexy Chun Duna returns to town. On one end is student Woo Haesol whose timid nature reveals a man just begging to be dominated. On the other is Professor Byun Minho, a male chauvinist who bitterly views Duna as his mortal enemy. Tempers flare as pain turns into pleasure under the watchful eye of a sadistic beauty.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: The series was cancelled by Lezhin at 51 chapters. It has since resumed serialisation on BomToon.

Sang-Nam lives by one unshakable dating philosophy: “before you commit to it, you must hit it.” If the chemistry isn’t right, he won’t even consider a relationship. The problem is, finding someone who actually meets his standards is harder than it sounds. That’s when he notices Da-Ol, a potential hottie with a not-so-sexy body. Sang-Nam casually suggests that he might consider dating Da-Ol if he can “fix” him to suit his tastes, and a nervous but determined Da-Ol agrees. What Sang-Nam doesn’t know is that Da-Ol has a secret preference of his own…and one he definitely hasn’t told anyone yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A girl who has been alone her whole life stumbles upon a VR fantasy dating simulator that allows her to be who she always wanted to be — someone loved by everyone. She chooses a character named Crocetta Gaetani, who grew up neglected by others just like her. Now she’s stuck permanently in the video game world until she can win over one of the game’s male leads and beat the game. Will Crocetta be able to marry one of the male leads and finally return to her reality, or will she be stuck in this VR nightmare forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A child was abandoned in a forest infested with monsters and ghosts. Woon Sowol was adopted by the five masters and learned the best magical techniques. Although the five masters are godly beings, now their inner balance is on the verge of being broken down. Woon Sowol takes revenge on behalf of his masters, and goes to the world to become a god. In the end, will Sowol be able to get out of the forest of beasts?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

How far are you willing to go for love?

Not a day goes by that Eve doesn't wish to reunite with her childhood friend, Mikha. But three years later, when she learns that Mikha has become a cursed sorcerer who leaves only death in his wake, Eve must embark on a journey to save not only the man she loves but also the world as she knows it.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: You Think It's Easy Rewriting a Story?

description:
Reincarnation stories are all the rage these days, but I never thought I’d be the one getting reborn! But still, life as a rich man’s beautiful daughter is pretty sweet... except for one thing. No matter what I do, where I run, or who I romance, this novel is dead-set on getting me hitched to the handsome duke destined to kill me! There must be some way to change my fate, right? I won't go out like this!

(Source: Tapas)

Yoon Bum, a scrawny and quiet man, has a crush on one of the most popular and handsome guys in his college: Sangwoo. After the two cross paths again, Yoon Bum's feelings grow in intensity until they become an obsession–and he breaks into Sangwoo's home. But what he sees inside is not the Sangwoo of his fantasies; his dreams of this alluring man abruptly turn into a nightmare.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Notes:
- Won the Grand Prize in Lezhin's 2nd World Comic Contest.
- Includes four extra chapters.

In Ergosphere Online, a VR MMORPG craze, O-Reum Lee is harshly mocked by his party members for being a mediocre healer. Not only that, his teammates in the game bully him in real life at school. O-Reum's saving grace is his alternate character, a powerful Avenger class character that he plays with extraordinary skill. One day when O-Reum logs out of the game, a glitch in the system imbues him with his alternate character’s abilities and forces him to fight against evil monsters from the in-game realm. Will O-Reum survive the game world and his school life at the same time?

(Source: WEBTOON edited)

Luck has only been on Yeon-Woo's side twice in his life: when he and his brother were saved by an esper named Seo-Joon, and when he reunites with Seo-Joon as a 20-year-old guide. Unfortunately, Seo-Joon doesn't seem to remember saving Yeon-Woo. Not only does the older man see Yeon-Woo as a kid, but he also makes it clear that he doesn't want to get attached to any guide. However, there's no telling what'll happen when their sync rate is so high and Yeon-Woo has had a crush on Seo-Joon for years...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Gangster Joo-Geon Kang, aka “Black Kite,” gets more than he bargained for when he shows up at Jae-Joon Min’s clinic looking for a certain intimate surgery at his boss’s request! Unable to resist this intimidating guy and his excellent manhood, Jae-Joon gets himself into trouble after a few nights of bliss and has to get out of town fast. He’s on the hunt for the father who abandoned his mother at her time of need. But Black Kite isn’t going to let him get away that easily. Better watch out, Doc!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Dungeon Cleaning Life of a Once Genius Hunter

description:
World’s first SSS-ranked genius hunter, Junu Kim. He regresses ten years into the past after being ambushed by unknowns one day. With all his hunter skills now locked, he must fulfill his career as a dungeon cleaner to unlock them. But this cleaner… is extraordinary! The once renowned hunter, Junu Kim, takes over the cleaning duty with vigorous determination.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A scholar who failed the national exams is picked up by a martial arts master and given the task to record his life into a book. Through their journey, Son Bin meets many great people and soon finds himself following the same path as the master, as the Martial Arts King.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Duke's Bored Daughter is My Master

description:
I was an illegitimate daughter abandoned by the promiscuous emperor. From there, I ended up on the street where I learned that I had a knack for the sword. I competed in tournaments, became a mercenary, and I made a name for myself. Just when I had become the talk of the empire, the emperor wanted me back. In return, I demanded to be next in line for the throne. After years of hard work, I finally became empress and died happily. But here I am, alive again. Ugh, can’t a girl be left alone? This time, I’m going to be as lazy as I please!

(Source: Tapas)

"Am I a beast or a human?"

This is the question that has plagued Leon his entire life. Born of a human mother and an ogre father, he has spent his days in hiding, away from those who would brand him an abomination. But after a threat to his village forces Leon to unleash the violent nature he had been suppressing, his existence becomes known to the world... With relentless hunters now on his tail, Leon must face his true nature and fight for his life against a world that demands his death.

(Source: Tapas)

17 years after her own reincarnation, Adelaide hears that a dimensional traveler has suddenly arrived at the imperial palace. Just the jolt of excitement my boring life needed, she thought! Attending the debutant ball to meet this new Susanne, Adelaide ends up making a deal with the handsome duke Felix: become his “fake” fiancée so he can keep the gold-digging Susanne away from him! As Felix warms to his companion, can Adelaide win this battle for his heart? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Notes: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: The Reincarnated Assassin Is a Swordmaster

description:
Raon was once a loyal assassin for House Robert until Derus killed him. Not willing to give up, Raon prayed for vengeance and woke as a member of House Sieghart, the most powerful noble house. He’ll need all of their near-infinite resources to get revenge. Though he carried over knowledge of a powerful Flame Link technique, he also carries the Curse of Bitter Frost, something that’s slowly killing him. As if that weren’t enough, the demonic embodiment of Wrath is trying to take over his body.

(Source: Tapas)

In the realm of martial arts, you’re either strong or dead. Ilyong Kim learned this the hard way after spending seven years training, only to die at the hands of a master. Resurrected in his home dimension, Ilyong’s experiences have granted him the power he’s sought all along. As an Awakened with no mana, Ilyong struggles getting a guild to accept him, but his fighting prowess quickly sets him apart from other new adventurers. But can he keep up with the monsters he must now face?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Must the Reincarnated Mother Always Die?

description:
Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. However, her mission’s greatest obstacle is her new husband, Emperor Helio. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. Thus begins the battle of wills between wife and husband. Will Lilliana be able to defy destiny and Helio’s affections?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Many people dream of being reborn as a princess in another world. And Ha-Ri, an ordinary woman, finds herself in that exact situation… or so she thought. Instead of flowy hair and the beautiful face of a princess, she has stubby limbs and shiny black toe beans. Yup, she’s been reincarnated in a palace in another world as a dog. And a talking one, at that! Will she be able to survive as the pet of the emperor rumored to be a ruthless tyrant? Will she ever be able to turn into a human? Find out in this humorous story about a little talking puppy living in a fantasy world!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

World War III has ended, but Ji-Min’s troubles are only beginning. A superhuman bloomer, he’s enslaved in a scrapyard, where his life changes after he finds and repairs Aurora, a discarded battle bot. Post-war exploitation of the weak and clashing factions has given rise to the Second Lost Generation. Even if they escape, they’ll still have to grow up in the chaos. But can they outrun the Stalker Bot and the mercenaries hot on their trail?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Arsel de Leahr knew her fate as soon as she realized she was inside the world of a novel. To prevent her eventual tragic death, she turns to the secret pirate of the empire, Duke Gael von Zenat. Arsel proposes marriage to him in exchange for access to her family's valuable sea territories, and he gladly agrees. But even though Arsel thinks their union is a mere formality, Duke Zenat falls deeper in love with her. Can their marriage stay afloat? Or is it doomed to sink to the bottom of the ocean?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: includes three extra chapter.

“Merry Christmas.”

When I opened my eyes after that unexpected drenching, an old friend stood before me, unrecognizable. Dan and Jerry, the wild duo who had attended every party during their college days, were friends who were so similar and well-matched, yet they drifted apart due to a certain incident. Ten years later, on a White Christmas Day, Jerry, who was gambling at a casino, was kidnapped by Dan. Dan then proposed a chess game to Jerry, making it a bet.

“If I win, let's go to ‘that forest’.”

As they played chess, recalling that incident they both wanted to forget, a tense atmosphere hung between them. In this uncomfortable situation, as Jerry tried to escape, Dan pointed a gun at him. And seeing Jerry, who could have killed him but didn't, Dan finally voiced the question buried deep in his heart...

“Back then, you...”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Set on a path to tragedy and misfortune from a young age, Aseph Randell is doomed to die a villain. That is, until the mysterious Elzay Tiathe appears in his life with a promise: "I can save you." After having vivid visions of him for so long, can Elzay untangle the twisted fate tied to Aseph... or will they both be dragged down together? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: TappyToon)

title.romaji: Yeok Harem Game Sogeuro Tteoreojin Moyangimnida
title.english: I Fell into a Reverse Harem Game!

description:
I woke up in a strange bed, with not just one, but two lovers beside me! In this game of love, affection, and deception, I’m Elvia, the Imperial Princess, with a gaggle of men vying for my favor. Sounds great, right? Except this means I'm also stuck as the villainess while the main character is my manipulative maid, Arielle! She’s out to bring me down, and she’s got plans for my harem of men. But I know all her secrets, because I can see her player notifications. Can I beat her at her own game?

(Source: Tapas)

Who said rural life is peaceful?

Tricked by his grandfather, city boy Jiyool stumbles into Heedong village and is now the local vet. Nothing seems to go right for him in his new life, until in a sudden turn of events he is reunited with his childhood crush. Will he survive this bumpy ride on country roads?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Dream of Health, Wealth, and a Long Life

description:
Lady Adrianna isn't just a noblewoman, she's the side character in "Ramona's Tale," the favorite novel of an ill peasant girl who died tragically young. This is her second chance at life, and she's not reliving that tragedy! An evil stepmother's not gonna stop her, and Rian slowly gathers handsome companions along the way... the calculating imperial prince, the friendly count, the mysterious and brooding demon prince. After all, she is determined to live a long, healthy, and wealthy life!

(Source: Tapas)

Han-Jun is the weakest hunter alive. While others wield powerful skills, he’s stuck with a useless copy-paste ability and mocked by everyone around him. Cursed during the Great Calamity, he has only five years left to live… but Han-Jun refuses to give up. When a chance discovery reveals his skill’s hidden potential, everything changes. As he rises through the ranks, a new calamity begins to stir. Time is running out, and Han-Jun may be the world’s last hope—an unlikely hero with a power no one saw coming.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

In high school, he thought she was a bully and she thought he was a huge jerk. Years later, Han-Eol and Da-Hae meet again... because their siblings are getting married! But tragedy strikes the newlyweds and their loved ones are left to wonder how they could have saved them. Han-Eol and Da-Hae awake to find themselves in high school again—and their siblings are alive! With only each other and a diary to rely on, can they weave a new destiny for their siblings? Or will fate unravel all the same?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Despite being thirty-three, Young-won sure is gullible. He falls in love way too easily, comes on way too hard, and still believes that he’ll meet “Mr. Right” sooner or later. Not that he knows who “Mr. Right” is, but he sure does know about “Mr. Wrong,” a.k.a. Kang Hyun-woo. Young-won swears that he’ll never, ever get together with this polar opposite of his, but the universe sure seems to think different. One drunken night, they end up in the same bed and Hyun-woo proposes an intriguing deal… Will Young-won end up with a broken heart yet again, or will he end up finding what he’s been looking for this whole time?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Cheong-Yeon is an academic legend with a soul of ice. To save his college applications from a failing character evaluation, he agrees to mentor Su-Han, the school’s most notorious troublemaker. Su-Han earns nothing but zeroes and lives with zero motivation. While Cheong-Yeon only wants his college recommendation, Su-Han just wants to be left alone. As they clash over study habits and life choices, the top student begins to find his missing empathy and emotions in the most unexpected place.

(Source: Tappytoon)

On death’s doorstep after being stabbed by an assassin, the one thing Idris is sure of is that she doesn’t want to die. Her fate seems sealed until her husband Khalid, the terrifying archduke of Caltes, makes a cryptic promise to save her life.
