That’s when Idris wakes up a year earlier, on the day of her wedding, with a chance to redo it all. But while she’s grateful to be alive, her memories aren’t adding up. The Khalid she remembers was a ruthless tyrant, but the man before her now is affectionate and kind. Was their loveless marriage just a horrible dream or has Idris’s past become twisted in reality? She has no choice but to trust Khalid’s heart if she wants to survive and find out who tried to kill her.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Woo-Ri Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Su-Bin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woo-Ri wakes up back in high school, right beside Su-Bin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Su-Bin’s hands, Woo-Ri becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woo-Ri finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Su-Bin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woo-Ri sets out to give Su-Bin the happiest life possible.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After an intense night of drinking, Dawoon has a dream about the kiss he and Jin shared back in high school, something he had long forgotten. He feels uneasy but ignores it, blaming the dream on his long hiatus from dating—until he runs into Jin on campus the next day. Jin seems unusually playful and clingy, poking and prodding at feelings buried in Dawoon’s heart. When Dawoon confronts him about it, a casual reply—”We just kissed”—only adds fuel to the fire. As their long-standing friendship begins to blur into something more, Dawoon must confront his own complex feelings while Jin comes face to face with his heart’s desires.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I'm Kang Yong-ho, the Chairman of Choi Sung Group, one of South Korea's top 10 conglomerates. Just when I was basking in the glory of my retirement declaration, out of the blue, a new employee fell from the sky and landed on my head. But hey, where'd my body go, and now I've turned into a new employee?!

"What's this? Are you telling me to start with Excel or something?"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lee Young-Jin has never been like other Omegas. Rather than being physically superior to humans like the rest of his species, Young-Jin is a gifted hacker. But when his talent leads him to an ill-fated heist mission, Young-Jin finds himself trapped in the clutches of a powerful Alpha businessman named Seo Seung-Hyun. Now, he must do anything he can to guarantee safety for himself and his colleagues - even if it means sleeping with the enemy. But as the business deal between Young-Jin and Seung-Hyun quickly becomes more personal, will they be able to see eye to eye? Or will their differences be too much to overcome? Set in the Omegaverse.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Scrawny high school student Ho-Bin Yoo is probably the last guy you’d expect to star in a NewTube channel that revolves around fighting. But after following some advice from a mysterious NewTube channel, Ho-Bin is soon knocking out guys stronger than him and raking in more money than he could have ever dreamed of. Can Ho-Bin keep this up, or will he eventually meet his match?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Seo-U always knew that running away from the son of a murderer would eventually haunt her, but she never expected to be locked underground with him. Years after she abandoned Won-Hyeok following a bloody secret on some stairs, a twist of fate traps them together in the suffocating darkness of an abandoned bunker. As the heavy door clicks shut, Seo-U must decide if the boy she betrayed is here to finally protect her, or if he’s been waiting all these years to exact his revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Nobleman Park Hyowon is no stranger to the pleasures of the flesh. If anything, he’s actually quite experienced. So when a friend mentions an oh-so-secret sex toy workshop, Hyowon’s interest is thoroughly piqued. But the coarse Shinwoo is nothing like the refined artisan Hyowon expected, and he finds himself drawn in by the man’s almost rude nature. So much so, that he’s determined to get past that rough exterior, and what better way than by targeting his pride? Accusing Shinwoo of lacking confidence in his products, Hyowon demands a hands-on demonstration, and soon gets much more than he bargained for when Shinwoo shows him pleasure he could never have imagined. There’s just one thing Hyowon can’t figure out. Just how much of his pleasure is caused by the art…and how much by the artisan?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Finally, Byeokwu has mastered it—the Sacred Art of Grand Clarity, one of the most precious arts of the Gonryun Clan. But nothing he learned in seclusion could’ve prepared him to understand the state of things one hundred years later. Leaving his clan behind, Byeokwu starts a new life as a chef at the Gonryun Tavern, determined to help the owner turn a profit. And if his noodles are good enough to tempt the Divine Demon of the Bloody Heaven into changing his ways? Surely, there are worse things.

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Yang runs away to the other world after getting caught sleeping with a married woman... The best married woman in this world, and a bed? Can Tae-Yang complete his harem in this other world successfully?

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: Let Me Kidnap the Male Lead!

description:
Following a carriage crash, our heroine recalls being reincarnated as Vivian in a novel called "The Bloody Flower." Poor Vivian now knows she's a side villain who dies after kidnapping the male lead. But if she doesn't kidnap him and guide him to the female lead, the demon will destroy the world anyway! Unfortunately, the male lead was only described as "handsome," and this world is crawling with handsome men. Thirty kidnappings later, all Vivian has is a handful of good-looking fans who loved their luxury hostage experience. If only someone could point her to the man she's looking for...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Will You Be My Male Lead?

description:
Ah-Rah Shin was secretly in love with Seung-Woo Han, her childhood friend. Unable to express her feelings, she wrote a novel, molded the male lead after him, and confessed her love in the pages. He never read it, but everyone else did, and her first novel was a hit! Now a famous web novelist, Ah-Rah struggles to write her second book without a muse until she meets Joo-Won Cha. Joo-Won is the ideal male lead. He's handsome, professional, and very different from her first male lead! There's only one issue... he's the CEO of her publishing company!

(Source: Tapas)

Childhood friends Eun-Ha and Seung-Min used to be inseparable until Seung-Min started running with a bad crowd in middle school. That marked the end of their friendship, or so Eun-Ha thinks until she runs into Seung-Min again in college! As if that wasn't jarring enough, his appearance has done a complete 180, and Eun-Ha can't figure out why. Everyone thinks the former delinquent is a quiet nerd because of the way he dresses and behaves. But once Eun-Ha starts talking to Seung-Min, she gets the feeling that he hasn't changed as much as his glasses and plaid flannel would suggest...

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

I chose the thing I could do right away to pay off my debt, and for me it was sales. And then I was given another chance

(Source: Naver, translated)

Joo-Hyun dreams of a romantic first time with someone he truly loves. Enter Seo-Jun, a shameless flirt with undeniable charm (and a body to match). Determined to stick to his ideals, Joo-Hyun finds himself wavering as Seo-Jun’s relentless allure tests his resolve. Will his heart win over his head, or is this just a disaster waiting to happen?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Not everyone is infatuated with their boss like Doyoon. Ever since Gang Taehyuk's days as a 2nd gen idol—a pop star from way back—Doyoon has been obsessed. So, what does he do when Taehyuk retires and establishes an entertainment company to nurture new talent? Naturally, he trains to become Taehyuk’s personal secretary, landing the coveted role. But Doyoon’s life takes another dramatic turn when a member drops out of a new idol group just about to make their debut. There’s no one better suited for the role, and Taehyuk wants Doyoon to step up and fill the spot. Besides, Taehyuk is willing to sweeten the deal with a wish, so looks like Doyoon is gonna have to leave the office and step into the spotlight…

(Source: LezhinUS)

title.english: My Sweet Enemy, Thy Name Is Husband

description:
My husband, my nemesis. Till death do us part.

Canach Riadon — a slave who rose to emperor and the man I wed in my first life. Yet our ill-fated marriage left my family murdered and my homeland destroyed at his hands. Now given a second chance, I vow to succeed in this political marriage and save all I love... Or will his love save me first?

(Source: Manta)

Mumyeong Heo’s grandmother passed away years ago. But when he visits her home to spend some time in the quiet countryside, he notices that someone kept it clean all this time. His new neighbors aren’t exactly thrilled by his visit. In fact, most of them don’t want him around. But that’s when his nasty neighbors go missing one by one… for better or worse.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One dive shattered To-il’s future. Once a rising star on the 10-meter platform, a brutal fall forced him into eighteen months of recovery. Now he returns to the pool, where rivals have surged ahead and every leap carries the shadow of his past. Along the way, he discovers teammates who lift him up, rivals who test his limits, and the fragile but unyielding hope of youth. In the air, seconds feel eternal. Will To-il soar again or will the water claim him once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Netkama – a male who portrays himself as female online. This is what Kim Seyeong decides to become after reencountering Shin Heejae, the guy who destroyed Seyeong’s gaming career in “Arcadia” a year prior. His plan is to pretend to be a girl in the game, get Heejae to fall for him, and then make the big reveal to everyone so that his archnemesis will also be humiliated out of “Arcadia” forever. But being a dude trying to become the girlfriend of your worst enemy is no easy feat, especially more so when said worst enemy starts to show a bit too much interest in you. Will Seyeong come out the victor of this scheme? Or will he find himself losing to Heejae all over again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Sir, please bless me with your superior baby seeds❤️"

He had clawed his way up from nothing, building a kingdom in his dusty hometown without any help from his parents. Having lived so fiercely, he left his company to his sons, in hopes to spend the rest of his life in peace. However, his naughty daughters-in-law were not going to leave him alone- not his dick at least.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Ga-Jang No is a strong, dedicated, and humble man, with much respect for the martial arts. After the death of his lovely wife, this muscle-for-hire just wants an easy job that allows him to be a good father to his three little babies. He’s even happy to pull guard duty and fend off amateur fighters if it means he can return home safely each night. But when a creepy cult starts stealing children from the city, Ga-Jang must step up to the challenge and discover his true warrior potential.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Welcome to Arcadia! The world's most plausible virtual reality game created by three major conglomerates, Ajin Electrons, Sillicoff Industries, and Argos Corporation. Join Jaeyeong, a legendary gamer who goes by the ID Dex, on a chaotic adventure as he hops in the capsule Dreamer to access the fantasy world of Arcadia! Are you ready?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jaehyun may be the composed upperclassman on campus, but he secretly plays the hottest elven diva online with a love of pricey costumes. He meets Eunsung, a handsome first-year with deep pockets guarding his own secrets, at a school event. They connect instantly, but what begins as a sweet challenge becomes a risky game of affection on- and offline!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Only Fence, a platform filled with sexual content. You know what? You can make tons of money on this site with porn. So come over here, dork! Take your pants off.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Am I dead, or am I alive? After Seong-Hun gets bitten by a zombie, he soon realizes that he hasn’t completely turned into one. Yes, his movements are slow, his urge to bite humans is strong, and his looks are completely different. But he remembers. He remembers the scent of his crush, he remembers how to read, and he remembers that he should protect his friends. Unfortunately, the other intelligent zombies seem to disagree with the last bit...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra chapters

Orange cats have a reputation for chaos, but not Big Cheese! This clever feline has a mission: play matchmaker and help two clueless souls find love.

(Source: Toomics)

Framed for a crime she didn't commit, Isabel died leaving behind her little daughter. Ten years later, she awakens in another woman's body, with only one year left to live. But the world she returns to is even crueler. Her daughter is now married to the very man who murdered her, all in the name of revenge. With just one year, Isabel must find a way to save her daughter, no matter the cost.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Surviving as the Crown Prince's Childhood Friend

description:
When Ella finds a sickly young boy suffering from a mysterious illness in a cave, she brings him home, only for her to discover a special healing power that helps him recover. Six years later, Carl has grown into a striking young man, but to Ella, he remains like a brother… or so she thinks. Though childhood friends, what Ella doesn’t know, is that Carl is the lost crown prince of the Easton Empire, believed to have perished in a fire… and is only biding his time to make things right again. But Carl has another secret–his feelings for Ella go far beyond family…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Life at Hyosan High School is nothing special… until the students realize they’re in ground zero of a deadly virus that turns its victims into flesh-eating monsters. As the virus tears through their schoolmates in a matter of hours, they realize they have nowhere to run. Trapped in their high school with zombified versions of their friends and teachers, they must find a way to fight -- and escape with their lives.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Soohan likes his uneventful days working at a small ad agency. But when new guy Taeyeol from a big-shot ad firm joins the team, all his quirks gets on Soohan’s nerves – most especially the undeniably good looks that remind him of his first love…

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

“You smell.”

One day, Tae-Gyeol, a 20-year-old returning student, is suddenly told by a classmate he's never met before that he smells. Though flustered by this remark he's never heard before, he tries to brush it off as a minor incident. Offended by a teacher's remark comparing him to another returning student from a different class, Tae-Gyeol impulsively heads to the classroom. There, he encounters none other than Mu-Won, the very person who had told him he smelled. When Tae-Gyeol confronts him about the earlier comment, Mu-Won evades the question with an ambiguous, half-hearted response. Annoyed by this, Tae-Gyeol finds himself strangely unable to look away from Mu-Won. Finally, Tae-Gyeol approaches first and proposes they become friends.

“Want to hang out with me later?”

“No...”

Even though he clearly said no, Mu-Won is waiting for Tae-Gyeol at the school gate after class. What exactly is this guy's true intention?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: The Dangerous Convenience Store: Eui-joon's Dream

description:
As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-Jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans.

“As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”

(Source: Naver, translated)

School is home to judgmental eyes and home a source of abuse. But that's ok because Junyeong Yun found an abandoned home where she could study to her heart's content. Unfortunately, soon after, Beomjin Kwon, the town's most notorious delinquent, has also begun using the home to catch up on sleep. As the two are forced to coexist, they come to learn about their reasons for avoiding others.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Reborn in South Korea in 2026, former hero Yong Sa-Jun struggles to adjust to a world without magic or dragons. After surviving a brutal job market, he finally lands a position at a major corporation - only to come face to face with the man he once loved in his past life: the prince he failed to save. Haunted by memories of tragedy, Sa-Jun tries to keep his distance. But when he discovers that the prince has been cursed, Sa-Jun resolves to save him once again…even if it means juggling deadlines and danger alike!

(Source: Lezhin US)

For 10 years, Pyung-Hwa Gong and Sae-Byuk Shin have kept their love a secret from family and friends. But then, the alpha and omega pair invite their old classmates to their daughter's first birthday party, ready to reveal their unbelievable love story. Strap in for the romance of a lifetime!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: This Wasn’t in My Adoption Plan!

description:
I spent a decade cleaning up after Duke Havenik Brauno’s mess only to be murdered by him? Reincarnated as Aerin Brauno, an illegitimate child of the Brauno family, she’s horrified to find her adoptive father is none other than the man who killed her. This time, Aerin refuses to let him control her fate. Armed with the knowledge from her past life, she’s determined to escape his grasp and find a new path. Can she rewrite her destiny, outsmart the deadly Duke, and maybe even save the Brauno family?

(Source: WEBTOON)

"Your husband must be… ridiculously handsome…”

Leah Uzkal, who grew up obsessed with good looks due to her mother’s last wish, is shocked when her arranged marriage partner is King Mikrok of Fritan, the War Demon. Refusing to marry a man she’s never seen, she decides to run away—until she bumps into the most handsome man ever.

“Who are you? State your name and status.”

“I’m Leah Uzkal… your future wife. ♥”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Having been outed at work, shoe designer Park Seok-Yeon is forced to start all over. He gets a new job at “Youm,” an up-and-coming brand with an accepting work environment and generous perks. It seems like the perfect company until Seok-Yeon finds out that the CEO is none other than his former crush, Jin Yeowon, the cold-hearted jerk who nearly drove him to end his own life. Now, they must work together, but will old feelings well up? Like a sudden downpour, love appears when you least expect it.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

It’s a rude insult when lowly and headstrong servant Edna comes to marry Duke Eli, instead of the noble daughter he expected. But the ambitious maid hides an even bigger secret behind her obvious ruse – one that could change the kingdom’s very history. Can the two find freedom, redemption – and love – without drawing their swords on each other? Based on the hit novels.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Country life is supposed to be idyllic, isn’t it? A peaceful place full of amiable neighbors with big hearts, right? That’s what Ji-Woo is looking forward to… But out of all the next-door neighbors to have, he gets Dong-Chan. Curt, stand-offish, and inscrutable, Dong-Chan isn’t the most welcoming of folks. In fact, he looks like he doesn’t want Ji-Woo and his family here at all. Bemused but not daunted, Ji-Woo tries his best to adjust to life in the country…until it turns out that someone is trying to chase his family away from here. Jiwoo has his suspicions, but will he be able to find the real culprit?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 48 extra chapters.

Rebecca, who went undercover as a spy to eliminate the mafia, intentionally approaches Daniela, the only blood relative of the mafia boss. However, as Daniela grows up and her affection for her grows, she begins to lose her sense of purpose and starts to distance herself from her. However, she fails to notice the desire hidden deep in Daniela's heart, and after carrying out the operation, Rebecca's daily life becomes increasingly tangled...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: The Flower That Swallowed the Beast

description:
A bargain for her life, to escape a tragic future. When Iris Whittle is murdered by her sadistic husband, she is sent back in time to when she was 20 years old. As the unwanted daughter of a duke, Iris realizes she can leverage her status and foresight to secure a better life this time around. Thus, Iris makes a daring marriage proposal to the fearsome Count Keibrandt Green, the most eligible bachelor of Gavizar Empire, whose gruff and stern demeanor hides the fangs of a wolf.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Cherry Blossom Empire, known among players as "the weak princess game," is a game with the objective of keeping Princess Tatiana alive until her 18th birthday. That's easier said than done since Tatiana dies just from eating cake! So when an avid gamer who's finally cleared this frustrating game is reborn into it as Tatiana, she has to do it all over again, starting as a baby... But with a potential death ending lurking at every corner, will Tatiana's gaming skills be enough for her to survive?

(Source: Tapas)

The mercenary Tened gathers information to find his younger brother. One day, he gets a clue that his missing younger brother is related to the Great Chapel. Tened is assigned to escort a carriage to the Great Chapel, and the mission, which he thought would proceed smoothly, falls into chaos due to an attack by heretics. As a result, the carriage he was escorting catches fire, and Tened hurriedly opens the carriage door to take out the holy relic. However, instead of the holy relic, there is a child sitting in the carriage...

Tened rescues the child without hesitation and escapes from the heretics. After that, Tened sets out on a journey to take the child to the Great Chapel, and the child feels strange feelings when he sees Tened being kind to him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Since childhood, Bak-Ha has been able to see "things" that others can't. On the first day at his new school, Bak-Ha meets Jin-Do, and due to the sickeningly sweet smell Bak-Ha has, Jin-Do notices he is different, just like himself. As they get closer, Bak-Ha finds out that he was the moonchild, the mythical creature who ruled the spirits in the past, and realizes that this is why the ghosts and demons are after him.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Expensive shoes, a nice watch. Smoldering good-looks. That’s the new guy, Doh Jaeha, appointed to lead a new team in the company. Tae-eun is a third-year copywriter who’s vying to join this new group to move his career forward. Jaeha seems a bit strict but if he’s achieved this position already at his age, he must be competent, right? But something suddenly dawns on Tae-eun… This Jaeha...is this the same Jaeha he went to school with, his first crush?! Second chances at love don’t come around very often. But they were just kids when they first met, surely things are different now. Still, this guy is confident, hot and seems interested, why not make the most of this opportunity? But office romances are always complicated and there’s a new air about Jaeha that feels just a little off… Love and lust ensue but things aren't quite as they seem...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

It's more than just coincidence.

Young Pal-Jae drifts to the isle at world's end to be taken in by Mun-Ryeong, a hermit with a mysterious past. But when Pal-Jae begins to waste away in the sun-bathed climate, Mun-Ryeong takes his little companion on a journey to the cold north that uncovers their forgotten past encounter.

(Source: Manta)

The leader of the demonic cult is a formidable entity that everyone is afraid of. However, while the demonic cult members expect him to exude great violence, the new Demonic Cult Leader, Do Yu-Gang, wishes to live a simple and peaceful life. Will his modest wish be granted in the end?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After being neglected in her past life, Izelle is ecstatic to be reborn as a rich character until her family suddenly goes bankrupt! While thinking about what to do, she's given the perfect chance to solve her financial crisis when she saves young Archduke Karl Byron from being bullied. Unfortunately, Karl doesn't remember her at all when they reunite as adults, and she has no choice but to coerce him into helping her. Can Izelle get what she wants, or will Karl be more trouble than he's worth?

(Source: Tapas)

Geon-Yeong is a brilliant girl. Despite being underprivileged, her exceptional intellect allows her to enroll in the prestigious Pyeonghyeon High School. There, she meets new competitors and friends. She struggles to compete with all the other privileged students who have expensive lessons. Amidst these challenges, she is determined to succeed and become a judge. This is Geon-Yeong's journey to prove that despite the disadvantages life has dealt her, she is worthy of respect.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The story of Hana, a genetically engineered mouse who escapes from a laboratory.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Lia, a penguin-turned-human, hides her anthropomorphic self from her dad for fear of abandonment and hatred. Fleeing her home, she’s discovered by Souradel—a killer whale anthro with a thing for penguins. His obsession with her fluffy belly leads to wild misunderstandings, mistaken kisses, and hilariously tense encounters. Now, Lia must dodge his affections while keeping her identity secret.

(Source: Tapas)

Born into a family of handsome, wealthy, and well-educated alphas, Woo-Young always expected he would be the same. Come to find out, he was the odd man out as the lone omega, and not even a perfect one at that. To compensate, Woo-Young goes through life pretending to be a beta, but when he begins to experience hormone imbalances, irregular heat cycles, and a distinct lack of control over his impulses, his lowly recessive omega status becomes impossible to ignore. That’s when he meets Kyung-Ju, a powerful and successful dominant alpha who can turn him into a true omega, and also makes him weak in the knees. Now, Woo-Young must use every tactic there is to court Kyung-Ju and make the brooding alpha his very own.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 23 side story chapters.

title.english: The Tale of the Skeleton Messenger

description:
120 years have passed since the First Emperor’s death. Venlyra, a powerful rogue and trusted herald of the Emperor, awakens from a long slumber to a crumbling empire that has strayed from the light. Once more, the Skeleton Messenger makes the rounds, bound for a decaying throne, and for the embers of a self long thought extinguished within. Hear ye, hear ye! Hark, and heed the Emperor’s words! The hour of reckoning is upon you!

(Source: WEBTOON)

My mom brought home a pair of beauties from Bali. The daughter is cute and all, but the mom is a real smoke show. She's our new maid, so she has to do what I say right? Well let's just see how good of a worker she really is... ?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: The Twin Sister Goes on Strike

description:
It is imperial belief that twins are bad omens, so Rosette Sigran was out of luck when her twin sister, Lea, was born a saint. Despite possessing the saint’s mark, however, it is not Lea, but Rosette who has immense divine power. She does her best to help Lea with her holy acts, but their power-hungry father only sees Rosette as a blight on the family, and so he transfers Rosette’s power to Lea and has her killed. Rosette then wakes up years in the past, but this time, she’s done playing nice.

(Source: Tapas)

Boasting a kempt appearance and brains to boot, Yaha seemed to have everything required to become the queen. But she lacked one very important skill - the one required upon nightfall in his majesty’s chambers. After being ignored by the king on their first night as a married couple, Yaha’s anxieties multiply amongst rumors that the gorgeous court lady Seo-kyung has been reappointed. In order to overcome this challenge, Yaha summons a famous “novelist” to the palace for some private lessons. It’s clear that Yaha has much to learn, but just how far will they take these lessons…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Soon-I, the daughter of the Kim family in Doldamgeori, is very concerned about her older sister who sells medicinal herbs at the market. There are many rumors about her sister selling medicinal herbs behind the cloth, but Soon-I does not believe them. She takes care of all the errands for medicinal herbs in the neighborhood and goes to see her older sister every day, and eventually she even dreams about her sister. Then one day, she finds her older sister taking a bath in a hot spring in the forest while it is snowing heavily, and she is captivated by her older sister's gentle smile and enters the bath...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

Hans wakes up as a minor character in Vantablack Ring, a game he's cleared countless times. To survive the monster attack, he decides to stick close to the hero, Kadith, only to see him immediately killed in battle. Shocked, Hans sets out to find the other heroes... but soon learns that the same fate awaits every one of them and that he seems to be absorbing their abilities. With his plans to lay low gone awry, will Hans have to become the hero and save this world himself?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

It’s been about a year since Lee Eun-Kyum started working at his office job. He’s outgoing and gets along well with his co-workers, but his success with romantic relationships is less than stellar, especially since he tends to fall hard and fast based on looks alone. History seems poised to repeat itself in the form of his new boss, Han Ji-Hyuk.

The handsome Han Ji-Hyuk is exactly Lee Eun-Kyum’s type, but his personality is a total turn-off as he proceeds to work Lee Eun-Kyum to the bone. The more aggravated Lee Eun-Kyum feels, the more he can’t get Han Ji-Hyuk off his mind. Could this heated attraction be mutual?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After dying due to an unexpected accident, Kim Yohan reincarnated as Johann Aitz of the prestigious Aitz Family. He may have been born a noble, but Johann Aitz ranks at the very bottom of the family hierarchy. To make matters worse, this world revolves around a ruthless medieval society. “The only person you can trust is yourself.” In a world ruled by the law of the strong, survival requires only two things: money and power. While training relentlessly using the knowledge he gained in his modern life, Johann ends up encountering Kaegal, the Master of Poison of the Empire’s greatest assassination guild, the Nesos Guild. This is the fierce struggle of Johann, who refuses to become just another prey of this brutal era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Chomin has been violently bullied since middle school, but when his estranged brother suddenly dies in a motorcycle accident, Chomin finds out he was the leader of Imperial Gang, a huge gang. Now in possession of his brother's phone, Chomin seizes this chance to get revenge on his high school bullies by ordering his brother's underlings to beat them up. But the King Game begins when his brother's girlfriend shows up and threatens to expose him unless he cooperates in taking down a rival gang. With his life now on the line, can Chomin manage to continue this farce?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Superheroes of Class F: Rebooted

description:
Can’t be the superhero? Be the supervillain.

Welcome to Leaders Academy for the Superhumanly Gifted! As Korea’s most elite superhero institution, we aim to bring out the best in our students and encourage them to use their powers for the good of— Pardon? Class F, you say? Apologies, but we don't talk about Class F here.

(Source: Manta)

Thanks to his false bragging, Geon-Woo's friends think he has lots of experience in the bedroom when he's actually a virgin who hasn't even kissed anyone before. When Han-Eul, the pretty upperclassman Geon-Woo admires, asks to sleep with him, Geon-Woo is nervous but on cloud nine. However, Han-Eul's intimidating friend, Ji-Ho, is waiting for them at the place of their hookup. Not only that, but Han-Eul insists on having a threesome with Geon-Woo and Ji-Ho, claiming it's the only way he can be satisfied! And so, poor Geon-Woo is trapped in a dangerously filthy throuple with no way out...

(Source: Tappytoon)

After waking from a long slumber, the vampire Isle discovers his home has been taken, leaving him with nowhere to go. Taken in by Loan, he puts his extraordinary talent for identifying counterfeit wine to use, while slowly recovering fragments of a past he thought was lost. As his memories resurface and their unequal relationship deepens, desire, power, and fate begin to intertwine in ways neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When a sudden fire forces Jae-Gyoung out of his shared living quarters, he's left scrambling for a place to stay-- all while struggling to stay afloat. Just as things seem to take a turn for the worse, Seong-Beom, a college classmate of Jae-Gyeong's, surprises him with a streak of generosity. He offers Jae-Gyeong a spare room in his apartment-- free of charge. But the two couldn't be more different, Jae-Gyeong is reserved, while Seong-Beom's outgoing nature seems to fill every room he enters. As they navigate the challenges of sharing a home, and a budding friendship, their clashing personalities ignite tension, possibly warming up to something more. Will their spark turn into a roaring flame or die out into embers?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 side story chapters.

Seyden is the captain of the Paladin’s Order, and it is one of his duties to protect Bellota, the Saintess of the Empire. However, his feelings for her go beyond what duty demands from him. When he discovers that Bellota has been cursed to need a man’s seed in her every full moon, he volunteers to be the one to spend those nights with her. Although Bellota treats Seyden coldly, his determination to protect her and find a way to lift the curse remains unchanged. Will he be able to break this curse before it breaks Bellota’s spirit?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: How To Ride the Hero's Coattails

description:
Ever read one of those webtoons where an obnoxious male protagonist transmigrates into his favorite game, uses his knowledge of the plot to become ridiculously overpowered, and somehow gathers a harem along the way? Now, imagine reincarnating into that story! That's what happens to Nahyeon, but unlike the freewheeling teenager of a hero, she has no interest in becoming the main character. After all, it's way easier to stick right at his side and benefit from his grand plan! Or so she thought...

(Source: Tapas)

Amidst a worldwide zombie apocalypse, genius researcher Doctor Hwa Seok’s predecessor has been murdered. Now, Hwa Seok has been assigned the best bodyguard the military can offer, but Major Suhwan Kwak certainly has better things to do than protect a delicate, oddball scientist—like getting him into bed, for example. Doctor Seok can tolerate Major Kwak’s brash, crass, and impassioned behavior, but with a murderer at large, can he trust him with his life?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Life as an Internet Novel

description:
Every novel has the usual cast: a gorgeous heroine, handsome boys vying for her attention, and a homely best friend at the heroine’s side. Dan-I, an ordinary student and avid reader of internet novels, is all too familiar with these tropes. But she never imagined that one day she’d wake up at the center of one herself! Her new fictional world is complete with a beautiful best friend named Yeo- Ryeong, and four impossibly good-looking boys who all happen to be in her class. Dan-I is determined to stay out of the way and not get involved in the twists and turns of the plot. But is she really just the sidekick -- or is Dan-I actually the leading lady? Anything is possible in the world of a novel!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

A society where martial arts warriors dominate the underworld. Heo Pung-gae, a Taoist monk who has been living since the end of the Joseon Dynasty, compulsively practicing good deeds and following the path with the impure motive of not wanting to die of old age at the end of his lifespan, suddenly undergoes a reversal one day... Among extremely selfish people, he loses meaning in the good he does. Will the bragging dog be able to achieve the climb he wants?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Doya Seo, a demon, is one day captivated by a mysterious dream. That same day, he happens upon Wish So, a new freshman. Curiously, each moment their paths intersect, Doya finds himself engulfed in a perplexing whirl of emotions and physical sensations that his demonic sensibilities fail to decipher. Meanwhile, Wish finds herself amidst a flurry of events after being invited to the home of famous actor Jaehyeon Woo. In a world where the supernatural coexists with humanity, and caught between the devilish charm of Doya and Jaehyun’s allure, will Wish be able to navigate her school life without trouble?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: A Single Dad in Another World

description:
OHis wife has gone missing. His baby daughter is terminally ill. But as Junhu falls to his death, he wakes up in his wife’s unfinished dark fantasy novel--a world infested with vile demons. Armed with knowledge of the story, he allies with powerful demon hunters to avert the tragedies to come. Yet every action rewrites the story in unpredictable ways, and Junhu must seek answers if he hopes to keep his daughter safe.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yu-Jin, the model student who dreamed of medical school, threw off her pace with a brief high school romance and blew her college entrance exams. While retaking them, her thug ex-boyfriend Jun-Ha reappears before her eyes. Is he trying to sabotage her exams again? Or is it genuine lingering affection?

A sexy campus romance between two people so different they can't help but be drawn to each other.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Junsu is an ordinary college student who spends an extraordinary amount of time trying to beat a pay-to-win hero collector game called Arcane Seoul. All his hours of painstaking gameplay finally pays off when he lands Cheonma, one of the ultimate SS-ranked characters in the game, seconds before a truck runs him over. Now, he finds himself as Jeonsa Kim, a basic tutorial-stage character who can learn any skill. Can he use his gaming knowledge to survive the godforsaken, magic-driven, and monster-ridden alternate world of Arcane Seoul?

(Source: WEBTOON)

"Sir... Promise you'll guarantee my success in return for claiming my body..."

In the corrupted athlete training center, players are ravaged by the coach’s absolute power. Their hunger for success intensifies, and they slowly begin to crumble under the weight of their own desires.

(Source: DAYcomics)

When Do-ha has been kicked out of his parents’ house and is in dire need of a place to live in, he finds his sanctuary in a beautiful, brag-on-social-media-worthy shared house in Home5. It’s the perfect place for him! There’s exactly one catch: the owner of the place is Si-woon, his first love from high school. It should be fine, though. They’re cool with each other now, they both have their own lives, and there’s no lingering feelings whatsoever, right? …Right?

(Soruce: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.

I woke up inside my favorite novel, not as the protagonist, Luca Winterwald, but as Judith, his abusive aunt and the first character to die—time for a rewrite! I’ll hand Luca off to his loving, long-lost uncle as scripted, and then live my own life far from danger. At least, that was the plan. When his uncle arrives, Luca suddenly calls out, “Don’t leave!” Now, I must protect Luca from impending family tragedy, raise him to become the hero, and turn this villainess’s ending upside down!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Lyrica is a hardworking 8-year-old girl who has always used her vivid imagination to escape the harsh realities of living in the slums with her neglectful mother. After her mother has a premonition of a disastrous future, she snaps to her senses and devises a plan to provide a different life for Lyrica. But even Lyrica couldn't have imagined that the plan was to marry the emperor! Now that she has everything she could ever dream of, can Lyrica face reality in spite of her wild imagination?

(Source: Tapas)

Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

(Source: Tapas)

The story of Yun-Ji, an innocent new teacher at Charlene Prep Academy. She wanted nothing more than to be kind and respectable. But before she knew it, she became the object of their darkest desires, and now she craves it too.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.english: Trapped in a Hentai Game Academy

description:
He left a really negative review on a hentai game... Only to wake up as the main character! To make things worse, he will be killed by the god of games unless he gets all 6 girls in the game to fall for him!

"Damn it... Fine, I'll do whatever it takes to get all the girls!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

As a stickler for rules and a knight with the highest regard for honor, Sigrid believed her loyalty would be unswerving and true... until she is killed by the liege she serves. Just when the guillotine's blade hits her neck, she wakes up to find herself five years before her execution. With a second chance at life, Sigrid swears to change her old ways and avoid her wretched fate. Unfortunately, she soon discovers that shaking off her past may not be as easy as she had imagined...

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 25 extra chapters.

title.english: The Archmage Becomes the Swordmaster's Youngest Daughter

description:
Rosette was a mage and assassin who lived as a mere tool, mistaking control for love, until her choices led her to kill Duke Adrian, the Empire’s legendary swordmaster. Haunted by regret, she uses ancient magic to send herself back in time and fix everything that went wrong. However, although she succeeds in returning to her childhood, she ends up being adopted by the very duke she murdered in her past life. Will Rosette’s knowledge of both magic and the future be enough to rewrite a tragic destiny and change fate itself?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Bullied in school, and now reunited... Can I get my payback?

(Source: Toomics)

Raised in darkness, Ji-An learned early that giving up was the only way to stay alive. Then Hwan arrives: bright, irresistible, and dangerously easy to love. Their relationship feels inevitable, intoxicating, and fleetingly perfect. Until everything falls apart when Hwan takes Ji-An’s place in a hit-and-run accident. Desperate, Ji-An rushes to the hospital, only to be met with unfamiliar eyes and a cruel voice.

“You smell like an omega. It’s disgusting.”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joo Yeomin, a diligent college student burdened by an unjust debt, struggles to make ends meet through multiple odd jobs while evading persistent loan sharks. His wary nature around strangers is understandable, especially when he keeps encountering one in particular! Enter Yeon Tae-seo, the privileged chaebol heir. To Tae-seo, Yeomin appears at the most inconvenient times, sparking suspicions of paparazzi. Determined to put Yeomin in his place, Tae-seo initiates a high-stakes game of cat and mouse. But what happens when both players risk getting caught in their own trap?

(Source: Lezhin US)

For Sehyun and Yumi, taking sexy pictures was just a side gig. That is, until Hannah came into the picture...

(Source: Toomics)

Jin Yu-An is a shy, sweet-faced sub who’s never actually tried any real SM play. He’s never had a partner or a lover—mostly because he’s way too busy, kind of a scaredy-cat, and hasn’t found anyone who fits his taste. One day, while browsing a BDSM app, he stumbles upon a profile that makes his heart race… only to realize the guy hasn’t logged in for years. Still, hoping against hope, Yu-An starts sending him cheerful messages. And then—a reply.

[You got a death wish?]
[Can’t you see my age?]

Oops. He missed the guy’s age. And the terrifying attitude in the response? Yikes. But somehow, Yu-An gets stubborn and insists on meeting him. The guy is exactly his type—intense gaze, scary tattoos, and an aura that screams danger. BDSM? More like organ theft??

Still… should he give this scary-sexy dom a shot?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

The fate of a girl in a BL novel is a tragic one. Girls are either vaguely helpful, evil, or add nothing to the plot. So what happens when you turn into the older sister of a BL novel protagonist? The older sister who dies a tragic death at the hands of a madman who’s infatuated with your younger brother? You go with your gut instinct: hide him. Hide your brother from everything, especially men, that could harm him and you. That’s the task that Kyla Vesta is set with in this life, and a task that she’s determined to complete.

(Source: Lezhin)

With her outstanding business acumen, Min-Gyeong Kang climbed the corporate ranks of TK Group, Korea’s top conglomerate, to become a senior manager in record time. But after 10 years at the company, she’s been assigned to be the secretary of I-Seop Tae, the successor to TK Group. The two entered the company at the same time, but ever since he came second place to her at new employee training, I-Seop’s never taken kindly to Min-Gyeong. She’s better than him in every way and trampled all over his ego… so why can’t he stop thinking about her?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Hyeonsu's life took a turn for the worse when a fire left him covered in burns, his father in the hospital, and their family smithy in a blaze. But just as he was losing hope, his friend had an idea: If he can't be a blacksmith in real life, why not try it in Ares, the AI-powered virtual reality game? With a bit of luck, he might make enough money there to pay for his father's hospital bills. With so many irons in the fire, can Hyeonsu rekindle the flame of his passion and rise from the ashes?

(Source: Tapas)

Do you ever wonder what the most popular boy at school is really like? As it turns out, he might be just as awkward and shy as any of us. That’s what wallflower Ja-Yu Nam begins to discover after a chance encounter with Ja-Hyeok Yeo, a boy in her class who seems to excel at everything in life. Well, almost. Underneath Ja-Hyeok’s persona is a secret super-introvert who would rather just stay home, except his charming good looks keep forcing him into social situations. Together, Ja-Yu and Ja-Hyeok begin to learn a little something about friendship and maybe more…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

A car accident leaves both Taekin, a high school outcast, and Heechan, a business owner, in the hospital. But Heechan has no time to sit around and enjoy his hospital bed. If he doesn’t get up and make sure his clients get their products, his business will be in jeopardy! There’s just one problem. After the accident, he now inhabits the body of this high school kid every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Talk about an out of body experience! Heechan decides that the way to fix things is to go to Taekin’s high school in the boy’s body and sort things out himself! While looking for the source of their transformation, Heechan sees a familiar face from his own past. But who is going to believe this ridiculous scenario and help him out? Just how is Heechan going to get his body back?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Gyemoinde, Jugeumeul Pihaneun ge Neomu Swipda
title.english: A Simple Guide To Surviving as a Stepmom
title.native: 계모인데, 죽음을 피하는 게 너무 쉽다

description:
When a girl abused by her father wakes up in a novel as Luella Masimelle, the cruel stepmother of the protagonist Hirah, she is determined to make things different. To do this, she proposes a contractual marriage to Duke Huppert to make him Hirah's guardian, but the duke surprisingly seems genuinely interested in her. And with the once timid Hirah also starting to open up and show affection to her, Luella begins to wonder if she'll finally have a happy family... Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

Baek Jinwoo, savior of humanity, is done with being a hero. In his last moments, this battle-scarred warrior vows never to pick up a sword again. But by some cruel twist of fate, he finds himself reborn as Riley Finn Epheletta, the youngest son of an esteemed family of swordmasters! When trouble comes knocking, Riley is forced to make a decision — take up the sword, or let his loved ones die. Will the “Lazy Sword” finally bloom into the legendary swordmaster he was always destined to become?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Youngest Has Much To Hide

description:
Amid the chaos of war, young Rubian realizes a shocking truth: she’s trapped in a novel where the hero dies suddenly, plunging the world into disaster. Luckily, fate leads Rubian to enter the hero's household—giving her the perfect chance to stick close, prevent his death, and leave once the crisis passes. Yet the warmth and affection she receives from his family are unlike anything she's ever known, making it harder to remember that she’s there to stop a tragedy… not start a slice-of-life!

(Source: Tapas)

Dakyung Lee, an elite member of a criminal organization, learns of the death of her beloved boss. Upon discovering that Chairman Lee was behind it, she vows to take revenge. Yet, since he’s protected by the Sa Yeong Group, all her attempts appear futile. Just as Dakyung is about to give up, she uncovers details about the chairman’s son. In a final bid for revenge, she infiltrates his son’s school, Chaebol High School.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Legend of an Asura - The Poison Dragon

description:
The mighty Medicine Faction has fallen to the evil hands of the Venom Clan. As they travel across the land, taking out each clan under the faction, Zhen Ziqiang becomes a test subject for the Elder of the Venom Clan. After being injected with various poisons, Ziqiang rises from the depths of hell as an Asura. Full of anger, he escapes and begins to plan his revenge as the sole survivor of his faction. Now, his goal is to destroy the entire Poison Faction and give them a taste of their own venom.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: From a Knight to a Lady

description:
When Estelle meets her untimely death, she is a valiant knight of the Kingdom of Ersha. But death is not the end for Estelle - four years after her demise, she finds herself reincarnated in the body of Lucifela Aydin, the spoiled and cold-hearted daughter of a count in the Empire of Jansgar. To her dismay, she finds that her country fell to Jansgar years ago, and that she is now betrothed to Zedekiah Heint, the son of a count and her adversary in her previous life. Can Estelle discover the truth behind her death while attempting to navigate her new life as Lucifela?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

Princess Evienrose, despite advocating fiercely for the rights of the homunculi rebels, now awaits death at their hands… that is until she is poisoned by her own sister! Awakening eight years in the past, Eve now has one goal: become the Empress and liberate the homunculi to stop the rebellion from ever happening! To do this, she appoints the rebel king himself, Mikaelis Agnito, as her personal knight. But with Eve’s scheming sisters standing in the way, the fight for the crown is on, and the fate of the Hadelamid empire rests in her hands!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Delivery Man From Martial World

description:
Stranded in a new world, Smiley Kang covertly lives the life of a delivery man. Until now, humanity has fended off demonic beasts and their portal “gates.” There are the Awakened, citizens imbued with supernatural abilities, and there are those more scheming, fighting to monopolize and claim demonic resources. But as the number of gates starts to rise, the world is at risk once again. Can humanity survive another onslaught of demonic beasts? The answer lies with the mysterious delivery man…

(Source: Tapas)

For years, basketball player Lee Ahn has kept his feelings for his older friend Geon-U locked away. But when he hears the sudden news of Geon-U’s divorce, his heart starts racing all over again. When Geon-U reaches out to ask him to model for his company, Lee Ahn knows he has to take his shot.

"I'm too horny to focus on basketball... Could you help me out?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Seo Ji-Hun, a 9th-grade civil servant, longed for a long, peaceful life. However, he was stabbed to death by a malicious complainant, and opened his eyes in the martial arts world where martial arts existed. He longed for a quiet life there, but an unavoidable figure appeared before him.

"Choose. Death here, or becoming my disciple."

The old man, who suddenly thrust a knife into his throat, was the leader of the Cheonma Sect. Believing that survival was the only way to achieve success, Seo Ji-Hun, reluctantly, decided to become a Cheonma. Originally a capable civil servant, he grew into a unique talent within the cult with his powerful martial arts skills and exceptional wisdom—but why does his workload keep piling up? Why does he keep getting promoted? His original goal was simply a "peaceful life," but somehow, his second life spiraled into the path of the Cheonma. Will he ever find the life he truly desires in this world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Perhaps karma does exist. Han Nokyoung, an A-list actor with a foul attitude, winds up getting his just deserts when a video of him sleeping with LK Entertainment’s CEO, Kang Junil, surfaces on the internet. To make matters worse, Nokyoung soon becomes the victim of an acid attack, ending his career entirely. With even his boss and the man he loves, Jang Hyunjae, leaving his side, Nokyoung feels there’s nothing left for him anymore and takes his own life. But instead of waking up in the afterlife, Nokyoung finds himself three years in the past! Now determined to change the future, Nokyoung turns over a new leaf and tries not to get involved with either of the men that led to his downfall. However, when it comes to Kang Junil, Nokyoung’s fate might already be sealed…

(Source: Tappytoon)

When a former detective wakes up as Ordelle Kyris, the villainess and fake saint of the novel "Idella the Holy," she is entrusted with the task of saving the Sun God and this world from disappearing forever. However, being a fake, her divine power is close to nothing. And the only way to increase it is... money! From securing rich followers to starting a new business, Ordelle strives to gather funds and gain more power. Will this fake yet fiery saint successfully climb the ladder of holiness?

(Source: Tapas)

Former archery prodigy Yoo Sanghyun was destined for greatness until an injury forced him to quit. Though his coach helped him secure a stable job, he never felt like he belonged. Frustrated, he leaves it all behind to pursue game streaming. Leveraging his incredible archery skills and the charm of his noob character, he quickly rises to fame as "Almond." Now, he's determined to dominate the gaming world, but will his virtual success translate into something greater in real life?

(Source: Tapas)

Vivian awakens to find herself possessed into the body of a terminally ill female lead, doomed to a tragic ending. Refusing to accept her doom, Vivian seeks out Rahel, the story’s infamous villainess and the only person capable of curing her. What begins as a desperate gamble slowly turns into a genuine bond, and against all expectations, the two become close, true friends. But...

"Not for a single moment did I ever consider you my friend, Vivian."

"Do you really think you could enter a contract marriage with anyone else?"

...Wait. Wasn’t Rahel supposed to be a villainess?! My best friend just turned out to be a male?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Count's Youngest Son is a Gamer

description:
Do-Hyeon is a top-ranking gamer in Connect, an immersive VR game that is overrun by corrupt guilds. After being murdered for discovering a mythical item, he wakes up as Lord Raul Ashton, an NPC in a closed beta version of Connect. Now the sole player in this realm, he decides to use his knowledge from his past life to prevent the downfall of House Ashton and unlock unprecedented powers. For Do-Hyeon, Connect is no longer just a game—it’s now his reality. Join him as he embarks on a thrilling quest to reshape his fate!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

The genius lawyer No Hyeong-Jin's justice-executing returner fantasy! Valedictorian of his University, perfect score on the Bar Exam, and even a 95% case win rate. No Hyeong-Jin was a so-called successful lawyer! While he was fighting against evil, higher powers to make South Korea a just and fair land, he was ruthlessly murdered by National Intelligence Service agents.

"He shouldn't have died..."

No Hyeong-Jin was a man sent by Emperor Yeom-Ra to fix corruption on Earth! However, after ending up in hell without having been able to achieve anything, Emperor Yeom-Ra returns No Hyeong-Jin back in time... What is this "power" given to him by Emperor Yeom-Ra? Will No Hyeong-Jin be able to change his future as well as the future of South-Korea?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After being taken in by the noble house of Nacht, Sienna grew up with her adopted sister, Lorena, who she believed to be the sweetest, kindest person in the world. But after Lorena attempts to kill her, Sienna realizes how much her "loving" sister actually hated her. She tries to end her life with a magic potion but ends up going back in time instead. Determined to survive, she tries to use her memories to her advantage. For some strange reason though... Lorena is now nowhere to be found.

(Source: Tapas)

After saving one world, warrior Min-Su Kim returns to Earth only to find that he’s lost everything... so he decides to destroy the world he used to call home. In his rampage, he kills teenager Jeong-Su Park and his family. But instead of dying normally, Jeong-Su is transported to another world, where he finds that he's now a warrior himself. After killing the demon king of this alternate world and honing his skills as a warrior, Jeong-Su returns to earth, hell-bent on revenge against Min-Su. As the two warriors fight with the fate of their country in the balance, who will emerge victorious?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

As a devoted servant of Artemis, the nymph Daphne has taken a vow of maidenhood and pledged to never give her heart to a man. However, she finds her loyalty to her goddess shaken when she meets Apollo and is instantly mesmerized, feeling things she had sworn never to feel. As Daphne falls into temptation, she finds herself helpless against the chaotic whims of the gods. Will her transgression lead to true love? Or will the consequences of breaking her vow be more severe than she ever imagined?

(Source: Tapas)

Hyeon’s what some may call resourceful, thrifty, or, um, stingy. Whatever you call him, he’s also dedicated—he grinded night-and-day to get a top-tier character. But once he sold it, every last cent was taken away by loan sharks. In the new VR MMO Royal Road, he’s committed to making it big for himself and his family. He knows that he should absolutely NEVER be one of those weak and poor sculptors, so what’s he going to do when he accidentally becomes the Legendary Moonlight Sculptor?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

In a world where one's worth is determined by how powerful their skill is, Taehyeon is 35, unawakened, and barely able to scrape by as a pack bearer for monster hunters. But when a mysterious being calling itself “the King” gives him a skill of his own, Taehyeon gets a second chance at life. Now he’s back in high school and armed with Gluttony, a skill that allows him to block and absorb the skills of others!

(Source: Webtoons)

The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child. In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression. Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle. Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles... His growth would bring about these things, bringing hardship upon Lee Cheol. Life itself would be a struggle for Lee Cheol, and this is his destiny. But in order to protect himself and his surroundings—in order to protect everything—as the fight continues, he'll unravel secrets from his past life, one by one...!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: My Very Own Tower Strategy Guide

description:
15 days until the apocalypse happens. That's what Ho-Yeong Lee, a 29-year-old office worker, learns when he takes the mysterious medicine he got for saving a goblin from a bear trap. As it turns out, it allows him to level up more easily and provides him with a strategy guide! Everyone in the world is forced into groups to conquer the mysterious Apocalypse Tower, and Ho-Yeong has to find a way to work with his teammates so that everyone makes it to the top alive. Will his ability give him an advantage, or will it end up spelling out his doom?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Lee Yun, the youngest son of the Sermin family, a prominent house on the Dreia Continent. The once peaceful family descends into ruin after the disappearance of his father and brothers. And in the moment everything collapses, Lee Yun is captured by the Paton family and meets his end after horrific torture. But when he opened his eyes, he found himself not in reality, but in Adeon; an endless battlefield and playground of the gods. In that place where countless players lost their lives, Lee Yun grew into the Ghost King, a master player who mastered all classes: Assassin, Necromancer, and Ghost. He challenged the gods. He met his end in defeat, but his story did not end there. The moment he awoke again, he had returned to his childhood at age twelve, retaining the power of a player. To prevent his family's downfall and reclaim everything lost, Ri-yun now begins transforming reality into his own game board. His first target is bloody vengeance against the Paton family, another great clan that destroyed the Sermin family and killed him.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In a world where the Han Empire never fell, martial arts is a power used to squeeze people dry. So when a new continent is discovered, both good and evil men alike flee to settle there and escape the tyranny of the Emperor, opening up the era of a Martial Wild West.

In the turbulent frontier, Zhang Qian is a man that reincarnated from our cushy, modern world, but his new world is nothing like the fantastical world he dreamed about from reading martial arts novels. While the martial arts in his new world are powerful, they are also too crude and lack elegance. And so Qian journeys along the continent for his dream of bringing true martial arts back to the new realm.

(Source: Naver, translated)

To escape a life of poverty, Jang Youngkuk aspired to be a famous actor. And he succeeds... at the cost of his mother's life. Upon proceeding to take his own out of despair, Youngkuk miraculously returns to his childhood. With a second chance to make things right, he swears to abandon acting and be the good son he never was. However, when financial troubles begin to haunt Youngkuk and his mother, he discovers that he may have no choice but to return to the set for one last take.

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Taegun is the nation’s top esper, unmatched and untouchable with how powerful he is. A veritable immovable object. But the truth is, he’s not as untouchable as he seems. Like every esper out there, he experiences negative side effects of using his powers. However, unlike every esper out there, he’s dead set against partnering with a guide who could help him recover. Now here comes Seo Eunsung, one of the greatest guides alive, and he’s determined to guide Taegun whether he likes it or not. So: irresistible force meets immovable object. Who will fall first in this battle? Or will they both fall…for each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Gi-ryeo has a secret: he's really an alien from another world! As High Wizard of the planet Alpha Uri, Gi-ryeo slaved away day in and day out working his soul crushing job. But, after perfecting his transmigration magic, Gi-ryeo escapes into the body of a starved Hunter on Earth. On a new planet, surrounded by more magic than he's ever known, can Gi-ryeo adapt and keep his identity hidden from those seeking the High Wizard?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Status Window Went on Strike

description:
Monsters pour out of gates, wreaking havoc on the world, but Tae-Jun couldn’t care less. After seven years of failure and bullying in his hunter’s guild, he’s fired—until his dormant S-Tier power suddenly activates. Now, with newfound strength, Tae-Jun hunts monsters, exacts brutal revenge, and rises to fame. But as his power grows, so does the danger, and shadowy forces begin targeting him. Can Tae-Jun stay one step ahead and crush those who want him dead?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Swept Up By the Wind Spirit

description:
After being reborn as a weak wind spirit destined to be killed in the battle against cursed beings, Asella had only one goal: survive! But her plans go awry when she forms a pact with Captain Lassez Siertensia, the man who will cause her death. Desperate to change her fate, Asella tries to find a way to break the pact quietly, only to attract the unwanted attention of four other men who take an interest in her. Will Asella find a way to overcome her misfortune without being swept off her feet?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Male Lead's Little Lion Daughter

description:
The handsome Duke Voreoti is the most terrifying man in the empire, with the coldest of demeanors and a gaze that can kill. But one day, he suddenly says that he wants to… adopt a child?! And that child is me?! After finding me at a shady orphanage, he whisked me away to his snowy palace without a second thought. Now I’m learning all the ways of the feared Voreoti family from his knights. However, things get dicey when the Duke becomes suspicious of my origins. With these fangs and jet black hair, perhaps we are more than just kindred spirits…

(Source: Tapas)

Yuhyeon becomes the youngest CEO of Hansung, a successful electronics company built on toxic work culture, but nobody he cares about is there to celebrate with him. After a night of drinking and wondering if he could change the past, he wakes up the next morning, 20 years younger at the beginning of his career. Armed with the experience and insights that made him CEO, Yuhyeon begins to revisit broken relationships and battle the enablers of Hansung’s cut-throat work environment. But he does not yet know how changing the past will affect his future...

(Source: WEBTOON)

After a messy breakup with a trashy ex forces I-Hyeon Seon to take a three-year-long break from college, the last thing she wants to do upon her not-so-inconspicuous return is to dive straight into another relationship. But then comes Chan-U Nam, a notorious bad boy who finds himself having a vested interest in I-Hyeon. And suddenly, what was supposed to be a low-key senior year is looking like it's going to be anything but. The harder I-Hyeon pushes Chan-U away, the stronger he keeps pulling her back. But something’s gotta give – so who’s giving in first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

After defeating the Demon King, our Hero saves the princess and rides off into the horizon to start a new life... In his dreams... Little did he know that unemployment and mediocrity awaited him. Comic Fantasy at its best.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

title.english: To Whom It No Longer Concerns

description:
Exploited by her brother, betrayed by her sister, and killed by her husband. So ended the tragic story of Ariana Lopez--until, at the moment of her death, she suddenly finds herself back in the past. Now that she has a chance to do it all over again, she enlists the help of Duke Dante Heigenberg, the most feared and desired man in the entire empire, to take revenge against her family and reclaim what’s rightfully hers. But strangely, the duke seems to want Ariana more than just for her extraordinary musical talent...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Only I can see the future in this deadly game. Yoon-Jae leads an empty life after his wife and daughter are brutally murdered. One day, his journal reveals one mysterious sentence: “You can see them again.” Yoon-Jae is pulled into a parallel universe where everyone is a player in a lethal game, and the final survivor will be granted any wish. Desperate to be reunited with his family, will Yoon-Jae succeed in fighting his way in this hellish world to be the last one standing?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: A Hero Who Knows His Stuff

description:
For 20 years, Hyeonseok fought monsters in another world before finally managing to save it and be sent back to Earth as a reward. Now a former deliveryman named Chanseok, he looks forward to enjoying modern conveniences, only to discover that Earth is very different from what he remembers. Monsters have started appearing from Erosion Points that pop up at random, and people with innate abilities become Hunters to defeat them. Reluctantly, Chanseok applies to become a Hunter himself, mostly for the money. He saved the world once before, so how hard can it be the second time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Dungeons and monsters suddenly appear and the world falls into chaos. Ki-Bong Kim, an ordinary young part-timer, has been sucked up into an awakening dimension for 3000 years to train his powers. When he makes his return to reality, he is a max-leveled player who only has one wish -- to reconcile with his loved ones. 10 years have passed in the real world during his absence. How will Ki-Bong be able to find his place in the world with his new limit-breaking abilities?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Beauty was her curse. What others envied and longed for only brought her misery. Scarred and weary, I-yeon decided to hide her crafted-by-god looks. In doing so, she gained a new identity, the ugly secretary, I-yeon Yu. She endured the mockery and lived quietly in the shadows until one day... "Let's live together." Do-hyeon An, the only heir of the powerful Wooseung Group, suddenly proposed to her. No one can ever discover their contract marriage or her true identity. Under the same roof begins a thrilling and breathtaking romance of secrets and deception.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Max Level Hero Strikes Back!

description:
Struck by an enemy’s arrow, the powerless Prince Davey O’Rowane falls into a coma. His soul travels to a place where the greatest of the great gather—the honorable Hall of Heroes. There a thousand years pass as Davey undergoes excruciating training under their watchful eyes to become a hero too strong for his own good. Now back to his timeline and his kingdom, he’s wide awake and the enemies hiding in the king’s court better be prepared. The prince they had dismissed is now their biggest threat!

(Source: Tapas)

One day, a gate suddenly opened in the heavens, bringing with it the invasion of monsters and the intervention of monks in the human world.

『Miracle Drug “Coffee” Administration』

『Medicinal Contents: Caffeine and Sugar』
☞ Provides energy
☞ Stimulates the central nervous system
☞ Maximizes senses and reflexes

The whole world appeared to slow down, and Han-Yul’s medications began to show its true effects.

Shay, the S-Class Hunter everyone dreams of becoming. But Dennis, a man with the power to switch bodies, sets his sights on stealing everything from him... by taking his body.

"You want my body? You'd be better off chasing youth."

(Source: DAYcomics)

When a junior boldly confesses his feelings and asks permission to stalk him, Jeong-Hyeon is intrigued by the audacity. Amused, he agrees on one condition, turning desire into a secret, physical arrangement meant to be nothing more than fun. But as the relationship continues, Jeong-Hyeon begins to develop real feelings, just as Ji-Wu starts pulling away, leaving them both caught between obsession, vulnerability, and emotions neither intended to face.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Once a promising athlete, Yoon-Bin is ready to give up after repeated injuries shatter his dreams. At his lowest point, a mysterious man with a tiger tattoo gives him the strength to stand again. Years later, after retiring as a gold medalist and becoming a taekwondo instructor, Yoon-Bin unexpectedly reunites with Kwon Young, an underworld boss and the man who saved his life. Haunted by his past, Young pushes Yoon-Bin away, convinced he brings only harm. But Yoon-Bin refuses to let go, because now it is his turn to become Young’s light.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Cha Hyeon-seong, a boy who lived a painful life, is killed by unknown beasts one day. However, what he saw before his eyes was himself, who had been resurrected and awakened from his death, and Son Ga-yeong, a girl who hunts beasts. In the battle between beasts and humans, Hyeonseong starts a desperate struggle for survival.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After returning from military service, nothing sounds like more of a drag for Wookyung Cha than hanging out with his old friends. In fact, nothing seems to excite Wookyung anymore aside from his new fetish: anonymous, rough sex. Thankfully, a chance encounter at a suspicious bar may just help him find his fill and more...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Little Saint and the Grand Duke of the North

description:
Everyone knows Duke Windzorice is a cold, powerful man, but for the young saint Lilliette, he's a kind adult and just the person to save her from the Temple's abuse! After healing his eyes, Lilliette is granted a home at Windzorice Castle, but the Temple's not willing to let her go. That's when the duke comes up with a foolproof plan to keep her by his side... They'll say she's his daughter! Can this fake family vanquish the Temple and live in peace? Or will the little saint suffer once more?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Tricked into Becoming the Heroine's Stepmother

description:
After her death, Daisy Heidi is reincarnated into the world of “Why Did the Duke’s Daughter Roll Across the Pumpkin Patch?”, a so-called “tragedy” novel where the beautiful heroine Pierta indulges in reckless lust and hedonism with ten ardent suitors to a bitter end. Though Daisy is reborn as a poor commoner in this world, she has one distinct advantage over others in her second chance at life -- she’s the author of the original novel! When fate brings Daisy into the lives of the novel’s heroine Pierta and her dashing father Duke Henstone, Daisy vows to do everything she can to prevent Pierta’s future of despair.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

For two blissful years, So-Ryung's world revolved around her husband—until he vanished without a trace. In her search for answers, she learns the heartbreaking truth that he was never hers to begin with. But she’s not about to let him slip away, even if he is a black ops agent with a hundred faces…

(Source: Manta)

Once a middle school bully who would harass those he saw below him, Hong Il-tak found himself among the lowest of the low after puberty struck for everyone but him. His body remains as small and soft as it’s always been, even into his late teens, making him a prime target for constant sexual harassment at the hands of the other school delinquents. Lee Hyun-woo is his complete opposite. Tall, stoic, and intimidating—Il-tak sees befriending him as a surefire way to climb the school’s social hierarchy once more and escape his daily harassment. Even as Hyun-woo tries to keep Il-tak away, wanting to keep his own burgeoning feelings at bay, circumstance always seems to bring the two together.

Vice Chairman Youngjun Lee and Secretary Miso Kim have been the star duo of their company for nine years... until Miso suddenly decides to quit! But Youngjun is smart, rich, and used to getting what he wants — and he wants Miso to stay. So when he discovers she’s leaving in order to find a husband, the only logical way to keep her at his side is... offering to marry her?! Too bad she’s just not that into him!

(Source: Yen Press)

Kang Jin-hoo gains an extraordinary ability to foresee the future after a life-changing accident during his military service. Armed with this unique power, he dives into the world of investments, targeting companies and financial markets to amass wealth and become the world’s top investor. But his vision extends beyond just making money. Kang Jin-hoo’s foresight begins to influence the global economy, political systems, major corporations, and even the course of globalization itself. Now, with his sights set on reshaping the world of finance and beyond, he is about to rewrite the rules of the future.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After winning a long war, Asha Pervaz is expecting the emperor to compensate her with money. Unlike her expectations though, the emperor asks Asha to choose her own husband from a list of nobles. Asha chooses Duke Carlisle Haven, the emperor’s eldest son and former crown prince. Asha expects him to object and pay an alimony instead, but the duke actually agrees to marry her!
