Though she sets out to give the emperor a piece of her mind, little does she know he's not the only obstacle to her dream...

(Source: Tapas)

All pure-blooded vampire Ha-Yan Park wanted to do was live a normal life. But the rise of half-bloods ten years ago transformed the world into a dangerous and frightening place—robbing her of her one true wish. Determined to return Korea to how it used to be, Ha-Yan teams up with local police captain Eun-Tae Hwang to wipe out the bloodthirsty killers in a tale of hot-blooded romance and revenge.

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: In the Spirit of the Law

description:
After a mysterious accident on a scorching summer day, high school student Jaehun wakes up to a startling discovery - his soul is now sharing his body with that of an enigmatic ascetic. Over the next three years, Jaehun adjusts to life with his unexpected companion while undergoing rehabilitation. Just as he begins to settle into this strange new reality, he faces a pivotal moment: choosing his path for college. A conversation with his defense attorney father opens the door to a world he had never considered before.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lee-Hyeon, an intern, drops by the convenience store on his way home from work and there's something different about the part-timer.

"She's not wearing anything right now, right?"

I'm so confused...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Baek Hwi-Soo has an embarrassing bedroom secret that has earned him the nickname “Cream Can.” But his uncontrollably big load of vitality is just what the starved incubus, Prince Amon, needs to come out of his century-long hibernation. Motivated by a reward of curing his cancer-stricken cat, Pancake, Hwi-Soo comes to the demon world to offer up all the cream from his can to fill the prince’s sweet tooth!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The phototaxis of living creatures — their instinctive response to light.

After the death of Chairman Jeong Ilhwan of DS Group, the only one left by his side is his cherished young omega lover, Yu Cha-Yeon. Determined to seize full control of the organization, Choi Tae-Mu decides that taking even Jeong’s bonded partner as his own will solidify his power. But Cha-Yeon isn’t what the rumors promised. Far from the mute seductress people describe, he seems strangely innocent—soft in a way Tae-Mu can’t quite understand. And when Cha-Yeon’s heat cycle begins, Tae-Mu gives in to impulse…and sets their fates on a dangerous course.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Mr.Blue's Seongbidan Gyeongongjuui (성비단 견공주의) Collection.

Empress Desa, a great witch and ambassador for the founding of the country, proposes a bet to find herself among 108 people with identical faces to test the emperor's sincerity. Meanwhile, 'Arit', a young witch who admires Desa, secretly participates in the bet to stop Desa?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

How far would you be willing to go to save the ones you love? With his grandfather bordering life and death, Taesun takes on multiple jobs in order to pay a seemingly endless stack of hospital bills. On one of his odd jobs, he ascends the great mountain Geumryang, unknowingly the home of an eponymous serpentine spirit. When Taesun encounters the divine being, he too is on the brink of death, desperate for water in his slithering form. Taesun offers him a sip of water, and saves the sacred snake from certain death. Later that night, a cold-blooded body embraces Taesun and offers him an exchange: bear the ancient being’s seed, and his grandfather will live. But is all really as it seems? After all, can one ever truly trust the forked tongue of a serpent…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

It’s a world where a magical tree grows from the back of a swordsman, a mute girl is turned into a living weapon by her mother, a frost dragon roams the skies seeking vengeance, and beings with godlike powers clash for the balance of nature. In the middle of it all is Bira, an orphaned boy, happily spending his days fishing inside a secluded forest. Then he meets Tanyu, a former general on a quest to find his childhood love. Together, they journey into an enchanted landscape unlike any other.

(Source: Tapas)

Gi-Woo just needs a job, and almost any job will do…but he gets more than he bargains for when he stumbles into a position at Cha Seon-Jo’s Battle Cafe. Not only is the owner of this top-tier PC cafe so handsome it’s nearly criminal, he’s also hiding a secret that's actually criminal…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Friend versus friend. Grand Master pitted against noob. Self-confident alpha high schooler meets loner who may or may not be a gaming savant capable of defeating everyone he plays. All this and more comes together on the battlefield of PSI BOND – the hottest online game in the world played by the coolest kids in Korea. High speed connections and high school will never be the same again.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jung-woo is stuck in a reincarnation cycle along with his nemesis, Shin-Ryong. Ever since he was little, he had a dream. He wanted to become strong enough to conquer Murim.

However, things did not always go the way he planned. Shin-Ryong defeated him on every occasion. At this point, Ha Jung-woo had been reincarnated 5 times and was defeated yet again.

When he was reincarnated for the sixth time, he is born into the modern world. Being born into a new world changes Jung-woo's goal, as there is no Murim in the modern world.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The F tier awakener Paster is always bullied by the female S tier awakeners. Then he used a hypnosis app for 6 months to subdue and make sex toys out of them. But one day, he found out that the app was fake. Then why did they pretend to be hypnotized...?!

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

I’m... back! After a comet collides on Earth, a gaming world filled with monsters and dungeons becomes a reality. Amidst the chaos, Won-Ho wakes up as Hardcore Leveling Warrior, an almighty game character with exceptional luck and power. Once again, he will embark on a journey to become the strongest... but this time, on Earth!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Ajin Bae suddenly dives into Dear Dane, the world’s top MMORPG, using her brother’s account—who just happens to be the master of its number one guild. Tasked with keeping her identity secret, she tries to protect his legacy, but things spiral when she’s mistaken for a creep hitting on Bloomie, a popular female player who’s secretly a male idol. Trying to clear things up, Ajin sends a video with her voice in it. But that just gets Bloomie thinking: Wait… I know this girl!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Saying bye-bye to Earth and blasting off to school in space was a dream come true for Nux. But no one told him how mediocre he would seem stacked up against the brightest minds in the universe. With lackluster grades that could never afford him a scholarship, he's forced into illegal part-time work just to pay the bills. But when a handsome alien propositions him with an offer to make his money problems disappear, he realizes it comes at an astronomical price.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yeonkwang Arts High School makes a clear distinction between the talented and the mediocre. The talented receive full benefits of the Gifted and Talented program—funding, training, opportunities to participate in exclusive art contests—while the mediocre are left to fend for themselves in the hopes that they, too, can one day make it into the prestigious program. Talent equals power in this competitive school, but when Chung-eun, a G/T student, falls for Yumi, a non-G/T student, the tables are turned. While Chung-eun is blinded by Yumi’s charms, Yumi’s got a hidden agenda.

(Source: Lezhin)

Tae-Ha, who was barely making ends meet working as a delivery man, accidentally wins the lottery, but gets into a motorcycle accident on the way home and loses consciousness. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself as he was 10 years ago when he was a student, and to make matters worse, he finds himself in a dating simulation game... 'Find the target characters and increase their favorability ratings!' Will Tae-Ha be able to gain people's favor and return to reality?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

When Seo Jun-Ho and his companions sacrificed themselves to defeat the frost queen, they thought they were restoring peace to Earth. But after 25 years of being frozen solid, Jun-Hho thaws out only to find that nine more floors appeared in his absence, only one of which has been cleared! As the only one who holds the key to clearing the next floor and defrosting his friends, Jun-Ho must step up once again. But has this hero been in hibernation too long to take on the world’s fearsome new foes?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Doyoon Kim should've died in the car crash, but fate had other plans. He wakes up in the hospital, trapped in a bruised and unfamiliar body. Upon returning to university, he crosses paths with his old friend, Hangyeol. However, Hangyeol is unrecognizable. He is consumed by grief and unwilling to engage with Doyoon. Yet, a haunting familiarity tugs at Hangyeol, as if this stranger is an uncanny reflection of the dead man he still loves...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Return of Elena the Knight

description:
Elena Blaise grew up as a count’s daughter in a royalist household backing Crown Prince Carlisle. The prince’s sudden assassination makes way for the Anti-King Paveluc, who annihilates House Blaise overnight. As the sole survivor, Elena trains as a knight to avenge her family. When she finally faces off with Paveluc, a deadly blow not only knocks her unconscious but also catapults her into the past! Elena wakes up one year before the fall of House Blaise. Determined to protect her kin, she rushes to save Crown Prince Carlisle, asking for his hand in marriage and offering her services as his knight. Bewildered as he is, Carlisle takes the bait. The future now lies in the hands of his fiancée fighting on his behalf!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Genius Midfielder with the Killer Pass

description:
I17-year-old Yujun Song lives for soccer. However, when he suddenly becomes color-blind, he has no choice but to walk away from his dream. 15 years later, after a car crash, Yujin finds himself on the brink of death and makes one last wish: to step onto the soccer field one more time. In the next moment, he appears to have been given this chance as he finds himself back in his 17-year-old body. On the pitch, strange bands of colorful light dance around him. With the colors as his guide, can Yujun become the midfielder he always dreamed of?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Spunky mercenary mage Priscilla Mortia sets out on her final mission: to reclaim the last 15 years of her tragic life. Using a mana stone called the Dragon Heart, she travels back in time to when her family ruled over the land. While Priscilla’s goal is to reawaken her magical powers by obtaining the Dragon Heart in the past, she must survive the sinister plots of her wicked stepmother and her elderly fiance. To aid in her quest she seeks out Kian Lustin, a renowned swordsman who once captured her heart. But why does their fateful first meeting seem strangely familiar? Can Priscilla finally gain Kian's allegiance and claim her rightful seat as the heir to House Mortia?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ba-Reum’s planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend’s hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.english: Wait Where the Shooting Star Falls

description:
This is Table Land, a mystical world where fallen shooting stars take the form of a witch and are bound to a cat, so when the witch dies, so will the cat. This story begins with a witch's end, but with her still-living cat left behind, and another witch who fell from the skies, soon left alone by the death of her guardian. Forlorn, they both start their lonely search for a place to belong. Will the shadows of the past loom or will the light of hope shine bright? Embark with us now on this curious tale of Table Land...

(Source: Tapas)

"It's simple. Fuck them!"

I became a vampire after a ridiculous accident. For better or worse, I didn't need blood to survive. There's only one way to survive. Become a predator and suck girls' vital essence!

(Source: TOPTOON)

All Charlize Ronan ever wanted was to bring honor to her family. But instead, she is forced into becoming a “living sword” -- a mere tool for the emperors. It is from this hell that she prays for justice… and awakens in her former body. Now, determined to tear down this horrible empire, Charlize seeks out the young prince, Dylan Blade. She will put him on the throne, not as an honorable ruler, but as a tyrant. It is time for Charlize to tame the one who will bring forth her revenge.

(Source: Tapas)

Kim Jihyun, who lived his life as a disreputable surgeon, gains a second chance to relive his life. He then goes back to his middle school days, and live his life to the fullest unlike before, he studies nonstop. His goal is to become a dermatologist who make lots of money instead of the poor surgeon he was from previous life!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

To avenge his older brother, an orphan named Jongli Chu killed Hwang Jung, a Heaven-slaying sect disciple. Following the death of Hwang-Jung, he joined the Imitating Blade killer of Soul-killing Chambers to avoid the pursuit of the Heaven-slaying Sect. However, a huge mess called ten chastisements was waiting for him.

To escape the shadow of chastisement, he has no choice but to become a Legendary Death God! Can Jongli Chu become a Death God and find freedom in the stifling rules created by the Orthodox Sects?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Write Me, Touch Me, Read Me

description:
In an era where romance between hybrids and humans is taboo, Kang Seok-Won finds himself crammed into an overcrowded subway on his way home from work. There, he keeps brushing against a large-built young man who gets his heart racing. Seok-Won, who has the ability to read others’ thoughts through physical contact, is suddenly overwhelmed by a flood of indecent ideas…and to make matters worse the subject of those indecent thoughts is…him?! A clumsy love story between the reclusive and socially anxious hybrid, Jin Dal-Lae, and the telepathic team leader, Kang Seok-Won begins!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Exhausted after a grueling day at work, Ham Yegyeong drifts into a light sleep during her chaotic evening subway commute. Her peaceful rest is violently shattered when the man sitting next to her, who had seemingly offered his shoulder for her to lean on, suddenly thrusts his middle finger deep into her private opening. Jolted awake and paralyzed by terror, she can barely squeeze out a desperate whisper: .

"S-stop, please stop...".

The predator only offers a cold, mocking smirk.

"Stop what?".

"If you stop, I'll... I'll just pretend this never happened, aaah!".

Yegyeong gasps, her plea cut short as his touch grows even more invasive. To her absolute horror, the nightmare escalates. As she looks up through tears, she realizes that the crowd is shifting, and a group of completely unfamiliar men are slowly closing in, surrounding her seat to seal her fate.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The moment he was about to die, Axel was transported to another world where he is the long-awaited half-dragon.

(Source: Toomics)

The world collapsed and built underground city Sindorim. The boys who couldn't get there and survived, dig into the secrets of the underground city.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yejun, who had always believed he was a beta, found himself unexpectedly in the throes of heat, resulting in the birth of his child during college five years ago—a consequence of his complicated relationship with Do-yoon, his unrequited first love and friends-with-benefits partner. Returning to Korea, Yejun decides to bear the sole responsibility of raising his son in secrecy, keeping the truth hidden from Do-yoon. However, five years later, Yejun crosses paths with the child's father at his workplace—a long-overdue meeting that he had hoped to delay for as long as possible.

(Source: Lezhin US)

This is a world whose peace was destroyed by the Shadow Lord, ‘Secneum’. ‘Niro’ is a half-elf, half-human boy who lost his parents as a baby and was adopted by a slave couple. In this world, slaves are not treated as humans. Since Niro’s adoptive parents are slaves, they are mistreated and eventually lose their lives. Now Niro is alone once more, and must shoulder the burdens of his family and do whatever is takes to protect his two younger siblings. If Niro wants to escape this fate, there is only one thing he can do. He must graduate from the academy, ‘Excanum’ just like the current Emperor, ‘Muren’ who was once a slave!

title.english: Like Wind on a Dry Branch

description:
As plague and turmoil afflicts the empire, enchanting widow Rieta Tristi finds herself at the mercy of a malicious nobleman and his dying wish to have her buried alive beside his corpse. The plague has taken her husband, slave traders have taken her young child, and now her own life is at risk -- until an unexpected visit from the empire's outcast prince changes everything.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Hogil Byeon is a third-class killer in the criminal organization Glory Club, with no way up and only one way out. He pivots into law, but his knack for killing doesn’t disappear. Juggling courtrooms and bullets, Hogil starts redefining justice his own way. The law has limits, but Hogil doesn’t. When a lawyer has killer skills, justice is served… with a bang!

(Source: WEBTOON)

A necromancer is a profession considered the noble of nobles, with less than 1,000 in the population worldwide! I was born with a diamond spoon, no, a necromancer spoon in my mouth! ...Or so I thought.

"I'm just a defective necromancer."

[Using skill, "Summon Ordinary Skeleton" (E-rank).]

You'd think a necromancer should be able to summon liches, Dullahans, or death knights. But nope, I can only summon skeletons. But then one day, suddenly...

[Hidden condition achieved!]
[Condition: The 10,000 Uses Rule]
[Your rank has upgraded to D-rank!]

I achieved the hidden condition and gained the ability to raise my skeletons. From E-rank to S-rank! The story of Joo Donghoon unfolds, the world's only cursed necromancer, who's speeding toward becoming a ranker!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A romantic comedy between two opposing forces, the ultra-short Yu Bo-Ram and an Iljin Basketball Club member, Choi Gyeom.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

After an asteroid destroys Earth, Moon You unintentionally becomes the last person in existence, or so he thinks. Stuck on a research facility on the moon, he struggles with being the last person alive. Little does he know that humankind is watching his every move from Earth.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

"If only I could live like in an eroge even in real life... that would be fun."

After finishing his military service, Jin-Seok Lee went back to enjoying his usual eroge. But one day, the powers from his games suddenly appeared in reality?!

"With this ability, I can make anyone do whatever I want."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Back at school after a year. On her first day back, she thought it would be fun, but a miraculous turn of events landed her in the same class as her younger sibling. Then, a stranger caught her embarrassingly...! And why did that man have to be Seo Jin-Young?! Why am I getting involved with Jin-Young, whom I haven't spoken to all school year, now?

Da-Jung's school life is going haywire... Please, let her graduate safely!

(Source: Naver, translated)

For ten years, Hong Su-Rim has been confined, hidden away by the powerful Baek family. Why? He’s suspected to be “Illishine”, a mythical figure said to bring either ruin or salvation to the clan. On his twentieth birthday, the mark of Illishain finally appears on Su-Rim’s body, and his fate is sealed. He is dragged into the cold world of the Baek family, where he’s placed under the control of Baek Woo-kyeong, the aloof and calculating son of the family head. Su-Rim, having endured years of isolation, has no illusions about love or trust—he plans to use Woo-Kyeong to survive and gain some control over his life. But things don’t go as planned. Woo-Kyeong, at first wary and indifferent, begins to feel drawn to Su-Rim’s strange charm and hidden vulnerability. As the two navigate a maze of family politics, supernatural legacy, and growing attraction, their fates become more entangled than either of them expected. Is Su-Rim truly the cursed savior of the Baek family—or just a pawn in a dangerous game of power and prophecy? In a world where nothing is as it seems, can love be more than just an illusion?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hye-Jung loved to read to escape her daily stress. But that’s before she woke up inside the bizarre world of her favorite novel! Instead of the main heroine who courts three eligible men, she is now Latte Ectrie – a minor villain that everyone hates?! One way or another, it’s a chance to live out her most beloved storyline, with popcorn in hand to watch all the drama! Taking charge of the narrative takes on a whole new meaning!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 59 extra chapters.

Being the new kid in school is never easy. Especially not for a wallflower like Eun-jae, who has spent most of his childhood in and out of hospitals because of his weak heart. Now, his only wish is to live and experience life as a normal high schooler. Unfortunately, the high school experience for him not only means attending classes and making friends, but also getting bullied for looking like an omega. But things aren’t all bad. Not when you consider his regular encounters with Jin-hyeon, the popular kid in school. As accidents and coincidences keep bringing them together, Eun-jae realizes he had met Jin-hyeon a long time ago… even if the latter doesn’t remember. And although a throbbing heart has always been a cause for concern, Eun-jae discovers a heart can throb for sweeter reasons too.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Su's prescient dreams show him an apocalypse which is confirmed by his awaking powers. To survive, he bonds with Jae-Young, a hidden powerhouse and seemingly guaranteed survivor. As monsters invade and the world unravels with gods, betrayal, and chaos, they must fight to stay alive—together.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Ju-Won Lee works as a doppelganger who poses as a hero’s alter-ego, and fills in for them in their social life while they perform their duties as heroes. One day, Justice, the strongest hero, approaches Ju-Won and requests his services with the promise of a hefty payment in return for his work. However, when Ju-Won arrives at their meeting spot, he is instead greeted by a completely unexpected sight...

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

In Jung-gu, Seoul, tucked away in a secluded industrial alley behind the glittering skyscrapers, a vampire lives.

Mignon, orphaned at a young age, works as a car mechanic by day and fights as a mixed martial artist in illegal underground arenas by night. Amidst his daily grind stained by exploitation and violence, Yeong-Won, the arena's doctor, is the only one who shows him genuine care and concern. One day, Mignon witnesses Yeong-Won's dangerous secret.

“I'll do whatever you tell me...! I can help you!”

Even knowing his true identity, Yeong-Won slowly opens his heart to Mingnon's blind devotion. But the hellish reality that binds Mignon begins to shake Yeong-Won's own life to its core...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

He wanted an heir. Not a heart.

Baek-Ryeon, a sacred dragon spirit, once took the human Ha-On as his mate, never realizing that love would be his undoing. When Ha-On discovers he was meant for nothing more than producing an heir, he vanishes, leaving Baek-Ryeon to face the centuries alone. Now, in the modern world, Baek-Ryeon meets a man with Ha-On’s soul and the same fire in his eyes. But with Ha-On having no recollection of their shared history, can Baek-Ryeon truly atone for the sins of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Dumped after confessing to her first crush of three years, Ro-Sa Park falls for her second when the nation’s favorite Superpowered Police Officer, Do-Ryeong Han, swoops in to save her as she’s plummeting from a toppling building. A few years later, a mysterious villain called Blackdog appears, but Do-Ryeong notices something is not quite right. Will the world’s worst villain ever win the heart of the strongest hero in the country?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

A one night stand becomes so much more when Yeon Subin and Jin Hoyeon begin spending more and more time together…until one day, out of the blue, Subin asks to break up for reasons unbeknownst to Hoyeon. But the two just can’t stay away from each other, and so they get back together again…and again…and again. But each time, Subin suddenly breaks things off without telling Hoyeon why. Until finally, after their seventh breakup, Hoyeon is determined to find the reason why.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

Spring, 1995. Messy-note business major and campus hottie Jinwoo needs someone to rewrite his essays so that they are at least somewhat legible. Perfect-penmanship P.E. major Daehan needs dating lessons so that he can stay in a relationship for at least two weeks. So when the two end up living under the same roof, it seems like the perfect opportunity to help each other out... but after a few fated run-ins, it might be more than just skills that they're swapping!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: How a Goddess Wins Over Tigers

description:
After being betrayed by her lover, the sun god Moha meets a bitter death--but soon finds herself thrust back into her past in someone else's body. Two tiger spirits from Moha's past vie for her affection as she struggles against the looming tragedy that once ripped her heart--and the world--apart. As Moha navigates this unfamiliar world alone with no divine power, will she be able to change the tragic course of her life and find true love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes one side story.

title.romaji: I'm Fine Thank You, And You?

description:
Summoned into her favorite novel as the infamous Duchess Roselia Chade, Haena is bathed in riches, power, and a family of her own. Life couldn’t be better, save for the small detail that her beloved stepson, Einspanner Chade, is also the evil mastermind destined to kill her. At this point in the story Ein is still just an adorable child yet to reach his cruel awakening, and so Roselia is determined to stop him from becoming a ruthless killer. But with the duke getting in her way and trying to poison his own son, safely raising a child that was primed for villainy may prove harder than she originally thought. The survival of both mother and child depends on whether Roselia can successfully rewrite their tragic ending!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one prologue and 24 side story chapters.

After a wild night at the club, Gyuha wakes up to a surprise. He's tangled in the sheets with none other than his childhood friend, Chayoung. The more Gyuha thinks about it, the more he realizes that Chayoung is actually his ideal type, maybe a tad too tall. Despite their rendezvous becoming a regular thing, and the chemistry between them getting steamier, Chayoung is still dead set on marrying an omega. Too bad he doesn't know Gyuha is not the beta he's pretending to be.

(Source: Tapas)

As a powerful 8th circle mage, Henry Morris used his magic for the good of the empire. But when the corrupt king Silver Jackson Edward takes the throne, he beheads Morris on fake treason charges. Moments later, Henry wakes up, but in a new body. Though this body’s owner shares Henry’s name, he is but the lowly, talentless son of a baronet. Set on revenge against the king, Henry enters the treacherous Demon Forest to hone his skills so he can once more wield his powers as an 8th circle mage!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Leveling Up My Husband to the Max

description:
A cold, uncaring husband, and unreasonable mother-in-law, and a wrongful death — could your life get any worse? What if you were given a chance to change things? When Amber is sent ten years back in time at the moment of her execution, she finds herself face to face with the younger version of her husband, but something’s different about him... He’s completely at her beck and call! Will she be able to prevent the past from repeating itself, or will her life spiral into misery once again? Operation: Leveling Up My Husband to the Max begins now!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jin-Tae Seo and his younger sister Ji-Na, a purple-eyed albino, are separated after being kidnapped by human traffickers. After two years of torment, Jin-Tae is rescued by an assassin named Shin Kim. After years of training, Jin-Tae, now an assassin himself, follows a lead to Hong Kong to find his sister. After accidentally getting involved in a gang war, it is revealed that Ji-Na is apparently an assassin working for Kai Liu, another albino, who is rebelling against the Triad, and claims that Ji-Na is his half-sister. Can Jin-Tae stay alive long enough to reunite with her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
Climbing to the top of Heaven’s castle will prove a herculean task, for the one who can reach the summit shall be granted control of the world.

Reclusive and withdrawn, Tae-jeong has spent years shut away from the world, surviving in the quiet suffocation of his own room. But when his father is suddenly hospitalized due to a car accident, even that fragile isolation begins to crumble. Grief and fear twist together inside him, leaving only one outlet, an uneasy rush of desire that both calms and consumes him.

Enter Eun-won, the golden boy who has everything Tae-jeong doesn’t: confidence, charm, a life untouched by loneliness. He looks at Tae-jeong with disdain, pity, and something darker, an attraction he refuses to name. As the line between disgust and desire blurs, both are drawn into a dangerous intimacy born from guilt, curiosity, and longing.

What begins as comfort becomes compulsion, and behind locked doors, Tae-jeong and Eun-won learn that even the most broken hearts can crave, and destroy, in the same breath.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Yeon Woo-Hyeok fell into the world of martial arts and became a civil servant in the martial arts world.

Yeon Woo-Hyeok, a veteran of the martial arts mystery game [The Great Revolutionary King's Great Pokai], one day finds himself possessed by a Po-Kwai in the game without warning. Fortunately, he realizes that the events in the game that he had memorized are exactly as they appear, and begins to adapt to being a Po-Kwai in the game while solving the cases. However, the joy is short-lived as Yeon Woo-Hyeok's ability, 'Young-An', is actually an upper chamber opening, and because of this, he is in danger of dying. No, being a Po-Kwai is difficult, so he has to learn martial arts to become a powerful master?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ji-Yu thought her first relationship would be nothing but happiness, until an uneasy suspicion takes root. Her boyfriend seems a little too attached to his female friend, and Ji-Yu can’t tell whether she’s being paranoid or not. Desperate for clarity, she downloads an AI dating advice app called Love Meddler. Instead of gentle reassurance, it hits her with brutal honesty. As the app starts “meddling” in her love life, Ji-Yu is left wondering how an AI understands her so well. The thing is, perhaps it’s not AI at all and rather someone who has recently re-entered her life…

(Source: WEBTOON)

"You look like you'd be fun to mess with."

These senior girls treated me like a pet, humiliating me every chance they got. But the tables have turned, and now they find themselves completely submitting to their junior.

"I'm going to turn this whole relationship upside down. Get on your knees."

(Source: DAYcomics)

A decade ago, Chae Songhwa and her friend Seo Hyunwoo promised to meet again as their best selves. Unfortunately, life hasn’t quite turned out the way Songhwa imagined. So when they meet again at their high school reunion, Songhwa is stunned to find that Hyunwoo remembers her and wants to reconnect. One meal and a little too much wine later, he asks her to take him home, where the night takes a spicy turn. Are they simply spicing up their bland lives? Or is this the start of a delicious romance?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.

Aiden is a quarterback and Seo-Won is a chronically-ill forest boy. Could it be any more obvious? Seo-Won can’t quite bring himself to believe that a popular football player has been crushing on him for years, but Seo-Won’s remote forest home might be the perfect place for romance to take root. But Aiden is only visiting Korea–is two weeks enough time to establish a relationship, or…a family?

(Source: Tapas)

Series of unusual, strange, and mysterious thriller.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Genius Grandson of House Namgung

description:
When young Hahyeon Shin’s mother sacrifices herself to give him a chance to escape the family she married into, he finds himself alone in a hostile world. His only goal is to find his mother’s family, the House of Namgung, and train in martial arts to avenge her and become a protector of the innocent. But when he is tested by the Namgung family, they discover that he is a martial arts genius with a perfect physique and the potential to become the greatest martial artist who ever lived.

(Source: Tapas)

After a bus accident, Lim Mari awakens to find herself in a novel as an odd-eyed cat named Marie. Mistaken for a spiritual animal, she's gifted to cold Emperor Klaus von Bismarck. While Klaus slowly warms up to Marie, she is focused on finding a way to turn human... until she stumbles upon an assassination plot targeting Klaus! Despite being powerless and unable to tell anyone what she knows, can this cute ball of fluff find a way to save her new owner? And will she ever become human again?

(Source: Tapas)

Gardening and solving crime aren’t what straight-A student Ye-On Han thought she would be focusing on at her new school. But when she discovers a notebook that contains clues to a 15-year-old murder mystery, she and the other members of her new gardening club realize the murderer not only has access to the school -- they probably work for the school. Can the gardening club squad figure out who committed the murder even though the principal and their teachers seem desperate to cover it up?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue

When a night out to a piano recital turns into a literal nightmare for Seo-Yun, she's unceremoniously inducted into a world of horrifying beings. There, she meets Hui-Won, a charming "superbia" who informs her that she is nothing more than food for these creatures born of sin. Now, she must succumb to the likes of vampires and incubi as they feed on her for sustenance. Can she escape the darkness that lurks under the cover of night, or will she find a reason to stay inside this sinister realm?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Lysithea Hilenaire Del Arman is a woman on the run. After a dangerous revolt claimed the lives of her family, Lysithea employs the broker, Taron Cardis, to help her escape the kingdom before she meets the same deadly fate. But Taron isn’t exactly the easiest man to work with, and the two spend most of their transactional relationship with plenty of bickering and arguing. That is, until an unexpected snowstorm leaves them stranded in an eerie, abandoned mansion. Now, Lysithea and Taron must put their differences aside to survive the cold and continue their escape.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

His father, who abandoned him 11 years ago, bequeathed him with an apartment. But it turns out he was to share it with his stepsister. Find out who's going to get on top in this thrilling romance!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

title.english: Resigning and Healing in Another World

description:
I'm sick of the same dreary life and food every day. There has got to be more to life than this! Isu's life was never the same after his parents died, and he barely held on until one day, when a mysterious portal suddenly popped up in his apartment and sucked him into the fantasy village of Raudoren. With so many things to explore and most importantly, food that makes him drool, Isu starts to make himself at home.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When ordinary man Moo-Yeong awakens as an A-rank guide, he is shocked to find out he has been paired with his long-lost first love from high school: the elite S-rank esper Yoo-Hae. Although Yoo-Hae is delighted about their reunion, Moo-Yeong is determined to keep their relationship a professional one. And thus begins an endless amount of “work” as a guide. While it’s standard protocol for guides to heal through physical intimacy, Yoo-Hae’s demands are obsessively intense, pushing Moo-Yeong to his limits. Is this so-called business relationship going to work out?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

The Devon family sits on a mountain of debt and they are on the brink of bankruptcy. This is no fault of hers of course, but Courtney Devon has always been the one painted as the villain in her family. However, the family is in dire straits and they have to do something, anything, to raise some money and get out of this situation. But then one day, news arrives from the Imperial Palace that His Royal Highness the crown prince has decided to make Courtney the crown princess. Seemingly a typical prince on the outside, His Royal Highness is actually quite a troublemaker with a dark side. Will this arrangement end up solving Courtney Devon’s problems or just complicating things further? Will a love against all odds bloom or will someone end up in the doghouse...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The only way out is through.

In the midst of a disastrous monster attack fated to end the world, a strange device throws Hee-Jae back in time 20 years where he meets the students of his foster father, Seok-Young. Now it's up to him to take them under his wing and stop the apocalypse so he can finally set off for a peaceful life.

(Source: Manta)

When a zombie outbreak overruns Seoul, the government abandons the city to its fate. Amid the chaos, ex-special forces bodyguard Shin-U fights to protect his skittish charge, Te-Bek. But as every day brings them closer to death, their bond grows harder to resist. Can love survive an apocalypse?

(Source: Manta)

Si-Ru is devastated when her crush, the dreamy Gi-Baek Seol, effectively friendzones her. She goes out that night to drown her sorrows, but after one too many drinks, ends up accidentally kissing someone. The next day, two people in her class show up with a swollen lip. One is Gi-Baek, and the other is Cheong, a tall and quiet guy who’s always been a bit of an enigma to her. In just one day, Si-Ru’s non-existent dating life takes a sharp turn and she suddenly finds herself with two love prospects. Will she finally be able to get her happy ending with Gi-Baek? Or start something new with the mysterious Cheong?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: Ten Ways to Get Dumped by a Tyrant

description:
Scarlett Arman is no ordinary lady, not just because she’s engaged to the emperor. Newly reincarnated as a character in a fantasy novel, Scarlett knows she is supposed to die a horrible death at the hands of her fiancé, Charleon Kalior. Determined to escape her fate, Scarlett decides to make Charleon break off the engagement... But why does he keep wanting to spend time with her?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Han Yihyeon and Oh Taeoh go way back. They were best friends throughout most of their high school years…until one day, they just weren’t. Taeoh suddenly began to hide everything from Yihyeon, and try as she might, she could never find out why. Fast forward years later, when the two are young adults. Struggling to make it in the big city, Yihyeon returns home to live with her mother when she runs into her old friend again. Isolated from the rest of the world, Taeoh has not left the town - let alone his own home - since Yihyeon left. As the two grow closer once again, will Yihyeon be able to help lead Taeoh back into reclaiming a life of his own?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Welcome to the room you can't leave before becoming a bitch.

Woo Tae-Yun, with the highest trait of being an extreme right-wing alpha and the powerful title of successor to Hanseo Group, is kidnapped along with his childhood friend Do-Hyun one day and locked in a pristine white room. Is it for ransom? Or is it the work of a stalker of Woo Tae-Yun? Just as anxiety is growing, a mysterious message arrives on the cell phone in the middle of the room. The 'first mission' begins with a lighthearted drinking of each other's XX. It seems that they were not simply kidnapped, but captured by a pervert.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Bianca de Arno was a ruthless countess in the Kingdom of Sevran, infamous for being a wicked and selfish wife. While her husband, Count Zachary de Arno, bravely risked his life out on the battlefield, she sat at home and spent his money. It wasn’t until her final day that Bianca realized the error of her ways. Before she dies, Bianca prays for a second chance, swearing she will do better, and wakes up in her 19-year-old body. With her second chance, Bianca starts to see everything in a new light… starting with her husband.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 46 extra chapters.
Note: Promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.

title.english: The Little Lady Behind the Scenes

description:
Julianne is as close to perfect as it gets: she’s got looks, talent, and smarts. The only problem is she has terrible taste in men! That’s why her little sister Lilianne is doing everything she can to make sure she doesn’t end up with the wrong guy. However, Julianne’s suitors are quickly catching on that the way to her heart is through Lilianne’s sweet tooth! How far will Lilianne go to set her sister up with the right man? Who will be the sweetest suitor?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Nobody said being a parent was easy. It’s especially hard for Belphegor Verscios, the adoptive father of an exceptionally gifted human girl who insists on becoming a warrior someday and defeating the Demon King — who, unbeknownst to her, happens to be him. But when you’re a doting father like Belphegor, what else can you do but try to support her dreams while simultaneously making sure she never reaches her goal? It’s a fine line to walk, but he must succeed at any cost, or suffer the worst fate he could ever imagine… disappointing his daughter.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Helplessly falling in love at first sight.

Jeong-Hyeon is a girl who easily gets carried away by her feelings. On her first day of work as a manager for actress Hee-Ra Ju, she falls head over heels for her! Jeong-Hyeon can't afford to lose her job, but her heart melts every time she sees Hee-Ra's face. Will she be able to hide her feelings?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Yeon finds herself as an extra in her own novel. To make the most out of the bizarre event, she goes on a quest to find her handsome male lead Chang. However, who she finds is none other than the younger, frail version of the antagonist Bi. Yeon finds that the "antagonist" Bi is being pushed through the narrative of a villain -- can she stay by his side through it all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Gon Manghal Gamunui Gyeyakjing Ttari Doeeotda
title.native: 곧 망할 가문의 계약직 딸이 되었다

description:
After dying in an experiment, Anisha wakes up in the past at the orphanage where she was sold to a mad scientist. However, things take a different path when she is adopted by Duke Aubrey to replace his late daughter, Annette. Though having to live as someone else, she decides to enjoy her new freedom while plotting revenge on the scientist. But as she starts to recall facts unknown in her former life, Anisha wonders if it's a side effect of the experiments or if her past holds deeper secrets…

(Source: Tapas)

Choose your player: a noble hero intent on saving the world, or a devious demon prince hell-bent on conquering it? A normal choice when playing a new game, but when gaming nerd In-gong Ju wakes up inside the VR game Knight Saga:RE, he finds himself playing as Siutra, a tiny, gnome-like ninth prince of the demon kingdom. In-gong must work quickly to unlock a range of potentially overpowered skills to help him level up and win over his siblings before the Day of Massacres, when they’ll all be slaughtered by the game’s antagonist, Zephyr Ragnaroth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Han-Soo Kang was an average boy living in the normal world when he was suddenly summoned to Fantasia, a fantasy world run by demons. Deemed the Chosen Hero, he’s spent the last ten years building himself up to defeat the lord of Fantasia - which turned out to be a piece of cake. As he eagerly awaits his return to the real world, the “god” of Fantasia appears and throws a wrench in his plan: a report card that reveals there’s more to being a hero than just might.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Laritte Brumayer, the illegitimate daughter of a count grew up in an abusive household. As if that wasn't enough, she's sent to marry Duke Ian Reinhardt after he was killed and named a traitor, instead of her sister. Despite her dreary prospects of being a dead man's wife, Laritte is ecstatic to escape and start her new life! Just as she's settling in, Ian returns, claiming he was framed. Though wary of him at first, she agrees to help clear his name, oblivious to the hardships that lie ahead...

(Source: Tapas)

In a world crawling with monsters and dungeons, Na Sunhoo and the other Awakeneds fight to protect humanity. But after he is killed in a deadly battle, a screen appears: "Initiate Time Regression?" Now with a second chance at life, Sunhoo returns to the past, determined to make as much money as possible to buy the land the dungeon is on and destroy it before the monsters can appear. With innocent lives at risk, can Sunhoo strike it rich and vanquish the monsters once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

One day, an unidentified flying object appears in the sky along with unknown insect-like monsters. A normal high school student, Seung-ho Yun, is trying to survive as well as find his family. Along the way, he is aided by a message that tells him the future that only appears in his head. As he moves on with that slight advantage, he finds out that there are others who are getting the same message as him. Will he be able to find his family? And where are the messages in his head coming from?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Can't Keep Up With My Stallion Duke

description:
Not a single soul in Olivia Florence's life, including her own husband, provided the warmth that she craved, and she lived her life alone, growing strong.
Waking up two decades earlier right after her regretful arranged marriage to the Duke, Lord James Parnell, she plans to live a different life.

She hatches a plan to anull her marriage remarry the Duke, Ian Tyrone, infamous for being ""IMPOTENT"" for never showing any interest in the ladies.
Maybe his disinterest in women would allow Olivia to comfortably live as his wife, unburdened by childbirth and free of any other pressures in life.

But wait, the Duke who seemingly ""couldn't get it up"" turns out to be a complete stud at in the bedroom. What has Olivia gotten herself into?"

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

With a single touch, Detective Dong Baek can read anyone’s memory. Thanks to his supernatural skill, he’s gotten cocky over his virtually flawless track record. But a mysterious serial killer ends up mystifying even his supernatural ability, and a genius criminal profiler is brought in to close the case. Dong Baek will have to swallow his pride and work with her if they want any hope of stopping the slaughter…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 side stories.

After leaving behind his past as a failed idol from Meteor Boys, Seok-Wu returns to university hoping for a fresh start. Unfortunately, his timing could not be worse…because rising star Yeo-Wun, a rookie actor with a glittering career, also reenrolls. Seok-Wu is used to the contrast in how people treat them, but when Yeo-Wun starts provoking him in ways that feel far too deliberate, irritation turns into wounded pride. Just how far does Yeo-Wun plan to trample on Seok-Wu’s dignity - and why does it feel so personal?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Strongest Lady Hides Her Strength

description:
The Hero guards the empire in times of war but is sealed away when peace prevails, making her life an incessant cycle of fighting and slumber. That is, until she wakes up as Roshanne Leilaten, a meek noble lady looked down upon by even her own servants. Unwilling to give up the freedom she so yearns, Roshanne conceals her true identity as she investigates how to permanently break the seal that binds her to the emperor. But can a girl who's used to leading with her fists navigate high society?

(Source: Tapas)

Melt, the sheltered daughter of a notorious mob boss, has spent her life like a fragile flower trapped in a gilded cage. On her 20th birthday, instead of receiving a gift, she is kidnapped by a mysterious man named Budd. Together, they are thrust into a citywide chase, with hitmen, hounds, and every thug in town hot on their trail. But why is Melt the most wanted woman in New Jersey? As secrets unravel and bodies pile up, this gritty noir tale spirals into a storm of love, murder, and betrayal. Melt Bless You!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Secret Bedroom of the Abandoned Princess

description:
After her mother is executed for treason, Princess Llewellyn is shunned by high society and stripped of her rightful claim to the throne. So lowly does she become, that she is left with no one to protect her when she is kidnapped by dark mages and cursed with a wicked spell of lust. With no choice but to satisfy her desires as the curse demands, Llewellyn finds herself falling into the arms of unexpected suitors. But this life of lust can only go on for so long before the flames of passion begin to burn out of control…

(Source: Tappytoon)

A rural factory faces a new outbreak of the 'Dumfluenza' virus, and for Daeho, this could be his chance to get back at his arrogant boss lady.

(Source: Toomics)

When Rachel de Erlando opens her eyes, she realizes she has woken up as a character inside some webnovel. After the initial shock abates, she adapts quickly and leads a happy life with her new parents, or at least, until they die from an accident. Not long after, she gets adopted by Duke Leon, her father’s best friend, and is introduced to her adoptive brother, Lucian de Leon. Rachel finally realizes that she woke up in her favorite BL webtoon which she was reading in her past life. She also recalls that Lucian is the traumatized and obsessive male lead who meets a tragic end but not before he gets tormented by Rachel and consequently kills her. In order to save her favorite character and avoid getting killed herself, Rachel is determined to change the narrative of the story!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Men were all losers, and women only existed to lie under me. I deserved to stand above them all. Until I got this damn curse…

"Use your body to satisfy those men ❤️"

(Source: TOPTOON)

Those “things” have been watching me. Ever since the day I felt their eyes on me, the people in my life have been acting strange. Actually, the whole world has been acting strange. Everywhere I go, I’m haunted by distorted faces and eerie shrieks. There are a few of us who have managed to evade their influence, but we don’t know why. It seems like something about me is different… special. I need to stop them from hurting anyone else, but I fear that it’s too late. Domination has already begun.

(Source: Tapas)

An overworked game developer dies and is reincarnated as the weakest character in the game he created himself. Challenged by Jaeseokcheon, the ruler of the game universe, he must complete a series of quests to survive and prevent a second death. Epic battles between monsters, celestial beings with magic powers, and Jaeseokcheon ensue. In this tug-of-war between the omniscient game designer and the hidden mastermind ruler… Who will win?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After catching her fiancé cheating, all Seo-Ha wanted was to drink the pain away. Drunk and heartbroken, she shouted she'd sleep with another man too – only to wake up in a stranger’s room, in just her underwear. But the man isn’t a stranger at all… it is Do-Hyeon, her childhood friend turned longtime nemesis. What the hell is he doing here?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Divorce with a wife whom he wanted to give everything to. He started realizing how popular he was after he was freed from her grip.

(Source: DAYcomics)

“Ugh! Life’s been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It’s all her fault, and now she’s ignoring me! I can’t stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Ji-Won, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she’s left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Hitman Lee Ja-Gyeong. His gun never misses, piercing the heart with pinpoint accuracy. It doesn't matter how despicable the target is. He took the job, killed, got paid, and that was the end of it. All he believed in was his skill and money. Then one day, a sudden, large-sum request came from a regular client. The condition for the $5 million payment was one thing: Kill Kang Il-Hyeon and retrieve one item from his safe. The target was ‘the son of a Korean gangster godfather’. Kang Il-Hyeon was a man with eyes as sharp as a snake's. Ja-Gyeong found himself slowly being strangled by the trap Kang had set, cornered...

“I heard a very interesting story while on a business trip to Hong Kong.”
“......”
“Aren't you curious? What that interesting story is?”
“Someone's trying to kill me. Right in my own house.”
“Explain it. I'll decide whether to believe you after hearing it.”

Can Ja-Gyeong kill Kang Il-Hyeon and complete the job? Or will he die a dog's death? The fight between men who wouldn't look out of place dying right now had begun.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

"The key to a successful operation lies in Seongil Seoul Hospital itself."

Yoo Jinwon, a specialist in surgical operations, receives a request to perform a secret surgery from Seong Wooje, the chairman of South Korea's largest corporation, the Seongil Group. At long last, the opportunity for revenge has arrived! Can Yoo Jinwon not only conquer Seongil Seoul Hospital but also seize control of the entire Seongil Group with just a scalpel? Let the battle no one thought possible begin.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In a world where you must steal or be stolen, kill or be killed, Ray, an orphan from the 50th sector, possesses the unique ability to see mana in the form of colors. However, despite the colorful sparks that fill the world around him, his existence has been numb detachment, completely devoid of emotions. But when a life-altering event shatters the cold, unfeeling life he once knew, Ray's journey might just unfold into a story richer in color than he could have ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After 20 grueling years of hellish training, Juhyuk's stats are maxed-out, and he is ready to venture out into Olympus, a virtual reality game. His master's last dying wish is for Juhyuk to be the Ultimate Evil, the most powerful in Olympus. But when he steps out of the tutorial area, every player tries to kill him, and the game forces him to start over from Level 1! With these setbacks, Juhyuk will need all the help he can get to complete his SSS-rank quest and become the next Ultimate Evil.

(Source: Tapas)

Jin-Wol Ma, better known in the martial realm as the ‘Mad Demon’, once stained the earth with blood in his pursuit to become the pinnacle of all living things. That was until his final battle with the Five Supreme Masters, where the leader of the Fire Dragon sect sealed him away using the Demon-Sealing Sword. Now, three thousand years later, Jin-Wol awakens, but he is no longer on Earth. Instead, he finds himself surrounded by hostile alien civilizations. Will Jin-Wol rise once again to aim for the peak of all living creatures?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After the zombie outbreak, the boss's stuck-up daughters, who used to look down on him, showed up at his shelter.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Yeong-Hyeon is a quiet and nice boy who is leaving school early when he runs into Dae-Han, an intimidating classmate rumored to have ties to a gang. Although Yeong-Hyeon tries to sneak past him, Dae-Han drags him to a cafe and asks him to be his boyfriend when they're both guys and have never even spoken before! Undeterred by Yeong-Hyeon's immediate refusal, Dae-Han walks him to school, buys him snacks, and changes seats to sit beside him. Eventually, his constant attention begins to grow on Yeong-Hyeon...

They say opposites attract, but can these two very different boys find love together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Have you ever been so angry that you wanted to break the laws of physics and throw down with a cosmic being? Well, you might if you’re Great—no, not “great”; I mean Great the Executioner. On planet Graymark, where the law decrees that all sinners must die, Great makes a name for himself butchering criminals in their thousands. Except now the law is no more, and Great must stand trial before the King of the Cosmos, Lohumlagaha. Enraged by fate, Great takes up his sword. It's just one last time… Or is it?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After the fall of the Kingdom of Solaris to the Demon King Zermes, a princess and her queen mother are captured and branded with a cursed Pleasure Mark. To protect her daughter, the queen embraces corruption, while the princess loses her last hope. And day by day, both are broken down and forced to submit to the Demon King's pleasure.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Elena Sorte is your average carefree noble lady. That is, until she finds out doomsday is on the horizon and the only person who can prevent it is Duke Kyffin Mayhart’s yet-unborn child. Resolving to take matters into her own hands, Elena marries Kyffin — the notorious “monster duke” — to ensure the birth of humanity’s savior. There’s just one problem: Her new husband is dead set on not laying a finger on her! Will Elena be able to tear down Kyffin’s ironclad defenses before it's too late…?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Manghal Unmyeongui Girl Group Leader-ga Doeeossseupnida

description:
Solo idol Baek Nokha sees her world crumble the day her mother dies while she's busy accepting an award. So, when a strange creature offers her a second chance, she accepts readily. But she never imagined she'd have to restart from the bottom as Yoon Chung, a trainee in an idol competition show! To see her mother again, she has to grant Chung's wish of debuting in first place. Armed with nothing but her voice and her knowledge of the industry, can this superstar climb her way back to the top?

(Source: Tapas)

Seok-Jun only wanted one thing: peace and quiet. Tormented night after night by the nonstop sexcapades of his new neighbor, Ye-Chan, he reaches a breaking point and prays for the man’s “precious equipment” to disappear. The next morning, the moans are gone...and so is Ye-Chan’s manhood. Shocked by the eerie coincidence, Seok-Jun feels guilty enough to try to help…but Ye-Chan seems more interested in using him as a solution than finding one. What begins as a bizarre curse quickly spirals into a chaotic, heated romance between the man who wished it away and the man desperate to get it back.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One night, Byeong-geon experiences sleep paralysis in his new house. He finds a ghost performing oral sex under his blanket but brushes it off, thinking it’s just his exhaustion. The next day, the ghost appears again, this time holding a knife to his dick?! "I'll... cut it off..." He barely manages to soothe and placate the ghost to keep it away, but now his body starts reacting to the ghost's seductive expression...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

“Become his therapist, and you’ll earn 500,000 a year!"

When Moon Dobin, a dominant omega, goes for a job interview, he’s baffled by the CEO's proposal: have sex with her son as a form of therapy. His client? Seo Tae-oh, a dominant alpha who can't sense pheromones. Dobin has worked hard to protect his virginity, but for that salary… anything goes! So, Dobin leads a secret double life as Tae-oh’s secretary by day and his therapist by night. As the two spend more time together, something is in the air - and not just pheromones!

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being worked to the bone at her office job, getting introduced to her longtime crush’s new girlfriend, and dealing with her family’s debt hanging over her head, Hari Shin's life seems to have hit rock bottom. Luckily, her friend Youngseo has a business proposal for her: go to an arranged date in her stead and Hari will receive a hefty compensation. Things grow complicated, however, when it turns out that the other party is Hari’s new CEO—and he's dead-set on marrying whoever shows up to the date!

(Source: Yen Press)

“I’m an unknown actress who cleans houses as a side gig. Ironically, my name means fame.” Struggling actress Myeong stumbles upon a photo exhibition filled with photos of her younger self, when she was filled with hope. Can she become a star as this mysterious photographer’s muse?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Ahn Yiyoung has won big in both his career and love. Not only is the start-up company he started with his college friends thriving, but he’s also dating SJ Group’s talented director, Kang Daehyung. Well, “former” director, that is. After resigning from his position, Daehyung has been doing everything to be Yiyoung’s perfect trophy boyfriend at home. But it won’t be long until Daehyung is back to wearing his professional suits, now as the investor and director of Yiyoung’s company! How will these two keep things balanced between work life and love life?

(Source: Tappytoon)

All’s fair in love and war. Two couples will need to battle it out for love and money! But who knew they’d swap partners before doing so? Tae-Rin and Ju-A are both friends and studying fashion at the same university. So why is Ju-A going on a couple’s show with Tae-Rin’s boyfriend? And why is Tae-Rin going on the same show with Ju-A’s boyfriend?!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Gayoon decides to enroll into a high school far away from home just to be closer to Soha, her middle school heroine and idol. Gayoon finds out about Soha's loss and decides to help her by filling the role of Soha's once true friend - Happy, Soha's pet dog.

(Source: Lezhin)

While pursuing a case, Detective I-Eum Kim of the Violent Crimes Unit rescues a man collapsed on a mountain trail. Stricken with amnesia, the man believes himself to be a child... Thus begins I-Eum's dangerous cohabitation with a mysterious stranger.

(Source: Manta)

After his mother remarries, Minseong ends up living with his stepsister, Sohyun. One day, by accident, he sees her naked. But something feels strangely familiar—the moles on her chest look exactly like those of a woman who appears on a secret, explicit account his friend once showed him. He tries to brush it off as a coincidence. Then a new post goes up on that account. [LewdRabbit – Today, my stepbrother came into my room without knocking… and I ended up showing him my body.]

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: The Monster Dame Requests Maternity Leave

description:
Lucia is the captain of the imperial knights and a swordmaster famous for her extraordinary achievements. However, she regrets something on her deathbed: unknowingly aiding a nefarious group in their plot to sacrifice the saintess for profit. So when she wakes up in the past as her 25-year-old self, Lucia is determined to rescue the child saintess and keep her safe until she’s old enough to protect herself. But the formidable knight is completely clueless when it comes to raising a child... Will six months of maternity leave be enough time for her to figure things out? The following series contains depictions of child abuse that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Two years ago, the great lord Sylhan was stripped of his title and status, reduced to a life of mania, amnesia, and slavery. He is resigned to his newfound lack of freedom, until a knight appears in front of him. A gentle hand around his waist, sweet lips pressed upon his own, and a deep connection forged in the unknowable past: Sylhan is confused, but unable to stop himself from being drawn ever closer to the mysterious man. The once proud lord can no longer lay claim to glory, wealth, or power…but what about love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

All Nae-Un Kim ever wanted was to become the best surgeon she could be. She’s satisfied, even if there’s no time for herself. But when her power-hungry father sends her on a blind date, her life is thrown into chaos. Kang-Joon Cha is a legend–and not just because of his powerful family. He’s a brilliant and respected surgeon in his own right. As busy as he is, it’s no wonder he’s single--unless there's another reason. Can this pair thread the needle? Or will this relationship end before it starts?

(Source: Tapas)

Amelie Bourbon is a witch, destined to die at the hands of her lover, the ruthless tyrant Serwin Hennessia. So when ordinary office worker Lee Suyeon is reborn as Amelie, she vows to change the ill-fated story. The problem is the “calamity” sealed inside Serwin’s body, which threatens to ruin him and the entire world, can only be calmed when he is near Amelie. As she grows closer to Serwin, Amelie must hone her magic to subdue his violent impulses, but can she defeat calamity once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Jisuh is quiet, unassuming... observant. He’s suited to working behind the camera. But for reasons he’s not exactly quick to disclose, he’s run into some debt. Heejae, an actor he’s worked with before, proposes he work with him exclusively on a private project of his...shooting himself and his partner having sex. Jisuh thought he was hired for his camera skills, but Heejae seems to know an awful lot about him and he can’t help but wonder why he really hired him.

(Source: Lezhin)

In Damyeon, where there are no tourist attractions, seeing a foreigner is very rare… especially one covered in blood. It’s the first time in all Yuhui’s 20 years that she’s seen someone who looked like a mobster.

“I’ve been wondering this since earlier, Baby…”
“Yes?”
“Did you get that wet thing out on purpose to show me?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The story of a woman and a curse that leads men to their death, will she be able to find happiness?

(Source: Toomics)

A dangerous thirst for a beautiful stepmother. Once hooked, there is no way out. JI-WON's desire ends up pointing toward his stepmom and her friends...

"Mom... Only for tonight... I'll do this only for tonight"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Third season of Cheese in the Trap.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Romance? That can't possibly happen to us!
New comic romance concept.

Eun Pyo-Eum, the leader of the failed idol group Moses, is desperate for a comeback. When a mysterious sponsorship deal offers him a lifeline, there’s just one problem: he has chronic erectile dysfunction. Seeking help from the nation's top urologist, Professor Han Girip, Pyo-Eum finds that standard medicine won't cut it. To fix his condition, he agrees to participate in Girip’s new experimental therapy...a treatment that quickly turns into a series of (quite literally) shocking encounters.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The son of a lowly innkeeper, U-Mun Song always dreamed of being a martial arts master, a dream that would never become a reality thanks to his frail body. Then one night, a mysterious guest leaves behind a painting as payment that enthralls U-Mun for reasons he can’t explain. It soon becomes clear that it’s no ordinary painting when U-Mun starts showing prowess in the martial arts he’s never had before. Thus begins the path for a scatterbrained kid to change his destiny and become truly undefeatable!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

“You, too, will be corrupted. Then I will make it all come true.”

If I had only joined hands with him and agreed to become his mistress then, could I have lived a little longer? At least I would not have know the pain of my eyes being gouged out. But instead I shouted: “I refuse. I will not betray my country”, not realizing that my country, my family, had betrayed me long ago.

Sacrificed, used, abandoned, and finally executed by my own family... I only realized after returning to 10 years in the past that the reason why you wanted me to stand by your side is because you and I were so much alike. Let us fall together this time.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Won first place in the Tateyomi Manga Awards 2025 domestic category.

Juyeon has a crush on the new recruit to the theater club, Sol. Things seem to be going well until Juyeon’s ex girlfriend, Minkyeong, joins the club and approaches Juyeon with questionable intentions. As if running into Minkyeong wasn’t enough, the trio are asked to perform in a play, “The Maids” by Jean Genet, for the annual theater club performance. Will Juyeon be able to unravel their tangled relationships and find love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: Hacking to get closer to streamers!

description:
One day, a hacking app gets installed in Seon-U's phone by chance. With the app, he finds out about the secrets of female streamers, and starts using the secrets to approach them.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Namjoo moves into a new home, only to discover that his next-door neighbor, Juhee, is no ordinary woman. Like a real-life gacha game, her face and body transform at random! And the only way to revert to her original form? Multiple orgasms. When Namjoo accidentally stumbles upon her secret, Juhee strikes a deal—they'll be fuck buddies. They say a man’s ideal type is a woman he’s never seen before... but what if she changes every time? A thrilling, unpredictable romance begins with the ever-changing "Gacha Girl" next door!

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where werewolves live among humans in secret, Ji-u Han, a detective agency owner and a powerful werewolf, crosses paths with Yuseung Cheon, a famous actor, when he “accidentally” hits her with his car. And when they run into each other again “by chance,” one thing becomes clear to Ji-u: She must have him —whatever that may entail. Ji-u wants Yuseung’s rare ability to make werewolves stronger through touch. Yuseung, on the other hand, wants information on key figures in the werewolf world to eliminate them. Will they each get what they’re after? Or more importantly—will they fall in love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: When the Archduke's Leash Is Pulled

description:
Jenna, a girl cursed to see others’ emotions as light, awakens as an extra in a novel. Yearning for a quiet life, she settles in a forest cabin—only to discover it belongs to Enoch Winchester, a cursed duke cloaked in an ominous black light. When Enoch realizes Jenna may hold the key to breaking his curse, he proposes a contract: she must spend time with him each day and come whenever he calls. Jenna agrees, but with one condition—he must appear in the form of a snow leopard whenever they're together.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Several days of torture is not enough to make the Captain disclose the location of his team’s safe house. Seeing that their tricks are working in vain, his captors call in the Colonel to get the vital information out of him. This cold-blooded Colonel will readily kill anyone within a heartbeat to get the information he needs. However, the Captain just so happens to have a pretty face…and the Colonel knows just what he wants to do to it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When ex-mercenary Gyuwon Kim returns to Korea after his retirement, he has just one goal in mind: earn enough money to get plastic surgery. While having a face that is capable of making even a grown man cry in fear came in handy as a mercenary, what Gyuwon really wants is to be the one crying himself at the hands of a ruthless master. The perfect opportunity comes when Gyuwon is hired as a bodyguard to protect the precious youngest son of the Yoon Clan, Hwayoung Yoon, from a recent stalker. Unbeknownst to Gyuwon, hidden behind Hwayoung’s pretty face is actually a sadistic dom who already has plans to make the vicious-looking man his new pet.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

When an accident shows Ellie what bullying the male lead, Damian, would do to her in the future, she tries to stay away from him at all costs. But after seeing everyone else mistreat the poor boy, she decides to protect him until he meets Duke Schuetz, his future adoptive father. However, there's one thing Ellie doesn't expect when she helps them reunite: the duke's offer to bring her with them as his daughter-in-law! How will this new plot twist change her fate and the course of the story?

(Source: Tapas)

Rejected by her family and betrayed by her fiancé and scheming half-sister, Efna gets a second chance at life when she wakes up before the accident that was meant to end her. Determined to live quietly as a teacher, she soon discovers that her mischievous Sunshine Class is only the beginning. Add a few politically feuding older brothers into the mix—a dashing captain, an emperor, and an archduke—and chaos is inevitable. Can Efna make it through nap time, or will she lose her sanity first?

(Source: Tapas)

Following a life of bloodshed and heartbreak, the great Empress Martina is reborn as Astina, the genius daughter of a humble count. But her peaceful world is shattered when bankruptcy forces her father to marry her off to the dangerous Archduke Atalenta. All of high society knows him as "Terriod the Beast" because of a family curse that turned him into a wild monster. Luckily, even the deadly beast of Atalenta is no match for the former empress's mighty sword. Everyone is shocked when the new archduchess tames her husband all too easily and takes over as the family head. No one's more surprised than Astina, however, when her casual kiss returns Terriod to his human form. Not only does he resemble her past life lover, but he has no memory of her from his wolf days. Despite these awkward circumstances, can the new power couple join hands to rule over the archduchy?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Straight-laced honor student Jin-Woo decides to break the rules just once, and steps into a club for the first time in his life. One drunken mistake leads to him spending a passionate night with a strikingly handsome stranger - the next morning, he wakes up alone in an empty room…with a pile of cash on the nightstand. Shocked and humiliated, Jin-Woo assumes the worst, and buries the memory deep in his heart. Back at school, Jin-Woo volunteers for a student performance…only to lock eyes with someone on stage. It’s him. The man from that night, and the king of campus: Kwon Tae-Yeong. It’s then that, in front of everyone and with a glint in his eye, Tae-Yeong smiles and utters two words that will change the course of both of their lives forever: “Found you.”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong-Yoon has harbored a crush on Chae-Heon all through high school and now college. Despite ‘fate’ always bringing them together, Jeong-Yoon hasn’t been able to become close to Chae-Heon, much less tell the latter about his feelings. This is mainly because he is convinced that Chae-Heon doesn’t like him. But unbeknownst to Jeong-Yoon, Chae-Heon is not without his own complaints. Will the two resolve ever their misunderstandings and will love, which has been put on hold for so long, finally begin?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong-O Han was just expecting to take on a part-time job as an assistant. What he didn’t expect was working inside people’s dreams with a cute, but grumpy shaman named I-Beom. And he certainly didn’t expect I-Beom to be cursed by a nightmare seedling, with uncontrollable sexual arousal that can only be tamed by acting out his desires!

I-Beom may not be too sure about Jeong-O, but with his prickly personality, he has no one to turn to for help. But luckily for him, Jeong-O is always in a giving mood...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

Wrongly accused and left to die, a fallen queen opens her eyes ten years earlier—back at nineteen, just after her parents’ deaths. Given a second chance, she swears never to be used again. To protect her family, she sets her sights on the empire’s highest rank of knighthood: the **Chevalier**. Through relentless training and treacherous court politics, she forges herself into a true warrior—until the commander of the knight order appears before her, setting a new fate into motion.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In the sweltering heat of summer, seven office workers lose their way during a company workshop. They stumble upon an old mountain lodge filled with mysterious, unidentified bottles of alcohol. As if bewitched, they drink one glass after another slowly letting their reason slipping away. The boss then discreetly offers us a proposal. The lodge suddenly fills with desire and secrets.

“Would you like to hear the story of my first experience?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

After the death of her mother, Ruby is taken in by her mother's friend, Mrs. Watson, as a maid for the Bell family. She meets Grace, a young lady of different origins. She thinks she's just a bad girl, but Grace is the only one in the Bell household who cares about her. She becomes the only one who cares about Ruby, and a strange feeling grows between them...

Ruby's feelings for Grace are either envy or love.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

All I wanted was to return the lighter! Taehun finally gets in contact with his old buddy, Wonu, and before they part after a few drinks, Wonu gets into a car accident after Taehun stops him to give his lighter back. After he wakes up from a coma, Wonu starts acting strange, like he’s a totally different person… Wait. So you’re Wonu, but not Wonu at the same time? Who are you?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 epilogues.

Yoo-Joon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Ji-Ho. When Ji-Ho says "Jump," Yoo-Joon asks "How high?"
