It is a blessing for the society debutantes of London, then, that Cupid’s arrow should be guided by the dainty hand of Miss Laura Pendleton, granddaughter of Countess Pendleton and the city’s finest matchmaker. When Laura’s self-ascribed duties call her to befriend the stoic and saturnine Mr. Ian Dalton of Whitefield, however, she soon finds that when it comes to the grand contest of love, it may well be every woman for herself…

(Source: WEBTOON)

What would you do if you caught your friend stealing your underwear...? Is that weird or is it just me? Somebody, please explain!

(Source: Toomics)

Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities’ wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its torment, all while living a double life filled with secrecy, betrayal, and a growing conflict between heroism and villainy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The new semester at the prestigious art school begins with each of the four characters coming to face their newfound ambitions and desires. But while desire turns into insanity, those who thirst for more find themselves heading to even greater ruin...

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day l woke up, and started living the dream. How long will this last?

(Source: Toomics)

While working overtime, Ji-Chan Choi happens to stumble upon the 'Office Romance Registry.' Out of curiosity, he writes his name in the manager's column. From that day on, his life begins to change... 'Office romance is forbidden in our company. However, managers are excluded.'

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

"Is it really this hard, just because of me?"

After finishing his military service, Gi-Chan develops a strange condition. Once he gets hard, he doesn't go down until he cums. And when he finally does? He releases an explosive amount of cum. With this dangerous condition, Gi-Chan returns to his hometown... where a seductive new family is waiting for him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.english: How to Send Your Husband to Hell

description:
Helena Winston, the dazzling diva of noble society, is thrust into scandal when the crown prince unexpectedly confesses his love. To protect the Empire—and her own reputation—the Empress proposes a secret deal: marry a man of her choosing and expose his secrets. Her target? Count Benjamin Ischpern, a veiled noble rumored to be tied to enemies of the throne. As Helena begins her life in an arranged marriage, one thing becomes clear—there is indeed far more to this man than it seems. So she swears: she will bring her husband to ruin, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ever since his eighth birthday, Yeonwoo has been the target of cruel bullying by his classmates. It was a well-known fact that he was poor, smelly, and living with his grandma. But with the new transfer student Seongwoon’s dramatic appearance, he gains his first real friend. Just as Yeonwoo starts getting used to his new happy life, Seongwoon and his parents are in a tragic accident that leaves him orphaned with no memories. Now, it’s Yeonwoo’s turn to take care of the precious person who gifted him so many of his “firsts”—even, if Seongwoon doesn’t remember a single one.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six side story chapters.

A series of cat killings occurs in a neighborhood. The suspect is surprisingly Baek Si-Yun, the top student in his third-year middle school class. When Si-Yun finds himself in a situation where no one believes his claims of innocence, he sets out to find the real cat killer himself, accompanied by his friends Su-Min and Jeong-Hyeon, who believe in him. However, during their search for the killer, they become entangled with Hwa-Ja, an auntie working at an animal shelter, and Detective Jun-Woo, who lurks around Hwa-Ja, plunging them into an uncontrollable whirlwind of events...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yun Byeol’s world is turned upside down when his brother, Hye-Seong, gets into an accident. But when Byeol visits him in the hospital, he’s surprised to find him in an expensive private room and learns that Hye-Seong received compensation for the incident. When he goes to confront Seong Un, the person who pushed his brother down the stairs, Byeol is met with another surprise: Un knows about a dark side of Hye-Seong that is hard to believe. What is their relationship, and why would Un push him?

(Source: Tapas)

Neris is forced into an engagement by her father, but when she arrives at the Duke’s estate, her sister is already there, demanding the Duke for herself. As the Duke shows interest in Neris, she discovers her sister has returned from the past, determined to take everything—including her fiancé.

(Source: Manta)

Steamy stories that might be true...or totally fake. Hooking up with your married friend? A wild foursome out of nowhere? Who hasn’t fantasized about something a little out there? New episodes every day to tease your curiosity—until the big reveal. Can you tell what's fact and what's pure fantasy? Take your best guess...if you dare.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeong Ji-Heon, a once-promising swimmer, retired early due to an injury and now works diligently at a sports agency. The hottest topic in the sports marketing world is none other than Kwon Jae-Kyoung, and agencies are fiercely competing to win him over. Ji-Heon’s boss orders him to secure a meeting with Jae-Kyoung at all costs. Using a trivial connection from a decade ago when they briefly trained at the same aquatic center, Ji-Heon miraculously succeeds in arranging a meeting. However, when they finally meet, Jae-Kyoung shows no interest in contract terms and instead seems strangely fixated on Ji-Heon’s genetic traits…

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the near future, a small number of Alphas known as the Awakened are born with extraordinary powers. Diego should have been one of the strongest, but every time he uses his ability, his body betrays him with violent seizures. When he’s introduced to Shane, a quiet scientist who offers to create a stabilizer, Diego begins to feel an inexplicable pull toward him. As buried memories resurface, Diego starts to wonder if their meeting was fate, or the beginning of something that transcends time itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

If there’s one thing that ruins a good story, it’s a cliché! Handsome prince? Lame. Damsel in distress? Yawn. Knight in shining armor? Depends... How good is he in bed? Wait, HUH?! Well, Yuna Han is out to make sure her sister’s story is anything but a cliché, only now she'll have to live inside of it. And luckily, she plays a fairly minor role. Her only crime is being the main villain's older sister! Can she manage to save both her sister's story AND her own neck before we reach the final page?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a 8-chapter side story

Grace and Henry are childhood friends and engaged to be married until Grace’s family loses everything after being charged with treason. With her parents dead and nowhere to go, Grace is taken in by Henry’s family to work as their maid. But with that comes the duty of serving her fiancé-turned-master at all hours of the day, even at night...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Gyeong-Won Cha, who has Highlander syndrome, always wanted to look more like an adult. But one day, he hears:

"We gotta use the only advantage we've got - to pretend we're kids!"

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

When the hand that used to so lovingly hold Annette Rozenberg ends up being the one that causes the downfall of her family, Annette demands that Heiner Waldemar give her a divorce. But Heiner refuses, stating that he must see her miserable by his side, no matter what. At odds, the two continue a precarious relationship, only to be met with wounds of the past that bring them tragically together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

As the one and only fire witch in 300 years, Liona spends her life isolated from the world... until she falls for Rakus, prince of the Kingdom of Carrell. But after he betrays and kills her, she opens her eyes as the newborn baby princess of the Hasys Empire! With her OP-level strength and royal dragon-blood lineage, she’s out for revenge against Rakus. To get there, she must first secretly harness her mana, find people she can trust, and defeat her 11 siblings to gain the power of the throne!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The double life of a public official

description:
James Lee, a grade 7 official, is trying to make it through each day dealing with Amanda Shin, a grade 5 official. One day, James finds out about Amanda's double life that he can use for revenge.

"Shall we do a roleplay? It's about forced sex volunteer."

(Source: DAYcomics)

Hyun-A's mother remarried, and she had a new stepfather. He was young, strong, and handsome. But starting on the wedding day, his obsession with Hyun-A grew stronger. When her ailing mother went abroad for convalescence, Hyun-A and her stepfather's secret encounters deepened...

"I've always wondered what my daughter's pussy looked like. Ever since I first saw you."

Hyun-A's breath caught in her throat. She wondered if what he was saying was real.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Tired of the city, I moved to the countryside for a quiet life. But now... everyone I see has a number on their chest!

(Source: Toomics)

Kinemia Lyon's got two rules for surviving a novel: recruit talented geniuses to save her territory and don't get involved with Ayan Krotz, a dangerous mage. But when Ayan gets captured for trespassing on her land over and over again, she decides to hire him as her bodyguard instead. Unfortunately, letting Ayan into her life means dealing with his erratic magic and even more concerning personality! Can Kinemia come to tame this master mage? Or will she regret not kicking him out for good?

(Source: Tapas)

War hero and army captain Fedele Aske is haunted by the ghosts of his past, preventing him from getting any sleep at night without a woman to warm his bed. When one of his nightly companions turns out to be an enemy spy, Princess Igraine forbids him from taking any more women into his tent as his military adviser. But the lack of sleep greatly impairs Fedele’s abilities on the battlefield, leaving Igraine with no choice. She’ll just have to be the one to ease his restless nights from now on...

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a war against demons for the fate of the world, even three chances at life may not suffice. Such is the fate of Lady Sacred Beryl, a divine maiden tasked with rooting out demonic corruption, only to be murdered and travel back in time -- twice. Upon her third attempt, Beryl realizes the truth: Her only hope to purify the realm is to face the fearsome House Vine, a lair of demons in mortal guise. Can Beryl survive in the domain of Duke Beleth von Vine, or will she find nothing but death and damnation once more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The cutting words of Lee Seok-Jun’s first love during his school days left a scar that still follows him into adulthood. His fear of intimacy and emotional distance have turned breakups into a recurring theme in his life. One night, while venting about yet another failed relationship at a bar with friends, Seok-Jun crosses paths with Yae Ji-Hoo—a notorious bar regular with a reputation for living like a gigolo. Enticed by Ji-Hoo’s bold offer of a "crash course in adult technique," Seok-Jun narrowly escapes an awkward situation just in time. But Ji-Hoo’s wounded pride refuses to let the matter rest. When he learns that Seok-Jun works as a swimming instructor, Ji-Hoo begins plotting an elaborate revenge scheme.

(Source: Lezhin US)

HYPNO is equipped with hypnosis, status window, nonsense and self-justification. He intends to build a harem using his new abilities in a new world! And... the first woman he meets in the new world is a married one with the hottest body!!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After being returned to the past multiple times, Lyatte finally succeeds in escaping execution by murdering her treasonous husband. The only catch is that each time she returned, it cost her half of her remaining lifespan, and now she has less than two years left. Determined to live the rest of her short life to its fullest, Lyatte decides to hold a contest to find a new husband. Will the competition be a success, or will Lyatte's time run out before she can experience true love?

(Source: Tapas)

In my past life, I was praising my professor as a graduate student; in my present life, I’m praising my younger brother as an older sister. To survive in the Duke’s household where I was adopted, I absolutely have to get on the good side of Kilian, the male lead of the novel. Fortunately, it’s still a long way before the original novel’s events unfold! Reina strives to survive by diligently flattering, running errands for, and offering snacks to the young male lead Kilian, who will eventually eliminate her in the future. “Sister, you have to marry me too.” What…? Did I win his favor too well by using my past life’s skills to the fullest? This little chubby kid is proposing. I tried to dismiss it as a child’s prank, “You’ve never been my sister. If anything, you’re a woman to me.” Suddenly, a deep voice echoed. When did he grow up so much? Unaware of the passage of time, Reina, who only thinks about escaping, and the obsessive male lead Kilian, who only cares about his sister, engage in a game of cat and mouse in their romance.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Unwelcome Guests of House Fildette

description:
Hayden Grummond Fildette, the only son of Count and Countess Fildette, was the perfect heir and lovable anchor who kept his family together. But the peaceful days come to an end when an unwelcome guest from his father’s past surfaces, threatening Hayden’s position with a possible half-brother and tipping over his parents’ precarious relationship. Will he and his family be able to withstand the storm of uncomfortable truths and misunderstandings, or sink in the raging conflicts?

(Source: Tapas)

Annis, a knight, married Marquis Devon Pizetra out of respect for her late mother’s wish. As the lady of the house, she brought wealth to the family by successfully managing the finances. However, the incapable husband Devon spends her hard-earned money on his ex-wife, who is pregnant with his child. Devon asks Annis for a divorce but forces her to stay on the estate and continue to manage family businesses. When Annis was broken by her husband's betrayal, she encounters Rowan, an old acquaintance and fellow knight who seems to have feelings for her that’s been kept hidden for a long time.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Andrew is the only daughter of the famous Grace family. She also has an incurable disease. Due to her family's high status in society, Andrew grew up with no friends save for her maid, Herta, whom she has become intensely infatuated with. Little does she know, her family is responsible for ruining Herta's life. Can Andrew break the hierarchy and be with her? Or will Herta end her suffering first...

(Source: Tapas)

Saeyeon was like a second mother to Wonhee. She took care of him since infancy, but now... Wonhee is a full grown man.

(Source: Toomics)

Eun-chae, a freshman, dreamed of a fun campus life at university, but on the school's orientation day, she received an unexpected assignment.

"From now on, there will be a regular assignment once a week. The assignment's content is..."

"A hole inspection."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In 1940, amidst an era of chaos, a beautiful mansion named Yeongchunhwa was built on a remote island, constructed solely out of a man's deep love for his wife. Time passed, and the story of the couple tied to the mansion faded from memory. Yet one day, a mysterious ‘caretaker’ appeared, transforming it into a lodging establishment. He began inviting people to the mansion—those who must love, guided by the couple's spirits...!

“Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, the secret mansion that will bring you infinite imagination. Here, any form of love is possible. Love and indulge freely. As long as the mansion permits.”

A luxurious mansion and the people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women, crafted by various authors, unfold now.

First Short Story Parachute Blouse: Influencers Choi Baek-Tan and Yang Su-Ji win a free stay at Yeongchunhwa Mansion while searching for a travel destination to celebrate their 7th anniversary. Arriving at the beautiful, opulent mansion, they explore and discover a mother-of-pearl cabinet in a second-floor room. Wearing the antique clothes found inside, they passionately make love. But after that day, Su-Ji notices Baek-Tan has become strange...?

“What is this unfamiliar feeling? It's like... he's someone else.”

What was the true identity of that other presence that had waited for Su-ji there for so long?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Five years ago, an accident erased Ha Do-Geon’s memories. Even so, his life has remained mostly smooth, calm, and manageable. He believes the past he lost no longer matters. That illusion cracks the night he returns home after a university alumni event. His designated driver, Yang Ha-Il, is a stranger, yet the moment their eyes meet, something deep inside Do-Geon stirs. A gaze that feels unfamiliar but achingly known, an attraction he cannot explain. From that night on, Do-Geon’s carefully balanced life begins to shift. Emotions he does not remember choosing start to resurface, pulling him toward a man who feels tied to a time he was sure was gone forever. Caught between erased memories and revived feelings, Do-Geon is forced to confront the possibility that forgetting did not mean letting go.

As the past quietly pushes its way back into the present, Do-Geon must face the question he never thought he would ask again, what if the most important part of his life is the one he lost?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a quiet countryside village lies an ancient, family-owned hot spring, passed down through generations. As it prepares for its grand reopening, Jinho is suddenly left to run the bathhouse alone. His only help? Sejeong, the gorgeous girl next door. As they work together to deep-clean the place, they stumble upon a mysterious bundle of herbs and an old medicinal book in the storage room. When they brew a vibrant, green herbal bath from the fragrant herbs, something unexpected begins to heat up—and it’s not just the water!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Falling into the Arms of a Mad Villain

description:
Instead of being caught by Prince Charming, I've fallen into a complete nightmare! Not only did I transmigrate into a trashy romance fantasy novel, but I fell from the sky and ended up in the arms of the mad villain, Edwin Crawford. Before I knew it, he called me his wife from the heavens and was raving about some prophecy. I don't even know who I am, so how can I be his wife?! Until I figure out what is happening, will it be safe to stay in the embrace of the Mad Dragon of the West?

(Source: Tapas)

Yeon Hae-Geum, the nation’s one and only S-Class Guide, has been in love for years with Seo Moon-Hyeon - his guardian, mentor, and the man who raised him like family. From teaching him how to eat and read to mastering his guiding abilities, Moon-Hyeon has always been Hae-Geum’s everything. But just when Hae-Geum thinks he'll stay by his side forever, Moon-Hyeon suddenly announces his engagement… without even telling him. Crushed, Hae-Geum prepares to walk away... that is until fate throws in a twist: Seo Moon-Hyeok, Moon-Hyeon’s identical twin brother, shows up. Cold, blunt, and endlessly flirtatious, Moon-Hyeok needs Hae-Geum—not for love, but to power his climb to the top. Still, he’s not above using his twin’s face to seduce him. Now trapped between a possessive first love and a reckless new temptation, Hae-Geum must navigate a storm of emotions, pheromones, and dangerous attraction.

Will he remain loyal to the past—or give in to the thrill of something forbidden? One face, two destinies. One guide, caught in between.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.english: The Ice-Queen Class Ace Is a Masochist?!

description:
Perfect grades, perfect face, and an iron wall that no man can climb. Taeyeong is the campus Ice Queen, and Namjoo is just another guy stuck in the friend zone. But when he discovers Taeyeong’s deepest secret, a hidden masochistic streak, the power dynamic shifts. The Ice Queen doesn't want a prince, she wants someone who knows how to pull her strings. Is Namjoo ready to stop being the "nice guy" and give her exactly what she secretly craves?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A cosmic anomaly has opened interdimensional breaches on Earth, creating exotic hybrid environments called “dungeons” inhabited by deadly otherworldly creatures. Yoo Jaryong, left to fend for himself as his father’s health deteriorates, secretly cultivates the superhuman potential arising from the anomaly and becomes a dungeon smuggler to pay his bills. When elite dungeon raiders discover his skills, he is given the chance to train at the alma mater of the world’s heroes: Yongsa High School.

(Source: Tapas)

Seo Hae-young, the only light of Yoon Hae-won, who has no money, no family, and no future. After Ko Tae-gyeom, his "friend," reveals his feelings for him, Hae-won's life begins to fall apart.

Tae-gyeom demands a relationship through threats, Hae-young wields violence in an unknown manner, and another friend Joo Hyun-woo joins the ranks...

The broken relationship between the four people, the memories of the past that are now faded.

Who will win this irreversible game?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Lee Changsoo is a bodyguard who was disciplined and removed from his job after an accident. However, he is offered a chance to return to his job if he performs well as the temporary manager of the company’s top idol group, Luminous, until a new manager is found. Changsoo coldly accepts the opportunity, but it doesn’t take him long to realize that the girls are uncooperative and landmines waiting to explode at any moment… Will Changsoo make it back to his job as a bodyguard in one piece?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: An Extra Stole the Male Leads

description:
Reborn as Selonia Bessin, the heroine of a romance fantasy novel, a girl is thrust into a demon-slaying mission with the novel's three male leads. They successfully defeat the demon lord, but Selonia falls unconscious for three months on the journey back. Upon awakening, she discovers the trio is now enamored with Grace Benet, an unknown extra. Moreover, the supposedly defeated demon lord is back in hot human form! Why has he returned, and who is this mysterious Grace stealing the limelight?

(Source: Tapas)

What do you when you have a burning crush, but can’t work up the nerve to tell him? Buy a nice dildo and dream about making sweet, sweet love, of course. However, Chi-Woo’s plan takes a turn when he finds his toy comes with a special offer: fight monsters with the magic dildo to make your wish come true! Chi-Woo will do anything to get closer to his crush, but the monsters he must battle are quite...nasty. Can Chi-Woo protect his crush from danger, and save his first time for the one he wants?!

(Source: Lezhin)

The inseparable three princesses of the Ernst Kingdom each had their own vice. Cecile was obsessed with her slender figure, and Charlotte was plagued by insomnia. But Abelle’s vice was comparatively tame: having the occasional lewd fantasy. That was until they were all cursed by a witch who sought vengeance on their father. Now, Cecile can’t stop eating, Charlotte can’t stop sleeping, and as for Abelle... Well, she can’t stop craving sex! As the only one capable of breaking the curse, the wanton princess must find a way to quench her desire or risk ruining her reputation!

(Source: Tappytoon)

The Mara destroyed everything in its path, including the Awakened. It selected humans with the stigmata of each sign in the night sky, except for one—Shin Hyuk Lee. This lone Awakened dealt the final blow against the Mara. Upon achieving such a feat, Vega, the goddess of Lyra, appeared to grant his wish. Shin Hyuk wished to go back with the Lyra stigmata to prevent this tragedy from happening again. Upon returning, Shin Hyuk’s body rejected the Lyra stigmata and died... with the Mara beside him.

(Source: Tapas)

Woo-Yeon never liked Alphas, not before, and definitely not after he manifested as an Omega. The only person who ever made him feel seen was his tutor, Do-Hyun. Years later, Woo-Yeon follows him to university, hoping for a fresh start. But when they meet again, Do-Hyun doesn't recognize him. Woo-Yeon, however, never forgot—not his voice, his kindness, or the way Do-Hyun still makes his heart flutter. Then he learns the truth. Do-Hyun is an Alpha...

(Source: Tapas)

“I’ll wait for you,” whispers a mysterious, red-haired woman. So goes the recurring dream Jae-Sin Yang has had every night since the tragic massacre at the orphanage when he was a child. When he moves to the notoriously haunted Orchid Road to delve into the meaning behind his dreams, he is nearly killed by a vengeful demon on the first night. However, he is rescued by a beautiful woman named So-Cheon who looks just like the woman in his dreams. Together, they join forces to help innocent demons and fight against the demonic designs of Geumgwan, the lord of all demons.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

Arthur Groban, a new detective with the LAPD, is desperate to prove his ability despite being a rookie within the force. But with every case he is assigned, things look more and more bleak as the corruption in the shadows becomes ever more apparent. Feeling helpless, Arthur is almost ready to give up when he happens to cross paths with the mysterious and alluring Silas Moore. Silas is willing to pull some strings behind the scenes to help Arthur, so long as the detective gives him two things in exchange: his body, and his pride. The further Arthur goes for Silas, the more he will get in return. But how far is too far in the pursuit of justice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count include 11 extra chapters.

The two main characters of our story may not know each other, but their lives take remarkably similar trajectories. Both work in the adult industry, yet both suffer performance issues. Namgeun works at an adult toy company, and his less than stellar performance in the bed leads his girlfriend to dump him. Meanwhile, Yeorang’s made a career as a sex columnist, but a leaked video reveals her inability to orgasm. Separately, they visit the local hardware store for rope to take their lives. But not only do they not die...it seems the rope has magically cured their sex issues. Now it’s time for Namgeum and Yeorang to discover the extent of the rope’s power.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Claude, who happened to see the Korean archery player Na-Ri beautifully drawing a bow on TV, fell in love at first sight and became a member of the French national swimming team with only the thought of meeting Na-Ri. And then the long-awaited first meeting with Na-Ri. "Please marry me!!" Claude is so nervous that he proposes to Na-Ri in the middle of a restaurant! Na-Ri, who became close to Claude due to the unexpected proposal incident, starts to find Claude cute because he fidgets in front of her but is honest and approaches her...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

Azadin, a member of the cursed Messenger Clan, is born with the worst of curses. Lacking magical prowess, he becomes the lowest-ranking messenger, wandering the continent collecting gold coins in hopes of breaking his curse. But when his twin uncovers a great conspiracy, how will he face the impending doom?

(Source: Manta)

Some women would kill to be the love interest of a book’s charming protagonist, but Maise Hazelnut is different! As a girl from the 21st century, she struggles to keep up the appearance of the angelic “Maise” while defying the fate laid out for her by a harem romance novel. That’s right, Maise’s boyfriend is none other than the goofy and lovable protagonist, and every woman in the book has her eyes on him. Right after she dumps him to work toward her own happy ending, Maise gets set up on a blind date with a man named Eith Lancell. She falls head over heels for Eith, but notices his strange behavior at times… Something’s weird about this devilishly handsome new beau. What could he be hiding?

(Source: TappyToon)

Noi, who has taken a job as a housemaid in a mansion called “Yoo Ri-Ah Mansion,” had no intention of getting into this situation, but somehow ends up receiving love from both the owner of the mansion, “Nonah,” and her sister-like figure, “Nico”! What’s more, various individuals such as a game center fairy, a famous influencer, and a romantic biker, all fall head over heels for Noi at first sight. It’s an endless feast of lesbian encounters! Either being overwhelmed or overwhelming others, it’s a cruel female-dominated world of sexual desire! Can the protagonist truly protect her innocence throughout it all?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"I like you! Have sex with me!"

Seon-Ung, a new hire at a large company, has come across a program that changes what constitutes common sense for the people around him. He decides to use his newfound skill to teach his team leader a lesson for giving him a hard time over the past 4 years.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

"I heard you're the master at sex."

His friends call him Dr. Sex, but in reality, Jin-Yeong is still a virgin. However, he lies to his sister, Bom, and acts like he has experience. However... He didn't expect Bom to sneak into his room asking him to teach her about sex every night!!!

(Source: DAYcomics)

"Is this really Joseon?! Even so, we must save lives!"

Baek Gang-Hyeok, South Korea's greatest genius surgeon. After touching a mysterious painting, he falls into Joseon. And of all times... right before the outbreak of the Imjin War!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In a rural village where he was always ignored, Jun-Hyeon one day discovers a mysterious megaphone with strange powers. The moment he uses it, the villagers begin to flock to him...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Betrayed by her trusted boyfriend, Yuna breaks her pre-marital chastity and asks Junghoon to have sex with her. Junghoon then tells this to Yena, Yuna's younger sister and friend, but Yena's expression is somehow not good. Junghoon has an unrequited crush on Yuna, her older sister. Yena, in turn, has an unrequited crush on Junghoon. 'Why isn't it me, but my sister? I... I liked him first, so just keep doing it.' This is a somewhat very erotic story of these individuals, each with their own 'circumstances,' as they overcome unrequited love.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Son Joong-gil, chairman of the Korea Finance Group, who represented Korea in the 1990s. 30 years after he closes his eyes, he opens them in the body of his grandson, Son Jeong-hoon, in 2022. A financial group that has declined noticeably compared to 30 years ago. Son Joong-gil is trying to bring the group he helped build to the top again.

(Source: Naver, translated)
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Blessed with dragon's blood, a royal is born every generation with the creature's legendary might. But with that might comes a dragon's cruelty. Thus, each royal is assigned a Regas, a dragon tamer capable of quelling the raging hearts of those with the dragon's blessing. Abel has been trained in the ways of a Regas, but can he withstand the lunacy of the latest blessed prince?

(Source: Tapas)

Would you rather be the target of a ruthless gang of loan sharks or become the boy-toy of an unhinged corporate heir for a year? This is the predicament Hojin finds himself in when Yoo-Seong, a former one-night stand, wrestles him into a deal that’ll solve all his money problems. He’ll have to pay a hefty price in return, but Hojin soon comes to learn that his cruel master for a year hides a rather lonely heart. Thus, the two begin to grow closer... Will they actually find comfort in each other or will this year crush Ho-Jin for good?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 34 extra chapters.

title.english: My Middle-Aged Next Door Neighbor Is in My Wet Dreams

description:
For as long as Han Young-Hae can remember, his neighbor, Yim Tae-Hwan, has always taken good care of him. But when Young-Hae starts having wild dreams about his hunky father-figure, he grows conflicted over his feelings. On the other hand, Tae-Hwan is plagued by prostate issues and buys a bunch of toys, thinking they'll help him. When Young-Hae walks in on Tae-Hwan using those toys, it's just like a scene from one of his dreams and he pounces! Will Young-Hae and Tae-Hwan be able to figure out their messy future together?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Becoming the Obsessive Male Lead's Ex-Wife

description:
A struggling part-timer suddenly collapses at work and wakes up in the famous novel "Pervin and Stella" as the villainess Irwyne Liliath. To make matters worse, Irwyne's fate in the story is grim as she's condemned to execution for attempting to poison Pervin, the male lead and a highly respected duke. Desperate to survive, Irwyne is determined to win Pervin's heart. But as she grows closer to him, his feelings evolve in unexpected ways. Irwyne now faces an uncertain fate that wasn't written in the novel's pages. Will she be able to rewrite her destiny?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The son of a brave warrior is pursued by an elf princess and a dwarf princess, each determined to secure his seed as the key to ruling their world.

(Source: Toomics)

The Caretakers' Council is a group of dedicated servants with only one goal: to nurse terminally ill Arelyn Halbern back to health. But Arelyn is already resigned to her fate, knowing she's simply an extra in a novel meant to die young. That is, until Crown Prince Pession Allermand takes an interest in her. Now, Pession visits Arelyn daily, nagging her to eat better, play, and be more active. With the novel's male lead lending his strength, can Arelyn finally find the will to fight her illness?

(Source: Tapas)

Adrina has lived as her dead twin brother since she was eighteen. Known as the Mad Dog of Palesa Palace, she's assigned to guard Duke Julius. One problem: he should be older than her. So why does he look like a child?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: A Tender Heart: The Story of How I Became a Duke's Maid

description:
Liandro was stricken with a hideous curse at a young age, shunned by his family and rejected by the only people he ever loved. As the supporting character in a novel, he’s doomed to a role of misery and loneliness. That is, until a sympathetic reader is suddenly transported into this fictional world as his lowly maid, determined to change his fate! Can Evelina break Liandro free of his wretched destiny and help him find true love after all?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

No one understands why local lowlife Lord Aden Remes suddenly acts like the upright knight he was meant to be. The truth is, Aden's been possessed by Aden Albireo, the empire's hero who died after defeating the villainous Underlord and facing betrayal by his closest friends. Now, Aden's out to get revenge on those who killed him with the help of a few new allies and none other than the Underlord himself! Can Aden and his gang buckle down and power up? Or is the lord hero fated to fail once more?

(Source: Tapas)

"A wedding without a bride?"

Taesung Group's president, Mu-Jin Tae, is a workaholic with no interest in women. But one day, he's suddenly been given an ultimatum by his father, the chairman of the company. He must find a bride to walk down the isle with five months later. The one who's been put in charge of finding a bride for Mu-Jin is none other than his secretary, Su-Yeon Cheon, who's had a secret crush on him for nine years. But when her father, CEO of Gaon, gets into a car accident and falls into a coma, everything changes. Su-Yeon quits her job and finds herself trying to appease Gaon's stockholders about the disappearance of her older brother, who she believes should take over. But her fate changes when her "god-like" ex-boss shows up at the meeting and recommends her as the acting CEO. Su-Yeon accepts and decides to learn all she can from "the best," Mu-Jin, to save Gaon. Will her relationship with Mu-Jin be different now that she's a CEO herself? What if she was the bride that Mu-Jin needed in order to make his father happy?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
Kim Paksa is a genius programmer. He is currently working on rovers in outer space when one night he sees a face appear on the screen.

A wayward teenager with existential questions, Su-Gu has a secret that he can’t tell anyone: he has a swimsuit fetish. When his homeroom teacher catches him peeping on the girls’ water polo team at school, Su-Gu is given only one way out. He must disguise himself as a girl and join the water polo team. He reluctantly accepts, only to discover that there’s much more to the sport than splashing around with cute girls in swimsuits. Somewhere along the way, Su-Gu might even discover the reason his heartbeat is taking up a new rhythm.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Gang-ho is a laborer at the local factory, sleeping just 3 hours a day and working like a horse. But when his face is burned in an accident at work, he's left unemployed. Scared of his daughter's reaction to his burns, Gang-ho decides to transform into the superhero, Gugu-Man!

(Source: WEBTOONS)
Five individuals, 24 years old. Their first memory starts in 1994, and it all revolves around a mysterious crime that occurred... Will they be able to escape the dangers?

Ortez, first daughter of Duke Tesa, marries someone she’s never even seen before. An exciting love story that starts with an arranged marriage!

(Source: Copin Comics)

College professor by day, and bartender by night, psychologist Dr. Frost believes in one simple belief. Humans are all the same. He uses this tenet to guide his practice, and solves the puzzles of the human mind one by one.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.romaji: ENT. Ore no Kagi ga Hazusareta K Noukai
title.native: ENT. 檻の鍵が外されたK能界

description:
In the world, people can be classified into three types: strong carnivores; middle carnivores and herbivores.

Somi Han is referred to as "Invisible girl". She befriends a fellow herbivore, Yujin Ko. However Somi Han feels that Yujin Ko is more like a tiger pretending to be a rabbit. Meanwhile, the entertainment industry is in an uproar with the appearance of a fanfiction writer called Foxstar. With incredibly detailed and accurate information about the personal lives of many of Korea's hottest stars, celebrities are more than nervous.

What happens when Somi and Yujin discover each other's secret identities?

21-year-old Ryu Yeon-seong is about to start his mandatory military service in the ROK Army. But unlike most other conscripts, he and four others are assigned to the mountain police rescue unit stationed at Mt. Bukhan, a small mountain on the outskirts of Seoul. Not knowing much about it, they think it'll be a walk in the park, and count themselves lucky to have landed such a cushy assignment. But when they arrive at the mountain, the group soon learn that they're in for more than they bargained for

A Demon Lord spirited the Princess away, and cursed her with eternal sleep. Countless knights sought to save her, only to die in vain by the Demon Lord's hands. But then, a Nameless Knight arrived to vanquish him and save the Princess, ignorant of what fate had in store for him...

A contest to determine the most unfortunate person on Earth is underway?! A hybrid school fantasy action thriller from Jung Pil-won, the author of "Family Man"!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Regular college freshman Kim Jeong-Hyeon and his roommate Kim Ho-Mo are polar opposites and friends. This is a story that deals with many sensitive topics with a dash of humor.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The country of Greenland, after losing the war to the Imperial Army, were in agony and despair for what will the future bring them. They had hired mercenaries to help them during the war and now they’ve come back to collect their reward while the country were still picking up their pieces of their broken dreams. By that time, the King has passed away and his heir was still too young to take up on the throne. After hearing the news of the King’s death the mercenaries decided to take over the throne and rule in his place. But there was an obstacle in their way... The Oracle!

A bloodstained man stands in front of a terrified girl. He proclaims his love for her and makes this ominous declaration: A year from now, she will either die alone or will be with him forever. Now, rumors abound about the cursed girl that causes any boy who proclaims his love for her to die. Join us to discover the mysteries of Metronome.

One day, a young glider technician crashes into a strange tree that turns out to be the nest of the last dragon on Earth. The technician accidentally bonds with the dragon's powers after she and the dragon fend off a weapon used by knights hunting the "Dragon Pearl," an item that holds the life and powers of a dragon. The technician finds out the Dragon Pearl has temporarily fused with her body and the dragon will die if they separate. So begins the story of how the dragon and the technician survive the onslaught of knights and villains while dealing with the strange events and moral differences that come from inter-species friendship... Or is it something else?

Ryun is an unmotivated high school student who feels like there's nothing to do in life. Min is her childhood friend who is annoyed at his own popularity. This series is about their daily lives, who they meet, and how they grow.

The RPG “Lost Story” not only allows players to interact with NPCs but also introduces a new system to rank your closeness with them. With this update, the hero discovers that his relationship with Emma, one of the guild receptionists, is maxed out—even though that shouldn’t be possible! Despite being level 99, Emma always worries whenever he leaves, no matter how much he tries to reassure her that he’ll be fine. Meanwhile, he encounters two star-crossed lovers: the inventor Slaki and Iragneff, the avatar of a god. Can he help them be together while also coming to terms with his own feelings for Emma?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lark is different from the rest of the kids. He has red eyes, just like Vampires do, and he is bullied by the other kids for it. One day he meets Setz, a genuine Vampire of a Noble clan who is the only one that doesn’t call him a monster or bully him. Eventually they become friends, but when Lark finds out he may have to return to the orphanage, Setz decides he does not want to lose his friend, so he invites him to his home... The world of the Vampires.

Note: This project began as an amateur manhwa on Naver, but became popular enough that Naver chose to turn it into a professional work. The author and artist changed their pen names (from TieRo to Mirchi and Muchi to Yamchi, respectively) and restarted the series from the beginning, redesigning the artwork and part of the storyline in the process.

title.english: I Don't Want This Kind of Hero

description: A hero who fights countless mythical creatures. A story of SPOON's remarkable efficiency!

title.english: The Stories of Those Around Me

description:
Summer is happily in love; Mira is a beautiful and successful woman but doesn’t have a boyfriend; Jung-A lives with her boyfriend for 5 years. These 25-year-old girls are very close and believe in that they can keep thier friendship and love forever. However, everything changed after Mira’s blind date.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A beautiful tale about a 20 year old divorcee who cannot bare children and her second marriage to the 16 year old, fourth son of a prestigious family. The son who was ill since childhood became forsaken by his family. But in order to prevent his spirit from haunting the family after his death they forced him to marry Sou.

People are no longer afraid of vampires but that doesn't stop humans from discriminating against them. Can Mari Baek hide her identity when she falls in love with a popular boy who hates vampires?

(Source: WEBTOON)

This is the story of a girl who was forced to become a piano prodigy with the pressure starting from the moment she was born. Her family has had distinguished musicians in their past. She is constantly forced by her father to practice (up to 12 hours a day, 10 if he's being nice), wear gloves whenever she's not playing, no friends, makeup, etc.

Sihoon is a boy who lost his parents and lives with his older sister. This story begins as he meets Mephisto that came to the world to find Faust and makes a deal with Mephisto to supervise the fights between Mephistopheles and Faust.

A fantasy comic about a boy's destiny that starts to change as he receives a gift from his guardian god.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Whether it's appearance, grades, or social life, Dongtae's at the bottom of the barrel. When popular transfer student Taebin gives him an opportunity to change all of that, Dongtae heads down a path to make things right. This is the world of DICE, where a single roll can change your fate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A story about a demon hunter named Rano who is trying to find his sister. Along the way he finds a person who has the same teeth structures as demons yet is not affected by sunlight. This person, Lessa, seems to remember who Rano is, but Rano does not remember who he is. Rano only dreams of this person; what are the connections between these two?

Note: Contains two prologues are two epilogue chapters.
A cynical romance, 'Have you been addicted to love?'

Strange things are appearing from the sky, and the world is slowly dying. In Korea, there aren't enough military men to fight these enemies off, and high-school and college students have no choice but to join the military and help the others survive—at the risk of their own lives.

A plain but considerate main character falls for a girl who happens to sit next to him in class. Using a group project as an excuse, he gets her number and they go on a date, but everything is ruined because of the unexpected rain and his credit card reaching its limit. Over the course of the story, the main character learns the hardships of love.

With simplistic drawing and short dialog, the protagonist and the writer of the story Waroo succeeds in evoking the beauty and the slice of everyday life through gentle humor and sensibility. Even though there is no overreaction, the last lines of the comic that wrap up the event with wit and charm are especially memorable.

What happens when you take a good, long look and realize that your boyfriend is prettier that you? And what happens when you go to a high school with so few girls that you're considered a goddess? But then again, your pretty boyfriend is also attending the same school...

This is not your typical invasion story. Gigantic oxygen-doped bees are attempting to dominate the human race by reversing the food chain. Lee is a middle-manager at a large company who has only one thing on his mind: save his family from the bug-apocalypse.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Sia Lee is a modern-day vampire who absorbs energy from humans by touching them instead of drinking their blood. She has been desperate to touch Jiho since the day he moved in next door—but he's a germaphobe. Will Sia best his mysophobia and touch Jiho?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

On February 29th, children under the age of 14 are said to have their wishes granted on a day known as Melly Day. In a world where humans are said to be blessed by the gods, Hiasen has been granted the ability to manipulate mana in his dreams... but all he really wants is to see his mother again. When his wish is granted on Melly Day, the world as he knows it changes forever.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A few thousand years have passed since an alchemist created Winter. Winter begins living with Jane, a writer, in exchange for telling her his story. From their interactions, Winter begins to learn the meaning of being human, and without realizing it, Jane begins to see a man who has changed her life in more ways than she could imagine.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ever had a dream so realistic you couldn't be sure what was real? Raeum has a special power - the power to control his dreams. His power will bring to life an eerie dreamscape that may reveal the key to unlocking the truth behind his past.

(Source: Lezhin)
A bittersweet growth story about headstrong children.

A webtoon writer, Songshin Ha, lives in the apartment, at the top of the hill, that has serious problem with neighbor's noise; and he desperately wants to solve the problem with his neighbors.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
Hilariously drawn, centered around a humorously short boy named Waru, his friends, and his memories. The memories are all based on according pictures that were taken during those moments...

Beginning on the 4th day after a zombie virus broke out, this is a story about the will to live, human instincts and our selfish desires. A thrilling tale about the survivors of a zombie apocalypse.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes DEAD DAYS 0 (12 chapters) and 2 extras.

Togeun used to work for his father’s company without any passion, so he quits his job and moves out from his parents’ house in order to follow his dream in drawing. At the homecoming party (reunion party), Togeun begs Sonagi, a great illustrator, to teach him how to draw.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jang Sung-gi is always misunderstood as a pervert and a worthless man! He meets a mentor who suddenly turns him into a very charismatic man?! A cool and edgy tale of how an average guy who turns into the greatest "pick up artist"... A story about misbehaved men who are constantly trying to pick up girls~!

To say that Ho-Sang's luck with women throughout his life had been underwhelming would be an understatement. That all changes when he gets electrocuted by an electric mat that he bought from his old college friend Ga-Hui. Armed with a newfound ability, Ho-Sang embarks on a life that he had never even dreamed of...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Taehyun Choi lives with his sister Hakyung Choi. You could say they have a normal life. On the one hand Hakyung has a good job and is successful, however Taehyun isn't good at studying.

His life takes a drastic change when he accidentally learns that he and Hakyung aren't siblings. Which is why he decides to confront her, but then she suffers a serious accident and loses her memory.

This is where everything will change, because those feelings of kinship will become much more important.

The same girlfriend in 2 different ages?! The young version of her came across time to meet me in the present. A story of a guy stuck between his past and present!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

“This is the end, boy.”

Yong-Jin hears the news that his younger brother, Yong-Joo, tried to commit suicide at school. Yongjin, who never thought this would happen, heads directly to the school to talk with the teachers. But, as he arrives, a fight breaks out among the students. In an attempt to cover it up, the students involved decide to frame Yongjoo as the assailant.

Proper education on how to protect the students from violence…A just society where perpetrators receive proper punishment for their crimes…Yong-Jin, who doesn’t believe that such things exist in real life, decides to take matters into his own hands! Satisfying action with an exciting plot twist. A story that will send shivers down your spine. Can you say…Catharsis?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.

Neglected wife commits adultery with the delivery boy, but unbeknownst to her, her husband is an assassin.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

Who cares if you’re invisible in high school when you can see and talk to the invisible? Reserved and quiet, Jamie Oh prefers to remain in the background and confide only in his friends, who happen to be ghosts. But when the most popular girl in school takes interest in him, his normal -- or rather, paranormal -- life takes an unexpected turn.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Rai, the noblest of all vampires, wakes up from 820-years long sleep and starts his new life as a student in a high school founded by his loyal servant, Frankenstein. But his peaceful days with other human students are soon interrupted by mysterious attackers known as the "Unions".

(Source: WEBTOON)

A magic pair of glasses that turns getting girls into a video game? Get ready, because it's time to get all the girls! But things start to change as the relationships get complicated...

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

A collection of sweet stories about couples and singles, office workers and unemployed people. But be warned: there’s more than a touch of bitterness here.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Sung Hoon was a normal High School student, but one day he finds himself with a tiger that Hwangun didn't marry, and is told that the world will end if he doesn't marry that tiger. The story begins with the cute smile of the tiger girl.

High school senior Min-Gyeom has been left to his own defenses after his parents kicked him out of their lives. His new house is in a shabby neighborhood, the site of several mysterious assaults that have left victims with bite marks on their necks and blood loss symptoms. After moving in, Min-Gyeom heads out for a meal…then somehow wakes up at home with strange marks on his neck. He tries to shrug it off, but his deskmate at the new school looks suspiciously pale and familiar…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
The not-so-normal daily life of a pair of twin siblings.

A boy's terrifying dream that brings an end to a humanity that is rotting. A high school student named Gi Haru, who has an illness that prevents him from differentiating between reality and delusions. His only friends are his studious friend Kang Yul and girlfriend Kang Lee Ha. However one day, after seeing a hallucination of a Nazi assembly during his friend Kang Yul's poetry recitation, the school falls into a pandemonium of hell where everyone is killing each other, but Gi Haru believes it to be another one of his delusions. However, that was the blunt truth. That day, where the mass murder of the entire student body took place, (The starting day) Gi Haru kills his girlfriend Kang Lee Ha with his own hands, is betrayed by his one and only friend Kang Yul, and ends up losing both his eyes. Afterwards, he was detained in a mental institute as the culprit of massacring the entire student body, but after receiving help from the capable group of the Panthers he begins to chase after Kang Yul and begins the road of vengeance.
Eden, a captured servant and bodyguard to the prolific Count Ricardo Adolph, is forced to take part in a gladiatorial competition for his master while dreaming of his own freedom.

They consider themselves the best of friends. Others seem to think otherwise. There's something about their relationship that's hard to describe. What will become of these two "friends"?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue, an epilogue, one special and 16 side story chapters.

After Kang Hu’s death from bullying, the family was torn into pieces. His younger brother suppresses his resentment and heads back to school. The story begins exactly one year after Kang Hu’s death when his brother seeks to destroy the delinquent circle...
Set during the Goryeo military regime, a hero that arises from a slave to be reborn as a general.

Edward the priest is asked to care for the legendary hero who carries a deadly curse. Will the young priest be able to cure the hero of his curse?

(Source: Toomics)
Remake of the classic "True Colors of Gangster" (건달본색 - 乾達 本色).

Although she never asked for it, 27-year-old So Yeori possesses the extraordinary ability to communicate with ghosts. She has always considered it a burden rather than a gift and always passes spirits without a single glance. When she moves into a new house, Yeori resolves to ignore the resident ghost. However, he has a different idea.

Even when he was alive, Go Joon yearned for the comfort of living together with someone, and his untimely death three years ago only exacerbated his pain. He wants nothing more than to talk to someone, for Yeori to stay; and reluctantly, she agrees to live with him for a year. As two people who have always been alone, Yeori and Joon must now face the joys and hardships of the cohabitation between human and ghost.

A man whose time has stopped, and a woman who flows like a river. A story about strife that comes and goes in the past and in the present.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

When we first met, Yun-Hui was my friend's girlfriend.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In a world where only females are born with the ability to wield magic, a boy, Americano (Amel), is the only exception. In this world, he must conceal his gender to protect his legitimacy. From the prestigious Beans family, he must prove himself to be the most capable practitioner of the magic arts in the process of capturing illicit escapees of his home land.

(Source: Comikey)

After Kang Hu's death from bullying, the family was torn into pieces. His younger brother suppresses his resentment and heads back to school. The story begins exactly one year after Kang Hu's death when his brother seeks to destroy the delinquent circle...

"Dokgo Rewind" follows Kang-Hyuk and the events leading to his brother's death one year prior to the events that transpire in "Dokgo".

Da-ae’s past and present is filled with dirty little secrets. It was about time someone noticed. The only problem is Gitae, the minister’s son, is not your ordinary someone. He gathers all the people that suffered from Da-ae’s dirty acts and starts the road to her redemption.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, 15 side stories and an epilogue.

Everyone considers me the purest girl to ever walk this planet. I'm viewed as the girliest of girls and no one dare thinks I would think about anything naughty. But that isn't always a good thing. I have my desires and I want to let it out!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

"Am I a bad friend to you?"

Ji-Min, who is now in the same class as Ki-Jung, the source of all kinds of rumors and an object of avoidance. Contrary to expectations that it would be a difficult year, ordinary days pass by. Then one day, he spots Ki-Jung approaching a stray cat he was taking care of, and this becomes the opportunity for the two to gradually become closer...

Ji-Min skips school for the first time in his life and goes to a karaoke room. He knows it's an important time, but for some reason, he can't refuse to be with Ki-Jung.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Taemuk Han is a 39-year-old Barista who opens his own coffee shop. He likes being free and finds it hard to get the right woman. Yeoun Sun is a 28-year-old woman who wants to be a Designer and wants to be a cool career woman who spends her life alone. However, she can't get her career started and somehow ends up working at Cafe Velomano.

A young very talented hairstylist Hyunkang Kim, with an obsession for scissors, is one day recruited by an old man on the street. He later discovers that the gentleman in question was once the director of best hair salon in Seoul!
Accepting the offer thus begins his story. Challenges, friendship, overcoming past traumas, and delirious situations now fill his life! And there might even be time for some romance... ?

Baek Jooin is a smart, diligent student and has a crush on Ham Sobok, another elite student. However, things start to go downhill when Jooin's twin brother, Jooyul, turns up to meet Sobok while pretending to be Jooin. What's worse, Sobok's best friend, Lisa, doesn't seem to like Jooin one bit. How will it all play out?

(Source: Lezhin)

Yu Mano wanted a job where he wouldn't have to deal with lots of people looking at him, and maybe where he could get some of his college homework done during breaks. Being an albino in South Korea, he always stands out. There's this creepy yet eye-catching mansion in his neighborhood that somehow is a library, so he decides to work there part-time for a while.

But his annoyance level soon shoots through the roof because every single one of the (admittedly gorgeous) librarians there are vampire otakus! They even dress and talk as if they are vampires—and as if they're certain he is one, too!

After an awkward first encounter with the head librarian (including being dragged into his elegant coffin), he is determined to never go back but...

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue

The legend want that when the world will sink into chaos 7 valorous leaders will appear to save it. The Earth is about to be conquered by the evil, when two guys come in contact with a mysterious robot, the Rainbow Metal Ranger, whose task is to find and protect the seven Rainbow Warriors. The group then starts a long journey trying to save the world.

The adopted son Yu-Jin is more respected than the biological son Tae-Hyeon, who's always getting into trouble. He finds his younger brother, who pretends to be carefree and cheerful, utterly pathetic. Then one day, feeling strange emotions toward Tae-Hyeon, Yu-Jin makes a dangerous choice...

“Brother, if you do it with me once, I'll keep your secret...”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

After a violent outburst in his first match, an amateur MMA fighter haunted by dreams of a past life as a gladiator is offered a chance to go pro, if he survives the fight. He’s untrained, unhinged, and utterly untamable.

(Source: Toomics)

Jun-Su, a public health doctor serving his mandatory term at Songhwa Prison, thought his assignment would be dull, routine checkups, a few minor injuries, nothing more. But on his seventh day, the world literally collapses. A mysterious nationwide sinkhole disaster swallows cities whole, cutting the prison off from the outside world. Now trapped inside a fortress filled with men more terrifying than demons, Jun-Su has only one thought:

“I have to get out of here.”

Clutching a stolen keycard, his only ticket to freedom, he makes a break for it. But before he can escape, he runs into the infamous Lee brothers, Tae-Hyeong and Tae-Mu, cold-blooded criminals whose names alone strike fear even among inmates.

“What a feast. Lick it clean.”

With monsters above and monsters within, Jun-Su’s fight for survival turns into a chilling game of instinct, trust, and the brutal will to live.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ever since the day I laid my eyes on you... I can't stop dreaming about painting all over you.

(Source: Toomics)

San once found comfort in Hee-Min’s kindness. Years later, he confesses the love he has kept hidden, not to win Hee-Min over but to finally walk away with closure. To his surprise, Hee-Min accepts his feelings without hesitation. Struggling to trust something that feels too easy, San finds himself torn between doubt and longing. He yearns for a kind of love he has never learned how to receive. A tender and tangled love begins between a black-haired beast still learning how to be human, and the man who never turned him away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

On his first day at Nakseong High, Lee Jun enters more than a new environment. After a status window warns him of the school's horror stories, he is killed in a wave of gore and sent back to his first day. This time, Jun ignores the ominous window and tricks fate, only to be killed again three years later, forced to restart high school, and lead a brand-new horror story club. Pulled into this life-and-death game, can Jun rewrite the Nakseong urban legend once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

The terror man and the revival man finally meet. "Destruction is the beginning of resurrection". The whole world is in danger with the birth of a new evil. Min Jeong-U has the ability to see misfortune and Seok-Hwan has the ability to come back to life. The two heroes made different choices... Who will be the final winner?

Han Dong-U's and Ko Jin-Ho's first crossover work!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue and epilogue.

Ahyoung is the director of a down-on-its-luck animal hospital. Pragmatic, blunt, and single, this 30-year-old veterinarian is determined to succeed! But she is barely able to make ends meet... that is until a mythical creature makes its way to her hospital. With the help of her talking cat, her softie werewolf assistant, and her chipper dragon friend, she is committed to treating all fantastical beasts that make their way to her door. It can’t be that hard… right?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Jega Eodinga Binguireul Han Geot Gateundeyo
title.english: I Think I've Been Possessed Somewhere
title.native: 제가 어딘가 빙의를 한 것 같은데요

description:
Transmigration is easy. Step one: Figure out which novel you’re in. Step two: Expertly navigate the complex web of political relationships, ensnaring the heart of your male lead. Step three: Live happily ever after. Or that’s how it’s supposed to go, unless you’re avid-reader Elena Sevess and can’t get past step one! Unless she can figure out where this story is going, Elena is in a world of trouble... or is it the world that’s in trouble because of her?

(Source: Tapas)

The bond of family can be a star that guides us in the night, or a chain that drags us down. For aspiring hunter Seung-Hyeon Gi, both are true. He dreams of becoming a legendary hunter like his father, despite his bitterness at his family’s preoccupation with his comatose sister, So-Hyeon. Everything changes when So-Hyeon suddenly regains consciousness and reveals herself as a ‘Homecomer’, possessing powerful abilities from transmigrating to another world while comatose. Seung-Hyeon realizes that if he wants to protect his sister, he'll need to grow stronger, and there’s no better place than the Seong-Han Academy for the Gifted…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ahn Si-Yoon, a pitcher who does not hesitate to play the role of a losing team if it is possible to play baseball. After continuing his junior high school career with poor results, his baseball life begins to change when he meets 'Baek Tae-oh', a catcher of the opposing team.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After being killed by the organization he worked for, the infamous assassin Bi-Gwang is reincarnated as Kim Gyeong-Su, a police officer. He vows to take revenge on Hwaguksa, the organization of killers that betrayed him.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Yeo-Won, desperate for money, starts a high-paying caddie job at Royal Golf only to find that it’s a private country club where only the most powerful and wealthiest people are allowed. Yeo-Won caters to the guests' whims and catches the attention of the mysterious and ominous Jang Gi-Ju, who makes him a lucrative offer he can't refuse, changing the course of both their lives. Can Yeo-Won handle Mr. Jang’s eccentric and prolific tastes?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Mage Neoniah Ryan is hired to break the nightly curse afflicting Duke Syetry Demott Costas, a noble with dragon blood running through his veins. The plan works—until the cursed duke mistakes Neoniah for his mate. Trapped between spellwork, survival, and a monster’s instincts, Neoniah must end the curse before the night claims her...for good.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He’s broke, lonely, and he’s a loser. With the betrayal by the only friend that he once thought he had, Ui-Jin’s casual investment in cryptocurrency miraculously bears fruit, turning him into a millionaire in an instant. Thanks to the unexpected fortune, Ui-Jin’s life somehow drastically changes for the better… or does it?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

King Karloi of Croisen finds himself at odds with his position in life. His wife’s father, Duke Deluah, is angling for the throne, and as an outsider to the family, Karloi fears for his position. His frustrations have affected his marriage, though he finds himself questioning his cold approach to his wife, Evonne. He may no longer recognize her, but Evonne saved his life long ago and was his first love. This is but one of many secrets Evonne bears the weight of, having fallen victim to a curse that prevents her from telling any secrets...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes an 8-chapter side story.

Two couples take a trip to a beautiful beach house. While enjoying themselves there, they realize that some of them pair better with others. Can both pairs survive the trip? Or will there be some secret moonlight meetups...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The women, aiming to rise in status, begin classes to conquer their family's assets.

(Source: DAYcomics)

While working as a waiter at the bar ‘Nante’, Choi A-Seul received an unusually large tip from Seo Jin-Hyuk for simply serving drinks. For some reason, A-Seul couldn't forget that day. A month later, Jin-Hyeok, who hadn't been seen since, appears to rescue A-Seul from a sexual assault in a private room...

‘Does he remember...?’

Just as A-Seul's hopes rose, Jin-Hyeok pulled out a “token of appreciation.” ...It was a check.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Lee Hyun and Yoon Jae, who met by chance at a gay bar, are teammates and sex partners in the same swimming team. Enjoying their time together without worrying about the location, Lee Hyun and Yoon Jae accidentally expose their intimate scene to Seo Hoo, a swimming pool staff member...

(Source: Mr Blue, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

Won-yeong’s feeling the pressure of family life. Newly unemployed and with a wife and three kids to support, the bills keep stacking up. What’s worse, he hasn’t gotten laid in over a year… Talk about stress! Nevertheless, as the sole breadwinner, he resolves to buck up his ideas and earn some cash however he can. When you’re handsome, bright and eager to please, work should just fall in your lap, right?! Luckily for Won-yeong, it isn’t long before an old acquaintance reappears and makes an offer he can’t refuse. Time to put that talent to good use... and relieve some of that pent-up “stress” as well!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Long ago, a "door" connecting to another world opened, and those who gained special abilities along with a "mark" began to be called "wizards." After the incident of "that day," Ophion's first-class wizard "Blow" became very famous. One day, he receives a very special request. It is to protect the second son of the Artian Duke family, who is being called a "monster" and suffering at the "Magic School Helios"! Thus, Blow enters Helios as a student under the name "Rood Krisch" while hiding his identity... Will Blow be able to successfully complete the request amidst the whirlwind of unexpected events?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Nam Hae-Sul, who is handsome but famous for his dog-like personality, is only nice to his childhood friend, Yang Mi-Ru. "It's clear that he's nice to me because he likes me!" But is it really like that? Mi-Ru has no idea about Hae-Sul’s true feelings. Then one day, she finds out about the "black heart" that he harbors! Cracks are starting to appear in their 10-year friendship...! The wild growth story of a wolf boy and an innocent girl!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Growing up with a silver spoon, Rosa has lived a flawless life as the perfect modern-day princess. She’s always gotten everything she wanted - except for one thing: Kim Yeonwoo, the boy from the orphanage who once slipped through her fingers.Ten years later, starved for something to stir her restless heart, Rosa finally sees Yeonwoo again. But there’s just one problem...he’s now the man by her mother’s side. Though she knows it’s a dangerous love she can never have, Rosa can’t resist toying with her new father-to-be, both in body and in mind…

(Source: Lezhin US)

For little Mint, every day is hell at the Merigold orphanage. One day, Master Yulius, the Grand Duke of Elkedonia, offers to take her in as the little lady of Elkedonia! However, Mint is extremely shy and nervous, and such a huge transformation doesn’t happen overnight. Join Mint as she grows from a meek girl to a daring, outspoken lady while magical and religious tensions unfold!

(Source: Webtoons)

Some marry for love, and some marry for convenience. In I-Jae’s case, she marries Yu-Heon, the son of a business tycoon, to save her family after her father ends up in deep debt. Even though their marriage is contractual, I-Jae feels an intense attraction for the cold and calculating Yu-Heon. Every night in her dreams, she imagines what it would be like to make love with him… until one day, the two end up actually sharing a passionate night together. But will their physical chemistry be enough to build a genuine connection? Or will I-Jae remain a pawn in Yu-Heon’s game?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Alpha male 'Cha Jun-Seo' with a handsome appearance with strong lines, a relaxed attitude that resembles cold warmth, and a perfect physique. He is famous as a transfer student who suits a life of being treated well. Just as people are captivated by beautiful things, when Jun-Seo appears at school, the surroundings do not know how to be quiet. Gay 'Baek Do-Ah' is no different. He was captivated by Jun-Seo's physique that he had never seen before. Then their eyes met. Jun-Seo casts a strange glance at Do-Ah, and Do-Ah is filled with excitement at the unexpected luck... Do-Ah cannot come to his senses because of the specs that are on a different level from other men who treat him like a male prostitute. Even the alpha male seduces him and whispers that he is interested in him. The moment he gets the coveted Jun-Seo, an unpleasant iron bar and a photo of his past are placed in front of Do-Sh's eyes. "Do you like it? I prepared it for you." "You're pretty, Do-Ah... You're prettier than I imagined." It was the moment Do-Ah was caught in a trap.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.

Are first loves overrated, or can a reunion as adults bring back emotions of the past? Yun-Ji and Sae-Bom share a first love story left unfinished, abruptly interrupted by ten years of being apart. Now, as adults, both seem to have moved on from that unfinished chapter of their lives and agree to remain friends and coworkers. However, the surface is not everything there is to be seen, as an unspoken tension lingers between them. Will they merely stay friends, or does destiny have other plans for them?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: Living Out My Deadline as the Tyrant's Wife

description:
When she wakes up as an extra in a fantasy novel, married to a villain and destined to be poisoned to death, Lea knows she must change her fate. Her strategy? Get rid of the booze and men in her harem, soften up her tyrannical emperor husband by being kind and gentle with him, and make him fall in love with her for real! But he’s been trained his whole life not to feel anything at all... Hopefully, that pesky prophecy about an emperor with feelings bringing doom to the empire isn’t true!

(Source: Tapas)

During the period of Japanese colonial rule, a young Korean boy, Yong-Hyeon, is invited every summer to a royal residence in the mountains behind his village. The residence of one Count Tachibana. The peculiar Tachibana Sho is a complete mystery, as it seems he’s never left his mansion, not even once. But over the summers, Tachibana Sho and Yong-Hyeon have made a strange but solid bond with each other. Now Yong-Hyeon is devising a plan to help Sho escape his mansion but it won't be easy. Adults with their meddlesome ulterior motives and the giant mansion itself all present challenges to their idea. How will the two boys break free and what will they learn about each other...?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

How are you supposed to go about your workday when your secret crush, a sexy CEO with amber eyes, lives in the hotel you work at? What’s worse: you’re his personal butler! Ian Seo lives this every day, watching the alpha of his dreams bringing home guy after guy, not even sparing him a second glance. But determination gets the best of Ian and he formulates a plan to make CEO Jaek-Won Yoo his. Can he woo the cold and distant alpha, or is Ian destined to be just the butler for the rest of his life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 28 extra chapters.

After a drunken night, Yi-Yool wakes up to find his boss, Hyun-Mo, making breakfast in nothing but an apron. But the surprises don’t end there—Hyun-Mo has a proposition. He wants to date Yi-Yool, and he’s got a contract to back it up. If Yi-Yool sticks to the deal, his dream of transferring to the UK branch is within reach. But as the lines between business and romance blur, Yi-Yool is left questioning... is this really love, or just a contract?

(Source: Tapas)

Keith, a legendary con artist who made a career out of swindling mafias and criminal syndicates, finds himself cornered by the police. To avoid capture, he hides in the most unlikely place—prison. But the temporary safety of his self-imposed confinement is short-lived when he catches the attention of the prison's ruthless warden, Della, the most feared guard in the joint. Now, Keith must navigate a new power struggle where he might be forced to lose more than just his freedom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite his ordinary skills, Sir Shake, captain of the guard, dedicates his life to defeating the demons and bringing about an era of peace with the immortal swordmasters. However, when Shake finally succeeds and also becomes a swordmaster, he dies, only to reincarnate 20 years later as Asher. He's shocked to find that his comrades have vanished and demons are rumored to have returned. In the midst of all this chaos, can Asher find his former allies and vanquish the enemy for good?

(Source: Tapas)

Farewell, Miss Original Female Lead. Three cycles of despair and death. At the end of each, I realized the woman who stole my husband and everything else was actually a possessor. The fourth return—now is the time to reclaim everything stolen. To do so, I needed a powerful ally. To a madwoman, a madman.

“Plunder me.”

Crown Prince Arpad Eastrid. I requested a marriage of plunder from him.

“In return, I'll keep Your Highness from going mad.”

An offer he absolutely couldn't refuse. I stared straight at him, wearing a triumphant smile.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

What do you do if you're going on 18, totally awkward and lacking in self-confidence? You could just sit in your room all day and all night and study and wonder why you never get asked out…OR, if you’re Woo-Yeon Song you could join up with the Spirit Fingers – the strangest, hippest, coolest (yet most welcoming) art club ever. But as Woo-Yeon is about to learn, discovering your TRUE colors is about more than just painting.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Hui-Su’s world revolves around Chan-Young, his best friend and secret crush. He doesn’t mind cheering Chan-Yeong from the sidelines or listening to all his girl problems.
