He doesn’t care if people only know him as “Chan-Yeong’s friend.” Then one day, Hui-Su starts hearing his name everywhere. On the bus, in the halls, during lunch… Turns out, there’s a rumor going around school (Got a love problem? Find Hui-Su in Class 2 and he’ll tell you what to do!) and with that, Hui-Su suddenly finds himself the center of attention. But how could he give anyone advice? He doesn’t even know what to do about his own crush!

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Note: Includes one prologue and ten side story chapters.

Hye-sung spent his entire life believing he was an alpha, the jackpot of the genetic lottery. His world is flipped upside down when he learns that he isn’t a dominating alpha, but a submissive omega instead! His frustration redlines whenever he crosses paths with the handsome Dojin, a true alpha. Supposedly, Dojin can’t stand omegas, but sparks fly when he butts heads with Hye-sung, and their explosive arguments set off an unexpectedly spicy relationship. Is their sizzling chemistry truly just pheromones?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A few stories about humans, the most frightening creatures of all.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: To You Who Will Ruin Me

description:
Unloved and unemployed, Laeyeon's only joy in life is the mobile game "Salvation." After spending all hours playing the game, her body gives out. When she comes to, she's now Irel, a character in "Salvation." As Irel, she can now enjoy things she never had: beauty, wealth, privilege, but most of all, unconditional love from her family. However, Irel is aggressively pursued by Barkan, a cruel, and extremely violent man who asks for Irel’s hand in marriage. She knows that in the game, Irel’s family rejects Barkan’s offer to protect their daughter. This will lead to Barkan slaughtering Irel’s entire family. Now Irel must do whatever it takes to change the narrative.

(Source: Manta)

White Tiger member Yoojoon infiltrated the faction to get the corruption books of congressman Jang Seokjoon, whom he serves. Yoojoon, who successfully caught the eye of Viper boss Jaeha as planned, asked Jaeha to spare his life…

“Then can you suck my dick?"

"Imae," born to a human father and an Imae mother, endures various persecutions and grows up without ever obtaining a name. One day, the notorious Black Martial Emperor, the merciless king of the Baedal Kingdom, destroys the Imae village. After his beloved mother dies at the hands of the cruel emperor, he is determined to seek revenge, posing as a painter to paint his portrait…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

In the not-too-distant future, a Full-Dive game called “Lowtow World” captivates players worldwide. Kang Tae-young, an unemployed 20-year-old, is farming virtual items for his former high school bullies. One fateful day, he stumbles upon a mysterious and legendary item that inexplicably attracts the attention – and bodies – of nearby women to him: The Eye of Yoma. With his newfound powers, Tae-young will try his best to leverage this unexpected advantage, changing his life from a nerdy nobody into a super stud.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world of hunters, monsters, and dungeons, Ina is just an ordinary Korean woman--and she wouldn’t have it any other way. Ina was a spiritualist in her previous life, but now she can finally enjoy a peaceful world... or so she thought. One day, after touching a mysterious egg found in a dungeon, Ina reawakens her S-rank spiritualist ability! With her new spirit companions, a couple of troublemakers named Iz and Rika, will Ina ever fulfill her dream of living a quiet life?

(Source: Tapas)

"Could this all perhaps be Hwayeon's dream? Or did Yeonu create this fantasy world in her head to escape her harsh reality?" Hwayeon Ryu, without knowing the cause, falls into a coma at the age of six. Then after 12 long years of her father, Chung Ryu's persistent attempts, she finally opens her eyes. As she wakens from her prolonged sleep, she realizes she not only has her memories but has the memories of someone else's life, Yeonu Lee. Though startled at first, as time passes, she manages to adjust to her new life. Then one day, in hope to have lunch with her father, she pays a visit to the palace. But she ends up taking the wrong turn and finds herself in front of the notorious beast, crown prince Muyeong... The story unfolds then, when the soft and delicate flower Hwayeon meets the arrogant and fearless beast, Muyeong.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.

Was this life a failure? On the contrary, I like it!

Kang Su-Hyeon, who has failed in everything he has done in life for four years. He finally found his calling as an actor and thought he was seeing the light, but he collided with a truck coming from the opposite side and despaired as death approached...

“Wait a minute, didn’t I die?”

When he regained consciousness, was his appearance reflected in the mirror the cutest version of himself from when he was 5 years old?

Yes, in this life I start as a child actor!

Kang Su-Hyeon's acting career begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A rebellious spirit trapped in her marriage to a violent husband, Giselle leads a miserable life playing the role of a meek wife and lady. But one night, wandering her new home, Giselle discovers what seems to be a young boy trapped inside a cage. An inheritance from her husband’s eccentric father, the boy is considered a monster, an immortal “flower that feeds upon blood”. Despite her fear, Giselle begins to visit the boy nightly. Will these illicit meetings shatter life as she knows it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: A Royal Princess with Black Hair

description:
Caruel and Euricienne have a lot in common: they're both 16 years old, belong to royal families, and absolutely hate the idea of a political marriage! Both are determined to make the other beg for divorce. But enemies on the sidelines are also scheming to tear them apart and even threaten their lives! As Caruel and Euricienne overcome various obstacles together, perhaps they're more drawn to each other than they initially thought… Will they follow through with the original plans to end their arranged marriage? Or does fate have something else in store for the reluctant couple?

(Source: Tappytoon)

When Manager Son is sent to a new department, his boring office life takes a sweet turn. There, he meets Manager An, an older colleague whose competence and charming aura leave him in awe. But as Manager Son grows closer to her, he realizes there’s more to her strong, independent front than meets the eye. And soon enough, he begins to understand why office crushes can get complicated.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Sangun, the tiger lord of Baek Mountain, was living a peaceful life until a young, white-haired girl named Choa visits his cave, claiming to be his bride. Sangun immediately realizes that Choa is a descendant of the White-blooded Demon Beast, a dangerous creature feared by all spirits and beasts. He tries to send her away for fear of the dangers she will bring, but changes his mind upon discovering that she has nowhere to go. Unfortunately for him, this marks the beginning of his hardships...

(Source: Tapas)

A disastrous beginning—god-tier progression! The protagonist, a jobless man barely scraping by with part-time work, drifts around like a wandering orphan. His only joy in an otherwise dull and unchanging life is the online game God-Forsaken World. To him, it’s more than just entertainment—it’s an escape from reality. Then one day, while immersed in the game, he hears a mysterious voice from nowhere. When he comes to... he finds himself inside the world of the game! You’d think that after being transported into a game, he would become a cool, powerful protagonist... but no. He wakes up as the Empire’s disgrace and failure of a third prince: Gilroshan Elro de Valt. And if things couldn’t get any worse, the moment he opens his eyes, someone tries to kill him! Trapped in the body of an overweight, pathetic prince scorned by all, the protagonist has one secret weapon—a strategy guide, the key to survival that only a veteran player like him possesses! With the stumbling prince, his loyal knight Carls, and his fearsome yet reliable mage mentor Tirvaen, a new adventure begins—one more intense than reality itself!

“Survive in the body of a good-for-nothing prince? It’s not going to be as easy as playing the game.”

This is an unpredictable fantasy full of laughs, battles, and non-stop survival action!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: Lord Baby Runs a Romance Fantasy With Cash

description:
Romance fantasies were my happy little refuge. I’ve read countless novels and left tons of top comments in RF forums, and where did that lead me? To getting hit by a reincarnation truck! Now I’m stuck in a zero-star rated story fighting for my life! My father, the vile Duke Phaeraton, abandoned me. I’m barely surviving, no thanks to my thieving uncle, Marquess Tarenka. I’m not even the heroine of this novel! But what’s this? “QUEST COMPLETE. ABILITY ACTIVATED.” Is this my ticket out of here?

(Source: Tapas)

She just wants to start fresh so she can graduate in peace. She just wants to leave behind all the bad memories — her sleepwalking, the trauma from being bullied at school — all of it. She did everything she could to keep to herself, but the class president, Hae-On, just won't leave her alone. One day, when Seul-Bi visits the local lake Hae-On recommended, she comes across something she never imagined seeing in her wildest dreams: a wild, dark mermaid.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra.

A new neighbor moved in next door—7 years younger, polite to the point of formality, yet with a gaze that was anything but innocent. From the very first day, his eyes lingered too long, too boldly. “Did you sleep well after kissing me yesterday, noona?” A casual fling for one month couldn't harm, right?

(Source: Manta)

Kang San is a bottom 1% tanker with no talent, abilities, or skill. Misfortune follows him until a divine messenger appears before him one day.

"You were the Blood Demon in your past life."

To atone for his past life's sins, he must endure harsh trials. But in return, he will receive immense rewards?

"Fine. I'll do whatever it takes."

Can a weak F-rank tanker drenched in blood change his fate?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Luna and Formicarium are rival factions plotting to seize a territory called Liveta. The Luna family have the upper hand in the area, and thus Victor Luna, notorious for his killing sprees, resides there as de facto ruler. Enter Yohan, a bumbling puppy-dog type who has become a Formicarium spy out of dire circumstances. When Yohan meets Victor under the guise of being his guard, he is expecting sharp edges and a fiery temper... But the first thing Victor wants to confirm about Yohan isn’t his trustworthiness, but the size of what’s in his pants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Robelia Naegrad married Emperor Carmond DeHardt, it was expected that she would produce an heir to the imperial bloodline of the Golden Dragon, one who would inherit the family's mind-control abilities. However, with her own deadly powers being manipulated for her devious mother's mysterious scheme, Robelia must do all she can to avoid sharing a bed with her husband. Caught in between the two, will she be able to resist Carmond's continued seduction and avoid becoming her mother's pawn?

(Source: Tapas)

Hyeon Kang, a self-centered high school kid, has to bear the burdening fate of being the master of 'KANGTAWOO', the only robot that can stand against 'Spelta Empire', which seeks to conquer Earth. A giant robot action in Busan!

Byeon Tae-in was an ordinary geek, completely engrossed in webtoons and internet culture—until one day, everything changed. Gates opened, monsters poured out, and humanity teetered on the edge of annihilation. But unlike everyone else, Taein didn't feel fear; he felt a rush of excitement, as if he had been thrown straight into one of his favorite webtoons!

"These monsters look like the weak ones that always show up at the start to highlight the hero's new powers!"

And then, something extraordinary appeared before him: [You have been chosen.] Status window? Perfect! Taein had consumed every webtoon in existence. Now, if he becomes the strongest in this world... what kind of epic story will he write next?

(Source: Naver, translated)

1 to 10, from holding hands to kissing, everything in a relationship has to go according to plan for Geon-Jun. You can’t just skip over one stage to the other, not when everything needs to proceed in order—you gotta hit those bases one by one. Then there’s Jeong-Seok who’s the exact opposite, carefree and spontaneous and just looking for some fun. So just imagine Geon-Jun’s surprise when after one drunken night, he wakes up in the same bed with none other than Jeong-Seok. Looks like Geon-Jun’s gotta brace himself for a romance that defies the 1 to 10 rule, a rollercoaster ride of a love that’s gonna blow his mind for sure…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

She is reincarnated as a secondary character in a novel who is killed early on by the villainous male sub-protagonist.

But the villain says things like: “You are as graceful as a deer that grazes the mountains.”

This villain, he has no intention of killing me…

This is an emergency.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Han Juwon has the worst habit ever. He’s an average guy with an average college life, but his facial expression and words become terrifying the second he feels shy. Although he’s trying his best to fix it, Juwon realizes he messed up yet again when he says something rude to his hoobae, Jeong-min. And not only that, but he also keeps unintentionally touching Jeong-min’s chest every time they meet! Juwon knows he has to find a way to apologize to Jeong-min, but even while he feels guilty, he can’t stop thinking of what he accidentally discovered about Jeong-min’s chest… Turns out Juwon’s soft-hearted interior and gruff exterior aren’t the only things that are completely inverted…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapter.

At first glance, Yeong-Han seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he’s actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. Unfortunately, they have to act as a couple for a college course that assigns pairs to recreate a dating relationship. Yeong-Han is displeased, and Yae-Joon even more so. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other’s walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Serving a young master can be demanding in several ways, as poor Jayed learns while working as Seo Onka's bodyguard. Not only does he have to accompany Seo on all his nights of debauchery, but he's also constantly tempted by his sultry looks and body. Still, Jayed feels conflicted escorting Seo on his trip to meet his prospective fiancee in the desert. He knows this might be his last time seeing Seo alive, and not because the desert's crawling with dangerous criminals. But what he doesn't know is that things are about to heat up in a completely unexpected way...

(Source: Tappytoon)

One day, Kang Ju-Han, the president of Hakcheonpa, receives an unpleasant package. Inside the box was an old, broken rope. Ju-Han, who thought he might be one of the perverts who had always been interested in him, goes to the address written on the delivery box to seek revenge. In an abandoned factory in a deserted corner, a man, Seo Jeong-U, attacks Ju-Han from behind as he looks around. Jeong-U wraps a rope around Ju-Han's neck and tightens it. Ju-Han felt strange as he was being strangled. Jeong-U, who notices that Ju-Han has an erection, lets out an awkward laugh. Unlike Ju-Han, who thinks it's just a physiological phenomenon, Jeong-U realizes how he can make Kang Ju-Han, who is only proud, miserable. Kang Ju-Han is forced to have sex with Jeong-U. He curses and rejects Jeong-U, but at the same time, he is overwhelmed by the pleasure he feels for the first time.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter

Police officer Ma Young-Tae thinks he’s in for a long dry spell after being transferred to the countryside with only old people for miles. But a trip to the neighborhood cleaners ends in Young-Tae getting more than just his laundry done when he finds Seo Dae-Hyeon, the only other young man in the village, in a compromising position. They strike a deal where both of them get down and dirty…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 3 extras.

One year of marriage was terrible. But after divorce, incredibly good things start to happen. A coin I found while organizing my father's gambling-crazed belongings. You bought coins with my 10 million won that I lent to my father?

My life has changed 180 degrees from a crazy coin!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Ninenya Seiah’s misfortunes began from birth, owing to her mother’s traitorous reputation and subsequent death. Ninenya was thus banished from the noble Seiah family and forcibly separated from her father, Lord Rubenio Seiah. In extremely poor health, Ninenya has mere months to live. To save his daughter, Rubenio enlists the mysterious Count Adelman as her protector. Ninenya must now work with Adelman to improve her poor health and stop her from becoming the victim of a deadly family feud.

(Source: Tapas)

DJ, drop the beat! When 18-year-old K-pop stan Su-Hyeon gets his heart broken, he turns to his actual true love, girl group sensation MainTainA–especially his bias, the group’s main dancer, Hailey. Leaving his bittersweet first relationship behind to transfer to Seoul, Su-Hyeon finds not only a spitting image of his bias in the school dance club member Hye-Eun, who is supposedly Hailey’s younger sister, but also a new love in the most unexpected of places: the art of street dance! While helping Hye-Eun overcome her stage fright, Su-Hyeon finds there may be more to life than love!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ein Price was 35 when he was murdered. Now he’s 19 again and back in college with the man he was madly in love with: Ray Cunnington.

After saving a dragon named Null, Ein was given three wishes. The first was a sausage. The second was for Ray to be the last face he saw before he dies.

His wish was granted…

(Source: Tapas)

One day, a mysterious virus spreads through the city of Seoul in the form of mutant cells that keep multiplying. When people come into contact with these cells, they turn into hideous and dripping creatures that can infect others at any time.

Yeon-U, who is on a school trip to Seoul, is excited at the thought of getting closer to So-Yeon, a classmate whom he had a crush on. But for Yeon-U and his classmates, the trip soon turns into a nightmare. In order to survive, these high school students must find a way to escape the city before it is completely engulfed by the virus.

The story of Kim JaeHan starts now! A dad who only has eyes for his daughter faces a sudden death. His mission is now to protect his daughter DaHyun from the 12 bullies by using his powerful character from webtoon drawing when he was once alive! As a dad, he’ll never let his daughter get bullied. If he sees this?… he won’t let those bullies alone. Whoever touches my daughter, you’re fucked.

Against all odds, Ma-Hyun escapes the demonic realm he was trapped in and returns to his family. They’re shocked and overjoyed to find the son they thought dead is alive. They’re even more shocked to discover that his ordeals have transformed him into a martial arts master of incredible skill and power! But Ma-Hyun soon learns that surviving demons and monsters may not be as challenging as adjusting back to a normal life after a decade away, especially as a shadowy organization targets his family...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

After a life of hardship as an orphan, Ji-A Han finally achieves the dream of homeownership... only to have her moment of jubilation cruelly cut short. While indulging in her guilty pleasure--a riveting soap opera--she experiences a sudden, piercing chest pain and meets an untimely demise. But when she wakes up, she finds herself not in the afterlife, but within the very drama she was watching and as none other than its villainess! In a realm where a glance sparks a scandal and a step triggers a landmine of emotions, what fate lies ahead for Ji-A?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Dante has lived his life hiding a secret—he is immortal. Working as a repairman, he one day witnesses a murder at the home of his client, Demis. Instead of running, he makes an unusual request: Kill me. Demis refuses at first, but upon discovering Dante’s immortality, he becomes intrigued. A dangerous promise is made—one that ties them together in a fate neither of them could have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Taking orders from his boss, Namsoo goes to Baek-ho’s Gang in order to take care of some business. But little did he know that Baek-ho’s Gang’s namesake and leader would take a particular liking to Namsoo and capture him all for his own. Now Namsoo just desperately wants to escape but how will he break free from this insatiable lust…?

(Soure: Lezhin)

After three failed marriages, Archduke Theo de Phoenix has long accepted that love simply isn’t in the cards for him. After all, who could love a war-hardened monster like him? So when his fourth bride arrives, he greets her covered in blood, gives her a shabby attic for a room, and keeps his distance. Surely, this one will run too. But Yuelina is not like the others. To Theo’s disbelief, she welcomes his presence and fills his cold world with warmth and light. As the walls around his heart begin to thaw, will Theo finally allow himself to love?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Brother's Boyfriend Fell for Me

description:
Reborn into a boys' love novel as the stepsister of gang leader Baek Hawon, Cha Yeonbyul is determined to prevent her death at the hands of Hawon's future lover, Yugyeom, a rival gang member. But as she ends the original Yeonbyul's twisted obsession with her own stepbrother by pretending to seduce Yugyeom, the new Yeonbyul finds herself trapped as the unlikely object of Yugyeom's affection! Will she escape the clutches of the male lead or stay caught in the middle of this gang love triangle?

(Source: Tapas)

After finding out his sister has been gang-raped by a secret fraternity before she commited suicide, Lee Kirin decides to catch the rapists and take revenge on them. He approaches one of the known members of the group, Kang Moo, and asks him for his cooperation. However, in order to join the fraternity and find out who led his sister to her death, he is asked to have sex with everyone in the fraternity. As time goes by, this isn't the only challenge he has to face in order to come closer to the truth.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 39 extra chapters.

Josh visits the gym after his girlfriend calls him fat. There, he meets the woman who almost became his stepmom but became estranged from him after his father’s death.

(Source: Toomics)

Leah Hildebrandt, who is known for her good looks and popularity, has a secret she can not share with a soul. Rihit, her younger brother, runs away hoping to come back a stronger man who can support his family. Their father passes away in his absence and he still cannot be found. Leah finds herself face-to-face with the reality that she will need to act as the temporary head of her family in order to protect their position in society. So, she makes the decision to enter into a political marriage for her family. Will a political choice turn out to be fate?

(Source: Netcomics)

It’s been years since Haemin first began craving blood…and only his brother’s will do. Something uncontrollable has called out to Haemin since he was a young boy: an animalistic urge that won’t quell until he’s had his share of blood. Despite this, his younger brother Dogun will do whatever is necessary to keep him safe…and that includes lending him a hand (or vein) whenever his thirst takes over. On top of this, as an elite agent, Dogun needs to fight off the mutants that have begun to invade the world. As the two brothers try to survive in a world full of ravenous beasts and calculating figures disguised in shadows, they uncover secrets that were meant to stay hidden far below the surface.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A twisted school romance of someone who can "truly be mine" and love me to death.

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

“It looks the same as the ideal type in your imagination!”

One spring day when cherry blossoms are in full bloom, “Bo-Mi,” a freshman in high school who was alone in an empty art department, she pours all her ideals and draws a fictional character, surprised to learn that the person in my imagination looks the same as Hae-Yoon, a handsome, tall, athletic senior in the nation’s rankings for the practice test. Hae-Yoon appears in front of Bo-Mi, who is worried about the infringement of her portrait rights, and Bo-Mi is thrilled at Hae-Yoon's request to continue drawing herself...

(Source: Peanutoon)

Eun-Gi has been in college without being engaged with others. One day by encounter, he finds the secret of underclassman Jeong-Woo. Why are you so nervous to forget? A love story that’s both easy and difficult.

While trying to hide the fact that he’s an alpha, Hayden is approached by Brett for help on a class project. However, it turns out that Brett is not only a fellow alpha, but one that doesn’t use scent blockers. The two naturally butt heads and continue as a series of unsettling encounters unfold…until Brett takes things one step too far.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: This face genius is good at soccer

description:
One day a goddess asked Min-Jun, who loved football and chased his dream harder than anyone else, but was left behind due to slow growth and an unimpressive appearance.

"I'm the goddess of soccer. What is your wish?"

"Sex"

On that day, his ordinary life completely changed.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.romaji: Eoneu Nal Jameseo Kkaeeoboni Bagelyeoga Doeeo Isseotda
title.native: 어느 날 잠에서 깨어보니 베이글녀가 되어 있었다

description:
A Korean NEET who lives day to day playing games turned into a girl all of sudden! What will he do?

Notes:
Bagel is Korean slang for a girl with a baby face and a glamorous (sexy) body.
Includes 2 extra chapters.

After losing his parents in a tragic car accident at a young age, Tae-Jun Kim vows never to forgive those responsible. Now, as an adult, fate reunites him with So-Eun Han, the daughter of the driver who took his parents' lives. Young, powerful, rich, and handsome Tae-Jun is hungry for revenge and will bully So-Eun until he feels satisfied. However, complications arise when love enters the equation, blurring the line between resentment and affection. A story in the making, in which "I will never forgive them!" turns into "I think I like you...".

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: I Will Protect My Tyrant Dad!

description:
Sien is your average adorable kid living in the country with her kind dad... or so she thought. It turns out her dad is actually an heir of a grand duke banished from an evil family! Sien will do anything to protect her innocent dad from the wickedness that awaits them. Join Sien on her adventure to keep her tyrant dad safe!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seol is a rising Go prodigy who built her career by memorizing every game she could find, but her play is empty. When she meets Sang-Hun, a self-taught player who defies all logic, her world begins to crack. To surpass the greatest player of her era and her own past, she must abandon everything she knows and step into the unknown. In a game with endless possibilities, can she create a move that’s truly her own?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Na-Hee is sent to bring food to Hyun-Jin, the chaebol heir just back from England. She dreads seeing the boy she used to roughhouse with, yet feels sorry for how lonely his glittering penthouse seems—until he corners her and blurts, “How can I see you as just a friend when you’re so damn pretty?”

(Source: Manta)

Raised in poverty, Kim Woo-Joon has done every kind of job imaginable just to survive. When he rushes back to his rural hometown after hearing about his mother’s car accident, he is crushed by the impossible weight of hospital bills and daily expenses. Desperate, Woo-Joon stumbles into an interview at a luxurious hotel hidden deep in the countryside, a place that caters to the ultra rich and keeps its most exclusive guests in sealed off VIP rooms. There, he meets the enigmatic owner, Kang Ra-Han, a man whose calm smile hides dangerous intentions. Instead of an ordinary job offer, Ra-Han presents Woo-Joon with a startling contract, one that blurs the line between employment and something far more intimate.

With his mother’s life on the line and no other options left, Woo-Joon must decide how much of himself he is willing to give up in exchange for survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Geu Meori Gin Seonbae, Ireumi Mwodeora?
title.native: 그 머리 긴 선배, 이름이 뭐더라?

description:
Sol Song has a uniquely quirky taste in men: they absolutely must have long hair. Otherwise, she sees them as literal "stone heads," devoid of facial features. So, when her first love—and the only long-haired guy on campus—shows up with a buzz cut, she's devastated. But as they start to reconnect and emotions deepen, Sol must discover whether she likes Okseok for who he truly is or just for his hair.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: Starting Over With the Dead You

description:
When I-Ru starts college, she unexpectedly meets Ha-Im, a guy who looks just like Ha-Yul—the one who used to torment her as a child. She feels uneasy around him yet finds herself drawn to his seemingly perfect nature. Is it really okay for her to open up her heart to him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A weak guy wishes to be stronger—and his wish is granted, but with a twist. Instead of raw power, he gains the ability to create clones, doubling his strength with numbers. But there’s an unusual way for him to grow even stronger… and it involves something far more intimate.

(Source: Toomics)

Kang Si-U is sent to prison due to a certain incident in the past. After being released from prison, he joins hands with Do Ji-Hyeok in order to take revenge on Kang Ha-Jun who ruined his life. Kang Si-U has only one purpose: to make Kang Ha-Jun feel the same as he did. But the more he hates him, the more Kang Si-U gets caught up in the past when he use to like Kang Ha-Jun and starts to gets caught up in a sense of self-doubt and guilt every day. It's getting more and more catastrophic...!

He started revenge to save his life, which had been ruined by the betrayal of his wicked ex-lover. Will he be able to succeed in his revenge, leaving behind the truth he faced and his feelings?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Is he really the guy who weighed over 100 kilos? Kim Jin-Su returned to school and he’s back to get revenge on his bullies.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

On the outside, Jeong Jaehan has it all. He’s a third-generation chaebol in charge of an incredibly successful film production company. Despite all the power and money, he’s been secretly suffering from a torturous ailment. After years of drugs and alcohol abuse, he’s lost the ability to orgasm- or so he thought. When someone from his past unexpectedly shows up, Jaehan experiences pleasure that he thought he’d lost forever...

(Source: Lezhin US)

May the best heir win!

Florist Riella never meant to catch the attention of Duchess Horssen with her shining flowers, and she certainly didn't mean to inherit her entire fortune! So when the enraged Grand Duke Hann appears before her to claim possession of the inheritance, what is she to do? Can she defend her newfound title?

(Source: Manta)

A bunch of thugs holding a demonic invocation have kidnapped Kiom to use as their sacrificial offering. Just as she’s about to be attacked, though, the wall before her crumbles, giving way to a tall, glowing figure. The newcomer is more handsome than anyone could dream of, so pretty-faced that he seems angelic, in fact. Kiom is relieved to be rescued, but the guy seems to have mistaken her for someone else. He calls her by a strange name, and pulls out a…sword?! Will Kiom get out of this alive?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Sinui Nuneul Garin Chae Ibeul Matchumyeon
title.native: 신의 눈을 가린 채 입을 맞추면

description:
One kiss could save my life.

As a prophetess, Noemi can see the futures of those she touches. Yet sadly, as the wife of a god, she sees only death in her own fateful future. But then, a sudden kiss with an unruly merchant brings a vision of life. Could he be Noemi's key to survival? Or will she be unable to escape her destiny?

(Source: Manta)

Ji-Han Yoo played Hero of Legends but always lost to pro-gamer, Gamgak. Fed up, he jumps ship to a new game, but the guild master, Yoo-Chae, picks a fight over his gamer ID. But when Yoo-Chae finds out Ji-Han used to play HoL, he becomes obsessed. Can Ji-Han withstand Yoo-Chae's relentless pursuit?

(Source: Manta)

A warrior who was slaughtered at the hands of his comrades after having saved the world from monsters, wakes up in an unknown world after his death.

After attaining a second chance at life, he vows to live his life in debauchery, but the way his savior gazes at him... is somewhat strange.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 side stories.

title.english: My Egocentric Boss is Obsessed With Me

description:
For the chronically single and overworked Soohan, thirsting over his boss's firm booty is his greatest guilty pleasure. It's sad and pathetic, but after a long string of lousy exes and an even longer dry spell, the handsome and talented Mr. Woo seems just that much hotter. Sure, he comes with blazing red flags like his egocentric personality, his bizarre preferences, and his sadistic tendency to overwork his employees. But as off-putting as these qualities are, they aren't enough to deter Soohan's massive crush - especially when the man keeps calling him "babe" and giving him special attention outside the office. Why on earth is his demonic yet charming boss asking him to pick out his bedroom sheets and cooking him his favorite dinner when they aren't even dating? Though he doesn't want to get his hopes up, Soohan can't help but wonder whether his self-centered boss is actually obsessed with him...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: includes six side story chapters.

A recluse by choice, young cafe owner, Lee Jooin, has fled the hustle and bustle of Seoul to live in the countryside in peace. His peculiar ability to read people’s thoughts as text left him unable to trust or face the words left behind in his broken home. But his peaceful new life is suddenly interrupted when a sack of drugs winds up on his doorstep. With that, he finds himself tangled up with an unusual new customer, the right-hand man to the infamous Sa Gang, Mookya. Besides Mookya’s adorable quirks, there’s one thing about him that Jooin can’t ignore; the fact that he can’t see Mookya’s thoughts. After longing to find someone with whom he can have a normal relationship, Jooin follows Mookya back to Seoul. But, with an incestuous brother who's been waiting for Jooin’s return, life-threatening investigations with the police, and other mind readers to worry about, their relationship ends up being anything but normal. As both of these mysterious men become more and more infatuated with each other, their hidden pasts begin to unravel, and they find their social circles overlap more than they realize. But how long before they are torn apart by the words they never wanted the other to hear?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

The story of a possessed person in a book who will not hesitate to kill for her goal. Brinny, who lived in obedience to her stepfather, thought it had nothing to do with her. Until she got involved in an incident with the sickly second prince, Lucian. At a moment of crisis, Brinny used her supernatural powers to save Lucian, and was relieved that everything was resolved when she saw that the possessed person, 'Aridna', was captured. However, for some reason, her beloved sister and the first prince died in a carriage accident, and even Lucian, who became her fiancé, began to act strangely. Wasn't the possessed person executed in the past? Is 'Aridna' still alive? Brinny decides to reclaim the empty space left by the disappearance of her precious people. She will fight the possessed person.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Some people win the lottery or find their dream job, but Sohan…has an alien spaceship land on his brand-new house?! To make matters even worse, there’s an – admittedly sexy – alien inside threatening to wipe out the entire population. Sihwa has come to earth in search of someone specific and has no qualms about using Sohan to get what he wants. The thing is, things work differently on Sihwa’s home planet, and he seems to be expecting things from Sohan that sound downright impossible! Nevertheless, Sohan finds himself making a deal: help Sihwa find the person he’s looking for in exchange for the safety of humanity. But will this strange partnership turn into something...out of this world?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Aylah Goldwyn’s destiny had been determined since her birth: she was to marry the crown prince. However, on the day after her wedding, the prince asks for their marriage to be dissolved. Now, she suffers from near-constant headaches and insomnia, made bearable only through the embrace of a man. One night, she discovers a man who can make her headaches disappear entirely with nothing but a touch. But the next morning, she discovers that he left without a word, and she doesn’t even know his name. Will she be able to find this mysterious man, her “cure”?

(Source: WEBTOON)

For two decades, Actress Kang Seo has been haunted by terrible nightmares. Then, out of the blue, San Han, the man who always rescued her in those dreams, appears before her in real life as her personal bodyguard. Will Kang be able to uncover the true identity of this mysterious figure?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: Keep Up the Good Work, Boss!

description:
In a male-dominated corporate jungle, Ma Ki-Woong, the notorious “Devil Director,” reigns with absolute power. His tyranny has driven countless employees to quit in tears. But Ryu Ha-Jin, an unassuming junior manager hiding his identity as the chairman’s grandson, has had enough. Determined to bring the mighty director to his knees, Ha-Jin sets out on a secret mission of revenge, one that blurs the line between punishment and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After Seok-Hyun's death, Sung-Yun lives a shattered daily life, until Jae-Han, his college classmate, appears before him. Jae-Han, who had secretly loved Sung-Yun during their university days, persistently sticks to Sung-Yun, determined to restore him to his former self. Sung-Yun, unable to discern Jae-Han's intentions, feels uncomfortable. Yet, as Sung-Yun struggles to move on from Seok-Hyun, he gradually begins to accept Jae-Han...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: I Abdicate My Title of Empress

description:
Once Crown Princess of the Empire of Kotrov, Adelheid is reduced to a political pawn by her own mother when she is married off to Emperor Karl Ulrich Echmont of the faraway Echmont Empire. Expecting little from her new life, the reality she faces is even bleaker; not only is her new husband distrustful of her, but Adelheid must also contend with the jealousy of his concubine Diane. Thus begins Adelheid’s journey to gain allies in court, while also using her hidden mage powers to combat a rising threat…

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 side stories.

“All the decent men are already taken.”

Truly good men are quickly claimed by smart women. Just like Dong-Ju—my friend’s husband. With his handsome looks, a solid career, and a warm, caring personality, Cha Dong-Ju is a proven man who has spent seven years with my friend. Is there really anyone more perfect than him… to be my boyfriend?

(Source: Naver, translated)

"Rano, faster!!"

"Harry" always dreamed of becoming a dragon rider ever since he was a young boy. Then one day he rescues a dragon and its egg from a cliff. When Rano finally hatched from the egg, he and Harry instantly become best friends. Where will the series of adventures take the dynamic duo? Will they come out victorious against their rivals? Will Harry become a dragon knight? Join the rookie rider and his baby dragon as they race against the world!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: The Overflowing Elixir of the Fallen House

description:
Ryeon knew from the moment she was born that her life was a cursed one. Born sickly in a martial arts family meant she had nothing else to do other than wait for death. And when that icy embrace came, it delivered not peace but a second chance at life! Regressed to her days as a child, Ryeon resolves to cure herself and live a long, healthy life for the sake of herself and her family.

(Source: Tapas)

Won Dong-Hyuk, a member of the National Assembly, had accidently committed murder in the past. Ironically, as of 2015, the bill to abolish the statute of limitations on murder is being dealt with when he received a message: “I know what you did 15 years ago”.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"Sunbae, what have you been up to these last few nights?"

Taeyoung, who is living with his hobae(his buddy), Junghoon, has a problem. He relieves himself while thinking of Junghoon every night, but can't finish. But what is..?! While they're drinking together, Junghoon offers to lend his hand...!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Sujin Park is a young girl from a small village who suddenly finds herself moving to a big city far away from home because of a new job. For the very first time, she must learn to navigate life and work all by herself while also suddenly becoming the caretaker of a creature known as the sock monster.

(Source: Spottoon)

There are a lot of different people in the world. One girl has a very unfortunate condition. Her whole body is an erogenous zone. Even a look can turn her panties into Niagara falls. And she's just starting college too...Uh oh.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Milo lives in a world where interacting with androids is completely normal. And now, he lives with TWO androids built by his sister. How safe is he living with androids who have deadly strength? Why did his sister gift him a "bodyguard android?" Well, he's about to find out the hard way.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Heli Yun, notorious degenerate, shocks everyone by suddenly turning from his lowlife ways. No one realizes he's been possessed by Lee Siwoon, the author of Heli's story! Trapped in the martial arts novel he wrote, Heli knows that unless he gains power, he's headed for a villain's death. Armed with knowledge about the novel's world, Heli sets out on a quest to gather friends and past enemies to create a martial arts force strong enough to defy the fate he was given... or literally die trying.

(Source: Tapas)

When the hottest girl in school offers Wonyoung a part-time position at her family’s women-only boarding house, Wonyoung is stoked. But when she ditches him and her family yelling how she doesn’t want to work at a boarding house filled with a bunch of “creepy” women, Wonyoung starts to wonder what he’s gotten himself into... Turns out the building is built on some inauspicious land, amplifying sexual desire to an uncontrollable state. It's Wonyoung’s job to help curb that desire for the reputation of the boarding house, and the sanity of the ladies living there.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

The time is Christmas and all the girlfriendless singles have gathered for a Guys Only Party. As they chug on their boozes, their conversations start to revolve around their past love affairs. See what stories these lonely wolves have to share!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Having lived as a fighting legend in Busan, he wanted to live peacefully in Seoul. However, we all know that wasn't how Lee Jung Woo lived. Showing off immense skills in the fight against the best fighters in the school, Lee Jung Woo takes over the area in no time at all. After that, the gangs nearby never leave the 'Tong' Lee Jung Woo alone. Although he is the 'Tong', since Lee Jung Woo did not wish to being harm to those not involved, he starts changing the way he lives. What exactly was Lee Jung Woo trying to protect through all that violence?

What would you do if you had the power to see through objects? After using it to seduce girls, Jin-goo sets out to use it on gambling. What a good choice? Who would be able to beat someone with psychic powers? Well, things don't go as planned as his opponents are more than meets the eye.

(Source: Lezhin)

Nari who just wants to blend in ends up forming a squad with the three prettiest girls on her first day of high school.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After acquiring the crème of the crop slave, an unimaginable adventure begins. A birth of a sexy-fantasy series that will rock your world!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Long, long ago, deep within the towering forest, there existed a world inhabited only by humanoids. Among them, two adjacent mountains were home to the Fox Tribe and the Wolf Tribe, living separately. The beastmen from these two tribes fought constantly, like sworn enemies, and caught in the crossfire was the small village of herbivorous beastmen nestled between the mountains.

“Please stop fighting! If this keeps up, we'll all pack up and move away!!”

Finally, the furious herbivore-type humanoids declared a strike, forcing the Fox Tribe and Wolf Tribe to prepare a wedding for peace. Thus, Hwang Mi-Ho of the Fox Tribe and Jang Woo-Rang of the Wolf Tribe were chosen as representatives of their tribes and bound in matrimony.

“What?! You have no shame?! How could you...”

“What's so terrible about spending the first night together? Ah, could this be your first time?”

They intended to create harmony through marriage, but will this truly lead to a happy ending... for everyone?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

A dissatisfied married couple is given a second chance at love and are transported back in time to the day they met. Will they get back together or find new loves?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Mia’s dream was to become the perfect wife but when that dream was about to come true... she meets and swaps bodies with a SPY. Now Mia is trapped in a man’s body and on top of that he is the legendary Ice Cold SPY who has extraordinary powers!

Blood Bank is where vampires come to buy human blood! In a land where vampires, the supreme beings, rule human beings, there are those that have abnormalities. These vampires, while still superior, prefer to be ruled and commanded by humans. See how Shell, the son of a Blood Bank lord, falls for a mere human banker, One.

(Source: Lezhin)

Kim Jumi's life is like that of any other teenager preparing for her CSAT's: all work and no play. But one summer day, she witnesses something on the rooftop of her school... From then on, she finds herself getting tangled up with two boys who are in a complicated relationship.

The boy next door, friends for life, is actually a werewolf!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jade is told that her childhood friend from China is going to stay at her house. Yet, the grown man who arrives at her door is no longer the sweet boy from her distant memories, rather far from it. As she struggles to re-adjust to their new life together, will she rediscover her childhood crush or simply kick him to the curb?

(Source: SpotToon)

Go Si-Won's dreams are constantly visited by the clever, beautiful Kang Jin-Ha. In the dream, Jin-Ha keeps on mentioning this "incident" that happened between them but Si-Won can't remember anything! And how can it feel so real? Luckily for Si-Won, hints about the "incident" start to appear and Si-Won is able to regain his memory bit by bit. How will their relationship change at the end of it all?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra chapters

"I love you master." Born a servant, he falls in love with a master who loathes servants. An exquisite BL romance, fantasy between master and servant.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Third Winner of the 2nd LEZHIN World Comic Contest.

title.english: At The End of The Road

description:
After a car accident, Tae-Min finds himself in the body of Si-Won, who was a victim of bullying at school. No longer a pushover, he starts standing up for himself but then meets Woo-Jin, an old friend from the past. Somehow, Woo-Jin immediately picks up Tae-Min's 'scent' from Si-Won. What happened between these two in the past and how will it affect their future?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Every Friday, forbidden tales will be revealed.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Baker on the First Floor

description:
Sun Hwa is a BL artist using his room as a secret base to draw his work. One day, he gets caught working on his comic by a handsome blond man. Later, he finds out that this man is the new baker on the first floor. But there's just more to this man than simply his looks.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He’s a dark, uber-powerful god-level demon…who’s also really helpful around the house. Welcome to the unique world of Ghost Wife, where an average high school girl can go to sleep with normal teenage problems, only to wake up and find herself married to an over-protective demon with a creepy smile and an appetite for live cats.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

“From my earliest memory until now, there wasn't a single moment where I didn't like you.” Eunho Jung proposed to Jaeha Yoo, the older boy next door, for the first time when he was three. It stopped being cute when he confessed his feelings again in high school, and once Jaeha got married, the two lost touch. They're reunited by chance years later, Eunho as a university student, and Jaeha, a jaded divorcee. Eunho's determined to prove he’s not a kid anymore, but does Jaeha’s self-destructive spiral allow for feelings?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue, 12 side story chapters, 2 special chapters and an epilogue previously self-published as a Christmas side story.

Alien invasions come in all shapes and sizes. This time, the Earth is under attack by "Unknown Codes" that infiltrate digital devices to eviscerate the human race. The only known way to counter these codes is to play their own game. An awkward mesh of men with different motives are recruited to fight. How is everything going to end?

(Source: Lezhin)

Gi-woo has always been a merciless go-getter. He was a top student in school, and now he’s playing all his cards right at work. He gets the ladies, too, of course, and though his marriage is loveless, you can’t tell from the outside. One day, he receives news that an old professor of his, a father figure, has passed away. Gi-woo rushes to the funeral and meets the beautiful widow and her gorgeous daughter for the first time in years. Soon enough, desires old and new begin to snowball beyond control… A new series from the creator of “Redemption Camp” and “The Seagull and the Hunter”!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

Llewyn Winston is a humble man who lives to serve crown prince Helion Andres Ischeny. Thanks to a blessing cast on his bloodline, Helion never gets sick – so, when one day he suddenly collapses, Llewyn is tasked with finding a cure. Distraught, Llewyn goes to the royal library uninvited…when he is caught by none other than third in line for the throne, Helion’s brother Esteban. Annoyed at the thief that invaded his property, Esteban is ready to have Llewyn killed. In a desperate attempt to save himself, Llewyn kisses Esteban to distract him. After the kiss, the unwieldy prince reveals to Llewyn that he is cursed. The only way to break the spell is for the two to sleep together…and Esteban won’t let him leave until that happens. Is the prince telling the truth? Or could this be a love trap…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yuna Kim, the vocalist of the 21st century rock group 'Rainbow Forest', meets a musician from the Joseon Dynasty and forms a band to spread Korean fusion Korean music for the first time in Joseon!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Su-Yang used his developed sense of taste and smell to become a high ranking clerk. He bemoans the fact his good looks are wasted on such a lifeless job. Then one day, he senses a faint poison eminating from a plum blossom!

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

From the moment Princess Raha's eyes turned blue—the color symbolic of the imperial heir—she has wanted nothing but death. After her brother seized the throne, he sent her an endless stream of bedchamber slaves captured from conquered lands, but none emerged alive. None until Shane Hildes.

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Sesangeul Kkeunnaeneun De Piryohan Jump-ui Hoetsu
title.english: The World Ends at the Jump
title.native: 세상을 끝내는 데 필요한 점프의 횟수

description:
"We are no different from gods."

Hyunhee starts a new job as a server developer at a budding game company. As she digs deeper into a mysterious bug where if a player makes the character jump 65,536 times, the server shuts down, what shocking truths will she uncover? It's just a game... right?

(Source: Manta)

A senior disciple from a countryside martial academy returns as the world’s best! Dragged into a brutal political war, senior disciple ‘Hyeok Musang’ didn’t return after the bloody war ended. No one knew whether he was still alive for 5 years.

Upon barely returning to his hometown, he found his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy being persecuted and destroyed by a third-rate gang.

He thought he could live peacefully with his fellow members after winning the war but seeing the miserable state of his master and fellow disciples, he was filled with anger and guilt.

With the return of the senior disciple, everyone thought things would get better but only for a moment. Things were still happening in his hometown of Yangzhou County. Was the war really over? The head disciple raises his sword against the dangers threatening his Dragon Tiger Martial Academy.

Can Pai the lynx and his younger brother Kova survive in the wilds of Eastern Siberia?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Seung-Bin finds a room near campus, but he has to share it with a mysterious roommate. He's about to say hello... and finds a girl lying there!

"She looks so pretty...!"

His boring life is about to change!

(Source: DAYcomics)

A world full of zombies. But this apocalypse... is it worth trying?! Mental care, wooden construction, heavenly magic, animal communication, mechanical engineering, performance, etc... There is so much to learn!

The sprint of the prepared survivor, who is good at everything, begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Once tormented, a man returns rich and powerful to destroy his teacher—using her own daughter.

(Source: Toomics)

Love and art go hand in hand.

Seon-A, the daughter of a rich family, is trying to transform her mother's failing art museum. She soon encounters art restorer In-Ho, who disagrees with her methods. As he tries to convince her that restoration is often better than a complete do-over, the two begin to fall in love.

(Source: Manta, edited)

How could Terryl’s boyfriend leave her simply because of her low status? After her humiliating breakup, a mysterious man tells Terryl the shocking truth about her identity—she’s the daughter of a powerful duke! With her advanced standing in society and newfound powers, Terryl plans revenge against her pitiful ex-boyfriend and contemplates marrying his brother, Cesio. This way, he’ll never get the title of marquis! But what will Terryl do when she discovers Cesio’s dark secret? Will she get her happily ever after, or is that just a fairytale?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 17 side story chapters.

'Delivering pleasure directly to the clients!' GUN-WOO starts working at a mysterious delivery company, and soon finds that he has real talent in satisfying his clients. "Ma'am! You can't do that!"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jinah has a secret habit: she can’t fall asleep without the explicit ASMR videos of a mysterious YouTuber named NA. It’s the only thing that calms her insomnia, even if the creator’s voice and trademark lip mole are hauntingly familiar. But when her company hosts a workshop featuring the internet's hottest star, Jinah’s digital fantasy becomes a physical nightmare. NA is actually Heo Jina, the high school "friend" who stole Jinah's first love and left her life in ruins. Now, it turns out the woman who ruined her is the only one who can make her feel alive...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Enter Heilbronner: gentleman thief! The main villain of a novel, who fought against the heroes, steals from the rich at night, but by day takes on the identity of Ludger Kassen, the philanthropic son of a duke, more interested in history than politics or power. As commander of the ragtag Ruby Knights, isekai’d knight Clara has no choice but to get involved in the Heilbronner case. However, in doing so, and in working alongside Ludger himself, Clara learns he secretly has far grander motives...

(Source: Tapas)

After falling into a river to elude her attackers, the mercenary Ilian Heinrich wakes up a decade prior as Haven Winter, a 12-year-old noble burdened with debt and a family to look after. Determined to protect them, Haven uses her past memories to be hired by the young Duke Julius Al Richard, the one person she cared for as Ilian. Unfortunately, prickly Julius isn't going to make her job easy. With such a difficult boss, will Haven live up to her name and secure a safe future for her loved ones?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 side stories.

All Ell wants is for a warrior to come along and kill him so he can finally achieve a comfortable life after death. Just when it looks like he might get his wish, he accidentally kills the warrior who came to end his life. But Ell soon comes up with a different plan: if there are no warriors to kill him, he can raise one himself! So Ell the dragon, Lafi the magician, and Dino the baby warrior become an unconventional family. However, Ell soon discovers it’s harder than he thought to teach a baby combat moves!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ju Baek is a high-schooler who can see through other people's lies. Now, she is after a famous detective who might fabricate cases to improve his crime-solving rates, Je-Heon Lee, to unveil the whole truth about him to the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Just before her passing, Seul-Gi's grandmother hands her a mysterious note. On it is an address where her grandmother claims to have hidden a secret inheritance. But when Seul-Gi visits the location, she finds that a stranger is already living there!

Will Seul-Gi be able to become the heiress she was meant to be?

(Source: Manta)

At a college welcome party, Kang Ju-Yeong overhears a juicy rumor about Choi Hyun, a popular student from the Physical Education department—apparently, he accepts professions of love from almost anyone, even strangers. As the drinks flow, the conversation escalates into a daring bet: whoever confesses their love to Choi Hyun wins 100 dollars. Uncomfortable with the vibe, Ju-Yeong leaves the party, only to run into Choi Hyun as he's breaking up with someone. Seizing the moment, Ju-Yeong blurts out:

"Go out with me too!"

But unlike the others, Ju-Yeong’s profession isn’t just a spur-of-the-moment gamble—he’s been secretly in love with Choi Hyun since high school. With Hyun caught off guard and no way to take it back, the two start dating that very night. Will Ju-Yeong’s long-time crush turn into a lasting relationship, or is this love destined to be just another fleeting romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Ju-Sa, a poor civil servant living an ordinary life. One day, while busy with work, his forgotten Bitcoin from 10 years ago suddenly skyrockets, making him the owner of 8 billion won and putting into practice the cider office life he always wanted... Kim Ju-Sa's crazy, crazy life with 8 billion won begins..!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Bukbu Daegongui Jeongchega Heungmak Angnyeora Gollanhada
title.english: The Grand Duchess of the North Was Secretly a Villainess
title.native: 북부 대공의 정체가 흑막 악녀라 곤란하다

description:
Eloise Wayana, the grand duchess of the North, is executed by Emperor Caien Helisis after it is revealed that she was secretly a villainess all along. This marks the end of season two of the latest trending web novel, “The Crown of Blood.” As one of its avid readers, Kim Dakyung is eagerly waiting for the next season when she is suddenly hit by a truck on her way home! But once she reawakens, she finds that she is in the body of the grand duchess herself and has been teleported back to the novel’s beginning. Already knowing what road Eloise will go down, Dakyung is desperate to change her fate and survive until season three. Lucky for her, a younger version of Caien falls right into her hands, and she is going to do whatever it takes to keep him on her side.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Dragged into a host bar by chance, Minkyeong meets Sihyeok, a man whose savage charm awakens desires she never felt with her husband. As she becomes addicted to the thrill he offers, she drains her money, her pride, and herself, only for his demands to grow more dangerous with each encounter. But her fall is only beginning, because Sihyeok is merely a tool, and the true owner watching from the shadows intends to claim her completely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chae Yeon runs a quiet little pension on a remote island—but with her painfully shy personality, dealing with guests is more stress than success. Just as she’s contemplating closing up shop, an unexpected guest checks in: Baek Sanho, her high school classmate…and the guy she once rejected. Now all grown up and annoyingly charming, Sanho seems determined to turn up the heat—on the island and in Yeon’s heart. With old sparks beginning to flicker back to life, this getaway is about to get way too hot to handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.
Jungwoo gets misunderstood because he looks older than his age despite being 20 years old while Youngmin looks like a highschooler despite being a university student.

After her sister turns up dead as the latest bride of a monstrous, exiled prince, Louanne is assigned to take her place and hopes to uncover the truth. The prince initially refuses her, but with her magical powers, she begins to heal his pain each night while concealing her own. Meanwhile, her evil uncle, who took advantage of her ability in order to run a medical scheme at home, begins to crumble. Has Louanne truly escaped her cursed family, or is she stepping into something darker at Sable Manor?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jorace, a warrior, is on the road to success.
Marriage to an unidentified, super-cool, handsome man has come.
By the way.... the mother-in-law is a devil?! ㄴ(°0°)ㄱ

(Source: Naver, translated)

Four years ago, the idol group Dream Boy disbanded after being embroiled in some kind of scandal. And now... Jae-Young, formerly known as "Happy" in Dream Boy, was struggling financially and working a part-time delivery job when he heard that the group's leader, Su-Kyum, had passed out drunk at a club, and he rushed to him. Although they share the same stage name, Seung-Min, aka "Happy" and the most popular rapper and producer these days, saves Jae-Young from collapsing from photosensitivity syndrome and suggests they work together...

"You know who I am, right? Let's work together."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

If only progressing in life were as easy as leveling up in a game. That’s what happened to James, a game developer who thought his life had hit rock bottom—until his creation began to blur the line between the game and reality.

(Source: Toomics)

“I’m going to cash in the lottery ticket! Take off your clothes and have sex with me!”

Him-Chan, an ordinary office worker, receives a mysterious lottery ticket. He scratches the lottery ticket with doubt… Only to find it’s a sex coupon? Yet, as he hands over the mysterious ticket, the woman begins to undress on her own… Is this the beginning of a new chapter in his sex life?!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.romaji: 100-man Undong YouTuber-in Naega I Webtoon-eseoneun Choneungnyeokdo Eomneun Jjeori? -Buje: Wollae Geuraesseum-
title.native: 100만 운동 유튜버인 내가 이 웹툰에서는 초능력도 없는 쩌리? -부제: 원래 그랬음-

description:
Take a look at this—!!

[Saving the World at the Gym!]

The year is 20XX. With the invasion of monsters straight out of a B-movie, humanity opens its eyes to a new power! Among the heroes who ooze strength and power without having to work out is a "tiger" who guards the Stronger Gym... No, it’s not a tiger, it’s a man wearing a tiger-patterned t-shirt and pants! Today, he greets his gym babies with joy like any other day.

"What? A gym baby?! Don't be scared. Come on in!"

Come watch the main character and his Stronger Gym friends cultivate a healthy mind and a healthy body!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A drinking game unfolds among friends who have just become adults. Hyun-Oh, hoping to kiss his crush Hee-Won, participates in the game of spin the bottle, but the person the bottle points to is the devilishly gay Yu-Ra. Hyun-Oh tries to end the game with a quick kiss to ease the embarrassment, but Yu-Ra unexpectedly thrusts into a deep kiss. From that day on, Hee-Won's mind constantly wanders to Yu-Ra's lips, and he even begins to dream about having sex with him...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Jae-Hyeon has always gotten everything that he wanted, but the housekeeper's son, Eun-Hae, was the one person that he desired above anything else. So when Jae-Hyeon heard that Eun-Hae's moving away, of course he's going to push him down the stairs. Eun-Hae loses his memory due to the accident, and Jae-Hyeon decides that he will never desire anything ever again. However, an unexpected reunion with Eun-Hae triggers Jae-Hyeon's desires to come rushing back...

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a once-dormant contract requiring descendants of House Morgana and House Kalakis to wed resurfaces, Meivia Morgana receives a shoddy proposal from the ever-miserable eldest son, Gilbert Kalakis. Determined not to settle for less, Meivia decides to marry the single and mysteriously alluring family head, Grand Duke Edis Kalakis. Between a volatile son always knocking at her door and an enticingly enigmatic father who leaves her wanting more, will Meivia be able to sign her way to happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

"Everyone has someone who protects them. Except for me..."

Am I really living according to my destiny?
Or can you change your own destiny?

A fateful meeting between a man who wants to escape fate and a guardian spirit who appears after 20 years.

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

"Please help me get a boyfriend!!" "Okay, but in return, you have to get me into college." Sora is the top student at the prestigious Jaeil All-Girls High School but she suddenly finds herself lying to her classmates about a boyfriend she doesn't have, which leads her to accepting the near-impossible task of getting the delinquent Haena Woo into college. But in return, Haena will have to find Mr. Right for Sora so she doesn't get caught in her lie. Yet strangely, instead of some boy, Sora finds her heart beating for Haena...

(Source: Copin Comics)

An immortal high school student, So-Yeong is secretly crushing on human golden retriever Hui-Jae. Mysteriously, he keeps coming into near-death danger and So-Yeong repeatedly sacrifices herself to protect him. Something begins to grow between the two, and someone doesn't like that. What will happen to their lives and fate?!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Benjamin Barker, a special agent at the CBI, attempts to apprehend Ian Basti, the boss of a major crime syndicate, only to be overpowered and captured. As Ian's prisoner, Benjamin is subjected to countless forms of sexual torture and even abandoned by his fellow agents. Despite this, he decides to stay by Ian's side to learn more about the inner workings of the organization and their drug operations. Will Benjamin survive this ordeal, or will the mob boss's grasp suffocate his escape plans?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After losing her parents, Laria Losstree is saddled with a mountain of bills. Enter the archvillain, Duke Icardes, who agrees to pay off her debt, but only if she’ll marry his son, Evan. Cool and distant, he’s not exactly ideal husband material, but that’s okay, since Laria plans to secretly stash his money, then bounce! But when the duke starts acting suspiciously nice to her, Laria begins to wonder if he's on to her plan, and a battle of wits between archvillain and daughter-in-law begins!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

title.english: Lady Baby Is a Revenge Maker

description:
The Allegros are about to get what’s coming to them. My family barely remembers my name (it’s Sephiel!), but I’ve written all of their names on my revenge list. Now that I’m engaged to Elgar from the powerful Remdragon family, I’ve got the allies and influence to make it happen. I’ve definitely got to be careful that these half-dragons don’t catch me in a lie (or kill me themselves), but I’m sure my cuteness and cunning will keep me alive.

(Source: Tapas, translated)

My name is Sua Jo, and my life couldn't get any better - my loving dad is a Mayor, my handsome boyfriend is the top dog in school, my fun-to-be-with friends love me, and my background is top-notch. My life is perfect. But wait, did I just hit someone?! No, no I didn't... No one saw me, so nothing happened. My life is still perfect, or so I thought... until "M" appeared claiming to be a witness. You think I'll let you ruin my perfect life?! Just wait until I find you!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Trapped in a game where she’s a spy tasked with seducing the men of the Empire, our protagonist finds herself in a twisted reverse harem scenario with no way out.

“Did I log in to the game last night? But I don't remember logging in...”

What started as an immersive gaming experience for her day off quickly turns into a nightmare when she realizes she’s stuck inside. Now, surrounded by irresistibly handsome men and intense encounters, she desperately wants to escape. But there’s one problem: the game doesn’t plan on letting her leave anytime soon!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yoon-Woo and Tae-Gyeom have been best friends since childhood, but Yoon-Woo is hiding a secret that could tear them apart–he’s an omega… and he’s in love with Tae-Gyeom.

When a traumatic event leads Tae-Gyeom to despise all omegas, Yoon-Woo is forced to keep his identity a secret. After struggling for years to avoid Tae-Gyeom, they both end up at the same college, and Yoon-Woo’s carefully guarded secret is in danger of being exposed…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Then I thought it was a coincidence. That style is quite common and it’s not my specialty. After that, I got a little nervous. Did my drawing get copied and spread? Was it my follower? Was he referencing my style because he liked it?

Finally, I got anxious. When I saw the T-shirt with the pattern I drew myself, I thought, ‘Did I draw that pattern without knowing it? Or did my drawing get stolen?’

In the end, I asked her directly. “This one? I didn’t buy it anywhere...” And then, “I custom-made it myself. What do you think? Does it suit me?” She asked me back. She wore clothes that matched the style I drew, emphasized the items that emphasized the pattern I drew, styled the accessories so that they would stand out, and posed…

“I wanted to hear you say that I look good on you.” Looking straight into my eyes…

(source: Comico, translated)

After a messy breakup, beta Hae-Min swore off alphas for good… until a reckless one-night stand with dominant alpha Seong-Han turns him into an omega overnight. Now stuck needing a regular partner (doctor’s orders!), Hae-Min bites the bullet and proposes a deal with Seong-Han, who just so happens to be his newest coworker. One weekly “appointment” turns into sparks flying - but just when things start to look sweet, who should show up as their new boss but Jin-Tae, the ex who dumped Hae-Min for being a beta?! From awkward office deals to tangled love triangles, Hae-Min’s love life is about to get a lot more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When I opened my eyes, I was back in the past 23 years ago?! The brother who killed my parents. Missing my parents, Woo-Joo cried until he fell asleep, and when I opened my eyes, I found myself in the past 23 years ago, before I was even born. Woo-Joo was faced with the other side of his parents, whom he thought were affectionate, and the truth about his brother who had no choice but to become a murderer. Woo-Joo struggles in the face of cold, merciless violence and tries to change the past, but humans do not change so easily. Can Woo-Joo stop the violence of the past and save his parents? What can we do in the face of violence?

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

title.english: To You Who Doesn't Love Me

description:
Ages ago in a land of myth and legend, a young girl called Rose stands tied to a stake, awaiting her cruel fate as a sacrifice to the sea serpent known as Leviathan. That is, until a dashing hero suddenly appears to defeat the monster and save Rose’s life. Eternally grateful, Rose becomes devoted to her rescuer Mikhail, who is the demigod son of the moon goddess, Diana. She joins his party of adventurers, but soon comes to realize that her savior may not be as noble as he seems…

(Source: Webtoons)

Su Xiao, a girl from the modern century, accidentally transmigrates to ancient times and inhabits the body of the Second Lady of the Prime Minister's manor. Pushed around and often brought to her knees, the Second Lady falls in love with a complete jerk before dying in the hands of a malicious villain. However, from now on, she will no longer be a foolish, meek little girl! She will make all of her enemies pay... Very, very dearly!

(Source: WebComics)

“Money? Beauty? Power? It’s all for the taking!”

A magical app turns an underachiever’s life around! Money? Beauty? Power? It’s all for the taking! Ning Xiaofan was an unremarkable teenager from a poor family who was often bullied by his classmates, until one day, when a magical app called the “Three Realms Online Shop” suddenly appeared on his phone. Ever since then, Ning Xiaofan’s life has been thrust onto a completely different path, taking him from zero to hero.

(Source: Comikey)

title.english: Myriad Paths of the Dragon Emperor

description:
With his bloodline taken away, the young man Lu Ming was reduced to a good-for-nothing and suffered humiliation. However, he accidentally found the Ultimate Divinity Hall and rebuilt the almighty bloodline. Therefore, he embarked on his unique path toward the peak of martial arts. Devouring spiritual Qi and fusing various bloodlines, he defeated the enemies, ventured into the world, and with the help of the Fighting Dragon Technique, he eventually became the Dragon Emperor.

(Source: Webnovel)

By stars, a vow. By feather, an oath.

(Source: Hypergryph)

Cybernetic enhancements, AI girlfriends, neural networks, cyberspace—this is a world of hyper-advanced technology where innovations can transform your life like magic. While incurable cancers of the past are now insignificant before nanomedicine robots, new technological heights also breed all manner of fresh problems, new troubles, and new... cyberpsychosis. “What is capitalism?” Jack Sun stood with hands on hips, leaning back.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shang Guo Fu Zhi Qian Dui Xue

description:
Despite her talent, Xuan Qiancao is continually humiliated and mocked as the daughter of a traitor. One day, she is helped by Chen Tongxue, a nobleman at the top of the hierarchy at the Grand College. From that moment on, she falls in love with him and works hard to become his servant!

(Source: INKR)

Having offended his class counselor, Zhao Yan was faced with the problem of impending punishment. At that moment, the Swapping Lives Club System was activated for him. Zhao Yan entered the system’s club lobby and thus began his journey of swapping lives with members of all levels within the club. By helping his swap partners resolve their life problems and realize their dreams, Zhao Yan forges his way, step by step, into a bright and dazzling future.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 暮岁闲谈：正是团圆时分

description:
Lots of dishes, lots of people, and lots of time.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

After an encounter with a blue-haired boy, Shi Lei was given a mysterious black card and became their puppet. After that, he began to start his days by spending money! “Kill me if I don't spend all of the money?”“I've only heard that growing stronger might make people bald, I don't know that being rich will also…”“Close friends are allowed to help me spend money?”“Brilliant! My childhood sweethearts, gorgeous beauties and wacky lolitas, let me be your personal ATM! Yeah!”

(Source: Webnovel)

Who says you have to do whatever the System says? Su Chen refuses to do these menial tasks. He's not going to do what the System says, not in this lifetime.

The System posts a new mission? Not going to accept it!
The System dares to threaten me? Beat him up!
The System kneels down and pleads: "Oh Master, please have mercy on me and accept a mission."
Su Chen dismisses the System's plea, "You can just wait until I finish spending these million skill points!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wuxian Chouqu: Kaiju He Ping Xiu Xian Shijie
title.english: Cheat Summoner: Wipe Out Gods with a Starter Pack
title.native: 无限抽取：开局核平修仙世界

description:
After an unfortunate encounter with a cargo truck, Chen Ke transmigrates into a cultivation world—only to wake up in a dungeon, captured as a "birthday sacrifice" for a man-eating demon. Just as despair sets in, his [Multiverse Lottery System] activates with a catch:

The more he shocks others, the more prizes he draws! Now, while fellow prisoners tremble before the guards, Chen Ke does the unthinkable—he slaps a demon sentry and demands better prison food. As jaws drop, his system pings:

» [Shock Value +50!]
» [Reward: "Indestructible Crocs™"]
» [Next Prize: "AK-47 of Qi Refining"]

Armed with increasingly ridiculous artifacts, this madman pioneers…

The Path of Techno-Cultivation!

(Source: Webnovel)

An ordinary salesman transmigrated to a Xianxia world and is known as the good-looking Lu Changsheng. Due to his godly looks, people think he's a genius, but he actually has mediocre talent. His master wants him to be Elder Senior Brother, but will he be able to pull it off with just looks?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Heihua Nan Zhu Zaixian Yang Tu
title.english: The Blackened Male Lead And Bunny Spirit

description:
