Medical student Ruan Ruan was transformed into a rabbit spirit and met a cold and bloodthirsty fox. When they first met, she slipped and died under the opponent's knife. Unexpectedly, she would be resurrected with full health the next day. To survive in this fantasy continent with big bosses everywhere, Ruan Ruan decisively clung on the fox Qi Yang and became his loyal follower. Doing laundry, cooking, and coaxing people to sleep, the big boss going berserk and wanting to be smoothed out, and even becoming the other party's mobile blood bank on a full moon night, which really worries Ruan Ruan...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Shen Ji Yu Wu: Wo Wuxian Qiyue Nüshen
title.native: 神级御物：我无限契约女神

description:
Lin Fang awakens an SSS-level artifact mastery talent, granting him the power to turn anything into a divine weapon. Armed with an invincible holy sword, clad in god-tier armor, and riding a flashy motorcycle, all equipment granted by goddesses!

As terrifying beasts invade and threaten apocalypse, Lin Fang fights alongside his goddess companions. With love, he vows: “My ladies, let us ascend to the throne of power—together!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Theater and death dance together, the truth is hidden behind applause.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

To assassinate his target, Meng Shiyu, assassin Xia Ran rents a house to observe him day and night. An unexpected entanglement leads him to become Meng Shiyu's bodyguard. Xia Ran begins to learn to protect people, thinking he is protecting the innocent. However, he doesn't realize that from the moment he accepts the assassination mission, he has fallen into Meng Shiyu's trap...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Sheng Xi is an elite CEO by day, but by night, he leads a double life as a barely safe-for-work streamer… One day, the company sends a handsome and cheerful second-gen wealthy idiot his way to serve as his assistant. Now, he has no choice but to juggle between hiding his secret identity and putting up with this foolish rich heir. Except… this seemingly clueless golden-retriever-like assistant seems to have a few secrets himself~

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

title.english: Oh No! It Became A Spirit!

description:
An erotica suddenly becomes a spirit. All she wanted to do was cultivate her powers, sleep and flirt with Master, but... No matter where she goes, objects seem to be turning into spirits. Enough, throne! Stop thinking about sleeping with the emperor!

(Source: Webnovel)

College Student Zhao Zhe and classmate Liu Qingyan participated in the concert of an idol group MMC48 but they accidentally broke their identity and landed in trouble. When Zhao Zhe almost lost his life, the mysterious girl Chen Mo suddenly appear to save him. For revenge Zhao Zhe followed Chen Mo to join the mysterious forces that backed her. Follow Zhao Zhe as he embark on a new journey and travel around in order to compete and to kill.

Prince disguised as the emperor vs Conniving Prince Regent. How will she entrench herself at every step and take back what belonged to her? You've got to check out this hilarious story of the royal family!

After the former emperor passed away, the prince also died of illness. His 10-year-old twin sister, Chu Fengchen, had to disguise herself as the prince and ascended the throne. One person was responsible for all of this, Pei Yu, the Prince Regent, who was ever-more powerful in the imperial court. Nasty traitors! She will destroy them all eventually!!

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Nan You Ban Tang Ban Yan

description:
The father mysteriously disappeared, the mother committed suicide, and the hidden truth was discovered from the clues. Chai Nana, the master of decryption who inherited the mysterious Yangyu Ukey, turned into a socialite and decided to serve the man with her beauty. She made a hidden rule deal with Mr. Mo, the most powerful boss in S City. Who wants to summon the warm side of the man with a kiss! One is cold as ice, the other is warm...

(Source: MangaToon)

In our infinite universe, there are countless planets and worlds. Among those shining stars, there exists a world called "The Roc Kun". The continent of wind is a land of wars and disorders.

Here, a story of a warrior, is about to begin...

(Source: MangaToon)

After dating for a year, my boyfriend confesses to me that he has super power. Not only can he be summoned by me anytime and anywhere, he also does whatever I want him to!

(Source: Boom Manga)

The starlet Yu Chaoyan made herself famous through all sorts of antics and gossip, but in reality she's just a mouthy virgin. Tired of the rumors tying her her to another male actor, she angrily said live on camera, "If he were the last man on Earth, I would rather become a lesbian before I'd go out with him!" The outburst made waves online, and she shot to the top of the hot topics list. But in the aftermath, a crazed fan of the actor ambushed Yu Chaoyan in the parking lot and tried to disfigure her. Faced with danger, that was when Yin Zhou stumbled on the scene and stepped in to save her from the attack…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wangye, Ni De Majia Diao Le

description:
Criminal psychologist Gu Ruoru travels back in time and becomes a broke widow with a young son. Oh, that's right, she also picks up a slightly "dumb" guy along the way too. Gu Ruoru decides the three of them can play a happy family for now. The real identity of the three members of the family? Well, all I can tell you is that each one is better than the next.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Gun Kai, Wo Yao Xian Meng Yihui Er!

description:
A series of short serialized manhua stories that focuses on cats' daily lives. It centers on interesting everyday life stories of a sweet naive cat called "Fu Gui" and an arrogant cat called "Fa Cai", as well as their sentimental owner Niu Hong Hong.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Wuxian Zhuan Zhi: Wo Neng Zhaohuan Man Ji Nushen
title.english: Unlimited Profession Switching: I Can Summon Max Level Goddesses
title.native: 无限转职：我能召唤满级女神

description:
After a bizarre car accident, Yun Xinghe wakes up to find himself in a perilous world. To his shock, a beautiful demon starts doing all sorts of embarrassing things to him and even claims she has to take responsibility for him. "Hey… what are you saying!? I’m a gentleman! Wait, what’s with this unlimited job changing? Where’s the promised harem of beauties?!"

(Source: Webnovel)

Lin Jing was your average model student: serious, diligent and polite. However, after transferring to a new school for his sophomore year, his life took a sudden turn when he was forced to become a minion for the bottom-ranked delinquent.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Yiwan Shuang Bao: Mommy, Shushou Jiu Qing!
title.native: 亿万双宝：妈咪，束手就情！

description: After meeting the two children of the Li family, Shi Qing realized the meaning of a word that no one would ever offend people who can’t be offended. Her peaceful life was completely broken, and even if she ran away, they would have stopped her in the middle of it. Little Lo Li waved and whispered to her softly, “Please come home with us!" Xiao Zheng then said to her coldly: “You can only be bullied by me! Remember?!"
This is a two-person comic without any dialogue. A blossoming romance between a boy and a girl.

title.romaji: Ni Shi Wo De Mao Bohe

description:
Wu Yue is a 'catnip' descendant- one who carries the fragrance of catnip on her body. Not knowing better, she enrolled in a school that is filled with cat descendants, causing a commotion and to be chased around by them. In the process of escaping, Wu Yue accidentally kissed Li Zechu, a descendant of the jaguar, and unexpectedly discovered that Li Zechu's kiss could somehow camoflage her unique fragrance.
Thus, in order to quell the commotion she had caused and survive in school, Wu Yue had to become Li Zechu’s pet. She would have to endure all sort of harrassments, just for a kiss from Li Zechu...
It is an impossible kind of development. Wu Yue vows to find another solution to this problem and be rid of the control of the demon Li Zechu!

During their first meeting, the five-year-old Tang Junhe started to view the six-year-old Yang Xuan as his hero, and he willingly became Yang Xuan’s little follower. Yang Xuan once said, “There are 12 ways to fold a paper plane. You didn’t know that, did you? Let me teach you.” Ten years later, the 17-year-old Tang Junhe lived in Yang Xuan’s house as his younger brother. The grievances of their past remained unresolved as the two young men fought constantly. “The first one to fall is the loser. I knew that, yet I willingly fell into it.”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Twelve Alien destroyers turned into meteorites and hit the earth, bringing an unknown zombie virus and setting off a doomsday frenzy. The evolution zone has opened, and power user has started to emerge! Wang Zhe, who died in battle ten years later, has reborn and returned back in time. Now he decided to use the advantages of his memory and strength to become the strongest evolutionary!

The primordial Qi on the Blue Planet was revived, and the monsters were back in the world! Divine Beast Zhulong, Fierce Beast Fengxi, Evil Beast Qiongqi, North Sea Monster Kraken, Midgard Serpent Jormungand, Mighty Beast Behemoth... The only ones who could contend with these monsters were the awakened! But Lin Xiu failed to awaken any abilities and became a laughing stock. However, with the mysterious pendant left by his father, he accidentally gained the ability to harness monsters. King of Monsters Kuilong, Monster Tyrant Jintian, Demon Bug Queen Jiaochong, Star-breaking Giant Ape Aohen...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chong Qi Chengyin: Lu Shao de Xinjian Chong
title.english: Fall for You, Dote on You
title.native: 宠妻成瘾：陆少的心尖宠

description: After a night, her boyfriend became her sister's fiance, while her parents wanted her to serve an old man. Having no choice, she broke into his room accidentally. Unexpectedly, after one night stand, he fell in love with her and insisted on marrying her. Since then she became the wife of Lu Zeyuan, the devil incarnate, which discomposed her parents and her blamed ex-boyfriend. A romantic relationship after marriage thus began...

When the prince was on the verge of death, he saw not only the moon in the sky, but also a vampire with a beautiful face. The human prince, who was saved by the vampire, decided to repay his kindness. Little did the vampire expect there would be a day he would be involved with a human!

A warm smile suddenly appeared in the endless life of the vampire, and the loneliness of being imprisoned began to change from the day they met~

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

After Andre is financially cut off, he joins a digital marketing company, where he is assigned as an assistant to a fiery woman Gwen. What kind of intriguing story will happen between them?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Zhang Yi has made a deal with the domineering doctor Bai Li. In order to save his sister's life, Zhang Yi is willing to sacrifice everything, his life, his freedom, let alone his body. He is now at Bai Li's mercy. He is a desperate prey who has bee targeted by the predator long time ago. How could he possibly run away? How could he go without his master's permission?

(Source: MangaToon)

Mu Ning Xi says that the farthest way she’s ever walked is the President Mo’s routine. Five years ago, she was the antidote to a man with great physical strength. Five years later, her son took her to the Big President and said, “Mummy, I found my daddy! He will raise me and will pamper you!" Mo Qi Ao embraced Mu Ning Xi’s waist and said affectionately: “My wife, we should have our second child early, so the siblings’ relationship will be better!" Mu Ning Xi: " … ”

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Scum men have cheating excuses too much! Depressed Zheng Wei Wei accidentally reunited with Gu Chang An, an intimate contact a few years ago did not let the two immediately remember each other. Workplace harassment accidentally fell into a trap, Gu Chang An repeatedly comes to help.

“You are as unforgettable as I remember.”

You Qiuzi's name was one that everyone in her school has heard of. With barely any friends because of her thick makeup and redoubtable presence, hardly anyone dared to approach her. But beneath her intimidating exterior was a hurt and broken soul that just couldn't relate to anyone, let alone making friends with strangers. Until one day, when her boring life was changed by her reunion with her childhood friend Gao Tuo after five years. Facing someone who felt so familiar and yet so distant at the same time, before she even knew it, she found herself trying to scale the extra mile just to see him smile...

(Source: Webnovel)

Jiao Yang, a naïve intern, finds out the handsome man he met at the bar is renown scriptwriter Li YuanXiao, his new boss. After endless pestering from his friend Pei Qui, Jiao Yang slowly acquaints himself with Li YuanXiao. As Jiao Yang gets to know Li YuanXiao, he also meets his inner demons. Getting to know Li YuanXiao is like sipping a martini. Bitter but sweet, bittersweet.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

He Xianzi's soul was crushed, and he was expelled from the celestial realm for the crime of stealing the Fair Wind Scroll. Just before his execution, he made a promise to his disciple, San Tu... Now, thousands of years later, San Tu has achieved great progress in his cultivation and descends into the world of mortals in search of his master. He meets a man who looks exactly like He Xianzi, as if he is his reincarnation, but he claims not to know him. Will San Tu be able to clear He Xianzi's name of injustice and continue toward their destined fates together, despite the onslaught of evil and nefarious plots in the shadows?
(Source: INKR Comics)
Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras

title.romaji: Meng Bao Jia Lin: Diedi Mami Chao Xiong De
title.english: Cute Baby Arrives: Mommy is Super Fierce
title.native: 萌宝驾临：爹地妈咪超凶的

description:
When the not-so-famous actress Jane wakes up in the morning, her cute-but-nagging son Ian already had her day plan out for her – go on a blind date and find a father for the household. However, her date turns out to be Mark Quinn, the biological father of her son. The sullen business man obviously doesn't have the best impression of Jane and would not have expected that they will enter marriage soon with the help of Mark's father and Ian...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Jingsong Youxi Li Feng Shen

description:
Bai Liu, an ordinary laid-off worker, finds himself drawn into a perilous survival game driven by his craving for money. Within this deadly contest, he not only encounters allies to fight alongside but also rediscovers the lover who has been waiting for him all along...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An aloof CEO suffering from "Cold Heart Syndrome" was forced to enter the World of Comics and experience different stories: The devil and slave; The Vampire and priest... Will their stories have happy endings? Through these fantasy and tragic stories, he'll regain the memories of his last life! —“Wherever you are, you're destined to be my captive.”

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 6 extras.

Men Ke, an ordinary office worker, spent the first half of her life being bored, but in the second half of her life, she was faced with a situation where she would die of boredom.
"You are responsible for getting me into this mess!!!" "It doesn't matter."
Now see how our heroine, who faces sudden death but continues to go to work every day, and our hero, who is enthusiastically trying to save her but not very being very helpful, "live life to the fullest".

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Beautiful as a flower, delicate as a young blossom, the ruler of a nation accidentally slips and falls through the passages of time to the present world. By strange coincidence he ends up in the body of a famous superstar with all eyes on him! How does the emperor, who is straight as a pen, become bent as coiled incense after traveling through time?! Read to find out!

Jeff has been called the 'future star of tennis' from when he was young. However, after a traumatic loss in his childhood, it seems impossible for him to win ever since.

Even though he has mastered all of the techniques- serve, smash, volley, footwork- the goal of victory always seems distant.

Tennis is supposed to be about the enjoying the game, not the result. But will Jeff ever overcome his habit of losing at the crucial moment, and achieve victory?

title.romaji: Shenmi Jianglin: Wo Neng Zhuzai Guiyi
title.native: 神秘降临：我能主宰诡异

description:
A week later, I died. When I used the system to alter the future, I discovered that terror had returned to the world!!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

When he woke up, Ji Ran, the son of a rich second generation, found himself lying beside his arch-nemesis from his school days, Qin Man!

Despite reluctantly agreeing to a sponsorship agreement with the green tea black belly enemy, Ji Ran finds his lonely and stubborn heart gradually melting by the occasional tenderness displayed by Qin Man.

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

When he woke up, he found himself transformed into an ostrich, and his precious ostrich egg was stepped on and broken by his customer?! Have you ever seen a kidnapping caper started over an ostrich egg?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Eric has been in love with Byron for five years, willingly accepting Byron's distant, often cold demeanor. But everything changes when Byron's "first lover" returns from abroad. Watching the tender way Byron treats her, Eric realizes that he has only ever been a stand-in, filling the empty space in Byron's heart.

(Source: WebComics)

I come as soon as I hear you ring the bell, because I’m your most loyal dog...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

Cold and heartless meets sunshine and warmth. This is what it was like when Sheng Minou met Lu Feng. It was when abnormal met abnormal. If a monster can only love a monster, then I will become a monster. I wish to meet the beast hiding beneath painted skin, that when it breaks free from its binds, it will come at be with sharpened teeth and go straight for my neck. My delusion, my obsession. I thought I had done it perfectly, but he knew everything. The gull knows the fisherman's thoughts, it always dances but never lands.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Tseng Chyi, the most popular escort with a deep understanding of how to please his clients, has got his chance to succeed by approaching a young wealthy man with a bad temper. Thanks to him, friends become enemies, brothers turn against each other, and companies are falling apart... When this game of revenge is about to end with his absolute triumph, the truth suddenly revealed turns his whole world upside down...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

This is how it's supposed to play out: a young man with a difficult past drops into a game world with awesome powers and fights his way to the top while finding true love along the way... so how do you explain this? Why do I get stuck with the "Loser's System"? Is there some place where I can lodge a complaint about this?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Cute Wife at Home: Never Marry a Crafty Husband

description:
It's really out of luck for Ye Zixin to know Quan Hejun. The first time they met, he touched her breast by mistake. The second time, the rumors about them spread everywhere. The third time and the fourth time... Quan Hejun, let's make a bet, "the loser will warm the bed for the winner"! Wait, why do we share a bed? Probably because… it's more wonderful than we ever thought?

(Source: Webnovel)

When Gu Bao went bankrupt, he noticed the cold-hearted Big Bro Pei’s attitude had a 180-degree change but he seemed a little over enthusiastic… When Gu Bao had a girlfriend, only then Pei Ting realized he had slowly fallen in love with Gu Bao after befriending him… “Hey, did you not know that you were flirting with me all along? How could you simply call me Big Bro?”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Evil Young Master's Rules of Survival
title.native: 反派大少爷的求生法则

description:
When I was playing games in the cyber cafe, my soul was suddenly transported into the body of the duke's third son with the same name as me. Is God giving me a great responsibility or is this redemption of my fate? Neither! He’s just another typical little brat of a fodder with the title of a rich playboy… My instincts tell me that I should be doing something! If not, I’ll never survive past episode three! Even though I say that he’s a typical fodder, why does this little brat have such good luck with women? Maids, rich daughters, lolis, mature ladies, even… Cross-dressers. Gosh, why wasn’t my past life this fulfilling? The world is a big place, but I’ve only been nesting inside a cyber cafe my entire past life… In this life, I’ll go around this prosperous world (with the ladies)! I’ll survive even if I’m just some typical fodder!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The Leader of the Imperial Guard, Li Sheng, doesn't believe that "getting back together is torturous". So long as he does a good enough job, even an iceberg will into melt a puddle of water! It's a good thing that Martial Arts Master Lang is so handsome! This time, Li Sheng isn't running away! He's putting down roots and staying put! o(////▽////)o

[Ruthless Emotional Military Genius Dom x Idiotic Masochist Imperial Guard Sub]

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Chen Yuncheng's childhood experience was a nightmare. He didn't expect that sixteen years later, he'll encounter someone who experienced the same thing as him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: He Ni Zai Yiqi Cai Shi Quan Shijie
title.native: 和你在一起才是全世界

description:
The journey of a very sweet, fluffy, and warm couple! The author, Da Ning, wrote about the 10 years of her relationship with her lover, Lin Zhiyi, in a light, humorous way. The two fell in love at first sight on the university campus. Time and distance tested their relationship, but it only made their love stronger, as they built their life together with love. "No matter how big the world may be, the only view that matters to me, is you."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue

title.romaji: Kuaichuan Zhi Haohao Gaizao Chongxin Zuoren
title.native: 快穿之好好改造重新做人

description:
There are all kinds of jerks in the world, acting as jerks in their own way. Devious and cunning, they toy with people's emotions. True feelings have no value to them. Nothing else matters to these guys besides fame and fortune. The system raises his arms and cheers: A good reformation for them to become good men! Karma is always watching. When these jerks are given a chance to be reborn, they will start on a path of forced reformation.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Daizhe Xiuzhen Jie Xianzimen Tianxia Wudi
title.native: 带着修真界仙子们天下无敌

description:
I, the only one in the cultivation world to reach immortality, was trying to transcend the final calamity when I became reincarnated as a teenager? My cute childhood friend, the seductive little devil, and the cool swordmaster… why do all their souls bear my imprint? Which one to choose as my wife… Um, all of them, of course!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Jiang Wang was betrayed by his sworn brother Fang Pengju, who stole the Daoist Academy's reward of a Meridian Opening pill that he had earned with his blood and sweat. On the verge of death, he inherited the relics of Zuo Guanglie, the genius of the Chu Dynasty, opened his meridians and embarked on the path of cultivation. He was confused and hesitant, but he always held on to the light in his heart, which was a pure heart that remained true to its original intention.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After transmigrating, our protagonist gained god-level powers, so he was recruited by all sides, and he ended up as an N-sided agent?! Repeatedly jumping between the Daoist, demon, youkai, and dragon sects, all the while collecting harem members, he will become the most powerful man in the world!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Thrust into another dimension—a world of nothing but monsters and combat—he discovers a unique cheat: he can "borrow" the rewards of a battle before it's even won.

He can claim equipment, experience points, gold, and even a perfect Mirror Image of his foe in advance. The catch? He must defeat the original enemy to keep his spoils permanently.

His ultimate goal: to collect and cultivate a legion of these Mirrors, turning each one into a Grandmaster of its class. He can then "log in" to any of his creations, becoming a one-man army capable of fighting as a hundred.

In this world, sheep move in flocks. Tigers hunt alone!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After transmigration, time traveler Chen Yu found himself in a martial-domineering world, where he was deemed by “the will of the world” an illegal intruder and cursed with a state of reverse causality! While others ate to satisfy their hunger, Chen Yu suffered from starvation when he did. But wait, in this dog-eat-dog martial-domineering world, doesn’t it mean that taking a heavy blow can help him increase his Qi Energy and HP?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Moshi Citiao Cheng Shen

description:
In the desperate struggle for survival in a post-apocalyptic world, all humans awakened a special ability known as “lexicon.” Zhao Cheng, who has been searching for his adopted sister by hiding himself from place to place, finally awakens the world's only diamond-rank growable lexicon on the day he turns sixteen! However, the reality of the hardships in this world begins to unveil before his eyes... Will Zhao Cheng be able to grow stronger and find his sister?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Tianzi Dianxia Ni de Majia You Diaole
title.english: There Goes Your Cover Again, Your Highness
title.native: 太子殿下你的马甲又掉了

description:
While under the cover identity "Murong Yan," the crown prince became smitten with the palace guard, Gu Lang, after a fated encounter. The two had to part ways after "Murong Yan" died, but the crown prince couldn't resist trying to get close to his beloved once again... this time under a different cover identity.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When intern journalist Tang Nan was distressed by Yan Zheng's inexplicable disappearance, he unexpectedly discovered that Yan Zheng had transformed into his interviewee, Yan Zongguang, the CEO of a listed cosmetics company. However, when faced with Tang Nan's urgent questioning, Yan Zongguang remained extremely indifferent and considered Tang Nan to be a "fraud." Feeling deceived, Tang Nan decided to expose this CEO...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

50 years ago, a silk scroll that the tomb raiders from Changsha uncovered recorded the location of a unique tomb from the Warring States period. 50 years later, one of the tomb raiders’ grandson discovered this secret in his notes. He then assembled a party of experienced tomb raiders to go for a treasure hunt. But nobody had expected that so many strange things would happen in the ancient tomb. The Seven Stars Sarcophagus, the green-eyed corpse, the nine-headed snakes, and more. They discovered the owner of this mysterious tomb and found the real sarcophagus. This is a story filled with mysteries and a plot with twists and turns.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

His childhood friend was going to become a demon? And it's all because of his previous life? To save Bai Ye from her curse, Ye Yi will set out on a curse-breaking adventure. In the course of his travels, the truth of his past life will slowly emerge… This is a story that has conspiracies, monster-bashing, friendship, romance, and every other fantasy story element readers love, all blended into a hilarious adventure!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Sunny on the outside, but sly on the inside, the foxy Mo Xi tried every trick to seduce cute little Bai Jiu into becoming her special friend. But when Bai Jiu finally responded, Mo Xi turned blue with regret.

Bai Jiu: "We'll be best friends forever!"
Mo Xi: "…what friend!!! I don't want to be just friends!" QAQ

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Sha Shou Da Lao Zai Xian Yang Hu
title.english: A Professional Assassin Raises a Fox

description:
In a twist of fate, Yun Liushuang, the only survivor of the fox demon clan, meets Mo Sheng, the lone ranger. They’re constantly butting heads, but little do they know that fate has tied them to one another. This isn't a simple story about the romance between a beautiful reporter and an overbearing CEO. No, it's far more complicated than that. A family of Celestial Masters, assassins, and the fox clan’s curse are also involved. With so many forces at play, their feelings will be put through many hurdles. How far will love take them?

(Source: Webnovel)

Get to know the operators on Rhodes Island with Amiya and the Doctor.

(Source: Hypergryph, translated)

“I'll show you my prodigal ways!”

I’m Li JinLong, and I’ve just reincarnated from present-day China to the Ming Dynasty! Everyone here has reincarnated themselves, and it’s all to fight monsters and level up?! Here’s the thing. They all have powers, while all I have is me, myself, and my money. With competition this fierce, how am I supposed to rise through the ranks and become the best fighter in the Ming Dynasty??

(Source: Comikey)

He kissed his archenemy, thinking he'd die soon, but he was saved.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A rich little heiress runs away from home and meets a swordswoman in seclusion deep in the mountains. What sort of story will unfold between the two of them? (Probably a simple and sweet little love story)

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

‘The Other Family's Kid' and dreams buried deep in my heart.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Xiyu, who has risen from poverty, has a handsome face. As chance would have it, he becomes an idol star. But the reality, far from being glamorous, is not what it looks like on the stage. After going viral for the "assaulting fans" incident, Xiyu is attacked by netizens. Abandoned by his own management company, he goes back to school and lives a life of being cold-shouldered and even attacked by his classmates... Can he overcome these difficulties and make a comeback?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and one extra.

title.romaji: Jintian Ye Mei Bian Cheng Wanou ne
title.english: I Have Yet to Become a Doll Today

description:
It's about an infinite-flow survival game. When the world turns into a game map, humans become dolls continuously. Ding! Welcome to the Dolls' Game! The rules of the game are as follows: 1. One will become a doll if he refuses to play the game! 2. One will become a doll if he loses the game! 3. One will be rewarded with a doll if he clears the game! Check the comic and see how a smart scheming girl works with a strong handsome guy to clear the game vigorously!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: [Kuai Chuan] Hei Hua Fanpai Chong Shangtian
title.english: May the Best Man Win my Heart

description:
Yuriel, a system host who traverses various worlds to fulfill missions, is renowned for his unparalleled beauty. His object, however, is to capture the heart of a designated mission target in each world in order to ensure his own survival. Surprisingly, all of his targets—the domineering CEO, the distant straight-A student, and the scheming prince—turn out to be the same man...

(Source: WebComics)

Born into poverty, Boole fights to rise through the ranks of the personal guards for one sole purpose, and that is to be closer to the Saintess. However, in a series of events, he winds up being the royal family's pawn to to defeat the church. On one hand is the girl he has longed for since ages ago, but on the other is the omnipotent crown prince. Which will the young knight choose?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Those who have wet their feet in the underground society must pay back sooner or later. When a handsome mafia boss decides to become an elite bodyguard, the game of seduction and anti-seduction begins!

One sees humans as dirty animals, the other protects humans with his own life. Can these two people who meet change the world as they wish?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shi Xie Laogong: Cuo Jia Xinniang Xiuxiang Tao
title.native: 嗜血老公：错嫁新娘休想逃

description:
It is said he becomes a vampire on midnight with a full moon, sucking blood of women to survive. It is said he has married eight times with each one of his wives died or went crazy in less than a month. It is said he needs to suck young women's blood every day to survive. However, she is his ninth wife. Could she survive his strange game? After she met him on their wedding night, she found that what had been said in legends were not just legends.

(Source: Mangatoon)

The interviewee turned out to be her one-night-stand man, which drove Maple Xia crazy. She thought she could fake her way out, but was stopped by this man, 'You want to escape after all you have done? I am your responsibility now.' Oh please! I was the girl and I didn't say such thing, hadn't this guy no shame? However, now that you requested strongly, I had no choice but to obey.

(Source: WebComics)

On Valentine's day, Mandie was betrayed by her boyfriend who had been dating with her for three years. That's not the worst. What's the worst is that she met Benjamin. He approached her gently, and at last they were together. After they broke up, neither of them knew each other. Until one day, Mandie passed him by hand in hand with another man.
(Source: WebComics)

When I woke up after a thousand years, I realized that my compatriots were being treated as fodder by extraterrestrial demons. So I set out to slay the demons with my trusty battle companions: kitsune waifu, cutie alchemist, vampire princess, yin-yang master, sword-saint lady, hacker girl, cross-dressing bro, and cat-eared maid. But when I reached the Demon Queen, she told me that the Earth would be the dowry given to me for marrying her? Should I accept her offer and live an easy life, or should I lead the revolution to free Earth?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Yolan has loved Colten for 11 years. Every cell in her body feels inferior. When she decides to end this love and to separate him from her life, she finds that the separation is not only pain, but also takes her life...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan: Bing Jiao Nan Zhu Ta You Chicule
title.native: 快穿：病娇男主他又吃醋了

description:
Qu Yan is a well-known charming and “willful” beauty among the transmigration agents. She never failed a single mission. No matter how arrogant and unruly a man is, he will eventually turn obedient under her discipline.

The bossy president, "My dear, I’m sorry.”

The playboy, "Yan, I promise I will never even glance at other girls.”

The cruel villain, "Whoever dares to bully you will be killed by me!”

The emperor, “I share the country with you, and I will abolish my harem for you."

The bloodthirsty demon lord, “Be my wife, the world will be yours.”

(Source: MangaToon)

In the world of demons where humans are simply an old folklore...

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Mu Qingge never understood why she and her investor, Dong Fangyan, who spent 70 million to forcibly marry her, don't get along. Why does he pick on her and humiliate her so? With the return of her step-brother Huo Zhangling, the superstar Lu Linghan's kindness to her, and the sudden appearance of the Bai-clan siblings, a past sealed away is slowly being uncovered. What is the secret buried by time? And how will it affect all their lives?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In order to practice the art of seduction, the useless nine-tailed fox Tu Shanqing was thrown into the "Mirror Flower World" by his sister, and he could not leave until he passed the test. But who can tell him why in the world of "Legend of the White Snake", the gentle and beautiful white snake disappeared, and was replaced by a hard and fierce man!? And he tried to stab him without saying a word?

In order to return to the real world, Tu Shanqing has to bite the bullet. But why is the way the male protagonist looks at him more and more wrong!?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

As a behavior coach, Cheng Ran is good at finding human weaknesses to guide other people's behavior. He thinks he knows people's hearts very well: "The reward I want is... to kill you." Cheng Ran knelt on the ground, his hands and chin resting on Han Qi's knees, looking up at Han Qi's eyes like a puppy. "Start a fire, I will hold your body and burn it to ashes along with this house. Our ashes and the ashes of this world will be mixed together and can no longer be distinguished." Cheng Ran was confident that what he said at this moment was the love words that Han Qi wanted to hear the most. Han Qi was really stunned. "You can't burn a person to ashes by burning a house."

Han Qi stroked Cheng Ran's head with his hand, like comforting a puppy. After thinking for a while, he slowly said: "Put the body in the incinerator and burn it at a high temperature of 1000° for one hour, then use a hammer to break the calcified bones, and finally grind it finely to become ashes." Cheng Ran was surprised at Han Qi's understanding of the incineration process, and even more surprised that his thinking direction seemed to deviate from expectations. "Okay."

Han Qi looked into Cheng Ran's eyes seriously. Okay? ! Cheng Ran was shocked. What's good? I was just talking nonsense! I didn't really ask you to do it! Cheng Ran thought he was using the physical game to open the other person's heart, but he didn't expect that the other person was willing to accompany him into this taboo game.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Gaomen Zhumu Chuan Cheng Haomen Nüpei
title.native: 高门主母穿成豪门女配

description:
Gu Xueyi was born into a military family who became the matron of the prosperous Sheng clan, overseeing more than 400 family members. But when she woke up one day, she found herself transmigrated into a novel as the wife of the male lead, who was about to divorce her and doomed to die young. Seeing her husband Yan Chao's crooked siblings made Gu Xueyi seethe. She didn't care whether her husband wanted to divorce or not. The most important thing was to make something out of these useless family members!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A story about two young demons who are always slacking off at work, a place that happens to be an organization that vows to keep the balance between the worlds of the living and dead by killing humans! Vol 1&2 contain a small short story about a robot with a mission to 'save humans.'

title.romaji: Gang Tuihun, Jiu Bei Nai Xiong Huli Guai Jin  Minzhengju
title.native: 刚退婚，就被奶凶狐狸拐进民政局

description:
Luciella Sullivan finds herself trapped in an arranged marriage to Silas Chase, the powerful Ninth Prince of the genetically superior Beastkin royal family on Planet Alpha. Though the union was orchestrated by Luciella's scheming sister, not her own wishes, Silas refuses to let his alluring wife abandon him. As Luciella battles for her freedom, she uncovers dangerous undercurrents in this advanced alien society. Navigating court intrigue and her own complex feelings, Luciella must decide how far she'll go to control her destiny on Alpha, where ancient dynasties and advanced technology collide.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

What was supposed to be a video game world filled with monsters and magical beings suddenly came true.
A huge tree more than ten thousand meters tall appeared near the beach with a portal inside its truck that churned out an endless horde of monsters and foul beings!

That was how the Great Calamity came to be.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Shou Shi Nüwang Jintian Fan Paizi Le Ma
title.english: Be the Queen in the Beast World
title.native: 兽世女王今天翻牌子了吗

description:
As the heir to a beast kingdom, Ayres fell in love with her childhood friend Aunrae, a half-beast. One day, her parents arranged a spouse selection meeting for her. Ayres eagerly anticipated Aunrae's arrival to propose marriage. But little did she know, behind the bouquet presented by the man she loved, lay a violent blood feud... Caught between love and hatred, how would they make their choice?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chengba Fei Tu: Wo Zai Moshi Zhizhang Xian Men
title.native: 称霸废土：我在末世执掌仙门

description:
Craft celestial-grade treasures from apocalyptic scraps, and roam the wastelands of the end times using immortal cultivation techniques. With a soul traversing two realms, truth and illusion blur… In the realm of the void, a frenzied path of cultivation begins!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Xiaozao is a girl who always brings misfortune to others. She has to move into a temple named God of Mountains Temple where lives a real god of mountains. Xiaozao met the god when she was a young girl and it seems it’s the god who cursed her. But, later on, they fall in love with each other! And their love story began much earlier than they thought?

(Source: Mangatoon, edited)

An Ultimate Showdown Between an Introvert and an Extrovert.

Ai Xu, a designer of trendy toys, suffers from extreme social anxiety and despises socializing and teamwork. Once she became an adult, she did her best to find a job where 90% of the time, she only has to be accountable to herself. However, there is one drawback to being a designer for original IP: She still has to attend and speak at a weekly team meeting. Thankfully, she could simply play a presentation without saying much. Today, however, she was paired with the beautiful and dazzling extrovert Zhiyi from marketing to work as partners on a project.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Lin Xianting manages a struggling restaurant and lives a mundane life without any grand dreams. However, his life takes a turn as he gets entangled in a war between gods and demons, resulting in him becoming a non-human, non-demonic entity. Human food can no longer sustain his existence, and the only food that he can consume is those processed with peculiar ingredients infused with spiritual energy...

(Source: WebComics)

One is a policeman who suddenly opens Yin-yang eyes (eyes that can see ghosts which ordinary people can't see). The other is a pet shop owner who is born into a spiritual family but is powerless. The two unexpectedly involve in a monster rampage incident and their cooperation is noticed by the the special affairs section. Since then, the two start their fantastic career of monster hunting.

(Source: WebComics)

One day, zombies spread to every corner of the world. The living are unsure whether to be lucky or unlucky, whether to become accomplices to the zombies, or to strive for survival but ultimately become food. What should they do?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

"Hey, if you're not here to fight, spare us the time and yield!"

Wu Yuan is often ridiculed by his colleagues for not being a very talented cultivator. One day, he gets stabbed in the back by an unknown enemy. When he opened his eyes again, he's traveled ten years in the past. In order to avoid the mistakes he once made, Wu Yuan goes through trials to finally attain immortality and become a talented cultivator. But he fails a second time! Luckily he's got one last chance. Will third time finally be the charm?

(Source: Comikey)

title.romaji: Nüe Wen Nü Zhu Juexing Hou
title.english: Reborn to Choose My Own Male Lead

description:
If anyone wants to play heroine in this love story, be my guest—I’m over the sadistic male lead and his games! But with one problem solved, another always pops up. For example: this obsessive new guy who wasn’t in the original novel. Why won’t he leave me alone? Can’t he see I’m trying to find a new love interest?

(Source: Tapas)

Shen Qingshuang is a “Guanyin” from a distinguished family, yet a caged beast in seclusion; Mu Yunzhao is a “Rakshasa” from a military lineage, yet a lone wolf in the capital. She despises the Rakshasa for defying orthodoxy, she loathes the Guanyin for her haughty rigidity. Yet unbeknownst to her, the Guanyin dreams only of tearing off her robes, burning her precepts, and plunging into the abyss with her; the Rakshasa harbors a heart set on weaving a net, bewitching sacred chants, and clinging to her until death. Will the Guanyin subdue the demon, or will the demon subdue the Guanyin? The answer lies hidden in that springtime first encounter—the Rakshasa holding the reins, the Guanyin's strings in disarray...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Pian Wo Lai Shi Qia Feng Chun

description:
To lure her widowed sister-in-law into depravity, Song Zhimei resorted to every unscrupulous tactic imaginable. One night, she stumbled into her sister-in-law's secret chamber. Within lay two rooms: one locked away her long-lost elder brother, the other a golden cage filled with her sister-in-law's treasured possessions. The usually fragile woman now blocked her path, chains in hand... Who, truly, was the prey?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Fun facts you probably didn’t know!

(Source: Hypergryph, translated)

Jiao Xifan, the group's leader, was betrayed. He turned the tables, using his own “death” to pose as a student seeking the truth from over a decade ago. He befriended “poor little thing” Xue Zhi, unaware that from the moment he became Xue Zhi's friend, he had fallen into this person's trap...

(Source: IQIYI, translated)

title.romaji: Weile Mei Shaonu Youxi, Nüzhuang Yeshi Buke Bimian De
title.native: 为了美少女游戏，女装也是不可避免的

description:
Aspiring to be the ultimate Pokémon trainer and butter-making master, Baiji was determined to create an outstanding butter masterpiece for her graduation project. However, she didn't expect to clash with the illustrator Sharky right from the start. As she was about to finish the character design phase and advance to the master level of game development, she encountered a classmate, Sanchuan, who perfectly embodied her ideal character. But bigger trouble followed—Sanchuan turned out to be...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Around the 17th century, Wu San Gui overthrown the Mu Wang Palace with the help of a mysterious person, allowing them to do whatever they please to in Yun Nan, the Mu Wang Palace who had hidden in seclusion was massacred, and a simple youth named Jing Xiu Ming became the only survivor after being saved by the disciple of the Yunyou divine doctor named Ling Le Sui, but was infected with an illness that causes people to go berserk. In order to find the killer who killed his entire village and cure his illness, Jing Xiu Ming and Yunyou divine doctor's disciple set off for a journey.

A cat demon with a split personality is reincarnated with the memories of her past life. She wishes revenge on her lover from her past life, but upon meeting him finds herself falling all over for him again. What should she do?! A female main character with no sense of moral principles, between an arrogant, abstinent man and the charming, indifferent demon king, who will she choose!

On Beloved ex's wedding, ex's brother falls in love with her at first sight... "Fate is such a naughty boy" she said, "Why couldn't I deserve a normal romance?"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Chuanyue Zhi Hu Wang De Zhuan Chong
title.english: Back in Time: The Fox King's Sole Affection

description:
She, who was once an ordinary girl, now only wants to cultivate herself and return to the earth as soon as possible. What troubles her most is that her identity is the consort of Fox King in this world. A really clingy one. Wherever she goes, he follows. What is the wrong with his persistence? For love, let's see what can a thousand years fox king do.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jicheng Zhe Jiadao: Xiao Cao, Nao Gou Mei!
title.english: The Heir is Here: Quiet Down, School Prince!
title.native: 继承者驾到：校草，闹够没！

description:
An Xiaxia is a true anti-fan, and she loves spending her time slandering Sheng Yize! Slandering Sheng Yize! Slandering Sheng Yize! Slandering Sheng Yize! But one day, this national idol becomes her classmate... and even moves into her home...

(Source: Web Novel)
After 8 years, Yi Xiao Xiao wants to divorce from Yang Sheng because he cheated on her.

A nuclear crisis dubbed as "Hellfire Blaze", that nearly pushed mankind to the brink of extinction. A group of elites' research gave results to a tree sapling that can absorb radiation, under the protection of the "shade", mankind started to revive civilization, giving birth to a cunning yet interesting New World of Murim.

This is a past that he thought that both of them didn't want to mention. But when Lin saw his childhood friend Yin, all comes to his mind. Will he forgive me or want me get lost?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Feiyue Qian Shan Lai Ai Ni

description:
I was the last swan to take human form. Once I peeped out of the lake and a ring was thrown in front of me. For this ring, I met a shemale! After I figured out who the shemale really was, he taught me, and somehow became my 100th girlfriend!

(Source: WebComics)

Everyone has a childhood dream of martial arts, leaping across rooftops, controlling Internal energy, and being immune to all poisons. Is it just a fictional legend, or is it true? This story will take you into the modern world of martial arts.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: My Life as the Retired Hero

description:
On the year I arrived on this continent, I ascended as the Sword Saint at 20 thanks to my unparalleled talent and extraordinary opportunities... Eh? Am I the protagonist? You've got it all wrong—look over there. Yes, that blonde narcissist is this story's real protagonist... Demon Lord? She pulled out at the start. As for a harem... Do you think a character like me has that sort of interest?! Ahem! Anyway, this is the tale of a disenchanted and unambitious Sword Saint...

(Source: Coolmic)

In the 21st century, Ye Kong, a young man on the earth, accidentally travels to a world of cultivation where killing, snatching, and law of the jungle prevails, with the help of the body of a poor youth, he is reborn and gets acquainted with various characters. Under the guidance of a unique and rare book, Ye Kong embarks on a new and interesting journey of immortality cultivation.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zai Xuanhuan Shijie Bianchengle Yi Ke Cao?
title.native: 在玄幻世界变成了一棵草？

description: Our Main Character was transported into a Fantasy Game World but in the same time, he was also turned into a grass.

Ye Chen, a lowly outer circle disciple of the Ye clan, had never accomplished anything in his life. But one day, fate bestowed upon him twelve ancient symbols. Each symbol, once activated, provided him with a mysterious power and an ancient martial art skill. From then on, the former good-for-nothing began his journey to become number one in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: He Nüshen Heti Hou De Wo Wudi le
title.english: I Become Invincible after She Saves Me
title.native: 和女神合体后的我无敌了

description:
In 2514 of the New Era, the apocalypse came. A world-class phenomenon appeared. Many strong mutated beasts have been wandering around the world since then. Humans are under deadly threats. They can only struggle for life. The one who will save everybody and protect the world from collapsing is... an average-looking barber from the slum?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Feisheng Shibai, Zhihao Zuo Lie Mo Renle
title.english: Failed to Ascend, So I Became a Witcher Instead
title.native: 飞升失败，只好做猎魔人了

description:
Qiu Qian, a brilliant cultivator, failed in his ascension and space-traveled into a fantasy world of witchers. Out of curiosity, he decides to become a witcher and exterminate the monsters. His immense power attracts the attention of numerous females of this alternate realm, including she-elves, sorceresses, and dancers, all of whom wish to become his companions...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo! Tianming Fanpai Bei Chengle Zhengdao Lao Zu
title.english: I, The Destined Villain, Will Become the Righteous Patriarch
title.native: 我！天命反派摆成了正道老祖

description: Zhang Yuan, who died overworking from 9am to 9pm 6 days a week, entered the mental system he created — the strongest villain system in history. He became the strongest villain — the demon lord. Zhang Yuan could totally destroy all the humans in that world with one finger and complete his mission, but he doesn’t want to! He wants to enjoy retirement life in this system! When the slackest MC meets the most hardworking system, they go against common sense! Think outside the box! Enjoy the apex of life! Get everything he wants!

title.romaji: Juese Shi Shuimu De Wo Yiran Chao Shen
title.native: 角色是水母的我依然超神

description: In the virtual online game, the race is forced to be the protagonist of the inferior "stinging jellyfish", and through the fairy operation, he becomes the first in the whole server and changes the legendary experience of real life.

title.romaji: Yinwei Nimen Tai Ruo Wo Jintian Ye Sibuliao
title.native: 因为你们太弱我今天也死不了

description:
Liszt, a programmer of the game "Miracle," agreed to entered the game world to play the role of the final boss "Dark Lord," to help cure his mother's illness. The contract agreement stated Liszt must stay in the game world until he was defeated by the players. But the the stats of the Dark Lord were too high, and what was suppose to be an easy fight to beat Lizst became a reverse slaughter for him instead. He slowly realized that if he wanted to be successfully defeated and return to the real world, he'll have to try some different strategies…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shenjing Wulin Zhi Gai Shi Wu Shuang
title.english: The Insane Martial Arts World: Second to None

description:
The quinquennial opening of the Heaven's Will Pagoda is upon us. A mysterious letter stirs the quietude of the martial world. Martial artists that had been in seclusion—Wei Ge (The Blind Hero), Zhen Jian (The Sword of Demise), Dan Teng (The One-Armed Swordsman), Murong Yue (The Fatal Demon), Liu Qian’er (The Gold Meowling King)—are on the move. With more and more martial arts experts rising to the challenge, the entire martial world is about to plunge into bloodshed. Regardless of the imperial court, or the cult, or factions of the martial arts world, all of them only have one goal: To take control of the Black Tortoise Order and find the treasure hidden in the Secret Realm of the Black Tortoise.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In the Xuanjian Continent, swordsmanship is prized above all, powerful swordsman roamed the earth, and stories abound about legendary cultivators... Today, the continent's swordsmen weren't as glamorous as in the past, but sword cultivation was still widely practiced. One day, a cultivation prodigy accidentally triggered the Sword Forge System. The Sword Forge allowed him to access countless legendary swords of past and present. With his first legendary weapon in hand, the young man was on his way towards piercing a path to immortality...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Shouldering the mission of mastering his own destiny and following in the footsteps of the elder generation, he, sword in hand, is standing up and showing courage in adversity, bringing out the best in him and embarking on the road to success!

(Source: WeComics)

Gu Cheng transmigrated into a world of cultivation and became the eldest son of the Grand General Hou's household. To escape his aunt's assassination attempts, he left the imperial capital to join the Night Watch, in charge of dealing with supernatural phenomena. It is a world full of treachery, filled with monsters and spirits, with a corrupt government dealing with with unrest. Gu Cheng proved his strength and became known as The Great Saint.

"I am Gu Cheng. If this world doesn't have religion or gods, then I will become a god!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Qingshang Fushu De Tezhongbing Zhi Wang Chongsheng Xiaoyuan Hou Que Yiwai Shou Nüsheng Huanying?!
title.english: The Special Agent With Negative EQ Reincarnated as a Student and Became Popular With the Ladies?!
title.native: 情商负数的特种兵之王重生校园后却意外受女生欢迎?!

description:
When special agent Wang Gucheng was taking revenge for his best friend’s wife and daughter, he was killed by a mysterious power. However, he somehow reincarnated one year in the past and became his best friend’s dead daughter’s fellow student? With his negative EQ, how will he survive in school and protect his best friend’s wife and daughter?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A sliver of remnant soul snuck through the fingertips, and thus Li Tianqing began the journey of recovering glory for the Li clan!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Mo Shi You Zuo Huang Jin Gong

description:
I woke up from a coma only to find myself being overrun zombies in a post-apocalyptic world! And that lady is just watching it happen, how cruel is that! Who'd want to stay in this damn place, if it weren't for all the treasures scattered around! I've gotta stay alive, I'm still a virgin! Gold, girls, all mine!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The legendary Beidou swordsman Xiao Chen was betrayed and murdered by his disciple, but he was reborn on modern Earth! Now in this life, Xiao Beidou will cut through all the liars and enemies with one swing of his sword!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Battle soul - a soul that carries great power. Only those who possess a battle soul can use ancient martial arts that have destructive techniques. The Warring States Martial Academy is a mysterious school founded over a thousand years ago for the purpose of receiving and punishing people with battle souls. The protagonist was sent to the Warring States Martial Academy by his parents without any knowledge of the place. What he saw and discovered in the school completely changed his concept of the world and of martial arts. The Warring States Martial Academy has the right to decide the life and death of the martial artists who possess battle souls. Who decides if what the academy does is true justice? In the modern society, are the powerful ancient martial arts a boon or bane for mankind? Please look forward to the development of the story!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Shou Hun Zhe: Gui Han Zhua Gui

description:
Strange occurrences in an institute of higher learning, along with ghost generals of the four dharma seals itching to make a move. The legend of the soul hunting world has only just begun... This is the prequel of Thriller Campus, the maiden work of Santian Liangjiao, one of Qidian's celebrated authors.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Nage Jiaozhu, Chong Chu Jianghu Le!
title.english: The Return of the Sect Leader

description:
Tang Ke, the former leader of the Demonic Sect, had left the martial arts world ever since his cultivation went astray. But he was forced to return when his son went missing. Forgotten by others over the years, working as a poor writer after failing the Imperial Exams, he will slowly grow into the one that was once feared by all... the demon king! "Tell those who respected me, feared me, dreaded me, that the sect leader is back!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhou Xuanji barely escaped death and awakened the system of legendary swords, the system that he had developed as a game designer in his previous life. The legendary swords he receives from the system can transform into beautiful sword-girls! With his harem of sword-girls, Zhou Xuanji set out to avenge his mother...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Hao Ren, an ordinary landlord, had a werewolf and a vampire girl living in his house. He got dragged into a mysterious organization by a crazy goddess to save alien creatures. Surprisingly, everything seemed to have been arranged ten thousand years ago, and the goddess who could solve all this was busy getting her year-end bonus...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Zu An is your typical flame-war keyboard warrior. But then he was transmigrated into a world of cultivation, where political power is tied to the cultivation level of the temples and dojos. The Emperor of the Dazhou Kingdom is himself one of the most powerful cultivators in the world. Zu An migrated into the body of the despised husband of the princess Chu Chuyan. His reputation was irrevocably ruined when he was found sleeping with his wife's sister on his wedding night. But actually his whole marriage was part of a conspiracy, and the seemingly irrelevant son-in-law was the key piece in the imperial intrigue. See how Zu An will navigate the dangers and come out ahead, with the help of his keyboard!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Xiong Tai Kanjian Wo Di Le Ma

description:
The martial arts master Chu Wenshan has lost his memories, but the only clue to finding out about himself is a threatening letter… Huh? My brother was kidnapped? Wait, who’s my brother? No, even if I don’t know, I have to rescue him. Excuse me my friend, have you seen my brother?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Bei Zhaohuan Chengwei Yiji Mowu De Wo, Yiran Hai Yao Zuo Zhongyi
title.english: Despite Being Summoned as a Demon, I Still Need to Practice Chinese Medicine
title.native: 被召唤成为一级魔物的我，依然还要做中医

description:
The 30-year deadline was up. Huang He, who could have easily inherited 10 billion yuan, married someone rich and beautiful, and walked to the peak of his life, ended up transmigrating into the game and became a level 1 little zombie… In his despair, Huang He learned that as long as he died, he would be able to transmigrate back to his original world. Thus, he began his path of seeking death. But little did he know that wanting to die was not that simple…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The story tells of our male protagonist Xia Tian who just turned 19 years old. Suddenly, he found himself on a strange road and barely escaped from a truck that almost killed him. Then he was picked up by a luxury car on the way to Jianghai City, all whilst not remembering anything except the name Qiao Xiaoqiao...

The elite special commander Tang Ke was assigned a new task to go to a building full of felons, and he had to "persuade" these criminals on his own. How can this be... Fortunately, when I entered the door, I met a loli...

In this world exists demon spirits, river deities, and cultivators who seek for eternal youth. Through their mystic eye, cultivators can sense these supernatural beings. They cultivate their flying swords to slay enemies from thousands of miles away. With abilities attained through refinement, the second young master of the Qin manor, "Qin Yun" is one of those cultivators.

title.romaji: Tianyuan Mi Chong: Nongjia Xiao Niangzi Huolala
title.english: Young Hot Lady From The Village
title.native: 田园蜜宠：农家小娘子火辣辣

description:
When waking up, not only had she travelled to the villiage in the olden days, but she had also earned four exquisite potential husbands... Liu Duo, who thought it...it was so hard for her to make a choice!

(Source: Web Novel)

title.english: Love in Fallen City: Forbidden Royal

description:
On that night, she lost her purity as an innocent woman and turned into the most desolate being in the cold palace. What she asks for is only a simple, normal life but she is instead forced to fight to survive in the imperial palace, which is filled with intrigue, tricks between concubines, and competition for power and status...Is this the beginning of a love story or a tragedy which began the day they met?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chuan Tang Jing Lue Pipa Sheng
title.english: The Flustering Sound of the Pipa from the Hallway

description:
He has experienced disappointment and betrayal, walking a path that shows the world at its most undisguised. Yet he keeps a young heart—sincere, frank, and true to his feelings.He says, "This is beyond my control. If my blood is spilled, there will be someone else to succeed me."That day in the lofty teahouse, the sound of the pipa pierced through the hall, like the swift stirrings of love strumming heartstrings.One full of anticipation, the other in love at first sight.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Speeding and drifting at 200 miles/ hour, heart beating twice as fast as usual… Don’t try to escape you old driver, as the sexy cop is trying to catch you from behind! Follow the traffic rules and law, and drive reasonably! Racing is strictly prohibited…

(Source: WeComics)

title.romaji: Bao Jin Wo de Xiaolong Nü

description:
The sudden appearance of the raccoon man, the strange death of grandma and the mysterious fortune telling house... All of these show that something unexpectedly has happened in this town. Why did grandma passed the fortune telling house to Silver Baen? Is the girl with the horn on her head trustable? The gear named Fate is starting running. How many secrets are still behind this house...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zai Aiqing Sha Si Wo Zhiqian

description: Being reborn ten years later, my childhood friends have become a ruthless businessman, a son of a rich family, and a superstar respectively. What is even more ridiculous is that I seem to be their first love from years ago?

Chen Xiyan, a girl from the 21st century, travels in space to another world which is full of wars. The tyrant Yu Chenhua forced her and imprisoned her, which, however, couldn’t cover her brilliance. A rare Goddess as she is, she can’t feel his love for her. The love and hatred between two people from different countries and spaces thus begins...

(Source: Webcomics)

Little Princess, who has become a king? Is the world patriarchal? The minister can execute the grand princess of a country at will? So, in order to survive, she can only please the king and the naughty brother? No, Babyqueen is not willing! Not only does she not want to please these men, she also wants to compete for the throne as a queen! And in the presence of thousands of ministers scolded her king father as shit! Strangely, after the scolding, everyone seems to be looking at me!

It's not unusual to meet a handsome man when betrayed by a lover as the beginning of a love story. It's not uncommon to start a relationship because of a necklace either. However, the combination of the two situations and being forced to give her own necklace really makes our heroin confused. Let alone the man she met has such a bad character. So why do good-looking guys always have bad personalities?

(Source: Webcomics)

Lin Chen was betrayed and his martial arts were crippled however, he had unexpectedly made a fateful encounter with the sacred engulfing star map, which led to the awakening of the Holy Vein constitution, and reaching the pinnacle of cultivation!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

A miserable female lead meets a notable bossy male lead. She is ill-fated and constantly bullied and framed by others, even to an extent that she loses her father... Until she encounters him on a rainy night. Is it a fortuity or a destined reunion?

(Source: Webcomics)

CEO Liam Bian is young, brash, and charismatic. He knows what he wants, and he’ll take it, even if it means rolling up his sleeves and bloodying his knuckles. But he meets his match in Miles Han, the steely heir to a conglomerate that’s out to destroy Liam’s own budding empire. When Liam confronts Miles with a baseball bat, it’s fuel that turns their rivalry into an inferno, sparking an attraction that burns red hot. Now they’ll do anything in business—and in the bedroom—to take the other down.

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Ti Jia Xinniang De Gonglüe Jihua

description:
June Qin was forced to marry an idiot on her cousin's behalf in order to help her aunt repay an enormous debt. Who would've thought the idiot's older brother would be the one to appear at the wedding ceremony. He was the third generation heir to the Zong Family, Michael Zong. "You're finally in my hands, I won't let you go." Michael Zong forcibly married his younger brother's fiancee in order to take revenge against the humiliation he faced when he was a kid. Who will be the first to fall in this mismatched marriage, and how will this preposterous beginning come to a satisfactory end?!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: My Mr. Right is a Zombie

description:
Being a prince who died fighting on the battlefield a thousand years ago, he woke up in modern times and encountered his former imperial concubine to whom he’s indebted. He thought he could make up for regrets in this life, but a fake concubine appeared. This time, will the tragedy go on, or will he find the real her?

(Source: Webcomics)

I was just an ordinary skeleton, up until the day I crossed paths with a flat-chested sorceress and a hellhound. Since that fateful day, my life as a skeleton began to change...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

He Xiao, an apprentice in a merchant shop, buys fox fur for the owner, but a fox demon falls on him and insists on being his wife... Under the tutelage of the fox demon, Fu Qing, He xiao aspires to become a a wealthy businessman in the human and demon world. He is forced to go on an exciting journey to discover the truth about demon hunting.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

"I was the moon that couldn't shine, and he was my sun." "Others think that I saved him, yet he was also the one who fully healed me."

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

She thought she was being chased after by two men, one selfishly cold-hearted and another beautifully doting. Intertwined with their love, who will become her lover? The decision is difficult… a child would pick one, but an adult would want both… Under the protection of her “two” lovers, will she be able to overturn her fate as a marriage replacement and suppress the slegs…?

(Source: WeComics)

Penny-pinching, poor college student, Qian Buduo accidentally gains access to the Money Talks system, leaving him with more money than he can spend. But the money can only be used to complete the messy tasks given by the system. If he completes the mission, he can get nothing or special rewards, and if he fail, he will be ravaged by the system!

(Source: WebComics)

Lin Tian, a college loser, lives in poverty. After he happened to help the weak who were bullied by local vulgar rich people, he accidentally acquired a system and lived a "painful" life of being forced to spend money. Since then, he has been forced to spend money every day and is always distressed that he cannot spend all his money. "Alas, there is still a hundred million left to spend, and I will be punished again. Hopefully they will go easy on me this time!" Lin Tian shook his head and looked depressed. "Damn, look at he, he began to show off again. Can't spend all your money? Just give it to us, and we will help you!" The inner voice of everyone...

(Source: WebComics)

Chu Mujin's older brother ran away with the president's fiancee, the heiress Lu Mingyue. She wasn't able to escape and she was captured by Lu Minyue's fiance Lin Chengyao. Thus began her miserable 99-day life as a contractual lover. Chu Mujin was caught between the autocratic bully Lin Chengyao, and the seemingly kind Gu Tingzhi, and then she found herself pregnant with child...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

He was hit by a bolt of lightning and time-traveled back to thousands of years ago. What he didn’t expect was, someone had already waited for him for decades... His arrival brought big changes to so many people’s fates. That young boy who had been waiting for him for years also got the chance to meet him, know him, and fall in love with him. However, hiding behind their romance is the redemption of the older generation...

(Source: Webnovel)

To look for his younger sister who disappeared mysteriously, racer Jerry Han went to the famous J Club and accidentally found a murky industry behind the normal operation of a night club - a “Night of Girls Group”, which served the elite society exclusively. He met a mysterious man Alan Liu, who disguised in female attire with ambigous characters. Can the two of them find out the secret of the club? Who is the mastermind behind all this?

(Source: Webnovel)

In the year of 2013, the tide of zombies outbreak exploded in everyone homeland, humanity launches a large-scale battle in the endless nights awaiting for the arrival of the dawn.

The end is approaching, is there going to be a way out for them?

Their faiths were shattered into pieces and buried in ashes in the raging fire.

But within the blazing fire, a newborn hope arise once again.

The coward You Qi was always following the hot-temper Zhou Zheng around. It’s quite annoying for Zhou Zheng to see him being so weak, but he just couldn’t leave him alone. One is a blunt and proud superstar; another is a timid and persistent support-role. When will they finally admit their true feelings for each other?

(Source: Webnovel)

In bustling, cosmopolitan city of old Shanghai, there was an assassination organization named Shades. The assassins in Shades were all women, and their victims had invariably fallen into wretched souls. The woman who led this mysterious organization in the dark came from the shadows with no name. Once upon a time she believed in destiny, now she does not. If the God was unjust, she would be the God, to punish those who ruined everything in her life!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes eight bonus chapters.

Li Fei, who had to find "work" because his mother was seriously ill, somehow caught the eye of a rich big-boss. Not only did he have to help the boss-man with work, but also to accompany him to dine and entertain? Li Fei thought he was just a mean boss who liked to tease, and he found it hard to handle, even as he was charmed by the man. But then Li Fei discovered that his boss was actually the Devil himself...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Due to the huge debt of her family, the new nurse Xiaoguo Li had no choice but to chose Jia Yu Hospital where the salary was relatively high. Bad things such as being pressed for payment of debt, mobile phone being robbed, salary being deducted, and dereliction of duty happened one after another on her first few days of work. The moment when she decided to sell her blood impulsively, a special patient who had the same blood type with her appeared, and a blood relationship thus came into being between two of them.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Destined to Meet on the Trends

description:
Top Actor Lu who was knee-deep in bad press was suddenly revealed to be seeing an unknown minor star. This sent shockwaves throughout the entertainment world and thus begin an annual retainer to stay on the hot search charts... As the manager said, "This is an agreement for 3 years! You're not allowed to fall for each other for real!" Three years later, the top actor announces, "Thanks everybody, we're celebrating our third anniversary."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A traffic accident caused two unrelated souls to be bound spiritually. Many years later, the victim, Feng Yi, and the assailant, Chu Jiangye, swapped identities. Can they forgive each other’s mistakes and create a brighter future together…?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A contract with a sky-high price attached to it... I was forced by my own sister into my brother-in-law’s bed to ‘become’ his bride. Sometimes, he treats me like a hungry wolf who cannot get his fill of me. At other times, he is so sweet and tender that I feel as though all my hardships are behind me and only good days are to come. Unfortunately, it was just another nightmare! I did everything I could to escape while the seed within my womb grew slowly. Seven years later, I returned to get my revenge…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Qiuyi is the star of her college boxing club and guys tend to gravitate towards her… but for all the wrong reasons. She’s seen as a fierce fighter, a tomboy, and a “bro,” yet all she wants is a chance at a tender-loving relationship! Feeling doomed to be single, she wins a free trial for a mysterious dating game app. With round after round of romantic encounters, Qiuyi’s set on knocking out the in-game objectives—but why does she keep on running into the most popular guy in school?!

(Source, Tapas)

A century ago, in a continent far, far away, an ancient kingdom, Laham, was destroyed. During the war, Zeluo died in a foreign land, his body reduced to dust and bone. But one day, Zeluo was reborn by a mysterious power. Reborn without any memories or emotions, he was driven by the hallucinations and voices in his head that urged him to return to his homeland, Laham. In order to find himself and his home, Zeluo embarked on the long and treacherous journey without any hesitation...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Lin Jia Didi Tai Nan Guan La

description:
The boy next door was as cute as an angel when he was a child, but after returning to his hometown after many years, he's not that cute little boy anymore. The gentle older boy Lan Tian tries his best to keep his "rebellious" childhood friend Bai Yun in line. What he doesn't know was that Bai Yun just wants to tell him: "You treat me like a little brother, but I don't want you to just be a brother!"

Can the long-time unrequited crush finally blossom?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 4 extras.

New and budding actor, Yu Nian, never imagined that his idol, the top actor in the industry, would one day walk down the red carpet with him. This single event then stirs the scandal of the century. However, that's not all. Yu Nian finds out an even more baffling secret. A-list actor, Xie Youjun, turns into a wolf during a full moon. Besides that, this stunning star even ends up biting him and tells him that he has the smell of an Omega. Out of the blue, Yu Nian finds himself taking a step into the mysterious Omegaverse.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Once a rising star with a brilliant future, his life crumbled the day he caught that man's eye. Now, he's a captive lover, walking on eggshells, with his dreams shattered. All he wants is revenge to make sure his captor never finds peace. A dark story of love and vengeance unfolds…

(Source: WebComics)

Others have an awesome reincarnation such as becoming a king or war general. But me? Why was I reincarnated as a treacherous prime minister that brings calamity to the people and betrays their country?! It’s terrifying you know, seeing how heads roll because of what the king said!

“Is there anything you’re dissatisfied with?” said the king with a pursed smile.
Trembling He Lanzi replied, “No your majesty, this prime minister wouldn't dare.”
“You’re acting distant like this, because you actually want me to...”
“No your majesty, please don’t !“

Blackhearted Younger Emperor X Beautiful Scholarly Tyrant Prime Minister.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Shao Yiyou and Shao Yiliang met purely by accident in a sports event, and they look exactly alike. To repay Yiyou, Yiliang finds himself posing as the other as his replacement in a competition. In an elaborate plan to trick everyone, will Shao Yiliang be able to pull off posing as Shao Yiyou?

(Source: INKR)

Goran had already reached the state of zero emotions and was bored of his world of martial arts. Will he be able to find what he is seeking for in this new peculiar world?

(Source: Toomics)
