title.english: This Song is Only For You

description:
There are hidden truths, lying beneath all the limelight and glory. That day, a Rockstar and a surgeon met each other.

This is a story about abandoning their facades, restoring the truth, and becoming each other’s saving grace.

“Will you hold on to me even if darkness befalls upon us?”

They never loved someone as deeply as each other. She was willing to descend into hell with him, while he was willing to put down his bloodied knife for her.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

She was deceived into entering the wealthy devil's den. Her days of misery begun as she lost her freedom and was forced to be the personal maid of the devilish president. Struggling through the days in a luxurious manor where evil lurked in every corner, she gathered her wits and courage as she tried her best to stick up for herself. For the sake of her family and the boy she liked, she had to swallow her anger and tolerate the ingenious tortures of the devilish president. She was extremely careful and cautious, but no matter what she did, there was no escaping him. She did not understand why a complete stranger like him would treat her this way. She was after all, just a simple girl who minded her own business.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Deadly enemies join forces to solve a case.

In Meng Zhao's eyes, Lu Shichen in the past looked like a paper sack wrapped in skin, looking calm from a distance but terrifying up close. So, at that time, everyone was chasing Lu Shichen, but Meng Zhao found him so fake that he hated him. Meng Zhao never expected that one day he would be able to meet Lu Shichen, and even less that he would become the prime suspect in a murder case... And it turns out that the person who is in charge of resolving this case is none other than Detective Meng Zhao.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

On a pitch-black night, corporate wage slave Qi Yan sees his first love — the one that had passed 10 years before. After quite a bit of pestering and persuasion, he finds himself forced into the miserable lifestyle of working during the day and investigating at night. The topic of the investigation? Finding out who the culprit is. Can the top who had passed years before successfully manage to be resurrected?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 7 extras.

title.romaji: Qiyue Hunyue De Zhuma Tai Fuhei
title.english: Contract Marriage: I Married My Cunning Childhood Friend
title.native: 契约婚约的竹马太腹黑

description:
Zhao Youwei is a girl who's always been worried about her masculine name. All of a sudden, her childhood friend, who had just come back from abroad, proposes to her when he realizes that she is a girl! Liang Miaoyu did that because she bullied him when they were young, which caused him to be traumatized when being in close contact with others. Moreover, Zhao Youwei can't reject his proposal! What a disaster!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When Jay proposed to Cyril, Cyril suddenly lost his memory about meeting and falling in love with Jay and didn't know who Jay was. Jay didn't give up on Cyril, he determinded to help Cyril to get memory back, Jay took Cyril to old places that they went together… Days later, Cyril found out that he could find some memories back when he kissed Jay in particular places...

(Source: Webnovel)

The popular idol, He Ju, has a crush on the president of his management company, Zhao Zhiang. They accidentally swap bodies when Zhao Zhiang rejects He Ju's advances. Zhao Zhiang is left with no other option but to brace himself for show business. They can temporarily switch back, but only through a kiss. Until the problem is resolved, they are bound at the hip. Upon investigation, they find that someone coveting He Ju's fame and status is behind it all. There is something really fishing going on...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Gu Ann, an artificial intelligence robot, is capable of travelling between virtual worlds. Her job is to avenge hosts and crack whoever fails them. She talks little, but moves ferociously. Whatever you scums obtain regardless of moral and manner, I will crash them with the flick of a finger.

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: You Bei Bing Jiao Chan Shang Le

description:
On a stormy night, Shen Nianque found herself fleeing danger and accidentally took refuge in a private residence. Inside, she encountered a strikingly handsome young man. Contrary to her expectations, he was unafraid of her threats and even assisted her in treating her gunshot wounds. Shen Nianque thought their paths would never cross again, yet to her surprise, this seemingly delicate young man, who was a year her junior, started to persistently seek her out. His attention towards her grew increasingly intense and unsettling as time passed...

(Source: INKR)

Justin is loved by two men, and it's tearing him apart. His past is haunted by the complicated love-hate relationship with his first love - Alex, who also happens to be his adopted uncle and a powerful CEO. But in his current life, Mills, a seductive lieutenant has always been by his side. How will he make a choice?

(Source: INKR, edited)

How do you get over a rejection? Let the 90-day Don’t Let Your Heart Beat Challenge begin! Can you really suppress the beating of your heart? There’s no way! The only way you can break the barrier of a two-way crush is through my Love Lab app!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Born from a stone on Spring Mountain and given the title of the Handsome Monkey King, Sun Wu Kong is the main character of Monkey King (The Journey to the West), which is regarded as one of China’s greatest novels.

It is evident from the start of the story that Sun Wu Kong is very conceited. He seeks to learn the secret of eternal life, but uses the teachings of Master Puti to wreak havoc in various worlds, traveling by cloud and wielding a powerful miracle staff to intimidate other rulers and declare himself “the Emperor of Heaven.” He is finally stopped by Buddha, who locks him away on Five-Finger Mountain for five hundred years. Upon his release, Sun Wu Kong departs for India in search of the Buddhist scriptures. During the journey he learns patience and a sense of responsibility, defeating the monsters that block his path before becoming one of Buddha’s fighters.

(Source: monkeykingbychen.tumblr.com)

The Prince of Qin sets sail for his 100th conquest; If he comes back victorious, the throne will be his and he will be able to marry his childhood sweetheart! Will he come back victorious? Or does fate have other plans for him?

title.romaji: Shaoshuai, Ni Laopo Yao Fan Tian!
title.english: Young Marshal, Your Wife is Too Cunning!

description:
Su Qinyi was the fifth daughter of the Su family. Although she was addressed like a proper lady, yet she was leading a maid's life. Her dad never paid much attention to her and her sisters bullied her whenever they found the chance. But Life is like a drama. A young marshal was coming to their house for a banquet. Never thought the first time they met, she took him as a thief while he thought she was an assassin! Time to test her acting skills! Will she be able to take her revenge? What would life be like after the young marshal came into her life...

(Source: MangaToon)

An idiot who doesn’t understand feelings and is a talented killer x A schemer who endured hardships and is in a vegetative state

You’re in a vegetative state for 6 years. In the 7th year, your doctor started talking to you, sharing his killing tracks. Maybe it was due to the stimulation of your nerves, you miraculously woke up. You’re unable to leave the bed as your muscles have shrunk, your speech system is on the brink of breaking down — how are you going to escape?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Chao Yu is the new guy in his school who always fantasizes about a magical world and being a hero. He's close with the prim and proper class representative Nan Mochuan who puts up with his silliness. As Chao Yu becomes closer with Nan Mochuan, will something more evolve between them?

(Source: INKR)

Legend has it that Ji Yu was a genius suffering from hypermnesia. Those with this condition can remember every detail of their lives from something as significant as the world’s turning point to something as small and as insignificant as a minor fleeting thought. In addition, it was said that he was especially beautiful. As soon as the news that he was going to support Tianqiong’s seventh squad broke out, it sent everyone buzzing.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Shen Wei Fanpai, Diao Da Zhujiao Bu Guofen Ba?
title.native: 身为反派，吊打主角不过分吧？

description:
When Su Wuya transmigrated into a fantasy world, he became the heir of the prominent Su family. He was accompanied by a Narrator, whom he thought would be a powerful helper, but it just made fun of him all the time. During his training, he found out that he was actually the villain of the story! That was when he activated the Narrator Hint system. By beating up on the good guys, he can gain villain experience points that will unlock cheating hints from the Narrator!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

What? A super sweet senior and a tsundere teaching assistant are both her cat guardians?! This girl with a thousand-year-old jade in her body is the successor to the previous master of these Thousand Year Cat Men. With inexplicable events popping up one after the other, the twelve cat guardians and their ancient secrets are there for this naive girl to slowly unravel...

(Source: Webcomics)

A demon just wants to become an immortal, but he's focused on... I'm talking about you, heir of the Yun family! I want to become an immortal, but you're in my way!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The curse of twelve stars, a girl who plays piano with a dream of becoming a chef, because of an odd job that she pretends to be a boy. What's waiting for Yue Hui is a mysterious mansion and 12 boys who have the curse of 12 stars which fall upon each of them. What's awaiting her? Where are her and the boys' destiny leading to? A love song for 1000 years, the legend of 12 beautiful stars, everything is in《Starry Night Club》

title.english: The Way Back to Your Embrace

description:
She is the Prime Minister's legitimate daughter, devoting her life to vengeance. He is the invincible, ruthless Warlord Prince of Blessia, yet committing to loving her for the rest of his life. Between them are not only the difference in status but also the enemy intrigues. Can they change their fates and fulfill the promise they couldn't have in their previous life?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Dujie Hou Wo Bian Cheng Le Kulou Mozun
title.english: I Became the Lich King After a Tribulation
title.native: 渡劫后我变成了骷髅魔尊

description:
The Demon Lord Li Tian, having cultivated a demonic scripture, was sure he’d become the most handsome man in the universe after his latest breakthrough. He never expected he would instead become a skeleton that would shatter at the slightest touch!!! Determined to get his old body back, the Demon Lord embarks on a quest…to build a harem?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The heroine meets her childhood friend, but he seems to be a naïve boy, and he is always receiving good guy cards, which seems to be very funny. The heroine thinks it’s time to teach her childhood friend to fall in love … but why did it slowly become that she was the one being taught?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

When An Zizi got into a car accident, angel and devil both converged to try to take her soul away, but she was rescued by a passing boy Yu Qiuren instead. The angel and devil wouldn't give up so easily and kept harassing An Zizi in her daily life. Even worse, the angel accidentally shot her with a Cupid arrow, further tying her to Yu Qiuren…?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Song Miaomiao is an unpopular, but optimistic girl who has mind-reading skills. However, the hottest guy in school has just made a bet with his friends: he'll get MiaoMiao to fall for him in three days to solidify his status as the school's most handsome guy. But when she hears this, she kicks him in front of everyone and runs off—labeled "uncool" forever. Now they're in college with a fresh slate. Except this time, when they run into each other once more, he somehow knows her secret?!

(Source: Comikey)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Shen Dai, a gentle and rational Omega got himself into an arranged marriage for the money to pay back his debts. Little did he know that he was getting married to Qu Moyu, the wealthy S-class Alpha that he has a crush on. However, Shen Dai is aware that "Apex Alphas are heartless." He is captivated by Qu Moyu's kindness, but also acutely aware of the contrast between them.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: CP Ke Dao Xiang Lianai Zen Me Ban?
title.english: My OTP Is So Sweet That I Want to Fall in Love

description:
Zou Ming, a young girl who longs to find real love and creates fanworks for her One True Pairing. Li Dongxu, a young man who gives off an appearance of sincerity but delights in making others laugh. Who doubts love at first sight? A sweet-and-sour first love will quietly bloom this summer.

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Winner of the 2020 Tiaoman Grand Prize for Best Shoujo Manhua.

title.romaji: Lu Zong, Ni Laopo You Shang Re Sou La!
title.english: CEO's Wife on Trending Topic Again
title.native: 陆总，你老婆又上热搜啦！

description:
After all the twist and turns, they still belong with each other.

He was her McDreamy when she was still a student. Now, he has become the heir of the richest family in the world. Deeply in love as they were, the misunderstandings separated them for 7 years. Fortunately, the mist of disbelief has eventually dissipated. It\'s time to get back together again.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.native: 我家徒弟又挂了 第二季

description:
Master Yu Yuan's neverending search for his beloved apprentice continues! Now that he's ascended to immortality, does that make fixing the The Bug even more difficult?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Lin Zuning was recently dumped by his girlfriend. Depressed and angry, he rode his motorcycle in the rain. Speeding as he went, he was met with an accident and broke his leg. He thought that he would be stranded there before someone rescues him, but instead he saw a little girl. Her name is Yulan and she is an angel working under divine orders to cause such accidents. It was an encounter that would change both of their lives. The story revolves around the angel's three lives reincarnated in Ancient China - all in which she meets and falls in love with the same person, but due to fate, she can never be together with him. And so starts a bittersweet story between Lin Zuning and Yulan, as they slowly discover just how much their fates are intertwine together in their past lives.

title.romaji: Ming Liao! An You! He Dingliu Yingdi Lian Zong Sa Tang
title.native: 明撩！暗诱！和顶流影帝恋综撒糖

description:
Li Jiu, a renowned beauty in Bejing social circles, got drunk one night and accidentally harassed the movie star Pei Shisi. The video of her groping his butt went viral all over the net! Little did people know, the two are actually childhood friends, and Pei Shisi has had a secret crush on her for many years. That night, he had just found out she has been going on matchmaking dates, and he was trying to seduce her instead.

"Come on, Jiu-er, forget those lousy guys, how about give me a chance—?"

But Li Jiu doesn't want to get into trouble by having anything to do with him! Trying to clear up rumors about them, she goes on a dating show, only to fall further into his non-stop doting pursuit…

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

In the middle of the bustling campus carnival, five people escaped to the beach to play a quiz game. Lin Weixia got the chance to ask Ban Sheng a question.

Lin Weixia: "What do you want to be?"
Ban Sheng: "A shark."
He then paused and asked, "What about you?"
"A fish tank." she answered.

Everyone knows that a shark can't stay alive in a fish tank.
The story of a handsome but arrogant boy × a cool studious girl.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A badly injured boy was luckily saved by fencer Isabella and Ana, but unfortunately lost all his memory.
Ten years later, the teenage fencer Ryun got a magic sword by accident and all have changed since then.
He's eager to explore the mystery of his own life and to solve it.
The quiet life was over, the teenage boy, Ryun, started the adventure on his own.
Meanwhile, in the North Pole - Savage Land, a grand plot was being hatched.

title.romaji: Wo Chusheng Dang Tian, Bai Gui Ye Xing, Xue Shi Hu Dao
title.native: 我出生当天，百鬼夜行，雪尸护道

description:
On a dark, snowy night, a female zombie came to a small mountain village and gave birth to a boy. The birth caused the moonlight to flicker and attracted evil spirits, but fortunately the boy was rescued by the deaf sage woman of the village. The boy grew up with a seemingly normal childhood. However, major mysteries shroud the boy's origins, and eerie supernatural incidents seems to always happen around him.

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

Irrespective of gender, I only love you.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chuan Yue Xiuzhen Shijie, Dan Shi Ke Yi Lian Wang
title.english: Traveling Through the World of Cultivation, But Being Able to Connect to the Internet
title.native: 穿越修真世界，但是可以联网

description:
Thanks for getting back to me, I've just gotten back to the sect on their flying sword. Like, have you ever seen the sun rising at 6am in a fantasy world? Don't forget you're in another world! In this world of cultivation, the people are poor and desperate, and danger lurks around every corner. Don't forget you're just an ordinary guy, with no talent for cultivation at all. But… he's got his smartphone with him, and it's still connected to the Internet… And so he made a new forum post, "How the heck do you survive when you've been isekai-ed into a dangerous world of immortal cultivation?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Bing Jiao Baojun Gai Na Lücha Juben
title.english: The Sickly Tyrant With An Innocent Facade
title.native: 病娇暴君改拿绿茶剧本

description:
Fu Xin, a powerful president of her company in the modern age, finds that she had travelled to the past and transmigrated into the body of the village girl Fu Qibao along with her Merit System. Now, not only did she have to suffer the consequences of the original host’s cruelty to other people, but she had also earned herself a betrothed. No one had foreseen this exceptional teen who the original host had brutally beaten up to one day become a merciless tyrant of an emperor that ruled the world. He was going to kill everyone who hurt him before… Hold on, why does this sickly tyrant have two sets of personalities? Wait, is he acting innocent in front of Fu Qibao to gain her affections?!

(Source: Webnovel)

Hi, my name is Ling Yu. My occupation? Your most ordinary delivery man next door. Well, the only difference is that I provide delivery services for anything. Yes, you hear me right, absolutely ANYTHING, as long as you pay me fairly.

(Source: WebComics)

Ye Shuling is a psychologist with the ability to enter other people's dreams, while Su Yi is a highly self-esteem-driven patient with depression. Bound by destiny, they join forces to help those who suffer from mental issues...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Chengwei Bing Jiao Bojue De Nüpu

description:
Yara suddenly found herself transmigrated into a novel she has read, only to become the personal maid of the story's yandere antagonist.

From that moment on, Giulio, who believed he was unworthy of love, found the only light in his life—Yara.

As an adult, he slowly approached Yara. "Yara, red roses and chains go perfectly together. Let's stay here forever, okay?"

Wait a minute... This kid wasn’t like this before! Give me back that adorable, tsundere boy!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Ning Yi, a modern-day doctor, traverses into the universe of a novel and becomes the vicious female supporting character who dies in the plot. Forced by a system that ensures she acts in accordance with the story to her death, Ning Yi then finds that only by getting near Prince Ning, the villain of the fiction, will she be able to escape the monitoring of the system. That leaves her with no choice but to follow him around.

(Source: WebComics)
A boy falls in love with a girl, but she does not love him back... A story evolving around theme of "youzhi (naivety)" begins.

Gu Jiahui, single for 26 years, discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant on her birthday. The father is not only her longtime crush, but also the company's newly appointed CEO! Faced with this sudden change, should she keep the child? Should she tell him? What does her senior think of their tumultuous relationship? This barrage of questions leaves Gu Jiahui at a loss.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An ordinary girl suddenly receives an invitation to join the most popular band! While falling into dangerous traps and being hurt by conspiracies, she also meets a goup of beautiful music spirits, a race of mythical creatures! And one of them looks so charming and gorgeous~

(Source: Webnovel)

Don’t sit around and wait for your hero to appear— you are your own hero.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A hidden murderer lives in a seemingly quiet and peaceful magical town. When the two girls arrived in this town, they thought they could learn magic happily until they became terrified. Who is the murderer who has been traversing the magical and mortal realms...? How will the two girls' love and hatred be balanced? Welcome to another Shoujo-Ai thriller series involving magic.

(Source: INKR)

When Ning Chen, a scientist of the 21st century, arrives in a different dimension and possesses the body of the Dark Demon, he freaks out as anyone else would. However, what he is completely unaware of this that the wheel of love has started to turn...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Quan Shui Deng Ni

description:
Three years ago, Si Ning and her team rose to fame after winning the Summoner's Cup. However, after learning that her boyfriend and teammate cheated on her, she withdrew from professional play, vowing to never return. Three years later, she became a full-time video game streamer, sporting her new long peppermint green tresses. Through hard work, her stream steadily grew until one day, a random in-game opponent destroyed her 5-0 in front of all her viewers. Unfortunately for her, the embarassing defeat went viral. Her opponent turned out to be the newest sensation in pro player circles, superstar Ye Feisheng, who continued to be a major thorn in her side. He regularly showed up uninvited, first plying her stream with massive donations, then visiting her home in person with a large horde of fans in tow. Why does this little brat keep bugging me? What does he want?? Watch as she fights back to reap the seeds of success and love!

(Source: Coolmic)

"A shy woman, a lively grandma, and a smart but scary boy live in an old house in Beijing."

They each have their own issues and troubles when it comes to love, work, friends, and school life Romance and comedy happen in the big city as they face their day-to-day life in Beijing.

(Source: Comikey)

title.romaji: Wo Shi Xuexiao Weiyi De Renlei
title.english: I'm The Only Human Being In My School

description:
This is a story about a young man, the only human being in a school of various different animals. His day-to-day life bursts with excitement as he hangs out with his quirky friends. Enjoy ordinary school life with a funny twist involving all kinds of animal-related traits!

(Source: INKR)

title.english: Even Gods Need Fans (Fans Are Real)

description:
A love comedy where the girls and the male gods work hard to gain fans!

(Source: INKR)

Is it the advent of luck or the beginning of bad luck when a genius cheater meets a koi girl? From today on, let's change our fate! Click to get your own lucky koi!

(Source: WebComics)

In the 11th Century BC, a group of thirsty travellers found an oasis in this desert. Suddenly, they were pulled down into the oasis, except for a man - "Yanshi". This oasis has been given the name "Sunset Spring" and it is believed that it can take away the souls of mankind.

Previous life, she was a pawn controlled by others. When the information was leaked, she was tortured to death. This life, she was reborn as the daughter of Vice Prime Minister in Dongwen. She vowed that she would never become anyone's toy again.

(Source: WebComics)

To investigate the truth behind his sister's sudden disappearance, a rookie Enforcer arrives at the special zone city of Laia, where unlawfulness runs amok. But when he bumps into a mysterious amnesiac with an unknown identity, he is forced to cohabitate with him. Numerous strange signs hint that his identity might be more than what he had imagined, and he soon discovers that the monsters depicted in myths may not be myths after all...

Can loving education and having iron discipline change a person? As a devil, he would not educate the lost children using a common strategy. Don't say that he is too much, because if you knew about about his cruel methods, then he wouldn't be called a ghost teacher.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Tianxia Shei Ren Bu Shi Jun

description:
Ye Qi, a disciple of the Kunlun Sect, descended the mountain on his master's orders to investigate the disappearance of his senior sister. Venturing alone into the Demon Cult, he unexpectedly rescued a man imprisoned in a secret chamber. The man's bones were shattered, his condition pitiful beyond description. Ye Qi tended to his every need, changing his bedpans, feeding him, and even transported him to Kongsang Valley for medical care. Just as Ye Qi was filled with profound admiration for the man's indomitable spirit despite his crippling injuries, he discovered the prisoner was none other than the Demon Cult's leader he had been searching for!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Heyi Nong Quan Ta Shang Huan

description:
The Scheming Fake Eunuch X The Madly Infatuated Prince.

Reborn and returned, they don masks for their own purposes—mutually distrustful yet irresistibly drawn to each other. Amidst suspicion and testing, they soberly succumb to their attraction.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

After being reborn, an elite police officer becomes a prisoner and is taken in by his nemesis. Amidst suspicion and entanglement, the two eventually become accomplices in their shared fate.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

How to be a chef when you lose your sense of taste? For starters, get a hacked knife! There are also these lucky draws and a gorgeous mentor. And that's how a master chef is born!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Gold Time That You Owe Me

description: Chen Yanxing was being chased by creditor of her father and she was forced to hide in a nightclub, so she dressed up as hooker and mingled with the crowd. She thought she could hide in a private room and escape the chase. Unexpectedly, she met a man who is also being pursued...

This is surely a story you've never thought of! The cartoon’s main character is called Yuan Xin. She’s an otaku who likes to immerse herself in a fantasy world. She, who likes to look at hot guys--after embarrassing herself in front of them in the school yard, decides to retaliate. Unexpectedly, during the crucial moment, an accident happened, and she crossed over to the game world!

title.english: The Beautiful Wife of the Whirlwind Marriage

description:
It was by chance they met. If it wasn’t because of a desperate situation, Lin Che would have never married Gu Jingze, a man who appeared cold on the outside but was hot on the inside. What would happen next between this pair of quarrelsome lovers?

(Source: WebNovel)

Once a glamorous daughter of the city’s richest family, falls from grace. What’s more, she even falls off a building…the story doesn’t end just there. Even though her brain splashes everywhere on the street, her new life just starts.

(Source: Mangatoon)

This is a comedy story about a popular idol who was frozen out by the entertainment company and gained extra weight of 100 pounds. She ended up work as the servant in the bossy president’s house. She helped the president to solve his problems in his social and love life. When she finally lost the weight and returned back to the show business, she found the president is actually face blindness and can’t recognize who she is. She decided to continue her life as the best servant in his house.

(Source: MangaToon)

Ah Tong was only planning on going to the rooftop to contemplate life when it turned into a journey down his memory lane. Falling off a 25-floor building, it takes less than 5 seconds to hit the ground. In this short 5 seconds, he saw the most astonishing views and experienced the most exaggerated life. As the mystery unwraps, deeply buried memories start to float back up, and he will ...

Lin Yi, an omega man who has been friendzoned for hundreds of times. He accidentally has access to a boyfriend sharing system where people can transfer customers’ requirements into their own skills if they accept the orders. For instance, masculinity equals to charming eyes, top fighter means an all-rounded command of wrestling, and a transgender refers to a drag queen. But wait a second, why the customer would like their boyfriend to be a transgender? Don't run away and explain yourself to me, boyfriend sharing system!

(Source: Webnovel)
Heartache, competition, and the behind the scenes battles of the imperial harem; an ancient story based upon revenge.

There is a new store in that cursed corner of the town. There must be no business there at all!!

(Source: WeComics)

Ye Fengwu, a capable male actor who debuted after filming in an X-rated movie, is known as the pinnacle of the age of beauty in the entertainment industry. During a vacation in Europe, he met the mysterious rich man, Augustine, and an intimate and dangerous relationship began. Emotions, gambling, wealth, dark past and a hidden truth...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In this era, demons and monsters roam the streets at night. Humans and familiars work as partners who kill those monsters. Civil servant Fan Xiaotie and the strongest demon girl Linyu of the secret department “Supernatural Affairs Armed Response Team” must face an endless crisis.

title.romaji: Tiancai Baobei De Fuhei Di Niang

description:
A 21st century top-class assassin travels back in time one day to find that she's been transformed into the Second Miss of the Duanmu Family, one of the five great aristocratic families of the Xuanyuan Dynasty. But, this Second Miss was naturally useless, obsessed with men and a mother out of wedlock! Fine, since she was there already, then she should live coolly. When she appeared in front of everyone with her genius son, she was no longer "her". She wandered Jianghu with her son, killing everyone that got in the way. How would she survive in this chaotic world? And, out of all the handsome men that followed by her side, which one was her child's father? Finally, who would win her heart?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Wo Zhishi Yi Zhi Xiao Maomi

description: Somewhere within a family of three, lived four cute pets: three balls of purrs and a little puppy. Not a moment goes by without something interesting happening with these four adorable pets each and every day...

A boy who was bullied in school suddenly gets kidnapped after witnessing an attack in his city. He changed into a monster when his kidnappers tried to kill him after injecting a drug into him. The hidden truth of the Monkey King will uncover as the boy protects him and those around him.

(Source: INKR Comics)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

Endless sky and infinite space, the cosmos isn’t some paradise waiting to be found, it is full of darkness and danger, death and terror of the great unknown. However, for that glittering swath of blue, we have no fear! For the longevity of men, we have no regrets! Nothing shall stand in our way because it is finally our time, our age! The age of cosmos exploration!

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter 0 is included.

title.romaji: San Sheng San Shi Shi Li Tao Hua
title.native: 三生三世 十里桃花

description: Through the course of unlikely coincidences, a man and woman meet again and again in three different lives. What will become of their love in the world of the immortals?

Lance, who had been abroad for many years, suddenly returned home and broke Laine's peaceful life. This abstinent guy was pretty much a stumbling block in Laine's life, who pissed Laine off every day and always "bullied" him for fun. However, a company crisis completely changed Laine's view of Lance. At the same time, Laine also perceived the true purpose and ambition of Lance's return... What's Laine supposed to do?

(Source: WebComics)

Our protagonist is a normal guy with no luck when it comes to love; he's on an eternal quest for a girlfriend and dreams of romantic relationships, but the problem is that all the girls seem to be taken, or avoiding him altogether!

Meeting a girl can be hard, especially if you're clueless around the opposite sex and don't even know where to start.

Then, one day, everything changed. His friend Ade met a beautiful girl on the Internet and he was struck with a brilliant idea; why not seek love online?

(Source: Ephidel/MAL)

title.romaji: Qi Fei Jintian You Qifei Le Ma

description:
Even though we're opposites, we’re still drawn to each other.

Qi Fei finally became the captain of the girls’ basketball team. While out recruiting, she ran into the senior that she admired so much! The tsundere junior tried her best to hide her fangirl excitement, but the sly senior already saw through her…? Will the junior help the senior rekindle her love for basketball, or will the senior make the junior confess her feelings first? A youthful GL school story!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

These cats with bells are experts raised by the company to encourage the staff. Each floor has its own "meow bell," giving everyone the chance to have some quality kitty time to replenish their energy when feeling down. Of course, it's hard to say whether they're actually curing depression or causing trouble, but after all, what kind of bad intentions could a cute little kitty have? However, in the cats' eyes, they're the real "executives" at this company~

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a Christmas special.

title.romaji: Dou Shi Chuanyue Ping Shenme Wo Shi Jiexiaqiu
title.english: We’re All Transmigrators, so Why Am I a Criminal?
title.native: 都是穿越凭什么我是阶下囚

description:
When some people transmigrate, they transmigrate into emperors or nobles, living lives of luxury and influence. Some people transmigrate into shizuns or sect leaders, revered by all and achieving extraordinary accomplishments. At the very least they transmigrate into villains, stirring up trouble with aspirations of "crushing the protagonist". Li Changtian, an upstanding young man of the modern age, died in the line of duty. In the blink of an eye. Hey! He transmigrated! He transmigrated into a criminal guilty of deeds so heinous that everyone wanted to beat him. Travelling official Yan Shu who hated injustice more than anything, stepped on him and said coldly: "A life for a life."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Love-dependency Syndrome, commonly known as "yandere". I have a special constitution which naturally attracts that type of people.
Before I tell you my story, let me first get off this operating table.
“I won’t let you run away”
“You’re mine”
“No one else can have you but me!”
“We'll be together until we die, promise!”
The girls’ words, they still echo in my ears.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The World-class agent opened a shop in the night market?! Apart from common folks, my old enemies, friends and even their daughters drop by for a meal!? I, Li Cheung, welcome everyone, but if ya’ll gonna pull a scheme, then don’t blame me for being uncourteous.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Jintian Jujue Lu Xiansheng Le Ma?
title.english: Did You Reject Mr. Lu Today

description:
Betrayed by her lover and forced into a marriage by her stepmother, the miserable young heiress Gu Yixue is tricked by CEO Lu Liyang and is forced to become his young wife. But she's no pathetic pushover! Lu Liyang may think he can tame her, but not so fast! She's about to flip the game on its head and tame the ringmaster!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Bailian Lücha Nanyou de Qian Ceng Taolu
title.english: A Basic B's Guide to Stealing a Man’s Heart
title.native: 白莲绿茶男友的千层套路

description:
There's a secret behind Xin Qianyu's happy relationship: he captured the handsome yet distant Su Zhong's heart by pretending to be gentle and meek! However, Xin Qianyu always felt that Su Zhong never cared about their relationship as much as he did. How will Su Zhong prove him wrong?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: This manhua was originally titled 覆水满杯.

How to have a romantic relationship with someone who doesn't know anything about romance?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.native: 小蓝的老板“死”了一百次

description:
The daily inner OS of the social animal: ask the boss to do it a hundred times~! Give the boss a chance to be unlucky a hundred times, and the necessary stress relief secrets for the social animal in the workplace are here, waiting for you and Xiaolan to open it together!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Legend told; there exist a single being who embraced death to kill the God. Before death, he managed to create three eyes to hold his immense power and was then thrown down to the world of humans.

(Source: OSTNT)

Tian Jiao Lianmeng, is a mysterious yet popular game. Legends say that only five people can clear it, and by doing so, will gain riches beyond belief. In order to continue his peeping obsession on the Jiejie next door, Luo Xiao Wei was determined to clear the game and gain the rewards, and to also replace his telescope. However, more and more puzzles await him…

In his past life, Ye Xingchen was hacked to death in the streets for his debts. But he found himself reincarnated as the son of the godfather. His strong physique and fearsome background means that he won't be such a pushover in this life! What kind of waves will he stir up when he returns to campus?

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Sichuan Chushi Yu Yishijie De Yongzhe Shaonü Men
title.english: The Sichuan Cuisine Chef and His Valiant Babes of Another World
title.native: 川菜厨师与异世界的勇者少女们

description:
After transmigrating into a world of magic, Qin Chuan who was a Sichuan Cuisine Chef discovers his food is key to boosting combativity. With demons rampaging the land, it’s about time to put an end to the misery and suffering. Who's to say a chef can’t save the world? But why are the heroes super hot babes?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
A story about Yan Gui-fei, a beautiful woman from Chinese history.

When Wang Xiaomie awoke, he discovered that he had been reborn and buried underground for over a thousand years, even living in a double room! This handsome guy, who was wearing the same red wedding dress, kissed him!! What can this weak, helpless, and ugly man do!?

In order to revive his senior brother, he collected countless fortunes, built an underground tomb, found the legendary Acacia tree, and finally waited with him in the coffin for thousands of years without hesitation. But this person involved had no memory of this!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Hart, a self-destructive death row inmate, is drafted into a dangerous mission to go mining in the jungle. The leader of the jungle camp turns out to be his former lover, whom he broke up with long ago. Hart desperately tries to defy fate, but gradually falls into a dangerously inappropriate relationship.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Two people with a height difference of 41cm? How can we successfully complete our love homework?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Campus Belle CEO Is Stuck On Me

description:
Chu Nan who is a top-class agent came to the city to cancel his engagement. Right as he hopped off the train he was dragged away and forced to pretend to be the boyfriend of a domineering CEO! I came to call of my engagement, why won't you let me go!"

(Source: Webnovel)

After witnessing the fall of her country and the destruction of her family, she is reborn a decade into the past as an arrant villain. Killing playboys, playing the double agent, and exposing the false innocents, she is determined to leave her enemies with nowhere to hide!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jin Hou, Wo Jiu Shi Fashi De Die
title.english: I'm Really Not Targeting the Mages

description:
Luo Jie, who unexpectedly went into a post-apocalyptic game world, spent ten years in the novice village because of his caution. After he killed more than 10,000 Devil Blast Frogs during the ten years, his spell resistance finally reached 100%... Now, as Luo Jie steps out of the novice village, he only wants to say to this world, "I'm not targeting mages, but I wanna say that you guys are all trash.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Gang Gou Cheng Zhun Sheng, Wo Bei Nüdi Zhao Huan Le
title.native: 刚苟成准圣，我被女帝召唤了

description:
In the Empress's bedchamber, the would-be assassins laid on the ground. Lin Ke led the squad of imperial guards, all beautiful women, protecting the Empress's bed. Looking directly at the Empress, he boldly declared, "From now on, I will be the man guarding the empress's back!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: The Prodigal Son of Ming Dynasty

description:
Q: Who is Fang Jipan?

Father General: He’s my prodigal son. sob sob
Emperor: Every time he opens his mouth, my head hurts; every time he comes close, I want to run away
Prince: He’s the sole cause of my misery, and the reason I'm always being berated.

Fang Jipan: Hi guys! Did you miss me?

Father General, Lord, Prince: We have to go now!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Did a general dress up as a man and capture the enemy Highness? Did they trap the beautiful prince in the harem to "humiliate" him?! Let's see what happens when the disguised general confronts the cold and dark prince!

(Source: INKR)

The person Qiao Qiao hates the most is Sheng Qiao, the female star who latched on to her idol Huo Xi to stir up a scandal.

Unexpectedly, one day, she woke up as Sheng Qiao. The actress was exploited by her agent, mocked by the whole network, and blackmailed by nude photos. After her soul traveled through time and space, Qiao Qiao decided to start a career counterattack, and unknowingly, she got closer to the idol Huo Xi in her dreams.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Moshi Qiusheng: Wo Neng Kan Dao Yincang Tishi
title.english: Apocalyptic Survival: I Can See Hidden Clues
title.native: 末世求生：我能看到隐藏提示

description:
One day, several billion people were all transferred into a post-apocalyptic world! Survival suddenly became everyone's common goal. However, Zhang Chen was given the power to see hidden hints! While other people were carefully exploring this unknown wasteland, Zhang Chen was rushing ahead to become a powerful zombie-killing hero…

(Source: Fanqie Manhua, translated)

Terren has been holed up on the outskirts of town after being punished by Black Sand, the most feared gang in the West. A year later, to save the town, he resurfaces and sets out to search for his father who went missing when he was a kid. With incredibly fast reflexes and superb shooting skills, he takes out his powerful enemies, one after another. On the other side, Black Sand's mastermind seems to have a secret agenda that involves Terren...

(Source: WebComics)
At the beginning of Lin Fan's life, a sand world appeared, in which the biological cells unearthed from each sand tribe multiplied. He knew, that it would change the world…

title.romaji: Jipin Xinniang Ba Wu Long Guai Pao La
title.native: 祭品新娘把恶龙拐跑啦！

description:
Princess Shina was sentenced for treason and offered as a sacrifice to be fed to the evil dragon. But when she was thrown into the dragon's lair, no evil dragon was to be found—only a barely conscious, naked, dark-skinned man lying there instead.

(Source: Webnovel)

After a drunken one-night stand, Susannah finds herself involved with an insatiable man. “I can’t stop thinking about you. I’m yours now.” When she retches violently at a party and repeatedly kicks him, he purses his mouth in a self-satisfied smirk.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Xian Wei Nu Shen Wei Pu, Dadi Kan Men Gou
title.english: Immortals as Slaves, Gods as Servants: The Emperor is My Guard Dog
title.native: 仙为奴神为仆，大帝看门狗

description:
Li Tianyuan, Lord of the Celestial Severance Hall, walks the path of a Grand Player—one who manipulates the chessboard of destiny itself.

Branded a tyrant by foes and a madman by allies, he willingly shoulders the hatred of all eras to lead his followers in rebellion against heaven’s decree. Their vision? A world where no soul kneels to another.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo, Xinshou Cun NPC, Diaoda Julong Hen Heshi Ba
title.native: 我，新手村NPC，吊打巨龙很合适吧

description:
Reborn as an NPC, starting the game by being kidnapped at the hands of bandits and was taken to a mountain stronghold? A genius in magic, compelled and left with no choice, deviating from the traditional path and embracing the path of evil! But how… no one can defeat me?

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

What would you do if you have reincarnated into a vulnerable wolf pup? Need an answer, now!
For survival, Chiye chose to wag his tail and address the vampire nemesis “Papa”, living a miserable, meaningless life.

Chiye: Fucking stupid idiot (arwoo arwoo papa)
Fan Shiye: Good, become my noble pet!

Poop Shoveller x Noble Pet — what kind of sparks will fly between the two who used to be enemies in this life? And will Chiye reclaim everything that was rightfully his in his previous life?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Three years ago, Ye Tang born in the slums yet dreaming of becoming a lawyer to escape poverty fell for Meng Yixing, the masked heir to a crime syndicate who used him before casting him into despair. Three years later, Ye Tang, now a lawyer through forged credentials and stolen identity, reunites with Meng Yixing. He blackmails him into rekindling their past, knowing his history. This time, Ye Tang resolved to turn the tables and exploit Meng Yixing. The two con artists first deceived each other until they had nothing left, then used...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

“The war is on!”

Every night, Jiang Xiao Ya has a recurring dream of the same mysterious man. He’s got fire-red hair and indescribable power. One day, by pure coincidence, she meets him in real life! As it turns out, this man has a very important job: he’s guarding ancient, dormant beasts called the “Creation of the Gods.” To make matters worse, Jiang Xiao Ya inexplicably inherits the powers of Jiang Zi Ya, and gets drawn into the battle against these ancient beasts. A tale that transcends time and space unfolds!

(Source: Comikey)

The world is contaminated. Supernatural abilities awaken, ushering in a new era. My ability? I can grant abilities to others to awaken the powerless and make the powerful even stronger. But every ability I grant eventually returns to me. Level-A, Level-S, Level-SSS…even Level-X! Your abilities become mine, and mine only! However, from the depths of cosmic corruption, monsters have emerged… and their abilities are Rules. Dream of them, you die. If they see you, you die. Even hearing their footsteps means death.

(Source: WebComics)

The exciting life of the young boy Dai Hong who died, lived, and died again. Should he choose his childhood sweetheart, or the magical beauty from another world?!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A normal, honest sophomore guy, whose life was changed when he became a super beautiful girl. Who was the one that caused it? Are there any more misfortunes lying in wait for him/her? What kind of charming experiences will he have...?

(Source: Boredom Society)

Just because he tried to be a cheapskate and scan a QR code that he thought was for a business promotion, the Li Ming Yang who was rushing to be on time for his date with his girlfriend was sent to a mysterious place...

A comedy about a puppy love affair that develops unexpectedly.

(Source: WeComics)

On this planet, which looks like Earth, there is an energy in the human body that can activate the potential of animals. Those who are good at this are called Pet Trainers.

(Source: Webcomics)

The love story between a military officer and an actor during war.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 5 extras.

After 20 years of misery, Wu You thought he was going to live his life in a muddle until he found the failed half-immortal Shenyuzi in a garbage can on a stormy day. After which his fate was changed forever! Let’s see how a loser inherits an immortal body, has beauties as his companions, subdues demons, owns hundreds of billions of dollars, and starts down the path of a counterattack!

(Source: WeComics)

It’s a story about adventure in the virtual world.
During the investigation of the disappearance case of the South City, police officer Zhang has noticed a girl named Jiang Han. Later the girl was forced to enter a holographic game, in which she found the boy of that disappearance case and other missing people, and started an adventure…

After killing many monsters, Zhong Kui and his apprentice Qin Shuang found a bizarre connection between these monsters and their some odd setup. Finally they find out that someone is trying to set up an this kind of array in the capital.

(Source: Web Comics)

In a chaotic world, the Chu kingdom's emperor Chu Yuan relied on his Lord of the Southwest Duan Baiyue for support. Together, they led the mighty army of the Chu, ten-million strong, into bloody battles. Until they finally united the country and make peace for the people, in this epic tale of blood and iron.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A woman dies on her way to a martial arts competition and wakes up as a rich young lady.

At first, I was a martial genius and only wanted to become a hero but due to hunger, I ended dying. When I opened my eyes again, I had reincarnated as a weak lady and worse, she isn't just rumored to have to marry the young master of Fu but also an annoying fan of the city's most handsome man. She is known as arrogant and bossy, hated by all. HOW IS SHE SUPPOSED TO BECOME A HERO LIKE THIS! Thankfully, there is a martial artist around, so I must absolutely get on his good side! Huh? This dude seems to dislike me...

Isn't rebirth for taking a full control of my life? Waking up and back to high school, do I really have a change to live again? Then first thing I should do is..

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Quan Neng Zhuang X Xi Tong

description: Zhao XiaoFei was a student who got into a car accident. On the verge of his death, he got an AI system that grant him points based on how much he brags.

When she woke up, she only found herself in a state of unawareness with nothing in mind but blood. "I killed my own mother!" She shouted, like a wild monster.
On the brink of her breakdown, he suddenly appeared, holding her tight and gently. "I will cure you." He decided to bet his own life to treat her from the moment they met...

Xia Yuxiang was born into a family of butlers. He has been taught since childhood that he must protect his master with his life. One day, all his hard work pays off: he’s going to work for the Zong Zheng family as a butler.

He meets with his master with high hopes, only to find that his master, Zong Zheng Tong, is a petite genius girl. Her left eye is an icy blue colour and she has a mean mouth and personality. What is going to happen between Xia Yuxiang and his master?

(Source: WeComics, edited)

A gifted boy shuttles between the arena and reality, weaponized by powerful forces. A seemingly fragile girl, a thug clinging to his dignity, an assassin, a princess—how will they each choose when faced with a horrifying truth?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

One mistake made the future a wasteland rampant with beasts; another mistake made the bloody heroes turn the tide. The wild sand, the sea of ​​the beast, and struggles of humanity, which one is the real enemy of the travelers, or are the enemies already laughing at you in the sky...

After calling off his engagement, Xinglai once again meets his former lover, Xiwu.

Thinking that this is a second chance in their relationship, Xinglai gives his all to stay with him.

A heartwarming boys' love comic of two men finding each other once more to give love another shot.

(Source: INKR Comics)

Will ribs taken out from humans' bodies really turn into Eves? This is obviously ridiculous!But what's going on with this... little girl...in sight? Where is she from？Anyway...I'm not obesessed with little girls!

(Source: Webnovel)

The underworld passage sealed by the Cat Demon King and Taoist Priest Zhang Junhao was attacked by ghosts once again. The weak and powerless Cat Demon King finally dropped into the human world because he was lack of physical strength. To close the door of the underworld as soon as possible, the Cat Demon King needed to find out Zhang Junhao’s successor and work with him to seal the door. Friendship+monster hunting+SSR collection…Now join us!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Re Shang Shouxi Zongcai Zhi Qianjin Guilai
title.english: Trouble with the President: Return of the Princess
title.native: 惹上首席总裁之千金归来

description:
When Shen SiXuan's family business was seized conspiratorially by her uncle, her father passed away from illness due to rage, and she was disowned from the Shen family. In order to take back Bo Ya Enterprise, she willingly became Qin YiChen's woman. However, will this domineering and ruthless man really help her reclaim what was once hers?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Mi You Chu, the second miss of the general's residence was betrayed and killed by the prince of duke Xing manor, Su Bu Xiao and her personal maid in her previous life and gets a chance to be reborn. This time, I will protect those dear to me and not repeat the same mistakes twice. Despite that, she gets into the same scenario as when she fell for Su Bu Xiao in her previous life. Though this time, the so called sophisticated young master seems to have changed, like he got a lot more... dumber? He also clung to Mi You Chu like crazy. That's because... the person currently inside of Su Bu Xiao's body is a reincarnator from the 21st century! and currently he's trying to trigger the first event for meeting his capture target; the player gets in danger and was saved by the capture target, disregarding her own life.
And so, he tangled a snake to his neck.

title.romaji: Tao Hua Yuan Ji Zhi Yu Ze

description: A runaway young master accidentally falls into the water and strays into the legendary Peach Blossom Springs. Just like described by the ancient poem, no pressure or disputes would arise in there, and the whole place seems like from a fairytale. Everything is perfect, but a feeling that something is wrong still remains. What is hidden behind the Peach Blossom Springs?

What is telencephalon? If one were to derive the surface meaning of the word, telecephalon is a living organ made up of both the left and right brains. In this story, it will be used to describe the universal conflict within the grand scheme that we call telecephalon cosmo. The story begins with a mysterious murder that progresses to reveal the secrets of the entire universe. From dark conspiracies to galactic warfare, from inhumane betrayal to noble sacrifices, humanity have never understood how pitiful and weak they are as they make one final desperate struggle against fate...

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

title.romaji: Wokao Chenghao Xitong Dabai Wanqian Shen Hao
title.english: I Defeat Countless Tycoons with my Title System
title.native: 我靠称号系统打败万千神豪

description:
#System##Goddess# A down-and-out guy, who's been treated unfairly, gets the invincible Title System and turns his life around. From then on, he scores all the big wins and lives the high life, surrounded by all sorts of hotties.

(Source: Webnovel)

This is a story of a mystery investigator, Levi, and a flamboyant medium, Laird.

Two people have disappeared in this ordinary town. They were seen entering a 'door' that sudden appeared only to disappear along with that 'door'. To find the missing, investigator Levi and self-proclaimed psychic, exorcist, explorer, and mystery researcher Laird decide to enter this 'door' together and investigate the truth behind it all.

Laird, "And here I thought mean and aloof people like you don't understand what a 'warm hug' is!"
Levi, "Why? Is this not warm enough for you? It's not that difficult."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Jiao Wo Tong Zhuo Da Ni
title.english: I’ll Get My Deskmate to Hit You

description:
The poor little top-scorer was bullied, so he transferred from a high-ranked high school to an ordinary one.

Class teacher: Zhan Ming, look at the score you got!
Zhan Ming: I'll ask my deskmate to teach me.
Former classmate: Gu Qinan, don't think we can't find you just because you transferred.
Gu Qinan: I'll get my deskmate to hit you.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

As a military commander, I accidentally crossed over into another world due to a car accident. After opening my eyes, I found out that I had become the only waste princess in this world who had no spiritual power. To that, I just wanted to say, "You messed with the wrong person!" I got the system and awakened the top spiritual power in no time! I fought the enemy with a bazooka and turned the world upside down! The only problem is that there are too many people who like me, like can you line up and wait for your turn, huh?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Qingdi Meitian Dou Zai Bian Mei

description:
Transmigrating into a novel as a minor side character, Shen Jintai was determined to remake himself by completing the missions from the system "Xiao Ai." He has to become prettier in order to become a star in the entertainment industry. And he has to get between the male lead Yan Qiuchi and his partner Bai Qingquan so that Yan Qiuchi will focus more on his career. Yan Qiuchi originally disliked Shen Jintai aggressively, but now his attitude towards Yan Qiuchi has been getting more and more ambiguous?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

As an e-pal, it took Chi Yu an entire year to snag the top spot on the e-pal platform. Then, he met the most difficult rival of his career, who struck him down from his throne. However, he never expected that his rival would be...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The banker—Zheng Yuan—encountered the CFO of a cooperative company—Yan Shuwang—for reasons of work. In the discussion for cooperation, Zheng Yuan gradually grew fond of Yan Shuwang under his teasing. Unbeknownst to him, the teasing was deliberately and meticulously thought out…Affectionate long-haired beauty CFO Yan Shuwang (Top) x Gentle and charming Banker Zheng Yuan (Bottom)

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zaoqi Xunfu Da Mao de Zhengui Ziliao
title.native: 早期驯服大猫的珍贵资料

description:
Wen Haoxue was arranged on a blind date by his family to a cat demon Earl. Wen Haoxue valued good looks, and he immediately fell in love. Not only that, but the big cat also found it hard to resist…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: The original title was Kua Wuzhong Xiangqin (跨物种相亲).

title.english: I Have a Divine Beast at Home

description:
When a mission goes terribly wrong, the top-ranking divine beast killer of the world suddenly finds himself as a simple pet to ordinary human Ji Keyuan. The once proud divine beast must constantly find ways to keep his new owner happy ever since then… what a hard life he has now.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

One learned to slowly become accepting while the other slowly started maturing... This is a story about going with the flow.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

A system suddenly appeared in Zhan Weiyang’s mind and started assigning him missions. The system wants him to get together with the first person that he meets on the first day of the new semester at school. He found a target at random and started working on an impossible mission. Meanwhile, Pei Qing, Weiyang’s cousin who is staying over at his place, finds it amusing that his cousin does not seem to be very bright.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

This is the story of a foolishly obsessed fencer and his dream of standing on the podium as the champion with the first runner-up in his arms.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A story about growing up together, from kindergarten to university.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Fifteen years ago, the Demon Lord, all human's enemy, was killed by HERO. The war lasted for 1000 years finally ended. With the Demon Lord's death, the Demonpedia——the symbol of Demon Lord——was lost as well.

(Source: WeComics)

Note: Chapter count includes the one shot

title.romaji: Meimei Xiaoshi De Di Yibai Tian

description:
I killed my younger sister and managed to get away with it. But on the 100th day after her death, something strange happened…

(Source: MangaToon)

There are two top students in this particular city. One was a studious, friendless recluse who doesn't date. The other only ever wanted to have a beautiful and soft-spoken partner. Rumor has it, one day, these two top students ran into each other.

Jiang Yao: Brat, don't I treat you well?
Jiang Yao: The brat is kinda cute.
Jiang Yao: Hey, Brat...
Yin Che: Get lost.

Friendly Big Bad Wolf Jiang Yao VS Reclusive Little Bunny Yin Che

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note:
- Chapter count includes three extras.
- Original publication on U17 has 100 chapters, which Tencent compiled into 44.

title.romaji: Wo de Tongxue Dou Shi Qipa

description:
In this world, there are wods worshiped by people, and there are also gods never worshiped. Among the unworshiped ones is the Chao God, the God of the Eye. The Chao God makes a living by lying and decpetion. Once the god confesses his wrongdoings, then he will gradually wither away.

This story is about the encounters of the God and the human beings.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Dixiacheng: Kaiju Nuyi Lan Xing Wanjia
title.native: 地下城：开局奴役蓝星玩家

description:
Sherlock is a newly promoted dungeon boss, determined to become a great demon lord. Until he summons a mob of goblins who call him names, gang up into cliques, barter amongst themselves, and even get into fights. These goblins call themselves— The Players!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Ming is a fifth-year primary school student who lives a dull and meaningless school life in the worst class of the worst school in a declining industrial city. One day, his deskmate Hua became the class president and declared herself "Empress". The class now goes on a journey to fight against the old order made by adults.

title.romaji: Quan Neng Yujie You Bei Chai Majia Le
title.native: 全能御姐又被拆马甲了

description:
The rumor is that the Lu family has a good-for-nothing daughter? Bad grades? Lu Mian got the top score in the national test in engineering. No talent? She put on a show simultaneously playing the piano and painting a portrait. Wastes money? You know she earns enough money to buy whatever she wants? Boxing, go, appraisal, racing… Come on, she'll beat you at anything you try. The handsome Xiao Qimo pushed up his glasses and asked, "What else you got?"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Oldman, a mysterious man who wears an old-man mask and punishes the criminals and evils in the city, is the idol of many, including an elementary student named Tong. Even though Tong's father is a policeman, he feels embarrassed and ashamed of his father's inability to solve any crimes. However, on the day of Tong's 12th birthday, something shocking happens..!

title.native: 殺手 無與倫比的自由

description: A Manga adaptation of the 9th book from the famous Killer Series written by Gibbens(九把刀). This is a story about an ordinary guy under extraordinary circumstance turning into a psychotic mad killer.

When a game turns into reality and your husbando is summoned in front of you, what will you do?

(Source: OSTNT)

In order to maintain the order of the new world in which men and demons coexist, the industrious incredible imperial censors use their spare time to exorcise and fight demons to ensure world peace. But where there is light there is darkness...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bu Zhuang le, Wo Bi Yingxiong Huan Qiang
title.english: Chosen to be Immortal in the World of Superpower

description:
In a world where ordinary people possess superpowers, becoming a superhero is no longer an unattainable dream. However, for him, who lacks superpowers but aspires to be a hero, he can only embark on the path of cultivating immortality. You have superpowers, so what? With immortal magic, saving the world only requires the wave of a finger!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Yao Bazhan Ni De Wen

description:
There's nothing more devastating than being forced to go on a blind date. She thought her blind date is a terrible and creepy guy, but it turned out to be a hot CEO...

(Source: WebComics)

In order to escape the confines of life in the harem, Liang Jian travels a thousand years into the future. During an archaeological dig, the tomb of Emperor Sheng is unearthed, and his body is put on display in a museum. Hoping to finally sever his ties to the past, Liang Jian visits the museum to say his last goodbye to Sheng Mingzhou. But unexpectedly... Sheng Mingzhou is resurrected?!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shiye Hou Wo Huiqu Jicheng Yi Wan Jiachan
title.english: I Returned Home to Inherit Billions of Fortunes after Losing My Job
title.native: 失业后我回去继承亿万家产

description:
After being driven out of the entertainment industry by online trolls, she decides to return home to inherit her family's fortune. Anti-fans, "Family's fortune? What’s her background? What kind of wealth does she have?" CEO of the Luo Group—worth billions—tweets, "She is my biological daughter." Anti-fans, "W-what?!"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Xuezu You Dian Meng

description:
Hey! Can you not look at me like I’m your food? Alright alright I’m sorry okay? Don’t come closer! And don’t lick me!!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: I Am Loaded with Passive Skills

description:
"#Space Travel##Transmigration#""Is the most powerful skill in the world one that needs to be actively wielded?"

"Nah, passive skills are the real deal!"

"What are passive skills?"

"A passive skill is an active skill that can be instantly activated. It's an ultimate trump card that no one would guard against and can only be known by the dead!"

(Source: Webnovel)

After Wen Li, a social animal, witnessed his lover Chi Haoye killing someone, he was entangled by Chi Wuye. However, it seems that the real abnormality is not his lover, but this world?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Kaigua Ye Shi Zong Men Zui Ruo?!

description:
All my sect brothers and sisters are freaking reincarnated supreme powerhouses—while I’m just some random ordinary guy from a third-tier city, somehow tricked and dragged back by my master to play nanny for the whole damn sect!

Luckily, this sect is absolutely stacked with buffs—and by sheer luck, I’ve awakened the **Affection Value Codex System**!

Collect codex entries of these reincarnated powerhouses, earn their affection, and temporarily wield their insane abilities. Life’s about to get seriously OP—and ridiculously fun!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Tian Xia Di Er Jiu Ting Hao

description:
There is a Wushu Record of Fame which records all the celebrities. Heroes that specialize one perticular weapon can enter this Record. Gao Jianli, a young man who just finished one's apprenticeship and wants to beat Qin Huangliang to be the No. 1 Swordsman, comes to Qin's house. Then, he finds that Huangliang is—a nut. This is a daily comedy that depicts how Jianli keeps challenging Huangliang...

(Source: WebComics)

Diane Tao caught her bestie and her fiancé having sex accidentally in her own room. Feeling pathetic about herself, Diane immediately married a "surgeon" who came to her home to check up on her father in a fit of rage. She thought she would live an ordinary life for the rest of her life, but one day after the marriage, she found various secrets of her doctor husband...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Feichai Xiaojie De Lianai Shengcun Youxi
title.native: 废柴小姐的恋爱生存游戏

description:
Once a spoiled beauty, she became fat and ugly after a serious illness!? Dumped by her boyfriend and friendless, she spent her days disheveled and unkempt, branded as the “good-for-nothing girl.” The heavenly princess has fallen into hell. Just as she resigned herself to drift through life all alone, a mysterious full-length mirror suddenly appeared in her room. The girl regained her beauty, and to her astonishment, she found herself transported back in time to when she was 17?

(Source: Baidu, translated)

Being a singleton, the occupation of professional vet, Anna Ling, is to mate animals. In a pet shop filled with hormones, a celibate and sorehead store manager was assigned! Meanwhile, being troubled by both family pressure and mysophobia, how will he fight back?

(Source: WebComics)

"After an immense battle, the Ninth Son of the Golden Crow Family was reincarnated as Ye Xingchen"

The Phoenix of Chaos descended upon the world with the power to burn everything down to ashes which inflicted terror for centuries. It was the ruler of Heaven and Earth! When the crown prince of the Chaos Phoenix was reincarnated, he stirred up trouble throughout the world. The king had been reborn to start his journey afresh!

(Source: Comikey)

Unemployed and penniless, Jun Bo gets a phone call from his grandfather who claims he will leave his billion-dollar fortune to Jun Bo. However, before that happens, Jun Bo must complete a special mission – receive signed approval from all six tenants who rent his grandfather's mansion. Upon arriving, Jun Bo is surprised to find that these tenants are six attractive women with markedly contrasting personalities.

(Source: WebComics)

Third year fine arts student Ji Ye has been living with his teacher and lover Guan Shan for three years, but life has become boring. Their relationship has slowly turned stale, and the two start facing problems borne of anger and jealousy as Ji Ye considers breaking up and Guan Shan starts suffering from a mid-life crisis. While dealing with the opposition of their friends, their 16 year age gap, and their turbulent emotions, the two search for the true meaning of happiness.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated and edited)

Unity of Heaven and Earth is an action-packed Manhua set in a fictional modern society. It features the characters from Journey to the West, but all completely different. Introducing the master-turned-loli San Zang; the dragon-turned-horse-turned-beautiful woman White Dragon Horse; the pig-turned-Adonis Pigsy and Sun Wu Kong, who has been reincarnated as a human. All of your preconceptions from Journey to the West will be turned upside down!

The hot-blooded high school boy, the mysterious female swordswoman from the Blade and the capricious black hearted girl make you unable to tell the reality from the game world! What plots were waiting for them? Please enjoy the story in Being the Reality.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Ling Qi Zhi Yue Luo Shanhe

description: How to adapt when you are a different child? Fundamental question, often treated with anguish and pain. To illustrate this, the author tells us two stories. One sees the son of a capitalist during the Chinese cultural Revolution whe receives currently rough jokes from the other boys. He can only bear this situation thanks to his main dream: build a plane and fly away. The other story leads us in the future, where time travels can be performed (inspired from a science-fiction novel). what will happen to this boy teared awy from prehistoric era? A book full of emotions…

Xiao Mei is a normal high school girl whose hobbies are reading and drawing manga. To encourage her because of her failed love confession, Xiao Zhu gave her a makeover. However, after the photography club's president took pictures of her and published them in the school magazine 'CLOVER', she becomes the 'MYSTERY BEAUTY' the whole school's looking for!

Included one-shot: 4x4 Prince's Diary

Lily, an executive who lives prisoner of her past, cross her path with Wen, a young top-model wanting to forget her passionate romance with Jian, a fashion photographer. That's until one day Wen meets Jian again...
And the story goes on...

Her name is Jasmine–the most beautiful flower of summer. This is a nostalgic tale about friendship and the magic of childhood…

(Source: Shinnen)
Alice is a dream decipher. She notices that the class president has been sleeping a lot in class recently, so together with her rabbit partner, she enters his dream and hope to find out the cause...

Storm Riders takes us on a journey through an amazing world in ancient China where, aside from the hegemony of the Royal Government, an individual and separate society exists: The World Fighting Association. Conquer, a powerful Kung Fu master, aspires to gain control of the Association and assembles the mightiest force of fighters known to humanity. Forgetting the evil deeds he’s committed in his lifetime; he takes on Wind and Cloud, two very talented and young martial artists, as his disciples. His destiny to be the Ultimate Master draws nigh; however, destiny has a will of her own and at the crux of the impending maelstrom blow Wind and Cloud.

Yuqian may be the "greatest" guardian the Underworld has ever known, but he and his awesomeness can get a bit annoying. Naturally, he receives a task that can only be accomplished by the very best (and that sends him far away). He travels to the human world, on a hunt for a murderous demon as he helps Shuihua, a Daoist priest who’s as pale as a ghost and who insists on pointing out how often Yuqian is wrong. Despite their bickering, can the dangers they face force them to rely on one another and show them how much they actually need each other?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and three bonus chapters.

On a rainy night, an abandoned black kitten on the street was brought home by a young girl named Luo Xiaobai, and she named the kitten Luo Xiaohei. Luo Xiaohei is not an ordinary cat, it is human-like, knows how to use the toilet, refuses to eat cat food, and its long tail can even split into minions named "black shoo". Meanwhile, the mysterious character named "Shimeji", sent out three winged wolves to search for Luo Xiaohei. Soon, Luo Xiaobai took Xiaohei to the countryside to visit her cousin Gen and grandfather, which led to various strange and mysterious events.

(Source: Weibo, translated)

An 8 year old child, along with his brother, managed to escape from the disasters of an army's merciless killings! His own past, how much could people possibly know? His own heart, who could possibly understand? These questions was the "revenge-mindset" that has lingered the brothers through extensive training to become insanely powerful in the martial-arts. Now, this same 8 year old child has grown into an adult and is now a King! He is the Leader of the Southern Barbarian Sect. He is known as the southern barbarian, SANDSTORM..!!

(Source: MangaToshokan)
At the peak of Beijing Operas, female roles were played by men. These men were required to have an excellent voice, postures and most importantly, beauty.

title.romaji: Xu! Kuai Ba Weiba Cang Qilai

description:
In the vampire's cruel cleansing plan, the werewolf boy, a "heretic", was in danger. He got accidentally saved by a man called "traitor". The arrogant and irritable young wolf cub was given to a man who was not good at making a living! It could only be a total mess! The only way out was to save each other, but the journey to find a place to live was fraught with crises. The killer who was both good and evil, the human boss of the mysterious bar, the sickly vampire who believed in science...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Gong Ben Wu Cang De Mo Shi Chuan Ren

description: How do you stop an assassin who takes pleasure in killing? Read about the story of Miyamoto Musashi's Last Successor.
A princess calls upon a hero to kill the newly born demon king and that's how the story begins...!

It's my fault, so you're punishing me... The story of a self-absorbed rockstar and the guitar player he betrayed.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

At the peak of the Great Tang Dynasty, technological advancements dominate the world while society is open-minded and prosperous. When an ancient Chinese civilization gets some modern texting culture thrown its way, what will happen in the imperial court? This is a story of the whimsical tales between nobility in the Great Tang, one of warmth, comedy, and wholesome endings.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The world is big and contains countless mysteries. The human realm will always have many varieties of terrifying and abnormal happenings; perhaps in the past, the present, and the future.

A collection of short thriller stories that will blow your mind.

title.romaji: Mei You Shen Ti De Wo Men Ru He Lian Ai
title.english: How Do We Fall in Love Without Our Bodies?
title.native: 没有身体的我们如何恋爱

description:
Cheng Nuo, a "virus girl" with a difficult physique, thought she could get rid of her past by being a small, transparent girl. Unfortunately, she attracted the super popular and cool cat-like campus prince, and became the public enemy on campus again! However, the online "virtual world" that she accidentally entered seems to be going exceptionally well? Is it better to continue fighting reality, or to take the opportunity to change my life and have a virtual love affair with Mo's avatar while I’m at it? Well... the heartthrob wolf that I met at work doesn't seem that bad!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Lianxi Sheng Cong Tushou Pi Zhuan Kaishi
title.english: Being an Idol Starts with Breaking Bricks
title.native: 练习生从徒手劈砖开始

description:
Han Lan, a mercenary, was sent to another world by a mortar shell and possessed the body of an idol trainee who was about to take part in a show. However, in this world, favored male idols are usually slender and cute, and they have fair skin. What? Why can't a strong man with tanned skin be an idol? A true hero should be able to break bricks with bare hands!

(Source: Webnovel)

There are thousands upon thousands of demons in the world, and half of them reside in Zhaoye City. As for the other half, they all died in northern realm of Canlangli, under the control of the Celestial Immortal Xiao Fuxuan. Only one demon remained alive there, imprisoned for the last twenty-five years. He is Zhaoye City's former lord mayor, Wu Xingxue.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Even siblings have different tastes.

(Source: Official Site)
This is the story of a mangaka that swaps bodies with a killer maid after eating ramen. A story with a side of gratuitous violence and explosions!
