Trying to rescue his imprisoned wife, Feng Beixuan died at the foot of Daoshen Mountain, only to be reborn in another world because of his immortal soul. Yang Fan is a cultivation prodigy of the Yiyuan Sect, considered by many to be the best choice to eventually become sect master. However, he fell for Luo Zhong’s trap during a competition and unfortunately died. Just as Yang Fan’s dying soul was gradually dissipating, Feng Beixuan’s immortal soul suddenly appeared and merged with Yang Fan’s body. The two will become one, and the wheel of fate turns again!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Liaozhai Bukeneng Name Ke'ai
title.english: My Liaozhai Can't Be This Cute!
title.native: 我的聊斋不可能那么可爱！

description:
A ancient scroll of illustrations sent me to a fantastical world. This world is in turmoil, full of demons and monsters preying on on humans. Therefore, wielding a three-foot sword, I will slay demons and fight evil! However... these demons seem a bit different from what I expected! They're just too cute!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Rebel fangs defy order, price paid with raging fire.

(Source: Yostar)

At the age of four, Ruiwen exhibits Go skills more remarkable than the great majority of her male peers'. When she grows up to be a professional player, she realizes that decades of gender inequality in Go have greatly disadvantaged female players. Consequently, she sets her sights on learning from the best and overcoming learning barriers as a woman, all in the hope of making her mark in the male-dominated world of Go.

(Source: WebComics, edited)

In the wake of rebirth, Lu Yuan stumbled upon an enigmatic selection system. Empowered by fragments of his past life and bolstered by the system, he steadily gains mastery and uncovers a labyrinth of clandestine conspiracies. In this life, he confronts an array of options, refusing to adhere to the prescribed narrative. Instead, he consistently opts for unconventional paths, avoids cliches. He morphs into a malevolent avenger, gaining ever-evolving superpowers. Along the way, he outwits myriad goddesses and delivers resounding slaps to unsuspecting villains. Could Lu Yuan defy the shackles of his tragic past using this newfound cheatcode?

(Source: Webnovel)

I just want a male mother! College student Song Fu, had 3 babies overnight and fell into a [child-rearing hell] — In order to solve this problem, he decided to hire a professional nanny. However, to his surprise, the person knocking on the door turned out to be a [Super tall, muscular bodied] man?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes five extras.

title.romaji: Qing Shen Bu Di Chen Nian Hen

description:
After three years of marriage, I found my husband is a two timer and did not want to hide his betrayal any more. I tried my best to please him and save the marriage but all I have done is far less important to the other woman - his first love in his eyes. Finally, I abandoned myself and chose another path of attack. At this time, the man I met was like a landscape that opens the door to my new world. He said to me, "There are so many a**holes in the world. If I hold your hand tight, you won't be afraid."

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qian Fu Bai Ri, Wo Qu Le Diguo Nüdi
title.native: 潜伏百日，我娶了敌国女帝

description:
When a mysterious explosion destroys an insane asylum, the Chief Director of asylum Yun Zhonghe is transmigrated to another world, with the memories of 29 mad genius inmates in his head. With those 29 unique skills, he joins the secret service in his new world and goes undercover as a spy in the enemy kingdom. Three years passes, then three more, and he finds himself in the position of consort to the enemy Empress, and she wants to have children with him!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Princess Cha Cha's birth, steeped in prophecy, spelled doom for the Yanchi Dynasty, leading to calls for her death. In response, the emperor executed the dissenters and exiled her and her mother in the cold palace. Years later, young Cha Cha, with her enchanting innocence, greeted him with a fish from the lotus pond. Despite her small stature, Cha Cha gradually wins over her tyrannical father and siblings with her wits and charm, defying the omens and reshaping her destiny in the Yanchi Dynasty.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Sui's Daily Slices: Wanna Shoot a Picture?

description:
Is this something more solid than a memory?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

title.english: Like You for The Rest of My Life

description:
Xiao Kai Kai falls in love with her homeschooling tutor Xu Mo Ran. But on the day she was going to confess, Xu Mo Ran suddenly disappeared - and hasn't been heard of since. Six years later, Xiao Kai Kai becomes an instructor. Meanwhile, Xu Mo Ran suddenly reappears and starts to fervidly pursue Xiao Kai Kai. If you like me, why did you disappear? If you don't like me, why are you pursuing me now? All the mysteries surrounding Xu Mo Ran get revealed one by one…

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

Disguised as a high school student, the killer Xie Yan had just finished dealing with the "rats" in the shadows when, on his way home, he was unexpectedly "scammed" by a drunk neighbor! "Hey uncle, it's very dangerous to take a nap anywhere..."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Time is wrong. It isn't flowing the way it should.
The person she killed the day before yesterday—their body was already rotting, putrid. But the next day, when she got home, they were standing right there, beaming at her.
What the hell is going on?
My doctor... he promised me. He swore that if I just took the medicine, I would wake up.
Where am I? What is this place?
And you... who are you?

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

title.romaji: Bie Nao! Wo Xiang Jing Jing.....

description:
A cute and heartwarming story about catboys, dogboys and a girl's daily struggles with her pets.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Bixia Zong Xiang Huo Guo

description:
Ni Shizhu has always thought of herself as an orphaned beggar. However, her master who adopted her made her swear to destroy the Chen Kingdom. When she ends up thrown into jail, her savior turns out to be the formidable regent of the kingdom.

She transforms from beggar to empress in the blink of an eye, and she even has six dashing men to choose from to be her husband. As she tries to keep her word and ruin the kingdom, she has to deal with all six candidates for emperor consort as they try to win her heart!

Chen Huan used to be a top agent in China who recently got out of prison and is broke. He refused to come back to the organization to investigate an accident 13 years ago. This is a former agent's life out of prison as he saves and woos many girls around Nanhai City!

(Source: INKR)

Male polytechnic honor student He Zhizhou and airheaded yet lovable female idiot Shen Xi had their bodies swapped in an accident. From the ever-present issues of misplaced youth to the supernatural chance encounters, the two of their lives have changed a lot from their past. He Zhizhou was forced to live in the female dorms, and Shen Xi had no choice but to adapt to the life of a man… This fresh new take on the school-life slice-of-life romcom is about to begin!

(Source: Coolmic)

Three ant girls were forced to leave Red Rose art institute under the mayor’s restraining order, No. 66. Since then, the ants have faced persecution under the ruthless, and strong domineering mayor. The opportunity for these girls to win back their freedom is slowing presenting itself…

Since he started high school, Lu Jia has rarely called Mu Wenran “Big Bro”. Exceptions would be whenever he is lying or feeling nervous. Back when he didn’t want to do his homework, he would act sickly and say, “Big Bro, my head hurts” or “I understand everything in this chapter. I really do, Big Bro”. Yet now, 23-year-old Lu Jia will still cry in front of Mu Wenran.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A manly girl met a girly man when they found out the affair between her fiance and his fiancee. After one night together, they were forced to play a couple and started learning from each other to become more "marriageable". But when they finally found someone "ideal" to marry to, they began to realize who's their true love...

(Source: Webcomics App)

The world’s largest aquarium – “Living Sea Aquarium” ushered in its first opening day, No one expected that the hidden (invisible) crisis would spread quietly in the blue water… Suddenly unknown creatures are going rampage in the aquarium. Zhang Chen, a diver who suffers from depression and Zhang Xing, a rebellious, sensitive and cold-hearted student. How will these two brothers who have never been friends unite and cooperate. The question also remains, how will these two brothers find each other and a way to escape?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
Note: Chapter count contains 2 extras.

title.romaji: Benzuo Zai Zongmen Yang Le Ge Xixiegui
title.english: I Brought A Vampire Into My Own Sect
title.native: 本座在宗门养了个吸血鬼

description:
I was unexpectedly reunited with my senior, who was my former crush and savior. But not only does he have amnesia, but he also likes… sucking my blood?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Three hundred years after the Great Cataclysm of the Fairy Continent, the demons gradually awakened. The Seven Divine Artifacts that could save the Fairy Continent appeared in the world. By chance, two teenagers from the Three Domains of Humanity obtained the Peerless Pearl, one of the Seven Divine Artifacts, which gave them the power of symbiosis. The demons were searching for the seven artifacts, trying to strangle the hope of redemption in the cradle. The two boys fearlessly embarked on the road of adventure, as they hoped to unite the races of the fairy continent against the powerful demons, and buying time for the development of the weaker human race...

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extras.

The kingdom's wisest man, Luo Xiao, joins the affluent prince Yan Ancheng in an investigation of a mysterious murder involving the prince's sister. Along the way, they face several bizarre occurrences together. As the feelings between them grow, they also get closer to uncovering a conspiracy...

(Source: INKR, edited)

Strange things have been happening to Bai Xi, heir to the rich Bai family, recently, so his parents decided to employ Han Zhuo—a mysterious bodyguard to keep him safe. Well-versed on the battlefield and in the kitchen, this very bodyguard can even turn into an adorable little star! While a huge conspiracy begins to bubble behind the saccharine sweetness. The existence of the Supernaturals, human modification, anagalactic life, and more have now put an end to Bai Xi's normal everyday life... and the crisis has begun to spread...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A boy with the “Heartbroken Symptom” could not learn martial arts and was destined to die before 25. After remaining anonymous in the world for ten years, he went back to the capital. At night, he removed the disguise, put on the moonlight-like armor and turned into Baiguyi. What on earth was waiting for him?

(Source: Flying Lines)

title.romaji: Yingdi He Ta De Gongzhu Daren

description:
In order to break away from the engagement with Gu, Ye finds him, a hopeless genius. She trains him into the best actor and makes him only be loyal to her. But what should she do when her loyal puppy become a devil make her his possession?

(Source: MangaToon)

The year is 2020. Brain-computer interfaces leading to more realistic virtual experiences have been developed. While initially driven by gaming, virtual reality has made its way to other industries. One such industry is psychotherapy, which utilizes the virtual reality game Dream World. Psychology graduate student Wan Youxi is one of Dream World's players. Her mother was one of the game's developers, but died a bizarre death after finishing the game. Wan Youxi dives into the game to search for clues and comes across her neighbor, Xie Zhehan, a high-level player. She realizes that the game is no longer the same as it once was. A disturbing air lingers in the game. PVP players become highly aggressive and develop mental illnesses. Missions leave players susceptible to hypnosis...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Icy Chairman's Cute Little Wife

description:
A punk girl turns into a great goddess to beat up scumbags and oppress fake angels. She angers all of the surrounding rotten women to death.

After being reborn, I, Chi Yan, have to marry this brainless playboy with X disease? I found a handsome man to play my boyfriend, but he ended up trying to flirt with me every day!

An icy chairman announced: My Yan'Er is the cutest in the world. I won't hold her back!

(Source: Webnovel)

In the ancient era of the legendary Three Sage Kings and Five Virtuous Emperors, with the death of Shen Nong, the heroes of various clans began to stir. In this turbulent era, a young man appeared out of nowhere…

(Source: MangaToon)

I was transmigrated into the body of a villain? Who the hell wrote this script?! And I even stole someone else's girl? And have a powerful older sister? This script keeps getting worse and worse!
And there's even a divine space and ten thousand worlds? I'm definitely dreaming!
After steadying himself, Wu Ming faced these new developments and continued on his journey...

(Source: Webnovel)
Our love is as brilliant as the aurora borealis.

title.english: Chronicles Of Everlasting Wind And Sword Rain

description: Ancient Shenzhou human races and demon races hated each other. When the yin and yang were wrong, the demon princess and the extreme hatred Taoist teenager Zhang Kuangyun became partners, and were forced to 'assist the demon catching' ... , The same black hand, vengeful raging flames, conspiracy nets, blood fire wedding dress, weaving into a most exciting fairy legend.

In the future world, magic crystals hold up entire cities, and abilities are studied as a form of technology. Magic supports the entire world and allows it to function. One confused boy named Zack embarks on a journey to find the lost kingdom. The Four Great Families? Ministry of Magic? The Dragonborn Brotherhood? This magical world that looks peaceful is actually brewing a huge conspiracy. The mainland is about to fall into a crisis and Zack will step up to stop it with his magic!

title.romaji: Ta De Weixiao Xiang Ke Tang

description:
Xu Jingshu, a sophomore in Class 1, is a wallflower seen by no one except when being punished to stand in the corridor during math classes. The arrival of Chu Youning, a transfer student, changes everything. He's attracted by Jingshu's candy-sweet smiles, and these two youngsters with different family backgrounds and personalities are brought together by fate...

(Source: WebComics)

After being falsely accused, the goddess of war died a miserable death and possessed an ordinary young lady, allowing her to start her revenge! The prince, the head courtesan, and the Devil Cult's Saint are all at my disposal. Whether it's the empress or scumbags, I won't let any of my enemies go!

(Source: WebComics)

Han Che and Jiang Yichen like each other, but both of them are shy and sensitive. As a result, the relationship between them gets more and more strained. Xu Chen, a boy who always takes advantage of Han Che, makes fun of Han Che each time he meets him, which, on the other hand, gives Xiao Xinan who has a crush on Jiang Yichen a chance to get close to him.

(Source: Webcomics)

Aliens? Magicians? What does this mean for a world where espers are fundamental to the pillars of society? As a mysterious maiden falls from the sky, the only thing that is certain is that she is moe as fuck.

After losing his memory, Shen Yiqiu, a disciple from the decent sect meets a very special man named Yan Luofeng, who is the leader of the evil Divine Wind Cult. When escaping and conflicting with Yan, Shen gradually finds his original self as well as his previous love back. Together they rip off the facade of the martial world and reveal the hidden true...

(Source: Webnovel)

The night her acting skill was finally recognized by the famous director Ye Ze, she died in this man's hand—or maybe she thought so. Yet instead of being gone for good, she woke up as another woman—a woman who seemed to have very complicated relations with that murderer. She vowed for revenge, yet her heart burnt and ached every time she tried to plunge a knife into this man's chest...

(Source: MangaToon)

Miriam is a young princess of the royal family who is loved by all, but she puts all her thoughts on her sister. The only person of such nobility and beauty is her sister, who is so perfect. She has always admired her, but how can she get closer to her?

title.english: You're the Apple of My Eye

description:
Jiang Yeyu and Qiu Xi became family after Jiang's mother remarried. But when they grew up, Jiang Yeyu fell in love with his younger brother unwittingly. After a long separation, an unexpected reunion awakens the affection that Jiang Yeyu has suppressed in his heart. To protect the brotherhood or to confess his feelings, how will Jiang Yeyu choose?

(Source: Webnovel)

The killer, Cong Zhong Feng has always despised those who fail to keep their word, especially those first parties who keep changing their requests! When he meets a bald young painter, Cong Zhong Feng agrees to avenge her for free. Who would have expected that along the way, they would meet “a set of Matryoshka”, who is the ultimate target?

Cheng Sunian is the captain of the SP club. One day, a superstar player unexpectedly transferrs to the club, shocking half of the e-sports community. Feng Can has a bad reputation, because although talented, he is not a team player and fights alone.

Let's look at the two-man team of a ruthless master player and a novice wolf cub.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Xu Chen has been in bad luck ever since his birth, and everyone avoids him. At the age of 29, Xu Chen looks back at his absurd life and is deeply bored of it. Before committing suicide, he chose to save a young girl who fell into the water. As a result, he awakens the perfect life system.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Buyao Zai Lese Tong Li Jian Nan Pengyou
title.native: 不要在垃圾桶里捡男朋友

description:
Chi Xiao Chi, born into a fourth-rate background, became a three-time award-winning film emperor with a second-rate personality and first-class looks. He started overcoming the hardest obstacles and paved his way to becoming the winner of life. Then, he was struck into a coma by a falling chandelier.

061: "Hello, here’s a brief overview of the scumbag recycling system. This system will measure the remorse statistics of a scumbag. For every 100 remorse points collected, you will be able to immediately enter the present world..."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Xiaocao Bu Keneng Zheme Meng
title.native: 我的校草不可能这么萌

description:
Sharon's parents died in an accident. They left her in the care of their close friend, Mrs. Mu. Sharon entered the noble academy as the basketball star Minz's younger sister...
(Source: Mangatoon)

The Crippled General Lu Ji X Substitude Bride Merman, Yu Xiaoman

My name is Yu Xiaoman. My surname, "Yu", comes from Yujia Village, the place where you saved me; My given name is from the solar term of the day you saved me seven years ago, and also the day we first met. This is the story of Yu Xiaoman, the little merman who wanted to repay his savior's kindness and offered himself as a substitute bride in his marriage.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

One is a child prodigy of a swordsman, and the other is a cold-faced senior envied for his talent. When they pair up as training partners, what special techniques will the prodigy pull off? What challenges and difficulties await them?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Is he the Emperor Dan reborn? Or have their souls merged? Long Cheng has none of the blood, bone, or soul needed for cultivation, but with his previous life's memory of potion-making techniques, he mastered the Nine-Star Technique. As he unravels the mysteries of the technique, he will come to hold up the sky, stand on the stars, gather up a harem, and conquer all evil.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The office lady, Fan Lu always thinks herself as the most ordinary woman, but one day she is kidnapped by an alien. The so-called Saturnian tells her the bizarre reason why they invade the Earth, while the key part of the invasion plan is to have Fan Lu fall in love with him and then betray the Earth! After spending time with the Saturnian, aliens from other planets appear one after another! Fan Lu realizes that she is not ordinary as she thought, and starts to have feelings for the Saturnian. What is she supposed to do?

(Source: WebComics App)

title.romaji: Yin Hun Mi Ai: Zongcai Dashu De Tianjia Baobei
title.english: Secret Marriage: Priceless Baby of the President
title.native: 隐婚蜜爱：总裁大叔的天价宝贝

description:
When she just grows up to be an adult, she messes up the wedding of her adoptive father, "Lu sheng ting, I am your daughter and will be your woman as well!" The truth of the murder six years ago begins to emerge, “Lu sheng ting, you are both my love and my enemy ..."

(Source: MangaToon)

With the development of modern technology, people on Earth no longer worshiped the gods of weather. Because of this, Yushi the Rain God’s power started to wane. He decides to venture to Earth under the name “Shi Yu." Shi Yu was soon scouted by an unscrupulous talent manager and joins his nearly-bankrupt entertainment company as a new trainee. Shi Yu is then sent to participate in the talent show “I am an Idol”.

With absolutely zero common sense and desperate to gain followers, he causes all sorts of chaos on the show. But he somehow manages to become popular enough to debut in the boy-group SWEN alongside three other members. Eventually, Shi Yu discovers that his group mates, Yang Dongjun, and Zhong Yun were also Gods who came to the mortal world to find work and restore faith...

(Source: Dongman, translated)

Note: The entry covers Seasons 1 & 2. Includes one bonus chapter.

title.romaji: Mou Tian Chengwei Wang Jue De Yuanqi Shaonu
title.native: 某天成为王爵的元气少女

description:
After accidentally transmigrating into another world, the heroine wakes up as an 8-year-old loli—only to be sacrificed to the legendary ‘Night Duke’! But instead of devouring her, the cold-hearted aristocrat inexplicably decides to adopt her.

Now, as his cherished (and spoiled) daughter, she’s caught in a storm of suitors: her childhood sweetheart from her past life reappears, a tycoon CEO pursues her, and a cryptic sorcerer demands a blood contract.

The Duke’s response? ‘Over my dead body. I’m raising her MY way.’

(Source: Mangatoon)
In an ancient era full of dangers, an isolated city without any help, human beings who lost their industrial civilization discovered, that those ferocious ancient behemoths were not the only threat…

Li Zhenruo never thought he would be the first to be kicked out of the Li family’s internal struggle between brothers. If that wasn't enough, he then lost his life in a meticulously planned “accident”. However, this was not the end for Li Zhenruo. After waking up, he discovered that he had turned into a Garfield cat, giving him the opportunity to return to the Li family and investigate the truth of which of his three older brothers was behind that “accident” of his. At the same time, he was shocked to realize that this body did not seem to be that of a normal cat. It could… transform!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Laoba Rang Wo Cong Shi Ge Nüshen Zhong Xuan Yige Jiehun
title.english: Choose One Right Girl from Ten Fiancees as Dad Commanded
title.native: 老爸让我从十个女神中选一个结婚

description:
Feng Lin, the "Dead Doctor", was the head of the Death Night, the most distinguished squad of the hidden legion of Huaxia. As per his father’s wish, he had to marry one of the ten beautiful ladies who were engaged to him. Not wanting to get married yet, Feng Lin decided to break off these engagements one by one. During this time, the traitor of Death Night, Liu Nian, appeared in the city. Then Feng Lin started his journey to seek vengeance and root out the “Netherworld”, which ultimately led to a civil war of the human race.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chao Shen Cong He Xiaohua Lian'ai Kaishi
title.english: Legendary! It Started with a Date
title.native: 超神从和校花恋爱开始

description:
Adapted from the novel 'The Most Powerful Learning System', Su Mo discovers that the secret to academic excellence is... love. Who says dating gets in the way of your studies? With the Learning System installed, anyone can become a star student instantly!

(Source: Coolmic)

To Yang Juan, He Lang seems to be just an Internet Cafe Manager who lives frugally and saves up money to buy dresses. In the world of an online game, Yang Juan portrays a naive, adorable, and soft girl - at least that's what He Lang thinks. The honest Yang Juan was entrusted by his roommate to control a female character's gaming account and use it to expose a cheating, in-game partner. By day, he's a serious and studious scholar. But at night, Juan Yuan goes online to play a gentle girl. And every day, he tries his absolute best not to expose himself.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 extras.

Merman Ye Ming falls in love at first sight with the handsome human Lu Chuan while performing at the aquarium. After receiving help from Lu Chuan, his feelings grow stronger, and in the blink of an eye he brings him home with him. The next day he suddenly reveals that he's a merman?!

What?!

Use your little merman brain! What are you going to do now?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Small but certain happiness, stemming from merely discovering the beauty of life. The simple sentence “I love you” requires all of my courage to say.

(Source: Chinese publisher, translated)

When did you start to be sure about your dreams? When you meet someone at a particular moment, will you be so jealous of that person that you wish you were him/her? He met one of his seniors in school. He started to play piano for this person. After graduation, however, they were separated because of fate. When they saw each other again, their positions had already been switched. A bitter-sweet romantic story about the growth of two boys thus started to unfold...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Yuanlai Wo Shi Modao Lao Zu?

description:
Once unmatched, the Cloud God Emperor’s life nears its end as the so-called righteous Eight Great Sacred Lands close in to steal his sect’s secrets. At death’s door, a modern man named Yun Ye awakens in his body with a system that trades justice for lifespan. With six loyal disciples, he punishes the corrupt, reclaims lost treasures, and rebuilds his legacy. A fallen legend rises again, this time, justice will be repaid in full.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Hao Men Ye Chong: Meng Qi Chao Dapai
title.english: My Cute Wife Is the Boss

description:
On a stormy night three years ago, she found a man gravely injured in a cave. She decided to save him and on that night, in the dark, she received a marriage proposal that seemed very much like a dream—until she found out that it was in fact, very real. Three years later, they were reunited at a party. However, it had been so long since their first encounter, and they had long forgotten what the other looked like. What will happen when their deeply buried feelings resurface, and when the fragments of their memories are put together piece by piece?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

It's a story about psychological disorder. Twelve years ago, Lin Mo's mother, who was diagnosed of depression, wanted to kill herself and Lin Mo. Tai Yingjun, showing up like sunshine in Lin Mo's life, saved him. Twelve years later, after doing the Psychopathy Checklist-revised (PCL-R), Lin Mo was diagnosed of mental disorder. Will Lin Mo be saved by Tai Yingjun again?

(Source: Webnovel)

“Let’s break up, but just give me 61 days, okay?” — this relationship that cannot be continued, two hearts that still throb, nine long-awaited destinations and 61 days with you. This time, no one knows if this break-up trip will end as a regretful make-up or something left to luck. A very sweet, sincere and romantic love, the reality of confusion and struggle; will we still have a future? A masterpiece on a cure for metropolitan affections, a bittersweet story is now online.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)
We are a cute fat meow and paper rabbit that likes eating, sleeping, more eating and more sleeping!

Mu Yiran, an orphan girl, died with hatred in the post-Apocalyptic era. After getting a rebirth by chance, she goes back to three days before Doomsday. In this life, she has managed to deal with the mistress and the guy who two-timed her. She has got a space for immortality cultivation and uses it to stock as many supplies as possible, but accidentally, she offends the strongest marshal of the post-Apocalyptic era. "Girl, you have no way to run!" The romantic story between the stone-faced marshal and the girl who is an immortality cultivator therefore begins.

(Source: WeComics)

title.romaji: Wo He Zhanan Zhuma You HE Le

description:
If I hadn't met my jerk husband, I would still be alive! I won't make the same mistake again... I'll just never marry him in the first place!

(Source: Toomics)

The short-lived geniuses who disappeared mysteriously in history have become the darkest secret of successful people. Those seeking their own happiness through other people’s lives are devils!

(Source: Webnovel)

Jump Wong—an infamous, poor little live streamer with zero gold coins—accepts his grandfather's request to transport a body to the Kunlun mountains! Unexpected and thrilling adventures happen along the way! The secret of the "bug" appearance and its extraordinary superpower will slowly be revealed. Just like before, it will be an amusing battle with superpowers! amid the excitement and nerve-racking times, there will be mystery and fun!

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Luna Xia summoned a devil to help retaliate against her classmates. However, she never expected to summon the Devil King! Suddenly, Luna's life starts to take off on a crazy roller coaster of events! Along the way, they attracted a succubus, angel, and knight. They jumped right past Luna's skepticism and went straight for the gas pedal!
Devil King Lucifer: Romance can't be romantic. How can it ever be romantic?
Luna: Can I return the product?
We don't accept returns. Please use with ease.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

After an accidental one night stand, she left 200 bucks for the man as compensation.

"We are strangers from now ooonnn - let me finish my sentence!"

"You want compensate me? Then 200 bucks are far more than enough...I want a lifetime with you!"

(Source: MangaToon)

A neighbourhood where strange and bizarre occurrences are common. Is there an ulterior motive behind these seemingly unrelated events? Are they evil spirits? Is it a ghost? Or is it greedy bottomless hearts? There is still hope. There is love, and only love can save us all!
In a world about to be destroyed...

Mu Su is a mobile game designer who is teleported to another world where using magic is the norm. To succeed in the new world and care for his little sister, he sells Qi-refining pills to earn money. With everyone vying to enter Xiuzhen University, Mu Su's finances skyrocket to new heights!

(Source: INKR)

“In the name of the Federation Command, I order you to withdraw. Otherwise, all-out war awaits you.”

“War?”

Gujin took a step forward. His form swelled against the wind, transforming in an instant from less than two meters tall into a chaotic demon god thousands of meters high. A white dwarf-like radiance emanated from him. His gravitational pull alone unleashed thunder and lightning, tidal waves, and storms across a thousand-mile radius. He reached out, and a hydrogen bomb fell into his hand.

“I think you should choose peace.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Youkai have their own way of life. Each youkai collects offerings from his own territory, while offering protection and delivering the occasional punishment. Until one day, when a major youkai descended from the heavens…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yao Bei E Long Chi Diao Le

description:
Legend has it that the Yan River's Dragon King demands the sacrifice of a young beauty every year. This time I, Cui Su, swear that I will rid him once and for all. However, why are things not turning out the way I expect them to? How did I end up cross dressing and becoming the dragon king's bride?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Angel Will Love You Instead of Me

description: The heart of Shao-Mi's dead boyfriend was transplant to another boy, that goes to another school -- Yi Tang-Yao. Like many other guys Ming Xiao Xi wrote about, he is tall, handsome, rich and cool... Shao-Mi did everthing to get close to Tan-Yao like doing his homework, run 1500 meters... Finally, Yi Tang-Yao accepted Shao-Mi and began to go out with her. But one day, Shao-Mi suddenly found out that her dead boyfriend's heart did not actually get transplanted onto Tan-Yao's body... and Yi Tang-Yao found out about the real reason that Shao-Mi wanted to get close to him...(source: Sherbet Lemon)

There was a young lady from an influential family that was famous for being a sloth. It was said that if she could lay down, she would not sit; and if she could sit, she would not stand. There was a young master from an influential family who was educated, talented, and had unparalleled good looks. However, the best-among-men young master was rumored to have an unmentionable disease?! Yang Zhaojun only wished to become a chamber's sloth, but unfortunately for her, the Gods had other plans. With a smile, she captivated the young master's heart. Would Zhaojun be willing to spend the rest of her life with him?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Wang Jiang is a regular teenager who loves playing PUBG, his cute little sister, and anime. He accidentally gets transported to ancient times and is saved by a strange old man named Gong Shang. Follow Wang Jiang as he is thrust in a dangerous world with a divine artifact to save the world!

(Source: INKR)
The demon king has awaken after his 500 years long slumber and he tries to destroy mankind. Now a little monk has to travel to look for 12 warriers with powers of the 12 chinese signs to fight him.

He reincarnated as a raven and flew out of hell itself, to find revenge on his enemies from his past life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A short story about Ali’s life. The first chapter shows how he used his nine lives. The second chapter reveals his parents who have passed away. The third chapter is about the continuous chain of love between animals; there is some gender identity mistakes in this one by the author. The fourth chapter highlights the past when he was with his mother. The fifth chapter is about the friend he had when young. And the last chapter is about the shadows which somehow feel like he is in his own world.

by Xu Han

Help! I'm in a hurry! Our CEO has a crush on me? But, what's the relationship between him and my brother?! As an entire brother complex, she always cares about her brother in every possible way. Being afraid that her brother might get hurt, everything about her brother would arouse her full attention. But why is there such a striking scene? Her brother sleeps in the nude with a man in the same bed?! When does her brother become a gay? How can this man take her brother from her? What’s more, this man is the CEO of the company where she’s going to take an interview...

(Source, Webcomics)

title.romaji: Yan Huang: Xiao Yuan Mi Yin

description: Mu Qian Ran, a sixteen year old girl, who had always set her heart onto studying the art of Chinese medicine, is excited as she has been accepted into her first choice of college, Yan Huang Advance technical school! At the same time, due to a mysterious portrait of a girl that no one could tell when was it drawn, Qian Ran is able to see illusions of fire. She ignores the incident, but this would start the unraveling of a great secret.

Zhao He transmigrated into a world of cultivation, but without any powers! So staying safe became his mantra! But while staying safe by hiding in the grass, he became possessed by the soul of the former Demon Lord, and now two souls will have to share one body! Lacking spiritual power, the Demon Lord forcibly used his body to cultivates demonic powers, breaking through to the next level. Lacking resources for further cultivation, the Demon Lord forcibly seized the treasures. Lacking a companion, the Demon Lord kidnapped the high priestess of the demonic sect to become his cultivation partner. All Zhao He could say to that was, "I must be a great guy to be so helpful!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: A Novel Way of Escaping Death

description:
What seemed like a casual slice-of-life story turned out to be very strange. Upon further examination, Qi Huantian found out that his mission wasn't as simple as playing out the story of the book he transmigrated into. There are multiple intertwined plot lines, tricky easter eggs planted by the author, and a connection between the FMC and the real world. One misstep and he'll lose out. Did you really think you can escape from your harem of death?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Cheng Shan, a mysterious one-armed young man, travels around the world with his companion, a young girl named Ming Cai, in search of a miraculous medicine, the "Faded Dragon Scale". The theft of the black umbrella from the imperial palace resulted in heavy sins. Due to past relations to the black umbrella, Cheng Shan and Ming Cai decide to search for the black umbrella and recover it. However, after several twists and turns where their lives were in danger, they find that the matter is not as simple as they thought. Will Cheng Shan finally be able to unravel all mysteries and distinguish good from evil? Will he be able to escape unscathed from the lethal threats and dangers lurking in every corner, and eventually find the Faded Dragon Scale? dragon? Or, is there a greater conspiracy behind this? In this life, he is destined to be unable to hide and have no other option but to fight with his life because he is... The Craftsman.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

It’s said that the Great Demon Lord Satan once went to the world of humans to train, however he was eaten by the humans after he passed out in a desert. Feared of the humans, many demons refused to wander the world of humans. In order to become a Super-Mega-Demon Lord, our prince Lucifer finally decides to wander the world of humans to collect 10 billion devil points.

(Source: OSTNT)

In the 17th year of the glorious republic, Sun Dianying dug underneath the coffin of Empress Dowager Cixi in the Eastern Qing tombs to find a hidden stone door below, which was guarded by a monster who feasts on the flesh of humans. It is said that by feeding it, you would be allowed access to the stone door and possibly immortality. Our hero embarks on a journey to find the Soul Burial Door, uncovering secrets of the Qing Dynasty along the way.

The schools have fallen and the teachers no longer have control. One teacher, Jang Oh-ja, arrives at Volcano High. Other than making Jang Hak-sa angry he took the job of principal, Oh-ja is rumored to carry the Teachers Memorandum; a mythical item that can make the wielder Number One of the Martial Arts Academies. The student body soon become aware and vie for the position of Number One.
Meanwhile, a group of rogue teachers are hoping to use the power of Lightning & Thunder to instill powers to another. However, their plans go wrong when the Lightning & Thunder misses and strikes a little boy instead. When Kim Kyung-soo is struck, the teachers don't expect him to live. They advised Kyung-soo's father that if he should live, he should not attend school because of the jealousy and hate he'll get. Years later, the teachers are aware that Kyung-soo lived and has received powers and they now want to expel him. He is set up and must transfer to the last school who'll accept him: Volcano High.

Source: MU

Gao Miaomiao was finally going to meet her online friend after chatting for more than a year. When she found Pu Xu at the meeting spot holding the sign, she never expected him to be so different from his gentle and easy-going online personality. She wanted to stay away from that cold and distant Pu Xu, but when they had to cooperate for a school assignment, she slowly realized the shining qualities of this diamond in the rough, as they helped each other to resolve the issues hidden deep in their hearts.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Hi, your hater just sent you a date request~
This is a Tsundere bottom who thinks himself poweful enough to control the top. Yet, the situation changed at just one moment! My innocent boy, you never know how scheming the top is!

(Source: MangaToon)

"Exorcists" are the protectors of the human world with sole responsibility to deal with the evil demons that come from the magic world.... Lan Ximing, a normal student, unexpectedly meets a demon named Nilu and a fantastic journey unfolds before them. Here lies an unimaginable tale that is just waiting to be experienced!

Could it be that Snow White?s stepmother is naturally just an evil woman? Where did her magical mirror come from? And unexpectedly her magic mirror is a handsome supernatural being? You Gui Xiu will tell you the unknown tale of the evil queen.

Leaving her hometown to study at Wuhan High School, young Xiaoxi did not expect such a drastic change. Lost in the hustle and bustle of this big city, she feels less herself, less gifted and less legitimate than her classmates. Her meeting with Yan Huan, the most beautiful girl in the school, and Lin'an, the brilliant student, will allow her to flourish in this new environment, but will also confront her with the emotions of adolescence...

(Translation of the French edition)

This work is full of super sweet snippets of love, beware of dental cavities!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Once upon a time there was an innocent and straightforward little Aries girl.

After being targeted by a black-bellied Leo boy who used food to lure her, she couldn't resist the Leo boy at all!

The boy said : "I'm determined to be there whenever you need me. I'll be with you wherever you eat and drink, and I'll even finish all the vegetables you hate. I'll do my best to make you happy, so just be with me."

The girl said : "Follow me."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The Thousand-Eyed Carp, a monster that lives forever, has a desire to leave this world. However in her attempts to do so, she keeps getting saved again and again by humans. Because of the acts of kindness displayed by humans, she gradually dispells this idea, fully integrating into the human society.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wan Ren Xian Chongsheng Hou Huobao Quan Wang
title.english: Coming Back as a Fair-Haired Boy
title.native: 万人嫌重生后火爆全网

description:
After living his last life betrayed by a scumbag, framed by a rival, criticized by the netizens, and ended up dying miserably in a car accident, Kyan Lim decides to focus on his career when he gets a second chance at life. But he soon discovers that Faye Gu, the famous business tycoon, was the mysterious man who took care of him in his final moments.

(Source: WebComics)

To be immortal has always been the long-held wish of every emperor. The job of the Long-life Hall is to collect methods for the emperor to live forever, such as developing secret recipes, catching rare animals, refining medicinal pills, seeking and visiting Immortals. Even if there's just a glimmer of hope, we must try our best to find it and test it.

(Source: Webnovel)

Jiang Xue has transferred from school to school ever since she was young, out of specific reasons. This summer, she meets Xia Zhi, our male lead who turns her world upside down. She also meets Shi Haitian who is crazy about her. A story full of youth, dreams, ​and basketball is just about to unfold.

(Source: Webcomics)

The Han siblings, the brother and sister who stayed secluded, have embarked on a journey because of a dream.In her dream realm, there are thousands of species, and the people are ethereal and beautiful.There is warmth and coldness in them; there is love and hatred; there is affection and resentment. Most importantly, they are waiting for her arrival.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

She, who can see monsters, meets him, who has lived for a thousand years and longs for a quick death. He's the only one who can protect her, expelling monsters for her. A spiritual agreement reveals their entanglements from the previous life. "Protecting you is the only reason that I live..."

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Wei! Edu Zhang Gongzhu Kaishi Lianai Nao
title.native: 危！恶毒长公主开始恋爱脑

description:
The queen of a doomed dynasty transmigrated into the body of the princess of the Yun Kingdom. Turns out the princess is spoiled and lustful, with a large harem of men, and she just broke the leg of the main villain of the story! She realized that once the villain takes over, she will be tortured and executed in the most painful way. Wait, give her a chance, she can be a good girl! She can turn her fate around!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Abigail Canler lived a life of tragedy, helpless as she lost her loved ones and the world was destroyed. When time rewound, she swore to take revenge and alter history. But how? Tangled in the strings of fate, she meets the captivating asura of the battlefield, who also happens to be the cursed crown prince that met an early demise in her past life! Together, they hold the key to saving the world, but he's destined to die in three years! Is history doomed to rewrite itself, or will she succeed?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Poetry of Love and War

description:
A humble slave girl marries in place of someone else to a prince of the enemy country with demon bloodline, embarking on a journey of struggle towards the pinnacle of power. Can the conspiracy hidden behind be uncovered? Will everything the girl pursues come true?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

After the system awakens, one beautiful woman after another awaits their fated binding for dual cultivation. Loli? Mature woman? Jiang Mao loves to make female demons submit and command maids with a whip. All enchantresses heed my command!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 只有恋爱才能防止黑化

description:
A high school girl is transported into a game world and transformed into a ten-year-old girl. She got a mission to develop a relationship with the prince regent who always killed her in the final of the game. Therefore, she had to start to win his affection when he was still a nobody. However, he despised her very much, which made the mission more difficult...

(Source: Webnovel)

The God of Rainy Days finally saved enough vacation days for a three-year sabbatical in the human realm, and he was just starting his new life on earth, when he ran into his new neighbor who was dying from hunger. Unable to just leave her alone, he took her in and cooked dinner for her, and he thought that would be the last of it. But despite their very different daily routines, the two of them became closer when she invited him over for a meal to repay his kindness, and his secret identity as a god was exposed! The seemingly ordinary life between two neighbors seems to have become a fantastic story…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A story about the moon rabbit and his adventure as a human, sent to rejoin a broken red string of fate.

Note: Originally published in 畫匣子 vol. 5.

Legend says...
There was a white dragon living in River Long En, preventing floods, and bringing rain. People worshiped him, and hailed him as the "Lord of the River".
By coincidence, he finds out that Long En Town's annual "River Lord Festival" has been abandoned for years. Angered, the River Lord Huan Yi, swears that Long En town will never see another drop of rain.
What appears in the pond of the River God's Palace, however, is something he doesn't expect...

title.romaji: Chong Sheng Nüe Zha: Jiao Yang Bingshan Zongcai
title.english: Revenge After Respawn: Spoil the Iceburg President
title.native: 重生虐渣：娇养冰山总裁

description:
In her first life, she was ruined by her then boyfriend and her best friend. Reborn into her second life, she gave everything she had to take revenge but lost the man she loved the most. But they say "the third time is the charm". This rebirth, not only will she get her revenge, she will also save the man she loves most and tie the knot with him.

(Source: Webcomics, edited)

This story happens in a cultivation world, Gu Qing He arrived in "Ark" during a time of crisis. "Ark" wanted to bestow incredible powers to Gu Qing He and thus started to modify him. After that, Qing He found out that his original world has actually already been infiltrated by the [Old Gods], overturning all the cognition he possesses since young.

With a danger that can arrive anytime. The Forged Immortal begins his journey, going against the ruling of the [Old Gods], changing the ending of the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Hou Ye Bu Chong Wo

description:
"Every month, the Duke I serve needs to drink...blood! What do I do?"

By a twist of fate, Su Li, a cunning young girl, was bought by the cold, proud Duke as a cure to his lust for human blood. Set in the most terrifying estate in the capital, witness a hilarious performance of love and hate.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Shuohao Zuo Kepu, Fensi Que Quan Shi Monu?
title.native: 说好做科普，粉丝却全是魔女？

description:
Aspiring to be a science-popularizing content creator, Xie Pu transmigrates to a different world—a place where only women possess magic, and magic equals productivity and power! Starting with a disastrous situation, Xie Pu teams up with the weak and impoverished lord, the "Calamity Witch" Lena. Unexpectedly, he rises to prominence, spreading science and spearheading production and construction in this new world. A double harvest of career success and romance?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

Rowan Zhou is an infamous playboy in showbiz and everyone is convinced he doesn't care about anyone... Until a certain video of him went viral. Like a devotee, Rowan's fingers clenched around the woman's thin wrist as his eyes flared with passion. "Please, Yvonne…"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: He E Quan Zhangfu De Xiangchu Faze
title.native: 和恶犬丈夫的相处法则

title.romaji: Wuqing Da Lao Bei Wannong Hou Zhi Hui Ying Ying Ying
title.native: 无情大佬被玩弄后只会嘤嘤嘤

description:
Out of the blue, Jiang Yu transmigrates into a xiuxian novel. But who decided that she only deserves to be a small fry who barely even counts as cannon fodder in the novel? And why is she suddenly bound to a useless retribution system? She's not only the bottom-of-the-barrel weakest of the weak, but she's also a tiny black sheep who gets made an example of in the first few chapters of the book!

And yet, Jiang Yu is not entirely helpless. Using her quick wit and cunning, she forges out the path of a self-reliant, feminist-ideal heroine when they least expect it.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Jian Ye, a damsel in distress, sought to pay her debts. Through her natural ability to see food spirits, she became a painting master and a gourmet influencer. She cures Ou Jinnian, the influential figure of the IT industry, from his feminophobia and anorexia. He lodged himself straight in her house, making her cook for him, paint for him and started to tease her. Yet, she does not remember a past where she saved his life, and how Ou had fallen in love with her many years ago...

title.romaji: Wo Chengle Kexue Jiade Lianai Shiyan Pin
title.english: I Became a Scientist's Romance Guinea Pig
title.native: 我成了科学家的恋爱实验品

description:
“Your IQ is high. But can your EQ get any lower?”

Chronically single Bai DuoDuo sneaks a picture in a seminar. Little does she know, that picture gets her into a whole world of trouble. Now, she’s being forced to marry a tall, handsome, and well-off scientist. However, the more she looks at him the more she dislikes him.

(Source: Comikey)

Through continuous efforts, Wen Xilin has turned the gentle senior who she used to have a crush on into her own... boss! It wasn't until she became his subordinate that she felt how harsh he is and fell into all kinds of strange rumors! Although I still like him, it's now time to quit. You said Xiao Nanhe also has a crush on me?! Do you think I'll believe it!

(Source: BiliBili, translated)

The universe started as a big joke. A poke from the Staff of Creation released immense amounts of sarcasm and chuuni energy, which combined into memes, which then formed everything in the universe.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

"Your fiancée will be coming back soon, isn't she? She'll be hanging all over you, as usual."

"Your little boyfriend is always hanging around here every day. So we're even."

The bickering couple share the same bed, but they didn't know that these "other people" were only lies they told each other to fool themselves.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the world of Zhonghua Ziku, each citizen is a Chinese character, who must live according to the meaning of the character, and no singular radicals are allowed. At the Zian Hall academy, the character "Chou" is shunned and bullied because it means "ugly." One day "Chou" met the radical "Hand," who was trying to escape capture, and they decide to work together to uncover the conspiracy behind the mysterious organization Liezitang. Combined, they now form the character "Niu," and they will embark on an adventure to change the world, like the meaning of their character.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

I accidentally transmigrated into the body of the Lady Protector of the Xuanyuan Dynasty, and I now have three husbands and four concubines! However, these husbands of mine are either hostages or spies who are all pawns of political marriages! This is terrible! I have to divorce all of them! All. Of. Them. Yet, after I have finally gotten rid of those freeloaders at home, another husband turns up? No! No way! I want my freedom! Why would I want to keep so many men?

(Source: Webnovel)

Prince Jing'an, decisive and ruthless, is known as the foremost nobleman in the State of Mo. It is widely believed that he harbors an intense aversion toward women. Little do they know, he only has his feelings for one person. The very girl who makes him angry and leaves him with no room for resistance.

(Source: Webnovel)

Amidst the chaos of a shattered life, Yu Zhou faces a crisis: discouragement that threatens her career as a writer. Everything seems to be falling apart — until an unexpected encounter changes her course. Xiang Wan, a mysterious and resilient woman who claims to have traveled back in time from Imperial China, appears in her life as a breath of hope.

With her ancestral courage and peculiar vision of the modern world, she helps Yu Zhou find the strength to move forward. However, fate has another surprise in store: Yu Zhou's literary work is adapted into an audio drama, and the protagonist chosen to give voice to the story is none other than Su Chang, her ex-girlfriend. The reunion of the two rekindles dormant memories and feelings, creating a delicate emotional triangle.

title.romaji: Jue Mei Yaonu Dui Wo Yubabuneng
title.english: The Beautiful Witch Can’t Get Enough of Me
title.native: 绝美妖女对我欲罢不能

description:
Armed with the mystical Linglong Tower in one hand and a super-charged palm in the other, our protagonist dominates the urban landscape, capturing demons and subduing spirits. Whether it’s a slit-mouthed woman, a cat-faced girl, or a ghostly figure in white—no supernatural entity stands a chance against his command!

(Source: Webnovel)

Sophia's marriage life had never been about tranquility and happiness but betrayal of her husband and abuse from his family. She chose to put up with it all for the sake of her own family. After three years of torture, she finally decided to give her husband a taste of his own medicine by sleeping with a random man. However, she never expected that the man she messed up with was someone not to be trifled with.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Shou Shi Tian Chong: Wo Zai Yi Jie Dang Yu Shen
title.english: Sweet Love in Beast World: I Become A Rain Goddess In A Bizarre Realm
title.native: 兽世甜宠：我在异界当雨神

description:
Lin Mingyue, a brilliant modern bio researcher, stumbles into a fish tank during her quest for new species. But instead of a splash, she plunges into a primitive beast world's scorching desert. There, she accidentally unlocks the mystical "Rainfall Buff". She must complete the perilous "Desert Oasis" mission assigned by the system and retrieve treasures from four tribes to return home. In this bizarre realm of beasts, Lin Mingyue becomes the object of desire for males, while countless jealous females plot against her. How can she navigate treacherous waters, fulfill her mission, assemble a harem of handsome men, and outwit the villainous superficial whores?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Fengsao Mowang Dianming Yao Wo Zuo Wangfei
title.english: The Sultry Demon King Wants Me
title.native: 风骚魔王点名要我做王妃

description:
Nebi, the chief saintess of the Holy Order, is forced to bear the heavy responsibility of fighting against the demon race. But Tatos, the feared leader of the demons, desires an intimate relationship with her. Tilo, the knight assigned to protect her, lacks common sense and insists on being guarded 24/7 and is even willing to give his body. Nebi originally wanted to hide, but did not expect that Tatos turned into a human appearing in the Holy Order, using various ways to lure her into his trap…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Yuan Lai Jiu Zai Wo Shenbian
title.english: True Love was Right Beside Me

description:
This was originally a relaxing island trip, but she accidentally fell into the situation of being hunted down with a mysterious handsome man, and even was framed into the police station by him. How will this unhappy encounter turn out?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Furen Ta Chengle Dalao Men De Tuan Chong
title.native: 夫人她成了大佬们的团宠

description:
When Lan Jin went back to her own world three years later, she found that her reputation was ruined. What's more, she had five fiancés and five sons who came from five time-travel worlds. She was not a loser anymore. And all the heroes loved her.

(Source: Webnovel)

Flower shop owner Xia Lan takes on Qin Mo, a guy who claims to have money to burn, as an employee. As a smooth talker, he's helped attract many customers to the business. Soon afterwards, more cute guys show up out of nowhere, offering to work for free. And it's all because of Qin Mo?

(Source: WebComics)

At the behest of his father, Qin Wenyu went to Japan, where he came into contact with a strange curse that caused him to enter a dream. Soon, he realized that he had been cursed as well, A Noh mask, Shinjya, had thus materialized, and he had also obtained Nine-Eyed Magatama. The curses were divided into five color categories: gray, white, black, blue, and red. Every cursed person would have his own Noh mask. Before the start of the next curse, the cursed would be contacted by the psychic hosting the feast and asked to participate. There was only one way to end the curse: collect all nine Nine-Eyed Magatamas…

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Shixie Baojun Jing Shi Wo Qianfu

description:
Lin Lei wakes up as Grace Gottlieb, her favorite character from a tragic novel. The bad news? Grace is destined to be murdered by her husband, a bloodthirsty tyrant. The worse news? Grace is currently only five years old. Trapped in a child's body, her plan to escape her gruesome fate by divorcing him is dead on arrival.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: The Duke's Cute and Tough Sweetheart

description:
Ye Liusha had a blind date with a man, but surprisingly, the man was the young uncle of her ex-boyfriend, and he insisted on marrying her. What should she do?
He said, "If you marry me, you'll be the Duchess, and your ex-boyfriend will have to call you aunt."
"Aunt?! Okay!" she said excitedly.
So, Ye Liusha married Murong Mobai. However, what she didn't expect was that, although her husband always looked aloof and serious, he was actually lively, tricky, and jealous inside! His brain was filled with all kinds of ways to "trick" her into doing it with him.
What could she do now? Run away with her baby of course!

(Source: Webnovel)

Princess Lena, the future queen of Kimshirt, was injured and lost her memory in an assassination attempt. She met Dante, the king of the Kingdom of Drakona, under the guidance of fate. With fragments of memories flooding into her dreams and intimate nicknames appearing in her mind, mysteries emerged one after another, all hinting at a complicated past between her and King Dante...

(Source: Webnovel)

In the tea town called Jasmine Hill, a monster called “ ⁇ ” by the world suddenly appeared, causing disaster to the village. Although the sisters —— Roy and Luo Changtuan survived, they had to embark on a journey to survive. However, what is waiting for them is a layer of mist and despair, and the only trace of dawn.

Lies! They were all lies! The scriptures were a lie! The Western Paradise was a lie! Even universal salvation was all just a lie! Back then, the Westbound Team perished while on a pilgrimage in search of holy scriptures. The so-called "Eighty-One Tribulations" were just eighty-one different paths to death. So, aspiring pilgrims, do you still dare… to embark on this journey to the west?

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Legend has it that in the past, the demon king, Queen Mother of the West, led her hordes on a rampage, plunging the world into endless darkness. Three sorcerers, fearing their own lives, joined forces to defeat the demon king. With the demons leaderless, peace gradually returned to the world. However, the shadow lurking behind this peace may not dissipate with the demon king's demise...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Qin Shinan reunites with Chi Chuan, her high school crush. She remains the wealthy heiress she always was, while he has become an underground boxer. As they cross paths again, what sparks will fly between them? Meanwhile, long-buried secrets from their past begin to surface...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The devil’s soul comes into a pathetic young man’s body, making the young man have two souls in one body! With the devil’s soul, nobody is a match for him! With a man’s soul, he can’t defeat anyone… Let’s see how Li Yulan embarks on his journey of recasting heaven and earth step by step with the coexistence of two souls!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Flora traveled through spacetime with a heart attack into the Comic World. When she woke up, she found her icon, Edmund lying on top of her!! “Hey! Get out!”

(Source: WebComics)

The unparalleled girl Liang Xi is the illegitimate daughter of an important official. The official takes Liang Xi back to the residence after the death of his wife. The elder daughter Yu Yan is jealous of Liang Xi's beauty and talents and orders her subordinates to sell Liang Xi to the brothel. But fortunately, she was rescued. Yu Yan is even more jealous of her and plots to get rid of Liang Xi. It is a gorgeous court story, in the Forbidden City filled with schemes and plots, love and miracles surge…

(Source: INKR)

After time travel, Ye Xuan got a devouring system,, which can devour anything in the world and offer him bloodline, martial techniques, pills, treasure for exchange... That's simply awesome! Pick me up again, I will devour your sword!

(Source: MangaToon)

In a car accident, Ling Cheng activated a magical delivery system. Get a 5-star rating, and you'll be able to redeem all kinds of skills in the system. So, here comes a super delivery guy!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Coming-of-age Ceremony of A Devil

description:
Signing a contract with the homebody Liu Liang through Internet, the Little Demon Boni was summoned to the human world, she didn’t realize that she was involved in the war between the deity world and the demon world...

(Source: WebComics)

If the legend that says Chang'e flew to the Moon is true, the elixir of life really exists, and you must kill to survive... Will you fight alongside your Immortal Spirit against old deities? A doomed young man embarks on a journey to find his little sister, only to watch the flight he took crash. In the moment between life and death, he has a vision of the immortal tomb in the Moon Palace and forms a contract with Chang'e. From now on, he is the master of Chang'e and the only way for him to survive is to fight other Immortal Spirits to the death... An ethereal figure takes shape in the Moon Palace! Tonight, the goddess of the Moon makes an appearance...

When she was betrayed by her fiancé and sister, she was so grief-stricken that she agreed to a blind CEO's unexpected love confession. She became his babysitter before realizing she wasn't privy to the full picture. He needs someone to feed him, dress him, bring him his towel when he forgets them in the shower, and cuddle him at night. Thus begins a marriage on unequal terms...

(Source: WebComics)

The beast-like CEO is trying to lure me into his bed! As a man with a beast inside, is there still hidden tender love? For all those days, I have been sharing a room with the beast, and I end up getting to know more of his kind…how could I keep my chastity after accidently stepping into the beast lair?

(Source: Webnovel)

"Li Buhui was forced to marry her crush Xia Yusheng, but his heart only belongs to Wen Zhirou"

They are the three best friends growing up together, but have three different lives perspectively. It's a tangled and cheesy love triangle. Three years ago, someone framed her and made her vanish from sight. Three years later, when they met again, he still hated her. It took her three full years to forget him, but she still couldn't give up her desire to see him. She planned to see him for one last time, but an unexpected conspiracy was lurking around...

(Source: Comikey)

Can love be reignited between the woman who has lost all memories of her past lover and the heartbroken man who was forgotten?

(Source: Lalatoon)

He is a martial arts master, internationally renowned, a god in martial arts, capable of killing a person within ten steps; he is a knowledgeable antique expert, skilled in gambling on stones and appreciating paintings, with a collection that can rival a nation's wealth; he is a highly reputed master in the esoteric arts, able to discern feng shui, good at detecting good and bad omens, equally respected by Buddhism and Taoism. Furthermore, he is a medical expert, the king of scouting, and a genius investor! His name is Zhang Jun. With a fortunate occurrence, he received Buddha’s eye relic and from then on, he has appreciated women from all over the world!

(Source: MangaToon)

Lin’s life is about to be over. After failing to pitch her comic book over 110 times, she’s broke and—worst of all—she’s 26-year-old and doesn’t even have a boyfriend yet! That is until a young college boy rents her extra room and begins staying with her. Well, that solves some of her problems anyway.

Under the eaves of this small home, two people share their joys, their struggles, and learn to share their lives together.

title.romaji: Wo Shi Gui Zhaijing Ji Ren

description:
Here lies the ultimate horror! A mysterious app, a series of eerie properties. I'm a real estate agent—what I sell are haunted houses where all manner of strange occurrences have taken place.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"If you don't want your fake identity exposed to the world, then complete my seven little demands, Qi ChaoYue."

[Dominant Sadistic Queen True Heiress X Submissive Masochistic Tsundere Fake Heiress]

Despite how much she hates these outrageous demands, her body seems to be falling deeper into this world...

In this world, there are countless immortal monsters that feed on the life-force of humans. For thousands of years, sorcerers have been trying defeat them to no avail until the appearance of the San Zhen school of sorcery. Three disciples fight against the undead "simultaneously" across three eras. They are the only hope of victory in the battle between the living and the dead.

title.romaji: Xianzi, Ni You Da Xiong Zhi Zhao!

description:
Transmigrating into a world of immortal cultivation, Wang Xiu discovered that he could see the "Trial of Life-and-Death" in others people. By helping them survive the ominous signs, he could also replicate their abilities. So, whenever someone faced danger, Wang Xiu would swoop in to save the day. After thousands of years, almost every cultviator, sage, fairy, and witch owed Wang Xiu their lives…

Immortal Dan: Senpai has saved me nine times. I have nothing to repay such great kindness except for my own body!
Sword Saint: Senpai has saved me thirty-two times. It's only fair that I should bear him thirty-two children, no?
White Empress: We were saved 108 times. Are you sure you want to compete with us?
Emperor of Heaven: Senpai has saved his emperor 321 times. I am the one most qualified to stand by his side!!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jiu Xihuan Ni Kanbuguan Wo You Gan Bu Diao Wo De Yangzi
title.native: 就喜欢你看不惯我又干不掉我的样子

description: A house cat with a superiority complex.

Gin is a tall private eye with a dangerous side project crafting potent drugs for mobsters. He's also an inept swordsman whose most powerful tool is... bluffing. Gin's about to get his butt handed to him when a short but deadly fighter named Ian rescues him with a ridiculously large weapon — just who is this shorty?! Despite Gin's best efforts to eject this annoying (albeit talented) kid from his life, danger knocks on their door. They've got big cases to solve and bigger secrets to discover.

(Source: Tapas)

Nite: Chapter count includes prologue.

Playboy prince Zhan Rong got married in his childhood due to an unexpected mistake while the cross-dressing Yan Jifeng cultivated her hatred. Due to an arson Yan Jifeng becomes Zhan Rong's bodyguard until the assassin can be found, however the assassin is none other than Zhan Rong himself. After a series of dangerous events, Zhan Rong finds himself developing feelings for Yan Jifeng leading him to think that he is gay!

(Source: Weibo Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Fen Wei Er De Yichan
title.english: Fatal Choice: Legacy Torn in Two

description:
Cheng Sheng's lover, Wei Hongze, is suddenly shot to death, and only left behind his two sons with different personalities - Wei Tianheng and Wei Tianchu.

Cheng Sheng is responsible for taking care of these two people, and will distribute the legacy to the better person between them in accordance with the will.

As time goes by, Cheng Sheng gradually realises that these two have changed...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Taking place during the Republican era, the trials and tribulations between the young master of a prominent family and a mute uncle not blood-related to him.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

No one could guess that the two largest companies in town are run by a werewolf and a vampire, who also happen to be childhood friends. The werewolf has loved the vampire since forever, and to take their relationship to the next level, he volunteers to be an assistant slash slave to the vampire. And that's how their love story begins...

(Source: WebComics)

As the climate gets warmer, the ice sheet in the Arctic Ocean is slowly melting, and the ancient virus that laid dormant for billions of years in the permafrost of Siberia is gradually awakening... Facing two young men from the distant past with advanced technology, the life of the ordinary girl Liu Zitian is about to get very exciting...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After a series of unfortunate events, the poor debt collector Ning Caicheng was forced to spend the night in a haunted temple. There he met the ghost of a beautiful woman Nie Xiaoqian. To help free her soul, he will have to fight off an evil tree demon.

(Source: Shuipan Workshop, translated)

Manhua adaptation of the 1987 Hong Kong fantasy movie "A Chinese Ghost Story" directed by Tony Ching Siu-Tung

Lin Mu grew up with his sister, Lin Chao, who is congenitally deaf. He is the "little sun" that illuminates the lives of those around him. Meanwhile, the tall and handsome Lu Rong lost both his parents at a tender age and had since been living with his grandmother who has Alzheimer's disease. He was forced to grow up quickly at an age when he should have been ignorant and oblivious.

Kunqian, an institution that provides learning opportunities for the special community, is where their worlds collide. One a silent soul, and the other a blazing firecracker. With a bunch of schoolmates—a deaf-mute, a visually impaired person, a cerebral palsy patient—they embark together on their chapter of youth.

"Lu Rong, you don't have to put your guard up around me as if I'm some kind of a thief. I have a sister. I get it."
"Okay."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

What are Chinese folktales? They are ancient legends passed down by word of mouth, the distillation of a thousand years of folk wisdom. They collect the people's life experiences and imaginations, weaving their emotions into short stories. They represent hundreds and thousands of years of intelligence and inspiration from the Chinese people. Sima Gonggong brings six such stories to life, finding inspiration in the historical stories to express the difficulties of daily life such as greed, anger, obsession, and evil. Some will face difficulty and loss, others will gain fame and riches. Some will do good even in poverty, while others will betray good intentions. That is the legend of "Dao."

(Source: Baike, translated)

It's just a story about a clueless leader and his worthless underlings shamelessly playing around and saving the world. An otaku loser suddenly became the leader of an empire, blessed with a charm that allowed him to collect lolis. This is a slapstick comedy about an otaku and his useless army...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The school bully has a nemesis—a rival in love who likes to snitch. The worst thing is that his nemesis is bad at recognizing faces and is oblivious to everything he does. Move aside, love rival. You're in the way of me pursuing my dream girl!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.romaji: An Lian: Ju Sheng Huai Nan

description:
A love so deep, yet no one will ever know. A childhood encounter was enough for Luo Zhi to secretly pine for Sheng Huainan for the next eleven years. Every time he appeared, he was like a shining star to her. Ever since, Luo Zhi's diary has been devoted to recording memories of him. Because of Sheng Huainan, Luo Zhi followed him to the same university. Finally, by coincidence, Luo Zhi will get the chance to get closer to Sheng Huainan…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When a sly fox meets a slyer one, the hunter becomes the hunted.

""Seeing this letter is like seeing me in person. Last night, I had a dream within a dream, and in that dream, you were there. Waking up from both layers of sleep, it felt like I lost you twice, and I was filled with great unease. Enclosed with this letter is also a blank piece of Xuan paper, as white and pure as the moonlight when I thought of you last night."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Gayan was a villain whose task was to sharpen the male leads, molding them into the suitable protagonists. However, the protagonists he encountered had various quirks, and none of them showed the slightest desire to aim high. They remained indifferent even when Gayan walked all over them. Gayan had no choice but to change his approach. He worked tirelessly to gain the protagonists' trust and affection, only to betray them afterward. Gayan plotted various schemes such as stabbing the protagonists, trapping them, and more. As expected, the protagonists grew and became supreme heroes clad with immense powers. Gayan was very satisfied as none of them could take revenge on him. He would then move on to the next world upon completing his quest as a villain. All was well until the day Gayan completed every last quest.

It was then the system spoke to him, “Your quest will only be deemed completed when you’ve returned to every single world you had ever set foot on and survive for a decade.” Gayan turned quiet before saying, “Run that by me again,” to which the system replied, “You are to return to every single world you’ve completed quests and stay alive for ten years.” Gayan, "&#￥#￥#!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Bu Jianmian Jiu Buneng Lianai ma

description:
As an anti-social hikikomori vampire, Max's favorite thing to do is watching an angel's livestream! When the present Max carefully prepared was damaged in transit, the one who came to process his refund claim was that angel streamer Feiluo himself! Unfortunately, Max made a mess out of their first meeting! Now the vampire must embark on a long journey to reclaim the angel's favor…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

She married him to please her parents, but after half a year, he had never even touched her. Meanwhile, a mistress stands in her way, and an old flame makes a reappearance. As trouble brews, tensions rise and misunderstandings grow rampant, she's had enough! Divorce papers signed, she leaves and later becomes a jewelry designer—only for them to meet again so he can declare domineeringly, "You're mine".

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A story of the desire, love, power, and conspiracy behind the glitz of the prosperous Tang Dynasty.

Originally known as "Kaiyuan Yi Wen Lu", this is a political thriller. It's not BL, not BL, not BL! The protagonist just enjoys gay sex.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Jin Xu, a 20-year-old college graduate x Xiao Ran, a 32-year-old blind broadcaster.

Although they are of the same gender, the two live completely different lifestyles and happened to meet by chance. In the process of getting along with each other, they both are impressed and drawn to each other's strengths. Jin Xu's bright aura allows Xiao Ran to feel the light he is unable to see. However, Jin Xu doesn't feel the same about Xiao Ran, who is talented and beautiful. Something unexpected happens...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Six chapters were released before being removed from both Bilibili and Kuaikan Manhua.

It was the most humiliating era of Chinese history. During those desperate times, there was a group of true heroes, who fought valiantly and gave up their lives, only to be seen as losers and treated with disdain by their own people over the next century. On the 120th anniversary of First Sino-Japanese War, we reject those prejudices, and with this work, commemorate the loyalty and courage of those brave souls.

(Source: Author's Foreword, translated)

The passage of Time is one of the many things that we often take for granted. What if tomorrow never comes? Or are the events that occurred yesterday real or are they just a figment of imagination?
