A woman had a strange dream as she awaited the moment of her baby's delivery in the hospital. In that bizarre and strange nightmare, her child from the future came back in time to murder her unborn baby.
She did not know if the nightmare was true as she tried push aside her premonition that the dream meant something ominous, until the Guardian of Time Liu Ya appeared before her. But what would become of her and her unborn child!?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Kao Da Lao Wen Zhu Nan Tuan C Wei
title.english: Boss Makes the Boy Group's Center of Me

description:
The influential A-list female artist Ye Xian becomes a vicious character with the same name in the novel "Proud Best Actor Only Favors Me." In this novel, she disguises herself as a boy in the hero's boy group to pester the hero, bullies the heroine, sabotages the relationship between the hero and heroine, and finally dies a tragic death. To avoid the sad demise, Ye Xian decides to stay away from the hero and heroine, work hard as a boy, turn the tables by virtue of her appearance and strength, and attract thousands of fans. Ye Xian thinks her future will be bright, but she accidentally "offends" Bo Tingshen, the top boss who helps the hero in the novel. As an amateur in romantic relationships, Ye Xian is unaware of Bo Tingshen's crazy love and intense possessiveness, resulting in many awkward situations…

(Source: Webnovel)

Yi just wants his romantic happily ever after with a handsome alpha. Unfortunately, he’s so tall for an omega that everyone thinks he’s an alpha. When he finally starts dating Keyao, a handsome, heroic, and kind alpha, his romance plans are back on track… until Keyao’s unexpected aversion to omegas spells the end of Yi’s dreamy dating life. But the two can’t seem to avoid each other and when back luck lands Yi in Keyao’s spare bedroom, will romance spark anew?!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.romaji: Jiazhuang Shiyi Hou Qingdi Shuo Wo Shi Ta De Nanpengyou
title.native: 假装失忆后情敌说我是他的男朋友

description:
Can two rival Alphas end up as a couple? Ask Cloud Ling, who gets hit by a car while escaping loan sharks. The driver? None other than his ex-rival, Marius Ji! Their journey from childhood friends to estranged rivals takes a dramatic turn when Cloud feigns amnesia to avoid an awkward reunion, only for Marius to insist that they're boyfriends! As Cloud grapples with this bizarre claim, he wonders: Is this mishap a stroke of luck, reigniting a long-lost bond, or are some chapters best left closed?

(Source: Tapas)

The Plain-Looking, Mushroom-Haired Xiao Ming had always been a simple soul. Yet under his cousin's influence, this unassuming boy developed a fascination with the “visual style.” After his cousin's car accident, an unexpected encounter upended his simple life. The drumming skills he'd honed since childhood under his parents' “cultivating talents” program finally got their chance to shine. Having joined a visual kei band through a series of twists and turns, just how far can he go? Stay tuned!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: Obsessive CEO, Please Let Me Go

description:
To save her father, she has no choice but to accept a marriage arranged by her family. On the night of her engagement, the man she once secretly loved reappears. Now, he is the powerful figure behind the Royalcore Corporation and the man responsible for her father’s downfall. Cold and cruel in public, he secretly watches over and protects her…

(Source: WebComics)

Five years ago, she was framed by her cousin and sent to a strange man's bed. But she thought the man was the one she loved. Then she was pregnant and dumped. She decided to raised that kid by herself, however, due to an accident, she miscarried. Five years later, a child she met who brought the truth of the conspiracy to surface...

(Source: Webcomics)

As a super popular school doctor, Cheng Yiri was born with a silver spoon in his mouth. Blessed with a perfect personality and a handsome look, and having been ranking top in everything, Hunter Cheng has been the prince charming for girls since his childhood. However, on his first day at school, he was pushed down by Qiao Qing, the Chinese teacher who he met for the first time! To save his face, Cheng Yiri decided to challenge Qiao Qing and steal her heart!

(Source: Webcomics, edited)

After the No.1 doctor Changdeng Xu fell of the cliff and died, her daughter Youran Xu turned herself to Lord Rui. But she was ambushed on her way and her memory was lost. The maid Qinglu seized the chance and pretended to be Youran. Qinglu went to the Lord Mansion, aiming to marry Prince Rui. Surprisingly, the soul of an evil doctor Qianqiu Le was living in Youran’s body. Now that the evil doctor had reborn, how will she live this life?

A quaint little bar awaits its destined clients… Meanwhile, the strange bartender with a glass of cocktail reveals the mysteries of your life by looking into your past reincarnations — containing stories of love and hate throughout the centuries. Come and explore the brotherly bond between a dragon bartender and demon hunter. A touching story that even dazzles the heavens with its world of monsters; a world where a dragon searches for traces of his demon hunter friend from his past life, longing to meet again. But how did the talented demon hunter and mysterious dragon meet?

A girl who has lost her memories, Ah Kong, falls into a cold pond in the forbidden area of the Yan Sect. The first time she meets Yan Mo, he almost kills her. A mythical beast that's been in slumber for the last millenium suddenly awakens, the True Demon's Eye is opened, and a series of strange events follow -- all seemingly brought on by the arrival of Ah Kong, this mortal girl.

(Source: Webnovel)

"An apple a day keeps the doctor away." But to some people, the basic necessity for living on is a kiss a day. What kind of sparks can Maple Xu, someone diagnosed with oversensitivity to the other sex's touch, and an alien who needs one kiss a day to survive on Earth create?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: The Crown Prince Lost His Mind

description:
The sick and weak Crown Prince of Daqi, Feng Jin Yan has only one last breath left so the emperor ordered the chaplain, Wu Nian to perform the opening altar practice and use the method of invoking the soul to snatch back his beloved son from the Halls of Hell. However, he did not know that after the practice, Wu Nian brought back the most tyrannical prince in history, Feng Wu Yu, who was from 900 years ago instead. The emperor cried at the feet of the chaplain "return my cute and soft prince to me!" Wu Nian replied with a serious fudge "the crown prince is not hurt, he just lost his mind, he will be cured after being treated by me". Instead of really curing the prince, in her thoughts, she was thinking "thousand years old soul, that will be a great tonic ah! Hehehe~".

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The Tianwu Boxing Hall in Haicheng City is the branch of the world's largest boxing gym. In order to earn money for the treatment of the righteous girl, Su Chen came to Tianwu Boxing Hall to do sparring. Because of his outstanding learning ability and strong comprehension, Su Chen became the "gold medal training" of the boxing gym. However, the splendid performance of Su Chen attracted the jealousy of the leader Wang Tingwei. He made Su Chen into a dangerous situation. Su Chen, who was involved in it, not only wants to live, but also takes this opportunity to make a career.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Ai Shang Ni, Ai Zi Ji

description:
The love story between a female teacher and a 3rd year music major living under the same roof.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Liang Ge Baba Yi Ge Wa

description:
A two-dad parenting team!
Doting father Sung-Sil suddenly discovers his wife is a gangster and their son isn't actually his! The real father, actor Seung-Heon Kang, reclaims his child but soon realizes he can't handle the constant wailing. Can these two men find a way to work together and raise little Hyun-Woo?

(Source: Manta)

Flirtatious Lawyer x Tsundere Detective!

Detective Shen, known as the human-lie-detector, finds it difficult to resist his nemesis Mr. He, a smooth-talking lawyer who spits out lies like flowing electric current.

"We used to be friends, yet you ruined my reputation. Now you dare to come back and beg me for favors?!”

The former elite police officer, now exiled to a dull desk job, meets his Mr. Liar again. Can they resolve their past misunderstandings? Can they go back to how it once was?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes prologue and four extras chapters.

title.romaji: Jian Yu Yuanzheng: Wu Mang Zhi Ren
title.english: Legends of Esperia: The Silent Blade

description:
In the land of Esperia, the war between Lightbearers and Maulers is on the verge of breaking out. A young swordsman, Thane, from the noble house of Lightbearers meets Baden in this war, whom later becomes his best friend and also rival. A bigger conspiracy behinds the empire also emerges as the two young men fight for their honor...

(Source: INKR)

Xie and Xian are both arch-rivals and inseparable best friends. Living together in the same house, their days are filled with playful banter and constant pranks. However, despite their close bond, there seems to be no hint of romance between them. Will their mischievous and laughter-filled lives pave the way for a deeper love to blossom?

(Source: WebComics)

Xiao Xiao is a high-level F2P player. While he was playing the game, he jumped into the game world itself. He could just go on grinding levels? But it seems that our hero has other ideas? Why are you exploiting the economy instead of leveling? Hey, what kind of hero are you anyway?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Haishen Daren, Qing Haohao Gan Huo!

description:
The Lord of The Sea — riding above the waves, calling upon the life of the seven seas, and even the beasts of the abyss listens to his callings. As the acting Lord of the Sea and possessing godly powers, I, Hai Ming, have to infiltrate the Magic Academy while pretending to be a normal student and doing ‘espionage' work?? How degrading! But for the sake of the world of magic, I have to fight back against the evil demons! I'll have to work very hard! My Lord of the Sea, please do your work!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Zong De Lai Shuo, He Zhipian Bazong He Zu Le
title.english: Living Together With a Fictional CEO
title.native: 总的来说，和纸片霸总合租了

description:
Wang Yiyi was a regular, busy comic artist who lived from deadline to deadline. When the male lead from her comic, CEO Leng Ziye, came to life in front of her, he was certain Yiyi was the female lead from the same comic. Unable to convince him otherwise, and without any idea how to make him disappear, Yiyi reluctantly began living together with the fictional CEO of her creation!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Hai hu, is a rich playboy during the day. At night, he is hero for the people, known as the Sea Tiger. He fights a world renown organization lead by Blue Dream. Blue Dream wanted to conquer the world and destroy everything on Earth so that it could be restored into an unpolluted state like it used to be. Full of action, drama and mind-twisting plot.

Yuan Zhuo has a perfect lover who is considerate and attentive; his professional life is running smoothly under his lover's guidance. But, suddenly, his lover's temperament changed drastically! So, his body was possessed by some supernatural power! To regain the control of his life, Yuan Zhuo is forced to deal with the spirit that has taken over his lover's body, but he never expected this ghost to “play” with him.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A twist of fate took the life of legendary hitman, Wu Qi. Strangely, he was not even aware of the identity of his killer. It was then that the Killing Intent System revealed itself to him. Wu Qi and the system made a pact— as long as he completes the tasks he was assigned with, he would get a chance at resurrection and uncover the truth behind his death. Just like that, Wu Qi, with the help of the Killing Intent System, travelled through time and space to put an end to enemies who are intent on killing others. Despite shouldering the burden of unpardonable sins, he decides to commit himself to saving the universe.

(Source: Coolmic)

The Shengjia Empress toyed with a cute guy on the street, not realizing he was Jiang Mu, the most feared man in the wuxia world, and the lord of Shengyun Mountain. In retaliation, he kidnapped the empress and took her to Shengyun Mountain, to force her to experience the life of the common people. He thought she'd suffer with the bad food and poor accommodations, but she actually enjoyed the experience. Furthermore, she turned out to be quite the charmer, and even Master Jiang himself seemed to be falling into her trap...

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.english: There's Something Strange About Our Majesty

description:
I’ve transmigrated into this loser emperor’s body, and I even have to stick to the script and follow the storyline. Sh*t, the storyline wants me to bring the handsome general into the harem to humiliate him?! This… this can’t be good…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Feng Sunuan’s soul was transmigrated into the body of a cognitively-impaired young lady, whereupon not only was she cruelly rejected on her wedding day, but she was also poisoned by her own elder sister, almost losing her life! She swore to bring down all those who have wronged her, so she pretended to be dumb and mute, embarking on the path of crushing her antagonists to overturn her fate!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Shuxing Fanwai Zhi Wo Jian Qi Le Yi Di Meizi
title.native: 属性番外之我捡起了一地妹子

description:
The hard-working game-player Feng Xia was ambushed and fell through a dimensional rift into another world, again. But in this new world he ran into "them" from the Xuanyuan World "by accident," too? Huh, why have the girls been turned into classmate, CEO, idol, delinquent, and chef? I have to seduce all of them to get back? And I can gain attributes for each one I seduce? What are we waiting for, then? Come on, ladies!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Nie Xiaoxiao’s mother had passed away after saving a stranger’s life. It turned out that the stranger was Chairman Han! Nie Xiaoxiao, who became an orphan, was then adopted by the Han family. Never has she ever thought that she would be oppressed by Han Yiyang, the Han family young master on her first day home! God, why are you so unfair to me? You’ve taken my parents away, yet you still send me an enemy like him! God’s words, “This enemy might be the happiness I’ve granted you~”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Balang has become a diligent official of hell to pursue the cause of his brother’s death. One day, the primary system of the six realms collapses upon the ascension of a new god, and an innocent girl named Lin Xiaolu falls into hell.

In order to send Lin Xiaolu home and find the truth about his brother, Balang resolutely conquers the former god, Yazhu. He then embarks on an expedition with Lin Xiaolu before trudging on valiantly through the six realms regardless of the peculiar events they encounter. At last, they travel to the end of the world and come face to face with the new god...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Taoism has Five Arts: "Mountain (Nature)", "Medicine", "Destiny", "Physiognomy", and "Divination". The Arts are what make the Dao great. As a Taoist medical practitioner, Zhou Jinyuan can read a fortune, and, better yet, save lives. But being a doctor who draws protective talismans and practices alchemy—and a young one, at that—means he has to constantly prove that he really isn't a scammer!

Zhou Jinyuan: Need me to treat your illness? Hold on, let me finish this talisman first.
Patient: *terrified* ??? Sorry, my mistake!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Weiwu de Wo Gui An Chanshen

description:
Luochen, a criminal investigation expert who firmly adheres to atheism, was drawn back to China by a supernatural case. However, at the crime scene, he was unexpectedly attacked and possessed, subsequently being forced into a thousand-year-old conspiracy. To top it off, a seemingly random bartender who claimed to be a spiritualist kept pestering him. Could he just focus on solving the case?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

What? Only after I pay this man back can I return to the Cat Planet! It's so troublesome! Meow!

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Adapted from the web novel "Jiu Ming Yi Miao" (九命一喵).

Street racing shifts into high gear, taking a turn down the dark streets of underground racing as the proteges of legends arise!
Most of the Four Kings have since fallen from grace, and now the streets are ruled by the 13 Ghosts! But when a legendary racing god comes out of retirement to recuit some new talent, the die is cast, and the wheel is set in motion for some major competition with the 13 to rule the strets of Asia! So it comes that the chlidren of racing icons Tien Ren and Ichiro Sakazaki step forward to prove their worth as champions! But will the heirs to street thunder receive their crowns, or will previous kings Fuma and the Seer intervene with a plan of their own?
(Source: ComicsOne)

Luo Fan’s parents were missing for many years but they suddenly reappear again. Before the whole family enjoy their reunion, Luo Fan’s parents are slaughtered by mysterious people! However, because of his strong willpower, Luo Fan is resurrected after activating the Academic Tyrant System, which opens up a whole new life for him! In this new life, Luo Fan must not only get revenge on the person who killed him and revive his relatives, but must also fight hand in hand with other academic tyrant goddesses.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Wo De Nüyou Guai Guai De
title.english: There's Something Off About My Girlfriend

description:
After Gu Bei lost his memory, a pretty girl named Su Mo appeared and claimed that she was his girlfriend. However, Su Mo has multiple personalities! Now the problem is, does Gu Bei have to win the heart of all her personalities to secure their relationship?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Lei Xi accidentally ends up in the wrong place at the wrong time while on an errand for his friend. He meets a strange woman who looks exactly like him who tells him to run before it's too late. Unable to escape, Lei Xi finds himself entangled in a cursed love story with the mysterious Qi Chen.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

title.romaji: Ye Nanren Dou Xiang Jia Gei Wo
title.english: All These Wild Men Want to Marry Me!

description:
Waking up in the world of “Love and Pandora”, a trashy otome mobile game set on the Pandora Continent, the main character found that she had transmigrated as the renowned villainess of the game, Medea, the queen who would be executed in the future. To change her fate, she decided not to cross paths with the male leads, or the original female lead of the game. Unbeknownst to her, however, all the male leads were revived with their memories of their past lives, and they felt deep guilt towards Medea. On the other hand, Freya, the original female lead of the game, noticed Medea and started romancing her as well…

(Source: Webnovel)

#time-travel #overfancy-mind
To find his way back to his home Earth, the time-traveling adventurer Gao Miao embarks on a journey spanning novels, comics, movies, and other interdimensional worlds. Along the way, he lives countless lives, encounters enchanting gorgerous beauties, and triumphs over formidable foes amidst the grand cosmos.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Zai Zongcai Man Li Xunshuo Changshi Shi Wo De Cuo?
title.native: 在总裁漫里寻找常识是我的错？

description:
"A $2,000,000 shopping spree? A Gold Card with no spending limit? The sky is the limit for rich people in romance novels!"

A story about a CEO and a legal director that get sucked into a book and have to complete the mission of setting up a rich businessman with a naïve, innocent girl before they can return home.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Yuan Ni Chang Xia Yongbu Tuishe

description:
Twin brother or lover? What would happen in colorful college life? A series of unforgettable touching stories caused by mistaking a guy for a twin brother...

(Source: WebComics)

A demonic invasion has put humanity's survival at risk. Until a generational "genius" appeared. The genius told them, "No, don't help me up. Really. I think better when I'm lying down. It's an old habit! I'm not falling asleep!" After all, laziness is a basic human trait. If we could turn laziness into power, humanity's future will be assured.

(Source: Webnovel)

A trip to Yanjing made Luo Shiyi the step-wife of her brother-in-law. Everyone thought it was a marriage of convenience, but she ended up being the love of his life. So what if she was born of a concubine? This story tells you how she became the mistress of a powerful family.

(Source: Webnovel)

I heard that others were reborn with cheats, becoming saviors and making great strides. But Meng Feiqiu was different. He was reborn without cheats - because he was the cheat for the saviors!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Jiao He's a drunk good for nothing who comes home to find that his house is invaded by strange cats. With no other choice, Jiao He takes in the strange cats from another world into his home. To feed the cats and himself, Jiao He needs to get creative in the earning money department.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Di Shao, Ni Laopo You Pao Le

description:
"1 million is your limit!" "I know I'm handsome, but you can't keep looking at me like that, or else I'll get embarrassed." "Once you put it on, you can never take it off." He gave her both extreme love and harrowing pain. In this unbalanced life, when could she find her Mr. Right?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Qiqiu Heping! Zhege Shijie Bei Zhenshi Dalao Tongshi Le!!
title.english: Praying For Peace: This World has Been Dominated by the Real Boss!!
title.native: 祈求和平!这个世界被真实大佬统治了!!

description:
Magic Capital! A metropolis that has everything! Here, there is a man that comes and goes like the wind : The Real Boss !! In this realistic society, he hunts as a lone wolf. On his path towards ladies and the truth, he inches further away day by day!!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Bao Jin Wo De Gui Fujun

description:
I am born in a family who make a living by robbing tombs. Its retribution accelerates and befalls in my fate—I have to marry to a power ghost. He says, "I am waiting for you for 20 years." I, "You are a ghost. Why don't you marry a ghost too?"

(Source: Webcomics App)

title.romaji: Wo Bu Yao Zheyang de Tuodan
title.english: I Don't Want to Leave Bachelorhood Just like That

description:
He traveled across time and space to a world beyond his understanding after a car accident. He has no superpower or girls throwing themselves at him. But he found himself in this Queer World...

(Source: Webnovel)

During a thrilling escape from her wedding, the energetic female detective Su Mu bumps in to the Ministry of Investigation's boss, Zhang Zhao. The two bicker and harass each other while maintaining a complete, yet silent, mutual understanding. As they journey, hand in hand, cracking cases together, feelings begin to grow. But at the same time, details about their heavily linked past start to come to the surface...

No one in the world stops, everything flows endlessly. In the future society of rapid technological development, an oasis of human emotional desert-"Changzhou", tens of billions of people are online at the same time, and a large-scale once-in-a-decade event has been launched around this virtual world. competition. In the complicated and confusing game world, Kai Thief X and Master Yu chase each other like meteors, turning into shining trails, flying across the civilized night sky. The sparks are lit one by one, the heroes awaken one after another, and a violent storm of rebuilding the civilized world has already begun.

title.romaji: San Ge Huangyan Yi Ge Wen

description:
Genius player x industry elite.

After five years, the innocent and shy junior in Li Moyang's memory disappeared, and he suddenly became an advertising genius known as the "No. 1 Fox in the business world". Faced with the signing request of his ex-boyfriend, Li Moyang decided to launch a "full revenge" on him, and it would be best if he would lie at his feet and beg for mercy!

He thought he could avenge his previous shame, but he didn't expect to fall into the trap of the "fox". When he found out, he was already deeply trapped and couldn't extricate himself... With his left hand doing business and his right hand falling in love, let's see the passionate story of the two people loving and killing each other, fighting wits and courage!

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

Pas Liley meets Quin, who smells like catnip, by chance; For he's crazy about Quin's pheromone odor, he's fully attracted to him. Therefore, he tries everything to increase the secretion of Quin's pheromone by finding fault with him. Pas uses Quin as the human shaped catnip, but time after time, they're getting to know each other better. Perhaps things may be different if it’s Quin…

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras

title.romaji: Jiang Cuo: Bu Jin Ze Tui

description: In order to avenge her sister, the Demon King sneaked into the God Realm alone, but was rescued by the enemy's fiancee by accident. I wanted to get close to the enemy through his fiancee, but discovered that this fiancee was hiding a secret that could subvert everything.

When Xi Zhonghe got dumped five years ago, Gu Tang was there to witness it and helped him to get over the heartbreak. But when Xi Zhonghe got into a car accident and lost his memory of the rejection, he didn't remember Gu Tang anymore and he wanted to get back together with his ex instead. Gu Tang: "......."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes prologue and eight extra chapters.

title.romaji: Mowang Fa Ze, Nüwu Zhi Ban
title.english: Demon King's Rules x Witch's Covenant
title.native: 魔王法則 女巫之絆

description:
Warning! An association of valiant individuals formed by the villainous demon lord and the rebellious witches has surfaced! Through casual methods of operation, they will turn the definition of justice upside down! By committing crimes across dimensions, they will ultimately snatch the halo of the main characters away from the hands of pesky humans!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Baojun Shi Ai: Yaohou Ruci Duo Jiao
title.native: 暴君试爱：妖后如此多娇

description:
When she was just a child, Liu Rushuang almost lost her life in a plot by her own father and matriarch. Ten years later, she returns as the leader of the famed assassin group known as 'Bloody Repose'. Just as she is going to carry out her revenge, she is suddenly hounded by the tyrannical lord Han Moze. Will her revenge go off without a hitch? And what sort of thrilling tale will play out between her and the tyrannical lord?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Hardcore First Middle has a historical problem: the students are too good at studying! So, this hot-blooded school filled with high-achieving students launched a "NUTCLEAR BOOM" ranking competition. The misfit transfer student Rong Xingye, ostracized by the entire school, faces off against the famous ranking GangStaR, TyCooN, hiGHnEss, and other opponents who are threats to winning the NUT prize. However, after he accidentally violates the ban on fighting, Rong Xinge is forced to live side by side with his opponents… only to find out that his transfer was a trap from the very beginning!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

It gets lonely when you have no equal. It's no fun when you're too strong. The bustling city in the mortal realm looks a lot more interesting. This is the adventure of a divine master in disguise.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Shy and sedulous Dominant Omega Aster was left alone during his heat cycle by his careless boyfriend. Just when he can no longer take the adverse symptoms of his heat cycle, Mr. Xin – his aloof Dominant Alpha boss comes to his rescue by remarking him... How will the two deal with their complicated relationship?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue and four bonus chapters.

Based on the game Chinese Paladin 7, this is a story about the Mingshu Sect's master Yue Xilou and the Tianshi Sect's master Zhang Donglin when they were young. It tells how they met, how they established their sects and defeated their enemies. The feats of the two are legendary, told and retold by future generations, becoming a part of the fabric of history.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Didi Tai Zhan Renle Zenme Ban Ya
title.native: 弟弟太粘人了怎么办鸭

description:
The 22-year-old MC starts his senior year of college as an intern, and because his mother's best friend is going to work abroad, he is asked to help take care of the 11-year-old brother who is attending school in the same city. From then on, a mature and vicious primary schooler and a gentle and stingy older brother live together, because they played together when they are young, the two got close quickly, starting a hilarious and heartwarming life of living together. Although the two have no blood relations, they are closer than relatives.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Wen Yun is a college student and a part-timer who solely cares for his little brother Little Jian. Because of their parents' deaths years prior, the two brothers have an inseparable deep bond. Little Jian really loves his brother, but there's something unsettling and strange about him.

(Source: INKR)

Shortly after Christmas, I. Blanc, the famous pianist of the city of Paga and Countess of Willockel, was murdered in her own piano pavillion one night. The next day, the newspaper headlines and the streets were abuzz with the topic. Who is the murderer who caused all this commotion?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I am healthy, handsome, wealthy, and good with the ladies. However, I was suddenly told that I'm doomed to die soon… and the reason is because that I'm too well-liked by beautiful women. Well, it can't be helped, in order to stay alive I'll just have to use all sorts of dirty tricks to make all those lovely ladies break up with me. But I underestimated my opposition. Who knew making beauties dislike me would be so hard!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Qiudu Meng jumped to his death and ended up starting his new life in the promised land. He has 7 days to ascend into heaven or harm an old dying friend and end up in hell. Follow this story about a man caught between saving his dying friend or saving his own soul.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Bronze-prize winner in the 2021 Kuaikan Original Comic Contest in the Serialized Manhua category.

Spirits cannot be destroyed, they can only be controlled by spiritualists. While in desperate straits, Yang Jian will use his spiritual powers to turn the tide. He'll collect powerful spirits, recover ancient manuscripts, and dispel evil shadows. Any spirit that can't be destroyed will be made to serve him!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Li Huang is a gutsy high school student who stole the sword of a famous hero in an online game. As word got out, Li Huang was sought out by mighty enemies to take the sword for their own. An action-packed series set in an online game where everyone can determine their own destiny.

(Source: INKR)

Lu Can looked down at Chu Jin and teased, “Lately, I keep getting the feeling that you’re stalking me. The SWAT building, the hospital, the restaurant, the bathroom, even the toilet…”

Chu Jin, flustered and embarrassed, quickly covered Lu Can’s mouth, trying to erase the awkward mental images. “Stop talking! I was just trying to sneak a bit of mental energy, okay? Don’t make me sound like such a pervert!”

Lu Can raised an eyebrow with a smirk. “Just mental energy? That’s kind of a pity~”

Chu flared up. “We’re just partners! What the hell are you regretting?!”

Everyone else: Heh… sure, I believe you.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Car-chasing accidents, derailed trains, gas explosion and orphanage bankruptcy… Through all those terrible events, Mathew Gu is still alive. In order to eliminate Mathew from this beautiful world, the lord in charge keeps bringing him various types of trouble. However, Mathew never gets knocked down. “What’s beyond my expectation is that this truly happens to my life”, he says when the game starts. [Welcome to the global evolution game. It’s developed by the planet and all humans will be its players.]

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Lianai Yao Zai Shang Zhuang Qian

description:
Qiao Senna, a straight-A student who hates makeup, accidentally finds out that Ho Er, a handsome boy in her school, is the popular (female) beauty influencer Hera. She doesn't wanna get involved and decides to ignore that matter, but Ho Er doesn't wanna let her go and even asks her to take his job. Will Qiao Senna accept this request and starts to be a beauty blogger?

(Source: Webnovel)

A tough-looking girl came up and pushed me against the wall to ask me to help her with mutual cultivation!? That's how a boy with a big appetite found out about the method of cultivation by feeding. The more food I eat, the stronger I get. So sorry, you're no match for me anymore!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Gonglue Yao Nande Yi Wan Zhong Zishi
title.english: Ten Thousand Ways to Win Sexy Guys' Hearts
title.native: 攻略妖男的一万种姿势

description:
There's a girl called Summer. She has social phobia and is allergic to men. As soon as being crashed by a car, she got one and only chance—the qualification to get the heart of superstar Donggong Shuiyue in a game?!

(Source: Webnovel)

"Anyone who lives in this mansion will die, including you, who are watching this diary now.
—— No. 63, Pompeii Street"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.native: 抱歉，有系统真的了不起

description:
By chance, the protagonist got a broken system. It didn’t matter, though. A broken system turned out to be better!

By posting his own quests, whenever and however he wanted, the protagonist was heavily rewarded each time when a quest was completed.

“I’m going to catch 10 mice tonight.”

(Source: Webnovel)

A young Taoist master descends the mountain to vanquish demons and subdue monsters. He battles fiercely against the Corpse King of Western Hunan and the Undying Evil God, strikes down the vengeful spirit of the Ouija and the ghostly bandits from all directions. Wielding the divine arts of Maoshan, he captures all the seductive demons of the world. Yet, he remains witty and charming, winning the heart of a wealthy heiress. Born with extraordinary courage, he dares to venture into the underworld itself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The Righteous and Evil male protagonists' souls enter each other's bodies? Both of them keep stirring up trouble in the enemy's camps? Welcome to this world of superpower!

(Source: Webnovel)

Growing up in a family full of chefs, Mo Ting has brilliant culinary talent but later is diagnosed with a career-ending hand problem. At the lowest point of his life, a girl shows up out of nowhere and drags him into a magical realm full of drool-worthy foods!

(Source: WebComics)

The "Eternal Flame" has returned to its proper place, but the peaceful and prosperous times are shattered by a bizarre phenomenon. A sudden meteor shower unleashes the "Heart of the Earth," a world element hidden within the Earth's core! This unleashes an unprecedented war between the Celestials, the Dragons, and the Asuras. To quell the chaos, Sanzang, entrusted by Tathagata, embarks on a journey to seal the "Heart of the Earth." The westward-bound team reunites, embarking on an unknown and treacherous journey...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Mung Min Chiu Yan Lung Kei

description:
He was originally a rich second generation of a local tyrant. Unfortunately, he was deprived of all the possessions and driven out of the family due to his father's disappearance, leaving him nothing but a small supermarket. However, it's this supermarket that connects another world and makes him a business tycoon in both worlds! Chew gum can be exchanged for celestial pills! Orders are coming nonstop! Perfume can be exchanged for the constitution-reinforcing liquid. Strengthen your body and defeat villains with just one punch! What? You want a Qilin beast from the Eastern Fairy World for riding? No problem, as long as you have enough money to pay. What? You want the iridescent clothes of the fairy? Sure, downpayment first and then I'll go talk to the fairy. As long as you have the money, I'll get you what you want. I'm the only supplier of the other worlds!

(Source: WebComics)

His mother entrusted him with obtaining the Martial God's Hammer, but young Xi Zitang wasted ten years trying to lift it and gained superhuman strength instead. Ten years later, he returned with the hammer, forging a path of supremacy while gaining the favor of many beauties!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Zhende Bushi Eyun Zhi Zi

description: Gu Que came to a new world after traveling through time and space. It should have been a lucky experience, but he was envied by the heavens. He became the son of doom, had a third eye and would be dogged by misfortune. To revive his wife, he started his journey of getting magical tools, killing the crown prince, fighting the whole continent and meeting new hotties. After all this, he'd finally become the master of disaster in this world!

title.romaji: Emo Youxi: Tiaojiao Xiao Tian Qi
title.english: The Devil's Game: Training His Sweet Wife

description:
Badly humiliated by him to pay her father's debts off, she thought she was in hell. She hadn't expected that it was just a beginning and a magnificent revenge. Who on earth was sinking in heart?
(Source: MangaToon)

Being forced to get married, she is really confused. What’s more confusing is that he isn’t willing either! He forced her to quit, but he also touched her head to comfort her when he said too much. Those sweet moments are like illusions. The moment when she decides to put an end to everything because of tiredness, however, she was won back by him with the words, "take responsibility for him"... What does he want?

(Source: Webcomics)

A tree spirit from an unknown origin (who's actually more than a few thousand years old), infiltrates 'cold on the outside but warm on the inside' Tang Jun's life. The spirit that fell from the sky decides to live in Tang Jun's house! From then on, a series of funny events start occurring in Tang Jun's everyday life.

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

title.romaji: Xitong Zai Shou Ren Wo Lang

description:
Abandoned young Su Hao from a wealthy family fell into the sewers. He got a blessing in disguise and was ordered to install the X system. With the moonlight treasure box given by the system, he traveled to ten years ago and started a new life.

In my last life, I lived like a dog, those who hated me celebrated, and those who loved me had tears in their eyes. In this life, the Moonlight Treasure Box sent me back, the people who love me, sing and dance, and those who hate me, are in tears.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Xiao Bai recently moved to a new city with her family due to her father's job offer, despite her being so shy and timid. One day, Xiao Bai and her family were visiting the temple where she noticed a statue of a lucky cat. She decided to make a wish, and suddenly she found herself concerned with a black haired cat god...

From the live-action series with the same name, Vanguard has been renewed. It features a girl named Lei Xiaoyu that has caught the attention of a mysterious assassination organization! The tsundere Wu Yue of the Vanguard was assigned to be Xiaoyu’s protector. A love story full of youth, campus life, and action?! As the plot was revealed layer upon layer, the brutal truth gradually appeared...

The disaster that happened twenty years ago didn't just leave behind painful memories in Wuge City. It also brought upon unusual changes occurring quietly behind the scenes... These mutations didn't occur in just their bodies, but in their hearts as well...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter.

Lady-killer Qin You'an is caught on camera visiting a production set. The peanut gallery: Mr. Qin must have been there to see the gorgeous Wen Tingyue. Ohhh, they are such a perfect match. Wen Tingyue's fans repost on Weibo, examine details, retouch photos, and imagine Wen Tingyue and Qin You'an being lovey dovey. But when a little-known actor named Shen Suyun is photographed throwing himself at Mr. Qin later on by the paparazzi, all netizens flare up: How dare this lowly nobody touch Mr. Qin?!

(Source: WeComics)

A top-tier female agent finds herself reincarnated as a tragic young woman in ancient times. In a world overrun by the undead, she fights for survival while tearing apart scum and trampling on trashy men. The aloof and handsome Crown Prince, the rugged and unruly General of a Thousand Victories, the tender-hearted Pirate Chieftain—hey, hey! Stop distracting me from fighting zombies! Fine, fine. Since I'm already here, I'll reluctantly (but gladly) take charge of this world's peace and handsome men!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Feng Qi, a young UFC fighter who fell from the top, he returns to China to live an ordinary life, but he discovered that high school life is even more exciting than the UFC. Although Feng Qi doesn’t want to fight for his reputation, he can only defend himself and become strong in order to protect all his loved ones. Although his left arm is badly injured and has only his right hand, Feng Qi will not run away from a fight. “I, Feng Qi, doesn’t violate the law, won’t do illegal activities, not bully the weak.”

Wen Changshi X Yuji suffered from memory loss, what should Mr. Wen do?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Ryan is the son of the Prime Minister of the Blue Moon Empire and has a distinguished background. Even so, Ryan is forced to endure the abuse from his half-brother throughout the year since he is not a favored child of the household. Upon his half-brother’s coming of age birthday party, Ryan manages to escape but only to be kidnapped by traffickers and auctioned off in an underground market. By chance, Ryan is then bought by Marshal Austin of the Star Sea Alliance. In a foreign country, Ryan meets his mother’s blood servant and slowly begins to uncover the mysteries of his past. As the story progresses, the vampires that have been silent for a century starts to re-emerge. Thus, another war between orcs and vampires begins.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Kao Mei Yan Wen Zhu Tianxia

description:
Gu Yuanbai transmigrated into a boy's love novel as a side-character, the sickly and weak emperor. He tried to make something of it, but it turned out he only had a few years to live anyway. So he decided to sit back and watch the main characters, the aggressive regent Xue Yuan trying to seduce the beautiful courtier Chu Wei. But Xue Yuan's tactics were too over the top, and Gu Yuanbai decided to take him down a notch. But as Gu Yuanbai tried to bring the mad dog Xue Yuan to heel, he found that his meddling is making himself stronger, and causing the plot to go off course...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Lu Xuan, a mad ruler of the five emperors, was killed in a sneak attack by his friend, Zhuo Yang Emperor, after exhausting everything in defeating the Vault Demon Emperor, the world's number one expert. Although things have changed three hundred years after his rebirth, his hatred has not disappeared. Let's see how Lu Xuan, who has been reborn, rises again to stir up a storm and dominate the world!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In a world of animal-people, Mu Wei, a lion who was the big man on campus, fell in love with the rabbit, Bai Li. Mu Wei usually has an intimidating air in school, but whenever he sees Bai Li, he becomes a big pussy cat. And as he became more familiar with the lion, the normally timid Bai Li gradually opened his heart, too...... A fluffy school romance, so sweet you'll get a toothache!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ta Sheng Lai Jiu Shi Wo De Ren

description:
A rich young heir and an abandoned boy from an orphanage. Two people vastly different in wealth and status, yet still became good friends for ten years of companionship.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

After their family fell into ruin, the Ling sisters met a young man while on the run. This is the start of a fantastic journey into transcendence!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Fifteen years ago, Mu Cang, a mischievous guy with a passion for fancy clothes, was the victim of a thief. His heart was stolen… literally! His only memory of the incident is of a handsome masked man.

While Mu throws himself into danger in search of the truth, Mingyi Bai, his calm, responsible friend, watches over him. It’s no secret that Mingyi has been crushing on Mu ever since they first met… but to no avail.

Will Mu open himself to Mingyi’s love? And can the two overcome this mystery together?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Mo Huang Shidi Shizai Tai Zhuan Qing le
title.native: 魔皇师弟实在太专情了

description:
The hasty and powerful Lord Demon Emperor of the upper realm, sneaking down to the lower realm to find all kinds of girls.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo de Shijie Wen De Yi Pi

description:
To survive in this world, one must be prudent, impassive, and merciless while he can't challenge someone out of his level nor consort with girls. Big sister, he is just at the Foundation Establishment Stage. Why would you bomb him with forbidden spells three times? Big sister, it's just bruises. Why would you feed me with Immortal Pills? Big sister, would you please stop pretending to be cute?

(Source: WECOMICS)

title.romaji: Nüzhuang Da Lao Yang Cheng Ji
title.english: How To Raise A Cross Dressing Master

description:
In the middle of Mt. Fu Yun and on the banks of Lake Egret, there is a school called tao yuan academy, which houses the children of imperial and wealthy families. Su Li's twin sister, Su Li, who was intelligent and sensitive at an early age, was given an imperial order to study at tao yuan academy. however as the start of school was just around the corner, Su Li (the sister) ran away with a handsome young foreign boy... to avoid the punishments of lying to the emperor, Su Li (the brother) had to dress up as a woman and attend tao yuan academy in place of his sister. Initially, he wanted to keep things low-key, but to his dismay, he had caught the attention of multiple suitors... Hey, we're all brothers, can't we settle this peacefully! Stop it! Don't run away you rascal! Damn it, what do you guys have that I don't?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Jintian De Wancan Shi Shan Hai Shenshou!
title.native: 今天的晚餐是山海神兽！

description:
Food is the best thing in the world. It can let someone feel indescribably wonderful~ The genius Mo Bai once thought that he stood at the peak of the culinary world. However, since his encounter with that person...it opened up a door to a whole new world for him!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Xue Ba De Xiaoye Mao Tai Liao Ren

description:
School bully Xie Gu — the person I hate most is my deskmate, Fandu, who’s only good at studying and nothing else!

Honor student Fandu — what I hate most is my deskmate, Xie Gu, this person is nothing but a cat-shaped sucker!

It is said that since ancient times, the "enemy" had true love, and the two were unhappy with each other. After "injuring" each other 300 times, they found out that the other party was quite cute…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The snow mountain is his territory, no one is suppose to live there! Who is this daredevil?! How dare he chop off my favorite gingko tree. To make it worse, he took all the furnitures in my cave! Darn! I won't be a demon fox if I didn't take revenge! But... he's just an idiotic scholar, why can't I get close to him? When the mischievous but innocent snow fox meets a slow yet scheming scholar, the truth isn't what Xue Qiu expected.

(Source: Sherbet Lemon and Covenant of Darkness)

title.romaji: Da Si Ye Bu Zuo Shi Zun

description:
What?! Traversing to become a Master? The job with the highest risk factor? No! I won't become a Master, even if you kill me!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Does Love At First Sight Exist in E-Sports?
title.native: 电子竞技存在一见钟情吗？

description:
The story of Asia's Champion and his opponent.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.romaji: Wo Dang Yinyang Xiansheng Di Na Ji Nian
title.native: 我当阴阳先生的那几年

description:
Cui Zuofei accidentally drowned and died. In the underworld, he met Jiushu, who taught him the Sanqing Tome, and he became an disciple of the Sanqing techniques. He was able to return to life and got a job with a fortune teller, where he met another Sanqing disciple Yi Xinxing. The two got along well, and they decided to strike out on their own to slay demons and fight evil, in a series of stirring adventures.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In the Kalan empire a prophecy exists, a prophecy that foretells the destruction of the world. The hope for salvation rests in a young prince, but only if he manages to attain the rank of Archmage. As fate has it, the sole prince of Kalan was cursed at birth, rendering him incapable of controlling the power of his spells.

Growing up, the mischievous prince's fascination for magic got him into all sorts of trouble. And now he has managed to stumble into a world of dragons, elves, and ancient magics, in a quest to remove this damnable curse. Destiny awaits? Can he fulfill his destiny with no weapons, no spells, and two servants who can never agree to disagree?

On an ordinary day, a rift suddenly opened in the sky and innumerable monsters came through the opening. Yi Tianhang relied on his spiritual sense to get him and his sister safely through the "Seven Days Of Disaster." After which thousands of other worlds appeared and merged with Earth to form a massive new planet, as the world moved into a new era — The Eternal Kingdom.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Prince Bei Chen is set for an arranged marriage, but his bride ends up being someone different. He takes in the fraudulent Chu Mei as his concubine, even though his heart lies with men. And so begins a fake romance between two arrogant people who rely on each other for their own means.

(Source: INKR)

He was once known as the Blade Of China, the mightiest soldier in the military, a member of the Tianjian special forces. He set up shop in the criminal scene in the West, quickly becoming known as the fearsome Lord Of The Underworld.

"My name is Liu Feng. I am good at two things: killing and healing. Anyone I want to heal, not even the devil can take. Anyone I want to kill, god won't be able to save."

(Source: Tencent, translated)

After transmigrating into his sister's favorite novel, art student Ethan Ji must adjust to the perils of life as a bodyguard in the imperial palace. His plan for survival depends on the novel's main character, ninth prince Jian Mu. But there's just one problem: there's a limit to how friendly he can be before the prince becomes attached. Can he show the prince the right path and earn enough money to leave? Or will taming the tyrant become the very thing that ties them together forever?

(Source: Tapas)

In the early years of the Sui Dynasty, a murder case brought Feng Xiao, the Second Master of the Xie Jian Bureau, and Cui Buqu, the Chief Envoy of the Zuo Yue Bureau, together in a small border town. Driven by different motives, the two engaged in a battle of wits and courage. The usually successful Second Master Feng, however, met his match in a sickly Taoist priest. Moreover, they didn't know until they clashed that this frail ghost had even more disguises than he did!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhao Zihui and his elder brother Zhao Ziyue were born and raised in Harbor City. One day, Ziyue discovers the existence of an alien species and abruptly leaves their home. A few years later, Zihui still can't find peace as his brother's disappearance comes back to haunt him.

title.english: The Ace has a Secret Crush on Me

description:
Three years ago, the Emperor Alliance was disbanded. The gaming prodigy Mo Bei retired quietly. Three years later, the prodigy returned crossed-dressing as a man and hiding his identity. She once again stepped back up onto the altar from a state of shame, drawing the cheers of everyone! He was handsome and had no time for love. He had countless fans, and everyone knew him in the eSports industry. He then said to her when she first joined the team, “Keep your head down, and don’t try to take things that you don’t deserve.” When her identity was revealed, he looked at her from behind his desk and stood up.

“You want to abandon me just like that when we just got married ingame? Hm?”

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Loulan Zuzhou: Baojun Hen Chong Wo
title.english: Curse of Loulan: The Tyrant Bestows Favor on Me

description:
A ruthless tyrant, who is said to be cursed with bloodthirst, feeds on woman's blood on every full moon. He is feared and ostracized by everyone until this girl comes into his life and changes everything...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

“It's commonly believed that I'm arrogant and aggressive. Let's teach them what arrogance really is! Anyone who dares to provoke me is doomed!”

Formerly a professional bodyguard in the modern era, Xue Moyun dies while on the clock. When she wakes up, she finds she's inhabited the body of the Prime Minister's eldest daughter, a long long time ago. And as it turns out, this girl has just had two engagements annulled one right after the other—one to the crown prince, and then one to his younger brother after that! What's an arrogant girl to do?!

(Source: Comikey)

After Selina Tucker, the daughter of a rich man, is kidnapped, Harvey Lowe gains the trust of his father, William Tucker, by rescuing Selina. To find a way to heal his master, Harvey set off to the city where he works as Selina's bodyguard by chance and embarks on a legendary journey full of excitement…

(Source: WebComics)

Despite being hardened in combat sports and the field of espionage, Wan Ruoli had no skills to prepare her for her sudden transmigration into the body of a disgraced concubine's daughter. Set to be married off to a dying prince, the formerly frail girl uses her new-found martial arts and wisdom to exact revenge on those who would have her family's memory besmirched and lost to time.

(Source: Tapas)

A sheet of contract and a ransom of ten million changed her into a close maid to an evil-like billionaire. Although once a rich young lady, she was made a puppet nowadays. He tried his best to torture her only to give birth to a boy to revenge against his family? In an attempt to flee away from him, she learnt how to seduce men and contribute her body, swearing to identify who was manipulating her life.
(Source: MangaToon)

"Country of East" are known for their dictatorship and malicious human experiment towards the underground citizens, while the "Country of West" who speaks "democracy" are notorious for sending their people to the battlefield in the name of freedom. After two great wars that devastated both countries, another one will soon be enacted, which now also joined by several revolutionary armies. Our main character is Leo who seeks for his son while being accompanied by a former imperial slave who had lost both her hands and feet.

(Source: Manga Club)

Chu You has always been responsible and hard-working in order to fulfill her goal of becoming a famous movie director, but unexpectedly, she was betrayed by a scum man and woman! Not only was she falsely accused, she was also robbed of her hard-earned savings! In despair, she committed suicide with hatred, but after her rebirth, she's contracted with the Diva system?! Once a scumbag, always a scumbag! Now, what you made me experience before, I'll give it back to you in double!

The regent held immense power and harbored treacherous ambitions. Zang Xiaojing, the emperor's most favored younger brother, was determined to eliminate this thorn in his side for his elder brother. However, he lured the enemy deep into his territory and ended up sacrificing himself.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Some people with abnormal abilities invading the institute have triggered a battle for superpowered organs! Has the unknown creature been resurrected as a teenager? What is the ending of the forbidden love between the decadent bodyguard and the test...

(Source: Wecomics)

Coming from a mysterious place, the gray and red creatures collide on earth. They manage to transform as many humans as they can into their own kind. Xiao Cheng and Zheng Yiren, best friends from childhood, were transformed into red and gray respectively. Standing on opposite ideals, faced with this collapsing world, what choices will the two brothers make?

(Source: Mangatoon)

I have three grandpas. The eldest grandpa is the best physician of Huaxia, second grandpa is a martial arts master, third grandpa is in South Africa, so the task of searching for the Celestial herb rests on my shoulders.

The King of Soldiers returned to his home city and lived together with his icy fiancée under the same roof. Staying hungry, staying foolish, he finally wins prestige as well as beauty's heart.

(Source: Flying Lines)

title.romaji: Dakai Nan Shen De Zhengque Zishi

description:
A long time ago, humans coexisted with all living beings in this world. All of them were able to cultivate with the Heaven and Earth Soul Force to become a deity or a demon beast. Although everyone had equal chances in cultivating not all of them were able to understand the cultivation techniques. Other than deities and demon beasts a strange new power formed from the concentration of heaven and earth soul force. We call it Soul.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

title.romaji: Nixi Zhi Wu Liang Nü Jiaoshi

description: The Continent of the Goddess is divided into two realms, the Xuan, Ao, and Ling tribes are gods in the sky. The human beings who have awakened the soul wheel can summon the gods to inhabit the gods in their bodies and become the goddess masters! Song Xiaoliu, a young man from the border town, possessed peerless talents and was tragically assaulted. He was judged that he had no destiny for his life, but because of fate he would summon many peerless gods to descend from the earth, and then embarked on a journey of surrendering against the world…

The young general who is supposed to get married actually breaks his engagement before his wedding, and he's even sent to a wild place to find some kind of elixir? As a consequence, the leading female character who already prepares her wedding dress directly gets shocked, no! Disguising as a man, she becomes young master, and she'll surely bring her fiance back... to marry her.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: You Yao Lai Zhi Hua Zhong Xian

description:
Ye Fang is the Deputy Director of Special Security Bureau of Earthly Environment. He works every day to deal with cases involving supernatural creatures while trying hard in the huge crowd to find his master who lost touch with him over four hundred years ago.

(Source: Webnovel)

The Skyfire Avenue is a shopping street where no vehicle is permitted to get in, and each store owner is a powerful adept. Lan Jue, the greatest of the mercenaries, has secluded himself here after his wife passed away.

However, a mysterious message gets him back into the world in his third year here.

This is a world of mechas, novel powers, raging battles, stunning beauties… Come and witness someone at his pinnacle to create new legends!

title.romaji: Chu Dao Dìqiu Qing Duo Zhi Jiao

description:
Alone on Earth and billions of miles away from his home planet, Orion Nan must find his family’s long-lost relic, the Stone of Neptune. Thrust into earthling life, Orion is equipped with his alien powers, charm, and a guidebook… on male seduction?! Yes! Nothing can stop Orion, not even handsome college student, Luka Nan. But the Stone has other plans. Will Orion retrieve the precious relic and maybe win over the hearts of those in his way? More importantly, will he ever find his way back home?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.romaji: Zhengjiu Jing Fen De Yibai Zhong Fangfa
title.english: A Hundred Ways to Save A Soul Splitter
title.native: 拯救精分的一百种方法

description:
Tang Dongbao, who was just about to become a deity, had to take on a mission: Save the grand deity Xiao Yi who split his soul because his divinity was too strong. However, Xiao Yi killed Dongbao in the first world! How am I supposed to save you, my soul-splitting target?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

She just wanted to make a living, but she came across a domineering CEO. Not only was she forced to live with him, she also had to be his daily personal dessert!

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: 195 main chapters + 32 extras chapters

A fantasy story based on twins! The heartbreaking past that has resurfaced in the present. In my past life I was a pair with my disciple, and in my present life complicated feelings between me and my sister have started to arise....

(Source: Kuaikanmanhua, translated)

Childhood friends went their separate ways due to unfortunate events in their families. Ten years later, the two reunite after experiencing devastating changes, but the one thing that won’t change is that they will never be apart again.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
Manhua adaptation of the Hong Kong action movie A Better Tomorrow directed by John Woo.

Six years ago, Ye Lingxi fled from the world of Sheng Nanheng without a word. Six years after, they meet again. Ye Lingxi insists that they have broken up, while Sheng Nanheng refuses to let her go. "We haven't officially broken up yet!" What is Ye's secret buried six years ago? Could they solve their misunderstandings and get back together? Breakup Loading 99%... The 1% remained stands for I love you.

(Source: Mangatoon)

In a flourishing city, Chen Yang thrives as a security guard through a mix of impressive skills and outstanding intelligence. He defeats tough and vicious enemies with a punch! He outsmarts craft enemies with his wit! But what's to be done with the mature, sexy, and divorced homeowner? The cunning chairwoman with unparalleled intelligence? The bold and brave policewoman? As their snares of love intertwine with Chen Yang by surprise, how will he endure them? Can he overcome the chaos of life?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The youngest professor of medicine in history transmigrates to a matriarchal kingdom, where she has four husbands. She initially thinks that she’s the chosen one and is at the top of the world, but it turns out that her husbands are trying to kill her. She has no choice but to farm and run a business in order to improve her situation. Beautiful men then come running to hit on her. Out of jealousy, her husbands push her down. “Are you trying to avoid taking responsibility now that you’ve slept with us?”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Originally completed with 71 chapters on 2022-01-15, a second season of serialization was added starting 2022-08-21.

title.romaji: Jiangjun Jin Jia Ye Bu Tuo

description:
A popular actor transmigrated into a movie script and becomes a character that is supposed to die early! He can only return to reality if a natural anomaly occurs on the day of the peace negotiations between 2 countries. In order to live until "The End", and as a cinematic "king", he activates his survival mode...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: The title comes from a line in the poem 《走马川行奉送封大夫出师西征》by 唐岑参, talking about a general leading an expedition of soldiers. The original meaning of the line is that the general keeps his armor on even at night due to the harsh and dangerous nature of the expedition, but the double entendre here is that the general doesn't take off his clothes (refuses advances) at night.

The king of the tiger spirits picked up a cute, wimpy "devoured ghost" while patrolling the mountain... Hey, stop crying! What if... I provided for you?!

[Villainous tiger king x dumb, but cute devoured ghost]

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Contains two extra chapters.

title.romaji: Wo Yu Jiangjun Gong Shan He

description:
Shi Jiu, despite being a general's son, has been pampered since he was a kid. Unlike Shang Qu, his adopted brother and childhood playmate, he was never the strong and capable sort. But so what if Shi Jiu is lesser compared to Shang Qu? His adopted brother still falls head over heels for him. There are no misunderstandings between the two, and separation is out of the question. That's how much love there is between them!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wan E Motou Wu Sui Ban

description:
The fearsome demon-empress was suddenly transformed into a powerless child. Will she be bullied, pressured, or assassinated? No way! Hey, you trash cultivator there, be honored that you now have the duty of escorting the royal highness home!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The story of an arrogant company director who takes over the care of his late brother's blind ward.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

The immortal emperor Xia Guixuan and his archenemy were both badly wounded in battle, and he retreated into the core of a remote planet to heal himself. The planet's environment was gradually transformed by the spiritual power that emanated from his presence, and it became a habitable planet with a rich spiritual aura. Many years later, humanity's galactic exploration ship came upon the planet. They found all sorts of powerful beings living on the planet, and conflicts will ensue.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

At the end of the ancient alley, there is a mysterious antique shop. Sometimes there will be strange laughter in this store in the middle of the night, and some strange guests visit, until one day...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The bad guy Luo Jianqing was slain by the hero! After being reborn, he will take up the script and the sword, and he was on his way to defeat the hero and win the throne. Furthermore, he's going to make his haughty master into his plaything, too!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

To get help to find his mother, Yanxia agreed to a strange condition set by his estranged brother Siyue: Yanxia has to pretend to be Siyue and take his place for a year at Tiancheng College, the most exclusive private school in the city. But from the first day of class, Yanxia realized that the entire school was filled with Siyue's messy relationships! Taking on his brother's esteemed nickname of "Hardcore Playboy," Yanxia not only has to deal with crazed female fans, but a bunch of weird guys, too!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In the First Year Of Twilight, mankind had to rebuild from ruin, slowly restoring the economy and societal order. During that time, numerous dojos sprang up like weeds. In Zhonghai City, a massive metropolis of ten-million people, the annual Young Masters League was the most important martial arts tournament in town. The championship is the ultimate dream of every young martial artist.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

My grandfather and grandmother killed my mother behind my father’s back before I was ten. On the seventh day after her burial, her body vanished from her coffin, and a living ghost showed up. After that, my grandfather fell ill, and terrifying corpses appeared in the deserted graveyard. My mother’s death brought endless trouble to my family…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

It is the year of the Empire 5021 (5000 years after Bai Shounan united the earth). Wu Nan, a prodigal boy from the Wind Tribe, is searching for a destructive weapon from 5000 years ago. In a world ruled by might, who will be the continent's ultimate conqueror?

(Source: Ocean Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Tang Ping De Wo, Zi Sun Men Dou Shi SSS Ji
title.native: 躺平的我，子孙们都是SSS级

description:
Qiguan Xiaojian, the hero who saved the world, is reborn a thousand years later. He wants to live a peaceful life drinking cola, eating fried chicken, and playing video games, while letting his descendants do the work! Will his wish come true?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Forced to Date with BOSS Everyday
title.native: 每天被迫和大佬谈恋爱

description:
Xue Xi, who had been missing for 18 years, was ridiculed by her grandmother and cousin as soon as she returned home. She was also disliked by her classmates when she arrived at school. Unexpectedly, she met Xiang Huai and inexplicably triggered the "date with someone or die" debuff. To save herself, she had to fall in love with the gangster, also a grocery store owner. A love story between an almighty boss and a straight A student began.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: The Strong, The Few, True Cultivators on Campus

description:
“All kinds of woman walk into his life causing him to be surrounded by beauties!”

In order to live he must get close to girls, what kind of rule is this? Tang Zheng possess the Nine Yang Saint Body, a rare body constitution that is hard to come across within a millennium, yet he must absorb pure Yin energy to stay alive. In order to live, he will fight! Absolute campus belles, goddess teachers, charming housewives, haughty lolis…

(Source: Comikey)

Su Xiao one day wakes up and finds himself shrunk down to 5cm, not knowing how or why it happened. In his eyes, everyday items are gigantic, and insects and small animals are terrifying monsters. With his landlady in the same situation, they both must live and test their survival instincts.

(Source: INKR)

After being betrayed and killed, an intelligence agent is led by a mysterious beauty into a system where he is given a secondAfter being betrayed and killed, an intelligence agent is led by a mysterious beauty into a system where he is given a second chance to live. He decides he wants to have a radically different life and even picks a small goal, which is to become the most powerful being. But... there seems to be something wrong with the system.

(Source: WebComics)

Characters are beginning to disappear. Cognitive abilities in people are starting to decline. An underachiever named Wan Yi travels to a different dimension where he embarks on an adventurous journey. Shape-shifting monsters, divided clans, awakened ancient creatures... In a realm full of danger, can he shoulder the burden of saving the world?

(Source: WebComics)
The Fan clan, which possesses the ability to borrow powers from ghosts, had its succession ceremony interrupted by an accident. Everything began to spiral out of control...

During the middle years of the Shang Dynasty, the nation's power gradually declined. A struggle for supremacy within the royal family sparked the "Nine Generations of Chaos." As the second son of the incumbent Emperor Zu Ding, Pan Geng was forced into this struggle for royal power, burdened with false charges and driven into exile...

(Source: Yiben Manhua, translated)

Three centuries ago, the scarlet mists appeared, emerging from nowhere. They brought death and destruction, and humanity was on the brink of extinction. However, small groups of survivors managed to migrate to the mountain peaks, where the mist could not reach them. Thus, families were able to settle and, over the years, prosper... Time passed, the mists remained undefeated and their origin unknown, but human games continued. Today, rivalries, alliances, and betrayals rule Qingpiu, Tieliu, and Danzhu, the three kingdoms that make up the world. To establish its hegemony, the kingdom of Qingpiu has finally managed to negotiate an alliance with that of Tieliu. The stakes are high: a political marriage that could spell the imminent demise of the kingdom of Danzhu. However, on the day of the meeting between the princess of Tieliu and the emissary of Qingpiu, nothing goes as planned. The soldiers of Danzhu attack, the scarlet mists surround the city, and a mysterious group of “Rebels” appears...

(Source: Glénat, translated)

title.romaji: Shenxian Jiao Wo Lai Zhuang X

description:
I lived in an age where everyone could become a cultivator, but I didn’t have the talent for it. I even died to save the woman I love. To make it worse, I got scammed by the captain of the Heavenly Court and became an officer after I reincarnated. But what else am I supposed to do? For the sake of peace and justice, I’ll give it my all!

(Source: WebComics)

He returned from the depths of hell. Using this nine feet long sword, he splits mountains, ocean dividing, flies to the heavens, and rules the word! He was poisoned, losing all his power, he was accused of high treason. Can he take back what's rightfully his?

(Source: WebComics)

In the world, cultivators practice on their soul. A young man named Ye Xinghe, a prodigy with an inborn talent, awakens a ninth-grade Soul: the Dragon Pattern Purple Gold Cauldron, becoming the youngest alchemist ever. However, he is envied by his brother, who steals his Soul, turning him into a cripple! Unexpectedly, he awakens the ninth divine-grade Soul! From then on, he rises and becomes a supreme master of both alchemy and martial arts!

(Source: MangaToon)

Outmatching the heaven and the earth, he is matchless and capable of everything. Challenging genius in humble and poor families, evil person from noble families, holy sons, monsters and beasts...he became the king who owned beauties and killed the strong! There is no limit for martial art, he can either be mundane or unworldly.

(Source: WebComics)

Famous female live-broadcaster You Mao was mysteriously kidnapped, but the kidnappers began to question the various suspicious points involving the incident, resulting in them killing each other out of doubt. By the time Yang Haoyu appeared, the scene was already full of dead and injured people, but everything is just the start of his revenge...

(Source: Coolmic)

I woke up to find myself reincarnated as a princess, yet to my surprise, I was disliked by the monarch and was set up by my bastard sister. I thought I had run into my true love, yet he turned out to be a reborn person who is out to get revenge on me! How can I turn the tables and become the monarch's most beloved little princess?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Yaochuan Ta Ren Mei Xin Shan

description:
If the villain gets killed by the bandit, then the happy ending will be achieved! Xiao Mian Niang has had to pretend to be an innocent flower all her life, but she finally reveals her true dark nature and personally shoves the villain off a cliff. But... did she get the script wrong!? It's saying there's only one way to achieve the happy ending—to fall madly in love with the villain.

"Sister-in-law, I've adored you since childhood. Yet you deceived and betrayed me."

The villain gave her an icy smile,

"Now that I despise you to my core, you seriously expect me to fall in love with you again?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia You Ge Chuansong Zhen
title.english: There's a Teleportation Circle in My Basement!

description:
Qi Xiaotian, a youngster staying by himself, accidentally discovered a mysterious magic circle in the basement while he was trying to expand his villa. Curiosity led him to place his hand on the seal and with a flash of light, a majestic blonde haired girl walked out from the circle! "Are you my...wait a minute! Why are you pulling out your sword?! Let's talk this over!!"

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Weilai De Wo Shi Gonglüe Zhi Shen
title.english: The Future Me is a Conqueror

description:
Lin Zihan had been single. He had no luck pursuing any of the girls he had a crush on, not even his childhood friend. His future self appeared out of nowhere and charm Zihan's favorite girl. This future self of him called himself the Conqueror. He claimed he would change Zihan's life and the future of the four girls who were important to Zihan.

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.romaji: Ta Chengle Bing Jiao Junwang De Bai Yueguang
title.english: Becoming the Lover of a Twisted Tyrant
title.native: 她成了病娇君王的白月光

description:
When Jiang Ru realizes she has been pulled into a novel and become the villainess, she has no way out but to complete any bizarre prompts a nasty system instructs her to do. The system, which has failed countless hosts before, is now forcing Jiang Ru to provoke Li Yaoche, the protagonist of this very novel, as much as she can in order to complete her mission. However, while Jiang Ru grasps the opportunity to flirt with Li Yaoche's harem, she somehow ended up becoming his love interest.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Dark Love of Nine Tailed Fox

description:
Due to a conspiracy, the world's number one killer, Xia Yan betrayed the underworld overlord, Beiye Lingxuan who loved her deeply. Beiye Lingxuan was furious and ordered others to capture her alive. But what he didn't know was that Xia Yan was poisoned and her life was only 2 years left... While because Xia Yan loves him too much, she decides to conceal the truth and let him fall in love with her again.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zui Xihuan Ni Di Na Shi Nian

description: A viral web post digs up the memories that have spanned across 10 years. A heart-warming story revolving around three people. A promise that's 10 years overdue. It's a story about youth, first love and companionship.

title.romaji: Nage Bei Wo Huomai De Ren
title.english: The Man That Was Buried Alive

description:
The psychological counselor Ling received a patient on a normal afternoon. That patient seemed to be a weak and well-mannered gentleman from a wealthy family... But he confessed that he beat his lover unconscious and buried him alive... Doctor, what should I do?

(Source: MangaToon)

Icy is an average Jane. She professed her love for her Mr. McDreamy that she had secretly loved for many years. After she got rejected, she became so confused until she met someone that changed her life -- agent Finn. He took her into the entertainment industry and told her that she had the potential to become a new generation of Mr. McDreamy. But, the agent made a mistake about her gender and signed the contract with her. Icy cannot afford the penalty. Together with the agent and company, they lied to the whole entertainment industry. Everything went smoother and smoother and she also met someone that worth spending rest of her life with. She told him everything, but the man is a total liar? Shall she give up or pull herself together and go back to glory?

(Source: WebComics)
In a heavy-duty tournament, Team Fatal Fury ends up fighting against Team High School Girl. However, dark forces are watching them.
An evil orginization hosts a tournament to help further their plans to dominate the world.
He struggles for influence between the emperors and nobles, the fight for power between the underworld and imperial court. During these prosperous times, how will the fates of the people play out.

How far would you go for love? Legend speaks of a sacred spring with the ability to bring the dead back to life.
