Princess Yun Qingran, the only master of the spring exhausted her cultivation and used her to blood to revive her childhood love but was unable to bring him back with memories of her. Origin and extinction, what will she choose in the end?

title.romaji: Tian Tian de Weidao Shi Hongse

description:
Oh my god! I see my idol! But why is he bleeding? And I want to…

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

Ye Xuan is a high-powered attorney who also happens to be an unscrupulous playboy. While trying to seduce yet another woman, he got into trouble and got himself accidentally killed. In the afterlife, the System reincarnated him into another world, but as a woman! To get back to his own world, he has to help other woman get revenge on their scummy boyfriends. How will he use his own experience as a bad boy to make these guys' lives as miserable as possible?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue and two bonus chapters.

title.romaji: Suiran Danshi Gu Lang Ye Keyi Yongyou Niaozi de Ai
title.english: A Lone Wolf Can Have Toriko's Love
title.native: 虽然但是孤狼也可以拥有鸟子的爱

description:
Chi Su Mu's favourite hobby is feeding stray dogs and doing house chores. In a sudden incident of “Kleine-Levin syndrome”, he met the hot-tempered yet tsundere “fox”, Gu Xue. With his kind disposition, Sumu suddenly became an emergency member of “Whale Fall” and has to commit a vaccine robbery, thanks to Gu Xue. A complete noob in combat, he was somewhat molded into a versatile agent under Gu Xue’s training. After joining the organization, only then did Sumu know the shackles and mission of being a “sentinel and guide”. Sumu’s inclination and admiration towards Gu Xue when he first met him gradually turns into mutual feelings of attachment.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 extras.

title.english: Don't Touch Me You Gay Emperor!

description:
A famous actor named Gu Kai randomly traveled into a parallel universe in the past that is known as the Country of the RoseFinch. In order to save his own life, he became the empress and began his journey in this parallel universe which often involved: eating and sleeping, fighting evil officials, and protecting his virginity from the Emperor.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

What our protagonist Neo enjoys doing everyday is loudly preaching his father's adventures above the Cloud Sea. Nobody believed that these stories were true, and all called his father a liar who deceived the public to gain fame. In order to prove his father's innocence, Neo resolves to break through the obstruction of the Cloud Sea and find out the truth. On his journey, he discovers that the Cloud Sea’s existence is not what it seems, and that the companion who he deemed to be a friend, may also be an enemy…

Ye Yu Xiao, a young master, who is a player, self proclaimed that he's a rich young master who will not get himself into trouble. He accidentally met Fan Jing, a new star who is well known for playing "hard to get". In order to make the the proud and stubborn beauty fall completely in love with him, Ye Yu Xiao made a bet with his friends that Fan Jing would fall in love with him within 3 months. However, 3 months later...the scenario of chasing the wife changed! Who will be the first to fall into the trap of this love match?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

A thousand years ago, a little boy lost his life to save a fox. A thousand years later, a scholar met a beautiful young man whose beauty amazed the country. Spring rivers and the alluring sceneries, is it just an illusory and a greedy dream in the mirror? And What exactly are love and eternity? Instead of being overwhelmed by thousands of thoughts, it is better to forget and to enjoy the time right now.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

When the boy at the bottom of the class suddenly became the top student and gained cooking powers, he will gather a harem and make their clothes pop off with his gourmet meals!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Yang Shan is good at online comments which is also his job. His famous quotation is "Even a dog can do better than you if it travels back in time."One day, a system makes this come true and sent him to a place called Otherworld, and he was reborn into a Goldie dog...

(Source: Wecomics)

It's a story about the delicate relationship between two boys. In this world, there won't be anyone else who will help me express my feelings for him.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Can anything stop a bond this deep?

In Victorian London, where people are beginning to enjoy the achievements of their forefathers and the luxuries of life, there exists a mystical bond between special individuals known as sentinels and guides. As a string of murders threatens the city, how will Lance track down and fight these killers?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: General, Watch Out For The Mad Dog!

description:
Shen Zhuofeng, a beautiful General of the Divine clan, stumbles upon a mischievous Divine Beast Wolf. As he was trying to capture this wolf, he got bitten which made him to be his lifelong mate. With Shen not being able to get rid of his mark, will he be able to tame the handsome wolf?

(Source: INKR)

Several months after the Repliforce war, Earth is at a peaceful time. The repair of the space colonies damaged during the war was almost complete, the only space colony remaining being the giant colony Eurasia located in a Lagrangian point. As it was quite old, it was planned to receive extensive renovation. However, one day someone had occupied Eurasia and took control of it, scattering a virus in the colony and using its artificial gravity systems to set it on a collision course towards Earth. Within 16 hours, Eurasia will crash and cause great destruction, in the worst case extinguishing all life from the planet. The Maverick Hunters plan on using the large particle cannon Enigma to destroy Eurasia before it happens. The Enigma cannon is somewhat old and needs to be upgraded. Signas, the Hunter's new commander, orders to Mega Man X and his comrade Zero, as they race against time to collect the four parts necessary to upgrade the Enigma and stop Eurasia before it's too late. To make things worse, Sigma scattered the Sigma Virus all over the world and the parts needed are being protected by Mavericks.

Xie Shiye entered the entertainment industry and worked hard to become famous because of Fu Xu. Fu Xu was his dream and his light. When he finally worked his way up to fame, Fu Xu suddenly announced his retirement from the entertainment industry. Xie Shiye wondered if he should cuss at him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: You Bei Qian Nanyou Ding Shangle

description:
A black-belly stubborn CEO x A strong show-off celebrity

Separated by 5 years, during his most difficult times, Yang Jiali met his ex-boyfriend again. A few years ago, his ex had pampered him too much, but torments him to death now. He wants to preserve his music band, but his ex purchased the management company and wants them to disband. He tried his best to gather resources, but his ex messed everything up.

Yang Jiali: You didn't plan on letting me go from the start, did you?
Ex-boyfriend: What do you think?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Nimen Da Ge Youxi Zenme Jiu Jiao Dao Nanpengyou le
title.english: How’d You Two Become a Couple While Gaming?
title.native: 你们打个游戏怎么就交到男朋友了

description:
The male protagonist goes on a business trip and coincidentally shares a love-themed room with a famous e-sports player. What’s with the transparent bathroom door and vibrating bed? The next day, the two go their separate ways. When the male protagonist gets frustrated with work and goes to drink at a roadside stall, the man who shared a room with him suddenly appears and calls him his idol. Wait a minute? What’s going on? I already quit e-sports three years ago! Don’t you dare try to tempt me back into playing!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The love story of two broken people who save each other.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Feiwen Tai Duo Shi Wo de Cuo ma
title.english: Is the Scandalous Gossip My Fault?

description:
The "Shiyue" ship was the #1 trending topic online, but nobody knew the true story behind the relationship between Bai Fangshi and Sheng Yue from three years ago.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The steady talk-show host Yan Chao and the flashy fast-talking crosstalk comedian Zhou Chenyu are placed together in a reality show where they take over each other's jobs. What kind of sparks will fly when they put their speaking skills to the test against each other?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Shrouded in mystery, He Lu harbors a closely guarded secret that has made him a loner among his colleagues. But He Lu's tightly-wound, solitary existence takes an unexpected turn upon crossing paths with the enigmatic Song Qi. As these two worlds collide, the reclusive He Lu finds himself stirred by unfamiliar feelings, gradually awakening from his self-imposed isolation to discover the transformative power of being cherished by another.

(Source: WebComics)

In his third year of junior high, Tao Xi learned about his fate of being deliberately swapped at birth by his "mother." He lived his days in a daze until, on the remote live-stream screen of a poor county high school, he saw Lin Qinhe from the prestigious Wenhua High School thousands of kilometers away.

For him, living at the bottom of a well, it was the first glimpse of the moon in the sky.

But when he exhausted all his strength to climb out of the well and trekked through mountains and rivers towards the moon, he discovered that the star beside the moon was originally meant to be his place.

Tao Xi wanted Lin Qinhe, along with the missing affection that should have been his.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Nüyou Shi Elie Daxiaojie Ma?!
title.english: I've Loaded Into a Gal Game
title.native: 我的女友是恶劣大小姐吗？！

description:
#Transmigration# #Revenge# [Beep...]
[System activated. Game starts.]
[Gain girls' affection for bonus points.]
I'll put on the ""golden crown"". If it's to conquer the pretty girls... Ahem, if it's for the points, then I got to do whatever it takes to get there...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Zai Saibo Xiuzhen Shijie De Wo Sha Shang Dingduan
title.native: 重生在赛博修真世界的我杀上顶端

description:
In the era of the "new Divine Land," the old sects stand on the brink of annihilation, crushed under the heel of the cyber-enhanced New Sects. Ling Chen, a disciple of the fading Fortune Sect, witnesses his brethren and father humiliated and slaughtered in the New Sects' ruthless purge. Swearing vengeance, he clings to life... until the latent power of his sect's forbidden skills, the "veiled skills," awakens within him.

At death's door, Ling Chen becomes the perfect vessel for the primordial True God of Time. Reborn with the wrath of the ancients and the might of a god, he returns to the continent drenched in blood.

His path is clear: Carve a new epoch from the corpses of the New Sects.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

An ordinary high school girl accidentally got lost on the way to a friend's birthday party, and when she realized it, she had already arrived in a frenzied world where wishes are granted by killing. Endless accidents, bizarre guardians, and a red sky eternally stuck at dusk… so begins her unbelievable journey to escape. As she witnesses the other side of the world, can the joy of escape withstand the cruel truth?

"Do you have a wish that you'd like to fulfill at all costs?"

The purple-eyed demon raises the gun and takes aim.

"There is no kindness in the world, Welcome to— a lawless world."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

This is the story of two lovers, Jae Moon and Ji Yeon, fated for each other as a dragon is to its pearl. Their love overcame the barrier of hierarchy, but the star-crossed lovers were torn apart when one of them was killed in a tragic incident.

The reincarnated Jae Moon and Ji Yeon are reunited once again in the present time. With such a tragedy in their past lives, will the two be able to rekindle the feelings they had for each other from a happier past?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 10 extras.

Bo-Mi is the prettiest girl in school, and she wants to live at my house! Has springtime finally come for me at last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Su-Won is an S-class Guide with a notorious temper and a strict "no-touching" rule. After beating up one too many Espers who tried to get handsy, he’s given one last chance to save his career: a month-long live-in contract with the powerful Esper Gong Ian. There’s just one problem. Ian is the same pervert Su-Won caught grinding against him on the bus earlier that day! To make matters worse, Ian isn't just a creep, but a massive masochist who gets off on Su-Won’s violence. Su-Won came to guide him, but he might end up beating him into bliss instead.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After witnessing a mob hit, surgeon Jack Francisco is put into protective custody to keep him safe until he can testify. A hitman known only as D is blackmailed into killing Jack, but when he tracks him down, his weary conscience won't allow him to murder an innocent man. Finding in each other an unlikely ally, Jack and D are soon on the run from shadowy enemies.

Forced to work together to survive, the two men forge a bond that ripens into unexpected passion. Jack sees the wounded soul beneath D's cold, detached exterior, and D finds in Jack the person who can help him reclaim the man he once was. As the day of Jack's testimony approaches, he and D find themselves not only fighting for their lives... but also fighting for their future. A future together.

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

Reborn as the daughter of a humble family in the countryside, Evie Collins has settled into a quiet and uneventful life in the boonies. Everything changes when she becomes the sole commoner up against 100 noble ladies to marry Crown Prince Ikasha, one of the most powerful rulers in the world. But rumors say his face is horribly disfigured, always hidden behind a mask. Is that why his marriage is up to this most unusual contest? Can Evie hold her own against the field of haughty aristocrats and unravel the mysteries of the man behind the mask? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: TappyToon)

When homicide detective Dexter J. Daley’s testimony helps send his partner away for murder, the consequences—and the media frenzy—aren’t far behind. He soon finds himself sans boyfriend, sans friends, and, after an unpleasant encounter in a parking garage after the trial, he’s lucky he doesn’t find himself sans teeth. Dex fears he’ll get transferred from the Human Police Force’s Sixth Precinct, or worse, get dismissed. Instead, his adoptive father—a sergeant at the Therian-Human Intelligence Recon Defense Squadron, otherwise known as the THIRDS—pulls a few strings, and Dex gets recruited as a Defense Agent.

Dex is determined to get his life back on track and eager to get started in his new job. But his first meeting with Team Leader Sloane Brodie, who also happens to be his new jaguar Therian partner, turns disastrous. When the team is called to investigate the murders of three Humanitherian activists, it soon becomes clear to Dex that getting his partner and the rest of the tightknit team to accept him will be a lot harder than catching the killer—and every bit as dangerous.

(Source: Dreamspinner Press)

Woohyun is, for lack of a better word, normal. He’s not rich, looks sorta regular, and isn't overly smart. Add that all up and you’ve got a guy who women look at and go, “Meh.” But somehow, he’s scored the hottest girl on campus, Moon Ina. Long blonde hair, legs that go on forever and… let’s just say that when she walks by, men feel the unexpected need to cover their pelvis.
Unfortunately, all of Woohyun’s sexual experiences with women have been of the digital or imaginary variety. So when his childhood friend, Ha-eun, shows up and offers him free lessons, he… totally shuts her down. Because, honestly, how hard could it be?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.english: The Hopeless Desire of a Witch

description:
A charitable count offers to adopt young Kaidel into a life of nobility, and the orphan boy only has to pledge one thing in return: follow the "ember" and seek out the witch that set fire to his childhood village. Raised as a skilled fighter in a family of alchemists, Kaidel now sets out to find the white-haired witch. When he finally encounters a woman with flowing white hair, she is kind and gentle--contrary to the rumors spread by other villagers. Could the sweet Eleanor be the same witch from his nightmares? Between love and vengeance, which will Kaidel choose?

(Source: Tappytoon Comics)

Mabel’s been mocked her whole life for her nonexistent magical ability, but when she finally meets her true father, it’s the all-powerful archmage, Raquiel! Forced by an imperial pact to let her go long ago, he can now welcome her into his home, with his half-wolf butler, three nymph sisters, a fox halfling, and a kind disciple to watch over her. But dark secrets from his past threaten to catch up with them. Will his magic be enough to protect her? Could she even come into power all her own?

(Source: Tapas)

Dirt needs to be dug up on the Crown Prince Laurent.

Zigrien, having been appointed to work under commander Sir Idris Klyne, has the perfect opportunity to get on the inside and bring to light any incriminating information. There’s just one issue: Idris Klyne is a bloodthirsty maniac and a lapdog of the crown prince. Getting caught snooping by Sir Idris could mean the end for Zigrien. But having access to the royal palace now, this is Zigrien’s perfect opportunity to satisfy his father’s objectives and thus avoid being sent off to do military duty in remote lands. But what was supposed to be standard eavesdropping turns into a shocking revelation. Now Zigrien is caught up in affairs he had never anticipated. Will love and lust wither or bloom in this wicked royal web that Laurent has ensnared him in?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes two Christmas extras.

Yoseob, normally very quiet and composed, is in the police station convicted of stabbing 8 civilians with a knife. Everyone's wondering whether he actually committed the crime. Does he, a mere high-schooler, really have any reason to have done such a horrifying act? Does his obsessive love for his older brother, Jaeha, have something to do with it?

(Source: Lezhin)

Like the children of other prominent families, Sia Cha (Alpha), the second daughter of the SW group, became engaged in an arranged marriage at an early age. In order to increase their genetic compatibility and get used to her pheromones, she was placed with her fiancée and his family since childhood. But her fiancee found his true love and asked her for a breakup. After that rejection, she suffered from omega pheromone intolerance for the next several years. That day too, she tried to get away from a party and take her rest, when a stranger approached her...

"I want a child with you, no strings attached. Just give me one night!"

For the first time since her breakup, an Omega appeared whose scent did not trigger her disgust.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: Beloved by the Male Lead's Nephew

description:
After being reborn as a stalker villainess destined to die for trying to kill Archduke Calix Elluiden's lover, Charlize Lienta fled from the capital to stay away from the archduke at all costs. But her plan goes awry when she returns a year later and rescues a poor boy on the streets... because he turns out to be Sasha, Calix's long-lost nephew! Given her infamous reputation as Calix's stalker, will Charlize succeed in returning Sasha without raising the archduke's suspicions?

(Source: Tapas)

Lily’s family chose to sacrifice her freedom, but the infamous Duke Blake has set a trap to ensnare her heart instead. Lily is sent to the duke’s estate like an innocent lamb for slaughter...although Lily’s love already belongs to a handmaid named Anna. At the estate, an uneasiness gnaws at her mind...is there anyone in the world who truly loves her back?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Siyeong and Jihoo are "just friends." At least, that's what Siyeong tells herself before they share a steamy night that redefines their relationship forever. How was she supposed to know that the guy who invited her to work at his company, hasn't dated anyone in almost a decade, and has been pining for her since college might want more? Still, being upset with her lying boyfriend was no excuse for the drunken night she had with her pseudo-friendzoned boss. Now Siyeong is torn between the man she's loved for the past nine years and the one who was by her side through everything. Can she find the will to forgive the very person who sent her running into the arms of another man, or will she fall head over heels for her longtime friend and risk losing him forever?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes ten side story chapters

Dandelion, the quirky, time-limited prince. He occasionally sees "a fragment of the future." Sometimes it's a crucial moment, sometimes a trivial one... but once he sees the future, it inevitably becomes reality. One day, at a party, he meets Kelewen, the high elf who will save the world—and that fragment unfolds before his eyes.

"Tell him you won't leave, Leon."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

“You’ll get hurt if you’re close to him.”
“I don’t know why he’s so unlucky.”
“Yeonjae, I’m scared of you…”

Lee Yeonjae, avoided by everyone as if just being near him beings misfortune. Even he thinks it’s weird. Why do bad things only happen around me? I wonder how it feels to live a life of being loved and not hurting those around me. But, was even wishing for that too much? —Bam!! After an accident, I woke up in a strange place facing a mysterious entity.

“Strange. You should’ve died according to your fate, so why are you still alive?”

One truth I learned after meeting that entity is, I can avoid misfortune if I act like someone else. To survive, I have to become an actor.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Han Maru, an ordinary husband and father, dies tragically in an accident but is granted a second chance at life. With only vague memories of the past, he relives his high school days and rediscovers his passion for theater, a dream he once sacrificed. However, longing to find his wife and daughter again in this life, he fears choosing theater might steer him away from them. Juggling dreams and family, he navigates life's intricate choices, seeking fulfillment in this extraordinary second chance.

(Source: Tapas)

Chi-Young might be completely useless as a guide, but he’s imprinted on the strongest ESPER around. It was love at first sight when Chi-Young was rescued from servitude by Baek-Han Gi, a beautiful and supremely powerful Lieutenant Colonel. But Baek-Han’s affection turned quickly to disgust when he realized the pretty, young guide he’d claimed was a man. The only way to end their bond is for one of them to die, but Chi-Young hates himself for how much he loves Baekhan…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Can two people look exactly alike? Fear sweeps the city as people report seeing their own doubles. Then the disappearances start. Mere coincidence? Or are the mysterious twins harbingers of bad luck? Whatever they are, if you spot one, you better think fast!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: How to Raise a Nine-Tailed Fox

description:
As captain of the holy knights, Celia excels at protecting the country from monsters. So, when a priestess tasks her with raising a baby nine-tailed fox, Celia is hesitant but does her best to help the creature. Despite the abuse he has endured from other humans, she manages to gain some of his trust and names him Rahn. They start getting along, but the crafty fox is always looking for a way to escape. Can Celia raise Rahn until he's an adult, or will this sly fox pull one over his holy knight?

(Source: Tapas)

YUN-HO starts studying to get a government job after failing to get into college. One day, he has a strange dream and now he can see people's status! [Mission: Punish A Woman] He decides to use his new powers to get revenge on women who's been rude to him...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jongno-Gu. One day when I was four, my father's death notice arrived. My father, who claimed to come from an empire called Talochium and was the strongest paladin, left me behind.

"If you wish, I'll send you back. To where you were born. To where you should have been. To where that man still lives."

The last chance offered by the mysterious lifeform that appeared from my father's keepsake box. Now I can save him, right? But...

The father from the past I finally reunited with seems a little off somehow.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Tae-U and Ji-Eun are friends—just friends. Both of them were comfortable with this arrangement, with neither holding any romantic feelings for the other. However, when Ji-Eun returns from summer break looking noticeably different, Tae-U’s feelings for his friend begin to change, and new feelings of jealousy and confusion taking their place. When Ji-Eun develops a crush on a handsome classmate, things start to get even more complicated between the two of them as Tae-U begins to try to beat out his new competitor and take his longtime friendship with Ji-Eun to the next level.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: A Dance of Swords in the Night

description:
Kidnapped as a child to be trained in the art of poison, So-Han Jin returns to his hometown in search of the group of New Moon Sword Dancers who raised him. However, upon his return, So-Han discovers the sword dancers have been defeated by a nefarious sect that now rules the area, with some members having been abducted. What would have been a heartwarming reunion transforms into a quest for revenge as So-Han begins his search for the remaining sword dancers, and he’s willing to poison anyone who gets in his way.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Moon-Pyeong Seok, a lowly grunt of the Demonic Sect, never expected to be dragged into the deadly struggle to choose the next cult leader. Tasked with guarding the terrifying Heavenly Demon himself, he’s caught in a dangerous mission far above his station.

(Source: Manta)

Jaehee’s always prided himself on being a reasonable alpha. All that pheromone nonsense between alphas and omegas? Ruts? Heats? He thinks it primitive, and considers his two-year long relationship with the beta Yeowoon as true, pure love. But all that comes to a screeching halt when he finds himself stuck on a bus with an older omega going through heat. After one night of passion(and infidelity) with the said omega, Jaehee finds himself tormented. He’d always thought himself as a nice guy above all that alpha stuff, so what is he to do now? Jaehee knew that night would be the ruin of him but he didn’t know just how much, until he comes across the same omega on campus…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

For a princess, Ethela Inuas has led a pretty miserable life. Her fiancé ran off with her cousin, and her other cousin stole the throne from her, condemning her to die in the Ice Palace. However, after death, Ethela finds herself waking up several years in the past! This time around, two things are different. One, she has the ability to tell when someone is lying. Two, she's out for vengeance! Can Ethela reclaim the life she deserves and be the most dazzling princess the kingdom has ever seen?

(Source: Tapas)

"Mr. Hyde, I'm getting married."

Hyde, a cold and love-averse individual, is tasked by the prince to go undercover as the tutor of Lily, the adopted daughter of Viscount Bardin, to uncover clues about illegal firearm trafficking.

"And who will be the lucky gentleman to take your hand in marriage, my lady?"

"Lord Lucien Sornell, the first son of Count Sornell. Are you perhaps acquainted with him?"

During his mission, Hyde discovers that his innocent and demure pupil, Lily, is engaged to Lucien, a notorious rake in high society. Ahh, yes. She's been adopted to be married off, so I guess now is when she comes in handy.

"Mr. Hyde, what do you think the lord likes in a woman?"

With her big, innocent eyes, Lily looks so pure, yet she has the delicate beauty of a painting. Her body is frail, yet she is well-developed in all the right places, and utterly adorable. For just one week, she vows to become the most beloved bride.

"Mr. Hyde, if it’s not too much trouble, will you teach me how to do it?"

"Of course, Lady Lily. Teaching you is the greatest joy and pleasure I've known in life."

Though Hyde despises getting his hands dirty and is in a constant rivalry with Lucien, he decides to masquerade as a genuine tutor, teaching Lily the refined ways of noble romance to give Lucien a taste of his own medicine. Will Hyde’s lessons turn Lily into the perfect bride, or will they uncover deeper, more dangerous secrets?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joo-Ahn and Do-Jin couldn’t be any more different at work. She's a perpetually single career woman who takes everything too seriously and rules with an iron fist. He's a modelesque klutz with a heart of gold who lucked into an entry-level marketing job.

But when a company trip to a mysterious temple starts an inexplicable soul swap, they end up switching bodies for an hour each day. To avoid utter embarrassment and keep up their reputations, the unlikely pair will have to cooperate and bide their time. Will Joo-Ahn learn to sympathize with the pretty boy who can’t do anything right? And will Do-Jin see the softer side of his boss’s spiky persona?

From the artist of hit rom-com 'What's Wrong with Secretary Kim" comes an all-new company couple about to spark some serious fireworks.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: A Taste of Happiness for the Tragic Extra

description:
Once upon a time, a neglected princess died a tragic death, only to wake up as a child once more and find herself beloved by all. This is the novel Leivella wakes up in, but she’s not the princess. Instead, she’s a mere extra whose family was framed and slaughtered by the tyrannical emperor. Now serving as the princess’s food taster who tests for poison, Leivella must find a way to avoid meeting a tragic death of her own. The world may revolve around its protagonist, but the unmentioned extra might have a shot at writing her own fate!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Male Lead Proposed to Me

description:
Ciel wakes up in a novel as the villainess who torments her adopted sister and the female lead, Clara, until she’s executed for her misdeeds. Determined to avoid this fate, she becomes the sweetest sister, doing anything for Clara’s happiness. But to her surprise, her efforts end up altering the plot, eventually leading Prince Alex, the male lead, to propose to her instead of Clara! Will accepting his proposal bring Ciel the happy ending she desires? Or will it only bring her greater challenges?

(Source: Tapas)

Andy, a financial planner on Wall Street, gets fired after an ill-fated hookup in a car. By chance, he lands a new job at an AI startup—only to discover that the company's CTO, Hwang Jio, is none other than his one-night stand from just days ago. Workplace romance is already risky, but when it's between a sharp-witted Wall Street man and a brilliant Silicon Valley techie, things get even more complicated.

A smart and sizzling office romance set in the fast-paced world of IT!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: My Childhood Friends are Trying to Kill Me

description:
I was reborn into my favorite novel as Lelia, a tragic side character. Sent to a royal academy as a decoy, I befriend four princes fated to slay a dragon. Years later, they return as heroes, only to accuse me of murder! How can I reclaim their shattered trust?

(Source: Manta)

One day, I suddenly became the protagonist of a game. However, the more you look at this protagonist... the more you'll sigh. He's got the worst stats, the worst talent and zero connections. But still… You have acquired [Heavenly Martial Physique]. You have become the master of the [Martial God's Tome].

“So what? I’m the ultimate veteran player!”

He's not just a veteran player— he’s a full-blown obsessive maniac. Thus begins the legendary playthrough of a hardcore veteran!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Cha In-Woo, who is timid and has no presence, becomes partners with Kwak Ha-Jun, who looks exactly like his favorite student, among his new friends. While Cha In-Woo is excited to become friends with Kwak Ha-Jun while doing homework together given by his teacher, he suddenly gets caught up in a mean bet by Kwak Ha-Jun...

A fresh and bashful romantic comedy between two high school students!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: The Runaway Lead Lives Next Door

description:
Seina Rohill is a D-class hunter making a living off of killing monstrous fiends—or so she thought. In actuality, she's become an insignificant character in the novel, A Secret in the Flower Shop. What's more, she happens to be neighbors with the female lead, Ellen Euclis! The story revolves around Ellen receiving daily love confessions until she meets the male lead. But when Seina encounters a side character named Dion Fravel, who seemingly has a deep connection to Ellen, she's determined to make him Ellen's endgame. Unfortunately, Seina also has to deal with Duke Rashad Carlman, who appears to be the strongest candidate as the original male lead. As these four characters' paths cross, who truly will be the protagonists of this tale? And what could the "secret" mentioned in the novel's title be?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Sena’s been tossed into another world, as the despised daughter of a noble family. Her little restaurant was her refuge in her last life, so she’s got some tricks up her sleeve—cooking skills! As Senianna, she’ll put her brains and fine-tuned taste buds (Korean fried chicken, anyone?) to the test so she can take back the kitchen and gain this society’s esteemed title of Chef Royale. Will her cuisine reign supreme over the empire and bring her the sweet and salty balance of power and affection?

(Source: Tapas)

Friends since middle school, Yipeul and Dawoon rekindle their friendship after Yipeul returns from military deployment. To celebrate Yipeul’s return, Dawoon plans a surprise—she waits for him in his closet with some birthday cake one night. The surprise is on her, however, when Yipeul comes home, takes off his pants, and starts masturbating while calling her name. Will the two be able to go back to being friends? Or will this mark the beginning of something more?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 13 side stories.

Kang Sung-Tae, commissioned as a cadet officer, is unexpectedly transferred to a unit where his senior officer deserts. Because of this, his superiors begin to harass and suspect him from the very day he transfers. Stigmatized as a decommissioned officer, how will Second Lieutenant Kang Sung-Tae navigate this situation?

(Source: Naver, translated)

"All I ask for is your evenings."

Soaked from the rain, Joo-ahn steps into a stranger's penthouse and enters a world of seduction, secrets, and a contract sealed with desire. He needs money, but what he gets is a man who wants far more than just his time.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: The Tale of Goldiluck, the Black Kitten

description:
A sweet tale of companionship and found family set in Joseon dynasty Korea between a lonely young scholar with a kind but weak heart, a stray black kitten with a strange secret, and a loyal but jealous servant boy.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes three extras

100 years after the devastation of a nuclear World War III, a small group of humanity managed to survive and unite to form a “world government.” This organization brings together the greatest minds to rebuild society, establish order, and create safe zones called “Domes” where humans can live without fear of radiation or crime. As the population grows, the government sets its sights on constructing a Dome in District 12, located in Seoul, the Korean peninsula. However, powerful criminal organizations that have long dominated the area are determined to prevent the government’s project from encroaching on their territory. To thwart these criminal organizations and ensure the successful construction of the new Dome, the Korean Division of the world government deploys their top law enforcer, code-named “Alpha,” and the newly appointed government administrator of the Seoul Division, “Amber.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The largest theme park in America has been overrun by a zombie virus. Sung-heon finds himself trapped with his daughter among zombies and foreign tourists with whom he cannot communicate. In this unprecedented disaster where any moving living creature, not just humans, is turned into a zombie, Sung-heon struggles with his injured leg to save his daughter. They must survive - from the zombies, and from them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Selena, the top star that had the entire world's attention, was suddenly warped to Northern Duke's land during an accident while filming.Kalcion, the Northern Duke that saved her from the infernal beasts, offers Selena a chance to go back home in return for collecting information in various social circles by pretending to be his lover. Selena quickly accepts Kalcion's offer, but... There was a critical problem. The Northern Duke's acting skills are horrible! And thus the contractual relationship between the two started. Will Kalcion's acting skill improve first, or will he start to have true feelings for Selena instead?

Five years ago, academy teacher Song Yeo-Dan looked out for troubled student Yun Jae-Won. But when Jae-Won began mistaking that concern for something more, Yeo-Dan knew he had to draw a firm line. Now, Jae-Won is back, and he's older, sharper, and more relentless than ever. As time goes by, Yeo-Dan can no longer ignore how much has changed. The boy who once trailed after him like a shadow now stands before him as a man, and Yeo-Dan isn't quite sure how long he can keep denying the spark.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The widowed Evelyn Winter is the master of her home until Colonel Gilath Black, her scorned ex-lover and former servant, darkens her doorstep with accusations of treason. As Evelyn fights to maintain her rightful place as the duchess, Gilath, her once faithful and timid dog, lurks at every corner like a bloodthirsty wolf ready to pounce. But are Gilath’s actions driven by revenge or lust? Does the colonel seek to rekindle their old love or to ensure Evelyn’s life goes up in flames?

(Source: Tapas)

Adelaide Sergio never knew luxury until she was reborn as a wealthy count’s daughter. She was set to inherit the family estate, but her scheming sister’s sudden engagement has thrown everything off. With just two weeks to find a husband, Adele turns to the temple in search of a holy knight, only to find that their commander is the perfect man! He’s handsome, respectable… and completely uninterested. Can Adele win over the cold commander in time, or will the silver spoon be yanked from her mouth?

(Source: Tapas)

Dae-Woong always has risks of losing his penis. Eun-Ha introduces him to an institution, and he realizes that he has the "King's Yang Energy"...

"Ah, this energy... It's so sad to let it go to waste. Here, touch this!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

After spending a lifetime drinking an absurd amount of strawberry milk, Song Seol-Ah thought the worst she’d ever have to face was a stomachache. Until her chest started leaking the stuff, that is! As strange new urges overtake her body and mind, she tries to deal with it alone…until an ill-timed encounter with Kim Yushin, her childhood friend turned national medalist, throws everything into chaos. When he offers to help relieve her unbearable desire, she’s thrust into a dangerously sweet arrangement that’s quickly spiraling out of control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

With 99 nations conquered and the cup of the ruler in her hands... you'd think she was off to a heroic conquest, but the great queen's Cecia's real concern was her uncomfortable corset?

The queen of Valencia suffered from complicated laces and heavy corsets, and thus ordered her trusted brother, Duke Ennon Lionheart to bring her a comfortable clothes. Meanwhile, Yuri, a clothing designer was killed in an accident after suffering from a small minimum wage at a medium-sized clothing company in Korea. She was reborn in a renaissance country ruled by Cecia.

Yuri vowed to revolutionize the outdated clothing dilemma, so she dressed up as a man and worked as a designer at the top of the continent's highest court to do easy business. But... what happens when Ennon discover's Yuri's true identity...?

(Source: Comico, translated)

I quit my job, became a voice actor, and drastically changed my looks — all to catch the attention of dreamy Jaehyun from work. But he doesn’t know I’m me! What he does know is that I dub his favorite animation, and adores the way I sound. On top of that, now he’s moved in next door too?! A perfect chance for neighborly love!

(Source: TappyToon)

title.english: I Adopted the Male Lead from the Shelter

description:
In a universe ripped from the pages of a story, Siena Robert, a self-aware villainess, strives to rewrite her fate. Daughter of a man running a therianthrope shelter, she discovers Ivan Levdilin, the captivating male lead, detained within. Aware of her scripted demise when Ivan's father arrives for his rescue, Siena defies her villainous destiny. She showers Ivan with kindness, a stark contrast to the original Siena's cruel persona. Her actions shield Ivan from her father's cruelty and forge an unscripted bond between them that changes their destiny in an unforeseen direction.

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Winter Anthology (포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

In middle school, Cheol Im was a living legend for his fighting prowess. Years later, he learns that his childhood friend from the orphanage, Sol Kim, was bullied to death. Determined to get revenge, Cheol returns to school. But his plans take an unexpected turn when Ha-yun Seo, a fellow orphan who was like a sister to him, is assigned as a teacher at that very same school. Now, Cheol is forced to choose between his thirst for revenge and his loyalty to the person who once protected him.

(Source: WEBTOON)

What happens after you fall out of love? Nevaeh Solene was engaged to the Duke, Baler Eustache. But for ten long winters, she endured in a relationship that was not meant to be. After calling off her engagement, Nevaeh moves to another country, hoping to lead a quiet life. But there she meets Emperor Arendt, who wants to give her the love she’s never had. Will Nevaeh’s eternal winter finally melt into the blossoms of spring?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: How to Survive a Haunted School

description:
After her brother Raven’s mysterious death at the prestigious Saint Gloria Academy, Melody gets one impossible shot to infiltrate the elite school as a student by turning back time by a year. But beneath Saint Gloria’s gleaming halls lie chilling secrets. Students whisper lies, ghosts linger in classrooms, and worst of all, Raven keeps avoiding her. With time running out and Raven slipping further away, can Melody uncover the school’s dark truths? Or will she become one of its buried secrets?

(Source: Tapas)

Evelyn Monstera knows two things. First, she's been reborn as a mean girl in a fantasy novel, and second, if nothing changes, her cruelty to the main characters will be her undoing. So when the male lead of the novel, Casis Urquio, comes to stay at her manor, all she has to do is stay out of his way. Unfortunately, Evelyn not only causes a fight between the protagonists, but also wins the affection of the male lead too! Can Evelyn set the story straight and get the happily ever after she wants?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: A Cat, Adopted by a Wolf Family?

description:
Kittia is a young but brave kitty who wants to avenge her mom’s wrongful death. But with no one left to rely on, she seeks help from the powerful Gritwolfs by pretending to be an orphaned wolf pup. To her relief, they completely fall for her act... Well, they fall for her cuteness anyway. Despite realizing Kittia is a cat at first sniff, the Gritwolfs decide to take her in as the family’s youngest daughter. Totally oblivious to the fact that she has already been found out, Kittia will try her best to be the most convincing wolf ever...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

In order to leave the nunhood to avenge her parents by killing the tyrant king, Rubiana swears to devote her firstborn child to God. After all is done, she’s ready to fulfill her oath, except… She doesn’t have a husband! Enter Louis, the only descendant of the late king and rival to the current ruler. He’s got a proposal for Rubiana: he’ll help her bear a child if they marry and she assures his safety. But with danger around every corner, will they both be able to hold up their end of the deal?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Was Tricked into this Fake Marriage!

description:
After the Delpice Empire unifies all kingdoms with brutal subjugation, all the noblemen who stood up to the empire had to relinquish their titles. As her father’s only child, Leyrin Efran becomes a countess overnight, but to secure her family’s title and estate, legally she must be wed! She enlists info from the infamous Nine Night Guild to find a man of lower rank to keep the empire at bay. They deliver as requested (eep! he’s SO hot!), but things don’t completely seem as advertised...

(Source: Tapas)

In the far, far future...

"Jin" opens his eyes with no recollection of where or who he is. All he knows is that he's bloody, bruised, and a damn strong fighter. And just like that, Jin grows up without it occurring to him that his past is important at all. That is, until he's captured by a security company named "Scanner" and meets strange men who claim to be his former "Sunnyside Daycare" classmates. It looks like Jin's going to have to strap in for a bizarre and horrifying adventure...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Galetocherdo, a fearsome serpent shark with an unexpected soft spot, falls head over fins at first sight for a rabbit statue and decides then and there that a bunny will one day become his mate. So when he stumbles upon a white “rabbit” fast asleep on the roadside, he doesn’t hesitate to bring it home. There’s just one problem. Virdo insists he’s not a rabbit at all, but a hermaphroditic sea slug, and he very much did not agree to becoming anyone’s bride. Trapped in an unfamiliar place and relentlessly courted by a forceful yet strangely sweet shark who refuses to take no for an answer, Virdo is pushed into a whirlwind of misunderstandings, identity chaos, and dangerously close proximity. As Galetocherdo demands “proof” and the line between obsession and affection blurs, Virdo must find a way to escape...or survive...this wildly inappropriate marine matchmaking.

A high-energy monster rom-com featuring one stubborn shark, one very unlucky sea slug, and a sea full of misunderstandings, My Bunny Bride delivers four times the chaos and four times the trouble.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Once an enemy, now a husband? Femme fatale Veronica is sentenced to death for obsessing over the prince. With her life now in danger, she boards a ship to escape, unaware that it belongs to her archnemesis, the alluring Prince Halid. He agrees to help her, but only on the condition that she pretends to be his wife!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Won-Young gets unjustly suspended from work after getting caught up in a corruption scandal. But when he accidentally discovers the chairman's favorite artist Yoon Tae-Jun living under an alias, he is tasked with a tricky new mission. Could this be Won-Young's chance to get his job back?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Death comes to Gwon Young by scent. Every ten years, the person Young loves most dies. Hoping to escape the curse, he moves away. But then he meets An Ji-Ho, a man who seems to be quietly waiting for the end of his own life. Their connection forms fast and deep, filling the emptiness they both carry. But with another ten-year mark approaching, Young can’t shake the scent of death on the air.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A high school student, Im Da-Joon is used to being bullied at school. Right before he was about to end his own life, he saw the interview of a friend killer on TV by chance. He got impressed by the interview and decided to seek revenge. His revenge was successful, but his life went in the wrong direction… Im Da-Joon quit school and joined the group of teenagers who ran away from their homes. Da-Joon is now free from school bullies, but now he has to survive against the street gangs who are much tougher than school bullies.

(Source: YLAB)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

Dahlia Averin would've been just fine living as a pretty, loaded extra... were it not for the fact that she's destined to fall for Rudrik, the male lead, and be used to better his love life! Determined not to go down that path, Dahlia swears to just remain a friend and stay out of his romantic relationships. But upon discovering that Rudruk is not quite like she had imagined, she finds herself caring for him more. Will Dahlia's resolve stay strong, or will they end up as more than just friends?

(Source: Tapas)

After leaving the city behind, Jeong-Won returns to his seaside hometown of Samcheonpo. There, he meets Do-Jin, a runaway college student with a bad first impression and nowhere to go. When Do-Jin ends up staying at Jeong-Won’s house under the pretense of teaching him to swim, the two begin an unexpected cohabitation by the sea. As summer unfolds, their awkward start slowly turns into something tender - like the calm waves that bring them closer each day.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Modern-day culinary genius Ji-Yeong suddenly finds herself transported back to the Joseon Dynasty, trapped in the royal kitchens of the most notorious tyrant in history. To keep her head on her shoulders, she must satisfy the volatile cravings of King Yeon-San-- a man whose legendary temper is as sharp as the chef’s own knives. With political rivals plotting her downfall and a mad king watching her every move, can Ji-Yeong’s 21st-century recipes serve as her ultimate shield, or will her next meal be her last?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A prophecy foretold that the Grand Duke would only have one water elementalist born from him. Though she lacks her father’s affection, Keira knows she’s destined for those powers. But after years of doing what was right and proper of a noble, she’s executed after the conniving Cosette appears, claiming to be the Grand Duke’s real daughter. But then—Keira wakes up with newfound purpose: make changes, allies, and even friends before it’s too late. Will it be enough before Cosette hatches her plot?

(Source: Tapas)

Yong Seong-Il, on the verge of entering music college, lives a dissolute life with many women at his hideout until he suffers an accident where his finger is severed by a stray dog attack. After the accident, he approaches through the gap left by his missing finger, a blend of tragedy and comedy.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Didn't Mean to Seduce the Male Lead!

description:
Baroness Eleanor Mariche, renowned novelist and relationship expert, has been summoned by an ambitious duke to convince his son, Count Ryan Calabria, into marrying the princess. The problem is… not only does the count have no interest in the princess, he seems to have fallen for Eleanor instead! Now, she must deal with the wrath of his unhappy father, and also defend herself against a two-faced princess! Will she emerge victorious in this struggle for love and power?

(Source: Tapas)

In 2009, a resident of a small mountain village is shot and killed, and this murder leads to a series of sinister events. Jeong-U Cho, a boy who was born and raised in the village, begins to feel a mysterious gaze on him, and finds himself caught up in an uncontrollable disaster.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

"I'm going to break your back from now on." Han Seo-A, a seemingly ordinary high school student, attends Hasa High School to bring order to the students. It's not a game or a fight, it's piling!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Winner of the 1st GEN Excellence Award in 2020.

Gyeoul Yoon is no stranger to tragedy, having lost everything -- even her life -- because of her good-for-nothing father. When she reawakens after death, Gyeoul finds herself in the body of a newborn baby -- she is now Princess Mabel of the powerful Ermaneau Empire! With her doting new family and the empire’s might at her disposal, Mabel has everything she’s ever wanted. Upon learning that she’s the subject of a prophecy with the world’s salvation at stake, Mabel quickly realizes that there are people who will stop at nothing to destroy her newfound peace.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Aiden was a normal, albeit glitched, NPC trying to make ends meet to support his sister when suddenly, the all-powerful system administrator appeared and deleted his whole town during routine maintenance. Due to his particular glitch, Aiden instead gains the power of an administrator... but it's too little too late, as his sister slowly fades into nothing in his arms. With his new administrator update abilities, Aiden swears to get revenge on the unseen overlords of his world. He'll stop NPC’s from ever being deleted again!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: In the Shadow of the Spring

description:
Cha-Hui finds herself being forced to return to her hometown of Cheongna, where she practically ran away from after graduating high school. The reality of her family's poverty and misfortunes begin to overwhelm her, all while her first love and ex-boyfriend U-Kyeong insists on coming back into her life. She was the one who broke his heart, but he seems to still have feelings for her, flirting with her incessantly and making her waver. This is a story about Cha-Hui's heart-wrenching first love that she has no choice but to turn her back on.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Just four years ago, Rustica Genas was the most gifted knight in the Caleta Empire and one of the emperor's most trusted servants. But after challenging his will one too many times, all of her fame, glory, and power were stripped from her. Then what can poor Rustica do but shamefully fade into obscurity? Well, when the rival empire's ruler sets his sights on winning her heart and freedom, she might have a chance to reclaim more than just her reputation. What could be waiting for her just beyond the Great Barrier?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ever since being disowned by his religious parents for being gay, Kwon Yi-Hyeon has been all alone. After nine years, he believes he has gotten used to this life until he runs into Gu Seung-Hyeok, an old wound from high school. Now a ruthless gangster, Seung-Hyeok is just as cold to Yi-Hyeon as the winter they have reunited in. But when Yi-Hyeon enters a contract deal with Seung-Hyeok due to his financial troubles, perhaps their frosty relationship could turn into hope of a spring to come...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Suk-Yun is Mr. Perfect from head to toe with crisp creases in his suit, a handsome and fit figure... and an expensive wristwatch dominating his timetable. Woo-in fell for him HARD, because he’s just so... perfect. But over time, the beep of the wristwatch had more power over Suk-Yun than his feelings for Woo-in, so he left. To get over the breakup, Woo-in starts working for a cleaning company and just who is his first customer? The crazy messy junk-filled home of Suk-Yun, Mr. (Not 100%) Perfect.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.
Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Winter Anthology (포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

To pay off his parents’ debt, Hyeon-Do is sold into an arrangement as the fake fiancé of a powerful conglomerate heir. His supposed partner, Yi-Sak, is an infamous alpha known for his volatility, a man others call mad. Yet when Yi-Sak realizes his uncontrollable pheromones only calm in Hyeon-Do’s presence, their dangerous charade begins to blur into something else. As secrets pile up and emotions tangle, Hyeon-Do must keep his true identity hidden long enough to survive the wedding or risk being devoured by the man he’s bound to marry.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ex-idol trainee Gi-Yu has lived his whole life adored by everyone for his good looks. But he dreams of ordinary high school life, so when he puts on glasses to blend in with his peers, he finds that making friends is a lot harder when you don’t have your looks to fall back on. Not to mention he’s also socially awkward, his new seatmate has a permanent scowl on her face, and his fans have tracked him down at his new school.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: I Tamed My Ex-husband’s Mad Dog

description:
As soon as Reinhardt Lincke wakes up 15 years in the past at her father’s funeral, she stabs her husband, the crown prince, in the leg. Even though he is the one at fault, Reinhardt is the one who is punished. But fate seems to smile upon her when, during the rocky journey to her place of exile, she encounters Will Cohlonna, her husband’s “mad dog” and war hero from her previous life. Thirsty for revenge, Reinhardt decides to give Will a new name and use him for her revenge. This time, Reinhardt has the joker, and she’s playing to win.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

Hyeong-Oh’s disability has always painted a target on his back. It seems like no one at school, from his classmates to his teachers, can stand to treat him like a human being. That is until transfer student Cha Nam-Soo arrives. Quiet and straightforward, he makes no excuses for staying by Hyeong-Oh's side, but can Hyeong-Oh bring himself to trust this new friendship?

(Source: Tapas)

Just before becoming a god of the Higher Realm, goddess Seirene is betrayed by her friend Arwen and loses all her "Human Entertainment Points." To earn them back, she’s reborn as the daughter of Targa, an imperial bastard prince, and is on a mission to make him none other than the next emperor!

(Source: Manta)

"I only have the body as a collateral, but I better make sure it checks out."

Do-Hyeon Nam, loyal to his organization, used to indulge himself by fucking indebted women whenever he wanted. He then decided he wanted to live a normal life. By a stroke of luck, he met a nice woman and began dreaming of a modest future together... When one day, he was framed, stripped of everything, and executed by his boss.

"Even if I die... I'll take you with me!"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Yi-Hyeok and In-Seo have been friends for their entire lives. It’s something they take for granted. Just like the sky is blue and water is wet, the two of them are lifelong buddies. Or, well, that’s what they think right up until the moment In-Seo kisses Yi-Hyeok as a joke that turns into something more, sparking a whole new scorchingly hot relationship between them. It might be pretty funny, really steamy, and a little strange...but they’re still friends. Right? …Right?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 66 extra chapters.

“Do you know me?” A simple question was enough to change the trajectory of Lee Ha-kyung’s life. Seven years ago, Ha-kyung was struggling to support his family when he was approached by a man with an offer: assume the identity of Han Jiyoung, a girl from his past, for the summer and deceive the chairman of Taewon Group into believing he was really her, and he'd never have to worry about money again. All goes according to plan, until the chairman’s grandson, Yoonsung, shows up. One summer spent together forms a seemingly unbreakable bond between the two - and memories that should have lasted forever...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

By imperial decree, Duke Tristan receives his bride from the Kingdom of Haniel to form a marriage alliance between the two nations. After they consummate the marriage, his bride reveals that she's just a maid sent to test if he can do his business in bed...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Huhoe Namjureul Wihan Heungsinso Jeolchan Yeongeop Jung!
title.english: The Detective Agency for Regretful Male Leads Is Open for Business!
title.native: 후회 남주를 위한 흥신소 절찬 영업 중!

description:
After a lonely death from overworking, Selia Welfe finds herself reincarnated into another world... but not into a romance fantasy novel like she had hoped. Instead, she is the chief of a detective agency that specializes in tracking down runaway female leads! Immediately, she gets right to work, hunting for clues and risking her life to reunite couples and solve relationship issues. But when Selia rescues the life of a mysterious male lead, can she keep from getting too entangled in his story?

(Source: Tapas)

Once known as Mr. Perfect, MMA legend Sanghyuk Kang dies undefeated, only to be reborn as a nine year old young master in Murim. In a world without rules, where only strength decides life or death, he aims to become champion again.

(Source: Toomics)

Seon-woo is a pretty unassuming office worker, but he’s got a hardcore fetish: he wants some BDSM love from another man who’s willing to dominate. Enter his new co-worker, Tae-moon. Tae-moon is really hot, and based on a little snooping, he might be into men–and he’s showing signs of being a dom, to boot! Trying to start a sexy relationship at work can be rough, but Seon-woo likes it rough, so game on.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

Living in the slums of District Zero, Ban runs a small errand service, taking on jobs others would rather avoid. One day, he accepts a request from Shinwi, the boss of a rising criminal organization, and stumbles upon the existence of the mysterious “Project W.” While investigating the substance, Ban hopes to help Ray, the police officer who once took him in and whom he has secretly loved for years. But the deeper Ban digs, the more he uncovers a hidden truth Ray has long been keeping hidden. As secrets surface, Ban finds himself caught between loyalty, love, and a dangerous conspiracy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sometimes one splash is all it takes to make waves. Swimming prodigy Woo Seungwon, whose very being is vast and endless like the ocean, runs into former a-list singer Doh Si-on. Si-on, now a businessman trying to stay afloat, is doing his best to move forward with his life; but the weight of the world only drags him down, as if he is struggling to crawl through a swamp. Taking an interest in Seungwon, Si-on offers him the opportunity to make some extra money as his housekeeper…and perhaps do a little extra work on the side…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 40 extra chapters.

My best friend betrayed me! Born from a low-ranking noble family, Angela grew to be renowned for her beauty and grace, becoming the prized angel of society, all with my enthusiastic support. Yet beneath that glitz and polish, she was simply... evil. She used me and had me killed out of sheer spite in her quest to become the empire’s greatest woman. But unlucky for her, a magical gift from a dragon has given me a second chance at life. No longer blinded by her light, I’ll do all I can to stop her!

(Source: Tapas)

Ji Soon-yi’s always been the type to keep to herself. All her hobbies are things she can enjoy alone, and she’s the happiest when she’s at home by herself. Except…her neighbor certainly isn’t the same. Nam Changlim may be a stud, but he has a different girl over every night and each time, Soon-yi can hear everything that’s going on between him and his female companion. Annoyed, she curses Changlim and wishes that he be turned into a cock if that’s all he can think about. Alas, she’d forgotten that she’d purchased a magic candle holder earlier on that day… And the very next morning, she wakes up to find a very disgruntled, very animate dildo at her door. Uh-oh. Soon-yi did think her neighbor was too cocky, but she didn’t mean for the curse to be so literal…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kwon Woo-young and Ko Tae-sung were always the closest of friends—inseparable and unbreakable.

Their relationship took a drastic turn when Lee Soo-hwa, a timid classmate from high school, grew closer to Woo-young. Tension and jealousy began to simmer between the two friends, eventually erupting in a mysterious incident that shattered their bond.

Even after enrolling in university, they couldn’t repair their friendship. Struggling with his unresolved emotions, Woo-young chose to enlist in the army, hoping to bury his feelings for Tae-sung. But neither time nor distance could erase the complexity of his emotions. After his discharge, he moved into a new apartment—only to discover that Tae-sung was living in the same building.

What began as innocent friendship now burns with an intensity Woo-young can no longer deny.

(Source: Lezhin US)

My life was ruined after you bullied me in high school. So why do you get to be happy and successful? I’ll give you a taste of your own medicine! Now you’ll see what it felt like to be me... And you better be ready to pay the price if you want to return to your own body.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

When life gives you fairies, make a deal with them!

When a young boy living locked up in a prison cell meets a newborn fairy, he begins to experience new emotions and, for the first time, dreams of freedom. His new fairy friend can help him attain just that, but nothing comes for free. First, he'll have to enter into a fairy pact!

(Source: Manta)

Picture this: It’s your final year of high school, and you can’t wait to get out there and live your best life. You blush at the popular kid, and eye the new transfer student with bruises on his face. You’re looking forward to the future… Until you wake up in the future, with no memory of the last six years. Suddenly finding herself as a 25-year-old aspiring actress, Miyeon Seo begins to unravel the painful threads of her forgotten past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hae-Ri Jin is an aspiring actress who hasn't had the best of luck. But this time, she has a good feeling about the show she's about to audition for. Since it's a period piece, she decides to stop by a historical museum and comes across a beautiful incense burner from the Baekje era. Mesmerized, she prays for good luck, but little does she know that she has awoken a god named Onsaemiro who was trapped in the incense burner. How was she able to free him? Because she is the reincarnation of a princess of Baekje who was once Onsaemiro's lover...!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Your kiss smelled of lemons.

When Ga-Min steals a kiss from his sleeping classmate, Kang-Go, he’s positive he’ll never get caught. But what he doesn’t know is that Kang-Go has a unique gift — he can smell emotions. Now, Kang-Go’s on the hunt for the identity of his secret admirer, whether Ga-Min likes it or not.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: The chapter count includes 7 side story chapters.

title.english: Why the Villainess Wields the Sword

description:
No one knows how the pampered and wicked Erin Lisus suddenly becomes a top swordsman at Atenz Academy. That's because they don't realize that Erin was actually transported to the past after being killed by her stepmother and was reborn into different worlds. Now, with her past experience as a swordmaster, Erin's out to get revenge and rescue her allies from her stepmother's grasp. But with foes at every corner, can Erin save her loved ones? Or will her reason to wield the sword vanish with them?

(Source: Tapas)

Bearing the traitor’s brand, Se-un Tang spent a lifetime creating the tools of the Murim's destruction, waiting for a single moment to strike. But when the decisive moment comes, he is instead thrust back in time, carrying the weight of a future that hasn't happened. Let the furnace roar, let the hammer sing, and let their blood quench the steel. The Demon Smith stands before the anvil once more to forge a path tempered in vengeance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Emotions are something that cannot be suppressed even in a game company that buries their employees in overtime! This is the beginning of a secret office life where young people refuse to give up on either their work or love!

"That's strange... Why do you keep lingering at the back of my mind?"

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Aranhrod assumes the throne as the 17th ruler of the Laincaster Empire through the sole support of Grand Duke Roark, her most loyal and dedicated servant. Yet his devotion is met with her cold indifference, which he accepts with grace — that is, until night falls, and he has her begging for mercy.

(Source: Manta)

When Lee Chae-Rin kicks the bucket, she’s whisked into a dark fantasy novel as Rose Estania, a chambermaid at the mercy of the tyrant crown prince, Kalix Forsman. Armed with nothing but her real-world hotelier skills and a diary from the real Rose full of cryptic hints but no escape route, she's forced to navigate a dangerous world teeming with Kalix's enemies. Can she keep his wrath in check, evade death, and find her way back to reality before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

A scatterbrained, talentless civil servant returned as the heavenly Demon. He now wished to live the rest of his life peacefully, as his days in the Murim world were full of conflict and bloodshed. However...

"Please be my father until I graduate."

He suddenly gained a daughter out of nowhere.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Born with incredible luck, Jeong-Yeon always has good things happening to him. Then, the most perfect-looking guy, Lee Yun-Seong, appears before him. Yun-Seong, who had always received attention for his good looks since birth, didn't like people who only approached him for his face. So, he wasn't thrilled when Jeong-Yeon expressed his interest right after meeting him.

"Can I call you hyung? Yun-Seong: “Heeeey~ I hope we see each other often from now on.”

After their awkward first encounter, Yun-Seong gets annoyed whenever he keeps bumping into Jeong-Yeon wherever he goes. But Jeong-Yeon, completely unfazed by his irritation, keeps pestering him. Before he knows it, Yun-Seong finds himself quietly falling for him...

“Were you satisfied with my role as your living dildo last night?”

The story of Jeong-Yeon and Yun-Seong, who bicker and clash every time they meet.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In a world where only Guides can stabilize Espers, Wonwoo, a soldier and Purifier, is swept into a parallel world through a mysterious fog, where he faces his dying self and gets a second chance at life. As he starts anew, he encounters the ruler of the North, Yoon, who seems strangely familiar...

(Source: Manta)

In an ancient world where martial artists reign supreme, Un-Seong can only watch as his master is brutally beaten to death after a false accusation of practicing forbidden demonic arts. Even after a valiant fight, he fails to kill those responsible and faces his own end. But fate has other plans… Instead of taking his last breath, he awakens as a child, training to be an elite soldier of a demonic sect. Now Un-Seong must embrace the demonic arts and harness power in his ultimate quest for revenge.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

The rampant spread of a virus has turned most humans into grotesque beings called “the Rotten.” Amidst the ruin, Seonho leads a small group of survivors and protects his companion Haesoo, who is bullied for being weak and timid. Seonho’s group is thrilled to meet more survivors with a large stockpile of supplies—until they realize that this new group is shockingly barbaric and cruel. By far the most twisted is their leader Won, who has his dangerous eyes on Seonho. Determined to shield Haesoo, Seonho makes a deal with Won... but will any of them make it out alive?

(Source: Tappytoon)

While decoding an ancient manuscript, two hunters fall under a suspicious curse, and there’s only one way to break it — a true union of bodies. Will the stoic, eccentric Ha-Rim and the dapper yet inexperienced Do-Yoon succeed in this awkward and intimate operation?

(Source: Manta)

Desperate to save his father from crushing debt, Mi-Eum is compelled to accept a risky offer from a ruthless loan shark. The terms are clear: assume the role of a house servant and get close and gather vital information about the enigmatic young master of the house, Baek Ji-Tae. Upon entering his new workplace, Mi-Eum's mission takes an unexpected turn as he's assigned to assist Ji-Tae with an unusual task - his bath. Mi-Eum understands that this unique opportunity is his key to getting closer to his target. Yet, the moment their eyes meet, Mi-Eum realizes that no matter how much he may cry and weep, there is truly no turning back now.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Time travel is the bread and butter of romance fantasy novels, but the reader who wakes up as Liberata has had enough after the first 19 times. Sure, she's the villainess of "The Highs and Lows of Leonie's Life," but she keeps getting killed even when she's not trying to be evil! Not expecting anything to change in her 20th life, Liberata gets blackout drunk at a party... only to wake up next to the novel's male lead, Archduke Gerlach Cygnus! And the more Gerlach falls for Liberata after their one-night stand, the more the world around them starts falling apart...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: One Last Night With My Soon-to-Be Ex-Husband

description:
Bellia, the unfortunate Grand Duchess fated to die at the hands of her dangerous husband, planned to endure her loveless marriage just long enough to get a divorce. But before she could leave, one unexpected night changes everything.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: My Secret Business with My Boss

description:
The man leading up So-Young's new team at work not only has a handsome face but is clearing packing something sizable in his pants. She can't help but steal glances at the prominent outline until one day, gazing at her like prey caught in a trap, Tae-Kyung asks, "Do you really like it that much?"

(Source: Manta)

Cha Geon-Wu spent years nursing a hopeless crush on his classmate Lee Tae-Jun, ever since middle school, all the way into college. Tired of dragging around a first love that never went anywhere, he escaped into military service just to reset his heart. But the moment he’s back on campus, destiny laughs in his face, as a required course throws him right back into Tae-Jun’s orbit. Soon, one run-in turns into another, and somehow Geon-Wu ends up trapped in a new cycle he never saw coming. One where Tae-Jun isn’t just the crush he tried to forget…but the person he’s suddenly sharing a bed with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

At Midsummer High, Yeon-Su Guk is at the top of her class, while Wung Choi is ranked dead-last. And it’s not just their grades -- their personalities couldn’t be more different, as Yeon-Su is a no-nonsense stickler and Wung is a care-free slacker. When a filmmaker comes to make a documentary about their school life over the course of a month, they’re not exactly thrilled to be spending so much time together. However, as the month goes on, they begin to discover each other’s hidden depths. At least one thing’s for certain - they’ll never forget this summer!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue and a special episode.

Tragedy hits art genius Hyun-Sung Kwon in waves as his sponsors betray him and he falls into a slump. At risk of losing everything, he is forced to stop investigating his mother's scandal, only to realize his ex is the new beneficiary. Amidst the chaos, three men approach with ulterior motives...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I'm a Villainess, but I Won't Live Like One

description:
Bianca is just another noble lady with a simple dream: to marry into a dukedom and enjoy a life of luxury. But everything changes when she stumbles upon a book—one that casts her as the villainess, doomed to stand in the way of her real-life fiancé’s love story with a commoner girl. As Bianca realizes the book accurately depicts her own fate, she refuses to accept her tragic ending. Can she rewrite her story, or is she simply destined to become a villainess?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Gardener in a Hunter World

description:
Jiha is living a relatively quiet life, gathering resources after raids and selling potions from his general store as a worker-class hunter. Little did he know, taking a nap on top of an ancient text would completely change his life. He is transported to a magical forest, where he gathers rare ingredients to create never-before-seen potions and meets mythical creatures that help him on his adventures. Soon, he starts to build up his abilities to become a skilled alchemist, and high-level hunters start to see him in a different light. How will Jiha make use of his newly acquired skills?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sung-Bin, a serial philanderer and public enemy number one of the male students at his university, is confessed to by Ju-Won, a gloomy young man who has recently returned from a leave of absence. Sung-Bin initially plays along to sate his boredom, but things start to develop in a way he doesn't expect.

(Source: Manta)

Adrian Vernity would only ever scowl at his classmate Liz Plomento whenever he saw her. So imagine Liz's shock when she wakes up 5 years in the future, married to Adrian! Not only that, as Emperor and Empress, they are expected to consummate their marriage. Can Liz find a way out of this royal mess?

(Source: Manta)

Meet Aimu Hanamichi, a young man who towers just over 2m10cm tall but has a heart as soft as a teddy bear.
He constantly battles stereotypes and the harsh judgements of others. Will Aimu learn to love himself the way he is, will he change, or will he drown in the pressure and misery of all the misconceptions surrounding him?

Feared as the Divine Demon, Cheon Jeong lived and died on the battlefield, knowing nothing but violence. When death finally claims him, it should have been the end. Instead, he awakens thirty years later in the body of Mujin Hwa, the powerless heir of a ruined clan. His overwhelming strength is gone, replaced by a frail body and enemies closing in from every side. To protect the siblings now in his care and reclaim a clan on the brink of collapse, the fallen legend must begin again and build a future from nothing.

(Source: WEBTOON)

He found a child. He had lived under the ridicule of the world and raised the child, who became both his daughter and lover, in confinement for twenty years. Later on, hyenas attracted by the scent of money showed up in the place he had meticulously hidden.

"Old man, they said you've got loads of money. How about you give me some?"

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Stories of their last days.

I work at a nursing home, taking care of elders living their last days. I deal with their childish tantrums and shed tears as I listen to their life stories. They constantly amaze me with their insights, and most importantly, they remind me of the value of life.
