(Source: Manta)

Chosen by the last remaining Seabird, Lott has been cursed with a target on her back. After the notorious Woohoppiage pirates pillage her village and kidnap her sister, she embarks on a perilous journey to get her back. And she’ll do whatever it takes to make that happen, even if that means joining the Black Ocean crew and pretending to be a man. But she's not the only one with a secret on this pirate ship…

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I'll Just Look for a New Family

description:
Disgraced and executed for a crime she did not commit, Lady Letizia Manere is reborn to a time before everything went wrong in her life. Determined to make sure she doesn’t suffer the same fate, Letizia rebels against her family and the confines of high society. When the mysterious man who showed her kindness in her past life is in danger, she intervenes and becomes embroiled in a plot she could have never imagined. Can Letizia save herself and those she loves when given a second chance at life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A heart-warming tale of music.

Isn't classical music for the rich? Hokyung grew up in an average house, so despite his passion for the violin, he never dreamed of becoming a violinst. When the small violin he had outgrown breaks, his visit to the luthier takes him on an unexpected journey...

(Source: Manta)

Elena, the only daughter of a wealthy family, accidentally witnesses a friend's intimate moment with her lover and becomes curious about sex. As she grows closer to her loyal chauffeur, Kale, their secret bond blossoms into a forbidden love her father can never accept.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

When Seul-Yeong brought a puppy home, she never expected it to be an android — a sex android that looks exactly like her terrifying boss, Manager Seo! Now she's stuck hiding her look-alike manager at home while acting normal at work. But when her boss suddenly leans in for a kiss... chaos and temptation spiral out of control.

(Source: Manta)

Kang Taeyang, a chef who chased his dreams. One day, he lost everything due to a single choice. But an opportunity came to Taeyang, who was spending hopeless days working odd jobs. [Aurora is hiring employees.] A single line of text changed everything for him!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Vampire's Plans to Die in Peace

description:
After a failed attempt at ending her own life, our female lead is reborn in the body of a blood-sucking Vampire who is unable to die. To her dismay, she discovers that she is Luna, the Final Boss of the Novel, "The Hunter and the Saintess,", which she read before jumping to her death.

She realizes that her once chance at a clean death is the prolonged and painful end, destined for her at the hands of the novel's protagonists.

"Please, can't i just die in Peace?!!!" With centuries to go until the protagonists are even born, Luna launches a multi-generational master plan to change the course of the original story. If the protagonists are provided will all the tools and benefits they need, they could destroy her with ease, allowing her to end things in peace.

For centuries, Luna executes this master plan, only to have her own involvement interrupt her desired outcomes at each turn. With powerful abilities and the influence of noble houses at her fingertips, will Luna's plans to find and raise her fated killers succeed? Will she get the peaceful death she desires?

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

Shy and reserved Lee-Won has admired the charismatic Seo Han-Gun for years, but their unexpected friendship blossoms into first love during middle school. Torn apart by reality, they lose touch for eight years—until a chance reunion in Busan forces them to confront old wounds and lingering feelings. Can love overcome the pain of the past?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.english: Contractual Marriage to a Surly Duke

description:
Tragedy strikes when Selene’s parents pass away, and her family loses everything. With no other option at her disposal, she works multiple jobs to provide for her siblings. Luckily an opportunity for financial security arises; all she must do is marry the duchess’s son, Armand, and produce an heir. But the home situation Selene enters is complex, and Armand, once a great commander, is housebound with a mysterious condition. She’s determined to find the root of his illness, but she might drudge up some skeletons in the closet instead...

(Source: Tapas)

When Hwieon survives his brother’s demonic attack, a grim reaper leaves him one cryptic mission: find the living Hungerwraith. Now a reluctant ghost-hunting streamer, he crosses paths with Gyeol — the worst possible ally, and the one person he can’t seem to walk away from.

(Source: Manta)

The once-great Madorim sect has fallen on hard times after being embroiled in the Great War of the Heavens. The sect's Supreme Leader, Ju-Rin, is now faced with the return of his long-lost grandson, the son of his daughter whom he had abandoned many years ago. Possessing the same otherworldly beauty as his mother, he initially appears to be nothing more than a pampered scholar, unfit for the world of martial arts. However, he is in fact the King of Mount Wumian, the very same man who defeated the mighty Yellow River Dragon King, one of the Ten Great Masters of the Martial World! Having returned to Madorim in order to fulfill his mother's dying wish, Jin Murin, the Mountain King now sets his sights on reviving the sect and restoring it to its former glory.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Childhood friends Ju-Hyeok and Su-Ah once promised to stay together forever, but when their secondary genders manifest in reverse, their worlds drift apart. Years later, Ju-Hyeok’s dream of Olympic gold is on the line, and Su-Ah might be the only one who can help him reach it. What follows is a story of fate, pride, and a love that refuses to yield.

(Source: Lezhin US)

E-Yan is a Korean songwriter who has been struggling with a slump. Despite wanting to write love songs, he can't force himself to. Due to his job, E-Yan starts working with the hottest rising star in the K-hiphop industry, Cha Hyun-Ho, who is famous for writing psycho songs despite being a good person in real life. Though he catches E-Yan's eye, E-Yan forces himself to brush off his growing feelings for Hyun-Ho, for the sake of both of their careers, but, because they're signed on the same label, E-Yan and Hyun-Ho keep ending up together...

(Source: Tappytoon)

After falling victim to a deepfake scandal, Tae-Ri seeks justice at the police station. There, she meets Prosecutor Chi-Kyung Park — a man as composed and calculating as he is impossible to read. But when she refuses his settlement offer, his calm begins to unravel, and a dangerous obsession takes hold.

(Source: Manta)

Laviore Rea Bailey, the fake saint and heartless puppet of the merciless Prince Sidar, drinks poison on the day the prince is to give her up as an offering to the devil. Instead of dying, she reincarnates 10 years in the past. Set on righting her previous wrongs, Laviore vows to save the slave Damian Rhode Drake, whom she had once framed as a spy. As she gets closer to the mysterious Damian, new feelings start to emerge, but will this former villainess truly be able to change her ways?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Genius Swordsman of Mount Hua

description:
After being ambushed by the Demonic Cult, Goheon Dok and Hyeonjo, his close friend from Mount Hua, are cornered and on the verge of losing their lives. Before they're both killed, Hyeonjo hands Goheon the Plum Blossom Spirit Beads, a sacred relic of Mount Hua that causes Goheon to take possession of the body of Muhwi, an apprentice of Hyeonjo. Now, as a Senior Disciple of Mount Hua, Goheon Dok must fight to protect Mount Hua and fulfill his friend's dying wish.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Adel always wanted a family to love her, and she may be close to getting her wish. Upon realizing she’s the Child of Prophecy destined to lead the empire, Duke Aizen adopts Adel—but only for a month! Given an uncertain future, Adel tries to win over the hearts of as many of her found family as she can: her reserved adoptive father, the reluctant maid, even the colorful group that makes up her guards. Will it take more than being good (and eating those yucky bell peppers) to stay in this castle she now considers home?

(Source: Tapas)

A mysterious man suddenly appears in the desert separating the East and West Continents. A young boy, Yulian Provoke from the Pareia tribe finds this man, and brings him to his village. Turns out the man is an incredibly strong and amazing individual, and he begins to teach the young boy fighting skills.

For fourteen years, Yi-Hyun Han has hidden her love for her childhood friend, Yu-Jin Jo. But when the two suddenly end up living together, Yi-Hyun is forced to confront her buried feelings for him — feelings that soon take a sensual turn. With Yu-Jin harboring sparks of his own, will their friendship finally ignite into romance?

(Source: Manta)

A skillful secretary by day and choosy cruiser by night, Su-Ha is a young professional who’s in search of some no-strings-attached action. He hasn’t had much luck lately, though, since a handsome face doesn’t always match what’s in a guy’s pants. This might be why he finds himself wondering about his dreamboat boss, Director Park Ji-Woon. But there’s no way he can mix business with pleasure… That is, until Ji-Woon and Su-Ha run into each other in the gay bar bathroom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Contains 54 side story chapters.

Se-Jin, a dedicated high school teacher, reunites with Ju-Hwan, the school’s temporary chairman—and her first love. After an unexpected night, she tries to leave it as a memory. But Ju-Hwan suggests a three-month “bedmate” relationship, and Se-Jin finds herself sinking deeper into feelings she meant to forget.

(Source: Manta)

Lydia thought she'd finally get to live a life of luxury after being reborn as a noble in a magical world. Little did she know, she's actually a side character in a novel doomed to die at the hands of Ash, the merciless, psychopathic villain. Her best shot at escaping is to have the heroine distract him while she tries to run away. But the only problem is... the heroine keeps dying! With a limited number of magic tricks up her sleeve and her quick wit, will Lydia ever make her great escape?

(Source: Tapas)

The Earth has a message for all of its inhabitants: the world is ending in 42 days, and monsters will bring about the apocalypse. Game studio employee Jeong-U Park is selected by the Earth as someone who can save the planet, but he must first survive in a world where people are now killing each other for power. He also must compete with other saviors to retain his planet-saving abilities. As doomsday approaches, can Jeong-U become the savior the world needs?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Seo-In has a lover, Ki-Tae, who he met in college. Ki-Tae has a long-time best friend, Mu-Yeong, and Mu-Yeong has a younger lover, Min-Ho. Ki-tae and Mu-Yeong each have their own lovers, but they are tightly bound by a long-standing relationship, and Seo-In and Min-Ho cannot easily enter into that relationship. Even though Seo-In and Min-Ho are both awkward and uncomfortable, they have no intention of leaving the side of their loved ones. Until that terrible incident that day.

At the same time, Seo-In and Min-Ho were betrayed by their lovers. While Seo-In is engrossed in other things, Min-Ho, who is completely wounded, visits Seo-In and talks to him while looking at the stars. Seo-In becomes aware of Min-Ho for the first time, but their relationship ends there.Seo-In thought so, but several years later, Min-Ho, who has become a successful professional golfer, appears in front of him. Unlike in the past, Min-Ho makes a direct approach to Seo-In, and Seo-In cannot stop his feelings for Min-Ho.

However, as if by fate, Ki-Tae and Mu-Yeong, who had hurt them both, appear in front of them again...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

What’s a girl to do when she wakes up in the body of a villainess? Meldenique Babelloa is a supporting character in a romance novel starring her fiancé, Duke Lennox Hessman, and… her sister, Sheria! Heartbroken, she eventually dies a tragic death as a villainess… or so the original story goes. Determined not to follow the script, Meldenique resolutely abandons her old life and sets out to open… a stationery shop! Will she succeed in defying fate and building the stationery shop of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: includes five extra chapters.

When Dabi Song meets Dr. Han, the memories hit her like a ton of bricks. This is THE Junghyun Han—the WORST blind date she's ever had. Whether 10 years ago or now, he's still the same socially awkward jerk. So when on one fateful business trip, Junghyun discovers her sex toy, Dabi couldn't believe his offer. He wants me to train him... to be boyfriend material? For another woman?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After thirteen years as a loyal employee of the Soonyang Group, South Korea’s largest business empire, Hyeon-U is rewarded with betrayal–and murdered–by his employers! Miraculously, he’s given a second chance, reborn back in time as Dojun Jin, grandson of the founder of the corporate dynasty that betrayed him. In a daring quest to rewrite destiny, he will not only attempt to settle the score; he will aim for the ultimate hostile takeover.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Calahan, a famous hunter who has captured 999 wanted criminals, chooses Johnny the Grifter as the final target of his career for a reward of 10 million pais. But Johnny, a con man who preys on the pockets of the elderly, insists he's innocent... "If I prove my innocence, you give me a million pais.” Calahan and Johnny embark on a wild ride with a million pais on the line, and a mysterious group of men in hot pursuit. There's only ten days until they reach their destination, and both will do whatever it takes to win the bet - dead or alive.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

title.english: My Home as a Filming Location!

description:
A young beekeeper in the countryside, Yeon-Woo spends his free time drinking out of frustration. That is until he gets too drunk to remember signing a contract to rent out his house as a filming location for a variety show. Now Yeon-Woo finds himself sharing space with kind and handsome star actor Do-Jun Kang. Will this city transplant and country mouse’s budding bromance survive beyond 10 days of shooting?

(Source: Manta)

Min-Ji and Yu-Na have been best friends since high school, and Min-Ji counts herself lucky to have someone so pretty and kind in her life. She just knows that when she finally starts dating, she wants it to be with someone as amazing as Yu-Na! Everything seems perfect, but things start to change when Min-Ji begins having dirty dreams… ones starring Yu-Na herself! Min-Ji chalks it up to her own loneliness, but for some reason Yu-Na starts acting strangely when Min-Ji tells her about it… Is she upset, or could it be that Yu-Na has harbored feelings for Min-Ji all along? From unrequited love, excitement, and obsession, just where will these bad thoughts lead them?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Si-Won dreams of becoming a fashion designer. He meets his perfect model in Seo-Hu, the famous “bucket-hat guy,” from campus. With his angelic face and perfect proportions, no one else will do. But the closer the two become, the more a strange feeling of temptation creeps in...

(Source: Manta)

Stripped of everything he cherished to a pack of vampires, Se-Geon meets the legendary Jinma Slayer Sylvester and enters the path of the vampire hunter... Welcome to the lunatic moon.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A heartbreaking, fantasy romance of the two wounded souls finding their way back to each other again. "He abandoned me as a child, and I lost my voice. When I was reunited with him I was already broken."

Little Bella, a war orphan who once trusted for survival; grows up carrying an abandonment wound. It’s a life without purpose, she’s the unseen, unheard, and a war slave. Kiris embraces Bella, a girl he once abandoned, now has been forgotten. Maybe it is too late when he’d found...

(Source: Netcomics)

What would you do when you've transmigrated as the most-hated villainess in the story? In the case of Marso, she tried hard to change the storyline by performing good deeds and taking care of the female lead. However, things are not going as she had hoped for—every character in the story still hates her! It seems no matter what she does she cannot seem to change her fate. Tired of trying, Marso declares that she'll stay home and do nothing—for the rest of her life.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

As a young boy, Tae-Ha Jin’s life is turned upside down when an attack during a family yacht trip robs him of his parents and future as heir to the Cheon-Gu Group–Korea’s leading conglomerate. Uncovering the dark truths behind the accident–one of vicious power struggles and family betrayals–he escapes to Italy, vowing revenge. Seventeen years later, Tae-Ha is finally back in Korea. A man driven by vengeance, he can’t wait for the sweetest revenge as he makes those who robbed everything from him pay dearly. The stakes are high, and the battle with Cheon-Gu begins!

(Source: WEBTOON)

As Maurina, she's on the run as the last of her kingdom’s royal line. Disguised as Marie, she is just a maid, serving the victorious empire. She’s never been very good at anything, so when she's told to make a wish, she asks for the ability to help others and bring them happiness. Now as visions of brilliant and skilled people fill her dreams, she’s imbued with a bounty of abilities perfectly suited for any dilemma. But will her secrets last as the crown prince seeks out both Maurina and Marie?

(Source: Tapas)

Ten years ago, a group of gods turned everyone on Earth into players of a sadistic game that forced them to kill monsters in real life -- or be killed themselves. Sehan Kim has already seen how this game will play out: everyone in the world dies except for him. When he’s given the chance to go back in time and start a second playthrough, Sehan is determined to change the course of events and beat the gods at their own game.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Sweeten the Deal: Believe in Love

description:
Jaeyeon has been in love with Nana ever since she started looking after him as a kid, but he’s always kept it a secret. One drunken slip-up finally exposes his feelings, turning playful teasing into something far more real. On a warm summer night, a one-sided crush spirals into a sweet, chaotic rom-com romance neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

My boyfriend was secretly planning to marry my best friend. In an instant, I lost both the person I'd promised my future to and my friend. It felt like all the misfortunes of my life had hit me at once. But then, my brother's friend, Seo-Yoon, showed up and gave my life hope.

(Source: Manta)

Eve was once a human woman who loved to read romance novels. But after being reincarnated as an ice magic-wielding wolf hybreed in one of her favorite stories, Eve runs into a dragon hybreed named Rahel who will kill her in the future and fall in love with her little brother, Sion. Now, Eve thinks her only hope of survival is to save enough money to move to the human world. But as Rahel grows more attached to her, Eve has no idea if she'll cool Rahel's fiery nature or burn in a blazing inferno!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Don't Want To Play Matchmaker!

description:
After being reborn into a novel, Shuryna, knowing her ultimate fate, plans to become a magic knight and retire rich. However, her biggest obstacle is the four men in love with her best friend, Hestia. They're supposed to chase after Hestia but want Shuryna to be their matchmaker. She refuses since that role was what led to her banishment, but the boys are relentless. Can Shuryna grasp the wealthy retirement she desperately desires? Or will Hestia's love interests lead to her downfall again?

(Source: Tapas)

Han Seo-Ha is a warrior who fought to the end against the evil empress who ruled the world. She died in a final battle, but woke up in the past, the day she entered a portal called “Gate Dragon.” This portal was actually a virtual reality game that took people to a fantasy world full of monsters and dangers. She decided to use her knowledge of the future to survive and change the fate of the world but, she will have to face many obstacles and enemies who tried to stop her, Seo-Ha will also find several allies and friends who helped her on her journey.

Upon returning from a business trip, workaholic Ko Minhae is met with the news that her crush is engaged to her roommate. Devastated, she tries to drink away her sorrows before a horrific car accident sends Minhae into the past. With a second chance, she swears to live differently... starting by confessing to her crush! But unbeknownst to her, her plans are put in danger by a secret admirer who has his sights set on her. This time, will Minhae finally succeed in making her love come true?

(Source: Tapas)

Kyunghee's strapped for cash and with classes about to start soon, he's running out of options. He was fine last year, Sihyun paid him well for his "company." But that ended not long after it started. The old man was clingy and the last thing Kyunghee wanted was a relationship. Things make a turn for the worse when Kyunghee meets his mother's new boyfriend, a vindictive Sihyun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jihan is a college student with a special ability: he can see the future through psychic dreams. One day, he wakes up from a vivid dream about a guy who gets into a car accident. Jihan feels like it’s his responsibility to help this person, but he wasn’t able to see his face. Frustrated, he tries to brush it off with a coffee at the cafe near campus, only to realize that the barista is the guy from his dream. Will Jihan be able to save him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Fresh out of an abusive relationship with a controlling ex, tattoo artist Geum-hwa heads to Japan to work for a mysterious customer. When he arrives, he learns that his client, Ryusei Katamoto, is the handsome half-Korean son of a yakuza family. The tattoo work Geum-hwa will be doing is a cover-up for a huge burn scar on Ryusei’s back. And though Ryusei and Geum-hwa are curious about each other, Geum-hwa’s obsessive ex is far from giving up. Can a new relationship cover up these old scars?

(Source: Lezhin)

Following the trauma of a studying-induced death, Geenie is reborn into a fantastical realm filled with magic, orcs, and talking spirits. As Geenie Crowell, the daughter of a noble and a bona fide genius, everyone has big plans for her, including her new parents, teachers, and even the king! Not too keen on all these high expectations that might end badly for her again, Geenie thinks up the perfect way out from slaving over a hot magic wand: if she becomes a summoner, she'll be able to summon a spirit and have them do all the work! But Geenie will soon learn that there’s more to it all than just adorable spirit companions and collecting mana. Being a summoner comes with great responsibility–and dangerous consequences as well.

(Source: Tappytoon)

A school filled with woman! But wait... Do they really think i'm a girl too?!!

(Source: Toomics)

Magic grants what the heart desires… at least that’s what the grand sorcerer Charlotte Eleanor always believed. Charlotte saved the world while also forming a following of five disciples to learn her magical gifts. Despite all that, she still couldn’t find the true love that her heart desires. Now, after her death, she’s been reborn into Aria Lisen! With the help of the Grand Duke Louister, can Aria finally find her true love, while keeping her new identity a secret from her former disciples?

(Source: Tapas)

Obsessed with medieval fantasies, Marina develops a revolutionary VR device that can bring fictional worlds to life. Her dreams come true when she transports herself to Lasnarok, the setting of her own novel. The problem is, she can't get back out! Disguised as a runaway slave boy named Rino, she comes face-to-face with the main character she created, the ambitious Edward Allen Dihas. Can Marina help him overthrow the emperor and survive to make it out alive?

(Source: TappyToon)

Ji Ho’s week has been, to put it simply, quite eventful. He’s still getting used to being back in university after a leave of absence, he manages to snag a killer offer for a place to rent in downtown Seoul, and on his first day in the new house, he runs into a robber! The strange thing about this robber(?) is that he doesn’t seem interested in any valuables, but is enamored by the story Ji Ho scribbled down in some old notebooks. So enamored that he offers to keep house for Ji Ho so that he can concentrate on writing more. Ji Ho initially refuses that odd proposition, but the more he thinks about it, the less he has to lose...

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Won-Jun moves into a new apartment for his first day in college, he was not expecting an ex celebrity, Du-Na, to be living downstairs, hiding from her past life. Won-Jun finds Du-Na strange and avoids her at first, but soon finds himself in her room without realizing what he is getting himself into.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

Sold to pay off debts, Yu-Il worked at a members-only club catering to perverted clients. After stealing a customer's money and fleeing, he meets the priest Mu-Jin in a remote countryside village and falls for him at first sight. One night, Yu-Il witnesses Mu-Jin's secret, forbidden affair, something he should never have seen, and is caught aroused by the scene. Mu-Jin, whom he believed to be an ascetic priest, inflicts sadistic and obscene punishment upon Yu-Il. Yu-Il, as if confessing his sins, has his desires laid bare, gradually succumbing to Mu-Jin's influence. However, hidden within Priest Mu-Jin lies a dangerous secret that leads Yu-Il into deeper depravity...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Actor Kim Sung-Jae follows a suspicious man who claims to be his temporary manager for a filming assignment. However, they arrive at the village of a cult he escaped at age 15. Just as he's about to flee this place filled with horrific memories, Sung-Jae accidentally kills the cult leader. To make matters worse, followers, searching for the leader, storm in. In a desperate situation, Sung-Jae makes an irreversible choice. And the man who led him here also begins to slowly reveal his identity...

"You said you liked movies, Pastor."

Once on stage, the camera never stops rolling. A sinisterly beautiful cult thriller romance, CAST A GOD

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In a desolate world left only with extreme cold, a man named Chang-Jo lives alone, bravely and robustly thanks to his innate health. Chang-Jo works as a graveyard keeper in a village emptied by death, using knowledge gained from books to handle various tasks. One day, he discovers Yeon-Hwa collapsed in a snowfield. He picks him up and brings him home...

“After peeling the chili, you fuse together.”

Chang-Jo does his utmost to save Yeon-Hwa using the knowledge he learned from books (?).

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Jia Gang, the greatest swordsman of Joseon, fails to avenge his master and dies, descending to the underworld. Possessing a special soul, Jiagang is promised a chance for revenge by the King of the Underworld and takes on the path of a Grim Reaper who captures evil spirits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"Hey, loser. Did you just try to look at my panties?"

An ordinary guy gains the power of the Incubus, and stops time right before getting slapped by a sexy girl...!

"How dare you try to hit me? You need to be punished!!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

A summer special short story that unfolds in the background of a hot summer.

Contents:

1-5. Isegye Harem Yongsa (이세계 하렘 용사, This World's Harem Knight) [ero404]
6-10. #Dongmil#Yeoreum#Cheotsarang (#농밀#여름#첮사랑, #Dense#Summer#Firstlove) [Shampoo]
11-15. Pyega Eseoui Harutbam (폐가 에서의 하룻밤, A Night at the Ruins) [Daljakja]
16-20. Eeokeon Jom Gochyeojwo! (에어컨 좀 고쳐줘!, Please Fix the AC!) [Sin Yu-Ri]
21-25. Hanyeoreumbamui Angmong (한여름밤의 악몽, A Midsummer's Nightmare) [Sin Yu-Ri]
26-30. Geu Yeoreum Narui Chueok (그 여름 날의 추억, The Memories of That Summer Day) [Dongjijigi]
31-36. Paradise CLUB (파라다이스 CLUB) [ttwook x Maneul]
37-42. Yeoreum Sonagi (여름 소나기) [SSAEM x Ohagi]

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

We often follow stories of a man at the very top, surrounded by his harem. But what happens when we follow the man behind him, scheming to take it all out from under him? A drama of Machiavellian proportions, what's his is mine now.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Head down to the gym, and get yourself a trainer. But be careful, or you'll end up getting closer to her than you think. Want me to help you with the stretching?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

He comes back to his hometown after 7 years, and finds himself stuck between beautiful girls! A sexy girl in a diving suit, and his friend's mom with a mature body...!

"Want to do things that we couldn't do before?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Choi Hyeon-Gyeol is trapped in a hellish temporal prison. Every time the clock strikes midnight on the 15th, he is ripped back to the start of the previous day. Forced to repeat the exact same university assignments twenty times over, his sanity has worn dangerously thin. Pushed to his absolute breaking point by the monotony, Hyeon-Gyeol decides to abandon all caution and indulge in a wild, impulsive escape from his scripted life. This leads him to an unexpected, heated one-night stand with his fellow classmate, Lim Yeon-Jeong.

He falls asleep expecting to wake up to the same familiar nightmare once again. However, against all odds, the loop finally breaks. For the first time in what feels like an eternity, Hyeon-Gyeol opens his eyes to the fresh, uncharted morning of the 15th... with Yeon-Jeong right beside him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Mighty Delinquent of the Dan Clan

description:
Hongmun was a lowly warrior who secretly mastered the Dan Clan’s forbidden martial arts. In a battle against the Black Flame Sect, he met his death. But when he opened his eyes, he had become Wolbin Dan, the infamous fourth young master of the Dan Clan. Now blessed with a body perfectly suited for the martial arts, he is determined to rewrite the past and prevent the destruction of the Dan Clan with his own hands.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Han-Soo is an aspiring civil servant, preparing for the civil service exam. One day, he runs into his first love, Ji-Yeon, who also is preparing for an exam. She is joining a notorious "study club" for hookups.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Nam-Seok came back home after 10 years to run the family dojo. His life turned upside down when he heard that his childhood friend, Jeong-Bin, was actually a girl.

"I didn't know Kendo could be this lewd!"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Tae-Ho, the only guy in the dance department, always gets treated like a slave. One day, he finds a pair of sexy panties in his room after a party. Since that day, all the girls start acting strange, coming on to him with their lewd bodies...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jin-Myung has lived his whole life looking up to his father, even though he was only a lowly footman.

“This is an important job, the one who carries the flag and represent the country.”

In this epic adventure, Jin-Myung starts with just a tattered pair of shoes, a staff, and great ambition. But starting from his lowly station, he will train to become the mighty "Flag-Bearing Warrior"!

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

Undocumented immigrant Chang Rhee lives quietly working at a restaurant until all his colleagues suddenly die in a mysterious incident. Though he was there, no one remembers him. The only clue is Hwi Yoo, a man who died years ago, but spoke to him that day. From then on, reality begins to twist.

(Source: Manta)

Eom Ji-Cheok was just an underappreciated hunter's assistant until an odd dream and a simple thumbs up triggered his awakening as a hunter and hot GodTube influencer. Ji-Cheok doesn't earn points by killing monsters though. Instead, he must do good deeds and gain the approval of others. So when a heroic video of him goes viral and top companies start wooing him with contracts, it seems like the sky's the limit. But will fame be a more dangerous game than our rising star expected...?

(Source: Tapas)

For the past four years, Hye-Yeong has been juggling three jobs to pay off her father’s debt, all while single-handedly caring for her younger sister—never missing a single payment. But just as she’s on the verge of finally breaking free, her life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with Ji Joo-Chan, the enigmatic executive director of Shinwon Finance.

Is her luck finally about to change? Or will she be dragged into his dark world instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: I Am the Commander of the Second Male Lead's Knights

description:
After a monster attack kills her family, Nina is sold to House Louvoirennais, where she meets Adrian—a tragic secondary lead destined for abuse, betrayal, and death. Determined to rewrite his fate, Nina becomes his friend and protector. As she rises through the ranks of the Black Knights, her simple plan is to save the sub-lead. But when Nina accidentally summons a powerful elemental named Sol, she realizes her destiny may be greater than just saving Adrian... She might have to save the world.

(Source: Tapas)

Promotional Manhwa for the webnovel.

I came into the world of a novel I was reading, and became an unknown extra destined for a miserable life. Teaching manners to a crazy bastard who turns into a tyrant?

Manners, my ass!

Quick thinking was my only means of survival. I tried everything to prevent such a tragic relationship with the tyrant from happening. I kicked, punched and screamed his head off, but I was still beaten in the end. Actually, he’s unexpectedly docile at times and even told me,

“You’re the first person who understands me.”

The male lead’s personality is strange.

Wan’s got a face that scares everyone away before he can really become friends with anyone. So when Ha-woon befriends Wan on his first day at his new school, Wan is elated. Ha-woon must be an angel! It doesn’t take long, though, for Ha-woon to betray him in a terrible way, and Wan discovers Ha-woon might be more devil than angel. But then an accident happens that gives Wan a second chance at friendship with his angel. And it all starts with one big, fat lie.

(Source: Lezhin)

Life on rough, rundown Ira Street isn’t easy at the best of times, but a recent string of murders has left the residents traumatized. Not Shavonne, though. He’s too busy trying to get by to worry about some murderer. However, that all changes when he meets his peculiar new neighbor. Lewellyn is young and handsome, yet eccentric. Why does he spend all day peeling onions on the apartment stairs until his eyes are red-raw? And what’s with those filthy black fingernails? Nevertheless, Shavonne reluctantly accepts a dinner invitation at his neighbor’s place. But after he makes a gruesome discovery during the candlelit meal, suddenly the murders feel a lot closer to home…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Imagine if your grandparents magically became 17 years old again...That they had a second chance to relive their youth and possibly fall in love again, or actually for the first time. It’s the beginning of a fresh start, literally!

(Source: Tapas)

Lim Hyeonseon has lived an ordinary life, and now, as he reaches his forties, he feels an urge to start something new before it’s too late. He decides to take guitar lessons and joins a music academy. There, he meets Cha Yeoreum, a young and passionate guitar instructor. As their friendship grows, Hyeonseon begins to rediscover a sense of vitality and excitement in his life. But life is never without its surprises. When Yeoreum starts to reveal his tender affection for Hyeonseon, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, bringing new challenges and emotions to the surface.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Alphas lust for Omegas, and Omegas want Alphas. That’s the way of the world, but Karlyle isn’t your typical Alpha. He doesn’t thirst after every Omega he sees—well, let’s say that things are complicated. Karlyle feels no need to change, but when troubles occur with his sex life his doctor suggests something surprising. Try sleeping with Alphas, instead of Omegas. Karlyle finds this solution strange, but the doctor says he knows just the person to help him out. Ash comes into Karlyle’s life just like that, and Karlyle finds himself thinking about Ash more and more. More than friends, but not quite lovers—how can we define this relationship?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

I woke up as Kayena Hill, the novel's villainess, praised as the greatest beauty in the empire. Who knew that her story would catch my attention because I was her in my past life? Destined for terrible ends, I've died twice—but I refuse to die a third time as a pawn in someone else's scheme. I’m no longer the vain and naïve princess. Now that I know how the story will unfold, I’ll turn the tables around and have everyone dancing to my tune. This time, I’ll be the one pulling the strings.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Gloriosa Elvador can bloom flowers that produce harmless flames, but her evil brother, Magnus, deems her power worthless and feeds her to the sacred tree. Although she's resigned to die, she reawakens in the past as her 13-year-old self with a second chance at life. Now, she must find her cursed betrothed, Arvid Yultecia. Only he can save her from dying again, and only she can lift his curse. Will their blooming love be enough to save them both, or will Magnus trample their budding romance?

(Source: Tapas)

After 12 years of horrible nightmares that prevent him from getting sleep, Ujin Kim dies and wakes up to find himself in the world from his nightmares! Surrounded by demons of all kinds, he quickly realizes that he’s been reincarnated into the body of a mercenary and heads out to find civilization. He quickly learns that this is a world filled with magic, a Church fighting the demons, and all sorts of sketchy characters. But hey, at least he’s finally able to get some sleep!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Actor Gyeong Wu-Hyeon is a devoted fan of painter Do Han-Ah. When a treasured piece of Han-ah’s artwork is stolen from him, Wu-Hyeon is devastated, but fate steps in when he unexpectedly runs into Han-ah again at a charity event. To his surprise, Han-ah doesn’t remember him at all, and a small misunderstanding quickly snowballs into the two of them falling into bed. Determined not to let the moment slip away, Wu-Hyeon sets out to show Han-ah just how much he truly values his work. As Han-Ah slowly begins to open up, he finds himself drawn to Wu-Hyeon… yet every now and then, he catches a cool, unreadable side to Wu-Hyeon that he just can’t figure out.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Renowned for its exclusivity, only the children of Korea’s elite can attend International Island High. But when Kang Do-Ha, an ordinary girl from an average family, is given a lucky chance to enroll, she’s thrust into an unfamiliar world of money and power. Despite trying to fly under the radar, she somehow ends up in the same dorm as Rowoon, the most popular guy in school! He seems to have it all, but when it comes to girls, he’s completely clueless. Can Do-Ha teach him how to win a girl’s heart?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

“I have erectile dysfunction.”

Not exactly the kind of confession Woo Hyeon-Woo ever planned to make, but a few too many drinks later, his biggest secret slips out to his classmate Ha Jeong-Yoon. Mortified, Hyeon-Soo braces for pity or laughter… but Jeong-Yoon just grins.

“Then why don’t we test it out? Who knows? Maybe I can fix you.”

Wait, what?! Before Hyeon-Soo can process what’s happening, he’s suddenly part of Jeong-Yoon’s “scientific experiment.” What started as drunken honesty turns into a very hands-on test of chemistry, curiosity, and terrible decisions. Now, every accidental touch feels like a loaded dice roll. Will it be a total flop, or a nat 20? Caught between panic and possibility, Hyeon-Soo wonders if maybe, just maybe, his biggest problem wasn’t physical after all…

Because with Jeong-Yoon around, something else is definitely ""rising"" to the occasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Lillian Sergenev bumps her head and realizes she's been reborn into a hardcore tragic romance simulation game! As the sister of the game's protagonist, she decides then and there that she's going to change the game by preventing her sister from being locked up by the crazy, obsessive male lead. She is determined to keep the two from meeting at all costs, but what is she supposed to do when said male lead suddenly turns up on her doorstep... as a gift from her father?!

(Source: Tapas)

After being whisked away to another realm, Lee Kangjoon spent centuries defeating powerful foes, commanding armies of the dead, and bending entire realms to his will—becoming one of the greatest emperors and necromancers ever. Having achieved everything, he now only wants peace and quiet. Upon finding his way back home to Earth, he expects just that… only to face the most daunting quest of his life: raising a daughter. Can a man who once ruled kingdoms and overthrew rulers conquer fatherhood?

(Source: Tapas)

To avoid her predetermined death by guillotine, Siella Labyrinth befriended Tirielle, the female lead. But their friendship only lasts until Siella discovers that Tirielle is in an affair with her fiancé! Reeling from the shock and betrayal of this plot twist, Siella decides to get back at the adulterous pair by proposing a revenge affair to the male lead, Crown Prince Raynous, who accepts her offer. Will this new affair help ensure Siella's survival or bring her an ending she never expected?

(Source: Tapas)

Victimized by her little sister's trick, Hwa-Yeong heads to the imperial palace to participate in the crown princess selection process. Now she'll have to put up with… six months of palace stay?! No way! As a last resort, Hwa-Yeong tries to do everything wrong to get disqualified and sent home early but instead finds herself in the royals' favor. What's worse, coincidence keeps bringing Shin-Yeong, the Crown Prince, in her way, and now things are becoming more intense and personal for both of them. "You wish to get kicked out now? I'll do everything in my power to see the opposite happen!" Will Hwa-Yeong see her way through these obstacles and return home before six months?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

After being reborn in a novel, Renee Blair is determined to transform her reputation as "the villainess of the century," which will prevent her death at the hands of Sir Dywen the dragon slayer! But then she learns that the original Renee had been controlled by a pop-up game system of daily missions that forced her to either commit evil deeds or face painful penalties for declining. With this system continuing to affect her as well, can the new Renee outsmart the game and reset her evil legacy?

(Source: Tapas)

Childhood friends Yeon-Woo and Ji-Soo love each other, but their inability to express their feelings verbally leads to misunderstandings and clashes. They attended kindergarten and college together, yet never find the time to confess their feelings. As time passes, the distance that hinders them only grows wider. Yeon-Woo's confession, Ji-Soo's confession—more than once, with repeated failures—they seem to be growing increasingly distant...

When will they finally be able to finally convey their feelings?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: How To Reject My Obsessive Ex-Husband

description:
When Yu Seo-Hyeon sacrificed her life to save her first love, Ciel de Leopart, she never expected to wake up as Irene de Closhe in a world straight out of a book. Amidst this bizarre twist, she reunites with Ciel, who has now become a supporting male lead destined to betray the crown prince. As her unique guide abilities resurface, Seo-Hyeon is haunted by Ciel's intense, madness-filled gaze, a stark contrast to the man she once knew. Tangled in a web of past love and new identities, Seo-Hyeon must navigate a treacherous path where past and present collide.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

It’s Christmas Eve, and Doyoung’s made a reservation at a luxurious hotel in the hopes of spending a romantic day with his crush, Hyunjin. But nothing seems to be going according to plan. They lose cell service, miss their reservation, and drive through a terrible rainstorm only to arrive at a haunted-looking hotel. When Doyoung asks for a refund, the imposing concierge insists he must participate in a game—a game that quickly turns Christmas into a nightmare.

(Source: Lezhin)

What if one little misunderstanding led to the biggest mistake of your life? Lee Kang, dominant alpha and the heir to the Se-ryong foundation, first helps out Yeo Juheon because he feels sorry for him. But the more he gets to know him and the closer they get, Kang starts to fall for the beta for real. They could be a thing, or so Kang thought… His whole world comes crumbling down when he finds out Juheon is already someone else’s. That’s already 7 years ago now, but Kang’s still reeling from the hurt… until he figures out maybe he was in the wrong after all. After years of hurt and misunderstanding, can Kang find his way back to the love of his life?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Children--pure, innocent, and ready for a new beginning with their foster parents. But here at the Dead Mansion, those seemingly innocent features become lethal assets. Our orphans are schooled under the finest instructors, ensuring they meet your highest expectations and are sure to impress. However, these guardian angels come with a steep price tag. Perfection, after all, is a cruel mistress. Would you like to see the catalog now?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Love is the new kid on the block when he runs into the Peach Club, the local gang. Simple and gentle, with an interest in sex toys, Love isn't looking for trouble. Too bad the gang's got plans for him. And so does their leader, Peach.

(Source: Lezhin)

My friend of 15 years Hyung-Woo has always been secretive about things. But one hazy night, he's bitten my lips because... he was a vampire all along! "I'm a vampire and now... so are you!" Why do I suddenly feel... thirsty?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Sweet Life of a Reincarnation Pro

description:
Arel may have been born as a prince of the Ernesia Kingdom, but this is actually his 101st life! He has been reborn into multiple types of universes that were full of magic, qi, and even spaceships. So this isn't his first fantasy world, and he's going to make use of his magic knowledge to take it easy. His past 100 lives have taught him that the best way to avoid dying young is to keep his head down and make lots of money. But let's see if this reincarnation pro can finally live the sweet life.

(Source: Tapas)

On a mission to find the two most important people in her life, Sica steps foot outside the Magician's Tower for the first time ever! She soon meets Karsus, a mercenary swordsman who looks like her first love. Despite being confused for someone else, Karsus offers to help find the people Sica's looking for if she helps him with his work. Thus the two begin their adventure ― one that will change not only the fate of the Empire, but also their hearts! First love or Karsus… who will Sica choose?

(Source: TappyToon)

Once a winner of the middleweight challenger’s decider bout showdown, Junseo Kang is now a retired fighter struggling to overcome his worst nightmare: zombies. Every time fear catches him, he sees others as zombies. Now with the new opportunity rising, he sees his way out: join the ranker game, win the prize money, and overcome his fragile mental. In an all-or-nothing showdown, a total of 100 characters must fight for their players and eliminate each other to get to the top 5 ranks to win the accumulated prize money of 20 million dollars.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baphomet is the ruthless, dispassionate lord of the Abyssal Tower, a mysterious, monster-filled dungeon plaguing the human world. Many Hunters seek to defeat him and bring the tower down to no avail. Despite his demonic power, Baphomet grows curious about humanity. One day, Baphomet is defeated by Raven, the strongest Hunter, and realizes that his true wish is to be just like the humans he previously looked down on. In death, he is granted his wish, as he awakens as a human – without his powers!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Grand Duke’s Bride is a Warrior from Hell

description:
Alicia Sirius Rayne, a timid, stuttering spinster betrothed to the rumored "Grand Duchess Serial Killer," falls into Hell after opening a mysterious artifact. Now, she must adapt to survive. Years later, she has become a fierce warrior. But as she sets out to conquer all of Hell -- she wakes up in the past. Armed with a second chance at life and a new goal, Alicia must actively pursue the feared Grand Duke Reikart Tessen to secure her destiny. Can this fierce warrior from Hell win the heart of the man who has "killed" six grand duchesses?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Can't Take My Eyes Off You!

description:
Taeho’s barely scraping by after moving out of his parent’s home when he catches just the lucky break he needs: an easy, overpaid job as the manager of top celebrity, Wooyeon (overpaid being the key word here). The job starts to take a weird turn when Taeho notices that people tend to like Wooyeon a little too much... Fans are one thing, but the adoration Wooyeon ignites is something else. And why is everyone at Wooyeon’s agency related to him? Meanwhile, Wooyeon can’t figure out Taeho doesn’t adore him like everyone else. How long will it be before Taeho discover’s Wooyeon’s secret...?

(Source: Lezhin)

Mikhail Walpurgis didn't feel qualified for the title of Hero, and instead let the warrior Siegfried lead the prophesied battle against the Devil. But after Siegfried dies and the army is defeated, Mikhail has one last move before the end of the world. And so he turns back time. Now, Mikhail has the chance to reclaim the title he gave up and save everyone. The only problem is, no one believes the prophecy about the war! Can Mikhail manage to gather an army and make this life count?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Boss is My Biggest Fan!

description:
By day, Naeul Ju is an unassuming pushover at J&H Tab House. By night, she is Author Juna, a popular writer known for her web novel, Love Shot. No one knows about her secret double life except for her two closest friends. Hiding behind her taglines, she struggles to speak up while working for her ignorant boss, Dobin Kwon. She finds comfort in her cyberfriend, Dobi, who has always been there to support her. Workplace drama, pen names, and hidden identities… what will Naeul do when she realizes that Dobi is actually her ruthless boss, Dobin?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Shall I Write Your Love Letter?

description:
Employee-of-the-Month champion and service-industry all-rounder Lim Seongshik thought he’d seen everything, until he wakes up inside a bleak BL novel as none other than Elliot Brown, a minor villain doomed to die. In the original story, everyone meets their end at the hands of the protagonist, Arzen Theron. So Elliot decides to keep his past life as a writer hidden, lie low, and quietly avoid the one event that triggers the tragedy: ghost-writing a love letter.

But life—and his cat—have other plans. A desperate situation forces him into becoming Arzen’s personal bed attendant, of all things. To make matters worse, his “secret identity” as a writer gets exposed to the novel’s original love interest. Before he knows it, Elliot is back to ghost-writing letters… this time for Arzen himself! But something’s off. The Arzen in front of him doesn’t match the cruel lead he remembers...

Can Elliot keep faking those letters just enough to dodge his scripted death ending? Or has the story already started to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: A Tale of a Hundred Nights

description:
Ho-Yeon Baek is fed up with his bad luck. That phony shaman telling him his nightmares are the result of being haunted by spirits was one thing, but sleeping with a hundred different souls in a human body to get rid of those dreams is another! The body in question? Dan Choi, dreamboat celebrity. He’s just as haunted as Ho-Yeon, but that’s nothing compared to the sadness he seems to carry inside. Strange powers brought them together, but could this odd relationship turn into something more?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The hot new guy in Min-Soo's department turns out to be none other than his childhood friend, Jun-Won. But Jun-Won thinks of Min-Soo as more than a friend. Finally craving into Jun-Won's persistent advances, Min-Soo agrees to go out with him for one semester. While Min-Soo's plan is to make Jun-Won grow sick of him during that time, will Min-Soo succeed? Or will Jun-Won manage to win Min-Soo over?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and seven extras.

Hong Yo-Han has finally realized his dream of owning his own home. On the first day of moving in, he invites his friends over for a housewarming party and spends his first night in his new home with excitement, but unexpectedly sees a ghost. Thinking it was just a nightmare, Yo-Han is tormented by the ghost appearing at random times. By chance, he discovers that the clue to solving the ghost problem lies with his awkward colleague, Go Philip, and in desperation, he invites Philip into his home...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Do-Hwa, who can see ghosts, becomes susceptible to possession starting on her 30th birthday. Coincidentally, he is possessed by a lustful ghost who happens to be a virgin. Wandering in his possessed state, he encounters Mu-Yeong and tries to attack him. However, Mu-Yeong, being a grim reaper, recognizes Do-Hwa's possessed state and helps the lustful ghost achieve enlightenment...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: The S-Class Baby Princess Is Too Powerful

description:
Princess Anatrisha is only a year old, but her life is already far too complicated. Her father, the emperor, is cold and distant, and her mother is nowhere to be seen. Her older brother, meanwhile, is bullied by other nobles. Luckily, Anatrisha was an S-class hunter in her past life and is set on using her skills and magic to protect her loved ones. Can this little princess defend her right to the throne and bring her family closer together? Or will it be game over for this S-class baby?

(Source: Tapas)

After staying late to work overtime, Lee Gi-Yun stumbles upon his boss, Jeong Yi-Tae, masturbating at a coworker's desk. Horrified, he tries to leave, but a disembodied voice urges him to stay. When Gi-Yun tries to record Yi-Tae’s depravity, he is caught, and something about his boss seems disturbingly off. From that moment, Gi-Yun is pulled into a warped reality where nothing feels certain. As his relationship with Yi-Tae takes a dark turn, strange and ghastly events begin to plague the office, ensnaring both Gi-Yun and his coworkers.

In this story of erotic horror and psychological dread, Gi-Yun must uncover the truth before reality slips away entirely..

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Can't Go Too Far with the Unrelenting Duke

description:
How can her one-night stand be her student's guardian? Amelie escaped her life as an abused housemaid and became the youngest professor at the Royal Academy. When a prophecy reveals that the person she marries will die an untimely death, she decides to spend a passionate night with a handsome stranger before succumbing to her destiny. However, she is shocked when she comes face to face with her one-night stand again, for not only is he her student's guardian, but he's an unrelenting duke who will stop at nothing to win her over. Will the star-crossed lovers beat destiny and find their happily ever after?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

"Everything you see and hear here must be kept a secret."

Chi-Seong receives an offer to handle chores at a billionaire's secret pool party. He heads to the vacation house, hoping to build connections with the elite. But he soon gets caught up in some trouble as he encounters a series of unexpected events and temptations.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Kidnapping, murder, and risqué relationships! Within the scandalous pages of The Abysmal Flower, the downfall of Roxana Agrece's criminal family is already foretold. So when Cassis Pedelian, the heroine's older brother, is kidnapped by Roxana's father, she can either wait for the heroine's revenge... or take matters into her own hands, since Cassis is the key to her survival. But with deceitful characters on all sides, can Roxana and Cassis trust each other enough to bring down the brutal Agreces?

(Source: Tapas)

Ashley thought she and her husband were in love, but he abused her and she died giving birth to a child. Before she could take revenge on him, she opened her eyes and found herself in a pre-marriage phase with him. She felt like she was going to live that hellish life again, so she looked for a replacement husband for her. Ashley went straight to visit Duke Esperad Camedici, who was rumored to have been afflicted by a curse after his fiancée died under mysterious circumstances.

"I'm Ashley, I would like to ask Your Grace to marry me."
"Does what you said mean that you wish to die now?"
"Do you think the misfortune that has befallen me is a joke?"

Ashley knows that he will become emperor, so she tries to win his heart. Moreover, she has finally replaced her husband, and yet he is still arguing with her. Will Ashley be able to take revenge across time and space and succeed in replacing her husband?

(Source: KakaoPage)

The first time Vedis transmigrated into the novel “Princess of Eventide,” she followed the original plot exactly for seven straight years—and lost almost everyone she loved along the way. Lucky for her, she’s been sent back to the start again along with her close friend Rosanne, the princess of Moselberg. Together, they will do everything in their power to prevent the violent rebellion and save the people they love. But when they start making different choices, what else will change? And will they discover the traitors in time?

(Source: Tapas)

Once a slave, Lev is unexpectedly freed by a passing nobleman named Nox and brought into his household to start a new life of quiet stability.

But everything begins to shift the night Lev shares a bed with Arad, Nox’s close friend.

From that moment on, the balance between the three begins to twist, tangle, and unravel, turning the mansion into something far more complicated than a place of refuge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Adrienne Trovica, the sole Grand Duchess of the Rhonta Empire, suddenly dies from a seizure and wakes up in the body of Countess Bleiah Acacia, who looks exactly like her. As it turns out, Bleiah is no ordinary woman. She was the mistress of Adrienne’s loving husband, Noevian Trovica. Adrienne, shocked by the news, attends her funeral as Bleiah to confirm the rumor. To her surprise, she sees a man crying for her at her grave. Who is this mystery man, and was everything that she knew about her husband a lie?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Asil, a poor noble, enters the academy as the top student, determined to restore his family’s honor. Instead, he becomes the target of relentless bullying. Seeking justice, he confronts Valery, only to face an even harsher fate. Reduced to Valery’s pawn and isolated from everyone, Asil searches desperately for a way out. But Valery’s growing obsession only tightens the chains around him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Kaira willingly risked her life to make her beloved Prince Reagan emperor. But when the man she sacrificed it all for crowns her cousin as empress instead of her, she loses the will to live. It’s only when she’s finally succumbed to a lethal dose of poison that she’s met with the tears of a heartbroken Prince Faylon, and she realizes her love was wasted on the wrong person. Vowing to exact revenge if ever given the chance, Kaira is thrust back in time to right the wrongs committed against her and reclaim the title that is rightfully hers. As she joins hands with Prince Faylon and sets out to punish those who conspired against her, she’ll discover a world she once took for granted and seek to correct the course of her fate.

(Source: Tappytoon)

A beautiful and successful news anchor, Yeo-Jin's life looks perfect from the outside. But in reality, she's trapped in an unhappy marriage. Not only did her husband have an affair with her close coworker, but he also murdered her parents and stole their company. Yeo-Jin thought her life was over, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back on her wedding day. Watching her husband and his mistress flirt, Yeo-Jin swears to get her revenge. She will do whatever it takes, even if she must marry her husband's older brother.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Manny, a member the Seven Sins gang and a secret informant for the police, loses his partner to a brutal serial killer. Before he can even process the shock, his boss assigns him a new partner - Sean, the one colleague he can’t stand. To make matters worse, his contact at the police asks him to dig into Sean’s past, suspecting he’s hiding something. With no choice but to get close, Manny turns to the method he knows best: seduction.

(Source: Lezhin US)

There are animals that were abandoned by Dangun and live secretly in the human world. Narae, an ordinary high school student, discovers their existence... A modern version of Beauty and the Beast with comedy and exorcism action.

‘Will the project of becoming human, for the animals that could not become human, be successful?'

(Source: Naver, translated)

Following an intense session of physical intimacy, Dojun is blindsided by a statement from his girlfriend that defies all logic and expectation. Instead of the usual post-coital whispers, she drops a bombshell that leaves him reeling in shock: “Babe, have you ever thought about getting a fuck-buddy?” Far from being a test or a trick, it turns out to be the opening act of an extraordinary "Harem Project" specifically designed to handle her boyfriend’s inexhaustible stamina and high libido.

The ambitious goal is set: seven different women to fill every single day of the week, ensuring he is never left wanting. As the boundaries of their relationship dissolve into a provocative new reality, his girlfriend even takes the lead in scouting the candidates. With a mischievous glint in her eye, she suggests the perfect starting point for their scandalous venture: "First... how about the girl next door who always masturbates while eavesdropping on us?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Former ranker Lee Hoyeon is looking to make it big in the new VR game, "Labyrinth World." He isn't about to get his hands dirty doing all the work, so how about recruiting someone else to get things done? Enter Kaiser and Lina, his new henchmen. They've got the skills, the brawn, and... a thirst for blood! Kaiser and Lina will take down anyone standing in their boss's way, but as the bodies pile up, Hoyeon starts to wonder if his lackeys aren't just insanely strong, but rather flat-out insane!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Child Will Have a Different Father

description:
“Fate, save my unborn child…!” These are the last words of Princess Hinael as she plummets to her death at the hands of Count Chetaire, her unfaithful husband. Little does Hinael know that destiny will grant her a second chance, as she awakens two years in the past, shortly before her marriage. With her knowledge of what’s to come, Hinael attempts to rewrite the stars for herself and her future child. And what better way to achieve her ambitions than to court her kingdom’s former enemy, the dark and stern Prince Lutz of the Empire of Triekas?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Eliano, the daughter of a powerful duke, marries the seventh prince of Jakador, and they fall in love. But their happiness is short-lived when the prince ascends to the throne. After suffering a miscarriage, she is cruelly poisoned by her husband and dies. Eliano miraculously wakes up to find herself 21 years old and is now determined to avoid the tragic future she once lived. Will she be able to find happiness in this new life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Adele Leopold has perished at the hand of the emperor three times now. As soon as her fourth life begins, she vows she won't go down the same path again. Filled with vengeance, Adele starts her new life with a plan to get back at those who wronged her. In all her lives, the one thing in common is that emperor wants her married into his family. This time, Adele will choose her husband and get the revenge she has been waiting for. But the person she decides to marry is no one anyone expected...

(Source: Tapas)

Once a year on a cold midwinter night in the Empire of Hartan, a fortress of frost appears, revealing the resting place of a blue-eyed demon said to grant any wish – for a price. When Princess Estelle of Hartan flees her abusive imperial family, she is encounters the otherworldly Frost Fort and makes a pact with Satael, the blue-eyed demon of legend. Pledging her body and soul to him, Estelle begins to plot for the crown.

(Source: WEBTOON)

I possessed a character in a female-oriented dating simulation game. As the Second Prince, he seduces the female protagonist to overcome his inferiority complex toward the First Prince, Edward. I don't want to be killed by Edward. I don't want to interfere with someone else's love life, and I don't want to be hated.

"You like her. I have no feelings for her."

"Right. It's better not to like her. You'll never end up with her."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Simon's sister asks him to boost his account because she's busy. But it turns out the guild his sister belongs to is for women only.

(Source: Toomics)

Jeong-Cheol is a gambler, a failure, and now a divorcé after ten years of a marriage that finally collapsed. Before he can even catch his breath or curse his miserable luck, the very person who started it all returns to his life. Ji Min-Yeong, the ex-lover who terrified him, chased him, and yet was the one he loved more deeply than anyone else, appears without warning. Standing before him with the same chilling certainty as in the past, Min-Yeong whispers the words Jeong-Cheol fears most:

“I will stay with you until the moment you die, Cheol."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Go Yi-Young, a mystery game enthusiast, is walking down the street while leaving a review for the popular mystery game The Sin of the Blue Silhouette when he fails to avoid a bicycle and gets hit by it. When he regains consciousness, he realizes that he has entered the mystery game he was playing just a moment ago, and in order to survive, he tries to prevent the murder of the culprit he saw in the game, Cha Gyeon-Woo...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Idel Fleure was born without a scent in a noble family where fragrance defines one’s lineage, causing her to be ostracized. She escapes a forced marriage by being accepted into Euphiter Imperial University, but finds herself bound in another marriage– one to Archduke Chaeron, who is drawn to her scent that only he can smell. Chaeron proposes a contractual marriage, and agrees to take her as his wife for three years and then divorce her. Will this seemingly contractual partnership conclude as smoothly as planned, or will the Archduke’s fascination with Idel’s scent lead to a different ending?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Knight Becomes a Black Flower

description:
Diana Lesley, a renowned knight of the Agripana Kingdom, is killed by her rival Cornelius Heimann in the war against the Heverunia Empire. However, when she wakes up, she finds herself at 10 years old and decides to pursue the life of a proper lady instead of a knight—much to her family's disapproval. After becoming Princess Juliana's lady-in-waiting, she must contend with conniving noblewomen, the threat of oncoming war, and the affections of Cornelius who, in this life, dreams about her past life and falls for her. Can she keep her loved ones safe and live in peace?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Young Ruan, the little lord of House Marcellion, has never had an easy childhood. With his older brother constantly feigning illness, the burden of the harsh heir’s training falls squarely on his small shoulders. One day, unable to take it any longer, Ruan dashes out of the mansion and loses himself in the forest. There, he stumbles upon a boy his own age. They don’t exchange names, and yet none of that seems to matter. With him, even nibbling on grass becomes an adventure. Ruan finds himself laughing, playing, and perhaps for the very first time, feeling free. Day by day, his thoughts drift further from the rigid lessons of succession and closer to the warmth of that kindhearted boy. But gossip spreads quickly, and soon even the stern Count Marcellion hears whispers of his son’s wandering heart…

Could a simple forest friendship change the path of an heir?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

Naturally charming, Irene attracts women like a magnet, even when she doesn't mean to. Enter her best friend, Claudia, who refuses to marry any of her three suitors because of her affection for Irene. As a result, these powerful and mentally unstable men declare Irene as their rival in love and threaten her life. She knows none of them deserve to be with Claudia, but she doesn’t want to die! To save both her friend and herself, Irene must prove she's their ultimate rival, but will she succeed?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

Soo-jeong is always getting on the self-absorbed Eunchan's nerves since he first appeared before him out of the blue.

Soo-jeong feels the same way towards the socially inept Eun-chan, who is often harsh towards him. Their ironic relationship develops as they try to survive together, even though they don't trust one another.

What should you trust? Your past experiences and memories, or intuition?

Note: The chapter count includes five side story chapters.

The Song family's true biological daughter appears, shaking Ju-Ha's world. Seeking an escape from an unwelcoming home, Ju-Ha embarks on a series of blind dates until she meets Sa-Hyeon, who boldly suggests setting a wedding date within minutes of their first date. Just as Ju-Ha starts to develop feelings for him, her cunning younger sister—who has already taken everything else from her—declares her intention to marry him instead.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The Exorcism Agency is a state-run secret organization whose mission is to protect humans from demonic possession. Taehee Yoon, an exorcist from the Execution Department, is looking for a "genius" who can see and hear ghosts to be his new subordinate. While operating undercover at a high school he meets a mysterious boy...

"By the way, how old are you, buddy?"

(Source: Manta)

Born into a world where divine power defines status, Turan hides his true strength to live as a simple shepherd. Descended from a line of wizards yet raised in secrecy, he avoids the attention of powerful nobles who would exploit him. But when a wandering knight recognizes his extraordinary potential, Turan is faced with a life-changing choice. Will he remain in hiding, or journey to the capital and embrace the destiny he was meant for?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Stepping in a puddle, slipping and falling, getting pooped on by a bird—Hwi-Bum seems to attract misfortune like a magnet. Universally acknowledged as the unluckiest guy on Earth, he finds himself partnered with Yeon-Woo, a student with the gloomiest aura he's ever seen, for a group project. Initially attributing it to his typical luck, Hwi-Bum is surprised when Yeon-Woo not only takes on the project single-handedly but also brings an unexpected twist to Hwi-Bum's fortune. As Hwi-Bum starts to revel in his newfound luck, he dismisses the subtle signs of Yeon-Woo's seemingly growing obsession. Is Hwi-Bum truly starting to turn his luck around with this relationship, or is there more to Yeon-Woo's fixation than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

Trapped inside the world of "Praesepe in a Cage", Ju-Yeon Yun becomes the game’s female protagonist, Praesepe, and must navigate a tangled web of romance and danger to escape. After completing all five male protagonists' storylines, she’s thrust into "secret mode," where everything changes. The characters she thought she knew are acting strangely, and Praesepe begins uncovering secrets—memories, death, and a mysterious new ally named Grand Duke Fenrick. As she gets closer to finding the "real" male protagonist, Praesepe must decide who to trust, and whether escaping the game is truly the freedom she desires.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A girl from modern day, is transported into the kingdom of Larson after being hit by a truck while trying to save a stray cat. She wakes up in the body of Maria Lwelin. Maria lives an ordinary life in the backwoods of the Larson Empire. She learns about her complicated relationship with her sister, and that she has the power to hear animal's thoughts and interact with them. Upon hearing that the emperor is seeking for a vet that can heal his pet panther, she jumps at the chance for adventure.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Helmut was only a baby when he was left in the Forest of Pahe, an evil place full of beasts where sinners are banished for eternity. Luckily, one magical beast and an exiled swordsman take pity on him and raise him as their own. But with a dark seed growing inside him, Helmut decides to take up the sword to prevent the seed from turning him evil. As Helmut grows stronger, he seeks out the family that abandoned him, but will Helmut end up following his human heart or his beastly instincts?

(Source: Tapas)

High school life is hard enough, but it’s even harder for Seon Jin. A sickly disabled boy, Jin might as well be invisible. No one ever pays attention to him, except for the bullies who prey on him for being weak. Jin, however, keeps a very dark secret—there’s a serial killer in his house…and it’s his father!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Back in high school, Park Haneul was the object of everyone's affection, the popular girl who captivated hearts. Yoo Jung-in dedicated himself to his studies in pursuit of becoming someone worthy of dating her. However, life had a different plan as Haneul married another man. Now, Jung-in finds himself working at a guesthouse, surrounded by bittersweet memories that refuse to fade away. But then, out of nowhere, a familiar face reappears and asks to stay at the guesthouse. Will this unexpected reunion reignite old flames or open doors to new possibilities?

(Source: Lezhin US)

When a goddess transports Hansoo Kang and his classmates to a magical fantasy world to become heroes, it’s like a dream come true. But when Hansoo declines to risk his life for a world that isn’t his own, the goddess leaves him for dead, alone in the forest. That’s when he realizes she’s not what she seems. With the help of a loner god, Hansoo faces the hostile new world and earns powerful blessings to help him survive. But his goal isn’t to save the world; it’s to return home… well, after he gets revenge on the goddess that is.

(Source: Tapas)

“A love life? Give me a break.” A complete non-believer when it comes to romance, Eun-Ho is focused on climbing the ladder at work. Smart with excellent social skills to boot, both her bosses and clients love her. But when a new hire suddenly appears in front of her and an old first love start to shake things up again, she can’t help but waver.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

When Archduke Cesare returns from war, Eileen barely recognizes the man she once knew—he's cold, commanding, and burning with unspoken desire. But nothing shakes her more than his sudden proposal. As old feelings stir, Eileen must choose: take his hand, or flee before his fire consumes her.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Genius Sales Person: Mind Reader

description:
Jihun Min is a diligent and honest medical sales representative who is trying to make a name for himself in a company that is rampant with nepotism. Hence, he is constantly being outshined by his general manager’s nephew, Junseong Choi, who monopolizes sales performance through lobbying and shady tactics. One day, Jihun is blessed with a special ability that could propel him forward in his career. Things are finally going his way and he’s feeling more optimistic than ever, but will Jihun be able to maintain his strong moral compass and not lose sight of what truly matters?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After learning 15 miserable years of his life as a failed gamer was one long nightmare, Lee Eojin is glad to be a newbie again. Vowing not to repeat the same mistakes, Eojin starts anew as the hotshot, Old-timer. He’s conquering monsters, getting sweet gear, and making enough dough to set himself up for life. Loved by fans and hated by foes, both old and new, will Eojin break the game and triumph, or will the game break him once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Ji-Han Han is your typical high school student -- minus the fact the he’s acquired the special ability to view the world around him as a video-game. Not long after this discovery, he stumbles upon a hidden world filled with others just like him. Now, amidst juggling homework and completing quests, Ji-Han must learn how to navigate his newfound power in order to level up in life.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seeking a way back to her world, Anna becomes a maid at the infamous "Swan's Grave." When the marquis mistakes her for his vanished wife and offers a forbidden bargain, Anna is drawn into the haunting legacy of the Lorengreen house.

(Source: Manta)

Gloria wakes to find that she has become the infamous evil stepmother of a cute little werebunny?! She has mysteriously entered a fantastical world of knights and werebeasts, but not as its main character. Now, she must prove that she is not the terrible person everyone thinks she is. It won’t be easy, but she has help. The World Tree’s butterfly guardians will aid her in winning the trust of her new husband and stepdaughter.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Life is about survival of the fittest... But what do you do when you're reborn as a crow? Find someone big and strong to take you in, of course! After saving Prince Camute's life, Rainelle is brought to the imperial palace to live as his pet. However, just as she believes she's set to live a life of comfort, she finds herself caught at the center of a dangerous power struggle between Prince Camute and his brother. Now that her survival depends on his, will Rainelle find a way to help her prince?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.
