Na-Ji, known throughout the industry as the ‘Legendary Developer,’ is a notorious workaholic who routinely overworks himself until his herniated disc finally gives out. Amidst this, he ends up attending a colleague's birthday party at a gay club for the first time in his life. There, he meets Ki Sung-Geun, a man dubbed the ‘Legendary Healer,’ and spends the night with him... The next day. More surprising than sleeping with a stranger was the fact that his aching back had miraculously healed! He needs this man, Ki Sung-Gun, to meet tomorrow's deadline.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In a world where doppelgängers exist and are tasked with killing their human counterparts, a devil named Joon falls prey to distraction and accidentally creates Doh Seong-ah. He’s supposed to be taking the place of Lee Woo-yeol, but instead comes out looking like the male version of Joon’s favorite idol! Undeterred, Seong-ah enters the human realm to start his mission, but Woo-yeol proves to be far more formidable and terrifying than Seong-ah anticipated… Can he succeed in eliminating Woo-yeol? Or will the world be big enough for the two of them after all…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

She was sent to spy on him. Falling for him was never part of the plan. Hye-Won Yun works tirelessly to secure her future, but loyalty comes at a cost. Vice President Ji-Seok Ha makes her track every move of his cousin, Executive Director Tae-Beom Ha. Tae-Beom knows she’s spying on him. But instead of pushing her away, he keeps her close. What begins as a cold arrangement shifts into something unpredictable. Their worlds were never meant to intertwine, but the more they fight it, the more inevitable it feels. Is it just proximity -- or something deeper?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

When the ruthless Lord Tiwakan seizes the kingdom of Nauk, Princess Liene Arsac faces an impossible choice: marry her captor or watch her homeland crumble. But Lord Tiwakan isn’t just after power; he desires Liene, and his devotion stirs a mix of fear and undeniable attraction within her. With her former betrothed, Lafitte, still missing, Liene must decide whether to trust Tiwakan's promises or hold out hope for a rescue. As dangerous secrets come to light, Liene’s decision could change the fate of Nauk—and her own heart—forever.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Heavy are the shoulders that bear the burden of a household. To keep his waning clan afloat, leader Mujin Baek has no choice but to leave his homeland and venture out into the martial arts realm. When he passes the entrance exam of the Northern Sky Union with flying colors—leaving behind one unconscious opponent in the process—Mujin soon finds that the realm is not the noble place he once envisioned. With his powerful frost-style qi, however, he sets out to make a chilling mark amidst the fiery maelstrom engulfing the realm.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Airi is reincarnated as a noble’s daughter, she expects an easy life—until her family goes bankrupt and she’s forced to work as a maid for the Grand Duke. While chasing a young lord, she stumbles into a hidden chamber and is trapped for what feels like 100 days. But when she escapes, twelve years have passed, and the world is at war with monstrous beasts. Now, Airi must navigate a broken kingdom and rewrite the story of her second life.

(Source: WEBTOON)

With a handsome face and manners that would put a diplomat to shame, new hire Hyeon-U Lee is a sight for sore eyes to Senior Manager I-Yeon Shin when he walks through the doors of Hanshin Worldwide. Feeling like she’s won the lottery, I-Yeon is looking forward to her company life alongside this polite and hard-working young man— “Hey, I-Yeon. Get this done by tomorrow.” Hyeon-U is no regular employee; he’s the son of the CEO. And as he begins to show his true nasty nature behind closed doors, I-Yeon begins wondering what she did to deserve him.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Childhood friends Do-Jin and Hyun-O end up at a group blind date, where they get heavily drunk and unexpectedly spend the night together. While Hyun-O clearly remembers what happened, Do-Jin seems to recall nothing... However, following this Do-Jin starts pursuing Hyun-O without hesitation.

Does he actually remember...?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Civil Servant of the Sword Returns

description:
The nation's buzzing about Ahn Su-Ho, the newly awakened player who's giving up a life of riches to become a civil servant. They don't realize that Su-Ho's been a civil servant before... in his past life before he was killed by his own team! Now, Su-Ho's out to save the country from the worst of its criminal scum by gaining the strength to stop them before they can strike. Can Su-Ho power up and protect the nation, even if it means starting over completely? Or will justice be thwarted once more?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Bratty Lady Throws a Tantrum

description:
Duke Heros Archeon slays the black dragon Sellus, thus freeing the world from calamity—or so he thinks. But then, Sellus transmigrates into the body of Daphne Archeon, the duke’s cruel, petulant daughter, and somehow... this improves the girl’s personality?! Sellus takes over Daphne’s life and vows to train her body until she’s strong enough to kill her father. However, when dark mages threaten her family and kingdom, a feeling of righteous responsibility flares in her bratty little heart.

(Source: Tapas)

A university professor is sick of seeing students doing it everywhere on campus. One day, a girl who seemed innocent approaches him with a special request...

"Can you... teach me about sex?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

To adjust the intensity of the gangster male lead on the verge of going dark!

Alone and isolated, Baek Yi-Hae finds herself possessed by a depraved 19+ romance game.

“No way... I didn't get targeted by the gangster male lead, did I?!”

Baek Yi-Hae unexpectedly moves into the Seo family, a notorious gangster clan. To protect her peaceful, safe life as a supporting character, she must prevent baby gangster Seo Do-Gyeom from going dark and secure a happy ending. Amidst the intersection of school life, romance, and the game's threatening rules, the relationship between Baek Yi-Hae and Seo Do-Gyeom grows increasingly complex...!

“Why are you only kind to me?”

A sweet yet deadly survival romance where you can never let your guard down!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Gang-In Na wakes up in the year 2024 in the middle of South Korea with no memory of where or who he is. Upon hearing a voice that sounds strangely familiar, he comes face to face with a robot named ACE (Autonomous Combat Entity), who informs him that he was once part of the Earth Federation Forces in the year 2082 and possesses a wide array of skills. Gang-In decides to join forces with ACE to recover his lost memories and adapt to life on Earth, but the two look to be in for a bumpy ride.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Maeil Bam Jipchakpokgungwa Jamdeuneun Goyangiga Doeeotda
title.english: The Possessive Tyrant and His Sleepy Cat
title.native: 매일 밤 집착폭군과 잠드는 고양이가 되었다

description:
I've found myself trapped in a mature-rated novel as a cursed cat, whose mere existence is believed to be harmful to the empire. This place has killed every cat in every alley all because of one prophecy... The moment anyone finds me will be my last moment in this life.

"What's this?"

Before I could even think of escaping, the male lead, who's fated to become a mad tyrant, effortlessly snatches me up.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Ban Ji-Un is loved by all. No matter how chilly someone's exterior may seem, she always finds a way to break through. That is, until her classmate Lee Yu-Seon comes along. For some reason, Yu-Seon ignores Ji-Un’s every attempt to win her over. Ji-Un is dumbfounded that, despite her best efforts, she just can’t find a way to weasel her way into the standoffish student’s heart. But when the two have an unexpected encounter, they just might discover that it’s never when a girl is looking for love that she finds it. On the contrary…sometimes it comes from the place she least expects.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

"Aren't you here to look at the room? Why are you looking at my body?!"

Living in a share house full of sexy girls. The rent went down, but something else is going up!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

To cover her father’s hospital bills, Ji-Wan agrees to become Tae-Seong's legal wife for three years; a marriage of convenience with one condition, one billion won once the contract ends. Bound by strict terms, the contract prohibits any contact throughout their marriage. Three years pass, and two weeks before the contract expires— Tae-Seong suddenly shows up at her door convinced that Ji-Wan is the love of his life. Now, with her payout on the line and Tae-Seong clinging to a love that never existed, will Ji-Wan still be able to walk away with the life she planned?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the middle of a scuba diving trip in the sea around Malta, Hyun-Min finds himself kidnapped to the mythical island Ogygia, where the Greek goddess Calypso is known to reside. Except...Calypso turns out to be a god, not a goddess. Not that Hyun-Min cares. He’s going to escape this place and go back to the human realm! Or, well, that’s what he plans to do. But does he really want to leave this island and Calypso behind? Little by little, the two of them find themselves drawn to each other. Can there be a happy ending for a god and a human? Or is this all destined to end in tragedy?

(Source: Lezhin)

Branded as a cursed child, Princess Osiria spent most of her life locked in an attic. In actuality, Osiria is the divinely chosen, the one who could’ve saved the empire of Trionfo. Instead, she was sold to a neighboring kingdom and left in the care of Sir Fedelius, a handsome young knight. Although her heart beats faster when Fedelius is around, she doesn’t plan on staying for long. She wants only one thing… to get revenge on those who abused her and killed her mother. Will her heart soften with love or will she seek vengeance to the very end?

(Source: Tapas)

After being dismissed from his university professorship due to a bullying scandal, Sung-Won becomes addicted to gambling. While fleeing his debt collectors, he is kidnapped and taken away. He awakens at Si-Hyeon's house. Ha Sung-Won, his childhood tutor, is obsessed with him, a maniac who is obsessed with him to the point of obsession. This obsession leads Sung-Won to reveal a secret about his body he absolutely cannot bear to know.

"I love you, teacher. You'll be by my side forever."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Students of Illip Arts High

description:
Meet Sol Han, the human photocopier who can replicate anything she sees with precision! One day, she stumbles upon a mysterious genius's drawing in a VR game, igniting her passion for art. Curiosity leads her from a quiet countryside to Illip Arts High School, the epitome of artistic excellence. Amidst challenges and tangled friendships, Sol's journey, a captivating tale of youthful growth and camaraderie, unfolds in the picturesque halls of Illip.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Outdoors, with the neighbor’s wife, in the kitchen, on the floor…just about anything you can imagine! Let these tantalizing tales help you break from the monotony of everyday life, and explore your deepest desires!

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult achieved unification after 300 years thanks to Sama Geon. He had one wish: to live an ordinary life with his family. Returning to his hometown, he learned butchery and began a small business, but his younger sister's illness forced him to wield a sword once again—and the Soaring Heaven Demonic Cult is threatening his serene life. For the sake of peace, he must wield his sword once more.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Nayoung, a newlywed bride, looks forward to welcoming her husband back home after working overnight as a police detective. But she comes home only to learn he had been murdered. Unable to trust the police, she takes matters into her own hands to uncover the truth. Too bad for them, though. Nayoung turns out to be a former North Korean spy and notorious elite assassin known to intelligence agencies by the code name "Tarantula." How will the Tarantula avenge her husband's death?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baek Dohu’s a university student who writes BL novels on the side. And his preferred type of top character? The scumbag kind, who treats their partners like crap. And Dohu’s first impression of Seo Juheon is the complete opposite: the typical nice-guy—always smiling, always catering to the needs of those around him. But things take a turn when he accidentally comes across Juheon blackmailing someone in an alley. The real Juheon is a polar opposite from the facade he puts up; he swears, he has a temper, he’s manipulative…and Dohu loves it. Juheon could be THE inspiration for his next big novel that hit a dead end long ago. Excited, Dohu starts following Juheon around “observing” his character, which is bound to give Juheon some wrong ideas… Between the lines of artist and muse, business and pleasure, who’ll be the first to cross the line over to the other side?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice! I’m Gu Yeongjin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?! Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jaerim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant. No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

“You need to go into politics.”

And I’ll get my revenge. A political genius ghost, Gu Yeongjin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jaerim, for the ultimate combo in

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A new town, a place of new beginnings... and as one of the very few delivery riders, I'll make sure it's worth my while.

(Source: Toomics)

I, a mere extra, have to protect the main character?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Jang Yeon-jae, a drama assistant writer for 6 years, desperately wanted and tried to be a main writer, but ahead of his debut, his teacher the main writer Kim Tae-jin stole his script.

"Sir! How could you do this! That's my script!” “Yeon-jae. It is true that I was a little influenced by your ideas. But that is definitely my work.”

After leaving the assistant writer job out of anger, he looked for a way to knock Kim Tae-jin down, but there seemed to be no hope. But at that moment...

A miracle happened.

[You can purchase 200 characters of the script with a rating of 0.1%.] [When broadcasting with this script, the expected average rating is 15.2%.]

[Do you want to buy?] [Yes / No]

"On-air shooter" required! Assistant writer Jang Yeon-jae's high-rating drama, "Drama Writer Who Reads Spoilers".

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After "outboxer009" wakes up in the body of Jude Bayer from Legend of Heroes 2, he soon discovers that his rival "sandstorm" has also entered the game world as Cordelia Chace. These top-two-ranked old pros come to realize that navigating this game world is much harder than just pointing and clicking. With the apocalyptic conclusion of the game looming before them, they'll have to combine his quick wit, her foul mouth, and both their gamer mindsets to make a new, less cataclysmic ending.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The teachers' struggle to send Si-Yun Min, the son of the chairman of the IR Group, to a prestigious university begins! With a $1 million performance bonus at stake, it's no easy task due to Si-Yun's indifference toward studying. In the end, the teachers dedicate themselves fully to the challenge.

"Si-Yun, are you curious to see what's underneath my panties...?"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Fernan Fallenberg, heir to the Empire’s most prestigious household and a prodigy of the Imperial Academy, was infamous for valuing everything by money and keeping others at a distance. One day, he is struck by lightning, and a foreign presence tries to invade his mind. Resisting with force, he instead witnesses the Book of Prophecies reveal itself—foretelling the world’s end.

(Source: WEBTOON)

My ex-boyfriend of 10 years, 'Daniel', married his best friend 'Olivia'. Even on my birthday, Christmas!!!! 'Chris', a world-renowned singer-songwriter, pays a surprise visit to Daniel and Olivia's wedding and turns it into her concert venue, avenging her handsomely. But the next morning, Chris receives shocking news. Will Chris be able to regain all her lost love, friendship and fame?

(Source: Naver; translated)

title.english: The Extra Decided to Fake It

description:
A child shows up claiming to be Duke Maynard’s long-lost daughter, but he’s skeptical. However, Lilian came with proof, her best friend Swan’s locket, stolen from the orphanage’s headmaster’s office. After Swan died from an illness, Lilian heard the headmaster talking about Swan’s origins and his ruined plans to use her to gain the duke’s favor. She decides to stop living as an extra and live the life Swan was supposed to have.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Minchan has always harbored a secret crush on his friend Ah-yeon, known as a goddess within their department at college. Despite his shabby appearance, her undeniable beauty leads him to swallow his pride and ask her over for drinks. On that fateful evening, the two are hanging out at his place when the atmosphere heats up. Just as they are about to take things to the next level, a shocking revelation shatters the moment: Minchan is disappointingly small. Devastated by Ah-yeon's harsh words, Minchan contemplates taking things to the extreme, but even in despair, he lacks the courage to follow through. Just when he is trapped in a hopeless limbo, the most unbelievable game falls into his hands, promising a fantastical journey of unexpected twists and turns. Will Minchan find a way to level up his confidence and change his fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

In a world where adventurers raid dungeons for fame and fortune, Nagi is stuck as a lowly porter – overlooked, mistreated, and considered expendable. But armed with a mysterious magic bag and quick wits, Nagi begins to challenge the brutal hierarchy from within. Can he rise above betrayal, dangerous monsters, and a corrupt system – or will this ruthless world discard him like the baggage he carries?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Saintess and Her Secret Chambers

description:
When Aristella gets chosen as the new Saintess for the Temple of Yggmentar, she has no choice but to abide the orders. However, when the goddess of destruction Yggmentar gets sealed into Aristella's body, all hell is about to break lose. Yggmentar lures the young, inexperienced priests to get into bed with her every night, and the men have no choice but to give into her temptation. Even when Aristella isn't possessed by the goddess, she finds herself lusting for the men inside the Temple. It's only a matter of time until she finds out about the dark secret of the goddess Yggmentar, and that the priests aren't exactly the type of people she thought them to be...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

On Ha-jae, a once-in-a-thousand-year handsome trainee. After rebuffing a sponsor's proposal and kissing his debut goodbye, he vowed to not step foot into the entertainment industry again. That is, until he transmigrated into some idol raising game. Find your hidden talent and grow into an idol, Play hard to get with the System that doesn't listen well/be disobedient, Figure out the past of the transmigrated character/character you've transmigrated to. Without money, a home, or any knowledge, I went through all sorts of hardships, but…

"I'm in trouble. This is fun."

Whatever works, however works, as I please. First, go onwards, make a challenge, and take it head on! The genius idol On Ra-on's manual to taking on showbiz and the industry.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ganghyeok is ruined. His gym business is failing and there's no way he can pay off his debts. But one night, while reading his favorite author's latest webnovel, he gets sucked into a world of martial arts fantasy and wakes up as a child monk in the Shaolin temple. There, he must apply his knowledge of modern fitness to survive their strict training, juggle the friends and enemies he makes along the way, and find a way to get back home.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

"I would like to sign up for more classes..."

The lonely and sexy city moms all want his lesson, but it's not only for their children...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Lady of Vengeance and the returned Prince.

Cecylia Saryan, liege to the order of Hearthtread and heir to the Dukedom after her father's sudden death, discovers a young boy hidden in his legacy — the Crown Prince Ethan, thought to have drowned 5 years ago. Will Cecylia be able to keep her House intact while helping Ethan reclaim his throne?

(Source: Manta)

"I'll make a man out of you!"

Ji-Hoon has a secret that keeps him from losing his virginity. His sister, Ji-Ah, goes out of her way to prepare a special lesson on sex for her brother. Will Ji-Hoon be able to pass her class and lose his virginity?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The academy where Amon was assigned as a new teacher has gone bankrupt! The principal is addicted to gambling, the teachers are no-goods, and the students are lethargic! How will Amon tread forth as he stands at the crossroads of escape and success? A comedic fantasy series that will make your sides hurt from laughing!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The god of the Jeongpa and the magic of the Sapa. Two legendary doctors are getting married? Father is the god, mother is the magic. An absolute master appears before Dan Ak-Seon, who inherited his parents' medical skills. That fateful meeting leads the young Dan Ak-Seon to the world of martial arts...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Kim Isaac, once the all-powerful Skeleton King, is now a baby in a onesie. Tricked by the gods and sealed away, he’s reincarnated into a family of saints at the heart of the Holy Empire. He can’t walk or talk, but he can plot. And with his loyal demon followers working from the shadows and a grudge deeper than the underworld itself, this baby isn’t here to be cute—he’s here for payback. The Holy Empire has no idea what's coming… and the gods are about to regret ever crossing the Skeleton King.

(Source: Tapas)

If there’s one thing Hwan Seok can’t stand, it’s witnessing injustice. But this time, getting involved with a pair of men targeting his next-door neighbor, Yerin, costs him his life. Three days after his murder, Hwan Seok wakes up…. alive! Armed with his newfound ability to be brought back to life after three days, Seok is determined to save Yerin but soon realizes he's gotten himself entangled in a plot bigger and more sinister than he originally imagined...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ajin Baek is an actress at the top of her game. She has everything. She’s a beautiful, award-winning actress, the public loves her, and she’s about to announce that she’s getting married. But on the night of the award ceremony, a news program exposes the darkness behind Ajin’s glittery exterior. Just how far was Ajin willing to go to get to where she is now?

_The story consists of a total of four parts, and when the titles of each part are put together, it becomes one sentence, "Do Not Provoke the Heartless Monster"_

'(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: His Majesty is Vexed by His Handmaiden

description:
Oh, Your Majesty… Clayden A. Roccarso, the newly crowned ruler of the Empire of Roccarso, is the most sought-after bachelor in the land. With his striking looks, refined swordsmanship, and heroic victories against the monsters, he has captured the admiration of nobles and commoners alike. All but one. Emilia Valleta, his own handmaiden, remains completely unmoved by his charm, leaving him both intrigued and frustrated. Now, the young ruler must not only secure his empire, but also win the heart of the one woman who refuses to be impressed.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Rowan glimpses a dark future just ten years away. Unfortunately, he’s no powerful leader—just an orphan with an incredible talent for magic. Luckily, his potential won’t stay hidden forever. He joins Union Academy, which is filled with potential partners in the fight against dark magic… if only his teachers and classmates could understand magic theory on his level. But if Rowan can keep everyone focused, they might just stop their world from going up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

Bookworm - Soo-Hyuk. Reading fun number one, always looking for a new way to read books. Even joined new game <Pangea> so no one could disturb him from reading books. The moment Soo-Hyuk finished reading his first book and closed it, he received notification: Wisdom +1 level...

title.english: Turning the Mad Dog into a Genteel Lord

description:
Diarin, a priestess without any noteworthy family background or connections, always gets the toughest assignments. So when her boss tells her to help Ceres, a war hero, reintegrate into society, she decides to stop being a pushover and get as much as she can out of it, including a juicy promotion. But upon reaching Ceres’ manor, she’s greeted by a growling hound instead of a human. Tasked with the impossible job of turning the mad dog into a proper gentleman, she dedicates herself to caring for him. But his unexpected obsession with her was never part of her plan.

(Source: Tappytoon)

College student-cum-pianist Su-yeon goes into a destructive spiral after he messes up his piano performance. And he's decided getting into bed with strangers is the best way to cope with his anxiety. When he's sleeping with someone, it's like all his troubles just melt away—like he's underwater. During one of his meltdowns, he ends up sleeping with Hae-su, a student-athlete. Except Su-yeon has no memory of the incident. Hae-su remembers it all however, and when the two end up working together on a group project, he is determined to break down Su-yeon's walls. Hesitant at first, Su-yeon gradually discovers that there's more to life than just being surrounded by shades of blue. Will Hae-su be able to pull Su-yeon from the water he's submerged himself in or will the current be too strong to...resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 14 extra chapters.

Though Leon has years' worth of training in swordsmanship, it's still not enough to defeat his rival at the royal academy, Lionel. That is until one day, the holy sword Elsyd appears and names Leon as his chosen hero and new pupil. The young swordmaster didn't expect the holy sword's instruction to be easy, but now Elsyd is even trying to teach him how to... see? If Leon can manage to endure this, will he finally be strong enough to beat the privileged Lionel and earn his place in the world?

(Source: Tapas)

Yeonwoo's plaid sense of style is a lost cause, but a Stylist for Hire ad just might save his social and romantic life. Designer Jaehee starts the makeover project of a lifetime, but can he transform this walking fashion no-no into a runway model for the graduation show —without falling for his handsome charms?!

(Source: TappyToon)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

After a traumatic past with her ex-boyfriend, Su-Yeon had developed a taste for bad boys. Due to this, she feels a little dissatisfied with her current boyfriend, despite the fact that they’re doing well together. But then one day, Su-Yeon’s type (the ghostly embodiment of the ultimate ‘bad boy’) possesses her boyfriend’s body. Must this curse really be lifted?

(Source: Naver, translated)

A playboy named Petruchio accepts a request to seduce the unfriendly Katherina...?

This webtoon is based on Shakespeare's comedy play, "The Taming of the Shrew".

Park Gwang-Seok is an average office worker who enjoys reading web novels as a hobby. And as he's reading one night, the author of his favorite story, "The Great Demon War," asks him to save the world. After a flash of light, he finds himself sitting on a throne in the body of Emperor Axeltrion, the villain of the novel. But the worst part is that Axeltrion's murderous instinct makes him crave bloodshed! Can Gwang-Seok save the world and fight the urge to kill anyone who even slightly annoys him?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Twenty-one year old Yuna is tired of having guys hit on her all the time. As popular as she is, she's been single her whole life. Just when she decides to make herself a boyfriend to fend off guys, she meets a handsome guy who looks good enough to be her boyfriend. But wait, the guy is actually a girl! In fact, rumor says that Min is a lesbian. Nonetheless, the two decide to pretend to be in a romantic relationship.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Happy, who grew up as a slave in the arena, has survived with monstrous skills. When the arena owner is executed, Happy is freed and meets new family and friends, gradually learning about society. However, the world did not give Happy the chance to stop fighting. As his identity, war on crime, and the secrets of his birth continue to intertwine, Happy becomes a being who goes beyond a monster and stands at the top of the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Do-Young, the man she met at a blind date and ended up sleeping with. He keeps intruding into Wi Da-In's life, stirring up her emotions.

“Let's just play at dating for exactly three months, Ms. Wi Da-In.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

I was a normal grad student until I woke up in a world right out of a novel I wrote as a teen. But danger’s on the horizon—the character I became was originally destined to die AND people are out to get me! Even though this character’s past was full of villainy, I’m using my insider knowledge to survive the flame of the Azure Ring, settle debts, and make things right for the House of Latia! Can I earn the trust of the hero and get ahead in this world? Are there secrets that even I don’t know?

(Source: Tapas)

"Jae-Hee, why do you always carry two copies of your script?" "Well, you might lose them."

That's a lie. One is for carrying around to the filming set and showing it to others. The other is. [The drama 'Youth Train' can be absorbed.] [Would you like to absorb it?] It is for my own consumption. I devour the script and make it mine alone. The story of Jae-Hee, an actor who can absorb a script 100%.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

After losing his sense of smell, genius perfumer Si-Bon tries to end his life but is saved by Ha-Eoon, the owner of a small antique shop. Planning to stay just 3 months before returning to France, Si-Bon takes a live-in job there and finds himself slowly drawn into Ha-Eoon's world with no escape.

(Source: Manta)

As the last princess of Elpasa, Beatrice could only watch as the Nosteros Empire destroyed her homeland. Now forced to live as a slave in the empire, the former princess adopts the name Chloe to hide her past and start anew. But when Duke Alexander, the very man who destroyed Elpasa and attempted to kill Beatrice, takes notice of Chloe for her intellect and charm, a hide-and-seek romance between a princess in hiding and a wicked duke unfurls.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

Shayla’s desperate bid to escape an unwanted marriage leads her to the Grand Duke. One night with him should’ve been fleeting, but a mysterious collar mark on his neck says otherwise. Once untouchable, he’s consumed, his fate tangled with the woman who dared to claim him.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: He's Just My Brother, Your Grace!

description:
After losing her parents and ending up on the streets with her brother, Astel realizes she is actually in a novel where she and her loved ones die at the hands of a mysterious villain. Determined to change this, she decides to infiltrate the castle of Duke Anais and uncover the villain's identity! The first step of the plan succeeds, but now there's just one issue: she is bound to the shapeshifter duke as his mate! Will Astel be able to fulfill her goal while dealing with this new relationship?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: When the Third Wheel Strikes Back

description:
When Ye-Seo Jung wakes up one day, he finds himself trapped inside the body of Jesse Venetiaan, the ill-fated second male lead of a mega-hit fantasy romance novel “I Quit My Job, then I Became the Princess Bride.” It turns out this second male lead is destined to die at war, trying to protect the male lead. Ye-Seo’s goal is to avoid getting entangled with the main characters and survive until the war is over, all while searching for a way to return home safe and sound. But the female lead, Christelle, and the male lead, Cedric, keep approaching him…

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Everyone dreams of knocking out their insufferable boss, but what if that boss is a war hero, a duke, and constantly breathing down your neck? For Chloe, enduring Curtis's relentless inspections was a daily struggle... Until a royal marriage decree offers her an unexpected way out.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Anything and everything—Unhwi Yeon, heir apparent to the Heavenly Demonic Cult, owes his master at least that much. Unable to learn who is backing the cult members who betrayed them both, Unhwi is forced to flee into the body of Unhwi Dang with the help of forbidden magic. Isolated, alone, years into his future, moving from one assassination attempt to another—but capable of cultivating Naegong for the first time in his life. Anything necessary to protect his master is as good as done.

(Source: Tapas)

Tempted by the high salary, Lucy, a maid, goes to work at a remote mansion. Her new employer is Skar, a hot-headed half-dragon said to hate humans. Despite his initial skepticism of her, Lucy starts to grow on Skar. But with his fiery outbursts, can Lucy successfully cool the flames of his temper?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Changing the Genre From Angst to Heartwarming

description:
I've been reincarnated. Into a novel I used to enjoy in my past life, no less! My name is Renatis, and I'll be playing the part of little sister to the female lead in this dark, tragic whirlwind of a story where a beastly bad boy shatters my sister's hopes, dreams, and her life. My sister is too good and too beautiful, and I'm not about to let that happen to my perfect sister. So, I'm taking charge. I shall turn this dark, tragic story into a heartwarming tale of healing. I will save my sister.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hae-Bum Shin and Ryu-Jin Jung have both suffered devastating losses at the hands of a corrupt government. Despite this, they find themselves on opposite sides of the coin—one as leader of the Disciplinary Training Corps and the other as a member of an anti-government organization. Now, revenge will require them to set aside their differences.

(Source: Manta)

If he didn't touch her constantly, she would die. Thus, Lyret's fate was sealed when Duke Balderion's name engraving suddenly appeared on her skin. Yet, he's the one who killed her traitorous father and cast her into ruin. Can Lyret escape the Duke and his smouldering glare?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Would You Give Your Heart to Me?

description:
Back in elementary school, Jin Sung-yu left things on a bad note with Ryu Wonha before transferring to a new school. She never really did get over it. Now she’s in high school with some key players from her elementary school years: her best friend, Oh Yeonji; the girl she hates, Lee Mi-ae; and her first crush ever, Ryu Wonha. Yup, that Wonha. And it’s starting to look like Wonha might not have gotten over what happened between them either.

(Source: Lezhin)

All Seong-A Myeong wants to do is spend her life playing video games. Unfortunately, after defeating a streamer in an online game and taking his money, she realizes that he is actually a boy in her class named Han-Jun Kang, who also happens to be a terrifying delinquent! Determined to keep her identity a secret, she decides to request a class transfer, only to run into Tae-Ui An, another classmate who looks exactly like her game character! Can she spend time with Tae-ui while keeping Han-Jun from discovering who she really is?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After years of grueling study and a job that left her scarred by endless complaints, Iseo retreats to Apricot Hill for peace. There, she reunites with her first love, Hyuk — changed yet familiar. Amid blossoms and quiet hills, could her weary heart find healing and love again?

(Source: Manta)

As the son of King Yeom-ra of the underworld, Jae-shin has lived a hedonistic life full of ever-changing bed partners and condescension towards humans. One day, however, he crosses a line and is given a rather unusual punishment: by day, he becomes a powerless puppy, and by night, he becomes a human. The only way to escape his punishment is to win over a human’s heart, which won’t be easy…especially when the human he sets his eyes on is sweet-natured prince Lee Nok. Will Jae-shin win over the prince? Or will Jae-shin be the one who is won over?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Seong Oh’s school life was smooth until she caught Yoon-Do Cha’s eye. To endure his attention, she tried befriending him. Yoon-Do had everything yet felt nothing—until Eun-Seong. Maybe it was never friendship at all, but love from the start.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Baby Saint Wants To Destroy The World!

description:
In her 99th life, Archwitch Lucifella was known as the scourge of the continent, wreaking chaos and havoc over the land. Looking to end her continuous rebirth cycle, she attempted to destroy the world and failed upon being defeated by the pope. But for her 100th life, she was reborn as the opposite of what she stood for—the baby saint prophesied to bring peace! Under such circumstances, can Lucifella bring ruin to this world instead of blessings and break her endless cycle?

(Source: Tapas)

Irae wakes up in the hospital, married but with no memory of the wedding or her husband. To everyone else, he’s the perfect man, but to her, he’s a tentacled cosmic horror! Bewildered by the gap between memory and reality, she wonders... Is this really just an aftereffect of her accident?

(Source: Manta)

Shin-Woo Cho's got money and looks, but Yu-Ju Lee knows he's arrogant and scandalous. He’s also her brother’s best friend, so waking up in his bed after way too much wine was… not ideal. Yet the more Yu-Ju tries to pretend it never happened, the more Shin-Woo seems determined to remind her it did!

(Source: Manta)

Sick and tired of her mother's ruinous debts, Richelle accepts a post as tutor to the illustrious Otis family. But upon finding a letter with strict, eerie rules on how to survive within the manor of roses, Richelle senses that something sinister is lurking. Now, she must pay the price for her choice.

(Source: Manta)

How far (or low) can an attractive body take you in a slum? Pretty and well endowed, Choi Hyung-Do scrapes together a living as a waiter by day and porn actor by night. He's occasionally called in for odd jobs at the male brothel where the charismatic owner, Lee Gyung, relentlessly tries to seduce him. Hyung-Do feels as though he’s spiraling, but his attraction to Gyung feels as real as his imminent bankruptcy. The descent may be ruthless, but it's not without its pleasures.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Shyla accepts an arranged marriage to escape her father and travels to the North, only to find that her legendary Black Wolf husband is a prickly little pup who can't even take human form! With Calleon intent on chasing her away, Shyla must stand her ground to achieve her goal of becoming the duchess.

(Source: Manta)

Humans live in the Overworld and Demons in the Underworld. There is only one way for humans to travel between the worlds.

Mankind's last hope: WARBLE.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: I Will Kill the Male Lead

description:
Kwon Jinha is a fit and healthy kindergarten teacher until she gets too obsessed with a silly web novel. Gradually, she starts feeling the aches and pains of the main character, the maid Elby Tindale, until she suddenly enters the novel as Elby! Facing a toxic secret relationship with the male lead Flynn Raiders, Jinha's version of the novel is a virtual reality game in which her mission is to figure out how to kill Flynn... or be forever stuck with this obsessive creep!

(Source: Tapas)

She only meant to be friends with Gyeom Han, the stranger on the phone. But teasing him awakens something deeper—his surrender, his shame, his desire. And for her, the thrill of it all is far too satisfying to resist.

(Source: Manta)

In the shadowy heart of Seoul near Cheonggyecheon Stream lies a sinister mansion whose porch only fools would dare tread. Welcome… to the house of the Ki sisters: Jang-nyeo, Sal-gyo, Jae-rim, and Jenny. Homeschooled and raised in isolation, the four sisters and their inadvertently menacing demeanor may strike terror into the faint-hearted, but don’t judge a book by its cover: the youngest, Jenny Ki, is a scary-- I mean, starry-eyed hopeless romantic who’s out to find love! The problem is… everything she knows about love is from romance novels. Will Jenny put the Ki in “kiss” or “kill”?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Viviana Lorentz, the Duchess of House Fortuna, becomes utterly displeased with her far-too-rigid husband, Alto Fortuna, the duke who rarely entertains her at night. When she finally snaps and clashes with him, she ends up tumbling back in time, exactly a month before their destined marriage. Determined to escape the marriage this time, Viviana requests to call it off, only to be taken aback by Alto's firm refusal. As a final measure, Viviana decides to make a rather lustful "deal" with her current fiancé, not realizing she will end up facing his unexpected secret.

(Source: Manta)

In a monster-infested world, only those summoned by the Tower become hunters, powerful individuals with special skills. Despite his ardent wish to become one, Cho Hyunsoo is stuck slaving away for other hunters. But when a near-death experience gives him a chance to fulfill his dream by bringing him to the Tower, Hyunsoo seizes it, only to discover that he cannot leave until he reaches the 100th floor! Will this hunter successfully get to the top, or will his dream end up being a nightmare?

(Source: Tapas)

Would you confess your love for someone if it meant saving your life? Well, that's what I did. I’m a ghost named U-Min, and my girlfriend is a ghost hunter. Quite the cliche, I know... Honestly, I don’t know how I’m gonna get rid of her, but I can’t just let her kill me, either!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.english: Forget My Husband, I'll Go Make Money

description:
Imprisoned for years, Princess Aristine hides her true nature and that she possesses the Emperor's Eye—a skill to see past, present, and future that the emperor of Silvanus covets. Finally, her chance to escape comes when her father sends her to Ilugo, Silvanus' enemy nation, as a scapegoat to incite war under the guise of an arranged marriage to Ilugo's second prince, a known barbarian. Now ready to take the reins to her life, will Aristine be able to make money to support her freedom?

(Source: Tapas)

Written as the villainess, Ilyana Glayne finds a noble boy named Magnus and tames him, causing him to lose his identity and become her submissive “beast.” While reading this story, a fan emails the author to inquire about the plot. When she wakes up the next morning, she finds she has become Ilyana herself! Disgusted by Ilyana’s actions, she vows to free Magnus from his beastly existence. But when Magnus steals a kiss from her, Ilyana realizes she may have changed the plot more than she wanted!

(Source: Tapas)

Ga-Jun and Sun-Woo, students with supernatural abilities, are trapped in a time loop during their school trip. After witnessing their friends’ deaths, Ga-Jun realizes Sun-Woo’s death triggers the loop. He becomes fiercely protective, while Sun-Woo, confused, tries to protect Ga-Jun in return.

(Source: Manta)

Valentina’s former fiancé appears before her, looking like a ragged vagabond and carrying a letter secretly ordering his death, sent by none other than his uncle and her future husband. Though Valentina tries to push him away, Aethelred seems intent on winning her back.

(Source: Manta)

In the not-so-distant future, humanity faces extinction, not from war or disease, but from a total lack of action between the sheets. With AI doing everything (including flirting), people have stopped dating, marrying, or even having sex. Enter the Onnuri Sex Culture Laboratory, humanity's last, horny hope. Their solution? A time machine. Their mission? Study the golden ages of getting it on. Meet Garam, an awkward grad student turned chronosexual researcher, who's now zipping through history under the wing of the mysterious and seductive Professor Eun Ahyeon. From ancient orgies to disco-era hookups, Garam must document sex culture and harvest the elusive energy source known as... Orgasium. History class has never been this NSFW.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Fallen Duke & the Knight Who Hated Him

description:
Sleeping with the enemy... literally.
After Duke Louison is given a second chance at life, he sets out to save the people he had so terribly failed by surrendering himself to the enemy. Yet little does he know that crossing paths with an enemy knight — the noble-hating Carlton — would become so... intimate. Things are about to get messy!

(Source: Manta)

In a world where monster hunters are hailed as heroes, Cheon Hae-Sun has been treated like an outcast because of his abnormal looks. As if that wasn't bad enough, a pack of monsters attacks his neighborhood on the day he discovers he's dying from an unknown illness. With his sister's sacrifice, Hae-Sun survives and somehow awakens to become a Poisoner, a rare hunter with toxic healing abilities. But will his poisonous powers cure Hae-Sun's illness and guarantee a normal life he's always dreamed of?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Fresh out of the military and eager for a fresh start, Ji-Woo returns to university, ready to slip back into the rhythm of normal campus life. His plans hit a sudden, unavoidable roadblock when he is forced to enroll in a course taught by Professor Ha-Yeong. Ji-Woo absolutely dreads the prospect; he carries a deep-seated resentment toward her, stemming from a painful past where he was subjected to her blatant, unfair treatment. Forced to grit his teeth and endure her lectures, he prepares for a grueling semester of academic power games. However, the dynamic changes entirely when Ji-Woo makes a startling discovery: he accidentally stumbles upon a secret, private account managed by Ha-Yeong. Behind the facade of the strict, demanding educator lies a completely different personality, and as Ji-Woo peers into her hidden world, he finds his perception of his antagonist crumbling and his intrigue growing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After losing her father, Yeon-Su struggles to support her sick mother and little sister alone. Desperate for money to save her family, she accepts a life-changing offer to be the surrogate of a handsome rich man named Tae-Gun and his infertile wife.The contract seems simple at first, but Yeon-Su soon realizes she's trapped in an arrangement she’ll regret. By the time she's questioning her morality and self-worth, it's already too late to turn back. As forbidden intimacy blurs the lines, unexpected emotions begin to stir between Yeon-Su and Tae-Gun. But is anything real between them?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After quitting her high-pressure job, Seo-Ri returns home and reluctantly joins swimming lessons at her brother’s urging. There, she meets instructor Yu-Jeong — her brother’s friend, who instantly recognizes her as his first love. Under summer’s heat and rain, a heart-fluttering romance begins.

(Source: Manta)

Seowoo, president of the film club, is standing outside in the rain, a welcome break from the noisy and chaotic bar behind her, when a girl with orange hair stumbles out the doors and practically into her arms. Then she begins singing “Dancing in the Rain” while... dancing in the rain. It’s a minute encounter, really, but Seowoo has seen the greatest romances bloom from the smallest moments in the movies. So when Hayoung shows up to join the film club, Seowoo – who’s not even sure what she herself is feeling – finds her heart skipping a beat.

(Source: Lezhin)

Known as the muse of a renowned designer, Iliyan Moore has achieved almost everything a model could want: celebrity status, money, full bookings…and a reputation as a man-seducing home wrecker. No, scratch that. Iliyan has never wanted this reputation. And above else, it's completely untrue! Stalked by the paparazzi and harassed by an obsessed boss with a jealous wife, Iliyan is on guard against everyone around him. So, one could only imagine Iliyan's shock when a dashing young man by the name of Kyle Hackman manages to effortlessly charm his way past his defenses and into his bed on their first meeting… How will Iliyan manage to avoid this scandal?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.

title.english: I Tamed the Male Lead Who Tried to Kill Me

description:
Latia's family took in Karshian when his father went on a maritime expedition, but after rumors go around that he's dead, they treat him like a parasite. Egged on by her sadistic parents and desperate for their approval, Latia bullies Karshian relentlessly. However, when Karshian's father returns as a national hero and powerful duke, Karshian gets his revenge by executing Latia's entire family! As she recalls her last moments, she realizes that her family had been lying to her all along. So when she's thrown back into the past, she's determined to prevent her death and treat Karshian right this time. But this won't be easy when Karshian distrusts Latia's every move. Will Latia be able to win over Karshian and turn the tables on her family this time around, or is she doomed to die once more?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

Sung Ha-Gyeom is a rich, spoiled omega who aimlessly cruises through life, leaving chaos in his wake with his carefree behavior. But when a scandal complicates everything, his father forces him to live in the countryside with Doh Do-Hoon, a humble, beta gardener who owes him a favor. At first, Ha-Gyeom is bored out of his mind, but then he catches a glimpse of Do-Hoon's naked, muscular body, and the boredom vanishes. Will Ha-Gyeom's wily charms win Do-Hoon over, or will Do-Hoon's rose garden heal the unruly Hagyeom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the barren northern Snowlands of the empire, a war that has raged on for 37 years against the vicious Norcans is finally brought to an end by one Captain Sahara Ellawood of the 128th Order. When Crown Prince Cheshire Wi Solante goes to escort Captain Ellawood to the capital, he expects to find a savage who beheads and eats the eyes of her enemies. But to his surprise, Captain Ellawood is an incredibly strong, loyal, innocent, and most importantly, beautiful woman. Cheshire is instantly enamored with Sahara, and the two spend an intimate night together after the victory party. But things quickly turn sour when Sahara claims that the only feeling she harbors for the prince is devout loyalty. Will Cheshire be able to break down Sahara's walls and captivate this charming knight's heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

As a successful captain in the military, Yun-A is an icon of success and power. But after an accident on the battlefield, she finds herself trapped in a romantic fantasy novel. Stuck in a supporting role as the best friend of the main protagonist, Yun-A is determined to overturn the plotline. Will she be able to change Rosalie’s fate and find happiness in the new world? Will she ever be able to return home?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

After being cast out from her wolf pack, Yeon resolves to survive on her own, but a chance encounter leads her to share a hut with a handsome young human named Hwan. Against all reason, Yeon finds herself drawn to the dashing human male, but it turns out... he’s a wolf, too?!

(Source: Manta)

Woo-Ri’s 5-year old poodle mix, Maru, has turned into a human — a 5-year old little girl, that is! Now Woo-Ri’s gone from pet owner to big sister, and it’s her job to keep Maru out of trouble. Human Maru has the same endless curiosity and playfulness of a puppy, but now she can walk into grocery stores, go to kindergarten, and check this out — hold things with her opposable thumbs. Being human rules!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: The Ghostly Grind at Cuvershaiden Manor

description:
Laura Highen needs a way to support her siblings and hears that House Cuvershaiden is hiring... except that the manor is haunted! Tempted by Duke Cuvershaiden's lucrative offer, Laura takes the job anyway. Who knows, with her ability to see ghosts, perhaps she can be of service!

(Source: Manta)

“You have been chosen as a player in the great game to select the next god’s successor, the Mission! Congratulations!”
Seong-Hoon has suddenly fallen into another world to participate in a game to become a god. This other world that is akin to that of a game contains players who cooperate and also kill each other in cold blood…!! Seong-Hoon, a person without an ounce of talent, uses wicked and crude tricks to become an all-powerful player!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hee-Do, fragile yet dangerously obsessive, locks debt collector Woo-Rak in his basement after a violent outburst. Demanding affection, Hee-Do blurs love and desperation. As captive Woo-Rak’s defenses crumble, obsession and tenderness twist their bond until the line between captor and captive vanishes.

(Source: Manta)

The male lead, Gi-Go Lee, who has never lost a single time in his life, and the female lead, Ro-Ji O, who defeated him. Who will end up as the victor of this 'bet'?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Six years ago, humanity was almost brought to an end when mysterious towers filled the skies across the globe, unleashing deadly monsters. Fortunately, the people known as “players” emerged, blessed with supernatural powers that they harnessed to save mankind. Among them is Yuseong Kang, a phenomenal player who has saved the world time after time. Once again, he has successfully averted global catastrophe… and in an internationally broadcasted interview praising his heroic endeavors, he says,

“I’m just in it for the money.”

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Male Lead Is Obsessed with Proposing

description:
Senelia, for having the powers of a Chloracaen Thorn, is puppeted by the paranoid Emperor Clifford in exchange for her life. To thwart the plot of the original novel and avoid his fated demise, Emperor Clifford forces Senelia to usurp the original female lead as the male lead’s lover. As a plant, Senelia is to weaken him so that he cannot challenge Clifford’s throne. But Senelia falls for the man, Veneruccia, whom she’s meant to undo. Can Senelia’s love, built on a foundation of fear, survive?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I'll Change the Ending With Education

description:
Killed when her employer, the drunkard Timothy Reynold, is accused of treason, Agnes May Graham wakes up 14 years in the past. Eager to change her fate, Agnes becomes young Timothy's tutor in order to guide him toward a better path. However, she soon learns Timothy's misbehavior stems from the negligence of his guardian and her killer, the distant Duke Ethan Battenberg. Educating children is Agnes' expertise, but how can she solve this problem when it's her employer who really needs a lesson?

(Source: Tapas)

Stuck in the body of a rich and spoiled side character in a romance novel, Aris Horrison is determined not to experience the destitute fortune of her namesake. After deciding to take the plot—and the plotting—into her own hands, Aris starts to romantically pursue the novel’s hero. However, her preemptive strike only pushes the other characters to deviate from the original plot, ultimately sending her little rewrite spinning rapidly out of control. Aris soon begins to wonder if having spoilers about her life is really all it’s cracked up to be…

(Source: Tapas)

When the warrior Hamel sacrifices himself to protect his rival Bermut Lionhart, he makes Bermut vow to vanquish the last of the demon kings. Reincarnated with his memories 300 years later, he is shocked to find that not only are the demon kings still alive, but that he has been reborn as Eugene Lionhart, a member of his former rival’s bloodline! Now, as Eugene comes of age, he must train to prove himself as a Lionhart and eliminate the remaining demon kings once and for all.

(Source: Tapas)

Yi-Hyun, beloved daughter of a wealthy family, has loved A-list actor Seo-An for years. When an arranged marriage lands her with him, she can't believe her luck! However, Seo-An insists on a temporary marriage and to divorce later. As secrets unravel, will their union stay "temporary"?

(Source: Manta)

An illegitimate daughter of Emperor Berthold Amaryllis of Visio, Ludis has spent her entire life being mistreated and pushed into the shadows. Now, with the Visio Empire standing on the precipice of destruction under the threat of Demonspawn hordes, her father finds a new use for her in becoming the sacrifice necessary to summon an ancient god. But as the colossal golden eyes seem ready to consume her, she finds herself in the embrace of a mysterious man...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Caught up in her parents’ political scheme, Yurania is forced to lose her sight and voice in order to marry Duke Casius Euclid and betray him. After being imprisoned for her treachery and despised by all, she makes one dying wish to turn back time and freely live her own life. When Yurania miraculously awakens mere days before the betrayal, she seizes the opportunity to right everything... only to discover that her past relationships and all that she had known weren't what they seemed.

(Source: Tapas)

The new empress is given an unexpected chance to stop her nemesis from destroying her family.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

A turn of fate... by your own hand.

Alicia Melfont vows to restore the former glory of her house after the Dark God's agent massacres her family. But when a mysterious book reveals that she's only a supporting character meant to die for the true protagonist of the story, Alicia decides she won't let some silly book determine her fate.

(Source: Manta)

Note: includes one extra chapter.

Lee Saehoon, the blacksmith of humanity’s last desperate united force, fought against the demons until the very end. However, the result was mutual destruction, with the world coming to an end. The moment he took his own life over that futile conclusion

“…What is this?”

He had regressed to his days as a candidate at the hero training institution, Babel Academy. Having obtained a second chance, he swore to use anything as material to gain victory this time. Anything at all!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Dio has long harbored a crush on his unit superior, Aidan. Wanting no regrets before leaving the military, he confesses and spends a night with him. Infatuated by the night and Dio’s sweet scent, Aidan asks him out. But as their relationship deepens, unspoken words begin to form between them…

(Source: Manta)

Rexid Van Hexen, prince of the Hexen Empire and feared defender of the border, wants to become emperor. But because his brain doesn’t even come close to his brawn, he enlists the help of “The Viper,” a notorious swindler and master of disguise. With her life on the line, The Viper must now pull off her greatest scam while posing as… Rexid's heiress? Will the unlikely duo succeed, or will they end up being deceived themselves?

(Source: Tapas)

The talented but overlooked knight Pollyanna comes face to face with an ambitious king who finally acknowledges her worth. "I like hard workers, because I am one," Luxos II declares, as he shares his dream of unifying the continent. Moved by his vision Pollyanna vows to fight in his honor, and together the two set out to build a grand empire. But what happens when the young king slowly realizes, battle after battle, that this stalwart knight has conquered his heart? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

"What will you do for me if I defend you?"

Do-Yun is a successful lawyer. He is assigned to defend the family who left him when he was young. Taking the superior position this time, he goes into the mother and daughter's house. We're done with dinner. Shall we sleep together now?

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

title.english: The Back Alley Mage's Second Life

description:
Once a loyal hound to a powerful magic family, Aster was used, betrayed, and killed. But death wasn’t the end—it was a second chance. Back in the back alleys of his youth, Aster now holds the future’s secrets in his hands. This time, he won’t serve anyone. Can a man who once served power learn to become his own master?

(Source: WEBTOON)

To fry or not to fry, that is the question!

After an innocent favor blows up in his face, Ha-Chan is desperate to start afresh. His last remaining hope is to infiltrate a mysterious fried food shop to reveal its secret, which will guarantee him a job as a reporter. But his investigation soon takes him down a completely unexpected path...

(Source: Manta, edited)

Joshua Sanders, the legendary spearman who ended the brutal civil war, shattered the belief that one must wield a sword to be a master knight. He fought in the service of his friend, Emperor Caesar Van Briton, but it is all for naught when his fearful comrades try to kill him. He’s on the brink of death when his trusty weapon, Lukia, shines and propels him back to the stables of his childhood. With his mighty spear in hand, Joshua is dead set on revenge in this life!

(Source: Tapas)

The world was destroyed. A world filled with death and despair. The one who fought with a sword until the end — Sword God. Karselian Le Vandeyan. However, as if by fate, the door to another world opened, and this time… It was the Earth that had not been destroyed. There, monsters slowly appeared, and people were still living without knowing how great this disaster was. This world had not yet been destroyed. However, the moment they let their guard down, that terrible nightmare from the past would repeat itself. To prevent that Sword God takes up his sword again. He borrows the body of a weak human from the past and begins a new life. In exchange for taking over the body, he makes one promise. “I will protect your family.” And now, the real beginning.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Work at a Witch's Mansion

description:
"What did I get myself into?!”
Elena works at a theater troupe as a cleaner with big dreams of making it on stage. But when the troupe is disbanded overnight, she’s forced to find a new job. Luckily, she stumbles upon an old mansion where she’s hired as a maid. But there’s something strange about the madam of the house...

(Source: Manta)

Ye-Sul Hong has a secret – when she kisses someone, she can see flashes of their future. It’s hard to believe she’s ever met the right guy when she can’t even see herself in their destiny. She doesn’t get much use out of her ability until one day, when she accidentally kisses her evil boss, Min-Hu Cha, who’s got a secret of his own. To her utter shock, she sees a vision of herself… in bed with him! As if that’s not confusing enough, she shows up to work the next day to find out that her first love has been hired to work in her department. Will she be able to survive working with the man she wished had been her destiny and the man she’s destined to be with?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After my family fell on hard times, I, Hergenes Targael, disguised myself as a male mercenary named Herge to make money. Along the way, I rescued and met Shaun Kyroxus, a formidable ally who I abruptly left when I was needed back home. Sometime later, I am now part of an arranged marriage with none other than... Shaun?! He’s dying to see Herge again, and it’s only a matter of time before he finds out! I'm not sure if this marriage will work out, and what do I do when he finds out?!

(Source: Tapas)

Bibi is a bubbly girl who's deeply obsessed with Peter, the cutest boy at her high school. So when she sees a random girl talking to him, Bibi invites her to a sleepover with malicious intent... only to have a surprisingly nice time! That's how she makes friends with Amy, a shy and sweet girl who agrees to help Bibi get with Peter. But as they cook up all sorts of love schemes to win Peter over, Amy's place in Bibi's heart grows bigger and bigger by the day...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Morae Jung had a drunken one-night stand with her mentor from hell, Kangjae Seo, the night before he left for America. 5 years later he’s back, but now he’s her boss! What’s more, he’s got his sights on Morae. Will she be able to survive working under this man?

(Source: Manta)

Beauty, brains wealth—Duke Claude Winterville had it all, except one thing: sleep. Then April Renoen, a healer-barista, walks in and cures his insomnia with a single cup of her coffee. As they grow closer, Claude discovers that it's not just her coffee that captivates him, but the woman herself...

(Source: Manta)

After being kidnapped, Class A Omega Yeon-Weo is rescued by Kang-Woon Joo, a Class A Alpha and CEO of Cheonsang Group. However, she's also attracted the interest of another Class A Alpha, Shin-Woo Lee. Now caught between the two Alphas of the Cheonsang Group, what fate awaits Yeon-Seo?

(Source: Manta)

What happens when you lose the one thing that you were the best in the world at? Ji-Ho Seong was once a top-ranked player in the online action game, One Sword. When the game eventually shuts down due to a lack of players, he loses all interest in competitive gaming. That is, until he finds out that his school has an e-sports club and discovers a popular team-based game called Sword Rush, which seems to be an exact copy of One Sword. With new teammates now by his side, Ji-Ho takes another shot at rising to the top of the game!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Jaehee comes across as a shy, hard-working high school teacher. But behind closed doors, she gets her kicks by kneeling at the end of a whip, with her childhood friend Huilin holding the handle. However, when Sulhwa joins the school as a student teacher, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now Jaehee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain. Back with the same writer and a new artist, “Lilith 2” follows on where “Lilith” left off. So strap in and enjoy the rest of the ride….

(Source: Lezhin US)

Have you ever considered human blood is a premium ingredient for winemaking? Have you imagined blood according to different human races have different aroma? Modern vampires are no longer in lack of human blood, what’s more, they’ve begun pursuing a certain taste. Humans who owns sweet and tasty blood can exchange things they want from vampires with their blood. From Napoleon to Hitler, from Albert Einstein to Elvis Presley, whose blood are all listed in wine vintage chart, nevertheless, there is one girl living in the modern era who has the most aromatic and unique blood type which attracts not only mosquitoes but also vampires.

(Source: Mangatoon)

To others, Soo-Ho might appear a little strange. But to Soo-Ho, there’s much more to “life” than the average person may ever know. And that’s because Soo-Ho sees spirits. At first he thought his “abilities” were limited to the average ghost-y here and there, but one day he witnesses a real life angel floating in midair and staring at him. And then he promptly breaks said angel’s wing on accident. Soo-Ho's had many a ghost follow him around in his short life, but he’s never had to take of an angel… nor a spirit quite so handsome as Taker.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: The Secret Life of Empress Isana

description:
College student "Sa-Na" wakes up in the Body of "Isana Castilla" of the Titan Empire, sentenced to burn at the stake for practicing witchcraft! A chance encounter with Ludwig, the Crown Prince leads her on a path to become Empress, as she embarks on a journey to help the now Emperor combat evil rivals! What lies in store for the new Empress and her little secret? Will she manage to find her way back home?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

"I think I’ve fallen for you." With a single drunken confession, Renesha's plans to live a comfortable and uneventful life were shattered. Somehow she confessed her love to the wrong man: the Grim Reaper of the Battlefield, Duke Cavert Willard! It's the worst thing to happen to her since she woke up in this fantasy universe and discovered her divine powers. In the midst of a war with a neighboring country, Renesha must balance her duties as a healer with her feelings for two alluring knights. When romance blooms on the battlefield, who will be victorious in the battle for Renee's heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

College is supposed to be for fun, learning, and experiencing new things. One of these things could be witnessing your TA and professor getting it on. And what about this new freshman? She might be interested in me...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

ASURA is the champion of the hot narakas (hells), but there’s no one left for him to fight anymore. Then he hears Indra, the strongest being in the world, has appeared…

(Source: Toomics)

From the moment she woke up in a foreign land with no memories of her past, Dia knew she was fated for misery. Taken in by a baron but beaten and abused for four long years, her only friend was the eldest son of House Knolls. Everything changed when the sadistic Emperor Caire, notorious for having a macabre hobby, barged into the mansion and gazed deeply into Dia’s eyes. Soon she is whisked away to his opulent castle, where gothic nightmare of blood and lust unfolds. Could the bloodthirsty emperor hold the key to unlocking Dia’s past?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In the world of "Pian Pian", people are born with the initials of their soulmates on their bodies. The location of these "imprints" is unique to the individual, but the meaning behind the letters is the same. Suha’s happens to be located in a – ahem – very private location. The chances of actually uniting with one’s soulmates is rather slim, but that hasn’t stopped Suha. Not only does he believe he will find his soulmate, but he also refuses to date anyone until then. But lately, his handsome boss, Chef Calix, has had him feeling some feels "down there..." He thought he was alone in these feelings, but the chef has suddenly started showing interest in him. Could the tides be finally changing for innocent Suha?

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

What can you do with three wishes?
Amina, one of the last wizards, loses her loved ones when her palace comes under attack. Trying to turn back time to save them, she gets stuck inside a lamp. 300 years later, Jakard, a military commander, wakes her up. He has three wishes before Amina returns to the lamp. What will he wish for?

(Source: Manta)

Korean Wolf Kang Doha is quite the popular guy in school. One day, he bumps into the fox, Yeojoon, who is known as a loner. Doha finds him irritating, but he couldn’t stop seeking him out. Is this… perhaps… love?

This romance starts with some bumps in the night, that turn into some truly irritating bumps in the day, that then turn into Sung-eun literally bumping into the reason for all the noise: her handsome and charming neighbor, Eun-sung. She quickly finds out that the private student representative has a somewhat questionable reputation, but that doesn’t mean she shouldn’t do her duty as the kind neighbor. I mean, they are literal neighbors, after all. She hides her true feelings to him, and the two grow so close that it isn’t long before Sung-eun has to wonder if maybe Eun-sung...is also hiding something from her?

(Source: Lezhin)

What if an unexpected accident suddenly transported you back to ten years ago? For Hayoung, suddenly traveling back in time to high school means the opportunity to save the life of Jaehyun, the one person she's always loved... Will she be able to change both of their fates?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

As a socially awkward college student, Hayeon lives a pretty boring life -- except she can communicate with outer space. One day, she meets Ujun, an alien who is curious about human nature. When she rejects his request to “borrow” her body, he takes over the body of her crush! As Hayeon helps Ujun adjust to human life, their friendship blossoms into something more. However, their love story faces many obstacles, including an alien plotting to invade Earth. What will be the fate of these star-crossed lovers?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lately, Yeji's life has been less up and more down. She's barely making ends meet with a dead end part-time job, school's been rough, and her roommate is the worst. Moving in with an old friend just meant that after a year, she had one less friend. Things quickly take a turn when her roommate/former-friend/"frenemy" announces she'll be moving out. Too bad Yeji's new roommate wasn't exactly what she was hoping for.

(Source: Lezhin)

Eun Si-An, otherwise known as Shanshan by her good friend Hyunee, is popular with all the girls at school. Which would be great if she swung that way, but she doesn’t. It just happens that she’s terrified of men, and her mother is obsessed with protecting her from all men. And suddenly, Yu-Ri, the prettiest girl at school, has admitted to Si-An that she has feelings for her. Now Yu-Ri won’t stop following Si-An around, which would also be fine by Si-An, except it seems like Yu-Ri wants Si-An all to herself... and who knows how far she’ll go to make sure that happens.

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

In the real world, Taehyun Kim has a boring low-effort life, but as a virtual reality gamer, he lives for a harsh challenge. Why become the best player in the world’s hottest online game if you’re going to do it the easy way? Warrior? Nope. Rogue? Nah. Taehyun wants to reach #1 as a blacksmith or, even better yet, unemployed. Unfortunately for him, his natural skills keep interfering, and this game likes him way too much! Seriously, how the hell did he end up as the god of luck?!

(Source: Tapas)
Brothers and sisters, don't fight because of us!

title.english: Raising the Children of the Main Characters

description:
After watching his first love marry his best friend, Eins Lainswaine resigns himself to life with another violet-eyed woman. Ye-Hi Lee never expected to be part of his story, until she is reincarnated as Eins’ reluctant wife, Märchen Lainswaine. On the bright side, twins Lieph and Joseph remind Ye-Hi Lee of her deceased siblings at every turn. Could the Lainswaines overcome a lifetime of tragic accidents (and mysterious circumstances) to become adoptive parents…and maybe even something more?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Princess of the Underworld and Goddess of Resurrection, Lucalis, comes into being from the peculiar union of Hades and Persephone. Despite her divine nature, Lucalis finds herself facing a challenge beyond her years: she’s never felt love! This has slowed her growth, both in body and heart. With this handicap, how can Lucalis face the jealousies, power struggles, and divas of Olympus’s divine world?

(Source: Tapas)

The thrilling counterattack of the female lead's friend against the fabricated female lead! The pitiful Mia, who served as the villainess protagonist's handmaiden, died after being wrongfully accused. That was Chae Mia's past life. Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

[If you could go back, would you make different choices?]

'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'

Mia resolved to return to her past life and change her actions. And so, she regressed to the very moment she first met the female protagonist who had tormented her.

‘I will absolutely live a life I can be proud of.’

Right then and there, Mia's counterattack began.

“The thrilling counterattack of the ‘female lead's friend’ against the fabricated ‘female lead’!”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The Yang and Kim families were once rival gangs with construction company fronts that spilled blood over a smidgen of gold. But a new company has entered the picture, and now both their stakes are at risk. Reluctantly, they form an alliance… sealed with an arranged marriage between their children, Hyejin and Moogahng! However, Hyejin’s past traumas keep her heart guarded, and Moogahng shrouds himself in mystery. It doesn’t seem like any amount of blood, tears, or gold will make their marriage better. But can love make this troubled pair work?

(Source: Tapas)

“Get close to the only son destined to inherit the crown. That is your mission, River Winsted.”

River Winsted, a suspended FBI agent, receives an opportunity to be reinstated… under one condition: she must accept an undercover infiltration mission. She must become the lover of Alessandro, the son of her enemy—and her first love—in order to steal information.

“You’re not the only one who’s changed, Alessandro. I’ve changed too.”

Using the false identity of Lily Gray, River manages to get close to Alessandro and eventually enter his home… a place where, according to him, he had never allowed any of his lovers to step inside. But the deeper she goes into the mission, the more she finds herself irresistibly drawn to this enigmatic man, and it torments her. However, after an unexpected accident exposes her identity, River barely survives. Regretting the moment she hesitated, she swears she will take Alessandro down with her own hands. But the more she follows his shadow, the more shocking secrets come to light… “There is something I have to do. Just give me a little time. When I’m done… you can stop my breath as much as you want.” Alessandro. The only feelings that should ever have been tied to his name were hatred—perhaps resentment. Any emotion other than those should never, under any circumstances, be called love.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Aika is a 7-year-old girl who can see the future, and after losing her beloved mother in an accident, she is sent to live with her notoriously bad-tempered uncle, Kassel.

Though he couldn't care less about her at first, Aika is determined to save his life after foreseeing his tragic future. But eventually, her uncle starts to get clingy, her sweet childhood friend becomes obsessive, and the father she had never known suddenly shows up and asks her for another chance. Will Aika be able to save her uncle with everything going on?

(Source: Manta)

Heeran Kang had one goal: vengeance. She was murdered in her first life and is abused in the next by her stepmother, but meeting her gentle nanny puts Heeran's revenge on hold...until her stepmother murders her nanny.
