Guided by insight from her first life, she makes alliances and moves to the Prison of Abyss. There, she is shown unexpected kindness. Will she fulfill her vengeance, or can she honor her nanny another way, and live a good life?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Naerim accidentally breaks the seal of a vampire who starts following her around like a little puppy! It may not be your typical vampire story, but for Naerim, a victim of school bullying, Vlad’s manic energy might be just what she needs!

(Source: Yen Press)

Notes:
- Includes six extra chapters.
- A total of 85 chapters were released on KakaoPage, which in the published volumes were recompiled making for a total of 19 main chapters and 4 special/bonus chapters in 4 volumes.

Yeoju is a second-rate author living a mediocre existence in modern-day Korea. A tragic accident lands her in the plot of a bestselling martial arts novel and she wakes up as the infamous villainess Hae-Won Tang. Hoping to save herself from a gruesome death, Yeoju must figure out who to trust, harness Haewon’s inner chi, and learn martial arts as she fights to save the Sichuan Tang Clan. Can she change the outcome of the novel and prove she’s the worthy hero?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

On New Year’s Eve, a pink smoke bomb turns the city into chaos, infecting people with a virus that transforms them into animal hybrids driven by uncontrollable lust. Yeonwoo and her friend Dojin hide out at Dojin's house after she infects him, but hunger forces them outside... into a world gone wild. With no cure in sight and a mysterious woman watching it all unfold, the only rule left is: stay inside… or lose yourself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

With rapid developments to the human civilization, the need for God and his angels have decreased at a significant rate. Thus, the angels are experiencing a historic unemployment crisis! With this problem in hand, God decides to start a company that will reduce the unemployment rate in both Heaven and Hell. He hereby founds the company, H&H Roman Company!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue and five side story chapters.

Harang is a rising star in women’s handball… until she isn’t. Unexpectedly sidelined by a devastating shoulder injury, Harang tries to return to her daily grind as a student. But life has a way of throwing huge curveballs, and she finds herself a part of the women’s futsal team at her high school along with passionate, determined teammates. Women’s national league, here we come…?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Vanna is an ordinary pharmacist who runs a small herb shop in Blalock City. Yet, when night falls, the mysterious “Witch Raven” emerges in this seemingly serene city, casting curses upon her targets before vanishing into the shroud of darkness. Consequently, Vanna often receives requests to make potions to lift the witch’s curse. However, her days are disrupted when a policeman approaches her, and the two ultimately form a partnership in the hopes of unveiling the truth behind “Triplet Academy.” Will the unlikely duo succeed in uncovering the mysteries of the Academy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Dam, who at some point stopped growing, avoids people and leaves to the forest.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The lowly ‘leaf’ of an Italian mafia organization. He secretly harbored an admiration for ‘Camellia’, the boss's brother-in-law. He was like a sacred place, an absolute domain he must never trespass upon, yet every night, he couldn't help but express his intense desire for him. Yes, it was like a fever...

'Your desire will lead you to ruin. He who dares reach into the untouchable realm shall be struck by divine punishment.'

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

After losing her parents at an early age, noble lady Elissa Lohengrin is brought into the powerful House Rubelin by the duke so that she can marry his grandson, Richard. However, having read this story in her past life, Elissa knows Richard is destined to murder her! To avoid this, Elissa makes a deal with Richard to divorce when they become adults. But as she plans for her future single life, Richard's feelings begin to grow, and a whirlwind of events begins that pulls Elissa closer to danger.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes: Chapter count includes 10 side stories

After five years of devotion, Yu-Ju Han was dumped by her boyfriend for her best friend. With nowhere to vent her rage, she crosses paths with Tae-i Go, the nation's hottest and most controversial superstar. He’s wealthy, breathtaking… and terminally ill. When a fake dating scandal between the two sets the internet ablaze, Tae-i offers Yu-Ju a "golden ticket": a chance to turn her life into a masterpiece of revenge. The price? Just a little bit of love. Will Yu-Ju remain a victim, or will she finally get greedy?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ananta, a descendant of one of the First Six Incarnates, can transform into an unstoppable brawling dragon whenever anything stands in his way. And it's a power he'll need in his quest to exact revenge against the Wings Incarnate, a power-hungry deceiver that resembles a heavenly angel only in appearance.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The princess, who knew her abilities were extraordinary but knew that she would not become the king, wanted to spend the rest of her life quietly with her maid.

He touches the maid, and the maid disappears.

The moment she touches the maid who truly cares for them among those who have spent their entire lives in the palace telling lies for their own benefit, the extraordinary serpent stretches to become a dragon that leaps over the Imoogi to protect his people.

“The princess of the present country will unify the three kingdoms.”

In a country built with the consideration of God and the kindness of dragons, human greed and power were stained by the dragon's curse, and the war was scheduled to begin with prophecy.

Can a princess really become an emperor?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Sex is so important for a healthy relationship. So when both sides are dissatisfied, it's easy for hussies to sneak in and try to make things worse. Both husband and wife will have to make a choice...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Cheryl is a well-to-do lady of Neus Castle and a beloved little sister to Melvin. But, the night before Melvin's coronation, in an evil scheme plotted by their power-hungry uncle, Cheryl and her brother's peaceful days at the castle come to an abrupt end. Just as she's about to face her doom, she is rescued by Felix, her brother's best friend and the lord of Blair Castle, under the pretense of marriage, as he declares war against anyone who attempts to murder his bride-to-be. Cheryl's married life with her brother's-friend-turned-husband begins with the news of this fake but life-saving matrimony.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Waking up in a novel is bad enough, but being the villainess Daphne Peregrine is even worse! Knowing the doomed character's fate, Daphne starts mending her strained relationship with her family, hoping they'll let her move to a peaceful land. Since she'll need money, Daphne asks the enigmatic Archduke Luciel Gresbel to go into the antidote-making business with her so she can use his noble connections. Will the original Daphne's past misdeeds ruin her plans, or can she dodge her untimely death?

(Source: Tapas)

"You will win this round if the male contestant cums."

In-Ho gets invited to a dirty death game through a suspicious woman, Tae-Ri. Putting his life on the line as a wager, he enters the game with an enormous prize at stake. The do-or-die game begins!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Min-U lives rent-free with a pretty landlord. They always thought of each other as family, but all of that is about to change...

"Why does holding her breasts make me so hard?!"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

For the past 13 years, Lucia has harbored a not-so-secret crush on her childhood friend, Herwyn. After 99 rejected confessions, she’s determined to move on. But just as she prepares to accept her arranged engagement, fate takes an unexpected turn. When jealousy flares and hearts collide, Herwyn and Lucia are about to find out they’re not done with each other yet. They say third time’s the charm, but could this final chance be the one that changes everything?

(Source: Tapas)

Find love and…500 million won?! Three women are about to take on a special challenge to escape their “forever alone” status. The “airhead” Jurim, the “trash collector” Seona, and the “devout Christian” Chaeyul are ready to compete for both money and love for the first time ever. Who will take it all?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Sharon is a warrior who defeated a vicious dragon a thousand years ago. One day, an unidentified man appears in front of Aru, who grew up longing for Sharon. "What? Are you that terrifying dragon? Besides, I'm that hero?!" A cute and sad romance fantasy of a dragon and a hero who reunited after a thousand years!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Do-Hun has been secretly in love with Ye-Jun since middle school. They were always together through high school and college, and Do-Hun believed they would stay by each other’s side forever. But one day, Ye-Jun suddenly got married, shattering Do-Hun’s quiet hopes. Even after years of trying, he couldn’t shake off his endless, frustrating one-sided love. Determined to move on, he decides to take a solo trip. Just as he’s about to leave, he hears the news, Yejun is getting divorced after just three years of marriage. That very night, Ye-Jun unexpectedly shows up at Do-Hun's door and asks him...

“Can you take me on that trip?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: The Girl from the PC Café

description:
At a local PC café, the shy owner secretly pines for his drop-dead gorgeous part-timer, Mina. But subtle details about her stir painful memories he can’t ignore, leaving him torn between fear and desire, especially when her bright smile makes his heart race all over again.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Executed for failing to save the emperor, Serena Vincent wakes up again and again on the day she’s assigned as his physician. Azaid Khan Krothen, the emperor's bastard son from a lowly maid, was cast aside at birth. But he now sits on a throne others want to control. As Serena races to cure his mysterious illness, each failure ends in her death. Trapped in a deadly loop, she must find the cure to the emperor's illness... before her next death is her last.

(Source: Tapas)

An unprecedented virus spreads across the world. After deserting the military upon learning the truth behind its human experiments, Tae-an is captured once again. When he wakes up, the first thing he sees is the gentle smile of the laboratory director watching him. Trapped inside an obsession he cannot understand, Tae-Han begins to slowly break.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.

Tae-Seok is about to meet his soon-to-be wife's mother, and is shocked after finally getting to see her. She is the woman who used to be his sex slave. Tae-Seok decides to take advantage of this chance and his mother-in-law. Now... His goal is to turn his mother-in-law into his bitch!.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Ha-Na runs into a suspicious saleswoman on the street who hands her a bath gel sample, saying it'll give her what she truly needs. Intrigued by this cryptic message, Ha-Na goes home and tries out the bath gel, only to be seized by tentacles that suddenly pop out of the water! Thankfully, her childhood friend, Won-Hoo, walks in and saves her, but Hana wants to die of embarrassment. Even so, she can't help accepting more weird "self-care" products from the mysterious saleswoman. Will her questionable samples be the key to helping Hana relax and get closer to Won-Hoo?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Cheon Joong Myung, the third son of the CEO of the fifth wealthiest corporation, Ji Gyoung Group. And his assistant working under him, Seong Chang Ook. While Seong Chang Ook tried to kill Cheon Joong Myung and cover it up as an accident, Seong Chang Ook was accidentally electrocuted along with his boss. That’s when they find themselves trapped in each other’s bodies…

“You want me to become a playboy Conglomerate the world has never seen before?”

“I’ll be opening the doors to hell if I do this.”

This is the start of the endless march of Cheon Joong Myung, the Lord of Money.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Adopted from a poor, rural orphanage by a wealthy duke, Naviah Agnus wanted nothing but to win her new father’s heart. Despite her best efforts, the calculating Duke only sees Naviah as a pawn, a mere stand-in for his terminally ill daughter Vivian, who was set to marry the crown prince. But when Vivian miraculously recovers, Naviah is pushed aside and driven to her own death. When she wakes up, she is 8 years old again, but this time, Naviah is done playing nice. Can they ever really become family?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

Taenyeo has always been curious about sex but has never had the chance to experience it firsthand. Then, out of the blue, she meets a drop-dead gorgeous man she’s never seen before who insists they're married. To her surprise, he's eager to get to know her...starting with a very physical approach. Intrigued, Taenyeo decides to go with the flow, but things get complicated when another classmate catches her eye. He's equally stunning, with intense eyes and a perfect physique. Torn between two equally attractive men, Taenyeo faces the dilemma of choosing one...but why not try them both before making a decision?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Myung-Woon, a waiter at a host bar suffering from the hardships of life due to his extravagant nature, lands a job as a private driver for a rich family.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Witness the corruption of reason and divinity. Escape the nine hells of Fog Land. Driven by his conviction that everyone deserves education, science teacher Dante Kang agrees to teach in Fog Land, a mysterious international prison that houses the world’s most notorious criminals. But his very first class gets interrupted by a violent prison riot, after which, he finds himself in the cell of his mysterious captor. Dante must now travel through the nine circles of hell and escape Fog Land.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the near future, the world is a desolate place occupied by the undead. Strange crystals emit a deadly zombie virus as the last remnants of humanity struggle to avoid infection and survive. Despite all this, life is relatively peaceful for young Ruby, who lives in the Amina Safe Zone with her father and a small band of other survivors. All of this changes when Ruby encounters Arvan, a white-haired young man with pale skin and no heartbeat. This meeting sets off a series of events that force Ruby and her father to embark on a journey to discover the truth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

"I thought I had lost my future forever... But the moment I realized that it had returned to me, my hands trembled with both joy and wonder."

Yudrein Ail is a commoner who was bestowed with powers on the night the Red Stone fell. He is also the first omega to rise to the rank of Imperial Trooper, but was accused of a crime he didn’t commit and executed soon after - only to reawaken eleven years ago, before the war began. He can't repeat the mistakes of his past…to survive is to save the world. But in order to do so, he must prevent the man he killed from facing his inevitable death.

"The future won't be the same. I'll make sure of it."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Min-Seong is the most popular and dominant Alpha at the school. One day, he lost his inhibitions and went into heat and had a one-night stand without thinking... The other person was In-Seo, who was taking the same liberal-arts class as him, and Min-seong fell in love with In-Seo because of his bright personality. Min-Seong thought it was a natural meeting between Alpha and Omega, but In-Seo was a beta...?!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Do-Hui is too busy girl-bossing her way up the corporate ladder to care about love. Her ability to randomly time loop makes her professionally successful but also renders all relationships meaningless. What's the point when she'll have to restart everything at some point? That all changes when Jun-Won, her annoying new boss, reveals that he can time loop too. Though she cringes at the mere sight of him, he's also the only person who understands her. Will they learn how to find solace in each other, or will their professional friction mess up their one chance at love?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Dong-Jun has always loved Na-Yeon, who owns a small corner store. She never thought of him as anything but a very close friend. One day, she learns of his amazing hand skills, and asks him for a massage. The pleasure she feels will change how she views him forever…

(Source: TOPTOON+)

I won't rest until they're dead.

Charlotte has no qualms about murder if it means her beloved Prince Albert can ascend to the throne. But when he accuses her of treason and leaves her to rot in prison, she learns that loyalty is no virtue. 5 years later, Count Kaitel appears before her with a request: “Won’t you kill the emperor?”

(Source: Manta)

Following the brutal Virtuous-Demonic War, the Demon Cult emerges victorious, seizing control of the world. But their triumph is shaken when the Cult’s vice-leader is assassinated in a sinister conspiracy. From the shadows emerges Ryeon-Hwi Hyeok, Crown Prince of the Demon Cult. Determined to uncover the truth and avenge his brother, he infiltrates the elite Academy of Mirages. There, he crosses paths with Seol Bi, a hidden master from the Virtuous Sect, and as the two aid each other, their relationship begins to blossom… Follow Ryeon-Hwi on his journey to conquer the Murim and become the next Demon King!

(Source: WEBTOON)

U-Jin is the only man working in the kindergarten. While working as a driver, he learns about the special power of the mysterious app.

"I can control both teachers and parents with this? Things are going to get fun around here."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After failing the auditions for a role he'd been preparing for, Lyle takes a trip to Korea for a change of pace. As a black-footed cat-man, he was not able to present himself as a top amongst the larger beastmen, but having travelled to this place with all sorts of small and cute animals that suited his tastes, he thinks he could be a top here. After downloading an online dating app, Lyle starts chatting with a rabbit-man with the handle "Kkyu," and steadily grows fond of him. Finally, the day they meet arrives! However, what appears before Lyle, as his heart pounds, is...a brute-like rabbit...?!

"Is this person...really my Kkyu...?!"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

Seo Do-Gyeom, the young master of a mansion, and Yoon Seo-Won, the housekeeper's son, share a secret bond despite their different social statuses. After a kiss, Seo-Won falls in love, but Do-Gyeom abruptly leaves to study abroad. Five years later, Seo-Won, now an adult, is about to leave the mansion when Do-Gyeom returns and offers him a role as his pheromone partner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: My Once-Enemy Sister Now Cherishes Me

description:
After a life of misfortune resulting in death at the hands of her sister, Calista, Harper wakes up again as her 8-year-old self. Realizing she's been given another chance at life, Harper is determined to stay out of the way and avoid becoming her sister's target. Unfortunately, her plan to go unnoticed goes awry when the sister who once hated her seems to be interested in her instead! But maybe this is for the better... if Harper can make Calista like her, she won't try to kill her, right?!

(Source: Tapas)

Yo-Han is no stranger to unrequited love. As a child, he watched his older brother suffer that pain, and he knows the person with feelings always loses. So when he spots his senior, Mu-Gyeong, mooning after another boy, Yo-Han decides to step in. Confess or give up is his motto, that is, until Yo-Han’s the one with the crush on Mu-Gyeong.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Kim Minjun, a 21-year-old hoping to break free from the forever-alone label, reluctantly joins the university film club with hopes of making friends and, ideally, a girlfriend. However, his shy demeanor makes him an easy target for teasing from his friends during club gatherings. Just as he considers quitting the club, Minjun stumbles upon an old smartphone in the storage room. Ding!

"Welcome, Minjun. StudHub is an app designed to enhance your love life."

As Minjun explores the app, his junior, Sua, walks into the storage room, triggering a series of tasks promising special rewards from the app. Will this mysterious app lead Minjun to true love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: My First XXX: The Marquess is Wild for His Princess

description:
Princess Elena is devastated when her hand in marriage is rewarded to war hero Marquess Lupus Bernardo against her will. Her dreams of marrying the kind Count Favio are dashed, and she has no choice but to wed the rumored brute who demanded her as a trophy. Trapped in a seemingly loveless marriage, both her heart and body ache for true love and warm affection. But as it turns out, Lupus may be hiding some heat beneath his cold exterior...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Includes three extra chapters.
- Part of CNC Revolution's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.

After a lifetime of devotion to you, I refuse to be taken for granted any longer!

Six years of patient waiting for my fiancé, Phillen, ended when he returned with a woman carrying his child. I now reside with her, feeling neglected as he showers her with attention. I'm left questioning my place in this household, facing a tough decision: stay or bid this place farewell.

(Source: Manta)

Morán, a man whose only asset is his face! Just as he was dumped by his live-in lover and faced homelessness, he falls for Ho-Su's sweet talk when he appears claiming to like him.

“Hyung, you won't have to worry about money anymore.”

Well, for a while, I guess I'll live in a nice place with this young, rich, cute boy. Morán thought it was nothing but a lighthearted idea, but he gradually became entangled with Ho-Su, who showered him with passionate attention and affection...

This young boyfriend... something about him feels off...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.english: How to survive as a maid in a horror game

description:
The Murderer of Pflatzgraff Manor is a brand-new horror game from the developer A-coms. Even though it has beautiful graphics, its player base dubbed it as one of the worst games due to how difficult it is. You play the game as Adrian—a fine young man who’s also the devil’s reincarnation. Your goal as Adrian is to kill as many people as possible because of Lilith’s Curse. One night, you played the game until you couldn’t anymore and found yourself waking up as Hilda, one of Adrian’s maids…

(Source: Tapas)

Eunuch Lee Cheolsu is a secret power figure who controls the affairs of the empire at will. He possesses absolute power, wealth, and even strong martial arts skills... but what does that mean? If he can't do "that"! Through a reincarnation technique, Cheolsu returns to the time before he became a eunuch. He has one goal in mind: to become an alpha male and enjoy life with the most beautiful women!

(Source: Naver, translated)

“Wanna suck me off?”

Ji-Han gets caught by Shin-U having a crush on a guy. To keep it a secret, Ji-Han ends up facing sexual demands he never imagined from Shin-U. To make matters worse, when a stalker targets Shin-U—his bodyguard client and a popular star—they end up living under the same roof...

Kim Shin-U, the spoiled younger man who acts however he pleases, and Ji-Han, who resents him yet finds himself helplessly swept along. How will their tangled relationship ever untangle?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A decade ago, Captain U-Jun Kang, an S-tier Esper, saw “Doc” sacrifice himself to save him—no doubt about it. He never even learned Doc’s name. Fast-forward to now, U-Jun’s staring down his new S-Tier Guide, Hui-Won Chae, who’s a dead ringer for the man he thought was gone. Hui-Won draws a complete blank on Captain Kang. Their paths haven’t crossed... or so he thinks. As far as he knows, he was out two months due to an accident. Will they connect the dots, or will this second chance slip away?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Moving into her dream apartment was supposed to be a relief for Yuri, but choosing a moving company proved to be a total headache. Desperate, she takes a recommendation from her assistant manager and books a service that promises to handle everything. But when the movers arrive, Yuri realizes she accidentally selected the premium package. These gorgeous men aren’t just here to unpack boxes - they’re ready to deliver an unforgettable, full-service experience that caters to her every desire. Moving day just got a lot more hands-on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: Give Love

description:
Tae-Kyung’s life has been in a downward spiral for a long time. Shouldered with the responsibility of paying the bills and the hospital fees of her only sister, she is barely surviving paycheck to paycheck. It’s hardly surprising that she resorted to borrowing from a loan shark. The true surprise, however, is when she discovers that the loan shark she owes money to is the father of her old high school classmate, Hae-Joo. Delighted with their reunion, Hae-Joo makes an irresistible offer: she’ll clear Tae-Kyung’s debt and take care of all her financial needs… in exchange for Tae-Kyung herself.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

title.english: I Accidentally Saved the Male Lead's Brother

description:
Charlotte Rania thought she'd be free to enjoy her life as an unimportant side character... until she saves a dying boy, who turns out to be Theodore Heinst, the younger brother of the male lead! Despite her reluctance to get involved with said male lead, Duke Carlyle Heinst, Charlotte has no choice but to help him when she discovers that mysterious forces are trying to kill Theodore. It doesn't take long for her to realize that changing a character's fate comes at a price...

(Source: Tapas)

Ever since inheriting his father’s debt as a teenager, Joo Ha-Won has been doing whatever it takes to buy his freedom back, whether that means working as a VIP dealer in the casinos of Macau, or taking other riskier jobs. In a world where money is worth more than lives, Ha-Won knows he’s always walking a fine line. But when a mysterious casino guest by the name of Kwon Tae-Ha offers to pay off his debt if he successfully finishes a job on a cruise ship, it’s too good an offer to turn down–despite his instincts warning him of obvious danger. With lives and livelihoods at stake, could this man be Ha-Won’s savior? Or will he be the devil that lures Ha-Won to depths deeper than he ever imagined?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Your Regrets Mean Nothing to Me

description:
Elijah Croft was an empress who had everything… except for a loving husband. Though she was used to the emperor’s coldness, the reappearance of his former lover proves to be the last straw… and she finally asks for a divorce. However, Elijah soon realizes that escaping the political and social machinations of her former life isn’t going to be as easy as she thought. Can this former empress make a new life for herself and her unborn child? Or is she destined to be tied to the emperor forever?

(Source: Tapas)

Would you make a deal with the devil to get a second chance at life? After her family was framed and executed, Ayana spent the last 13 years desperately trying to exact revenge, only to lose her life at the hands of her nemesis. But just before death’s door, a "loyal knight" appears with a strange proposition. Is he truly her knight or is she truly alone? Will Ayana be able to save her family from doom and finally get her revenge, or is she dancing to the devil’s tune?

(Source: Tapas)

Taepung Shin knows every nook and cranny of his favorite MMO video game Paradiso like it was the back of his hand! However, his gaming adventures suffer an abrupt end after his untimely death. But this is not his last hurrah since he's reincarnated as Jared, a delinquent lord of a frozen province... in Paradiso! Now, he must brave the world he loved and take advantage of all glitches he knows about and turn himself into the main character of his new solo adventure!

(Source: Tapas)

Edward Kenway returns to take the leap of faith in an all-new adventure. The high-seas hunt is on for a long-lost treasure left by Those Who Came Before. But this time, The Templars aren’t the only ones after the prize. Join history’s most cunning pirate in an epic journey around the Chinese Sea.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The Buddha of Fighting descends to the human world!

An incident occurs in which demons escape from hell and hide in the human world. Son Oh-Gong, on the orders of the Jade Emperor, descends to the human world to capture the escaped demons. Concerned that the demons, startled by his extraordinary magical powers, will escape, he decides to hide in the body of an ordinary high school boy, Ryu Ha-Seon.

"From now on, I am the Buddha who will return victorious from battle, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, the Fighting Buddha, descends to the human world!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Dreams come and go, but this nightmare is here to stay. A-Reum keeps a note to keep track of her dreams and premonitions, which, to her horror, oftentimes become true. One day, she discovers a set of pages she doesn’t remember writing, and that’s when all hell breaks out in her school. Can she piece the broken parts of her dream together and survive the terror that lurks in the dark?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In a world where blue snow freezes everything it touches, humanity has long forgotten what warmth feels like. Seonu, a teenage boy with a prosthetic leg, carries the lifeless body of Iseo through the snow-covered wasteland, determined to bring her home one final time. The snow will soon erase his footsteps but not the promise that keeps him moving.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hong Doo-kke, who lived on a secluded island to escape the Imjin War, ventures into the sea on the anniversary of his father’s death to find a sea anemone. However, he is reborn into an alternate Joseon era in another world…!In this alternate Joseon era, a curse afflicts men, causing their descendants to wither. Reincarnated as Hong Doo-kke, he faces a challenging trial alongside Princess Somyeong to overcome this curse.Will Hong Doo-kke be able to break the curse of this alternate Joseon era and ascend to the throne?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

College student Eunho Lee is a recessive Omega with a sweet tooth. The handsome owner of a café and his cookies both captivate his heart and he applies as a part-timer. However, only Betas are hired and so Eunho hides his true gender and finds himself in a nerve-wrecking daily routine, steadily falling deeper for his cold but good-natured boss.

After Hillaria sees a future where her beloved nation is burned down to ashes just because she refused the emperor’s proposal, she accepts an invitation to the imperial palace with a mission to change this grim future and prevent the fall of her home country. How will the story unfold for Hillaria and her unique powers?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: includes three extra chapters.

title.english: If You Give Me Flowers, I'll Give You Myself

description:
Haewon’s ambitious dream is to discover a rare new flower and be forever remembered in botanist history. Eunseong just wants to get away from the drawn-out fight to inherit control of his father's company, seeking solace in a simpler existence. When these two cross paths in the vast Mongolian desert, the attraction is near magnetic. But no romance is ever that simple, especially not when Haewon is terminally ill and dying. She's desperate to keep her illness a secret just long enough to fulfill her dream. But Eunseong is not willing to let her go, and returning to the life he ran away from may be the only way to save her now. With both of their lives on the line, what does fate have in store for them?

(Source: TappyToon)

Note: Includes two side stories.

Chang-Jae Lee is an orphan and a high school dropout who has lived a miserable life. However, before his death, a mysterious being appears before him suggesting to grant him a wish. He says,

"I want to live a happy life with money and women!"

And that is how he became a Cult Leader.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.english: Excuse me, This is my Room

description:
Kim Jinsoo ends up moving in with his personal bully... will he be able to find love between his bully and his crush?

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: The Lady I Served Became a Master

description:
When Su-A wakes up inside the world of her favorite novel as the character of Blair, she is determined to help the female protagonist, Chloe, get through the darkest period of her life.

For years, Chloe has had to endure discrimination and abuse for being an illegitimate child. Blair becomes her maid and confidante, and the two form a special friendship. But Chloe turns out to be quite a different character than the one described in the book. She wields black magic, sends Blair to fetch her mysterious potions, and seems totally uninterested in any of the male lead candidates. Then one day, a handsome man who looks an awful lot like Chloe shows up at Blair’s doorstep. Could it be…the lady she used to serve?!

All bets are off as plot twist after plot twist unravels in this unpredictable tale of love and redemption.

(Source: Tappytoon)

To Yoonha, a model student at an elite high school, romance has always felt like a frivolous distraction. But when four surprising choices for love appear, her pencil begins to waver. Will she choose the right answer and ace the ultimate test?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Papnida. Mollagyeongae. Han Beondo an Aseun.
title.english: For Sale. Ruined Lady. Not Used.
title.native: 팝니다. 몰락영애. 한 번도 안 쓴.

description:
It’s been three years since I became a character in the game. After I turned the ruined lady into my finest sex slave, my harem life in this world began.

"Show me your affection and cherish me... Master!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Help, I'm stuck as a fox and can’t turn back into a human! I, Princess Eristella Leonalph, am the greatest magician in the empire, but I've been cursed to be hated by everyone. I was chasing after dark magicians when I became stuck like this! How am I supposed to break the curse? Maybe my fiancé, Grand Duke Heinlesione, can help, but our relationship is rocky… Well, even if I become a palace pet, I can’t give up! After all, some things are easier when you’re an adorable little fox.

(Source: Tapas)

After seven grueling years, Jihan Yu, a support hero, is expelled from his guild. But fate throws him a curveball -- a contract with an elemental grants him the ultra-rare power of a Wind Elementalist! In a world ravaged by monsters and invaders from other realms, Jihan joins the underdog Epic Guild. Can he utilize his newfound power and strategic mind to lead the ragtag guild to greatness, all while mastering his abilities, overcoming fierce rivalries, and surviving in this chaotic world?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The world fell into the grasp of an Artificial Intelligence system that changed reality into a game map consisting of monsters, items, and NPCs. Only the ‘Master Player’ is capable of turning this game-like world back to normal. When Na Sanggi’s family was murdered by an unknown Player, a mysterious voice told him that he must become a ‘Player’ in order to bring his family back. Thus begins Na Sanggi registration as a Player to uncover the truth of the incident and save his family!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Individuals who return from death as Terminal Revenants are granted unique abilities that allow them to surpass human limits. They have the power to steal the lifespan of others. Twenty-one years ago, the worst of these revenants, Hae-su Shin, disappeared without a trace after killing 144 people and stealing everything. Now, a revenge 20 years in the making begins, aimed at capturing the most dangerous of these resurrected beings.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Joonwu Kim, the 1st generation hunter, a hero, and founder of the subjugation system and code against monsters, finally defeats Gigantiana at Black Tomb Dungeon, but it costs his life. As he lay dying, Gigantiana softly whispered, "I will be resurrected in 42 years and bring destruction to this world." 42 years later, Joonwu reincarnates into the body of another person, namesake Joonwu Kim, who has a young teenage physique. A moment to rejoice for a new peaceful world is short-lived. Joonwu becomes distraught, witnessing the subjugation system and Hunter's Law that he and his cohorts had built on their bloodshed and sacrifices in disorder. With this state, Gigantiana's resurrection will bring devastation to this world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The bullied loser Kim Jae-Hyeok receives 'Top 1 Fighting Tutoring'!

Kim Jae-Hyeok is a high school student who has been living in despair under the torment of bullies. He's good at studying, but he'd rather be good at fighting.

Then, as if by fate, a 'fighting tutor' comes into his life!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Why Are You Obsessed With Your Fake Wife?

description:
Nadia Valajit thought she had nothing more to lose until her family and fiancé betrayed her. After she finds herself thrust back in time prior to the events that ultimately led to her death, Nadia kicks off her plans for payback by marrying Glenn Winterpel, the icy marquess to the north and the Valajit family’s favorite punching bag. Armed with knowledge of the future, Nadia sets the table to serve up her ice-cold revenge, but she might end up melting the marquess’s heart instead…

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Skill Breaker of the Namgung Family

description:
As the hated Great World Killer Jin Cheonrang draws his last breath, he learns the terrible truth that his long-lost son took his own life out of shame for his father. So when he wakes up to find himself alive in his son Namgung Cheon’s body, he is determined to give Cheon a better life. Now, he's ready to take on proud clan heads and cruel bullies using his trusty martial skill copying technique. Can this skill breaker bring honor to his son and clan, or will his shameful past break him first?

(Source: Tapas)

A university student, a model, a hacker, an auto repair apprentice…the list goes on, and these seemingly unrelated people have one thing in common. They are all from the same graduating class. One day, these 32 former classmates receive a suspicious text message from an anonymous sender. They’re promised $10,000 if they attend a class reunion held on an abandoned island. No one knows who sent the message or why, but they all participate. Some for fun, some for money, and some for the mystery. What will be awaiting them on the island?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Baek Un-ho, a third-generation disciple from a respectable family but lacking inner strength, may be expelled from the Mount Hua sect. However, one day he stumbles upon a fateful encounter with Mong Won-kyung and emerges as an unparalleled prodigy of the Mount Hua sect. Just how powerful will Baek Un-ho become?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Chae-a Han and Yunsu Park may be perfect angels at church, but Chae-a is really a foul-mouthed ex-convict, and Yunsu is… a vampire? When Yunsu blackmails Chae-a with a murder she didn’t commit, she begins searching for ways to escape the situation until the perfect opportunity presents itself. With Yunsu’s life now at her mercy, the two begin a life-or-death game of cat and mouse, only to find themselves falling deeper and deeper into each other’s traps...

(Source: WEBTOON)

College freshman Da-in Kim enters Myeongmun University determined to craft the perfect campus life: top grades, meaningful friendships, and even a handsome boyfriend. However, her plans unravel quickly after meeting her stunningly beautiful namesake, Da-in Kang, and a reserved guy named Su-hyeon Cha. When Su-hyeon publicly rejects her in favor of the “prettier” Da-in, her carefully built vision begins to collapse. Surrounded by students chasing their own ideal selves, can Da-in figure out what perfection really means?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: I Get Stronger the More I Eat

description:
Known as “Pet Shop,” Mr. Kim has the unique ability to absorb the skills of the creatures he eats. One day, Pet Shop is mysteriously transported to a magical world full of orcs, trolls, and monsters. A new world, new chow, and new skills. Now Pet Shop is determined to become the most powerful creature in the world. Follow his epic climb to the top of the food chain.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Rebirth of a Tyrannical Empress

description:
After downing one too many glasses of wine one night, Songha wakes up inside the world of her favorite novel as Empress Yulia. But being given the reins to an empire isn’t as exciting as it seems—the tyrannical Yulia will soon meet a bloody fate at the hands of the captain of her personal guards, Justo. Songha must think of a way to reverse the events that lead up to the coup d'état, which will take place in just three days. She chooses to use warmth and benevolence to reach out to a group of loyal subjects Yulia exiled, but will her strategy be enough to win back the people’s trust? Or will the empress’s sudden change in behavior raise even more suspicion among the rebels?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: In the Hall of the Mountain King

description:
Sold off as a male bride to Marquis Oderic, who rules over the territory of Trufinnen, Everard expects to be treated as a prsioner—but in Oderic’s quiet care, he finds peace and freedom. Can love blossom in these austere halls?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

title.romaji: Naege Michin Segyegwan Choegangjareul Josimhal Geot
title.english: The Mighty Master Is Crazy About Me
title.native: 내게 미친 세계관 최강자를 조심할 것

description:
For her sister's happiness and happy ending, Charlotte decides to bring home the knight who holds her sister's heart. However, that means getting to the Black Dragon Order, where the mysterious Archduke Ludovika lurks. With rumors of the archduke's penchant for men, Charlotte dons a wig and becomes Charcharl, a new squire of the order! Despite trying to lay low, she keeps drawing the archduke's eye and suspicions. Can Charcharl keep up the act till the end, or will her cover get blown?

(Source: Tapas)

Sujeong writes romance novels but has never lived one. A proud homebody and a self-proclaimed loner, she's content on her own—until the sly and irresistible Seunghyeon crashes into her life and turns it upside down. His charm feels dangerous, yet impossible to resist. Now Sujeong must find out: is he the love that she's been waiting for... or the heartbreak she never saw coming?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I thought going back in time or going into someone else's body was just imagination. However, I died in a sudden accident, and when I woke up again, I became a grandson of a rich man. My new life begins now. I'm going to be successful and seduce all successful women.

"Boss, this is from me"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Rai wakes up from an 820-year-long sleep and starts his new life as a student in a high school founded by his loyal servant, Frankenstein. But his peaceful days with other human students are soon interrupted by mysterious attackers known as the "Unions."

(Source: WEBTOON)

One snowy winter evening, Chang-Deok spots a high schooler crouched in front of his favorite restaurant, blood running ice-cold in the falling snow. Lured in by the promise of meal made just like the restaurant's, Chang-Deok ends up inviting the boy—Jong-U—into his home; after all, Chang-Deok's life is as dry as day-old rice, and food is his only joy. So when Jong-U offers to cook him a delicious dinner every night in exchange for a place to stay, he reluctantly agrees. But as their unusual cohabitation begins, Changdeok can't shake this bloody feeling that Jong-U might be hiding something... Hopefully being a good Samaritan doesn’t come back around to bite him in the neck—er, butt...

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Jaheon comes from a lineage of omegas. Omegas who have raised the children of their branch families, only for them to be offered to the Snake God, Lord Mugo, every 12 years. Though it is said that Mugo handpicks his sacrifices no one in the head family believes such an old tale anymore. However, Jaheon knows that Lord Mugo came to him when he was a child and picked him to be the sacrifice, and even remembers the events of the day.

Even though Jaheon has prepared himself, both body and mind, for as long as he could remember, upon entering Mugo's lair he quickly realizes that he doesn't want to be eaten as a sacrifice, at least not after finding out the "Lord Mugo" he adored was just one of the snake god's three personalities. Will the Snake God take pity on his sacrifice? Or will Jaheon be swallowed whole?

(Surce: Lezhin US)

Olivia Liberty is the first commoner ever admitted to Herolington University. However, she cannot be properly recognized because she is a woman and must instead use the name of a man, Oliver, to receive credit for her creations. Meanwhile, Noah Astrid, Prince of Herod, takes notice of Olivia, who is beloved by the commoners of Herod. Noah seeks to involve her in royal affairs to raise the royal family’s popularity and asks for her hand. But while every other member of the royal family treats Olivia affectionately, Noah alone continues to treat her coldly. Will he come to regret it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Although Baroness Cassia is on her deathbed, she’s relieved that it means she’s finally free from her loveless marriage to her mercenary husband, Zester. Oh, how she regrets her tireless efforts to keep his territory afloat! If only she had taken more time for herself. Her wish becomes reality when Cassia wakes up to find herself ten years back in the past. With this second chance, she’s determined to live a stress-free life. But can Cassia find the courage to rebel against Zester? Or is she doomed to repeat her nightmare of a past life?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Cross My Heart and Hope to Die

description:
Silvia Florette wants nothing more than to die. In fact, most days, she can’t even be bothered to get out of bed. Sentenced to repeat life 99 times, she agrees to marry Duke Randall in an attempt to appease God and die at the earliest convenience. However, while Silvia is eager to consummate the marriage, her husband insists they must first fall in love before they can finally sleep together.

(Source: WEBTOON)

World-renowned actress Son Yu-Ri has it all: beauty, talent, and now even unimaginable wealth upon her marriage to IT magnate, Dave Cheon. But the happiest day of Yu-Ri’s life soon becomes the worst when her husband suddenly goes missing after the first night of their honeymoon. With them having been the only two on their yacht in the middle of the vast sea, Yu-Ri is immediately suspected of murdering Dave. Just when the entire world seems to be against her, Yu-Ri is reunited with Lee Do-Jun, a lawyer and old acquaintance. Despite their complicated history and disadvantage in the case, Do-Jun is determined to prove Yu-Ri’s innocence by uncovering the truth behind this impossible mystery…

(Source: Tappytoon)

“Ten years younger!”

[Special compensation will be paid that reflects the object's aspiration.]

A legendary hunter who was in retirement at the age of Palsun. I accidentally regained the power of fire and rejuvenated it, and returned to the hunter industry after a long time... In the Hunter industry... too many rotten ones?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Min-woo and Jae-min have been eyeing one another across the classroom for ages, but so far they’ve only gotten hot and steamy together in their imaginations. Just as the sexual tension reaches a boiling point, Jae-min makes a shocking discovery: Min-woo is a werewolf! And this only excites him more! Will Min-woo be a good pup and make Jae-min howl in bed? The fangs and claws will surely come out this semester!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: includes six extras.

The grand union of the watchman family, the wedding everyone had been waiting for. The groom brought his mistress to that very wedding, and I finally confessed my true feelings.

"I can't do this marriage."

Just as I was about to leave, shaking off the chilly atmosphere, a man suddenly stood up in the middle of the already chaotic wedding hall.

"Then marry me."

I received a marriage proposal right after the wedding was over?! Why are you doing this? Since when have we been so sweet?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

In the shadows of Mt. Bukhan, a lonely tiger spirit discovers the corpse of a man and seizes the chance to live among humans in his body. Dreaming of love but armed with raw instinct, he stumbles through human life until he meets Suhyeon, a quiet young man with a shaman grandmother who sends him to confront the unruly spirit. But when a protective charm breaks, the tiger’s suppressed desires explode, and he becomes fiercely obsessed with making Su-Hyeon his mate—promising to protect him for life, no matter what.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

“Is this how I’m gonna die?” At the height of battle, a space sergeant meets her unfortunate end and enters the body of the cursed Miola de Langtree! Now this soldier-turned-princess’s only mission is to locate her spaceship and escape this fantasy world of frilly dresses and haughty manners. But the shuttle is nowhere to be found, a suspicious masked man is hounding her, and her own sister wants her dead?! Time for this sergeant to fight for survival the only way she knows how… by joining the prestigious Knights Order! Will she make it back to the stars she came from? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

A lifetime as a fencing prodigy prepared Eunha for her new role as Selena Evan, novel side character and daughter of a renowned swordsman. Life isn't actually so bad after being sucked into a fictional world, but she’s doomed to meet an untimely death if she can't escape the clutches of the villainous Prince Ignus. When Selena's twin brother, Celestine, runs away before his military conscription, she has no choice but to enlist under his name to avoid getting her entire family executed. But hiding her identity won’t be so easy once Ignus takes note of her impressive sword skills and sets his sights on turning “Sir Celestine” into his top henchman. With the threat of execution looming over her head, can Selena avoid getting caught by the villain?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Though she comes from a rich family, Ga-Bin is a bullied loner at school. That doesn't mean she puts up with bullying from other students, though -- Ga-Bin is infamous for her fierce personality. Worried about Ga-Bin's well-being, her family secretly offers Tae-Ung $500,000 to transfer schools and act as her bodyguard. Will Tae-Ung be able to protect her from the school bullies, all while keeping his identity hidden from Ga-Bin and the other students?

(Source: WEBTOON)

We all hate the greedy villains hell-bent on sabotage. Enter Carnelia Easter, the awful secondary villainess of the romance I’m reading, who trapped the prince in marriage at the behest of the evil empress. I didn’t shed a tear when her head’s lopped off, but now I’m Carnelia! I gotta play this smart and convince him to divorce me instead! Still, between the prince, the empress, the heroine, the second prince, my terrible health... this story’s getting unpredictable. Will I survive after all?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Villainous Family Won't Let Me Be

description:
A distant echo from a life long-forgotten; shattered shards of an ominous future. When her late mother’s heirloom pendant is broken, Elodie Perdia regains the memories of Ga-Eul Yun, a girl from our world who realizes she’s landed in the body of a villainess from a fantasy novel. In the story, Elodie serves as the dark foil to the virtuous heroine and is destined for an early grave – a dark fate that can perhaps be avoided with Ga-Eul’s knowledge of future events!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

An outcast from the imperial family due to her freewheeling attitude and refusal to get married, Princess Melody Corbella wants nothing more than to live life on her own terms and protect the people of the empire. Using her secret powers to sneak out of the palace to influence affairs from behind the scenes, she ends up drawing the attention of the handsome imperial guard, Caisar Bethel. Though she avoided romance until now, could love finally bloom for this crazy flower?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Lazy Lord Masters the Sword

description:
After witnessing the shocking death of his mother, young Airen Farreira uses sleep to escape his painful reality, earning him the nickname, “the lazy lord”. Yet, in spite of others’ jeers and whispers, Airen has no intention of changing his ways. But when he awakens one day from a dream about a mysterious swordsman, his life’s trajectory takes a complete turn...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Although an old porter has shown great determination and loyalty to his escort agency, he is never given the chance to become an armed escort due to his bad leg. But after sacrificing his life to keep a priceless treasure from a group of bandits, he is reborn as the 22-year-old Li Zhenglong who died 30 years ago! Now, in the body of the fourth young master of the Heavenly Dragon Escort Agency, will he finally realize his dream? Or will Li Zhenglong's terrible reputation ruin it all?

(Source: Tapas)

Charlotte De Perol is a beautiful lady with a heartbreaking past. She has endured long years of abuse and threats from her mother while her father was busy chasing girls and wasting the family’s fortune. But on the day of her grandfather's funeral, Charlotte becomes the countess instead of her father. Out of resentment, cruel father locates his long forgotten daughter named Kara to steal the title back from her daughter Charlotte.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Karen Heyer thought that a happy ending with the male lead, Raymond Sayerteth, would help her escape the romance novel she had entered. Unfortunately, fate had other plans. Karen soon discovers that regardless of how the story ends, she always dies tragically and returns to when she was 17. After being forced to relive the story for 117 years, Karen's sanity finally reaches a breaking point... as she decides to change her destiny by killing everyone who has wronged her.

(Source: Tapas)

Seven years after leaving the Herbet Empire to escape her selfish mother, Rosena Estalot returns seeking treatment for her sick son, Illion. There, she reunites with Yerhan, the third prince of the empire and Illion's father. When Yerhan proposes marriage, Rosena, reluctant to reenter high society and confront her mother again, agrees on one condition: an eventual divorce. With Rosena so set on pushing him away, can Yerhan win her heart before their marriage runs its course?

(Source: Tapas)

Ruud Denatos' life of living in the shadow of his talented older brother Aesir, a genius dragon slayer, ends when Aesir is killed in a brutal battle. After the fight, a hidden dragon lord appears and sends Ruud to a past where Aesir doesn't exist! In order to find answers and his older brother, Ruud takes Aesir's place and wows the school with his skills and knowledge. But will Ruud continue to impress the academy, or will the lackluster skills of his past catch up to him?

(Source: Tapas)

When Emperor Rustanard of the Rusclan Empire summons the Otherworldly Savior from another world to fulfill a prophecy, he doesn’t expect to find 16-year-old Sihan Seong. The emperor casts him out, only to have Sihan return with a party of six warriors to defeat the so-called “Mad Emperor” and set the Rusclan people free. Just when victory is within Sihan’s grasp, he is betrayed by his teammates and sent back to his own world. 10 years later, Sihan returns to the Terranor Continent and finds an unlikely ally in Alita, the daughter of Rustanard…

(Source: WEBTOON)

He may be from the boonies, but he's strong, he's kind, and he won't stop until you're satisfied. His name... is Kangsae the Strong.

(Source: Toomics)

Ho-Jun’s recent breakup was pretty rough. His partner told him it wasn’t him, per se… Ho-Jun just wasn’t good in bed. But it turns out Drunk Ho-Jun is surprisingly resourceful; singlehandedly managing to find and set himself up with a sex tutor by the name of Mr. An. An Seung-Hyeon was only half serious when he posted the sex tutor ad, but he quickly finds himself in too deep to call the lessons off. And the more he sees Ho-Jun, the more he can’t help but notice how much attractive he is. Seung-Hyeon is making it up as he goes along, so what will the final exam look like?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Ju Yun-Seong thought getting a job at JH Soft was the start of a normal office life—until he noticed his cold, intimidating CEO, Baek Ha-Jin, glaring at him every time they crossed paths.

“Why is the boss always staring at me? Did I do something wrong on my first day?”

Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yun-Seong keeps his head down… until he stumbles upon a mysterious employee ID and uncovers a secret: his boss isn’t just intense—he’s a nine-tailed fox. And to make things worse? Ha-Jin’s fox bead ends up lodged inside Yun-Seong’s body. Now the CEO won’t leave his side, and “normal” has left the building.

“Mr. Ju, you have two choices: stick close to me and do as I say, or I cut you open and take it back.”

Excuse me?! Are those really my only options?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

As a professor of English Literature, strict but capable I-Hyeon is both admired and feared by his students. He's surprised to discover his love for poetry is shared by one of them, the quiet yet arresting Nam-U. Drawn to her despite a painful past, can their love remain strong when faced with the new challenges that lie ahead...?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Harley thought that marriage would be her ticket out of the Ernst household and away from the family’s three sons, aka her perpetual tormenters. But on the eve of her wedding, she’s transported back in time 20 years to a youth she’d hoped to forget. As long as she’s getting a second chance at childhood, Harley’s determined to stand up to her bullies. But what began as retaliation quickly turns into reconciliation as both Harley and the Ernst brothers come to understand each other’s pain.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

One female knight, two princes.

Despite having been trained to be the next duchess, Lamia Orphe decides to become a knight. Meanwhile, the first prince of the Kingdom, Ethan Taylor, and the second prince, Aquilla Theodore, are engaged in a battle of the throne. Why does Lamia keep waking up crying? How could her fate, both present and past, be intertwined with the two princes?

(Source: Manta)

Heejae is the youngest executive director of the Jinhwa Group, nicknamed the "Chaebol Prince" by the public. But his life is turned upside down when documents linking him to an embezzlement scheme are found by an accounting student, Taekyung! To make sure the secret stays that way, Heejae pretends to have a crush on him, but... is there more to Taekyung than meets the eye? Watch sparks fly as this chaebol rom-com begins!

(Source: Tappytoon)

What would you do if you could live forever? Suk-Hui Kang has lived for over 10,000 years, yet always seems to make the same mistake — she wants to save others from certain death. This time, she chooses to help veterinarian Jae-Shin Lee with his terminal cancer prognosis. But the great clans of Baekje are dead set on finding out the secret to her immortality and healing powers. Will she be able to save her beloved doctor, or will the clans get to her first?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In a neighborhood known for its diversity, delicious food, and spunk, ex-convict Park Saeroyi works to put his hole-in-the-wall pub on the map. This is just one step in his 15-year plan to live a life that would have made his father proud. As his pub attracts its own unique crew, Saeroyi embarks on the next phase: taking down the very family who stole his father away from him. It’s time for revenge and to prove to the world what he’s worth.

(Source: Tapas)

It’s been seven years since King Heon Lee declared a marriage ban in Joseon after the death of his wife. But one day, he comes across a woman named So-Rang Ye who claims she can summon the spirits of the dead. Though So-Rang was lying about her spiritual powers, she now has no choice but to put on an act for the king. As the secrets behind the mysterious death of the king’s wife and So-Rang’s past start unraveling, the red thread of fate becomes more entangled…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Angela is mortified when her cringey fanfic about the dethroned Prince Rayburn is published behind her back and becomes a wildly popular bestseller. Not only is it super embarrassing, but the book gets her in trouble with the current imperial family, who now want her head for treason! Luckily, Rayburn's sister Hoya offers to protect her-- but in exchange, she must write a sequel that will improve Rayburn's tarnished reputation. But that's easier said than done, when the scary prince already hates her for writing the first novel. Will Angela be able to chip away at Rayburn's cold exterior and gather enough inspiration for her next book?

(Source: TappyToon)

Studying abroad in the US, Do-Jin has experienced his fair share of unexpected surprises. New schools, new people, new roommates. However, of all the surprises, Do-Jin never expected to catch his roommate’s handsome younger brother, Tae-Hui, jerking off to him in his sleep?! That’s when the scandal began…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes six side stories.

She is beautiful, persevering but what amazes people is her sharp mind. Sharp minded enough to become the next empress. However the prince despises her... How will she manage to make him fall in love with her?

The only daughter of South Korea's white hat hacker, Lee Eun-Jo, who seemed to have everything anyone could desire. As she was thrown from the top of a 46-story apartment building, she cried out more desperately than anyone else.

Please, anyone, save me.

Then, like fate itself, a phrase appeared before her eyes.

[Interfere with fate? YES or NO]

Fate? Interfere? What the hell is this? Who cares? Yeah, it's over now. Since it's over, no need to hesitate!

[YES!!!]

And so she opened her eyes, alive. In the body of a woman with the same name... rough, shallow, and a bit vulgar, Na Eun-Jo.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

For hopeless romantic Ginger Torte, getting engaged to the man of her dreams is a fairy tale come true. It isn’t long before she realizes the gut-wrenching truth — her fiancé has been seduced by her rival! The heartbroken Ginger finds solace in a new book that recounts the tale of a young woman and a cursed prince… But to her horror, the protagonist turns out to be none other than her beautiful nemesis, Lerazie! As reality unfolds according to the book, both ladies fall in love with the handsome prince at first sight. Ginger vows to steal both the spotlight and the prince’s heart! But, does this story harbor a sinister secret?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: The chapter count includes 10 extra stories.

Having mastered the art of lying her way through life, Yeon-Hui Bae has vowed to leave her past behind and make a fresh start for herself by going to college at 24. But when she runs into someone who knows a secret from her past that could completely ruin her reputation, her hopes for a perfect life suddenly start to crumble. Amidst college gossip, crushes, and jealousy, can the two set aside their differences and embrace each other for who they really are?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

The hit series from Eun Song returns with officially updated artwork, chapters, and additional scenes! With the sudden outbreak of a deadly virus, humanity is thrown into chaos. The few who survive it are either transformed into horrible cannibalistic creatures called "Worms," or super-humans called "Anomalies." Haru, a young Anomaly student at New Seoul High School, dreams of joining the prestigious "ISO" - an organization formed to fight the war against this virus. But the future in store for him is nothing like he imagined...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Being called a freak isn’t so bad when you have a spunky little black blob as a companion. An explosion leaves Nam Kang orphaned, scarred, and nearly blind, but he toughs out the daily bullying with the help of his imaginary blob friend, Inky. Until one day, Nam wakes from a bad beating to find his scars healed and his vision restored. At a new school, Nam is finally given the chance to live life as a normal kid. But it isn’t just his scars that have disappeared. His best friend Inky is gone, too.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Dayeol hears two guys fooling around in the nurse’s office and accidentally knocks over the curtain rod. When the nurse walks in on the scene, devilishly handsome Taehyun tells her that Dayeol tried to make out with him. Before Dayeol can correct the misunderstanding, the rumor spreads and his archery scholarship is in jeopardy. To make matters worse, Taehyun doesn’t show the slightest bit of remorse; in fact, he shamelessly begins hanging around Dayeol. It’s not long before the two begin walking the thin line between hate and love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

College student Hadam desperately needs a recommendation letter from her professor. The only way to get it? Be a mentor to an exchange student and house them for a full semester. Hadam was expecting a female, but the exchange student turns out to be… a handsome French male?! What will happen when Hadam has to live with him under the same roof? Will they be able to overcome the language barrier to find love?

(Source: Manta)

Achoo! Love is in the air - and it’s causing Ki Je-Yeon a real headache. As a dominant omega, she has the power to help alphas heal through a process known as “guiding.” The only problem is, she’s allergic to others’ pheromones. Luckily for her, she has her childhood best friend and recessive alpha, Cha Jae-Heon, to help her through all her symptoms! But wait, why is she starting to sneeze every time Jae-Heon’s around her now? That would mean he’s releasing pheromones, which would mean… Oh… Oh no…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extera chapters.

The most popular person on campus, a pretty face with smiling eyes, a friendly-yet-awkward classmate…that’s all Sung-yeon ever was to Hosik. But after a wild night out, Hosik awakes with zero memories of their time together - and one naked Sung-yeon in bed next to him! Hosik would have been fine with leaving their relationship as a drunken mistake on a night of many; but when he started feeling funny in the following days, a trip to the doctor’s office would change everything: “Mr. Kim Hosik, you’re pregnant!”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 37 extra chapters.

I'm a celebrity manager, but one day, I awakened a new power...! With one glance from me, all are powerless to resist...!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Princess Enisha’s birth marks the start of the Hyperion Empire’s prophetic reign. With her unfathomably cute face and a ceaseless supply of loyal servants, life is pretty great for the baby princess. There’s just the small issue of her two psychotic-killer brothers and a war-hungry father who she must stop from driving the empire into ruin. Enisha’s got a lot on her plate, between the constant flood of assassins trying to kill her and those pesky memories of her past life. But she’s in no rush to return to being the powerful high mage of a magical kingdom. After all, being Hyperion’s one great hope certainly has its royal perks. It’s not easy being the empire’s beloved princess, but these subjects will just have to do.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 30 side stories.

Mercedia Sasha has it all: looks, wealth, status... No man is good enough for her, and she makes sure everyone knows the fact. Her single life is peaceful and perfect... until one day, she wakes up wearing a hideous wedding dress aboard a ship in the middle of the ocean! To her horror, someone has devised an elaborate kidnapping to wed her off to admiral Demetriu Cyprosa, the empire's greatest war hero—or massive jerk, as others call him behind his back. What’s worse, they're headed to a deserted island for their honeymoon! Can the incompatible newlyweds put aside their quarrels to plan an escape? Or will their stubborn ways get the best of them before they can exact revenge on the ones who set them up?

(Source: TappyToon)

To Hae-Jin, the stranger with black eyes, ‘family’ was the warmth he wanted to protect with his entire life. But instead of the blessings of his 20th birthday, a cruel tragedy arrived. To save his shattered family, Hae-Jin offers himself as a commodity. His partner was Ryle, a cold-blooded tycoon and extreme alpha. To Ryle, Hae-Jin was merely a disposable commodity to relieve his pheromone congestion. Despite being a dominant alpha, Ryle despised omegas intensely. Hae-Jin was treated like a tool, his body and mind crumbling further amidst the humiliation and abuse from servants who ignored their master's neglect. As days piled up, each one barely bearable, news of his parents' death, his sole support arrived. Hae-Jin left behind the life of nothing but suffering in the mansion. It was only after that Hae-Jin departed that something strange began to happen to Ryle, who had thought of him as just another easily acquired omega.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Three hundred years have passed since the dragon and the serpent vanished. The Heavenly Emperor, who had worried about the human realm, commands the last dragon, Yeonmok, who had gone into seclusion after the death of his beloved disciple, to find the whereabouts of the dragon and the serpent. Descending to the human realm, Yeonmok encounters an enigmatic young serpent named Doya...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Edith—who lost her mother at the hands of the Reynolds marquis family—was branded a madwoman. She dreams of vengeance, but a chance comes to the powerless: marriage to the third prince, Duke Myers, who is rumored to be perfect in every way. It’s a marriage of convenience meant to use one another, and that’s fine. If I can make you live through hell without even knowing it’s hell, I will do whatever it takes. Keep smiling, Reynolds. Until I have paved the road to the very fires of hell right before you.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Adopting the Hero Changed the Genre

description:
Nobody understands why the wicked Belinda Blanche is giving special treatment to her child servant. They don't realize she's actually from the modern world, and her servant's the hero of her favorite childcare game! All Belinda wants is to give the hero the love he deserves, but the game keeps twisting her words to make her sound like a third-rate villain. Can Belinda beat the game and figure out how to fangirl without saying a single kind word? Or will she be forced to play the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)

Short track speed skater Yeo-Jun Lee joins the National Team, only making it by sheer dumb luck. Dejected, he walks into his new room to find gold medalist Ji-Hun Nam, his long-time crush! With the Olympics just 6 months away, can Yeo-Jun make history in the rink? Or will his face flush ever more pink?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Jo Ji-Won is just your average college kid—well, except for the part where he scams people by pretending to be a shaman. Thanks to his silver tongue and some lucky guesses, he gains a reputation as a spiritual powerhouse. Unfortunately, word gets around… all the way to Jeong Tae-Oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-Oh shows up demanding help, Ji-Won pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught.

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Ji-Won blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to… sleep together!"

He’s sure a tough guy like Tae-Oh would bolt at the thought. Instead, Tae-Oh just shrugs.

"You should’ve said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Raised as the perfect assassin for her captor's revenge, Ayla finally learns the truth of her kidnapping as she takes her dying breath. When she wakes up again years in the past, she vows then and there to turn his own plan for vengeance against him. But as she begins to unravel his plot, she discovers that she was just a small pawn in an even greater scheme. With so much at stake, will Ayla succeed in her revenge? Or will she be dragged further into something she never wanted to be a part of?

(Source: Tapas)

After reawakening from a C-rank to the strongest A-rank Esper, Ha Jae-Il is pushed to the brink by insomnia and unresolved trauma, unable to endure even the slightest touch. His only match is Seung-Hyeon, an A-rank Guide with a 98 percent compatibility who comes from the lawless District 13 and lacks all formal guiding skills. With no other options, the Haon Division orders an extreme solution: the two must share a bed twice a week. But when Jae-Il wakes to unfamiliar hands in the dark and sees Seung-Hyeon looming over him, he realizes that something else has awakened as well - and it is already guiding him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jooin is a young vet that charms pets and owners alike at his animal clinic. When a puppy and kitten are dumped at his door, he decides to raise them as his own. With love and care the furballs quickly become full-grown ‒perhaps a bit too much as they’re now two… hunky humans?! When your pets are this eager, it takes being a ‘pet lover’ to a whole new level!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Working as a servant for the handsome Duke, Theodore Winston, was dreamy enough, but Alois is determined to win his heart. He has tried every trick in the book to seduce his master, only to be met with a fatherly pat on the head. When rumors of a new Duchess threaten his dreams, Alois makes a desperate plea to the heavens. The magic works a little too well by bringing a youthful and ruthless version of the Duke across time and into his arms. Now that the tables have turned, will Alois finally get the love he has been craving?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The rich are strong and the poor are weak... Yushin learns what it means to fight for what he believes in.

(Source: Toomics)

When Yuri Gable first pulled the young Ling Xinlu out from the ocean, he didn’t expect the two of them to ever meet again, especially not at gunpoint. Danger always seems to follow their encounters, though it isn’t until Xinlu messes with the wrong psycho and loses both his first love and an eye that the two men finally find the chance to open up to each other. But how will their relationship progress when Xinlu has no memory of Yuri saving him before and only recalls a man who seemingly left him for dead underwater?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Soo-Hyeon’s peaceful life in the countryside, running a quaint general store and tending a garden, is upended when rumors spread of a luxury hotel project—and the arrival of Tae-Yeon, a gruff yet oddly charming director from S.W. Construction who looks more like a mob boss than a businessman. Despite warnings from the village grandmas to steer clear, Soo-Hyeon isn’t intimidated, even as Tae-Yeon’s attempts to “bribe” him with sweet treats start melting his defenses. But when an unexpected moment reveals Soo-Hyeon’s biggest secret, what starts as a clash of personalities turns into a tangled mix of sweetness, spice, and chaos that neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As a top-tier film star, Jae-Gyu is no stranger to the spotlight or the toxic rumors that follow it. Exhausted by the public eye, he has become a professional at pushing people away. That changes when he meets his neighbor, Cheong-Rok, a counselor at a psychiatry office. Cheong-Rok does not recognize the star and treats him like anyone else. Intrigued by this normal treatment, Jae-Gyu finds himself drawn to the one man unimpressed by his fame. Despite his long career, Jae-Gyu has never experienced romance, not even through a script. So is he finally ready for the real thing?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Eighteen-year-old U-Ri Chae is just a normal high schooler who loves reality dating shows—until she unexpectedly lands a spot on "Love in Session" alongside her childhood crush, U-Jin Hyeon. Frantic to win his heart, U-Ri throws herself at the opportunity. But her mission quickly becomes complicated: U-Jin is mysteriously absent, one participant hates her, and she finds herself unexpectedly attracted to others on the show. As romantic tensions rise, U-Ri must navigate her feelings and the show’s drama. Can she untangle her heart and find true love amid the chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Hyeol Yu is a third-rate warrior feared more for his menacing appearance than his actual skills. Branded by false rumors and endless misunderstandings, he has long been an outcast in the world of martial arts. But everything changes when Seolhwa, the woman he once vowed his life to, reappears before him as a true martial arts master. From that moment on, Hyeol is thrust into chaos, his name weaving its way through the ranks of warriors, sects, and factions. As his unwanted reputation spirals out of control, he is pulled into a conflict far greater than he ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Worried about your marriage because you're a terrible cook? Don't worry and leave it to us! At The Cooking School, you will leave both very full and satisfied.

(Source: Toomics)

After losing his mother to the mafia, Ro-Wan goes undercover to destroy the organization from the inside. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets its enigmatic leader, Raphael Valentino…a man he should loathe, but can’t seem to ignore. Determined to bring the seedy underbelly of New York down - whether as Rafael’s hunting dog or as someone powerful enough to crush it from above - Ro-Wan spends years as a member of his gang. But the more time they spend together, the harder it becomes to draw the line between duty and desire. In a world built upon lies and vengeance, can this tangled relationship end in love…or will it all fall apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After missing the village bus, Da-Eun sets out on foot to reach her village in the remote mountains. As she stumbles wearily along, her sweaty clothes flapping in the midsummer sun, a man stops his car and offers her a ride…for a price.
