Can she see them or not? Hayeon has always felt something creepy near her. She knows ghosts exist, but she can’t really see them. She suddenly meets a boy who not only sees them but fights with them? Hu-an Lee isn’t your average student. He’s a half-ghost. He knows there’s something different about Hayeon, but he can’t seem to figure out what. No one can. Human or ghosts!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Tired of being picked on, Yeongha, the new transfer student, decides to fight back… and discovers he can pack a punch. He soon becomes the top of the food chain, savoring his new title as the toughest guy at school. But he meets his match when Suho Kang, the Champion of the PVP games, single-handedly takes down him and his crew. To earn back his honor, Yeongha decides to join the PVP games. Will he finally get the satisfaction of beating Suho up? Or will he gain something more?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Notes:
- Includes one extra chapter.
- Belongs to Blue String universe.

When high school teacher Na Aejoon shows up for work on an ordinary day, he never expects to bump into his favorite celebrity in the hallway. But when his school becomes a filming location for a show starring Choi Siyeol, his bias from the idol group A-One, that’s exactly what happens!

If that’s not enough to give a fanboy a heart attack, Siyeol takes an interest in Aejoon and asks him to join the show as his “co-teacher.” Desperate to keep his fan life a secret, Aejoon is forced to put his acting skills to the test, and not just on camera. But as he spends more and more time with Siyeol, the deception becomes harder to keep up. Not to mention, he might not be the only one keeping secrets…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

"Where am I? What... am I?"

The Gold Armored Sword Dragon (or Geumgap Doryong), the boss monster of Demon Palace's 7th floor and the Guardian of the Abyss, becomes self-aware and awakens in a game world! He is a giant dragon covered in golden scales, but he takes on a human form once he withstands a set number of attacks. He's a rare character in the game, "New Legend of Mir", a supposedly authentic martial arts game.

And then there is Dorothy, a girl who calls him "Geum Ryong" (Gold Dragon), and Jeok Chan-Woon, the attack force's leader and commander of the Red Blood Group, and Gepetto, who goes by the nickname, "Dumplinghead Girl"... Their story takes place inside the world of Murim within the virtual-reality martial arts game, "New Legend of Mir"!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Eun-Chul was left alone in a big house after his father got remarried. He began to seek new family members to deal with his loneliness and he finally succeeded to make his new family. But all of the female family members try to seduce him...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

So that girl finally grew up? My neighbor Ji-Eun suddenly came to share my room and motivate me sexually. I am Hae-Yeong, a student who is motivated because I will finally be able to have sex with my girlfriend Sena, after a long relationship, but...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

You know when you're at a crazy college party and some dude with a massive dick is asleep with it out? The normal reaction is definitely to take a pic of it. And as for our Sleeping Beauty? Well he's about to be a lot more popular...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Hae-Sung and Ji-Woon were childhood friends that grew apart after Ji-Woon moved away. Reunited at college years later, the friendship is rekindled - but there’s no sexual chemistry to speak of. However, that all changes when Hae-Sung catches a glimpse of Ji-Woon’s package as he’s getting dressed. After the “big” reveal, Hae-Sung begins to view her hunky childhood friend in a new light!.

"Human beings must be happy no matter what"
A society where emotions are controlled by a chip. And hackers that can hack the chips to make the people hallucinate.
The survival of Ah-Yeon, a white hacker who suffers from depression in a world where negative emotions are forbidden.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A childhood friendship ruined by a confession?!

A pretty girl popular in college is even popular in her own home! Her stepfather is always in pain trying to control himself not to cross the line. Will he be able to hold it in, or will his instincts drive him wild?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Every person has something they desire, whether it’s beauty, wealth, or power. Depending on what you’re willing to risk, you could have anything your heart desires. You could be beautiful with the swipe of an app or become anyone with the press of a button -- but it all comes with a price. How far would you be willing to go to get what you wish for?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Eun-Oh is always alone because of his peculiar ability to see fairies. But one day, Jae-Hwi, a transfer student, comes up to Eun-Oh without hesitation! "When I'm with you, I feel good," he said, shaking Eun-Oh's heart.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three extra chapters.

Jun is a hedonist man but he feels empty in his boring daily life.
One day, he meets an innocent girl Ma-Di and he sets a CORRUPTION PLAN to awake her dirty desire deep inside of her! .

(Source: TOPTOON+)

There’s no lock Detective Do-Bin Kim can’t open. With his unique ‘opening’ ability, he can unlock anything -- even people -- to get the information he needs to hunt down criminals and solve crimes. Enter Locker -- his polar opposite and his enemy. When Locker uses her ability to ‘lock’ a witness and prevents Kim from accessing key information in a crucial case, they plunge into a cat-and-mouse game with justice itself at stake. When two equal forces collide, who will emerge the victor?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

All members of the Ascania imperial family are cursed to die at the hands of a loved one, a curse only broken by the birth of a girl into the bloodline. So when a young slave girl with the telltale, color-changing Ascania eyes is discovered, she’s declared Princess Chloe, the little sister of the three princes. She’s excited to finally have a family, but her new brothers seem a bit strange… They’ve always had to be cold and unfeeling for their own protection, but will Chloe’s arrival plant the seed of change in their hearts?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: chapter count includes a prologue

Forced to leave his internship to take care of his ailing mother, Jang Hyunjun had long given up on his dreams of becoming a doctor when one day, a freak accident causes him to absorb an AI network into his body. With sharpened senses and unlimited access to medical knowledge, Hyunjun is now able to return to his chosen path of saving lives. But even with the AI at his disposal, one wrong cut could spell doom for this doc in his mission to become the perfect surgeon!

(Source: Tapas)

"A slave who knows things only a noble would…Who is this girl, really?"

Lilliette, once the Empress of the vast Pardinas Empire, was killed by her lover and found herself reincarnated in the body of a nameless slave girl, roughly 17 years in the past. Choosing death over a life of pain, Lilliette provokes a noble and collapses. When she opens her eyes again, standing before her is none other than Slarhan Bentiac, her greatest political rival in her previous life. Now bound as a slave to the same capable man he was then, Lilliette begins a strange new life.

But… why is this man unexpectedly kind and considerate to me?

Determined, Lilliette resolves to use the knowledge from her past to help Slarhan become king for the sake of the empire and to take revenge on the lover who betrayed and killed her: Clid.

(Source: Naver, translated)

For her lover of 10 years, belle of the ball Julia Rapiere played the part of a sheltered flower in a greenhouse. That is, until he betrayed her by having an affair with her trusted maid. Bent on revenge, Julia reveals her true colors, and the demure flower transforms into a fearsome monster.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: When the Mad Emperor Holds Me

description:
Princess Celeste has endured a life of torment under her half-brother Raf's oppressive rule. Just as she loses all hope, an unexpected opportunity for marriage appears. Batizo, the fierce emperor of the Kelenev Empire, and his enigmatic aide, Terkan, enter her life, offering a chance to escape. As Celeste finds herself caught between Batizo's wild intensity and Terkan's dark allure, a complex web of romance, jealousy, and power begins to unfold. Will Celeste navigate her way to freedom and love, or will she be ensnared by the dangerous passions that surround her?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Dex has a dangerous gift: with a single touch, he can read the memories of others. For the past thirty years, he’s been bound by a lifetime contract with the Hero Association, forced into service to cover up a mysterious incident. Now, the Association makes him an offer - if he can uncover the criminal past of the notorious villain Jin, suspected of recent terrorist attacks, they’ll finally set him free. Determined to return to the people he loves, Dex accepts. But to dig into Jin’s memories, there’s only one way forward: intimate contact that blurs the line between mission and desire. Will Dex succeed in his task? Or is he going after something impossible…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Everyone knows Kang Su-hyun. The Class president, social butterfly, the kind of guy who shines in every corner of campus life. But even the brightest star has shadows.His secret? He runs a private “alt account,” an anonymous SNS page where he draws and posts scandalous 19+ art. It’s his hidden world, one that absolutely no one can ever discover.At least, that was the plan.One day, his double life is accidentally exposed to the very last person he’d want: Lim Ji-ah, the school outcast who barely talks to anyone.“Wait… sunbae, you’re that famous lewd artist? Hehe… guess I’ve got some leverage now, huh?”From that moment on, Su-hyun’s carefully maintained image as Mr. Perfect begins to crumble.Stuck between bribes, blackmail, and the most awkward partnership imaginable, can a campus golden boy survive having his NSFW alter ego in the hands of an unlikely accomplice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Love, money, fame… They all come to Paradise Island chasing different things, but what they find is a nightmare. Oreum joins 15 other participants on a reality dating show, hoping to win prize money that could save her sister’s life. But when a mysterious virus spreads, turning people into flesh-hungry monsters, trust crumbles, terror rises, and Oreum’s only goal becomes making it out alive.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

I opened my eyes underwater, then found myself in a dazzling palace straight out of a historical fantasy. There is no doubt about it, I have been isekai’d right into the world of a novel. And lucky for me, it is even the genre I loved the most, so I know all the rules. Or so I thought. Because in this world, instead of gaining power through intimate encounters, anyone who loses their virginity becomes cursed. Yes, cursed. In a supposed mature fantasy. How does that even make sense? While I am still trying to wrap my head around this ridiculous twist, I receive my main mission: help the story’s second male lead achieve his destined romance. Avoid curses, dodge questionable situations, fix the love plot, survive the chaos, all with my purity intact.

Can I possibly complete this mission without destroying the entire story, or myself, first?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The light that fell from the heavens shared a gift with its creations, seeking connection. But humans and their dark hearts would corrupt the very essence of the gift, turning their desires and themselves into twisted, misshapen monstrosities. Yet, there was hope. Heroes would arise--heroes, who would not only stare into the abyss but fight the horrors in it. The gift was golden, but darkness festered within. Now, murky whispers tug on the edge of our consciousness, daring us to make the pact... But with who?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

During a terrorist attack, CEO Jung-Hoon is saved by a soldier named Ha-Yoon Jang. Determined to find her, he hires ex-special forces Ji-Woo as his secretary. As they clash and grow closer, a hidden truth and a corporate plot threaten everything. Can Ji-Woo protect Jung-Hoon while keeping her secret?

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Zai E Jiang Lin: Wo Jinhua Wei Xinghong Zhi Wang
title.english: Doomspawn: I Evolve to Ultimate Therianthrope
title.native: 灾厄降临：我进化为猩红之王

description:
In the wake of the apocalyptic Red Mist, Caleb Hunt's world is reduced to two truths: his family is dead, and his sister is missing. His quest for vengeance and answers leads him to the front lines of humanity’s final stand. But Caleb is a living weapon, harboring a power born of the same source as the invading horrors. To fight them, he must become like them—devouring beasts to steal their abilities, evolving into a stronger, more monstrous version of himself with every battle. This is his sacrifice. Every step toward salvation is a step into the abyss. In a world where evolution is the only law, Caleb must choose: cling to his fading humanity, or embrace the beast within to become the strongest survivor of the end times.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Moshi Gaowen: Wokao Anquan Wu Cheng Shen
title.native: 末世高温：我靠安全屋成神

description:
When disaster strikes, watch me rise again with trillions in resources! Take revenge on that trashy woman, have the goddess throw herself at me, and become the king of this chaotic world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Ganqiao is a wandering vagabond. When Zhengli is attacked by mysterious monsters, he tries to help her, and Zengli gives him her father's mysterious henshin belt. When Ganqiao put it on, he is transformed into Kaman Rider 555 and defeats the monsters. That is the start of their adventure together.

(Source: YesAsia, translated)

title.romaji: Quanmin Qiang Ta: Wo Tiqian Tongguan 999 Ceng
title.native: 全民抢塔：我提前通关999层

description:
Su Bai uses the “Clock of All Things” to enhance his skills and forge equipment, breaking records in the global tower-climbing competition. As he grows stronger through battle, he experiences class advancements, first-kill rivalries, and inter-racial wars. By clearing dungeons on each floor of the tower, he builds a powerful system and gradually unlocks abilities such as Time Manipulation and Necromancy to confront the higher races! Su Bai is the embodiment of both the Hero and the Demon King!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

Ever since starting university, Cen Lin hasn't had a single night's sleep without being awoken by terrifying nightmares. One night, after receiving a strange charm from his landlord, he's rescued in his dream by a mysterious beast. Desperate to reclaim his sleepless nights, Cen begins researching the creatures and protectors that plague and protect him while he rests.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 special chapters.

After being accidentally electrocuted, Li Xiuxian transmigrated into the world of the game Martial Heroes to become the big boss of the Demon Cult's Xinchen Palace. His job is to fight off adventurers and occasionally sexually harass his subordinates. But even though he has great spiritual strength, he has no martial arts skill at all. Even worse, he knows from the plot of the game that the Demon Cult will get wiped out in two weeks. Now he is most worried about how to hang on and change his destiny!

(Source: Kuaikan, Translated)

Fashion stylist, Ji Xun, traverses across ancient times. He should have married a beauty from a decent family and realized the pinnacle of his life, unexpectedly, he is narrowly stared by a man! Is it actually this life's debt or prior life's untied fetters?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: He Fanpai BOSS Tongju De Rizi

description: All I did was defeat the highest level BOSS in the game and make fun of him while doing my usual streaming, and now he crossed over to my world and isn't going back??? Please give me advice on how to bring him back. URGENT, I'll be online waiting!!

A main vocalist with the temper of a lion x a cheerful and straightforward bassist. Who knew that the band couple I fangirl about is actually real! In order to understand and save the band that is on the verge of getting disbanded, he found a child prodigy star, who had to secretly leave the entertainment industry because of a car accident. But, this gangster-like youth, who became a "backside singer" at a bar, how should I tame him? Should I chase after my dream or choose my husband? I want them both!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Ling Yufei overcame many obstacles on his journey to become a pilot. However, a sudden company order dashed his dreams by assigning him a new captain, who's younger than him and parachuted in above him?! Under these circumstances, Ling Yufei can only rely on his wits on this flight of romance...

Skyhawk Airlines is about to take off, please enjoy the amusing shenanigans of the captain, co-pilot, and their flight crew!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Across thousands of years, a terracotta warrior comes back to life! With a girl who looks exactly like his sister-in-law, they fight cirmes and become heroes to bring back justice!

(Source: WeComics)

title.romaji: Yue Yu Er Fen Zhi Yi Lianren

description: Ji Xianfeng and Zhao Yushuang both have a quirk that transforms them into the opposite sex when exposed to moonlight. One fateful night, they stumbled upon each other’s secret, which led to their lives becoming intertwined and a series of comedic events. A youthful schoolyard romantic comedy thus unfolds!

When she found herself pinned by a man on the bed, she was only wearing a bath towel. He took her as a paparazzo while she's just a strong and positive girl who wants to raise money for her sick father. She discovered the secret that the powerful and rich CEO of the Song Corporation actually hates women so she didn't believe that he'd do some "between men and women" stuff to her, but he proved to her that she was wrong, completely wrong...

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.romaji: Wo Chengwei le BL Manhuajia de Zhuli
title.native: 我成为了BL漫画家的助理

description:
Lychee is an aspiring comic artist, and he dreams to be an assistant to a comic writer. When he steps into the Rainbow Comic Studio, he realizes his artistic career is deemed to be not so…normal?

(Source: MangaToon)

She was threatened to accept the unreasonable deal. Though she thought the deal was over, she met him again after five years. It seems he hated her but he only had special feeling towards her both physically and mentally. The secret she kept was found. She thought she would never surrender just because he was handsome and strong.

(Source: Webnovel)

On the extravagant wedding ceremony of the icy CEO, a stand-in bride appeared out of the blue. On the wedding night, he vent all his anger on her! After insulting her, he dumped her with a divorce proposal but was informed that she was pregnant! His coldness led to her depart... Five years later, they met again and he was surprised to find her assertive and strong…

(Source: Webnovel)

Our family business is in debt, my aunt is dying of a heart attack, but my uncle asks me to be his mistress. Only if I am his mistress will he be willing to help us…The cold and merciless young master of the Han Family meets a reckless and unruly little girl. In the end, i fall in love with him, but I also discovers that the death of my parents is actually related to the his Family…

(Source: MangaToon)

The designer Joe was discovered accidentally by his boss that he normally regards her as his sexual fantasies…Out of fury, she reduce Joe's salary, causing a series of economic problems and Joe has to take the strategy of sharing house with others to cut down the cost. But the first tenant is his beautiful boss…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

One night in a luxurious villa, Fang Yi was humiliated by a man called Lin Han, who had countless ties with her. Their lives have been destined to entangle each other since the first time they met as children… After all these years, did Fang Yi manage to turn her life into a new place? What kind of romance and tension will be happening between them? What is the secret behind their hatred to each other?

(Source: Manga Toon)

title.romaji: Yiye Haomen: Zongcai Wo Yi Hun
title.english: Overnight Riches: I married the Director

description:
For his inheritance, he married her; for her family, she married him, how does one maintain a loveless marriage? The nightmare began on the first night of our marriage, he actually dared to bring another woman home! Does he think I’ll just accept this? Ling Qiao, you player, go and die!

(Source: Web Novel)

How could Xia Mei make a choice between two men: a gentle man with sincere guarding and a bossy man with stubbornness? As time goes by, Xia Mei finally knows what she wants?

(Source: Manga Toon)

title.romaji: Zongcai Yi Wen Hao Xiu Xiu

description:
"One million for one night. Who will?" "Ten million for one night!" Feng Lingye, a powerful man in the capital, had his eye on her. She could do nothing but retreating one step after another in face of his aggressiveness... However, a sudden car crash led out a huge conspiracy... She brought her two cute and talented kids back six years later in an attempt to find out everything, but she met him again.

(Source: Mangatoon)

If you can be tied up and stay with me, I am willing to imprison you for the rest of my life. Can this unfulfilled love come true? Forbidden brotherly love x dangerous gang warfare is about to kick off.

(Source: WebComics)

A story that takes place in a great continent grounded on the skeletal bones of a phoenix that is inhabited by many nations and people. Suddenly in the region to the West, seven volcanoes that have been inactive for centuries begin to erupt and its fire burns a blanket of red that is large enough to covers the sky, blazing across heaven and earth.

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.romaji: Shi Yi Jiao Qi Chongai Ji

description:
A conspiratorial relationship, an arranged plane crash. She forgot her past, but met the love of her life. The man said: You are my kitten from now on! Maybe this is destiny!

(Source: WeComics)

Dumped by her boyfriend, Helen got drunk in a bar and slept with a strange but handsome guy, who turned out to be her new financial teacher! In order to take revenge for being treated as a money boy, he even threatened to fail her at the final! How to deal with the tough task given by the new teacher...
(Source: Mangatoon)

The World of Immortals, it is the world every mortals long for. For many, it is an eternal glory to cause a spatial distortion and enter the World of Immortals. But the vicissitude of time is simply merciless, the legends regarding immortality had long been forgotten.

However, a miracle shall rise once more! An immortal was about to split the space with martial arts and cut all ties with the mortal world. The protagonist, Xiao Chen, was caught up in it and accidentally brought to the World of Immortals. What will they find in the vast world beyond the rift?

Kissed by a rogue on one night, and then I was kidnapped by a handsome guy to a strange place... what a bad luck! What is more unfortunate, I was arranged to study in a noble while violent school by that guy, who is the biggest leader of the underworld...

(Source: Mangatoon)

The veteran actor Liang Xuanxuan falls in love at first sight with newcomer Li Yu, and takes the initiative to attack. When the mysterious young man called Luo Fei learned of Liang Xuanxuan's actions, his heart was broken. And the girl next to Li Yu, Zhao Feifei, even warns him: "Be careful of that Liang guy! He's dirty!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

She is the reincarnation of the Sea Dragon's daughter, born with extraordinary wisdom and talent. Yet because she was born in troubled times, suffered tragedy and became an orphan. After ten years of grinding, she finally cultivated an exceptional set of martial arts. With XiaoHun sword in hand, she begins a journey to seek revenge, even disguising as a man to enter court. At first, revenge was her everything. Until she met those two equally exceptional men...

Ge Ming Ming is a foreign student who is also a gambling expert. Due to a certain incident, he is forced to return to a mainland high school to complete his education. But he has not gone to school before, and did not know what is work or even any knowledge of the subjects taught! To obtain a good result, he tried to use his tactics and cheated. In each examination, he, along with the teachers, monitoring equipments and a group of other students who want to cheat undergo a battle of the wits.
This is a Side story from the City of Darkness manhua following the lives of the red hair Xiao Ji and his boss Shi Er Shao.

XIANG Wei-er, who has exceptional grades and a sense of justice, upon transferring to a new school and class, got named by the teacher as a little teacher dedicated to guiding the "special students" in the class... Gosh! Before she can even adjust to the unfamiliar new environment, she has to first deal with a bunch of difficult people... a serious girl meets a strange handsome guy, and together act out a surreal campus love comedy!

Yi Zhe found the world to be meaningless and uninteresting until he met the only source of warmth in his life, Xu Tangcheng. He lived in his own world, as well as the world where only Tangcheng and him existed. He gave up on himself and sunk deeper into ecstasy. "All love stems from wakefulness, but that does not mean you won't lose yourself. Even if the road ahead is chaotic, having him by my side makes it worth it."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wugong Zidong Xiulian: Wo Zai Mo Jiao Xiu Cheng Fo Huang
title.native: 武功自动修炼：我在魔教修成佛皇

description:
Lu Li transmigrated into the body of a new disciple of the Demonic Sect. He was even blessed with a Martial Arts Training System. But the System keeps telling him things like:
"You haven't drank human blood, so your Bloodsucking Magic skill has dropped a level."
"You've only killed fowl and fish, so your Bone-Breaking Palm technique is not progressing."
"You're too nice, so your Sevenfold-Killing Fist skill has dropped a level."

Seeing all these messages from the System, Lu Li decided he'd be better off practicing techniques from the righteous Buddhist Sect instead, even though he's still a member of the Demonic Sect…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Everyone has their own little secrets. My secret is about a special someone, who isn't like anyone else.

(Source: Toomics)

Only those who are afraid of losing will be afraid and anxious. I won’t be because I want to win.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shenwei Renlei De Wo Que Chengwei Guaiyi Zhi Zhu
title.native: 身为人类的我却成为怪异之主

description:
The protagonist Chang Zaikun has been able to see terrifying "weird" creatures ever since he was a child, but he was never afraid, rather deeply attracted by the creatures and fell in love with them from the bottom of his heart. One day in high school, he accidentally met a weird administrator and received an invitation: to manage a "prison" inhabited by the creatures, and to find those who were lost in the world!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Elite commando Jiang Shan was brutally betrayed and killed by his own teammates during a raid on a criminal syndicate. Upon waking, he finds himself transported back to his high school days in 2003. Vowing revenge and determined to rectify the regrets of his past life, he confronts a horrific sexual assault and murder case unfolding in the girls' dormitory. This time, Jiang Shan resolves to seize the opportunity, strike back at the perpetrator with full force, and rewrite history!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Xu Yuan is transmigrated into the world of the game Cang Yuan, only to find himself the third son of the villainous final boss?! And to make things worse, he’s being hunted by Ran Qingmo, the lady disciple of the Sword Sect’s leader! Being pursued with deadly intentions by his favorite character, Xu Yuan must find a way to rewrite the villain’s doomed fate!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Dang Wo Chuan Cheng Bazong Jiaoqi de Dushengnü
title.native: 当我穿成霸总娇妻的独生女

description:
She’s not the innocent, naive heroine; she’s not the stunning but brainless second female lead; she’s not even the heroine’s devoted best friend, the third female lead… She’s the only daughter of the domineering CEO and his pampered wife—and she’s the one “ball” in the “running away with the ball” scenario. What? You think that sounds good?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: He Bao Dao Fa, Wo Yi Dao Yige

description:
Special Forces soldier Jin Quan is betrayed during a mission and becomes a living target for guided missiles. When he regains consciousness, he finds himself as a destitute man collapsed on the streets of the Lower City—a slum where the world’s lowest class of humans gather, living as cannon fodder in the mines. At this critical moment of life and death, Jin Quan awakens to the class of Demon Swordsman, and the radiation from the dirty bomb explosion in his past life becomes his innate talent. In this world, Jin Quan will engage in a fierce battle against the Chosen Ones.

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Sihou, Huashen Wu Dao Tianmo

description:
Humanity has been defeated. Merchants who betray their own kind, hunters who side with the monsters—they trample over the corpses of countless humans to reap staggering profits. Monsters from another dimension are consuming our world like a raging inferno. Until Zuo Chi arrived. You were so happy to invade Earth—why are you crying now?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Xiu Xian Ma? Yaoming Di Nazhong!
title.english: Cultivating Even Though It May Cost Your Life?!

description:
After accidentally bumping into each other, two people of completely different worlds – the cold and proud but powerful ancient cultivator, Xie Jun, and his total opposite, genius doctor Jin Yutang – were trapped in an endless loop of a curse together. In truth however, they had already met each other many times before in just as many various timelines where the ancient cultivator always ended up dead. Once he found about this fact, Jin Yutang made a promise to himself for Xie Jun’s sake and claimed, “Regardless of however many times we travelled through time, I’ll never let you leave my side.”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Twin detectives Xiaotu and Xiaohu set up a business that specializes in dealing with supernatural occurrences. However, when they investigate what seems to be an ordinary “Supernatural” case, a series of bizarre events unfold. To that end, Xiaotu and Xiaohu conquer hardships with every step they take, to clear the hazy path towards the truth.

Mu Qingyi died in order to save the people of the world. Ten years later, he discovered that his obedient disciple had become the world’s greatest demon after reborn! “Yinli, please respect me , I am your master! “It is precisely because you are my master that I want to "practice" with you”

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Guzhu Ta Yao Baozhe Cai Neng Shuijiao
title.native: 雇主她要抱着才能睡觉

description:
The college girl Xia Yu was offered a strange part-time job. To literally sleep with her employer?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The undefeatable general of the Ye army died tragically of a vicious treachery on the battlefield. Though she was given a second life, she unexpectedly relived as a eunuch, whose life was threatened by a disabled prince on site! Who can tell me why this prince can't help but wish to hug and kiss me all the time? Destiny bound the despised servant and the slighted prince. Together, they shall rewrite their fate.

(Source: WebComics)

Rebecca, a timid little hamster demon, gets promoted to a personal maid for the tyrannical Demon King, Albrandt. On her very first day, she accidentally stumbles into forbidden territory and nearly dies, only to be saved by the Dragon King, who the Demon King himself imprisoned. To survive, she is forced to follow the Dragon King's orders: enter Albrandt's dreams to uncover his deepest secrets. Now, she finds herself caught between two powerful beings, each trying to keep her by their side. Between the dominating Demon King and the formidable Dragon King, who will claim her heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The young lawyer Chi Yumo mistakenly thought that the corporate boss Lei Tingli's wife was cheating on him. To earn money for her sister’s medical expenses, she aggressively pursued his potential divorce case. It was only after Chi Yumo signed the contract that she realized that she didn't sign up to represent a divorce case, but an agreement to be with him instead! Despite her reluctance, she couldn't help but be overwhelmed by his doting affections. When she found out about their past, she realized that they were meant to be together all along.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: The Glorious Rebirth: Good Morning, Mrs. Fu

description:
In a one-to-one comparison, they are both equally pure and innocent inside out. While she can be fierce and sweet, he is the son of a rich family, indifferent, noble, and unattainable. Despite it all, he develops a soft spot for his beautiful wife, and falls deep in love with her.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: The Ace Undercover of Southern Song

description:
The story is set in the sixteenth year of the Jiading era during the Southern Song dynasty. Shen Mo, a modern undercover detective travelling to the past, begins his ambition to manipulate and bend the empire to his will. Armed with countless schemings and trickery, he uses his modern detective skills to crack many strange cases in Southern Song, as well as his mastery in espionage to torment the secret agents from the kingdoms of Liao and Jin. And when the threatening conquests of the invincible Mongolian cavalry begin to draw near, he trains an army made of steel to smash their sweeping invasion! To single-handedly dominate the world and fight against the odds, this is the epic war of a man versus an era!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zhan Shuang Pa Mi Shen: Gouzao Jiyuan

description:
The outbreak of the Punishing virus destroyed almost all the achievements of human civilization as technological development touched forbidden areas. The survivors of the cruel environment still hold hope and are now determined to recover the Earth and rebuild human civilization.

The manga records the story of the characters in the game's worldview, who have influenced the course of history with their own powers. In addition, the past of the living weapon against the Punishing virus, the Constructs, are also included in the extra chapters.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Do you still remember your first love? Maybe you have forgotten how you felt when you fell in love for the first time, maybe you have hidden it deep in your heart, or maybe you are enjoying your first love. Whatever, when you are in your first love, you may feel sweet, shy and happy. What story is going to happen when you meet your first love again?

(Source: Webnovel)

A sly thousand-year-old top takes a little celestial master under his wing to fight demons together as a power couple. (Except the sly thousand-year-old geezer does all he can to slack off in the meantime. ) Hey, I’m doing this to help you improve your cultivation, not to slack off~

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Who says that you can't get rich fishing? Farm some fish, farm some shrimp, salvage a sunken ship along the way. And pretty soon you're dating movie stars and supermodels.

This is the story of the fisherman Xiao Peng, who became the richest man in the world, starting with a small fish pond.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Linghudujue was supposed to be the top martial artist in the wuxia world. Stories say he defeated the demonic sect leader, cut down the Swordsman Of The East, and single-handedly snuck into Heifengzhai to slaughter 300 bandits. His exploits are legendary in the wuxia underworld, and women swoon at his name. But Linghudujue is actually hiding a shocking secret — he has no martial arts skill at all.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I, The Supreme One has returned, after four years, the grudges from 4 years ago must be avenged, I will kill anyone who gets in the way of my revenge, no matter if it’s a demon, god, or heaven itself, they all will perish under my wrath.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

What happens if a modern, straight guy time travels to an ancient world where women are superior to men? His new, powerful mother had been expecting a daughter but ended up giving birth to him. So, guess what? He's been forced to be a drag queen ever since!

(Source: Webnovel)

The Qin clan's son-in-law Yang Fan was looked down by everyone. In the face of all the humiliation, he gained the Twin Cultivation System, which allowed him to gain revenge by cultivating his medical and martial skills simultaneously. Now he's a medical expert, a martial artist, and super handsome, too...! Even if he only married into the family, Yang Fan was determined to become the strongest son-in-law in history.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Ye Wen Xuan, a boy who always longs for love, suddenly has a new family where he meets Chen Yu and grows up with him like brothers, gradually, he finds that he wants more from Chen Yu instead of simple family affection and friendship, to maintain the current situation, he decides to hide his feelings, but facing Chen Yu who is eager for his answer, what choice should he make?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Jin Tian Ye Mei Bian Cheng Ren
title.english: I Didn't Become a Human Today

description:
Ji Ran, a useless deity who had just taken up his post, decided to battle monsters head-on to increase his achievements. However, he ended up getting turned into a dog... His spiritual energy was shattered, and his magical abilities were lost. Not only that, but he'd also change into a different animal from time to time. Today, he's a dog. Tomorrow, he might be a pheasant. The day after that, he'd become a silver carp. From then onward, he'd stray farther and farther away on the path of being a non-human creature.

In order to recover his human form and return to the world of deities, Ji Ran embarked on the arduous journey of re-refining his spiritual energy. However, he'd encounter all kinds of troubles along the way; Ah, I didn't become a human today either... The owner, Xing Ye says: "Perhaps you won't believe me when I say this, but I've raised an entire zoo." The cold, picky, food-loving bottom vs the tolerant, evil, godly chef top.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.english: Trials of Being a Shadow Guard

description:
These days, shadow guards not only have to be good at carrying out assassinations, but they also face the risk of being sent away if they elicit the ire of their master. What Shadow fears most isn't punishment, but being abandoned by his lord. Heart-broken and exhausted, even a stone can fracture under enormous pressure, let alone a human. When Shadow finally learned to let go, the man who once treated him with disdain refuses to give him up.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Many of the brightest minds in medicine assemble in the emergency ICU, which makes it the perfect place for two budding young doctors to hone their craft. And that is exactly what happens when sharp-tongued beauty Xiao Yan and handsome former neurosurgeon Bai Shu are both placed in leadership positions in the fast-paced medical unit. While their clashing styles when practicing medicine often put them at odds, as professionals, they understand that the patient must always come first. One case at a time, these doctors will push the limits of what medicine is capable of, and in doing so, they might just learn enough from each other to see past their differences. Perhaps fate has even brought them together for a reason.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Dong Nu was an ordinary beautiful girl in her junior year of high school. After an accident, she met a very powerful yellow-haired man. Although his behavior was a little eccentric, he attracted her attention. As she learned more about him, she began to discover that this man had a shocking identity, as he was not just an ordinary mortal... In fact, you might even call him a...

As a commoner, Bai Luo once made a childhood promise and became Prince Duan Chi Yan’s living antidote, sacrificing himself to neutralize the poison in Chi Yan's body. Yet Chi Yan misunderstood him and treated him with disdain.

Five years later, with the poison completely purged, Bai Luo, drained and broken, decides to leave. Though Chi Yan is unwilling to part, he stubbornly denies the love in his heart. In the end, Bai Luo is heartbroken, and the truth comes too late—Chi Yan is filled with regret!

When they meet again, Bai Luo has lost his memory and become cold and indifferent. Chi Yan bravely throws himself into a heart-wrenching, soul-crushing pursuit of love—a true “emotional crematorium” to win him back!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Chun Ai Zuozhe Yu Nan Te Zhu

description:
When the BL author, Lu Xiao Ying, meets the female dream editor, Lian Ye, of course she'll take advantage of it! In addition to his good looks, this ditzy upright young man is willing to slog it out serving her without complaints, and he also comes with special (?) abilities, which Lu Xiao Ying deeply appreciates. Just when she thought he will always stay by her side, a crisis suddenly strikes...... will he still be willing to stay by her side?

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

Xia Hong spent her school years dealing with bullying and found herself in a marriage that ended in misery as an adult. After her tragic death, she finds herself back in high school... with a chance for revenge! Her goals: break her ex-husband’s heart and get back at all the people who used and abused her. But Xia soon discovers that revenge isn’t easy as she learns more about her enemies’ complicated pasts and opens up to others. Will Xia get the happiness that she wants or will she discover truths that change everything she ever knew?

(Source: Tapas)

Wang Li is a cultivator of the Xuantian Sect. The senior girl who was supposed to help guide his cultivation went a little crazy in the head after she failed to pass her trial. So Wang Li's cultivation path seemed to have gone astray, too...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhan Tian Bai, former General Chi Yan of the fallen Yao Guo empire, is captured and put up for auction. Bought by none other than the cunning Emperor Duan Mu Li, of Wang Li, the very person he once tried to assassinate. He is forced to become a slave to the enemy, whom originally wished only to break Tian Bai’s stubborn pride, but is he falling for his beauty instead? What will become of his fate?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After a catastrophe, the biggest trouble facing humans is energy shortage! A brand new profession was thus born, controlling various elements such as iron, copper, phosphorus, gold, silicon, and carbon, they are the strongest combat power in the world. Restarting a powerful system, the youth began to be accompanied by compulsive tasks again and again! Challenging missions full of danger time and time again, he gradually became stronger, and went further and further on the road to a great demon...

(Source: WebComics)

Adapted from the otome game of the same name. Yue Feixi transmigrated into a mad world where human greed and desire are magnified. When humanity has lost its light, can we find a way in the dark? See how Feixi will navigate the Nanchao continent, in a courageous adventure filled with love and betrayal, promises and lies, despair and hope.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes prologue chapter.

A modern medical student transmigrated to a cultivation universe, into the body of Zhao Chen, a wastrel scumbag quack who kept his job as the palace doctor only with the help of his beautiful assistant. But the reincarnated Zhao Chen was given the Super Scumbag System, and he could gain rewards from the System by accomplishing missions like hitting on girls, flirting with the princess, challenging high officials, and other almost suicidal tasks. What he didn't realize was that the Emperor was secretly watching him all along…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Ordinary high school student Lin Ran saved his classmate Li Li, who was supposed to die, during an act of heroism. This caused the script world to fall into chaos. To save Li Li and rewrite his own life script, Lin Ran embarked on a journey with Gu Bai, a special commissioner from the script world, to fix the runaway scripts.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Forced by his grandfather to enroll at Greenhill University, an infamous place for being haunted, what was supposed to be a normal first year for Ceng Jian ended up being filled with supernatural incidents. Journey along with the protagonist as he crosses paths with a Taoist priestess, Zhou Chuchu...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Dashu Tai Leng Ao
title.english: So What, You Are My Maid?

description:
Eight years ago, a homeless Qiqi was rescued by Qi Sichen, and became a servant of the Qi family. Many years of companionship created undeniable bond between those two! Sichen's mother getting in the way, Sichen's many admirers, and the oldest son of the Ji family who can't stop his love for Qiqi.... Will the truth from eight years ago come to light? After all these years, is it true love or just a game?

(Source: Webcomics)

Qiu Ning, an apathetic snooker genius who grew up in a pool room, once faced off with Cheng Haiyan - a pool shark of the same age. Despite losing for the first time in his life, Qiu Ning's talents in snooker astonished Cheng Haiyan. Qiu Ning subsequently decided to train under the snooker club where Cheng Haiyan serves in order to beat him and hence enters the world of professional snooker...

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 3 extra chapters.

As the leader of a debt collecting company, An Yamo threatens people and acts cute. When she acts pitiful, nobody can resist her. Once she takes action, there is no debt she cannot collect. But one day, she meets a tough opponent. Since phone calls don't work, she brings her men to knock on his door, only to discover that he is a super handsome boy who is actually her schoolmate! Handsome boy: "If you don't want to be exposed, become my slave~" Thus, the school life of the tyrannical girl and the sadistic prince, which is full of battles and clashes, begins.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Snow Xia, a pretty girl who’s positive towards life and always emits her sunshine to people around her. But she never imagined in all her life that at her wedding today, she caught her husband cheating on her! Being in extreme despair, she wanted to kill herself but one moment before her drowning, she wished if someone could save her, and she closed her eyes… "Who are you? Why are you naked and l am also…ahhh!” and she saw him, the man with a pair of devilish eyes sneering at her.

(Source: MangaToon)

The cool forensic doctor woke up and found herself transmigrated into the body of a country farm girl. In addition to the family full of annoying relatives, she's even got a dumb husband! To return to her modern world, she has to raise a kid with this idiot! A cold-hearted lady who dislikes kids and a demon-prince who loves children... How will they make a family together?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Exorcist Fang Hui has searched for the Cirrus Cloud Scroll for 10 years, with no success. When he comes across an all-powerful sword, he's launched through a magical portal, where he encounters the slain Wan. He resurrects her with a special spell, and though she can’t recall her origins, the one thing she recognizes is… Fang? A hothead, a mysterious girl, and more join them as this eclectic group sets out on an adventure full of demons and magic in hopes of unlocking the mysteries of their pasts and the prized scroll!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and five extras.

The sweet pea flowers have bloomed, but when will that man return?

Cold, innocent fairy x two-faced wolfhound

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zhen De Bushi Qi Yun Zhi Zi
title.english: I Am Really Not The Son Of Providence

description:
Transmigrating into a world of immortal cultivation, Shen Tianfa realized that he has the power to see other people's fate and fortune. Trying to get along in this new world, he actively befriends the most fortunate people he sees. Pretty soon, people realizes that whoever Shen Tianfa hung out with, that person is sure to gain great fortune. Ever since then, Shen Tianfa has become the most popular person in the cultivation world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chu San de Liuyi Ertong Jie

description:
The two-faced elite x the bad-tempered mafia boss!

Elite student He Chu San was kidnapped by the head of the Warrior Clan, Xia Liu Yi?! When this kind-hearted and upright citizen, who isn't influenced by the bad environment he is in, meets the "Twin-Blade Blood Asura," who causes people to tremble in fear, it seems to be a situation of the lamb entering the tiger's den, yet the "lamb" keeps pursuing the "tiger" relentlessly?

Hold on, this "lamb" seem to increasingly resemble a fox, and has manipulated the big cat into his trap..

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Badao Xiao Cao Qiu Wo Huitou
Zhengjiu Xiao Kelian de Zhengque Fangshi
title.native: 拯救小可怜的正确方式

description: Note: Adapted from the web novel "Weisheme Zhe Zhong A Ye Neng You O" (为什么这种A也能有O).

In the school’s gym equipment room, the transfer student pinned the female lead against the wall in a patch of sunlight, playing with the tip of her fluffy ear as she smiled lightly.

“If you move another inch, the whole school will know that the top student’s ears turn redder than a cat in heat.”

“You can do whatever you want… as long as you keep my ‘secret.’”

Yet the crux of this “secret” seemed to hold a deeper meaning…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The Demon Lord is said to be a siren who can turn all fighters into her admirers. One day, the Demon Lord was reborn on earth to live in a new identity...

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: This World Is Way Too Dangerous

description:
After being sent to a different world called "Earth" by an elder with a grin, Gu Yun discovered that this new world was only peaceful and stable on the surface. In fact, this world was filled with many evil spirits and demons. For some reason, Gu Yun felt like going home when the countless twisted evil spirits appeared before him.

As a result, an urban legend that caused all the evil spirits to shudder in fear was born!

(Source: Webnovel)

I'll decide my own fate! A plucky young man changes his fate, against all odds! High school student Li Gaolou discovers the Book of Life and Death in his school bag one day. The Book can change his fate. Saving a damsel in distress, making a fortune, becoming powerful… Things he'd never dreamed before are now possible!

(Source: INKR)

Princess Bai Luo Luo was struck with misfortune, and as a result she was put to sleep for thousands of years.
Later on she meets up with a mysterious hunter, Heng Ting Lei, and together they embarked on an adventure to the country's capital... A sweet love story between a princess and hunter!

(Source: Manga Rock)

Betrayed and stripped of his powers, Chu Jianqiu was left broken. But fate had a different plan. He stumbles upon a legendary cultivation technique, the Divine Chaos Codex! Now, he's on a path to reclaim his glory and ascend to the top of the world!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Du Zhuansheng Le, Wo Cai Buyao Zai Gei Ni Bumo!
title.native: 都转生了，我才不要再给你补魔！

description:
In her past life, she wore shackles for her. In this life, she received a wedding ring from her.

"I'll be the one to take care of you this lifetime!"

A wolfkin princess reborn from the flames x a reincarnated saint bound by her destiny... A forbidden love story that renews across time and space!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jinghua Yuan Zhi Bai Hua Wangchao

description:
Sammy Dayn has been appointed as an inspector to find the traitors of the empress. But does it have something to do with her father?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Ren-nei Hanemiya is a self-proclaimed ladies' man. With his dazzling looks and flirting abilities, there should be no woman able to resist his charms... so why hasn't he been able to find a girlfriend yet!? At his wit's end, Ren-ei pops into a host club, where he believes he could work and up his chances of finding a pretty lady to court, especially after learning that all the hosts are gay. Following his sudden interview, Ren-ei is hired on the spot by the host club's young looking manager, Makoto Izumida, who also offers to share a room with him for the time being. Will Ren-ei successfully find a girlfriend at his new job? Or will he discover something about himself that he never knew was there?

(Source: MangaPlanet)

To pay off his debts, he dresses as a woman, only to accidentally cross paths with a gang’s top hitman—and, through a series of misunderstandings, ends up becoming his partner. Forced to live together, this unlikely pair finds themselves caught in a tug-of-war between lies and growing feelings…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Tian Zhi Chi: Hong Long De Guilai

description:
A boy with long and black hair and a pair of fierce eyes like dragon appeared in the mecha battle. He was fearless, alert and calm but above all, he was as mysterious as a dark abyss. Facing the so-called “Dragon Slaughter” mecha, this mysterious boy had beaten down his rival completely and won without showing much emotion. What was his story and would the owner of Dragon Slaughter revenge on him?

(Source: MangaToon)
Follow the Devil King as he embark on his journey to become a gentleman!

title.romaji: Zha Nan Zongcai Bie Xiang Tao

description:
Amilia Yu is the member of the secret organization, Wolf-hunter. Her job is to punish playboys and to make them pay for their ever mistakes. This time, her target is the well-known underworld's king and famous financial group's Mr. President, Ezekiel Jiang. Although he has extraordinary appearance, his heart is ice-cold. Now he is the top ranked playboy in the target list of the organization. In order to make him fall in love with herself, Amilia will drain her strength and wits. In this game, will the hunter be hunted?

(Source: WebComics)

The almost invincible teenager, Mu Lian, is actually a country boy who hails from the southern edges. The mysterious city girl, Linglong, has the passion to challenge everything. The two of them are confronted by an evil plot that enshrouds the haunted metropolis. Can they care for each other? Can they save each other? Something extraordinary is happening in the haunted metropolis...

(Source: WeComics)

Tang Ke Ran got drunk and slept with a strange man, she ran away next morning unknowing that she was impregnated.... After her family entered bankruptcy, she went abroad, years later she came back and met with that man again. What kind of story would happen among a hacker son, a smart daughter, a president dad and a mother who's good at muddling through?

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.english: Tip To Taming The Flirting Girl

description: He is her master, but she is only a wolf girl picked by him. He stands high above the masses, but she just No. 7 in Ten Thousand Shadows store. She is the most perfect work carved by him. However, she didn't expect to meet him again at the palace. She stood on tiptoe and whispered in his ear, "This time, who will you send me to lure?"

This series relates the camaraderie and heart-stopping exploits of the Celestians, extraordinary people who live during the tumultuous Warring States Era. Living in a world of their own - a place known as the 'Celestial Zone' - they cultivate special powers beyond the comprehension of mere mortals. Unfortunately, some of them branch into the cultivation of the evil power of corruption, bringing destruction and sorrow to the mortal world. The series centres around the war that starts between the Celestians.

Sanmao, a young orphan living in Shanghai between the 1930s and 40s, struggles to survive during a time plagued with war, poverty, inflation, and colonization. Presented in a series of short comics, sometimes with a touch of dark humor.

Lan Xieyi, an ordinary boy, wakes up one day to find he's travelled through dimensions and has become a demon's male pet! And he's even being used by the owner of this body to act as Bai Yueguang's substitute - this demon slave's body is actually quite sweet!

He must deal with the owner of the body, the Dragon Prince, Di Jiang; the cold heavenly immortal, Liu Yun; the wolf in sheep's clothing, You Chang; and the beautiful phoenix Bi Wu.

Their love makes Xieyi hesitate - if this is a dream, then when will he wake up? Where does this nostalgia in his heart come from? After transmigrating to a new world, the male pet strikes back and creates his own harem of beautiful men!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

This comic tells about the mighty general who jumped into the modern age was forced to live with the a cold but handsome man! Is the general scared?! Never!! Buy groceries, wash the dishes, running errands to make money and fight villains! But why do he always turn into a big puppy dog in front of his beautiful "guardian"? That man's beauty is just too provocative, who can withstand it... but this general is not that innocent either! Take down the beauty in minutes! I am the god of war admired by thousands of people, and you'll also be my conquest.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

The demon king, who had been sealed for three thousand years, once again invaded the mortal world, but unexpectedly he fell into the greatest crisis of his life! Guns vs magic, mobile phones vs elves... Ignorant demon king set out a new aggressive adventures in modern human society.

(Source: Webcomics)

In the 20th century, a secret military project which sends signals into space to establish contact with aliens makes a breakthrough in progress. An alien civilization on the brink of destruction captures the signal and plans to invade Earth. Meanwhile, on Earth, different camps start forming, planning to either welcome the superior beings and help them take over a world seen as corrupt, or to fight against the invasion.

(Source: Webnovel)

Due to the destruction of his home, mountain god Chen Shan entered the entertainment circle and accidentally became the film emperor. Meanwhile, the slow and adorable snail monster Lin Wo went down the mountain to seek shelter with Chen Shan. Although he was the film emperor's assistant in name, in reality he was the one being taken care of every day. These two helped similar monsters everywhere in the entertainment circle. They rebuilt the homes of displaced monsters, bringing about a pure camaraderie in which they could share their laughter and tears.

(Source: Tapas)

The series features the now well-known characters such as Old Master Q and Big Potato, as well as Mr Chin, Mr Chiu and Miss Chan, in many different hilarious situations. They are usually portrayed in a variety of social statuses, professions and time periods, ranging from beggars and office workers to actors and ancient warriors, allowing a wide variety of settings and ideas. More outlandish scenarios include close encounters with aliens, ghost sightings and the afterlife.

(Source: Wikipedia)

A trainee nun, Sister Lu Lu has mistakenly entered the house of the legendary one-eyed devil. A cruel devil who eats human’s heart is not what I think he is! Why do I feel different when I touch you? A blocking mind of a nun with a lonely one-eyed devil, is there any forbidden of love and sin between them?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

title.romaji: Wo Jia Zhu Jin Le Da Mowang

description:
A tangled love story between human and demon! A high school girl suddenly found a cold-faced little boy living in her home. It turns out he's a demon lord, here to win her heart and soul before consuming it as sacrifice?! Can't there be real love between human and demon?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo He Wo De Si Ge Ban Wu

description:
His alternate account on Weibo got hacked. Overnight, the public persona of Yan Shuo, the 'gentle and good leader' of the poplular boy group M.E.N crumbled. A certain sinister forum post: "Congratulations to Brother Yan Shuo for becoming M.E.N's new center! How honored to even get 4 crappy backup dancers!"

(Source:Bilibili Comics)

Wen’s boyfriend, Hua, seemed perfect. He’s super hot, a little oblivious, and—as Wen will soon find out—was an adult film star in gay porn?! He says he did it for the money but, when more secrets and more lovers appear from the past, Wen can’t decide who Hua really is. Does he love her? Or is this just one of his many faces…

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Gao Ta Zhong De Ye Shou

description:
Leigh travels to the royal capital in search of his father’s whereabouts and is introduced by the headmaster to a job as a royal tutor. What he doesn't expect was that Prince Potter is a barbaric half-beast imprisoned in a tower who can't even speak human languages. Unable to leave the tower, Leigh is locked up inside and tasked with teaching the Prince courses according to the instructions and objects that come through the door...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

After a millennium of cultivation, I am the most beautiful and bewitching red-fox spirit. It'll be easy for me to charm that young weakling of a king? No man should be able to resist me? Wait, something's not right here. Your majesty, please stop, don't tempt me!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shou Shou Bu Qin Zhi Yin Lang Ru Shi

description:
Igor Ezelle is an impulsive vampire with OCD who signs a master-slave pact with a werewolf on a whim. He enjoys bossing his new pet around, only to realize he isn't really the one calling the shots.

(Source: WebComics)

During the holidays, Mo Bai and his older brother Mo Fan were attacked by a zombeast that broke into their house. After the attack, Mo Bai found himself turning into a zombeast, while Mo Fan was rescued by the zombie-hunters. To find his brother, Mo Fan became the strongest hunter in the organization. People were frightened when Mo Bai reappeared as an S-rank zombeast. Now the brothers will finally meet again, but the situation is completely different, and they are on the edge of an explosive conflict.

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

For centuries he has lived in secret and under different names just to find a cure for what has turned him into a vampire — the plague. Until one day, she finds out about him being a vampire. What is she going to do? Will she still love him despite everything?

(Source: WebComics)

Gu Rouxi was set up by her coworkers and walked into the CEO's office insistent on applying medicine down there to help fix his problem. That got him very angry. He was just about to push her down and demonstrate that everything worked just fine, when they were caught in the act by the CEO's five-year old son.

Xiaobaozi jumped into her arms and asked, "Daddy, is this pretty lady just for me?"

He picked up the boy and put him aside, "No, this is my woman. Meet your new mommy."

Gu Rouxi: ....

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

title.romaji: Rezhong Chu Yong Mei Shaonü De Degula Zijue
title.native: 热衷初拥美少女的德古拉子爵

description:
Bucky Dracula — the young heir to the vampire clan — wished to have the world's prettiest girl as his First Embrace! He thought he could finally fulfil his dream when he was exiled to the east. Nevertheless, never did he expect to encounter so many of them: wight, werewolf, exorcist, fox demon... "Arghh! An innocent vampire like me can only have a girl of destiny!"

(Source: Coolmic)

He's not your usual tyrannical CEO, he's arrogant, unpredictable, and... blind!? If he weren't blind, he wouldn't be interested in a disobedient, trouble-making wild child like her! A contract may tie her to him physically, but it won't capture her heart...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Physics prodigy Ning Yiwei has known handsome businessman Liang Chong since they were children. As they grew up, Liang Chong slowly fell in love with Ning Yiwei. For all Ning Yiwei's high IQ, he barely understands human emotions, and so he's completely dependent on Liang Chong — although he's never thought about why. Liang Chong keeps his feelings in check, hiding them from Ning Yiwei so he can live a happy life. But as the disagreements between Ning Yiwei and the son of his academic supervisor grow, his past comes back to him, and he starts to realize that there's more to his feelings for Liang Chong than he'd ever thought.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Tang Qian dropped out of college to work in order to find a cure for his father’s illness. One day when he was standing up for the owner of an antique shop, he bumped into a cinnabar furnace. From that day onward, he had gained a special ability whereby an elder sage’s voice could be heard speaking to him in his mind, telling him a patient’s diagnosis and course of treatment upon seeing the patient. He verified that the sage’s prescriptions were truly effective and could even save patients on the verge of death. His actions of saving people were caught on by the hospital and people were sent to investigate him. Nevertheless, Tang Qian wanted to treat his father’s illness with his newfound ability. However, the ingredients for his father’s prescription could not be found in this world. Alas, he could only continue working for his father’s medical bills. He bought that very cinnabar furnace that he bumped into because it could have something to do with his special powers. He also believed that he had not fully manifested his powers yet. One night, he gained another clairvoyant ability...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A few months into their marriage, her husband has quietly supported her but haven't shown his face. Meanwhile, Huo Tingshen suddenly barged into her life and showered her with affection. One is her supportive but invisible "husband", the other is Huo Tingshen, the person by her side everyday offering her love. How will she choose...?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Catch Chen Xiaogou and his father Chen Laogou as they journey on a destined career conquering evildoers and robbing tombs. Let us all embark on ghostly adventures with them!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The unassuming Meng Yixi had always quietly crushed on her school's god Xu Rui, but her feelings were never able to make any progress. Once, she happened to buy a bracelet that contained another girl, Gu Yanran's spirit! Since then, Meng Yixi's school life underwent enormous changes......

An accident caused Jiang Xue to forget all about Xia Zhi, the boy who changed her life so much. As they pursued their basketball dreams together, the secrets of the past will slowly be revealed...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The Thunder Kingdom in the Elemental Continent has long become legendary. The heir of the Thunder Kingdom will only appear when every elemental kingdom is in turmoil and distress. Due to the instability of the interface, whenever a huge earthquake erupts, all kinds of animals that evolve into monsters will appear in the Elemental Continent, putting humans in danger. Rumor has it that the world is about to end, and everyone is looking for a solution. Can the heir of the Thunder Kingdom, Lei Zhen, lead everyone to save the world?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Baobei Ni Hao Tian: Shixie De Wenrou
title.native: 宝贝你好甜：嗜血的温柔

description:
What the hell is falling down in campus? A stranger handsome guy! He even forced me to raise him?! He also said that my blood and saliva can heal wounds, especially by kissing!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Jian Dao Jian Sheng Zhong Me Ban

description:
Ling Feibai, the current blademaster, was as noble as an immortal. Kong Xiaomeng, an evil cult's religious fraudster, was as destitute as a dog. The two of them would have never crossed paths until one day, Kong Xiaomeng unexpectedly took in a handsome, elegant man. Not only was the man docile and obedient towards him, but his fighting skills were out of this world. The only thing was... he was a huge idiot that just stayed at home lazing around, even...

Kong Xiaomeng: Hey, hey, what are you doing?!
Ling Feibai: Master, you don't spoil me! Me, who's so weak, pitiful, and helpless!
Kong Xiaomeng: What do I do if I picked up a blademaster?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Anye Tian Chong: Wu Re Diyi Emo
title.english: Demon Alpha: My Dark Sweet Heart
title.native: 暗夜甜宠：误惹第一恶魔

description:
An accident happened seven years ago brought me to a vampire... Who dragged me down into the abyss and forced me to leave the man I loved... After seven years, I finally returned home, only to meet a corporate boss whose attention only brought me trouble... even causing me to be kidnapped by youkai. While my life was in danger, another man with silver hair came through to save me... What will I do when faced with these three men!?

(Source: Youlu Wenhua, translated)

title.english: Naive Girl and Her Wolfish Husband

description:
Guan Qingyan is just a naive girl, so naive that she even signs a marriage document and gets sent into a large mansion. Her husband, President Mingjue, seems to be a very wolfish man in their first encounter, but turns out to be a loving husband. Still, Ming Jue's childhood sweetheart, Miss Feng, and his nagging mother keep creating trouble to Qingyan, but the childlike girl doesn't care about anything...

(Source: Mangatoon)

I attend a special school where all my classmates are talented, and the instructor is also special...

Huh? You're saying this school isn't as simple as it seems? We are going to participate in special operations in the future, and there are people behind the scenes who are watching us?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Yishijie Zhi Lü Bukeneng Kao Shaizi Jueding
title.english: The Dices Can't Decide My Destiny!
title.native: 我的异世界之旅不可能靠骰子决定

description:
Ou Huang, who has always been known for his good fortune and cognition in time-traveling novels, traveled to the otherworld. Initially, he thought he could show off his skills and become invincible in the otherworld. However, the system was too absurd to his expectation — his every action has to be decided by the dice. The time to test his luck has come!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Cool chill tsundere streamer x naive multiracial rich beauty

Li Naiyou ran away from home. He streams his company's most popular game every day but has zero viewers until he meets a cool streamer. The cool streamer invites Naiyou to stream with him, but Naiyou doesn't know why. Li Naiyou isn't doing anything, but the cool streamer seems to think he's poor.

One day, the presidential suite Li Naiyou lives in gets flooded, and he's depressed about having to switch houses. He posts "I'm so sad... my house got flooded. My new house feels so small and foreign ;-;" Five seconds later, the cool streamer response. "If you're in a difficult situation, I actually... have a spare room."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Talented Bassist X Indie Singer-songwriter
Idol X Assistant

Independent singer-songwriter Chi Nan had to give up on his music dream after finding out about his irreparable hearing defect. At the depths of despairs, the bassist of his favorite band LOTUS bought the rights to all his songs and made him his personal assistant.

“Even if I become completely deaf, I can’t break free from myself. Even if half of me grow old, the other half will always remain within the dream of the one they called Rock & Roll, Teenage Dream, Salinger.”

The series shows the daily lives of a chart-topping rock band, told from the perspective of the bassist's personal assistant.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

A sword pointed heavenward will shake the nine continents. Rise to the heavens, defeat the heroes, become the emperor, to write the saga of domination!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

As the male protagonist of a shoujo manga, Bai Yuguang could be called a winner due to his wealth and good looks. Until one day, due to the low popularity of the manga, the author changed it from a shoujo to a BL! When Bai Yuguang woke up, he discovered that both the popular girl he secretly loved and the scheming girl who was his childhood sweetheart had both become cute boys! This is the tragic story of a shoujo male protagonist struggling to stay straight in a BL world, all because of a crappy author.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Lu Ning, the heir to the spirit-doctors, can heal the sick and cultivate spiritual powers. He received orders to descend into the mortal realm, only to find himself with a choice. The haughty CEO and the prettiest girl in school, he has to choose a fiancee between the two sisters. In the mad city, looking for his roots and protecting the ladies, he will overcome all the challenges to reach the top!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In one treacherous game, money-hungry players battle it out in a barren land with clear blue skies. You win money when you kill; you lose money when you get killed. When a girl accidentally gets involved, it's up to her brother to steer her through it at all. Will they ever earn enough to leave this godforsaken game?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Gu Ning tried to stop a murder she foresaw but the victim did not heed her advice. Hence, she rushed to lodge a police report. However, she ended up being suspected by the police because she reported the case before it happened. Captain Zhan Ming began to pay attention to the strange woman. Even though Zhan Ming did not believe in her so-called death predictions, Gu Ning repeatedly surprised him. By staring into the eyes of the dead, Gu Ning would know details that only the medical examiner should have known. She could even draw the scene of the crime with an ink brush on the spot. By sitting on a chair from the crime scene, she would be able to see the crime unfold from the other side...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Shan You Mu Xi Yue Jun Xin

description:
The only male of the Siyou clan has finally found another partner to call his own. They settle together in their own home, learning to manage the household and care for their child. A love story filled with intimacy that also focuses on the responsibility that comes with romance.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

The HCDV virus secretly developed by Germany in World War II was rediscovered 70 years later, but it only led to disaster.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Jian Zhi Caishen Dai Hui Jia

description:
One day, the orphan AnLe surprisingly woke up to find an extraordinarily beautiful young man in his bed.

"Wait a minute! What the hell am I responsible for? I am a gentleman with good principles!"

It turns out that the young man is the little God of Wealth whom he asked help from to avoid a misfortune. However, upon assisting him, the God of Wealth temporarily lost his powers! In order to restore his magic, the God of Wealth must help AnLe do good deeds and make worship offerings. The chaotic* life of living together has officially begun!

(Source: iQiYi, translated)

title.romaji: Tiancai Xiao Du Fei Zhi Yun Xi Chuanqi
title.native: 天才小毒妃之芸汐传奇

description:
She is the most menial ugly daughter of a medical family, while he is the noblest prince in Kingdom Tianning. On their wedding day, when the bridal sedan chair reaches the Prince's mansion, the door is shut, she has no choice but to enter the mansion alone. Unexpectedly, the ugly girl is actually a gorgeous genius medic! Accidentally, she saves an assassin on her wedding night and promises him: Bro, hurry and leave, I won't get you exposed. However, the assassin says: it's our wedding night, where do you want me to go?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wanmei Lianren Zhi Moshi Shaojiang Qiu Fangguo
title.native: 完美恋人之末世少将求放过

description:
I lost my brother in a different galaxy, and I need help finding him... There's only one that can help me, but he's a total jerk!

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Wo De Shi You Hao Qiguai

description:
Two roommates who are total opposites turn out to be married to each other inside a video game! Now they are stuck with each other inside the game. How will they get out of this relationship and get back to the real world?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Starting from that day, he walked into my life... It's the roaring twenties and thirties, and Shanghai is undergoing a rapid wave of westernization. The young master of a mafia family, Du Yinghong, encounters the street hooligan Shen Xiuhai. This fateful encounter changes the lives of both these young men. In these turbulent times, amidst complicated relationships, the two of them forge a true bond of selfless sacrifice. This is the story of a sincere friendship born during the tempestuous Republic Era.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a two-part prologue and two extras.

By a fluke, trainee teacher, Shen Yitong, became the temporary assistant of her senior whom she is in fond of. While being close to her is the only thing she had hoped for, she accidentally offended the mogul of the entertainment industry! What? That hooligan dare lay his filthy eyes on her? To protect my heart's devotion, don't blame me when I get onto ya!

(Source: Webnovel)

Ping Dan is a loser. His life is a total failure. Nothing is going his way. Finally, he spent his entire life's savings on an expensive blow-up doll. A few days into playing with his new doll, it suddenly came to life!! What's going to happen next?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Shou Shi Fujun Zhengchong Cheng Yin

description:
Song Xingxing transmigrated into a world of beast-men as a rare, precious female. There she meets the quietly stoic black wolf, then the mouthy tsundere white-lion. After she's tamed both young cubs, they both want her as their mate! Her nights are about to get exciting… As she shows off her skills in the village, she becomes beloved by the villagers, and there are more pretty boys to come…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Meng Bao Yi Xian San Sui Ban

description:
Xuan Tianji, the most famous alchemist in the immortal realm, had an accident with the Sealing System, and it turned her back into a little girl. Now her childhood friend, ex-boyfriend, apprentice, and rival are all looking for a missing "woman." Instead, they find themselves playing the role of "daddy" instead.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Become a wealthy, mysterious, man’s wife or let your ill father die? Macie Qiao must decide. The contract stipulates two years as President Xiao’s wife. In return, he will pay for any all medical bills. He’s handsome. He’s rich. The question remains: what are his true motives and why Macie?

(Source: Tapas)
