Once a proud woman, she was taken away by a crime syndicate and her memories erased. A fiery playboy will become a cool and calculated police detective to search the world for her. Fate conspires to finally bring them together again. When their memories awaken, will they find happiness, or sink into the abyss?

title.romaji: Ben Jian Xian Juebu Wei Nu
title.english: Liberated Sword Immortal In Feminist Realm

description:
Chu Ran, known as the "heartbreak consoler," mends broken hearts by dealing with scumbag boyfriends. However, when these scoundrels retaliate by forcing him to be with ladyboys, it unwittingly unleashes a cosmic force—the Sword Immortal System. Suddenly, he finds himself transported to a realm of feminist immortality. The Mount Yao Sect becomes his training ground, a place where he must cultivate to ascend as an immortal. Armed with scientific knowledge and futuristic weaponry bestowed by the system, Chu Ran embarks on an extraordinary adventure where women reign supreme.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Chengle Wu Ge Dalao De Zhangxin Chong
title.english: The Apple of Five Men's Eye
title.native: 我成了五个大佬的掌心宠

description:
In an accident, Mu Haohao transmigrated to the world of a one-versus-five erotic novel. She is bound to a system in the novel and becomes the female lead. In order to return to the real world, the system requires Mu Haohao to complete a task. However, the task is to win the hearts of the five male leads simultaneously! Yet, she only wants to be with one man all her life! Initially, she tried to break away from the novel's original settings. Unfortunately, she got reborn again, and this time, the five male leads were reborn with memories of their previous lives intact...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: A Fabulous Dream with My Master

description:
This absolutely gorgeous gentleman not only cured me of my bizarre illness, but also requested me to be his disciple? Since I had nothing else good enough to repay this kindness, I could only pursue him and make him mine! Once my master, always my hubby!
"Huggies please, Master~"
Wait, where are you going? Don't run away!


(Source: Webnovel)

Since Gu Chenyi became entangled with Yi Ran, his daily routine became— “How can I get rid of this troublesome woman?” Recently he's been annoyed. The woman who craved to give him a child suddenly wants to do that for another man. Hehe, is it so hard to be honest these days? “You've cost me my marriage savings. How dare you seek to have a child with another man!?”

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Gong Zhu Ta Shi Luan Zhong Qi Hou
title.english: I Played with the Prince’s Feelings

description:
Abandoning my ex-boyfriend without knowing he is Lord Shuo, what to do? Two years ago, Qiu Xingchen, a princess of the Zhou Empire, met Yan Xuan, Lord Shuo of the DaYe Empire who was out on a trip, and got emotionally and physically involved with him using tricks. Karma has its way. Two years later, she fell into his trap. Yan Xuan, who looked indifferent with a poker face, curled his fingers and sneered, "Want to run? Too late! You have to pay the price for tricking me."

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras

Wei Haoran is a rich, handsome, and overbearing CEO. However, he got played by some random woman: She took advantage of him, and... ran away right after? No matter in which corner of the world she ran to, he'll definitely find her! But one day, suddenly, a little boy appears in front of him, calling him father. What is going on?!

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Fantasy: I Am Not a Master

description:
"Wait, you mean to tell me that the chickens I raise are pure-blood Phoenixes? And the carp I raise are true dragons? And even the weeds in my yard are top-grade elixir? Li Fan couldn't believe his ears. 'No, it's impossible,' he exclaimed. 'How could I, a mere young man from the city, become a peerless powerhouse?'
But fate had other plans for Li Fan. One day, he found himself transported through time to ancient times, where he quickly rose to become a top-level powerhouse, revered by various sect masters. With his incredible strength, he set out to dominate the world. Let's follow his journey and see how he overcomes all challenges that come his way!"

(Source: Webnovel)

The heart of the emperor, the love of the fox spirit... In this life, the king of Zhou is just a scholar, and the resentment of the past life is just in memory; infatuated Da Ji, across time and space in order to chase love, will never regret. Different fates of familiar characters in history, let's to feel their love and hate...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: How the Princess Became the Queen

description:
A girl reborn after death? A sudden personality change, like a schizophrenic. Meet your lover in past life again, do you like her beautiful appearance, or me in her body...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Husband, the Emperor's Position is Mine!

description:
Chu Xi, the female emperor of a matriarchal nation, died from overwork and transmigrated into a patriarchal world. In a chance encounter, she met Xie Yi, a frail and sickly prince. Intending to kidnap the beauty, the two became acquainted. However, Chu Xi had always refused to surrender to fate and certainly didn't plan on just going with the flow. What was the point of becoming a princess consort or empress? Doesn't opening her own harem sound better?

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Wo De Wang Hai Wei Cheng Nian
title.english: My King Hasn't Come Of Age

description:
When the violent human girl picks up the alien king who is incarnated as the adorable boy, see how the girl develops the powerful dragon clan that dominates the universe!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Huxian You Dian Xiong

description:
Yan Xiaoqi, the human girl accidentally opened the seal of Li Xiu, the fox fairy. She thought she picked up a handsome man, but she didn't expect to be forced to embark on a journey to find the soul jade pieces with the fox Lord...

(Source: WebComics)

Li Nianjiao, as the top dancer in her city, privately is a night hunter that hates blood vampires. A hunting, she accidentally involved in a fight between handsome man, Xia Ye and other clan. But Xia Ye found out who she really is and used it to blackmail her into doing whatever he says... At the same time, the mysterious leader of another clan also seems to have a different ambiguous to her~

(Source: WebComics)

On the first day of youyou transferring to the automotive professional, she fell in love at first sight with the hottest man in the department. But soon, she found that Tan Zuo turned out to be a frivolous boy who coveted beauties. Her love for him instantly extinguished. However, as they gradually become familiar with each other, the mysteries of Tan Zuo are solved one by one. And Youyou find that she can no longer leave Tan Zuo...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bing Shan Shang Shen Qiu Fang Guo
title.english: Lord Deity, Please Let Me Go!

description:
Jian ZhiXi enjoys arranging fates for other immortals, but one day, she lost control of her own destiny and became trapped in a relationship with Lord Deity Cangling, who demanded her company along his journey in the mortal realm. Never for once had she been able to escape from him. Lord Cangling, please let me go. I’m just a nobody... Wait, why is this cold-hearted man now becoming so warm? What is he going to do with me...

(Source: Webnovel)

It’s known to all that the new online celebrity Xu Ling, who relied on Zhou Yanhuai to be famous, is extremely ignominious. What’s more shameful is that she is actually proud of it! “Miss Xu, Mr. Zhou possesses a high social status, why did you sell him easily?” “Have you experienced being ignored for 4 years (1461days)? Have you even been refused for three years(1095 days)? I’ve loved him for seven years, I... I’m not going to love him any more.”

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Tong Yang Fu Xiang Gandiao Wo Zenme Ban
title.english: My Husband-to-be Wants to Kill Me
title.native: 童养夫想干掉我怎么办

description:
When Chang Xiaoyun, a 26-year-old policewoman, wakes up after being run over by a car, she has become the ailing baby daughter of the Grand General in ancient times.
As the sickly infant recovers under the watchful eye of the royal court, the King makes a shocking decree - Xiaoyun is to be betrothed to the unfavored Prince Shu.
But why does this Prince want Xiaoyun dead? Thrust into the dangerous politics of the royal court, Xiaoyun must use her wits and modern sensibilities to navigate this strange new world.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Friends since high school, Ye Shen and Lin Xiangyao’s relationship started out like any other. Friends, just friends…until they started secretly seeing each other. Now adults, Ye can’t help but feel his relationship with Lin is shallow. Ye is an accomplished designer, Lin is a wealthy CEO. They have sex but never kiss, never make love. When Ye tries to get closer, communicate, Lin pulls away. Is a fragile lie that lasts forever the same as the truth?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Wo Yu Si Ge Gu Xiansheng

description:
“Four souls existing in one body at the same time?!”

Sang Wan is a young woman who's just been forced to marry the heir of the Gu family. When her new husband hits his head on a wall, she discovers that he has dissociative identity disorder. She has to get used to all four of his personalities, which are all very different from each other!

(Source: Comikey)

He left, and this lipstick was his final gift. She must lose it if she wants to lose this stupid love... She needs companionship, redemption -- someone to end this awful loneliness. Lipstick and cats are her saviors. A stick of expensive lipstick with no owner plays the role of the God of Fate, connecting the lives of two different people. Seductive colors, taboo colors, colors for singletons... Every girl has her own style of lipstick, and every color tells a story. Perhaps your story could be here as well?

(Source: Webnovel)

To cure her mother's illness, Yu Qianqian entrusts herself to Lu Li, who is consumed by a desire for revenge, all stemming from past events. Can these childhood sweethearts return to the joyful times of their youth? Can the lovers, lost on their paths, find their way back to each other?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

When Ma Yu locks eyes with the handsome transfer student, she immediately falls head over heels in love. Later that night, she runs into a middle-aged man who bears an uncanny resemblance to Qu Xin. Shortly afterward, she stumbles upon his secret.

(Source: WebComics)

Gods can only love one god in their lifetime. This is the golden rule, and Artes has already lost his sole love by the time he meets a young Liam. The short interaction plants a seed in Liam’s heart, and his love blooms when he meets Artes once again years down the line. However, Artes cannot love Liam back because of the gods’ golden rule…which will bring death to those who defy it. However, Liam is a temptation that Artes has difficulty resisting. In the end, which will Artes choose: his love or his life?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Custom-made bookcase for the young superstar?! And enter freely around his private home?! But how can he be so different from his look on the screen, gentle and warm? Arrogant, bad-mannered and even cannot reading! The only reason she was hired was she could read the script!

(Source: WebComics)

I got cheated on and also hit by a car, but God did not abandon me! Now that I'm the CEO of a big company, I want revenge!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wenshi Li De Ke Lai Er

description:
Claire, a young girl who grew up in a greenhouse, finds an injured bat. Unexpectedly, the bat, who looks like an angel, turns out to be a vampire who has lived for over a thousand years.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In order to find out the truth about his father's death, Sapphire was involved in a series of conspiracies. Fortunately, he made a contract with the lost god Yis, which gave him the ability to go back in time.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A hamster that is put on the human world with a secret mission is attacked unexpectedly by a demon. She narrowly escapes death, but little does she know that it is only the beginning of the cohabitation between her and her enemy.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ru Shu Zhong Suo Shuo de Lian'ai

description:
Miao Hanyu is an otaku girl addicted to novels, who is hooked on Hu Haotian, the hero of a fiction, and was eventually dumped by her boyfriend. Her friends said it was because of her craze about this fictional character that her boyfriend broke up with her. When the drunk Miao Hanyu was on her way home, discarding a cell accessory, a boy who looked like Hu Haotian appeared and brought her to the world in the novel.

(Source: WebComics)

In order to find out her identity, the 19-year-old Yu Liang does her best to get into the GMS Company and works hard to become a temporary assistant to the mysterious character He Yan. She does not expect her boss to be not only sloppy but dangerous, and also someone she never wants to see again in her life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Xing Dong Tian Qi Xia Xiao Xing
title.english: Take A Shine to My Sweetie

description:
An ordinary girl named Stellar Xia, a powerful president Jamil Qin, and the engagement written on paper... poor as Stellar Xia is, she embraces a mysterious lot, in which there are unbeknown secrets; While Jamil Qin, a cold and bossy president, thinks that he can lives up to his family as long as he chooses an obedient girl to be his wife, however, after getting married... this story is not only about the growth of the leading female character, but also chivalric code of the married couple.

(Source: WebComics)

You, who abandoned everything for the sole purpose of avenging your mother, and I, who was born in complete innocence and knew only you. In the end, have we composed a love story of awakening the puppet, or a lament for Hell drowned in anger and hatred?

(Source: MangaToon)

News reporter: "President Li, what do you like to play in your spare time?" After thinking deeply for a while, President Li replied, "I like to play with my wife..." That night, a woman in tight spandex brandishing a leather whip appeared in front of a man. "I heard you liked playing with your wife?" "Wife, let me explain..." "How do you want to play? Standing up? Sitting down? Lying down? Or..." "Are you really doing it, wife?"

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Long Live My Dear Prince Consort

description:
After her family was destroyed, Aria Su was left with no choice but to sell herself to pay the debts. But, the man that ended up buying her, was her enemy, the man that forced her father to his death -- Haden Yan. From that point on, Aria lost her freedom and was forced to stay by Haden's side. The man held her captive, but... he also hugged her with his heavily wounded body and said, "I've waited a thousand years for you, so I don't mind waiting a little longer. But, if you'll eventually be mine, I hope you don't make me wait too long."

(Source: WebComics)

A wealthy vice president of an entertainment company is accused of violating a "moral code of conduct for women" and is sent back in time to inhabit a singer's body who is destined to die in a year. She must follow the code of conduct, but begins to suspect that the singer's death might have been more than just an unfortunate incident.

(Source: INKR)

title.english: Classmate Gui, Please Be A Little Bit More Patient!

description:
After failing to reincarnate countless times, Tao Zhi, a young girl, finally found a way she might enter reincarnation: to help a human teenager, Gui Zizhuo, who collaborates with the Ghost Realm, to raise the ratings of his ghost exorcisms. That being said, could Gui Zizhuo, whose exorcism methods were oversimplified and crude, get any good reviews?! Tao Zhi was once again deeply concerned about her chances at reincarnation...

(Source: Coolmic)

Being reborn in a mysterious ancient country, the modern girl becomes a princess who is going to be married with one of the princes so as to make peace between two countries. She thinks it will be a happy beginning of her romantic love, however, it turns that they only want her wolf heart. In the meantime, this girl finds that another soul co-exists with her in her body...

(Source: WebComics)

Wendy Xu, an ill-behaved teen girl who was in heavy debts, suddenly became a young lady of a wealthy family?! She established a firm footing in the complex relationships of this family, found her biological brother who was protective to her and fell in love with the president who helped her. But she didn't know that everyone was trying to conceal a shocking truth from her...

This home was left by our good friend, Smile. Take a look at their new daily life as three online-met friends move in together to their new house.

(Source: Lalatoon)

title.english: Fantasy of the Buried Beauty: Lihua & Liancheng

description:
In order to change the fate of its owner, Liancheng—a maid of the Royal Kitchen—and Little Lihua—a white cat who had been granted wisdom but had no demonic power—travelled through time with Liancheng's body under the help of the demon king to change Liancheng's fate of inevitable death.

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Shao Zhu Hao Xiong Wo Hao Ai
title.english: My Master is Fierce but Adorable

description:
After being hit by a car, Xiao Ran wakes up to find herself back in the ancient time in the body of a homeless teen. As she sneaks into a restaurant to look for food, she encounters a pair of handsome men. When she runs into one of the pair - the more arrogant one later on, she realizes that she has witnessed him dealing unspeakable business and is therefore forced to become his servant. Xiao Ran goes on to find out that the gentler man of the pair is an old acquaintance, and her background is connected to the former royalty...

(Source: WebComics)

The zombie apocalypse suddenly descended. As the virus spreads among everyone and they are faced with countless walking corpses. How should they handle it? And how do they survive?

(Source: Coolmic)

Shen Hanguang, a woman who loves games and animation, was hijacked by a Rolls Royce at the school gate. Her younger brother goes missing, her parents are involved in a big incident, and she was appointed interim president of the multinational conglomerate, GKG? The handsome assistant delivers this explosive news, but even more incredible is to come...

(Source: WebComics)

Another summer holiday has arrived, and the little girl Gu Li Li finally meets her uncle Song Qian again. Indeed she prefers to call him brother and has harbored a secret crush upon him. This year, Song Qian brings Li Li to the green mountain to collect specimens, and before long, Li Li discovers that it is a magical world where plants and animals all can become spirits and ghosts...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Kuai Chuan Zhi Liao Zhai Qi Yuan

description:
When she dies, she travels into liaozhai world (A famous Chinese legendary book) by accident. Bad guys are unexpectedly handsome and cool while good guys are weak and half-witted! Couples were supposed to be together don't know each other while friends were expected to support each other become enemies! What happened? Everything is in a mess! Can our heroine retrieve the situation and win her own love?

(Source: MangaToon)

The corporate drone dies and is reborn as a witch, only to be immediately ensnared by the white-haired vampire Alice, who binds her in a blood pact! In her loli form, she's clingy and adorable, the only one you can rely on. In her mature form, she's fierce and protective, her combat prowess maxed out. The bond forged through shared blood is sweet enough to make you dizzy. Yet dark currents already churn beneath the city's surface. Beneath the blood pact lies an unsolvable mystery—their meeting was never mere coincidence...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Zhou Jincheng, who lost his eyesight in a family massacre, embarked on a path of vengeance alongside the young girl Lingling after training a wolf to serve as his guide dog.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Tuanzi Hou, Fanpai Yijia Dou Xiang Sha Wo!
title.english: Turned a Toddler: The Villain Family Wants Me Dead!
title.native: 穿成团子后，反派一家都想杀我！

description:
Wendy Reed wakes up to find herself inside a novel, now living as a three-and-a-half-year-old little girl. To make matters worse, she's landed in the infamous Reed family, a household doomed for destruction. To survive, Wendy must rely on her charm and cuteness to win over Logan Reed, the dangerous and unpredictable head of the family. But survival won't be easy. Her new "big brothers" are far from ordinary. They're all watching her closely and could snap at any moment. Can Wendy make it through this villain-filled nightmare with her life intact, or will her cuteness be her only way out?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Crown Princess is a Fairy Fox!

description:
Charlotte comes to another world due to an accident and becomes a fairy fox! accepting the new identity immediately she is determined to change the world with her powerful magic. As a little pure fox, she is tricked and sent to marry a strange prince in the place of a princess…Will she realize her conquer dream?

(Source: MangaToon)

Who'd have thought the Crown Prince would be determined to marry the first miss of the Hua Family, a woman of "easy virtue" and bad reputation? Once the news got out, it broke the hearts of countless ladies in the capital. What?! This bad woman refuses to become the Princess Consort… Ran away with a man for a jar of good liquor? Miss Hua: I'm just a vulgar girl with some street smart. I'm no match for you! The Crown Prince: I will see to it that of all the people in the world, you are left with me but no one to choose from.

(Source: WebComics)

Ren Jiang are able to extract bones, modify tissue, and remodel the body. They can heal illnesses or create chaos. Cheng Shan has this unique ability and leaves home at the age of 16 to venture into the city.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

By coincidence, Ye Fan became the Yama of the hell and gained a mysterious and scalable underground system. And when everything is going well, he suddenly found that it seems that the underground system is still hiding a secret...

(Source: MangaToon)

A girl who is introverted and incompetent finds a bow in her room. After wearing it, she sees something unexpected... Adolescent feelings, afraid of discovery, and longing for new knowledge. My love for you because I like you. My gaze is on you and you only.

The tragedy of a city was wrapped in a layer of the secrets. When he returned to the old city, he was caught up in sudden changes. And the boy he once loved became familiar but was a stranger at the same time. Behind the mysteries and the temptations, what is the truth...

The lingering love of her past life has turned to a demon that will hate her until death. The Qingcheng of this life is certain that the past life that killed her was stained in blood... A tale of the strings of love and hate connecting three people. Love and hate are so hard to understand...

"If I had the choice, I would never have met you again."

Welcome to the Lunar Eclipse Circus! A world where magic is the norm. Esil has strange memories that seem to betray her own beliefs about her identity, and only hopes to uncover what her role in this new world is.

Mangmang Yu and Lin You used to be childhood playmates. As years go by, Lin You has become a school prince while Mangmang Yu has become a weirdo on campus after having been through a lot in high school. They reunite and recognize each other at the first day of the new term when Mengmeng Yu pour a buck of water on Lin You's head. Mengmeng Yu soon finds out that Lin You is no longer the angel boy in childhood. She wants to stay away from Lin You, but Lin you seems to have another idea...

(Source: MangaToon)

On the verge of being beaten to death, Zhen Su had little hope till a sultry stranger named Yirong Wen saves him. Little did he expect the stranger to actually be his boss, Jin Ling?! Well, his boss’s boss. Now seeing each other after work, Zhen must keep their relationship secret or else...

(Source: Chinese publisher, translated)

To get revenge, Xia Yihan swallowed her pride and disguised herself as a maid to sneak in Family Ye’s mansion. She didn’t want to have anything to do with Ye Zi Mo, but life brought them together. They went toe-to-toe at first, but later on, they got engaged to each other? But things didn’t go as happy-ever-after as we thought. Why did Ye Zi Mo get outraged when he know that Xia Yihan was pregnant?

(Source: Webcomics)

She was tragically framed by his father and step-sister, and was given to an old and ugly man’s bed.
After the night, unexpectedly she gave birth to a pair of adorable and high IQ twins of mixed sex. She was afraid the kids would be taken away by the old man, so she changed her name and hid her identity. The pair of adorable twins brought her a man of dignified and noble character. Look at the man with the same looks as her son, Ye Xin Bai’s startled, before she could spoke, the man embraced her waist...

(Source: MangaSy)
Li Meng Meng wins a ticket for a luxury cruise and becomes entangled with a wealthy man, Wu Wen He, who is used to getting his way.

Fu Ruan had to work very hard to pay off her huge debt. But thanks to her outstanding strength and perfect massage skills she was hired to work as a maid. Her new job was to take care of the prince who suffered injures at the war and help with his rehabilitation. She thought that her new employer would be a collected and mature man, but he turned out to be a sharp-tongued tsundere?! How will they cope with each other? And how soon will their employer-employee relationship become a blissful love story?

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.
When Shadow Man's house breaks, he enters a racing competition to earn money.

A car collision marked the end of Chen Chao’s five-year relationship with Sheng Ruzuo. Just as Chen Chao anticipated starting anew, Sheng Ruzuo resorted to multiple pretexts to hold onto him. Simultaneously, a savior named Jiang Youlin emerged, triggering lost memories from five years ago, along with the revelation of a supposed younger brother who didn’t exist. As a cascade of truths unraveled, Chen Chao came to understand that the past events were not as he had perceived them. Now faced with their outdated bond, the question lingers: can it still be salvaged?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo He Kongjie Huangdao Qiusheng De Rizi
title.native: 我和空姐荒岛求生的日子

description:
The retired veteran Liu Yi was caught in a plane crash and washed up on a deserted island. Just to survive, he'll have to kill wild beasts and fight off savage natives. Meanwhile, the twin stewardesses, the sexy blonde, and the gentle kindergarten teacher are all throwing themselves at him! Liu Yi swears that he's just trying to survive and live a quiet life! Until he accidentally inherited divine powers somehow, so now what?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A witch getting married with a paladin is definitely an rebellious act in the eyes of the old and stubborn people from the Church. However, the Church hasn't found out the fact that a useless and decadent witch shamelessly relies on her husband, a reliable and righteous paladin to live. And talking about their married life... obvious it won't be a peaceful one!

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Haomen Qiang Chong: Ji Shao Qing Zizhong

description:
At her bedridden mother’s request, she sold her body to him in order to save the Gu Family, who returned injury for kindness. Six years later, she returned to her long-departed hometown with her son, plotting her revenge. But as fate would have it, he ran into her son who was the spitting image of himself. “Since when do we know each other?” she asked. To which he replied, “Now is as good a time as ever.”

(Source: WeComics)

Picking up a mysterious ring, Nie Chen, originally a loser, successfully made himself the one who gets along well with various beauties and defeated talents from different places. Wherever he goes, all heroes will have no choice but to be surpassed by him. The moment when his knife flies toward the sky, all the tyrants will meet their fates instantly.

(Source: Webcomics)

Spiritual energy is coming back into the world, and ghosts are running rampant. An ordinary young man, Fang Zheng, chances upon a scripture of human skin that can perform miraculous things. The Gray Qi the scripture uses to upgrade objects also has strange origins.

In order to survive in this world of ghosts, Fang Zheng takes a giant step onto a road filled with hilarious ghost-busting capers. Shearing wool from the body of a ghost, carrying out a demolition at the scene of a murder...

It's horrifying and humorous -- and you'll laugh as you scream!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Ye Ren Mu Bang He Wo

description: Famous movie star, Su Ran, travels to the Stone Age during an accident on set. By chance, he encounters Lang Ya, a primitive warrior, and is taken back to his tribe. Greatly annoyed and fearing for his life, the fastidious and cultured superstar is now forced to live the barbaric life of a savage. But, he soon discovers he can return to the modern world for 24 hours during the night of a full moon…

He is the unreachable moon in the eyes of the world, who cherishes and protects the world and the common people. He is his most revered master, and also the one he has been looking for and loved at the bottom of his heart. Even if we turn into enemies, I want you to be mine as well.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.english: A Phoenix on the Ninth Floor of Heaven

description:
On his way to school, Feng Ming lost his life to save a child and somehow "transmigrated" into the body of West Thunder Nation's Crown Prince in a different universe. However, this Crown Prince was not as highly respected as Feng Ming expected; moreover, he seemed to be in an unusual relationship with Prince Regent, Rong Tian. Later, Rong Tian realized that the Crown Prince actually harbored a different soul in his body. Coupled with the incredible ideas Feng Ming would blurt out sometimes, Rong Tian started finding Feng Ming more and more interesting…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.romaji: Ge He Qian Li, Qin Chuan Zhi Xia

description:
Zhan Zhixia and Qin Chuan were deeply in love with each other, but due to differences, they broke up. Three years later, they still think about each other even when they claim they've moved on. But with one simple chat message, they didn't expect that fate would lead them to one another.

(Source: INKR)

The story follows the entanglement between a young, handsome general and an emperor. The general bears an uncanny resemblance to the emperor's most hated love rival, which makes him a frequent subject of threats and torture. As their relationship develops, love and hate become entwined and indistinguishable from one another, leaving their mark on both of their lives.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

Everyone believes that the emperor of the Ning Empire is a young, promising and wise ruler, except Shong Shiwei. Only Shong Shiwei knows how childish this man is in front of him! This man wants to stick with Shong Shiwei every moment, so much so that Shong Shiwei always feels he is not doing his duty at all!

(Source: Webnovel)

King of the silver screen, Ye Changshi, was diagnosed with stomach cancer at the peak of his career. Unexpectedly, he transmigrated into another world into a younger version of himself. But upon arrival, he found himself in the bathtub with a hunk, Ji Ling!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

For the sake of her brother—who had congenital heart disease—Yun Yao's stepparents 'sold' her off to a wealthy man. Yun Yao appeared to agree to the marriage, and she wanted to get out of it after her brother was sent abroad for treatment. Unwilling to compromise with the arrangement, she decided to walk toward a male brothel, thinking that she would get a divorce sooner if she were no longer a virgin. She accidentally bumped into a good-looking escort and gave away her first time. Initially, she planned for it to be a one-night-stand, yet unexpectedly, the handsome male model was actually the rich director she had never met! When a little rabbit meets the hungry wolf, she will only be…devoured!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Ta de Renshe Bu Tai Xing
title.english: There's a Problem With His Persona

description:
The top, a talented author doomed to be single forever and an expert in the arts of switching between personalities x the bottom, an inspiring actor with a hint of crackbrained-ness amidst his handsome look. Gu Lizhou, a legendary author with works renowned all across the country, got set up and ended up becoming the target of the entire internet's mockery. Zhong Weishi, a stuntman that has been making a living on the outskirts of the entertainment industry, acting roles like palace servants with less than ten seconds of total screen time. Due to an accident, the two met. The first time they saw each other, Zhong Weishi believed the other was a boytoy who lived off the providing of a wealthy older woman, while Gu Lizhou thought that Zhong Weishi was an escapee from the asylum. Essentially, there's a problem with his persona... After some time, Zhong Weishi, "... Then can you talk to me in the tone of the characters from your novel? I want the voice of the male protagonist who's overbearing but gentle, powerful, yet sweet!" Gu Lizhou, "Then can you be as wild in person as you are on television?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.romaji: Mowang Xiang Gen Wo Jiao Pengyou
title.english: The Demon King Wants to be Friends with Me

description:
The male lead supported and believed in science ever since he was young and had a naturally unsociable disposition. However, since he was born in a family whose maternal lineage were sorcerers, he was cast out of the clan due to his lack of magical powers. He and his younger sister depended on each other thereafter. One day, the male lead noticed that his sister had gone missing and heard rumours about the Demon King’s evil doings. Believing that the Demon King had abducted his sister, he decided to crossdress to infiltrate the Demon King’s city to save his sister. Unexpectedly, the Demon King is actually a handsome guy who likes making dresses?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Feisheng Cong Yang Ge Xianzi Kaishi
title.english: Ascension Starts From Raising a Fairy

description:
Lu Wuyan had been cultivating for a thousand years and become matchless, but why couldn’t he ascend even though people worse than he had ascended to immortality! He couldn’t take that! He wanted to talk about it with a fairy. How on earth could he achieve immortality!?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Shen Wei Guichu up De Wo Bei Yingdi Kanshang Le
title.english: Falling For a Parody Content Creator
title.native: 身为鬼畜up的我被影帝看上了

description:
Top Actor Jiang Ran & Shut-in Mo Shuyao. Parody content creator—Mo Shuyao—had his account banned overnight all because of him making a parody of Top Actor Jiang's video? Is this the perversion of humanity or failure of morality?? In the set, Jiang Ran read out loud clearly, “With a swing of the whip in his hand, he wrapped the other party tightly and pulled it into his embrace…” This section is quite well written. Mo Shuyao blushed, “F*ck you! Stop reading! Get lost!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Yun Su lives by a strict code of honor: whatever he receives will be repaid in kind. For most of their lives, this has meant seeking vengeance in battle against his nemesis, the Martial Regent. But when Yun Su finds himself on the brink of death, that same nemesis shows him unprecedented kindness by saving his life. For once, Yun Su has no idea how to reciprocate… until he finally settles on an idea: marriage!

(Source: Tapas)

She thought it was just a sham contract marriage. But one night of passion later, she found that she couldn't cut herself loose from that man. After six years on the run, she has to face him once again. And this time he won't let her go!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After the Raccoon City incident, Claire is still searching her brother, Chris. Her actions cause her to be captured by Umbrella and taken to a strange place called Rockfort Island. Infested with zombies, Clairetries to escape, and is helped by Steve Burnside, a young man imprisoned on the island as well.

Like a savage, he creeps up to her. He makes her his prisoner, clinging to her tightly. She tries her best to fight back, but she falls into his trap over and over again. He snickers into her ear, “From now on, I have one goal and one goal alone, which is to devote my life to conquering you!” That’s right! He hates her, he conquers her. He loves her, he conquers her. He dotes on her, and then he knocks her down again!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

This is the story of the 12345th generation soul hunter Xiao Leize with his soul beast familiar Hao Tian, and how they pacify youkai and defeat demons in the mortal realm. It all starts with a vengeful spirit that escaped from purgatory and attached itself to a dog.

(Source: Baike, translated)

title.romaji: Lian Shang Wunü De Yao Zhu Daren

description:
During the Edo era, youkai once shared the world with humans in prosperous times. But as time passed, youkai became the stuff of legends. Under the tutelage of her grandmother, Rena Aihara strongly believed in the existence of youkai. After her grandmother passed away, she took on the job of shrine maiden and took care of the shrine by herself. During the summer festival, a handsome stranger came to the shrine for blessings. Rena was suspicious of the stranger, and in his surprise he reverted to his true form, a youkai named Senshounushi.

(Source: Samanhua, translated)

Traumatized by a fire that killed her family, Xu Nian lost the ability to speak. She thought that she could live happily after she was adopted by the Ning Family, but who knew that her adopted parents and sister would abuse her. Even more, her tragic fate didn’t end there. Her adopted father gave her off to a client to be his mistress for his company profits. Thankfully, she encountered S.N.'s chairman, Gu Mingyan. He was a domineering and arrogant man. Though he was indifferent on the surface, he protected her silently...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Due to a lie, Yi Xiang Nuan disappeared for five years. When she came back, her ex-boyfriend Su Chen proposed to her on their first meeting? He threatened to make her marriage life miserable, but the life after the marriage was not quite the same as what he said. Nevermind, she didn’t even care about it anyway. She just wanted to bring the person who harmed her family to justice. She buried her head in search of the truth and ignored her husband. Su Chen was very unhappy with it. Su Chen: Didn't we promise that you would hide cowardly behind me and let me protect you? You step back, let me handle it. Yi Xiang Nuan: Come on, husband, I'll try my best to support you.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zhang de Shuai Jiu Keyi Weisuoyuwei ma?
title.english: I Can Do What I Want Because I'm Handsome
title.native: 长得帅就可以为所欲为吗？

description:
For three years, everyone in school criticized me for pursuing Zhao Guanyu. They said, “Aren’t you, a man, ashamed of pursuing another man so publicly that everyone knows about it?” However, what made Zhao Guanyu change his mind to pursue me a few years later? Is it love? Is it responsibility? Of course not. It's my face!

(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)

Note: Originally published under the title Wo Zhang De Shuai Jiu Ke Yi Wei Suo Yu Wei (我长得帅就可以为所欲为).
A boy discovers that his bonsai has a human form.

title.english: The Self-Cultivation of the Provincial Commander

description:
The Qihuang Kingdom is run by women. As the head eunuch, Yan Lang’s dream was to wander aimlessly in life, and resign with honor while disguising herself as a man. However, Yan Lang unexpectedly encountered the biggest failure of her career when the new empress ascended to the throne. Wait a moment! Who could explain to her why the empress was a man? Yan Lang panicked and barely managed to beg him to spare her life. Before she could even celebrate, he forced a pill down her throat. “All this drug will do is to keep you in check. Behave well, and I will make sure you have nothing to worry about,” he said. “Just be a good empress! Starting today, I’ll be your loyal subject during the day, and serve you well at night,” she said. Every day, Yan Lang wandered on the edge of life. It wasn’t until one day that the empress discovered her secret that Yan Lang, the provincial commander, was a woman!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Ninety-nine percents of humans are suddenly captured and taken to an unknown location by a mysterious power. The last one percent of humanity are left in a desolate civilization to struggle against mysterious invaders. An unrecognizable power is slowly awakening in Yang Mo…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Wang Chao is like Peter Pan, a boy who won't grow up. Xie Zhuxing is tall and handsome, but poor like Cinderella. A mischievous boy and a scheming boy, just because they're silly in love doesn't mean their relationship will be sweet. It's a story between two people that may seem familiar, but told in a way you've not seen before.

(Source: Bilibli, translated)

Soft, cute, smart, talented disciple with psychological drama x cold, stern, and beautiful master.

In order to pursue the cold (male) goddess on the train during the winter solstice, he worked hard to get admitted into the public service department——the Ministry of Demon Subjugation. Not only did he work himself to death, he danced with it, struggling through innumerable hazards and hardships. Isn't this goddess way too hard to chase?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Ni Shi Wo De Wan You Yin Li

description:
Qin Se had been married for two years, but she had never consummated the marriage with her husband. Until a mysterious package led her to find out her husband’s secret... Looking for revenge, Qin Se plotted a grand plan. She carefully set her sights on Gu Jingyuan, the head of the powerful Gu clan. Qin Se thought that she was just playing with another bossy man, but she didn’t know that she was being led step-by-step to get revenge, regain her freedom, and escape her marriage. But at the same time she was also being led step-by-step, into the web of love he had setup for her.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

No cultivation resources, and penniless, too? It doesn’t matter, I have a mirror, and whatever I see with the mirror, human or beast, dead or alive, anything could be duplicated by its projection. Whatever martial arts tomes, heavenly treasures, divine weapons, even talents and skills can all come out of this mirror! Ding! "The Seven Stars Soaring Cloud Technique" just dropped! Ding! Canglan Battle Armor! Ding! Advanced Gold Talent! My name is Feng Yun, and I'll speak for myself.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: Reborn with Might: Spearhead to the Zenith

description:
With the Earth engulfed in an epic Revival of Spiritual Energy, Maximillian Lin and his friends are left for dead in the aftermath of a cruel betrayal. Before his last breath is drawn, Max awakens the mysterious Spiritual Cultivation System, which sends him hurtling back in time to a world still on the brink of its Spiritual Revival. With vengeance in his heart, Max finds himself with a unique knowledge of the future that just might help him avoid his past mistakes, save his friends, and rise to the Peak of Spiritual Cultivation!

(Source: WebComics)

Zi Le disguised himself as a female dancer and tried to get close to Zuo Yicheng—the licentious Counselor-in-chief, but Zuo saw through him and pinned him down on his bed! Zi Le yelled, "Get down! Get off me!" And Zuo Yicheng said, "Alright, you can get on me." Then a blow landed on Zuo's face, and Zi Le shouted in anger, "Piss off!"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo You Yi Zuo Ying Hun Dian

description:
What's the point of reincarnation, if you don't get to show off? As ancient demons awaken, cities will fall, and civilization will perish. In this life, I have a sword that can pierce the heavens! This time, I will control the heroic souls from past and present in order to rewrite history!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Chengjiu You Dian Duo

description:
To reward Meng Fan for his good deeds before his death, the Universe awarded him with a System, and returned him to three months before. He received missions, and if he completed the missions, he earned achievements that gave him traits. The story begins as he received this mission: confess to and be rejected by 100 people...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Xu Su, a novelist suffering from a mental disorder, somehow managed to summon Zhong Ye, an evil spirit from his novel. Despite Xu Su’s best efforts to eliminate Zhong Ye, he was pushed to the edge of insanity again and again. To free himself from this torment, Xu Su finally fulfilled Zhong Ye’s wish and unlocked the seal. But his life did not return to the peaceful days that Xu Su had hoped for. “Surely you know, that if you make a deal with the devil, sooner or later you’ll lose yourself to him…”

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

When you gaze at others, there's also a pair of eyes gazing at you from behind...
Surveillance and counter-surveillance, eavesdropping or stealing hearts?
When specialized professional talent [Fu Ying] meets a high-IQ, cunning old lover [Zhong Qiu], the chase across fate officially begins—
Every accidental encounter you create is precisely my carefully arranged plan. Every trap you personally design, I've already laid an ambush at the bottom.
A match of equal strength, the thrill of facing a worthy opponent... How much sincerity lies behind the deception?
One wrong move, and the whole game is lost, but this time, I'm willing to bet and concede defeat. I only hope you can soften your heart for me, even if just for a second...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

It is rumored that there is a lake in Chunze City where people can make wishes come true, and only one wish can be granted in a lifetime. In the spring of high school, the bullied An Yuji ran from Mudong City to Chunze City to make a wish to the lake to bully her and leave Mudong City no longer. Unexpectedly, her wish came true. She successfully transferred to Chunze No. 1 Middle School and met Qin Fengshi, a rebellious and withdrawn teenager. And the price of making a wish is...?

(Source: Bilibili,Translated)

Mu Jiusi went through 5,000 planes and decided to take revenge after being reborn, and resolutely hugged the regent Xu Huaibei's thigh. In this life, the prince is favored, the brother is in pain, and the system is blessed. Those who hurt me must die! Don't say, the husband you chose is really fragrant!

(Source: Kuaikan, Translated)

title.romaji: Bingshan Shouxi: Zhen Shang Ti Jia Xinniang
title.english: The Icy CEO and the Substitute Bride
title.native: 冰山首席：枕上替嫁新娘

description:
He is an icy CEO, and she is a substitute bride. He is determined to seek revenge for the death of his brother and marries the woman he plans to torture but the bride is already substituted! Then what happens when the mistaken icy CEO acts so brutally upon the innocent substitute bride?

(Source: MangaToon)

When Li Yuze first debuted, he made his marriage public. The media was flabbergasted. It was the talk of the town. However, no one could figure out who he was married to. After a while, the fans started doubting the validity of the news. After all, no one saw the rumored mysterious wife...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo He Wo De Lixiang Xing Ge Pile!
title.english: My Ideal Type and I Are Dying!
title.native: 我和我的理想型嗝屁了！

description:
Affectionate, cold and occasionally off-line president Top X Charming and lively, occasionally silly president Bottom
In order to avoid other's courtship and marriage, Ren Chuan pretends to be terminally ill and hide in the hospital. But unexpectedly... he met the one he fell in love with at first sight here. The sad thing is, the two terminally ill patients still talk about to last their friendship forever... It's important to create memories before we die!

(Source: Mangatoon)

Note: Adapted from the web novel Zongcai Meitian Du Zai Bingwei (总裁每天都在病危).

Lu Wen, an eighteenth-tier actor, is handsome, hot, and has a natural flair for acting. However, he has low EQ and lacks the ability to make discerning judgments. On his first day of joining the production crew, he accidentally offends Qu Yanting, the most famous screenwriter in the industry. Later on, he thinks the latter is exacting revenge on him through his position, sponsoring a young male actor, and working on a silly web drama for the sake of money. Watch him slowly change his tune about Qu Yanting over time!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Their marriage is entirely contractual. Just to be clear, this is a fake marriage and none of it should be taken seriously! He says, "People say I'm arrogant, overbearing, and ruthless, so don't fall for me." She says, "People say I'm the most beautiful and kind-hearted doctor, an angel sent by God to save patients, so you'd better not fall for me either..." They are both powerful people, and are a great match for each other! As they live together, their attitudes towards each other gradually change, and love develops between them...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Long before the universe came into existence, a magical object appeared out of chaos. No one knows how many years has passed, and now it actually split into 18 pieces. Each piece of it contains some overwhelming power that eventually metamorphoses into an immortal being. By chance, Yun Changkong obtained the tripod of the God of war. So begins his wonderful journey to the supreme.

(Source: Mangatoon)

title.english: My Wife Is Playing Spoiled Again

description:
Tang Xiaorou has a crush on Mo Jicheng and she just can't let it go. After ten years of painful, unrequited love, she wanted to give up. Even marriage was just a piece in his game. But whenever the cold Mo Jicheng came on to her, it still made her heart flutter. They could only show their feelings by hurting each other, but even as they fought, they made ripples in each others' hearts. They will stay together, as if she was fated to be forever held in the palm of his hand…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Zheng Xuaner lived with a pair of vampire twins whom she vowed to protect. The twins, however, took the initiative to bring a vampire hunter to their house and he was suspicious of these two children. Would they be able to overcome the obstacles and defy all odds for each other?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Bai Xiaotian transmigrates to Aola Star: Parallel Universe game world as a coincidence. In this familiar and unfamiliar world he will face many bloody adventures...

Note: Includes 7 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Zhong Xiaojie De Qian Shi Jin Sheng

description:
He's a rebellious heir with no respect for money, she's a gold-digger which money didn't respect. He was starting a new job after returning overseas, she was a smart and beautiful office lady. A spiked drink during a party resulted in a one-night-stand that set their gears of fate into motion…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Three years ago, Lu'er's best friend mysteriously disappeared. As a result, Lu'er ended up marrying her best friend's boyfriend. The marriage lasted three years, and she did everything she could to maintain the marriage only to receive the response, "I'll never love you!" When her husband's old flame returned, what should Lu'er do about her marriage...?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Fu Anyang, born into happiness as a spoiled rich kid, died when his sister fled her marriage. Forced to cross-dress to replace her on a blind date, he didn't expect Ji Yuan to be so hard to deal with. With this, Fu Anyang's one-sided feud began. As they grew closer, his impression of Ji Yuan started to change as he discovered Ji Yuan was a man with a passionate and sincere heart beneath the shackles of solitude...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

I was given a second chance at life with this transplanted heart, but I have also lost my freedom because of it. Di Zigang, the man who wanted me to take his late girlfriend's place; Wei Rufei, my doctor and childhood friend who sacrificed everything to save my life; and the sister of the heart donor. One transplant operation tied four people together. How will I be able to bear all the emotional baggage attached to the original owner of my new heart?

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Ta Gei de Shizai Tai Duole

description:
Jing Xiaobei was paid handsomely by his boss to infiltrate a rival company and sabotage their work. After a drunken gathering, he woke up in the morning to find a white-haired beauty in his bed – wasn't this his new superior, Qin Zhou? Should he take responsibility for sleeping with his boss? Never mind, his own boss was paying him too much to care; he had to complete the mission! But why was this new company so strange in every way? It was as if they knew each other in a past life?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Qin Zongzhu Cong Bu Pian Ren

description:
Just one "Yo, kid, interested in trying cultivation?" successfully "kidnapped" He Yue a cultivation genius with exceptional physique!! Just imagining being obediently called "Shishu" (junior uncle/master) by such a genius made He Yue feel lightheaded... Little did he expect that this seemingly upright and reliable martial nephew actually harbored such thoughts in his heart?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Yuan Wei Ni Xiansheng Liming

description:
The moon sets and the stars sink, waiting for the dawn to rise, I would like to offer you the glory of this dawn.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Xiao Zhenye fell in love with Mu Zijin at first sight. For him, he became an emperor while young; for him, he pacified the world and imprisoned him in the palace; but he was repeatedly hurt by his ignorance of love. And Mu Zujin didn't wish to stay with one person for long. To restore the country, he became Xiao Zhenye's "demon concubine", bringing disaster to his world. In the end, he committed suicide in front of Xiao Zhenye. Xiao Zhenye followed suite, committing suicide, but the two simultaneously returned to their childhood. What choice will Xiao Zhenye make this time...?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Xia Yuyang unexpectedly received a death invitation from his deceased grandfather. After experiencing seventeen deaths, he arrived at the Wheel of Reincarnation in Hell in hopes of rebirth. There, he learned that the only way to be reborn was to travel to various worlds, fulfill the regrets of the clients, and complete the tasks assigned by the system to earn points. His journeys through different worlds and the lives of various clients immersed him in these illusory realities. He gradually forgot his own identity. Who was he? What was his wish? In fact, all of this was a long-plotted return!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Si Hou Wo Chengle Gege de Zhusha Zhi
title.native: 死后我成了哥哥的朱砂痣

description:
When Jing Mo showed demonic powers that was latent in his blood, his brother Jueming was forced to kill him. Jing Mo woke up to find himself reincarnated into the body of the boy Bai Zhu, but there seems to be something… strange about this body, too. Jing Mo wants to run away and hide his identity, but Jueming wants to find his brother's missing body and wouldn't let him go. One wants to hide, the other wants to find the truth, as they become embroiled in a deadly struggle over Bai Zhu's true nature.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extra chapters.

She's a D-list actress, who is unwanted by all, including her family. He's a negligible CEO, who has to carefully calculate his every move, just to survive. Facing the betrayal of close ones, they formed an alliance: knowing acting is her dream, he rolls out the red carpet for her; knowing he wants to prove himself, she offers him unconditional support. Hurt and hatred, company and comfort, who can deny that they are already in love...

(Source: MangaToon)

A dashing male idol named Li Wen Huo moves in next to the pretty and popular manhua artist, Bai Jiu Jiu. Despite it being their first encounter, Li Wen Huo disregards his own safety to save Bai Jiu Jiu from a falling object. From that moment on, the pair keep growing closer to each other, but are unable to advance their relationship due to a single misunderstanding. While Bai Jiu Jiu is agonizing alone, she is unaware that Li Wen Huo had known her from the past…Centering on their jobs, lives and past memories, it will unfold a story of laughter, happiness and healing!

(Source: WebComics)

The good girl Zhu Yun meets the bad boy Li Xun at their college freshman orientation. Their lives come together and their fates become entangled, as our story begins…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: the patriarch has left the mountain

description:
After 500 years of closed-door cultivation, Ye Jieyu emerged to find the world has changed drastically. In this modern world, other powers are on the rise and traditional martial arts have declined in importance. His former disciples have all become bigwigs in various fields. See how the old master will come to rule the modern city after coming down from the mountain!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yu Sheng You Ni, Tian You Nuan

description:
Pei Yucheng had been possessing Lin Yan to get back at anyone who gave her a hard time, but once he left, she forgot what happened. Soon, Lin Yan found out about the possession, at the cost of her repeated sexual harassment of Pei Yucheng...

What the hell? The whole thing was staged? What should I do? Emergency!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Baituo, Wo Zhen Mei Xiang He Zhangmen Tan Lian'ai A
title.native: 拜托，我真没想和掌门谈恋爱啊

description:
Li Ran traversed to another world and became the scion of a demonic sect. When his system awakened, the first mission it gave him is to romance a girl? Li Ran was going to seduce the cute and gullible junior girl, but he ended up sending his love letter to the Master of the sect instead! That woman is a ruthless, cold-blooded, killer! As Li Ran was considering what he's going to do in his next life, he finds out that the master is actually… "very nice!"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jia Ying Hou Chao Tian Da
title.english: Sweetest Top Actress in My Home

description:
When she was young, Jiang Yuning's grandfather promised her to the third son of the Lu family in an arranged marriage. But then Jiang Yuning's family fell into ruin, and the playboy Lu Zongye disliked Jiang Yuning, so he plotted with the two-faced actress Huo Yuxi to ruin Jiang Yuning's reputation. With dark rumors spread all over the internet, Jiang Yuning's engagement arrangement was annulled, and she became lovers with Lu Jingzhi, the man she long had a crush on. As he tried to protect her from further harm, they started to develop real feelings for each other. With Lu Jingzhi’s help, Jiang Yuning will turn the tables, along with her cousin the paparazzi reporter, and bring revenge to those who wronged her.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zai Hunpeisuo Yao Dao Le Shijie Shoufu
title.english: I Hook Up With The World's Richest Man At The Registry Of Marriages
title.native: 我在婚配所摇到了世界首富

description:
As soon as Ye Xingguang graduated from college, the country assigned her a husband, who happened to be Ye Junqing, a billionaire who topped the Forbes Rich List. Ye Xingguang, knowing he was rumored to be a hardcore celibate, didn’t expect to get along with him. Yet to her surprise, he treated her as the apple of his eye!

Who would have thought that drawing him was the biggest lottery she’d ever won?

(Source: Webnovel)

Ji Na, a beautiful game live-streamer, went hunting for treasure at the bottom of a lake late at night. She didn’t find any treasure but she dug up a cute little zombie boy. When the boy Li Chen woke up and kissed Ji Na, he turned into a handsome man with supernatural powers! He's handsome enough to be the lead of an idol group, he can fight off monsters and then set off romantic fireworks with his magic. If Ji Na won't let him kiss her, he will turn into a cute little boy to tempt her that way… Even though she was filled with questions and doubts, Ji Na and Li Chen began a “shameless” cohabitation life. Sure enough, the hunters soon came looking for them…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Meng Bao Lai Xi: Zongcai Diedi Tai Nan Chan
title.english: The President Is Too Hard To Deal With
title.native: 萌宝来袭：总裁爹地太难缠

description:
Rumor has it that President Xi is a devious and treacherous man, but he spoils her to the point of overkill.

Assistant: "Sir, Madam's hospital was smashed."
"How's Madam?"
"Madam almost... beat him to death."
"Send the doctor to see if Madam hurt her hand!"

Rivals from all over the world: "Sweetheart, what's so great about that stodgy old man! Come with me, and the world is yours."
President Xi: "Baby, the kids want you home for dinner."
Rivals: "Well, that's just unfair."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The Demon Goddess is My Maid

description:
Xiaobai Su is a teen who is down on his luck with life from being poor to having no girlfriend. After being tricked by his friends, he ends up meeting a demon goddess and accidentally forms a pact. With a demon princess as his servant, weird and demonic shenanigans start to infiltrate his life.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Du Fei Zai Shang, Xie Wang Zaixia (Re Dao Ta Le)
title.english: The Evil Consort Above an Evil King
title.native: 毒妃在上，邪王在下（惹到他了）

description:
Hey adonis, I'm in a hurry, lend me your top! A girl removed an evil king's clothes and escaped right away when he was having martial arts practice. He was the almighty lord of the continent who received worship from millions people—mysterious, noble, and withdrawn. While she was the king of modern assassins, she tried her best to avoid him as if he were a venomous snake but he was obsessed with her and turned himself into a vine to capture her. She was emotionless, evil, and ruthless; but nothing came before her in his heart and no one was allowed to insult her. He said, "I would consider forgiving those who insult me, but there's no mercy for those who insult her!"

(Source: Webnovel)

Tang Yue had thought that she would be sold by her foster father for 30 million to a gay Huo Shengxuan as a nominal wife, which should be an easy job. But Huo Shengxuan arranged her to marry his half-brother Huo Shengzhi who onced served in the special force. Huo Shengzhi firmly objected the marriage due to remeberance of his late wife. However, as time went by and with the increasing interactions between the two, Huo Shengzhi found it difficult to let go of the coquetish young girl, Tang Yue.

(Source: Webnovel)

Lin Xiaomu, whose life deeply revolved around playing the "supporting role," had finally made contact with the school hunk, Huo Dongze, after an incident. In her eyes, he was "dazzling." Who would've thought that he, too, cared a lot about her as well?! Maybe it was the day that I met you that my life had become dazzling and radiating…

(Source: Coolmic)

Notable talent agent Jiang Langning is accidentally killed and sent into the past, where beauty is regarded as a sign of supremacy. With a wealth of experience and an eye for talent, she discovers a pleasure-seeking but smart man Chu Yudu, a meek old-money guy Gu Nanyi, an aloof scholar Shen Yanqing, and a loyal bodyguard Xie Sa. The four are selected to form a band that quickly becomes a nationwide phenomenon.

(Source: WebComics)

Five years apart, and he's nothing like the "brother" she remembers. Joanne is still innocent and untouched by the world, but Reid has been spinning a web of sweet deception in the shadows. Playing the role of protective older brother, he moves closer with calculated precision—all to stir the feelings she's kept buried deep inside. When forbidden memories resurface, logic battles desire—"Forget the past if you want," he murmurs, his smile dangerously inviting, "but come any closer, and I'm never letting you go."

(Source: WebComics)

The gangster wants to study hard, too?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

“City cats have homes but no freedom. Forest wolves have no homes but possess a freedom domestic cats lack.”

Molly, a Ragdoll cat living in the suburbs, yearned for freedom. After setting out on her journey, she made new animal friends...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

It's about a girl, Taobei, who has somebody writing on her book that she's a pig. This really angers her. Then, there's Muyu, the guy who's been friends with her since childhood...and he's angry with her. A really funny story of a silly and dense girl.

title.romaji: Dianxia Qiu Ni Bie Zuo Yao

description:
Met by chance in the mortal world, the charming and prideful young master of the flower house and a two-faced prince.

These two have many fights arguments, and kill each other along the way. However, the prideful young master overturns again and again in the presence of the young prince. In the process of repeatedly reviving and overturning, the hearts of these two are slowly coming closer together...

In order to kill the dictator, an assassin wore female clothing and snuck into the palace. He didn't expect to be caught immediately that night. But the dictator did not kill him. Instead, he asked to sleep with the assassin and treated him like a sleeping pill.
After staying in the palace for a while, the assassin discovered a deep conspiracy, and the dictator didn't seem that bad after all. Meanwhile, he even started to feel a little sympathetic...

A girl with a pair of bony braids has been labeled as evil since birth. One day, she is accidentally struck by a dragon egg, and a cute yet fierce baby dragon hatches from it. Together, they embark on a journey to find their respective homes. Along the way, what obstacles will they encounter?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Paohui Gongzhu Xiang Gou Dao Zuìhou

description:
While running away from her wedding, Qian Duoduo falls into a lake and dies due to a miscalculation. She is then transmigrated into the body of Mu Yunkai, a princess of the former dynasty who is being hunted. If she can max out the affinity values of all the gorgeous men the system has set up as targets, she will be able to return to her original world and have a second chance at life! This should have been a happy adventure of embracing beautiful men, but why do all the guys arranged by the system… want to kill her?!

(Source: WebComics)

This story describes the lives of gods and monsters living together. There are two Masters and three Disciples living together on Mount Nirvana. Master Guan, who is sometimes a man and sometimes a woman; Master Tang, who is plagued by strange thoughts; Sun Wu, an incredibly handsome chap; Bai, a naughty and outgoing girl; and Yi, a soft and gentle lad. The story is set in the small town of Tao Hua and is centered around the never-changing laws of nirvana and rebirth.

(Sourcce: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Li Shao Ba Ai Xiao Jiao Qi

description:
Bullied and persecuted by her step-sister, she woke up from an accident to find everything had changed. The plot to kill her backfired, which caused her step-sister to lie unconscious in a coma. Now she is forced to take her sister's place to marry the man who had once loved her, but now angrily scorns her.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Cheng Quian loved art, so he entered the prestigious Academy of Arts despite his family's opposition. Penniless, he works to support his studies, and he meets Xu Qiujin, who is his exact opposite. Despite their differences, Cheng Quian and Xu Qiujin can't seem to get enough of each other.

(Source: INKR)

Lin Ruiyi has received a tough mission, that is to disguise as his twin sister and trick the most powerful president in the city, Shang Mingze. However, unlike his badass sister, Lin Ruiyi is way too introverted. At the banquet, he fell into Sheng Mingze's arm but he ran away like Cinderella instead of hoaxing this arrogant man. Just when he thought this whole thing was over, he met Sheng Mingze right the next day! It turns out he is Lin Ruiyi's new boss! Lin Ruiyi prays everyday that the president won't recognize him but ... it seems that he's already become Sheng's target...

(Source: MangaToon)

Living as her sister’s shadow, Xia Shengge took the blame for her sister and got chopped up and killed by Qi Ming. After she died, she realized that others had been manipulating her and using her. Holding on to her grievances and resentment, Xia Shengge was reborn and traveled five years back in time. In this new life, she encounters Lu Jiucheng, the Deadly Terror, and marries him despite his terrifying image.

(Source: Webnovel)

Twelve years ago, 70,000 soldiers of the Crimson Flame Army were killed by a traitor, and only the Young Marshal Lin shu survived.

Now Lin has reinvented himself as the "Great Genius" Mei Changsu, and has established the Jiang Zuo Alliance. He has returned to the imperial capital, setting foot on a dark and thrilling road to take over the throne.

The self-center Ji Xi transmigrated to another world and became a prince. He thought he could accomplish great things in his kingdom, but his lousy father the king sold him to the prince of another kingdom for 100-kilotons of goods! Prince Ji Xi thought he'd be the hero of a shounen manga, only to end up as a shoujo manga character instead! What kind of isekai adventure story will play out between Ji Xi and that haughty tsundere prince?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A brothel tale of two brothers. Sold young by their mother, older Lan was once a great beauty, but now bears the disfiguring scars of a life in misery. Only fit for servant work, he watches over the blossoming younger Hui Hui who must now serve his first customer. As Lan wonders whether death wouldn't be kinder for them both, a customer requests him for the first time in years -- and it's a handsome young man. Can this fragile love save Lan, or will it consume the last of his hope?

title.romaji: Didi Kan Wo de Yanshen Rijian Xiee
title.native: 弟弟看我的眼神日渐邪恶

description:
A sudden wave of zombies swept across campus. MC was lucky to escape the original man-made disaster, but could not escape the turbulent suffering. Human nature, life, future, everything is crumbling. In order to survive, partners join each other and leave one after another. Under tremendous pressure of survival, can you still be able to keep your true heart and keep going as a human？

(Source: WebComics)

What should I do if my same-sex junior colleague keeps confessing to me? Not only was he confessed to, but voice actor Mingsen unexpectedly found out that the junior was actually the fan artist of his book?! Under these circumstances, the two of them have to work together to voice a gay radio drama...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: The Burning Flames of Intense Love

description:
Sienna Bowman is stuck with the abusive Ian Wolfe. When the truth emerges and she wants out, he begs her to stay. What choice will she make?

(Source: Webcomics)

Ziye Zhao, who has lost his will to live and was forced to play a terrifying "Nightmare Game". If Ziye wants to continue living, he needs to emerge victorious from each and every twisted round. Is it possible for him to find out what the nightmare that lies between life and death is all about?

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Kai Zhibo, Zai Yi Jie Hengzhe Zou
Yi Li Po Zhu Tian Wan Jie

description:
On his birthday, university student Bai XiaoShu suddenly receives a strange phone call from his father. Afterwards, he is inexplicably chased by people dressed in black who are intent on taking his life. Bai XiaoShu follows his father’s instructions and returns to his family residence. On the brink of death, he makes a contract with a devil. When he awakens, he finds himself face-to-face with an adorable girl who calls herself his maid. However, all of the strange events in his story... have only just begun...

(Source: Webnovel)

Ye Chenben is a young lord, because of a conspiracy, parents were killed, twin sisters were imprisoned; On the occasion of his death, the blood of benevolence awakened the ancient god beast and got the stunt of the god. Who is to destroy the door of the leaf house? Why is the beast and my present? And look down the young Yechen, how to change life against the heavens, the mountains and sea-sealed God!

title.romaji: Wo Bei Nanshen Ding Shang Le

description: Su Aixin, a fourth-year university student got a magic bracelet by chance. Since then, she has had the ability to change her personality, and each different personality that she changes into grants her different powerful abilities and knowledge that she never had. With this unexpected turn of events, her life has never been the same again....

The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

(Source: Webnovel)

Li Xiaorou caught her boyfriend cheating with her step-sister, then she was drugged when she got drunk at a bar. Fortunately, she was rescued by Song Chengbang, a former high school classmate who had just returned from studying abroad. The heir of a wealthy family, Song Chengbang had fond memories of Li Xiaorou from their student days, and when he returned from overseas he was determined to find her and propose. Their accidental meeting is just the start of a bittersweet courtship, as he tries to win her heart while helping her overcome her stepmother and stepsister in the battle for the Li family business.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Gonghui Bukeneng You Nühaizi
title.english: There's No Way There Are Any Girls in My Guild
title.native: 我的公会不可能有女孩子

description:
Li Yu, an introverted otaku in real life, is a veteran "Star Track Online" player. The elite guild he belongs to in the game is known among the player base as the "Gay Party" because it consists entirely of male characters. Li Yu, who has always been troubled by this, eventually finds out that he is in fact the only male player in his guild -- the other guild members are not only pretty girls who are all cute in their own ways, all of them also have deep ties with him...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Tian Shang Diao Xia Ge Hu Meimei
title.english: A Fox Girl Fell From The Sky

description:
Liu Quanyou’s father was an exorcist from a small mountain village who got into some trouble when he was dealing with a spirit. Combining that with his grandfather owing a blood debt when he was young, Liu Quanyou had been cursed by a spirit since he was a kid. He would not be able to live past 23. Not wanting to let his child walk down this path, his father started to teach him some exorcism techniques. Since Liu Quanyou had the natural ability to see spirits, a lot of talent, and had inherited a special scroll from his father, the fox deity grandpa that died saving him left him with his granddaughter, Qianqian. She was to become his fiancée, being raised along with him and was given the new name, Liu Jie. The fox demon Liu Jie was powerful, she followed Liu Quanyu, who managed to get into a university, to the city and begin their path of exorcism. At the same time, they had to find a way to break his curse, they only had three years left.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Even in the nation where Strange Tales had become a myth, occurrences of the paranormal persisted. Lu Wuji, an ordinary hoodlum, inadvertently crossed paths with the young demon huntress Xiao Zhai, and a destined adventure full of freakishness commenced...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A temp florist x the owner of a second-hand clothing store. In the busy city, these two ladies will meet by a twist of fate. But amidst a hazy tomorrow, can they find real love and an unwavering future together?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A lazy female foodie suddenly found all her snacks have disappeared! That was when a handsome man appeared and told her that he came from the future to save her from becoming a fatty?! This must be a dream, no, a nightmare!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Haomen Hunyue: Zongcai Furen You Dian Kuang
title.english: An Aristocratic Engagement: The President's Wife is a Little Wild
title.native: 豪门婚约：总裁夫人有点狂

description:
What do you do when your fiancé just can’t seem to keep it in his pants? Well, she decided to keep her options open, thinking that she could cancel the engagement… Only to find out that it wasn’t going to be as easy as she thought it would be! And so, she turned to the neighbor for help: "young master Shao, let’s strike a deal." Young master Shao huffed, "no, I can’t be bothered." "Young master Shao, are you even a mad?" "Since you say I’m not a man, I guess that I should prove to you that I’m one..."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Throughout time, there have been many special objects with exotic properties, which the ancients called "divine artifacts" and now we call them "exotic treasures". Brilliant treasures, shocking histories, exotic phenomena, and supernatural wonders... Will you accompany Luo Chen and Zhou Mu on their journey to explore this "Strange World"?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

An ordinary college student, a feared blood fiend. When the two identities overlap in the same person, how will he deal with the conflict?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

This is the story of a young photographer named Cinderella and her new budding romance!

(Source: INKR)

In a world that emphasized the martial arts, the loser Chen Ji thought he he worked hard enough, he could train himself up to overcome the school bullies. Maybe get together with the school beauty, and make something of himself. But he'll discover that the world is not quite so simple...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Is he like a cat? A dog? No, it's obviously a beast! In a small town where an incident of bloodshed suddenly occurred, Cha Na, a typical high school girl, met Yu Mu, a popular boy at school, who was suspected of being the perpetrator. As their relationship changed over time, the boy who seemed so gentle and kind at first gradually showed his true colors, and the truth behind the incidents were revealed.

(Source: Manman, translated)

Su Yuanyi comes from an immortal but anonymous clan who fight the shadow spirits formed by peoples' negative emotions, to save people's souls from being devoured. After being injured on a mission, the human boy Tang Yao was assigned to be his servant. Conflicts and misunderstandings ensued.

"Maybe Mr. Ice Cube should talk like a human being for once."
