"If you've lived for 500 years then you might understand."

Can the two work together and come to an understanding, in order to heal others and heal themselves?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zai Peng Wo Jia Tudou Shi Shi

description:
The two-faced vampire Bai Nuo and the haughty Taoist priest Shen Yanming battled each other in armor, even as they fell in love. My junior is a vampire with split personality? Which one do you love, the trusting moe side or the evil haughty side of me? Let's just have a threesome?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The human body is a representation of the world, controlled by internal desires. Desire is driven by will. The will communicates desires through the body and governs our world.

When your world becomes dazzling and shining like never before because of the arrival of a person, you should be alert. That is the collapse of will.

Indifferent college student x cold and rational associate professor.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the original work "CEO's Personal Tailor," Song Fengshi is the manager of a luxury store and unexpectedly runs into an old classmate who is now a CEO. The next day, he wakes up to discover that he had an intimate encounter with said classmate. He fled in a panic, only to later discover that the CEO had acquired their brand and had become his new boss.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Ye Zigui, one of the four well-known cultivators, was punished by his master for getting too close to the great demon, Jiang Shu. He was required to repent for three years, but he still refused to believe that Jiang Shu was the demon lord that everyone claimed he was. Until Jiang Shu attacked Tianyuan Mountain and his sect, which led to his death...

A hundred years later, Ye Zigui was brought back to life through forbidden methods. In order to find his main body, he had no choice but to sneak into the lair of the demon lord, Jiang Shu.

(Source: INKR)

title.native: 忧郁先生想过平静生活

description:
One is Earth's strongest guardian, the other a supreme being who has cleared countless dimensions and is hiding here. After they start living together, each believes the other is just an ordinary person: one works at the local sub-district office with a salary of only 2500, and the other was just forced to quit his job after accidentally injuring his boss. Now, new interdimensional invaders have appeared... What to do? Having hidden their true identities so painstakingly, when will these two ultimate powerhouses finally reveal their true selves to each other?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

"Reborn and I still ended up marrying him. Annoying."

Double rebirth, older love interest, melodramatic, a mix of sweet and angsty.

Qin Weiyu (formerly a渣 (scumbag) then loyal and gentle CEO Gong) X Ji Zhinan (tsundere, soft-hearted, naive and sweet celebrity Shou).

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Yingye Duixiang Ta Bu Tai Dui

description:
Okay, I'm listening. What? You're saying the business partner you found for me bailed? Then who is my current business partner on the show?! Help...it's actually getting more and more popular!!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Heixin Lian de Shadiao Tudi
title.native: 穿成黑心莲的沙雕徒弟

title.romaji: Yuhui Wei Wan, Gui Shi You Mao
Luo Nan Mo Zun Wan Ren Qi

description:
The leader of the Demonic Sect died and was reborn as a boy-toy in the harem of the leader of the Heavenly Sect. It turns out everyone in the harem looks like his old self! Cold playboy beauty x Fallen anti-hero.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Geile Tongguan Jiejing Da Lao Que Xiang Nian Ya Quan Tu
title.native: 我给了通关捷径大佬却想碾压全图

description:
As a GM, Liu Yu entered the "Island of No Destiny" with the goal of becoming a [human]. He intended to use his "level-clearing shortcut" plug-in to get close to the "skills" of the boss to quickly clear the level, but each of his "skills" has various pitfalls. He thought this was already miserable, but then he met the strongest boss who ignored the "level-clearing shortcut" and insisted on crushing the whole map to clear the level at the last second. From then on, quickly clearing the level became a dream. Liu Yu and the boss, with different purposes in a dangerous world, went from pulling each other into hostility, to fighting together, and finally joining hands.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In just one night, the Nouveau riche, Chen Chen, became broke and miserable. His girlfriend ran off with somebody else, and surprisingly, the culprit behind his tragedy was his own best friend. When Chen Chen almost got hit by a car, a mysterious system suddenly appeared. “Do you want to take revenge?” Chen Chen couldn't die in content that way. Since then, he got the Xue Ba system, which helped him take over the world and live without an opponent!

(Source: WebComics)

The most cunning war god in the universe ✖ The most paranoid elite in the universe

Wherever you are, I will be there, without rest or discouragement. ——Shooting Star

(Source, Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Shaoshuai Meitian Dou Zai Chicu 2: Shaoshuai Shi Cu Jing
title.native: 少帅每天都在吃醋2:少帅是醋精

description:
She is a forensic expert who died in vain and time-traveled back a hundred years ago, while he is an ambitious director of the Department of Military and Police. A shocking massacre rocked the city, leading to a twenty-year-old world-shaking mystery. Witness how she handles the vicious fights within the family, and how, together with the handsome director, they crack the puzzling crimes. Together, they are invincible!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Bai Qi Pu: Sheng Nü Dou Jiao Wo Fujun
title.native: 百妻谱：圣女都叫我夫君

description:
Gu Beichen accidentally crossed the world of Xiuzhen, but became a cowherd baby. When he was at a loss, he actually got the artifact that the ancient god Pangu waist had conjured: the Hundred Wives Spectrum! As long as a woman calls her husband, she can have their spiritual power and spiritual roots?!

“Holy Maiden, call Daddy... Ahh Listen to...”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

An Ying has recently been tormented by nightmares of being kidnapped, which feel too realistic. In order to feel more secure, An Ying chose to hire Cheng Lengyi as his bodyguard. However, during their time together, An Ying discovers that the person he personally chose to be his bodyguard is actually the one pushing him towards the abyss: Cheng Lengyi’s appearance was premeditated, and his seduction of An Ying was orchestrated by a backer behind the scenes…Who is holding such intense hatred towards him?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

After being framed for bullying his bully, Seon-U is forced to transfer to a new school. All he wants there is a peaceful life, but that flies out the window when he meets Sion, who seems friendly on the outside but has a few glaring red flags. Despite Seon-U's efforts to avoid him, Sion becomes his friend with an odd persistence and is obsessive, touchy-feely, and manipulative. Even so, Seon-U wants to trust the only person who seems to see his true self... but can he really let his guard down around him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

A comical, twisted, parenting romance that requires a miracle!

A reclusive loner, social misfit, avoidant personality disorder, and best novelist 'Gong-Jeong' is faced with newborn twins?! What a bolt from the blue! Before Gong-Jeong can even blame his mother for leaving the twins behind, he has to deal with the newborns who cry loudly! Gong-Jeong, who is at a loss and hesitating, is helped by his editor friend, Boo Seung-Hyun, who finds a babysitter. That's how 'Igi-Jeok', the god of parenting, appears. Can Gong-Jeong, who hates people so much, team up with Igi-Jeok to raise newborn twins?

A twisted and tumultuous parenting romance where two people who met as fate when they were young raise twins together and establish new understandings about life, life, and human relationships!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yoon Onghyeon has a hard time while working at a cafe called Season Cafe in Jeju. He resigns and then comes to the cafe because he trusts a senior of his, but it's about to close down. A man is surprisingly hired when they are about to give up saving the cafe, but what bothers Yoon Onghyeon is that the man is his ex-boyfriend who was abdoned by him. Facing the trouble of unemployment and bad relationships, will he succeed in both his career and love?

(Source: Webnovel)
Jaehyeok, who lost his dream due to a series of events, in front of him a ray of hope comes to find him. Placed in a Korean highschool.

The social outcast, Seria, had changed.

Seria Shuteren, the vile woman who had everyone trembling with fear at her feet, was now calm. Truthfully, the woman had not just changed; she was a completely different person. Realizing she had possessed the wicked woman's body in this romance novel, she decided to live on the low, having a hunch about the future.

She would end Seria's dreadful habits and successfully avoid her death by decapitation at the hands of Kalis, the sub male lead!

title.english: I Swear I'm Not a Scammer!

description:
Yeon-Woo's an author but his work isn't going so well and there's the slight problem of his stalker (aka his ex). When he looks for a new place to live, the landlord of the apartment is suspiciously young and way too handsome...but desperate times call for desperate measures!

(Source: Lezhin US)

In 1960s America, stoic and solitary ranch hand Dennis is hired for a summer of shepherding under a strange warning: trust nothing but the sheep. A month in, a stranger named Tod appears, claiming to be a hunter passing through. Though Dennis is wary, he finds himself slowly drawn to the man, unsettled by the pull between suspicion and desire. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can’t name, Dennis must choose. Will he hold on to his doubt, or take a chance on the one thing he’s been told not to trust?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon is the sole survivor of a devastating fire that took everything from her: her home, her status, and her family. Cast aside by the society she once called her own, she learns to survive in isolation, forging her own path. One stormy day, she is drawn by the sorrowful cries of an unusual creature, only to find a mysterious boy with snow-white hair and piercing amber eyes lying in the rain. She names him "Bibi," after the soft, sorrowful sounds he was making when she found him. Bibi remembers nothing of his past or how he came to be on earth…all he knows now is that he feels an undeniable connection to the sky, and a fierce determination to keep Yeon by his side by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

As the earth reaches its end due to environmental pollution, it wakes their ancient sleeping guardians to exterminate all mankind. A slum-born robot pilot Kay leads a war against these guardians, for the survival of humanity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Up-and-coming actor Seo Gang-U is up for "Rookie of the Year" when his former lover, industry exec Lee Ji-Won, suggests they act like a couple in public. Although they are no longer dating, Ji-Won now needs Gang-U's help to create a dating scandal that will break off an engagement set up by her family. With his lingering affection for Ji-Won, Gang-U jumps at this chance to be close to her again. Although it's all supposed to be acting, will Gang-U's real feelings for Ji-Won blow everything?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Jeong-oh is a beta who lives with his alpha friend, Yeong-won. They’ve maintained a close friendship for years now, and everything seemed fine…until Ha-yeon, the newly hired alpha at Jeong-oh’s office, brings a crucial fact to Jeong-oh’s attention: Yeong-won has been secretly showering Jeong-oh with his pheromones to keep other alphas and omegas away. As the trust in their friendship cracks and reveals hidden depths underneath, Jeong-oh must navigate his rapidly changing relationship with Yeong-won—which is going to be infinitely harder with Ha-yeon entering the picture.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her noble family falls to ruin, Stella Embrose does whatever she can to make ends meet. But her departure from high society only sparks rumors about her supposed messy relationships with men. These false rumors reach the ears of Duke Callian Rochester, Stella’s unrequited first love and her to-be husband under the emperor’s ploy to keep him in check. Believing Stella to be unworthy of him, Callian hands her a contract stating they will divorce in three years. Will this be enough time for Callian to be unblinded by his pride and see Stella for who she truly is?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Are we bound by the fate of our blood? Or do we possess it within ourselves to change our destiny? Growing up between families as a child, Dora Blunt is elated when she finally finds a place to call home in the arms of her distant aunt, Grace Blunt. Grace, having forfeit custody of her son Jack after she was deemed unfit to be a mother, views Dora as a way to correct the mistakes of her past - a gift from the heavens themselves. The two grow closer and closer, and it seems to Dora that she finally has found the place she belongs. But when Jack returns to Grace’s care, Dora finds herself experiencing mixed emotions: jealousy tinged with curiosity, joy entangled with fear, and perhaps most intensely of all, a desire to be wanted. As she feels herself being pushed back into the familiar shadows of neglect, Dora must do whatever it takes to gain control of her path in life and stay in the light.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

When a shady police inquiry causes Scarlet Crimson to have a mysterious memory lapse and unknowingly betray her cold and distant husband, Victor Dumfeldt, their fragile marriage shatters in divorce. To start anew, she returns to her family’s watchmaking trade to rebuild her life and her parents' legacy. But when Victor reenters her life, Scarlet starts to wonder if what was broken can be repaired. Between memories lost and words unspoken, can they learn from what they didn’t know the first time?

(Source: Tapas)

Yi Seo-Yo is a prince who grew up believing he was a Yang being. But when he reaches the age of thirteen, he discovers during a ceremony that he is merely a commoner, a fact that deprives him of his princely status and palace home. Just as he is about to forget about the palace’s splendor, his royal past, and Nareu-Ye, the boy he promised to take as his mate if he were a Yang being, Nareu-Ye appears in front of him with everything he has been stripped of. Then, in the distant future, Yun Seo-Yo is born, carrying the memories of his past life as Yi Seo-Yo. He meets Kwon Cha-Heon, who looks identical to Nareu-Ye but has an entirely different personality. Despite trying to distance himself from Cha-Heon due to his painful past, he gradually finds himself opening his heart to him…

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Tae-Yul moves to a quiet new town, strange things start happening — a bus drives itself, food is served in a restaurant with no staff, and the sky changes color with the flicker of a streetlight. And each time, a mysterious man chides and saves him before disappearing. But who, or what, could he be?

(Source: Manta)

A doctor disgraced by a false accusation survives by practicing medicine in the shadows, only to be claimed by the ruthless boss of a powerful mafia syndicate. When the boss loses his memory after a serious injury, cracks begin to form in their twisted relationship, hinting at a hidden past that may be more dangerous than the truth itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

There’s no laws when it comes to love. Attorney-at-law Theo Ju is haunted by the disappearance of his ex-lover, who disappeared without a trace while in possession of important evidence. Compounding his despair, the purchase of his long-desired Green House falls through, leading Theo to try and blow off steam via a one night stand with Dylan Lowell: a famous a-list actor he runs into by chance one day. But Theo is soon to learn that what once seemed to be a serendipitous encounter may instead lead to a winding path of regret…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jang Gwon-U, the illegitimate youngest son of the powerful Myeonghwa Group, is its one glaring stain—a troublemaker with devilish good looks but little else to recommend him. By his constant side is Hong Se-Ha, his ever-loyal, and workaholic, secretary. She has always genuinely and wholeheartedly assisted him and stood by his side. Against all logic, Se-Ha wanted him. No matter what. But a whispered, "Kiss me," blurs their boundaries, intertwining their bodies. Will Gwon-U and Se-Ha succeed in obtaining their captivating happily-ever-after?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

I’m Selena, a daughter born to a family well-known for their fertile women. I was all but sold off in a marriage to a sickly duke whose life hung in the balance, all for the sake of producing an heir for his family. They provided me a medicine purported to aid in pregnancy, and the astrologist advised me good days for sleeping together, but... there was no child.

“So, are there any signs of pregnancy?”
“Ah, I-I'm sorry.”
“You’re useless. What luck do you think won you the position of the duke's wife?”

I couldn't say a word.

"No, excuse me. I only have to look at the sky to pluck a star. That's how I attained this position.*"

*Metaphor: Lit. Plucking a star from the sky: something that's difficult to get/achieve)

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: A promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Is it a good or bad idea to have your ideal type as your bodyguard? Young bestselling author Han Jaehwa is about to find out. With three hit novels and a slew of film adaptations, not to mention a flood of media attention for his chic good looks, Jaehwa seems to have everything going for him…but fame comes at a price. After a stalker breaks into his home, Jaehwa decides to hire a bodyguard for some inner peace. Seong Taekyung is seasoned and capable, everything you’d want in a bodyguard. The only problem is that he’s way too hot, and Jaehwa can’t keep his eyes off him. Hounded both by a stalker and by his own turbulent feelings, Jaehwa must face not only the enemies of his past but also his own longstanding intimacy issues with Taekyung's help.

(Source: Lezhin)

After his shaman grandfather passes away, Yoon Dam suddenly gains the ability to see ghosts—a gift he would rather not have. The only solution? The power of a goblin. Enter Lee Do-Han, who claims to be exactly that. But there’s a catch: every time Do-Han tries to harm Yoon Dam, mysterious wounds appear on his own body instead. Intrigued by this bizarre connection, Do-Han proposes a deal: “Why not just let me be your tutor?” Bound by strange circumstances and their own hidden agendas, the two set off on a journey neither of them could have imagined…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lorena chose death to take revenge on the husband who ruined her life. Thrown back in time, she is determined to rewrite her destiny, protect her family, and destroy her husband. There’s only one way to win: a scandalous divorce.

“I need a wild dog… because I’m going to hunt down a hound.”

A dangerous alliance. A deadly deal. Will she be able to take everything back this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Su-Bin’s love life? A total dumpster fire. Every guy he dates is just another disappointment, and even the fortune teller he goes to for advice tells him his love life is cursed. As a muscular bottom, Su-Bin has about 0% appeal to the tops in his area…and the men he does manage to date? Yep, trash. Every. Single. Time. And so, Su-Bin swears off dating for good…until his literal dream guy walks into his life. He’s hot, he’s charming, and he’s totally Su-Bin’s type. But can he really be trusted, or is he just another beautifully wrapped disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Yeo Jooyeon has always been different. Ever since her school days, her unusually strong sexual desires pushed her to seek an unconventional career path by joining an adult toy company. For her, testing products firsthand and leaving real reviews isn’t just work… it’s pure pleasure. But amid her chaotic office life, she suddenly receives a shocking proposal from her team leader and secret crush, Lee Jungwoo:

“Jooyeon, how about becoming our model?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

To protect her brother, Hari enters the royal palace disguised as a eunuch. Despite her worries, life as a male court attendant turns out to be surprisingly peaceful. At least, until she is suddenly assigned to serve Prince Sohyeon, Lee Ryeong, known for his striking beauty and well known attraction to men, in his private chambers.

“From now on, you will attend to the prince at night.”

That very evening, Hari is ordered to help arouse the prince, a task she has no way of fulfilling. Her panic spirals, and in the chaos, her greatest fear comes true, her true identity as a woman is exposed.

“You, you are a girl.”

Now discovered in the most dangerous place possible, Hari must find a way to survive the palace, its secrets, and the gaze of the prince who holds her life in his hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jin is the most perfectly beautiful man Matthew’s ever seen. He’s also a high-ranking and violent criminal full of frustrated ambitions and equally frustrated appetites. But Matthew, a sculpture student prodigy, can only see the beauty—not the darkness. One way or another, Matthew will pay the price for his muse, with his body... or with something far more costly.

(Source: Tapas)

Su Seong-Hyeon, a successful hair designer, has been secretly in love with his best friend, Jeong Jun-Yeon. One day, Jun-Yeon asks Seong-Hyeon to tutor his younger brother, Jae-Yeon. While Seong-Hyeon believes Jae-Yeon to be a Beta, he starts to faintly sense pheromones from him. Then, one day, Seong-Hyeon discovers a piece of clothing soaked in pheromones among the gifts he received from Jae-Yeon. Overcome by the pheromones, he experiences an unusual heat. At that moment, while on a call with Jun-Yeon, he ends up pleasuring himself to the sound of his voice...

"What kind of insane Omega spreads their pheromones like this?!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

An accidental deal with the devil goes awry.

Veterinary student Yoon Ha discovers he has a fear of blood! To solve his problem, he makes a deal with the demon Samael in exchange for his soul, which goes terribly wrong. Now Yoon must help Samael recover his demonic powers... but evil spirits keep showing up, lusting after Yoon's body?!

(Source: Manta)

Defeated in war, Geon-Mu, a former emperor, loses all power and is taken as a prisoner by the enemy nation. Stripped of dignity and freedom, he is forced to become the personal plaything of the beautiful yet merciless, Yeon-Hwa. Yeon-Hwa, who once forcefully claimed Geon-Mu’s body, now seeks to control every aspect of his life—his movements, his thoughts, even his emotions. And yet, each night, the emperor weeps, asking if Geon-Mu has truly forgotten him, whispering confessions of love through trembling lips.

“Your Majesty... you are beautiful.”

But Geon-Mu can no longer tell if the turmoil in his heart is hatred or something far more dangerous. As the line between enemy and lover begins to blur, Geon-Mu is left questioning: Is this agony the product of betrayal… or the weight of a love that should never have existed?

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Princess Alisa is framed for a terrible crime, she is shocked to learn that her own family wants her executed. Feeling defeated, she finds herself reborn as the princess of a rival empire. And though her new family acts sweet and kind on the surface, she’s not sure they can be truly trusted. Luckily, with this new life comes new power. But what exactly is this mysterious magic that awakens in her? And more importantly, can she use it to get vengeance against those who once betrayed her?

(Source: Tapas)

Former kendo prodigy Jae-Hyeok has lost his way, spiraling far from his golden days. The only person capable of reining him in is Yeong-Won, a steadfast police officer with a heart of gold. Though they couldn’t be more different, these single fathers find their back into each other's lives. As Jae-Hyeok moves in to learn the ropes of parenting, his Alpha instincts awaken, blurring the lines between duty and desire in a domestic whirlwind romance.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)
“Why do you keep asking if we’re dating? We’re just holding hands, we’re not dating!!” It’s a slice-of-life romantic comedy about couples who aren’t really couples!

"Watch out for the guy with the ponytail,” a warning Lee Myung-il heard on his first day in prison. But when he unintentionally rescues the central figure of the rumors, Choi Jingi, it takes an unexpected turn. And with Jingi’s younger brother, Heonjae, involved, things get even messier...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Se-Han wasn’t expecting to be turned on...but after catching a glimpse of Chan-Hyeong in bed with another man, he can’t shake the curiosity. As Se-Han begins to grow closer to Chan-Hyeong, Jin-Wu, who’s always had feelings for Se-Han, starts to suspect something. Fueled by jealousy and a few too many drinks, Jin-Wu confronts Se-Han one night. Se-Han’s response? He makes an unexpected proposition…one that blurs every line between friendship and desire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

When veterinarian Yoohee Han dies early, a grim reaper sends her into the world of a novel she once read to live out the rest of her time as the side character Alexa. She uses her knowledge of the novel (and of animals) to take on a more prominent role as the trainer of Isildus, heir of Terrecion, a wolf shifter who will remain in animal form until his 16th birthday. She becomes a beloved advisor in Terrecion castle, and her actions change the fates of other characters. How will little Issy feel about her when he becomes human?

(Source: Tapas)

It’s the apocalypse, and Seoyoung wakes up in a desolated world without any memories. He wanders around until he comes across Younghyun, an esper with the ability to summon and control fire. The two trek across a city of ruins, trying to recover Seoyoung’s lost memories. But Younghyun seems too familiar with the city as it is. There’s something he’s not telling Seoyoung, and it seems the two used to know each other from before. But he’s all Seoyoung has for now… Both of them need a way out of their darkness, but could they be the guiding light for each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

When Yiren catches her fiancé and her crafty sister Rielle kissing, something in her snaps. She decides she must get married in order to escape her family. Yiren happens to learn that the icy, aloof Noel Cristan is looking for a bride in order to inherit his father's title of archduke. They agree to an arranged marriage to get what they both want, but it turns out Noel isn't the only one after his father's title. With all the family drama and intrigue, will Noel's family be any safer for Yiren?

(Source: Tapas)

For as long as he can remember, Chaemin’s been an unlucky guy. But he’s also learned that there’s nothing he can do but pull himself up by his bootstraps and do the best with what he’s got… until he’s hit by a truck and dies. Or at least that’s what Chaemin thought when he was rudely awakened by a grim reaper who, to Chaemin’s surprise, decides they’re willing to give him a second chance at life! All Chaemin has to do for the soap-opera-loving reaper is make a “happy ending” with his fated partner, Cheon Woojoo. But Woojoo is the one guy Chaemin just can’t stand. How is he supposed to turn this hateful situation… into a fated one?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Cheongha Kim, a legendary swordswoman from the Joseon era, awakens centuries later in the body of Dajin Park, a quiet high school student. Armed with deadly combat skills, Cheongha must face school bullies, navigate the chaos of modern-day life, and find her place in a world far different from her own. The halls of Juwon High are about to meet a warrior unlike any they’ve seen before.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Lady Awaits a Broken Engagement

description:
After being separated from her mother, Savina is forced to live with her uncle and the Charlots, who despise her. To make things worse, due to the memories of her past life, Savina learns she'll be killed by Prince Ricardo if she remains in her new home. But before she can convince her uncle to send her somewhere else, she discovers that Ricardo will be coming to stay with the Charlots. With this turn of events, will Savina successfully change her future? Or does fate have other plans for her?

(Source: Tapas)

When skeptic Je-Hyeon and paranormal-obsessed Yeong-Hu become unlikely roommates, they think they’ve lucked into the deal of the century: a huge apartment for an unbelievably cheap price. But they soon learn why the rent was so low... You see, something else is living there, and it’s very interested in them! Now the two opposites must survive a nosy, perverted ghost and the bizarre mysteries of their new home…together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The most powerful families of the court owe their influence to three things: property, titles, and magic. House Konbayazen, lacking a sorcerer, became a laughingstock among fellow aristocrats; that is, until the head of their House took his daughter Sabina and invited the curse of death upon her - turning her into “death incarnate.” This curse causes any who utter Sabina’s name to catch a fatal illness and contact with her flesh causes one’s own to rot away. This new power allows her father to monger fear, killing anyone who dare stand in his way.

After countless years of abuse at the hands of her father, Sabina is allowed to convalesce in the countryside to regain her strength. He sends her to an empty, abandoned village with the imperial knight Erzan Muskovayev to be her bodyguard… But there is something different about Erzan. Normally repulsed by the heat of another person’s body, Sabina immediately finds an abnormal comfort in his presence. What’s more, Erzan seems immune to any curse that he encounters.

As the two spend time together in the seemingly haunted village, they find themselves inexplicably drawn to each other, in a way neither knew was possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eveness wakes up as the wicked princess of a novel who's doomed to die on her wedding day. Determined to change her destiny, she rebuilds her reputation and convinces her cold fiancé Grand Duke Terence Lenz into a partnership to prevent this impending peril. However, as she alters the story, unexpected twists arise—Terence’s hatred turns to passionate love, and new dangers loom. Can Eveness navigate this altered fate and find true happiness, or will the unknown challenges consume her?

(Source: Tapas)

I became the wife of a man who already had a lover.
So, I should do my best to help him remain faithful to her, right?

But how did I end up destroying the bed with him on our first night together...?

***

Aristine is a royal princess who's been confined all her life, as she is highly disfavored by the emperor.
But the truth is, as the possessor of the [Royal Sight], she can see the past, present, and future.

The emperor sends her off to die in a political marriage arranged with the prince of their enemy country, rumored to be a bloodthirsty savage, but...
Her soon-to-be husband, the so-called "savage," is far more normal than the rumors suggest.

"Still, he's taken, so he's off-limits for me. I'll just focus on making lots of money from now on!"

Will Aristine be able to fulfill her dream of living a luxurious, wealthy life?
Or will she be able to kill two birds with one stone and win over her husband as well?

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

Yin Tae-Rim, CEO of a failing company, turns to Seo Yi-Rin, a powerful executive with a reputation for sponsoring the lovers she takes a liking to. Desperate to save his business, he makes his move, but Yi-Rin already has a new “puppy” to play with and shows no interest. Instead, she passes him along. Not to a colleague. Not to a rival. To her husband.

That’s how Tae-Rim ends up in front of Jin Ha-Kyung, the cold and unreadable head of a major company. Ha-Kyung listens, watching him squirm through an awkward explanation. Then, with a slow smile tugging at his lips, he makes a proposal that stops Tae-Rim cold.

"Forget my wife. Try me."

(Source: Lezhin US)

While filming a TV animal program about feral dogs tearing up an apartment complex’s trash area, the crew stumbles upon a mysterious man living among them…who just so happens to be the boss of a gang of loan sharks. With no one able to train the man-beast, he is brought to Lee Ji-Ryong: star dog trainer in a heap of debt. In exchange for bringing their boss back to form, the sharks promise to eliminate all of his debt. Jumping at the opportunity, Ji-Ryong takes it on…only to find out that this wild “canine” companion has both bite and bark alike.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the nation of Seora, Yehwa Aryun is the Empress Regnant, and her court is full of consorts with special powers. The newest member of the imperial court is 8-year-old Sanya Yeoran. And although she has no powers, Sanya actually has the mind of an adult who knows exactly what will happen in this fantasy world, because she already read about it in her past life. Thanks to that, she comes up with a plan to avoid her tragic execution: stay away from Yehwa and her jealous consorts at all costs!

Seungjun works part-time singing congratulatory songs at weddings, and Jaehyun quit his job to work as an emcee for a wedding hall. The two end up crossing paths by chance. Will the talkative and personable Jaehyun be able to ruffle the feathers of the usually calm and collected Seungjun?

(Source: Lezhin)

Kwon Tae-Shin is a man worn thin by indulgence. A VIP at the exclusive members-only club Zeus, he buys fleeting nights with ease, yet never repeats the same encounter twice, forever chasing something that can cut through his suffocating boredom. Lee Won-Woo, a low-level club employee and the sole provider for his family, never expects to cross Tae-Shin’s path until he is assigned to drive him home one night. On a whim, Tae-shin makes him an offer that changes everything, proposing to buy a night with him instead. Stunned but tempted by the staggering amount of money, Won-Woo accepts, only to emerge from the experience shaken and regretful. He tries to avoid Tae-shin afterward, hoping to put it all behind him. But Tae-Shin is no longer bored.

Fixated on the one man who managed to leave a mark on him, he begins to pursue Won-Woo with unsettling persistence, turning a single reckless decision into a dangerous and irresistible entanglement.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Secretary Yeon-woo flees to her hometown of Moksan County, facing the harassment of Vice President Yoon-seok. There, she meets Seong-heon, the executive director of Seolyang Construction. Seong-heon's once icy heart melts and seeps into Yeon-woo, who resembles the warmth of spring. Meanwhile, Yoon-seok sets out to find Yeon-woo...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: There Are No Bad Warriors in This World

description:
Hyeonseok Choi finally becomes the undisputed heavyweight MMA champion of the world, but gets hit by a truck, and dies. A fairy, Rahel, appears and convinces him to fight as a hero in the afterlife, but accidentally sends him to the side of the demons. Stuck in the demon world, he sweet talks his way into positions of power, but slowly discovers this battle between good and evil isn't as clearcut as it seems.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kwon Ji-Hyeok, a good-for-nothing who’s lived his whole life relying solely on the handsome face he inherited from his parents, finds himself kicked out of his girlfriend’s house with nowhere else to go. While wandering in search of his next place to freeload, he stumbles upon a mansion with its door left open and decides to sneak in. But inside, he’s greeted by the horrifying sight of a dismembered corpse. Sensing imminent doom, he tries to escape, only for the missing homeowner to appear right then and there. One look is all it takes for Ji-Hyeok to realize it: this guy definitely has the face of a serial killer.

For someone who’s always coasted through life on his looks, this is the biggest crisis he’s ever faced. To survive, Ji-Hyeok might have to pull his most desperate move yet, using his charm to seduce this psychopathic killer. Because if he fails, it won’t just be his pride that gets pierced.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

"You and she won't work".

Since the night they faced destiny, something seems off about their friendship. Friends who've been close since childhood for over 10 years, Hae-Young, who has developed feelings for Ye-Ji, asks for help from his friend, I-Su, who is known for his power of foresighting. I-Su discovers that the one who loves Han Ye-Ji will inevitably get hurt. Despite I-Su's warning to stay away from Ye-Ji, Hae-Young still chooses her, and I-Su is determined to keep them apart by any means necessary...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kyun-Woo is the model employee—efficient, respected, and perfectly composed. But beneath his spotless image hides a secret he refuses to name: a submissive yearning tied to urophilia. He has kept that desire buried, dismissing it as shameful and unreal. That is, until one day he catches a glimpse of Hyo-Won, his new junior, silently struggling to hold it in. Something fractures. Something awakens. And for the first time, Kyun-Woo finds himself craving a role he never dared to imagine... one that would place him entirely beneath someone else’s control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After 13 years away from his hometown, Siu returns, reuniting with childhood friends he hasn't seen since "that incident" drove them apart. Though awkwardness lingers, their warm reception reassures him. But after a night of celebration, Siu wakes up to a shocking discovery—a kiss mark on his neck. Who could be responsible?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seung-Jeong inherits a shamanic power that only activates through intense pleasure shared with someone on the same wavelength. After a chance encounter at a casino ties him to Ga-Yoon, the two reunite under dangerous circumstances when Ga-Yoon’s adoptive father dies in a suspicious accident. Bound by desire and a dangerous power, they grow closer as they search for the truth.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

Born gay, born single Kang Woo-Jin. He's been secretly in love with Choi Yi-Tae, the transfer student he met in his second year of high school, all the way to his current age of thirty. Kang Woo-Jin couldn't betray the friendship he shared with Choi Yi-Tae during their youthful days, convincing himself it was okay to remain just friends. But when Choi Yi-Tae starts pestering him to move in together, Kang Woo-Jin finds himself facing an unavoidable dilemma.

“I'm gay.”

“What does you being gay have to do with us living together?”

Dragged into cohabitation, Kang Woo-Jin begins living with him. Months later, an incident finally pushes him past the line of friendship.

“Kang Woo-Jin, how do you have sex with a guy?”

There was no way he knew. He'd tried with other men, but never followed through. He could only think of this guy right in front of him. It had been 13 years of unrequited love. Now that we've crossed the line of friendship, what exactly are we?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.romaji: Cheongchun BL Danpyeonseon: Eorin Gochuga Tteugeopda
title.english: Good Things Come in Young Packages

description:
A collection of stories featuring hot guys in even hotter scenarios. Red blooded young men doing what they do best: exploring each other's bodies and giving in to temptation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

1-4. A Most Perfect Shape (가장 완벽한 도형) [Ujubihaengsa]
5-8. Caught Red-Hot-Handed (그 놈은 조폭 마누라) [Pugak x Guesa]
9-12. Top of the World (세계 최고의 탑) [Milokseo x Hyangtok]
13-16. Spot Landing (스팟랜딩) [Hya Kim x Jintae]
17-20. Get Me Heated (페이스 어 히트) [Chunsim]

Stuck between two men with the same face, I'm driven mad between them. Helplessly drowning in the pleasure they push upon me.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Hana thought she would only be haunted by the demons of the past, however, she soon learns that demons come in many shapes and sizes. After coming in contact with lust demon Luxuria, Hana soon finds herself wanted by just about every lust demon that exists. There’s something about her body that makes her absolutely irresistible, making her the perfect prey. While she’s trying to get her head around this, Luxuria comes up with a preposterous proposition which involves…entering a contract with him?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A romance of temptation and trepidation. Eun-Ha, a peasant girl, is asked by a blind nobleman, Ji-Hak, to become his reading assistant. Though reluctant, she accepts the shady Ji-Hak's offer in hopes of earning enough money to free her sister from the courtesan life. And thus begins a dangerous romance of hidden intentions and passion.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Gyo-ha and Jun-oh were once each other’s first love, but they eventually broke up due to sexual incompatibility. Ten years later, Gyo-ha, now an investment professional searching for fresh opportunities, stumbles upon a dating app called “AM2”—and unexpectedly reconnects with Jun-oh. Wanting more than just nostalgia, Gyo-ha proposes a casual fling—an offer Jun-oh eagerly accepts. However, as Jun-oh's feelings grow stronger, he begins to fear that history might repeat itself, and that his affection will only push Gyo-ha further away. Caught between nostalgia and desire, can they truly keep things casual, or will their unresolved emotions threaten to change everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.

Actor Yoo Haek-Yeong has been in love with his spoiled friend Seo Kwon-Yeong for more than 10 years. Not only is it a hopeless love, but it’s downright abuse as Kwon-Yeong takes complete advantage of Haek-Yeong’s feelings to constantly boss him around. Haek-Yeong just can’t help letting Kwon-Yeong string him along… until he connects with his crush’s older brother, Kwon-Lim, the top actor in Korea. Unlike his manipulative brother, Kwon-Lim is thoughtful and kind—and incredibly handsome. As Haek-Yeong grows closer to Kwon-Lim, the dynamic between him and his old friend begins to shift—and so do Haek-Yeong’s long-harbored feelings…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Min Harang’s future is clear. Go to KNU law school, become a prosecutor, and be successful. At least, that’s what her mother wants. But when Harang fails the entrance exam, she has to come to terms with the fact that her mother’s wishes might not line up with Harang’s own. Out sulking in the rain after an explosive argument, help comes in the form of her sex-crazed neighbor - the very man who’s constant moaning distracted her from studying! And since it’s his fault anyway, it’s only fair that he take responsibility, right? But there’s more to the man that first appears, and soon Harang finds herself coming face to face with a different form of family. It just goes to show that home is truly where the heart is.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Abandoned by her parents and friends, Choi Yeon is a struggling college student determined to escape poverty. To conceal her circumstances, she takes a job as an in-house tutor for Ji Shinwoo, the reserved youngest son of a wealthy family. There, she meets his older brother, Ji Sinhyeok, the arrogant and possessive eldest son of the house. Before long, Sinhyeok ropes Yeon into running odd errands for him, pulling her into his world. Despite his cold and crude remarks and domineering attitude, Yeon finds herself drawn to him, torn between frustration and the hope that he might desire her too.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Jang Jae-Woong is a golden boy. Kind-hearted and sharp-eyed but somewhat ditzy, he falls in love at first sight with Sim Jae-Yul, a man he meets on campus. Everything is all well and good until Jae-Woong starts centering his life around Sim in an attempt to catch his eye…and a momentary mistake lands the two not only in a life-threatening situation, but a whirlwind relationship!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.

Once known as the White Night Witch, Alisia is reborn without her powers as a young princess neglected by her father, the emperor. When she regains her magic after hearing the news of his death in battle, she plans to rule the chaotic empire herself... That is, until the emperor returns alive. Now, Alisia must mend fences with her father while also handling schemes and secrets lurking around them. Will these two, so different yet so similar, make amends and work together? Or is it all too late?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Please Get Out of My Family

description:
Favey Croshe founded her house on an agreement with elemental kings, giving her descendants elemental affinity...all except Winadella, that is. When Winny is kicked out of the house for being useless, Favey awakens from a 300-year death to possess Winny and help her get revenge on the family who cast her out like trash. Luckily, one of her old pupils, the half-dragon Wallika, is willing to help his master humble the arrogant elementalists and...maybe even offer Winny a new home.

(Source: Tapas)

Mary Siringa has finally realized the error of her ways as a spoiled burden to her family. In her search for a job, she runs into Prince Grandiel, disguised as his alter ego, Nepenthes. Intrigued by Mary, Grandiel draws up a magical contract for her to be a maid in the imperial palace and work as his spy. Now, Mary must protect Grandiel's secret identity and comply with the other clauses of her contract, or else her heart will explode! Can Mary keep her true self hidden, or will she die trying?

(Source: Tapas)

Lee-Won, who works as a poor lawyer in Russia, visits City Councilor Zdanov, who is in conflict over Nikolai's commission, and there he meets the mafia boss, Caesar. Behind City Councilor Zdanov, there was a mafia involved. The meeting between the two is extraordinary.

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 37 side story chapters and 1 special.

Freelance photographer Felix accidentally walks into the wrong hotel room and meets Uriel, who mistakes him for a hired companion. After a chaotic misunderstanding, they become strangely connected. Felix starts having drowning nightmares and, as he investigates, discovers unsettling truths about Uriel and the origin of his dreams, pulling him into a web of mystery and danger.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A-Jin is a carefree high school girl interested only in baking and is a loyal friend who values her bonds above all. Despite her ordinary appearance, she garners the interest of Jun-U, one of the most handsome guys at her school, adding a newfound excitement and unpredictability into her life. Will they be able to overcome the jealous manipulations of others and realize their feelings for each other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

In the eight years since he disappeared, Choi Kang-Woo has become a notorious gangster in the neighborhood. That cold and scary Choi Kang-Woo still likes me.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Struggling actor Hyeon-Su Kim suddenly gains a strange ability after an accident: he can dream the dreams of the dead. These aren’t hazy nightmares or random visions, but vivid relivings of emotions and experiences that don’t belong to him. When Hyeon-Su channels those experiences into his roles, his acting becomes terrifyingly real, as if he’s truly possessed. But how far can a haunted genius go before the dreams start consuming him?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yeon Ji-Hoon is the leader of an idol group that’s hit a dead-end in their career. Now, he’s received a golden opportunity to save his group: a spot on the year’s most anticipated reality show, where he’ll spend two weeks living and filming with top stars Do Yoo-Jin and Seon Yo-Han. The one threat to the show’s success? Yoo-Jin and Yo-Han won’t stop having sex with each other.

To stop a scandal from tanking the show and his career, Ji-Hoon must keep his co-stars’ antics hidden from the cameras at all costs. Will Ji-Hoon be able to keep these steamy shenanigans a secret for two weeks? And will he survive when both of his co-stars turn their attention on him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: chapter count includes three bonus chapters and nine AU chapters.

First impressions are everything, right? But it doesn’t seem that way when Yi-Kyung comes across Joo-Bin. When they first meet, Joo-Bin is just a handsome stranger with an exciting air of mystery. Yi-Kyung itches to draw him, to sketch out his beauty on paper like the artist he is… But at their next encounter, Joo-Bin is a completely different person. Sensitive, outspoken, and passionate about his own work as a photographer, he proposes that Yi-Kyung become his model. And drawn to this other side of his, Yi-Kyung says yes. Between lens and paper, who’ll be the first to sketch out the other to perfection?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A one-night stand turns into a messy love story.
Josh, a brilliant lawyer and obsessive neat freak, is coping with a broken engagement. The only upside? His firm changed cleaning services. But when the new cleaner is Angel—his one-night stand from last night—chaos ensues. Is this love or just a messy disaster waiting to unfold?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Erna Hardy is the daughter of a ruined noble family, and she's a fish out of water among the elites of Lechen's high society. But this country bumpkin makes a giant splash when her official debut is interrupted by Prince Björn Dniester, the kingdom's "Royal Poisonous Mushroom." Suddenly, Erna is the hot topic on everyone's lips, and Prince Björn decides that courting the young lady will help him thwart persistent reconciliation attempts from his pining ex-wife. It's not until Erna unwittingly finds herself becoming a pawn in the prince's toxic game that she realizes how he's earned himself such a venomous title. And despite her best attempts to steer clear of his royal mess, an innocent mistake leaves her indebted to the prince indefinitely. Now, she's at his mercy as she works to pay off her debt. But is this royal mushroom really as deadly as everyone says?

(Source: Tappytoon)

What if a myth from 300 years ago wasn’t just a myth? According to Joseon legends, it has been told that Haechi, the youngest son of the Jade Emperor, was inseparable from the Princess So-yang. Following the recent discovery of the princess’s tomb, Lee Young-gwang is chosen to curate the exhibition. However, it seems there were more than just ruins in the tomb that was excavated… Haechi reappears in modern-day Korea to search for his princess. Will he be able to find her? And is Young-gwang ready for the adventure that awaits her, full of danger and centuries-old vengeance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-Woo’s love life has been nothing but a series of runaway men - all thanks to his freaky fetishes. But just when he’s about to give up, along comes Jae-Hyun: a perfect face, silky baritone voice, and fingers that look like they were sculpted by the gods. He’s everything Yeon-Woo’s ever dreamed of…and more. Determined to make Jae-Hyun his own, Yeon-Woo pulls his usual rich-guy schemes; but try as he might, Jae-Hyun remains totally unfazed. One drunken night, however, Jae-Hyun lets the truth slip: this handsome hung hunk hungers for someone who knows who take the lead. A guy who checks all his boxes and wants to be trained? Yeon-Woo’s dream project begins now.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: It Wasn’t Supposed to Be Like This

description:
Overwhelmed by the endless affection of her overly clingy boyfriend Se-in, Roha finally decides to call it quits. But when Se-in keeps acting like nothing ever happened, she starts to wonder…are they really broken up, or still together somehow? In the middle of her confusion, Yeonjun suddenly moves in as a boarder - young, hot and secretly in love with Roha for the past ten years. Between an ex who won’t let go and a long-time admirer living under her roof, Roha’s love life is about to spiral completely out of control. It really wasn't supposed to be like this...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

12 men and 12 women are kidnapped and left on a remote island, where no laws exist. If they survive on this island for 10 months, they win $500,000. This is the story where true human nature is revealed. Welcome to project Utopia.

(Source: Toomics)

Baekya is childhood friends with Jichan, a well-known trash magnet. It has been and always will be Baekya's job to console Jichan after every one of his bad break-ups. One day, as Baekya was consoling Jichan yet again, the most popular boy in school, Lee Hyeon, appears in front of them. Knowing Hyeon's infamous streak of break-ups and bad boy stories, Baekya tries to stop Sichuan from falling for Hyeon when Jichan falls for him head over heels. Jichan even boldly asks Baekya to become friends with Hyeon just so he could set them up with each other. Baekya begrudgingly accepts and tries his best to become close to Hyeon, when one day Hyeon approaches him first and asks "Don't you think you're making it too obvious? I know you like me, but think you can stop it now?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joon-hwi has always been a beta. Which is a relief, given how his best friend and nationally beloved actor Seok-hyun hates omegas, and there’s no way Joon-hwi’s crush on him would be requited otherwise. But one day, when Joon-hwi discovers he might be the exact thing Seok-hyunh hates, everything spirals out of control…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes a prologue.

Ju-Hyeok is a clueless beta who is thrust into the messy world of alpha-omega dynamics when he leaves his wholesome beta college to work at a more diverse company. There, a full-on fistfight and loud makeup knotting in the bathroom isn't "workplace violence" and "sexual harassment," but just your run-of-the-mill lovers' quarrel. Repulsed by the pheromones that trump common sense in this crazy environment, Ju-Hyeok swears himself off dating until he saves up enough money to move to a faraway haven for betas. Unfortunately, fate seems to be working against him when he somehow attracts both the flirtatious alpha director and the cute omega junior at his company without lifting a finger. Can Ju-Hyeok flee the clutches of the dating world with his sanity intact, or will he fall victim to the pesky palpitations of his heart?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Lee Doosan is a master of the arcade. The only place he can find reprieve from the agony of adolescence, the games there act as an outlet for the stress and strain of daily life. But when he runs into his childhood best friend at the hottest spot in town—Justice Arcade—the real games begin. As the two boys try to reconcile their complicated feelings about the past with the realities of the present, will they be able to achieve a high score for their futures? Or is this reunion "game over" from the get-go...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I'm a Doll, but the Tyrant Is Obsessed With Me

description:
Others usually appear as a human when they possess a character in a book, but I possessed a doll... the favorite doll of a tyrant whose neck went flying because of the male lead.

"I’ve already died once, but I don’t want to die again!"
"To survive, I must edify the tyrant. To do that, I must first move my body… What? Oh, it’s moving?"
“Are you really Chloe? No, who are you?”

The young emperor of the Burgundy Empire and a tyrant with the end faith of dying. Reclaim my body while edifying him!

(Source: Comikey, edited)

I lived to the age of 19, only to be constantly taken advantage of by fake family members. With the vow to seek revenge still fresh in my mind, I made the choice to live my life again. Yet why have I returned to the night I was kidnapped from a burning castle?

"Hwelp me! Hwelp me! The willian ish twaking Maedie!"

My savior ended up being the enemy's son?! For days and nights I followed him to the enemy's castle, but upon arrival, a warm welcome...

"Ack! Father! Second Brother's picked up another living thing!"

...wasn't what awaited me.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: Webcomic prologue of the homonym web novel.

Ryu Ji-Woo wakes up to a nightmare: blindfolded and leashed, he awakes in the basement of a madman. In order to see the one he loves again, he will have to bend to his master’s will, forgoing his sense of decency for the chance to escape and see the sunlight once more…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

Doo-San and Tae-San were inseparable as teens, just two boys, side-by-side at their favorite arcade. Now reunited as adults, nothing’s changed…and yet everything has. Their bond is as tight as ever, but lately, the air between them crackles with something more. Doo-San can’t stop overthinking every glance, every brush of skin, every heartbeat. Just when he thinks he can keep burying those feelings, someone new shows up, ready to drive a wedge right through whatever’s been building between them. Unless Doo-San can work up the courage to face his own feelings, that is...

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where hunter rank is everything, Rank F Yun Seo-Ra is lucky to even have a job at the Hunter Association. But when she's trapped in a dungeon, she yells at the system, blaming her inability to escape on her low rank. Out of pity, it offers her an exclusive contract, which Seo-Ra accepts, soaring to Rank S! She begs the system to keep this a secret until she can earn enough money to quit her job. Can Seo-Ra resign with riches, or will her fellow Rank S hunters track her down first?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: It Was Just a Contractual Marriage

description:
I, the last princess, will use you to survive! As the last remaining member of the imperial family, Elise must do whatever she can to survive and someday reclaim her empire, even if that means marrying the archduke of an enemy nation and promising to bear his child! As a dragonborn, he needs an heir, and it's not as though he loves her... right?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Jang Hyeok-Jun, the second son of a chaebol family, is infamous for scandals, nightlife disasters, and giving his father chronic headaches. Finally fed up, his father hires a personal monitor to keep him in line. But the man who shows up is the last person Hyeok-Jun ever expected, Choi Jeong-Heon, the ex who ghosted him four years ago and left him shattered. Hyeok-Jun is furious. If his father will not fire Jeongheon, then he will drive him out himself. He throws tantrums, picks fights, and schemes nonstop, but Jeong-Heon remains calm, unbothered, and frustratingly professional. Digging through memories of their breakup, Hyeok-Jun finally stumbles upon the perfect plan for revenge.

“I found it. The way to completely ruin Choi Jeong-Heon…!”

But as he launches his little war, the line between torment and attraction begins to blur, and Hyeok-Jun discovers that the one person he wants to destroy might also be the one he still cannot let go.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite living in a dystopian world ruled by an insane dictator and reinforced by his discriminatory values, Victor managed to lead a happy life thanks to his wife, Julia. Unfortunately, that life is torn to pieces after she is cruelly murdered by the dictator's Special Security Unit. Grief-stricken and enraged, Victor swears to avenge Julia by entering a survival game that might give him a chance to meet his targets. But can Victor win this battle royale, where only the strongest survive?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Adele, the knight of the grand order, is struck with despair when he witnesses Vayne sharing a secret romance with Marshal Kyle, his superior. Yet, amidst his heartbreak, he finds himself imagining what it would be like to be in love Vayne. As the turmoil deepens, Kyle, now aware of Adele’s true feelings, makes him a forbidden, yet tempting proposal...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Erofan Short Story Collection (에~로판 단편선) or the Steamy Collection in english.

Jeong-Ueom has avoided his arranged marriage for years, but with mounting pressure from the other family, he can no longer delay. Yet, his heart has already been claimed by someone irreplaceable—his younger brother, Dong-Im. Dong-Im is not only Jeong-Yeom’s forbidden love but also the one Jeong-Yeom has kept by his side, no matter the cost. In the biting chill of winter, longing for a spring that may never come, Jeong-Yeom finds himself once again drawn to Dong-Im’s room.

“Dear brother, how does it feel? How does it feel to marry my woman?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english.

Ju-Won is a new hire in the product development team of a tea manufacturing company, quietly nursing a crush on his handsome and composed supervisor, Assistant Manager Yul. Content to admire from afar, Ju-Won keeps his feelings to himself—until one day, Yul suddenly frowns and asks, “Did someone wear perfume in the office?”

Ju-Won denies it, but Yul insists there’s a scent that only seems to linger when he’s around. Intrigued, Yul starts leaning in close, sniffing Ju-Won during every encounter under the guise of a “smell check.” What begins as an awkward misunderstanding turns into a daily ritual—one that leaves Ju-Won flustered, especially as his body begins to react to Yul’s warm breath and closeness. Caught between the sweetness of unspoken affection and the thrill of their strange new routine, Ju-Won wonders…

Could Yul be picking up more than just a scent?

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Han Sorang was hired as a model for a photoshoot, he didn’t realize just how…authentic the director would want it to be. As if being brought to a dusty old palace and forced into women’s clothing isn’t enough, Sorang’s day gets even stranger when a charm appears out of nowhere and sends him into a deep slumber. When he awakes, he thinks he is totally alone, until a man - no, a beast! - appears, declaring them spouses. Things are moving way too fast for Sorang, especially when the creature reveals himself to be gifted with an extra member. Two heads may be better than one, but three is far, far too many!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A girl whose wish is to see the ocean. A boy who is afraid of the outdoors goes on a school trip that was canceled to fulfill her wish.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Everyone loves Mr. Perfect, team leader Ji Do-Hoon-- except for one person, that is. For the past two years, Da-Jung has only had eyes for her coworker, Hyun-Woo. On the night of the company dinner, Da-Jung runs after him as he leaves and asks him to be her boyfriend. However, once the tall figure she confesses to steps out of the shadows, Da-Jung realizes she was talking to none other than Mr. Perfect himself! But what’s more shocking is… he agrees to date her! What in the world is he thinking?!

(Source: Tapas)

Kang Yui lost his parents in an accident, and has been blaming himself ever since. As bad things keep happening to those who try to get close to him, he decides to shut himself off from the rest of the world and live a life of solitude. But then comes the effervescent Lee Hyun, his new roommate at university: with his motto of “never give up,” Hyun is determined to wiggle his way into Yui’s heart, one way or another. But is Hyun bound to be beaten in this battle? Or is there still room for love in Yui’s life?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"My name is Song Gi-Tae. I’m 20 years old. That’s all I remember."

Gi-Tae wakes up in a windowless room, with no memory of how he got there—only the steady rhythm of three meals a day delivered by the ever-gentle Cha Ji-Hun to hint at the passage of time. No matter how cold or cutting Gi-Tae becomes, Ji-Hun only responds with warm smiles and tender concern. But trust is a luxury Gi-Tae can’t afford. Not when the man bringing him food…is the same one who cut off his foot.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

Seyeong's lips met Jeha’s, a seal being pressed to paper, igniting an overwhelming rush of pleasure that left his breath ragged. Instinctively, Jeha's tongue sought hers, hungry and primal, as though he were a beast claiming its prey. Just as he lost himself in the moment, a sudden slap on his back jolted him back to reality. He pulled away, laughing bitterly, brushing the back of his hand against her flushed lips. The cool night air did nothing to quell the heat surging through Seyeong’s body, her skin damp with sweat. That single kiss was so intense, it left her breathless—wondering just how much more her body could endure beyond that single, fiery connection…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seol Ipsae likes to keep things simple and clean: relationships never go further than physical, and one night per guy is the standard, and only the best will do. So when he runs into the big, bumbling himbo Jeong Han-Eum, he can’t believe his eyes; at first, it’s because the dude’s such a nerd, but then it’s because this nerd is hiding a big, uh, “secret.” Huge, in fact. Massive. One of the biggest Ipsae has ever seen. Y’know, maybe nerdy boys aren’t so bad after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes six side story chapters.

Ju-Han is a devout deacon who regularly volunteers at an orphanage where Seong-Mi resides. Drawn by curiosity, Seong-Mi visits the church, only to stumble upon a shocking sight—Ju-Han, the very picture of restraint and virtue, consumed by his own forbidden desires, punishing himself in secret. A dangerous temptation begins to take root.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Seol Jaeha and Lee Hyun have been best friends since childhood. They do nearly everything together, and despite Jaeha’s unprecedented popularity at school, he only has eyes for Hyun. Enter the new transfer student (and Jaeha’s personal nightmare), Kim Doyoung. Hyun and Doyoung spend more and more time together every day, leaving less time for Jaeha to make his move. What’s worse, Doyoung is icing him out for some unknown reason, all while growing ever closer to Hyun. The two seemingly butt heads at every turn, and Jaeha simply cannot figure out why. The answer is simple: Doyoung sees Jaeha’s coy, flirtatious teasing of Hyun as bullying, and wants to protect his new friend. Their wires crossed, an unending cycle of misunderstandings and misfortunes between the rivals ensues; however, a fateful game of basketball just might spark something electric between them…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: chapter count includes two extras

While the Great War between the Jeonggeomryeon and the Jipmacheon was at its peak, Sim Ho lived in the peaceful village of Baekriju. At the age of twelve, he was caught up in Je Gal-Hui's plot to take over Baekriju and was conscripted and sent to the war's frontline. In the midst of a desperate battle, he runs into the Black Ox Fighters, and they save his life. He then joins the Black Ox, and begins the arduous journey to becoming a powerful warrior and return home to Baekriju…!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Cheon Mudeok knows two things: fighting and loyalty to his friends. Will he be able to graduate safely? Or is this the birth of a legend?

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Honja Da Hae Meongneun Cheonjae Amsalja
title.english: The Genius Assassin Who Takes It All
title.native: 혼자 다 해 먹는 천재 암살자

description:
Waking up as the main villain of his own novel was not part of the original plan. Now a lowly level 10 assassin, Ganghu Shin must use all of his prior knowledge as the author to navigate the fantasy world he created himself, and somehow alter the ending in order to return to the real world. Can he change the outcome and defeat the “real” villain to prevent his own demise and save this world from impending doom?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Everyone's shocked when 9-year-old prodigy Adelia Ester suddenly refuses to enroll in the elite knights' academy. They don't know that Adelia was magically sent back in time after wasting her life on the battlefield and suffering an early death! Now, Adelia's out to protect her peace from her ex-boss, the evil future emperor, by setting her ally on the throne instead. Will Adelia succeed in one last mission and finally retire for good? Or will she find herself forced to be a hero once more?

(Source: Tapas)

“I will become a demon.”

A young man with a dark past, known in Murim as Won-Su.
After living a life without an identity, he feels remorseful.
He finds a lover, which he thinks must have been fate.
After losing his mother, he escapes Jungwon, but gets caught up in Murim and ends up losing his wife.

Even so, he grows older alone, without getting involved...

(Source: Mootoon, translated)

After giving up his dream of becoming a boxer, Park Kang-tae joined a gang. He was a well-known member of the gang but got killed in the end. His only dying regret is giving up his dream of being a boxer. Did God know about his regret? In a world where boxing exists in the form of pugilist games, Park Kang-tae pursues his unfulfilled dream.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Sun-Woo Yoon thought he knew who his enemies were, but when he woke up in Yi-Hyun Choi’s home after a night out, it didn’t take him long to learn he was wrong. While he’s angry that Sun-Woo doesn’t even remember him, that’s not enough to change the situation. Yi-Hyun will have his revenge and make Sun-Woo pay for ruining his life. Now that he’s being held captive, the only way out is through. As he starts to remember what they went through as kids, will his reasons for keeping Yi-Hyun happy change?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Summer, who had only thoughts of revenge against the duke's house, fell for the enemy's youngest son!

The day she lost her brother to the Valonek Duke's house, Summer's world completely collapsed. Her sole reason for surviving was to avenge the duke's family. Summer, who had sworn vengeance against the duke's family, heard rumors that the duke's youngest son, Gray Valonek, was seeking a personal aide. Disguised as the noble lady ‘Adel’, she arrived at the social club, Full Moon. But the moment she met his drunkenly languid blue eyes, Summer realized. She was slowly sinking into an emotional quagmire deeper than her vengeance...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A strange relationship began when orphan siblings met a old woman who claimed to be their grandmother, but this old woman is the superior master of Murim, who has lost her memory due to a disease. The woman recognized the hidden talent of the eldest sibling and started to train him, thus began the journey of Jinmu Sin-Mo, the last disciple.

The boy is destined to reach the end of sky!

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

Im Sang-Ho, the popular kid who was the center of attention during high school, reunites with his old friend Go Young-Ha at a long-awaited alumni gathering after graduation. Young-Ha, who had always followed Sang-Ho around during their three years of high school, had become incredibly handsome—a far cry from Sang-Ho's memories. Yet, Sang-Ho felt a sense of kinship upon discovering they shared a commonality: both were attending university at the late age of 28. After the reunion, on their way home together, Young-Ha and Sang-Ho feed stray cats in the park. As they talk about high school memories and the awkwardness begins to fade, Young-Ha makes a shocking statement.

“My boss at my part-time job seems to like me. But he's a guy, so it's awkward. How do you date a guy? How do you have sex? Do you know?”

Sang-Ho, who had already come out about his own sexual identity long ago, felt resentment and betrayal at Young-Ha's actions...

“So, are you going to teach me or something?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

I’ve been reincarnated as Lariette, a lowly sidekick destined to be the female lead’s errand girl. Tired of being a doormat, I decide to switch sides and suck up to the empire’s most powerful villainess, Evangeline. But the “vicious” villainess is actually a total sweetheart! Not only is she showering me with gifts, she’s now insisting I marry her brother so we can be family forever. There’s just one problem: her brother is the original male lead, a man supposed to be obsessed with the original heroine. I’ve tried my best to keep my distance, but he won’t stop pursuing me.

“What makes you think I’m not interested in you, My Lady?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The moment Duke Arcus saved her when she was a refugee, Miel became a sunflower. And after covering her heart with sincerity for 8 years… “Marry me.” The lord said to her who had become a capable adjutant. “I think you will be the least troubled.” What he wanted was a superficial relationship. To remain as a duchess until he passes the ducal title to his nephew. As always, the cool and cool man said that he would take care of everything as long as she did not produce an heir. The education of her siblings, the debt of the family. So she accepted. For the sake of everyone, she was able to hide her feelings until the end. However, his attitude is becoming more and more confusing. Could it be that he is also interested in me

(Source: Naver, translated)

ATime has passed since the great confrontation at the Core Business tower. After Chun-woo Han destroyed Si-woon's ki-center, depriving him of his ability to practice martial arts, Si-woon thinks his time with the Murim is done. But his status as the sole disciple of the Nine-Doors Dragon makes him a target for many clans eager for revenge! How will he cope now that he's deprived of his ki? Meanwhile, graffiti in praise of the Nine-Doors Dragon begins appearing all around the world for all to see, and the Murim Alliance must react quickly. The Soldiers Under Command are on the move; will it be possible to stop them before the destruction of the world as we know it?

(Source: ABLAZE)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

After her brother gambles away the money owed for his marriage, Louise is offered as payment under the so-called Right of the First Night. The man who claims her is Richard, Lord of Evron—a ruthless war hero feared for his icy heart. Trapped in his castle, Louise must survive the night... and the man they call a monster.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

I spent one night with the man who destroyed my country. Then, I ran away with his child in my arms.
I think that’s the end of my relationship with him…

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

Lee Kyung-Ho’s mind was engulfed with ending his life due to bullying and the loss of his mother. His determination to commit suicide entices Sierra, a grim reaper who later offers him a contract. This contract blesses him with the ability to borrow the powers of the dead in exchange for sacrificing years from his lifespan. In order to get what he wants, he ends up accepting it...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hee-seo was on the fast track to success - until her luck took a sudden nosedive. Her shaman grandmother insists it’s because her yin energy is too strong, and the only cure is to find a man with powerful yang energy to balance it out. Hee-seo laughs off the superstitious advice…until the night she meets Gong Tae-su, the charismatic head of the planning team whose energy feels almost dangerously magnetic. One unexpected encounter later, her world starts to spin out of control - along with her heart. Maybe Grandma was right, after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hayool was supposed to be a genius mage and the next head of his clan, but when he turns out to be incompatible with magical AI, his friends and family expect him to give up on his dreams. Too determined to abandon his ambitions, he discovers a book written by the founder of magic itself, and it teaches him to do magic without AI. Suddenly much more powerful than his classmates and school bullies, it seems he might have a bright future after all—if he can survive the secret plots against him.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Genius Wants an Ordinary Life

description:
A man who has everything and yet nothing. The only thing successful corporate executive Jin-Hyeok Son ever really wanted was an ordinary life with a beloved family, a desire arising from the tragic death of his parents when he was a child. This all changes after he finds himself back in his nine-year-old body after an accident -- to a time when his parents are still alive, to the very life he had longed to return to! Can Jin-Hyeok change the past and finally fulfill his dream of an ordinary life?

(Source: WEBTOON)

To the rest of the world, Ju Ha-Ram is the picture of innocence and grace, yet his nights tell a different story. From the vantage point of a stalker, Ha-Ram's modest reputation is a curated lie as he brings a revolving door of men back to his bed. Lost in a world of feverish fantasies, the observer has spent months imagining being the one selected for the night. The line between reality and obsession finally blurs when Ha-Ram makes his move, inviting his shadow into the very home he has been haunting for a year.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I Think I Married the Wrong Guy

description:
Our heroine is set up for failure when she wakes up in the novel "Betrayal of the Black Rose" as Lady Nadia, a side character who is killed by the murderous Duke Altair Gertrand. Poor Nadia's only hope of survival is leaving the capital and marrying an obscure baron in the countryside. Unfortunately, this baron turns out to be Altair before his days as a duke! Having stepped right into the lion's den, Nadia fears she might die even sooner than expected. Now, the only way she can survive is by steering her scary husband off his bloodstained path to villainhood...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: How to Hide the Emperor’s Child

description:
Astelle, the empire's one-day empress brought with her a secret when she left the palace after the divorce: she was pregnant with Emperor Kaizen's child. Six years later, Astelle is living a peaceful life in the countryside with their son until the imperial guards come knocking. Kaizen requires Astelle's consent to receive the key territory of Meilen. With the empire still in turmoil from a rebellion, will Astelle be able to hide her son's identity from these threatening forces, and more importantly, from his father, the emperor?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Jeon Geunyang Nae Jim Maryeoni Kkumindeyo?
title.english: All I Want is My Dream Home
title.native: 전 그냥 내 집 마련이 꿈인데요?

description:
Isabel lived and died as a doormat. After waking up in the past, she gets to work on dumping her terrible boyfriend and escaping her abusive household.
