However, financial and legal limits stop her from gaining total independence on her own. There is one potential solution: a policy that provides housing for newlyweds! This means Isabel has to find a man to marry. Enter Sir Dylan, the perfect catch. For reasons unknown, he volunteers to become her fake husband, and they earn Ishael’s dream house. But can they turn it into a real home together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

All Casia ever wanted was a happy home and a doll, but the former went out the window when the emperor forced her mother into marriage. Life as a princess was isolating but bearable... that is, until her mother was unjustly branded as a criminal. Now, with the help of her trusted aides, including the youngest prince, Casia is forging her own path outside the palace. As owner of her own doll shop, will she finally be able to escape the imperial family’s clutches and find her true happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Thought My Husband Was Supposed to Die?

description:
Alice was a chef living in Korea when an explosion transported her into a novel. Having worked so hard in her previous life only to die young, Alice wants to live this new life in peace. There’s only one problem: her mother-in-law is trying to frame her for the murder of her husband. Using her knowledge of the novel, can Alice subvert the original plot into something that might allow her to live in peace, or is she doomed to live as the caretaker of a comatose husband until her death?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Youngest Is Trying To Prevent the World From Ending

description:
After hitting my head, I remembered my past life and realized I was in a novel. Ugh, why do I have to be Diana Cartier, the bratty child brainwashed to do evil deeds and destroy the world?! I won’t let that happen. I’ll stop the end of the world with my own hands and save my brothers! Wait, why is the novel’s protagonist lying on the street? And oh, aren’t those animals so cute? Make way for the cute youngest who’s trying to save the world!

(Source: Tapas)

In a world filled with monsters and magic, a cat and a hunter named Hawk begin their adventure with different purposes but with the same goal in mind: to protect something precious and seek revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, I opened my eyes and found myself in... prison?!

That's right. Out of all the characters I could've reincarnated into, I woke up inside a 19+ rated romance novel as the villain's younger sister. To make things even worse, I was locked up inside the infamous Kambrakam Prison for my brother's crimes.

Deep within the very same prison lies Henrich Doran von Hel, who's rumored to be suffering from a curse that turns him into a beast. In the original novel, he's supposed to meet the female lead and spend an interesting night with her here in prison... but of course, the plot's gone awry thanks to my existence. What kind of future lies in store for me now that I've gotten myself tangled up between the novel's greatest villain and its male lead?!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Murdered by the man she loved.
Adeline Rotyn gave everything to her husband, Duke Venzak. That is, until he kills her one dark and stormy night. Instead of dying, she finds herself transported years into the past. Determined to make the most of her second chance at life, she vows to become stronger and escape her horrid fate.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extra chapters

title.english: I Didn't Sign Up to Be a Nanny!

description:
While working the regular shift in a supermarket, Ailene finds herself waking up in the body of a nanny within a fantasy novel. Knowing this character dies at the hands of the twin princes at the beginning of the novel, Ailene vows to raise these boys to be kindhearted and avoid their dark storyline. She fits right into her role and things seem to be looking up until the empire’s “mad dog” Duke Kasar stumbles into her life and asks her to pretend to be his lover. Will Ailene make it through the fantasy novel alive?!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The great hero Devota worked tirelessly to save the world from evil, only to be betrayed and killed by the very man who raised her. Luckily, she’s granted a new life as a young orphan named Diamond and, through a twist of fate, is taken in by an old comrade, now a powerful duchess. The whole family dotes on her like she’s one of their own, and as it turns out, she actually might be… But with her murderer still at large and her revenge still unfinished, will Dia be able to open her heart to love?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a 20-chapter side story

Following the death of the World Tree, all that stands between the apocalypse and salvation is the Divine Maiden, prophesied to restore peace and prosperity. But never mind all that. Princess Teriella Rufeon has more pressing issues at hand: her family keeps trying to kill her, she’s got a secret healing power to keep under wraps, and she’s just found out she’s being sent off to marry the infamous tyrant Emperor Rivanfel von Leonharta! But there’s more to Rivanfel than meets the eye, and Teriella discovers she isn’t the only one with a grave secret to hide…

(Source: WEBTOONS)

On her first day of college, Ho-eun joins a campus club—only to find herself surrounded by charming, shamelessly bold upperclassmen. All she's asked to do is read a book out loud. It seems simple enough… until she realizes exactly what she's reading. Flustered and unsure how to react, Ho-eun is caught between embarrassment, confusion—and a strange thrill she can’t quite explain. The way they look at her, the way they tease her... it awakens something unfamiliar. She wants to run, but something holds her in place. After all, her graduation depends on this club. Will she manage to escape the clutches of her dangerously perverted sunbaes, or will she be pulled deeper into their twisted game?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

In a French town wracked by fear, Rose Dupré is bullied as a witch's daughter. Marie and Pierre don't believe such rumors at first. But when a wave of strange deaths sweeps in, the three children are no longer safe from wary eyes. Can Rose survive the curse of magic and suspicion? An expansive yet colorful gothic tale begins.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 27 non-numbered chapters counting season prologues, multiple-part episodes, extra chapters, side stories, and an epilogue.

Ilex Davenport had it all—a noble title, top grades at the academy, and a reputation as its biggest playboy. He was living proof the world wasn't fair. Tilia Ambrose hated him for it. While he coasted through life, she was fighting to escape her toxic family. So how did she end up in his bed?

(Source: Manta)

After dying as an orphan unable to support her siblings, Siella Feiront is reincarnated as the villainess of a novel and the evil matron of Siella's Orphanage. Indignant at how poorly the children in her care have been treated, she immediately gets to work—repairing the rundown manor, buying the children clothes, and cooking nutritious meals—until she's left with next to no money. With her funds quickly deteriorating, Siella sets out on a mission: she must find a sponsor before it's too late!

(Source: Tapas)

Rayna Vinosht was always known as the cursed one. Unloved by her father, she’s married off to the handsome Duke Edgar Heathvilian, but he soon becomes cold to her, taking away her son, and giving him to the seductive Monica Espert. But Rayna has a second chance at life thanks to Ondine, an adorable water spirit, who forms a contract with her. Soon Rayna has supernatural powers and the confidence to rule over her estate like a strong duchess, but what will happen now that Edgar is falling in love with her?

(Source: Tapas)

When a perpetually overlooked supporting actor dies wishing to be jaw-droppingly handsome, he's reborn as Ma Gongja, a ridiculously beautiful baby who was left outside an orphanage. After a famous actress adopts him, Gongja suddenly has fame, fortune, and everyone falling for his cuteness, but he's just getting started! Armed with acting skills, this charming child is determined to become the most dazzling star there is, but will his stunning looks cause more trouble than he bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

Two princesses, one throne. Life is hard for a court jester. Not only do I serve as an emotional punching bag for the royals and aristocrats, forced to indulge their every whim, but now I'm also caught between two princesses. Is this a comedy? Or will this tale end in tragedy?

(Source: Manta)

Pressured by her demanding mother and hated by others for her intelligence, Han Narae led a miserable life, dying tragically at a young age. Reborn as Lysia Ambrose, the magical daughter of a count, all she wants to do this time is live a quiet life while attending the prestigious Asteria Academy. Though she tries her best to hide her true powers and live normally, she proves surprisingly popular. Now rubbing elbows with school celebrities, will Lysia’s plan to fade into the background fail?

(Source: Tapas)

Woori is heartbroken when she finds out that her favorite character Lancelot dies tragically in the novel "The Flower Raised her Sword." She knows too well that the butler suffered from his one-sided love for the heroine Charlotte and even gave his life to avenge her death. So when Woori wakes up in Charlotte's body, she's determined to steer sweet Lancelot away from his miserable fate. But with the original Charlotte making a reappearance, as well as the villainous Duke Vestia, things might not be so simple after all. Can Woori guide Lancelot to his happy ending without revealing her true identity?

(Source: TappyToon)

When Hannah gets a high-paying job as a tutor for Eilie, a noble young lady, she expects to start a new, peaceful chapter of her life. However, strange things begin to occur at the mansion, and she quickly realizes there’s more to it than meets the eye. What secrets are the inhabitants of this remote island hiding? In the darkness of mystery, there may be witches playing tricks.

(Source: Tapas)

Lindsay is a top-secret spy about to take on her most difficult mission yet: to disguise herself as a man?! Her target is the Duke. Rich, mysterious, and… an infamous womanizer. Cutting her hair, drinking elixirs to hide her voice, as a servant she must infiltrate his manor and investigate the mysterious disappearance of lords and ladies in the area. However, when she meets the Duke for the first time and he kisses her, is it her identity that's compromised or her heart…

(Source: Tapas)

After retiring from gymnastics, Han Ji-Won thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jung-Woo—campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Ji-Won thinks he has Jung-Woo figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

Earth is destroyed, and the sole survivor is the immortal being Seul Yun. After losing the only person she ever cared about, she is set out to seek revenge on the one behind it all – the emperor Horson. However, Seul finds herself lost in a strange world called Hetra. There, she must learn to harness her new abilities and fight against a new type of evil. Will Seul be able to hunt down the emperor and carry out her revenge?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Heesuh hates Jinmoo, always has and always will. However, his plan to destroy Jinmoo’s life flops because instead of humiliating Jinmoo, the pair spends a passionate night together. Jinmoo wants to take responsibility for his drunk actions, and Heesuh is definitely only dating him for another shot at revenge because there is no way Heesuh is falling for his sexy, sexy enemy.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 12 side stories

title.english: A Martial Master Wakes Up as a Concubine

description:
Once a notorious master of the deviant sects, Nyeon-Bi Cheon pays a hefty price for her romance with a man of a virtuous sect, Won Gae of the True-spirited Sword. As her lover poisons her to death with a dragonsbane fruit, Nyeon-Bi perishes with more questions than answers. When she wakes up, however, she finds herself in a different sort of peril, as she reincarnates in the body of Noble Lady So-Yeo Cheon, a concubine of the imperial palace. As So-Yeo, Nyeon-Bi must rely on her knowledge from her past life to navigate both intrigue and romance in the palace!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.english: D.I.L.D.O: Droid for Immersive Libido Dynamics Optimization

description:
For Seo Jae-Yun, a seemingly innocent game of Secret Santa is about to change his life. After unwrapping his special gift, he is shocked to find a dildo - and one that can come to life, at that! The dildo will do anything to please his master, and try as he might, Jae-Yun can’t find it in himself to kick his newfound companion out. Instead, perhaps they can work together find the greatest gift of all...deep, deep inside.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: There's Something Wrong About My Man's Morals

description:
After a fateful encounter as children, Evonne and the outcast prince, Theo, can’t deny their deep connection. However, their lives are torn apart when Evonne’s family is wrongly accused of treason, leading to their ruin. Cursed and forced to disguise herself as a man, Evonne struggles to survive until Theo finally finds her and uses all his power as emperor to take her with him. Together, they’ll start a journey facing challenges that’ll test their love as they try to start a life together.

(Source: Tapas)

Despite being a beauty from a famous family, Roselia Kaneph is quite literally the poorest noble in the empire. Sick of munching on carrots during teatime and not being able to add salt to her meals, Roselia comes up with a plan to go from rags to riches: marry the emotionless Crown Prince Anoch! But before she can even go through with this, she stumbles upon Anoch, who mistakes her for a thief and an assassin. Will Roselia be able to convince him otherwise and persuade him to marry her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I'm Not Letting My Duke Die!

description:
Three years ago, Hui-Yeon was just your average otaku living in South Korea when she was thrust into the world of At the End of the Abyss, a novel she thought was trash. Hui-Yeon is now Ella Rein, a talented monster hunter. One day, she meets Clive Winterock, the female lead's brother and the man Gerard Aselenus--her favorite character and the gorgeous male lead--wants dead. Although she's a Gerard fan, Ella can't let anything happen to Clive because he's just too handsome to die!

(Source: Tapas)

Haesoo takes care of Dojin after he loses his parents to an evil spirit. As Dojin grows up, he struggles to hide his feelings for Haesoo, but tries to do so regardless by assisting him in his priestly duties. But evil soon creeps into Dojin's heart when he stumbles upon Haesoo's dark secret, whispering to let his desires loose...

(Source Lezhin)

Jung Eon is a maid who works in the house of a rich and powerful family. She dreams of escaping a life of servitude and saves every penny she earns. One day, she receives an unexpected proposal from her childhood friend and boss, Hyun Mae-hwa. He's as pretty as a flower, but has a horrible personality. Mae-hwa says he wants to marry her because of a prophecy that says Jung Eon has six benefactors in his destiny. He thinks she is the source of his financial luck. She accepts, thinking it's a chance to change her life.

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

The omega crown prince of the Kingdom of Wistad has been living in hell ever since the day he was tricked into imprinting on Duke Amandaris. This is because while an alpha’s pheromone is supposed to be enticing and irresistible, it is nothing but unbearable stench to an omega that has already imprinted. However, the crown prince finally sees a glimmer of hope when he hears that there is an extremely affluent foreigner in the kingdom who is capable of undoing an imprinting. Unfortunately, this rare information doesn’t come for free, so can the prince pay the right price to the man who has it all?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Should I eat him?"

Orca Ware, the young master of the killer whale family "Ware," returns from a slaughter-ridden battlefield. He prefers slaughter to peace, and finds the battlefield more comfortable than comfort, so the Orca Mansion is simply boring. Then, a lowly and foolish servant, Nia, appears before Orca. Nia, who has been bullied by the other servants because he is a goldfish beastman, fills his hungry stomach by the lakeside of the mansion in the middle of the night... and encounters Orca.

"Master, I was wrong... Please, please, save me..."

"You are more insignificant and weak than anyone else, and yet you try to live... It really bothers me."

I try not to pay attention, but my eyes keep going to the small and fragile Nia... The once boring mansion is soon filled with an inexplicable thrill.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: I'm Not the Final Boss' Lover!

description:
When protagonist Jun Karentia enters a game as a support mage, she's all set to guide hero Fabian to success. But, oops! The game throws her a curveball when Fabian ditches her in round two, and Mayer Knox, Fabian's rival and secret final boss, recruits her as vice-captain for his corps. The problem? He's the final boss and now everyone thinks they're dating! Now, Jun's mission is to outwit Fabian, transform the final boss into the game's new hero, and put an end to those pesky romance rumors.

(Source: Tapas)

Did our runt Vanessa Blake encounter another god because yours abandoned you? May we, the lord of evil Belzebuth, tell you something interesting? Most humans seek your god when they end up meeting us. They seem to think their lord will save them and seeing their desperation never fails to make us laugh. That is because their god is just our other half. You may see your many reincarnations as a sign of your god’s disdain, but we feel you are beloved. Thus, we shall give you whatever you desire.

(Source: Tapas)

Ever since that fateful rainy day when she was rescued by the handsome Duke Killian Devonshire, Rowena has lived as his mistress. Though she believes that Killian has grown to love her over the past three years, she wants to repay her debt to him and become his equal so that she can stand proudly by his side. But when Killian begins to behave strangely, her trust in him wavers, only for it to be fully broken the day he introduces another woman to be his future wife. Thus, Rowena decides to make some drastic changes to their relationship. But will it be for better or for worse?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"I don’t want to even breathe the same air as you!"

...are the last words Jeong Sang-Heon says to Yun Hae-Sin before they part ways. But after ten years, the two reunite and end up living together under the same roof. Sang-Heon is the worst roommate one could have. He makes a mess wherever he goes, constantly breaks things, brings over uninvited guests, and even smokes inside the house. When Hae-Sin is at his wit’s end, he finally finds out a weakness that helps him put a leash around Sang-Heon's neck. Will Hae-Sin successfully tame Sang-Heon so that they can live in peace together while breathing the same air?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

title.english: To a Happy Ending for the Tragic Novel

description:
When Rosiana Evenheider opens her eyes as the villainess of the tragic novel, “The Miracle of Dawn,” she knows she has to do something if she wants to live. She must find a way to escape her evil adoptive father’s grasp while also helping the male leads one by one so that they don’t take drastic measures to claim the female lead. Will Rosiana be able to find a way to change the narrative so that everyone finds their “happily ever after”?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Helltham is a crime-ridden city ruled by the Golden Bite Family, whose boss dies in a mysterious accident. When Seven, the family's degenerate third-in-command, is named as a promising candidate for the next boss, he plans to use his power to live it up even more. However, he gets stabbed in the back by his long-time partner, Felix, who turns out to be a spy working with the city's only law enforcement agency. Felix then offers him two choices at gunpoint: either work with him to take down the Golden Bite Family or sleep with the fishes.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Chang-Gyeon, the bastard third son, clawed his way to the throne in a whirlwind of chaos and blood. Now, with his reign spiraling out of control and the kingdom teetering on the edge, his only comfort lies in one person—his childhood friend, Sam-Myeong. But what started as fondness has twisted into something darker. Chang-Gyeon’s obsession knows no bounds, and he’s willing to do anything—schemes, manipulation, even breaking Sam-Myeong’s will—to keep him close.

(Source: Lezhin US)

What started out as an ordinary day turned upside down when an unknown catastrophe struck Earth, transporting Suho Park to a different planet. He eventually learns how to adapt and fight for his survival in this foreign world, but one day, just as suddenly as he was sucked into this new planet, Suho is pulled back to Earth. He quickly learns that return to life as he remembers it is no longer possible, as Earth is in constant battle with monsters who’ve managed to infiltrate the planet. How will Suho fight against the monsters attacking Earth, and will he be able to survive this time with his current skills?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After fleeing from his home during a family feud, Boris Jineman is left with only his brother and Winterer, the family's treasured sword. But when his beloved brother sacrifices his life for him, 12-year-old Boris becomes the sole guardian of Winterer in a world where this sword is coveted by all. As Boris struggles to fend off those who are after his family blade, his heart only grows colder and stiffer. Will this young boy be able to survive this winter to reach the spring that awaits him?

(Source: Tapas)

One day, Seon-Ho Kang lost consciousness in an accident, only to wake up to:

"Alright, time to collect your semen, sweetie!"

Wait a second... Men are rare in this world?! With women throwing themselves at him... Well, if this is how things are, guess I'll just enjoy the feast, one by one!!!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Kim Sojin lived an intense everyday life as an oriental doctor. However, after losing her life in a fire accident, she woke up again in the Goguryeo period as the daughter of the Jeolnobu Yeon Clan 'Yeon Woohee.'

Although she was born into a noble family, war breaks out every day in this era! And now that she's twelve, she's going through a political marriage?!

A relaxing getaway in paradise, or a death trap? A young man wakes up on a breathtaking beach, but he has no idea who he is or how he got there. Try as he might to piece it all together, untangling this mind-bending mystery won’t be easy when every clue leads to more maddening questions... and the family that welcomes him into their home is not what they seem.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The accident that occurred seven years ago at the orphanage changed the lives of these two girls forever. In a world where talent and ability are everything, what will be their destiny now?

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

Cheon-Ho thought he was delivering righteous justice when he forced himself on Shin Je-Hui, the man suspected of assaulting his sister. But when the truth comes out, Cheon-Ho realizes he has committed an irreversible crime against an innocent man. Bracing for arrest or violent retaliation, he visits Je-Hui to apologize. But Je-Hui's reaction defies all logic. Rather than demanding retribution or turning him in, Je-Hui eagerly chases after Cheon-Ho, insisting they start dating. Trapped by his own guilt, Cheon-Ho has no idea how to handle his deeply unhinged victim.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Unforeseen guests and unforeseen temptations are in the air!

(Source: Toomics)

The state of Joseon is defeated by the invaders of the royal family.

Two girls are born with a power that both the emperor and his traitors can use. Will this light illuminate the chaos of the times that have come? Or will it be the reason an entire country burns out?

… A new story begins!

Ju Min-Chan had always suffered from frequent fevers as a kid because of some unfortunate curse. Now as a young adult, his condition has worsened into seizures which he can only keep at bay by hunting spirits. As if things couldn’t get any worse, the effectiveness of this method starts diminishing as his seizures become more recurrent. Then, he learns about a powerful being who could lift his curse. Despite the risk that comes with hunting down this being, Min-Chan readily jumps at this chance to finally escape his harsh fate only to find out that he was never destined to live a normal life…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Edwin Rocher and Leila Garwen grew up as childhood friends, but everything shifted the moment they became adults. When Edwin quietly asked, “Teach me how to touch myself,” Leila gave in to the request, thinking it would end there. Instead, he became addicted to the filthy pleasure Edwin fed him, and Leila found himself unable to escape the boy he once thought he knew so well. One night, Leila stumbles upon a creature with green eyes soaking in Edwin’s bath...a monster wearing the face he trusted most. In that moment, he realized he never truly understood what Edwin is, or what he wants. Caught between fear, desire, and the monstrous truth, Leila enters a den of corruption where escape is impossible and surrender may be the only path left.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Cha Yoonwoo intentionally gets arrested in order to smuggle drugs into prison, the last thing he expects to find out during intake is that he's pregnant. With no other option, he requests a meeting with Nam Soohyeon, the manipulative prosecutor who knotted him. But Yoonwoo's incarceration takes a surprising turn when none other than the man who put him up to this whole thing shows up in handcuffs. Just how will Yoonwoo make it through his sentence with such an unlikely cast of inmates, no alpha by his side, and a baby on the way?

(Source: Lezhin US)

I, Junhee Baek fell in love at first sight. But he rejected me immediately! One day, I was in a marriage arranged by my grandfather and turns out- “Argh!”
We haven’t seen each other after twelve years… “Junhee Baek, do you want to marry me?” Why the heck does he want to marry me?! “But you’re not my type” I don’t want to marry you either! But why does my heart beats rapidly whenever he touches me?

If you take off the checkered shirt and thick rimmed glasses on his head, you get a handsome and young blond man?! The nerdy Ethan fell in love with Dwayne at their high school prom. With no progress for 4 years, Ethan reunites with Dwayne in his graduation party. Dwayne, ignoring Ethan who had mustered up his courage to go talk to him, feels something hard graze his hand as he walks past the nerdy boy. This guy has something amazing…!

"You.. Do you wanna do something fun with me?"

What will happen to the nerdy boy, Ethan?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Once upon a time, there was a handsome king who was greedy and cruel. When God reviewed the record of his life, God shook his head and asked the three women who suffered the most because of the king, "What punishment would you like him to receive?" The three women, glancing at one another, answered in unison, "Please send all of us back to Earth."

The women took away his beauty, his swordsmanship, and his uncaring attitude, and the king is reincarnated as Ji-En the maid. The three women are reborn as men, and when they meet Ji-En, the tangled relationships from their past life reemerge…!

"What did I do in my past life to deserve this mess!"

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

“You need the money, and I have plenty of it… Don’t you think it’s a fair trade?”

“Tae-i Kwon” is a young youth suffering under a mountain of debt. No matter how hard he works, it seems the debt only keeps growing. Driven into a corner, he gets a high-paying job at a gay bar, and it is here he meets the CEO of the place, Odo Seo. Odo, who is being stalked by a mysterious pursuer, suggests a contractual fake relationship with Tae-i. What starts out as a quick stint to earn money for Tae-i becomes complex when he starts to fall in love with the ever sensual Odo Seo. But the closer he gets to Odo, the closer the dangers surrounding Odo approach to suffocate Tae-i. When the identity of Odo’s stalker slowly starts to unveil and Odo’s true intentions come to light, how will it shake Tae-i’s life around?

(Source: Copin Comics)

title.english: Baby Prisoner of the Winter Castle

description:
The last survivor of the Grezekaiah royal family is biding her time as a prisoner waiting to die… too bad everyone finds her absolutely adorable. When Clarisse became the youngest prisoner of Duke Maximilian Sheridan, she never expected her captors to be the family she’d always wished for. With an execution date set for her eighteenth birthday, will her emerging powers, bubbly personality, and cute face save her from her fate?

(Source: Tapas)

Do you ever find yourself glued to your phone screen all day? Such is the case for Damu Ju, a girl in her third year of high school who has a particular attachment to her relatively ancient smartphone of ten years. All she wants is to graduate quietly with no trouble, but her high school life becomes anything but ordinary when one day, her smartphone transforms into a cute human boy – who still functions as a phone!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Count Aeroc Teiwind, a youthful aristocrat of noble lineage, finds himself captivated the moment he sees Kloff Bendyke, baron of a small countryside estate. Despite the disparities in their social standings, their wealth, and the unusual circumstance of them both being alphas, Aeroc still boldly professes his affections. However, Kloff chooses to wed one of Aeroc's kin instead. Consumed by jealousy, Aeroc calls for a harrowing punishment. Reeling from the consequences of Aeroc’s actions, Kloff swears to seek revenge…no matter the cost.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a major screw-up at work, Hyunho is pretty much ready to give up on life. What he receives instead of punishment, however, is a delectable strawberry cream custard tart. Thinking it's his last meal alive, Hyunho gobbles it up, licking every last dollop of cream off of Seung-yun's fingers. This lights a certain spark within Seung-yun, which gets him thinking about all the other wild things he could make Hyunho do with his tongue...

(Source: Lezhin)

Chapter count includes Christmas Special

In a suspicious car accident, Seo Jiwoon's sister dies while top actor Cha Taehyuk walks off unscathed. While trying to uncover the truth, Jiwoon is also hit by a car. However, when he opens his eyes, Jiwoon realizes he has traveled back in time to his first day of work. Will this opportunity to work together with Cha Taehyuk be the perfect opportunity to avenge his sister's death?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ma Jinsung was once a top-ranked player in Arsia Chronicle, but he was brutally killed by his trusted leader. After that, he thought he'd wake up in his room... not 10 years in the past! Now, prepared to exact his revenge, he jumps right back into the game. But this time, his job class is voodooist, and he gets bonuses for killing other players. The only downside is that if he dies in the game, he dies in real life. Can Jinsung get his revenge without causing too much carnage? Don't bet on it...

(Source: Tapas)

Kwon Ji-Uk's monotonous daily life takes an unexpected turn at a club meeting when he becomes drawn to a mysterious new freshman. Captivated by the freshman's sweet looks, Ji-Uk tries to approach him, only to be met with a cold and dismissive attitude. Annoyed by the response, Ji-Uk resolves to teach the freshman a lesson in his own way. However, things take a shocking twist that Ji-Uk never saw coming. The next morning, Ji-Uk wakes up covered in someone else’s fluids, staring at an unfamiliar ceiling, only to realize he’s now trapped in an unimaginable and humiliating situation.

“You're all the same...how you let your urges take over...”

Once a domineering and fearsome figure who thrived on intimidation, Ji-Uk finds himself powerless against the alluring yet dangerous freshman, Park Ju-Yeon. With no clue about Juyeon’s true intentions or the deadly game that’s about to unfold, Ji-Uk is dragged into a personal hell designed just for him.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Let me hold your hand once more.

Jiwoo can see the future of those she holds hands with. Yet when she holds Haesung's hand, she can see her own! Hoping to know her fate in the upcoming art contest, Jiwoo tries to hold Haesung's hand again, but he refuses. What trauma lies in his past? Can the two pull each other back to the present?

(Source: Manta)

My bride, Neungso, has so many wonderful qualities! He’s as pretty as freshly fallen snow, as big and strong as a mountain, and has a hu... HUGE summer squash between his legs! I thought having a bride meant having someone to take care of and make happy, but it turns out he knows just how to make me feel good. I wish I could make him happy too, but I’m not the special moon rabbit he’s looking for, so I know he’ll leave me one day. Maybe it would’ve been better if Habibi never brought my bride home. Maybe then, I wouldn’t have to feel this pain…

(Source: Tapas)

When a naïve woodcutter steals the robe of a fairy descended from heaven, he condemns her to centuries trapped in the human realm. In the present day, the fairy is known as Mo-Ran Cheon, a renowned actress who is unexpectedly accused of murder. Bitter and resentful from her exile, Mo-Ran sees her plot for vengeance take shape when she discovers that Je-Ha Sa, a police detective tasked with investigating the murder, is the reincarnated woodcutter of centuries past.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Welcome to “Whale Barbershop”! Where there’s bubbling shaving foam, crisp scraping sounds from the razor, slightly pungent smell of pomade, and a man with a soft touch!

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

"To stay alive… I have no choice but to become a genius. I’ll do my best starting today, so please support me."

Lee Hyun-Woo finds himself possessing Kyle Seltarion, an extra character from a game where he used to reign as the world’s number-one player. Considering the game’s storyline, he soon faces the imminent death of Kyle, who, on top of being on death's door, can't use magic or aura and has a terrible reputation. How did he end up in the body of such a character?

However, after discovering a new talent, he learns to harness mana and begins to shift his attributes and reputation with knowledge of hidden routes gained through grinding in the game. His immediate goal is to save his own life, but that goal is closely linked to the impending global catastrophe... To overcome this situation, he needs to gather allies and boost his reputation!

It's time to turn his past, which was a reckless mess, around and move into a new phase!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Unkillable. Unstoppable. Still hunted. Ji-O, a “Heart Mutant” with the Heart of Resurrection, escaped ten years of brutal experimentation, but freedom doesn’t last. With a body that can regenerate from any injury, he’s a target the world won’t ignore. The moment he finds something worth protecting, and even a sliver of a normal life, it’s threatened all over again by the very lab that tortured him and his friends. But this time, Ji-O is done running.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A world full of zombies, where my daughter lives...

"Don't worry, dear... Mommy will protect you, even if I become a monster...!"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Leon Kierhi, the esteemed Commander of the Imperial Knights, renounces his title to pledge eternal loyalty to Prince Sienn. However, this devotion leads him into a harrowing nightmare when Prince Sonah uses a potent drug to erode Kierhi’s caution and pain, subjecting the upright knight to a series of degrading acts designed to shatter his pride. The betrayal reaches its peak as Sonah forces Kierhi to confront his lowest moment with Sienn, turning a sacred vow of service into a cruel cycle of trauma.

(Source: Tappytoon)

While working late one night, Kang Hyuna died in a sudden explosion... or so she thought. She wakes up as Belita Olden, the villain in the game she developed, "The Guardian's Garden." Unfortunately for her, this character is destined to die at the end of each route for messing with the heroine, Margaret Averdeen. Determined not to die a second time, Belita decides to go against the game and help Margaret have a happy ending instead. Thus begins her journey for a second chance of her own making!

(Source: Tapas)

To take revenge on the husband who betrayed their nation, Adelaide returns from the brink of death. To get revenge on her husband, Adelaide decides to use her innocent brother-in-law, Cadis, and to let him go once her revenge is complete. After all, she was the poison he mistook for the Holy Grail.

“The only thing I’m afraid of… is being abandoned by you.”

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the secluded town of Riverwort, Jade and Oje grow up relying on each other as family. But when Jade is suddenly consumed by an uncontrollable rut, he loses control and hurts the person he loves most. Consumed by guilt, Jade chooses to disappear, leaving Oje behind with nothing but unanswered feelings, until news arrives that the ship Jade boarded has sunk, forcing the truth of their bond to surface in the most devastating way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

“Do whatever you want.”

A broken omega, Yeo Ji-Woon is the perfect partner for alphas who don't want to use contraception to enjoy a night of pleasure. Ji-Woon, numb to the humiliation and using the omega rental app solely for hormone therapy, is matched with Lee Dan-Oh—the very person who destroyed him with pheromone shower violence.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Hong Dan-U, a man in his 20s with wild hair, has been avoiding hair salons for years due to a private secret – having his head touched tends to raise his "other head." However, when his boss asks him to tidy up his appearance, Dan-U can no longer avoid the salons. When he reluctantly steps into one, he encounters the strikingly attractive stylist, Tae-Han. As the man trims his unruly mop, Dan-U quickly gets turned on. And with his huge secret out, Dan-U finds both his hair and body tangled in quite a mess!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

After a bad break up with his first love, Jin-U falls into a creative slump with his ceramic art. During this slump he meets Colton, an alpha with whom he has a history. As things get steamy, it’s clear that they both have an agenda. And soon enough, the situation starts to get a whole lot more complicated. It was bound to, especially when pheromones are involved…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 24 extra chapters.

Yoon Dansae is a "healer" whose addictive voice heals souls but also drives people mad. Jang Sejin, who also loves to sing, grows resentful when his brother favors Dansae over him. Jang Kiha, seeking a true healer, mistakenly kidnaps Sejin instead of Dansae. Out of spite, Sejin betrays his friend, and both are turned into castratos, forced to sing for the elite. As Sejin's mental health crumbles, he’s drawn to Cha Leesuk, a client who desires only Dansae’s voice. But will he ever notice Sejin?

(Source: Tapas)

After unexpectedly becoming the non-biological mother of her nephew Ji-Ho at a young age, Na-Eun builds a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher. But everything changes when Gang-u, the uncle of Minho, a child with selective mutism, offers her a high-paying live-in tutor job after discovering the boy only speaks around her. As they care for the children together, their unusual living arrangement slowly grows into something more than co-parenting.

(Source: WEBTOON

One sunny day day, a portal burst open in the garden, and Kwon Jae-Jin got caught up in the chaos. His limbs were torn off, and he died...

…Or so he thought.

When he wakes up, he finds himself back on the first day of his captivity—with Seo Wui-Wu between his legs, tugging at his pants. Jae-Jin stares down at the familiar face, one he had come to resent over the four agonizing years of his previous life. Back then, he had believed he was merely a victim, dragged into an unfamiliar place and forced into submission. But this time is different. Now, Jae-Jin knows exactly how Seo Wui-Wu thinks, what moves him, and—most importantly—how to control him. With the promise of guiding as bait, Seo Wui-Wu will be his to manipulate. As Seo Wui-Wu’s breath grows heavy and his dark hair falls messily over his forehead, his hungry gaze flashes with dangerous excitement. Who will truly hold the reins in this second chance at fate?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being hit by the fateful truck of transmigration, Jeong Yujin wakes up in the world of a fantasy novel as Lord Eugene Linweisen. Eugene’s main role may be to marry the story’s antagonist, Grand Duke Ivilaron, but Yujin has an even bigger job to fulfill: saving the world! But how is he supposed to achieve this feat when the Gods won’t even give him a simple status screen to help on his quest? Plus, what’s only supposed to be a loveless contract marriage seems to be turning into something more the longer Yujin stays with the supposed villain...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Average college student Il-Han Yu has always gone through life without being noticed by anyone, even God! So when monsters were about to invade Earth and God sent all humans to other dimensions to train with mana... he forgot Il-Han and left him on Earth for 1,000 years! Realizing his mistake, God sends the straggler two angels to assist him as he takes on the monsters, eventually turning him into an unstoppable force. Now that people have returned to Earth, will Il-Han finally be seen?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Seo-Yun Mun’s life has been a rollercoaster of heartaches—losing his mom, dealing with his dad’s cheating, and abandoning his beloved piano. But one constant has been his best friend, Yeon-Jae U. Surprise, surprise, Seo-Yun’s head over heels for him, but Yeon-Jae already has a girlfriend. What makes it spicy? Yeon-Jae is all about pushing those boundaries, blurring the lines between friendship and something… deeper.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: The Ice Queen and the Hound

description:
He hadn't seen Se-Kyung since they were nineteen—his first love, his old wound. She was still elegant, untouchable, and casually cruel. Still the most beautiful thing he'd ever seen. "Let's date. You and me. A contract relationship." The "contract" was the excuse. The "relationship" was everything.

(Source: Manta)

Life has been hard for Choi Hyunseong and his family since the portal gates appeared. That is, until he finally awakens! While he is unable to level up, he is gifted with the ability to trade goods on an interdimensional level and get items that raise his stats! Through the power of commerce, Hyunseong is gaining skills, storming dungeons, hunting monsters, and collecting loot to help his family. Level is nothing but a number, and he is seemingly unstoppable as… the level 1 player.

(Source: Tapas)

Do Janggon’ is a human weapon and forcer special forces spy against North Korea. When both of his arms got injured he was caught and brought to the ‘Daesan Welfare Center’, that abuses human rights and exploits labor. The doctor said it would take him a month to fully recover. So he has to hold out in the welfare center until his arms are healed.

Left bitter and jaded after being betrayed by her fellow operatives, former agent Zero is reborn as Zenith, the daughter of a count in the Tioren Empire. Despite her disdain for aristocratic life, she does her best to attend school as a noble lady. But when a mysterious tragedy befalls a classmate and sets off a chain of misfortune, Zenith abandons her usual indifference to protect her friends. As her cold heart softens, Zenith may start to realize just how dangerous loving someone can be...

(Source: Tapas)

The martial arts world's most dangerous mastermind finds herself reborn in the weakest possible form: a tiny toddler and holy monarch’s successor, destined to die young. But Dan-Ye Jin didn't survive centuries of martial arts intrigue just to accept defeat in diapers. Armed with ancient techniques and disarming baby charm, this mysteriously capable little girl is turning imminent death into the realm's greatest adventure. Who knew saving yourself could be so adorably dangerous?

(Source: WEBTOON)

God, I only asked for mercy—why resurrect me?

“Any final words?”

“...God, have mercy.”

I was betrayed by those I trusted and ultimately beheaded. But with the divine decree, the world turned upside down.

Evil runs rampant; I send you the resurrected. Stand firm against them.

God. I asked you to have mercy on them, not to resurrect me. Can't you just let them perish?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ever dreamed about your friend’s wife? How about a charming masseur, or a MILF who’s hired you as a tutor? In Sexual Exploits, an array of characters share their juiciest sexual experiences. Toeing the line between reality and fantasy, these stories will pull you in real, real close…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Cheon Taesan, the Scholar Specialist in Reforming Scoundrels. He gains renown by rehabilitating the most notorious ruffians in the Martial Arts World (Murim). Born with the Heavenly Martial Body, he faces a cruel fate where he must acquire the Seven Stars Primordial Qi just to extend his lifespan. As he interacts with the mysterious Ice Star Body, he draws closer to the hidden truths of the Martial Arts World.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Eun-Nam's got it bad for his best friend Ji-Dong's mom. So he throws out a filthy deal. He offers up his own stepmom. That's how their dirty pact begins. Two shameless punks, both plotting to get into each other's mom's pants.

"It's only fair. We swap moms."

(Source: DAYcomics)

In a world of mystical beasts and magic, Rei scours everywhere in search of a cure for his curse. Having undergone extensive human testing by the Alchemist Society, he must find an external source to absorb the mana of the insignia that is eating away at his body. On a quest to find the magical flower flos magicae, Rei follows the sound of a distant groaning to discover its source: the remarkably handsome Kylen, writhing in pain. Though this commander is known to many as the captain of the Beast Hunter Corps, he has a secret all his own - the noble knight secretly holds dragon blood, causing him to transform when his body is ripe with mana. To prevent Kylen’s full transformation, Rei kisses the soldier, using his insignia to absorb the magic that surges within. With Rei now knowing his true identity, the Beast Corps captain must find a way to prevent his secret (and his beast) from getting out. Will this savage captain remain a beast, or become a beauty tamed?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Joachim Hjerpe is the one and only sniper of the Secret Intelligence Agency, an organization of individuals with very special abilities. The life of a sniper is extremely stressful, but quitting is not an option, as doing so could mean his own death. His only reprieve is meeting with his seductive and handsome lover, Juergen Eisler, who knows exactly how to fulfill Joachim’s needs. But when the dangers of his professional life threaten to invade his personal life, Joachim decides to part ways with Juergen before it’s too late. Juergen has no idea why Joachim suddenly wants to break up, and he’d sooner keep Joachim in shackles than let him walk out of his life. Will Juergen be able to persuade Joachim to tell him the truth?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extra chapters.

After more than 200 years, the kingdom Chronos is declining. Ten years of peace undermined the army and in the country, formerly called the "Land of the Sword", is left with nothing but old heroes. In the south and east, two major kingdoms threaten Chronos. Silonika Isiris in the west is, too, gaining momentum with the smaller states, united under the Radinka Alliance. In addition, King Chronos apparently begins to lose his mind...

In these challenging times Chronos's only hope lies in their mercenaries, among whom just came a new addition: the young, but incredibly skilled warrior Ares and his friends, Michael and Baron.

25-year-old Ji-Eon is stressed, overworked, and penniless. When a mix-up at a temp job has her spending a day as famous actor Do-Yun Nam’s personal assistant, she takes her anger out on a doll... which turns out to have the magical ability to control him at her every whim. Now it’s her turn to be the boss.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Back on campus after his military service, Jang Daechu can’t wait to get some action. However, a series of untimely events leaves him knee-deep in debt and with a tarnished reputation. All hope seems lost, but one day, he receives an invitation to the “Body Game.” The rules look simple: hide a number on your body, then find the numbers of three other participants. How? By having as much sex as you can! With 30 million won on the line, will this raunchy game help Daechu get back on his feet?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Charming the Duke of the North

description:
Rinha, Korea's most beloved actress, gets into an accident while on set. When she regains consciousness, she realizes she has traveled to the Kingdom of Iklein and meets the northern duke Calcion, who saves her from a demonic beast. Calcion asks her to be his fake lover so she can get into socialite and discover the conspiracy happening in his castle.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hell yeah! A major publisher wants Mai Sohn to write a webcomic on relationships. But she’s struck with heartbreak as her girlfriend abruptly dumps her. It’s hard writing about relationships without being in one, so she needs to find the inspiration for love—and find it fast. And what’s up with her possibly homophobic neighbor? Why is she cool with Mai one minute and then so awkward and weird to her the next?! Can't a girl catch a break?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: My Rat Is an S-Class Awakener

description:
Soul is dropped into a dimension where everyone's screaming about a status window he can't see. On top of that, his pet rat, who also got dropped in with him, turns out to be a beastman and a powerful awakener... And in love with him?! Will Soul and Rio accept each other and make it back home safely?

(Source: Manta)

What happens after the story ends with a “happily ever after”? When Hestia enters her favorite novel as a side character, she happily fangirls from the sidelines. Thinking she’ll return home when the story reaches its end, Hestia finds that the only thing awaiting her is the tragic death of her favorite character. Now miraculously restored to the day of the ending, Hestia decides that she’ll no longer spectate from the sidelines – instead, she’ll save her derelict favorite!

(Source: WEBTOON)

An unknown voice disturbed me while I was levitating during my cultivation to reach the transcendent demonic state.

My concentration had been broken, and I fell into an unconscious, overloaded state. When I awoke a month later, the Lich King had already taken control of the Murim.

After the battle that ended with the destruction of the Heavenly Demon Cult, I awoke a hundred and forty years later in a Murim where magic and martial arts coexisted.

I possessed a supporting character in a reverse harem novel.

As a young concubine who gained the interest of the empress. The concubines and male lords, eventually killed her for treason.

Fortunately, I possessed her just as she was entering the Imperial Palace. Everyone in the Imperial Palace was wary of me, but didn't hate me yet. I don't need, nor do I want to be loved by the empress.

"Come to my room tonight. I'll read you a fairy tale!"
'Woo, don't cry. I'll give you this."

But why is everyone so kind to me? I couldn't understand.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

title.romaji: Geu Angnyeo Insaeng, Jega Hanbeon Sara Bolgeyo
title.english: I Will Live the Life of a Villainess
title.native: 그 악녀 인생, 제가 한번 살아 볼게요

description:
After a fatal car crash, Yuna Jeong awakens in the body of Elena Rosaria, a character in the novel she read in her previous life. But there's a twist—Elena is no ordinary character. She’s a notorious villainess who meets a grim end. Now, Yuna must alter her destiny in a chaotic world and find her way in this new life. Can she rewrite her destiny amidst the surrounding chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON)

We’ve all heard that people would do anything for their 15 minutes of fame, and up-and-coming Mukbang star, Bang Ha-Ri is no different. She was dead set on eating her way to the top until she got slammed with a doctor’s order to lose 20 kg or run the risk of contracting diabetes, coronary heart disease, high blood pressure, and so on. Determined to get back to making mukbang videos, Ha-Ri starts exercising every day after school.

Meanwhile, her classmate, On Do-Yun, has his own problems. Busy fighting his inner demons and trying to keep his urges to suck blood at bay, this half-vampire is in for a shock when the scent of Ha-Ri's blood proves impossible to resist. What makes things even harder is that Ha-Ri won’t stop offering to let him drink her blood. This unlikely pair strikes up a deal to have weekly blood-sucking sessions. But, Do-Yun can’t seem to figure out what makes her sweet-smelling blood so delicious and why she’d go to such trouble just for her career as a mukbang vlogger. As he finds the answers, he soon learns that he’s not the only vampire in town after Ha-Ri's blood… or her heart.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

From childhood, Sohm has always felt queasy and unsettled whenever he looks at Geon, a boy who is almost like him but somehow completely different. The two can never meet eyes without arguing, and when their parents remarry and they suddenly become family, strict rules are put in place to keep the peace. Rule One: Go to and from school together. Rule Two: Hug for thirty full seconds before entering the house. Forced into daily embraces, their unwanted closeness begins to change in ways neither expected. Geon’s teasing eventually leads to something far more risky than bickering, and the two find themselves sharing more than they had ever intended...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19

"The kind of play I prefer is a little too hardcore for newbies."

Seo-Ha, a university lecturer, is a natural submissive with deeply ingrained masochistic tendencies. Yet, fear of being outed has kept him from ever pursuing a real partner, leaving him to indulge only in fantasies. When the fellow professor he has been secretly admiring announces their engagement, Seo-Ha is devastated. In a moment of impulsive rebellion, he turns to a BDSM community to find a one-night play partner, hoping to finally experience the domination he’s always craved. But this leap into the unknown may lead him down a path far more intense—and dangerous—than he ever imagined

(Source: Lezhin US)

From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here’s the secret: they aren’t actually related. Haeun’s just been living with Taesung’s family since her parents went to live abroad, and that’s the way it’s been for the last 15 years. They’re basically real sister and brother at this point…until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl’s sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts…and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun’s reaction? She’s blushing, squirming, not saying anything… Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? Things come to light, and Taesung’s starting to look at his “sister” a little bit differently now…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yoon Bom-bit loves one thing above all else – dating simulation games. Her most recent obsession? A feudal-era game called “The Lonely Hawk Sings in the Absinthe-Colored Cage” starring Anette De Valois. Bom-bit would do anything to give Anette the happy ending she deserves…but her plans are consistently ruined by Mariette: Anette’s twisted stepsister who leads Bom-bit to getting a bad ending over and over again. One day, Bom-bit starts her computer up, only to be transported into the world of the game – and inside Mariette’s body! With this newfound chance, will Bom-bit be able to help Anette finally get the happy ending of her dreams?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A close and dangerous cohabitation with the cult leader's son has begun!

Chung-A was swindled by her uncle who she trusted and her parents disappeared, saying they are chasing their missing uncle, and Chung-A suddenly begins living on her own. But it wasn't just Chung-A's family that was scammed! The biggest cult in the autonomous district, "Millennium Adventist," was also deceived by her uncle. And Yo-Han, the son of the cult leader, came to Chung-A's house. He's dragging his luggage in...! God, is this cohabitation gonna be okay?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

At Kangsan High School, one of the nation's most troubled schools, Gu Se-Ra is the top student. Her childhood crush, her older boarder, Lee Seo-Jun, comes to Kangsan High School for a teaching internship, and she experiences numerous hardships with the troubled students. To protect her crush, Gu Se-Ra resolves to transform this troubled school into a model one.

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, after two months of working cleaning bathrooms at a hotel, Johan's predecessor asks him to leave because he's coming back. All Johan has left is his younger brother, Philip.

A man says to Johan that he resembles someone he knew well, and suddenly offers him a job. Maybe it's a scam or something dangerous, but it pays $5,000 a month.

Johan now lives in a shabby, crumbling hut far away from the ridiculously huge mansion, but he's happy. That is, until he meets Herbert...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Lee Jeong-hyeok enters the Department of Physical Education at Lejin University as a track and field special student. His goal is to graduate with diligence and become a physical education teacher. Following his routine, he heads out to the field the day after a training session. However, things take an interesting turn when his classmate Yoo So-ra appears. Despite having just finished her own training, something even most men would struggle with, So-ra continues to run ahead, piquing Jeong-hyeok’s curiosity. The problem is, So-ra misinterprets his gaze, thinking he’s staring at her chest. But that’s just the beginning… While drunk, the famous 100-meter racer and influencer, Im Yoo-ju, unexpectedly asks Jeong-hyeok a personal question. To make matters worse, a sports massage therapist secretly rubs her genitals on Jeong-hyeok’s hand in an attempt to suppress her sexual urges. Amidst these strange and heated situations, Jeong-hyeok must navigate through them while striving to stay on track for his graduation. Will he be able to make it through without losing his focus?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Three years ago, Tae-Yang’s boyfriend ended their relationship by announcing his engagement to someone else. Tae-Yang never expected to cross paths with him again, yet while investigating suspicious rumors surrounding the couple, the journalist suddenly finds himself face to face with his ex, Woo Ju-Yeol. Ju-Yeol offers Tae-Yang exclusive information for his reports, but the price is unsettling: Tae-Yang must be at his beck and call for sex, no questions asked.. Determined to expose Ju-Yeol’s darkest secrets, Tae-Yang accepts the deal. What begins as a transaction soon spirals into a dangerous mix of obsession, desire, and revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After working like crazy at X small company, Jeong Seon-Woo finally succeeded in moving to a large company. With a clean face, the flattery skills honed at X small company, and top-notch social skills, Jeong Seon-Woo was confident that he would not be outdone no matter where he went. However, that confidence was shattered within 30 minutes of his first day at work...

The new employee whom I had scolded with 200% of my old-timer power turned out to be in a higher position than me?! He made a good first impression.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

It’s hard for omegas to find jobs, but Song Hayoon does the best he can. He spends all his time on part-time jobs just so he can pay back his father’s debts. It’s not easy, but he makes it work… but sometimes he wonders if there ever will be an escape out of this never-ending vicious cycle of a life. Then one day, he comes to learn that the prestigious Taewon Group has taken over all his debts. And none other than the Executive Vice President, Kang Hyun-tae, comes to offer him a job… as his personal boytoy. Will this put an end to Hayoon’s troubles, or will it be the start of his new misery?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

The last thing a powerful attorney like Jin Do-Ha wants to do on the weekends is fill in for his sister as a housekeeper. It doesn't help that his client, Yi Won-Yi, always finishes the chores for him. Won-Yi, on the other hand, is just trying to live her best life as far away from her messy family as possible. At the law firm where she works, she's known for being cold and distant, but somehow Do-Ha never sees that side of her. Could her rare show of openness have to do with her feelings for him?

(Source: Tapas)

Nick Stockton, ex-mercenary and now head of a top security firm, has never once lost control—until he crosses paths with Owen Rose, the stunning CEO of Rose Biotech. The moment their eyes meet, Nick is hit with an overwhelming surge of pheromones. He knows instantly: Owen is his Omega. When terrorists launch a sudden attack on Owen, Nick steps in without hesitation. Grateful and intrigued, Owen invites Nick to his secluded estate. But Owen harbors a dark belief—that he’s a “monster Omega,” ever since a childhood incident where he injured his Alpha cousin. He’s spent his life in strict control… until Nick’s bold, relentless (and a bit reckless) pursuit shatters his defenses. As their bond deepens, Nick begins investigating the attack—and uncovers a chilling truth. This wasn’t just a strike against Rose Biotech. Someone is after Owen himself. And Nick will stop at nothing to protect what’s his.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seoha, an abandoned child, whose relatives gave up on him after he lost his family. An uncle who is unable to forget his wife and their unborn child.

Their growth as the two of them wander through the snowy winter.

Cheoldu, a barbarian raised on Earth, lives a mundane life with his best friend Jintae. But when he sees an alien creature from his planet on the news, everything changes. Thrown into an apocalyptic challenge, Cheoldu and Jintae must adjust their lives in Nova, a savage world filled with goblins and ogres. Will the two conquer Nova’s perils and uncover the secrets that could change Earth’s fate? An epic tale of friendship, survival, and untamed adventure awaits.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Gong Eun-tae, an ordinary sales employee you can find anywhere, wins the jackpot in the lottery—something he had only dreamed of! After taxes, he takes home 1.8 billion won. A large sum, but is it really enough to turn his life upside down?

"Let’s just live as I always have… I'll think of the lottery as insurance for my peace of mind."

With that reassuring safety net, he takes the leap— and suddenly, everything he does starts going unbelievably well?! Today, Eun-tae heads to work once again! But this time, with a whole new mindset.

(Source: Naver, translated)

From the creator of Hook, Line, and Sinker comes its hilarious sequel!

Now that Kye-Soo and Myung-Tae are free of Kang Shin-Joo, he has his eyes set his next target - Myung-Tae’s older brother, Young-Joo. And while Young-Joo doesn’t exactly reciprocate the interest, he’s having a hard time forgetting the particularly…perky aspects of Shin-Joo’s undeniably flawless physique. Will the smarmy schemer Shin-Joo be able to use his charisma to reel in his bait this time? Or is this relationship dead in the water before it even begins?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Na-Yeon is shocked when she meets her mother's new boyfriend Pil-Ju, who's come to punish Na-Yeon for what she did to him in the past.

(Source: Toomics)

Judith, a war orphan with supernatural powers, survives thanks to an anonymous benefactor. He showers her with gifts but never replies. When she finally receives a reply, she travels to meet him. But who is her benefactor out of the charming rogue, successful businessman, and snarky gang leader?

(Source: Manta)

From twisted games of evil demons and the roaming of the undead to strange technology that makes the impossible happen, dive into Tales of the Unusual 2, another thrilling collection of supernatural horror stories that will have you scrolling for hours. With just the right balance of dark humor and the unexpected, each short story pulls you into a new immersive world and unravels plot twists you never would've imagined. Just remember, there's nothing to be afraid of... If you have nothing to hide.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The omnibus mystery drama Whisper Whisper by an old writer is back! A strange story that exists somewhere in the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

When a swarm of giant bugs threatens to wipe out humanity, the world’s only defense is a group of humans with special abilities called Butterflies. For Maehwa Baek, Butterflies are just heroic people he sees on TV until a tragic event brings him to the scientists that created them. Soon, Maehwa must confront questions about himself that he has long avoided: why does he lose control at the sight of his own blood? And what happened during the 13 years of his life that he can’t remember?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Duke Rotary obsesses over which of his sons will be his heir, and the battle to succeed him is vicious. Born a boy, but raised as a girl by his mother to spare him a hard life, Crystal Rotary lives in peace until the Duke tries to marry him off. To protect his secret, he flees and offers himself to the rival Duke Illian Pentrin, hoping to hide there until he can escape for good. Little does he know he's not the only one with secrets. Can Crystal run from his past, or will his lies ensnare him?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Seven years ago, Kanna was thrown into the body of a Korean girl named Ju-Hwa. She had everything in her new life—a loving family, a great boyfriend, a hard-won medical license, even her own clinic! But that all changes when she's suddenly swapped back one day. Just as she's been in Ju-Hwa's body, Ju-Hwa has been in hers... and she's left Kanna's life a mess! First things first, she's going to divorce her cold husband, Duke Silvian Valentino. After that? Revenge on everyone who's wronged her.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The day Yeon-U’s contract marriage came to an end was also the day that she witnessed her soon-to-be ex-husband, Seon-Jae, die right in front of her eyes. But when a twist of fate has her travel 100 days back in time before the tragic accident, she decides to do everything she can to stop the accident from happening. With a second chance to make things right, Yeon-U is determined to make sure that, this time around, they get their happy ending.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

After overcoming a miserable life, she entered the university full of excitement. Da-Bom, who had countless dreams and desires about university, encountered a villain on her very first day... And it's somewhat awkward from the start!

"Is my campus life going to be okay?!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Se-I Lim spends time with her mother, Hye-Jeong, at Taeseung Mall, where they meet Myeong-Hyeon, the mall’s CEO. Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to tutor her son, Seung-Hyo. However, Se-I accidentally walks in on Seung-Ju, Seung-Hyo’s older brother, naked. Seung-Ju accuses Se-I of being a pervert, but Myeong-Hyeon doesn’t believe him. Seung-Ju insists Se-I is the only one who has seen him naked, and Myeong-Hyeon, confused, wonders if Seung-Ju might be gay. Concerned, Myeong-Hyeon asks Se-I to investigate Seung-Ju for three months. Will Se-I uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

While running a small pharmacy in the outskirts of the city, Sam meets a mysterious and out of place patient. Is that all there is to him though?

(Source: Toomics)

No matter how much things can be like that, I never thought I would lock lips with my old rival whom I haven't seen in eight years. Andodam, who was so curious about the past that he ended up summoning the door of time.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Gosuwi BL Danpyeonseon (고수위 BL 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Skeleton Becomes a Cat Dad

description:
Life becomes a nightmare for Skelly when the oddest cat they've ever seen arrives on their doorstep. It's definitely not the Persian cat they ordered... not only is it hairless, but it pees constantly and cries around the clock. As if the neighbors' complaints aren't enough trouble, the vet bills are sky high and nearly bankrupts the newly independent skeleton. But even a mutant cat deserves an owner-- and so, Skelly struggles to fill the shoes of a cat dad with the help of an alcoholic succubus and a devil priest. Meanwhile, a mysterious demon notices their unique pet and wants to steal it for sinister reasons. Can Skelly protect their new cat from kidnappers and other threats within the Devildom, let alone handle living together with it?

(Source: TappyToon)

A comical fight between two perfectionists over the abolition of the game company ‘Castle Soft’.

(Source: YLAB)

Notes: this is the third season of Prince-ui Wangja. Belongs to Red String universe.

Geonwoo and Haru have been friends since elementary school. Now university students, their friendship continues as strong as ever. Both are currently single so after her friend cancels their Christmas Eve plans, Haru decides to invite Geonwoo to spend it with her. A memory of a promise made when they were younger as well as Haru’s choice in clothing that night makes Geonwoo start seeing Haru in a different light, and the fine line between lovers and friends starts getting blurred.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

I found someone who looks exactly like me on SNS! He seems to have everything unlike me who grew up in an orphanage. Maybe he could be my twin?! When I was about to find him and solve my life problems, I got into huge trouble!!

(Source: YLAB)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

Mysterious black circles have started appearing all over the world, and whoever falls in doesn't come back out. Then one day, a black circle swallows an entire school and everyone in it, turning it into a twisted maze of nightmares. Will Doyun and his classmates find a way out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kim Jee-Ha comes from a good background with decent grades and test results; however, he has one big flaw - when it comes to official events like university interviews for example, he is horrible. To overcome his social awkwardness, he embarks upon the virtual reality game Trikia where he meets an eccentric high level undead Nine - his future guild master.

Source: Manga Updates

Hui-Seong, who fell in love with Han-Gyeol after watching his short track speed skating performance during their school days, goes abroad to study. Upon his return, Han-Gyeol, now a national short track athlete, awaits Hui-Seong. The two become drunken sexual partners and awkwardly come to terms with their own feelings. With a major life goal ahead of them, can they find synergy through each other?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In a twist of fate, Ro-A finds herself thrown back a decade in time. This isn't just a trip down memory lane. She's faced with a younger, naive Si-Hyeon, the future superstar who would brutally wrong her. Armed with knowledge of what's to come, Ro-A sees a golden opportunity: a chance to rewrite their history. Can she resist the allure of revenge and change Si-Hyeon's destiny before he becomes her nightmare?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

Stories that crawl up and down your spine.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

At the Changgwan, the musician So-seo, who played the biwa, meets Ki Se-Won, the first person to recognize his talent. Though he opens his heart to his warm demeanor, strange events soon unfold, and So-Seo, realizing Ki Se-Won is behind them, tries to escape. But he is already caught in his relentless grasp, and Ki Se-Won, watching So-Seo crumble, confronts the changes within himself.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Kwon Jiwu is a top actor blessed with perfect looks and talent, but there’s one strange problem: every male animal seems to be in love with him. After yet another chaotic day on set fending off animal admirers, he’s ready to snap when his cheeky junior co-star Ju Yeongwon starts picking a fight. Just as Jiwu is about to put him in his place, something catches his eye. Cat ears? Wait a second, was Yeongwon one of those “male animals” all along?

(Source: Lezhin US)

For generations, the power of the Imugi has been passed down to the nation’s sacred Oracle—a divine protector of peace and balance. But for the young Oracle Ho-Yeong, that power remains dormant. Cast aside as a failure within the palace, he finds solace only in Chi Woo, the noble heir of the prestigious House of Chi. One night, Ho-Yeong stumbles upon Chi Woo in a forbidden tryst—and with it, awakens a feeling he's never known. As secrets unfurl behind silk screens and sacred duty collides with dangerous desire, Ho-Yeong's path as the Oracle may lead to more than just prophecy… it may unearth a destiny no one saw coming.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Scary and mysterious ghost stories. You're going to get cursed, once you listen to them...

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Ryu Su-Ho has trouble falling asleep every night. The only voice on Channel "J" that helps him sleep disappears one day. His insomnia returns, and he stops by a convenience store hoping to finally fall asleep tonight. He hears "J," the voice he thought he'd never hear again. He can't let go of the only person who can cure his terrible insomnia. In his haste, Su-Ho blurts out a few words to him...

"...Mr. J, right?"

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Unknown Caller is a horror anthology with stories from renowned Korean creators who have been scaring audiences for years. These stories use augmented reality to unveil the creatures that haunt your home.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: It began publishing exclusively through LINE Webtoon's app on October 24, 2016.

After Crown Prince Marmel falls into a deep slumber, Sonidor the Dream Meister must use her power of entering dreams through physical contact to wake him. But as she takes on a new form each time she enters his dreams, she discovers that the prince isn't cursed, forcing her to delve deeper into his subconscious to discover the source of his eternal sleep. Will finding that source help him overcome his trauma, or will facing it trap the prince and the Dream Meister in a nightmare forever?

(Source: Tapas)
The second season of Our Paradise.

The great house of the Azure Mountain Yeon clan was annihilated by forces that conspired against them. The only survivor was Yeon Hojung. Left alone in the uncaring expanse of the central plains, Hojung turned to the path of darkness for survival and ruthlessly chased power to become the Dark Emperor. After a long, bloody battle that ended in his demise, Hojung reawakens to find himself 26 years in the past with his beloved Yeon Clan and a second chance at life.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Black Leopard Family's Snow Leopard Baby

description:
The child of a black leopard and a snow leopard shapeshifter, 7-year-old Tiel escapes her abusive family to seek refuge with the father she never knew. All she wants is safety, but her father, the feared Duke Asterian, has other plans... to give his long-lost daughter a loving family and a wonderful home! Now, Tiel is set on protecting her family from the evil forces who want to take her away. Can she fight these foes to save her new home? Or will Tiel lose her loved ones once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Eda has been in training to be a priest all his life. He is chaste, kind, and spiritual, everything a priest should be. What will happen when his priesthood is threatened by a hooded man in the middle of the night?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Mino’s just like any other cat on the streets, except he’s got a secret… He’s actually a rare musk cat, and on top of that, he’s an omega. Mino hides his heats with as much suppressants he can get his paws on. If anyone found out his secret and just how much he’s worth, he could get in some serious trouble. But one day, a mysterious cat named Yiho prances into his life. Yiho’s so handsome and he smells better than any other cat Mino’s met, but he’s also got so much to hide…

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a long day at work, all she wanted was a moment of rest on a park bench. But when she closed her eyes, she awoke in a different place—and now, whenever she goes to sleep, she wakes up, trapped in a tiny room with a towering man whose wild, animalistic presence sends a shiver down her spine. Every night, she finds herself beneath him, powerless against the pleasure and confusion he brings. Is it a dream? A different world? Or something in between? As the boundary between reality and fantasy begins to blur, a strange and all-consuming romance unfolds—one that defies time, reason, and her very sense of self.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yulia Von Rosenthal gave everything she had to serve her liege and love, Emperor Leonard, but she was rewarded with betrayal and death because of her "ugly" appearance, the result of an age-long family curse. Just when she thinks everything is over, Yulia finds herself alive, eight years before her death. Determined not to repeat her past mistakes, she ventures out on a journey to break her curse and become stronger. The question is, will that be enough for Yulia to escape Leonard's clutches?

(Source: Tapas)
Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

Luke has devised a plan to sleep with his childhood friend, but will he succeed?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

title.english: My Comeback as the Youngest Member

description:
