After being disqualified from the famous boy group survival reality show Stardust Project, Seo-Han finds himself stuck in a mundane life of part-time work, unable to achieve his dreams of debuting. But then, an unexpected twist of fate catapults him eight years back in time, just before the inception of the show. Now equipped with years of experience, Seo-Han is determined to rewrite his story and fulfill his dreams with this second chance. With the many challenges and dark sides of the music industry, will he finally succeed in debuting as a member of a boy band this time?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Prepare to swallow your screams. This horror anthology is loaded with special effects for maximum scare–just in time for Halloween.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Stories Included:
1. Gwisinalba (귀신알바, A Ghostly Job) [DEY]
2. Live (라이브, Live) [Dan-Woo]
3. Sontopdal (손톱달, Stratching) [Jin-Guk Im]
4. Ttogakttogak (또각또각, Footsteps) [Karin Park]
5. Bunsinsaba (분신사바, Spirits) [Yong-Jin Kim]
6. Usan (우산, The Umbrella) [Yetsaram]
7. Jjirasigoedam (찌라시괴담, Tabloids) [Yeowon]
8. Nae Kkumeun Hyeonmoyangcheo (내 꿈은 현모양처, Good Wife) [joana]
9, I Black Dress (아이 블랙 드레스, I, Black Dress) [Bo Ri Cheong]
10. Hwanhyangnyeo (환향녀, The Returned Girls) [Il-Gwon Go]
11. Hyeolgyu (혈규(穴竅), The Hole) [Story: Oenunbagi x Art: Sihyun]
12. Gyegok(계곡, The Creek) [Soohun]
13. Danjjak (단짝, Best Friends) [Story: Se-Jun Park x Art: Jae-Il Seo]
14. Imyeong (이명, Tinnitus) [Yun-Jin Choi]
15. Siljong (실종, Missing) [Hong-Jun Choi]
16. Jumeonigwisin (주머니귀신) [Chyupeuretji]
17. Ppalgan Yeojaui Sup (빨간 여자의 숲, The Red Woman's Forest) [Rangddo]
18. Maengin (맹인) [Story: Massstar x Art: Jin-Guk Im]
19. Jeonsaenggeim (전생게임, The Past Life Game) [DEY]

Entertainment reporter Lee Ju-Won died in a traffic accident. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself possessed by Jung Yeon-U, the chaebol heir and entertainment company director. Before he could even process the situation, the doorbell rang. Standing at the door was... national heartthrob actor Seo Hui-Jae?! Without hesitation, Hui-Jae entered the room and approached Yeon-U, kissing him roughly.

Could I possibly be... Seo Hui-Jae's sex partner?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

To save her younger sister Aria from her illness, Cassmire Crisis became a mercenary, wielding a sword and shedding blood to pay for her medicine. But when Cassmire suffers a fall one day, memories of her past life as Aria’s wicked stepsister come flooding back. Rather than take up the role of villainess again, Cassmire vows to protect Aria this time. But with Aria doomed by the story to face only hardships, Cassmire must pick up her weapon once more to become her sister’s loyal sword!

(Source: Tapas)

One day, Eun-Chan Jung receives a confession from Seo-Yeon Kwon, a promising junior in Taekwondo who is in a slump. Because of his meddlesome personality, he cannot just ignore the promising junior, so he promises to accept her confession if she wins a gold medal in the next competition. Eun-Chan ignores his feelings, saying that it is a win-win relationship that helps both sides, and begins to pile up actions that he will regret more and more…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

The criminal organization disrupting the city's order. Do Hyun-Woo, the hound deployed to uncover the secrets of the Black Cloud Society. Infiltrating was fine, but for some reason, a figure named Team Leader Ha began obstructing Hyun-Woo's every move.

“Well, I'm just a beta, you know?!”

“This is weird. But why does this smell so damn tempting?”

Team Leader Ha, who invades even his personal space, causes complications in the undercover operation...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Living in a world infested with monsters is hard enough, but doing it without powers? That’s Hanyeol’s life in a nutshell. Fearsome beasts roam the earth and kill everyone in their path. Elite members of society called the Awakened mobilize to protect humanity with their supernatural abilities. Amidst it all, Hanyeol is just a poor porter, tasked as sideline support. But when a benevolent being gifts him with special abilities, he’s ready to harvest all the loot and take it to the next level!

(Source: Tapas)

On his last day of surgical residency, Dr. Jung Haejin was hit by a truck, and his life came to a tragic end. Miraculously, he wakes up in the body of Choi Giseok, a soon-to-be surgical intern and Haejin's heart transplant recipient. As he makes sense of his resurrection, he notices holographic screens that only he can see, showing the exact statuses of his patients and medical colleagues. Now, Dr. Choi vows to use this inexplicable power to become the world's best cardiothoracic surgeon.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes Chapter 0.

Jung Hyun-ho is an average office worker who is infatuated with his team leader, Seo Doha, also known as Mr. Seo. Despite confessing his love, Mr. Seo remains strictly professional and pays no attention to Hyun-ho's romantic advances. Frustrated and unable to resist his feelings, Hyun-ho purchases a unique adult toy with intriguing instructions. Filled with a mix of excitement and guilt, he begins to indulge in his fantasies, imagining what it would be like to be intimate with his boss. However, at that very moment, a peculiar and unexpected event unfolds, causing a ripple effect on both Hyun-ho and Mr. Seo's lives in ways they could never have imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Nina has carefully crafted an image for herself, but will sex ruin everything?

(Source: Toomics)

Ban Yuwon just wanted to get into college. But instead, he was summoned to an academy in another dimension. There, every student must climb the legendary Tower of Babel, built by Yuwon's own ancestor. Armed with the "Babylonian Code," an ability that lets him absorb and manipulate all languages, he sets out to conquer the tower and reclaim his family’s lost honor. However, with deadly monsters, hidden traps, and ruthless rivals from across dimensions, can Yuwon survive the climb?

(Source: Tapas)

"A fateful encounter between Joy, with a special gene, and Moowon, who has top class super abilities!"

The average girl Joy suddenly becomes the target of super powers due to her genetic mutation that she never knew about.
The super powered Moowon, who is at a supreme level, gets sent to protect her. And then out of the blue, Joy's gene makes Moowon feel strongly attracted to her no matter how much his rationality tires to resist...

(Source: NetComics)

AI robots are fighting against humans... for humanity. The world has fallen victim to a terrible virus, which turns people into zombie-like creatures. The government has decided to eradicate the infected people rather than cure them. But, Hasty, a housekeeper AI robot, cannot give up on her master Navil. She is willing to fight... for humanity.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Was there ever a greater tragedy than love turned to hate? Such is the tragic downfall of Emperor Ludwig of Berzantium, as he is betrayed and murdered in a fiery blaze by his empress. Olive Charleterre was once a bright young debutante, until her spirit was broken by the emperor’s cruelty. Yet when Ludwig opens his eyes, he finds he has been sent back in time to his childhood. Whether he uses this boon to reclaim his lost love and forge a new path away from his villainous future -- only time will tell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Five years ago, Winston and Yu-Jin fell deeply and irrevocably in love at first sight. But their passionate relationship shattered when Winston discovered the unthinkable truth: Yu-Jin’s was having an affair with none other than his own father. Consumed by betrayal, Winston channeled the love he once cherished into resentment. Yet no matter how hard he tries, Winston cannot extinguish the pull he still feels. Now, reunited by fate and unresolved wounds, passion and scorn intertwine… But can either of them truly escape what they once meant to each other?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"The King was killed by his own concubine?!"
Min-Ju suddenly remembered her past life while taking an exam. She was very embarrassed when she remembered but tried to calm down because the most important thing in that moment was her college entrance examination and not her previous life. However, Hu-Gang, who was her husband from the previous life, appeared. Min-Ju's life is in a crisis now.

"Forget about the past life, Min-Ju. Hurry up and study!!"

Note:
- Includes a Prologue.
- Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

You tore out my heart. Now, I must find out why.

The humans of the Bavenberg Empire and the sea people called mermarcs have been embroiled in a bloody war for over a decade. When a truce is finally called, a young half-mermarc girl called Cordelia is sent to the imperial palace as a token of peace. As the years pass by, she befriends the imperial prince, Noah von Bavenberg, and the lady-in-waiting, Melina von Hannover. She has everything that she could want or need, except for one thing - the ability to set foot outside of the imperial villa. Despite this, Cordelia spends her days free from care, surrounded by the love of her friends and the generosity of the emperor.

However, on her 18th birthday, Cordelia's life takes a dark and twisted turn. After a horrific incident, she finds herself transported two years back in time.

Can Cordelia remove the veil from her eyes to discover the sinister truth behind the empire? Will she be able to save herself from the inevitable events to come?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

College student So-Yi Han has been unable to move on from the lingering affection she has for her ex-boyfriend. She tries to sort out her complicated feelings by concentrating on her studies, and receives a flower pot from a local elder to use for a class at school. But little does she know, the pot she receives happens to be a cursed pot, where a man's soul is trapped...

(Source: Naver, translated)

On the beautiful Jeju Island, Mi-Ho Won, a beautiful teacher, and Van, a cold and mysterious guy, become entangled in strange events, fighting unknown monsters. A legend of exorcism comics is back as webtoon!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

There’s a convenience store that feels uncomfortable but somehow keeps drawing you in. One day, a new night-shift part-timer appears at the small convenience store -- his rugged looks fill everyone with unease, but soon he brings about a refreshing change to this small convenience store. He helps not only his coworkers but also customers, resolving their worries and troubles. Who is this mysterious night-shift part-timer?

(Source: WEBTOON)

"I should never have looked at my girlfriend's phone that day."

From a friend, I hear a strange rumor about my girlfriend, Olivia.

"They said Olivia walked out of a motel. And... she wasn't alone. She was with another guy."

I tell myself it must have been a mistake and try to brush it off, but the doubt takes root in the back of my mind. For the first time, and the last, I check my girlfriend's phone.

"What are you doing? Take it off. Everything. Your bra and panties too."

(Source: TOPTOON)

Edmund, a vampire who lives as the famous actor Sharon Thane but has actually lived for hundreds of years, has one problem. His relationship with his subordinate Michael is not what it used to be. When they first met, the stimulating and rough sex was satisfying...

Why on earth has this guy changed?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

At a remarkably young age, Choi Mu-Jin has already ascended to the prestigious position of second-in-command within the notorious national syndicate, 'Weolha Organization.' While he is a figure of intense envy and admiration among his subordinates, Mu-Jin carries a burden no one else suspects, a hidden, degrading mission assigned by the Chairman himself. Every week under the cover of darkness, he is sent to extract semen from Baek Wu-Yeon, the Chairman’s secluded ""human talisman"" kept hidden away from the world.

Inside the suffocating luxury of a high-end penthouse, the command is always the same: ""Suck it."" The moment Wu-Yeon’s lips part, Mu-Jin’s autonomy vanishes entirely. Faced with an order he is powerless to refuse, Mu-Jin finds himself trapped in a cycle of duty and desire. Can he successfully carry out his visceral task tonight, or will the weight of this secret finally break him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

With the press of a button, Yu Sol’s life is about to turn upside down. When a mysterious post with the power to transport the user to their favorite fictional universe pops up on his feed, Sol clicks “share” and falls asleep…only to awake the next day as a round, winged puffball! Try to speak as he might, he can only mutter one word- er, sound: “Peep!” With his new avian appearance, Sol must navigate the land of Sevon under the guiding hand of his new (strikingly handsome) owner, Karhan Barthés, while trying to find a way back to world from which he came.

(Soure: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Rules of Rose Ivy Manor

description:
Rosé Ovair thinks she woke up in a romantic love story where she's the rich heroine with a handsome fiancé, but her new home... isn't quite right. Her family seems to be keeping the cause of her father's death from her, and the servants all have fake names. Unfortunately, she is so enamored by the idea of marrying a good-looking man that she fails to notice much else! Will Rosé realize that breaking the rules of Rose Ivy Manor leads to deadly consequences before it's too late?

(Source: Tapas)

A men's clinic in the neighborhood is always filled with male patients. Is there something different about this clinic?

(Source: Toomics)

Starting as friends and teasing each other for seven years, Tae-Rang and Jun-Hui clearly like each other now, yet their relationship hasn't progressed. Frustrated by Jun-Hui's passive attitude, Tae-Rang boldly tries to kiss him only to suddenly get a nosebleed.

'Why now of all times!'

He curses his tendency to get nosebleeds, but Jun-Hui's reaction is strange...?

Looking down, he sees Jun-Hui's excited, somewhat embarrassed expression and a vigorously erect member greeting him. His momentary embarrassment quickly turns to gratitude that Jun-Hui has a nosebleed fetish. With each trickle of blood, he resolves to seduce Jun-Hui...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Succubi are the weakest in the underworld... But what if one was able to again sexual control over the Demon King?

(Source: Lalatoon)

Jihyo is an Account Executive at a mid-size ad firm. Jegook is Jihyo's ex-boyfriend who shows up one day as a very important client. Jihyo tries to avoid working for Jegook, but the client is too important for her company that she has no way to escape.

What does he want from Jihyo?!

(Source: NETComics)

title.english: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog

description:
After a rough day and a run-in with a missing dog, overworked office worker Umi Seo wakes up to a surreal nightmare: she’s trapped in the body of her boss’s beloved pet. By day, Umi is a dog. By night, she’s back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her normal life for good? Or will she be stuck living on a leash forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Young Alice Estevan has a secret. She was actually reborn in "The Tyrant's Silver Flower," a hardcore, tragic BL where she'll be killed for abusing the male leads! Luckily, she still has time to avoid that fate by liberating Edwin, one of the male leads, from the tower he's trapped in. And though she succeeds in getting the key to free the boy, there's just one problem: he hates her guts! With the threat of death looming ever so closer, will Alice win Edwin over and earn her happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)
Note: Part of Metatoon's Bulgongjeong Danpyeonseon (불공정 단편선) Collection.

Moon-Su has to win another short-film award to become a full-length filmmaker. A good actor produces a good film! To cast the famous actress Su-Ah Kang who returned to film major, Moon-Su approaches her...

"Hey... This is just casting. How far are you taking this?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Actor Jung Woo-Jin kills his co-star by firing a gun loaded with live bullets instead of a prop while filming a movie. Woo-Jin, who was only acting according to the script, appeals his innocence, but no one believes him. He then encounters Seo Ju-Yeon, who introduces herself as his sponsor, and his bodyguard Kwon Seung-Hyun...

"Honestly, I feel like I'm going to faint just thinking about that time... when the bullet went through my heart."

Could this crazy person have done everything...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Dulbodaneun Sen Danpyeonseon (둘보다는 셋 단편선) Collection.

What does it take for a guy to get laid, you ask? Well, a hell of a lot of tries is the answer. Lee Si-Hyeon is a 21-year-old virgin who has been in the bottom rungs when it comes to getting laid—and it’s not the kind of bottom he aspires to be. After four failed attempts at having sex, Si-Hyeon’s fifth attempt is finally successful. Kind of. He wakes up in bed with his former-childhood-best-friend, present-arch-nemesis, Han Baek-Kyung. Baek-Kyung may not have been the top of Si-Hyeon’s list of eligible boys, but he could be the top Si-Hyeon needs to undo the curse on his sex life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

title.english: The Regressed Demon Lord Is Kind

description:
Zich Moore, the fearsome Demon Lord, is struck down by the hero Glen Zenard. As he dies, he hears Glen's request: for him to be a good person if he is ever reborn. Miraculously, Zich awakens in the body of his younger self and resolves to be a better individual. But the problem is... he has no idea what it means to be good! Can the former Demon Lord truly learn what it means to be kind? Or will his old habits and misconceptions about virtue and goodness make redemption difficult?

(Source: Tapas)

Arsinoe knows a few things about redos. Her first three lives all followed the same tragic script: born the scorned daughter of an enslaved queen, married to a crown prince as charming as he is cruel, and driven to death by the very man she trusted. But in her fourth, Arsinoe refuses to play the doomed princess. Determined to claim her own destiny, she forms an unexpected alliance with Walter Heibergh, the kingdom’s most formidable commander — one powerful enough to change fate itself.

(Source: Tapas)

Kwon Ju-Shin gets a candle that can reproduce omega pheromones with 90% accuracy. Using this candle, he tries to think back to his first love, but for some reason, he thinks of his alpha acquaintance Sung Je-Won rather than an omega. Ju-Shin decides to have fun with the candle instead of getting rid of it, so he has a bet with Je-Won to see who can withstand the candle's effect. However, the candle unlocks Ju-Shin's desire to be with Je-Won, and try as he might, he can't stop wanting him, a fellow alpha.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Katisha Ainsley's adoptive grandfather dies and leaves her with a grieving heart... as well as an incredible fortune! Katisha's grandpa was actually the former Duke Blasco, the head of a villainous family. Fearing what the Blascos would do to get the inheritance, Katisha joins them to reverse the will. But as they work together, she begins to like the evil family, and they start finding her too cute to hate. Can Katisha safely return the Blascos' riches, or will she stay the villains' heiress?

(Source: Tapas)

You think your ghost stories are scary? Try listening to these stories from the ghosts themselves.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
<i>Note: The first three chapters were initially published in the anthology "Neoui Kkoriro Eungeung ♥".

title.english: The Baby Fairy Is a Villainess

description:
Since awakening as a fairy, Lichesia the Enchantress was constantly on the run from fairy hunters wanting to sell her. Now, hoping to learn who was really behind the hunters, she poses as 5-year-old Chesha to infiltrate the mysterious House Basillian... by getting adopted! But Count Basillian and his three sons are a peculiar bunch, and while they spoil Chesha, the count seems to be plotting something sinister. Can the Enchantress get her revenge and make it out of this strange house alive?

(Source: Tapas)

Alex grew up lonely, forced to live as an Alpha. He likes Nathan, who comforted him regardless of his traits, but pushes him away coldly to protect him from a certain incident. Nine years later, Alex reunites with Nathan as a witness in an assigned case... Alex tries to offer a belated apology, but Nathan draws a firm line. Amidst this, Alex develops hormonal abnormalities due to side effects from his suppressant, and Nathan discovers this. Contrary to his cold demeanor, Nathan steps forward to help him. Within this relationship that began without emotion, the two begin to waver once more.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Everyone loves her, so everyone hates her. Her name is ‘Bible.’ Her college life is getting complicated amidst the unwanted love and hatred. “I love you, Bible.”.

(Source: YLAB)

Note: Part of YLAB's Red String Universe.

After getting scammed with his apartment, Hyeon-U needed quick cash. After getting an offer from his close friend, he starts working as a delivery man of . He thought it was going to be a regular delivery service, but his first customer grabs "His part".

"Did it get big because of me?"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Lehanne Copland led an ordinary life as a wife and a mother before a carriage accident cut her life short. In the next moment, she finds herself in the extraordinary situation of being 19 once more! Ecstatic at this second chance but reluctant to let go of her old life, Lehanne decides to do just one thing differently: confess to Schudermel Laft, her first love. But when she succeeds in asking him to be her partner for a party, Lehanne discovers he is not quite like what she had imagined...

(Source: Tapas)

Once reviled as the wicked magician Hailey, the most hated woman in the realm, she was cast into a poisoned wasteland to die. But death never came. A year later, she’s alive and farming, bickering with a tree fairy, and somehow the new Marchioness Maron. As secrets of the contamination zone begin to surface and the ghosts of her past return, Hailey must decide whether to seek vengeance or build something new from ruins. When survival itself becomes the greatest twist of fate, who needs revenge?

(Source: Tapas)
The captivating story of an budding artist, who is willing to come out of his mother's shadow so as to paint whatever he sees... mainly things concerning the supernatural.

If there’s one thing Do Haejoo loves more than her job, it’s handsome men. But after a breakup and a career blunder that lands her a week off, her luck turns around when she finds a mysterious flyer for a cleaning service exclusively for women. The cleaner who shows up is not only competent—he's drop-dead gorgeous and awakens her dull world with his special services. Is this the beginning of Haejoo's very own love story or a messy temptation that's too hot to handle?

(Source: Tapas)

After Tae-Yoon's ex-boyfriend sends a package to his old address, he quickly rushes to get it before anybody sees it. There, he unexpectedly runs into Jae-Min, a former high school classmate with whom he shares a tense and complicated past. Tae-Yoon flees quickly, hoping it will be their final encounter, but fate insists on intertwining their paths again. To confront his lingering guilt, he offers Jae-Min a sincere apology, only to be met with a shocking suggestion—that they meet five more times. What seems like a simple request leaves Tae-Yoon both confused and anxious, as he begins to wonder what Jae-Min’s true intentions might be.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: My Possession Became a Ghost Story

description:
A monster lives in the Rohanson manor. It wears the skin of the dead Lady Evangeline. While she believes she is the heroine of a romance story, to everyone else, she is a haunted nightmare.

(Source: Manta)

Veronica lost everything—her home, her family, and even her humanity. Her monstrous red eyes see only horror until Leon, a renegade holy knight, presses a kiss to her lips. Could he be her only hope for salvation?

(Source: Manta)

Minseok loses his daughter again and again in a world overrun by zombies. He’s been mysteriously given 100 lives to save her and has watched her die in 99 of them. On his final one, he dies before they even make it out the front door–except this time, he wakes as a zombie. But a zombie papa still has a father’s heart. Now stronger than ever, he’s ready to take on the world to protect his baby girl.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Choi Kang, a key figure in the notorious “Seven” crime syndicate, reunites with his estranged stepbrother, Choi Leehan. Before they have a chance to mend their fractured bond, Leehan reveals his true identity: an undercover officer determined to dismantle the organization and free Kang from his criminal life. But behind his seemingly noble offer lies a hidden agenda. What could he truly be after?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Blühen's Hageukasang (하극상) Short Story Collection or Downfall Collection in English.

Ho-Yun, a cynical, jaded office drone, is roped into housing Ju-Ho, an annoyingly upbeat college freshman he once knew as the kid next door. Now, instead of quiet mornings, Ho-Yun wakes up to home-cooked meals and a giant puppy of a housemate who can't stop looking at him like he's the best view in the house.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Moosung is an inn server with a huge crush on Soyeon, a beautiful woman from an influential family. Unfortunately, she’s only willing to marry… a very handsome swordsman. Now Moosung’s life mission is to become the best (and most handsome) martial artist in the world and win over Soyeon’s heart. So he starts training hard, but it’s not until he reads a book of secret martial arts skills that his true potential is magically unlocked. Can Moosung become a great martial artist, or will someone else swoop in and steal the love of his life?

(Source: Tapas)

In the office, Taejoon reigns supreme as the "Cupid of Sales," renowned for successfully pairing colleagues thanks to his ability to see the color of people's auras. Unfortunately, he himself has been single his entire life. But everything changes when he drunkenly kisses the new recruit, Hongyeon, which leads to a sizzling night at a motel. And then Taejoon discovers something fascinating—Hongyeon's aura is a mesmerizing rainbow! As Hongyeon boldly pursues him, Taejoon's shyness clashes with their steamy connection. Now they must navigate a somewhat clumsy and spicy office romance, where colors will fly in more ways than one!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Chae-Wool's world shatters when his boss - and the man he’s been in love with for ages - Chae-Heon, unexpectedly dies. Struggling to cope, Chae-Wool fights to maintain his composure whilst going about daily life…until a familiar figure appears before his teary eyes. Chae-Heon is back. Alive. But something is different; his memories are fragmented, his gaze unfamiliar, and his touch colder than before. What is this mysterious force lurking beneath the flawless exterior of Chae-Heon? And is that…hissing I hear…?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The world's greatest master becomes the instructor of students with countless stories?!

Seok Won-Cho, the leader of the Demonic Cult, was a monster that surpassed even the Blood Cult. Do you know who killed him?

“Ha Mu-Baek.”
“But why that story...”
“They say he’s coming to our Mengryongdae as an instructor.”

… Damn it. It’s over! Ha Mu-Baek, the world’s greatest martial artist who destroyed the Demonic Cult and the Blood Cult. He gets caught up in a power struggle and is appointed as an instructor at a martial arts training institute. He thought he should hide his identity and live quietly, but he’s strangely busy… ? Welcome, is this your first time as a genius idiot instructor?!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Freshly unmoored from college life and hiding a leave of absence, Yeong-In stumbles into the orbit of Ji-Heon—a solitary bookstore owner who seems to understand him like no one else. But when love blooms, Ji-Heon lays down one unshakable truth: “I want to watch my lover with someone else.” Desperate not to lose the only person who’s ever truly seen him, Yeong-In agrees to a love that hurts—until pain and pleasure begin to blur. In a relationship built on imperfection, how much can you give before you lose yourself completely?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Prosecutor Baek has built his career by manipulating evidence and witness testimonies with the help of a gangster. His success catches the attention of higher-ups in the prosecution, who now want him to clean up his act and arrange a marriage with a woman from a respectable family. Seeing this as the perfect opportunity to discard the gangster who has been clinging to him, Baek accepts the proposal. However, the gangster - who has long harbored feelings for Baek and aided him in his illicit dealings - feels a deep sense of betrayal and rage upon hearing the sudden news. Now, with resentment festering, their once-covert partnership threatens to unravel in ways Baek never expected…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english. Chapter count also contains prolouge.

title.romaji: Naega Jami Deun Sai (feat. Nappeun Chingudeul)
title.native: 내가 잠이 든 사이(feat. 나쁜 친구들)

description:
Yeona and her three longtime friends have shared an unshakable bond for years, one so familiar it feels safe from romance. Believing none of them see her as a woman, she lets her guard down and falls asleep at Taehyeok’s place. But in the stillness of the night, a lingering touch awakens desires that have been carefully hidden, and a single moment of weakness begins to unravel their friendship into something far more dangerous and irresistibly tempting.

(Source: Lezhin US)

20-year-old Choa ends a relationship after discovering her boyfriend mocking her for being bad in bed. Soon after, she learns her childhood friend and tutor, Seunghyeon, was dumped for the same reason. They decide to “study” together to rebuild their confidence, but these weekly “lessons” soon turn into something far hotter, and as bodies and boundaries blur, they must decide whether this chemistry stays in the bedroom or becomes something real.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Leonhard, the noble commander of the Knights of the Kingdom, sets out to subdue monsters, only to be captured by them instead. The beast-like monster, "Kelles," takes the Knights hostage and makes Leonhard a despicable and obscene offer...

"You'll soon be XXing me. Shaking your butt like a horny boar."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Since ancient times, fairies have existed to maintain balance in the world, each governing a fundamental human desire - wealth, pleasure, appetite, rest, and honor. Pence, a money fairy with an insatiable thirst for riches, was poised to become the next ruler of the fairy realm. But his greed came at a cost. When he exploits his powers at the expense of others, he is cast out and stripped of his status, forced to live among humans. Now stranded in the mortal world, Pence crosses paths with Yoo-Jin, a relentless workaholic struggling to make ends meet. But old habits die hard, and Pence's schemes for easy wealth quickly backfire. As karma catches up to him, he’s about to learn the true cost of greed—and what it really means to earn one’s fortune.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

After being reincarnated as the villainess of a novel, Yurina is determined to escape her fate of being killed by the story’s second male lead. Her solution? Save his life and get him on her side before he falls in love with the female lead! Her recollection of the story is spotty, but after months of searching, Yurina finally finds him-- or so she thinks. He’s a bit different from what she expected, but that’s probably because of her poor memory... Her plan should still work, right?

(Source: Tapas)

I thought I was a beta all my life, but it turns out I'm an omega! And not just any omega, but one who’s about to become the crown princess. Not only am I confused by shattered images of my past and the cumbersome imperial etiquette…most of all, I’m confused by my supposedly destined union with the so-called “golden alpha,” crown prince Wookyung. Besides, I’m a man - how am I supposed to get pregnant?! But my desperation to avoid carrying his baby is only making the crown prince more and more upset…

Something is in the air, and it’s not just love…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Despite his terrible luck in life, Ted was a top livestreaming musketeer in the fully immersive VR game, "Face Chronicle." But his bad luck made him stumble upon a conspiracy where major guilds were illegally taming boss monsters to get ahead. They were far from happy when Ted threatened to expose them, so they coerced him into deleting his game character, which forced him to start over. Can Ted turn his luck around by starting all over from level one? Or will his bad luck ruin his last shot?

(Source: Tapas)

Endymion passed the interview to finally become a Swallow Knight because he’s... cute? His lifelong dream has turned out to be nothing like what he had expected. He thought knights were supposed to be honorable and tough! But there is also good news: his past experience as a party host may come in handy after all. How will his life change as he becomes a Swallow Knight?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Since childhood, Do-Kyung has been plagued by lingering spirits drawn to his strong yin energy - a curse that only worsens with age. Cornered by malicious ghosts, he’s saved by Yoon-Je, a powerful spirit radiating yang energy. But Yoon-Je doesn’t offer his help for free. “I’ll share my energy with you if you share yours with me.” Caught in an unusual pact, Do-Kyung must navigate this strange exchange while fending off the feelings that begin to creep into his heart. Can their balance keep the darkness at bay?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.

title.english: Dearest Fiancé, I Know You Despise Me

description:
When they were first engaged, Janet and Rihanel were in love. However, after Janet’s three years in prison for burning down the chapel that Rihanel grew up in, their engagement is nothing more than a sham they keep up for financial reasons. Eventually, Rihanel says he will marry Janet on one condition: she will allow him to injure her ten times. Rihanel actually has the ability to see a person’s memories by touching their blood, and he wishes to seek out the secrets that run in Janet’s veins, including whether she truly loves him.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.

title.english: In the Shadow of the Serpent

description:
In a world where malevolent spirits roam freely, Jeong Wol has spent his entire life pretending not to see them. Having witnessed countless evil entities since childhood, he believes that ignoring the supernatural is the only way to survive. That fragile resolve shatters when he becomes entangled in a mission led by the Disaster Squad and loses his life in the process. Or so he believes.Jeong Wol awakens to find himself alive once more, bound by a mysterious pact with Sa Hyeon, a black serpent whose presence radiates both danger and allure. Granted immortality in exchange for an unknown price, he is forced to confront the very world he tried so desperately to deny.

Is this second life a blessing that spared him from death, or a curse that will drag him deeper into the serpent’s shadow?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ho-Joong, the Indomitable Champion, was at the peak of his career as a mixed martial arts fighter when a shoulder injury forced him into early retirement. He then spiraled into a life of addiction and gambling, eventually hitting rock bottom. Burdened with a debt of 700 million won, his wife, who had been managing the interest payments, finally gives up and leaves with their son. When his creditors threaten to take his organs as payment, Ho-Joong encounters a mysterious stranger. The stranger offers Ho-Joong a chance to participate in the "Brutal Cup", the largest underground fighting competition. Unaware of what awaits him, Ho-Joong accepts the offer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He's mad. Rohshan, abandoning the pride of his Count family and his duty to continue the lineage, is addicted to his relationship with his slave, Kyle. Before the Nest Wedding, the grand finale of this year's Black Dragon Festival, Kyle relentlessly provokes Rohshan into intoxication, desperate to get him to confess. With Rohshan refusing to confess, Kyle loses his reason and goes mad with each passing moment.

"How long do I have to wait? If I keep this up, I'll go completely crazy."

Secrets swirl around Rohshan's mansion: the suspicion of his parents' murder, the origins of his lustful nature, the identity of the slave who has captivated him...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Kang Yeon-U, who was born with a natural talent to become a shaman or entertainer, gains the ability to live longer after overcoming a near-death experience by resolving his grudge. After that, Yeon-U's life completely changes after meeting top star Kwon Seong-Hyeon while resolving a request...

(Source: Naver, translated)

His friends betrayed and abandoned him in a foreign country, and now he aims to take everything away from them. The unstoppable revenge of a tough guy begins!

"As expected, a successful man's woman is delicious. I'll enjoy her from now on."

(Source: DAYcomics)

After being reborn three times as a book character and reviving a fourth time as a villainess in a dark romance, Rosetta Valentine has had enough. Instead of fulfilling her given role, Rosetta decides to live a normal life. The one thing holding her back? The fact that Elisha, her sister and the story's heroine, is destined for a tragic ending. In order to save Elisha, Rosetta swears to use everything at her disposal... including the male lead's brother. But will this villainess's plan succeed?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Villain’s Daughter Plans to Run Away

description:
I'll make my evil dad good and survive this time!

I was killed for being the villain's daughter, but when I opened my eyes, I was 14 years back in time. Too young and penniless, I decided to wait to escape... But why should I have to run away?! What if I train my dad to be good instead?

(Source: Manta)

Choi Yu-Il is no stranger to misfortune. From losing his parents in a freak accident to suddenly presenting as a recessive omega in his twenties, bad things seem to follow him around. But through it all, his only friend Cha Hwan has stood proudly beside him. Hwan lets Yu-Il live with him, and when Yu-Il loses his job, Hwan even finds him a new one. The problem is…Hwan hates omegas. Terrified of losing the only person to ever stand by him, Yu-Il tries desperately to hide the truth. With his first heat fast-approaching, will Yu-Il be able to come to terms with the inevitable changes in their relationship…?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

Shin Kim is a special killer who gathered men from all over the country and made the organization "Baek-Yi" to destroy the absolute power "'Castle" of the underworld. Through a negotiation, he got inside Castle and started working with the enemy... Will Shin be able to take down Castle and complete his revenge as he hoped?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Catherine's Key to a Happy Life

description:
Catherine Panya thought she could live a happy life after leaving her terrible family. She was lucky enough to find a huge manor for dirt cheap, but only because the land attracts demons! And the only one powerful enough to vanquish those demons is Grand Duke Chezare Christopher, the Great Sorcerer. Although the reason is unclear, he offers Catherine a key that can summon him whenever she needs him. Is this Catherine's literal key to happiness? Or will it unlock a door to even more trouble?

(Source: Tapas)

Da-in never expected to reunite with her first love, Seojun, under such bizarre circumstances. Claiming that marriage is the only way to escape his supposed fated death, Seojun proposes a 100-day contract marriage. Refusing to be at a disadvantage, Da-in negotiates her own terms and plunges into an unconventional newlywed life. What starts as a calculated agreement slowly unravels into something deeper, as unresolved feelings resurface and the countdown to day 100 threatens to change everything.

(Source: WEBTOON)

"A plain face, the illegitimate child of a viscount."

With no notable background to boast of, Leona managed to grasp power from the lowly position of a maid, thanks to her extraordinary intellect. But when the seemingly eternal empire fell to enemy invasion, she too met her end by an enemy soldier’s blade.

A life spent harming others for ambition, scheming without hesitation it was a life full of regrets, and so she welcomed death. But then... she came back. To the very moment she first entered the palace as a maid. Surely, this is a chance to right the wrongs of her past life.

"This time, I won't live a life of hurting and taking but one of protecting and nurturing."

With that resolve, she chooses as the key to changing this life none other than the crown prince, the political rival she had personally dethroned in her previous life. As she serves him once more, now as his maid, everything seems to be going well... Until...

"Leona, let’s leave this place together."

Something feels off. The cold, indifferent crown prince she thought she knew hides a secret. And as truths buried by the world come to light, a shadow of ruin begins to fall over the empire once again.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

An immortal emperor rules the Kingdom of Yeol, a divine country blessed by gods with awesome powers. After a thousand years of peaceful rule, the time has come for a new emperor to be chosen. This is determined by a series of trials, in which twenty princes with special powers who have trained since birth must compete. As all princes of varying personalities and agendas gather to partake in the trials, intrigue and possibly even bloodshed seem all but certain. Meanwhile, unbeknownst to the other princes, the Fourth Prince Jeok-yeon Ryu hides a secret he must guard with his life.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

To treat his sensitivity issues, Do-Won agrees to be part of the blindfolded kissing booth at the school festival. He thought he’d only get a few meaningless pecks, but ends up making out with a mysterious guy whose kiss is so intense, it makes him hard! Do-Won becomes obsessed with finding the other man, but he never imagined it’d be Jun-Hyeon, the otaku nerd from school who's a total jerk! Will Do-Won be able to accept that his body reacts to this nerd, or will Jun-Hyeon's secretly sexy side be his undoing?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeonsoo is a gentle swimming instructor for kids, content with the calm rhythm of everyday life—until top star Cha Juhwan suddenly walks into his pool, needing to master swimming fast for a film role.

What starts as a professional arrangement quickly turns personal. Yeonsoo, shaped by years of gaslighting from a toxic partner, has come to believe he can only enjoy relationships that hurt. But Juhwan sees right through him, and offers something different—something kind.

"I’m used to getting hurt. My partner likes it that way."
"Then try it with me as well."
"I’m not talking about pain. I mean something real—something gentle."

With Juhwan’s quiet patience and unwavering honesty, Yeonsoo begins to realize that love doesn’t have to come with bruises. And maybe, just maybe, he deserves something softer.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

Living alone in the forest ever since his family was framed and killed, Byeo-Ru has lived a simple life: gathering food from nature, living in a small house, and avoiding the village people who aren’t aware that he’s still alive. He’s fine living that way, until the day he finds a dragon’s egg. Once hatched, dragon Shin-Ri changes Byeo-Ru’s life into a more complicated one. Whether that is a good thing, Byeo-Ru himself is not quite sure…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 30 extra chapters.

A young man with red eyes appears as the acting leader of the strongest martial arts alliance in history!!

[Age: Young]
[Martial arts: Unmeasurable]
[Background: Born in the mysterious Ihwa Palace ruled by five female princesses]
[Special Note: An absolute genius who passed the three civil service exams in succession, including the Hyangsi, Hoesi, and Jeonsi]

The new acting leader investigates the suspicious death of the former leader, and the terrifying monsters of Jeong Sima appear before him! Will the new acting leader be able to overcome this terrifying fate?

The miraculous and unparalleled martial arts of Jeong Sima, which have never before appeared in the martial arts world, have all appeared! An unprecedented martial arts story begins now.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Choi Kwon is haunted by nightmares and cursed to watch those he cares about face tragic fates. Wracked with guilt, he isolates himself, until one day he decides to take a chance - only to see his classmate get hit by a car right in front of him. Though Shin Yooyoung survives, he now claims they were married in a past life—and that breaking this curse is within Kwon's reach. Faced with a strange new reality, Kwon must decide what to believe and just how far he'll go to end his torment.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Renoc was supposed to be a video game character, so giving him a dying body in exchange for extreme magical prowess felt reasonable. However, when his creator wakes up inside Renoc's body, it doesn't feel like a game anymore! His life in the game is unbearable until he discovers the mysterious drug Vyper, which gives him the strength to wield his magic to its full potential. As Renoc walks a fine line with the drug that could save or destroy him, can he find a way to survive in this new world?

(Source: Tapas)

As the leader of the demon sect, Yan Su-Yun lived a difficult, wretched life. It is only as he is dying that he realizes he never lived the life he truly wanted. Reborn as a child, Su-Yun is now determined to be an honorary elder of the powerful Wulin Alliance, one of the many enemies of the demon sect. Despite his aspirations, Su-Yun is only a puny kid and has much to learn of the alliance’s ways. With his second life hanging in the balance, can Su-Yun go from absolute demon to absolute master?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Istina was just an ordinary high school girl until she got struck by lightning. Upon opening her eyes, she realizes that she has woken up inside her favorite novel. At first, she's ecstatic that she'll get to meet her favorite character, Laon, but her excitement quickly dies down when she gets a look at her reflection in a mirror. The beautiful little girl looking back at her, with red hair and purple eyes, is the bully who torments Laon relentlessly and makes his childhood a living hell. But mending her relationship with Laon isn't the only thing Istina has to worry about. Laon is fated to die while protecting the female lead, but Istina isn't about to let that happen, even if it means that she'll have to get her hands dirty. Will Istina be able to tame the prickly swordmaster and change his ending at the same time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Cha Yiseul is rich, reckless, and completely unapologetic about it. With her looks, money, and an endless roster of casual flings, life is one big party—until her mother cuts her off and kicks her out. Just as she hits rock bottom, a mysterious woman named Kang Sori appears, offering her a lifeline…and stirring up blurry memories of a drunken night they may—or may not—have shared. Who exactly is Sori, and why does Yiseul keep thinking about her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ddeosari Cha, or Plankie, lost her family to an alien attack years ago and is bullied for her unusual name and obsession with aliens. When two mysterious Kudoomians– aliens with pink blood, disguised as humans– appear to capture her, she fights back using a strange power… the ability to control the stars. Outnumbered and outmatched, suddenly a blue alien steps into the fray, offering what might be the chance at friendship she’s been searching for her entire life. Will Plankie finally find the ally she needs?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Husband Who Hates Me Has Lost His Memories

description:
In a politically arranged marriage devoid of love, Lily is wed to Theodore, the head of a rival family. Theodore loathes the union, but little does he know that Lily despises her own family as much as he does. Living a quiet life, she counts the days until their inevitable divorce. Then fate intervenes—a sudden accident erases Theodore’s memories of her, transforming his coldness into unexpected affection. Can Lily trust this dramatic shift, or must she guard her heart to avoid future heartbreak?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

A massive asteroid is about to hit earth!

Humanity has failed to stop a giant asteroid from plummeting into Earth, and life as we know it has ended. An ordinary Korean office worker named Cheol-Su is somehow given the chance to go back in time and prevent this catastrophe from ever happening. Does he have a chance?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Bottom of the 9th, two outs—the ‘Club Knight’ swings for the game-winning home run! An unknown power resides within the baseball bat. Dan's adventure to smash monsters from another world and return home!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I have these childhood friends... But were we ever just friends?

(Source: Toomics)

Five years since Shinbi left. Ghost vanished without a trace, and peace returned to the world. Ha-Ri, who once fought evil spirits with childhood friends, is now a police officer living a busy life. Then one day, the Ghosts sealed within ‘GAU’ break free, and the dormant disaster stirs once more...!

Right now, Ha-Ri's new journey to save people begins! Right here in ‘Mystery Apartment’.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jeong-Guk Woo delivers mail as a postman in a post-apocalyptic world and dreams of riding the subway. When headquarters announces plans to revive it, Jeong-Guk is eager to join, but government worker Yong-Han Cho personally bans him, citing the lack of dangerous missions in Jeong-Guk’s file. Infuriated by the snub, Jeong-Guk accepts the deadly task of delivering a letter to the AAA, a militarized area infamous for refusing mail. Once he arrives, he discovers the letter is addressed to Yong-Han's sisters, who beg him to help them escape. Will he follow the postman rules, or risk everything to help them?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

The strongest man of the Murim, “Asura,” got transported to another world. Having reached the pinnacle through his martial capabilities alone, he smashes the status window and the tower with his own hands—rejecting participation as a player outright.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Beloved Gardener of the World Tree

description:
The transmigrated Lilith La Noella does everything she can to avoid her fiancé, Duke Edrion La Arkshad, the cause of her death in the original story. She even chooses an unpopular job as a horticulturist in the rural South to get as far away from him as possible. But this choice backfires when the empress calls Lilith back to the capital to give her the nearly impossible task of flowering the World Tree. Otherwise, her entire family will be put to death. Can Lilith dodge another tragic end? And will she flower something more in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kim Sang-an is a cold-blooded loan shark. When his younger sister, a schoolteacher, takes her own life after relentless bullying from her students, he becomes the homeroom teacher of those very students to collect the price of her life. A merciless loan shark who will collect his debts even if it means descending into hell and a class of devil-like students... A vicious, twisted teacher-student relationship.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A world stained black. Driven by the Black Witch, humanity is forced into a vast city where light and color converge. To reclaim the world, humanity continues its pioneering efforts, and a boy named Kay aspires to join the expeditionary force. But he’s rejected because he is colorless, lacking any hue. Then one day, through an unexpected incident, Kay gains the color black....

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Privilege of the Second Life is Power Leveling

description:
Ten years after humanity’s fall, Earth lies under demonian rule. After losing his sister and his life, Yoon is offered one last chance by an angel statue. Sent back in time with a leveling system, he must reach Lv. 99 to save her and change Earth’s fate. Yoon fights, not for the world, but for her. One brother’s journey to save his sister may be humanity’s last hope.

(Source: Tapas)

In Eden City, no one slips through the shadows quite like Gemma Steele, the infamous jewel thief. So when the determined Inspector Raven Hunt finally catches her, she expects a jail cell, not a proposal. But Raven needs her skills to retrieve a priceless royal gem, and a fake marriage is the perfect cover. Now, the city's most wanted thief and its most straightlaced officer must team up to play newlyweds. Can Gemma and Raven pull off their act without getting caught in each other's feelings?

(Source: Tapas)

"From today on, I will never see you again."

Helena, abandoned by her husband on their wedding day, is about to break the vicious bond. But just as she's about to sever ties, her and her husband's bodies switch.

"One year from now. If you don't reconnect your fate, you will die as the natural course of events dictates."

With this profound prophecy, the fates of the two begin to waver.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"New photos have arrived."

I picked up a cell phone that shows the future. If I just had this device, I could be happy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I Opened an Illegal Werebeast Hospital

description:
Reincarnating after a life of tragedy, Shana's ready to live her best life. As the only child to a doting Duke, how hard could it be? That is until the Crown Prince claims she's his... and a handsome werewolf says only she can heal his kind! Well, time for Shana to open her (illegal) Werebeast Hospital!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Baby Dragon to the Duke’s Rescue

description:
After the loss of its divine beast, House Moonreppe is on the verge of collapse. Desperate to save his household, the young Duke Edenver Moonreppe decides to summon a legendary beast to become their new divine beast. He’s prepared to take on whatever monster that is summoned, only to meet baby dragon Acille. Edenver is not sure such a small creature could be their new divine beast… until he discovers that this baby dragon packs quite the punch in terms of both power and loveability. Will Acille change Edenver’s life for the better in more ways than one?

(Source: Tappytoon)

What would you do for me? Despite possessing everything—money, looks, and popularity—

Su-Hyun, a delinquent, yearns for love, driven by an inferiority complex. He's exposed and trampled by Na-Yeon, the model student who's the polar opposite of him. Su-Hyun vows revenge, but gradually falls for Na-Yeon's unconditional love. Na-Yeon tests Su-Hyun's heart...

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Part Two of This Failed Fantasy Novel Begins

description:
I transmigrated into a novel, slayed the Demon King, and died—mission complete, right? I can go back to reality, right? Wrong! Turns out this flop story has a second part! Five years after I saved the day, I've reawakened in the same world as a haughty villainess. What's more, my old allies from Part One have all become awful people! I've got new rules and a new body, but it's still the same old mess...

(Source: Tapas)

Soyu Yang is better than you and he knows it. Even in his dreams, he is the chosen one. A martial arts grand master, Yukgwan, speaks to him in a dream and brings him into a parallel world with superhuman abilities and “errors,” mutations that turn you into a monster. One of these errors is a former disciple of Yukgwan, now a dragon, and terrorizing the parallel world. Soyu and Kara, his anti-romantic partner, are chosen to hunt the dragon, but Soyu meets another who says he’s the fake version of him…

(Source: WEBTOON)

“I think I’ll… fail if I try to twist the original work?!”

I'd been reincarnated into my favorite romance novel, which I'd reread countless times, even down to the spinoffs. And to top it all off, I was a pathetic, villainous princess who'd been engaged to the crown prince and met a tragic end. To avoid dying, I decided to twist the original story. But...

"I brought you the engagement letter to the Northern Grand Duke, Lily!"

A few days later, this crazy dad arrived with the Northern Grand Duke's engagement letter instead of the crown prince's.

"You've loved me for a long time, Princess."

And he even included a real-life version of the Northern Grand Duke. The bigger problem is... The Northern Grand Duke, the original male protagonist, is determined to seduce me.

"Do you know? How much those eyes confuse my heart."

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: I Became the Magic Civil Servant in Isekai

description:
After casting a spell to posthumously fix his mana growth in a previous life, Seonal Hae now works at the Special Department of Different Species’ Civil Affairs. He now uses his powerful new magical abilities to help anyone who has been maligned because of who they are… even if they’re a medusa, centaur, or vampire!

(Source: Tapas)

Marianne doesn't consider her mother's husbands as family. Their marriages end too quickly for her to get attached. But this time, her mother's latest match brings her a stepbrother, Orion. And he's eager to dote on his new sister, even though their parents' marriage might not last. That's why Marianne is determined to ignore him, but Orion's shenanigans soon prove too outrageous to dismiss. Can Marianne convince Orion she wants to be left alone? Or will she warm up to her weird new brother?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Nareul Jugin Hwangjeui Ttallo Saranamneun Bangbeop
title.native: 나를 죽인 황제의 딸로 살아남는 방법

description:
That day, when I was killed by the man I once loved and lost everything, I made a wish to the dragon.

"Please let me protect my beloved daughter. I can't die yet!"

Would I go back in time, to the time when I was alive? But my wish came true in an unbelievable way!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

A tyrant who kills the empress to marry a man. You will be my husband.

I possessed the empress Maybelle from a BL novel who meets a miserable death. If it is as in the original work, the tyrant Raven will soon meet his male lover Yunus and execute Maybelle. Before that, I must divorce my tyrant husband by any means necessary...!! But─

"I'm sorry.... I hope your heart will change."

Why are you suddenly taking the regretful male protagonist route?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ma Beom-Tae, whose dream of becoming a hero was given up on false charges, receives a second chance. He must debut on a survival program and become a hero. But being a K-hero these days isn't as easy as it sounds. Working seven days a week, donating money, constantly feeling guilty, and colleagues going crazy...

Will Ma Beom-Tae be able to keep his dream alive?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Geomeun Meori Appaneun Geoduneun Ge Anida
title.native: 검은 머리 아빠는 거두는 게 아니다

description:
As the sole princess of the empire, Vishnahel had her life all planned out until she was brutally executed. Thanks to her family’s ancestral god, she’s sent back in time… to live as her 5-year-old self! In order to restore glory to the empire, she must raise hell, team up with her new adopted father (whom she met in prison), and gather the most unlikely allies. With this first-time dad under her thumb, she’s about to prove that sometimes the best way to win is to break all the rules!

(Source: Tapas)

Astraea, the strongest swordswoman in the world. One day, she realizes that she has reincarnated as a character inside a novel. And that role is the one who gets killed by the Evil God, the final boss...

During a mountain hike, she saves a child from assailants, only to learn that this very child is destined to become the Evil God.

"Well then, since it’s come to this, how about I raise him properly and reform him?"

So she takes the child in and begins to raise him. But then...

"Rea. Where are you going? Are you meeting that guy again?"

The boy has grown into an obsessive man who follows her everywhere, watching her every move. Somehow... it feels like she raised him the wrong way.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

A demon from the underworld possessing a human?!

Bella, the demon and monarch of the underworld, is possessed by the villainess Isabella Dunkeld, hated by her family and pointed at by everyone as a villainess. 'How did I end up in this body?' She has no memory of making a contract with the human Isabella, and when she came to, she was trapped in Isabella's body with all her powers sealed. She decides to act like a 'human' for the time being, but...

"So how many people have I killed with these hands? Hundreds? Thousands?"

"Huh... You didn't kill a single person?"

"You're calling me a villainess when you didn't kill a single person?"

The demon Bella really finds humans difficult...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

The demons took his farmhouse, his wife, his peace. Now Vincent Burns lives to kill as many as he can. The excommunicated exorcist, along with Sister Beatrice and local sheriff Chloe, has found himself in the middle of a demonic plot to bring Hell itself to the United States, yet the biggest puzzle is the white-haired girl he found in a suitcase. Demons not only die upon biting her; flowers bloom from her wounds. Vincent and Beatrice must keep her safe until they know her purpose, while Chloe must keep her sanity against the demon horde.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Butler Kim is the leader of the virtual reality game "Metaria" and the guardian of two cats in real life. One day, a mysterious boss monster appears in the game and forces him to change his job to "Butler." Forced to serve the monster, Butler Kim discovers an unbelievable truth.

"Oh my... a cat has logged into the game?!"

His pet cat, Pichiu, has entered the game. But the shock doesn't end there. The "master" who chose Butler Kim as his butler and has been communicating with him is none other than Kalinas, the embodiment of darkness. He, who should be the center of this world, is trapped in the body of Pichiu, unable to do anything! Now, the butler's duty becomes clear: Butler Kim must carry out the dark mission in his stead. But does the incarnation's mission really matter to Butler Kim? Is he simply happy that he can embark on a fantasy adventure with Pichiu?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

With a 100% mission success rate, Jin is the most flawless killer in the world. But there’s one fatal weakness… His face. A face so legendarily ugly it could go down in history!

(Source: Naver, translated)

After guiding his 10,000th soul, Kai the reaper asks Shinos, the God of Death, to erase his very existence. But rather than meeting his end, Kai awakens in the body of Seian, the disgraced second son of House Shureyton. Forced to live a twisted life of regret and buried secrets, Kai must confront a past that isn’t his and find a way to rewrite a fate never meant to be. Can this once unfeeling reaper find redemption, or will his lesson in humanity end in destruction?

(Source: Tapas)

Newly-awakened hunter Habin Hyun is mankind’s only hope, but after many years of the minimum wage grind, all she wants to do is take a break. Unfortunately for her, her ridiculously broken stats catapult her into the spotlight in more ways than one. With every guild scouting her, the System’s bounty on her head, and love interests appearing from every angle, it seems Habin’s going to have to take her new friends and unlikely allies all the way to the Tower’s top, whether she likes it or not.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: How to Melt the Tyrant's Heart

description:
In a world of brutal politics and deadly curses, one woman's touch is the ultimate solution. When the reader wakes up as Lianna, a villainess in a fantasy novel, she discovers that she’s the only person who can touch the tyrannical Emperor Enoch without activating his fatal ice curse. As his only cure, she must heal him while surviving the imperial court and the schemes of her cruel family. But as she peels back the layers of Enoch’s cold facade, she finds a lonely man, and soon their roles as the cursed and the cure blossom into a world-altering romance.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Roznia Hill is the younger sister of the Magic Tower Master, the villain of "The Duke's Only Companion." Knowing that the male lead will kill them both in the future, she tries her best to stay out of trouble. But one day, Roznia finds a man collapsed at her doorstep... It's Duke Lewellyn Rasiane, the male lead she's been trying to avoid! But to her surprise, he soon starts showering her with sweet words and affection, which leaves Roznia torn—is his love genuine, or does he have another motive?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Spy Life in the Demonic Sect

description:
Iseo Jang, the Murim Alliance’s prodigy spy, has spent 14 years deep undercover in the Demon Sect, earning the ruthless title of “Rabid Dog” for his work as their counterintelligence agent. But his newest mission is his most absurd yet: make the Sect’s laziest, most notorious delinquent -- Wu Ma -- the next Cheonma. To pull it off, Iseo ditches his post and applies to be Wu Ma’s official aide. In a world of betrayal, martial arts, and political games, can even a talent like Iseo turn a hopeless young master into an heir?

(Source: WEBTOON)

As if reincarnating into a whole new world wasn't enough, Lewin was reborn to a father so bent on having a male heir that he used dark magic to disguise her as a boy. Over 20 years later, she finds an unexpected ally in a freshly-transmigrated fellow Korean girl. However, this new friend delivers shocking news: they're in a tragic BL novel in which a love triangle will ultimately lead to the apocalypse! Still, if Lewin can seduce the male lead first, they may just manage to save the world...

(Source: Tapas)

Jihun is pulled into Knight Defense, a game where he must lead the kingdom’s knights against endless waves of monsters. Weighed down by the scars of his real life, Jihun chooses not to fight and turns his back on humanity. But as soon as he does, the system unveils a new path: the Monster Faction. Defense is over. It’s now time for offense.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Go Seunghwan, a former world champion in jiu-jitsu, wakes up to find the world has collapsed into chaos. Civilization is gone. The streets are overrun with zombies. And worst of all—he’s already infected. But that doesn’t matter. He has one goal left. To find and save his daughter, no matter the cost. Even if his body fails, his will won’t. A father’s final fight begins—against the undead, against time, and against himself.

(Source: Naver, translated)

All things in this world have a price. But what if people did too? With the mysterious "Social Coin" app appearing on phones all over the world, people are now "priced" according to their reputation and character. While those worth high prices thrive, those worth low prices are in danger of facing ostracization, discrimination, or even death.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Harriet's sister returns with her stolen fiancé, demanding to stay at the estate. Enter Lennock Diorne, her brother's infuriating best friend.

"You'll really let her win this easily?"

His taunt sparks a reckless game of pretend. Is it pure revenge, or something far more dangerous?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Find Yourself Another Trainer, Your Grace

description:
After being reborn, all Litia wants is a quiet career training dragons. But when Duke Albarant’s temperamental dragon chooses her as its trainer, she's faced with an unexpected offer. She tries to refuse the persistent duke, but that's easier said than done when he never takes no for an answer. A dragon’s choice, a duke’s determination, and one very reluctant heroine—can Litia hold onto the peaceful life she's dreamed of, or will this second chance demand far more than she's ever bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

Hildegard is the best seamstress in Luminian, but her past life was different. Born in Korea, she was raised to work in fashion before she died in an accident. Now reborn in a fantasy world, she turns to sewing again, unaware that her talent has caught the eye of the crown prince. With an ambition to advance his empire through textile arts, he makes her a surprising offer to become the empress. As fate unwinds like thread from a spool, this choice will reshape her life—and the empire—for good.

(Source:Tapas)

26-year old Hansol's finally got a place of his own! But on moving day, he opens the door to find an unexpected roommate: a little white griffin. Where did it come from? Is it lost? But just look at those fluffy bird paws and cute kitty toe beans! Maybe he can stay, just for a while!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lohiriel is the second daughter of House Casyan, a family infamous for its virulent poisons, and she has only one year left to live. That is, unless she can procure a rare plant that's exclusively grown in the imperial gardens... To access it, she strikes a daring deal with the crown prince: If he enters a one-year contract marriage with her, she'll provide him with a treatment for the ailing emperor. That means Lohiriel's medical expertise will prove useful for more people than she thought!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Runaway Extra and the Obsessive Duke

description:
In this world, a duke's full power can only be unlocked by uniting with his "phero," his destined mate. So, to undermine his rival, Krua's father sends her to Duke Arzenta disguised as his phero, hoping she'll take his innocence and his power with it. But Krua has no intention of playing along! If she can just convince her fiancé to join hands with her and keep up the enamored newlyweds act until his real phero appears, she'll be able to flee safely when the time comes... But will he let her go?

(Source: Tapas)

For Olivia Madeleine, illegitimate daughter of a duke, her only hope of a better life away from her cold-hearted family is her betrothal to arrogant crown prince Leoford Franz. When the revelation of his tryst with another debutante comes as an unsurprising wake-up call, she has no choice but to barter for her freedom with Edwin Lowell Vikander, the ruthless, war-hardened Grand Duke of the north. As her dangerous dance with Edwin begins, Olivia seeks to leave her former fiancé with the coldest gift that vengeance can impart… A heart made bitter with regret.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Becoming the Heroine Out of Spite

description:
One day, Ludia Mertens wakes up inside a romance fantasy novel as the best friend of Elian, the crown prince’s obsessive stalker. To avoid getting caught in Elian’s madness and dying like in the original story, she tries to keep them apart. But to her shock, she somehow ends up seducing the prince instead. Tired of Elian’s mean girl behavior and nudged by the prince’s cousin to date him, Ludia decides that if fate won’t protect her, she might as well steal the heroine’s role out of spite!

(Source: Tapas)

I was a runaway orphan working three jobs to survive. I was always exhausted, but at least I had money. One day, I overheard some girls talking about Crown Princess Heine, a novel known for its risqué scenes. But before I could read it, I died! Soon, I transmigrated into the book as the villainess, Annette Ethelred. Annette is hated by everyone because she tried to kill Heine, but I'm not going down that route. I'm going to keep my head down, make money, and check out all the hot guys!

(Source: Tapas)

Jeonghwan, once a legendary mercenary, returns under an identity no one expected— a prosecutor. His mission is to uncover the truth behind his mother’s mysterious death, the tragedy that robbed him of his peace and future. To take his revenge, Jeonghwan must wield two weapons: violence for those who stand in his way, and the law for those who must be judged.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Everyone knows the Cinderella story, but few know that her "happily ever after" only lasted 10 years. When the prince betrays her, a harvest mouse named Elodie is desperate to help her as her loyal friend. Elodie's wish brings about a miracle—she finds herself back in the past and discovers that she has the ability to shapeshift into a human. With this newfound power, she is ready to rewrite the ending of Cinderella's story. Will the two friends be able to find their own happily ever after?

(Source: Tapas)

A strange door appears in front of lawyer Han Beom-Sang. Beyond it exists a space where time does not flow.

(Source: Naver, translated)

39-year-old Doraon's heart is anxious. Single, approaching 40. A virgin who wasted her youth in a fake marriage with a gay man, but has never had sex. Doraon heads to a singles' meeting to find a 'hexagonal husband.'

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In my past life, I struggled through countless part-time jobs, only to suffer a head injury in an unexpected accident. But when I opened my eyes, instead of a hospital ceiling, I see a traditional Eastern-style house? That’s right! I’ve reincarnated into the novel "The Noble Sons of the Namgung Clan," the very book I was reading before I died! Of all places, I woke up in a crazy story where people drop like flies… And worse, I’m a villainous side character who gets abandoned by her family and is the first to die a meaningless death! Fine. With all the experience I gained from my past-life jobs, I’ll escape this house before I meet my doom. Wait, what? Every time I show off my skills, the main characters start falling for me? The cold-hearted older brothers, the vengeful cult leader, even the tragic crown prince—all of them are getting tangled up with me! If the story follows the original plot, everyone is doomed to a bad ending... Alright! If it’s come to this, I’ll save them all. A well-raised side character can save many lives!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The High School Survival Guide for a Wizard

description:
Despite her hatred of humans, the powerful wizard Oz decides to attend a human high school and make friends due to an old deal. Unfortunately, she has difficulty adjusting due to her uncontrollable magic. Things get even more complicated when a mysterious tornado from Oz's world drops a knight named Dorothy at her school. In an effort not to blow her cover, Oz quickly takes him in, oblivious to the fact that this annoying intruder may be the key to unlocking the school life she wants.

(Source: Tapas)

After her grandmother passed away, Na Su-Hyeon returned to her hometown after settling down in the city. As if drawn by something, Su-Hyeon climbs 'Obongsan', which her grandmother had told her never to climb while she was alive. When she gets lost in the mountains and is caught up in strange events and is in danger, Su-Hyeon receives help from a man named Seo Moon-Ju, who is still fine even after being beheaded... Moon-Ju tells her that Su-Hyeon is the reincarnation of her former divine mother, the shaman Kang Yu-Hwa, and that the strange events that are unfolding before her eyes happened because Su-Hyeon climbed Obongsan. Moon-Ju finds this very suspicious, but after she encounters ghosts who steal the weapons buried in Kang Yu-Hwa's grave and gain power, Su-Hyeon feels a sense of responsibility. Moon-Ju speculates that the 'evil spirit' that drove Kang Yu-Hwa to death in the past must have been moved by Su-Hyeon's energy and dug up her grave. In the end, Su-Hyeon decides to listen to the voices of the ghosts and retrieve the five weapons together with Moon-Ju..

Will the two be able to defeat the evil spirits and end Moon-Ju's curse of immortality?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Su-Ji, the loyal dog of the Sedo Group and a promising top killer, has changed owners. The new owner demands something unimaginable from Su-Ji...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Korea’s most infamous power couple—now running against each other for president. One’s conservative, the other progressive. One’s an early riser, the other a night owl. They fight over everything—from house chores to national policy. And unfortunately for the nation… they’re both members of the National Assembly. But when a major political scandal explodes right before the presidential election, they both decide to run. Against each other. “Let’s settle this in front of the entire country. Winner gets the Blue House. Loser? Enjoy being First Spouse.” A satirical, high-stakes political rom-com of love, rivalry, and democracy. Let the 21st presidential election begin.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Eleanor Mecklen was never more than a political pawn who married into the prestigious House Mecklen of the Barden Empire. Under the scrutiny of her mother-in-law, Duchess Carolyn, Eleanor endured endless humiliation. But when Carolyn meets an untimely death, Eleanor is accused of murder and sent to the executioner’s block. But death does not claim her. Instead, she reawakens at House Mecklen. Armed with the knowledge of what’s to come, Eleanor has a second chance to seize her fate.

(Source: Tapas)

Erencia Nobelita has been killed and reborn three times, each life ending in tragedy no matter how righteous she tries to be. So she throws caution aside in her fourth loop and decides to live selfishly, but every “evil” choice only wins her admiration and praise. Frustrated and desperate, she sets her sights on Euclid Grethelos, the empire’s most adored Grand Duke, and boldly asks for his hand in marriage. But instead of ruining her life, her audacious plan may have just set the stage for a fate far more unexpected… and irresistible.

(Source: Tappytoon)

An ordinary aspiring web novel writer, Ji-Kyung Yu. After losing her fiancé in an accident and having her novel filled with her memories plagiarized, she falls into despair and dies… just when she thinks she has completely died, she finds herself possessed by the romance fantasy novel she wrote, Calathea on the Cliff. But… not in the body of the main character, but of the villainess ‘Celestia’! As the original author, Ji-kyung Yu (Celestia + Ji-kyung Yoo) feels an unbearable rage when she sees the content that the plagiarist has arbitrarily changed. She tries to use her rewriting ability, which allows her to change the progression of the novel by revising the content of the book, to create the ending she wants…
