Will Ji-Kyung be able to overcome the villains and the plagiarist’s interference in the novel and create the happy ending she wants?

(Source: Naver, translated)

As the illegitimate child of House Flores, Irenea has been looked down on and mistreated all her life. When she learns that she is to marry the cursed "monster prince" Cesar, she quietly accepts her fate. However, Irenea is shocked to see that he is treated far worse than even a beast. Empathizing with Cesar and realizing that only she can help him, Irenea vows to give him a proper life—as a human. Yet with the whole world against them, can they ever find freedom and happiness?

(Source: Tapas)

Claren, the half-breed princess of the barbarians. She has been weak since childhood and cannot walk, so she is ignored even by her servants, and is eventually abandoned by her family during the war with the barbarian nation of Kailom. In revenge, she handed over the entire royal family to Kailom, and was given a title in recognition of her achievements. When Claren raised her head with the king's permission, Dean, the runaway slave, was standing there.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: My Contract Husband Looks Like the Male Lead

description:
At the age of 8, Anya Lockhart realizes she's been born into a tragic dark romance novel she read in her past life. And unfortunately, she's the female lead destined to fall into the crazy emperor's clutches! So when his proposal arrives, she packs up and runs away from home. After years on the run, she meets Dale, a sweet mercenary living in a remote southern village. But is there more to Dale than meets the eye? The more she learns, the more he doesn't seem like an ordinary mercenary...

(Source: Tapas)

Princess Seraphina of Astria becomes the Demon Lord who will destroy the world and is killed by Cassiel Rune Ertman, the successor of the Holy Kingdom. When she opens her eyes, she returns to being a peaceful 10-year-old with her beloved family alive before the destruction of the world? In front of Seraphina, who is looking for a way to eliminate the Demon Lord's seed in order to live peacefully with her family, Cassiel, who killed her before her return, appears as a suitor...?!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

I possessed a mere maid in a Northern Duke’s household, just a background character in a romance-fantasy novel. A lifetime job with stability, as long as I keep my head down and stay out of trouble? Sounds perfect!

I planned to save up quietly and one day escape for a peaceful life... But then.

“You went to… a Korean cyber university?”

“How… how could Annie know that…?”

The heroine — reincarnated from modern Korea — found out I’m a transmigrator too! Now I’m stuck to her like glue, constantly in her spotlight… And worse, her overprotective brother starts to take notice.

“You want to quit your job? Who said you could?”

The male lead of this childcare story — the one I thought would ignore me — has become obsessed! Help! I’m just an extra!

Annie’s chaotic survival tale as an ordinary extra in a not-so-ordinary childcare drama begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A kindergarten where superpowers are a daily occurrence. The temporary teacher who was assigned here, Oh Sae-Ong, has no superpowers, no experience, and no physical strength. He endures each day among the children who light fires, call for water, and see the future, and gradually learns about their world. A kindergarten routine that is more special than special abilities, Super Power! Care Diary

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Knight of the Sightless Sky

description:
A consuming fire, a dead king, and a family in ruin. Ten years after witnessing her mother’s murder, a vengeful maiden returns to the palace as a deadly assassin. But her revenge plot shatters when she discovers an unlikely truth that makes her blade waver. Caught between the eyes of silver and violet, the barbed rose must decide... follow the treacherous path of vengeance or uncover the secrets that bind her fate to the kingdom’s fragile crown.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Welcome to the modern era, where someone’s life can be ruined over a malicious online rumor. Armies of trolls known as Cyber Wreckers gleefully tear apart every part of their victim’s existence for views, while Drivers stand ready IRL to steer the latest topic of online gossip to the Wrecker’s liking. When 17-year-old K-pop idol Ari Lee becomes the latest victim, it falls to her older brother Ajin to take revenge against those who drove her over the edge; a task that seems impossible until he meets a mysterious girl named Seol…

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: When Pride Fell at My Feet

description:
The beautiful Duke Enrico Michele approached like a devil whispering sweet lies, offering a cunning deal. "Just dance for me like a living doll. In return, I'll tell you about your dead parents." Along with his mysterious patronage came a chilling question: "Don't you want to know the truth?" And so began my secret, dangerous entanglement with the Duke, a meeting that should never have happened.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Oh, I'm the strongest demon cult member of the Nine Heavens, but I know how to return to the demon cult.

The absolute being who trampled the martial arts world and reigned at the top, Gucheon. He was the one who led the Demonic Cult to its peak, and to the Jeongpa, he was called the Heavenly Demon itself. The last Demonic Cult war fought by all the martial arts sects including Goopa. After a fierce battle, Gucheon was killed by an unknown being.

The moment I thought it was all over... I opened my eyes not in the martial arts world, but in a weak body in the modern era?!

"What is this...? This strange place?! Send me back!!"

Gucheon descends into the modern era...!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Became the Target of the Male Leads

description:
Elze, the villainess, was Marquis Oppenheyer’s plaything, used and unloved, fated to die at the hands of the three male leads. Now, a reader finds herself in Elze’s shoes. In order to save her life, Elze must first ingratiate herself with the male leads. As the evil superintendent of a nefarious boarding school, Elze is pinned between embattled student Lucian, the kidnapped son of a duke, her own murderous marquis, and a guild master–one of whom may be her ticket to freedom from her doomed fate.

(Source: Tapas)

Deep in the mountains, among the people of Yeong-Ji who say that a woman's happiness is marriage, a suspicious man with a somewhat naive look that I picked up in the garden near my house a while ago appeared. The man introduced himself as my husband..., but whenever this happens, the look in this man's eyes looks dangerous?

Jayden, who is unconventional and ignorant of the ways of the world, but has a great appearance. She comforted and appeased the beastly man, making him human, and furthermore, tamed him to her taste. However, the people who came to find this man a while later seemed amazing.

"I came to pick you up, hyung."

It seems that the status of this naive husband that I picked up is not ordinary.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

In Murim, four of the most feared criminals were known as the "Bloodstorm Lions"—ruthless, merciless, and utterly irredeemable. But one day, they were given something unbelievable: a senior disciple. And not just any master... Their new "Grand Senior Brother" is an 8-year-old boy: Geom Woo-bin. Armed with an undeniable charm, handsome looks, and unshakable confidence, Woo-bin isn't here to reform these villains... He's here to rule Murim in his own way! Follow the chaotic and hilarious journey of this unlikely brotherhood, as the villains who once terrified the world now find themselves under the rule of an 8-year-old prodigy!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Axe was once the best player in "Ryn Online," an action-packed fantasy RPG. But when his comrades kill him, Axe is forced to start all over. Devastated by their betrayal, he swore off gaming and opened a fried chicken shop to make ends meet. But when a new VR game called "Fate" is released, he notices that the friends who betrayed him are also playing. Now, he's willing to go back to gaming and munch on chicken-fried monsters to get stronger for his revenge!

(Source: Tapas)

Vivian, the daughter of Duke Karlsruhe, uses her influence to have her lover, the illegitimate fifth prince Alex, crowned emperor. But happiness soon turns to despair when Alex takes a mistress and has Vivian imprisoned. Driven to hopelessness, Vivian ends her life—only to awaken on the day of her wedding to Alex, this time with a burning thirst for revenge.

(Source: Manta)

Aubrey Sandalwood had one goal: to hide her past as a slave, and become the perfect lady in high society. But at her long-awaited debut party, she runs into a man from her past— the boy who rescued her from the island she was trapped on. Colhard Karnus, the only one who knows her secret.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The sensitive and crazy prince 'Cardin''s only maid, Rowena. One day, she discovers a 'monster' in the prince's palace garden wearing human skin and is attacked and put in danger of death...Tiring!

[Amazing experience! You have experienced death.]
[First experience bonus acquired!]

A strange letter suddenly appears.

[If you don't want to die like this, accept it.]

Of course I don't want to die! Rowena accepts the mysterious offer and... goes back 3 years. That's how the regression began. If you want to live and see the future, you have no choice but to keep dying and regressing to get clues and move forward! Will Rowena be able to overcome all the dead endings and reach the best ending?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

When Hester, manager at Collateral, is left in charge after the owner's sudden disappearance, she learns the bar is a spy hangout and every patron is after intel on a mysterious fugitive named Jackal. Problem is, Hester's now forced to bluff her way through as dangerously suave spies flirt in for secrets she doesn't have — and her life's on the line.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Bastard’s Revenge in the House of Magic

description:
All Lucia wants is a family. But as an illegitimate child of the House of Lordvel, she is cast into the Abyss. There she meets the Evil God and makes a pact to take revenge on the Lordvels. Reborn 10 years in the past, will Lucia rewrite her fate in this second life or succumb to dark forces beyond her control?

(Source: Manta)

[Unique Trait ‘Skill Master (EX)’ has been activated.]

▶ ‘Skill Copy (EX)’ is now enabled.

“Whoa… your skill’s insane!”

[Skill has been copied.]

From now on, there’s no skill he can’t have. Yours is mine. Mine? Still mine. The rise of the ultimate cheat-class protagonist begins now. All Skill Master Yoo Ju-yeon’s explosive saga is just getting started!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

"It isn't the strongest who survives. The one who survives is the strongest."

After being discharged from the military, Jin Seowoon did nothing but play games like a loser. One day, he was invited to the world of "Cloyd Survival," which resembled a game he enjoyed. In that world were masters of martial arts, kings from other worlds, and notorious killers... It was a gathering of monsters that surpassed human imagination. Jin Seowoon had just one objective—to survive and become one of the top ten. Here lies a tale of survival with Jin Seowoon's life at stake.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Villainess is Bothered By Male Leads

description:
All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The End of an Imperfect Divorce

description:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The shaman “Manshin Kim Seo-Ryeong” of Yeongwoldang. The client “Noh Seung-Rae” who was born into a shaman family and lives rejecting the spirit rope, receives a request from Seo-Ryeong to visit her daughter who is blind. However, due to Seung-Rae’s attitude of not believing in shamanism and ignoring it, Seo-Ryeong does not accept the request and returns. However, from that day on, Seung-Rae’s past is reflected in Seo-Ryeong’s dreams. In the end, Seo-Ryeong follows Seung-Rae’s family…

The daughter of this family has an unusual aura?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I'm a Beast, Not a Bunny!

description:
Born to a wolf-shifter and a lion-shifter, Chloe knows she'll be a predator like no other. So she's got no idea what to do when she one day shifts into… a bunny! Even worse, Chloe then realizes she’s also in a novel, one where her family’s to be killed due to a series of misunderstandings. Determined to save her parents, Chloe sets out to unravel the lies and bring peace to her family. But can Chloe uncover the truth while keeping her transformation unknown? Or will this bunny be bested by fate?

(Source: Tapas)

Rieul toils away at her office job until a sudden dungeon break ends her life. But instead of dying, she wakes up three years in the past with a second chance at life. Determined to change her fate, she reopens her late grandmother’s cafe. But the moment she gets to work, she awakens as a Cafe Owner-class hunter... with a talking cat agent named Mieum! Between brewing coffee and clearing system quests, Rieul’s new life is anything but peaceful. Has her quiet dream already gone up in smoke?

(Source: Tapas)

Mikhail, the strongest man in another world, turns into a golden retriever whenever he's around Sena? One day, a door to a dungeon suddenly opens in the basement, and a mysterious man appears.

“Here, we eat chicken whenever something happy or sad happens.”
“Miss… please, take me in as your servant.”

A man who wants to become your servant just because you fed him chicken — can you handle that? As if that wasn’t enough, turns out I’m a descendant of a legendary archmage? Sena’s already confused, but now her sweet little brother joins in with a barrage of unexpected confessions?

And yet… the mukbang must go on. A bond born from chicken — can it transcend the boundaries between fantasy and reality? For those worn out by the spicy chaos of everyday life, get ready for a sweet and savory dungeon romance.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Became the Wicked Beastmen's Catnip

description:
Once a brutally abused experimental subject, Yernianne returns to the moment of the kingdom’s collapse. Rescued by Licht, chief of the catpeople, she becomes their messiah and only princess—but as she plans her eventual freedom, aloof cat princes begin drawing closer.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: A Happy Ending for the Young Villain

description:
When Ahn Dohwa finds herself in an unfinished novel as Archmage Reina Heart, she resolves to lie low until the story reaches a resolution. However, unable to turn a blind eye to the abuse inflicted upon the story's villain, Prince Kevenriak Heteroven, she takes the young prince under her wing and begins training him as her pupil, hoping to change his destiny. But when everything starts to deviate from the original story, Reina's resolve wavers... Can she protect everyone's happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

"Once you're in, the only way out is death!"

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he'd left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage. But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers. And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too. With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yerin who died trying to save her student is reincarnated into Fiora a villainess from a story she is familiar with. In the original story, Fiora secretly torments the children of Duke Baridas the man she is engaged to, but later gets exposed and ends up being dumped and executed. Yerin, now in Fiora's body, plans to stay out of trouble and just take good care of the lovely children until the female character that ends up becoming the Duke's true love comes along. Her ultimate goal is a clean breakup that will land her some alimony so she can open a daycare center in this universe. But can she live this life as a character that veers off the set fate and most importantly don't end up dead?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: My Students' Guardians Are Obsessed With Me

description:
Eleanor died from overworking as a teacher in her past life, so now she's determined not to work! She teaches her brother to be the prince's aide so he can be the breadwinner instead. When he reveals his sister is the true genius, she is asked to tutor the siblings of the most influential men in the land: her best friend, a handsome duke, and the crown prince. How can she refuse?! But is a good education all they want from her? Maybe this time, her job won't ruin her life but lead her to love…

(Source: Tapas)

"I got thrown into this godforsaken world?!"

The infamous web novel Chronicles of the Seven-Colored World ran for over 800 chapters, gaining notoriety for being an absolute mess—with absurd plot twists, overpowered monsters, and yandere heroines who kill the protagonist on a whim. And now... I've reincarnated into that very world. As who? Some nobody named Rudian. A literal background character with zero plot relevance. But then I stumbled across two game-changing companions: a weird, googly-eyed monster named Adi, and a cursed sword known as Diablo. If this world wants to be crazy? Fine. I'll go full crazy with it. It's time for the ultimate chaotic run, and this time, the so-called "extra" is flipping the whole story on its head.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: When the Mad Dog Bites the Leash

description:
The noble daughter of house Dew, decorated knight of the Asellan kingdom, and undefeated warrior... is the second prince Ethan's 'mad dog,' Adrian Dew. Her foul mouth and fouler personality may have been the cause of countless headaches to her father, prince Ethan, the king, the princess... basically everyone she came into contact with, but Adrian is fiercely loyal.

Determined to ensure the throne for Ethan instead of his powerful, well-backed sister, princess Della, Adrian fights tooth and nail to win as many victories in battle in his name. But not even her prince can defend her for what she did in her last battle in the rocky plains of the East.

"You will assist the regent of Jolkyacarta for five years..." banished in all but name to a newly conquered kingdom, Adrian must serve her sentence before she can return to prince Ethan who is powerless without her. Five years among a different people, different customs, and different god... all of which hate her and her people, Adrian must survive.

Yet one set of eyes regards her with mysterious curiosity.

"Have I seen you before?... in a dream?"

(Source: Pocket Comics)

When Yi-hwan woke up, the world had changed. Zombies craving the blood of the living, Humans running for their lives. But then...

"Why aren't the zombies biting me?"

Unbelievable strength, One eye turned red, just like the zombies, And a strange hunger every time he sees blood.

"What the hell happened to me?!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

As an avid reader of romance fantasy novels, I wasn't that surprised when I transmigrated into one. But I didn't expect it to be a multiplayer VR game beta test! Luckily, the 99 other girls are super nice, and they caught me up: all we have to do is pick a male lead and reach a happy ending. Here's the catch... We're being ranked, and the more eligible our suitor is, the more money we'll get at the end. In this game that tries to pit us against each other, can female solidarity conquer all?

(Source: Tapas)

Hong Si-won, the greatest chef in Korean history, suddenly passed away. His last will was shocking: all the chefs in his restaurant were to compete for the position of head chef. A young man with a “divine tongue,” Park Geon-woo, is invited to this fierce competition. Can he survive the intense battlefield of “Tae Mi-ok” where no one can be trusted? A heated culinary showdown filled with passion, growth, friendship, and conflict. Who will emerge as the ultimate victor?

(Source: Naver, translated)

A cynical noblewoman cursed to hear others' thoughts struggles to control her childhood friend—a wildly powerful mage whose flirting is as explosive as his unchecked magic. His outrageous marriage proposals ("I'll conquer the empire for you!") and her exasperated damage control create a hilarious magical rom-com where keeping him sane might just drive her mad first.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Beast Won't Let Me Sleep

description:
Adele is a notorious villainess among the high society; rumor has it she married and murdered an old marquis, then allegedly seduced her stepson out of lust for power. As such, she’s shunned and ostracized at social gatherings-- until she meets the most sought-after man of the era, Count Vyce. However, this man turns out to be Chris, the poor boy she looked after before abandoning him long ago. The once-fragile boy now approaches her without hesitation. Does he approach out of past attraction, or is there something more underneath?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Ji-u Shin has been transported into her own dating game. Her life inside the game is now being broadcast live across the cosmos. If she wants the broadcast to end, she must win the game. The catch? The game is set to the hardest difficulty, and she’s been cast as the notorious villainess, Theresa. If she fails to win, she will lose her life. Can she avoid all of Theresa’s bad endings and bring this broadcast to an end once and for all?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Master Likes to be Spanked

description:
After waking up as an evil maid in a generic rated-R novel where skin-to-skin contact is needed to stop people from going berserk, the female lead is determined to change the ending of the novel so she can have it easy. For the greater good and to stop the male lead from going berserk, she "teases" the male lead a little bit. But after achieving her goal and helping the male lead get his power back, little did she know that he would get his revenge on her in the most unusual and unexpected way possible...

(Source: Tappytoon)

What life is there for a creature forever trapped in a cage? Such questions ring true for Isabella Heloise, illegitimate child of an abusive count who uses her as a pawn for his political ambitions. When Isabella's betrothal to an influential noble is broken off, her value within the Heloise household plummets, prompting her to flee from her father’s violence. Isabella finds herself alone and destitute, only to be found by Ethan Holden, a dashing duke with a nonetheless ominous air. Can Isabella trust the handsome duke, or has she found herself in yet another cage?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The rift brought an end to the world humanity once knew. Monsters claimed the lives of countless people, and those with supernatural powers known as hunters became humanity’s last hope. For Ji-Ho Lee, becoming a hunter wasn’t a choice, but a result of losing everything. Now, in the aftermath, she begins forming new ties and gradually rebuilding a life on her own terms.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: My Life Was but a Play

description:
With her beauty, power, and the position of empress, Vionne Rosa Ellient seemingly had everything one could want. But in truth, she endlessly yearned for love before ultimately dying in misery. Now, after waking up again as her younger self, Vionne calmly assesses her situation and past memories to avoid marrying Crown Prince Sirius and meeting the same fate. As different choices lead to a change in relationships and a turn of events, will Vionne prevent this life from being another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas)

Doyul, son of the world's top assassin organization leader, transfers to a Korean high school! Arriving as a penniless transfer student, Doyul takes on a request from Dong-gu, a victim of school violence, and starts taking down the surrounding bullies one by one!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Unorthodox Genius of the House of Darkness

description:
The world has ended. I was a genius hero, but my efforts were too little, too late—I couldn’t stop the Blood Demon Emperor. As I died, I prayed for a second chance... but this isn't what I meant! Of all people, I’ve become Christian, a rogue member of the House of Dark Demons. As if that wasn’t enough, the world is still ending in just five years. There's only one way to save it: I must become the emperor myself and stop the war! I know it sounds ridiculous, but I’m a genius—I can make it work!

(Source: Tapas)

Sierra's peaceful village life is disrupted when her ex-boyfriend, Duke Cassius Ideos, shows up and mistakes the child she's raising as his daughter. The thing is, the girl is her niece, not her kid! When he refuses to listen to any explanation, her only option is to follow him to his duchy and await the results of a paternity test. All Sierra has to do is keep to herself for three months, but will things remain that simple when she begins to suspect that the duke still has feelings for her?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: There's No Such Thing as a Naughty Munchkin

description:
Korean childcare worker Boyoung awakens in a mysterious land and a bygone era, trapped in the body of governess Edith Bruissel. Thrust into a world of secrets, magic, and noble intrigue, she is determined to find a mage who can send her home. But her plans are quickly complicated by a secretive duke with a troubled past, a marriage contract, and children who need her more than ever. Can Boyoung find her way back to the world she came from, or is she trapped in Edith’s life for good?

(Source: Tapas)

Reborn with memories she never asked for, Jian Song wants nothing more than a quiet, ordinary life. But everything changes when she meets him again—the man she once loved beyond reason, and the one who shattered her. No matter how hard she tries to stay away, fate keeps pulling them together in ways she never expected. As her new life begins to mirror the tragic patterns of her past, she must face one question: can she rewrite her story this time, or is she doomed to repeat it?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I have to defeat the great monster! ???: I'm 8 years old? An exorcism boys' manga featuring the cute and soft priestess Sea and the gloomy exorcist Shio!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Elizabeth is the richest heir in the empire. But after her parents’ sudden death, she’s told she must marry her uncle to claim her inheritance. No, thanks. So she fakes an engagement with her maid, runs away, and sets out to burn through the family fortune. Simple enough... until a drunken one-night stand with a man who looks like her first love throws everything off. And now he won’t stop following her!

(Source: Tapas)

"Please, do not leave me."

"We should get a divorce. You don't love me, do you? We... only got married for our families' sake."

"Why… Why are you saying such things? Did I do something wrong to you? If you want me to kneel, I will. If you don’t like my face, I will wear a mask for the rest of my life. So, please… please, do not leave my side."

My husband, whom I married through an arranged marriage, is the second male lead who harbors an unrequited love for the heroine of The Saintess’ Wish, the novel I have possessed. And I, his lawful wife, am destined to endure a lonely marriage before meeting a mysterious death. For my own survival—and for his love—I decided to cleanly end our marriage. But…

"Why is he holding onto me? Aren’t you supposed to love Aria???"

"This novel’s world… is different from what I knew. What is the truth?"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: To the Witch Who Forgot Her Bird

description:
Prince Alec, the troublemaker of the Royal Family, runs into some trouble himself when he discovers he is being hunted by assassins. With magic involved in this deadly scheme, the only one who can protect him is Victoria, the Witch of Bitter Cold, who offers her help in exchange for a “small” favor. But as her title implies, Victoria is devoid of human emotions and will stop at nothing to get what she wants. Although Prince Alec tries to maintain some distance between them, this proves to be difficult the longer he is stuck with his icy protector...

(Source: Tappytoon)

My pet dog, who is like my child, turns out to be the heir to a wealthy family?

It's been a year since he adopted Janggun, who was abandoned. But this special guy, well, not only became a family to Do-Hun, who was lonely, but he also brought him a fateful love called 'Lee Chae-Young'. However, Chae-Young was definitely not an easy target. Just as their love is about to begin, a second generation chaebol suddenly appears and says he wants to take Janggun away. And Janggun's surprising secret is revealed. Will Do-Hun be able to protect both his love and his family?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

title.english: The Regressed Genius Player's Mythical-Rank Weapon Creation

description:
With the death of Earth’s potential Constellation, the Crimson Eye is now bent on consuming the world. Simun Kim--an alchemist out of necessity, due to an inability to use magic--successfully transmuted the Philosopher’s Stone to stop this cosmic threat. But he still failed. As death closes in, the Philosopher’s Stone rewinds time, waking Simun in the past with one last chance to rewrite the end of the world.

(Source: Tapas)

Former national Taekwondo player Eun-Bi Lee. One day, while in a slump, she quit exercising and was living an ordinary life, she picks up an unidentified black puppy. But... that puppy turned into a human?! What are those ears and tail?! The fantasy cohabitation life of Sam-Wol, a puppy(?) who lost his memory, and Eun-Bi with 999 fighting power!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Extra Bohojaneun Toejanghal Timing-eul Nochyeo Beoryeotda
title.english: I'm Just a Side Character, but I Became the Guardian of the Marquess Family's Heir
title.native: 엑스트라 보호자는 퇴장할 타이밍을 놓쳐 버렸다

description:
I should have died in the accident, but when I woke up, I found myself inside my favorite novel...To make matters worse, I'm just a side character?! According to the story, the duke and duchess have disappeared, and all the servants are about to be fired...I've made up my mind. I'm going to live as I please! Or so I thought. Somehow, I've ended up as the guardian of two orphaned twins?! This wasn't supposed to be my role, but how could I abandon them? Just as I resolved to take the twins on their journey...

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title.english: I Became the Ghost Duke's Daughter

description:
Unwanted as an heir, Theresia Oblen is sent from her noble home to live with the ghostly Duke Everdin. As someone who can see phantoms, the haunted rumors mean little, but the residents of Everdin Manor are no average ghouls. Despite their lively warmth, they live under a curse that turned them into invisible beings. Theresia hopes that by absolving the woes of the manor's true evil specters, she can restore the duchy and return home. Can she put these spirits to rest and finally live in peace?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Country Life With His Sexy Majesty

description:
Rienna Fonde was meant to marry a crown prince, but after he cast her aside for the so-called saint, she was disowned by her own father. Abandoned and alone, she moves to Fostine, a lush, peaceful countryside, where she puts the knowledge from her past life to good use. After years of country living, Rienna has become a renowned farmer and loves her new life. But then, a mysterious farming tool brings a tall, handsome man to her doorstep. Will this man ruin her country life or enrich it?

(Source: Tapas)

“Let the Survival Game Begin!”

Designated as a disruptive species in the universe’s ecology, humanity must now participate in the ‘league’ under the watchful eye of the universal administrators. Jae-Hui Jin, sent back in time during the final stage of the game, arrives at one conclusion - only Sion Kang has the power to lead humanity to victory.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ji-Hwa Yeon died before her time. However, she is sent back to live the remainder of her life with a reaper to watch over her. She is also chosen as the unprecedented 1,001st candidate for King of the Netherworld. Now she must participate in brutal exams for the throne while getting burned for her trusting, helpful nature. She is told she is a “good person” and suspects it’s because she has no noteworthy traits. With no special powers, Ji-Hwa will see how far being a good person will take her.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Reincarnated as Sienna Winter, a minor villain with a terminal illness, her only goal is survival. However, she accidentally awakens a sealed demon and gets trapped in a lifelong contract. But... she's already dying?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“Who’s the garbage with zero morals saying they’ll marry a five-year-old?!”

I thought I had died in vain due to the betrayal of a comrade when I was a grand mage, but I was given a new life as ‘Nazia de Lavoie,’ the daughter of a baron. However, in this weak and frail body, I was treated as the family’s outcast and eventually sent off as a bride to the war-obsessed demon, Duke Iter. At the tender age of five, no less! I assumed he was a heartless scoundrel, but the Duke of Iter’s reaction to me was completely unexpected—

“I accept Lady Lavoie as a member of Iter. If the lady so desires, she can be my adopted daughter.”

Is this the beginning of Act Two—or rather, Act Three—of my life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I Ended Up Educating the Secret Villain Too Well

description:
Avel is a cute young girl who’s chaotic and a little violent. She couldn’t care less about social rules and polite society. Nevertheless, to avoid her tragic fate in the future of this novel at the hands of the cold first prince Chesa, she has to get to him while he’s young and teach him to be a good person. So what if she has to break some rules (and kick some butts) along the way? What matters is that the neglected boy learns to care for other people. What could possibly go wrong?

(Source: Tapas)

When orphan Rosie learns of her brother Julian and that they are a part of the esteemed House Noart, she gains both riches and the greatest treasure of all—the pure love of family. But after an accident causes Julian to lose all memory of recent years, including Rosie's existence, she discovers House Noart has many hidden enemies. Preventing her family from falling to ruin is one thing, but will these siblings be able to prove that blood is not just thicker than water but lost memories as well?

(Source: Tapas)

I was just enjoying my favorite web novel when the unthinkable happened—Castian, the male lead and my ultimate favorite, died in the most ridiculous way. Before I knew it, I found myself possessing Lydia, the necromancer who pulled him back from the dead! Whether it’s because I refuse to be falsely accused of harming my beloved character, or because even in his lifeless state, he remains as stunning as ever, I’m determined to save Castian no matter what. I ended up pretending to be his lover and officially joining his expedition team…

"Don’t leave my side, not even for a moment."

But wasn’t he supposed to distrust me? Why is Castian growing more and more affectionate toward me…?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

How is the reincarnated heroine supposed to survive as Enrica, a powerless noble lady who gets killed by her archduke husband on her wedding night? Fortunately, a mysterious but kind Count Belbrington hears Enrica's plight, suggests that she find another man to marry, and even says yes to her following proposal! Everything seems strangely smooth sailing from there. Not only is Enrica's power-hungry father surprisingly cool with her marrying a man of lower status, but the murderous archduke isn't retaliating at her for breaking off their engagement, either. Something's not adding up, but what could it be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After waking up inside a game, Minervina discovers that she has the ability to see information screens for everything within her new world. Unfortunately, she has also been given a quest to destroy this world, but she’s ignoring that. While Minervina wishes to use her near-omniscience to live a comfortable life, she’s continuously swept into chaos and political ploys. Her key to preserving the peace might be Exarch, the incorruptible Grand Duke. He seems to favor her, a trend that continues with everybody else, including the main system. Will Minervina be able to protect this world that loves her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After two years trapped in the dull rhythm of daily life, Heesu has grown numb—disconnected from herself and everything around her. But when she stumbles across a cryptic online ad offering a one-day BDSM roleplay experience, something stirs. Torn between fear and curiosity, she agrees to surrender control—if only for a day. What begins as a fleeting escape soon becomes a raw plunge into desire, power, and vulnerability. As boundaries blur, Heesu must confront not just the limits of pleasure, but the aching emptiness she's been running from.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Daughter-In-Law to the Mad Dog of Honor

description:
When Isabella woke up, she remembered everything—being poisoned by her in-laws and losing everything at their hands before dying. To avoid being married to the Rosemunds after her parents’ deaths, Isabella will do anything to become the daughter-in-law of Duke Barmouth, the feared "Mad Dog" of the empire. Worried for Isabella’s safety, Lord Barmouth treats her coldly to make her change her mind. But Isabella is set on melting the hearts of everyone at the Barmouth duchy to escape death.

(Source: Tapas)

Han Min-Seo grew up in a wealthy and harmonious family. One day, she witnesses her parents' car leaving a motel across from a restaurant she stopped by with her friends. However, Min-Seo does not know which of her parents drove the car. Is it a simple misunderstanding, or is it really an affair? In a truth she does not want to believe, will Min-Seo be able to protect herself and face the truth until the end?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Agi Mawangnimeun Yongsa Appadeuri Neomu Gwichana
title.english: The Baby Demon King Has Too Many Dads
title.native: 아기 마왕님은 용사 아빠들이 너무 귀찮아

description:
Reborn into a novel as the unawakened Demon King, Tatiana is imprisoned and exploited by demons who use her power for themselves. When her captors are killed by three heroes—Duke Siegfried Orleans, Archmage Kyrios, and High Priest Cesar—she nurses her saviors back to health, and they adopt her! Now, Tatiana is determined to awaken so she can be independent... But with three protective fathers watching her every move, can this 4-year-old keep her secret long enough to become the Demon King?

(Source: Tapas)

Eve, trapped in the cursed Tower of Babel, endlessly dies and revives as she struggles to escape and uncover the truth.

(Source: Toomics)

On the day the empire fell to rebellion and invasion from another world, Valen met his end alongside his sister, the Emperor. But when he opened his eyes again, he found himself 40 years in the past. This time, he vowed to do whatever it took to prevent the world’s destruction and protect the Emperor. And his solution? To live an even wilder life than before. “If I was a scoundrel in my past life, then this time… I’ll be the ultimate menace!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

I possessed an extra who didn’t even have a name in the novel. Her features are black hair and purple eyes that means that she is cursed. And I’m the lost daughter of the villain in the novel?! I thought I was a passing by extra, but she was actually the lost daughter of the villainous Grand Duke.

“Erita, my beloved daughter.”

“My precious little sister. I’ll protect you.”

……are these the bloody villains I’ve seen? My father and brother, who people said to be cruel, were too sweet to me. But the villain has a death ending! It was the first time I received love and warmth, and I decided to change the cruel ending of my friendly family since I possessed it 10 years earlier than the original. Yeah, I will definitely change my family’s future……

“Erita, I love you.”

What’s wrong with the Male Lead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In a cynical world where love has lost its luster, 37-year-old Ha-Yeong Kim is merely a shell of her former self. But in a twist of fate, she’s catapulted back in time, inhabiting the body and vibrant spirit of her 17-year-old self, Seon Kim, and reliving an era of passionate love and limitless potential. Empowered by her knowledge of what’s to come, Seon embarks on a mission to reshape her friends’ destinies. Bouncing between past and present, orchestrating grand changes, Seon begins to discover that altering others’ lives might be the key to rediscovering love, purpose, and the courage to dream again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: An Extra, Yet the Duke's Only Daughter

description:
Reincarnation Life Cast by Dice, aka "ReLife," is a mobile game that I transmigrated into. The objective is to help the main characters save the world from the evil demon king, with each character classified by how crucial they are to the plot. I awoke in the body of Alyssa G. Dravein, a side character who dies by her father's hand when she turns nine years old. But, my dad seems to love me so much--where did it all go wrong? Can I change my fate and live to see ten?

(Source: Tapas)

The Hunters League is a sport where only those with supernatural powers may compete, promising fame, glory, and incredible prizes. Changhyeon Lee had it all, but faces an abrupt downfall during his slump. Cast aside by even his own team, his world crumbles… but fate deals him an unexpected hand when a fatal encounter with a 10-ton truck ends his life, only to send him back in time to the day he discovered his powers. Armed with a second chance, Changhyeon is determined to reclaim and transcend his former glory in the Hunters League.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Don't Try To Tame a Wild Spirit

description:
With her feisty temperament and unyielding attitude, Katherina Smirnoff is labeled a villainess by the men around her. Tired of the smug suitors trying to change her, she decides she'd rather not marry at all. While striving to escape their pursuit and stand up for herself, Katherina crosses paths with Nikolai de Bassily, the feared Grand Duke of Blood. To her surprise, he seems drawn to her and understands her for who she is. Could this be a chance at true love for the free-spirited Katherina?

(Source: Tapas)

Hiding her identity as a Snow Maiden demon, Seol-Ha has carved out a life in disguise among humans. However, her life changes forever when she catches the interest of the Northern Prince, a man known for hunting down and killing demons, and agrees to become his bride. Will these two be able to overcome their differences and live happily ever after?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Luciel, a Crystal Fairy skilled in crafting jewels from her emotions, returns to the past after a life cut short by betrayal. Armed with the knowledge of a grim future, she proposes a contract marriage to the empire’s most villainous family. What begins as a desperate strategy to escape her fate soon becomes an adventure filled with unexpected warmth. Can Luciel rewrite her story, or will her past come back to haunt her?

(Source: TappyToon)

After a tragic accident resulting in her death, Ms. Yeo is transported to the Cleaf Empire... for the second time! With her new identity as Yureia Cratia, she sets out to reclaim the guild she had built from the bottom up and uncover who was behind her previous murder. However, while hiding her true identity and searching for answers, she only comes up with more questions. Will she be able to find her killer before they discover that she has returned, or is she doomed to face death once again?

(Source: Tapas)

title.romaji: Geuga Jungnyeoya Hal Choejong Angnyeoga Jeoramnida
title.english: I'm the Final Boss Villainess He Must Kill
title.native: 그가 죽여야 할 최종 악녀가 저랍니다

description:
Hongyeon Kim has spent her afterlife generally being bored. So when a new program is introduced to entertain the dead, Hongyeon jumps at the chance to be transported into her favorite novel. However, when she finds herself in the body of the villainess, the demon princess Bella, she attempts a spell to speed up time to the end of the novel. Instead, she finds herself ten years in the past. Now, she must wait fifteen years to escape all while living with demons and raising the main character!

(Source: Tapas)

Gyu Park is a survivor who predicted and prepared for the coming apocalypse. In this ruined world, he is willing to do anything and everything he can to protect the comforts of his bomb shelter.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Leon Winston, Captain of the Western Command's Domestic Intelligence Division in the Kingdom of Riphon, is both feared and revered. Known as the Vampire of Camden for his ruthless treatment of rebels, he strikes terror into both allies and enemies alike. But beneath his noble and elegant exterior lies a man consumed by a dark desire, one that burns as fiercely as his rage against the rebels. Sally Bristol, the unassuming maid in charge of the interrogation room, is the one who awakens this uncontrollable craving, fueled by the scent of her blood. And after a rebel spy mentions her name, Leon realizes he no longer has to suppress his violent desire for her. Will Sally be able to beg her way out of Leon's deathly grasp, or will she succumb to the bloodlust he can't resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I Don't Want to Be a Lady

description:
I'll be the one calling the shots.
After enduring an upbringing full of torment, Lady Arianne refuses to be used as a means to anyone's end but her own. When her father moves to have her sold off as an additional mistress to the crown prince, she takes matters into her own hands by proposing a contract marriage with a duke instead!

(Source: Manta)

202X. In the back alleys of Seoul, South Korea… He looked down at the heroes under his feet—the heroes who adorned themselves in a variety of colorful clothes, as if they were K-pop idols on TV. Those heroes? They were crawling beneath him, their gaudy outfits smeared with dirt. That was the true nature of being a hero. He hoped the individuals before him learned that lesson well. It was time to ensure they never forgot it. As a magical girl, he swung his hammer down. This is a bright story. The story of a man reclaiming his light.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Elijah is the almighty god of plants, but due to false accusation ends up being imprisoned in a cell for 200 years. He seeks escape from reality through the melodrama in novels and suddenly ends up possessing Roselita Derman, a dying marquis. Expecting the life in the novel to be much easier, he was in for a rude awakening. He finds out that Roselita did not commit suicide by drinking poison, and aims to find her name and clear her reputation in the meantime.

“Aak! Who are you, really?!”

“Me? I’m the fairy of the mallet who protects love and justice.”

 And he’s going to have a fateful love that he’s only seen in dramas and novels!

“No one will ever point fingers at you again.”

The Derman family, especially her uncle Benjamin, can’t stand it even if I move a finger. Damn it. This is the first time I’ve felt this kind of affection! And to top it all off, the broken-down crown prince is my fiancé…? What about my romance? My fateful love!?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Su-Hyeok and Seo-Ha secretly like each other, but when Seo-Ha plans to move out, it's her mom who makes a move on Su-Hyeok.

(Source: Toomics)

Luna wakes up one day to realize that she has been reborn into a novel as the childhood friend of the male lead, Fersen. To make matters worse, the guy is a clueless idiot! Luna wants to end their friendship to escape being bullied by the other ladies, but Fersen won't leave her alone no matter what she does. Things only get more complicated when she becomes entangled with the novel's villain, who hates Fersen even more than she does. Will Luna manage to get away from this dumb male lead?

(Source: Tapas)

Ha-Jin has suffered relentless torment from a stalker ever since he was outed… Pushed to both the metaphorical and physical edge, he sees no way out. Just as he’s ready to give up on life, an unexpected savior appears: an angel named Kael. But this isn’t your typical heaven-sent rescue. Kael offers a shady deal: he’ll get rid of Ha-Jin’s stalker, but in return, he wants Ha-Jin’s soul. With nothing left to lose, Ha-Jin agrees...only to learn firsthand what “touched by an angel” really means.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The MC is summoned to a matriarchal society. Due to his massive penis, he is enslaved by a baroness. Can our MC live a happy life by dominating high class women in this female-dominated world?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.english: The Acting Empress Still Spends the First Night

description:
Zelda von Trova never wanted the title of Acting Empress, but when she's forced to wed the Emperor of the Raphion Empire in place of the runaway princess, she has no choice. Yet after sharing the first night with him, her divorce plans begin to waver. As their attraction grows, Zelda’s heart is torn-- will she be able to walk away when the time comes, or will love unravel all her plans?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When Gavin becomes caretaker of his family’s apartment building, his parents joke that he should marry any tenant he falls for. On day one, he meets five stunning women, including his childhood crush. Living together has never been this tempting.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: The Dragon's Guide to Defying Death

description:
After suffering from an illness that cut his life short, Royce wakes up to find himself as a character from the story he read until his last moments. As a dragon hatchling, he believes his long life is just beginning. That is, until Royce realizes he's the son of the dragon who goes berserk due to his untimely death! Now, Royce is looking to race against the clock, even if his every move leads to a near-death experience. Will he be able to change his fate, or will he get stopped in his tracks?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Leveling Up in an Exclusive Dungeon

description:
Guilds are there to protect hunters, right? Right...? Nope. All they seem to protect is their own interests. As they monopolize hunting grounds, the monsters, and even the XP points, Jinhyeok, our MC and a hunter without guild affiliation, is left bouncing from one part-time job to another just to scrape by. What he needs is an opening. A shot. A crack in the system. Then the universe provides one. In his attic. What?!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Lieutenant General Leto Okeanos, the Mad Dog of the Navy, runs a tight ship… except when it comes to matters of the heart. He’s met his match in Captain Noah Bello, a fiery subordinate and old flame. When Leto blocks her long-awaited promotion, Noah challenges him to a duel. The wager? A wish granted to the winner. Leto wins and proposes marriage. Caught between duty, desire, and Navy politics, these ex-lovers must decide: is their love a second chance... or a disaster waiting to sink them both?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Ending This Marriage for Your Happiness

description:
Having forced her husband, Alfonso, into a loveless marriage, Charlotte accepted when he sought solace from another woman. So when she wakes up in the past with a second chance, Charlotte hopes to sever ties while uniting him with his true love. To her dismay, however, any attempt to guide him away leads him right back to her! With Alfonso's gaze shifted to her, Charlotte is stuck between fixing her past regrets and shaping this new present into the future she had once hoped for with Alfonso.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Raided the Demon God's Treasure Trove

description:
The peace of the world collapses after a war between the gods and demons, leading to the downfall of humanity—except for one person. Sewoon, the sole survivor, is determined to rewrite the ending of this tragic tale. While searching for Kronos' hourglass to reverse time, he discovers the treasure trove of the Demon of Greed, filled with items that can aid him in achieving his goal. With these demonic treasures at his disposal, can Sewoon stop the war and secure lasting peace in the world?

(Source: Tapas)

Gods have descended upon the world, and Da-il's ready to drag them all to hell. After the lives of his loved ones were taken by the gods, Da-il offers his soul in exchange for the powers of the very killer of gods, the Void.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: Trapped With the Male Lead in a Horror Game

description:
As an NPC stuck in the horror game, Charlotte sees a chance for freedom with the arrival of the handsome male lead, Dietrich. Desperate to escape, Charlotte aims to help Dietrich beat every level and unlock the final room. However, she is also forced by the game system to hinder him by obeying its mysterious and cruel demands. Can Charlotte's growing feelings for Dietrich break her free from her passive NPC role and escape the deadly game, or will her story lead to a chilling Game Over?

(Source: Tapas)

Saint Violet comes to the prison to save the Holy Knight ‘Lahart’ who has been corrupted by the demonic energy. Violet decides to save Lahart using the only healing method found in the old book. Lahart regains his senses with her help, but neither of them can easily extinguish their desire for each other...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Notes:
- Part of Bomtoon and Lezhin's Baedeong Danpyeonseon (배덕 단편선) Collection.
- Includes one extra chapter.

Lee Lina, resident of the dystopian world Tolka, plays the VR dating sim Raison D’Etre with the pain setting at zero. After her 99th playthrough, she is gifted a new patch for completing all the endings. However, as she begins her 100th game, and her favorite characters start acting oddly affectionate to her in an unfamiliar storyline, Lina wonders if the reward is more of a glitch. Will Lina be able to unlock a new ending before shocking news back in Tolka makes it impossible to ignore reality?

(Source: Tapas)

Yuujun Shin, a wealthy crypto investor, spends his time mastering a little-known game and purchasing all the best perks to dominate. When the game unexpectedly merges with reality, Yuujun finds himself in the game world with access to his massive virtual inventory. Now, with his amassed power and resources, he is more than ready to navigate this new reality...or is he?

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Gyeong is reborn into a world where women are dominant and male hunters are rare. After awakening as a Lust Manager of Female Hunters, he discovers an outrageous way to grow stronger. He has to satisfy frustrated female hunters and earn points from sex.

"Fine. I'll be a manwhore if that's what it takes... I'll fuck them all!"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Part timer Myeong-Hun has a crush on sexy Seo-Young, but is confessed to by cute Ji-Eun. Learning their secrets at the crossroad of sexiness or cuteness, their relationship begins to get complicated.

(Source: Toomics)

The long-term public service exam candidate, Minseo, finds himself trapped in the game, “Raising Lena” as he tries to escape his grim reality. In the game, Minseo becomes a character named Leo, and he must navigate through a world with three different scenarios to accomplish his mission of turning the protagonist, Lena, into a princess. However, the game “Raising Lena” boasts an overwhelming level of difficulty due to enemies who are set to thwart Minseo with their immense power and influence. Will Minseo be able to complete the game by making Lena a princess and return to reality?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Gyeong-Bok Lee possesses a gift that grants him a sixth sense and supernatural foresight -- however, this ability comes at a steep price, debilitating him each time it is used. But when Gyeong-Bok tries virtual reality gaming for the first time, he makes a startling discovery: not only could he leverage his psychic ability to gain a significant advantage in the virtual world, but he was also entirely free from its afflictions. Seizing this opportunity, Gyeong-Bok sets out to become a legendary video game streamer, turning his curse into his greatest asset.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title.romaji: Pahonhan Yeongaeneun Ending Oeen Jipchakaji Anneunda
title.english: I Just Want My Happy Ending!
title.native: 파혼한 영애는 엔딩 외엔 집착하지 않는다

description:
My fiancé just broke off our engagement, but I’m done crying over pathetic guys. I don’t need a man to lead me to victory—I’ll find my happy ending on my own! I’ve been trapped in a fantasy dating sim for three years and still haven’t reached a good ending. After all, it’s hard to win when I’m Serdel Loeveste, a forgettable side character. In this next playthrough, I’ll have to take more risks instead of simply doing what I’m told. Will I finally be able to escape the game this time?

(Source: Tapas)

Dumped by her boyfriend and fired from her job, Jin-Eon, her family's breadwinner, has no time to cry over the spilled milk. She must find another job and fast. Enter The Hell, a mysterious company with great pay, excellent work-life balance, and an easy commute! What more could she ask for? Or so she thought. Little did she know, she had walked into hell—literally. How will she navigate the harrowing journey in the hellscape of her new job with King Yeomra, her stunning new boss, further complicating everything? Could love blossom in this pit of hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

“Why should we care about free-to-play players?”

Seo Sa-hyuk, a planner who neglected gameplay and focused only on monetization elements, has now fallen victim to his own greed for making money, working tirelessly through the night until he succumbed to overwork. In his unfortunate situation, he wakes up once again.

“This place is just like the game I used to create…!!”

The demonic planner who tormented gamers is now experiencing the consequences he sowed, a story of redemption and transformation begins!

(Source: Naver, Translated)

title.english: One Too Many Supporting Male Leads

description:
Drained of life after being sick for so long, Eun-Jae closes her eyes only to open them again as Roella Clemend, the female lead of the web novel she was reading in her final moments. While she may have gotten a second chance at life with a healthy body, there’s a catch. Roella has exactly one year to find “the true male lead” of the story to be able to continue living in this new world. But unfortunately for Roella, this task may be like trying to find a needle in a haystack…

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Some things are thicker than water. Kwak Jahyung lives his life surrounded by hot women - too bad they just happen to be his sisters, as his playboy father has more children than he can count. But boys will be boys, and Jahyung is no exception. After his older sister Hanna gives him a potion meant to screw him over, the two find themselves in a sticky situation that goes to show family can be closer than you’d ever imagine…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: I Listened to My Husband and Brought In a Lover

description:
Louise wants nothing more than to live a happy life with her husband, Reyard. She loves her husband so much even though he has never been faithful to her. She had to watch him bring home mistresses and pretend like she wasn’t bothered by it. After all, Reyard was never deceitful about his wishes. He told her that if she were to object to his lovers then their marriage would be over. Louise feels lower than low, so when Reyard insists that she take on a lover of her own… she does just that.

(Source: Tapas)

In a remote, insular village devoted to the goddess Hygieia, Tauser lives a monotonous life, never having left its borders. One day, a journalist named Hereis arrives, stirring doubts about everything Tauser once believed and unraveling secrets long buried...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue.

Two years have passed since Eden was trapped in a dark fantasy game set in a medieval world with a reputation for extreme difficulty. He has struggled as a paladin and succeeded in destroying 49 demons, now finally able to proceed with the main story of the game. However, the more he plays, the more irregularities occur and the story and relationships with the NPCs change. Will he be able to prevent the destruction in the game and survive despite the numerous irregularities?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Top S-class hunter Sin Yu-Ri helps protect Korea from the dungeons that have been wreaking havoc. And when all the hunters refuse to take on the "I've Possessed the Body of a Weak and Terminally Ill Noble Lady" dungeon, Yu-Ri and her team head inside to challenge it. But while her comrades become an emperor, a pope, and a master of the magicians' tower, she becomes a dying noble lady! They have one year to prevent the destruction of the continent, but can she help with this frail body of hers?!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

Evie Ariatte, a lovely saintess candidate, has her bright future shattered when a sudden curse forces her to answer every question with the truth. This unexpected twist of fate threatens her reputation and jeopardizes her dream of becoming the saintess. As her blunt honesty earns her both friends and enemies, will Evie uncover the hidden truths of Thiendavis and bring about its perfect salvation?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: I Don't Want the Male Lead's Child

description:
In the novel I was reading, my favorite character, Abril, had a tragic ending. After marrying the male lead, Asellas, she dies of magic intolerance while giving birth to his child. I only wished for her to be happy–but when I opened my eyes, I was suddenly in Abril’s body! Before getting married to Asellas, I came up with a simple plan to survive: “I’ll never have his child!” But of course, things aren’t that easy...

(Source: Tapas)

A bird is the sacred symbol of the great empire Apollinaire. In fact, legend has it that one day a sacred bird of silver and gold will come to earth and bring glory to the empire. Nowadays, the thing on everyone’s mind is when the emperor will find a wife. Since Richard Apollinaire is a romantic, he wants to fall in love instead of marrying for politics. Then one day, a small egg appears and from it hatches... a tiny silver and gold bird.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Evan was a slave. That is until the demon blood in him awakened. With his new-found power as an incubus, Evan brings women who wronged him one by one to submission.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Money can’t buy her love, but it can help her get sweet, sweet revenge. Take a seat at Lady Ilya Bloden’s table and watch Ilya charm her way out of a loveless engagement, help the “Bloodthirsty Butcher of the Battlefield’' find the courage to speak to the manager, and single-handedly destroy one of the most influential families in the Ishtar Empire. Tea and crumpets will be served!

(Source: Tapas)

After countless reincarnations as doomed villainesses, Ms. Transmigrator gets her final chance to rewrite fate–as Ciani Felicité, the woman who drove the male lead to madness! Instead, she plans to rescue Redian, the male lead trapped in her family’s Subterranean Castle, nurture him, and then escape. But why is his intense gaze fixed on her? With so much attention, can she really navigate this reincarnation to a happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Became the Youngest Prince in the Novel

description:
Emperor Aurelian Agnes, founder of an empire and master of abyssal magic, one day falls asleep atop a book that portends his empire’s end. Waking up as a weak and sequestered prince in that future timeline, he must use his knowledge of the book and his unique magic to break the mold set before him and change the world’s impending end. Can he overcome an invading demon army, infighting royals, magical disasters, and even his own weak body, or will his empire fall for good?

(Source: Tapas)

Kwon Ji-Sung had no interest in dating until his casual sex partner suddenly became his colleague.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

I ended up possessing the body of an extra named Luberia, who is barely mentioned in the story. And right in the tragic novel “Emperor Caesar”, full of wars and disasters, where the protagonist sacrifices everything for the love of the hero and everyone ends up dying! I planned to live discreetly and hide my strength...

But the male lead, Caesar, keeps looking for me and even proposes marriage, saying he wants to keep me around. Luberia doesn't want to meet the same tragic end as the protagonist, so she tries to avoid Caesar at all costs... But due to Caesar's intimidating appearance and assertiveness, before she knows it, she ends up engaged to him.

Will Luberia manage not to fall in love with Caesar and survive until the end?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.

She became the villain of a novel. And not just any villain, but one who committed several crimes and was expelled from her family! Having no other choice, she started selling food on the streets to survive... But, suddenly, she was kidnapped by the prince of the empire and the villain of the novel. “I want you to be my personal cook,” he said.

But why is he interested in me? After many twists and turns, she became the emperor's exclusive cook and followed a quiet but dull path... Until she discovered that her food had a special effect on people. A genius alchemist, a rival chef, a mysterious fox... Everyone fell in love with her food and with her. And, above all, the emperor, who was the supposed villain, was very kind and protective of her. But, she just wanted to cook in peace!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Thought I Tamed the Villain

description:
After a close call with death, Iris has a sudden revelation: she's been living inside a novel from her past life. But if her memory's correct, all the characters in the novel, herself included, ultimately meet their demise at the hands of the villain, Theo. Determined to survive, Iris resolves to befriend Theo in hopes of reforming him while he's still young. At first, everything seems to go according to plan... But when she reunites with him ten years later, she realizes something's gone terribly wrong. Why is the same ruthless villain she saw in the novel... standing before her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After defeating the Demon King, all that was left for the hero was the betrayal and neglect from his comrades. Then, a goddess decides to grant him a wish.

“My wish is to return to the past and have those bitches who abandoned me pay the price.”

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: When the Witch’s Daughter Lifts the Male Lead’s Curse

description:
When Daisy wakes up in the novel “In Love With A Monster Prince” as the daughter of the witch who torments the male lead, Dionel, she must do whatever she can to prevent Dionel from killing her alongside her foster mother when he comes to seek vengeance in the future. 13 years pass, and Daisy is confident that she has achieved this goal until she realizes the original story has changed. Where is the female lead who’s supposed to lift Dionel’s curse with a kiss? And why is Dionel under the impression that Daisy abandoned him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The once up-and-coming monster hunter Suho has plateaued at B Class, dashing his hopes of ever avenging his parents' deaths. Enter the ghost of the Cheonma, former divine Murim master and Suho's direct ancestor! Fortunately for Suho, the disembodied Cheonma needs a body to hunt down his arch nemesis, the Blood Demon, and Suho is the perfect fit. Will Suho strike a deal with the Cheonma to escape his rut and gain the power to finally avenge his parents?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hae Jin has a father who devoted his whole life to finding the national artifacts that were smuggled out of the country. Then one day, after receiving an unknown “artifact” sent by his father, whom he had lost contact with for a long time, a strange light suddenly came from it, granting Hae Jin a mysterious power and a mission.

“The magic of the Heavenly Object has been bestowed upon you.”

Thus, an adventure involving the artifacts scattered all over the world, including the "Three Heavenly Objects," which contain the soul of the Korean people, begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Four years ago, Joe came out as a female writer from her pen name Jeffery Collins. Amid many denunciations, an amicable man named Liam approaches her. However, he turned out to be a notorious literary critic. Along with her father's disapproval as a writer, Joe became hostile and unable to trust anyone. That is until Anna Baker, a bright young art student, starts to change her.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

The fragile but cheeky Laviette is not here to save the plot of the novel she transmigrated into. Instead, her goal is to escape her fate of a short life through her best friend, Ahckard, and his healing powers. The novel says he'll fall for her brother, so she sees him as just a friend. However, it doesn't seem like Ahckard plans to follow the original plot either. Will Laviette have to look elsewhere for her happy ending, or will she realize that what she needed has been beside her all along?

(Source: Tapas)

Arlenne Serkia is granted the chance to go back in time and devises a plan to ruin the man who stabbed her heart. The key to her scheme is the slave Kasadin, renowned for his unmatched swordsmanship and stunning beauty, whom she adopts as her "younger brother" to use as both her sword and shield. But Kasadin has a past much deeper and more dangerous than she realizes... and this drives his own motives for staying close to her, both personal and political. If Arlenne isn't careful, the user might end up being used!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Aristana was once first in line to inherit the throne of Yiogrante. But after being charged with killing her own brother, her siblings vie for the throne that was almost hers. With her hopes of becoming empress shattered, Aristana lives every day as the imperial disgrace until she meets Marquess Patelo, an admirer who has come from the future. He knows she will rule the empire one day, but she no longer wants the throne. She'd rather ruin everything and everyone who has ever caused her pain!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: This Is the Wrong House, Mr. Villain!

description:
What do you do when a murderous villain ends up unconscious at your front door? For Yuri, the answer is simple: leave his body outside protagonist Anne-Marie's house and then live in peace as a background character! But for some reason, Yuri can't bring herself to let him ruin sweet, innocent Anne-Marie's life as is written in the original story, so she takes him in and slowly nurses him back to health. Little does Yuri realize the consequences of letting a villain inside her house...

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Jinhyuk has enjoyed his decade-long reign as Cornsilk, the undefeated number one PVP player in virtual reality game "The Abyss." But with the sequel "Abyss World" resetting all players as newbies, Jinhyuk accepts a sudden sweet deal from his Abyss Studios developer half-brother Jinho to log in as the infamous boss monster Black Knight. After slaying 100 rankers during the opening event, Jinhyuk agrees to keep the monster login scheme going... but will his unmatched talent blow his cover?

(Source: Tapas)

Junseong Kim had a hard life living secretly as a pro gamer to pay off his late parents’ debts before dying in a tragic accident. But his luck changes when he is reincarnated into another world as a boy named Elemis. Awakening to a doting mother and great magical power, Junseong, now El, journeys to become the most powerful mage in this brave new world! Soon, he and his mother are caught up in the schemes of deadly intrigue, and it’ll take both his mage power and gamer wits to come out on top!

(Source: Tapas)

Byeoridoryeong is a netherworld shaman who has made a name for himself by picking off those who delay their deaths. One day, as he goes about his business, he receives news of the theft of the Jewel of Beauty, which he keeps in the Heavenly Palace. Can he find it and restore his honour as a prince?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

title.english: The End is a Game to Me

description:
Cheon-Su Go is a shut-in NEET whose day-to-day is playing games and streaming to his one viewer. One day, he finds himself thrown into the midst of a survival game as a player character. The only clear condition for the game is to survive. The camera is rolling, and the 24/7 broadcast of his fight for survival begins now!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Lee Kang-Jin has just inherited an entire building in the affluent Gangnam neighborhood of Seoul. The only catch is he has to run the diner in that building for five years, but little does he know that he has to serve ghosts too! From 11 p.m. to 1 a.m., ghosts who carry resentment in their hearts come flocking to the diner in search of their comfort foods that remind them of what life was like. Can Kang-Jin handle both the culinary and personal demands of his undead customers for five whole years?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

"I'm ready to accept you anytime, son."

Me and my Stepmother were abducted to a strange island. In order to survive in this mad place, we have to do naughty things together. Use your penis to take her virginity!

"My Stepmother is a virgin...!?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

In a pristine and upscale new city, which is home to many corporate elites, a mysterious massage shop opens. What sets it apart? Its owner, the sole masseur, who possesses a strikingly handsome figure and a perfectly sculpted physique. Yu-Na, one among countless lonely married individuals, wrestles with unfulfilled desires brought on by her workaholic husband’s performance issues. When tales of this alluring new salon reach her ears, Yu-Na decides to pay a visit in search of the solace she craves...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Nae Chimdae Mit-e Goemul Namjuga Sanda
title.english: The Monster Male Lead Living Under My Bed
title.native: 내 침대 밑에 괴물 남주가 산다

description:
Waking up as a character destined to be killed by her family, Irina Sordier refuses to follow the script. She plans to survive by escaping after her father marries her off to Archduke Alexei Ruslan. That is until she is saved from her abusive circumstances by a slime! The two bond quickly, but the slime suddenly vanishes, and Irina laments its loss. Years later, she meets Alexei, but he seems to know things about her that only the slime would! Can Irina save herself and the slime after all?

(Source: Tapas)

I'd give my life to protect you. To others, she was a witch to be feared. But to Elaine, Bella was her savior. After a night of tragedy destroys the life she knows, Elaine wakes to find Bella's heart now beating in her chest. Startled, she sets out to find Rhys, Bella's son, only to discover he is no longer as he once was...

(Source: Manta)

"I like a man who desires my body... then just a nice guy."

Kwang-Min, a kind-hearted ideal student who loves comics, faces rejection for lacking men's appeal. Determined to transform himself, he emulates his favorite comic's protagonist-a blonde and tanned gangster. Surprisingly, this change leads to newfound power over women's desires and submission to his charm.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Sungjun has a secret. Try as he might, he can only gain sexual satisfaction through a fancam of former idol Minyoung. But on a night out with friends, the unthinkable happens. After sharing his first kiss with the inexperienced and innocent Geumji, he decides it’s best to take her home. There he meets Geumji’s mother, who is the woman of his dreams…literally. After dropping Geumji off, Sungjun goes home only to have a wet dream about her mom later that night! Shocked by this new revelation, Sungjun is left with unanswered questions: Who is Geumji’s mother? Why is he able to get off to her? And how can he meet her again?! Deciding to take matters - and hopefully mothers - into his own hands, Sungjun just might get what he’s after…and more!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Ibeon Saengdo Jal Butakae: Gieogui Han Jogak
title.english: See You in My 19th Life - Special Spin-offs
title.native: 이번 생도 잘 부탁해 - 기억의 한 조각

description:
A special side-story to commemorate the release of the live-action adaptation of See You in My 19th Life.

Ju-Won takes Seo-Ha on a trip to the countryside, where his mother used to visit often. What will they see, and who will they meet there?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Would you sacrifice your honor to marry a Duke?

In order to save her family from ruin, Chloe Verdier must find a groom for her sister, Alice. She soon runs into the handsome but arrogant Duke Tisse who makes a proposal that could save them. When Alice flees with a mysterious man, Chloe must seek out the Duke in the biggest gamble of her life.

(Source: Manta)

After her mother's death, Elrose Basellan was cast out by her father for 14 years. With news of his passing, Elrose rushes to claim her inheritance, but can't do so unless she's married! Desperate, she prays for a husband, and the mysterious Rakshan seems to fall from the sky! They agree to a temporary union that benefits them both, but unexpected issues keep delaying their plans for divorce. Will this fake marriage become something more? Or should Elrose have chosen her husband more carefully?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

A sham marriage... or is it?

Carlee Browning, the head of the powerful Brownings, is sick of suitors eyeing her fortune. Her solution? Propose to teenage aristocrat Ethelred Elad! With his family in ruins, this sham marriage would be perfect for both of them, just until they're able to divorce. If they do divorce, that is.

(Source: Manta)

The Tiger Lord of the East is now my father?!
