When he awakes the next morning, however, Jong-gu has gone missing! In his place is a cute guy who seems strangely familiar, but Euncheol can’t quite put his paw -er, finger- on why…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Tiger That Swallowed the Moon

description:
Taebom Gwak, an Olympic gold medalist of the national shooting team, suffers a dangerous hit-and-run accident. The person who he used to call "Daddy-Long-Legs" suddenly appears in this life-or-death situation, ten years after he's disappeared from Taebom's childhood. But he is actually… a vampire?!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: From Today On, I'm a Boy

description:
"If nobody notices that you are a girl until we graduate, I will give you a billion won."
"I'm in."

The bet was on. Will Shiru be able to hide her identity until she graduates?!

(Source: Webnovel)

Waking up inside your favorite novel sounds like a dream come true. Unless you’re born as the hated villainess, that is. Our new, full-fledged Louise Sweeny must try to reinvent her character to dodge her doomed fate of being killed off at the end of the story. It seemed easy enough at first, but there’s one big problem. The story, which she knew like the back of her hand, has veered so far off course that she can’t predict what plot twists are coming next. Can she avoid getting in the way of the male and female leads’ romance to save herself from impending demise?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When I told him my feelings, he replied, “I’ve always dreamed of a love straight out of a drama.” I thought he was just telling me to be a good boyfriend, but as we got closer, I finally understood what he meant — He wanted us to live out a true romance drama. But can I really play my part in his script called life?

(Source: Manta)

A strange current between the mysterious transfer student 'Do Won-kyung' and the girl 'Choi Kang' who is mistaken for a man?

(Source: Toomics)

Who knew that the game I designed for fun with my friend in middle school would later become a monster that would swallow up the entire world?

Taejun, who has been living a tough life with his younger sister, loses all of what he saved due to a lease fraud. In despair, he curses, "To hell with this fucking world!!" while looking at Namsan... but the next day, the curse came true!

Namsan suddenly turned into a large sinkhole where man hunting golems started endlessly spawning!! The world has turned into a living hell, but Taejun realizes that these golems may be a mob he created in the past? A strategy that only he knows of. Save the world, or save just yourself.

(Source: Tapas)

“Would you like to be the bride of a goblin?” Xi'an, the capital of the great Shun. There is a rumor, that at a local apothecary, there is a holy maiden can sing inside your dream and grant wishes to come true. To check if the rumor is true, Prince Sa Heon-Young disguises himself and visits this holy maiden. After listening to her song, as if under an illness, he seeks out the girl...

(Source: Copin Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Street boy Jack lives life the way it flows. However, after messing with gangster Trent Valentino's car for a dare, Jack gets caught in a pickle in this noir comic.

(Source: Smack Jeeves)

Yoon Hana finds out that her family is moving out just before the high school entrance ceremony. At first she as worried about transferring to a new school, but her bright personality prevents her from being depressed for too long. However, the first day at the new school doesn't go quiet well how she would imagine. She quickly encounters trouble with her intimidating desk mate, Lee Chang-wook! But soon Hana starts to learn that there's more to Chang-wook than meets the eye. This is the story of the sunny Hana's project to help the gloomy Chang-wook make friends!

A cute herbalist meets five warriors.

A hybrid: half animal, half human. Kakana, the hybrid herbalist-in-hiding awakes to find five poisoned and lost adventurers who ask for her help. In a world where non-hybrids want the extinction of her kind, she must decide whether to take on the adventure to save them or to continue to stay hidden.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes two side story chapters.

“Please let me take over someone else’s body this time!” That was my request to the King of the Underworld upon my latest arrival. None of my previous incarnations made it past my 25th birthday, so the king promised that if I succeeded, he’ll grant me a long, healthy life. I asked for an existence filled with wealth and physical prowess that had no siblings and no complications with men… At least he fulfilled the first three! My name’s Lukina. Title: the Duke’s daughter. And my goal: survive past the age of 25!

(Source: Tapas)

I tried to save the sub male lead, who was poisoned by the female lead, but an accident happened! He said he would repay the favor, but he randomly sent me to the most notorious villain, the Family of Assassins?!

The family that consists of the oldest brother, a knight in the Imperial Army preparing for a revolt, the second brother, a reverend with a large bounty on his head, and a father who is the greatest villain of all time...

Will I be safe in this villainous family throughout my three-year contract?

Note: Promotional prologue for the homonym web novel.

A long time ago the first celestial emperor decided to create Cheonjihae, an organization of 27 beings with fantastic powers in charge of maintaining the peace of the celestial world. Our heroine is destined to become the “Yellow Dragon”, the main defender of this association. Will she succeed in protecting the fragile balance of the heavens, despite the growing tension between the different races? And what to do when the organization itself does not believe in its mission anymore?

Kalia is a war hero and commander that put an end to the past war. But one day, she finds out that she's... pregnant?! Of all people, the father of the baby is Simon Terroan, her best friend and archmage, whom she spent a single passionate night with.

Believing that Simon doesn't want the baby, Kalia hides the truth of her pregnancy, then retires from her job and disappears while Simon is away in order to have her baby. But the truth is that Simon has loved Kalia, more than anyone else. And so, the frantic search for her begins.

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the web novel of the same name.

The unpredictable trial of a girl who was nothing at school begins!

Ordinary Park Ga-Eul witnesses the secret affair of Han Yu-Hyeon, who belongs to the so-called 'popular group', and uses this to blackmail Han Yu-Hyeon to join the group she admired...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 side story chapters

I thought I was reincarnated as the daughter of a wealthy family, but it turns out I was born as the child of the greatest villain in the fantasy world of martial arts. My father doesn't care about me, I'm ostracized by the others, and I'll eventually be murdered as a side antagonist by the male lead, after suffering from my one-sided love.

Even worse, this is a world where the weak are the prey of the strong, conceited antagonists.

So, before it's late, I need to learn martial arts and escape!

However, there was a fatal flaw in my plan...

Because of my notorious father, there were too many people who sought to end my life.

"Wahhh! Dadda! (Daddy!)"

...Will I ever be able to escape safely?

Note: This is a promotional one shot manhwa for the novel

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

God gave me a chance to relive my life. Before the rebirth, I had been used for the past 400 years as the empire's sword. And so, I swore to destroy the empire. I found the young prince of the country and became his teacher. I taught him how to become a tyrant and asked for the country.

"I will do the lady's will."

He conquered the whole empire for me, and I ran away.

"I came to take you, Charlize Ronan." Dylan became a perfect tyrant and searched the entire empire for me.

"You tamed me, so why did you run away?"

Rescued from a band of human traffickers, Eremia, the continent's most renowned traveling musician, meets Rajid Shan, the ruler of Istania. Soon, fate brings Eremia into the palace and she's forced to serve as his royal musician. They bond over their shared love of Istania's lore, but the threat of a devastating war looms on the horizon. Will Eremia be forced to watch the nation burn, as history repeats itself? And will Rajid realize that even a caged songbird longs to be free?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Someone within a 10 m radius likes you." With these words, LoveAlarm, an app that alerts users to the feelings of others, turned the world upside down. For struggling but optimistic high-schooler Kim Jojo, the day it-boy Hwang Sunoh rang her LoveAlarm felt like the start of a beautiful romance. But when the app that was meant to bring people together begins to dig up the darkest of emotions, Jojo quickly realizes that people may have been better off before they lived in a "ringing world"...

(Source: Tapas)

What on earth happened last night?! Hustling through life with three jobs, the extremely average Seon-U meets Zeus, the secret prince of Zerdel, one fateful night. The unlikely pair grow closer as they retrace their memories, but their relationship is shaken by the hidden past and the Prime MInister who holds the key to the secret...!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Hyeon-Ryeong, the leading character, lives on the border between the living and the dead because his heart had been exchanged with that of a monster called Gwi-Ho when he was born. As a series of mystery killings continue in his village, a powerful shaman and a mysterious girl, Gap-Jin, make a visit to the village. Hyeon-Ryeong’s elder brother Hyul-Ryeong kills the shaman with a vengeance when he is suspected as the culprit of murders due to the shaman. Hyul-Ryeong takes Gap-Jin, who is then left alone. He learns from Prince Sa-Do that Mr. Oh, a merchant from Qing, and a monster Gwi-Ho who has taken his heart, are involved in a series of murders in the village. Prince Sa-Do asks Hyeon-Ryeong to get rid of Gwi-Ho.

A period drama fantasy romance, the beginning of Hyeon-Ryeong and Gap-Jin’s adventures who want to recover their heart.

(Source: Pocket Comics, edited)

What if you had the power to erase people's memories? Would you use it to help those in need? Or would you use it to become the most powerful person in the world? For Kyle, this newfound power was going to change his life... for better or for worse.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A time bomb-like game starts in a certain girls-only high school! Every time the final bell rings, one person's soul is stolen away.

(Source: Hour of Lunacy)

Choi Kang is really a soft-hearted guy, despite his completely opposite looks. He is determined to make friends at school, but Haessal wrongfully gets the impression that he's a bully. Kang's online friend "Bada-nim" consoles him, as he tries to clear up the misunderstanding. Will he succeed? And what will happen to him and Haessal?

(Source: Hour of Lunacy)

Someone has made a wish to kill all students. The Dokkaebis, man-eating creatures who are bound by rule that they can only act to help people, are now allowed to hunt down students... Students are going missing left and right and Ki-mok, a student who is also one of only 44 people in the world with the "Blood of Gold", is now in a fight for his life against these supernatural beings that vie for his blood to empower themselves.

As a daughter of nobility, Apple Arden is expected to take part in the Crown Princess Audition. But one day, a never-before-seen girl named Rose arrives at their family home wishing to be adopted into the Viscount Arden family for her own chance to become the next crown princess. When that doesn’t work, she offers to buy the family’s candidacy to participate. The family accepts her generous offer, but Apple can’t help but notice how strange everyone has become since Rose’s arrival. Nonetheless, and Apple becomes Rose's lady-in-waiting as support, and declares to support Rose by participating in the auditions. But why is everyone in Apple's family acting strangely ever since Rose's arrival?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extras.

Han Seon-Nyeo hears about an old romance manhwa from more than a decade ago, with a female lead character whose face and name are the same as hers. She obtains a copy of that manhwa by luck, and falls asleep while reading it. When she wakes up, she finds Cheon Nam-Wook, the male lead character, lying next to her. From the moment he comes "straight out of manhwa," Seon-Nyeo's normal school life begins to go awry!

How awkward would it be to reunite with not one but two of your ex-boyfriends, and at the workplace nonetheless? When Nabom Han comes face-to-face with her unforgettable first love, Chajun, and her ex-boyfriend she hoped she’d never see again, Tae-o, she must learn to navigate the relationships from her past while ensuring the success of her father’s struggling manufacturing business. They say you should never mix business with pleasure, but will Nabom be able to resist the temptation?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A story about a man with a disease where he dies if he doesn't kiss, and the secret kissing contract made in order to keep him alive; an office contract romance.

(Source: Hour of Lunacy)

Caught in the clutches of an abusive relationship, Soo-In longs to escape. A vampire who finds human blood repulsive, Chi-Hwan only drinks the blood of other vampires. When chance brings the two together, Chi-Hwan makes Soo-In an enticing proposal. Chi-Hwan will help Soo-In get out of his living hell and in exchange... Soo-In has to let Chi-Hwan drink his blood. Will this proposal change both their lives for the better?

Note: The chapter count includes 19 extras.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Do-Yun Cha decides he isn’t looking for 'true love.' In fact, he wants a fake marriage. One fateful night, Ha-Yeon, who's known him since their college club days, confesses to Do-Yun that she wants in on his passionless arrangement. The problem is... she has a long-time crush on him! Can she convince him to fall head over heels for her? Or will he catch wind of her hidden intentions?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

As the illegitimate daughter of Duke McKellion, Lilian was never fully embraced by her father or society. So, when she has the opportunity to take her sister’s place in an arranged marriage to Emperor Kael Lu Kaldorf, Lilian jumps at the chance. The only problem is, her prospective partner gets cranky without his sleep, and since being cursed by a vindictive witch, the tyrannical emperor hasn’t experienced a single moment of slumber. But that’s no challenge for Lilian, who possesses the ability to induce sleep with a kiss. Now, tasked with the duty of keeping His Majesty well-rested, Lilian must kiss the emperor each night to keep his temper at bay. It’s a simple contractual agreement, and Lilian has no plans to develop romantic feelings, but what happens when Kael unexpectedly falls for her?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The main character reincarnates into a side character of a novel that she had once read. She becomes Amy, a young landlord, who has an older sister. From what she recalls in the original novel, her sister becomes the first love of the male lead she picked up and gets brutally murdered in the near future. The male protagonist has a disposition that of a sociopath, which stemmed from the unloved environment he grew up in. He has also been inflicted with a curse, where his body and mind would transform into an adolescent during the day. Can the curse of the male lead be lifted? What will happen next?

title.romaji: Appa, Na I Gyeolhon An Hallaeyo!
title.native: 아빠, 나 이 결혼 안 할래요!

description:
Juvelian is a villainess so hated by everyone that even her lover and father leave her to die a pitiful death. Just as she’s about to face her fate, she gets the chance to change the course of her story. In order to avoid the tragic end she knows awaits her, she breaks up with her lover and gives up trying to win her father’s love. Instead, she focuses on using his wealth to enjoy her new life to its fullest! But while she prepares for her extravagant life as a lady, her father begins looking for her new suitor. Afraid that he’ll marry her off to the infamously unpredictable and stormy prince, she lands on a desperate solution: a dating contract. And the best candidate is none other than her father’s student.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Women exist to be conquered. And the strongest man will conquer the most women. This is how one man thinks of the world, and he has lived by this creed for years. Will his appetite be his undoing...?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Hidden deep within the sanctuary of the forest lives the Rangae species, who form a precious jewel within their hearts once they reach adulthood. Viola, a young Rangae, has yet to form one when her village is attacked by human hunters. Due to her shocking resemblance to the late empress, she is rescued by Duke Khalid Alec Droy and assigned to serve the fifth imperial prince. Faced with the cruel hierarchy of high society and palace life, can Viola overcome her hatred of humans and discover the mysterious duke’s true intentions?

(Source: TappyToons)

title.english: A Villain Demands to Be Loved

description:
Senia Sunsethill longs to escape her mundane village life. So when the infamous cold-blooded Duke Tesar Ardielle asks for her hand in marriage, Senia agrees, if only to leave behind her suffocating life (and to stop Tesar from crying all the time)! Unbeknownst to Senia, she and Tesar shared a life in the past, and the two have been reincarnated over and over again, although each time has ended tragically. In this new timeline, can Tesar truly prevent Senia's doomed destiny, once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

I became the sister of the villain, who shed no blood or tears in a war-ridden novel! I thought I was born again as the youngest daughter of a noble family, but I'm the little sister of a villain who's only being used!

A baby's body too fragile to survive in the Lagrange household, a brutal family that makes children fight for successors... I've decided to stick to the villain in order to live!

I need you to be my guardian until I run away from here. Raise me, villain!

I remember the story of a novel I had read in my previous life just before my marriage. If you don’t mess up the wedding, you’ll be poisoned by your husband! So I just kissed the pastor who was in charge of the ceremony.

"Commander, are you alright?"

One of the holy knights shouted as he approached the pastor who was kissed.

"Huh, what?"
"Wait... are you the commander of the Holy Knights?"

****

Rurutia, who was about to die, wanted to spend her last moment in a temple where she felt at ease the most. She started a business with her friends for the temple, and it was a big hit.

"Miss, you have the world in the palm of your hands!"
"Are you a God who descended to earth?"

In the midst of being embarrassed by the large crown, the commander of the holy knights himself was also acting strange.

“All I wish for is to be your husband.”, he said that with eyes shining with obsession.
"Take responsibility for stealing my first kiss."

This is all so wrong. It seems that I changed my future.

I am the villainess in a harem novel. My role as "Erika" is to be an evil ex-girlfriend. I don't want to be a dumb villainess, so I broke up with the male-lead first... But after 3 years, Leo came back to me. "I can't live without you. I still like you..." I'm not the girl you should be obsessed with?! The second leads also came to me "I like it when you're next to me..." I'm just a supporting villainess, yet why are all these men confessing to me?! Who should I choose?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

He climbed onto a tree to avoid the teacher and saw a strange girl on top of the tree full of white beautiful petals.
The summer sun shined as bright as the white flowers on the strange Han Yeoreum (summer).

He endlessly searches for the storage room filled with memories of her.

While it may seem like a mere depiction of everyday life, The Sound of Your Heart is a comedy filled to the brim with wit, sarcasm, and parody. It gives no regard for the probable or realistic- it is a series of absurd situations that is sure to get a laugh out of every reader willing to suspend their sense of reality.

(Source: WEBTOON)

After finding out her boyfriend has been cheating with her boss, Hana loses her menial desk job of 5 years. Countless rejections later, she finally lands an interview at a small art gallery. Hana jumps at the chance to leave the drama of the past few months behind. But her high school friend (and worst enemy) Jiyeon is the gallery owner? Their most peculiar romance is about to begin- or not?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Perdi, known widely throughout the continent, is a very famous author of adult novels. But Perdi’s true identity is actually Vivian, the Imperial Night Librarian.

Vivian sends over the 4th draft of her latest novel to her publisher to be reviewed, but her work is criticized because the way she writes hetero sex scenes isn’t erotic at all.

“What, so you’re saying I’ll only know what sexual relationships are like after I experience it myself? But what can I do when I’m bound to a chastity contract?”

Unfortunately for Vivian, she had to sign a chastity contract in order to be hired as an imperial servant, and has been forced to remain a virgin ever since. Worse still, only a member of the imperial family could break the contract... but Vivian only has eyes for Ray, a mysterious man who visits the library every night.

But as it turns out, Ray is the imperial archduke and the emperor’s brother! One day, he approaches her with a sweet offer that she can’t resist…

Why do they keep killing him off? What did he ever do wrong?

A fan of the otome dating game finds that her ultimate bias, Rumins, ends up dead in every route but one.

After completing all routes of the game, a mysterious voice asks for her wish. Furious and choked up, she shouts to save her ultimate bias and to give him a happy life.



Waking up as Senepin, the villianess who harrasses the main character, she enjoys her dream where she could talk to Rumins, alive and well.

That is, until, ‘Senepin’ realizes that her new self was not a dream.

Senepin remembers that the only time Rumins survived his damned endings was when he ended up together with the female lead, Belkina. Realizing this, she makes it her utmost priority to get Rumins and Belkina together.

But for some reason, Rumins seems more interested in Senepin than the original female lead. Will ‘Senepin’ be able to save Rumins?

Hye-Ji is a famous SNS star with over 100,000 Instagram followers. Due to her popularity, Hye-Ji has received many confessions, but despite that, she doesn't really have much dating experience. One day, Hye-Ji received an invitation to go out on a date with another popular SNS star whom she secretly admired. On the day of the long-awaited date, Hye-Ji couldn't stand the subtle light coming from the karaoke bar, so she decides to use her feet to take a selfie. But due to an accident, Gi-Seong, who was a part-timer at that time, ended up seeing her in an embarrassing position.

After such a disastrous date, Hye-Ji decided to end her first-ever relationship. However, on her first day at school, she meets Hae-Ri, the person who gave her that embarrassing memory!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Pharmacy Where the Wolf Howls

description:
As a teen, Sooji was heartbroken when her favorite idol group LUPUS disbanded, thanks to the traitorous member Jackie quitting. Ten years later, Sooji has become a workaholic pharmacist who just wants a stable, predictable life. But she's thrown for a loop when she suddenly runs into Jackie--at an animal shelter, of all places! After learning that he plans to return to showbiz, Sooji is enraged and picks a fight with him... starting a deep dive into the untold ups and downs of LUPUS and it members. What really happened behind the scenes to Jackie all those years ago, and can Sooji, now along for the ride, survive his path back to stardom?

(Source: TappyToon)

After tomboy Haedam is thoroughly friend zoned by her first love, she's determined to glow up before college. But when she makes the wrong impression on her first day of school, she realizes she needs the help of her reluctant neighbor. In exchange, she promises to put up with their living circumstances and keep his secret. What could possibly go wrong?

Ha-Joon has been crushing on Eun-Woo ever since they started college together, but he hasn’t had any opportunities to get close with him. At least they have a class together this semester: a lecture taught by the popular Professor Seo Joo-Hyuk. Hours after the first class, Ha-Joon remembers he left his assignments in the classroom. Upon reaching the lecture hall, he becomes witness and accomplice to a series of private lessons Joo-Hyuk is giving Eun-Woo—lessons that unleash his own deepest, riskiest desires.

(Source: Lezhin)

Young, successful, ambitious. The young CEO was born to conquer. After his untimely death, he wakes up in an alternate world as the eldest daughter of Count Hall McGrewd. "I may be in a damsel's body, but you won't find me in any distress!" Follow the newly reborn Farrell Hall McGrewd as she begins to take over in the other world of nobles and magic.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

A job at a mysterious bookstore.

(Source: Manta)

Under normal circumstances, 24-year-old Dam Lee wouldn’t move in with a random guy who she just met, much less a 900-year-old one. But these aren’t normal circumstances: she accidentally swallowed the bead of a gumiho (a nine-tailed fox from Korean mythology) named Wu-Yeo Shin, and if they don’t find a way to extract the bead from her body within a year, she’ll die and he’ll never become human. Can Dam and Wu-Yeo find a way to remove the bead from Dam’s body before it’s too late? And will Dam ever find love, especially when her unusual circumstances restrict her dating options?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 11 extra chapters.

Cannon, the transfer student, causes an uproar in his new school as he claims to get rid of all the bullies in it.

(Source: Toomics)

Nam Ji-il, an ordinary student who entered Daemyung High School, famous for being bad. From the first day of admission, he became the target of ILJIN and became a bread shuttle known to all students.

A weak body with chronic heart disease, assaulted and bullied by ILJIN, and the painful days are repeated.

College life is a minefield! You know those times when you wish the ground would just open up and swallow you whole? Well, Mi-Seol sure does. She screwed up big time by ruining some random (hot) guy’s class schedule for the entire semester. Wracked with guilt, she hopes and prays she’ll never have to face him again… But the cruel hand of fate has other ideas!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

... There is a girl, whose dream was to swim, but couldn't win with just her talent alone even if her life was on the line. There is another girl, who started swimming because her life wasn't fun, but then ended up showing genuine promise, even though swimming was just a joke to her. Like this, the two of them met each other, forming the worst relationship, akin to water and oil, the modern version of Mozart and Salieri, leading to the romance of dreams and youth.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated).

A story that took place during a hiatus since the fall of the Skytrian Empire, before the war of destruction broke out. It was thought that the story had disappeared beneath the records.

The jewel that gives the owner great power... After a war over the jewel, six countries on the continent of Asd decide to sign a peace treaty. Then the six fragments of the jewel got stolen and now the world falls into an even greater chaos...

Prince Caleb of Tanesia, who was the only one who knew the kidnapper's face, was rescued by Serrea and Shan, the Holy Kingdom's investigative team, has all but lost his memories! Sabrina, the Knights Commander of Tanesia, has an offer for those who can recover fragments and stop the war.

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

Remi Do has everything - she's super pretty, has the best brand sponsorships on social media, and gets 10,000 likes within seconds of posting a selfie. Oh, and she also has a serial-killing stalker following her every move.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A love triangle is never straightforward!

As long-time best friends, Jin-Geon has always been there to listen to Hui-Seo ramble about his latest crushes -- and cry about his most recent heartbreaks. So when Hui-Seo asks Jin-Geon to fill in for him at work and make sure no one steals away the adorable coworker he’s been eyeing, Jin-Geon readily agrees. There’s just one problem: that coworker, Dong-Yeon, is totally Jin-Geon's type! And he doesn’t exactly seem to mind Jin-Geon's not-so-platonic advances, either...

When it comes to friendship versus love, which one will Jin-Geon choose?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The main character, Yoon-byul, was born with a physical feature floating in the air of 0kg, so she became a subject of study, and when she was old enough to go to high school after living in captivity at the institute, she transferred to high school in some way. However, the criminal organization is aiming for a chance to kidnap Yoon-byul, which depicts the confrontation between the institute and the criminal organization, and the process of Yoon-byul's adjustment as a normal person.

(Source: Namu Wiki, Translated)

Ever since being transported into the world of a book she read, Leana has had one goal: stay on the emperor's good side and avoid being sent to prison! Sure, she agreed to marry him and become his empress consort for a pampered life of luxury, but she's determined not to make the same mistakes as her antagonistic story character. But for some reason, things in the story keep changing -- new characters, unexpected events... Can Leana get this story back on track, or is she in for a plot-twist?

(Source: Tappytoon)

High school is hard enough without a target on your back, but that’s exactly the situation Kim Yeon-Doo finds herself in when she crosses a group of the most popular kids in school. Marked by the king bee himself, the notorious Ji Hyun-ho, Annie becomes his newest fixation--and he is determined to make her life miserable. Now at his beck and call, Yeon-Doo must stay on Hyun-ho’s good side to maintain her peaceful life and avoid becoming a social pariah. As she navigates her way through alienating social cliques, persistent old crushes, and the hot upstairs neighbor who never puts a shirt on, Yeon-Doo will soon learn that there’s more to being popular than meets the eye. She just wanted to live a normal life, but maybe there’s no escaping these king bees. An official comic adaptation based on the hit dating-sim game.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)
The emotionless agent Alpha was given a secret mission.

Jae-Won is reunited with his old classmate during a taekwondo lesson. But Jeong-Uk is no longer the timid dork from school. Instead, he’s a fully-grown hunk who’s huge in more ways than one!

It’s clear to Jae-Won that there’s animosity between them, but why? And how come he can't recall if they were friends or enemies? It’s all so hazy!

After class, a fall in the shower causes Jae-Won’s lost memories to begin trickling back to him. And the question, “Did I do something wrong?” sets the two old classmates off on a steamy journey to recover Jae-Won's forgotten past…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Hana is usually a glass-half-full sort of person, but lately, nothing seems to be going her way. After yet another fruitless day of job hunting, she finds herself pouring out all her frustrations to a stranger in the street. The kind stranger disappears before they get a chance to exchange names or numbers, however, leaving behind a phone with nothing but a single messenger app. “Can you read this message…?” As soon as Hana logs on, username “Unknown” tells her they know the person she is looking for. Although a little suspicious, she is intrigued. Who was the stranger that lent her a shoulder to cry on? Who is this “Unknown” she is chatting with? To find the answers to her questions, she must first accept a mysterious invitation.

(Source: Tappytoon)

One woman is on a mission to experience another night of ecstasy with a man whose name she never caught, but whose touch she can’t forget.

Seven years ago, Eun-Seong was plucked from disaster by an enigmatic savior. What she remembers most isn’t the heroic rescue, but what happened next. After winding up in bed with her hero, she didn’t catch his name, but she did get the most amazing night of pleasure in her life! Since then, she’s searched for the perfect climax with countless others, yet it always remains tantalizingly out of reach. Undeterred, Eun-Seong continues her hot pursuit of the elusive “Big O” and the mysterious man who holds the key to her ultimate satisfaction.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)
What will happen when the luckiest and unluckiest boy alive meet and try switching their lucks?! (Source: Toomics)

After her house falls to ruin, Abigail Dilloa is relegated to serving an imprisoned princess for the rest of her life. Just as she finally comes to terms with her fate, assassins murder the sweet princess in cold blood. Faced with the same grisly fate, Abigail's past regrets flash before her eyes, but she is saved at the last minute by Duke Lakiel de Edelgard. However, the cunning duke is hell-bent on revenge, and he gives her an ultimatum: die, or play the part of Princess Violeta in his sinister succession scheme. Now that she has become a puppet in this play, will Abigail manage to fool the world and steal the throne? Or, will the cruel politics of the palace expose her act as nothing but a sham? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

The beautiful daughter of the Farnese family is caught up in a whirlwind romance with a notorious royal playboy -- it’s the scandal of the century! When the title of “Elvynee Deer” is awarded to the pure and lovely Ingrid Farnese, all of high society expects her to marry into foreign royalty. Cursed in love with a history of broken engagements, Ingrid is determined to stay put at home in Valentine Kingdom. To take control of her own future she'll make the king's illegitimate son, libertine and womanizer Regan Espencer, propose to her. But the problem is, Regan is the only man in the country who doesn’t want her hand in marriage! Will Ingrid survive being tossed into the throes of debauchery and reach her happy ending?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Lee Yool Gatji Aneun Lee Yoo

description:
Lee Yoori, an employee of the EG Department Store HR team, and Lee Yool, the youngest daughter of the EG Group President, fell from the 10th floor building. Lee Yoori, surprised, woke up in Lee Yool body. But Lee Yoori believes that one day their bodies will return to normal. Lee Yoori will live her life as a daughter of a conglomerate. But the thing is, Lee Yool has a fiance and they're going to be married soon! Will Lee Yoori successfully overcome all obstacles as a daughter of a millionaire?!

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Things seem to be going well between Yoomin and his longtime crush, Seula, the hottest girl in school. But she’s only playing nice and actually has a twisted agenda in mind. As if that’s not complicated enough, a blast from Yoomin’s past is trying to get in his pants by using any means necessary (including jumping out of a motel window to chase him down the street). Don’t let pretty looks fool you—these ladies are sweet but psycho.

(Source: Lezhin US)

James Jung is the top student at Ozoh Academy, home of the gifted and mega rich. He is also an undercover agent protecting the principal from a dangerous assassin. His name? Samuel Gyo, codename black mamba and now James’ homeroom teacher. In order to fight, they must abide by three rules. First, they cannot have their identities exposed to the other students. Second, they cannot harm the students. Third and most importantly, no explosives or firearms. Poison and tranquilizers are fine. Fighting to the death, no one ever briefed them for the fourth and final rule: you must not fall in love. Will they break it?

As a closeted gay man, Gyulwoo is 28 and single. He has a decent job but he’s lacking in the love department, too terrified to come out and ruin his career or reputation. Ready to live the rest of his life hiding his feelings, Gyulwoo is shocked when Hojun, his old friend from high school, appears. In the past, Hojun had revealed he loved Gyulwoo but Gyulwoo wasn’t ready to accept his love. Decades later, will Gyulwoo keep their romance secret or will he finally share his heart with Hojun and the world?

We're cooking up a scandal!

Washed-up singer Rosa is at the end of her rope. She's jobless, her agency's just about given up on her, and her boyfriend is a deadbeat. But what happens when she's suddenly invited on to the reality show Celeb Kitchen Battle? And how will she react to meeting her one true love?

(Source: Manta)

With the appearance of the mysterious Sky Castle, people all over the world have awakened with supernatural powers and the ability to fly! Well… everyone but Jung Si-Woo that is… At least that was his fate until he saved Su Ah-rin, an awakened player who is now bound to Si-Woo as his personal healer! With Ah-rin by his side, Si-woo just may break into the player’s life after all!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

What's Remy gonna do, now that the two most popular girls at school are obsessing over him?!

(Source: Toomics)

Choa is a mermaid who can't swim! Discouraged, she trades the ocean for a pair of human legs. But when the star of the high school swim team finds out her secret, he offers her the chance to prove her family wrong: free swimming lessons for a mermaid!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The sun or the moon. Who do I choose?

Ever since they were little, Se-Un believed that he and his best friend Do-Bin only had each other. But when a rift between them makes room for the newcomer, Dae-Beom, Se-Un’s torn on who to choose: the beautiful but cold Do-Bin, or the warm and inviting Dae-Beom?

(Source: Manta)

A brilliant and never childish childhood drama about children's peaceful friendship.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

Yu-il’s ordinary life has been interrupted by top actor, Mu-i. Yu-il is looking for a corporate job while ignoring her true passion, writing. Meanwhile, Mu-i is dealing with the repercussions of having a stalker fan. As they navigate their hardships and find out how they complement each other, will these two be able to find their perfect romance?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Xi Wu is a rebellious mermaid who opposes her fate of marrying a human she never met before. She decides to visit the human world to nullify her engagement, but accidentally released magical creatures because of that! In order to reverse what she has done, Xi Wu must work closely with her human fiancé, Xing Chen.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Jiu Qiansui, the heir to the grandest sect in the Realm of Eternity, is murdered by his family's enemy after he was born. Although he is dead, his immortal body stays intact. So Jiu Qiansui goes to hell and is reincarnated as a mortal. But he is doomed to meet a disaster and he won't live to be 19. When he turns 17, he steps into the Realm of Prisoners in hope of surviving the disaster and becoming an immortal after causing a stir in the four realms.

(Source: Wecomics)

Erlang Shen! Why did I wake up with the Red Cord fastened to your hand and mine?! Did Yue Lao fail in his job?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Bao Xi Nanyou de Qian Ceng Taolu

description:
- The betrayal is intolerable, while the tricks are irresistible? Let's see how the leading female character says goodbye to the playboy, teaches the angelic bitch a lesson and harvests a double blessing!
- A love trap made up of arrogance and sincerity, would you like to fall into?

On the wedding day, Xiaoka Luo discovered the clandestine love affair between her bridegroom and her best friend by chance. Faced with double betrayal, she chose to divorce the two-timer and focus on her career. The destiny, however, drives her to the love trap set by Nan Xiao, how should Xiaoka Luo deal with the multiple tricks under his arrogant appearance?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Dang Ying Hou Buru Nian Qinghua
title.english: 17 Again: Smart is the New Sexy

description:
Dongfang Feifei, the best actress of the Golden Tiger Award, is well-known for her beauty and love experience with playboys. But she goes back to her 17 after her rebirth. And she has to get into the Ivy league to avoid being killed. But in face of this situation, Dongfang Feifei shouts:" Gosh!" I'm not well-educated. How can I possibly make it?"

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Jiuweihu Xiao Ba Ding Shang Wo Zhihou
title.native: 九尾狐校霸盯上我之后

description:
Natural fishing human cub vs arrogant and innocent nine-tailed fox! When humans study in a school full of monsters, it is like a sheep falling into a wolf's den, weak and pitiful and helpless? No, no, furry control Wei Zhi said that you can't be too happy to be able to brush fur every day~ It's just that, when you are brushing and brushing, you accidentally hook up the Nine-Tailed Fox School Bully back home? ! Duan Jingtang Fried Hair: Let go of my tail! Wei Zhi said coquettishly: Let me rua again!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ge qiang You Nan Shen: Qiangxing Xiang'ai 100 Tian
title.native: 隔墙有男神：强行相爱100天

description: She has loved him for 8 years. By virtue of identity substitution, she finally gets close to the man she’s loved for 8 years. But old times, old things and former famous people cannot be recalled. Will the love fade out or turn warm again? Gu Yusheng, do you know I’m Qin Zhiai? I will love you for the rest of my life.

Poor Qiming Zhang is wasting away as a D-list celebrity and agonizing over the meteoric rise of his archrival, Yang Chu, a frosty and successful A-list star and singer. They found fame—and a mutual disdain—on the same singing competition show. But when they’re cast together in a TV drama, Qiming’s secret is discovered... he’s got an imperial courtier alter-ego who is bound to fulfill the wishes of his “emperor”... who happens to be Yang Chu. Who will win in this love-hate battle of identities?!

(Source: Tapas)

An intriguing story full of supernatural occurrences. The main protagonist, a doctor who had died and somehow reborn into the bookstore owner's body. He is now caught as an envoy between two worlds: the dead and the living.

(Source: INKR, edited)

It's a journey filled with love and dreams. When girl next door Jiu Yue is revealed to be a notorious thief, a series of mysterious events surrounding the ancient Silan Kingdom start to occur. Love and friendship, justice and evil, power and forgiveness. How should our heroine choose her journey?

Includes 18 extras chapters

A young girl with the face of an angel but the spirit of a demon finds herself transported to a world of beasts, where she becomes a goddess desired by all. Every beastman dreams of being with her, but she has her own plans to tame them.

(Source: Webnovel)

Ordinary university student Lin Xian and the campus prince Yan Yusen shouldn't have anything to do with each other, yet unbeknownst to them, they had a coincidental meeting. An unexpected encounter let Lin Xian saw the other face of Prince Charming. Just which side is his true self? Lin Xian's quiet campus life is about to get turned upside down...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In the modern world, cultivation has evolved. Cultivators are using AI Matchmaker to find Cultivation Partners.

(Source: Webnovels)

title.romaji: Ta Liao Ren You Tou Xin

description:
An accident at the ski resort ruined her dream of becoming a ballet star. She fell into a coma, didn't have the courage to wake up because the world was too cruel for her. But still there is hope. The ones who truly love her brought her a new life. Again she stands and ready to pursue her dreams. This time, how will she tackle the difficulties of life? Will she meet her Prince Charming one day and lives happily like Cinderella in the fairy tale...

(Source: MangaToon)

If the twelve Chinese Zodiacs were being chosen today, who would be first, and who would be at the bottom? If other animals like cats, wolves, lions, and elephants joined in, which twelve animals would win out? This is a game, about choosing a new order for the twelve Chinese Zodiac! Gods, animals, and humans will work together to try to defeat their opponents and earn a place in the zodiac!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
Do you want to change, whether in the past or in the future?" He said. All coincidences are inevitable in fate. O book of prophecy that knows everything, can you break out of all cycles.

title.romaji: Quanmin Zhuanzhi: Kaiju Zhaohuan Siwang Nüshen
title.native: 全民转职：开局召唤死亡女神

description:
Yang Chen, a worthless outcast cast out by his own family, unexpectedly awakens an SSS-Class profession: Dark Summoner, with a hidden passive — Summoning costs reduced by 100x!

With ease, he calls forth powerful dark creatures. Right from the start, he summons the Goddess of Death, who annihilates his enemies with just a glance.

Rising from the very bottom, he turns his fate around — clashing head-on with his clan, the holy temple, brutal bosses, and even heavenly angels from the upper realm.

No one who dares cross him survives.

He smashes through every reckless enemy standing in his way!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Paohui Hou Wi Zhi Xiang Lihun
title.native: 穿成炮灰后我只想离婚

description:
To protect the one he loves, Lin Xiuyuan played a kind trick and successfully made the boy live together with him. The life after living together is, however, completely different from what he expected! Will he change his mind, or be in love with everything about his beloved?!

(Source: Webcomics)

The story begins with a middle-aged mother committing suicide due to problems with her adult son. Following her miraculous revival and return as a 20-year-old, she comes to know that her son does not, in fact, hate her like she'd assumed he did. However, in exchange for her second chance at life she's forced into playing deadly mind games with others in the same situation as herself.

title.romaji: Chu Yisheng Ye Yao Tan Lianai

description:
For ten years, Beatriz has been in bitter love with Travis. She has been trapped in the taste of his gentleness. But every answer to the implicit confession of her love is the coolest rejection. Finally, when she makes up her mind to let it go, Travis suddenly finds his life is so pale and boring without her and she has taken up the most important part of his life. Screwing up courage, Travis decides to make the final response: he wants to love and take great care of her.

(Source: Webcomics)

I've always had a crush on my childhood friend, but he only regards me as a brother?

I hate liking you, I hate that I can't stop myself from loving you, but I can't stop these feelings from growing.

False friend games, secret bittersweet love, youthful sweetness and pain.

I've always wanted to say this out loud to you: "Hey! I like you!"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

Lost souls seeking their true selves.
Wen Xiaoliu is a local physician. When he stumbles upon a man on the verge of death, he treats him and gradually nurses him back to health. The grateful patient swears allegiance to Xiaoliu and accepts his new identity as Ye Shiqi, Xiaoliu's servant. Slowly, their true identities are revealed...

(Source: Manta)

On Earth, spirits roam. As thousands of years pass, many curious and peculiar species are birthed. Some spirits satisfy their own desires by devouring weak human begins. With this, a group of humans possessing special powers came into being: exorcists, wizards... Within them, include those miraculous beings who defy natural laws. With one pen, they are able to redraw one's features... We call them: Skin Painters. The manhua tells the story of the master (The Skin Painter) and his disciple as they travel the world.

Spirits of those who've died a tragic death are unable to be led to the afterlife by the Black and White death gods. They wander aimlessly in the world of the living, unable to reincarnate. Two death gods go in search of the missing half, but will the person they find still be the person they were once familiar with?

title.romaji: Yin Hun Shenmi Yingdi: Jiao Qi, Lai PK!
title.english: Mysterious Star: Battle with My Sweet Wife

description:
Her childhood sweetheart suddenly comes to her with an offer: to be the surrogate mother of his child? Is he trying to help her or humiliate her? Even though her longtime unrequited love is coming to fruition, this relationship promises to be trouble. And that's how a rookie entertainment reporter secretly wed the superstar actor Shen Lianchuan. A former heiress fallen on hard times, her life is about to be caught up in a raging whirlwind. Now she must find a way to turn her life around.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Because of her father’s serious illness, Ye Youyou came back home in a hurry, but unexpectedly she fell into a sham… Her mother and elder brother sold her to a man who had a record of domestic violence for money. In order not to marry that old man to pay debts for her mother, she lied that she had married a rich man. When the lie was about to be revealed, a president who she'd never seen before appeared?!

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Dao Mo: Lian Qi Lianle Sanqian Nian Waizhuan
title.native: 道魔—炼气练了三千年外传

description:
A thousand years ago, the world was in confusion and kingdoms at war. An apprentice at the Immortal Jade Pavilion died mysteriously, drained of all of his life essence. Immortal Jade accused the demonic Hehuan Sect of the crime. When Bai Qiu learned of the incident, he went undercover into Hehuan Sect looking to uncover the truth, where he met Su Xiangxue, a Hehuan apprentice. The same strange power put Su Xiangxue on the verge of death. Whoever was behind this must be trying to control both the Taoist and Demonic sects! How will Bai Qiu solve the mystery and save his future wife?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Chocolate Yu Quan shi Jinzhi Shixiang
title.native: 巧克力于犬是禁止事项

description:
An unknown streamer Long Jieran fed a stranger on his way home from the supermarket, then he found the stranger got symptoms of food poisoning! Long Jieran, who had originally wanted to leave returned at the end because of the stings of conscience. And he helped the self-proclaimed homeless canine orc Xibo.

"If we can share the rent, everything will be good".

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

Duan Xingzhu, a promising young actor, contradicted Lin Si, a has-been who got involved in a contract problem. Their fans were fighting like cats and dogs on social media, while they announced that they were going to act in the same TV series. They two seem to have "discord". What will happen as they stay in the same shooting place? Does Duan Xingzhu really hate Lin Si? Or does he not show his true intention under the pretense of being inarticulate?

(Source: Webnovel)

A love story that takes place in a small town where humans and demons peacefully coexist...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After he failed to confess to his best friend, the male protagonist got first-love PTSD. In order to be able to successfully fall in love in the future, he has to find the original object of his affection and work out his issues. But it turns out that that friend who suddenly disappeared eight years ago is actually a god suffering from depression...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 extra chapter.

In a world famous restaurant, many delicacies are provided, and it’s also a heaven for all the women, both young and old. The employees here, from waiters to chefs are all top elites, with great figure and appearance. Taking the delicacies as a medium, the talented young chef Lu He, with the purpose of entertaining all the female guests, leads his partners to start their legendary lives in this restaurant.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Bu Si Liang Zhi Jun Chen You Bie

description:
Xiang Xi, the boss of the most famous Meile House, held a music festival, attracting lots of people. But inside the house was a dark tide. The true identity of the stunning Xiang Xi and the pitiful musician Zi Jun was mind-blowing. A battle of the dark is about to begin...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Wu Xunmei and Xuan Jihua were the leaders of two enemy clans. They were brought together by fate and became lovers. However, caught up by the hatred between their clans, Wu Xunmei was forced to kill Xuan Jihua. Unexpectedly, Xuan Jihua was reborn. In this lifetime, can their love bloom again?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The handsome president meets the lonely TV host (Sly Old Fox x Little Horse) Xing Ming was an outstanding med student who changed careers and entered the media industry, earning the title "Ice Prince". For the sake of clearing his father's name, he sacrificed his own body to climb the social ladder. When he opened that room door, however, what awaited him was…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

When there is a software that can produce innumerable money every day, what will you do? How will Song Ping reach the peak of his life through a money system! Beauties? Luxury cars? He deserves to own everything, is there anything he can't buy? No!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Jiangjun Zong Ba Ziji Dang Tishen

description:
Mu Zhiming fell in love with a scumbag in a previous life, and was tortured to death on the road to exile. After being reborn, he swore to never let history repeat itself. But as he was devising plans, he discovered that the cold general Gu Heyan was actually warm-hearted and sincere. Mu Zhiming fell into a once-in-a-lifetime love.

But on the wedding night, Gu Heyan said to him: I know that I’m just a substitute. Mu Zhi Ming pushed him onto the bed without a word.

Gu Heyan: What are you doing?
Mu Zhiming: We’re! Sleeping! Together!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The city’s most popular brothel ———Zui Xian Brothel, a place where all types of monsters and demons gather and where mortals get allured. The talented and calm beauty, Liu Siqing, was beaten by the coquettish newcomer, Ling Huyan, for the number one spot?

The fox demon and the green snake are fighting for the number one spot. Who will win in this battle, the calm and alluring green snake or the flirty and charming red fox? Who has the upperhand? And who is getting more and more into the battle?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Water God Ming Yao sacrifices his life for the lives of the three realms, yet becomes the servant of Jun Sheng, the Demon Lord after five hundred years. Does he live the rest of his life as a mere servant, or pretend to be meek and get his way up, using his strengths to return to the heavenly realm? His relationship with the Demon Lord in the past life never really ended, how does he cut off those shackles? What will be Ming Yao's future?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An ordinary surgeon accidentally gained a powerful System. Now he will shock the medical world with his miraculous hands, saving countless lives.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Due to urbanization and warfare, the places where humans once lived had turned into deserts. When Martin–a young researcher–and his team were exploring the desert, they were ambushed by a huge monster and he was separated from his team. Fortunately, he was rescued by a mysterious centaur, who then protected him as he found his way back. Eventually, Martin discovered the secret of centaurs and world transmutation. None of them seems coincidental…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The hot-tempered Wen Ruyi wanted to get rid of his old love and forget his past. But his seven-year crush had never planned to let him go.

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

The ruthless prime minister's icy heart was melted by the naive and sincere prince! He believed himself powerful enough to keep the prince in his hands forever, however... The brokenhearted prince left him so easily! “Where are you?! Without you, I can never be happy in this lifetime. Your Highness, where must I go to find you?!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Kaiju Yong You Qi Wei Juese Shijie
title.english: The Seven Beauties Are My Martial Sisters
title.native: 开局拥有七位绝色师姐

description:
When Ye Chen transmigrated to the world of the Tianxuan Continent, he was reborn as the son of the Master Of The Peak in the Sacred Realm. Also in the sect are seven elder disciples, each a beautiful woman who is an expert in her field. Blessed with the super-power of a Sign-In System to boost his cultivation, Ye Chen quickly grows to become the strongest cultivator of the Sacred Realm, and drawing the attention of several sisters. After defending the Sacred Realm against hostile forces who threatened their sect, Ye Chen left the sect to help the sisters on the outside, on his way to become the strongest master in the world.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A pair of lovers who committed suicide fell into the sea. Under the sea was the place where the soul of the 虣 Zhanhong was sealed. Faced with the body that he had obtained without any effort, he decisively took the body of the one closest to him and saved the other one. So after Qingxi was rescued, he found that

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ni Men Xiu Xian Wo Chou Ka
title.english: You Immortal Cultivate, I Draw Cards

description:
Transported to a world where strength reigns supreme, I find myself labeled as talentless. What’s a guy to do? Luckily, I have a card-drawing system that lets me rewrite my destiny! From mecha warrior goddesses to spirited knight maidens, I can summon them all to join the fight!

(Source: Webcomics)

Once the First War God of the Netherworld, he reincarnated as an ordinary High School Student. But as the gears of Fate turn, when the Heavenly Dao collapses and evil descends upon the world, he must wear his armor once more. Under the guidance of the aloof Goddess Black Impermanence, he will fight the Five Directional Ghost Emperors and battle the Ten Yama Kings. The King Returns to conquer the Three Realms, dominate The World, reshape the Cycle of Reincarnation—Only I Am Supreme!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Dao You Rang: An Lai Dushi Zhan Guishen
title.native: 道友让让：俺来都市斩鬼神

description:
After twenty years of secluded cultivation deep in the mountains, Liu Yu, a master of unrivaled Daoist arts, is finally ordered to descend into the mortal world. He never expected that the moment he set foot in the city, he’d stumble upon a haunted mansion and a wealthy heiress plagued by malevolent energy. Soon, both the criminal underworld and the righteous path are fighting to call him “big brother,” while powerful tycoons compete to gift him luxury cars and mansions, begging him to change their fates with his mystical formations. Even the most elite and untouchable families are forced to respectfully address him as “Heavenly Master.” With Daoist magic protecting him, Liu Yu banishes evil and slays demons, shaking the underworld and the heavens alike. Watch how he suppresses all manner of monsters and spirits in the city—and dominates the world of yin and yang!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Jiao Youmen Chuang Fei Mori

description:
No backstabbing by an ex-girlfriend, no betrayal by teammates, no dying in the mouth of a monster to restart another life. Right from the start, you already have traps activated.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

The role of hunter and prey now have changed, and Eli became the plaything of the other party! This pervert not only tied up and teased him, but also seemed to know a terrible secret about himself. Is there an ulterior motive or a hidden secret? As they fall in love and kill each other, a greater truth emerges... "Defile you, or save me."

Harboring deep hatred for his master, Gu Lingxiao, a rebellious immortal disciple, brutally slaughtered all his fellow disciples and imprisoned his once-beloved master, Chi Ning. Angered by Lingxiao’s ruthless killings and his choice to seek power through demonic cultivation, the Way of Heaven descended three Thunder Tribulations upon him—an event guaranteed to take one’s life. Yet, on the brink of Lingxiao’s death, Chi Ning stood before him, willing to sacrifice his own soul to save this demon.

(Source: WebComics)

Driven by poverty, Xu En’en and Lin Jingzhou were forced to participate in a variety show titled “Who Is The Real Billionaire?” Their mission was to pretend to be a wealthy couple on the show in order to win a million in cash. From then on, the two embarked on a game of celebrity masquerade!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Chongsheng Zhi Jiang Men Du Hou

description:
Betrayed by her emperor husband, her children slaughtered, and her noble family destroyed, Shen Miao dies with hatred in her heart, only to wake up as her 14-year-old self. This time, she'll rewrite her fate. Protect her family. Crush her enemies. And carve out her place in the empire. But she never expected him, the unruly young marquis who laughs at power and claims her with a smirk, "Take the world if you want… but you’re mine."

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Nitu Meitian Du Xiang Qi Shi Fanshang
title.english: The Disciple’s Daily Plan: Seduce the Master
title.native: 逆徒每天都想欺师犯上

description:
Shen Changjun is determined to change the tragic fate of the villainous disciple in the original story by crafting a perfect, radiant image of his virtuous master. Little does he know, after nine thousand nights, the disciple is reborn—and now vows to never let Shen Changjun escape his grasp.

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
A man and his companion roam around completing small tasks for coin. This time, they have a request from the lord of Wei Manor.

The high school student Cheng Bo, a male chauvinist with positive essential views, had been accidently involved in a secret shooting. When he planned to get back the video, he understood what the meaning of “hero” was in shame, and gradually went inside…And this is the reason why you need to wear it before you go to the street?!

(Source: Webnovel)

After losing his lover, Xingchen, to a terminal illness, Feiran lives a long and lonely life guarding only his memories. Suddenly, he wakes up back in his university days and realizes he has been given a second chance. He finds Xingchen on campus, seven years before they were originally supposed to meet. Armed with painful knowledge of the future, Feiran is determined to rewrite their tragic end. This time, he will protect Xingchen and cherish every extra second, turning their fleeting tragedy into a lifelong love.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Xiang Qi, who was previously a problematic student in Yu Cai High School, surprisingly transmigrated into a cultivation world called "Hong Meng" when he was attending a Year 3 Class 2 classmate's meeting. He thought he was the male protagonist, yet his life sucked. To survive, he had no choice but to take the path of cultivation, and then noticed a weird sect called "Yu Cai Immortal Sect". Someone called Xi Hongjun, who has the same name as his enemy, and is also the smartest student in high school, became his master. Not only are their names are the same, but they also look very alike and have the same b*tchy personality! And that Sect Leader who looks just like his monitor... Everything just seems more and more strange!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In a universe ruled by martial power, the son of the God-king clearly has powerful strength. But instead his family tested him by sending him to Earth to make a billion dollars by legal means. He thought it would be easy, but he ran into all sorts of trouble, and he ended up working as a minor security guard... He realized that money is everything, and a man without money is nothing. Now he'll do whatever it takes to make his fortune in this human world!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

A collection of oneshots.

1st Story: Mountain Love - A story of a girl, who is under stress to get into a medical school and one day, falls in love with her doctor.
2nd Story: A Mermaid is Singing - A story of a boy, who tries to commit suicide (because of certain medical reasons) and a girl who tries to stop him.
3rd Story: Autumn Night's Dream - A story of an architect and a girl who helps him to realise his real dream.
4th Story: ECHO - A story about a girl who knows the people who killed their class president but is unable to express her own thoughts.
5th Story: The Sleeping Time Paradox

(Source: Chinatown KM)
This is a short poetic 6 page full color manhua about a pair of sewn souls.

Tian Yizhe, who accidentally travelled into the game world, picked up Chen Qianhao, who was cursed with being small and having lost his memories, and named him Zai Zai, and the two of them began to live together. Unexpectedly, Zai Zai is not an ordinary orc child, and Tian Yizhe is determined to help Zai Zai to find out the truth...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In the year 2049, the Earth has settled into a period of relative peace, thanks in large part to the global efforts of GUTS--the Global Unlimited Task Squad--an international alliance dedicated to protecting mankind from threats within the planet and beyond. But when a mysterious meteor carrying an ominous message crashes next to GUTS headquarters, it heralds the end of peacetime and the return of the giant monsters that terrorized humanity many millions of years ago. Mankind's only hope is to find the lost land of Tiga and reawaken the 160-foot-tall warrior Ultraman!

Under the bright lights of showbiz, all sorts of rumors and drama spill onto the scene every day. Behind the battle for public opinion, slick players know how to manipulate people and turn the situation to their favor. They are the "crisis PR" agents! Zuo Bing is one of the best PR agents out there. No matter the situation, she can always catch the lying "wolf" and turn things around. But despite all her experience, for this one PR battle, she will meet an opponent who will knock the queen off her throne…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The honor student Yang Jiu always wished that he could be an anti-hero, and then he found himself transmigrated to another world after an accident. He was immediately betrayed and thrown into the treacherous wuxia world. But as he witnessed incredible feats of kung-fu and saw wuxia masters kneeling before the golden throne, even as the kingdom faced foreign invaders, he realized that "Bureaucrats and soldiers are worthless. Only an underworld kingpin can save the day." And that was when the young man embarked on his journey of conquest.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yuan Lai Fangdong Chao Shuai De!

description: A dejected newbie writer not only gets to live in a luxury apartment for free but more importantly, his landlord is drop dead gorgeous! But why does he like to inappropriately touch people? Could he possibly be...?
If you plant your yard full of red spider lilies, you can deceive spirits into believing it to be one of the many roads to the afterlife, and perhaps, meet those deceased dear to you...

Yu Zhu, a mermaid, is forced to stay in the human world because she lost her mermaid pearl. Unexpectedly, she discovers that the popular idol Mu Yuming is also a mermaid! When they meet, Yuming enthusiastically tries to "force" Yu Zhu to stay by her side! Could it be that the popular trope of the pop idol falling for her fan is going to come true?

(Source: Billibilli, translated)

The runaway teenager was kidnapped by a mysterious man late at night. When he woke up, he was facing the challenge of life and death in an unfamiliar laboratory...

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

The extremely arrogant high-class An Minyi and the oppressive school tyrant, Guan Xu, both of who had nothing to do with each other, started a fight because of an exam. The battle between an arrogant sheep and a violent tiger begins at once! But as they grow to learn more about each other, the atmosphere between the two started to change...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Bloody Mary, ghost building, wolf shadow, death soul, and the marriage crossing death and life... A steady stream of bizarre cases follow. Behind these absurd rumors, there often hides an incredible truth. In order to pursue the truth, our MC and his partners take risks to investigate and find out the roots hidden in their heart.

(Source: WebComics)

Confessing to your crush is supposed to be palpitating and beautiful, but what if it becomes a curse? You will disappear from this planet if you confess 100 times to the one you love, and they didn't say yes. When he first met her, he fell in love, with his true love of all time. In this life, he's revealed his feelings to her 99 times. Will he win her heart in the last chance he has?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Zen Yang Cai Neng Zhui Dao Ni

description:
I grew up with a crazy crush on the boy next door, but he moved away and I never heard from him again. Unexpectedly, one day we met again at the university, and he became my teacher? How should I catch up to that boy in my heart?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After the 16th play-through, Qianqiu finally realized that the world she was living in was just a game. However, she was not the heroine, but just the female support character, destined to always be the loser. Tired of being stuck in an endless loop, she decided to break free from the game's plot. However, in the process of doing so, the protagonist also started to act strangely?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: An entry in the 2021 Kuaikan Tiaoman Contest

title.romaji: Xingguang Cuican: Jian Ge Boss Zuo Laogong
title.english: Bright Stars: Pick a Boss to Be a Husband

description:
I was killed by my own fiancé and sister in my previous life. Now, I’m making a strong comeback in this one. Not only do I want revenge, I also want to cause havoc in the entertainment industry. I want to become an A-list producer. Who cares about that scumbag? I want to have all the pretty boys and handsome men. Some CEO got closer and asked, “Huh? I’m not enough for you?” People think she’s cold and heartless, no one understands her and loves her. But when she saves someone in the heavy rain, her heart starts to melt for him.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Wo Zhi Xihuan Ni De Ren She

description:
On the surface, this couple seemed like the entertainment industry's unrivaled: superstar and his innocent, angel-like fan. No one knew that beneath that angelic facade was a chaotic and cool personality and the matchless superstar was actually a naive tsundere!

"At first, I thought I was going to XXX my idol, but in the end it became my idol XXX me. Help! I only love your public persona, so please don't change."

(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Yu Huan, the greatest swordsman of his generation, was killed in an ambush, but he was reborn as a sword spirit. In order to prevent others from capturing his spiritual form, Yu Huan prepared to use his cultivation experience to forge himself into an ultimate weapon. But it turned out that the forging process required mutual cultivation with many different women???

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The overworked programmer Qin Jian suddenly died after working non-stop for several days. His soul transmigrated into the body of a provincial official in the Tianyuan Dynasty. He thought he find himself a pretty wife and enjoy life in the official mansion. But it turned out he was given the Heaven's Eye ability, which allowed him to see demons and other spirits. In fact, he's been sleeping with a major demon the whole time, which made everyone think he's a dangerous demon, too. Now he has to live with all sorts of demons, as he starts on a fantastic journey of demonic cultivation.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Scan the QR code and pay, then you will become the one who's favored by the angel.

(Source: Webnovel)

One day, the golden bachelorette met the steadfast single man. The God Emperor himself, still single after eons, finally came out from behind closed doors after completing his course of cultivation. He was immediately pounced upon by Ling Zhixi, the Security Chief of the Heavens.

“Hey, you beautiful man…”
"Shoo, go away."
“Ooh, he's feisty. Pretty boy, now you’ve successfully caught my attention,” Ling Zhixi thought.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

“I’m a worshipper of this city’s god!”
This story is about an unlucky and atypical youth who agitates a peaceful city by worshipping his divinity.
“Be it a ghost or demon, no one can stop me from adoring the Xuming god! Not even Xuming himself!”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yu Mingxing Nanyou De Tongju Shenghuo
title.native: 与明星男友同居的生活

description:
A boy group suddenly burst into fame and became the hottest group throughout the country! An ordinary girl who works in a convenience store, encounters the idol, Pearson and attracts him with her gentle and kindness. The co-living life begins with sweet and many accidents! Could the prince and Ciderella get together forever?

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: The Return of the Celestial Emperor

description:
Being reborn to be a little cowboy, the celestial emperor swears to make the enemies in his previous life suffer and pay the price. Unexpectedly, the body of this cowboy is completely weak?! Then he can only adopt another method, namely, rebuild his primordial spirit. Step by Step, with his most valuable treasure and memories, he rises abruptly and let everyone on the celestial world knows that the celestial emperor makes his comeback!

(Source: WebComics)

It took her three months to get used to her new identity—Xi's aunt. Every time she watches Xi dates with his new girlfriend, she always feels heartbroken. How could he forget everything? "I was not and am not and will never be your aunt, I am your..." Her mouth is sealed by a kiss before she could finish herwords. "I don't care who you are, I just know that I want to kiss you."
(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Shier Shaonü Xing: Chuan Xi Rumeng

description:
Legend has it that there are twelve zodiac cat guardians who guard twelve girls. Only they help their masters realize their dream to become real gods of the constellation. One day, the cat guardian of Pisces came to the human world and came across its master, a girl named Yuxi Lin who dreamed to be an excellent designer. Can it help her realize dream smoothly and successfully?

(Source: Manga Toon)

Ruby secretly starts to explore the forbidden cave near the school. It's here he meets Kyung, who is suffering from a fever... Wait, there's two of him?

(Source: Lalatoon)
A novice Shade Hunter forms an unlikely friendship with a teen zombie as they journey together, taking on the powerful Shades, dark creatures of the night determined to enslave humanity.

title.romaji: Pang Hui Da Tang Dang Nüshen
title.english: Back to the Tang Dynasty: The Chubby Beauty

description:
In an age where everyone pursues extremely skinny figures for the sake of beauty, Lu Xiaorun—who is slightly chubby—has to face many difficulties. But one day, by chance, she travels back in time to the Tang dynasty. What kind of encounters will she have in a world where plump is beautiful? Will an otaku fujoshi like her be considered a weirdo in the ancient times she finds herself in? The thrilling and hilarious story of a chubby girl’s transformation... starts now!

(Source: Webnovel)

When I asked my master why he wants me to study medicine, he said "Because you can't find a wife normally these days, if you have these skills, you can get touch girls."

You mean a pervert, right? But I too am a pervert, as I usually peek at my Senior sister while she takes bath. But I am also a Gentlemen who treats girls with care, that's why they call me A Gentleman Pervert. In this way, I've learned superb medical skills and came to the city to find a wife... or possibly a harem?

Game rookie, Mo Xiaoxi, inexplicable time-traveled into a game which she always plays.
Moreover, she is forced by the system to become the empress...

(Source: WebComics)

Claiming to be the gaming industry’s streamer “Rising Star” Xia Ri. Due to the decline in popularity, he played a popular Otome game recommended by his younger sister, but unexpectedly went into the game dimension. In order to return to the real world, he had to pass through all the obstacles.

Xia Xiai, a new rookie singer, hates Jiang Liushen from the bottom of his heart. This prince of the entertainment industry is really a rascal! The first time I met him, he groped my butt, and, the second time we’ve met, he kissed my... This type of scoundrel... I never want to deal with him in this lifetime! Eh? Why did it turn into me having to deal with this guy for a lifetime?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

"You have to get stronger! You're still so weak!"

That's what the Deaf Grandma has been telling Li Qingniu ever since he could remember. In the village, he can't outrun the Gimpy Grandpa, can't distill medicine as well as the Quack, and can't even beat the Black Bull at the village entrance. Only until he left the village did he find out that nobody on the outside is as strong as him... He will journey to find a real hero, he will find a way to become strong enough to satisfy the Deaf Grandma!

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

My name is Bian Lianlian, a fourth-year college student. I'm just an timid, ordinary, and unfashionable girl. But even so, I still aspire to become a fashion editor because that's the only way I can get close to what I love. I lack self-confidence and I get stage fright. However fate can be strange. I somehow got signed to become a model?! Just when I was at a loss about my future, all these crazy things suddenly happened. What a beautiful world.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

My name is Chen Chengyi. Fated to be a haunted virgin. Ever since I was little, I've been surrounded by spirits, ghosts, youkai, and demons. My master told me that I was destined to be a Taoist...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The 25 years old Tong Hua is once again harrassed by her parents to go to a marriage interview, and this time the guy supposedly is a noble? Little does she know, this man dressed in rags during their first meeting is not who he seems to be at all...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Because of a love affair turned sour and his turning to wine to relieve his sorrow, Chengze never thought that he would put a diamond ring on a strange man he had never met before! However, what he did not expect was that this man would become inseparable from him!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
The strongest ancestor in history re-cultivate in the city, captured beautiful women, and fought against the younger generation.

title.romaji: Ju Shuo Wo Shi Hehuanzong Laozu
