description:
Fairy Luo Yue of the Cloudtop Sect used to be a pure and pretty rare talent, yet got knocked off the Parting Cliff and imprisoned for over ten years by her master just because she wanted to marry his senior brother! Surprisingly, after she died, she became Tu Huan, leader of the Pleasure Sect who enjoyed torturing men and doing all kinds of evil things! What shocked her more was that her handsome and powerful master and all her well-behaved disciples all turned evil!

(Source: Webnovel)

The entrepreneur Zhao Manman was in trouble, as her company was deep in deficit. She was about to give up, declare bankruptcy, and find a regular job to feed herself. But then her major investor Xiao Ce suddenly confessed love to her and told her that he would do his best to help her raise the funds to save her company. Xiao Manman was happy but worried, as she wondered if the handsome and rich Xiao Ce was truly sincere or if he was just playing with her...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Who said God has disappeared? I am God! And I bear the mission of saving men and gods, wiping out the wicked and driving out evil!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

title.romaji: Yinwei Xian Fan Suoyi Quan Dianle Minjie
title.native: 因为嫌烦所以全点了敏捷

description:
God blessed me with a System. So what kind of hero will I be? A relaxed and lazy one, of course!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I treated you like a brother, but you treated me like a love interest. And you've stolen every girlfriend I ever had! I just wanted to get married and have a baby, why is that so difficult?! A black-hearted white lotus vs. straight guy. A wild omegaverse fantasy, that's both sweet and seductive~~~

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In his previous life, he was a cold-hearted and indecent Great Master, Ma Jiasheng! And, in this life, he is a small actor, Ma Lanyin, who is at ease with acting. However, His ordinary life was destroyed by a strange paper contract. He actually has to co-operate with his former enemy (love), Lu Huan who play his historical self.

Ma Lanyin: Crap!! I want to break this contract!
Lu Huan: No way, you can't run away from karma, your past and present lives are bound!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

There is a rumor about a mysterious organisation in the martial world, the Success Agency. In reality, it's only run by a boss with the features of a child, and a reticent warrior, yet it dominates the leaderboards of bounty hunts in the martial world, and is well known all over. What is the secret behind their success? When their competitors come looking for trouble, where would their paths lie?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In a certain era, in a certain corner of the vast universe, humans have already entered space and established a great empire. In this time period, the concept of "states" does not exist. Instead, private capitals and giant enterprises make up the government, and control every aspect of society. Besides from private property, nothing else is sacred. Dong Zhongmin, whose hometown near the border got destroyed and Chu Ping, who wants to find someplace she can call home after being ruined by her family, journey together far and wide.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Cao Mengran likes to go out of her way to attract people's attention, but her boss Li Jiaxi sees through her disguise, and the two have had a conflict since then. Mengran accidentally finds out that Li Jiaxi signed up for a dating app, so she starts dating him in an attempt to get revenge. The two become a virtual couple. Will Mengran's plan succeed? Or does Cupid's arrow have other plans for them?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

The sweet idol melts the heart of the icy CEO.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

My new stepbrother is an obnoxious womanizer, and even worse, he's my big sister's ex-boyfriend! Internet-famous med-student older brother x thrifty homebody high-school younger brother are dramatically reunited, as they try to get used to living together as a new family!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The story tells the story of a girl who met new friends on the first day of high school, and her friends never disliked the weird scar on her face. She spent a good school time and youth with everyone

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Siling Shushi de Laogong Xunzhao Jihua
title.native: 死灵术士的老公寻找计划

description:
Toast, the male protagonist who accidentally turned into a zombie, decides to help necromancer Lily improve her spell ability so that she can continue to survive. 1 month left!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the far future, beings from another dimension – "Gods", met humans in space, and easily destroyed their spaceships. But the Gods were here to experience the conflict between different life forms in the universe, so they let humans select “players” to play in the “games” designed by the Gods.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

You Miao is the son of the richest man, who grew up in a cute and pretty house. Once by mistake, he bought Li Zhifeng, a slave of Injun, for 200 taels to cure his illness and strengthen his body, and handed over the jade pendant he carried with him, hoping for his early recovery. From the moment he was rescued, Li Zhifeng decided to thank You Miao and to stay with him.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Suo Lianjie de Shaonü, Shi Yu Ta Suoyou de Jingxiang Wei Di
title.native: 我所连接的少女，誓与她所有的镜像为敌

description:
The "legends of campus loneliness" who have always lived in an energy-saving mode are all traced together, but one day, a mysterious light extends from the body... The other end of the light is connected to Xia Ying, a classmate who has awakened the ability of "multiple mirroring". Being coerced by unilaterally sharing the pain from the other party, Qi Ji had to help Xia Ying to regain his own life from several other mirror clones... Therefore, a group of high school students with strange superpowers were the protagonists. The youth campus romantic comedy gradually unfolds...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Chuan Cheng Zongcai Wen Li De Mishu

description:
Yan Dun transmigrated into a CEO romance novel as the miserable secretary. He originally thought his task was just to be a tool, observing the romantic entanglements of the Mary Sue and the CEO. However... the situation became increasingly strange. Why did the scenes that originally belonged to the Mary Sue seem to be silently shifting to him? Wasn't he just supposed to be a tool? How did he seem to become a heartthrob?

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

I, who held the speedrunning record of several difficult RPGs, was suddenly transmigrated into a game that resembled the real world. I was always looking for interesting RPGs to play, but it turned out that my own life was the most interesting RPG of all. What's this about login rewards? Who are these random women? There are too many complicated features for me to understand. However, it looks like if I don't figure them out in time, I might just die.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Everyone knows about the book Liaozhai Zhiyi and its collection of ghost stories. In it are all sorts of ghosts and spirits, some are kind and good, some are wicked and deadly. Each story has its own plot and characters, encompassing ghosts, youkai, kitsune, and more. The one who helps you might not be human, and the ones who hurt you might not be spirits. The evils hidden in the human heart far exceeds anything in the spirit world. We will present the classic Liaozhai stories with realistic art and modern dialog, to make them more relatable for you.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The heroine who is a cartoonist has a cat, but one day, the cat swallows a pill that can become a human... The story of joy begins.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The star-chasing girl Xiaoxue is a desperate Saburo who just entered the workplace; colleague Ximu, admiring Xiaoxue's indomitable attitude, decides to partner with her to fight for her career. The two people who are getting closer and closer, because the misunderstandings are solved again and again, they are gradually attracted to each other...

(Source: Manman, translated)

They have been husband and wife for ten years, and they have been together through thick and thin. She devoted everything, but in exchange, she died of bloodshed. After her rebirth, she was determined to protect her relatives, torture her enemies, and make clouds and rainfall with her hands. But, what's going on with this man? We only agreed to cooperate with each other, so why did we get involved? She gritted her teeth and glared: Your lord, please abide by the agreement! He bullied the upper body and smiled to confuse all living beings: I think we should Collaborate more deeply. Anyway, in this life, I will never let go again no matter what.

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Huanghou Ta You Liang Fu Miankong

description:
Detective Shen Jianqiao was assigned a secret mission by the police academy to return to his hometown of Feixing Village to investigate a weapon-smuggling case. He went with his colleague Ning Xiaowu and opened a detective agency for cover. But he found himself caught up with the town's many mysteries. He will have to use his wits and deductive skills to outsmart his enemies and solve each case.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Yi Zuosi Jiu Bian Qiang!

description:
Lin Tian died unexpectedly while playing a game, he actually traveled to another world, and activated a metamorphosis system that became stronger the more he died!

(Source: Tencent Comics, translated)

The nine-star commander Lin Xiao was betrayed by a friend, and he became a fool overnight and suffered humiliation. Fortunately, his fiancee Qin Wanqiu took care of him for two years. Lin Xiao swore that he would never let Qin Wanqiu live up to him, and would let the person who bullied him pay it back tenfold!

title.romaji: Dalao Yao Jia Mang Fu Jun

description:
Song Ge, a senior single female CEO, suddenly fell into the novel she was reading and found that she was about to marry a blind and lame prince known for his wives' untimely deaths. Well, an arranged marriage wasn't so bad. CEO Song decided to play the part of a "weakling" to gain favor, but she didn't expect that this beautiful and kind "white lotus" husband of hers... was also pretending?

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

title.romaji: Wo De Zhaohuan Shen Quan Shi Yaojie Meizi
title.native: 我的召唤神全是妖界妹子

description:
Ye Yan is the ninth generation heir of the Taiyin Yuanjun. Other immortals have always looked down on his family, and he was determined to become the Taiyin Yuanjun and restore his family to its former glory. Ye Yan was born with a strange ability that attracted demons, and any female demons who saw him wanted to possess him. Ye Yan worked hard to make a name as the Taiyin Yuanjun, but those female demons were just too tempting. Let's see how Ye Yan will fight off demons while making fun with his harem of female youkai.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Virtual characters in real life? Randomly generated character in the wrong gender?​ The down-and-out streamer won the latest game console in a drawing. While setting up the virtual lover dating game, he accidentally generated a male lover for himself. He was embarrassed at first, but when he uploaded the video, it unexpectedly went viral...

(Source: Dongman Manhua, translated)
The story of cats who are forced to run a restaurant in order to pay off their debts...

Ye Wuyou transmigrated into a fantasy world, only to find himself with no support, no talent, and no luck, stuck with a job as a worthless street-sweeper. He thought he'll just live a quiet life, until he was suddenly blessed with the God-Tier Luck System. A few years later, Ye Wuyou looked back to find himself on the top of the world, known as the luckiest man alive!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In the city, there is a group with a secret identity, they are the Soul Agents. Led by Yan Bo, the six handsome gentlemen made a pact with the souls of the city to gain special powers to fight the evils of the underworld and protect the city for each generation. During the day, they are e-sport moguls, racecar drivers… as long as the days stay peaceful. One day, Yan Bo's divination predicted great misfortune! Everyone laughed at his superstitious prediction, not realizing the danger that was drawing close…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The mountain boy was driven out by his mad master to fullfill a gambling debt, but he got caught up in a dark conspiracy that had been lurking for a thousand years. Stumbling and bumbling, the young man gradually unraveled the mystery of his origins, gained the power of the ancients, and finally opened the portal to another world, not realizing that the other world was the true source of darkness! By then, the other world has been consumed by darkness and become unrecognizable! The young man decided to take up the duty of a thousand years, and resolutely stepped into the door to the alternate world!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Fei Mian Zu Yi Wen Lu

description:
Nan Gonghua is a special agent on the hunt for a mad scientist and "deeds", artifacts with supernatural powers. While on a mission, he strayed into an alternate universe of beast-men. And in this world, there was also an secret organization looking for "deeds", known as The Faceless Group. Why does the same artifact exist in two different worlds? Are the goals of each organization the same? And what kind of secrets are hidden behind all of this?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Lu Xun's "New Tales" is based on mythological stories, expressed in a fun, imaginative way. It is the only novel among Lu Xun's works with a historical background.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

While on an exploration expedition, the male protagonist and his childhood friend accidentally broke a seal that released an ancient spirit and transmigrated him at the same time?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Chang Hongsheng had dreams of becoming an adventurer, so he became an apprentice to Chu Weikuang, a man with a complicated past. But his life was turned upside down by great misfortune, as his family was killed and his home destroyed. When he finally completed his training and went out into the world, he was ambushed and attacked. Whoever killed his family was still out to get him, too. As he tried to track down the person behind the plot, he discovered that this was all related to Chu Weikuang's past. History can be a fearsome sight indeed.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Feng Chi suddenly got an ability to travel to the future, only to find that the human race was extinct. Skeletons and monsters were everywhere. Feng Chi tried to figure out the reason for the extinction of humans and save the world, but no matter how hard he tried, the result was the same... What on earth was going on?

(Source: Webnovel)

About that time when I thought my bro was a girl cross-dressing as a man.

(Source: Tencent, translated)
Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

Urban anomalies, strange and bizarre tales, endless staircases, suddenly appearing doors, familiar places and people, silent disappearances and deaths, and... an old hand scholar x rich second-generation slacker (not really). We are the guardians of the night, fighting to the end!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The person who broke into his home, turned out to be his customized robotic doll.
“Why me? Why do you keep looking for me?”
“Don’t you understand?”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The amnesic An Ning woke up on an island full of monsters and thought he was an NPC in a horror game. But the appearance of a strange “player” named Zhu Wei brought another possibility: An Ning wasn’t an NPC at all - he was the real player chosen by this horror game! “You must find a way to escape this abandoned world… or die!” This is an escape game filled with dangers at every turn. Are you ready?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In ancient times, it was said that humans and demons lived in harmony, and could even have children together. Those children will bear the mark of their ancestry. Xue Feng's mother was brutally murdered by a demon. What he didn't know was that he was himself an experimental subject of the demonic sect, trying to resurrect demonic beasts. After Xue Feng was saved, he was somehow recruited into Xuanjingsi, established by the Imperial Court to be the ultimate authority of the land.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated).

title.romaji: Fuhun Zhi Zhan: Zongcai Zhui Qi Lu Manman
title.native: 复婚之战：总裁追妻路漫漫

description:
A marriage of convenience has turned two people into mere sacrifices. In the face of a mistress' provocation and the special attention of her best friend's brother, Lu Nanyin was forced to fight with everything she has while still playing the part of "the perfect Mrs. Gu." Meanwhile, Gu Xiaocheng resented the forced marriage to Lu Nanyin, but he couldn't help falling in love with her along the way...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

After the "Metaverse" incident, spiritual aura became the new reality, as monsters roamed the land, and humans were forced to stay within fortified cities to survive. Scientists developed a game called "Heavenly Palace," designed to collect spiritual power from its players and convert it into energy. Since then society was reorganized to allow everyone to play the game. But is Heavenly Palace really humanity's salvation? When Xiao Ce accidentally triggered the Zhuque System, connecting the game world to reality, he was able to freely travel between them. This allowed him to see the truth behind Heavenly Palace…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Zhi Shi Ge Pingfan Ren

description:
When our protagonist fainted after being hit in the head, he transmigrated into dream-land. Thus started his new life of working in our world during the day, and saving the other world at night.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

While live-streaming a game, I played along when my partner joked about us being gay. All of a sudden, some hater and his ten alt accounts all started flaming my chat room. Then I found out that the homophobic hater was actually my roommate. When other people play games, they have to risk being shot to pick up gear. But when I play, three sugar daddies give me more gear than I can use, and get mad when I don't accept.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Born to a family of forensicists, the college senior Song Ziyang was in class when he met the police investigator Tang Youyou. From there they will encounter a series of horrifying supernatural cases. Dead infants, haunted cars, mutilated bodies… each case testing the limits of human sanity, but each with a unique story to tell.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The boy band SME doesn't have a single serious member other than the center-man Lin Heng. The supposed captain of the group Fan Jingzhe is a pervert promoting weird couplings. The most popular member Lou Tang is good at attracting attention without actually doing anything. He just wants to take the center-man for himself. The final member Han Yinan is nuts for CPs, and he's willing to hook up with anyone and anything. Can this band really hold together?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.romaji: Hezu Duixiang Shi Qingdi Zenme Ban
title.native: 合租对象是情敌怎么办

description:
Because of his cousin's "mistake", the good boy Song Shuzhi lives in a shared apartment with his rival, Zhou Xu. Zhou Xu is a cynical playboy, and Song Shuzhi disregards him. The lives of the two are also chaotic. But later, an inexplicable feeling filled the two of them...

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Bixia De Juese Zhao Shangmen

description:
Qin Ge is just an ordinary web novelist living a leisurely life, until he meets a fan who turns out to be a character from a novel he wrote!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

In the beginning of the Flood, the Great Dao was ruthless and took all things as fodder. A young boy from the human race falls to the south and stumbles onto the path of cultivation, struggling for survival, fighting for his life with his sword.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An unemployed loser was possessed by the spirit of an ancient god-emperor, which awakened the mysterious power of the Star Wheel. Now facing greedy Old Gods and an evil criminal syndicate of super-villains, who all want the power of the Star Wheel for themselves, how will our lone underdog fight back?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Tui Hou Rang Wei Shi Lai

description:
He transmigrated to become a monk in the Tang Dynasty and successfully led an expedition to retrieve the sacred sutras. Thus he was given the title of The Victorious Battle Monk. One day, he woke up only to find himself back in the modern world? But he could see the world was filled with gods and demons, lost souls, and all sorts of wicked spirits.

"Stay back, let me take care of this," as Master Tang Luo flashed a "merciful" smile.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Shattering the Laws of Plot Armor!

description:
F*ck! Another harem novel?! Why is it that as long as it's a woman, she will inevitably fall for you?! I really hate this type of male MC! Lin Yaofei complained as he read through the webnovel. At the same time, a notification popped up on his phone in a form of a choice question that asked: Do you like reading these types of novels? A: YES! B: NO! He chose B without hesitation, then was suddenly summoned by an unknown system...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

In a strange twist of fate, Jing Qiu, a teenager living on an alternate Earth full of magical creatures, picked up a sticky slime. To his surprise, the little slime could transform into an adorable little boy, and also possessed an unbelievable identity!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Time and again, A You finds himself chasing a mysterious rabbit through his dreams. But before he can reach out and grab it…his mother is shaking him awake for another day of work. A You’s not exactly thrilled with his job at the factory, so when a persistent streak of bad luck leaves him unemployed, it seems like a great opportunity to start over. The trouble is, A You doesn’t have anything to move on to. With no goals or aspirations, A You roams the city searching for direction. Deep in thought on one of his strolls, A You suddenly rouses himself only to discover he’s lost in the woods. He catches sight of a rabbit, and in desperation follows it through the forest. But this scene seems familiar…Is it a dream? Or could there truly be an ideal world within the darkness? [From Yen Press]

Xiao Yi, who was abandoned by his girlfriend, loses his job, and is drowning in credit card debt and mortgage payments. A friend manages to help him get a job as a celebrity's assistant, and it turns out the celebrity he's assisting is the male god Lu Zhou.

In Xiao Yi's mind, Lu Zhou is a white lotus flower, but... Who is this bad-tempered, arrogant person who badmouths his fans?

(Source: Manman Manhua, tranlsated)
Collection of short horror stories.

Qing Chun, a canary, and Chen Di, a rooster, are holly birds that can take the form of humans. Chen Di has the job to wake the earth every morning whit his singing and Quig Chun is the one who eases everyone's heart with her beautiful songs. Pan Yi is the human Quin Chun felt in love with and just once she would like to be the one who wakes him up in the morning. She asks Chen Di to let her perform his job for enlist one day and in the end he agrees because he loves her, but things don't go exactly as planned for Quin Chun and somehow Pan Yi ends up finding her secret.

(Source: Evil Flowers)

From the drastic temperature drop during the Ordovician period leading to the extinction of invertebrates, to the cataclysmic meteor impact during the Cretaceous period that wiped out the dinosaurs, every major extinction event in Earth's history can be traced back to the consequences of the failed "Killing Game." In the seventh iteration of this game, which determines the survival of the human race, the chosen "gamers" must struggle for their lives, giving their all to complete the final mission... Gamer Leon White lets out a weary yawn. "Hey, is it just me, or is this a bit challenging? I mean... I'm just a fifteen-year-old boy who excels in academics and is skilled in bomb defusal, assassination techniques, and firearm assembly."

(Source: Webnovel)

In a world of eternal night and blood moons, the steampunk land is shrouded in eerie mist, with humanity mutating and a wall of flesh devouring lost souls amid constant wails. At this time, a lone strategist named Annan rises as the “Number One Player” to become the savior of the Mist Continent. Leading the Thirteen Saints and forming alliances with the Twelve True Gods, he carves out a new future. Declaring himself a “Champion of Justice” and the gatekeeper of the Fourth Calamity, he takes on the mantle of an uncrowned god to calm fears, guide people through the unknown, and face the challenges of this chaotic world together.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Fu Hei Zongcai Bie Luan Lai

description:
Damn! Did the Devil think he could use tricks to trap her always? Did he remember he is a boss? She was once a cold killer and remains impossible to be trapped by anyone. Though she had a child of his, she was still planning an escaping plan. This time, she would not fail...

(Source: Webnovel)

This is a world that is no different from modern society during the day, but once the dusk dividing line is crossed, darkness is forcibly opened, and it becomes a world where evil spirits and ghosts roam the night. My original world had just been destroyed, and when I traveled to the new world it was the end of the world again? It’s the end of the world, but I’m also possessed by an evil spirit? Being chased by villagers? Faced with various survival crises, how can I hide my identity as a traveler and survive?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

I’m way too unlucky, seriously. While others get to be time travellers, I can only watch as historical figures traverse to the present While others enjoy flirting with girls, I’m the one being played. My name is Xiao Qiang, but I go by Qiang. One day, I encountered an old man named Liu Laoliu, who claimed to be a deity, and somehow ended up making a deal with him. I run “The Nth Pawnshop,” where I now receive customers like Jing Ke, Li Bai, Xiang Yu, and Qin Hui. As the tale unfolds…

This story is filled with a sense of humor, cultivation, time traversing, slice of life, romance, you name it. That’s the Greatest Chaos in History for you.

Meng Yao is a dream fairy that travels through dimensions to solve problems that may affect reality. After a few things go wrong, Avery is forced by a vampire named Ellie to sign a blood contract. Adventures ensue as they solve multiple mysteries and look for a way to dissolve the blood contract!

(Source: INKR)
When a female doctor and martial artist whose family was tragically murdered encounters a sultry but frail scholar, a romantic tale unfolds upon their mutual hunt for the criminals.

In order to protect the mother and sister, 7 year old Cesare chooses to follow his father Long Borgia, the Pope of Messiah, to Florence, and joins the cruel robotic army. With his special genetic traits of owning purple eyes, he becomes a knight driving the robot, “the Flaming Angel”. Through this extraordinary journey, Cesare also starts to realizing what is his own truth in the life.

(Source: Mangatoon)

The meatatarian girl contracted the all-around herbivorous man for private purposes. She just wanted the pretty man/salary but the relationship's beyond the contract!

(Source: WeComics)

title.romaji: Qiu Yu Luo Feng: Shanzhai Dage Chengzhang Ji
title.native: 秋语落风—山寨大哥成长记

description:
Zhang Luofeng is just trying to live a peaceful life - all he wants is to fit in at school and make friends! He even has a crush on Yin Qiuqiu, the beautiful but cold Student Council member. The only problem? He’s the young master of the Sui Feng Clan!

A tale about the ups and downs of high school life, Autumn Winds is about fighting back against bullies, the thorny path of adolescent love, and, finally, the importance of letting go. Real men stand against the current and bravely fight for their dreams.

“The emperor is without romantic intent. Those with romantic intent cannot be exceptional emperors. But if I am disloyal to you, how would my empire matter anymore?” From young and naive to mature and experienced with the ways of the world, observe how the cute crown prince grows up, secluded in the palace, to be an unparalleled ruler of the world!

Adapted from a very famous novel.
A contradictory romance, “Every unexpected thing I’ve been through was all to meet you.”

His wife ran away and followed another man, and his brother was in a conflict with him. When everything seemed to be at its worst, he woke up after being drunk and found himself lying on his bed with a peerless handsome man! And this guy kept sticking with him all day long! Is it because of God’s will or an unhappy love affair that he’s unable to escape this scene?

(Source: WebComics)
A story starting with a sheet of test paper. A special love between two best friends. But even an ordinary couple's love affair could run into obstacles, much less these two.

Su Mu of the Su Family in Tang State is talented yet arrogant. But due to illness, he lost his cultivation base. An arrow from nowhere hit him one day, making him restore his strength and a Divine Master. The arrogant Su Mu who always seek revenge comes back now...

(Source: Wecomics)

title.english: How’d I Get a Heroine’s Script?

description:
Wheelchair-bound Chao Yi got transmigrated to another world, and was told that he gained a “system” who goes by the name of Qin Que. As long as he 'conquered' the male lead in this world, not only will he be able to walk again, he'll be able to enjoy the luxuries that came with his new status... Also, there was the teeny, tiny, super insignificant caveat that his soul would dissipate if he chose otherwise, but that was besides the point. Heeding Qin Que's advice, Chao Yi used every method he could to increase the affection level of the "male lead", causing all sorts of ludicrous situations, and even causing the secrets behind the death of the 'Original Chao Yi' to come to light...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Known for his angelic voice, Cheng Yi, a famous television anchor, was suddenly attacked by an overly obsessed fanboy confessing his love for him, causing him to fall off the stage and get sucked into a book where he ended up becoming a flower boy.

"Ah... But I'm straight! What?! And I have to do all sorts of stuff with this guy in front of me? What?! And every guy in the world will be craving for my body? Um... The beginning of this book has to be a joke! I think I might just loosen up a bit and let myself fly free!"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

"Classic of Mountains and Seas" said that there were once sixteen dieties with their arms intertwined, watching over Emperor on this wilderness.

(Source: Wecomics)

title.romaji: Wo Cai Bu Hui Ai Shang Qiyue Nüyou
title.english: I Will ~Not~ Fall For My Contractual Girlfriend
title.native: 我才不会爱上契约女友

description:
Three years ago, Shen Yucheng and Mo Ran were framed into a night of entanglement but failed to remember each other’s face. Shen Yucheng was blackmailed with his photos. For his own benefits, he lied about her being his girlfriend who was going to study overseas for three years. Three years later—pressured with marriage—he found her figure to be very similar to the woman he had a one-night-stand with and signed a contract with her to be a contractual partner. Mo Ran was originally a rich lady, but she was cast out of her family because of a plot and had to resort to taking the roles of movie extras. How would the love life of the romantic CEO and middle-aged background actress develop from this?

(Source: Bilibli Comics)

Jiang Siming suddenly discovered that what he saw in his favorite battle-royale game was a bit different from others. He can find shards of various colors in the game that he can synthesize into treasures such as skills, attributes, talents, money, artifacts, even medicines, techniques, and all sorts of overpowered items. By constantly collecting shards in the game, Jiang Siming will make his fortune!

(Source: Bilibili, Translated)

title.english: Luck Arrives After Being In Relationship

description:
Bad luck novelist x luck-transporting god

Yancy, a novelist, who has been depressed all the year-round has met an "exclusive" luck-transporting god. The two stumble and try to achieve the goal of helping Yancy getting out of bad luck, only to find that someone had been obstructing behind their backs. Things are far less simple than they seem. "I heard that luck will get better after we're in a relationship. Want to try?"

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Xiannü Baobiao Bu Jiang Wu De

description:
In order to make up for a mistake, the God of Fate sent his apprentice Ji Longyue into the mortal realm to become the daughter of a minister. Her job was to help the ineffective emperor Gu Xuanting to reform himself in order to become a wise ruler. She thought she would do that by becoming his queen, but she was appointed to be his bodyguard instead? He even gave her the title of General, which caused great dissatisfaction with the members of his court, and led to all sorts of unexpected events. This is not how the script was supposed to go! This emperor just can't be helped, how will she get out of this situation?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"I can't accept a confession from my stepsister." He thought he'd refused her forcefully enough! But now through circumstance they'll have to live together under the same roof???

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: My Sweet First Love Is A CV God

description:
Five years ago, Ruan Zhi left her crush Qi Zhan on bad terms. Now five years later, an unexpected reunion brought him crashing into her life. Hey man, I thought you studied architecture? How did he become the boss of her voice-dubbing company? What? That faceless voice-actor idol is you, too?! After a while, Ruan Zhi found herself in Qi Zhan's thrall, and she couldn't help but wonder how that man came up with such a deep strategy...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ba Zong Xing Wangfei Fanche Zhinan

description:
Fu Yu wrongly traveled to an immortal novel world and became a miserable supporting role. Unexpectedly, with an omniscient perspective, high IQ and EQ, she struck back and became a popular heroine.

(Source: Webnovel)

If you have seven days left in your life. What do you want to do? The death notice issued by the skybound death bureau experiment is as short as seven days, whether you have ever lived at the top of the world or struggled at the edge of life. There is always stumbling, always miss, always regret... It doesn't really matter how you die; How to live is the point.

(Source: WebComics)

Xiao Yao is a good-for-nothing dreamer who would like nothing more than to own a celestial sword but was raised as a worker in a restaurant. One day he meets a mysterious drunken priest who asks for some wine...

A writer of science fiction is in a coma following a stroke. But he continues dreaming the most delusional universes. Using a brand new machine, his doctor decides to enter the man's dreams, to bring him back to real life.

Get undressed and lie down on my bed.

If you dare to resist something even as little as a finger,
I promise, you will never see me again in your life. Do you understand?

Nnn!

Very good.

Come in first, and then strip! Are you trying to irritate me?!

Nezha, born in the form of a 3 year old boy with celestial power, inadvertently becomes enmeshed in a conspiracy by evil spirits. He is forced to commit suicide at a tender age. Story based around a Chinese deity.

Princess Hakunamatata of Mongolia was sent to Imperial China to marry the young emperor so that she can become the new empress. However, the emperor already has a benevolent and loving wife, and he does not wish to take in a new wife. Already angry that her new "husband" is weak, timid, and puny, the rejected Princess Hakunamatata began to create endless trouble in the Palace! She is straightforward and fearless, and does whatever she wants! Instead of confronting Princess Hakunamatata, the empress decides to betroth her to the emperor's uncle, who absolutely finds the princess intolerable. Amidst all the hilarity and misunderstanding, a conspiracy is slowly emerging from the shadows - and all four characters' fate will change forever.

If it weren't for the man who saved the little devil named Zhu Mingquan, would the big, bad wolf Hanyang be trapped in a human house like a dog?
What's more, he's forced to try to transform into a human every day so he can pair up with that kid?
Come on, he's still a guy~~~

(Source: Weixiang Culture, translated)
This manhua is a collection of short stories by this author. It is almost similar to the German Brothers Grimm's stories. However, these hold no morals but are more of a twisted outlook on life.

Ordinary guy on an ordinary day woke up in an ordinary house next to an ordinary dead body. What would you do? 

Source: MU

Surprisingly, the popular female superstar is actually a handsome young guy! To escape this awkward identity, he has to continue pretending to be the female superstar, while starting again as a trainee.
(Source: Webcomics)

A troubled otaku boy is obsessed with his favorite anime character, Aris Chan. When a small-town girl moves to his school, the boy believes she’s his idol come to life! The boy? Ga-Ra. The girl? Tae-Bok. Two people, two stories, one wacky and heartwarming romance.

(Source: Tapas)

X, a genius thief, and Ash, a boy with a mysterious past, decide to join the Azure Knights after a chance encounter with Ryu, the prime swordmaster. The entry exam for the Azure Knights is where the best of the best come to show exceptional skills. X and Ash must prove their might and win against the elite aristocrats! Will they be able to become knights? And what cruel destiny will they face afterwards…?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

What are the odds of running into an ex-lover at a recycling center? A new story written by two women who reunite as apartment residents.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A thick layer of mist shrouds the world and turns people into zombie-like monsters. Without knowing its cause or the solution, the only way out is to sneak into the capital city built for the privileged. While struggling for survival, Hayeon, a talented biologist, finds out that his crush Myung Woon has something to do with the virus...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Notes: The chapter count includes a prologue and 16 side stories. The side stories contain mature scenes.

After whopping 20 years as the headsman of the kingdom, Denil finally gets to hang up his ax – not. With the flickering prospect of a tranquil, possibly happy post-beheading life snatched from him, he’s got no choice; open his eyes, open up the skills given to him by the Creator Goddess, open up about his tortured past, and bury that hatchet – preferably in his new enemies’ craniums.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yi-Jae, an ambitious small town cop, discovers that his first love, Jun-Hyuk, is involved in the band of criminals known as the Black Goat Gang. Forced to pose as lovers, they must navigate danger and desire. Can their fake romance help put the bad guys behind bars, or will their tangled past blow their cover?

(Source: Manta)

After saving another world and barely returning to my original body, I found myself transformed into a pervert who seduced the Empire's mad dog, Lexion, begging him to spank my butt. Trembling in fear from the man who looked ready to wring my neck at any moment, a system message I thought I'd never see again announced:

[System Message] The Destiny Quest begins. Getting Spanked by Destiny (0/100)?!

Before I could even question it, my soul-swapped body reacted sensitively to Lexion's touch. Nadia, who had never held a man's hand before, found herself unintentionally enduring days where her flesh and bones burned. A life that seems like M, yet isn't quite M, but still feels like M.

“Me, an M...?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ozae is a blood-drinking monster known as a Bat. Knowing his secret, Seoho offers him a deal. Initially wanting nothing but his blood, at some point the beautiful Ozae finds himself wanting all of Seoho. While Seoho also soon falls for the beautiful man. How will their dangerous and dizzying dance end?

title.english: I'd Rather Live as a Villain

description:
After years of hiding his brilliance as a loyal executive aide, Taesik Yun finally has the chance to face the superiors who once stole his work and destroyed his reputation. He secures his seat as the new Division Director through a high-stakes, 10-billion-won contract marriage to his boss, Munjeong Kang -- the fierce legitimate heir fighting to keep her empire from her illegitimate brother. But as he steps into the spotlight to claim his revenge -- can Taesik survive the cutthroat succession war while navigating a fake marriage that feels increasingly real?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Woojin wants nothing more than to escape reality. Hwon wants nothing more than to be with Woojin. Baffled by the intensity of Hwon’s love, Woojin makes a series of absurd demands to push him away. But no matter how cruel the demands are, Hwon never gives up.

(Source: Lezhin)

With all his memories wiped out, Jesse wakes up in the hospital and in front of him stands a man that suggests he's Jesse's lover. However, the only fragmented memory Jesse has of that man is him trying to kill Jesse. But is his fragile memory reliable? Who's telling the truth and what is actually going on? Why was he in the hospital to begin with? A luxury BL thriller that will keep you wanting for more.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

The Myers are out of luck. Not only did the tyrant emperor strip them of their title and land, but Alexis, the head of the family, took his own life because of it... And no one's more shocked than his wife, Louise, when he suddenly wakes up a completely different person! But Louise doesn't realize that Alexis has been possessed by a hero from another world, one who's determined to save the Myers once and for all. Can the new Alexis become the family's savior? Or will he be rejected as a fake?

(Source: Tapas)

Friends, rivals... Lovers? Yeo Haon and Baek Rigon have clashed since the very first moment they met. For years, they straddled the line between enemies and friends, ignorant to what feelings had been developing deep below the surface. Yet just as soon are their eyes open to how much they mean to one another, events transpire to try keep them apart...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes ten extras.

Kim Han-Gyul was a child prodigy, born to act. Using his ability to see ghosts, he was able to deliver a captivating performance that helped him stand out in the competitive industry. All the other child actors admired him, and it seemed like he had a bright future ahead of him, until the mysterious red thread appeared. From that very moment, his life became mired in disaster. Ten years later, living an ordinary life and putting his childhood fame behind him, he finds out that the red thread on his finger leads somewhere – a black thread attached to childhood actor-turned-superstar, Jung Eun-Han. Their similar pasts have to mean something, but what secrets lie behind these ties that bind them?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"He slept with his next door neighbor's wife whenever he went away on a business trip"

A small town near Seoul that our family used to live in was a welcoming place. At least that's what I thought until the people of the town revealed their true faces. Our family was driven out of town due to their devious planning, but now that I've gained power, I will make my glorious return.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Blacked out from drinking, just what happened with his crush during that time...?!

Dong Saebyeok, a scary-looking but softhearted guy who falls for his cool-headed junior, Seo Gwangchae. Watch their cute campus romance unfold because no matter how bad the day is, the sun always rises!

Leo Lombardi’s a hotshot L1 racecar driver for Team Zeus. He’s young, good-looking and has the driving talent to make anyone jealous. And sharing in that success is Leo’s boyfriend, J.J., who just so happens to be a mechanic on Team Zeus. All signs point to a clear lane for Leo to take home the championship for a second year in a row. But when J.J. suddenly breaks up with Leo, things start going south. With Leo’s fortuna (good luck charm) gone, his professional (and personal) life starts to suffer. How will he get rid of this monkey wrench in his plans and reclaim the driver’s high he once had…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 12 side story chapters.

At the edge of a distant continent, a land perpetually blanketed in snow lies Oldenland, ruled by Archduke Giesel Zvendard. His cold demeanor, overwhelming magical prowess, and even the bizarre rumor that he carries the blood of monsters make everyone fear him. Yet few know that what Giesel truly desires is simply a peaceful daily life, immersed in magical research with a warm cup of tea in his quiet study. What shattered this modest wish was an unexpected bride from the southernmost tip of Cornia. Rensley Mallosen, the bastard son of Cornia, appeared wearing a bride's crown in place of his runaway sister. His brief attempt to hide, fearing discovery, was short-lived. This cheerful, chatty knight, his sun-like golden hair flowing as he roamed the castle, kept stirring up small disturbances in the ice castle that seemed destined for eternal silence. Even though he should have been driven out immediately for this fraudulent marriage, Giesel found himself increasingly unable to look away from Rensley, who beamed brightly and chattered away at even the smallest kindness. Rensley, who had been rejected from the moment he was born and ultimately abandoned, arriving in Oldenland, began to harbor affection for Giesel's seemingly indifferent yet kind demeanor. But the moment he became aware of his feelings, the time for parting drew near...

To Oldenland, the coldest land on the continent, yet where the warmest things gather, will Rensley ever be able to return?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Eun-San and Hae-Gyeong, who have known each other since childhood, begin to hold each other in childhood memories after Hae-Gyeong's manifestation. Yun-San, who has now manifested as an omega, accidentally reunites with Hae-Gyeong at an amusement park and continues to secretly communicate with him without the adults knowing. After a time when they felt each other through messenger messages and pheromones on clothes due to the pheromones of their still-imperfect adolescence, the two, now fully grown adults, meet again on Jeju Island...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

"I'll become a perfect loser and punish you."

Eun-Hyeok returned to his high school days when he was a loser. He trembled with anxiety at first, but he started taming the bullies, armed with his past.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

On the day he was abandoned by the company he devoted his entire life to, did he return to the moment of his first day at work? Kim Cheol-Su, a new employee with no qualifications who joined Hanyoung Trading, one of the largest conglomerates in Korea. Will he be able to rise to the position of 'CEO' that he had longed for in this life? A modern-day self-made story of success through hard work!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jae-Hyeong and Min have been friends and rivals in judo since childhood. Min always believed they would continue their journey in the sport together, but one day, Jae-Hyeong suddenly disappears without a word. Years later, Min enrolls at Jae-Hyeong’s university and tracks him down, only to discover that Jae-Hyeong has quit judo entirely. Determined to bring him back, Min challenges Jae-Hyeong to one final match—but the stakes are anything but ordinary. A tense and emotional story of friendship, rivalry, and unresolved feelings unfolds...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Chapter count includes five side story episodes.

“If I can’t have you, no one can.”

Hestia killed her beloved brother Ian with her own two hands. Three months later, he reappears in front of her seemingly unharmed; however, he has seemingly lost all his memories and become an almost completely different person. Everyone in the kingdom welcomes him back with open arms, but only Hestia suspects some foul play at work. Has her brother really changed? Or Ian not who he seems?

(Source: Lehzin US)

title.romaji: Gongjangnimgwa Ireomyeon An Doeneun Geol Aljiman
title.native: 공작님과 이러면 안 되는 걸 알지만

description:
“After spending a night with the duke I’d been secretly pining for, I was offered a contract marriage.”

Elin, who had been steadfastly enduring the increasingly severe torment from her stepmother and stepsister, runs into her secret crush, Dominic, at a ball. While looking after a drunken Dominic, Elin ends up spending the night with him...

Meanwhile, Dominic, who must marry to secure a deal with the Crown Prince, proposes a marriage of convenience to Elin while searching for a suitable partner...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

To clear his name, regressor Bae Min-Su is reincarnated as Go Ji-Hun, the youngest son of a wealthy family, and becomes a police officer to track down the real culprit. A crime thriller boasting incredible wealth begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Music and darkness make people honest.

Do-Young, a guitarist and sub-vocalist in a small, unknown band. He gets into trouble because of a bunch of bad guys, but he barely gets out of it with the help of a man. But this man, his face and voice seem somehow familiar...?

"Wait, wait! Why are you taking off your clothes and fucking...!"

"Do-Young. Did you really not want to see me? I... missed you so much."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Sa-Rang Park has only one mission in life: to save her cousin, Pyeong-Gang, from a life-threatening illness. The only way to do so is to find Pyeong-Gang’s “Ondal” -- the person Pyeong-Gang has been fated to be with since her previous life. But on her journey to connect her cousin with her other half, Sa-Rang just might get tangled up in a romance of her own.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

My stepmom's 10 years older than me, but she doesn't look like it... Is she... trying to tempt me?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Duke Carhel Luave is known as the devilish duke due to his uncontrollable magical ability to charm every single person who lays their eyes on him. But this is more of a curse than a blessing with several noble houses plotting to drive him out of power. Having no one he can genuinely like or trust, Carhel wonders if he will ever be able to feel the warmth of another human being. One day, after raiding the estate of one of his enemies, Carhel mistakenly has Lena, the house’s maid, captured in the aftermath. But when he tries to use his charming powers to give her a painless death, something unexpected happens. For some reason, Carhel’s powers have no effect on Lena!

(Source: Tappytoon)

With the appearance of the Overlord’s Star in the sky, the world plunges into chaos, and only the one born with the essence of the star can save it. Amidst the upheaval, former comrades Baek Woonhoi and Chun Ryuyoung each dream of becoming the Overlord. Ryuyoung to save his family, and Woonhoi because he has nothing else to lose. But as the star shines brighter, the two find themselves swept up in an impending war. Both men’s ambitions burn fiercely, but only one Overlord can reign supreme!

(Source: Tapas)

Following an uncomfortable run-in at a bar, Won wakes up at a hotel to find a strange man with crazy eyes fondling him under the sheets. Despite his initial disgust, Won is too easily provoked by the wacko's onslaught of snarky comments, and is soon forced back into bed for a chance to prove himself...!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Lee Jinhwa lived an ordinary life until she swallowed a fox bead gifted by a mysterious peddler, mistaking it for a wish-fulfilling marble. Little did Jinhwa know that her actions would lead her to be haunted by Koo Miho, an infamous nine-tailed fox who wishes to retrieve the bead. To add fuel to the fire, Jinhwa soon discovers that she's also become a target for various spirits and demons, and the only way to extract the cause of the issue is for Miho to kill her... or kiss her!

(Source: Tapas)

Lee Giho is trying to earn his tuition through the popular VR game Circuit, but things just aren't going his way. However, right when he decides to throw in the towel, he gets a lucky break that changes everything. Fortune leads him ever deeper into the game’s lore, and before he knows it, Giho finds himself stocked up with powerful items chasing an elusive group of mysterious warriors. But to unlock his true powers, Giho must learn the secrets of this group before his luck runs out for good.

(Source: Tapas)

A youthful romance for those who think they are unhappy.

(Source: Go Manga)

She once saved the world as the fearsome Archmage of Despair. Her reward? Being reborn as Lesia Elphinad, child saint and unwilling subscriber to a pay-to-live reincarnation subscription where missing a payment could cost her life. Instead of enjoying toys and naps, she must complete divine quests, collect Heaven Coins, and live under the same roof as her former rival, the powerful light mage. With the help of old friends and new, can she turn a cursed second chance into a life worth living?

(Source: Tapas)

Cheon Ki-Joon is a vampire cursed with a huge burden; if he drinks the blood of the person he loves, they will eventually grow sick and die. He resolves to live his life without harming another human when in comes Yoon Han, a wealthy playboy who saves Ki-Joon from the brink of starvation by agreeing to start harvesting human blood for him. Maintaining this relationship with Yoon Han, Ki-Joon has managed to resist his carnal instincts for the past ten years, but things take a complicated turn when Yoon Han wants to know why Ki-Joon will drink anyone’s blood but his...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Emperor Geom-Mu and Empress Yi-Ryeong were once a harmonious couple, but their inability to conceive left Yi-Ryeong anxious and obsessively fixated on her husband. In a tragic twist, an accidental injury inflicted by Yi-Ryeong on Geom-Mu leads to her being sentenced to death. However, just as she is about to face her end, news arrives that Geom-Mu has returned to the palace, gravely wounded by a gumiho’s poison during a hunt. The Empress Dowager decrees that the only cure for the Emperor’s affliction is for him to consummate with Yi-Ryeong. Torn between her lingering guilt and an uncontrollable Emperor transformed into a beastly shadow of himself, Yi-Ryeong must face a night of both passion and peril.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Haegeum's fiancé offers her an outrageous proposal... he wants them to each have one last steamy fling with other people before getting married. After her initial heartbreak and shock, she agrees, but for only one reason—revenge! She wants him to regret this selfish decision, and the best way to accomplish that is with a younger, sexier boyfriend. Luckily, the perfect guy just moved in next door. Sihoon is accomplished, handsome, and charming... but he's her younger brother's best friend. Can Haegeum get her revenge AND keep the guy?

(Source: Tapas)

We have developed love since our school days. As college students, we finally had the first experience we had been enduring, and our future as a couple seemed to be filled with only happiness. “We were definitely lovers in our past life… !” The moment I ejaculated for the first time, memories from my past life rush into my head, and I learn the shocking truth about my lover in the past! What will happen to our future now?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Love is tough when you don't have enough money to maintain the relationship...

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: They Wish to Take Away My Child

description:
When Iris Locha gazes into the enchanted mirror inherited from her parents, she's met with a haunting glimpse of what lies ahead. A future where she grapples with a terminal illness, and her husband's mistress relentlessly pressures her to abandon her husband and child. Amidst the dark secrets, sinister plots, and misunderstandings, can Iris carve out her path to happiness?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Overly rational. Sociopathic, even. Sean's unfeeling personality consistently drives people away from him. That is, until he wakes up after a night of heavy drinking in... an escape room? Now he must use his unique mind and join hands with other players to survive sadistic games of life and death. The only way out is to escape!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Crooked businessmen and civil servants got you down? Call the undertaker of the tax world, the Tax Reaper. Jae-Hyeon Sin has a gift that lets him see the amount of illegally withheld taxes as a number floating above people’s heads. But when he uses this ability to whistleblow on someone in his own company, he gets the axe. Branded a traitor in the business world, he decides to become a government employee and catch all the dirty white-collar criminals that profit through tax loopholes. Who’s neck will the Tax Reaper’s righteous blade strike next?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Spirits roam the land in the mountainous country of Donghye. Some live peacefully alongside human beings, whereas others prey on the innocent. Solitary swordsman Sehui Han travels the land hunting down spirits and ghosts that plague the lives of ordinary folk. He is aided by a powerful spirit called Black Tiger, who grants Sehui strength in return for being allowed to feed on the spirits they meet.

One day, Sehui encounters a young spirit called the Hwimori. Though she appears to be an innocent child, government soldiers are on her trail, determined to track her down. Empathizing with her plight, Sehui embarks upon a journey to restore her name and memories… but what will they find at the end of their road?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Lee Seohyun is the #1-ranked player in the long-forgotten game "Asura Online." As he wonders why no one plays anymore, he stumbles upon the hottest new game, "Asrian Online." Based on the world of Asura, with similar maps and characters, becoming the best in Asrian should be a piece of cake. But after he picks his hidden class, he learns he has become a puny supporting character. Though Seohyun has his sights set on becoming a star again, the only way to the top this time will be as a supporter!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Lim Shinyoon has been living a lie. A strange man is at the family dinner and reveals that Shinyoon is not actually a “Lim” but a “Nam.” This, of course, means that he is not blood-related to any of his sisters…and this man also confesses that he is actually his real father?! And with a dying wish to have Shinyoon give him a grandchild before he leaves this earth?! Well, there are four highly suitable options sitting right there next to Shinyoon... No, these are his sisters! But well, now that he’s a brother from another…everything could change!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Inside the world’s most popular MMORPG, the fearsome Dragon of Despair Taphras is raided by the game’s most powerful guild, composed of six top-rankers. Upon Taphras' defeat, he is divided into six items and split between each of the guild members. Little do they know that Taphras’ sister, Ignis, the Dragon of Destruction, has been awoken. Now, to resurrect her brother, Ignis must take down the guild members one by one and unite the missing items in this dragon-sized tale of revenge!

(Source: Tapas)

Poor law school student, Jeong-Hun Han, experiences a time slip via the time roulette machine he accidentally finds at his father's place. When he comes to his senses, he finds himself in the middle of a battlefield during the Joseon dynasty! But before Jeong-Hun can even process what’s happened, he’s approached by a messenger named Jun, who informs him that the only way he can go back to his time period is by completing the time roulette’s mission. Will Jeong-Hun be able to complete his mission and return to his time?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: chapter count includes 2 side stories

Still recovering from his past scars and navigating his attraction to the same sex, Unyul prefers to keep to himself—that is, while enjoying a low radar FWB relationship with his roommate and best friend. Then, comes along Seoha Han, a "god-given" perfection of a human being that is his exact ideal type. Opening himself up to love once more, Unyul must work to maintain his existing relationship with his roommate while trying to build himself a new one with his "lovely" Seoha. It's okay to pretend a little in front of the person you like, right? Will they still love me after knowing who I truly am? Who is this sweet, sweet swindler?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue, 31 special chapters and an AU chapter.

Estelle, the empire's saint, was an illegitimate child who tried her best to be loved by her family and fiancé... until they sacrificed her to a demon for the sake of their greed. After 600 years of being tortured, she makes a deal with the demon to return by possessing the body of Jewel de Garnet, the only child of a powerful noble family. With her new identity and fierce determination, will Estelle successfully carry out her revenge? Or will someone from her past stop her from doing so?

(Source: Tapas)

After being abused and killed by her family in two separate lifetimes, Blesse Lavian expects nothing from them in her third life. This time, despite knowing the horrible end that awaits House Lavian, Blesse decides to keep quiet and flee when the time is right. But the more time she spends with her cold-looking father and half-sister, the more she realizes that the Lavians aren't so bad after all. Will Blesse take a chance and rewrite her third life, or will she end up betrayed once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Jung-Ho is bullied to the point of self-harm, until one day, his prayers are answered by Mephistopheles, the archdevil. Mephisto offers Jung-Ho magical powers that would allow him to take revenge on his bullies, and in return, asks for his soul. It’s an easy choice for Jung-Ho, who thinks nothing can be worse than the living hell that is his life. But what he doesn’t know is that there are greater forces at work, and that he is but a pawn in a much larger game played by angels, demons, and exorcists.

(Source: Lezhin)

Woojoo and his older stepbrother Hanbit have always been close, with Hanbit doting on his little brother as if he had known Woojoo from the very minute he was born. However, Woojoo has a little secret… Swearing to push his forbidden feelings away, Woojoo tries to behave like an innocent little brother in front of Hanbit, until one day, Woojoo suddenly manifests as an omega. Now, Woojoo is not the only one with a secret…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Having lost his ranked account to a hacker, Kang Yoohan wants to get even. Assuming his lost equipment was sold, he’s hoping that as blacksmith Zig, it will come back to him through repairs and lead him to the hacker. After breaking many swords, however, he finds this is no walk in the park. Thankfully, he’s able to see cracks in the equipment and enemies that show their vital points to make or break them! Armed with these skills, Zig is looking to get things shaking, or rather, smithing!

(Source: Tapas)

Ha-Buk Paeng Family’s best strength, Ji-Hyuk Paeng heads to the Nakho Region to save his family that fell into destruction due to the attack of the Demon Sect, but everything was a trap. At the moment of death, he felt the wrath of being the only one left from his beloved family.

"Again…if you give me a chance…!”

Paeng Ji-Hyuk, who thought he was dead, woke up in the body of Young Master Sa, of the Paeng Family.

Sung Nam-Gung can’t hold down a job, and he’s lost yet another one after injuring artist Min-Tae Kyeon during a routine package delivery. But Sung’s in luck—Min-Tae’s been looking for a new model, and Sung has the perfect combo of gloomy personality and chiseled body. As Sung spends night after night under the hands of Min-Tae, both their families begin to suspect the other’s motives. Will the artist and his muse be able to escape the destinies their families have laid out for them?

(Source: Tapas)

Han Jungwoo (a.k.a. Kai), was always picked on for being too nice. An avid player of "MID," the world's most realistic online fantasy game, he spends his time helping those in need rather than completing quests. But when he is unexpectedly given the chance to become a Solaris Cleric, a rare hidden character class, the game actually starts to reward him for doing good deeds. With ruthless characters all around him though, can this "Mr. Nice Guy" make it as a top-tier player?

(Source: Tapas)

Yu-Eun Gam, a very capable secretary, works at IREN under the relentless CEO, Dohyeok Chae. After getting fed up with Dohyeok’s ruthless workload and cruel behavior, she buys a lottery ticket out of impulse and wins. Full of hope for her future, she hands in a letter of resignation only to be rejected.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

"Why does the Dragon King seek a rabbit?

Cheong-wan, a turtle from the Dragon King’s palace, ventures onto land to retrieve the liver of a rabbit to cure the ailing king. By sheer luck, he encounters the elusive rabbit almost immediately upon arrival. Determined to bring the rabbit back to the Underwater Kingdom, Cheong-wan is prepared to do whatever it takes.

""And how will you convince me?""
""Sorry?""
""If I go to the Dragon King's palace, what will you do for me in return, Cheong-wan?""

Cheong-wan finds himself mesmerized by the rabbit Jeok-ran's playful smile and enigmatic words. He realizes that to succeed, he must go to far lengths.

Thus begins a perilous and enchanting journey, as Cheong-wan navigates a world filled with unexpected challenges and mysterious allurements, where the stakes are as high as the depths of the Dragon King's palace."

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Young Emperor is Obsessed With Me

description:
When a royal kiss fails to wake the sleeping beauty in the forest, young Prince Cedric figures a knife to the throat should do the trick. Lucky for Ariel, she awakens from her long slumber just in time to avoid a funeral at the age of 1000. Unlucky for her, she has now become the object of the twisted prince’s obsession. Though she manages to banish him from the forest for a decade, Cedric finds his way back stronger than ever as the emperor. After setting her home ablaze, he has just one thing in mind: “Let’s get married, Ariel.”

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.romaji: Heungmang Nampyeongwaui Ihone Silpaehan Geon Gatda
title.native: 흑막 남편과의 이혼에 실패한 것 같다

description:
Ellen's plan is simple. Before turning into an obsessive villain who gets executed, she's going to get a divorce! But after she becomes Ellen Lianster, her plan gets complicated. Her new husband, Aiden, has developed a debilitating fear of being touched, and Ellen is determined to discover the cause and cure. As she finds ways to help him, an affection-deprived Aiden slowly begins to seek comfort from Ellen. With both hearts opening up to each other, can this marriage succeed... at failing?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.english: My Little Groom, Even After I'm Gone

description:
Despite being bound by a political marriage, Livenia and Heinrich form a bond and slowly become the family neither of them ever had. That is, until Livenia’s sudden death tears them apart. After being reborn into a new body, she vows to shed the cruel judgment she faced as a young duchess, but seeing Heinrich still trapped in the shadow of her death even 10 years later shakes her resolve. Will she embrace her new life or return to her former groom's side to keep the promise she once made?

(Source: Tapas)

Ever since changing his WIFI password, a strange video started playing on his TV...

"Who's that? Is my TV paired with someone else's?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

If you lived through – or are still living through – high school, you can relate to Joon-U. An outcast and a loner, his only joy comes from the hours he spends on his phone, randomly chatting with strangers. It’s all weird and meaningless, until Joon-U strikes gold – as he’s matched in a private chat with a pretty young girl his age. Jackpot! But when he discovers that this same pretty girl is actually his classmate Seong-A, things get a little too real for a guy who’s never even remotely been kissed.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Became the Duke’s Male Servant

description:
In the original story, Roselia was a maid in the duke’s household, used as a mere pawn in his schemes before being executed by the crown prince after being framed as a traitor. But this Roselia is different. The heroine, now in the body of the doomed maid from the novel and fully aware of how the story ends, is determined to change Roselia’s fate—disguising herself as a man to avoid the duke’s attention. But wait… why is she still being taken?! Somehow, Roselia still ends up in the duke’s estate—not as a maid, but as a manservant!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

he strongest in the martial world, leader of the Hojeongdan, Lee Hwan! During a mission, he battles the Heavenly Demon of the Demonic Sect, Deung Gwang-cheon, and loses consciousness... When he opens his eyes, he's at home? No... This is my childhood home? It's hard to believe, but if I really have returned to the past, this time I won't just stand by and do nothing! On the night of August 8th, when he was 17 years old, a sudden, splitting headache strikes, and something comes to mind. "Cheonsu Ilgi Hap (Thousand Hands One Energy Unification), Deukwon Gang (Obtain Original Strength)..." he muttered absentmindedly and then paused. "Wait, this is the Absolute Demonic Art of the Heavenly Demon! How do I know this technique? Am I going crazy?!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

College student Gao Xiaoliang is sent to another dimension after a car crash. To come back to life, he has to make a living as a street vendor.

(Source: WebComics)

In a world where humans and vampires coexist, a starving vampire Jess is trapped by humans and imprisoned beneath a slave camp. The warden tortures Jess, seeking a cure for his own disease, but Jess fails to heal like most vampires. Desperate, Philip locks Johan, a former doctor turned slave, underground with Jess to nurse him. As Johan works to gain Jess’s trust, he finds himself dangerously drawn to the enigmatic vampire. Sensing Johan’s feelings, Jess pretends to return them, planning his escape. But if they break free together, can they ever truly reclaim their old lives and escape this darkness?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Could love bedazzle like a gem?

For Melisa, the best gemologist in Annabel, no love can outshine a gem. She'd rather remain single and devoted to her career! But just when she thinks she has it all figured out, Duke Lewis Winterfelt, the most eligible bachelor in all the kingdom, asks for her hand in marriage — through a contract!

(Source: Manta)

As the ordinary owner of a toy workshop, Tria spent her days struggling to pay off a mountain of debt with the help of Shadie, her trusty shadow friend. Luckily for her, a mysterious, half-dead client shows up one day, offering a jaw-dropping amount of money to make an expensive toy. Despite being wary of the man and his circumstances, Tria accepts the commission. But it doesn't take long for her to realize that this dictatorial client is just one of the many tyrants that will plague her shop...

(Source: Tapas Media)

title.english: The Rogue Prince Is Secretly an Omega

description:
Prince Etienne de Frederick was born a dominant omega, but in a world where omegas can’t become the emperor, he must pretend to be a beta due to the empress’s greed. When his childhood friend, Grand Duke Rishar von Eckhart, returns after three years as a war hero, there’s no time to share a happy reunion as Rishar is a dominant alpha and his rival in the fight for the throne. The two continue to maintain a precarious relationship until, one day, Etienne has a sudden heat cycle, and Rishar finds out the truth. “Etienne de Frederick. You were... an omega?”

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Season 1 is R15 while Season 2 is R19.

title.english: I Shall Kill That Sweet Devil

description:
Chloe Garnache is an alluring trap for the emperor. After living a life full of abuse at the hands of her family, Chloe is finally freed from her torture by the grand duke, Kairos Ludwig. However, her days of getting taken advantage of are far from over. The only reason Kairos took her in is because of her beauty, which he plans to use in order to lure and kill the emperor. Chloe willingly follows Kairos’ orders, having fallen for his kind and gentle gestures.

Unfortunately, her feelings are never returned, and she is met with a pitiful death once her task is fulfilled. But just when things seem to be over, Chloe awakens to find herself back before her life came spiraling down. And this time, she won’t be swayed by the sweet words of the devilish grand duke…

(Source: Tappytoon)

"The world has ended now, so how about I try keeping human pets?"

I don't know why, but the world has come to an end. People don't hesitate to murder their friends and family as survival and desire are the only values that rule over them. All the survivors of this new world were given a single skill of their choice. Seong-Cheol, suffering from insomnia, chose the skill "sleep." Using his skill, he begins to hunt women and rape them after he puts them to sleep!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Live and die by your fists!

High school student Park Ki-Hyun is more confident in his fighting skills than anyone else. He assumed he’d naturally become the center of attention at his new school after transferring—

“Huh? Knocking someone out in one hit was my specialty, wasn’t it…?”

The result? Just one match! Facing an overwhelming opponent, Ki-Hyun’s pride is shattered, and driven by a single-minded determination to win, he eventually steps onto the mat— Hey, let’s have a match!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kang Chan dreams of becoming a boxer in a rural village! To repay the elders who raised him, he trains every day without fail. Then one day, men in black invade the village for redevelopment. They threaten the villagers, and Kang Chan steps forward, but he finds it impossible to face such a large crowd. As he sobs, berating himself for failing to protect the villagers, a person appears who will change Kang Chan's fate.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hyeon Seong-Min, who has already turned 40, looks around and becomes acutely aware of the reality that he is alone. Hyeon Seong-Min faces a crisis not only in his life but also at work and decides to struggle to find true happiness. It's not too late to reach that age.

(Source: Naver, translated)
A battle to top! Betting leads to smutty times...

Han Wol is known as one of the military’s finest young men, but… Wol is a woman! After her father was framed for the former emperor’s murder, she narrowly escaped execution by disguising herself and hiding in plain sight. Since then, the empire has been under the thumb of chief state councilor Shin, but the young emperor is hatching a plan to take back control. As the only one who holds the key to unlocking the mysteries of the past, it looks like Wol’s days of laying low are over…

(Source: Tapas)

After a painful breakup with her first love, Eunpyeong returns to campus still haunted by the past and burdened by a secret fantasy she’s afraid to reveal. When Nyeok, a younger guy, discovers her secret by chance, he responds with unexpected acceptance. Their bond deepens, but complications arise when another girl enters the picture, and Eunpyeong learns Nyeok has been denying their relationship. What will become of their romance, trust, and life on campus?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Becoming Best Friends With the Icy Male Lead

description:
After meeting a sad death as a Korean teenager in her past life, nothing could be better than being reincarnated as Livia Hote, a beloved princess of the fire kingdom. A life of only luxury and peace awaited her as the novel's supporting character. However, she eventually realizes that she must learn to control her ever-growing fire powers and she can only do so with the prince of the ice kingdom. Thus, Livia will now have to deal with new uncertainties and relationships that could disrupt her plans to live a peaceful new life…

(Source: Tappytoon)

When failed martial artist Kwak Noh is tasked with protecting a group of young orphans, he plans to send them off to good homes. However, after growing attached to the children, he decides to raise them all as disciples of the Shadowless Clan. But as times get tough, Kwak Noh is forced to journey far from home to make money, leaving Sunyu, first brother of the clan, to provide for his siblings. If Sunyu wants to step up for his clan, though, he'll need to step up his skills! Training begins now!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Big Spender in a Busted Game

description:
Though the fantasy game "Mystic World" is maddeningly difficult and money-grubbing, Luda just can't quit playing. So it's borderline traumatic when the final boss, Lucid Black, destroys her precious kingdom in the final stage. But luckily, our heroine wakes up in the beginning stage of Mystic World as her game character, Princess Luda Earl Grey. Armed with tons of S-rank items and her credit card, Luda might just have a shot at saving Milk Tea Kingdom from the deadly Lucid. And the first step in her plan... is to enroll in the same academy and befriend her worst enemy!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Mia is a young girl who lives a day without much hope. Seeing the ruby brooch displayed at the jeweler's shop, she is quickly taken away. When she comes across this accidentally brooch, her life starts to twist irreversibly...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Baek Yigang is a son of the Baek Clan, one of the seven great clans of Zhongyuan. Afflicted with the Taiyin Qi Blockage, he is cursed with a shortened lifespan and the inability to collect internal energy. He had been peacefully spending the rest of his days indoors when he was ambushed by a group of masked people. During the ambush, he lost his servant who was like a sister to him. Chased by the attackers, Baek Yigang escaped through a secret underground path. When he came across a blocked path, he decided he’d at least die fighting and picked up a rusted sword that was stuck in the ground…

(Source: Naver, edited)

Bark, bark! Yes, I aim to please and do your bidding. And I’ll certainly never bare my teeth – that is, as long as you don’t show your back. Because it’s a dog-eat-dog world out there.
