Whether you’re a judge, CEO, boss of the criminal underworld, or a nobody, it doesn’t matter. In the face of money, all are equal.

(Source: WEBTOON)

'What if women were drafted too?"

Republic of Korea today is sound and safe; all men and women are devoting one-fifth of their twenties for the country. Women are drafted just like men, and they laughs and cries just like men in their military life. Stay tuned! The story of women in the military.

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

Heo Jeong-U, a high school student who is bullied by a girl in his class for his weakness. Han Bo-Ra, a transfer student, comes to Jeong-U's class, where he was spending his miserable days. Jeong-U feels a strong sense of déjà vu when he sees the child with straight black hair and stains on his legs. Sure enough, Han Bo-Ra, who has subdued the arguing classmates, asks them, "Have you ever seen a child similar to me?" Jeong-U decides to approach Bo-Ra, who might be able to correct what is wrong...

(Source: Naver, translated)

At forty, Jeong Han-Seong finally begins the college life he’s dreamed of, enrolling as a nontraditional student after years in the corporate world. Mistaken for a professor by his much younger classmates, he struggles to find his place, until a helpful senior, Baek Cheong-Bin, steps in. With Cheong-Bin’s guidance, campus life starts to feel less overwhelming… but there’s something about the way this senior looks at him that feels anything but ordinary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Life of a Returning Officer

description:
Choi Jong-Hyeok, captain of the intellectual crime unit, loses his mother and his own life to a mysterious mastermind for digging too deeply into a case. In his last moments, Jong-Hyeok catches a glimpse of the man who kills him before waking up as his 17-year-old self. To prevent his mother's death, Jong-Hyeok swears to hunt down the one responsible. Luckily, he has knowledge about the future and his experience as an officer. But will these tools be enough to catch the criminal that eluded him once?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

He began to dance on the court.

Yu Jun, the MVP of the middle school league, was branded as the son of a criminal when his father's criminal record became public. To prove that all the ridicule, criticism, and judgments he endured as the son of a criminal were wrong, he joined the ‘Turnover League’.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"When a drug made from the blood of alphas, rumored to have an aphrodisiac effect, begins circulating widely, ace narcotics agent Jess is assigned to temporarily protect Lily, one of the world's rare dominant alphas. While begrudgingly playing babysitter to the pretty and pampered Lily, an unexpected rut strikes. “I'm just trying to save his life. There's nothing more to it.” But as the lines blur between duty and desire, Jess and Lily discover they might be the perfect match in more ways than one."

(Source: Lezhin US)

The human race plunged into a war against dragons, who have invaded the earth! At the same time, among the humans arose people with supernatural powers, called psykers. Through the countless sacrifices of psykers, the war seemed to be coming to an end with the human race as the victors. But when a psyker with the ability to see the future foretold that the dragons will be returning in 15 years, the people established Ark, a facility to train children born with psychic abilities to prepare for the last war of the human race. There are only three years remaining until the prophesized war. What will happen next?!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Every month, Suyeong’s mother receives one million won—money bound to a life-saving debt from years ago. After losing contact with the family behind it, Suyeong goes on with her life, unaware of how closely their paths will soon cross again. Transferred to a newly formed content team, she meets her new manager, Tae-eun—the same man she once saw publicly disgraced months earlier. Bound by an unspoken past and a debt neither of them chose, they keep their distance. But how long can that last?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Once a world ruled by men, women stand up and fight to become men's equal. Now, in a land that is equally divided up between man and woman, the battle of the sexes is on! Who's going to win?But more importantly...what's the name of the game?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: S-geup Hunter-neun Agyeok Gongnyeoga Doegi Silseumnida
title.native: S급 헌터는 악역 공녀가 되기 싫습니다

description:
S-class Hunter Kim Yi-Yeong can't wait to leave the novel she woke up in. She gets the chance after defeating the story's final boss, but instead of returning home, she’s sent into another novel! Yi-Yeong becomes Lady Renee Markious, a petty villainess who’s just been framed for murder. Fortunately, Yi-Yeong has a secret weapon nobody knows about… her skills from her past life! Can Yi-Yeong clear Renee's name and find her way back to her own world? Or will she be trapped in this tale for good?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

A story about how I conveyed my feelings to her through a restricted caller number. A rustic yet fresh 2000s era.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

title.english: Women at Work: Teach Me, Mommy!

description:
Sua’s biggest dream is fulfilled when she is given the chance to costar with her lifelong role model, Seo-Hyeon, in a movie. But the line between professional and personal feelings starts to blur when the two women need to shoot a steamy bedroom scene. Unable to get her act together, Sua asks Seo-Hyeon to help her practice the scene. It should be okay since it’s just acting... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.

Bom is trying to move on from her first love by focusing on work and her budding new relationship with her friend, Dongwook. But something seems... off. She can’t seem to give him her heart. When her ex, Joonyoung, suddenly comes back into her life, the cracks truly begin to show. Dongwook’s affection warps into obsession. But just as Bom starts to question how things ended up like this, a mysterious camera arrives on her doorstep with the promise of magical snapshots that will reveal the truth.

(Source: Tapas)

Won Yu-Ha, a trainee who was unfairly robbed of the chance to appear on a survival program that was expected to be a huge hit, became a 'loser'. After six years of struggling to lead the members who had no motivation, a series of scandals among the members and a sudden traffic accident resulted in him being declared ineligible for a comeback.

"If I were born again, I would never become an idol."

Just when he was about to give up on life, determined to never dream of such a life again, "Appearing on Design Your Idol. You'll give it to me, right?" He returned to six years ago when he missed the opportunity of a lifetime... ?

『Tutorial: The Crossroads of Life! Spin the Roulette and Decide Your Life!』

And what is this thing that just popped up before his eyes?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I’ve possessed the body of “Aristina Bianca Rosen,” the only daughter of the empire’s wealthiest tycoon and a woman of dazzling beauty. Just when I thought I’d be walking on a bed of roses… Of all times, I’ve been attacked by an unknown assailant right after being branded the empire’s worst villainess?! I narrowly escaped with my life, but the culprit is still out to get me. Thanks to my infamous past, there are suspects lurking everywhere… But the most dangerous of all are the three men circling around me.

The Crown Prince, who’s kind on the surface but as cold as ice on the inside, the Second Prince, who growls and bickers with me every time we meet, and even the head of the Sacred Order, who’s far too prickly and secretive to be called a saint! I tried to run as far away as possible… so why are they all so obsessed with me?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“You must be the one to reign over the world!”

With those parting words, Jin Sanwol’s fate was sealed. At just 23 years old, he becomes the head of the Jongnam Sect, once a proud and powerful clan, now reduced to only eight remaining disciples and barely clinging to survival. Once a sect that dreamed of dominating the martial world, it is now a shadow of its former glory. Yet Sanwol cannot afford to grieve or hesitate. To honor his master’s dying wish, to keep the sect alive, and to carve a new path — Jin Sanwol must step into the ruthless world of martial arts, where only the strongest survive. The battle for supremacy begins anew, and he must stake everything to reclaim his sect’s former greatness… and conquer the martial world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

U-Ju Hyeon dreams of living the ordinary life of a high school student, but his dream will never come true as he possesses special powers that others don’t have. One day, after being chased by an evil spirit, he is taken to the School of the Tiger and learns that he has a dragon orb in his body. Will U-Ju be able to protect himself and the dragon orb from evil spirits?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Yoo Seo-rin is the youngest team leader in the marketing team, and she’s headed straight for the top. Skill, looks, charm—she’s got it all and won’t slow down for anything... or anyone. Yoo Seo-rin’s love life is the only thing not going her way, especially not after her fiancé dumped her. She's sworn off men entirely, but when a handsome new rookie joins her team and makes his interest known, Yoo Seo-rin just might find herself in a man’s arms after all…

(Source: Tapas)

Dana, a Korean high school senior just days away from her college entrance exam, meets an unlucky end. Hit by the infamous "romance fantasy truck" and reborn in another world, she figures she might as well make the best out of it, but she suddenly stumbles across the Saintess's secret!

"I don't want to die, so I guess I'll keep the cat in the bag, Saintess!"

(Source: WEBTOON)

Legend has it that a man with black hair and red eyes will bring ruin to Den Helder's royal family. Because he was born with these features, Rayton is shunned by the palace as "the cursed one." When the vengeful prince stages a bloody coup detat years later, the powerless youngest princess, Setz, also dies by his sword. Little does Setz know that she's about to wake up in her body five years in the past-- but now that she has, it's her chance to get on Rayton's good side and turn her fate around. Cracking the prince's cold exterior is a challenge, but once she does, there seems to be no going back! As Rayton grows more and more attached to her, Setz is pulled deeper into the midst of the dark conspiracies brewing around the palace. Has the princess truly escaped death, or is she in more danger than ever before?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters

Do Shiyoon was the leader of a struggling K-pop boy band when he tragically died in a car accident... or so he thought! Miraculously, he wakes up in his 17-year-old body and realizes that he's gone back in time to before he debuted as an idol. Now, he is determined to make it big in K-pop. As he prepares for his re-debut, he has to avoid the pitfalls of his first life while gathering four like-minded and talented idol trainees to make a new boy band, the likes of which K-pop has never seen!

(Source: Tapas)

Yu-Ri is the perfect college student, so no one suspects she’s living a double life at night. Until Professor Baek finds out about her secret part-time job...

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

"Tae Seong-Jae... He’s the one who will take me back home."

One day, without warning, I woke up as Seo Seung-Won, a character in a BL novel given to me by my younger sister. The aftermath of being transported into this world is brutal—I’m plagued with relentless nosebleeds, bouts of coughing up blood, and unimaginable pain. I discover that staying calm lessens the torment, so I desperately try to empty my mind and maintain my composure. But as my original memories start slipping away day by day, I spiral into despair. Still, I refuse to lose hope. To escape this nightmare and return to reality, I set my sights on the novel’s ending. Following the story’s flow, I resolve to become Tae Seong-Jae’s lover, face abandonment, and eventually fake my own death—all to achieve my goal of going home.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Harrietta, the daughter of a viscount in the countryside, helplessly falls in love with Edwin, the heir to the most powerful and affluent family in the kingdom. Knowing how futile her dream is to be with him, she spends fretful nights, lacking the courage to speak to him. And then arrives the news about his engagement, which deeply breaks her heart. After much suffering, she begins to recover from the pain and pulls herself together when…“ Check his face. He’s our new slave. He’ll be living with us from today.” Edwin comes to Harrietta’s house as a slave.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Ned starts taking advice from an older girl on how to make things work with his girlfriend, but he starts getting distracted.

(Source: Toomics)

THOR's hammer, MJOLNIR has disappeared, and LOKI is the prime suspect. To return the hammer and prove his innocence, he sets out on a mission to please the beautiful goddesses of ASGARD!

(Source: DAYcomics)

When your wife is always too tired to have sex, it builds up inside. What is a man to do when his beautiful coworkers at the office seem all too eager to help him release some of that stress? But be careful what you wish for... ?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

This is the story of Namgung De-So, the youngest son of the Namgung Clan. After losing his dantian in the competition for the position of vice-patriarch, he then faces an unexpected death out of nowhere and regresses into the past…

The youngest son of the strongest clan? Such a title is way too bothersome. Let someone else become the strongest person or whatever!

Can the former trash of the clan make the most out of his second chance at life?

If you do something dirty with your childhood friend, your grades will go up?!

So-Ra, who grew up under a controlling mother, enters the Korea University Medical School as her mother wished, but she feels helpless as she falls behind her peers. Then, she accidentally sees a secret sex scene of her peers, and things start to shake up So-Ra's daily life... Suddenly, her childhood friend Chan-Hee and her mysterious senior, who is a very close friend, show up.

"This isn't the college life I thought it would be...?!!"

A cheeky and sassy love comedy that hits Sora, a freshman at Korea University♥

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

title.english: How to Clear a Dating Sim as a Side Character

description:
When Yewon opens her eyes inside Midnight, the top-ranked dating simulation game, she realizes things aren’t quite as fun when her own life is at stake without a “Load Save” option. The only way to clear Midnight is to reach a happy ending with one of the five love interests, but each route poses a different set of problems. Meeting the master of the mage’s tower will lead to almost certain death, the crown prince doesn’t even try to hide his animosity towards her, the merchant seems to be missing a few screws, and another barely speaks. The swordmaster seems relatively normal, but it turns out he’s a devout follower of the temple she’s desperately trying to escape. Will Yewon be able to capture the heart of one of these men and use her insider game knowledge to clear the game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

A girl at my new school asked me out. She's the school's strongest, Yi-Na Kim. Is this an elaborate scheme to punish me?

"Can the next challenger wait until tomorrow?"

Only the strongest girl can take me! Wait, do I not have a say in this?

(Source: DAYcomics)

After obtaining a candle with the power of hypnosis, Seon-U hypnotizes Su-A, who raised him and is like his mother. Seon-U, who had a crush on Su-A, inches his hands towards her privates…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

As part of his pre-graduation internship, culinary student Lee Eun-Seong finds himself working at a sushi restaurant, where one familiar face shows up day after day. But when Eun-Seong accidentally stumbles upon his regular’s secret, things take an unexpected turn. Jeon Ho-Yeong is determined to keep it hidden, while Eun-Seong can’t decide whether he’s annoyed… or oddly drawn in.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Lady Solea Just Wants to Go Home

description:
Lady Solea's family can't figure out how she lost her memories or why she keeps raving about her "jackpot." They don't realize she's actually Yoon Jiyoon, a lottery winner who was suddenly brought into their world! Determined to return to her reality and claim her riches, Jiyoon sets off a series of shenanigans to send herself home. Yet when Solea's family proves more fun than expected and distracts her from the mission to leave, Jiyoon begins to wonder if family is worth more than a fortune...

(Source: Tapas)

It’s a world filled with sex, sweat, and pheromones. Alphas and omegas sexually rule with betas getting what’s left. Ian Joo is a presumed alpha, who’s really an omega. Jae-Ho Ro is a dark-haired alpha. They come from proud families and were good friends until Jae-Ho abruptly leaves Korea for the U.S. Five years later, the two reunite with Jae-Ho discovering Ian’s burgeoning omega scent that’s just begging for hot bedroom fun! Will these two give in to the sexual tension heating up between them?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

The city-state of Greenpod is a divided society run by the brutal International Police. Here, money and power are king, but social status is precarious. When Mel, an undocumented slum-dweller with super strength and an invincible body, becomes set on revenge against Greenpod, she is saved by… Santa Industry package delivery service?! But these couriers are more than they seem—they’re the underground resistance. Can their motley crew convince Mel to join them in their efforts to change society?

(Source: Tapas)

One week before Laurea’s wedding, her fiancé disappears. So she marries his brother instead — a former monk sworn to God, now bound to her bed. What begins as a contractual marriage descends into nightly temptation... until Laurea learns how thoroughly her husband has forsaken his vows.

(Source: Manta)

“Could you sleep with me?” The moment Min Seolha accidentally lets that question slip to her boss, Cha Jeongmu, she believes she is done for. Yet to her surprise, her superior and crush of three years agrees, even adding on a condition that they won’t have a limit to the number of nights they spend together. And so begins the CEO and secretary’s steamy love affair after work hours. But unbeknownst to them, a shared tragic past could end up jeopardizing their already-risky romance...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Laehwa Lee lost all her childhood memories after a terrible incident, and now that she’s an adult, she’s on a mission to recover them. But some people, like her rich and powerful stepfather, will stop at nothing to keep Laehwa under control. Out of options, Laehwa hires mercenary Itae Gwon to enter into a contract marriage with her. Though Itae is her shield, he also has an intense bloodlust. Will Laehwa be able to keep her cool as sparks begin to fly?

(Source: Tapas)

Because of his fierce appearance, Kang Woo-Hyun has never had a girlfriend, let alone a proper friend. He confesses his crush to his club senior Chae Ji-Oh while drunk. Was it the aftereffects of the confession? After dreaming of a sweet night with senior Ji-Oh, he wakes up feeling good to find "Choi Ji-Ho" next to him instead of senior Ji-Oh?! Woo-Hyun thinks this is a dream, but Ji-Ho's one word shatters Woo-Hyun's hopes.

"You're the one who forced me to bed and touched me, right?"

Will Woo-Hyun be able to safely break up with his club senior Ji-Ho, who has a foul personality? A campus romance between a prickly handsome guy and a goldfish-like potato embroidery!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Geon is a personal trainer in desperate need of new clients or else he'll be fired. So when he encounters the overweight Gyu-Won decked out in designer brands, he sees it as a golden opportunity. Unfortunately, this comes at the cost of heeding Gyu-Won's request to go on a date with him once he achieves his dream body. When Gyu-Won transforms into Geon's ideal type a year later, Geon finds himself slowly drawn to him. Will Geon be able to resist the seemingly perfect younger, rich, and hot guy? Or will he succumb to temptation and fall for him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

Do-Yoon gets swept up in the heat cycle of Su-Ah, whom he has cared for and loved since they were little, enough to believe he was his own younger sibling and ends up in a relationship with him. Even though he is a beta, he wants to help Su-Ah, who is suffering from heat, but this is the first time he has been crushed by an omega... Is this really a heat cycle?

"I'll work harder because you like trash like punks."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes evelen extra chapters.

Rookie actor Yeo Jeong-Won just landed a spot on the healing reality show A Month in Europe. There’s just one problem: his ultimate celebrity crush, Kwon Hae-Woon, is his co-star! To survive the trip, Jeong-Won has two simple rules: don’t let anyone know he’s a superfan, and don't get too close to Hae-Woon. But when Hae-Woon insists on being roommates and claims they’ve met before, Jeong-Won’s "professional" act begins to crumble. Between shared rooms and constant filming, he’s one $5-a-month fan-app notification away from being outed as the world’s biggest fanboy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Emperor Yi Yeon is famous throughout the kingdom of Hochang for his outstanding political prowess and ruthless attitude towards sycophants. After relentlessly bullying his palace cleaners into fainting on the job, junior eunuch Yoo Yak-woo is called upon to fulfill the cleaning duties, which he enjoys to the point of being nicknames Sogwija, aka “the cleaning demon”. Immediately, this young, fresh-faced eunuch and his delectably juicy buttocks catch the emperor’s eye. One night, Yi yeon calls Yoo Yak-woo to his room for a very “special” cleaning service and the shenanigans begin to unfold…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Taeyi hears a familiar melody fill the empty halls and makes his way to the old music room. He knows his brother is dead, but he can’t help but hope, maybe, just maybe...it’s his brother playing his favorite song. When he slams open the door, however, he finds Seheon, the new transfer student, at the piano. Disappointment comes crashing down and Taeyi can’t control his anger. How dare Seheon play his brother’s song? How dare he smile? How dare he say he loves jazz? “If I ever catch you playing the piano again...that’ll be the end of you.” And with that begins their story, as unpredictable and visceral as jazz.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After parting ways nine years ago, Youngmin and his first love, Jihoon, have been reunited in the same homeroom class. There’s just one problem… that’s not really Jihoon. When the boys were young, a traumatic car accident landed Jihoon with an entirely new soul! To avoid suspicion, the fake Jihoon enlists his old friend’s help in fooling the rest of the world about his identity. This arrogant new guy is nothing like the old sweet, polite Jihoon… so why is Youngmin still getting butterflies?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.

Selene was fortunate to be born to her beloved mother not just once, but twice. And now that her single mother has died in her second life, Selene must face the world as an orphan... or so she thought. Before she knows it, she's swept up by a handsome stranger who turns out to be her father and the nation's emperor! Not only that, but she discovers she has three older brothers who absolutely adore her. Going from the slums to the imperial palace overnight isn't easy, however, and Selene must navigate her family dynamics, the rules of the palace, and the unbearable loneliness of missing her mother. Moreover, Selene begins to realize that there's a hidden reason why she remembers her past life so well. Will Selene be able to find closure from her past and finally mend the hole that her mother's death left in her heart?

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: This is the promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Centuries ago, Hestia was born with incredible magic, so she was the only one powerful enough to sacrifice herself to save the world from a great evil. Now, she has been reborn into a new body and retained her magic and memories from her past life. Hestia's only goal in this life is to make her sister happy. The only problem is her sister wants to marry Yanik, an immortal who's been waiting for Hestia's return. Can Hestia keep Yanik from discovering her identity so that her sister can marry him?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapters.

The best cruise in Korea invited the Yongjin Taekwondo team, which has amassed ten million views on YouTube and is growing in popularity, and boarded to perform. But what awaits them after their performance is a ?! There is still a week until the cruise gets to land. On top of the sea, where there is nowhere to go, the cruise turns into a prison where the people are locked up in an instant, and the fight to survive the zombie chase begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Eight children, each gifted with mysterious powers that could spell disaster for the world, grow up together on a remote island shrouded in a sinister and unsettling aura. What secrets are they hiding, and what future awaits them?

(Source: WEBTOON)

“Daysellers” absorb humans’ negative emotional time for sustenance. A story of daysellers delving deep into the minds of humans!

(Source: Lalatoon)

Wonwoo and I have been living together for the last ten years. We've also been dating for just a few months shy of ten years. Apparently, we were a fairly lovey-dovey couple when we first got together, but things are different now. These days, we fight more than we laugh, and our hearts rage with anger instead of racing with excitement. But any couple that's lived together through thick and thin for this long would say the same thing, right? That's why this is a story about the most ordinary relationship.

(Source: Tapas)

Former High School friends turned roommates, Ah-Young Jing and University arts student Nara Kwon have developed a close yet ambiguous relationship. What course will their desires and uncertainties take after Ah-Young Jing asks Nara Kwon about "Friendship Night"?

Shunned as the weird kid at school, Han Siha wakes up one morning to find he is not quite himself anymore. Instead, a former vet intern who died from overworking has taken over Siha's body! But this story isn't like the novel he read in the "real world." With status windows popping up, feisty dragon partners, and classmates meant to be his future enemies, Siha is unsure if his skills are up to snuff. Will this mage make it to graduation? Or will he find that this story has an abrupt ending?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Wolf Who Stole the Sun

description:
Golden Toldran is the wealthiest realm on the continent. Princess Charlotte, after years of religious devotion, is thrust into a public courtship she never desired. When Skadi, a singular suitor from the distant land of Nuanar, enters her life, boredom gives way to something far more dangerous.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

In a world that brands Espers as monsters, B-class Esper Seung-Won keeps his head down, until a false accusation from a chaebol heir ruins him. Suspended from duty and desperate to support his family, he accepts a job guarding Cha Jin-Ho, an untouchable S-class Guide from the same privileged world he hates. Cold and dismissive, Jin-Ho refuses even the slightest touch - until a clash between them triggers an unexpected contact guidance, a resonance that leaves them both shaken. Bound by a reluctant contract, the two are forced together, and Seung-Won begins to dream of a man who looks just like Jin-Ho, calling his name from another lifetime ago…

(Source: Lezhin US)

I am a wanderer martial artist. I don’t shy away from blood, but I’m ready to retire. Should I take one last job? or not? For many long years, he has roamed as a wandering martial artist's, living as a hired blade to make ends meet. But now, he finds himself utterly penniless, living in poverty with nothing to his name. As a master of martial arts at the peak level, he makes a decision, to take on one final, high-stakes mission, earn a fortune, and put an end to his life as a wanderer. The story follows his journey as he takes on this last assignment and the unexpected twists that unfold along the way.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Amarion grew up in a kingdom beset by monsters and took up the sword when she was just 10. Years later, the king introduces her as the kingdom's strongest knight to Victor Mort, a grand duke from a neighboring empire said to have no equal in battle. Impressed, he proposes to her immediately, which she accepts to receive aid for her people. After the marriage, though, she finds herself with a strange task: taking up a sword and subduing her husband as he sleepwalks. Can she fulfill her duties and help her new husband find peace from his trauma?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Cheon Yu-Hyeon is so close to inheriting the family business when his ailing father presents one condition: he needs to give his father a grandchild. It shouldn’t be too hard for an omega like Yu-Hyeon, as long as he can find himself a suitable alpha that isn’t his childhood friend and company rival Lee Hyeon-Do. But Hyeon-Do has been suffering a decade-long crush on Yu-Hyeon and desperately wants to be his baby daddy. And Yu-Hyeon is finding it harder to resist his friend’s flirty tactics to get him in bed...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Bom Yun is a shy and overworked high school ethics teacher who’s assigned to the most avoided class at Shinsu High School. The cause of its reputation is Jae-Gyu Seon, a confrontational guardian who terrifies the faculty. Yet as Bom gets to know him, she discovers a devoted uncle with an unexpectedly tender heart. Though Bom tries to keep her distance when Jae-Gyu openly pursues her, she soon finds herself hopelessly falling for this quirky but charming giant of a man.

(Source: WEBTOON)

I-Tae Jung, a Beta, suddenly finds himself being pursued by Dan Ge-Um, a rich and famous Alpha from his school. They say an Alpha can never truly be attracted to a Beta, but considering the strange offers Dan keeps making to get closer to I-Tae… Is it just a hormonal malfunction, or could it be real love?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 24 side story chapters.

title.english: I’m a Villainess with a Handsome Husband

description:
Newlywed life isn't so great for the heroine who wakes up as Lamaine, the villainess in the novel "The Blue Flower at the Duke's Estate." Although Lamaine's husband, Cedric, is handsome enough to make her nose bleed, he is unfortunately in love with the novel's female protagonist and despises Lamaine. But Cedric must stay married until he inherits the family title, and promises Lamaine a future divorce and hefty alimony in return for her cooperation. Meanwhile, Lamaine uses her skills as a doctor from her previous life to help people around the estate, blissfully unaware that Cedric's frigid attitude toward her is changing...

(Source: Tappytoon)

My teacher Seo-A, whom I first met at Aunt Jia and Uncle Deok-Sin's wedding. I never confessed to her, but I think she is the woman of my destiny... and now she's getting married?!

Now that I'm an adult... if I was the same age as her, would everything be different?

(Source: Toptoon, translated)

Latde, a member of a near-extinct God Tribe called The Hwan Tribe, is being raised in the hands of the Carnivore Tribe on the remote Carnivore Island, far away from the mainland. The Hwan Tribe members being raised on the island are sent away to the Hwan Continent upon reaching adulthood, and Latde’s older brother Latz has already left the island to live a new life in their homeland. But as Latde nears adulthood, the secret of the island is revealed, plunging it into turmoil.

(Source: WEBTOON)

John's wife and her best friend are up to no good... What is their secret past, and what are they trying to do with John...?

(Source: Toomics)

As the toughest fighter in the world of crime, Gijun claims victory in a battle that ends the long power struggle between Seoul's gangs. But when his brother Giseok rises in rank within the enemy group, Gijun decides to slash his own heel and leave the business to avoid fighting him. Just when all seems at peace 15 years later, Giseok is mysteriously ambushed and killed in cold blood right before his own retirement. Filled with a chilly rage, Gijun sets off on a one-man hunt to track down everyone involved in his brother's death. And he has a feeling he doesn't need to look far to find the main culprit... With revenge and old gang rivalries factoring into the equation, Seoul's underbelly is in for yet another grisly bloodbath!

(Source: Tappytoon)
Jeanne, a prostitute at address 74, took care of the fallen Janet. Jeanne wants to be friends with Janet, but Janet tries to get information out of her.

I accidentally got possessed while working overtime! And it was in a game that was scheduled to be scrapped after being deemed harmful by the review committee. Now, in order to return home, I had to raise my ‘ability’ and become a hero. But the method to raise that ability was…

“Ability can be obtained every time you seduce a man with a ‘strategy card’. To be exact, it’s based on semen absorption.”

She had discovered a new aptitude. One that she couldn’t find anywhere, at school or work. Its name was semen absorption.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: The Cup of Vengeance Is in Your Hands

description:
Princess Eudith’s story begins when her cruel brother, the king, sells her off to the neighboring kingdom to marry the queen’s powerless stepson, Prince Franz. Eudith becomes a pawn in the queen’s plot to discredit Franz and place her biological son, Krald, on the throne. Desperate, Eudith attempts to end her misery but wakes up on the day of her fateful journey. Armed with knowledge and experience from her past life, Eudith seizes the chance for revenge by helping Prince Franz take his rightful place on the throne. Will Eudith succeed in her revenge and find happiness?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Blooming Violet in the Back Garden

description:
Timid orphan Violet discovers she's the empire's new saint destined to destroy the evil Malum. Unfortunately, she's surrounded by scornful nobles and the power-hungry emperor and pope. Alone, friendless, and overwhelmed, she finds solace in Ethelmund, heir of House Ermengart, who vows to protect her until the end. Can this fragile wildflower find her footing in the thorny and dangerous world of politics and betrayal? And will she be able to fulfill her destiny with only Ethelmund by her side?

(Source: Tapas)

Yun-Jae Park thought his relationship with his girlfriend, Ji-Eun, was perfect--until one shocking morning changed everything. Ji-Eun has mysteriously transformed into a man overnight! Can the two adjust to this sudden and earth-shattering change? And will Ji-Eun ever turn back to who she once was?!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

Every night, a man comes to Seyeon’s dreams, but who is he? Four years after losing five months of her memory, Seyeon is haunted by a faceless man who appears strong, tender, and intoxicatingly passionate. Who is this man who visits her every night? Is he her lost lover? The father of her child? Or just a stranger? How far will she go to uncover the truth?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sergeant ‘Bucky’, a war hero belonging to the ‘Empire of the Sun’. He serves as an example to the imperial soldiers through his loyal loyalty to the emperor and his excellent martial arts, but in fact, his ultimate goal is to take revenge on the emperor by causing the downfall of the empire. Can Bucky achieve revenge against a massive empire?

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I am a Knight of Latem, destiny that cannot stand under the same sky as you."

The body that came into the book and became possessed was Karina Apocalita, a member of a heterogeneous race that reigned as evil in the world.

But in the original story, the heroine Paladin Ren, who was the first love of, almost saved the life of the novel, the content of the novel began to twist. Reneger doubted his faith, and eventually lost his brilliant white blonde hair.

So the holy paladin became corrupted and eventually sympathizes with Karina's fate.

“Now we have each other's desires," Karina said, stroking his cheek. It felt like a seductive thorn vine was pulling me in, one by one. Reneger couldn't cut it down.
“God, please forgive me."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A child born to become a shaman with the fate of putting the world in chaos. To let go of his greed and refuse god, he's trying to become an ordinary office worker. Choi Yeonghoon, the one who can see destiny through physiognomy (face fortune reading) and fortune telling. Will he succeed in becoming an ordinary office worker?

(Source: Naver, translated)

“The Change” brought dungeons filled with monsters into the world, altering reality forever. Pro-gamer Jin Jung-Do, whose lifelong dream was to be a hero like the Mana Users who fight in these dungeons, is crushed when he discovers his own abilities are useless. Just then, the “real universe” gives him a set of skills that allow him to draw information from the future and heroes from the past! Now all that’s left is for him to barrel through this game of luck and become the strongest hunter ever!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: You Are Obsessing Over the Wrong Person, Lord of the Tower!

description:
A bad fall awakened Selina Elsner to the truth… she’s been reborn into a novel! It also gave her a cruel realization—she’s a no-name side character! She barely even had any lines! As if that’s not bad enough, Louis Bloomberg, the evil lord of the magic tower, fancies her! He’s a sorcerer so powerful that his magic speaks darkness in his mind! But one touch from Selina and all the voices would go away! Is that why he’s obsessing over her instead of the real main character of the novel?

(Source: Tapas)

Reborn into the life of a maid in a novel, Betty has one goal: to live a quiet and unassuming life. Unfortunately for her, at the end of the original novel Duke Janus ends up annihilating the world. Now, Betty must try to change the story and escape from the duke, who is growing ever more obsessed with her.

(Source: Manta)

After being reborn as a desolate fire witch and villain destined to die a tragic death, Chersinia creates a plan to avoid her fate by gambling at a casino to become a wealthy recluse. The only problem? She somehow ends up with a slave boy named Ben instead of the money she needs! But much to her surprise, she starts to warm up to Ben, who provides the perfect joy and comfort in her lonely life. Little does she know that Ben has a dark secret that will change her life forever...

(Source: Tapas)

Soo-Jung hates romance—she’d rather spend her nights fangirling in her room. When a noisy neighbor is tests her patience she goes upstairs ready to fight, but the last person she expected is the scandalous celebrity she's supposed to hate. Love and hate, different sides of the same coin. Which will win?

(Source: Manta)

As the talented leader of the ESG team at Soya Group., Minsu always leaves work on time. However, his work life takes a dramatic turn when the daughter of the chairman joins his team. The ESG team gets entangled in the power struggle between the higher-ups, and Minsu’s overqualified abilities put his team in the eye of the storm. Can Minsu protect his off-hours from all this corporate chaos?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Writing My Male Lead's Happily Ever After

description:
A madman with a tragic childhood and a disease that brings on insanity, destined to fall obsessively in love with the saintess of the holy nation… This was the male lead of the melodramatic novel I wrote. He is also the very person who kills Laria Sherwood, the villainess I possessed, and whom I must stay away from to survive… or so I thought, until I saw the terrible reality I created. I suppose, as the author, it wouldn’t hurt to teach him how to love, then leave right when the female lead appears, right? But will it be as easy as I thought?

(Source: Tapas)

Jae-In is a typical middle school girl obsessed with beauty and makeup and wishes to become a makeup artist. One day, she finds a mysterious lipstick by chance, which leads to the opening of a mysterious portal that warps her to a different dimension. When she wakes up the next moment, she realizes she has become a princess of a different world! Stuck in this mysterious world, will Jae-In be able to find a way out? Or better yet, will she be able to pursue her passion for beauty and live the life she could never live before?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Kwon Yeong has been rejected by Yun Jeyeong six times, each dismissal wrapped in gibberish that he can't make out. But the real problem isn't just the heartbreak; it's that every time he's rejected, he's transported back to the first day of the new semester when he first met Jeyeong. Stuck in this endless cycle, Yeong's confessions always take him back to square one. Frustrated and fed up, Yeong declares, ""I'm not gonna like you anymore! Never again!"" Just when Yeong decides to give up, the loop restarts. But this time, something begins to change in their relationship.

Dive into the mysterious and heartwarming journey of ""Love on a Loop,"" where every reset brings new possibilities for love and self-discovery.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prolouge and two side story chapters.

Doctor Hong Gye-Dong has mysterious eyes that can see people's threads of life. Actually, Hong Gye-Dong is a woman. One day, due to unavoidable circumstances, she ends up getting caught while shifting a drink bill to a man she thought was a scholar. Entangled with a dangerous man whose thread of life she can't even see, Hong Gye-Dong enters the medical clinic of the royal family.

But as it turns out, the man Hong Gye-Dong thought was a common scholar is actually the King.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

title.english: The Heavenly Demon Doesn't Want to Level Up

description:
Goryeo prince Jin Yuseong is a martial arts hero, but after losing his comrades, his loneliness drives him to walk through the palace's magic gate for a fresh start. Arriving in modern-day Seoul, he becomes an unexpected hero in a gate break mission, drawing the attention of the Safe Gate organization, who protect civilians from the gates. Eager to escape recruitment into SG, Yuseong disguises as the high school nephew of a former comrade, but will this be enough to outrun his fighter past?

(Source: Tapas)

Thirty-year-old Tae-Gyu Lee has been drifting through life, numb and unable to feel the highs and lows of emotion. Everything changes when a mysterious old man gives him the power to copy other people’s feelings through a strange spirit flame. But what begins as an unusual new ability soon pulls Tae-Gyu into the orbit of drama writer In-Ho Gwak , sending his life in a direction he never expected. As his world begins to shift, Tae-Gyu finds himself stepping toward an entirely new path as an actor.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Kim Se Myung, a medical student from a humble background, ends up tutoring in a rural area during the summer vacation through the introduction of his girlfriend. There, he encounters a beautiful mother, a housemaid, and even a doll-like girl… Overwhelmed by their beauty, he is approached by an enchanting girl who says,

“Teacher, do you want to have sex with our mom?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Dan Eun-oh is an aspiring artist, and he's struggling to make ends meet. His lifeline and arch-nemesis all in one? Baek Joohyuk, the rich jerk who he grew up with. It doesn't help that the two of them go to the same university, and more often than not Joohyuk asks for sexual favors that Eun-oh ends up complying with. One day for their art club meeting ("full of jerks like Joohyuk," Eun-oh would say), Joohyuk asks—or rather, commands that Eun-oh hire a model for their nude sketches. Now, the quiet and buff model guy sure seems inexperienced and out of his depth, but even without so many words, it's evident that he seems intrigued by Eun-oh, or "Mr. Art Student," he calls him...

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world on the brink of extinction due to an alien invasion, Han Oreum, who continues her life as a soldier while raising her daughter Goo Cho-rok alone, is attacked by a strange creature during a civilian rescue operation. She hurriedly evacuated her daughter and tge survivors and fought the monstrous creature, but what was waiting for her after coming back alive is the corpse of her brutally murdered child.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I reincarnated as the wife of a cursed archduke in my own twisted novel. As the author, I took responsibility and set things right by lifting the curse, which was the key to returning home. I thought my job was done, and just when I was finally trying to go back, the archduke asked me, "Did you really think I wouldn't know that you’re planning on returning to your fiance?".

He had completely misunderstood!

"Whether you like it or not, I'm still your husband. I'm never letting you go back to that bastard."

All I want is for him to please let me go home!

Hari is your average quiet girl who got assigned the bubbly Yeonju as a roommate, and somehow they became best friends. But just before Hari can tell her about her crush on a charming senior named Jinho, Yeonju says it first—and that they’re dating! After years of watching from the sidelines, Hari finally gets over him, but now he’s chasing after her... With no time for romance, Hari agrees to a blind date to get rid of Jinho. Who knew her blind date had an unrequited love of his own?

(Source: Tapas)

In the second half of the 2nd century, Naru, a warrior from the state of Koryo, was sold as a gladiator-slave to the Roman Empire and waged a desperate struggle for freedom.

(Source: Naver, translated)

When it comes to employment, Jinwon’s suffered a string of bad luck. So at 29 years old, he’s unemployed and studying again. Lucky for him, his sister’s just married into an elite (read: super rich) family, and she’s offered him part-time work as a housekeeper for her husband’s son. The job pays well, and the hours give him time to study. But it isn’t long before Jinwon discovers that this arrangement with his nephew will involve more than just housekeeping...

(Source: Lezhin)

As the White Dragon succumbs to the warrior’s blade, it makes a final wish: to exact its revenge on the warrior, whom it had begun to consider its only friend. When the White Dragon next opens its eyes, it’s to find out that it’s been reborn...as a child. Not any child, but the warrior’s only daughter! The White Dragon, now known as Mir, has to adjust to being doted on daily until a certain incident breaks her newfound peace. Whisked away from her family, Mir is ordered to become the wife of a tyrant, but she won’t follow orders without a fight. After all, Mir may have the body of a weak and feeble human, but she’s still the strongest of all dragons at heart.The world's strongest white dragon... becomes the tyrant's wife?

(Source: Lezhin)

Haeyo can’t help herself - she gets aroused whenever, wherever. Whether she’s on her way home, in the gym, or in a bar, she’s ready to entice anyone who’s brave enough to accept her advances. Equipped with a sultry stare, she woos unsuspecting targets who can't say no after getting a glimpse of what she has to offer. Well... Are you ready to get tempted?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Kim Gun, a late-night snack deliveryman preparing for the high school graduation exam. One day he goes to the wrong address, and there he encounters a woman who is believed to be a vampire.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Former thug Choi Mun-hyeok will do anything to protect his younger siblings. When he’s defeated in an underground fight club and sold in an auction to Seo Yeonjin, he reluctantly allows himself to be put on a leash for his family’s sake. Yeon-jin, on the other hand, doesn’t care much for family. In fact, he intends to cause a scandal that will outrage his billionaire father by embarking on a twisted, carnal affair with Mun-hyeok. All Mun-hyeok needs to do is serve Yeonjin well, in work and in bed. However, their passionate encounters might turn into something greater than they bargained for. After all, the line between passion and madness is a thin one….

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Broke college student Ji-Ho is determined to win the grand cash prize on the TV show "The King of Home Cooking," where culinary mastery alone isn't enough to become popular with the audience voters. After a wild night of research, he concludes that faking a gay relationship with another contestant is the surest way to victory. The handsome and good-natured Woo-Hyuk could be the perfect partner -- but the instant he hears Ji-Ho's plan, Woo-Hyuk turns into a complete jerk! The two somehow agree to team up, but will their rocky "ship" be enough to beat the other attention-hungry contestants?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Just as your birth did not inspire me, so your death won't mean anything to me.

Jaina reincarnated as a supporting character who was born as mixed blood of human-dragon and died miserably after being neglected. She is branded as an unclean entity and was abandoned by the dragons.

And the first time she met her father, the lord of the tower, Diamide, he just looked at her coldly, as though he didn't feel any sense of intimacy to his daughter as described in the original.

"Is that the one you called my daughter?"

Jaina flinched as he approached and lowered her sight.

"Blue eyes... but that's not a proof that she's my daughter. You could have brought me a child born with another human."

And so he went back leaving her alone and Jaina was living in the shabby warehouse of the tower.

Rather than making vain efforts to get into the eyes of his father, the lord of the tower, she decided to have a small luxury that she had never experienced even in her previous life before her death.

"You don't have to think of me as your daughter. I won't call you father either."

"..."

"Tower's lord?"

So is the father, who should've been indifferent, starting to get obsessed? Father, can you just leave me alone?

I didn't think much of the creepy girl in class, but who would have thought...

(Source: Toomics, edited)

When I opened my eyes, the first thing I realized is that I am not a living person. Who am I? Why am I wandering around this place? And who is that man who visits my grave every week?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Nothing went the way I wanted it to in my life, until... she gave her everything to me!

(Source: Toomics)

The best part of being a driver's ed instructor is the one night stands with my students. Until I met someone I couldn't have and it turns out she's my friend's wife...

(Source: Toptoon)

For as long as Olga can remember, she's dreamed of setting sail and chasing down the hidden treasure that her father always told her about. But after her father and older brother go missing at sea, that dream seems like it too will be lost forever. That is, until pirates charge into her quiet English village, turning everything upside down! Now with a rag-tag team of sailors, can Olga finally unravel the mysteries of her family's disappearance and discover the treasure she always dreamed of?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kang Pado is a boy who accompanies his father on their countryside farm; raising cattle, fruits, and vegetables for a living. At the same time, he is studying at the not-so-nearby high school which, traveled by land, is 10km away. However, Pado’s father unwittingly mentions to him a shortcut using the river, shortening the distance to only 3km. Being an obedient kid, he takes his father’s advice and swims every day back and forth to the school whenever he has classes.

However, circumstances occur when, due to a lack of students in their high school, the administration shuts it down, leaving Kang Pado no choice but to go to Seoul, where his sister lives. There he will continue his high school studies and deal with what Seoul High School Life has to offer!

Note: Winner of the SPP 2018 Webtoon Awards.

Two young girls at a renowned boarding school depend on and despise each other for the attention they both desperately want—and the love they cannot sustain. Every rose has its thorns, each dazzling flame burns in this period thriller set in turn of the century Seoul, during Japan’s colonial occupation of Korea.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Praised solely on her looks for years, Lia was eager to put everything behind her and start anew… Until she got kidnapped and tossed into the harem of an unknown ruler. Desperate and afraid, Lia makes a deal with Karian, the handsome yet ruthless regent to the king, who seems strangely drawn to her. Will Lia be able to keep up appearances as Karian’s concubine long enough to search for the hidden assassin in their midst? And once she does, will that be the very leverage she’ll need to make her escape?

(Source: Tappytoon)

While Kayle is on the run and initiating a fake divorce from his wife, his friend agrees to take care of the poor woman...

(Source: Toomics)

One fateful snowy evening, Yi-hyun lays his eyes on Serin, noticing her potential as an actress. While he has ambitious plans to catapult her into stardom, Serin can't help but hide her growing feelings for him - until one day, she decides to act on it. Drowning in her newfound pleasures and fears, Serin is faced with the single most important question that keeps pricking at her heart... Does he love her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: The Director Who Buys Me Dinner

description:
Reincarnated a 4th time after accidentally naming a child of god, which is a sin, then falling in love with them, Min Yu Tan does not remember his 1st life & failing his 2nd & 3rd life of capturing the person he loves. Will he be able to succeed in his 4th life now that the person he loves is now a man?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yoon Yu-No is a small-time money launderer with a huge problem: he can’t seem to escape the sexual advances of his client Vasily Ivanovich Kaminsky, a handsome yet deadly Russian mafia boss. Yu-No is terrified of Kaminsky and determined to escape from him, but his attraction to the other man complicates matters. Will Yu-No be able to resist Kaminsky’s overtures and save himself? Or will he be devoured by Kaminsky’s unrelenting obsession?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After getting a divorce, Jordyn slowly starts getting involved in the gay community with the help of Owen, his first gay friend.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

I fell in love with my friend's dad. One night, I gathered my courage and went into his room.

"Do you not see me as a woman?"

(Source: Toomics)
The moment I looked Death in the eye, I made a contract with the Lord of the Underworld.

An enormous fortune, a beautiful sprawling estate, and five adoring male maids... what more could a gal wish for? Yeon-Hwa Lee is living out every girl's fantasy when she suddenly inherits her grandfather's estate, including his five loyal servants. Bom and Yeong-Ho are so cute and adorable, Alexander is buff and sexy, while Won-Hu and Edward are elegant and cool. Their only desire is to service their mistress... and Yeon-Hwa simply can't resist.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue and 11 extra chapters.

My wife died in an accident.
But when I finally go back to teach...
she comes back to me as my student?!

(Source: Toomics)

Naeyeon wanders in the forest with her memories lost and is approached by Dongcheol who tries to assault her. Naeyeon successfully escapes and is reunited with her husband  Kitae, but with her memories still a mess.

An aspiring cartoonist decides to become an adult cartoonist's assistant... but little did he know he'd fall in love with his teacher's wife.

(Source: Toomics)

My wife’s identical twin moved into our house. But she’s a little naughty… Is the one seducing me my wife or my wife’s sister?!

(Source: Toomics)

As a couple starts to get distant from each other, they get offered to join their company's secret club.

(Source: Toomics)

Joy, an art teacher, has difficulty finding any solace in her life. She has never been at ease with her neighborhood, her family, or her job, and is always packed up and ready to go somewhere, but is always held back by life.

Things start switching around with the appearance of an old crush, Aerie, who was the first breath of fresh air in her otherwise smothering life.

Baby steps for the both of them, as they discover the value of companionship, proper relationships, and ultimately, a way to a truly Joyful Life!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

His girlfriend disappeared after leaving a sex video. But his girlfriend was returned in front of his house. What has happened to her in the meantime, living with his girlfriend who returned with a screw missing in her head?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

As a young college student, Jiwon just wants to play video games, study, and...secretly date an older woman who already has a boyfriend?! Nobody knows about the affair, until an attractive upperclassmen named Yuhyeon catches them. He asks Jiwon on a date to keep it secret but, one night becomes much more…

(Source: Tapas)

I was never able to fit into any type of group... but life just got so much better after choosing to become a low life.

(Source: Toomics)

Catherine Caliburn, a duke’s daughter marked by tainted blood, desperately tries to end her engagement to Grand Duke Deimos Pendragon to keep her true origins a secret, but the Grand Duke has no intention of letting her go as he seeks revenge for her betrayal in his past life.

(Source: Manta)

Duke Bifolten, the man whose gaze alone is said to freeze anyone’s entire body. Ilyin has a prophetic dream about spending her first night with him. Because she was shunned by everyone in the mansion for her prophetic dreams, Ilyin rarely ever stepped foot outside. To think she would spend her wedding night with Duke Bifolten, a man she’s never even seen. But is Duke Bifolten really such a dangerous person? ‘He was definitely kind that night.’ Why is Duke Bifolten—the man who rules over winter with his Authority and whose sword is faster than his words—gentle only with me?

“If you see what I look like, you will never be able to leave this castle again, Ilyin.” I just wanted to escape that house, but now, the Master of Winter is obsessed with me.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Min, who can see ghosts. And Ju-Hui, who was Min’s best friend since childhood. Min never saw ghosts when she was with Ju-Hui, and thanks to that, she grew up leading a normal life, but Ju-Hui passed away at a young age in a mysterious accident. Min was certain that was the case... but in high school, she reunites with Ju-Hui, who is very much alive. However, the Ju-Hui Min knew is nowhere to be found, and this Ju-Hui feels strangely different.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Being an orphan, Vanessa never imagines that she'll attend the prestigious Vamburgh Academy. But when a mysterious sponsor spots her magic talent from afar, he sends her there on the sole condition that she write him letters about her school life. And so, the chatty Vanessa picks up her pen to tell him everything, from trying to get along with the rich students to battling the mountain of schoolwork and the rogue monster on campus! As her sponsor's kind replies get her through the hard times and make her happy moments stronger, Vanessa's curiosity about her secret benefactor only grows...

(Source: Tappytoon)

When the youngest sister of the Yu family ends her own life, her elder brother begins to investigate her untimely death. The only clue left behind is the record of her messages on Savior -- a mysterious online community for those who need salvation from reality.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Eun Woo’s never been one for attention. She’s kept her head low in the palace ever since she first arrived, and all she’s focused on is doing a good job. Her peaceful life is broken, however, when the prince calls her to his bedroom. Lee Hyun is known for never having the same maid in his chambers twice, but Eun Woo keeps lingering on his mind. A story about a lonely prince and a lovely maid—will love make the prince’s wild eyes lose their sharp edge?

(Source: Lezhin US)

It’s Ye-eun’s 32nd birthday, but she’s not feeling too great. After her lingerie line went out of business, she's been forced to move back to her hometown, a place she thought she’d left for good. Luckily, her best friend knows just the thing to cheer her up: a big, shiny, limited edition dildo. Ye-eun “breaks it in” that night, but wakes up the next morning sans dildo. All she's left with are fragments of a hot night of S&M and the muffled moans of a stranger… Who could the mystery man be?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The gentle dance of snowflakes as they fall to the ground. Sparkling lights twinkling in the frigid night air. Couples holding hands and sharing in joyous laughter. While most people anticipate the Christmas season, for Noel Alan Brown it is nothing but an inevitable annual annoyance. Making his way through the gaudy streets of New York in pursuit of some semblance of enjoyment, he arrives at a club and meets Lee June: mysterious, seductive, and utterly irresistible. But after a night of intensely playful passion, June is nowhere to be seen…leaving nothing but another reason to add to Noel's Christmas hate list. Returning his focus to a crucial upcoming presentation, Noel tries his best to erase the alluring June from his mind to no avail. Luckily for him, he’ll have a chance to see his disappearing lover again - because June is working for the competition! Tensions won’t be the only thing rising as the two go at it in both the board room and the bedroom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Believing Duke Aion to be indifferent and uninterested in her, Jasmine tries to get over her longtime crush on him through some dating and fun. But when she ends up in his arms due to a few too many drinks, she wakes up in bed next to the duke after a steamy night together! While thinking this one night will let her get over her first love, the duke suddenly seems to be reciprocating her feelings. Was Duke Aion interested all along? Jasmine will have to see if this romance was meant to bloom!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue.

At the hospital where I sought treatment for insomnia, an arrogant female doctor caught my attention. Unexpectedly, I pressed a button I hadn’t used in a long time, and the arrogant female doctor suddenly changed her attitude, spread her legs, and asked me to treat her…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Eunha is heartbroken when she finds out her high school sweetheart, Siyeon, used an elixir to make her fall in love. When the two reunite 10 years later at a business meeting, Siyeon asks for a second chance. But before they can talk things out and rebuild their trust, greater magical forces interfere.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The end is in sight! With three months left till graduation, Muyoung is on the high-school home straight. And it’s gone pretty well! He’s student body president, gets good grades, and has never strayed from the straight and narrow. Then out of the blue, the mysterious transfer student, Chanhee, confesses his feelings to him! Muyoung is so taken aback that he barely manages to turn him down… But with 92 days left until graduation, there’s still plenty of time for love to blossom!

(Source: Lezhin)

Seon-Woong's just trying to make a buck, so why is the guy buying his guitar so clingy? He doesn't remember the steamy night they spent together two years ago, and he doesn't know why a celebrity athlete like Jae-Hwan Cheon won't stop following him around! All Seon-Woong knows is he's got hospital bills to pay, possessions to sell, and an infinite cycle of part-time gigs to work. He doesn't have time to fall in love with Team Korea's handsome taekwondo darling!

(Source: Tapas)

Gang-In Na is the manager of a rookie girl group. One day, after clearing all the stages of an adult idol game, the girl group members he’s in charge of become characters in the game he completed…? A status message appears before his eyes, blending reality and the game.

[You need to have sex with the members in order to get the rewards!]

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

When he opened his eyes, he had a knife in hand and there was a female corpse lying next to him. He couldn't remember anything, who he was, why he was there, and why he had superpowers. In a panic, he could only try to avoid police pursuit and investigate the matter in private. But when he came face to face with the truth, he didn't know what he should do anymore...

(Source: QQ, translated)

Note: Series co-produced by Kenaz (South Korea) and Tencent (China). It was released a day earlier in Korea, so it will figure as a South Korean series in AniList.

Bo-Eun has recently acquired a furry little roommate named Dallae (Korean for azalea), who she met in an azalea field. Dallae has her own schedule, though, and comes and goes as she pleases. Meanwhile, Bo-Eun can’t seem to stop dreaming about a missed friendship in high school – her name is Sae-Yeon. Oddly enough, it was around the time that Dallae started showing up that Bo-Eun started having recurring dreams of Sae-Yeon...

This story has two (or is it three?) main characters, and they’re all hiding a secret from each other.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Won the 3rd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest.

​​Urania was just a lowly maid until she captured the attention of King Kraus III and became his concubine. The nobles and the other maids, however, despised their love and dragged Urania down. Heartbroken and at her wit’s end, she was ready to accept her death, but then a mysterious entity returns her to her past when she is still a maid. With her second chance at life, Urania is determined to become the king’s concubine once more, but this all changes when she meets Oscar, who pushes her to aspire for greater things…

(Source: Tapas)

"Women should only cry in bed."

Be it the orthodox faction, the unorthodox faction, or a member of the imperial family, the lustful demon, Cheon Ji-Jong, fucked them all until he was killed during the Demonic Cult Extermination. However, 10 years after the incident, the lustful demon returns and vows to fuck every woman in the Murim!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Drunk as a skunk, transfer student Moon Yeon-Su stumbles home and accidentally enters the apartment below his only to find the door code matches his. There, he witnesses his department teaching assistant, Yun Do-Ah, and his classmate, Hong Yi-Jae, in the act. The night passes amid this shocking scene, and the next day, Yeon-Su belatedly realizes his misdeed...

"... What the hell? Isn't that the pervert from yesterday?"

But unable to forget the pleasure of that night, Yeon-Su encounters the pair again, and thus begins his chaotic, lewd college life!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I caught a terrible summer cold. It's a sweltering summer, in a dorm without air conditioning. Why does my fever get worse even after taking fever reducers?

(Source: Twitter, translated)

Note: Part of the 2022 Summer GL Post Type Anthology ([GL] 2022 포스타입 앤솔로지ㅣ여름).

After the sudden suicide of his mother, Kwon Hee-seo has lived his life searching for answers. Taken in by an abusive foster family, he is left asking himself the same questions over and over again: What was the inciting incident that caused his mother to take her life? Who was the mysterious man that saved his? And could he be the same esoteric benefactor that has been shrouded in secrecy, supporting Hee-seo from behind the scenes? Unmoored like a tree without roots and desperate for answers, Hee-seo sets his family’s home ablaze in hopes of drawing the man out from the shadows. But this reckless attempt for a semblance of clarity in his life may lead Hee-seo to more than he bargained for… Can a tree without roots grow to reach the sun? Or is it destined to wither away in the absence of light?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeomin Chae has been living in the shadow of her stepsister, Nari Chae, ever since they were kids. One day, Seungjae, Yeomin's ex-boyfriend, tells her that he’s marrying Nari out of the blue. After being betrayed by the person she trusted most, she runs into Hwan Yun, who is the grandson of Taeju Group’s chairman. Frustrated with her life, she suggests to Hwan that he marry her. As the two decide to get married, what exciting events and struggles will they encounter?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: I Have to Sleep with a Stranger?

description:
Do-Hyun Nam, a college student, gets put in a snowy white space with a stranger. Then a beautiful goddess appears with a mirror filled with screaming people. Still confused, the two hear shocking words from the goddess.

"Only you can save these people. Please have sex now!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

I only went out for nothing more than a routine collection, and a mage's mistake turned me into something no bigger than the palm of a hand! Instead of offering a way to reverse the spell, the mage makes an outrageous suggestion, "Why don’t we sell you to Froix, the kingdom’s greatest collector, pretending you’re a fairy?" And just like that, I was forced into an unwanted 'fairy life'. But the infamous collector... why is he so handsome? A nerve-racking cohabitation where Hermy's identity could be exposed at any moment, his gaze warm, yet undeniably dangerous. Can she survive in a body this small? Or will she, before she realizes it, become become Froix’s most treasured possession?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

As far as anyone can tell, Jae-Hee is a shy, hard-working high school teacher. Once she's behind closed doors and drawn curtains, Jae-Hee enjoys spending her time kneeling at the end of a whip. And no one enjoys holding the handle more than her childhood friend, Hui-Lin. But when Sul-Hwa starts her position as a student-teacher at the school, secrets and feelings long buried start to surface. Now, Jae-Hee's about to learn just how much pleasure she can pull from pain.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Deoksun Kim, a 111-year-old mogul, built a thriving food empire, but her one regret was never experiencing true love. Miraculously reincarnated as 25-year-old Dohui, she sets out to fulfill her dying wish—only to be betrayed by her lover and lose everything. Fueled by vengeance, she soon faces an impossible ultimatum: fall in love within 111 days or suffer eternal torment in Hell. With time running out, will Deoksun seek revenge or take another chance at love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

"It's you. The woman who ate me and ran away."

Isabel, who had been secretly chasing Agares, unconsciously drew closer to him. As if in a dream, as she had always hoped, Agares' tongue delved into her lips. After the miraculous night of their contact, I thought I would never recognize him again...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

"I curse you, Enrique."

The powerful demon who ruled Hell was dead, and she awoke as the terminally ill wife of her ex-husband, now emperor.

"To return as a demon, love a human man and plunge a dagger into his heart."

With the fate of having to experience that dog-like love once again.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

After botching a job interview, a man climbs a mountain to end it all, only to wake up in a world of half-human, half-animal creatures. Caught between disbelief and temptation, he must navigate this strange new reality.

(Source: Toomics)

"I want to live a simple life."

Do-Hui wants to live as she always has, and her co-worker Dong-I likes to be alone. They have no intention of dating anyone in their workplace... Or do they? We invite you to the intimacy of two people who keep encountering each other.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Yu Eunha is the unfortunate heroine of the erotic BDSM novel The Demon’s Vivace, where she endures daily beatings from the male leads. Her miserable existence seems never-ending—until the author suddenly announces an indefinite hiatus. Desperate to keep her story going, Eunha decides to take matters into her own hands: if the male leads won't continue to torment her, she’ll make them suffer instead. But when the Demon King, who’s supposed to be her cruel master, refuses to harm her, Eunha flips the script and embarks on a mission to train him into the perfect sadistic lord. Can she turn this reluctant villain into the ruthless master she needs, or will her twisted plan backfire spectacularly?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lee Robin and Nam Hangyul were childhood friends. They haven’t seen each other since elementary school; but when they both get accepted to the same university, their mothers suggest they become roommates, offering a seemingly perfect solution. However, Hangyul, who discovered his true sexual orientation due to Robin's influence in their childhood, worries about potential awkwardness. To his surprise, when Hangyul opens up about being gay, Robin is unfazed. Determined to keep his feelings for Robin a secret, Hangyul establishes ground rules for their living arrangement. Unfortunately, Robin remains oblivious to the underlying emotions, unable to comprehend why his new roommate seems distant and guarded. Will this "abnormal" situation eventually blossom into something more beautiful?

(SSource: Lezhin US)

Mong-Ryong, a brilliant and stunningly handsome secret royal inspector in Joseon, is sent on his first mission with full confidence. But his destination? None other than Namwon, a region plagued by the notorious pervert governor, Byeon Hakdo.

While trying to expose corruption, Mong-Ryong finds himself in serious trouble—he’s about to be forced into serving the lustful governor. Just when things look dire, a strapping local official, I-Bang, catches his eye.Thinking quickly (and a bit shamelessly), Mong-Ryong grabs I-Bang and declares,

“Take responsibility! You’re the one who made me like this!”

If he’s going to fall into a man’s arms, he figures, he might as well choose the better-looking one.

What starts as a scheme to escape danger soon spirals into chaos, confusion, and unexpected sparks. Will this rookie inspector survive Namwon’s corruption… or lose his heart in the process?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"Do it for me!"

So-In Han, a gloomy and awkward virgin, suddenly finds himself back in his college days. But now he's got one outrageous new power: the moment he pleads for it, no woman can say no. Surrounded by gorgeous women, his long-buried desires start to boil over, and nothing's stopping him from indulging every last one.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

A quiet rural village. Alec, a handsome transfer student from the city, spots So-Ho, shunned by everyone for "shooing away even forest monsters." Alec, who was trying to unravel his own hidden, twisted complexes toward So-Ho, is overcome by an inexplicable emotion the moment he meets So-Ho's eyes behind his glasses. The forest he and So-Ho went to escape his father becomes their private nest.

"You will become my monster."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: Do It for the Fans, Not Me!

description:
For Yoo Jae-Min, debuting as an idol is everything, but his skills are outshined in particular by Jung Woo-Hyung. The other boy's laid-back attitude, especially toward their fans, irks Jae-Min, but their dynamic shifts when they become roommates and Woo-Hyung starts noticing cute sides to Jae-Min that he hadn't before. The fans notice this change and Jae-Min focuses all his attention on them and their love, which bothers Woo-Hyung. Will their group, 4ever, hit it big, or will Woo-Hyung and Jae-Min's tumultuous relationship lead to its downfall?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ban Su-Ho, a guard who died after failing to protect the Princess from the assassins! Back in time two years through an unknown force! “This time, I must…” Determined to protect the Princess he sets out in search of the sealed power to become stronger. Will he be able to protect the Princess?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

title.english: I Became a Sitter for the Obsessive Villains

description:
When Meia realizes she’s woken up in the story “The Flower of Shakir,” she immediately busts out of the temple and runs for her life. After all, she has no intention of becoming the side character who is sacrificed just for the sake of the male protagonist! But during her grand escape, Meia runs into Duke Rakha Aintia, the story’s villain, and his two younger siblings. In an unexpected turn of events, Meia is hired as the twins’ sitter, but she also happens to attract the duke’s attention due to something magical in her touch...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Recently, rumors have been circulating that the nuns are being seduced by the demon. Isabella, who has been living a devout life of faith, has never had difficulty maintaining her chastity until she became a nun, so she considers those who are swayed by the demon’s temptation foolish. However, the demon notices the desire hidden deep inside Isabella. That night, Isabella’s fellow nun Marianne suddenly comes to visit and confesses her feelings and kisses Isabella. Isabella, for some reason, cannot push Marianne away…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

“My body is good, right? Its not because you like me…”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Summer Anthology (2023 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

During a mission gone wrong, Yeon Yoo’s subordinate Ryoong is infected with the zombie virus — but he’s… different. He doesn’t hunger for flesh. He doesn’t turn mindless. The only thing he seems to be craving is... Yeon. If he’s not a zombie, then what could he have possibly turned into?

(Source: Manta)

Cheongyeon female prison is full of lustful, evil people. Woo-Jin works as a guard here, and he meets her, a girls as fragile as a flower...

(Source: DAYcomics)

"You need to learn to share with others."

My father made me sponsor a child since I was student. However, I had no idea it was not an ordinary donation, and that's how I met this really pretty girl.

"Are you my sponsor?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Omega Taekwondo star Tae-Hyun must find a “partner” before his final Olympics to help control his hormone levels. That partner is none other than Se-Jin, a fencer he took care of 4 years ago. As their relationship continues to develop in unexpected ways, can he break his jinx and finally win gold?

(Source: Manta)
