Errand service owner Wu Hyeon-Do never expected his first love to walk back into his life, especially not like this. Seong Su arrives clutching a flyer for a suspicious cult, claiming his dead son might still be alive. Reeling from the sudden mention of a child he never knew about, Hyeon-Do assumes Seong Su must have moved on and built a family after he left the island. But the truth is far more shocking than he could have realized...

(Source: Lezhin US)

After spending the night with Zion, a girl from a cult, Hageon finds himself worshiped as the cult’s Messiah—and he fully embraces it.

(Source: Toomics)

After losing his memories in an accident, Eun Jo transfers to a new school, convinced he's a model student—quiet, kind, and hardworking. But when he sees his classmate Bom being bullied, something in him snaps. His instincts take over—and so do his fists. As Eun rises against the school’s cruel hierarchy, he starts to wonder: Who was he before? And why does Bom feel so familiar? Packed with school drama, mystery, and unexpected fists, this is the story of a “good student” who may not be so good after all.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Junwoo, a hikikomori, passes his days alone, nestled within the darkness of his room that protects him from the outside world. The one strand of light capable of piercing his world is Hanbit, his neighbor and love interest. But when Hanbit leaves to study abroad, Junwoo is forced to take on a roommate to make ends meet. Could this break to his routine be the very thing that Junwoo needs to free himself of his darkness?

(Source: Lezhin)

Lee Jung had it all. A handsome young man from a prestigious family, it seemed inevitable that he would live and die as a successful nobleman. However, life is full of the unexpected. When his father is suddenly condemned as a traitor, his good name gets sullied and he is forced to become a slave. Full of contempt for the family he now belongs to, Jung tries to seek revenge by hurting the daughter of the house, Seo Yi-Soo. Little does he know that she has many, many ways of "punishing" him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hwan, a college student, is introduced to a part time job of babysitting.
To his surprise, Nabi, his employer, makes a move on him on his first night of work.
He is even more surprised when Nabi seems to casually brush off this encounter and signs him on for work.

So begins a peculiar working environment, as Hwan starts to care for Yoojoo, Nabi's son, and things get more personal and complicated between Hwan and Nabi

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

Calliope Rustichel’s family dies one by one in a series of tragedies. Just when she had given up all hope, a mysterious woman grants Calliope a second chance at life. Little did she know that chance would literally start from birth! Now stuck as an adult in a baby’s body, Calliope must uncover the conspiracy behind the death of her family and use her memories of the past to change the future… all while learning how to walk and talk! Who said being a baby was all naps and diaper changes?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

I woke up one day to find a world where male and female values of chastity were reversed... From married women asking for penetration with cash in hand, to college girls offering their virginities... Am I in heaven. My fuck journey is officially about to kick off!

"Who, the...? I've never seen such shamelessness..."

(Source: DAYcomics)

Oh Seung-Pyo has always been at the top of his class, but once he enters high school, his spot gets stolen by Ryu Jae-Min. No matter how hard Seung-Pyo tries, he can't seem to reclaim his place and is stuck in second. For the first time in his life, he develops an inferiority complex and, without realizing it, he starts keeping an eye on Jae-Min. One rainy day, the two accidentally swap phones. Though it seemed like a minor accident, what Seung-Pyo discovers on Jae-Min's phone leaves him in shock, complicating their relationship beyond expectation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Humanity’s once peaceful world was turned upside down when monsters suddenly emerged from a portal in the sky. When all hope was lost, special people with powerful abilities called “attributes” appeared—they called themselves Hunters. To survive, humanity turned to education, creating academies to produce the best Hunters. Though his attribute is low-level, Yusung Shin is determined to rise to the top of Gaon Academy—the best Hunter Academy in the world.

(Source: Tapas)

One hundred years after mosquitoes have evolved into the strongest predators on Earth, only 5,000 humans remain. Mankind’s last hope -- an elite team of special soldiers -- races to save the day. Will they obtain the secret research that may give humanity a fighting chance against the mosquitoes before it's too late?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

I thought I lost everything to my best friend, Valietta, but I didn’t expect I’d lose my husband to her as well. I, Sierra Brilloxen, was too naive to see that her copying me wasn’t affection—it was obsession. I shattered and decided to end it all. But somehow, I was given a second chance—seven years in the past. This time, I won’t let her get rid of me. I’ll take back everything she stole and show her no mercy for the pain she caused.

(Source: Tapas)

Code Name: Silver Rings, a top corporate spy, is given the high-stakes mission of retrieving the password to a vault containing the design for a groundbreaking quantum computer. The only problem? His target, the vault’s owner, has lost his memory in a car accident. Desperate, he infiltrates the man’s home, pretending to be his lover...only to discover that the password is hidden within the body of the target’s brother, Cha Won-Woo! As he searches for clues beneath Won-Woo’s clothes, tension builds, with Won-Woo growing increasingly suspicious. What begins as a cat-and-mouse game of seduction turns into a battle of trust and repressed emotions. In the end, will this intrepid mission end with a kiss...or a bullet?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hong Yoon is on the brink of death after a sudden motorcycle accident when he comes face to face with Lee Tae-Shin, a grim reaper from the underworld. Yoon pleads desperately for his life, but Tae-Shin responds with cold indifference—until he realizes that Yoon is the one person he once helped out of genuine compassion in a past encounter. Bound by that rare act of grace, Tae-Shin reluctantly postpones Yoon’s death. To justify this decision, Tae-Shin appoints Yoon as his temporary assistant. But the role comes with a heavy price: Yoon must regularly transfer yang energy to Tae-Shin through intimate physical contact. Though hesitant, Yoon agrees, knowing it's the only way to survive.

As the line between duty and desire blurs, both man and reaper are forced to confront their past, their bond, and the strange pull growing between them in the space between life and death.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Mok Hwi-Young, a prominent merchant of the Central Plains, is killed in an attack by the Demon Sect one day. Just as he believes he has died, he finds himself transported back to his childhood—some thirty years earlier—when he was training as a lay disciple at the Wudang Sect. Then, a mysterious bamboo tablet appears before Hwi-Young, offering to buy and sell martial arts talents...

What will Mok Hwi-Young be able to accomplish now that he has returned to the Wudang Sect?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shin is barely making ends meet, hustling as a rogue mechanic on the mean city streets. Problem is, work never comes easy and the dough is nothing to shout about. But when Jake pulls up with car trouble one day, it’s obvious that there’s money to be made: he’s tall, blond and dressed like a million bucks. Jackpot. And after such a handsome payday, Shin is reluctant to let this sucker go. Little does he know that giving Jake his number may be the biggest mistake he’s ever made. And it isn’t long before Jake wants more than his car fixing…

(Source: Lezhin US)

For eleven years, Sayeh has resided in the sultan’s harem, staying out of sight and doing her best to avoid attracting any attention. All that changes when one night, she happens across the sultan’s path and is called to his bedchamber… But just when all seems lost for Sayeh, news of a sudden revolt by the ninth prince, Kainer, rocks the palace. Under Kainer’s rule, all the other women are set free from the harem, and Sayeh hopes that her freedom may finally be within reach as well. Instead, the newly crowned sultan pays her a personal visit, expressing feelings for Sayeh that she never could've imagined. But does Kainer’s love offer her salvation or ruin…?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: A Second Chance for the Outcast Prince

description:
In a nation where alphas and omegas hold all the power, being born as a beta is a terrible fate for Prince Renato El Fleuret. His life is a string of tragedies leading to a cruel end… until he is reawoken in the past! Determined to make the most of this second chance at life, Renato enlists the help of Kalid, a prince from a neighboring kingdom with a complicated backstory of his own. Together, they must do everything in their power to fight for their own happily-ever-after…

(Source: Tappytoon)

The hunter known as one of the Five Heroes, Choi Kang-Ho, lost his precious partner at the end of the Great War. Left behind after his partner's death was an egg. He held that egg close to his heart and vanished from the eyes of people...

Exactly thirty years later, at 00:00 on January 1st, Seol-Ah was born from his partner's egg. And ominous signs reappear. To protect peace and raise Seol-Ah well, the absolute ruler of Cheorwon begins modern life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I Thought My Time Was Up!

description:
Feeling a little under the weather, Lariette Blanche visits Doctor Zakascoff only to find out that she has an extremely rare congenital disease, and only three months left to live. Though devastated at first, Lariette decides to write up a bucket list of everything she wants to do before she dies. However, little did she know that the diagnosis was actually wrong! With so many changes implemented in her life already, what will Lariette do moving forward? Will she return to her previous life, or continue living the new one, full of adventures she had never imagined before?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

The third season of Our Paradise.

Mae-Hwa and Jae-Won are living out their days as a couple to the fullest, and this includes getting steamy and intimate together. But their happy ending isn’t here just yet as challenges are always bound to arise in relationships, especially more so after all the hesitation and misunderstandings the two college boys have been through. Meanwhile, their friends, Yeo-Nan and Dal-Guk, are dealing with their own secret love affair. Tensions rise between them as they slowly take things one step further...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

"Kill me, as you promised."

When her twin sister Leyla, the Holy Maiden, suddenly disappears one day, the ordinary Elena finds herself having to marry Crown Prince Kyle, a man infamous for his ruthlessness, in her stead. After a dreadful marriage ceremony, Kyle demands that a certain promise be fulfilled, to Elena’s confusion.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Aura of a Genius Actor

description:
Struggling actor Yu-Myeong Shin has spent the last 15 years of his life trying to make it big, but has always failed to. After a devastating cancer diagnosis, he’s drowning his sorrows when a Yeon-Gwi, an acting ghost, appears and offers to send him back in time and with an added boost of life energy to start his career over. Yu-Myeong leaps at the chance and becomes a college student once more, running into Ryu-Shin Seo, his one-time rival. But this time, Yu-Myeong has the acting chops to back him up, and even Ryu-Shin will have to acknowledge him!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

When Baek Hayul wakes up in a foreign world as Duchess Aila Rinehart, she knows she has to escape. Her husband, Duke Claude Rinehart, is the antagonist of the story, “Prince, My Prince,” who gets executed for plotting a revolt against the crown. Hayul has no intention of dying alongside her new husband and demands a divorce. But when Claude turns down her repeated requests to end their marriage, she has no choice but to propose a deal. She gives Claude one month to win her love and change her mind, something she is determined to resist with all her strength, but her time with Claude leaves her feeling suspicious, restless, and uncertain. Will Claude be able to win Hayul over, or will they ultimately part ways?

(Source: TappyToon)

After a tragic accident, Seo Jihoon suffers a horrible injury that mars his face. With his dreams of being an actor seemingly dashed, he spends his time working in a small shop while imagining another life. But when he chances upon a spirit who heals his injury, Jihoon is given a golden opportunity to chase his goal once again. The road to stardom won’t be easy, but with the help of his special guide and some unique friends he meets along the way, he’s going to give one “spirited” performance!

(Source: Tapas)

Rookie hospital cook Jeong-Dong always wished he could do more for the patients who ate his food. But he never imagined the Roman goddess Ceres would answer his prayers, or that she'd name him her priest on earth! Now, Jeong-Dong's noble new mission is to bless people with his cooking and gather enough good karma to restore Ceres's powers. As he works miracles with his dishes, he's more inspired than ever in his journey to become a world-reknowned chef. What's troubling, though, is that the goddess won't tell him why she needs all the power she can get. Meanwhile, a mysterious enemy inches ever closer to the duo... will Jeong-Dong's cooking and Ceres' divine powers be enough to brave the storm that lies ahead?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Du-Sik is in a bind. After making off with the takings from the gay bar where he worked, he seeks refuge in a small, coastal town. As his funds dwindle, he desperately needs a way to make ends meet. Still, a boy’s gotta eat! So he dives into a clam house to satisfy his cravings. But with no money to pay, he dashes off leaving Ju-Ha, the server, to foot the bill. Later on, when Du-Sik returns to pay his debt, he’s greeted by a sordid scene that offers a tantalizing glimpse of the solution to his money problems. For within Ju-Ha's beautiful shell lies a secret treasure waiting to be drawn out. And Du-Sik is just the man to do it.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes 22 extra chapters.

title.english: The Huntress and Her Love Prey

description:
Aria, a wild huntress who spent her entire life in the forest, encounters a handsome stranger in her cabin. Who is this intruder and where did he come from? What began as curiosity turns into attention, friendship, and more.
Gradually learning the true identity of this stranger, she enters a whole new world she never knew existed. Aria is already the best huntress in town, but will she able to capture the heart of her new prey? What adventures await in this new world of hers?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Mr. Kim, a broke guy in his 40's, suddenly wins the lottery and decides to go get what he's always wanted first...

(Source: Toomics)

A new mobile game called Arcana Fantasy is all the rage across the globe. But here’s the game’s big secret: once a player decides to join the game, they’re unwittingly transported into a virtual world and trapped there until somebody beats the boss to clear the game. Yoon started the game to find his missing father, but now he’s in much more trouble than he bargained for. Will Yoon and his companions be able to find his father and escape from the blurred reality of this virtual imprisonment?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Winner of the Excellence Award in Lezhin's 4th World Comic Competition.

If anyone’s looking for proof that two people can have casual sex and stay friends, look no further than Choi Eui-hyun and Jung Min. First classmates, and now co-workers, the secret ingredient to this 9-year relationship may just be Min’s unique preferences in bed. As someone who has never needed a safe word for anything in his life, Eui-hyun often struggles with Min’s overwhelming demands. Min, on the other hand, sometimes feels frustrated by how much convincing Eui-hyun needs to get kinky with him. But they’ve already lasted nine years, so what’s nine more…right? Or will their differences ultimately drive them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A shy returning student who loves caring for flowers, Hyunwoo has a condition that makes him pass out in the presence of excessive stimuli. For example, he nearly fainted at a bar recently because of some freshman who’d doused himself in cologne. Thankfully, he got some fresh air in time, as well as a glimpse of that same freshman making out with another guy. Hyunwoo doesn’t think much of it, but a few days later, he’s overwhelmed by the same dizzying yet irresistible scent. But this time, he’s not at a bar—he’s at a flower-themed cafe, to interview for a job he desperately wants and needs. What will Hyunwoo find in this garden of memories?

(Source: Lezhin)

By anyone’s standards, Minhyeok is a good egg: he’s a reliable coworker, a faithful fiancé… a real stand up guy! The future looks rosy until one day he’s unceremoniously dumped by his future wife. As his dreams of domestic bliss go up in flames, Minhyeok goes off the rails. Strange thing is, his new devil-may-care attitude goes down extremely well with the ladies. And there are plenty of stunners around him who have been biding their time, waiting to pounce. Soon enough, Minhyeok learns that when the chips are down, you gotta rise to the occasion!

(Source: Lezhin US)

On the day I was betrothed to the Crown Prince, I witnessed my father and the Empress in a compromising position. For my mother’s sake, I tried to pretend I hadn’t seen anything and endure it. But after my mother discovered the truth and took her own life, all that was left for me was revenge. To deal with these madmen, don’t I have to become a madwoman myself?

“Your Royal Highness, the Crown Prince, will you marry me?”

The day before the wedding, to take revenge on the Empress and my father, I proposed to my fiancé’s half-brother.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

What’s important in living life is dopamine! With no social skills, shut-in loser Shin Jangseok wishes for the world to be rebooted…

“Ah ~ isn’t there a world where everything works with just one dick...”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.english: May as Well Get the Best Ending

description:
Avid BL lover Min Kirin attends a game expo to get some new BL games, but there are disappointingly few there. He nearly goes home empty-handed, but a mysterious, hooded man gives him a free copy of a VR BL game. Kirin is suspicious of the man and game, especially given the negative reviews, but he can't resist its mature rating and logs in just to be transported into that world! He needs to earn money and that's how he meets the various romanceable characters. Will Kirin find love with one of them and return to reality, or will he be unable to pick just one virtual hottie?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Since the old days, mystical creatures have existed to help humans. However, now that the times have changed, they suddenly receive a warning from their god: "Prove that you are still needed."

While grappling with how they can assist humans in the modern era, these creatures decide to send their younglings to the human world to seek answers.

Meanwhile, university student Park Geu-Ru, who lives his miserable days commuting for five hours to school due to a sudden move, accidentally ends up making a bet with the goblin Si-Han...

This is a story about the daily life of these young mystical creatures, exploring the human world in order to avoid their own extinction.

(Source: Kakaopape, translated)

I am inside the body of my friend. Now everything you own is mine, including your girlfriend!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Fresh out of the military, he learns his “innocent” girlfriend’s been playing him all along—and sleeping around, even with his tormentor. With the help of his childhood friend, he plots revenge to expose her true face.

(Source: Toomics)

Go Jun-Han is a punk, but he's smart. He's good at pretending to be a good person, and he doesn't get caught for his bad deeds. Despite his unfortunate family background, he seemed to have found a way to survive and become a successful influencer. Until he escaped a hit-and-run accident and met his annoying classmate from school, Shin Ha-Bin.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes one extra.

title.english: A Winter Cabin of Serenity and Insanity

description:
Roelle’s life has been nothing but tragic at the hands of her abusive family. But the worst tragedy of all occurs when she kills her cousin after he tries to take advantage of her. In order to avoid being put to death for the murder, Roelle runs away deep into the winter forest, where she encounters the lone Kayden in his cabin. When Kayden allows Roelle to stay with him for a while, the hopeless cold quickly turns into passionate heat. Will this cabin become Roelle’s haven? Or will it be the start of a new hell?

(Source: Tappytoon)

"Six months... Just six months, and it'll all be over."

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hyeok-Ju is finally done with his high school, waitlisted for a college he applied. A strange girl comes into his life asking him to give up his waitlist in exchange for sex. Like any other man, Hyeok-Ju is intrigued by the offer and makes a choice that no one saw it coming.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Shuelina has only ever wanted to be loved as she grew up in an orphanage. But after her birth father rejected her in a previous life, she tries to find a family who will accept her in this one. Luckily, Archduke Bylot and his sons fall for her indomitable spirit, and they shower her with the love she has longed for. But once they find out she's the long-lost imperial princess, can she be a part of their family? Or will she have to go back to the people who sent her away in the first place?

(Source: Tapas)

After being dumped by his boyfriend of 10 years, Jooyeong starts fresh at the only place that will hire him: a failing academy full of flunking students. When the director asks him to go on a show called "The King of Home Cooking" and promote the academy, Jooyeong dutifully agrees. What he doesn't expect is to run into Jonghan, the show's producer and his high school classmate who was much more than a friend. Their chance encounter sparks a heated fling behind the scenes, but all the while, the unresolved tension between them lingers like a ghost from the past...

(Source: Tappytoon)

"I wish you were my boyfriend instead."

After returning to college following his mandatory military service, Seong Junhui quickly becomes the center of attention on campus thanks to his good looks. Though he has no shortage of admirers, he finds himself tangled in a reckless affair with Suyeon, a bold and persistent girl who pursues him despite already having a boyfriend. But just as their secret meetings continue, someone new catches Junhui’s eye… Can these hidden rendezvous ever turn into something more? Or will they remain nothing more than fleeting moments of passion?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A plan that was supposed to freak out Yeongwoon's horrible neighbor might change the dynamics of Yeongwoon's relationships with everyone!

(Source: Toomics)

When Rienne transfers to the elite Alena Academy, she never expects Karcion, the most popular mage in school, to recruit her into his club... and she definitely doesn't think he'll fall for her! But the grumpy Karcion soon makes it clear how much he adores her, and she starts finding him too cute to ignore. Still, he's a future duke and she's a commoner, so Rienne knows his feelings won't last. Can Karcion magic his way out of the friendzone? Or will Rienne prove they're just friends after all?

(Source: Tapas)

After being abandoned as a baby and losing the one person he could call family, Sawol finds himself all alone in the world. He spends his lonely days at his tattoo shop, where he illegally has been taking on name removal jobs, a “name” being a mark on a person’s body that indicates their soulmate. Despite claiming he is now done working on names, a gangster called Seong Wonjae insists he be his last client. But unbeknownst to Sawol, Wonjae’s true intention is to find out why his name throbbed intensely the moment he laid eyes on the tattoo artist...

(Source: Tappytoon)

You can have everything else, but not him!

When Anita's long-lost older sister Arabella finally turns up after 19 years, their parents are overjoyed and begin to shower her with the love and attention Anita never received. But when they try to take away her best friend and fiancé, Axion, Anita finally puts her foot down. She's had enough.

(Source: Manta)

"I can dominate whoever I want?"

Ju-Won is a grad school student who everyone in the lab looks down on. But when he and Ye-Rim hear a certain sound wave that's been turned on without his knowing...

"I'm sorry... Please forgive me!"

After that day, Ju-Won starts taming arrogant bitches.

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: Daily Life of a Demon Dad

description:
Will, the only survivor of the demons, meets Ellie, a fragile human girl who has no one to rely on. No matter how you look at it, the two make a strange pair, but they become the most precious family to each other.

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

title.english: If You Can Hear My Song

description:
A great escape from an island town!

Two girls living different lives find their paths cross on an island—Seo-Ra, a transfer student from Seoul, and Ba-Da, an islander who's never left the island. One thing they have in common is the desire to get away, which leads them to join forces in an escape plan from the island.

(Source: Manta, edited)

How do you keep from falling asleep during math class? Well, fall in love with your teacher of course! That’s exactly what’s happened to the school stud, Subin. He’s a guy who could have any girl he wants but Ms. Lee is the one he’s after. However, because of a big misunderstanding, he’s suddenly expelled from school and that seems to be the end of that. But years later, pulled by both guilt and curiosity, Ms. Lee finds Subin once again. She wants to make things right and finally get closure on the past. But seeing each other in person again seems to reignite a spark within them... Will what was once forbidden become the start of something steamy…?

(Source: Lezhin X)

"It seems I must kill you, Your Grace."

Inas has always been Duke Nigel Montestein's most faithful knight. But when Nigel is betrayed and killed by Inas, he wakes up a year before his supposed death. Nigel's quick to realize this isn't a mere case of time travel however, and the only one who has answers is the man who betrayed him!

(Source: Manta)

“I didn’t follow you, you came next to me.”

Ian Gloucester, a paladin of the religious country 'Derwin', secretly traces the source of the rumor for Cardinal Heron, who took him away when he was a child, when rumors of preparations for war in 'Arcaia', a great country with a peace treaty, circulate. Meanwhile, Ian realizes that human trafficking is secretly rampant in his country when runs into 'Sol', who has the same special powers as him. Ian instinctively senses that Sol is a danger to him and tries to avoid it, but the more he does, the more he unintentionally becomes involved with Sol.

Meanwhile, Ian notices that the real purpose of the King of Arcaia's recruitment of special knights is to find someone, not to prepare for war as rumored...

(Source: Tappytoon)

The last thing Lady Rivera wants to do is marry the crown prince of the Lacrima Empire, Ranke Sol Reggenatore. The problem is that his nasty temper and frigid manners have already chased off every other young lady eligible for the title of crown princess! The only way she'll get out of this marriage is by making the icy prince cry and collecting his magical "tears of blessing." And to make matters worse, a tragic event in Ranke's past forced him to lock his emotions away deep within his heart, leaving Rivera with a seemingly impossible mission on her hands. Now, as she spends more time with him, she's realizing that there's more to him than meets the eye... Can Rivera break down this perpetually dry-eyed prince without getting her own feelings involved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Don't Hire My Brother, Your Highness!

description:
I had my share of working overtime for an evil employer. It’s no surprise that I died from it! But as if being reborn as Irene Werber, a minor character in a romance novel, wasn’t shocking enough, it turns out that my kind older brother is destined to work for the world’s most evil superior, Crown Prince Ervin Manuel Terence! It’s up to me to stop my brother from being exploited! The only problem is… I don’t even know what this prince looks like!

(Source: Tapas)

Sistina had a nice, quiet life, flying around on her broomstick and delivering delicious bread. But when the emperor dies, this unassuming witch learns she’s his granddaughter and now she’s tasked with running the empire! With all the tips and tricks she’s learned through her bakery, she's starting to get a taste of how to get it all done… but she still has to figure out her destiny as a witch, and then there’s this knight she can’t figure out, too! Will she find a recipe for success to take care of the empire, her fate, and maybe even her love life?

(Source: Tapas)

One month after dating, the maze suddenly disappeared. Hyo-eun has been waiting for him, believing that he will return the maze that has disappeared without a word. Why did you leave by yourself? Hyo-eun is in a maze, wandering looking for the answer. The broken cell phone left behind by Labyrinth, there is something in it. Hyo-eun pledges not to return for a long time and leaves the house following the traces of the maze.

title.english: How to Be the Chosen One

description:
Cho Sun-won finds his life boring and tedious. Sex is the only thing he isn’t sick of, but it’s getting a little too easy to talk any guy into bed. He wants a new life, a new world, and a new challenge…and he totally gets all of those when he’s summoned into another world as the so-called god of Abroria! Awesome, right? Except, nobody seems to fall for his bedroom talk, and there’s a sexy king hell-bent on exposing Sun-won as a fraud. Seducing the gorgeous men around him without blowing his cover is going to be quite the divine challenge. Can Cho Sun-won actually become the Chosen One?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jin-Hyuk is a model student. Studious. Hardworking. He can’t wait till the day he has his own place and his own car. He knows that the only way he can achieve his dreams is to go to a top-tier university. He’s fine with his repetitive daily routine of school and studying. That is, until one day, while taking a shortcut through a rougher neighborhood, he sees a kid that looks familiar. That kid… they’re in the same homeroom together, aren’t they? But he’s not the kind of person Jin-Hyuk would get mixed up with. He’s the kind of person that grows up to be a lowlife. Jin-Hyuk was raised better than that. But… that kid, what’s his name… Hee-Chan was it? He’s getting beat up by his dad. No, just keep walking. He should have nothing to do with Hee-Chan, but something seems to keep making their paths cross…

This feeling of ennui that Jin-Hyuk has, is Hee-Chan what he needs to shake it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Left paralyzed after a brutal beating, Lee Gwak masters the ultimate somatic art that restores his body. No longer content with mediocracy, he vows to rise beyond an ordinary martial artist and become a true warrior.

(Source: Toomics)

I'm having an affair with my brother's wife. And a girl who I once had a crush on, actually likes my brother. I'm also living with three hot sisters-in-law that make my love life even more complicated.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Some wounds are slow to heal. Giran’s been alone ever since his grandmother died, and he has no intention of letting anyone into his life. But one day, out of nowhere, he meets an exceptionally pretty face…who’s also exceptionally good in bed. This one-night fling turns into something more when Giran finds out that his meeting with Seon-gyeong was more than just a coincidence. The two have similar pasts that are stained with painful losses. Trauma can be all-consuming, but every walk through life is made better with someone by your side.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: The chapter count follows that of Ridibooks and includes a prologue.

A desolate town thought a new chemical facility would bring economic revival but instead chaos breaks loose after a gas leak. It causes a mysterious and toxic fog to consume the town, leaving behind a trail of death and mutation. The fearful townspeople begin their fight to survive while the government tries to hide the truth behind the event.

(Source: Spottoon)

“You want your phone back? Be my girlfriend!”
“Why!”
“Because I want it!”
“Then for how long?”
“Till the day before my birthday~”
But which birthday? Nobody knows.

(Source: MangaToon)

"Cold-hearted." That was the word Lee Eun-Young always used to describe her mother. But after her mother's passing, Eun-Young discovers a diary that shows her things she never even knew about the woman who raised her. Reading the entries allows Eun-Young to continue to feel her mother's presence and resolve their complicated relationship, but as the remaining pages dwindle and the visions that kept her company begin to fade, she's forced to face her new reality and say her final farewell.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.
One day, in the middle of summer, it suddenly starts to snow. What sort of changes will the snow bring?

Shi-Hyeon, aka “Red Candy,” is a secret agent whose code name comes from bathing in the blood of his marks on dangerous missions. Shi-Hyeon's tasked with seducing and obtaining intel from Ha-Jun, a hot college professor. Shi-Hyeon can disarm enemies, but didn’t expect to be disarmed himself by Ha-Jun’s own tight body. Now Shi-Hyeon's caught between loyalty to his spy agency and Ha-Jun. Can Red Candy survive the incoming wave of enemies and still indulge in the sweet ecstasy of Ha-Jun's embrace?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

The cruel Duke Rowan Alexei Peruka is a lovestruck puppy around Erin — all thanks to a random magic spell that was cast just as he was about to execute her. But with the spell’s power now waning and on the fritz, his shifting moods zip from dramatic professions of eternal love to cold threats of death. Exhausted from the emotional whiplash, Erin must find a magic spell to not only save herself but also her enchanting fairytale marriage before she loses her beloved and bewitched “Ru” forever.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

There's lots of ways to get a girl. Gyeong-Su has never had a girlfriend, and his friends are out to help him find one... The lesson begins now!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

After witnessing a murder and being spared by the murderer as a child, Chris has been obsessed with playing detective, and researching crimes whenever he can. When Chris goes to college, he is assigned to the same room as Max. Chris finds Max fascinating because he is a lot similar to him. In order to fit in, Max decides to not push Chris away. As time goes by, the two start to open up to each other. Little did they know that the two of them had met each other before...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hyunwoo, Yiseul, Nayeon, and Jimin – the four once-inseparable friends coincidentally run into each other in college. The surprise reunion is riddled with confusion, as some members of the group are less than thrilled about the meeting. Everything from their looks to their personalities has changed, and Hyunwoo is soon faced with the ultimate question: “Is it okay to sleep with your friends?!”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Their friendship seems stronger than anything. But will it resist the appearance of a beautiful student? For Nare and Minsu, nothing is less certain. No need to lie, one thing is obvious for the two friends : Nare is completely captivated by her new classmate. So when the pretty stranger tries to become friends with Nare, the latter does nothing to stop her...

Lim Iro is a BL writer, and a pretty successful one at that! His last project was lavished with praise by everyone… Well, almost everyone. Under pressure from his unimpressed parents, Iro is forced into applying for a “real” job. But instead of a cover letter, he accidentally submits an unreleased extract from his book instead! Disaster! Or maybe not…? Faced with Iro’s unconventional application, Baek Ho-ryung, the dashing CEO of Beus drinks company, is intrigued. But once Iro joins Beus, will his office life begin to emulate his steamy writing…?

(Source: Lezhin)

The enchanting flower maidens of Moonlight Garden are coveted by all, as they are known to provide sexual pleasures beyond the imagination. But Dohwa, a young flower maiden who has not yet “bloomed,” concocts potions in the hopes of escaping her destined fate at the brothel. One night, she is caught stealing ingredients for her potions by Lady Hyewon, the new mistress of the Garden. But it turns out Dohwa isn’t the only one with an agenda. Lady Hyewon harbors a few terrible secrets of her own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 3 epilogue chapters.

Emboldened by liquid courage, 20-year-old Bang Subin had thought it'd be a good idea to confess to his best friend, Nam Hyeonwoo. That in itself wasn’t a problem, except… Hyeonwoo was straight. The only thing Subin’s impulse confession did was cause a rift in their relationship. Fast forward three years, Subin is 23, and Hyeonwoo is back. A lot has changed with the flow of time, but for better or worse, Subin’s feelings haven’t. Can this precarious friendship ever blossom into something more…?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

Jung Erae has no clue about relationships and men to the point where she drives every man away. Desperate, she seeks help and ends up contacting a love doctor, Cha Yoon. Strangely enough, Erae starts developing newfound feelings for this so-called doctor.

(Source: Lezhin)
Saving the life of the girl he loves, Sahu incidentally turns into a zombie. And now he's trying to survive in a stone jungle, believing that one day he will sing for the world.

Bullied ruthlessly by girls in high school, Jinhoo’s done his best to put his past as a complete loser behind him. However, one day, he finds out that his newest tutee is his ex-bully, Yejin! Despite flunking the college entrance exam twice, Yejin’s only interested in her dildo and is adamant that she doesn’t need a tutor. However, as she starts to torture Jinhoo as per usual, Yejin realizes that there are some things that Jinhoo can teach her…but they’re going to have to find out the hard way.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Chapter count includes 35 after story chapters.

The story of a girl named Essirjar, a beautiful red rose living in the ancient Kingdom of Arabia. The king of this kingdom has many sons from different concubines, but his country has no future. Therefore, the battle for the position of the next king is fierce, and the king calls upon the nation's most famous prophet to decide who will be the next king. The prophet says that the next king will be "a woman named Essirjar, born with a red rose tattoo on her chest". The princes immediately depart in search of women with red roses on their chests. Amuzad, the second prince and most ambitious, sends his sister to help search for Essirjar.

O Romeo, Romeo! Where art thou, Romeo? Seriously, where the heck is he?! Secluded in his mansion, Romeo and his brilliant mind tug at the strings of power, unraveling the city’s plots and mysteries. His loyal servants have guarded his secrets closely, but when someone new enters the household, they begin to question this self-inflicted isolation. Meanwhile, a wicked web looms large, beckoning Romeo to it. Will these threats thrust him back onto the public stage and bring dark truths to light?

(Source: Tapas)

Drowning in debt and looking for a way to survive, Taegyu is given the option to sell his wife, for a month. What will happen to them?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

Yoon Baek is a typical young man who works part-time jobs to make a living. One day, he comes across a stray cat that leads him to a veterinarian named Jay Blythe. After realizing that he met him before in his dreams, he comes to learn that he's been selected by Jay to be his next prey. Yoon later finds out that his older brother who went missing a few months back was also eaten by Jay, the tiger, before he lead him to Yoon for the tiger's next meal. In order to escape the curse of the tiger, he must find another sacrifice. But the blurred lines in their relationship makes their fate growingly uncertain.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Chapter count includes a prologue.

When Kwon Yi-soo’s mom marries her long-term boyfriend, of course Yi-soo’s happy for her. But is it too much to ask that his new stepbrother not be his ex-fuckbuddy who is ALSO his boss, Han Gangjin? Yi-soo is desperate to stop him from revealing their relationship to their parents, but Gangjin doesn’t have the same qualms. He hadn’t been happy about Yi-soo breaking things off, after all. So Gangjin offers him a deal: they resume seeing each other in exchange for their parents’ blissful married life. But can that be all that Gangjin wants…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

At 78 years old, Midran, an archmage, has at least a solid 50 years left to live. That’s more than enough time to reach the infamous 8th circle—a place only archmages dream to go. At present, it’s a journey that requires an enormous amount of mana and has proven to be physically impossible time and time, again. But alas, that’s a problem for another day. Sleep comes first.

Then, he wakes up. Only it turns out he passed away in his slumber and has awoken in his next life as a child named Hyeon?! What the hell happened while he was asleep? And where did all his hard-earned mana go?!

(Source: Comikey)

“I…thought you were dead…”

For ten years, Cináed has lived solely for revenge, driven by the events of a decade ago. Despite the concerns of his long-time friend Rahman, he secretly prepares for his vengeance under the alias "Chaff," alongside his loyal retainer Yexing.
During his quest, Cináed discovers Albin, whom he believed to be dead, and rescues him. As they live together under the guise of protection, Cináed is struck by how much Albin has changed from their childhood days. This new Albin stirs unfamiliar emotions within Cináed, complicating his single-minded pursuit of revenge.
As Cináed’s feelings for Albin deepen, his thirst for revenge begins to wane. Will he choose the path of vengeance, or will Albin’s presence lead him to a different destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Man-Suk has lived a timid life as a cripple. However, he is able to walk again after a miraculous event. He sets out to find his first love with his new legs, but little did he know, there were more changes than just his legs.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A complicated story of a young boy falling in love with his tutor, but watching her get ravished by another man. After that distraction, he ended up screwing up his tests and entering a mediocre college. And who joins him there but...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

People are locked in a white room with nothing but the clothes on their backs... Who put them there? What do they want...?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: Tears by Day, Love by Night

description:
Eunsoo Seo's love life was always in turmoil. People always used him to get what they want, but not one thought about what Eunsoo wanted. When Eunsoo was about to be abused by his boy friend, a stranger named Hajoon Kim swoops in to save the day. Saved by the stranger, Eunsoo began his complicated relationship with Hajoon... literally, "Day" and "Night".

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes five side stories and three extras.

When your significant other does something to you... You gotta do something to her back...!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

When Ein is brought in to the Marquess Howard’s manor, he finds himself serving TWO masters. Unaware of the tension between the two brothers, Ein seeks out ways to be as useful as possible. As he teaches the naïve Collin during the day and gives his body to the Marquess at night, Ein will find his eagerness to serve... put to the test. While one may lay claim to his body—for now—which master will be the one to claim his heart?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: includes six special episodes.

Hiding their feelings for each other, Sehyuk and Yina, who were just friends, eventually end their ambiguous relationship and part ways. Eight years later, Sehyuk, who hears about Yina’s engagement, realizes that he hasn’t moved on… Youthful days that can’t be reversed, a romance of two people who had to live resisting their strong attraction towards each other.

(Source: Comico, translated)

Sang, once the little boy too afraid to jump into the lake with the older children, comes back home a brave new man – a huntsman, to be exact. It's only after reuniting with his friend Se-Jin, the shaman’s daughter, that he notices a black shadow has been following him... The experience reminds him that there are spirits that walk amongst us, and not always in the dark.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

From a small lake nestled in a secluded forest far from the edge of town something strange emerged one day: Three young girls. The three girls, Shem, Hamu and Japheth, are sisters from another world. Equipped with magical powers, they are charged with saving all the creatures of Earth from becoming extinct. However, there is someone or something sinister trying to stop them. While saving our world from destruction, these sisters live like normal human girls: They go to school, work at a flower shop, hang around with friends and even fall in love...

(Source: Tokyopop)

Celestia was in love and dreaming of a brighter tomorrow until, out of the blue, her fiancé cheated on her and left her for dead. Suddenly, she was alone with nothing. Enter the Emperor, cold and aloof with unlimited power and wealth. He was alone with everything. But now these two have each other. Her cunning and courage make her invaluable to him, and yet it’s the secret they share that makes them inseparable... and a target for those who crave power. Will their relationship remain professional, or will it become something magical?

(Source: Tapas)

When Ami Won’s mother was still alive, she always told her to grow up to be an exemplary woman. And the chance presents itself now that her dad has been elected President of Korea. Thus begins this klutzy girl’s transformation into the girl her mother had always hoped she’d become.

However, in the spotlight and imbued with a kind of social power she never expected, Ami is now beset on all sides by the jealous and the dismayed. Her cousin Bi-Na leads this parade. Bi-Na considers herself naturally charismatic and infinitely more charming than Ami Won, so she feels she deserves the role as Korea’s First Lady.

(Source: Tokyopop)

Seah is sick and tired of the boring, routine life she's had since college. That's when a pair of rich twins come to her and ask her to have fun with them and their uncle…

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Under the Glass Moon is a supernatural gothic fantasy from Korea. Wizards and witches with a fetishist/androgynous fashion sense ... think (Harry Potter meets Edward Scissorhands) Luka Reinhardt is the 21st century's greatest Dark Wizard and he has an amazing sense of fashion, to boot! He and his bookish sorcerer brother, Luel, live next door to two lovely witches, Madame Batolli and her witch-apprentice daughter, Nell. Relationships ensue ...

Jae-Kyung was the one hyung Se-Ju looked up to when they were kids, but after the financial ruin of Jae-Kyung's family, the two were separated. They never saw each other once during their time apart until one day they ran into each other at the bar Jae-Kyung works at. In a moment of drunken weakness, Jae-Kyung sleeps with Se-Ju and Se-Ju proposes they keep sleeping together? Confused and adrift in life, Jae-Kyung wonders if he can continue their physical relationship.

Stories included:
1. Momo Cinnamon (모모 시나몬) [Yun-Su Lee]
2. Wangbi (왕비; Queen) [Yeong-Chae Hae]
3. Nancy wa Lara (낸시와 라라; Nancy and Lara) [Ri-Geon Lee]
4. Yeouhaegol (여우해골) [Su-Seong Yu]
5. Be my baby [Gon-Ji]
6. Eomma (엄마; Mom) [Samgueok]
7. Oraeorae Haengbokage Saratseumnida?! (오래오래 행복하게 살았습니다?!; Will We Live Happily Ever After?!) [Jep Park]
8. Najungmalgo Jigeum! (나중말고 지금!; Not Later, Now!) [SONNA]
9. Bimildongmaeng (비밀동맹; A Secret Alliance) [Du-O]

Meet Dong-hae: a meek and introverted person who finds himself growing more and more weary under the fists of his abusive lover, and Su-hyun: a handsome and successful dentist who cares little about what others think of him and even less about the private affairs of strangers. As people from completely opposite worlds, the two would normally have nothing to do with one another… but when Dong-hae comes in for his dentist appointments with broken teeth and a bruised face, Su-hyun just can’t seem to leave him alone. Together, could this unlikely pair find a whole new love that may prove greater than the sum of its parts?

(Source: Lezhin US)

15 beauties drifted on a desert island. Unfortunately, they aren't the only ones on the island. Will they be able to escape the island?

(Source: Toomics)

Yoon I-Gyeong slept with a man. With Cha Seon-Ho, his landlord who changes men every week like clockwork. Seon-Ho seems to represent non-romance on the surface, casually moving from one affair to the next, yet secretly dreams of romance. Watching Seon-Ho exhausted from his one-sided love, I-Gyeong began to want something more than just one night with him.

(Source: Manta)

Forget "saving face," this is "saved by face!"

Roseny has been masquerading as a boy for years at the orphanage. But when the duke chooses her to be a playmate for his son, it isn't long before her secret is revealed. Instead of being sent back, her adorable complexion results in Roseny being adopted! What will this new future hold for her?

(Source: Manta)

The Mandarin House, a kitschy B&B on Jeju island. Lured in by an ad featuring a hot guy, first-timer Yeon-U is a bright-eyed and bushy-tailed 23 year old that has come to work here, looking for a little fun and excitement over the summer.

The hot guy in the photo? Tae-Hun, your classic tsundere. Hard(body) on the outside, but you know he’s got that soft, gooey interior that just needs to be coaxed out. But things aren’t all soju and sun in paradise. Insatiable front desk manager, Hyeon-Su, wants to get to know the newbie too. Soon, Yeon-U is smack dab in the middle of a love triangle he had never anticipated. This is no reality show! Who will find love, who will get over the past and who will just get their rocks off this summer in "Love in Kitsch"?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 2 extra chapters.

Jung Daeman leads a double life. On the outside, he’s the adopted son of a rich and beautiful family, but behind closed doors he’s little more than their servant. Only one of his “sisters” is ever nice to him, and the rest of them work him like a dog! Things only start to change when the head of the house, Mr. Kim, comes back from a business trip, and makes it clear that he thinks of Daeman as his son and tells his wife and daughters to be nicer to Daeman. The thing is, while he might want them all to be closer, surely he didn’t mean this close?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

title.english: To Those Who Long for My Destruction

description:
From parents forcibly married, whose only shared passion is mutual disdain, a neglected child is born—Leoni. Yearning for affection as a child, Leoni loses her mother to illness, only for her father to auction her hand in marriage. Enduring three arranged marriages, Leoni faces further hardship when she is falsely accused of a capital offense, seemingly destined for a bitter end.

"Those who orchestrated my misery... Every single one of them... shall pay...!"

Perhaps by force of will, Leoni finds herself back in childhood, with memories intact—and her ire. Now, she must reclaim her life and seek long-awaited happiness. But first, there are debts of suffering to be paid. And Leoni is coming to collect.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

"Mr. Esper, I told you already. I’m a B0-grade guide."

Lee Yeoni, a powerful dual-blood, has spent years hiding his striking looks and exceptional abilities while working in a quiet, rural town. But when circumstances force him to transfer to the capital, he finds himself entangled with Tae Hajin—an elite grade-S+ Esper with an intense, domineering presence.

Sensing that Yeoni is hiding something, Hajin becomes determined to uncover the truth. Using every trick at his disposal, he digs deeper into Yeoni’s secrets, setting off a tense battle of wits and wills.

Desperate to protect his identity, Yeoni resists Hajin’s pursuit—until he realizes he can turn the tables. If he must be exposed to danger, why not use Hajin as his shield? And so, he makes a bold decision…to become Hajin’s exclusive guide.

A gripping story of hidden power, dangerous attraction, and the fine line between hunter and hunted.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The male lead, who had been repeatedly reincarnating, went mad and turned the entire empire into a sea of flames. I ended up possessing the body of a character in the web novel If You Pick Up a Sword, You Might as Well Slit Someone's Throat...And of all things, I became one of the countless saintesses. My goal is singular...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Since childhood, Yeonha has fervently pursued his dream woman, Soo-yi, undeterred by her repeated rejections due to their age difference. For Yeonha, Soo-yi has always been his one and only. However, a harsh reality check arrives when he learns of Soo-yi's marriage while serving in the military. Years later, following Soo-yi’s divorce, Yeonha's unwavering love for her remains unchanged and he sets out to make his beloved noona aware of how deep his feelings truly are. As time passes, Soo-yi finds herself slowly but surely consumed by the fiery passion of Yeonha's love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Meet Ido Noh, a shy first-year high school student with a severe stutter that makes talking to people nearly impossible. Her life changes when she meets Se-i Ryu, a robot with a mysterious past and a quest to reclaim his lost memories. Can Ido find her voice with this unlikely friend, and will Se-i uncover the secrets of his origin?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes one side story chapter.

A collection of love stories between normal yet extraordinary people.

1-5. An Unbelievable Story
6-13. One Step, Three Steps
14. Secret
15-22. Return
23-24. Ballerino
25-31. Same Age
32-34. Not Lonely
35-36. Knock
37-38. Manito
38.5. Illustration (New Year Special)
39-41. Manheim
