(Source: Tencent, translated)

The golden ratio is the symbol of architectural aesthetics, as well as the most ideal proportion for human body. Huo Zhixiao’s bed partners all meet the golden ratio figure standard. Therefore, Ding Yinan never imagined waking up next to him. "-0.618 is universally recognized as the most aesthetically pleasing proportion. But in my eyes, you are the only aesthetic standard."

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Have you ever heard the story about a crane transforming into a beauty in order to return a favor?

Wait! Why did the crane become a man?! But... A man isn't bad either…

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.romaji: Li Haiwang Jintian Fan Chuan Le Ma?

description:
I thought I would be the only one to swim into her heart, but I didn't realize she's the king of the sea! Facing an awkward situation from her very first encounter, Li Haijue decides to live freely — and embrace her role as the flirtatious "Sea King" — in order experience a very different kind of love story! Meanwhile, this other world's hidden mysteries are starting to reveal themselves. What does the “Sea King” title over her head truly mean..?

(Source: Billibilli, source)

Zhen Yi is a smart teenager who suddenly got involved with a group called Phantom Exorcism Agency.
The Phantom Exorcism Agency is a group who expels supernatural beings called Phantom Tribe.
With Zhen Yi's wit, he helps the group with their troubling Phantom Tribe encounters.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Guiwang de San Shi Chong Fei

description:
Ye Ziling is a gifted girl who inherited her family's supernatural power of the Yingyang Eye, but she thought she would also inherit the family curse, doomed to die at the age of 18. Until a suspicious man suddenly appeared, claiming to be her fiancee and treating her with doting devotion. It turns out that he's no ordinary man, but the King of the Underworld himself. As unbelievable events unfold, a love that spanned three lifetimes will be consummated, and a conspiracy across the three realms of heaven, earth and hell must be defeated. How will they come together to find a way through?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Bu Ke Kang De Nianxia Dalao

description:
A martial art tournament is suppose to be the ideal way to find the perfect match between the strongest man and the most beautiful woman, but it's a trap! He spent big bucks to win the girl, but the girl turned out to be a guy? The loli assassin on top of the PK leaderboard x the highest-spending whale on the server got married in-game! Now he's stripped naked and all tied up so the marriage could be consummated? I want a divorce!

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

A superpowered male lead × a female lead with extreme delusions. Can their mutual unrequited love ever blossom?

Mo Er (male lead) is the youngest director of the film and television center at the integrated media center, and also a psychic with the ability to read minds. What he admires most are people with imagination, and a new intern, Li Yitian (female lead), who possesses extraordinary imagination, joins his team. However, she often fantasizes about various scenarios with him as the main character. Mo Er is both annoyed and enjoys the pleasure of being "secretly loved" by Li Yitian. He keeps waiting for Li Yitian to confess to him, unaware that she's using him as creative material for her comics. Will Li Yitian, who spends all day fantasizing about Mo Er, actually fall in love with him?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A boy and a girl met again after being separated for many years. The boy found that the girl had become his big brother. Now it’s hard for him to tell the girl the friendship they had fostered for years, and he even didn’t know how the girl felt. What story is going to happen between them?

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

A little little love story.
Leave, an incurable illness.

A story about a man dealing with the issue of insecurity and abandonment. To leave and to be left behind, are they the same?

Lin Fan was transported to another world, into the body of an ordinary disciple. As a vulnerable victim, he was just trying to survive, until he suddenly gained an immortal body… Funny, it seems like he's now totally invincible.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Accused of sins, Ying Tian and his tribe were imprisoned in the City of Sinners with collars that restricted their supernatural powers. However, Ying Tian was told that he was the descendant of a god. As Ying Tian was wondering about his true origins, disaster struck and destroyed the entire City of Sinners, leaving no survivors except for Ying Tian. Having escaped death, Ying Tian found himself free in the outside world, carrying the blood burden of revenge for his lost tribe. In order to find truth and justice, Ying Tian embarks on a new journey with new companions, as his godly powers awaken…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The ancient Aspect of War Chiyou found himself hoodwinked down into the Mortal Realm where he was forced to share a physical body with a young middle-schooler.

To separate themselves, they needed to work together to find a powerful artifact and defeat terrible enemies! So began their perilous adventure together!

(Source: Webnovel)

Geli Shijie (Segregated World); A virtual reality game were only those who are chosen can play. In order to prevent more players from entering the Segregated World, three hackers of the Hackers Alliance G attempted to steal the Odin Core to destroy the server.

While trying to protect the two goddesses, Xiao Chang Feng was heavily injured, on the verge of life and death, he was then fused with the Core, unleashing the power of the Core, Xiao Chang Feng....

(Source: OSTNT)
Explore a new world filled with illusion.

title.romaji: Yi Zu Xianzhi Ling 2 Yin Mian Zhen

description:
The evil beast man falls in love with a woman with an inferiority complex and finds his lover a thousand miles away! When the beast turns into a beautiful man, she flees in fear... What will he do when his beloved is hurt? When a handsome human man comes between them, how can this interracial love affair continue...

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua)

Duwei is born into this new world from Earth without a sound, he does not cry, he simply stares at the people around him. As he grows he does not speak and curses this new world he was forced into.
His Father a Great General is sure there must be something he has an aptitude for, however he is simply trash. Disregarded by his family as the frail heir.
This is the story of his journey to discover the truths of this world and use the knowledge of his past life to remove his title of weak, even if he has to become a devil.

A gifted medical student gets a time travel and arrives at a world that ruled by martial arts. Will he try his best to save the sick with his skills learned in his previous world? Will he obey the rules of the new world and practice to be a martial master? Definitely no! The beauties of the new world are more important!

(Source: Manga Toon)

Lin zhen’s stepmother and sister always bully her at home, her husband even has an affair with her sister and sends her to the mental hospital. No one cares about her except one guy…Can Lin Zhen finally rewrite her destiny and find her true love?

The Tale of Zi Wei is a series of comics based on an oriental fantasy novel written by Feng Ge. The comics chronicle the lives of a young wizard, Fang Fei and his friends, all of whom are Taoists at the World of Zi Wei. The main story arc concerns Fang Fei's struggle against a dark and evil Taoists organization.

(Source: MangaToon)
Wei Lai accidentally picked up a mysterious camera that can take pictures of the future but found that it only has an effect on her secret crush, a senior.

Mu Haiwei, a homebody with a short height and bad personality who longs for romantic love, suddenly encounters a miraculous frog one day, which brings dramatic change to her life. After the appearance of the miraculous frog, who is the man who shows up constantly? What does the frog bring to her? And who is the real prince for Mu Haiwei? Now the goddess of love favors Mu Haiwei - is it an affair of the previous life, or merely longing for love? Will Mu Haiwei be together with her beloved?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Hello Tianxin: Xu Shao de Xiao Lamei
title.english: Hello Sweetie: Mr. Xu's Little Hottie

description:
Cinderella takes the chance to get a new life. She gains a variety of opportunities to strike back at her enemy. Suspenseful elements are added into her life while she is pampered with the arrogant boss's love. The main character is unlike any other main characters in other stories. She is not pretty and sweet, she does not act tough but she is independent.

(Source: WeComics)

What? Join a matchmaking program with my fiancé and pretend to be strangers? Piece of cake!

Secret couple Linwei & Yiyu has been hiding their relationship for more than four years. In order to get married and buy their dream home, they’re in dire need of money after problems arise and they decide to join a matchmaking program in hopes of winning the $5M prize. With four years of love and trust between them, nothing can break them apart, right? But with other hands in play, can true love withstand the twists of reality? But why is he here?

The man with whom I’ve shared so many beautiful memories.

“I still miss you after all these years…”

Xu Nian, who was oppressed and disowned by his family, is the most wicked genius in history. Join his adventure as he exacts revenge on his family, takes a goddess into his harem, becomes a demonic lord's disciple, and gains a dragon god as his mount! Those who offend Xu Nian and cross his bottom line are doomed to suffer a horrible fate!

(Source: Webnovel)

Xing Tian has suffered many setbacks his entire life. He fell from being a Divine god to a god of war, and then again from being a god of war to a demon king. There has only been one person he longs for and chases after, but that person has forgotten about him again and again. Xing Tian consoles himself: it’s alright, he is a fish after all. And fishes…don’t have good memory…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: This manhua and its characters are based on ancient Chinese mythology recorded in Shanhaijing, or the Classic of Mountains and Seas.

title.romaji: Yi Ren Zhi Xia Fanwai: Xiutie

description: In the future world, technology runs the universe. An intelligent robot committed many mistakes as he did not fully trust human beings. As his punishment, he lost his job and was sent back into the ancient times. However, the device had accidentally brought him back to Ancient China, where he met a cold yet beautiful snake demon. A series of stories unfold as the two were brought together by fate...

Crossing, or a substitute? The ancient female hero's Hua Mulan traveled to the present world through time and space, and found that Xiao Li feng was exactly the same as the dead Xiangfan. Is this a coincidence of history? Or is it the meaning of her miraculous crossing? For this reason, Mulan became Xiao’s little assistant and small nanny, and the two began to live together in a fun and interesting life.

Down on her luck having graduated from a scammy university with no job prospects Xiao Jun doesn't have a lot of hope for the future but everything changes when a strange creature slinks out of her air conditioner. Could this be the start of a beautiful relationship?

Lin Ye was a naughty high school boy who always broke rules and befriended gangsters. One day, he ate food that prayers gave to the mountain god, so he was cursed to be a woman!

(Source: WeComics)

title.english: You and Me, In or Out

description:
Shen Wang’s life finally started when he met Lin Zhaoxi. He did not want Zhaoxi to be taken away and wanted to have Zhaoxi all to himself. That feeling grew stronger with each day… However, fate silently led him someplace more complicated… The Feather Kind bloodline, the mysterious father, the attractive butler, the loyal friend… His family, friendship, and love intertwined in the years. It was a symphony under the starry night of Lake Assal. Unlock the world of the Feather Kind. Will he stop or will he move forward? Will he stay the same or will he break through…?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The flawless young girl Chao Yin, equipped with both skills and looks, is actually suffering from a “social phobia towards the opposite sex”. Facing a brand new college life, Chao Yin wants to break away from her old self and make some changes. Just in time, club recruitments have started. Attracted by the charm of street-dancing, Chao Yin joined the dance club. There, she turned the popular male members LingChen and YunQi into the Bosses of her willpower training. However, a disastrous“curse” appeared out of nowhere, causing this task to instantly shift into hard mode…

title.english: There Are Weirdos All Over Jianghu

description:
22-years-old Shen Qianling attained the status of the King of the Silver Screen for the first time in his life. Afterward, while he was holding his trophy and breaming with tears of happiness, a piece of ceiling fell with a loud bang, smashing onto his head accurately. After that, he… transmigrated! Qin Shaoyu: If Ling’er is willing to, Zhui Ying Palace can hold a wedding any time. Shen Qianling: To tell you the truth, I am very unwilling.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
A failed rescue mission, a man driven into desperation, a deity who lost his powers. Guarding a vow made in a past life in return for today. If we meet again, will you remember me?

An unfinished love song, and a love that couldn't come true. One side is a childhood friend, another side is a classmate that's a silent protector. Facing reality's pressure and with destiny's teasing, promises become rejections; and they drift further apart. When the opportunity to meet comes once again, can they finish that unfinished love song?

title.english: With All Kins, Have No Pity

description:
The powerful God of War, Zhou Quan, is poisoned to death by his useless son. When he opens his eyes again, he realizes that not only has his adopted son imprisoned him and stolen the throne, but he had been reincarnated as his useless son?! And this adopted son who has once been loyal and devoted to him is actually deeply in love with his former self and even treats the current him as a substitute for the former self.

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: Urban Prince and the Amazon Girl

description:
A girl who grew up in a primitive tribe was entrusted by her grandfather to an arrogant rich-boy. Unfamiliar with life in the city, she caused a great deal of embarrassing incidents. But the young man gradually became captivated by the girl?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Exposing both good and evil sides of humanity. A fated encounter and bizarre journey. The Bizarre Tales creeps over with horror, supernatural, and suspenseful stories. Hush… Don’t make a sound.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Fei Ge, a high school student, had nothing but his better-than-average left hand going for him. His greatest wish was for his very own romantic encounter, but it still came as a surprise when the most popular girl in class asked him to have lunch with her at the rooftop! Fei Ge hadn't rejoiced for long when he realized things weren't as simple as they seemed. A hot-tempered girl, who identified herself as a warrior that protects human love, took residence on his left index finger and sought to kill a monster that Fei Ge learned was called Caterghost. To make matters worse, Fei Ge notices that the other fingers on his left hand were in a similar state of standby...

(Source: Bilibili comics)

title.english: The Reincarnation of the Influential Courtier

description:
Each book is a debt of love. Each step forward is a mortal challenge.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Just as Wu Xie thought he would finally have some peace and quiet, Jin Wantang visited and broke a news: Jin Wantang discovered the association between the scorpion engraving on the Moonstone and young ‘Wallflower’. Determined to get to the bottom of this, Wu Xie set off to Nepal and then landed in Metok—where he learned more and more about Wallflower. Later, he obtained Wallflower’s notebook from a lama in Jila Monastery which revealed the story behind Wallflower’s visit to the snow mountain. But what shocked Wu Xie more was the mention of ‘World’s Limit’ in the notebook and realization of another bronze gate amidst the snow mountain. Was there a reason why people from all walks of life gathered at Jila Monastery—was it coincidence or planned? What was the meaning behind the mysterious scorpion? What was the meaning of ‘World’s Limit’? Why was Wu Xie the only savior of the Zhang family? Were the Zhang’s trustworthy—were they answering a calling or conspiring against someone? A whole new journey awaits. Together with Fatty, Wu Xie trailed Wallflower’s footsteps into the snow mountain. Will Wu Xie’s question be answered in this adventure?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.native: 成为吸血鬼影帝的新娘

description:
Waking up in a freezing capsule, the cartoonist Xiao Tong finds that he's entered a new era 300 years later when human beings coexist peacefully with many bloodline-awakened clans. The Vampire Actor Caesar is somehow attracted by the landfill worker Xiao Tong and even can't help marking him when they first encounter. A human being who gets marked by the blood clan will become the blood clan bride. In the confrontation between vampires and humans, two people from different eras gradually get closer to each other.

(Source: Webnovel)

The Chiyou's court prince is an ominous presence, maintaining his composure amidst the bustling cour. He is a ruthless killer, never hesitating to kill his enemies, but he is a gentle lover and brother.

A historical tale about a great and noble prince ruling the mysterious land of snow.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Shoucan De Wo Zai Fanpai Feng Sheng Shui Qi
title.native: 手残的我在反派风生水起

description:
How does a game player with poor skills survive in a buggy game world after crossing over during closed beta? Fortunately, I am the original author of this game. Whatever devils and angels may come, I'll show you what a father’s love is really like!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zhe Ge Wusheng Guo Yu Kangkai
title.english: This Martial Arts Saint Is Too Generous
title.native: 这个武圣过于慷慨 签约

description:
Qin Jinyang transmigrated from our modern world to a world of martial arts, but without any special abilities or assistance systems. He is reduced to a common laborer at the Helan Estate, forced to suffer hardships on a meager diet. In the depth of despair, his System finally awakened. Qin Jinyang was overjoyed with this development, until he found out that his system is a little unusual. It required him to give away his belongings to others to in order to enhance his own strength…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Cao Xiaoman thinks he's just a guy with a pretty face until the two mysterious guys show up and tell him that he's the reincarnation of Cao Cao – the famous Chinese statesman and warlord in history. Much against his will, he seeks out loyal followers from his past life.

(Source: WebComics)

When Cang Qiong the monk stops a fight between a pair of Loong brothers, he accidentally kills Bai Mo, a Diven Loong. Full of remorse, he spends the next ten years searching for his soul fragments and creating a younger version of Bai Mo using his blood and qi. Their life is peaceful until Bai Rong, another Divine Loong drops in on them uninvited.

(Source: WebComics)

title.native: 中国惊奇先生金刚师篇

title.romaji: Chun Meng Kexuejia VS Yanjing Quanfa Jia
title.native: 蠢萌科学家VS眼镜拳法家

description:
Yan Jingjun and Zhu Gong are two high school students who like to make experiments. Both compete with each other, showing off the crazy things they came with at the time. This often leads to disaster, to the point of even creating an alien form in the laboratory!

(Source: INKR)

Tangerine Weekly's new reporter, Xiaoyuan, because of her vibrant hair colour and interesting methods, quickly gains the nickname 'Fire Girl'. They are now in a news assembly, featuring the celebrity Xia Yexuan - who is terribly arrogant. What should she do? Don't worry, Fire Girl has a trick or two up her sleeve...

(Source: Chinatown KM)

"I can finally marry you,” he told her, with smile like peach blossom shining in the garden, the spring color just pales in comparison.

But the man by the city gate tower keep yelling non-stop, “If you dare to marry him, I will make sure you die.”

Yet, until the last moment she realized her heart had selected him from the start.

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

After three years of negligence and apathy, Lu Yunzhan realizes that the woman he mistreated was his childhood love, Yan Xiaoan. But she is long gone, together with the child in her womb and all the embarrassment she had suffered...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Guomin Shao Shuai Ai Shang Wo

description:
For some reason she was asked to leave away from him several years ago. What she doesn't know is that he's still love her. Thus a run-and-chase love game is on.

(Source: MangaToon)

My body was swapped with my dog? How could I solve a series of problems with a dog body?? My favorite girl is waiting for me!!!! And my dog is fucking other dogs with my body!!!!! What should I do……

Includes 11 side stories.

title.romaji: Meng Bao Laixi: Mommy Ying Hou Tianjia Qi
title.native: 萌宝来袭：妈咪影后天价妻

description:
Qing Ruan is upright and proud. She always looked down on the ways of the entertainment industry. Her many public criticisms won everyone's dislike. At the end of her graduation party, she fell into her best friend's trap to make her fall into bed with a random stranger then being discovered. Now the laughing stock of the industry and broken down, she could only flee the country and study overseas.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: The Wind of the Bowstring in My Ear

description:
When Li Xun was nineteen, he participated in an archery competition and spotted a pretty child in the audience. After getting first place, he went up to the child with great interest, holding her up to take a photo with her.

Ten years later, that "little girl" turned out to be boy and found Li Xun in his home. He blushed while saying that he really admired him and wanted to see Li Xun do archery again. Li Xun: "Kid, are you sure you want to watch me do archery?"

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Zhi Ming Chong Qi: Zongcai Na Ming Lai!

description:
She is a bossy princess of a gang. She kidnapped a wrong man by mistake, and hardly did she know that the man is actually a demon! He is a business elite. He imprisoned her by a contract. He kept asking for more. She was too powerless to fight back. But revenge quietly grew in her mind. It was another night when he tried to force her. She resisted and pointed a gun at him. "Jerk, don't use my body to reminisce your girl!"

(Source: WebComics)

An obscure florist shop owner—unknown to the world—is secretly the heir of a renowned feng shui lineage. With his mother critically ill and in desperate need of money for treatment, he’s introduced to Liu Yingying, a glamorous celebrity from the entertainment industry who seeks his feng shui expertise. The entertainment world is a den of riches and intrigue—now watch as Wang Ye uses his feng shui mastery to navigate, conquer, and thrive in the cutthroat realm of showbiz!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Rupin, a loser who's protected by school goddess Candy, is always a joke of the Gale College. No one knows that his natural power got sealed for some reason. What will happen in the competitive college? And how does Rupin awaken his power?

(Source: MangaToon)

Soren Shen is a high school student. He's always a well-behaved student to his teachers and takes Sharon Li as his good example, who is the school idol. But one day... Soren accidentally found the secrets of his idol!?

(Source: WebComics)

This isn't about a war between empires, nor is it about a journey across another world. Trust me. This isn't about leveling up or cultivation, either. The truth is, this is a very serious science fiction on saving the world. As the reader, you have to take it seriously, okay? No...? Alright, then...

This story features a certain nerd who suddenly became the head of an empire. Along the way, he ends up involuntarily adopting a bunch of little girls thanks to his fatherly aspects. This hilarious tale goes on between the ambitionless man with his regiment of powerful freeloaders who fell from the sky. Once again, for the record, this is a very serious story.

title.romaji: Wu Xiao Hun Yue: Qian Qi Yao Gai Jia

description:
During the two-year marriage, Jason Lu has his own monthly routine, spending one night with her and mercilessly forcing her to eat contraceptive in the next morning. She's been in love with him for ten years. But she witnessed him haunting with other women and suffered in the position of Mrs. Lu, because it never really belongs to her. Without hope and patience, she threw the divorce agreement to him. Jason went mad and didn't agree...

(Source: Webcomics)

"If your bones are buried under the spring, I will come to loosen the soil for you."

The series follows Suyou's journey in the mortal realm. There, he meets Zhao Muya, a charming fortune teller who teaches him the art of understanding human hearts. Their close bond evolves until Zhao Muya rises to lead the Tian Di Sword Sect. Promises of spiritual cultivation are broken, and Suyou is left with the betrayal and the theft of his golden core.

(Source: Studio INKR)

The son of the Qing emperor is in danger. The soldiers have cornered him and things look pretty bad for him. Just when he was about to lose hope, a stranger with golden hair appears and saves him and his mother. Follow their adventures as they try to stay alive and unite the land under one ruler!

Zhong Yi saw a young man eating in the bathroom, who turned out to be the other male lead in the new drama he was about to film. Rong Mian was a cool, dark-haired, handsome young man. But at the moment, he was holding a spoon in his hand, intently eating a can of... cat food?! An imaginative but reliable human vs. a voracious, insensitive kitty.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 extras.

title.romaji: Ta Lai Le, Qing Pa Xia

description:
Make way for the queen!

A weak, C-list actress falls into the sea and returns with a 180-degree temperament change as a frightening and ruthless killer. Bigwigs from all walks of life humbly submit to her. Now referred to as the "Reaper", the queen both entertains and punishes evil. Shh, here comes the queen!

(Source: Manta)

What is love? After their father passed away in an accident, the only ray of light to the Zheng family’s three sisters is their brother Zhinian. The family’s ongoing misfortunes quietly bury the seeds of growth in the three sisters - Yihua, Erye and Sanguo, and their future takes an unexpected turn. This story is all about love and the the bonds between family, friends and lovers.

I got myself quite drunk because the man I loved for six years just dumped me. I just wanted to vent my anger on something, whatever it was! But WAIT! Did I just wreck THAT man’s car? I mean the President of Leng’s Financial Group!? This is not going to be good. The man wouldn’t let me off easily. Besides, where can I get the money to compensate him… Guess I’ll have to run!
Yeah, but he’s like a phantom haunting me everywhere…

title.romaji: Mama Yuhai Hou Bei Wo Biancheng Le Maoniang
title.native: 妈妈遇害后被我变成了猫娘

description:
My mother was brutally murdered by the powerful elite while protecting my secret. To bring her back to life, I've embarked on a journey to seize the twelve Zodiac God Cards.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Chen Fan, who was rejected by 999 girls after confessing his love, surprisingly succeeded on his 1000th attempt! What's more, the 999 girls who had previously turned him down came back to chase after him, creating the ultimate harem chaos!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The maid cafe's shop owner is always away throughout the year, but the two maids keep the shop oderly, neat, and tidy. Suddenly, supernatural attacks disrupted the peace in the shop, and the maids got into fights with them. Together with the male protagonist, Mo Qi and his hidden ability, they undo the manipulation, protect citizens. However, it seems like the shop owner has some sort of connection with these supernatural events, which leads to a big secret...

When the orphaned Bai Tian was taken back to a sect made up of salted fish (people who have no ambition whatsoever) by the young taoist Yu Xiao, who he had never met before, Bai Tian’s whole heart was filled with the desire to obtain revenge for his parents. But as he started living a life free of worries, his goal seemed to drift farther and farther away...

A teenager who has already passed on, relies on the power of drugs to continue protecting the 10 years long love he holds for his lover, the consequences he faces is the inability to reincarnate. Knowing the truth what will his girlfriend decide to do?

A scholar with absolutely no desire to study met a mysterious girl called "Miss Ugly" who had no memories of her past. She resigned to fate that she was destined to be sacrificed to the Huang Deity, but the scholar was determined to save her.

title.romaji: Huangshang, Qing Ni Chong Chong Wo!

description:
A rich playboy transmigrated to ancient times and became an uncastrated eunuch. He gained the power to see the favorability rating of the people around him. This allowed him gain the favor of the emperor, who relied on him heavily, but it made him an enemy to the ministers of the imperial court...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In the third year of the Sui Dynasty, the emperor Yan Jian established Jiejianfu, a spy agency to support his conquests. On a snowy night, the tribute caravan from the Yutian kingdom was robbed and slaughtered. On order of the Emperor, Feng Xiao, the second-in-command at Jiejianfu, was sent to investigate. In Liugong Town, he ran into Cui Buqu, an agent from Zuoyueju, there on a mission of his own. The two prideful agents didn't get along at first, but as they fought each other in a battle of wits, they began to realize that their missions had a common enemy lurking in the shadows. When they finally decided to cooperate, an enormous organization called Yunhai Shisanlou began to emerge…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.english: This Princess Consort Is a Man

description:
To be presentable in court, while still being capable in the kitchen, without a way forward, and trapped by men on both sides. Just why is it so hard to be a princess consort?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes five bonus chapter.

In the year AD 1127, the Mongols sacked Bianjing, the capital of the Song Dynasty, and took the Emperor and his brother prisoner. The incident became known as the Humiliation of Jingkang. The Song imperial court was forced to flee south to Lingan. Our story begins 17 years later, in the Niujia Village of Lingan Prefecture, where two sworn-brothers, Guo and Yang, reside…

(Source: Books.com.tw, translated)

In 1279, China came under Mongol rule for the first time. The Yuan dynasty, founded by Kublai Khan—the grandson of Genghis Khan—had effectively assimilated almost the entire Middle Kingdom. But in Yashan, an island off the southern coast, a last bastion of the former Song dynasty still resisted. One of the greatest naval battles in history was about to take place...

(Source: Urban China, translated)

Aspiring novelist Kim Woojin has been a side character all his life. He can't write stories that are his own, and he's not even his boyfriend, Minho's, priority. But like every cloud has its silver lining, Woojin’s comes in the form of an aspiring stage actor, Taehwan. However, Taehwan is not without his own problems: he suffers from terrible stage fright that keeps him from taking lead roles.

A friendship blossoms between Woojin and Taehwan, with each helping the other overcome their fears. Will this newfound friendship remain just that or could Taehwan be the spark that gets Woojin’s creative juices flowing again? And could they both muster up the courage to become the protagonists of their own stories?

(Source: Lezhin US)

There's no place like home...

Having grown up in a nursing home, Sheena wished for nothing more than to be reunited with her family. But when she finally returns home after 9 years, she finds herself feeling like a stranger in her own house as things take an eerie turn.

(Source: Manta)

I'm back, Saintess." "Welcome, Warrior." The Saintess always welcomes me with a smile when I open the door after returning home after a hard day. The Warrior and the Saintess meet again after crossing dimensions. The ordinary and calm daily story of two men and women who create a future together in a small single room.

(Source: Onestory, translated)

It really seems like the guy next door is a completely insane, crazy bastard.

Baek Gang-Hyeon, the fourth son of the chairman of the Baekcheong Group and its hidden successor, has one secret: he possesses a rare genetic trait—99% alpha characteristics and 1% omega. He has lived his whole life as an overwhelmingly dominant alpha, but then a storm named Kwon Hae-il enters his life.

“I think I’m gonna die from how much I like you, Baek Gang-Hyeon.”

Daniel and Sarah are complete opposites: one is an outcast, and the other is the school’s queen bee. However, they have one thing in common… they’re both virgins.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Assistant Manager Kim Hates K-Pop Idols

description:
Assistant Manager Yi-Wol Kim has spent five years working a day job—and five years doing “stand-in stanning” for his boss’s daughter’s favorite idol group, Spark. During yet another Spark-related overtime, he collapses… and wakes up nine years in the past with a second chance at life. But this chance comes with a cruel condition: to undo his sister’s death, Yi-Wol must debut as a member of Spark himself. Thrown into the idol life he never wanted, he’ll have to survive fame, internal politics, and his own reluctant heart.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Ji-Un's first romance ends when her crush, Jae-I, confesses that he likes someone else. To make matters worse, Jae-I mistakenly believes that Ji-Un's crush is his scary-looking best friend, Seo-Hyeon, and tries to help her win him over. Now, Ji-Un must deal with a bigger problem than her unrequited crush, the boy-friend she had never imagined getting close to.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

A string of demotions and even a broken engagement with the prince. Knight Asha, once on close terms with the emperor, had steadily veered off the path to success, receiving demotions as his annual birthday gifts.

That is, until his 24th birthday, when he was finally ordered to return to his post.

With his return, he decided to try to get married like his friends, albeit belatedly... But there’s simply no one suitable!

During his time away from the capital, Emperor Kiel had revised the laws and regulations, leaving him in an even trickier position. Can Asha manage to find a partner and succeed in getting married?

Dae-Jang Gong, aka Raid Leader, used to be rank one in the world’s first VR RPG game Rou Online, but now he’s trapped in a game called Astrom as an NPC due to the evil scheming of an AI! Now, Dae-Jang must find a way to escape this sick metaverse, but will he be able to outsmart artificial intelligence?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

A regular employee is belittled by his boss, but when he uncovers her secrets, he gets a chance for revenge.

(Source: Toomics)

"Let’s play…"

All Seo Woo-yeon wants is a simple university experience away from his intensely annoying step-brother, Woo-jin. So imagine his frustration when Woo-jin not only gets into the same university as Woo-yeon, but also follows him to the same major and even the same classes! Woo-yeon’s determined to make the world see how awful his brother truly is, but...well, his memory has been really spotty these days and, to top things off, Woo-jin seems to be acting even more smug than usual. Just what is going on in the times Woo-yeon can’t remember, and what does Woo-jin have to do with it?

"Playtime’s over."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

Betting on TaeHwa Group's future, an A.I. created for diagnosis named Baruda! First-year neurosurgeon President Lee Soohyuk was working with Baruda when he was hit by a mysterious explosion and lost consciousness. After regaining consciousness, he met the A.I. Baruda inside his mind. Already inseparable, they are faced with a situation where they must help each other.

Baruda, who, through deep learning, aims to become the best diagnoser, and Soohyuk, who still aims to come into his own, work together to become the world's best neurosurgeon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The man next door, Yang Seo-ha, who is more than a foot taller The man next door, Yang Seo-ha, who is more than a foot taller and has a small, delicate frame. Lee Hyun is the older brother alongside two- year-old Tuul, who has had a crush on him since childhood. "I like to be about the same height as me, sorry." It's a response to an almost lifelong unrequited love. One day, he couldn't give up despite Seo-ha's constant refusal and hovered around, until he found a huge man entering his house. "You say you like cute faces, but what about that mult?"

title.english: I Stole the Female Lead's First Love

description:
Karina Paeonia has just broken off an engagement for the fourth time—typical of a side character inside a reverse harem game. All her lovers have left her for Tatiana, the female lead. But when Karina is about to give up on romance, Tatiana's first love, Aster, shows interest in her. As furious Tatiana goes out of her way to get revenge, Karina learns that Tatiana might not be playing the game entirely fairly. Will Karina be able to hold on to Aster? Or will the female lead snatch him from her?

(Source: Tapas)

“Do you want to sleep with me?”

Baek Kwon-Young doesn’t like Nam Ju-Ha, no, not at all! But desperate times come for desperate measures especially when Kwon-young’s father announces that he wants Ju-Ha to become part of the Baek family. If Ju-Ha says yes to that proposal, that means Juha’ll basically inherit Ilbi Group, the Baek family’s conglomerate. Kwon-Young has to do anything to stop this from happening. Will Kwon-Young’s fake romance be successful? What will Ju-Ha become? The stepson or the sex partner?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

"Break up with him." – What kind of a friend would say stuff like this to his best friend?! Jaesu Sang, a male friend of mine who wants me to break up with my boyfriend, and I, Wonsu Ha, who can never be strict with him, am now getting a love confession. Thanks to that, our relationship gradually began to crack, just like the cell phone screen he broke.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Lee Jae-Ha knows it’s absurd for him to ask for Jang Tae-Geon’s hand in marriage. While Jae-Ha is the heir to Korea’s most prestigious corporation, Tae-Geon is a violent gangster. But above all, both of them are dominant alphas. So when they inevitably do get married, Jae-Ha doesn’t dare to ask for anything more, instead drawing lines in the name of respecting the man he selfishly fell in love with. But these lines only end up aggravating Tae-Geon, who’s actually had his eyes on Jae-Ha just the same...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Lee Woogeon, the Vice Chairman of Korea Electronics, is a man consumed by his demanding career. However, at his grandfather's request, he agrees to meet an important person. To his shock, the person awaiting him is Yeon Rieul, a 22-year-old woman who is set to become his wife. With no belief in love, How will Woogeon handle the trials of marriage with such a young wife?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ha-Je Kang can’t take it anymore. Pushed to the breaking point by relentless bullying, Ha-Je stands at the edge of the school roof, ready to end it all. But just as he’s about to jump, he’s given a push -- literally -- by a mysterious upperclassman named Si-Un Lee, only to wake up the next day, unscathed. Little does Ha-Je know that Si-Un happens to be one of the most powerful martial artists in the Murim, the hidden world of martial arts. Ha-Je begs Si-Un to train him, but he never could have imagined just how tumultuous things could get in the martial arts underworld…

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Possessing a character in a fictional story is one thing, but possessing a character in your own story is another… especially when you’ve become a dramatic villainess in a typical K-drama series. The only way Mi-So can escape from this world is to live through all of the episodes, but she has to deal with cliché tropes such as an arranged marriage with the male lead and an unnecessary rivalry with the female lead. Will Mi-So be able to break away from this predetermined destiny and find another happy ending for all of her characters?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Tired of harassment from his female superior, JUN-HYUN decides to punish her by asking her out. The relationship started off as a prank, but things start to change as he realizes his hidden desires...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Zeus is reincarnated as a lowly human, Je-U. To go back to Olympus, he needs to conquer all the goddesses...

"Just you wait. It's easy to make you mine once I set my mind to it!!"

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

At 18, Kwon Seung-Ho—the “Legend”—reigned supreme over high schools across Seoul, reaching the pinnacle of violence. But after reaching the top, Kwon Seung-Ho vanished without a trace... Now, ten years later, defying everyone’s expectations that he would have become at least a nationwide gang boss, he has reappeared as a new employee at Samjin Corporation!

(Source: Naver, translated)

The subcontractors were nothing more than robots I was grateful for. It was only natural to squeeze everything out of them. But after being betrayed by the group I worked for, I opened my eyes in a new body and finally saw the tears of those "robots." Having gained a second life on the brink of death, can my soul be saved?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Raffine’s Plan: Save My Favorite Character

description:
I'll marry the male lead myself!

Raffine is in a predicament, and there are three reasons why. One, she's been reincarnated into a super angsty, highly depressing novel. Two, her older brother is destined for death in said novel. And three, the only way to save him is by marrying the male lead. What the hell is going on?!

(Source: Manta)

Rixie is a succubus often masquerading as a service provider who visits homes, whether it to be checking the gas valves, the water pipes, or the internet connection. But that’s just a front for her to find humans to feed on. One day, she finds the perfect prey: Puhr, a boy who seems rich both financially and in energy to devour. Unfortunately, she has no idea who the predator really is until Puhr shows his true colors…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kay, the quiet deputy captain of the guard in a remote, impoverished village, leads a peaceful and uneventful life - until the arrival of the Grand Duke Zigril shatters his world. Zigril is in pursuit of the legendary Alosha, a rare and mysterious bloom rumored to grant pregnancy to anyone who consumes it, regardless of age or gender. Drawn to Kay in a fleeting moment of desire, the Duke expects their encounter to be no more than a brief indulgence. But as Zigril finds himself unable to shake thoughts of Kay, their connection deepens in unexpected ways. Soon, at the Duke's command, Kay is entrusted with the dangerous task of guiding him to the distant city of Edor. Along the way Kay begins to realize that there may be far more at stake than just the mythical flower. What will they discover on this perilous journey - and what does Zigril truly want?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The current world no longer has any need of special powers. Thus, witches have lost their value and are not that different from humans. That's why Misty lives a normal life with her fellow witches, Eve and Baba Yaga, while earning a living as a BL genre comic artist. One day, a mysterious group kidnaps Misty and all of a sudden their once normal life turns "abnormal!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Empress Olivia knows happiness is the last thing she deserves, but when she finally becomes pregnant with the emperor’s child, she thinks things might finally be taking a turn for the better. Alas, Olivia realizes how naive she was when her husband poisons her tea, killing both her and their unborn child. When Olivia opens her eyes again in the body of an unknown woman in the slums, she vows to take vengeance against the emperor. To do so, she forms a marriage alliance with her former fiancé, Duke Lucas Viterpan, the true heir to the empire who was deposed in a coup. Will this man and woman who had everything taken from them succeed in getting revenge?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Immoral Duke Needs to Be Homeschooled

description:
Estella Margaret Montiel is a dedicated governess for House Bertha. However, she is currently facing more pressing matters than math or grammar. She knows her pupils' half-brother, Duke Diego Bertha, plans to kill everyone in his family! Determined to protect her students from a tragic fate, she sets out to reform the charming yet dangerous duke. Can her resolve and guidance truly transform the devilish Diego and teach him the value of family? Or will her class be dismissed much too early?

(Source: Tapas)

After discovering her "friend" Min-Chae was only using her to clean up her own image, bullied high schooler Se-Yo’s life takes a dramatic turn when an accident leaves her in the body of a beautiful coma patient named Kkotbi! The deity responsible for the body swap offers her a deal: fulfill Kkotbi's destiny by becoming an idol within a year or lose everything. Now Se-Yo must learn the ropes of K-pop stardom while dealing with a jealous Min-Chae, who has no idea the gorgeous new girl is actually her former friend who knows all about her dark past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Student, The Witch, and The Academy

description:
For Nam Juho, life as a repeat student aiming for med school is supposed to be simple: study, eat convenience store kimbap, and sleep, preferably in that order. But peace is impossible when Yeo Jiwoo, his eccentric classmate from the same cram school, suddenly decides he’s her new favorite target. From stolen pens and playful pranks to unsolicited “study motivation,” Jiwoo seems determined to turn Juho’s quiet, disciplined life into a daily comedy of chaos. He swears she’s doing it just to annoy him… but why does his heart race every time she flashes that mischievous smile? Between mock exams, caffeine highs, and emotional confusion, Juho finds himself stuck in the most distracting kind of competition—a love-hate study war that’s way harder than any entrance test. Who knew the toughest subject in cram school would be romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ha-Min was the quiet, chubby kid with a hopeless crush on his friend’s older brother. Years later in college, he's slimmed down and unrecognizable. When Tae-Rim starts treating him with the same gentle warmth as before, Ha-Min finds his feelings rushing back.

(Source: Manta)

The story of two people brought together by the fluttering feelings that they know nothing about.

Note: Discontinued due to author's death.

So I’ve become Yunifer Magnolia, the villainess who’s crazed with jealousy that Duke Ishid Lucrenze, the devastatingly handsome hero, has eyes only for Raelle, Yunifer’s best friend. Yunifer torments Raelle so much that Yunifer’s killed off at the end. But... I’M Yunifer now. UGH! Good news is, I’ve reincarnated a year before her tragic end, so there’s time to make sure Ishid and Raelle have a fairy tale ending (and I stay alive). Bad news is, I got drunk and woke up with Ishid next to me. Crap.

(Source: Tapas)

The elves and orcs have put down their weapons. It is time to call an end to this war. There’s just the matter of dealing with the POWs. There’s the nice one, deputy commander Lena. The grumpy one, commander Isihr. As well as the elven privates. All of them are under the care of the orc guards Logahn, Bark, and Mog. These elven prisoners have to be treated well as the ceasefire negotiations between both sides are still ongoing. But will they end up testing the limits of the orcs’ patience? Every day is a new adventure in “Pampered Prisoners: Elves Among Orcs”!

(Source: Lezhin US)

While being reborn into a loving noble family with powerful elven blood certainly isn’t a bad fate, Eucenielle can't forget the people she left behind in her previous life. All she wants is to return to her original world, but things get complicated when the crybaby crown prince, Tes, falls head-over-heels for her.

Once they reunite as adults, Eucenielle is disturbed by the drastic change in Tes' looks and personality, which everyone else seems oddly oblivious to. Though she has a feeling Tes resorted to dark measures to win her heart, Eucenielle finds herself being drawn to the tyrant regardless...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Enter the world of Hajun Lee, just your average delivery guy trying to make ends meet. But when he's summoned to Olympus for a special delivery, his life takes an unexpected turn. Suddenly, he's the personal delivery man for the gods, earning big bucks and upgrading his gear with each risky delivery. Follow his daring escapades through dungeons and battles with monsters as he learns to outsmart them all. From one divine job to the next, Hajun faces it all with wit and guts. But can he keep up the hustle of being a regular delivery guy while also serving the mighty gods?

(Source: WEBTOON)

A professor living a successful life with a secret. Two students who each have a hold on their mentor: one who knows her secret and another who reminds her of her first love... A romantic thriller that will leave you hanging for more.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

Young, successful, ambitious. The young CEO was born to conquer. After his untimely death, he wakes up in an alternate world as the eldest daughter of Count Hall McGrewd. "I may be in a damsel's body, but you won't find me in any distress!" Follow the newly reborn Farrell Hall McGrewd as she begins to take over in the other world of nobles and magic.

title.english: The Adventures of a Demon King's Daughter

description:
Life’s not easy for a child of Heaven and Hell! Given a second chance to live, Jo-Ara was happy to trade her dire past for a world of fantasy and magic. The only catch is she was reborn as Irene Neros Parjunel, the beloved newborn child of the southern demon king! With the god of the underworld and her deceased mother watching over her, she sets out to discover her place in this world. Throw in a snarky angel godmother and a stubborn demon godfather, and it's the perfect setting for mischief and chaos! Will Irene succeed in helping her father battle the threats that plague him? And after making plenty of friends along the way, can she finally experience true love, too?

(Source: TappyToon)

They embark on a pilgrimage to Antarctica to discover their true identity. Who are we, and where are we going?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shunned by her noble father, and having gone mute after her mother’s death, Fey was just drifting through life until the empire invaded. Amidst the chaos, the terrifying Marquess Max Warren saves her life. Grateful, she enters his service as a maid. Despite the potential communication gap, the two have no problem understanding each other. Not so much for the other nobles though, who grow suspicious of their bond. Can this lovable maid prove them wrong and show that true charm goes beyond words?

(Source: Tapas)

Jang Dae-Ho, the infamous vice president of the Nine Snake Family gang overthrown after 'the purge', was disposing of dead assassins bodies in the ruins of the grand earthquake that struck the forsaken city of Kana when he found a starved and nameless orphan. Taking him under his wing and giving him the name "Gwangnam" would be the catalyst for a long and bloody revenge journey under which the name "Killberos" began. Thus, this is the dark story of Gwangnam's crime infested upbringing, riddled with the many street rivalries and gangs' power struggles that preceded the formation of the fence project and "Killberos", the guard tribe, as we know it before his passing.

Palace maid Viola Vilvaura was in the wrong place at the wrong time when she overheard Crown Prince Adrian Aphensen's secret. It turns out his fiancée was really his bodyguard in disguise! Not only that, but the bodyguard has disappeared, leaving the prince with no one to marry! Now that she's learned this secret, the only way for Viola to save her neck is to take on the role of Etienne, the crown prince's fiancée, and become the new princess. But how long will they be able to keep up the act?

(Source: Tapas)

To save her noble family from a massive 100 million debt, Ariana Astaroth marries the wealthy commoner Rowen Green, making him the new Count Astaroth in exchange. But after five years of marriage, he impregnates her best friend, and Ariana demands a divorce, stating that she'll pay him back. She goes to a guild run by a man named Rowen for help, who promises to help her escape the marriage. Can Ariana divorce her disloyal husband, or will the overwhelming debt crush her in the end?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: My Desire is Not a Sin

description:
On their ninth anniversary, Ian receives what seems like a perfect gift, a building in the most coveted part of the city for the expansion of her art gallery. With the steamy night that followed afterward, it was set to become the most romantic anniversary ever… until her husband sneaks out in the middle of the night to cheat on her.

(Source: WEBTOON)

All Colonel Kang Hajeong wants is to retire peacefully from the Esper & Guide Special Forces, but his plans are ruined when he’s partnered with a powerful new esper named Kim Muhyeok. Worse yet, a sudden ambush cuts his life tragically short… or does it? Waking up in the hospital years later, he finds himself in the body of Sergeant Kang, a different person who happens to share the same name. But that’s not the only mystery to be solved. Strange things are happening at the Esper/Guide center, and his old partner, Kim Muhyeok, still needs his help…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Asha the potion maker remembers everything about her tragic past life, including her former husband, Karligo. They were in a seemingly loveless marriage that constantly left Asha feeling lonely and unfulfilled because Karligo would never even look at her, let alone touch her. But in this life, Asha has met a drastically changed Karligo! Now that he's afflicted with uncontrollable desire and feverish lust, can Asha cure him before his fiery passion burns them both?

(Source: Tapas)

Ji Geon-Woo has been a thief since childhood, surviving with quick hands and sharp instincts. He isn’t greedy, stealing is simply a means to an end. One day, he sets his sights on a priceless necklace owned by Lee Ye-Shin, a troubled rich heir. To get close, Geon-Woo infiltrates Ye-Shin’s home as a bodyguard. At first, Ye-Shin appears reckless and self-indulgent, but Geon-Woo soon realizes he is deeply lonely, suffering from chronic insomnia. As their relationship blurs, Ye-Shin grows possessive, and Geon-Woo finds himself wanting to protect him, rather than just stealing from him. But when Ye-Shin discovers Geon-Woo’s true intentions, their fragile connection shatters. Now, Geon-Woo must make a choice, walk away with the necklace or stay for Ye-Shin. Meanwhile, Ye-Shin realizes that the only thing he truly wants isn't wealth, but Geon-Woo himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The second season of Aporia.

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

The girl who drives me crazy... Finding true love for bad girls.

(Source: Kakao Webtoon, translated)

In the scorching heat of summer, Seokhyun's life takes an unexpected turn as he and his family leave the bustling city behind and settle into a serene countryside town. Seokhyun quickly attracts attention and gains popularity among his new classmates. However, Seokhyun's gaze is irresistibly drawn to Heebok, his quiet classmate with striking blond hair. As Heebok helps Seokhyun discover the simple joys of country living, tender moments are shared between them, and love quietly blooms beneath the warm, sun-kissed skies.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six extra chapters (rated R-19).

On the island he arrives at to find his younger brother, he is tempted by women of a suspicious cult.

(Source: DAYcomics)

"Alma mater, home town, blood ties—they're all but a façade!"

The war against organized crime waged by the government has failed miserably... and the world turned into a battlefield of mayhem ruled by one's fists. The one who unified this hell, Chairman of the Taejin Group, Jin Young-ui, has decided to open a competition of man, "Festival of Warriors" in search for a successor. Will our unemployed thug Kang Dae-oh rise to the top of the pyramid?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

How far would you be willing to go for love? The unavoidable temptation to destroy one’s deepening love is an age-old dilemma for many. This provocative collection of love stories will show you how dangerous passion can sometimes be.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Stories included:
1. Bulgeunbamui Yeonindeul (붉은밤의 연인들, The Lovers of Crimson Night)
2. Relivable-ui Ice Cream (리리버블의 아이스크림, Riri Bubble's Ice Cream)
3. Dohwa♡Jupasu (도화♡주파수, Love Frequency )
4. Gocheungbildingeseo Tteoreojin Geu Gaemineun (고층빌딩에서 떨어진 그 개미는, The Ant that Fell from a High-rise)
5. Orange Scandal (오렌지 스캔들)

I came to overcome 55 cycles of reincarnation The protagonist, Hanbit, is kidnapped by a goddess and undergoes 55 cycles of reincarnation in this alternate world in search of a clue that might save the world of “Erport.” However, undergoing 55 cycles of reincarnation means enduring the agony of death 55 times. Tired of suffering, Hanbit confesses to the goddess that he can’t go on, and returns to his original world.

But the game he started just to pass the time turns out to be the very world where he endured 55 cycles of reincarnation, and the deeper he delves into it, the more he realizes that the goddess’s dark conspiracy awaits him...

Will Hanbit be able to uncover the goddess’s sinister motives?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After a traumatic incident in high school left Se-Jin with emotional scars (and a three-year delay), all he wants now is to quietly graduate from Korea’s top university with decent grades. But what was supposed to be his easiest class turns into a paired project from hell, and who just so happens to be his teammate? The overly friendly, overly handsome Wu-Hyeon, of course! Not only is this guy clingy like lost puppy, but there’s something about him that puts Se-Jin on edge… Why does Wu-Hyeon seem so familiar, and how does he know so much about Se-Jin…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

As the son of the fallen House Anatold, Michel's only duty is to help his family's social standing by marrying the prominent Duke Shelleg of the north. However, upon his arrival, he is met with the servant Ain, who is acting as the duke's stand-in to teach Michel what it means to be a northern husband. To his surprise, his most important duties take place in the bedroom! Michel is determined to be a proper partner, but what will he do when his newfound feelings for Ain start to get in the way?

(Source: Tapas)

"Stocks are basically the same as sex."

A miraculous second chance at life is granted to Chan-Uk, once the king of Wall Street. So-Ra, who had bragged about her rookie stock skills in front of him, ends up losing everything she owns. Left with nothing, she offers the one last thing she has to the man she despised more than anyone.

"H-Hey... would you... buy me?"

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

title.english: The Wolf Who Tempted the Black Serpent

description:
After serving the kingdom for 300 years as the wolf goddess, Lauren is brutally abandoned once she is no longer deemed useful. But instead of a death sentence, she is secretly given a second chance to live as a normal beastkin. And like all female beastkin, she soon experiences her first heat, which results in a spontaneous night with a serpent stranger by the name of Alexander. Although Lauren wishes to put this mistake behind her, Alexander is desperate to find the wolfish woman he has now marked as his mate...

(Source: Tappytoon)

The fathers of the Go and Do families promised each other when they were young that they would raise their families side by side and they did just so. Years later, their kids are now teenagers/young adult who have been with each other most of their lives and are childhood friends. This is the story of the kids, their friends, and the relationships that weave them together yet just might be changing too.

Note: chapter count includes 2 extra chapters.

One day, Joan, a young and sexually frustrated jobseeker, wakes up from a highly erotic dream only to discover that the star of that dream, a she-devil, is lying on her living room floor. So what does she do? Ask her to be her roommate, of course! With Lakam, a civil servant from Hell, she gets to enjoy all the perks of having a beautiful and perfect roommate. Large breasts, a wonderful physique, she even helps with the chores! But Lakam seems a bit too perfect. Is this arrangement truly a match made in heaven…or the beginning of hell on Earth?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Love and survival beneath the sand.
Baekgi awakens in a world engulfed in sand after being cryogenically frozen. She joins Spear and Shield, a unit entrusted with protecting the bunker, and begins training under her senior officer, Ibaek. They must fight to survive in this new world amidst sudden epidemics and monster attacks...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

To atone for his brother's crimes, a powerful tiger named Beom becomes the secret guardian of two orphaned siblings, Wol and Myeong. As the years pass and Wol grows into a man, the nightly presence of his fierce yet tender protector begins to stir a different kind of hunger. In this seductive reimagining of an ancient legend, a forbidden romance blooms between a vengeful past and a restless heart. Now, Wol is ready to offer up far more than just a "rice cake" to keep the tiger by his side forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Jeollaeyahandonghwa (전래야한동화) Collection.

The Seo family is cursed with short lives, but Seungjoo seems to defy fate. That is, until a drunken night with his lifelong neighbor, Kim Muheun, changes everything. Awakening beside Muheun, Seungjoo discovers he can suddenly see ghosts. As the eldest son of a prestigious exorcist family, Muheun vows to protect Seungjoo at all costs, even if it means facing deadly spirits. Bound by a deep connection that feels almost predestined, their intertwined fates lead them on a perilous journey of exorcism, danger, and the fight against an ancient curse.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born to rich parents. Eun-Yeong seemingly had a perfect life, but all she ever wanted was her parents' approval. Then one day, an encounter with one of her father's employees drags her deep into an endless pit of desire... She knows this can only lead to her own destruction, but can't seem to walk away...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Ji-Heon, who makes a living by working part-time jobs, appears in front of Do-Kyung, who he considered like a younger brother when he was young, but with whom he lost contact due to his sudden overseas study. Ji-Heon, who accepted Do-kKung's suggestion to have a drink, loses consciousness and collapses... When he comes to, he finds himself tied up by Do-Kyung.

"But hyung... shouldn't you be thinking about something more important than this?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Part of Daiwon's Neungyonk BL Danpyeon (능욕BL단편) Collection.

Gyojin mistrusts all alphas and he despises the society that makes life difficult for Omegas. He manages to find a job, but his superior is none other than Hyeono, his former classmate from middle school who was bullied because of a misunderstanding that involved him. They settled the misunderstandings, but Gyojin is now bothered because Hyeono started courting him. While trying his best to reject Hyeono, Gyojin’s senior from college, the source of his trauma of Alphas, re-appeared in his life. And this sunbae also turned out to be one of his superiors…

“Heartless,” former humans devoid of emotions, have turned the world and Jemyeong Han’s life upside down. Jemyeong, now facing termination over an unresolved Heartless case, turns to Heartless hunting company 4K for help. But it's not long before he's inextricably entangled with its problematic co-CEO, Guk. “What if you start wanting me over everything?” Those sappy words belong to a webnovel prince, not a shameless man like you!

(Source: Tapas)

There's no such thing as work-life balance for poor Nayul, thanks to her evil boss, Sijin. Not only does he make her work overtime constantly, but she's also dumped by her boyfriend because of it. Fed up with Sijin's demonic ways, Nayul storms to his office to complain... and finds him jerking off! Though the sight is initially grotesque, Nayul finds herself oddly turned on. Somehow, she ends up banging her boss on his desk, which leads to an irritating yet steamy colleagues-with-benefits relationship. But how long can Nayul keep this shameful secret from her prying ex and gossipy coworkers?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Broke and desperate, Marin talks her way into a job assisting Gerald von Vines, the blind and temperamental duke. Her plan is simple: earn enough to rebuild her life and return to normalcy with her mother. But a moment of kindness backfires, landing her an unexpected promotion to fiancée. Now she is stuck managing a stubborn man who rejects help yet finds his only peace by her side. As their arrangement turns personal, will Marin and the Duke discover that some things are better felt than seen?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Masters of Heaven and Earth

description:
The tales of the heavens are no different from those on earth. Tongmi just wants to live an ordinary, peaceful life. However, with new kinds of thugs appearing left and right every day, it seems like the world has other plans for him – plans that involve him becoming a legend.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Veterinarian Kim Ohjin was unexpectedly summoned by a dragon. After successfully treating the dragon's pet, he returns home... only to find himself in another world. "Animals in another world are still animals, right?" I was a vet barely scraping by in the real world, but now, in this strange new world, I'm a renowned doctor? With my old clinic on the verge of closing, I'm setting my sights on a new opportunity—my second clinic, and, hopefully, a big success!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Glamorous Life of the Fake Mistress

description:
In her past life, Duke Casis Esteban swept Sally off her feet and took her in as his mistress. However, she was living in a nightmare when Duchess Elysee Esteban plotted to ruin her life and turn all the nobles against her. Now, Sally has a second chance to turn the tables on the cold duke who used her to end his unhappy marriage. She agrees to be the duke’s mistress only in appearance. Meanwhile, Duke Esteban finds Sally’s intelligence impressive, and his alluring dreams of her have him wanting to drop the fictional part of their arrangement.

(Source: Tapas)

After her sister’s suicide, Bi-Do blames Mr. Shin, the man named in her suicide note. She approaches him at the funeral expecting a cruel monster, but instead finds he feels unexpectedly like her savior. He takes her from her suffocating small town to Seoul, the place she once dreamed of living with her sister. The more time she spends with him, the more conflicted she feels about the man she thought she was supposed to hate.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The moment you turn a blind eye on injustice, you will definitely become a miserable person”. A boy named Dantae died after trying to save his friend, and at the same time a monster called “Sin” appeared. An option was given to Dantae, who thought that he had died. Are you going to heaven or kill the sins and save other people. This is Dantae’s awful punishment action fantasy.

title.english: Could the Boy Next Door be a Vampire?

description:
Navigating the uncertainty of early adulthood is no easy feat, as Hong Woo-Ree is realizing on his year off from college. Not only is he trying to make it as a published author, but he also thinks that his best friend, Gong Min-Nee, is a vampire! After making some flawed assumptions, Woo-Ree believes that Min-Nee's secretive behavior comes from hiding his "true" identity-- he's completely unaware that Min-Nee isn't actually a vampire, and just has a huge crush on him. While Woo-Ree struggles to get his writing published and protect Min-Nee's "secret," Min-Nee must find a way to confess his feelings for the oblivious Woo-Ree. Will these two be able to reconcile their misunderstandings and allow for a real relationship to blossom?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Mu-Gyeol Cha, a high-school student, is consistently bullied by a group of delinquents at school. Elsewhere, Mu-Gyeol, a mixed martial artist, has been set up to be left paralyzed and meets his demise. Two different lives are at their ends, but somehow, they both end up living on in the same body. Will they succeed in finding justice, and climb their way back up to achieve their dreams?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

title.romaji: Ije Geuman Naeryeoga Jumyeon An Doelkka?
title.native: 이제 그만 내려가 주면 안 될까?

description:
Yun Si-Ho has one goal: to survive university without becoming one half of the school’s first official gay couple. But his best friend and classmate, Ji Seung-Hyeon, is making that impossible with his relentless, daily advances. Just as Si-Ho hits his breaking point, a mysterious app appears on his phone, claiming to show the "affection levels" of handsome men. Si-Ho sees his chance. He’ll use the app to systematically lower Seung-Hyeon’s feelings and finally get his peace! There’s just one problem: no matter what Si-Ho does, Seung-Hyeon’s meter keeps rising... and it’s not just his affection that’s standing tall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.

Noah was stealing from a church the night before Christmas with his friends, but just before escaping, he falls down a high chimney and separates his body and soul!

Eve, a prospective Santa, saves Noah and offers to return him to his body if he recovers the gifts his friends stole before the end of Christmas...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Yun didn't mind being the one to confess first, especially since he knew Kwon Yong-Ha felt the same. But "no" wasn't the answer he expected, and he definitely didn't expect his rejector to burst into a fit of sorrowful tears! Yong-Ha clearly wants him, so why is he pushing him away? Yun is determined to find out what kind of strange destiny is keeping them apart, even if he has to drag the truth out of Yong-Ha himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Hachankong Danpyeonseon (하찮공 단편선) Collection.

For years, Park Ji-Woon has been quietly in love with Kang Soo-Hyuk. Soo-Hyuk notices Ji-Woon’s feelings and begins to use him like a toy, indulging his own desires without restraint. As long as he can stay close to Soo-Hyuk, Ji-Woon tells himself that being used is better than nothing. But Soo-Hyuk’s cold and careless treatment slowly wears him down. Then one day, Ji-Woon receives a mysterious package. Inside the box, he finds a strange cord and a note. Taking it as his last hope, he decides to try using the cord on Soo-Hyuk. From that moment on, something feels different.

“Trash like you deserves to be punished and taught a lesson. So obey me.”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Tae-Seok, who worked on a construction site, receives a notice of passing the document screening for the major company El Sung. At the same time, a message pops up in front of him: 'You have entered the path to becoming a regular employee tutorial. Would you like to proceed?' Follow Kim Tae-Seok's struggle to become the legendary all-around employee in this corporate adventure!

title.english: Are you into that kind of thing?

description:
A nerd Jin-U and a school star Chae-Yeong found out about each other's sex fantasy that could end their college life. Here's their fresh but unpredictable love story.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Pit-a-Pat’s fans ship everyone together except Tae-Joon and Min-Jae. Which should be a good thing, because they’re already dating! But the group’s youngest member, Tae-Joon, can’t help feeling insecure when everyone adores his leader so damn much. Can their love story overcome the struggles of fame and fandom?

(Source: Tapas)

Kwon, known as the warrior who protects Goryeo. His story begins from his childhood. The protagonist Kwon and his older brother Jeong are the sons of Manjeok, the strongest warrior and a slave in Goryeo. Their father Manjeok started a slave liberation movement, but it ended in failure, and he met his death. After that, Jeong and Kwon are constantly targeted by people trying to take their lives. While hiding to survive and training in his father’s martial arts, one day, his brother is killed in an attack by masters, and Kwon barely survives. While fleeing, he loses consciousness, and when he finally wakes up, Kwon finds himself in a Song Dynasty martial arts arena. Not just any arena, but one where the entire region is a fighting ground, and only the strong survive. Determined to avenge his brother, Kwon resolves to become stronger in this brutal place. He vows to become the strongest and return to kill those who wronged him.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Su-Cheol has a crush on his math teacher. His feelings for her aren't the innocent kind of love a student could have for his teacher..His meticulous and premeditated plan to make her fall for him begins!

"My Teacher.. She's my girl."

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Loanna was raised in neglect and isolation as an illegitimate child of the Count Louis family. She gets married off to Duke Bruggen, who orders her to keep quiet and out of the way. Free from all expectations or responsibilities, she roams around the castle and runs into a coffee bush. A passionate barista in her past life, Loanna remembers exactly how to brew a perfect cup of Joe. The trouble is, no one in this realm seems to know what "coffee" is, nor its wonderful benefits. As a matter of fact, coffee fruits are regarded as "evil." As a coffee aficionado, Loanna is determined to turn this reputation around.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Stuck in a loveless engagement with the crown prince and tired of living in the violent capital city, Violet Hale wanted a way out of her miserable life. Enter the enigmatic archduke Cedric Etchell, who breaks off her engagement and agrees to a contractual marriage with her as thanks for saving his estate. Determined to make it on her own once the contract ends, Violet starts her own business. Love isn't in the plan, but could the archduke make this self-made lady have a change of heart?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Betrayal, rebirth, and second chances.

Jae-Ryun seduced and betrayed the tyrannical emperor before being discovered and executed. Now he’s woken up 20 years in the past and crossed paths with the emperor once again. Is this his chance to atone for his sins by reforming the man he loves, or are some romances fated to end in tragedy?

(Source: Manta)

Do you think you can conquer the entire martial arts world with just one bowl of Jajangmyeon? The protagonist dreamed of becoming the best Chinese chef, but was sent to the Song Dynasty in China! However, when he woke up, there was no martial arts at all, and all that was left was the cooking skills he had learned in his previous life. But these dishes... the response is very good! In this life , will he be able to captivate Jungwon with Jjajangmyeon and live a successful second life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

What’s it like spending your whole life coming in second place?

Ask Nam Jinwoo, he’s been living in the shadow of his rival, Ma Sangtae, his whole life. From high school to college, and now in the office. But passion is strange, it can start as envy or hate and turn into something… erotic. Now Jinwoo’s head is filled with the dirtiest and most erotic thoughts, none of which are in his control. More than anything, he wants them to stop. But the only way to stop them might just be the last thing he wants to do…

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes 29 extra chapters.

"Shove it inside your hole while I watch. It's an order."

The ruthless revenge of a man who was bullied in high school began with the kidnapping of the delinquent girl who drove him to near death.

(Source: DAYcomics)

After finding a mysterious book in the imperial garden, Princess Philomel not only discovers that the book's villain shares her name, but that other events in the story are coming true too. Now, she believes that she's an imposter and that the real princess will take her rightful place, leading to the execution of Philomel the Fake! So to avoid a tragic death, she has to make sure the rest of the book doesn't come true. Can this fake princess change what's already been written?

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Yang thought he'd never see Ji-Wan again after their messy breakup, but fate and the media have other plans. Now a heroic firefighter with a documentary deal, Tae-Yang reunites with his producer ex at the broadcasting station... except Ji-Wan is doing everything he can to avoid him. But then, why does he have a seven-year-old kid with the same name as Tae-Yang? Once he secures seven dates with Ji-Wan as "payment" for using his name, it's up to Tae-Yang to do some detective work and win over his reluctant ex in seven Sundays.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kyungshin Ilbo reporter Yoo Mi-gun one day receives a mysterious tip-off email. Fascinated by an unknown attraction, she goes undercover to report on Angcheonhoe, a cult that believes in aliens. But the more you know about this religion, the more dangerous it is.

(Source: Naver, translated)

What does the "Wu" in Wuxia truly mean? It is the power to enforce one's chivalry—to wield justice not just for oneself, but to shape the world by sheer strength. And if that strength transcends the self, flows through others, and reaches to the ends of the world... Then that power is none other than divine. So what does it take for a mere human to ascend to such godhood? To reach the realm of the divine through martial might?
