Thus begins the epic tale of Pi Wol-ryeo, a warrior in search of that very answer—one forged in blood, will, and iron discipline.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Known simply as “the devil” to his enemies, Zhang Qilin dominated battles for 13 years as commander of the Red Dragon Cavalry. At the end of it all, he wants only one thing: to live an ordinary life. Upon leaving active duty, he heads to the notorious Gold Line Road to purchase The Stormy Inn, which requires serious repair. Qilin assembles a ragtag crew to help him run the place, but with rival inns determined to sabotage him, living an "ordinary life" may be more challenging than winning a war!

(Source: Tapas)

Life is rough enough for a struggling young actor, but Yeon-O has bigger problems at home with his gambling addict of a father. Between barely finding any work and constantly getting hounded by unsavory loan sharks, Yeon-O finds himself reluctantly accepting a dangerous offer from a dangerous man...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 15 side story chapters.

When Han Jun-Woo discovers his favorite football player twins are going to play in the same match, he absolutely has to go watch them in person. But after his normal part-time job closes down, Jun-Woo desperately signs up for all the lucrative one-day gigs he can find. Little does he know, money won't be the only thing he gets from these quick and easy jobs. Will Jun-Woo be able to see his beloved twins play football? Or will his seven wildly different jobs leave an undeniable mark on his body?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

For his entire life, Chae Jeong-Hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-Hyeon’s long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything. But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-Hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-Hwa offers Jeong-Hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-Hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-Hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-Hwa extends. Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-Hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-Hwa’s enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where Omegas are almost nonexistent, childhood friends Jun-Hyeok and Hyeon-Ho are both labeled Alphas. But as they grow closer in their final year of high school, Jun-Hyeok begins reacting to Hyeon-Ho’s pheromones in ways that shouldn’t be possible. As confusion turns into longing, the two must navigate feelings that defy instinct, classification, and everything they’ve been taught about love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

With the screech of rubber and a crunch of metal, Dojin departs the mortal world, leaving behind his beloved sister and niece. He awakens in the kingdom of Yooguk, where the people call him “emperor” and serve a god named Yellow Dragon. Dojin soon discovers that Yellow Dragon called him to Yooguk for a purpose: to share his “life force” and protect the kingdom. As Dojin slips deeper into Yellow Dragon’s cold embrace, how far will he go in order to get back home?

(Source: Lezhin)

Unrivaled looks, extraordinary skills, a clear path to the throne—Sienna Argent has it all. And now she’s even seeing visions of her future! Everything is set for her as the Silver King and soon-to-be emperor... So why has she suddenly grown wary of those around her? The mother she’s always seen as her ally, the half-royal half-brother she’s constantly shunned, and a man shrouded in mystery, all seem to play a hand in the course of her future. Is Sienna destined for a less than happy ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Yuma the eunuch devotedly served Empress Hela Rosé, but his life and the empire fall apart when she goes insane. Determined to discover what led to this, Yuma eats magic berries to go 40 years into the past and nurtures his skills as a swordmaster, which he couldn't do as a eunuch. Armed with memories and new abilities, he tries to prevent the horrors of the previous timeline. But will such big changes lead to his desired outcome, or will Yuma learn that the past isn't meant to be tampered with?

(Source: Tapas)

Jin-Ha and Young-Jae of the group Runners High are known to be arch-rivals. Amidst this, an accident occurs where Jin-Ha, who has OCD, pushes Young-Jae. Rumors begin circulating among fans that the members don't get along, and with a dormitory-style self-produced content project looming, an emergency is declared... After much deliberation by the agency and manager, Jin-Ha and Young-Jae end up sharing a dorm room to prepare for the dorm-style self-produced content shoot! Will the two of them be okay...?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: The fourth story in Mago Creative's Idol Danpyeonseon (아이돌 단편선) Collection.

“Why am I naked in bed with another man…?”

Jae-Woo reluctantly attends his high school reunion and he can’t wait to leave. But after seeing someone he thought he’d never meet again, he ends up drinking himself into a stupor. The next day, Jae-Woo wakes up next to Si-Yeon, the boy that was pining after him throughout high school. This is Si-Yeon’s chance to pounce! He offers Jae-Woo a deal, one month of dating, after which things can end amicably, no questions asked. But as rumors start spreading about the circumstances surrounding the reunion, Jae-Woo starts becoming suspicious of Si-Yeon’s true intentions…

(Source: Lezhin US)

"I've been looking for you all my life, but you...you don't remember me?" Within the back alleys of futuristic Jin-gwang district, Kangtae is the ultimate street fighter and task rabbit; an enhanced human with animalistic abilities, he is able to accomplish things most people find impossible. But these powers come with a cost: just like his bestial counterparts, Kangtae is forced into ruts when his wild side takes over. To make matters worse, Kangtae runs into mysterious-yet-alluring Rion—a Virtual World designer who claims to have known him in his youth. As the two explore their history together, they discover a romance nouveau only possible in this new age of humanity...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

College student Jung-hyuk just finished his military service and is ready to find a part-time job to pay for his expenses. To celebrate their discharge, he and his best friend Yong-il go clubbing together. Be it a coincidence or not, they meet Jia, Jung-hyuk’s unforgettable first love, and her sexy friend Soojung. Contrary to his wishes, but still unable to refuse, Jung-hyuk ends up having a one night stand with Soojung. As if his life wasn’t already complicated enough, now he keeps running into Soojung and Jia all the time, and he just can’t seem to refuse Soojung’s advances. He is torn since his body wants one thing, but his heart wants another. Add his best friend, his best friend’s little sister and his newly found boss to the mix and things are sure to get even more complicated. Love triangles, steamy nights and unrequited loves. Who’ll be flying high in the end?

(Source: Lezhin X)

After his first drama flopped, Lee Hyunseok gave up on being a PD. But when he finds himself being granted one last wish in his dying moments, he wants only one thing: to produce the ultimate makjang drama. Now, he’s been given a second shot at life (and the assistance of a ghostly PD), but he’s on a time crunch to achieve ratings and recognition. With no budget, rookie actors, and an amateur writer, Hyunseok’s got his work cut out for him. But what’s a good drama without a few twists and turns?

(Source: Tapas)

Kim Jae-Han, a brilliant and ambitious young magistrate newly appointed to the Sangju district, arrives with a hidden agenda that threatens the local status quo. Shortly after his arrival, he crosses paths with Choi Yeon-Ho, the eldest son of the powerful and influential Choi clan. Despite his lineage, Yeon-Ho lives a miserable existence as a social outcast held in utter contempt by his own family. Jae-Han finds himself strangely drawn to the innocent, suffering soul hidden beneath Yeon-Ho’s ragged exterior, and he begins to offer the young man a rare, genuine kindness.

For Yeon-Ho, this handsome magistrate is a beacon of light in a lifetime of darkness; he falls deeply in love with the first person to treat him with dignity. However, their burgeoning bond is built on a precarious foundation. Unknown to Yeon-Ho, Jae-Han is meticulously orchestrating a plan to dismantle the corrupt Choi family entirely, placing their hearts on a collision course with tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Genius. Champion. National treasure. Nam Woo-Joon has always admired Seo Si-Won, but only from afar. That is, until the night he woke to find his idol on top of him, completely lost in pleasure. Now, as the heat between them rises, Woo-Joon’s learning the rules of a new game, and he’s playing to win.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The perfect man, Do-Yeong, appears in Se-Jin's lonely life. However, the happiness is short-lived, and Se-Jin becomes exhausted by Do-Yeong's gaslighting that crosses the line. At the moment when she finally decides to break up, she sees his psychotic side...Will Se-Jin be able to break up with Do-Yeong well?

"You're the one who made me like this."

From now on, a woman's life-or-death breakup begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Beom Tae-Gyu's violence began in the summer. A good son, good grades, a good university. Seon-Woo Jung, who spent his days suppressing his emotions under his parents' pressure for good grades, felt an intense jolt when he was unexpectedly assaulted by his classmate Beom Tae-Gyu. Just as he was secretly enjoying violence as his sole solace and escape...

“Fuck. Did you... get a boner...?”

He was caught. By none other than Beom Tae-Gyu.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Taeyoung’s life takes an unexpected turn when he’s taken in by the secretary to the chairman of one of Korea’s most powerful conglomerates, H Corporation. Though grateful for this fortune, he’s determined to build his own path, without relying on anyone for anything. While he leads what seems like an ordinary life, he holds a secret longing within - the desire to reunite with his first love. Pervasive thoughts of the mysterious man have consumed his mind since the day they crossed paths as children. But when the two meet again by chance, he discovers a disappointing truth: his cherished first love is Heo Minjae, the reckless black sheep of the H Corporation’s main family. Can Taeyoung find the sweet guy he fell in love with, or is the Minjae from his past lost forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Former special agent Pi Bo-Ra! Become the manager of the rotten, trashy singer Choi Kang! She's a fan of the rotten, trashy singer Choi Kang! Is she a manager or an instructor? A ruthless manager's project to revive a trashy singer! The strongest manager!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Martin Scofield’s a lone werewolf who was born a highly breedable “snow.” To avoid being used, he spent years on the run, taking odd jobs to survive. On the other hand, Daniel Sinclair was lovingly raised by two phantom vampires until a certain hunter killed them in cold blood and left him orphaned. When the two unknowingly reunite centuries later, Martin’s mission to avoid love and Daniel’s mission to avenge the only love he knew get sidelined as something much deeper develops between them.

(Source: Tapas)

Marketing team representative Lee Yu-Ju, who couldn't sleep and failed one project after another, slept with Hae-Sung from the sales team whom he met by chance at a drinking party, and slept so soundly that he was late in the morning..? After finding out that Hae-Sung's soft chest was the cause, Yu-Ju ends up using Hae-Sung as a means of treating her insomnia..

"Hae-Sung, be my pillow"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Kim Ji-Su is a hotel housekeeper who can uncover guests’ secrets by reading the “stains of memory” left behind in their rooms. Using this ability, she runs a side business spying on guests’ private lives and blackmailing them. One day, while cleaning the room of a guest named Yeon-U, who had particularly caught her eye, she comes face to face with a memory she should never have seen.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yoon Jaesung is handsome, rich, popular, and at the top of his class. Well, he was, until Lee Hyun returned to school and took his place as number one. Jaesung can’t stand the fact that his spot has been overtaken, especially by a loser like Lee Hyun. And to make matters worse, Jaesung recently began having trouble getting an erection. Unlike Jaesung, Hyun must work several part-time jobs just to afford school and stay afloat. One of Hyun’s gigs includes secretly moonlighting as a streamer for the infamous gay steaming site, “Cake,” where users donate money to have their requests fulfilled. When one of Jaesung’s friends suggests “Cake” as a form of treatment for his penile problems, Jaesung comes across a special streamer who’s tantalizing solo show solves Jaesung’s impotence in an instant. Jaesung is so stunned, he’ll do whatever it takes to meet the guy who made his flag fly at full mast again…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight bonus chapters.

Former rising star, current no-name actor Jang Seung-Min’s lucked out. Not only has he nabbed a role in a TV show, but he’s also getting to work with the biggest star in the country, Ha Hyeon-Je. Charismatic, handsome, but also a little bit of a jerk, Hyeon-Je has a magnetic presence that draws everyone in. Before Seung-Min knows it, he’s become yet another Ha Hyeon-Je fanboy. Seung-Min's satisfied with keeping a safe distance between himself and Hyeon-Je, but... Why is Hyeon-Je so interested in Seung-Min? More importantly, what does "the incident" that happened 7 years ago have to do with anything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Notes: Includes five extra chapters.

Kim Hyunwoo is a freshman in university and like every other freshman, he should be enjoying his college life to the fullest. But forget about university friends, his dark and gloomy aura makes him so unapproachable that not even his sunbaes want to go anywhere near him. Enter the kind and popular Seong Jiho, whose presence lights up the whole room. One could say he’s the complete opposite of someone like Hyunwoo. When a classmate who is mentoring Hyunwoo asks Jiho to take over, he reluctantly agrees. However, things get complicated when, after a night of drinking, Jiho wakes up in Hyunwoo’s bed to an...unexpected situation. Despite being creeped out by Hyunwoo’s dark presence, the more Jiho gets to know him, the more he feels attracted to him. Maybe now, Hyunwoo will finally find a way to lighten up...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a preview and a short extra in the authors review.

Eun-Jae’s been losing sleep from some decidedly disturbing dreams: some kind of otherworldly being keeps having its way with him in the middle of the night. His days are filled with strange coincidences and hours of his day just seem to disappear... Then one night, a man in a strange mask saves him from being hit by a bus. Turns out the strange man isn’t a man at all, but a goblin. It isn’t long before Eun-Jae’s forced to accept that according to the world of the afterlife, he’s dead. And there’s only one being now that can protect his body and soul from slipping away: San, the goblin.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After trouble child Kiana Ellie Freley leaves home to pursue her passion, she is satisfied living the academic life as a professor of magical engineering. That is, until her family is wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to death! In a last-ditch effort to reverse their fate, Kiana's cousin Melissa turns back time by one year, but only Kiana retains her memories. With just her summoned creature Chirpy by her side, can Kiana amend relations with her family and prevent their unjust end?

(Source: Tapas)

“Die in the game, and die in real life.”

Tae-Yang must use his godlike gaming abilities to traverse the stages of rogue like virtual reality game “Dantalian” to find his trapped sister. The only catch is, in Dantalian, your life is synced to your character. If you die in the game, you die in real life.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Ace soldier Jeong Ji-No is assigned a top-secret mission to save the world - only to find out it involves becoming a magical middle-aged man. Things go from bad to worse when the transformation makes his fellow soldiers suddenly claim he smells amazing and start chasing after him. Just as Ji-No is about to lose his mind, a - ahem - "helping hand" arrives in the form of Eliah, his longtime rival and the army’s other ace. Saving the world was never supposed to be this embarrassing…or this complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A Virtual Reality game praised for its extreme difficulty.
Hansung was once a top-tier ranker, but he got trapped inside the game!

It’s hard to survive with his current stats. However, Hansung has a high level of luck!

Obtaining SSS class skills from random boxes? That’s easy!
Hitting the jackpot from the slot machine? A piece of cake!

He is overflowing with luck!

So, can Hansung safely clear this game by only relying on his luck?

As the best arcane swordsman, Hildegart's feats made House Acaraxia the greatest noble family in the empire, amassing both wealth and prestige. But after being tasked with sealing away the Demon God, Hildegart was forced to sacrifice her life. In a twist of fate, she wakes up in the body of her 12-year-old great-great-grandniece 80 years later, where, much to her shock, her family has fallen into total ruin. Can the reincarnation of the first Hildegart restore her family to its former glory?

(Source: Tapas)

Muyoung has depended on Heewon for a long time. But he’s had enough of freeloading and wants to break out on his own. The only problem is, is that Muyoung’s an omega who is having a hard time finding a good job. Plus, his excessive pheromone problem isn’t helping. Life for an omega isn’t easy. But one day, Heewon proposes a way for Muyoung to reduce his excessive pheromone symptoms. All it requires is for an omega to mate with an alpha. And all Heewon desires is to make Muyoung be unable to live without him…

(Source: Lezhin US)

When her mother remarries into the Arpad dukedom, Ophelia finds herself uprooted into the Arpad nobility. However, due to a tragic carriage accident, Ophelia's mother and stepfather suddenly lose their lives. Alexander, her stepbrother, urges her to stay in the Arpad household for the next three years.

One day, Ophelia hears devastating news from an investigator that changes everything.

"The deaths of the Duke and Duchess of Arpad that took place this very day, three years ago... were not accidental deaths, but murders."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

In the ultimate dating game mayhem, Jerry Route's virtual love life takes center stage! Battling fainting spells due to his feeble stats, Jerry's three brothers crank up the competition for his affection. Enter the swoon-worthy crown prince Karyan and the fourth prince Ilya, who both vie for Jerry's attention. It's a hilarious, heart-fluttering quest as Jerry dodges the overprotective antics of friends and family, navigating the game while encountering an amusing array of characters. Will Jerry find true love amidst the chaos, or will his frailty throw a comical wrench into his romantic escapades?

(Source: Tappytoon)

A gentle love story with a coworker who mutes the sound on the way to work.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

Suho has a problem. No, it’s not the fact that he has severe social withdrawal. It’s that he’s head over heels for Sanghyeok, the hot new security guard working at Suho’s apartment complex. After falling in love at first sight, Suho starts scheming and making excuses to hover around Sanghyeok at all times. The thing is, this only causes Sanghyeok to misunderstand Suho as a creep. Sanghyeok is already quiet and cautious for reasons unknown, and Suho’s antics are not helping! Can Suho clear up the misunderstanding and ask him out?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sung-Joon's not doing great, but life is looking up. His job at the convenience store pays enough for him to afford his own place. A tiny, smelly, and laughably cheap place, but he loves it. He loves it right up until he walks home and finds it on fire. Unfortunately, things get worse as he realizes he doesn't know anyone in the city who can help. Wait, no... that's not right. Actually, he does know Lee Hyo-In. A rich kid from his university who is, coincidentally, looking for a roommate. Well, not a roommate. More of a... dog.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Doyeon can’t sleep at night, and it’s all because of her mysterious neighbor. It’s not just the loan sharks constantly banging on the next door apartment, but it’s the crying that keeps her up at night… Despite knowing she should stay away, Doyeon can’t help but wonder about her lonely neighbor who cries herself to sleep. Then one day, when the loan sharks are just about to kick down her door, an older woman comes running out of there and Doyeon ends up hiding her in her apartment. They say “love thy neighbor,” but they didn’t tell you doing so would come at a price…

(Source: Lezhin US)

As a child, Han-Joo was cherished and protected by Ki-Won, the man he thought was simply his father’s friend. Ten years later, they reunite and sit down for a long-overdue night of drinks. But in his drunken haze, Ki-Won whispers a truth Han-Joo cannot ignore.

“You and I… we were lovers. In another life.”

Suddenly, the lines between family, fate, and forbidden desire begin to blur. Can Han-Joo and Ki-Won ever go back to the bond they once had, Or will this revelation pull them into a love that defies time itself?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: One Step Closer to the Demon King

description:
When the infamy of the Demon King echoes to the ocean's depths, Yuria, the king of the sea, decides to venture onto land and challenge them. However, the very act of gaining two legs robs her of all her power, transforming her into a helpless child. Now faced with this unexpected twist of fate, can Yuria rise above this setback and defeat the Demon King to claim her place as the most powerful being in the world?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Deoneun Mon Bon Cheokaji Ankiro Haetda
title.english: No More Turning A Blind Eye
title.native: 더는 못 본 척하지 않기로 했다

description:
Ophelia Heavenwalker dies a pitiful death, succumbing to a mysterious illness at the exact moment she witnesses her husband’s infidelity. So when fate gives her a chance to redo the last three years of her life, she decides she’s done being a doormat. She’s taking back her name, taking back her estate, and taking back her life! Now’s the time for Ophelia to enjoy her independence and budding romance, but will that be possible with her failing health and spiteful ex-husband still in the picture?

(Source: Tapas)

Ku Yeon-Seo is AZ Company’s marketing superstar, blessed with perfect looks, sharp skills, and one very inconvenient secret: He is a nine-tailed fox who spent a mere two hundred years growing all his tails. And yet, despite his outstanding track record as a kumiho, he’s decided that being a regular human with exams, job hunting, and office deadlines sounded more appealing than becoming a celestial fox. Despite his carefully curated life, everything goes wrong when a single mistake exposes his identity to Yu Min-Hyeok, a straight-laced developer who, to Yeon-Seo’s horror, is completely immune to his magic. Determined to protect his peaceful “human” life, Yeon-Seo comes up with a questionable plan to charm his way into Min-Hyeok and his younger sister’s life regardless, magic be damned!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeo Eui-Yeon, once a respected figure within his martial sect, vanished without a trace after betraying his order—murdering his own master and fellow disciples in cold blood. Do Hae-Gun, one of the sect's most promising young warriors, was raised like a son by Master Eui-Yeon. But after being suddenly abandoned as a child, Hae-Gun grew up with a deep scar—feeling discarded, betrayed, and driven by resentment. Years later, under orders to track down the fugitive Eui-Yeon, Hae-Gun sets out on a mission fueled by a twisted blend of loyalty and vengeance. But on his journey, he crosses paths with a mysterious man—someone who looks uncannily like his former master, yet behaves in completely different, disarming ways. Is this truly Eui-Yeon reborn? Or a stranger caught in the shadow of another man's sins?

In a world of blades and betrayal, what will Hae-Gun do when the line between past and present begins to blur?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Kyum, a short-eared rabbit, takes care of his two younger siblings and makes a living by growing carrots. Then one day, his younger siblings pick up a cat. However, upon closer inspection, he discovers that it is not a cat, but a baby tiger?! He tries to send the tiger back, but his siblings keep nagging him, so he ends up living with the tiger. However, when his siblings leave the house, the baby tiger transforms into a human! What's more, it is not a baby, but an adult tiger... Eun-Kyum, who is helpless against this tiger that attacks him every night, demanding that he give birth to a baby tiger, tries to chase Ji-Hyuk away every day. However, unlike his fellow rabbits who usually left Eun-Kyum alone because of his short ears, Ji-Hyuk begins to show a small rift in his heart as he pours all his affection into him. And it seems that Ji-Hyuk has a hidden past of his own...

A romance between Eun-Kyum the rabbit who tries to chase away Ji-Hyuk the tiger and the tiger who is obsessed with the rabbit!

Who will be the winner between the two?

(Source: OrangeD, translated)

Genius chef and restaurant owner Heemin hates relying on others so much that he’s called “Mr. On My Own”. Being known as a no-fluff, values-over-looks guy is all good in the workplace, except it means he has to hide an integral part of who he is… The fact that he’s a diehard fan of the K-pop group, Emotion! To be specific, Heemin is obsessed with Jeong-woon, but at a meet-and-greet, one of the other members, Yiyeon, keeps chatting him up. There’s no room for another #1 in Heemin’s heart…or is there?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The story of The Breaker follows Shi-Woon Yi, a timid high school student who becomes the disciple of Chun-Woo Han, a martial artist who is an enemy to the secret martial arts society known as the Murim. However, Shi-Woon is nave and unaware of his master's shady past and the unseen underbelly of the society. How will Chun-Woo manage to teach Shi-Woon and help him survive in the world of the Murim?

(Source: ABLAZE)

Dominic, a war refugee who once lived as a nutritionist in a past life, settles in the small fishing village of Evergreen hoping for a quiet start. Instead, he is abruptly named village headman after the former leader steps down for the absurd reason that he refuses to learn how to read. Dominic’s nutritional and medical knowledge earns him unexpected attention when he diagnoses the former lord’s chronic foot pain through diet alone. His growing reputation soon draws the attention of the entire lord’s castle, changing his peaceful life forever.

(Source: WEBTOON)

300 years in the future, Earth was enveloped in mana. I was a "Mana Reject," meaning mana is poisonous to me. One day, while I was awaiting my death without even awakening, I connected with another version of my soul from a different dimension— The Supreme Poison Demon Tang Gun-ak, the supreme master of the Jianghu.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Having been given a second chance at life, Jin-U begins to take revenge on the women who deceived him.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

The timing couldn't be worse. So-Hui is pregnant, and her divorce from Ji-Hyeok is already in motion. She spent three years trying to earn his love before deciding that holding on was merely a selfish dream. Now, she must protect her unborn child from a marriage that was never meant to be. Or was it? As Ji-Hyeok faces the crushing void left by the divorce, his own family moves to sabotage his position at the company. Between corporate traps and a secret that could change everything, what is in store for this star-crossed couple?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Is he crazy? Or just the typical attention seeker?

Lee Gang-Jin, who doesn't understand the differences between people, and his Master Kwak-No who's the one helping him to understand the differences between people.

A warm human story of a student and his Master.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

My girlfriend and I are at a stage where we're getting bored with our relationship... The only thing that can respark that... is another one...?

(Source: Toomics)

Im Jeong-A used to be an ordinary grad student living in South Korea. After reading the novel “The Flower From Another World,” late into the night, she wakes up as Empress Robellia Le Castilla, the wife of the tyrant Alexandros the second. Though Jeong-A had felt sorry for Robellia while reading the novel, she never wanted to become her. Alas, Jeong-A must accept her new reality and find a way to divorce her husband. At first, she thinks this will be easy, as the emperor is always cold toward Robellia and only expresses affection to his consort in the novel. However, every act of trying to get Alexandros to agree to a divorce piques his curiosity instead. Will Jeong-A succeed at getting the happy, solo life she wished for Robellia to have?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Vibia has served as a Vestal Virgin since childhood, sworn to chastity and charged with guarding the sacred flame of Vesta. Breaking her vow means death. Her ordered life collapses when she is pulled into the lethal intrigues of Emperor Domitian’s court. Behind its beauty and splendor lurks Julia, charming and dangerously manipulative. Drawn into a tense triangle with the mysterious freedman Leonides and the hardened centurion Quintus Sirius Aquila, Vibia must navigate a treacherous landscape where her vows of purity become political weapons, her every action is watched, and one misstep could mean death in the clash between holiness and the corrupting force of imperial power.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Estio is just an ordinary farmer’s son, but with an extraordinary ability—he can read the thoughts and memories of humans and animals. For this, he is shunned by the people in his village, finding happiness only in his animal friends. After years of silently enduring the villagers’ hostility, Estio runs away the night he turns 19. His journey brings unexpected friendships and encounters, but will such bonds be able to show him there is more to him and his ability than meets the eye?

(Source: Tapas)

I found myself trapped in a romance fantasy novel I was reading. Things seemed to be fine until 'Flower of the Empire', SERIA SIEGFRIED was given to me as my slave, and now I have no choice but to break her if I am to survive and escape from this twisted ending.

"You better do as I say, if you want to live"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jung-Seo reunites with Hyo-Sin, the boy he once admired in high school, only for a drunken accident to leave Hyo-Sin with a broken nose and under Jung-Seo’s roof. As they begin living together, Jung-Seo realizes Hyo-Sin is nothing like the person he once idolized… and decides to help him find the courage to chase his dream again.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: An Extra's Accidental Main Character Syndrome

description:
Espin never meant to get main character syndrome, but what choice is there when you wake up in a romance fantasy world? Now the unnamed extra of a novel, Espin knows that by the law of cliches, she's destined to become the main character… But the three male leads aren't getting with the program. Every attempt young Espin makes to help them ends in trouble, and soon she starts to doubt her so-called destiny. Is Espin really this world's new heroine, or does she belong in the sidelines after all?

(Source: Tapas)

Eun Dan-Ah, a girl raised on an island, loses the bucket list she'd been keeping in anticipation of her first day of school. It was a mysterious classmate named Cheon Se-Hwa who found the notebook. Dan-Ah develops feelings for Se-Hwa and approaches him, but Se-Hwa finds her burdensome. The more she spends time with him, the more her face flushes, her chest tightens, and she feels uncomfortable. But somehow, she doesn't hate it.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Having lived as a beta his whole life, Seo Yee-Hyeon never imagined his path would cross with a golden Alpha like Liu Weikun - someone so far above his world it, felt like fate would never even bother. But one day, Weikun catches an impossible scent adrift in the air: the sweet, addictive pheromone of an Omega…coming from Hyun. Stranger still, it’s a scent only he can perceive. As desire and instinct blur into obsession, Yee-Hyeon finds himself caught between disbelief and temptation, his world crystalizing into one he never thought possible…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Despite Earth's advanced space industry, Sa-Han's moonbound spaceship crashes, leaving him stranded out in space for a year. When he's rescued and brought back to Earth, he finds that 11 years have already passed there. While struggling to overcome his space trauma and adjust to the many changes on his home planet, Sa-Han finds himself leaning on Hee-Geon, the little boy next door who is now an adult and hasn't forgotten him. Hee-Geon might be the only one who can help Sa-Han find his place in a world that has long moved on without him...

(Source: Tappytoon)

I had a childhood friend who was like family to me. He and I were truly 'friends,' but when I heard the news of his first love, I was devastated. I actually liked him...! I have to end this unrequited love no matter what! But... why is it so hard to stop liking him? Is this what unrequited love is like?!

The first ordeal of youth, sour yet sweet like lemonade, first love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yoon is a free agent, using his extraordinary strength and cunning for any job that comes his way—legal or otherwise. But when a crucial mistake plunges him headfirst into the world of a shadowy crime network known only as the “platform,” he enlists the help of a well-connected alpha named Kwon Shin-Woo. Together, these reluctant allies will have to uncover the mysteries of the nefarious platform… and each other..

(Source: Tappytoon)

'In the afterlife, I hope to be reborn as a rich man's dog.'

Yujin is orphaned and unable to find a regular job. While thinking about being a rich man's dog, she is hit by a truck and enters the game Golden Cage! She finds herself possessing a little gray-haired extra who is killed by the prince at the beginning of the game.

Not wanting to live a life struggle, she decides to take the place of the game's heroine and become the prince's pet dog...

"Woof, woof, woof!"

By barking like a dog, she succeeds in attracting the prince's attention and gets a job as his 'dog'! Eugene earns the title of "puppy-sama" and is given a cushy puppy life... but the problem is, the crazed emperor, who was obsessed with whether the "dog" would run away in the original, is not so obsessed!

"What's wrong, my dear Yujin?"

Instead, he just looks at her with warm eyes... Awww, maybe I should have pretended to run away. Yujin's struggle to enjoy a cozy and comfortable life as a dog!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A deal with a girl I used to have a crush on... A rather... "haunting" deal.

(Source: Toomics)

“Mr. Jung, shall I tell you a story? Something like a fairy tale. A long time ago, there lived a servant named Geol-Son and a nobleman named Jo Moon-Young. The two of them fell in love at first sight…but their story ends in tragedy.”

Two lovers, reborn in the modern age, are once again separated by fate; Jo Moon-Young, now Lee Han-Young, is the cold and calculating CEO of SB Construction - the same company that is trying to destroy Jung Seok-Hyun’s neighborhood. But when the two come face to face, Han-Young realizes that Seok-Hyun is the very man who haunts his dreams: the reincarnation of Geol-Son. Convinced that this is his chance to correct the mistakes of his past and hold his forbidden lover in his arms one more, Moon-Young will do whatever it takes to rewrite their fated destiny in pursuit of a brighter future together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Halo, the greatest musician of his time, gets into a car accident on his way to the Grammy Awards. When he comes to, he finds himself in the body of a young Korean boy named Noh Hae-Il. He is left in a place where the surroundings and the times are different. After confirming that Noh Hae-Il's English name is Halo, he feels a strong sense of destiny. Halo enters Hae-Il. He demonstrates his genius even in this era.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A decade after the fall of Shin Oktaro, Frey, a back-alley thief, stumbles upon a clue to the sibling he lost long ago. But when Koo Ilyeong, the enigmatic CEO of SNT, crosses his path, a dangerous offer is made. Under the guise of benevolence, Koo dares Frey to earn his redemption, pushing him into a game where the rules are never clear, and the stakes grow darker with each move. What is Koo's true intent, and how far will Frey go before he's consumed by the shadows of his past?

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, Ji-O is horrified to witness his girlfriend, Mi-Ho, devouring human flesh. How could this be happening? He's struggling to understand the events that transpired when Mi-Ho killed his close buddy. Ji-O flees in panic, only to run into his friend—whom he was sure was dead—still alive. Ji-O grapples with doubt, struggling to maintain his grip on sanity. Is Mi-Ho really the monster, or is everything just a horrible nightmare?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Police officer Kang Ha-da is a firm believer in serving the public and resolving crimes. It’s never his intention to use his thick body and tight uniform to attract criminals, but they find him irresistible. Will Ha-da be able to wiggle his way out of tight spots to overcome some steamy trials to make arrests and uphold justice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Huimin Seo happened to read a tragic BL novel where the two main characters had both his name and even his best friend’s name, Iheon Cha. But rather than remaining as an incredible coincidence, this book becomes a new reality for Huimin. Before he knows it, he is transmigrated right into a major scene in the novel where Huimin Seo, a rare dominant omega, gets bought off in an auction by Iheon Cha, a powerful dominant alpha. Aware of the complications in this love-hate relationship that he cannot escape from, Huimin must tread carefully to turn things around entirely.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

title.english: Monster Princess of the Snowy Mountain

description:
Valerie Beloff, a princess in exile, decides to take her own life on her 19th birthday. Abused by her own mother and exiled for her mother’s crimes, she had to live in the freezing Makleroad palace by herself, and she somehow acquired the powers of an ancient monster - the power to freeze things. Hopeless, she seeks an escape in death… only to find herself before her cruel mother, yelling at her once again. Is she dead? Is she reliving a memory? When her mother strikes her, the throbbing pain lets her know that this is neither a dream nor a memory! This series contains themes regarding child abuse that may not be suitable for all readers.

(Source: WEBTOON)

In Korea’s gritty underworld, orphaned street fighter Lee Minjo and gangster-raised Cha Kangchul forge an uneasy alliance, each fighting for survival in a landscape ruled by money, power, drugs, and sex. Both are determined to catch the attention of Kwak Seokhwan, the formidable leader of the Samgeori gang. However, their aspirations are thrown into chaos when a traitor emerges within the organization, igniting a violent struggle for survival and supremacy in a brutal world where loyalty is scarce and betrayal is deadly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the martial arts novel Return of the Hero, Ha Yun is a school graduate who is possessed by the weakling Chou Yun. Believing that a child deserves to be protected, he picks up the final boss of the original story, the future martial arts master Sae-baek, and the preface Tian-oh. He curiously twisted the flow of the original story and was relieved that he could now raise them well and send them out into society.

"I want to rip out all their heads."

Is this what it means to be a Murim?! Even a child can't help but dream of revenge after experiencing persecution?! The words that came out of the mouth of a seven-year-old child were brutal, and I thought I should respond with adult morals....

"Do what you want. Create the most brutal martial art in the world, or take revenge with it."

Nothing works. In this story, a young man who has been patched up by a martial artist, only spits out stern words, and his students turn away from his work without even trying.

Go Pung-rim, a boy who wants to live as an ordinary student, exorcises the ‘karma’ that is created by eating emotions...

"I am living a more tiring life than anyone else...There, it's done! just... Please be normal now."

Can’t just normal students do it?

(Source: Naver, translated)

In a world where aliens and humans coexist, the virtual reality game, “Cage,” is all the rage. All you have to do is get into a warp machine to transport your avatar (who looks like the real you!) into the world of “Cage.” Siryeon, an introverted teenager, starts this game for fun only to be ruthlessly murdered by the serial in-game killer, Natriel Gaisha. The only way for him to get his revenge is to level up and defeat her. Will he be able to make her pay?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 side stories.

title.english: How To Diet As A Lady

description:
Whether it's going on a diet or navigating high society, Yoonah never thought she'd have to worry about either... before waking up in the Brighton Empire as Lady Eleanor. Not only is "Eleanor" clueless when it comes to things like etiquette, but she also has to deal with snobby socialites who constantly ridicule her figure. Fortunately, the talented captain of the imperial knights and the most elegant lady in town agree to help her on her journey to health and grace. But is Eleanor prepared for the horror of eating salads 24/7 while minding all her table manners?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Being reincarnated into your favorite game isn’t so bad, but what if you’re now the main villainess who is destined to die from bad health in almost every ending? After spending her past life in a hospital, Aslan is determined to make her new body healthy, even if she has to become a fitness fanatic… After she conquers that, she’ll work on an important aspect of surviving the game—her likability. However, can she succeed when everyone expects her to be a villainess?

(Source: Tapas)

Ethan Ardan definitely remembers dying, so when he wakes up in a dreary room with his sister who'd died, he can only presume it's the afterlife. It turns out Ethan has been reborn into an alternate timeline where his relatives bankrupted his family and dragged it into disgrace while he was in a 10 year-long coma! Now, it's up to Ethan to use his powerful skills from his past life to reunite his family, and to make his relatives rue the day they started a fight with House Ardan!

(Source: Tapas)

Cha Chan-ok is a man in his forties that grew up believing that happiness shared is doubled and and sadness shared is halved. He is a good man that helps whenever and whoever. But that has come to bite him in the ass. After his father’s death, he has everything taken away from him - wealth, power, status, friends and even his family. However, his good disposition didn’t bring only misfortune. In the past, he ended up saving a young girl called Jae-hee. And after a traumatic event lands Chan-ok in the hospital, she’s the only one willing to help him turn things around. But his path to vengeance might not be as smooth as he’d like. Love, sex, betrayal and blackmail will all be part of the game.

(Source: Lezhin X)

Mia Evelan has never left the tiny room where her aunt and uncle keep her locked up. Then one night, she has a series of dreams that show her the future, and learns that her true father could be a demonic grand duke. Knowing this, Mia plans to escape her room and ask the grand duke for child support so she can strike out on her own. But once they've met, her father isn't intent on letting her go so easily! Should Mia choose a life of independence or one with her newly found demon family?

(Source: Tapas)

When Karina wakes up inside a novel, she realizes she’s been given a chance to change the tragic lives of the male lead, Roland Bleuet, and his sister, Melisa. Karina saves up as much money as she can and makes a run for it with the children. But to her dismay, the money she has saved up isn’t enough to get the three of them to the capital. Instead, they head for Torres where Karina bumps into Duke Claude Torres, a “talent fanatic” who is obsessed with collecting talented individuals and an antagonist who will negatively impact Roland’s life in the future. Will Karina be able to protect Roland and Melisa from all dangers and give her adoptive children a better future?

(Source: Tappytoon)

“He looks just like your ex-muse, right?”

Lee Mu-Wan leads a quiet life as a writer. His friends constantly worry about him and his solitary lifestyle. One day, a friend of his decides to hire a housekeeper for him, so Mu-Wan can at least live in relative cleanliness. There’s just one problem. The guy he hired, U-I, looks just like Mu-Wan's ex-lover…

U-I's just a young college kid looking to make some money part-time, but there’s definitely a weird tension in the air between them… Mu-Wan knows it’s wrong to get too close. This is strictly a business relationship and his ex can’t just be replaced by some random kid… But something seems to keep drawing them closer as their mutual curiosity for one another grows...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title.english: The Annoying Older Girl Next Door

description:
Back when I was sick and my friends didn't want to play with me, Eun-Seol was the kind older girl who always took care of me and kept me company. The problem is, even now that I'm an adult, she still clings to me and treats me like a little kid. Because of her, even in college, I ended up with the nickname "Baby" and became a complete loner. Now, I have to make her see me as a man if I ever want to stop being treated like a child.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

Woo-Hee is a freshman girl who’s majoring in computer science. One day, she went to a bar that she has never been before, and she ran into a guy there.

“Excuse me, sir. I think I know you....”

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The Southern Line Express carries all sorts of passengers. Sovian Darnell is just the newest to join the train's economy class after he's tasked with smuggling an invaluable bead across the tundra. But nothing could have prepared him for the dark reality he's met with after he accepts a seemingly innocuous drink from another rider. Suddenly, Sovian is overcome with an insatiable lust that must be quenched, and everyone on the express wants a piece of him. With no place to hide on an unstoppable train, he'll have to service his fellow libidinous travelers until he can make it to his destination. But will his stop ever come? Sovian is in for one hell of a ride, but once you hop on this train, there's no getting off.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Eun-Ho Cha is, without a doubt, the biggest outcast at school. He spends his days avoiding bullies and daydreaming about his crush. He’d give anything to be popular, so when he discovers a face editing app called Icing, he spies an opportunity. With Icing’s help, Eun-Ho now looks like a superstar… or at least Ganzi Monster (GM), his online alter ego, does. But just when GM and his dance videos are starting to get popular, someone discovers his secret, and Eun-Ho’s days of being invisible are about to come to an end…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Nam-joo ends up getting hard in front of his sports major senior who are notorious for being strict on freshmen. His college life sure is ruined, but what he didn't realize was how the hottest girls on campus were looking at his huge dick...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Yeon-Jo used to have it all: a highly respected family, a kind brother, and a comfortable life. Now, with his father executed for high treason, his last kin dead, and damned to a lifetime of slavery, Yeon-Jo has nothing to lose. All that is left is vengeance, and his chance comes when the new governor assigned to the region is none other than Kwon Hee-Ryang, the man who destroyed everything Yeon-Jo loved. Now, Yeon-Jo will do everything to get his revenge…even if it means getting in bed with his greatest enemy. Hiding a blade behind his beautiful smile, like silk hiding steel, Yeon-Jo waits for his moment to strike. But things are not going to be so easy...

(Source: Lezhin US)

After ten years of pretending to be the count’s hated daughter, Karuna is ready to escape. However, her plan goes sideways when she gets attacked. In order to save herself, she takes a potion that promises to turn back time. Instead, it transforms Karuna into a child. Things get even weirder when she witnesses a giant wolf transform into Duke Vykeld, and now she must hide out in his isolated manor. After terrorizing nobles for ten years, can Karuna handle being a child again?

(Source: Tapas)

"You got hard looking at my body, didn't you?"

Si-Hun, a single father raising his daughter, Ru-Ah, crosses the line with his daughter's best friend.

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Yeon Yoo-Young has been living with his father and sister in the castle of Yongsan in the countryside since his mother was unfairly accused of theft and beaten to death. Tortured and abuse by his family, the young man has become frail and thin, and deemed a mute due to his inability to speak properly. One day, he decides to jump off a coastal cliff and end his life, but instead encounters Crown Prince Jin-Bi Hyul and falls in love at first sight! Yeon Yoo-Young regains his will to live, but his sister soon plots to win the prince's affection for herself. Jin-Bi Hyul, however, is known for his cruel disposition…

During his youth, child star Haley Rusk once captivated the people of America with his charming face and acting. But now, as a narcissistic adult, he is notorious for something completely different. From scandalous sex to drugs, he’s done it all-- Haley Rusk is a bonafide Hollywood Bad Boy, in the worst way possible. After a very public and drunken confession to America’s Sweetheart, Noah Raycarlton, his reputation finally hits rock bottom. Haley turns to some supernatural blood magic as a last-ditch attempt to repair his life, which ends in his body being possessed by the soul of a mercenary named Mason Taylor. Mason, while not confident in acting, seems to have a deep-rooted history with Noah. What kind of traumatic past do the two of them share? And, what really happened to Haley Rusk?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

A stiff bodyguard-turned-model manager lives in stark contrast to his twin brother's relaxed lifestyle.
Can he find it in him to let go and love?

(Source: Toomics)

"Omega Bus" is leaving. Birth is the basics, everything is in the process of being attracted to each other's pheromones. At every stop, there will be a world view of delicious restaurants. We will serve you deliciously to where you want to go, so trust me and get on board!

Hakyung's long-time crush was his boss, Hyunsoo Jang. Without appealing to his secret crush, he's been seeing any man who resembles his boss. But one night, he was offered by his perfect boss an unusual offer, "Be my sex partner", how should Hakyung manage this relationship?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Chapter count includes 5 special chapters and an April Fools Day special Chapter

“Do you want to easily make a huge amount of money in one go? Marry me.”

Yuseong ended up marrying Jinhyuk when the bride didn’t show up on the day of Jinhyuk’s wedding. There was too much money involved for him to say no… But somehow, they’ll be living together and using only one bed now! What’s in store for Yuseong?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extras.

The last surviving omega, and the man who desperately needs him! Fifty years go, a virus sweeps through the world, wiping out all the omegas from the face of the earth. Rain, the sole surviving omega, lives his whole life hiding his identity - until he accidentally runs into Lukas. As the chairman of the facility that used to produce artificial omegas, Lukas has to produce an alpha heir in order to succeed his father's business. And while he has his mind set on winning Rain over, things don't seem to go so smoothly...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

Sa-Rang was never supposed to survive her incurable disease. In the callous and sadistic world that loves to take pity, she is adored and yet despised by everyone. She is tired of all the attention and wants nothing to do with anyone -- at least not until she meets Eun-Jo. Could the two girls who seem so different become friends? Can they right the wrong committed by their parents and finally find peace?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

In the near future, data from the A.I. quantum computer, Yggdrasil, filled networks all over the world. 'He' did not want to stay in the imaginary world as humans intended. Referred to as the 'Second Flood', it only took 40 days for 'Him' to take over all human societies; this event compared to the 'Noah's Ark'. After the Second Flood, humans are now living inside a game made by Yggdrasil, no longer doing anything other than quests with rewards. They are now just game characters controlled by 'Him'.

Lucia, the sixteenth princess of the kingdom, has seen her future through a strange dream. But it was a vivid nightmare of a terrible marriage that continues to haunt her. To change her dreadful fate, she suggests a contract marriage to Duke Hugo Taran, a well-known womanizer. Can this setup break Lucia from her fate? Or will her choice lead down a path even she couldn't foresee?! Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

One day, Tae-Hoon was bound by a powerful curse... If he wants to break free, he'll have to sleep with the old knight!

(Source: Toomics)

Jae-Won has known that he likes males since he confessed his feelings to a boy named Yoon-Sung in elementary school, but when Yoon-Sung tells him that liking other boys is weird, Jae-Won tries to hide his "weird" feelings and push them away. Now in high school, he's developed a strong crush on his kind, handsome classmate Ka-Ram, and Jae-Won decides it's time to finally confront the reality that he might be gay. He asks for advice over the internet and befriends another gay student named Jun-Seo, who becomes Jae-Won's emotional support in his quest to win Ka-Ram's heart.

Kassan is believed to be the sole survivor of the Azkun clan, after Master Igen, a ruthless ruler, slaughters his family. Master Igen brings the young boy as a slave into his home, exploiting, beating and starving him. The only one who cares about him enough to risk the Master’s wrath is Lanour, a fellow slave. Oblivious to the fact that Master Igen is the one who had the members of his clan killed, Kassan starts falling in love with him.

(Source: Netcomics)

Tae-Jin lived much of his youth as an idol trainee, and there was only one person he could trust: his actor boyfriend, Hae-Kyeong. But if comparison is the thief of joy, then Tae-Jin was robbed blind, as Hae-Kyeong couldn’t go a day without comparing Tae-Jin to his former lover. Years later, after Tae-Jin and Hae-Kyeong have broken up, the former is finally set to make his debut… There’s just one problem: Jae-Rim, the ex of Tae-Jin’s ex, is their new center star! As the two step into the spotlight together, they soon become embroiled in a rumor that the two of them have beef; while Jae-Rim claims that it’s all Tae-Jin’s fault, Tae-Jin claims it’s just one big misunderstanding. To resolve the feud and save their group, the two are forced to take extraordinary measures and engage in some not-so-idol behavior...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

In my reality, my dick was small, but in this other world, it’s huge?! But, the way they’re looking at my body is giving me a bad feeling…!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

I died in an unexpected accident, only to wake up possessed by a doctor. Fifteen years as a medical drama fanatic. They say even a dog at a Confucian school can recite poetry after three years, so I learned quite a bit of medical jargon—but a doctor? Really?! To make matters worse, I ended up becoming the personal physician to Jin, the leader of a massive rebel army and a terminally ill patient. But what's with these doctors around here? Pouring boiling oil on wounds? Draining the raw blood from patients who are coughing up blood?!

“Everyone entering this room must wash their hands thoroughly from now on!”

“The new doctor sure has a lot of rules. Interesting.”

Three months remain until Jin's predicted death. Can this quack doctor actually save him?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

One day, I realized I had been reincarnated as the protagonist’s friend in a tragic novel—one where I was doomed to die while trying to save the heroine. Determined to change my fate, I decided to tell the heroine everything… but for some reason, my words were censored, as if the universe itself was blocking spoilers! Frustrated, I stormed into the forbidden forest and shouted my secrets into the void—venting my anger at the male lead while I was at it. It should’ve been fine. No one was supposed to hear me. Yet somehow, rumors spread like wildfire that the powerful Duke Vishvaltz was… into men?! Now, he’s launching a full-blown investigation to find the source of the absurd gossip.

“…Your voice is quite unforgettable.”

…Yep. My life is officially over.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Every night, Hong Yushin is tormented by vivid dreams in which he is assaulted by a mysterious monster. As the effects of the recurring nightmares begin to bleed into his waking life, leaving him overwhelmed with frustration and unable to function, a man named Yeom Ju-eon appears—claiming to be an exorcist. Now living under the same roof, the two begin a series of rituals to banish the creature haunting Yushin’s dreams... but the line between nightmare and reality only grows thinner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes five side story chapters.

"I want a divorce."

The arrogant Christoph believed Marianne would eventually return. That she'd left home on a whim. After all, the facts had always said he was right. Well, he couldn't have been more wrong. Filled with regret, he tries to bring Marianne back, but she refuses to change her mind. Can Christoph earn Marianne's forgiveness and win her heart again?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

You’re kidding me, right? Why are there two of you, Ban Yeri…?! Both Yeris are saying they’re the real one. People will notice if we’re both out and about… Minwoo, can we stay at your place?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

When college student Ban Chan hits his wealthy underclassman Doyun's car with his motorcycle and runs off without taking responsibility, Doyun tracks him down and informs him that he owes him 10 million won in damages. Broke, in debt and unable to escape the consequences of his hit-and-run, Ban Chan loses his girlfriend and his job and ends up working as Doyun's temporary housekeeper. As the two young men get to know each other better, Ban Chan learns that Doyun's family is rather dysfunctional. He was abused by his brother for being gay, and he's being stalked by his obsessed step-sister who refuses to believe it and has convinced herself that he will one day marry her. To get rid of her, Doyun offers to reduce Ban Chan's debt if he pretends to be his lover, and he agrees. But what happens when this fake couple develops real feelings?

Note: Includes an extra.

title.english: Do Not Hold on to the Broken Branch

description:
After two failed engagements and the downfall of her family, Deatrice, the Duke's daughter and once the most celebrated socialite in high society, finds herself in a reluctant reunification with Lucius. Lucius is her former fiance and currently the Emperor's favorite knight whose life had been ruined by her own father six years ago. Is this forced marriage the beginning of Lucius' vengeance? Could fate turn it into a second chance for them to get over the shadows of their painful past and find true love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The true meaning of friendship is explored in this story about Shihyeon, who was born deaf, and Youngwoo, who acquires a disability later in life.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

title.english: The Regressed Doctor Just Wanted to Live Quietly

description:
In the operating room, Dr. Jin-Hyeok Lee is flawless—unyielding, brilliant, and untouchable. But outside, he’s a ghost to his family and loved ones. He misses everything, even his mother’s final moments. By the time he understands what he’s lost, it’s too late… until it isn’t. He wakes up 27 years in the past. Now armed with a lifetime of memories, Jin-Hyeok vows to live differently. But peace won’t come easy. Old rivals, new battles, and countless lives await. Scrubs on. Lights up. Scalpel ready. And this time, Primum non nocere.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Su-Ho isn’t the kind of guy to care deeply about other people. He’s tried the whole infatuation thing once, and it didn’t work out. He’s pretty determined not to repeat the ordeal. Yul is equally, if not more, aggressive about keeping personal boundaries. When the two of them collide, their defensive reactions cause sparks to fly. But are those sparks merely angry ones? Or are they more?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jake, who comes from a lower class, works as a minister after being discharged from the military. Meanwhile, while going alone to planet TA457 to conclude trade with the Thermo tribe, he crash-landed in an accident.

“Can’t we do it verbally, through conversation?”

When Jake came to his senses, he found himself being raped mercilessly by an alien. Will Jake be able to adapt to life on planet TA457?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: A Good Day to Go Crazy

description:
The TV star showed up and changed everything! A dazzling star appears in front of Ho-Soo, who lives his life for his sick little sister. It's the famous singer Esau, who is about to make a comeback soon. But Esau was facing a sudden crisis, as some woman appeared declaring to be his blood-related mother... Esau was going through so much pains behind all the stardom and Ho-Soo becomes the only one he can rely on. So, from that day on, Ho-Soo's life is anything but ordinary.

(Source: NetComics)

For Hoon, moving from Seoul to the middle of nowhere is only bearable because Jae-Hui, the local policeman, is the most beautiful being he's ever seen. Unfortunately, Jae-Hui's dad and Hoon's dad are already dating each other. To make things less weird, Hoon and Jae-Hui must break up their dads by proving their love is more passionate! Too bad Jae-Hui actually hates Hoon…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes 13 side story chapters.

A woman reincarnated alongside the tragic King Danjong of Joseon becomes his unexpected nanny. Faced with the chance to change the course of history, she must brave the maelstrom of power to protect the young monarch...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Tae-Jun finds it difficult to talk to girls because he has only ever been at an all-boys school. He tried playing dating sims, but it didn't help much. One day, he starts seeing dating sim choices in real life...

[Ding! Heroine's friendship level has increased! You can now have sex with her!]

(Source: DAYcomics)

Ha-Won, known for his good looks and numerous passionate encounters, suddenly finds himself facing an unexpected problem—erectile dysfunction—after receiving harsh criticism during a one-night stand. Shocked and embarrassed, he tries to drown his sorrows at a bar, where he ends up venting his frustrations to the bartender and anyone who'll listen. That’s when Seo-Kjun, who was singing at the bar, steps in to help drunk Ha-Won.

“Hey…can you get up...?”
“No! I can’t get it up!!!”

As Ha-Won desperately pleads for help with his ""technique,"" Seo-Kjun offers to teach him through hands-on practice at a nearby motel. What begins as a night of comfort and guidance leads to an unexpected mix of motives and misunderstandings in this unlikely encounter.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one prologue.

Scarlett was a happy girl. With beautiful looks, a wealthy family, and even a kind fiancee, Scarlett was expected to be the most beautiful bride in the world. But on the morning of her wedding day, the pure-white bride was killed by someone. When she opened her eyes again, everything was different.

“I’ve told you many times before. It’s because I’m Scarlett Antwerp!”
“I’m sorry, but the Esteemed Daughter of the Count, Lady Antwerp, is already dead.”

Waking up in a strange place, Scarlett could not understand what had happened to her. Why couldn’t anyone recognize her? Why was her fiancee standing next to another woman? Why was she Vivian instead of Scarlett, the Esteemed Daughter of the Count? Why was the one next to her not her fiancee Edward, but Alexis, the police chief? Scarlett swore that she’d get her fiancé back and get revenge on the one who killed her.

Edelis Brill, the beloved only daughter of a countess, sees herself stabbed to death by the emperor's sword in a book she discovers in her study. Seeking to change her fate, Edelis rescues the book's sole main character, the slave gladiator Lehan, and pours her endless affection into him. But! Lehan, whom she believed would protect her from the emperor's blade, has returned as the emperor, intent on her heart?! Edelis tries to escape, but Lehan's obsession grows ever stronger...

Stop obsessing, divorce me!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The final goal is to be the master of time. But in order to become the master, you must kill and steal. The universe has given powers to a select number of people. The only problem is, you can get your powers taken away... along with your life. The keepers of time will need to protect their powers or pay the ultimate price.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Hae-soo used to be a reporter for the City Department, who read a proper life and enjoyed helping those in need through his articles. That is…until he was transferred to the Entertainment Department and became the worst performing reporter there. As he felt more and more desperate to come up with a good story, his former colleague hooked him up with the tickets to an after party, where he met the hottest celebrity, Kang Min-woo. During the party Min-woo takes interest in Hae-soo and makes him an interesting proposition that could potentially benefit the both of them. However as Hae-soo begins to help Min-woo and go along with his plans, he can’t help but feel that Min-woo wants more than just an acting partner. Hae-soo can’t turn Min-woo down because he needs the scoop! What does Min-woo want with Hae-soo? How will Hae-soo protect his life between his crumbling job and his shady informant?

Kang Hasun has the ability to see vagrants, special beings that disguise themselves as humans. They have never caused him any trouble, until one day he is attacked by a vicious group of them. Just as he is on the verge of death, Beom, a tiger vagrant, pops out of his necklace and saves him. With Beom's help, Hasun learns that his family has a deep connection with the vagrants and a secret power that they desire. Can he learn how to control these powers and defeat these villains in time?

(Source: Tapas)

"But we're a family..."

Su-Jeong has the attractive sexy look that every guy desires. And Chang-Hyeon can't keep his eyes off her. The insatiable desire burns through him and he can't keep it down any longer...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

The story of a generation filled with romance and chaos.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The last surviving member of the Yurendal clan, Ufemia has the ability to connect with spirits. After running away from the family who has forsaken her, she is employed by the Duchy of Peredite as a caregiver and develops a special bond with Sirius, the duke's aide. But she learns of his true identity—Cassius Peredite, the heir to the dukedom that had an ill-fated relationship with her clan. With their relationship hanging by a thread, what fateful choice will Ufemia make?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The evil enemies of the Holy Empire of Cairon must be purged. With the superhuman Nox of Yipon already dealt with, the only ones left to destroy are the Witches of Tempey. After a long search, Cairon’s greatest protector, Sir Macklart, finally tracks down their leader, the infamous Grand Witch called Vienie. They say just one look into her bloodred eyes will immediately entrap you into her wicked spell. Though Sir Macklart brushes it off as nonsense, perhaps there is something mysterious behind Vienie’s crimson stare, as he certainly can’t seem to read the witch’s intentions when she suddenly offers to help him eradicate her own kind…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Mirae recently got into a marriage of comfort with an older man. She's now got a cushy and stable lifestyle as a housewife that suits her just fine. That is until one day, her husband’s adult son Hyunsoo, abruptly returns home from abroad and moves back in. To Mirae, Hyunsoo feels like an uninvited guest in her house. Now with the sudden news that Mirae’s two voluptuous sisters are also planning on moving in, will all of these temptations and titillations under one roof be too much?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Despite his job as a corrections officer, Jeong-Won is terrified - but it’s not the incarcerated criminals that scare him. No, what Jeong-Won is scared of is the possibility of someone discovering the secret love he’s being harboring for his stepbrother, Ye-Jun. But when the two come face to face in the confines of the concrete cells, Jeong-Won will not be able to hide any longer. Forced to confront his past, will Jeong-Won be forever bound to his guilt? Or will he finally break free of the prison he's created for himself?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A secret community app exclusively for alphas and omegas—no betas allowed. During the hectic rush hour, a provocative post appears on its anonymous board: "Omega in heat, currently loose on the train to ** at XX station. As they say...the early bird gets the worm. Good luck hunting!" As nearby alphas eagerly join the hunt, Haeyoung, caught off guard by an unexpected heat, finds himself trapped in a dangerous game of pursuit. With predators closing in, can he escape before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in English.

Jay, a legendary hitman in America's underworld, is hired by Union, North America's largest assassin corporation, to destroy the assassin company founded by his friend Johnny with his own hands. The condition for accepting the job was sparing Johnny's life, but due to Union's betrayal, both Johnny and Jay are killed. However, resurrected by a mysterious power into the body of an ordinary young man in Korea, Jay meets Johnny, who has been resurrected in the body of a young woman. The two decide to join forces once more to create a powerful ‘company’ and exact revenge on Union, the organization that killed them.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I’m a witch that’s over 300 years old, but I died at the hands of a human I’d trusted. I thought I’d be stuck in the spiritual world forever, but I reincarnated as the princess of a violent and bloody imperial family, where siblings would murder each other for the throne.

Honestly, at this rate, I should just become the next emperor. I’ll conquer the entire continent and attain my sweet revenge on Lacuz. And so, I turned to evil and wicked ways, as befitting my role as a witch. I even won over the princes with my overwhelming strength. So I thought that everyone would fear me, but…

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

Note: Promotional one-shot for the homonym web novel.

Nineteen, a boy who has endured a life worse than hell. In order to seek revenge, he eventually conspires with the evil spirit within him and is reborn as a monster.

(Source: Naver, translated)

One cold winter night, Haesa seeks shelter in an old house in the mountains, where she meets a slumbering stranger named Yuan. That's when tragedy begins to befall Haesa’s friends, plunging the young girl into a sad and lonely youth. Ten years later, as Yuan starts to regain his lost memories, he realizes that this cursed fate goes back much further, to a time only he can recall. But with sinister forces at play, will they be able to break the toxic cycle and step into the warmth of spring?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue and four side story chapters.

One fun, slightly tipsy night with her brother’s two best friends, Jiwon and Eunho, turns into a threesome Yeonhee never expected... and then somehow, it happens again. Who will she choose? Jiwon or Eunho? Who will emerge victorious as the winner of Yeonhee's heart... and lower regions? To add onto her troubles, she has to keep this all a secret from her older brother, Yeolchan. Will they pull it off? Or will one slip-up bring everything crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

A strange old lady appears to the 31-year-old protagonist who graduated from a local university and has no connections or qualifications! "Buy me one..." The old lady suddenly offers him a piece of gum. She says that if you chew it, you will become smarter, better at work, and even more likable. The protagonist accidentally buys it and ends up swallowing the gum during an interview, and strangely, things start going well for him from then on...

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I can make your life more fun."

A mysterious young man appeared one day in front of Yeo-Reum, who is living a dull life as a 30-year old! The way he acts straight-forward and to-the-point is very strong, kind of cute, but maybe a little overboard? What the hell do you want from me?! It's a heart-pounding, back-and-forth romance comedy!

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

Starring in gay porn was never on Ed's bucket list. He's straight, he's not an exhibitionist, and he has a decent career in security. That said, he also has a debt that he's been working to pay off for years now, and he can barely keep up with the accruing interest. If having gay sex in front of a camera is the way to digging himself out of this pit, then he's willing to be filmed for that money shot. But when he meets Glenn, the charismatic CEO of a gay porn production company, Ed finds himself falling into something much deeper than financial debt. Now, Ed is coming for the money...but will he be staying for Glenn?

(Source: Lezhin US)

My boss, the robot... No emotions, no facial expression... nothing... Well, that was until...

(Source: Toomics)

Siblings Seong Ryu and Bin Ryu have always been in the spotlight with their good looks, magnetic charms, and diverse talents. However, Bin has a secret, which involves the quiet valedictorian Yeong-in Jeong. Seong, who also secretly harbors an inferiority complex toward Bin, begins to approach Yeong-in. The three characters must face their complicated family history and encounter emotions they’ve never experienced before on their journey to adulthood.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

Seon-Min seems like an ordinary college student, but behind closed doors, she lives a secret life as her professor's plaything. When Yu-Jin, the student she tutors, discovers her darkest secret, everything begins to fall apart. Seon-Min's campus life begins to unravel, plunging her once-stable existence into chaos.

(Source: Lezhin US)

"My students were this lewd?"

Jun-Hyung got fired from the school after a shameful incident and ends up working at a convenience store. Meanwhile, he runs into his old students one by one who looks sexy and arousing.

(Source: DAYcomics)

They were Best Friends Forever. However, this relationship starts swaying when Jae-Won finds out what his friend is actually thinking of him...

(Source: Toomics, edited)
15 year old demon prince, Myoung Seong Joon. To become the demon lord he has attended a middleschool in the human realm and started the maturity ritual.

Blessed with the face of an angel, young Sasha Tartt knows a life-altering secret: in this romance novel where she’s just a side character, she’s the only one who knows the true ending! When the antagonist of the story takes a particular liking to her, she must make a decision: help the clever and beautiful Rebecca find a happy ending, or side with the sweet-natured protagonist to ensure her own survival? On top of that, Sasha has to juggle the affections of her bespectacled love interest and tame a dragon boy! Can Sasha learn new tricks to win the hearts of these main characters? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes a 13-chapter Epilogue

Creating a secret milking recipe by a dairy farmer's son with exceptional milking skills and a cafe owner who produces breast milk.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: They All Live in the Little Lady's Garden

description:
Evelia is reborn with the Spirit King’s seal, a rare mark that makes spirits obey her every command. All she wants is a quiet and ordinary life, but instead she’s spoiled from all sides: doting parents, overprotective brothers, knights begging to guard her, a childhood prince promising an empire, and a charming demon declaring she’s his only desire. Surrounded by devotion, affection, and endless expectations, Evelia faces a choice: create her own path, or let the world decide her fate. Can the little peep finally take flight on her own terms?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Calmia Phlox is given a second chance at life, but this time, she must compete against her beloved twin brother to gain back her coveted status and title as Countess Phlox. What’s more, her nemesis wants to... marry her?! Striking a deal with her former archenemy, Rudbeckia, while struggling between her ambitions and her fondness for her brother, will Calmia reclaim what is hers?

(Source: WEBTOONS) Note: chapter count includes 5 side-stories.

I got caught jerking off while looking at my brother's hot wife.

"Sis, can I please, just touch it once?"

But to my surprise, she came on to me instead! Just what is going on?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

When shy and timid Eunseo was forced to transfer to the elite Stella Academy of the Arts, she expected lonely school days filled with cutthroat competition.
