So she's taken by surprise when the free-spirited Ina takes a sudden liking to her. The two girls become closer as they secretly meet on the rooftop after classes, and Eunseo's friendly admiration grows into something more. Luckily, Ina returns her feelings as well... but they seem to border on a dark obsession that grows larger by the day. What will happen when Eunseo discovers the hidden reason behind Ina's mysterious love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The real world will soon be corrupted... Mankind may face extinction...

Facing the strange, twisted, and threatening Counterside corruption, humans were bewildered. Right now, they discover the heroes who have become Counters using the supernatural power generated by the “Watch”. To safeguard our homeland and future, Counters must shuttle back and forth between the real world and the Counter Side to fight the Corrupted Objects!

Jun-Ho, an ordinary office worker, decides to learn Jiu-Jitsu from A-Rum, his neighbor.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Leo is left for dead after a robber stabs him with a knife and runs away. But, up until the very moment he passes out, he keeps a firm grasp on his desire to live. He wakes up in someone else’s bed, and he finds out that he was saved by Owen Bentley, a popular celebrity. He also finds out that Owen is a vampire—and that he had to turn Leo into a vampire in order to save him! But Owen harbors another secret, one that he seems to hide desperately… What is this secret? How will Leo find out?

200 years after the asteroid collision, mankind had risen but not everybody was equal. Im Yoon, who was discriminated for being nonimmune, meets Lee Haejin, the pinnacle of human evolution. The SF romance begins with the meeting of the bottom 5% and the top 0.001%.

Note: Includes ten side-stories.

Uigang Bang is an ordinary small business owner who leads an ordinary life… until unordinary things start to unfold in his life. His business partner suddenly disappears, leaving a notorious loan shark chasing after his company. His wife and their child-like dog survive an attempted murder by an impulsive killer only to live in fear of his second attack. Uigang faces the killer to end the matter, but things go south and now he faces two dead bodies instead. Just when he’s debating whether to turn himself in, he receives a life-changing offer -- do you want to become a hitman?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count includes Episode 0.

Yoo Beom is a genius college student who lost his family to an organization that manipulated cryptocurrency prices. Deciding to seek revenge, he hides his identity and infiltrates the cryptocurrency gangster organization, ‘ONE’. He uses his genius brain to begin a bloody revenge on the cryptocurrency organization that ruined his life.

Can a war hero escape her murderous past?

Cerise, a condemned war hero on the run, seeks refuge in a country called Kincayla, by enlisting in the "Blue Bloods," an investigations unit specializing in crimes of the aristocracy. Will Cerise be able to escape her bloody past, as well as bring justice to the people of Kincayla?

(Source: Manta)

Ryan has a new stepmom. She's beautiful, smart and his age. What will happen when she decides to play with him?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Eunhyo has always been sweet and innocent. She grew up constantly smiling. But then one day he came into her life and took that innocence away. This man who’s thirsty for sex and violence. Once there to protect her, his presence has now become a curse. Eunhyo needs to escape from this beast at all costs, even if it means killing him…

(Source: Lezhin X)

What would you do if you were ordered to enter a fake marriage… with your crush? That's exactly what happened to Do-Dam, an agent working for the NSO, the most secretive government organization. Do-Dam's mission? To expose an industrial spy. But here's the twist: she has to go undercover as a newlywed with her boss and crush, Ju-Won Gi. Do-Dam is determined to accomplish her mission and win Ju-Won's favor along the way. Can she safely complete her mission? Or will her feelings jeopardize everything?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

A former member of the best film studio in Korea, a genius marketer, and the only employee who failed his peer evaluation and was involved in a bribery case, a public enemy within the company. All of these modifiers summarize Han-Rok's life as an office worker. He only wanted to focus on his work, and he hated politics and flattery, so he rejected all lines, but the price he paid was betrayal and false accusations from those around him, and at that moment, he was at a loss... He returned to that day five years ago when everything started to go wrong. Han-Rok, who started to cross the line with the determination not to be taken advantage of again in this life, started to see a clue to the problem that had not been visible until then.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Sometimes it sucks going back home. Annoying childhood friends, old people who won't shut up about helping raise you. But sometimes you get to see those girls you once hung out with. But now they're sexy women.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A couple can't be more chill than this! Come take a look into their lives inside and outside of school.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

"You guys use fists, not guns!"

Shin Hae-Soo, a specialist in excessive suppression, gains the ability to go back 60 minutes. On the day my father passed away, I intuitively knew. This was a murder disguised as suicide. Hae-Soo becomes a detective to catch the culprit who killed his father. And one day, along with a mysterious accident, he suddenly gains superpowers! A huge shadow gradually reveals itself as he solves criminal cases and pursues the organization!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: The Villain's Daughter-In-Law Rules by Nature

description:
After six short, measly lives as insignificant items of a novel, Florine finally wakes up in the body of a shapeshifter. The problem? She's a tiny sable without enough power to turn into a human. While spending her days as a servant, she crosses paths with Kiraxus, the original novel's villain. She thinks her short life as a shapeshifter is over, but instead, he makes her the daughter-in-law of his family! Will Florine finally live the long life she desires? Or is it all too good to be true?

(Source: Tapas)

After suffering both scam and divorce, Chu Minsik teeters on the edge of financial ruin. Still, he doesn't let it completely ruin his humanity - a fact soon rewarded when the old man he helps out turns out to be more than meets the eye. Minsik is rewarded for his help, being told that the key to his future lies within his dreams... Specifically, dreams where he dates oh-so-sexy women! Each dream is guaranteed to tell him which crypto he should invest in the next day, turning him into somewhat of an overnight success! Money, fame, and women - what more could a guy want!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ho-Jin has long harbored a deep affection for Gil-Tae, the kind neighbor who has looked after him since childhood. Unable to confess his true feelings, Ho-Jin’s clumsy one-sided love remains a secret, until one night he finds himself masturbating over a drunken, sleeping Gil-Tae. Despite the significant age gap, what began as a hidden desire is about to cross a line from which there is no turning back, forever changing the innocent bond they once shared.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The happiest time for Cheon, a slave, was when he took care of the young master Se-Young like a younger brother. After parting ways with Se-Young, he was bullied by his master for a long time and was destined to be offered up as a sacrifice to the general. However, the general he met before his eyes looked familiar? The grown Se-Young whispers to Cheon, who is happy to be reunited with the master.

"You are mine now, mister. Everything, even the deepest part of my body."

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

Isu Jin’s seemingly ordinary life comes to a violent end when he and his father are suddenly targeted by a powerful conglomerate. He survives. But his father does not. In a world where crime and authority are one and the same, Isu enters the underworld to hunt the truth. His fight is no longer just for revenge… It’s to expose a corrupt empire, no matter the cost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Iris Sabrina sets out from home to the capital to fulfill her dream of becoming a knight. However, her journey takes an unexpected turn when she’s mistaken for her twin sister—whom she never knew existed—Arke Bright, a notorious villainess who’s been missing for months. As Iris struggles to navigate life in the capital and prove she’s not her sister, she meets a family she never knew she had and a handsome prince who helps her unravel the truth behind her sister’s dark past.

(Source: Tapas)

Ange, the daughter of Duke Glaster, believes her life is all planned out as she is set to marry Philip Cardiner, the rightful heir to the throne. However, her plans are disrupted when Philip's brother, William Cardiner, schemes against him and removes him from the line of succession. In order to secure his power, William forces Ange to marry Aiden Fitzroy, an illegitimate child born between the emperor and a commoner. Will Ange learn to love the humble stranger she was forced to marry?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

She was forced to marry. Now, her husband wants a divorce. Leah retreats to a secluded villa to regroup—only to be saved from danger by a mysterious leopard. But the wild creature is no ordinary beast; he’s Januk, a shape-shifting imperial prince, and taming him might be the start of something wild.

(Source: Manta)

Yang-U Jo, a typical salaryman finds joy only when he plays gacha games. Unexpectedly, he downloads an app called Love Gotcha! as if he was tempted by “free rerolls”, he obtained his workplace junior Yun-Ha…?! He comes across the opportunity to scold her troublesome junior when…

“You have encountered your partner! Would you like to train her?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Duchess Helena Thordel has many secrets. One, her real name is Lila Violet. Two, she’s not actually an aristocrat. And three, she’s supposed to be in a loveless, contractual marriage with Duke Aslan Thordel, but in fact, she’s deeply in love with him. So when Aslan brings another woman into their home, Helena leaves so he can be happy. Or at least, that’s the plan until Aslan gets into an accident trying to chase after her! What if Helena’s one-sided love for her husband is two-sided after all?

(Source: Tapas)

I came into the world of a novel I was reading, and became an unknown extra destined for a miserable life. Teaching manners to a crazy bastard who turns into a tyrant? Manners, my ass! Quick thinking was my only means of survival. I tried everything to prevent such a tragic relationship with the tyrant from happening. I kicked, punched and screamed my head off, but I was still beaten in the end. Actually, he’s unexpectedly docile at times and even told me,

“You’re the first person who understands me.” The male lead’s personality is strange.

“Anyway, you shouldn’t do that to a woman.”

“Isn’t it okay to kiss in a bind?”

“No! I meant that you can’t kiss someone without their permission.” Somewhat miffed, Croft then gave a mischievous grin as he approached her.

Bending down to Rivi’s eye level, he asked in a soft voice with glimmering red eyes, “So you’re saying there’s no problem if you give me permission?” After hearing his words, Rivier’s heart pounded in trepidation. Tugging at her hand, he held it tightly, pulling his elbow as far as he could, before he stretched his arm out like a bow. Bam! Rivier accurately jabbed Croft’s abdomen. Wait, why is there such a hard lump?!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yeon-Woo starts working part-time at his uncle's bakery. His hopeless dexterity leads to constant scolding from chef Cha-Gyeom, but this only excites the masochist. One day, his uncle asks the two longest-serving bakers to create a signature dish, refusing to lose to the competition...

A sweet and spicy recipe that entangles them!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
The official 4-Koma comic series based off of the Blue Archive mobile game.

He will follow every command I give him. He will follow me to the ends of the earth. He is Forever Mine.

(Source: Lezhin)

Minhyuk, who used to be an athlete, breaks his leg in an accident and faces difficulties in his relationship with his girlfriend Eunjin. In response, his friend Yoon-chan recommends a VR game he developed. Within this game he experiences new stimulation in a fantasy world that transcends reality…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Watching over someone can be quite overwhelming... But what if you switched bodies with that person...?

(Source: Toomics)

When Hwang Mok-Yeon’s friend-with-benefits Chae Sun-Hwa proposes a threesome, he’s only mildly intrigued until he hears who the third is. His target? Eun Nan-Jo: wealthy, polite, and perfectly presentable…but, according to Sun-Hwa, hopelessly boring in bed. At first, it’s just curiosity. But once the three of them are tangled in sheets, Mok-Yeon finds he can’t take his eyes off Nan-Jo...not even for a moment. And when he realizes Nan-Jo may be more interested in saving Sun-Hwa than claiming him, Mok-Yeon makes a quiet, dangerous offer. He leans in and says, “I want you. Do you think you could spread your legs for me?”

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Chae-Sung is a ruthless loan shark who has seen every kind of debtor, until Byun Yu-On. Flawless on paper, Yu-On never misses a payment, no matter how brutal the terms. The kind of client anyone would want. But there is something wrong with him. The way his gaze lingers on Chae-Sung, quiet, unwavering, and far too intent. It is not just business to him, and that is exactly the problem. So Chae-Sung makes up his mind to break that obsession and cut Yu-On out of his life, no matter what it takes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Didn't Sign Up For This

description:
Theo is thrilled when he finally lands a job—until he realizes what they actually hired him for.

(Source: Toomics)

Won Do-Yun, a boy left alone in the most run-down neighborhood. Though he had talent, the world dragged him down. In a world controlled by a massive cartel, he realizes that the higher he climbs, the deeper he sinks. Won Do-Yun ultimately makes a choice: the abyss over the summit. And he stands at the very center of the cartel, determined to bring the massive organization crashing down.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Born as an imperial princess, Arnoah was forced to marry the pathetic young king of a small neighboring kingdom. Her older brother became the emperor, so what was she supposed to do? And due to the laws of inheritance, even if her older brother and younger brother were to die, she would still not inherit the throne - rather, her good-for-nothing cheater of a husband would!! Any title she inherits would be vested in her husband in accordance with their marriage contract... that is until he decides to divorce her because his mistress wants to be the official queen.

“I need to get divorced and become the emperor.”

Her now official ex-husband still doesn't seem to get it, so she decided to finally tell him everything she always wanted to say to his face. When he realized the truth, it was already too late. She spoke to her ex-husband who had his mouth agape.

“I told you to keep your head straight. Didn’t you hear me?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Our company is pleasing to the eye! From the gentle team leader to the handsome CEO! However, I made a ridiculous mistake at the new employee welcome party. The wonderful team leader until yesterday is starting to turn away from me... I can't put an end to my love for the team leader like this! I was going straight and going straight until you accepted my virtue... But can someone tell me why this becomes a love affair and not a virtue?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

When Hyeon-U moves into Terrarium Apartments, the place seems idyllic—until he witnesses a man plunge from the building across his window. The residents dismiss the victim as a “misfit”, and Hyeon-U soon notices their unsettling, scripted routines. Beneath the cheerful facade lies something far darker: a community that demands conformity and punishes defiance. As the walls close in, Hyeon-U realizes that once you enter Terrarium, leaving may no longer be an option.

(Source: WEBTOON)

To uphold her father's wishes, Seizel Aramis lived an honest and virtuous life, only to be betrayed by those she trusted, conned by crooks, sent to jail, and executed. But the moment she dies, Seizel wakes up in the past, right before her misfortunes began. This time, Seizel decides to live life differently by becoming the greatest swindler in the empire! Armed with a newfound goal and the determination to fulfill it, can Seizel succeed in going from noblewoman to con-woman?

(Source: Tapas)

Dr. Doh Won is a renowned psychoanalyst. Upon returning to Korea, he takes a position at the Institute for Psychoanalysis and does his best to avoid criminal cases to protect his family. One day, the enigmatic arsonist MJ pays him an unexpected visit. MJ insists on ongoing sessions to address his uncontrollable desire to start fires. Reluctantly, Doh Won agrees, only to discover that MJ is more than just an arsonist; he’s involved in something major related to a mysterious figure known only as ‘Father.’ Will Doh Won be able to extinguish MJ’s love of fire? And just who is this ‘Father,’ and what connection does he have with MJ?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Is there a body you'd like to inhabit for a couple of hours? Or how about you lend your own body instead? If you said yes to either one of these, Dharma's the guy you need to meet!

(Source: Tapas)

Instead of holding her accountable, Marie makes a strange suggestion to Seon, who is falsely being accused to have stolen the class' money. Was it a helping hand?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Gaon is a boy who turned into a vampire, having inherited the condition from his mother. He discovered that his one and only friend, Dong-yi, like his older brother. Gaon loses all control when he smells the scent of blood. Aware of his instability, he asked Dongyi for his help in order to safely graduate college, and in return promised to help him get closer to his brother. However, to the contrary of his plans, the possessive, cold-hearted Yohan came to take an interest in Dongyi, and the budding relationship between the two is slowly starting to get on Gaon's nerves.

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

Prophet Liye falls into a world where magic exists and wakes up as a woman that a shaman doctor resurrected when she was a little girl. Tanaril, a wizard cursed by a witch to never have children with any woman, meets Liye at a hotel bar by chance. After drinking cocktails from a bartender at the bar, they spend the night together. Tanaril misunderstands that Liye approached him on purpose and accuses her of approaching him to take advantage of his high status. Despite how she was offended by his accusations, she became pregnant with his child. After announcing the pregnancy through a magical letter, the two get married by contract for different reasons and purposes. She knows she shouldn't fall in love with Tanaril, since she's from a different world and all that. It'll be a piece of cake since Tanaril is a cold, distant person, right? But her expectations are ruined when she discovers that Tanaril is actually caring and warm.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.english: A Red Laurel to My Emperor

description:
Laurel Neales, the first princess of Tortia, has been married off to the emperor of Kairos following a political feud that ended with the assassination of her parents. Undiscouraged by the circumstances, Laurel refuses to give in to becoming yet another of the emperor’s concubines. Instead, she plays along with his romantic whims and gains her own form of power in this new life by proposing an offer he cannot refuse: to facilitate his conquest of the land that betrayed her.

(Source: Tapas)

An arranged marriage that ends in a body swap?! The quiet Princess Elissa has lived a miserable life thus far. To get away from it all she agrees to marry the war tyrant, Duke Ginger of Landall Kingdom. But by some evil curse, the new couple wakes up in each other's bodies! Between royal functions to attend and getting used to their physical changes, can they keep their cool long enough to find a way to switch back? Or will they be stuck like this forever?! Based on the hit novel

(Source: Tappytoon)

I have to survive, no matter what!

I've died and been reincarnated as the villain of a romance novel! In order to avoid the hideous fate that awaits me, I've righted her wrongs and even gotten engaged. I should be home free, but strange things have started happening ever since the heroine appeared. Why won't her fiancé leave me alone?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

When defective omega and skilled mercenary Erad Nox is hired to find a runaway alpha mage and bring him back to the Tower of Mages, he thinks it'll be the easiest job he's ever done in his life. Little did he expect that upon meeting Lucian, the mage in question, he'd suddenly enter his heat cycle - something that hasn't happened in the past 11 years. Intrigued by this strange phenomenon, Lucian asks him to stay and become his research subject. As they spend time together, Nox finds himself drawn to Lucian's compassion and bashful kindness, while Lucian begins to fall in love with Nox's fearless strength and integrity.

(Source: Lezhin US)

At Dowonhyang, a secret luxury retreat for the elite, Cheong-Woo works as a server when he catches the eye of Won-Jae, a man of power and influence who always gets what he wants. Unfortunately for Cheong-Woo, what Won-Jae wants is him. Though Cheong-Woo tries to escape, the trap has already been set, pulling him into a dark, consuming spiral of desire and obsession he never saw coming.

(Source: Manta)

Would you like to find a job? Even at the cost of your soul? If so, then you’ve found the right place. Our job hunting advice website, Soul Sellers, is a site geared towards those willing to even sell their souls for employment; that’s right, people like you. Are you dealing with angels or demons?

30-year old freeloader Kang Cheol-Ho made a deal through this shady site, even selling his soul for the chance at what else? Money! An invitation to the other world for the weak and downtrodden of society for a chance to change their lot in life! That is the mission given to Kang Cheol-Ho!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Gu-Won’s upbringing was straight from a storybook—he was the prince of his own world, surrounded by opulence and luxury. Yet, beneath the façade of grandeur, his life was a tapestry of loneliness and betrayal.

With a father who pits him against his own sister, Gu-Won’s world is icy and devoid of joy—until he meets Sa-Rang, the sunny daughter of a humble servant. Her friendship and radiant smile begin to thaw his frozen heart. But tragedy strikes, tearing them apart and leaving Sa-Rang orphaned and adrift. As their paths diverge, bitterness and longing fuel their journey onward. Can these once inseparable friends navigate their way back to each other?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

Note: This is a prequel of the tv drama of the same name that aired in June 2023.

Shy Tae-Young never thought he'd date his crush, Seung-Joo. Kind, patient, and nothing like his past flings—Seung-Joo says he'll wait as long as Tae-Young needs. But when their first night finally comes... Seung-Joo isn’t so gentle anymore. What's he hiding beneath that sweet smile?

(Source: Manta)

"Princess" Renagia is a slave girl acting as the body double of Regnos, a prince masquerading as a princess for his safety in the Italos Kingdom. So when enemy soldiers from the Taringia Empire attack the royal palace, Renagia gets taken hostage immediately and is forced to sleep with Taringia's emperor, Godfrey. Knowing Regnos will come save her one day, Renagia decides to seduce the ruthless Godfrey and use him in order to survive. But that's easier said than done when their past connection resurfaces, blurring the line between revenge and attraction...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

While working in the mountains as usual, woodcutter Choi Nam-Wook stops by a stream, only to lose a very...personal possession in the water. As he laments his misfortune, a dense mist rolls in and a mysterious Mountain God appears, offering to retrieve what was lost…for a price.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Jeollaeyahandonghwa (전래야한동화) Collection.
Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.

Hong Tae-yi had a big fight with Shin Yi-ru, a team member of the same group project, who did not get along with her at all. Then, she finds a strange application on her phone and meets Shin Yi-ru again at a drinking party. But what is that number floating on his head? Hong Tae-yi creates an event without even realizing it.

"I don't know yet... Can you tell a little more? Tae-i noona?"

Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.

Ham Yulha downloaded a suspicious application to gain knowledge for a fling with Kang Junseo, a senior in the same department, who she fell in love with at first sight. Through the app, one can see the likability of handsome men, so in order to increase Junseo’s likability…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Girl Next Door Knows Best

description: Note: Part of Lezhin's Miyeonsi Danpyeonseon (미연시 단편선) Collection.

Ma Seok-ho, the strongest high school student known as the nation’s No. 1 “Demon King,” and Jo Jin-ho, an ordinary high school student — the uneasy cohabitation of two souls.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Cha Hong just got her dream job, assistant director on the set of a real TV series! This show stars the nation’s top actress, Noh Seung-ah, so cool! But when the director’s relationship with Seung-ah reaches a boiling point, he recruits Hong to keep watch over her 24/7 so she doesn’t ruin his precious show! But this young diva is not interested in being told what to do. Plus, keeping an eye on her actually means…they have to live together?! Is trying to tame this wildcard going to drive her insane and make her run for the exits or will the experienced Hong have some of her own tricks up her sleeve...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sangwoo Yoon was climbing up the corporate ladder until he got caught sleeping with his boss’s daughter. Two years later, he’s back at the bottom of another soulless gig when he stumbles upon the famous CEO Jaehyun Han in a…compromising position. Now, Jaehyun wants Sangwoo to work under him. Is this the career defining break he’s been looking for, or a trap?

(Source: Tapas)

Kail Black, a soldier stationed at an Antarctic research base, is assigned to support investigations into unexplained supernatural phenomena. But one morning, he wakes to a nightmare. The base has been overrun by monstrous organisms, and everyone is gone except for one man, Revo Keypling, who calmly introduces himself as a researcher. With no memory of what happened, Kail struggles to understand the disaster unfolding around them. But something even more disturbing begins to haunt him. Every night, he dreams of Revo, their bodies intertwined like wild animals, the visions so vivid that they leave him breathless when he wakes. And in those dreams, Revo always whispers the same chilling line, “Right here, this is where our baby will be born.”

Trapped in an isolated base, surrounded by impossible creatures, Kail begins to wonder which is more dangerous, the things lurking outside, or the man smiling beside him with secrets of his own.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A tiger that is stupid and timid and cannot stand the weight of its size. After eavesdropping on the conversations of humans, he mistakes 'dried persimmons' for scary monsters, and when he encounters a thief in the dark, he mistakes him for 'dried persimmons' and faints. The cunning thief who finds the precious tiger seal dreams of making a fortune through 'tiger trade'!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Jeollaeyahandonghwa (전래야한동화) Collection.

After dying from overwork in her previous life, Beth finds herself in the world of a novel she was reading. While she's reborn as an unimportant side character, she ends up working for the house of the novel's villain, the strict Lady Claire. There, she witnessed first-hand the abuse and negligence a young Claire goes through and decides to stop her from becoming the main character!

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.

All he wanted was to get wrecked by a hung, handsome octoman... San-Ho’s been pouring his deepest desires into octopus fishing (literally), so when he saves the Dragon King's octopus prince and lands and lands an invite to the palace, the first thing he asks for is his very own beastman husband. But instead of the massive, tentacled stud he imagined, he gets Baek-Kyung. No tentacles, no monster size... just a cute, compact little guy. He wanted calamari. He got shrimp. But hey… sometimes small packages pack a big punch.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the prestigious Lee family, only Alphas are ever born—and 8-year-old Lee Mun-Ho is no exception. So when he's suddenly married off to Han Wol-Ah, the elegant 16-year-old heir of the famous Omega Han family, it's the talk of the town. At the wedding, poor Mun-Ho is a bundle of nerves… until Wol-Ah gently calms him down. Cue instant puppy-love. But the moment the ceremony ends? Prince Charming disappears. “Massage my legs,” Wol-Ah commands. And just like that, Mun-Ho’s honeymoon becomes housework. From that day on, Wol-Ah treats him less like a groom and more like a very tiny servant. Years pass in comedic misery until finally—Mun-Ho’s coming-of-age ceremony arrives. He’s taller. Stronger. Still hopelessly in love. But now the tables might just turn...

Will Mun-Ho get revenge? Or will he fall even harder for the bossy Omega who stole his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

As the son of a prestigious political figure in Joseon, Hajin has only ever been interested in studying to become like his father. That is, until he meets Namwoo, a young man who takes on various odd jobs as he struggles to pass his school exams. As they overcome hardships together and learn more about each other's history, they soon realize that their lives are intertwined in more ways than they thought. Will their relationship bloom, or will it just scatter like the petals of a plum blossom?

(Source: Tapas)

Jo Seong-Jae has a secret: he’s been spending passionate nights with a ghost that looks like Hong Do-Hui, the man he’s in love with. Plagued every night by his yearning and the unrelenting ghost, Seong-Jae’s health steadily worsens. Concerned for his ailing friend, Do-Hui offers to help Seong-Jae escape his nightmares. It’s a feat no ordinary man could accomplish, but Do-Hui is no ordinary man. See, Do-Hui has a secret, too. It just might be the key to saving Seong-Jae…or to destroying them both.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Chapter count includes 18 extras.

A prince with no claim to the throne, Yi Tae-Rok lives a quiet life removed from power. At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-Yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-Rok sees it only as duty. But Nan-Yeong grows up looking only at him. What begins as admiration slowly shifts into something deeper, something neither of them can easily name. Tae-Rok notices the change and chooses silence, drawing careful lines he refuses to cross. In the end, Nan-Yeong seeks clarity in the only way he can, by testing his feelings with another man. And Tae-Rok sees it.

“Then you become my scandal. And I become yours.”

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jeya is just a normal guy living a normal life. His life gets turned upside down when he meets his ex-girlfriend at a job interview. However, things get even worse when they get it an accident, travel back in time and swap bodies.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Yeon-Woo, the son of a hero who protected the country, is the number one candidate for groom among the village girls because he excels in both scholarship and martial arts. His only worry is that his lower body cannot stand due to erectile dysfunction. In order to solve his worry, he hears a rumor about a rock that grants wishes and climbs up the mountain behind the village, where he finds a young man being raped by a monster. As he hurries to save him, Yeon-Woo notices something wrong with his own body first...!

"Why is it standing up all of a sudden?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Hangyeol loves music, but for some reason, he just cannot write love songs. Desperate for advice, he visits a fortune-teller, only to receive the strangest solution imaginable: ""If romance is too hard,"" the old man tells him, ""then at least try sleeping with someone. Anyone."" Leaving with more questions than answers, a flustered Hangyeol somehow ends up surrounded by three very different men…in more ways than one. Caught between inspiration, temptation, and pure confusion, Hangyeol must figure out whether he can finally lose his innocence - and maybe find his muse along the way.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-hwa has always dreamed of being a top k-pop idol, and she’s worked hard to make it to her debut. But she’s certainly never dreamed of having her idol group partner to be a hell of a masochistic pervert. Insoo is uncooperative, but she’s infinitely easier to control when you become her master. Now, Yeon-hwa is determined to make Insoo an ideal idol partner—and to do that, she’s going to be Insoo’s ideal partner in bed. But this solution might not be as simple as she thinks…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Working at a small company is tough... Even worse when you work with two incompetent women. Well, guess what. I'm the boss now.

(Source: Toomics)

As the male lead's older sister, Edna Luschen Demirette is destined to die from the void virus, a dangerous disease with no cure. Fortunately, Edna discovers that the virus can be purified by touching Prince Carlen, a poor outcast with divine powers. But as simple as that sounds, Edna's plans to befriend him go awry when he mistakes her for an obsessive fan during their first meeting. Armed with nothing but her sharp wits, will Edna successfully persuade the cold prince and save herself?

(Source: Tapas)

"You called me."

A master, also a recluse. He became a warrior escort.

A historical martial arts drama based on a web novel!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Chaedam never planned to get cozy with the sexy CEO, but after discovering Yoowon’s secrets, Chaedam has no choice but to fake amnesia to keep himself safe. Suspicious, Yoowon ups the ante and tells Chaedam that they were lovers before his memory loss. Chaedam knows it’s only a ploy to keep him under Yoowon’s watchful eye, but he can’t reveal the truth without exposing himself to danger. So begins a cat-and-mouse game of deception and lust that sends them tumbling into bed together.

(Source: Tapas)

In the novel "My Dorothea," Maristella La Belflair is written as the titular character’s “dear friend,” but is more like her doormat. Ultimately executed due to Dorothea’s plot, she is given another chance at life after her death and is determined to survive this time. The problem is, she’s caught the eye of the male lead, Xavier, who is supposed to end up with Dorothea! With a love triangle and Dorothea’s schemes to deal with, can this former doormat step up to the challenges in her new life?

(Source: Tapas)

After years of hardship that culminate in the form of a terminal illness, Rita is determined to do whatever it takes to survive. It might be the wrong thing to steal somebody else’s body, but she doesn’t care about what’s right or wrong anymore. Now, she’s Verta, the affluent and beautiful daughter of Count Alberhart. She’s in the prime position to enjoy a comfortable life…but the people around her seem intent on breaking her. Well, she’s happy to crush whoever gets in her way. It’s time for them to learn how deep her malice goes…

 (Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

To Lord Vincent, his favorite servant, Adonis, has always appeared weak and fragile. This thought is further reinforced when Adonis becomes permanently injured in a horse-riding accident. In order to protect him, Vincent starts to keep his distance from Adonis, but that only triggers the servant to desire his master even more. Although the two of them can’t ride horses together anymore, with his whip in hand, Vincent might be willing to ride something else...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.
- Includes four extra chapters.

Webtoon artist Seol U-Young decided to try his hand at BL after seeing positive reactions on social media. To gather proper research material, U-Young heads to a gay bar, where he runs into Jun-Hyuk. Though he genuinely wanted to help Jun-Hyuk, who was asking for assistance in a tough spot, Jun-Hyuk mercilessly tramples on U-Young's kind intentions.

'How could I have been charmed by such trash!'

Feeling pathetic, U-Young ends up having the worst day ever. Then one day, U-Young receives notice that his assigned PD is changing. A few days later, at the meeting that follows, he finds himself face to face again with Jun-Hyuk, that piece of trash not even fit for recycling.

“PD-nim?! I'm having a hard time...”

“I'm still lacking. We need mutual satisfaction for a symbiotic relationship. Right, Writer?”

But how did we end up in this kind of relationship?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

People don’t really change—they just come to understand who they truly are. And sometimes, all it takes is a single day.

(Source: Toomics)

Ian had a grand dream of successfully completing missions and one day earning a major promotion. However, his ambitions were constantly thwarted by his incompetent squad members, the twin brothers Dylan and Elliot, causing their unit to be labeled as the troublemakers of the platoon. One day, as Ian was once again seething with anger because of the twins, he suddenly found himself under suspicion of being a spy for the enemy nation. While Ian vehemently denied the accusation, the company commander, determined to break him psychologically, gave a horrifying order—commanding Dylan and Elliot, whom Ian always looked down upon, to assault him. For the first time, Ian felt true fear...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.

On a dark, quiet night, as Se-A returns to her empty home, flickering lights reveal a man in a cap standing at her doorstep. He calls her name, and when she turns, she’s stunned by the familiar face: someone she believed had died ten years ago. Letting him in sets off a chain of unraveling truths, buried secrets, and painful misunderstandings. But he’s not the only one hiding something. As past and present collide, can the two mend the distance that time and silence have carved between them?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Ending Jul Algo Dorawatdeoni Jangneuga Bakkwim
title.native: 엔딩인 줄 알고 돌아왔더니 장르가 바뀜

description:
Though I was the villainess in the original novel, I skillfully avoided death flags and faked my own demise to escape. I saved the poor child destined to die, sacrificed myself so the protagonists could live peaceful lives, and hid away, waiting for my own happy ending. My joy at finally hearing news of the original protagonists' wedding was short-lived. Upon receiving word of my mother's passing, I returned home... My childhood friend and fiancé, the original male lead, said:

“If I knew you'd fall for a mere death notice, I would've done it sooner.”

The man I thought had married another woman stared at me with deranged eyes and laughed. Why are you like this? You weren't this kind of person.

“Now you can't go anywhere.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The culprit who turned his twin cousins into villains by appearing in a side story of a novel! Who would have thought he would be reincarnated as a villain? I sighed deeply and made up my mind. ‘Let’s raise the twins with love and prevent their darkening!’ I don’t care about the novel and get along well with the twins, but the second male lead, whom I had no reason to get involved with, keeps getting more and more obsessed with me! Ah. Where did it go wrong?And why did the second male lead turn dark when I was just trying to stop the villain from turning dark?

“Please, please don’t back down anymore. I don’t know how much longer I can endure it.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Picked up the Sexy Heavenly Demon

description:
“Would you take away my virginity?"

One day, So-Chan picked up a beauty who came floating on the river. Pink hair, pink skin, pink nipples... This pink girl proclaims herself to be the Heavenly Demon, the strongest existence in the martial world. She looks a bit insane, but it doesn't matter. She has big breasts!

(Source: DAYcomics)

A collection of oneshots:

1) Return of Princess Rouana
Asha was sent by her master Cayan, the so-called "evil sorcerer," to send a message to the Royal Court that Princess Rouana will be returning home. Forty years ago, it was believed that the sorcerer Cayan kidnapped Princess Rouana. However, when Asha starts spending more time in the castle, she finds the place strangely familiar. Slowly, she discovers the secret Cayan wants her to find.

2) Believe Ye Your Eyes?
Sei is a guy with a face so beautiful that he can easily get any girl. Unfortunately, after a certain accident, he cannot see women -- yes, all women are invisible to him. Of course, he couldn't care less since being able to have a physical relationship with them is enough for him. Seeing them means trouble because they may become special to him. One day, Sei notices something -- he can see one woman, the annoying girl that lives next door whom he never bothers to pay attention to. Strangely, he is the only person who is invisible to her. Slowly, he starts investigating her, but gradually, he starts falling in love with her...

3) A Short Game About A Chance Encounter
This is the story of two people meeting each other by chance and falling in love. The manhwa itself is put together in the most narrative, where the narrator rewinds the story after each turning point of the story and retells it with a switch of scenario and possibilities. This is really a simple story told in the most unusual method ever.

4) Automation
1005 is an android that was "born" with defects: she opened her eyes while being manufactured and she can dream. Yet, she isn't the only one. Shaa, known as 1004, also opened her eyes from the beginning. The two become close and they teach each other emotions that they are not suppose to have as androids. One day Shaa overhears her master saying that androids are implanted with the memories of humans, and she realizes the she and 1005 are not actually "faulty products"....

5) A Cold
A simple story about a couple breaking up due to a minor fight. After they break up, the two of them can't help regretting it. She takes on his habit of eating ice mix in the middle of winter, while he, who has never gotten sick, now has a cold. The two continue to take on each other's habits until one day...

6) Purple Eyes
Ruben was born with the ability to make accurate predictions and read people's mind. He and his brother, Dave, and his brother girlfriend, Pat, are stuck in a ghost town when their car breaks down, and have no choice but to stay there for the night. There, Ruben discovers the history of the ghost town when he starts recalling the memories of an innocent girl who burnt to death at a witch trial. Ever since then the town has suffered from a curse, where every single girl in the village perished after hallucinations and high fever...

7) Leucadian
There was a famous Greek poetess who jumped off a cliff and committed suicide after she was rejected by her beloved. That cliff is called Leucadian. Leucadian has become a legend where it is rumored that anyone, with a broken heart, who jumps off the Leucadian Cliff and survives will recover from his or her loss. On a cruise trip on the Mediterranean Sea, Len meets the girl of his dream, but she is always alone, staring into the ocean. It turns out that she came to the Leucadian Cliff with a broken heart...

8) Mint Flavor
She and Gia have been best friends for 10 years and they know everything about each other. Gia has just come back from a trip to Rome with her boyfriend and they haven't seen each other for two weeks. She goes over to her place first thing when she gets back to Seoul and finds out that Gia has just broke up with her boyfriend. Together they discover that their feelings for each other are more than just as friends....

9) A Flying Lesson
When Herman runs away from her tutor, she picks up a bird who considers her as his mommy. He's not just any bird - he's a human with wings. Herman becomes attached to the little birdy, Lilda, and is determined to to teach Lilda how to fly...

(Source: Floating_Sakura)

In Songcheon, a megacity with a population of 4 million, a mysterious creature and a girl appear before Min-Ho, a high school student who dreams of becoming a judo athlete. In an instant, Songcheon has become a living hell. Will Min-Ho be able to survive?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Through a political marriage with an enemy nation, Elfreda has become the queen of the kingdom. The only one welcoming the queen of barbarian descent is the assassin sent to kill her. In that life-or-death moment, Elfreda falls in love at first sight with her husband, Ainar, who saved her, and gradually becomes deeply enamored with him. Meanwhile, Ainar, who had married Elfreda from the start solely to use her as the granddaughter of his enemy, also finds himself unwittingly falling for the pure and lovely Elfreda...

Even though she knows she is not loved by him, and even though he knows he must not love her, the two are drawn to each other. Will this love end in ruin?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ba-Da never dreamed of getting into a steamy relationship with a celebrity before. Well, until recently, that is. Now, after meeting famous actor Shim Chae-Yoon and getting an offer from the nation’s heartthrob to teach him how to be in a relationship, Ba-Da has been having some explicit dreams. Except…maybe they’re more than dreams. The line between dream and reality is fading faster by the day…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

The arrival of a 167.8cm short guard!

"You say you can't play basketball if you're short? Bring a 2m or 3m player. No matter how tall you are, if I knock them over, they're all inferior to me."

Can Kang-Hwi, the main character, become the final puzzle piece for the Jeon Kwang High School basketball team, which dreams of winning the competition with his run-and-gun style?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Disobey the Duke if You Dare

description:
You must never see the duke’s face.
After her second husband's death, Lily is forced into a third marriage by her father. Her new husband is rumored to be a monstrous warmonger, but to Lily's surprise, the Duke turns out to be a kind man and husband. There's just one catch... she must never see his face.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

More episodes of Unintentional Love Story - find out what happens to Won-Young & Tae-Jun, Dong-Hui & Ho-Tae, and cutie pie Bean!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

This isn’t the life I wanted!!! After reliving high school as Jin-U, the boy he once bullied, An-Cheol is now a new person. But his new life takes an unexpected turn. Once again, he is sent back in time to live as Jin-U. But this time, Jin-U is also back... as An-Cheol!

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

From the outside, Taesung and Haeun look just like real siblings. They were certainly raised that way, living together in the same house since they were kids. But here’s the secret: they aren’t actually related. Haeun’s just been living with Taesung’s family since her parents went to live abroad, and that’s the way it’s been for the last 15 years. They’re basically real sister and brother at this point…until one day, Taesung comes to learn a prank from his friends. Grab a girl’s sides, and you can tell from her reaction what she really thinks of you. Taesung tries this out on Haeun that night, eager to see how she reacts…and accidentally ends up grabbing her boobs. Uh-oh. But just what is up with Haeun’s reaction? She’s blushing, squirming, not saying anything… Is this how you would normally act in front of your brother? Things come to light, and Taesung’s starting to look at his “sister” a little bit differently now…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Yoon, who was at the height of her success as the top makeup artist, died from overwork. She was given a second chance to enter the world of her favorite novel La Vie en Rose, however, her luck took a turn for the worse as she ended up inhabiting the body of Calypso Partuan, the cruel stepmother who tormented Coral in the original story. Kim Yoon tries to regain her senses and live well with Coral, but she receives a letter proposing a marriage contract from the second prince of the empire, Macaron. Not only did she never agree to such a contract, and to make matters worse, Macaron was the father of the male lead, Kai! Coral was supposed to marry Kai, but now she was going to marry Kai's father?! This is a family project between people who are not related by blood at all!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: What It Takes to Be a Villainess

description:
With a broken heart, Hwayoung falls headfirst into the river by accident but wakes up as infamous villainess Satiana Altisee Kaylon. Coming to terms with her new life as sole daughter of House Kaylon, Satiana is soon chosen as a candidate for the next empress! In the palace full of schemers and liars, she must become a cold-blooded villainess to win her royal seat by the crown prince - or her new family will face grave danger! Will being perfectly evil really be enough? ‘Cause even villains need love!
Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Wild Flower of the Palace

description:
Hun is the carefree crown prince of the Taesa Kingdom, wholly uninterested in state affairs and devoted only to his lover. However, Ryuha, his appointed bride, has other plans. With her ruthless tactics and political finesse, Ryuha plans to charm and educate him so that he stands a chance at surviving... But the imperial concubine and her son are dead set on taking the palace for themselves.

Ryuha must navigate the lies, spies, and savagery of the concubine, whereas Hun must face his growing feelings for Ryuha and figure out why she feels so familiar to him. Meanwhile, a mysterious tragedy from the past tying the two together threatens to rear its ugly head. Will Ryuha be able to use her wit and charm to protect Hun and take hold of the palace before it's too late?

(Source: Tappytoon)
This is a story about a girl who was dispatched as a sitter to take care of the last remaining dragon in the human world, an alcoholic, hikikomori, tsundere dragon.

I'm the Gingerbread House witch!

I possessed Yielle Frank, the witch from Hansel and Gretel! I didn't want to die like in the original story, so I took good care of the children and sent them off. But ten years later, Hansel returns, all grown up...

"Am I still just a kid to you? Please don't run away."

(Source: Manta)

The law says he must remain chaste forever. His brothers-in-law say otherwise. After losing his bride before their wedding night, the Widower Consort is forced into a life of lonely mourning. But the late princess’s brothers are harboring an obsession that defies all logic and law. Caught between two men who would kill to keep him, the consort must navigate a palace where the most dangerous threat isn't the law, it's the men who are supposed to protect him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lim Sooha is an independent woman who has it all: a busy career, a brand-new home, and an ever-growing pile of household chores. And the last thing she needs is a man to mess things up. But that all changes when one walks through her front door–literally! Homeless and desperate for a break, Taesoo begs Sooha to let him stay in exchange for keeping house. Tempted by the idea of coming home to a warm meal, clean sheets, and ironed clothes, Sooha agrees after Taesoo shows just how capable he really is…and claims to be gay.

Could this be the perfect arrangement, or will Taesoo’s lie and Sooha’s conflicted feelings make a bigger mess?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Pedro the Wolf, a fugitive with a 200 million won bounty, discovers an abandoned factory while weary from his long life on the run. Inside the factory lies the first boar, reduced to a wreck after everything he owned was burned in an arson incident Pedro had committed. Pedro sees meeting him during his rut as a chance...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

After a mid-match wardrobe malfunction leaves him exposed to the public, Lee Chae-yoon swears off water polo for good. Now he’s making a living (sort of) as a fashion model, albeit one with an attitude problem. But, after a chance run-in with Ham Suho, the pants-puller from his past, Chae-yoon soon finds himself thrown back into the deep end of competitive water polo, and now there’s more than just his own reputation on the line. With past emotions refusing to stay submerged, it’s up to Chae-yoon to decide whether he sinks or swims…

(Source: Lezhin US)

The strongest fighter at the worst high school in the country, Dupaul High School: Ryu U-Jin. He never loses a fight, but in reality, he's a romance novel maniac and an aspiring webtoon artist. Determined to find true romance, Ryu U-Jin decides to transfer to an ordinary co-ed school. Will he be able to find sweet romance material at his new school and create a proper work?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hae-On is a K-pop idol who never made it big. His career is halfway dead and his life is a bleak and boring grind. But one day, things start looking up. His career is kickstarted into life as he gains gigs and popularity. His life starts to become vibrant and busy. He’s finally about to become a true star.

Except, something dangerous is lurking around the corner. Somebody is following him. Watching him. On the brink of dragging him into darkness entirely. And once you’re trapped in the dark, it’s almost impossible to escape…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Can love really conquer all? Many might think Eun Ju-In lucky. As the son of a palace gardener, he was able to grow up in the presence of the powerful crown prince, Licht von Louis Kuellen, and even call him his friend. But Ju-In knows that his luck comes with its downsides. For one, being both a commoner and a beta in love with an alpha prince certainly doesn’t feel lucky. Licht must marry an omega, and then there will be no place for Ju-In at his side. Unwilling to subject himself to a life of heartbreak, Ju-In leaves the palace, hoping that time away will put a stop to his feelings. Three years pass, and Ju-In is ready to live his life as a faithful servant and nothing more, but Licht seems more determined than ever to rekindle their close friendship! Can Ju-In master his feelings before he falls even deeper?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: chapter count includes an 8-chapter side story

Min-Hyung's lifelong desire is simple: to wholly possess Yi-Jae, the man who raised him. Cunningly concealing his dark devotion, Min-Hyung eliminates any obstacles in his path until Yi-Jae becomes reliant on Min-Hyung alone. That is, before the arrival of a man named Hyeon Ho disrupts everything. Will Min-Hyung's meticulous plans withstand this bold interloper, or will he be forced to confront the harsh reality that some childhood dreams may remain unfulfilled?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ominous beings are intruding into our reality...

Park Yun-yeong has a mysterous power which allows her to see ghastly creatures that seem to inhabit our world but not interact with it - unless they notice you acknowledge their existence. That’s when they stop being harmless.

(Source: Naver, translated & edited)

As an occult club, all of us did rituals on a 1,000-year-old sacred tree in the back of the school to prove occult. Then, the sacred tree really talked to us…!

“Don’t curse so that your wishes will come true.”

“If you want to survive… have sex!”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Believing in his fantastic acting skills, Moon Ji-An stuck with Yoon Kang-Jae as his manager through thick and thin. But after eight years of constantly cleaning up after the mess Kang-Jae's picky personality made, Jian thinks it's time to focus on herself and quit her job. As soon as Kang-Jae hears, he cleans up his act, sticks to her like glue, and ponders how to make her stay. He's determined to keep Ji-An by his side, but can he come up with a proposal good enough for her before it's too late

(Source: Tapas)

Ji-Won just wants to enjoy a steamy one-night stand, but the neighbor from hell keeps killing the mood. After nights of listening to a heartbroken stranger wail breakup anthems through the walls, Ji-Won finally storms next door to demand silence. Instead of a typical nuisance, he finds Hyeon watching a cringey, viral video of Ji-Won’s most cringe college memory. Now that his secret "black history" is out, things are about to get a lot more sour - and a little bit spicy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Pil-Sang ends up living with Joo-Eon to treat the side effects of Sianacin. Joo-Eon, whose true intentions are unknown, secretly takes care of and protects Pil-Sang, even though no one knows what he's thinking. When asked, "Do you like me?", Joo-Eon tells him to say something reasonable and laughs until he's out of breath, but he doesn't tolerate Pil-Sang leaving his side even an inch. Then one day, he becomes unexpectedly affectionate. He wonders, "What on earth is he doing?" but a strange emotion blooms somewhere in Pil-Sang's heart...

What will be the end of this fierce battle of cohabitation between Joo-Eon, the chairman who was born with a diamond spoon in his mouth, and Pil-Sang, a loan shark who lives at the bottom?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Demon King Astrea tasked 72 worthy Demon Lords with destroying the world. Demon Lords--a title only given to those who passed Astrea’s test. Each was given powers befitting their title. Kharos, the ruler of madness and greed, was no exception. But his granted power was less than satisfactory. He received the power of "Gacha"—a luck-based ability with an abysmal pull rate. With this power, Kharos must do his best to engulf the world with madness and greed!

(Source: Tapas)

Several hundred years ago, when the world was devastated by the war between dragons and humans, humans tried to create peace by offering a 'bride' to the dragons every 300 years. After a long, long time, Baek Chan-Woo had to become the bride of this generation. All dragons are beautiful, so he was looking forward to the meeting, but he was blatantly disappointed when a man, Shin Tae-Oh, showed up instead of a woman.

"I have to see him begging to marry me."

However, Tae-Oh seemed to be intrigued by him appearance..!?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes 23 extra chapters.

title.romaji: Baekdusan Horangi Meori Wie Gitbal Kkotgi
title.native: 백두산 호랑이 머리 위에 깃발 꽂기

description:
A world where humans and beastmen coexist. The 20-year-old white tiger beastman Tae-Hyung meets Ji-Soo, a famous person in school and a giant rabbit senior, at a freshman orientation and falls in love at first sight. He gets drunk and his heart races. While he is in a daze and commits various bizarre acts and builds up his dark history, "Do you have white pubic hair too?"

Can I really like this senior?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Arts major Il Yoo is trying to force his way into music major Lee-Won On's proximity, but little does he know that he was inadvertently the cause of Lee-Won's heartbreak three years prior. One thing leads to another and the two begin to draw inspiration from each other for their respective graduation projects.

(Source: Manta)

Sensing shifts in mana, successfully manifesting it, and attending the most prestigious school at the top of his class at a young age, Ruin Ardell is on track to become a great mage. Everything was going smoothly until he discovered that he had a condition preventing him from expelling mana. Ruin’s tumble from grace gave those jealous of him the opportunity to toy with him. But in the depths of his despair, he discovers a miracle in the form of a system message.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra chapter.

Eun Seon-Myeong, a hunter and exorcist with two curses on his body, forms an alliance with Shim Yi-yul, a fox who he went to kill on a request, and begins living together. They get along well despite being wary and disgusted with each other, but after spending a night with Shim Yi-Yul during his mating season, driven by instinct... they become a little different...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: I want to work in peace

description:
Do-Yun Maeng, a local civil servant in a provincial new town, just wants to quietly serve out his full term without incident. But right after a near-fatal accident, he gets a hypnosis app-and suddenly, his dull little town starts turning into a playground!

(Source: TOPTOON, edited)

“I would like to go back in time one year. I lost someone important to me then.”

That’s what workaholic Eunkyeol Jung wishes one Christmas at a mysterious bar, as she laments being dumped by her boyfriend a year ago. And against all odds… her wish comes true! Unfortunately, she still gets dumped, but this time around she saves her best friend’s brother Yiyool from a tragic death. He even becomes her coworker! With this time to do over and without the love life she hoped for, will Eunkyeol find unexpected happiness or another year of heartbreak?

(Source: Tapas)

Hana was always second— because of Geon-u Han, who was always in first place! Hana would go to any lengths to defeat him. This time, she tried to shock him with a fake confession...
"Why are you accepting my confession? What... You like me?!"

Se-Ra, who broke up with her boyfriend, whom she even thought about marrying, On the first day of my new job, I found the back of my boyfriend's head at my new job and quickly poured coffee on him. It turned out that the man I had never met before was my boss, whom I would have to see every day from now on?

An office romance comedy about Oh Se-Ra facing the biggest crisis of her life.

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

On the day of my wedding, I found out that my lover was cheating on me with my best friend. I died because of their betrayal, and when I opened my eyes again, I returned to the past. I thought this was a blessing from God, a chance to take revenge. But this return was neverending as I kept dying either from their betrayal or in an accident. After my repeated death, I realized that accidents did not cause all of my deaths but that I was being murdered. So this time, I faked my death and left everything behind to catch the murderer, who was killing me repeatedly and to take my revenge finally.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Saintess is Stuck in a Wall!

description:
Saintess Liliana wants just one thing out of her second marriage: to finally be satisfied in the bedroom. However, her marriage to the kingdom’s biggest playboy, Prince Riverre, isn’t exactly welcomed by her modest first husband, the holy knight commander Altus. What’s more, Liliana’s unholy wish lands her a divine punishment of being stuck in the wall between her two husbands’ bedrooms. But perhaps this unconventional three-way might be just what the saintess needs to spice up her marriage!

(Source: Tappytoon)

After losing her professional golfing license due to a failed drug test, the innocent Im Soo-an is forced to find other work. However, the only person she can turn to is her first love - the very same man she coldly dumped in the past! Fortunately, he agrees to help her and manages to find her a job as a caddie, but it’s a far cry from being a professional golfer… To make matters worse, the men at the country club seem to think they can take advantage of her! She just has to deal with their advances until she clears her name, but how…?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Jong-Pil is a returnee student who keeps running into Jae-Hyeong, a rude, pink-haired guy at school. One night, in an attempt to retrieve his laptop, he winds up in a drunken encounter with Jae-Hyeong. Follow Jong-Pil as he hilariously tries to sort his feelings out about his rude but handsome junior

(Source: INKR)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

Mia has always been fascinated by kinky behavior. But because of her social status, appearance, and demeanor, no one is willing to talk to her about such things. Even the occasional flirtation she receives instinctively feels like an insult to her, so she ends up treating people harshly—only to regret it later—in a never-ending cycle. Realizing she can’t go on like this, Mia decides to seek out Claude, who is famous among women...

“Excuse me, I’m Mia Triang, and I’m here to win Claude over.”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Kang Tae-han, known as the Heavenly Demon (Cheonma), whose power once reached the skies, returns to his original life after 60 years!

“Wow… in such a blessed era, and my body’s in this state?”

“Your body’s screaming for help, but are you not hearing it?”

The physical and mental recovery project of the old-fashioned, grumpy(?) Heavenly Demon Kang Tae-han begins!! For the exhausted office worker drowned in alcohol and overtime, for the athlete whose body is broken and performance is failing, for the head of the family crushed under the weight of life, for modern people filling themselves with fat just to survive— All you weary souls of modern life, come get a massage!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I'm the Corrupted Side Character's Wife

description:
What would you do if your fiance holds the demon's power inside him and could kill you with it? The answer is clear for the reader who wakes up as Lucian's fiancee, Pernia. That is, she must help Lucian confess to the novel's heroine, Estelle, so his unrequited love won't trigger the demon! Whether it's teaching Lucian to dance or inviting Estelle to her own engagement ceremony, the plucky Pernia is willing to do whatever it takes to get them together. So why is the deadly Lucian turning his eyes toward her instead...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

[You're Invited to Nayun's Reverse Harem House?]

Shin Nayun, who always dreamed of independence due to a warm yet complicated family situation, suddenly becomes rich overnight after winning the lottery. She finally achieves her dream in a large two-story house. While enjoying her freedom after quitting her job and gaining independence, Nayun hears that her childhood friend Baek Jeon, who had emigrated, is returning to Korea. She offers him a spare room in her house. Was that the beginning? Starting with Jeon, then college student Dogun, and even her non-blood-related younger brother Yeonwoo—one by one, they all begin gathering in her house... You're invited to Nayun’s reverse harem house, where long-hidden desires will be brought to life!

They say size doesn’t matter… but he makes sure she feels it.

(Source: Toomics)

On the Warhaven battlefield, salvation awaits those who dare to fight! When Gillum Lee is betrayed and left for dead, he wakes up in the world of Warhaven with new memories and a new body. Now, he must fight to get his revenge.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

After losing everything in a war with the all-powerful Queen, Aden is reborn as Han Taemin, an ordinary man who cleans up after hunters in a world ravaged by monsters. But one day, when a disastrous dungeon raid ends with Taemin as the sole survivor, he suddenly awakens and becomes a hunter. With his new abilities and mana training, he starts gathering other hunters who seemingly have strange connections to his past life. Can Taemin save the world in this life and avenge his past self?

(Source: Tapas)

Living alone is tough, as it is... Living with a roommate could bring occasional problems... What if you bring three, four into the mix...?

(Source: Toomics)

Shy and unpopular Da-Som Park rushes to meet her only friend, the beautiful and adored, Iseul Chae. Instead, she finds Iseul's dead body, or rather, its hollow shell. Da-Som enters it and takes over Iseul's seemingly perfect life. But as Dasom discovers horrific family secrets, she wonders where her friend went, and if it was an accident she ended up in Iseul's shell.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Baek Hyeon-Woo harbors a secret he must never let his childhood friend Lee Seo-Hun discover. That secret is that he's been secretly in love with Seo-Hun since the moment they first met. As soon as he turned 20, he was practically forced into living together with Seo-Hun, and all he can do is masturbate with a dildo while thinking of him. Living in torment, Hyeon-Woo finds a suspicious app called "Hypnosis" installed on his phone. A sentence he typed in as a joke becomes reality. “Baby.” The hypnosis begins with that one word. Torn between irresistible temptation and guilt, Hyeon-Woo sinks deeper into turmoil.

This dangerous game started with hypnosis. Can Hyeon-Woo ever tell Seo-Hun the truth?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Hae-Gyeong, a rabbit shifter, has spent years pining for the golden boy of the neighborhood, Jae-Hyeon. Everyone loves Jae-Hyeon, but Hae-Gyeong wants to be the only one. One impulsive, drunken night, the lines between them blur when Jae-Hyeon crosses the ultimate boundary, leaving Hae-Gyeong more deeply in love than ever. However, the morning after brings a cold reality: Jae-Hyeon is drawing lines again. Now, Hae-gGeong must see if he can finally break through Jae-Hyun’s walls, or if his true love will remain forever out of reach.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Not a single day has passed by without Yeon-U calling her verbally abusive boss Jun-Hu Kang a “son of a b****”. After being cursed out for the millionth time, Jun-Hu turns into an actual dog. What's worse is that Yeon-U becomes Jun-Hu's owner, and the only way for him to temporarily turn back into a human is if she touches him. After internally cursing him 317,920 times, Yeon-U finally gains the upper hand against her supercilious CEO, who is now an adorable white puppy.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Mo-A never thought much of her cold, stern boss, Geon-Hu. At least, not until that fateful incident at the company workshop. Ever since accidentally seeing him in the buff, Mo-A can’t get him off her mind. After weeks of fantasizing, she finally asks if he’d like to spend the night with her. That’s when he drops a bomb: he’s a virgin, and he’ll only sleep with her if she marries him. The problem is, Mo-A doesn’t believe in marriage! With such different values, will these two make it down the aisle?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Legendary handball player Han Gangsan, who retired due to an ankle injury, teams up with his nemesis Shintaro—the man responsible for his injury—and embarks on a reckless challenge to lead the troublemakers of Gangsan Technical High School, the worst-ranked school in the country, to a top finish at the national tournament.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ho-Seok is a tiger who wants to make and sell cute desserts in peace. While he was once a member of a shady syndicate, he makes the decision to wash his hands of that life and instead follow his dream of opening his own dessert shop! But this new life isn’t as easy as it sounds. Can Ho-Seok overcome the prejudices his neighbors have against him and make his dream come true? A slice-of-life story to warm your heart!

(Source: WEBTOON)

"The empire is at peace only when an empress with brilliant golden locks is at the side of the emperor."

In the Empire of Oriet, every reign is marked by the birth of a single blonde woman who is worthy of being the emperor’s consort. Thanks to this multiple century-long legend, the empire has prospered. However, unable to obtain a blonde consort, the current emperor was forced to marry a vicous dark-haired empress. Without their blonde beauty, the empire is facing its slow decline. Meanwhile, the second prince, Carlix, loses in the race to become the next emperor. Forced into a marriage to a woman who doesn’t even show up to their wedding, Carlix is made even more furious after being publicly disrespected by her father, the duke. But then, as if by fate, Carlix stumbles upon a stunning blonde beauty. Will he be able to seduce her and steal her throne?

“Give unto me your heart and body…”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Infant formula lids, yogurt spoons... Hunsung Tech, a small-to-medium enterprise specializing in small plastic products. Peek inside, and you'll find a family (?) business where the CEO, his son, brother-in-law, younger brother, and daughter-in-law each hold a position, squeezing the life out of other employees.

Within this Hunsung Tech, Manager Lee Gyeong-Min, working in administration, is the company's ace. His sharp work ethic, early morning arrivals, and late nights are standard. He covers for the incompetence of upper management and even looks out for the treatment of production workers. After years of struggling like this, his patience reached its limit. Then, something astonishing happened in Lee Gyeong-Min's life.

Escape from the black company, job change, success, and even marriage. 99% of South Korea is made up of small and medium-sized enterprises! The fierce success story of one young man unfolding within one such SME.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: E Yi Jijie Jintian Ye Zai Koushixinfei
title.native: 恶役继姐今天也在口是心非

description:
Lin Anan was forced to bind to a villain system, reincarnating as Hera, the malicious stepsister in a Western fantasy novel. According to the plot, she must torment the kind-hearted “Cinderella” Duoliya, but each act of “bullying” secretly hides her protection of her. One day, an accident occurs: Duoliya’s tears trigger a system glitch—whenever Hela comes into contact with Duoliya’s bodily fluids, she loses control and speaks her true feelings. Though Duoliya appears fragile, she is actually a yandere. After discovering Hela’s secret, she deliberately uses her tears and saliva to force Hela to confess her true feelings. As the two become increasingly entangled in the tug-of-war between “villain” and “yandere,” they join forces with the original “antagonist” to expose a royal conspiracy, break free from the shackles of fate, and secure a happy ending for everyone.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Xue Rui once harbored an unhealthy possessiveness toward “Big Sister,” and this secret has somehow come to the attention of the university representative, Xiang Xiaoyuan. Will Xue Rui be able to maintain the image of the “good girl” she has cultivated over the years?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Bing Jiao Nü Xuesheng Chengle Wo de Shangsi
title.native: 病娇女学生成了我的上司

description:
Lin Shuo, the dreaded “Devil Teacher” who is feared by everyone, finds herself blushing in private when teased by one of her former students.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

My ex-girlfriend, with whom I had a precipitous breakup five years ago, is causing a scene at my blind date? The docile and obedient girl I remember now sports striking pink hair, a cigarette between her fingers, and an aura of mystery and danger. She arrives with a burning desire for revenge and to subdue him, only to find that the once-respectable "Teacher Zhang" has long since lost his youthful edge. But why is this seemingly inevitable confrontation spiraling out of control?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

There's a place between earth and sky where every suicidal's souls go.
Within their inhabitants, there are the members of a metal band called Third Man, who wish to become a great hit . For that to happen, they must find a lead guitar. They would do anything to find that guitarist, even if he's on the world of the living - but for that, to bring him to the world of the dead, he must commit suicide.

Lou Jie is a legendary street basketball player. His Uncle, a shady character, desperately wants him to go to the best sports college in China so that one day Lou Jie can play in the NBA. Lou Jie has plans that don't include basketball, however fate may have something else in mind...

(Source: Manyou Wenhua, translated)

Top student Wang Fei has always dreamt about becoming a Judge, a pillar of light and justice for the people! However fate isn't on his side and he ends up going to a high school for delinquents. How is he going to survive? Will he rise to the top or be gobbled up in the chaos of the hell that is Shiji High School?

She is my dead boyfriend’s sister, I thought my feelings to my boyfriend influenced me to have this vagueness with her, but I gradually fell in love with her.

She is my dead brother’s girlfriend, I thought we love each other, but I was no more than a substitute in others’ eyes.

I love her, she does not; She loves her, but she does not. I love you, but do you have the same feelings?

(Source: MangaToon)

Yu Qianyi, who is always careful to please other people’s lives on campus, often feels that his future is bleak, until he meets Cai Peixi, a boy who is completely opposite to him. By chance, the two have an indissoluble bond. The story of healing and growth of youth unfolds...

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Everything has a spirit, and so do words. Good words can bring salvation, and bad words can bring people to their doom. The unscrupulous "Taoist" is different from ordinary people. Instead of eating food, he feeds on the spirit of words. How will the fradulent Taoist be disciplined when he meets an envoy of the underworld? Evil spirits and and the human heart are equally unpredictable, but with the two of them side by side, this journey will certainly be interesting...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Zhou Yian used to be a naive and carefree young master of a dignified noble family. However, his family was toppled overnight. In order to survive and take revenge, he had no choice but to rely on Lin Mu, the notorious number one martial art master in the world. So he had to put up with Lin Mu’s flippant words and teasing, and even had to take it upon himself to butter up to him and… feed this tiger with his body. Will he be eaten by the tiger, or will he be able to tame the tiger and turn him into his big kitty?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Shadiao Zha Gong Jintian You Zhale Wo
title.native: 沙雕渣攻今天又渣了我

description:
