This is the story of the male protagonist Qiu Yanzhi, who escaped reality and indulged in holographic love games, but unexpectedly reunited with his childhood friend He Zhou. The dusty feelings between the two awakened again, and the secrets hidden in the game also gradually surfaced.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Bei Tiandao Zuzhoule De Wo Faner Geng Qiangle
title.native: 被天道诅咒了的我反而更强了

description: The male protagonist crossed over to get the cursed system, which made him stronger as long as he lay flat or gained the negative emotions of others, so the male protagonist began to lay flat and live a life of salted fish to upgrade.

title.romaji: Menpai Zhi You Wo Yige Zha Zha
title.english: I'm the Only Slacker in My Sect!

description:
The world's greatest sect's sect leader, Mo Shangchuan, failing to survive a robbery, was reincarnated into the body of a thrown-away child. And this child was actually black as heck! Yet, this wasn't bad enough. Even worse, they were taken by a Nine Schools' cultivator sect's most trash Daoist. Yan Qin as her disciple. I, Mo Shangchuan, have never suffered such treatment. As I was regaining my former self's strength, a mysterious memory rushed into my head. It was actually about a star-crossed love between me and this trash master...

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.romaji: Wudi Di Wo Zhi Xiang Dang Ge Fanren
title.native: 无敌的我只想当个凡人

description:
After transmigrating to the world of immortal cultivation, Shui Wuyu discovered that he had an invincible ability, but he didn't expect that once he used it, his lifespan would be consumed. In order to survive, Shui Wuyu decided to become a mortal. However… "I just want to be a mortal!! Why do you all want to mess with me!!!"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

With excellent medical skills, he brings the dying back to life. With a pair of powerful fists, he fights against thousands of enemies. Walking between death and power, he breaks rules, rescues all living creatures and dominates the city, thus starting an exciting journey among cities.

(Source: WebComics)

Qin Jing can’t remember when he first realized it, but it seems that everyone who falls for him ends up being targeted by misfortune. So Qin Jing came up with a plan: by acting cold and cruel when they confessed their feelings, he always managed to push them away and keep them safe from his “curse.” But… why doesn’t this strategy seem to work on the new transfer student? With Qi Yu—a mysterious boy who has just arrived at the school—misfortune strikes far more violently than it ever did with the others. What will Qin Jing have to come up with this time to protect him too?

(Source: WEBTOON)

From Fairyfly:

Laura Li, a high school student who grew up in a prosperous family where little warmth and love exist, always manages to carry a bright smile to hide her loneliness. Eric Zhao, a young man who grew up in a problematic family, has spent time in a juvenile prison when he was younger. Since then, he has put up invisible walls around him, forbidding anyone to come near him. When these two encounter in the big city, are they able to use their pure feelings to purify each other’s heart?

He approached and trapped her with a devastating smell, raping her every night. She fought back with her words,

"Do you believe I will neutralize you?"

He sneered calmly,

"I will sleep you even if I was neutralized. What I want is, from beginning to end, to push you down throughout my life."

(Source: MangaToon)

One day, a strange patient visited psychologist Shen Siqing's counseling Room. He was not an ordinary mental patient, yet not a completely healthy person either. With questions, Shen Siqing gradually walked into the trap set for him. What kind of past was buried at the bottom of the trap?

(Source: Webnovel)

Since birth, Huang Fujie was feared and viewed as an ugly freak. His painful and tragic childhood twisted his heart and made it wicked. Zhang Ping, a eunuch, is the only one who cares about Huang Fujie. This unwelcome prince and his clever eunuch will cause a huge storm in political affairs.

(Source: WebComics)

The lanterns which can see others' secrets, a lantern shop which gathers the love and hatred. The joys and sorrows of the world are all hidden in the lamplight. Kindness and evil intertwined in this small shop. The shadow on the wall reveals the true colors of human nature.

(Source: Webcomics)

For revenge, she signed a love contract with Sheng Yun. She thought she would get what she wanted, never did she think that she was also tricked by him step by step. Being trapped in love, both of them are afraid of confessing to each other. What will be the ending for this love starting from revenge and interests?

(Source: Webcomics)

Xue Yang auctions his sketchbook off online to purchase his younger sister’s favorite idol, Ji Jiayu’s concert tickets. The buyer later discovers a love letter that Xue Yang had forgotten in his sketchbook. Little did he know, the buyer is Ji Jiayu, and the two of them get closer and closer in the anonymity of the internet...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

A piece of fantasy love story in a field of light from magic land. Each story tell the story of the parallel time and space of Ba Jiu and Li Shi whom are destined to meet. The strange love story between normal person and strange person, how will their story end...?

(Source: Dongman, translated)

title.english: Caught in a Marriage After Provoking Mr. Huo

description:
Xia Wan never expected to be exposed, threatened, and caressed… all after getting involved with Qingcheng's mysterious legendary bachelor Huo Qingsui. Huo Qingsui's only goal for his relationship with Xia Wan: to dote on her and cherish her for a lifetime.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Barbara somehow finds herself role-playing Chuhan Bai, the pathetic female lead of a cliché CEO web novel she recently read, in a game. As the game has a mechanism that restarts every time she fails to complete a story quest, she has failed several times due to their completely different characteristics. Just when she is about to restart again, she realizes that Qian Song, a non-playing character, will restart along with her as well. In order to finish the game, these two decide to team up.

(Source: Webnovel)

Wan Xiang married to a civilian-born governor in troubled times because of a marriage contract after the decline and fall of Qing Dynasty. However, their marriage didn't bring any happiness but her husband's indifference to her. Until one day she met the person of destiny. When the true love comes, how will she choose?

(Source: WebComics)

How can this happen! A top secret agent like me is dragged into time travel and becomes an ancient female general whose engagement has just been broken off. And that’s not the worst. The most notorious playboy in this city tries to propose to me? No no no. To the original master of this body. But now I am the one who have to be in charge of this…

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Chengwei Chuji Maoxianzhe De Heilong Daren
title.english: The Dragon Emperor Becomes A Junior Adventurer
title.native: 成为初级冒险者的黑龙大人

description:
Heath is the giant Dragon of Space-Time and leader of the Demon Race. After he was sealed away in the Ancient War by a human sage, he used his space-time abilities to study the cultures of worlds in other dimensions, becoming a homebody extraordinaire. Yet one day the sage unlocked part of the seal, and Heath set off on a new journey as a junior adventurer, in a world that is familiar yet new to him...

(Source: Coolmic)

title.romaji: Zong You Yaoguai Xiang Hai Zhen

description:
Suddenly making me the Empress? Suddenly live a life of luxury? Suddenly give me a harem of beautiful men? I knew there had to be a catch! The poor farmer girl's turnaround battle - a struggle to the death!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

It doesn't matter if your appearance or your gender has changed. I love you, because you're you.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Qingding Jiao Qi: Feng Ye Chong Qi Chengyin
title.english: Mr Feng's Addiction to Pampering His Wife
title.native: 情定娇妻：封爷宠妻成瘾

description:
Ji Ruge's mother sold her in order to save her bedridden brother. On the brink of danger, the handsome crown prince of Shang city saved her life. To return the favor, she agrees to start a contractual relationship with him to help him avoid blind dates set up by his family. Will this fake relationship turn into a real one?..

(Source: INKR)
Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

“There’s no way a lady this gorgeous could be the villainess! And she’s going to end up as part of the OP MC’s harem?! Absolutely not, I refuse! I’m going to change the outcome of this story!” The weak and pathetic—but with a large stomach!—transmigrator Hu Xiaoman quietly made up her mind.

“You look so focused, silly.” The villainess, reborn in the New Game+, thought that this girl was very~ interesting.

Transmigrator x New Game+ character, who’s the one really hiding a secret side to herself?

Wait, the OP MC has nothing to do with this story anymore?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An herbalist named Lun stumbles upon a small village that is in a middle of preparing a festival. However, he finds out that the festival is actually a ceremony of human sacrifice. After saving the girl from being a sacrifice, Lun travels with this girl to find the Divine Scrolls.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Guanyu Wo Bei Emo Shouliu Bing Bude Bu He Ta Tongyi Wuyan Xia de Shi
title.native: 关于我被恶魔收留并不得不和他同一屋檐下的事

description:
There's no escape for humans that flirt with Demons. Fight or fall in love!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The renowned detective Lucien found himself drawn to a strange, brutal murder case. However, the scene of the crime was destroyed in a fire. Scarlett, a maker of dollhouses, was the last person to reach the scene. Lucien had to "coerce" this quirky woman into helping him with his investigation in order to find the truth. What he didn't anticipate was that Scarlett was hiding many bloody secrets...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Chief researcher Yanjing Zhuang came to a remote research facility with her bodyguard, Xiangyang Zuo. She was supposed to help in the development of a cancer cure, but an accident broke out in the lab. With the help of other survivors in the research facility, they must find a way to escape!

(Source: INKR)

The childhood sweethearts who lived in a small city ten years ago met again in a big city ten years later. The difference between identity class, domestic violence and bullying, inspirational growth and abusive love... But luckily, there are roses and sugar under the knife and glass, and maybe the two of them will have a happy ending after all?

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Xuanyi Mao —— Dashu Shenye Gushi Ji
title.english: Mysteries Cat: Uncle's Late Night Story Collections
title.native: 悬疑猫——大叔深夜故事集

description:
These are the stories as told to me by a wandering cat in the middle of the city. I've recorded everything the black cat has seen—some are heart-warming but others are creepy. Nevertheless, I hope to use art to retell these stories one by one in hopes that they'll make your evening a little better each day.

(Source: Webnovel)

Four youths with completely different personalities under Coach Shen’s training become a team of amazing swimmers. The life of these four are about to begin!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

According to legend, the world used to be a very different place. Exotic beasts, spirits, and youkai lived with humans in peace. But as time passed and events occurred, the spirits and demons eventually hid themselves away.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Notes:
Season 1: 15 chapters and 2 extras
Season 2: 31 chapters and 6 extras

An otaku manga artist who can see a world that ordinary people can't meets a new neighbor with the same special ability. This pair of delusional teenagers live a riotous life together.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The violent and perverted emperor and the stubborn and cold minister! The beginning is very sad, but the end is very sweet!

Three years ago, a palace coup occurred, and Du Yuzhang abandoned his family just to save the life of his beloved. Unexpectedly, his beloved ascended the throne and no longer had any pity for him. From then on, during the day, he was the left prime minister Du Da who was powerful and above everyone else; at night, he became the plaything of Du Yuzhang, who was tossed around in the palace and under one person.

(Source: MangaToon)

Wu Hao, whose confession was just rejected, suddenly transmigrated into a strange, post-apocalyptic world. He turns out to be the key to prevent the end of the world!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

On the first day of school, a little hooligan transferred to Chen Hao's class. What happens when both the top student and hooligan don't want to create trouble? Trouble ensues.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ben Gongzhu de An Wei Neixin Dan Mu Tai Duo
title.native: 本公主的暗卫内心弹幕太多

description:
The doomed princess can read the mind of her strange new bodyguard. When she saw her eventual tragic end in his mind, the princess was determined to grab on to the powerful bodyguard to help change her fate! The cold-blooded bodyguard had actually transmigrated from another world, and to return home, he must complete the mission given by the System – to destroy the princess's dynasty and create a new kingdom. But now he finds himself being seduced by the princess instead!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The job-hunting girl Tang Mu accidentally discovered Mu Tianchen's secret identity as an exorcist, so she was forced to become his personal assistant! Time to say goodbye to the ordinary world! How will their relationship go? What sort of drama went on in their previous generations?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Yi Ri Weishi: Chongsheng Hou Xunfu Hei Lianhua Etu
title.native: 一日为师-重生后驯服黑莲花恶徒

description:
In the era of the great Yin Dynasty, the famous minister Yan Xisheng and the leader of a martial arts sect, Sheng Yunqi, bear a striking resemblance to each other. Both were killed by their own disciples, but unexpectedly, they were reborn in each other’s body and must now teach each other’s disciples a lesson?!

Yan Xisheng: “I will learn from my past mistakes and surely be able to teach this ‘black lotus’ disciple properly.”

His crazy new disciple, Duan Wei: “Master, do you know what the first step is to tame a crazy dog?”

“Feed him until he’s full.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A soul from a different world was summoned to the world of cultivation. The female immortal gave her the inheritance of 10,000 years, so that she embarked on the cultivation unexpectedly! Hold on, how could there be such a good thing? The female fairy also gave her a task to save the “evil Lord”... How could she make up for the guilt from her previous life? How would she do when facing the love debts that she couldn’t avoid nor pay back?

(Source: Webnovel)

The 38th generation of Lu's exorcist teaches in a high school with a very negative atmosphere. The real purpose is because there are too many ghosts in the high school, and his goal is to become the strongest Lu's exorcist.

(Source: WebComics)

After graduating from high school, the protagonist, Yang, passes the civil service exam. However, despite his desire for a stable life, he is inexplicably assigned to the special department known as the M Department, which is tasked with dealing with transformed humans. The members of the M Department primarily use special weapons to combat these transformed humans, who blend into the crowd by appearing as ordinary people.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

Public defender Luka stumbles into a conflict between angels and demons while investigating a case. He meets Albert, who’s secretly a demon, and their relationship quickly deepens.

Just as things start to heat up, Luka discovers Albert’s true identity—and learns he may be involved with a mysterious group that’s wreaking havoc in the human world. Now, Luka feels lost and uncertain about everything.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

That night, he takes her virginity and makes her his woman. Several charming princes and a restrained and calm humble maid. Will their meeting with her lead to a series of sweet romances or a huge crisis that destabilizes the whole country?

(Source: Webnovel)

I never thought the kitten I picked up became a big man! He'd even squirreled into my bed. For the first time in Lise Xia's life, she wants to burst out cursing...

(Source: Webcomics App)

Spencer Chang, a talented strategist with a knack for breaking into the most secure places. Joy Wen, heir to his family’s fortune, who craves adventure almost as much as the attention of beautiful women. Sui Zhuo, a mysterious hacker with a dark past, whose timid appearance belies her strength and courage. Together, these three mercenaries form a bond that will see them through increasingly daring exploits… that is, if they can just stop bickering long enough.

(Source: Tapas)

Wang You Cai, who has the abilities of a detective, originally planned to take a break after resigning as a cop; but to his dismay, his friend experienced an unexplainable tragic death. As a detective, he has decided to solve the mystery; while searching for answers, he met the female Mc Zhen Meng, who is part of a mysterious group; confidentially, they start to uncover the truth of many other obnoxious situations.

(Source: Manga Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Mowang Daren, Ni Ge Han Ni Hujia Chifan
title.native: 魔王大人，你哥喊你回家吃饭

description:
Just imagine~ you'd just become the new demon king, drinking a little wine and singing before unceremoniously being thrown into the human realm. Not only did you lose your mana, you also became a little baby who has to live with a strange family.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

By a twist of fate, Liu Lang, once the richest young master in Nanshan City, becomes a office worker both in human and immortal worlds. He takes charge of the immortal imprison stationed in the human world. No pay? But he learns divine techniques from immortals! No social insurance? But fairy comes and gives him elixir! No year-end bonus? He gets 13th month pay from his fiancée's company! Lo and behold, how Liu Lang gets everything in his hands and becomes the legend of the two worlds!

Relying on women and taming your concubines can be an art to a master. An otaku died and gets to live again inside the body of the world’s top cultivator, the previous cultivation fanatic is thus reduced to a Kungfu loser. The golden rules of surviving in this world? Act cute with your honey! And let them cover you up in the real battle! Come along and let’s embark on the legendary cultivation path with that loser master and his concubines!!

(Source: Webnovel)
An original Chinese work, Absolute Zero is an exclusively-released, extremely popular suspense comic by Tencent on Webnovel

They seem like two very different people in the eyes of others. One is cheerful and outgoing; the other is quiet and introverted. "As long as you're willing to read, I'll always write for you." A realistic story between author (writer) and reader (artist).

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A sly demon that attacks x An earnest angel. As his job to fulfill people's dreams, the angel Nuoqiu took on the peculiar job of becoming a demon's private investigator. The demon kept claiming to have known Nuoqiu for a long time. But angels and demons aren't suppose to have anything to do with each other? As they get to know each other, the more Nuoqiu felt like this demon is different. "It's as if... I'm actually starting to like him?"

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Zhen Huan Zhuan: Xu Hua Lie

description: Short stories about the consorts and concubines from the original work "Empresses in the Palace" - famous for its original novel and TV drama adaptation.

title.romaji: Bai Lan Hou Wo Zhangkong Wangye Fangxin
title.native: 摆烂后我掌控王爷芳心

description:
When the foolish but cute glutton Hua Manman transmigrated into a novel becoming a villainess, she was supposed to refuse the king’s hand in marriage to wash away his misfortune and then enter the Imperial Palace to become one of the Emperor’s concubines. She didn’t expect the king to read minds, and he even took her in as his concubine?!

(Source: Webnovel)

The world controlled by the Tianqiong League has a strict caste system, and those common humans without cybernetic implants are treated like animals. Until the appearance of spacetime ruins offered normal humans a chance at redemption, but most died from the unknown dangers lurking in the ruins. Su Qian is just a normal guy, relying on his wits and courage to fight against the world's injustices. As he likes to say – he's just stubborn that way! Exploring the ruins, awakening powers, the boundary between life and death. With the help of a powerful hacker, Su Qian will step by step become extraordinary!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Bu Weizhen, a 18-year-old college student, suddenly was told that there is a 5-year-old biological daughter Zhang Xinyi, which Bu Weizhen's life become a mess because of the appearance of Zhang Xinyi...

(Source: WebComics)

Passionate competition and conspiracy coexist, what is the truth behind the death of the goddess? Giant grievances or emotional entanglements? The oppressed girl fought back and grew into a new goddess. Layers up layers of doubts and suspicions uncovered one step at a time.

Why an orphan girl with a bumpy life would be favored by a president? What kind of unknown past did an icy president have?

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Wo De Laopo Shi Nan Shen

description:
Chen Minning is just like any other housewife, busy with taking care of her family every day. However, under her mask of being a homemaker, she has another secret identity: She's a male idol. How does s/he juggle her/his dreams and reality?

(Source: Webnovel)

Qin Yuefang was reborn after a car accident, but was reborn in a body named "Fang Yeyin". By chance, Yeyin met his younger self! He was tied by Qin Yuefang (his younger self) and became his possession... As Fang Yeyin attempts to discover the truth of the his reincarnation, he also has to escape the clutches of this perverted Qin Yuefang. But will things go smoothly...?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

title.romaji: Mei You Ming Zi De Gu Feng ABO

description: Funny ABO manhua, such a name as Nameless ABO. What to do when encountered with a strong O? The only way is to to marry him.

A story about an unexpected cohabitation life between a warm and cute cat and a irritable chicken boss~~

Life is hard, let me sweeten it with meow!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

I occupy everything that belongs to Ji Chenfeng: status, family background, relatives... Knowing full well that I am a fake, I still usurp his place without any remorse.

Selfishness flows inherently in my veins, endlessly greedy, despicable and shameless. I want everything, I must have everything, and... I have no intention of changing.

One thought good, one thought evil; one thought greedy, one thought wrong.

When a bastard gains the ability to love, perhaps that is heaven's greatest punishment for his bastardry.

Ji Chenfeng x Sang Nian, the noble young man from a poor family x the bastard from a rich family.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Laura Davis never believed in fate. She didn't believe in fate when her father married another woman. Neither did she believe in fate when she was thrown to the valley all by herself.She started from scratch and became so powerful that people were scared of her. Since justice didn't come itself, she fought for it.

(Source: Webnovel)

Who says furry roommates are therapeutic? My Yun Ting Community F4 will crack you up! Watch as the mischievous, hornless sheep-curly hair shows off his death-defying antics, the “aloof” snow leopard ends up as the comic relief, the “useless” office drone Gray Teacher goes mad and awakens, and the gentle White Doctor tries to work miracles! All this and more in this hilarious urban comic about shedding, wrecking homes, and saving the day!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Isn't Cinderella in the fairy tale who puts on high heels and becomes a princess? Why I'm a man, who just temporarily wore high heels for fun, became a princess also?

(Source: WebComics)

The story begins to unfold in 900-960 AD, Later Zhou dynasty when Chi Wu is being imprisoned after purposely losing to the emperor. His true goal lies within the prison itself, a clue to the whereabouts of world’s greatest lost treasure - Qi Lin Treasure. The words of his capture quickly spread to the ear of his senior and a former officer of the imperial court. Tie Zong Heng (Lawless), decides to be re-enlisted to the imperial services just to hunt down Chi Wu.

At well-known University 985, there's 320 dorm. Because the four people in the dormitory have different personalities but all look very handsome, they are known as 320F4. Here is their little story.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Edgar, Ace and I are roommates. Lately, we've been surrounded by gays. Help us! what should we do?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Hillbilly-CEO with Zero fashion sense X Bamboo-rat-turned-Mukbang-streamer. Even though he's just a bamboo rat, Ou Yixi still has his own hopes and dreams! But why do I keep feeling a chill down my back on the road to achieving my dreams? And why does my CEO keep salivating every time he sees me?! Bamboo rats are so cute - how could you even think about eating us!

The cold corporate president who no longer believed in love after having lost it once before. The gentle boy forced to be strong trying to hold on to love. Two unrelated people are fated to meet as alpha and omega. Confrontation, conflict, reconciliation, and coming together… Is this fatal attraction a cruel joke of the devil, or a grace from god?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Before meeting Lu Xiao, Chu Yi had imagined his future partner thousands of times. Handsome, elegant, knowledgeable, smart and sexy... At that time, he didn't know that there is actually much more important things than physical features, namely the feeling of love. After meeting Lu Xiao, Chu Yi felt that none of those specifications were indispensable. He said to himself, Lu Xiao is the one.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

In a place known as "House of Constellations" lives a group of special girls. The personified Constellation Girls' daily life together will be presented here.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Shengshi Zhuang Niang: Zhuang Zhe Gonglüe
title.english: The Ultimate Guide to Becoming a Successful Makeup Artist

description:
What happens when you're caught off guard and thrust into a beauty game with its own psyche, where doing skincare increases buff, applying makeup increases attack power? Wu Xiaowei's goal is very simple: stay alive, go through the levels quickly, pass missions, purchase a large variety of lipsticks and eyeshadows that she cannot afford in the real world, as well as apply skincare products from luxurious brands. Limited items are not rejected but welcomed. The more discontinued limited items she owns, the better. She wants to survive in style in this fantasy world.

(Source: Coolmic)

Following the advice of his imaginary friend Jason, who told him, "Treat all girls like stones," Park Jin-yong starts seeing every girl as a stone. But then Sunwoo, a female student who doesn’t look like a stone, appears before him, and for the first time in five years, the sight of a girl’s face sends Jinyong’s happy little circuits into overdrive...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Summoned creatures have ranks, from the lowest F-rank to the highest S-rank... but something’s strange.

“Why is my summon EX-rank?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Claisy, who must marry in order to inherit her fortune, repeatedly misses opportunities to date due to the meddling of her niece Meron, who is only a few years younger than her. However, she eventually meets a man as if by fate and marries him after finding true love. During their happy honeymoon, a jealous Meron turns back time and returns to the past, and in this new life, she even goes so far as to steal Claisy’s husband. Having always been manipulated by Meron, Claisy declares that if Meron steals her husband, she will steal Meron’s husband in return!

After their return to the past, Meron and Claisy end up swapping husbands. A bitter love quadrangle begins as the two men’s affections intertwine amidst the sharp psychological battle between the aunt and niece who know each other all too well.

(Source: Naver, translated)

To parents who had wanted a son, their eldest daughter was neither useful nor lovable. Born as the eldest daughter of the Tilord family, Ladis was always forced to make sacrifices. But after striving until her very body was broken, what she received in return was ultimately her family’s betrayal.

“It was all a futile dream. I shouldn’t have lived for my parents, for my siblings, for my family, or for the family name. I should have lived for myself!”

In that final moment she thought was the end, Ladis was transported back to the age of sixteen.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“I used to wish you’d just disappear. But I never thought it would actually happen.”

Yun-Jeong, who wants to live a brilliant life marked by excellent grades and clear goals. Her older sister Eun-Ah, who longed for a simple, unassuming life without ambition. And Cheol-Yun, the man who became deeply entangled in the lives of the two sisters. Ju-Hwan, who had been quietly by Yun-Jeong’s side for a long time. Fate binds the hearts of the four together, leaving behind wounds that can never be healed.

A predetermined future, family expectations, and conflicting desires lead to an irreversible catastrophe. The secrets of these three people and the guilt they carry are passed down, casting a shadow over the next generation…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.romaji: Himeul Sumgigo Jeulgineun Pyeonghwaroun Hanyeo Saenghwal
title.native: 힘을 숨기고 즐기는 평화로운 하녀 생활

description:
They call Harriet Listerwell the Scandal Maker, but the reputation was carefully crafted by her cousin Bella. At an imperial banquet, another of Bella’s schemes unfolds—framing Harriet in a way which insults the handsome and formidable Duke Cedric Kailas. Disgraced, Harriet is sent to a convent. In exile, she discovers a troubling truth: Bella’s family may have been behind the death of her parents. Now Harriet is returning to the glittering society that condemned her. The Scandal Maker is back—and this time, she intends to live up to the name.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Legendary creators Lee Hyeon-Se and Lee Du-Hu personally produced Hell Camp Short Story Collection Season Eight!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Stories Included:
1. STILL ALIVE (STILL ALIVE) [Kingman]
2. Saebyeok Nesi Kaereolsong (새벽 네시 캐럴송) [ Yeoun]
3. Gwisineul Boneun Ai (귀신을 보는 아이) [Sunkki]
4. Lovely ♡ Ppakppagi (러블리♡빡빡이) [Suk-Jin Byeon]
5. Gyae (걔) [Yeong-Chae Hae]
6. Helster (헬스터) [Jeonglian]
7. Yeonggameul Chajaseo (영감을 찾아서) [Jeyang]
8. Joemok (죄목) [Nu-Ruk Sin]
9. Gudakdari Satang (구닥다리 사탕) [Yeong Eun]
10. Saejang (새장) [Dorandi]
11. Dreams Come True (드림스 컴 트루) [Il-Gong Yuk]
12. Goyangiseome Eoseooseyo (고양이섬에 어서오세요) [Su-Min Park]
13. Kkot Dokkaebijeon (꽃 도깨비전) [Alpha A]
14. origin (origin) [Min-Uk Jeong]
15. light blue (light blue) [Eun-Ji Hong]
16. Iljinsanyang (일진사냥) [Seoseo]
17. Eonjena Myeot Beonirado (언제나 몇 번이라도) [Kang-Hui Han]
18. Kkotdoduk (꽃도둑) [Yeong-Jin Ju]
19. Bit (빛) [Sang-Ki Hong]
20. Sopunggachi (소풍같이) [Deupo]

Yoo-Ju is forced to steal her twin sister's identity and enter a marriage of convenience. But Seung-Han Do, the chaebol heir she's meant to deceive, sees through her charade from the very beginning. Instead of exposing her, he finds himself enthralled by her dangerous game.

(Source: Manta)

After years of unrequited love, Angelica finally marries Lord Dominic, but he remains cold and distant. To make matters worse, Angelica’s uncle selfishly betrays the family. As endless debt and sorrow pain the poor girl, she tragically decides to end it all... Yet, she somehow wakes up in the past, returning to the day she proposed to Dominic. Was it all a dream? One thing is clear—Angelica won’t commit the same mistakes again.

“I don’t love you anymore, Dominic. Let’s break off the engagement!”

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Min Ah-Hyeon, who grew up abused as a test subject in a research facility, enlists in the military, which seems connected to the facility, to uncover its secrets. There, she meets her direct superior, Shin Hae-Jun. He was a military dog who unquestioningly obeyed orders from above, no matter how contradictory. The world reaches its end with the emergence of zombies. Amid the chaos, Ah-Hyeon loses her younger brother and blames Hae-Jun for it. To avoid ever crossing paths with him again, she deserts and becomes a mercenary. But Hae-Jun calmly tracks her down, offering to help find her brother and proposing they work together...!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

“So you've been sharing your bed with a demon, my lady. I never imagined my wife could be so vulgar.”

Just because she had a dream about a demon, her husband, affectionate throughout their marriage, suddenly changed in an instant. Niv endured a life treated worse than an animal, like a candle that could be snuffed out at any moment. Then Delphion appeared, like salvation in that life. Niv fell helplessly for his mysterious, languid aura, continuing her illicit affair with the demon as her body and soul became drenched in desire...

“Do you call the one you love your savior?”

Therefore, to survive, she had to grasp the savior's hand. Even if it was impure.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.romaji: Sihanbu Agi Uiwoni Cheonjaein Geol An Sumgim
title.native: 시한부 아기 의원이 천재인 걸 안 숨김

description:
In my third life, just before becoming the empire's top councilor and returning to my original world... I was deceived by the emperor, lost my life, and reset back to age three. I refuse to reincarnate again! In my past life, my abilities blossomed, but the problem was I had no one to protect me. My trump card was my uncle, the greatest warrior, who was exiled to the East after contracting an incurable disease...

...my father. Treating him would give me a powerful ally! I hate it with a passion, but it's my last resort. I have no choice but to meet that despicable father who never once came looking for me.

“Father, this is a contract and a deal. I'll cure you if you become my guardian.”

Me... will I be able to return this time?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.romaji: Sihanbu Agi Uiwoni Cheonjaein Geol An Sumgim
title.native: 시한부 아기 의원이 천재인 걸 안 숨김

description: Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the novel of the same name.

Harvey scrapes by working part-time at a fast-food joint. His only escape from this grueling life? Watching band performances! Then one day, through some incident, he gets tangled up with Logan, the vocalist of his idol band Vanilla Sunday...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Goh Wun is back from the brink of death, but the man who loved him is gone. Waking up with total amnesia, Wun finds that his only lifeline is Kwon Hui-Jae: a guide who looks at him with equal parts longing and loathing. As they navigate a dangerous web of secrets and supernatural stakes, Wun realizes that forgetting the past didn't make the pain go away. He still has his powers, and he still wants Huijae. But in this game of redemption, the truth might be more dangerous than the loss of memory itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Two families who loathe each other to the core: Vermonte and Temnes. Clodel becomes the sacrificial offering for a forced reconciliation, marrying Kaian, the Duke of Temnes. “So you’re a bride unwelcomed by Temnes. Know your place and walk in on your own feet.” Kaian treats her coldly, as the heir of a family locked in long-standing hostility. “How admirable. Selling yourself to a man from your enemy’s house because of starving children.” For him, it was an unwanted marriage. For her, it was a marriage she chose. Clodel endured the humiliation poured upon her— she had not come here ignorant of what awaited her. Between the two, a fragile bond of husband and wife begins to take root. Gradually, he grows obsessed with Clodel, and she finds a reason to live in Kaian. But a shallow, unstable relationship is easily shattered and ruined. “It’s disgusting—mixing such filthy blood. It’s not like you can split a child in half.” Upon learning her husband’s true feelings, Clodel leaves him behind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

A genius female surgeon who hates humans, a germaphobe, emotionally detached, and terrified of physical contact, Irene Rios. The third prince of the Kingdom of Divoa, praised by all, the Grand Duke of the North, weary and bored with life, Diego Cassis. Two people who defy each other’s common sense, meet by chance, finding one another strangely intriguing.

"Miss Irene Rios, would you become my personal physician?"

"No. I cannot be a doctor."

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seong Ji-Hyun reunites with Baek Ian, her high school crush. Ian's competitive nature, obsessed with defeating Ji-Hyun, had strained their relationship, and she thought they'd never see each other again after graduation. But when they finally meet again, Ian approaches Ji-Hyun in a different way, becoming obsessed.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

I've possessed an extra in the novel I was writing, one without even a name. The problem is that extra is destined to be sold to a tyrannical emperor and meet a violent end! After escaping the damned Duke's estate and risking my life to hide... Of all places, I ended up at the Grand Duke's residence where the novel's ultimate villain is being raised!? But working here as a ‘nanny’...

“I can do what Father does!”
“...The child's birthday party is the most important thing.”
“Bella isn't some servant—she's someone I cherish!”

This was the story I hadn't yet written. How could such warm-hearted people meet such tragic ends? I couldn't let things unfold exactly as I'd written in my novel. After that day, I resolved. I would rewrite their destinies.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Shy and lonely college junior Do-Rae Lee never expects to see her high school crush again until she runs into Hae-Won Cha, who’s just as handsome as she remembers. When Hae-Won suddenly confesses his feelings, Do-Rae is completely thrown off. Because one, he already has a popular girlfriend who happens to be Do-rae’s friend, and two, he believes he’s still eighteen years old. After a car accident erased five years of his memories, Hae-Won is stuck in the past and determined to make Do-Rae his girlfriend. Now the two are confronted by the question: Can first love survive reality?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Five hundred years have passed since Mu-Jin began praying for the lost souls' ascension. Then, his lover, Geum-Ji, who died 300 years ago, appeared before him, reincarnated. However, she was already dead in this life. Unaware of her own death, she returned to Mu-Jin.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Becoming the Lady of the Cursed Ducal House

description:
When Hana wakes up in a novel as Cielina, a character who is destined to die, she decides to keep a low profile—until disturbing rumors surface that her husband, Duke Killian Seyfried, killed his own niece and nephew. Diving into the mystery, she uncovers a haunting family curse that renders the children monstrous in others' eyes. Yet, Cielina's touch reveals their true forms. As she digs deeper, Cielina discovers she's been transported into this world by a goddess with a mission: to lift the Seyfried family's dark curse. Can she unravel the family's twisted secrets and alter her own fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)
Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the webnovel of the same name.

title.english: The Swordmaster Who Leapt Through Time

description:
The Kingdom of Vanroah has fallen. Lansen, the last prince, flees with the remaining survivors to a faraway land. Vowing to one day revive the kingdom, he becomes a swordmaster at a young age, only for a treacherous incident to strip everything away. Powerless to protect those he loves, he uses an ancient artifact to travel 10,000 years back in time to the Age of the Arcane. There, its rich knowledge and wisdom help him avert disaster in the present. But each time he turns back the clock, new secrets emerge, entangling the past and present in ways he never foresaw.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When a prophetic dream shows her future stepfather killing her family, Emeline Wedgewood sets out to stop her mother's marriage to the duke at all costs. And what better way than to start a scandal with the duke's son, Eric Orleans? Suspicious of his father's intentions, Eric proposes that he and Emeline marry so their parents can't. But will the scandal of the century be enough to foil the duke's plans? Or will their sham marriage pit these unlikely allies into greater danger than ever before?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Get In My Bed, Supporting Male Leads!

description:
Sure, I was reborn as the villainess, but her life seemed like a hassle, so I chose peace. But even though I’m keeping my distance from the main plot, the sub male leads keep showing up on my doorstep. They all want the same thing: to share my bed! Whatever the reason, I don’t want to get involved… but how could I refuse?

(Source: Tapas)

After failing at both love and work, Dokyung returns to the stillness of her hometown, Mooyung, where a chance encounter at her mother’s old corner store brings her face-to-face with Doh Joon, a top actor with eyes like midnight. What begins with a bold proposition soon turns into something far more complicated: a fleeting summer affair between a woman afraid to love again and a man who wants forever. As their days grow hotter and their nights more intimate, Dokyung clings to the idea that it’s just a season, just a moment. But Doh Joon is already dreaming of something that lingers long after summer ends.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Camellia: Mastering the Three Kingdoms as Alice

description:
Dong-Baek’s life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious crow pulls her from the modern world into ancient China. Trapped in the Three Kingdoms era, she must disguise herself as a man and gather allies from each kingdom in order to survive. Amid heavy political intrigue, she also faces a rival determined to defeat her. Can Dong-Baek outsmart this enemy and navigate the dangerous world she now inhabits?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Byeong-Gwan, who hates being bored, got a job in the security department of a college and started peeping girls through CCTV. One day, he sees a cowardly girl getting naked in public.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

She always wanted to be a campus couple with someone, he just thought she was a weirdo with an impulsive streak. So what happens when what starts as a whim becomes something neither of them expected? Maybe love really does come when you least expect it...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Moment When You and I Meet

description:
Life in the palace kitchen is tough, especially when the emperor is a picky eater! Anna tries to satisfy his appetite, and surprisingly, he likes her food. But when Anna finds a strange notebook, lost memories of her past return, and she soon has far more on her plate than just serving the emperor.

(Source: Manta)

Karen, the director of the administrative bureau of Lihian. She dreamed of a quiet retirement, but one day she receives an absurd order from the queen.

"I won't be queen. Find my successor."

She finds and raises Erich, a boy who is her distant blood relative, but Erich, who has grown up, is no longer an innocent boy. Unexpected emotions begin to creep into her life, which is built on principles.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.romaji: Nae Saekki Debwisikiryeoda Naega Debwihage Saenggim
title.native: 내 새끼 데뷔시키려다 내가 데뷔하게 생김

description:
With her weird talents and weirder personality, idol trainee Yoon Hyesung can't help but catch everyone's eye, even though that's far from what she wants. She's actually a fangirl from a different future with one goal in mind—help Na Yeonwoo debut as an idol! Now as Yeonwoo's friend, Hyesung is determined to get Yeonwoo the top spot on an idol survival program with the help of an oddly supportive game system. Can Hyesung help Yeonwoo debut, even if it means she will too?

(Source: Tapas)

“I’m the real Edith Abina?!”

Trapped in a reverse harem game. Even becoming a villain who has killed countless times! The protagonist, a player in the virtual reality game, “Experience! The Scene of Life: Saint Edition,” wakes up in the body of the villainess “Edith Abina,” not the game’s protagonist, the saint “Gian.” But no matter what I do, I can’t log out-?! On top of that, in order to figure out a way to return to reality, I have to beep-- beep- with 5 other characters to find true love?

“What the heck~~~!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Kim Ji-Hoon is a first-year intern at the prestigious Seoul Hospital. Having grown up as a poor orphan, Ji-Hoon worked his way through college, dreaming of one day becoming a professor of general surgery at his alma mater. He's passionate and eager to learn, but the unexpected politics at the hospital startle him. Even his fellow interns seem to care more about themselves than the patients. Can Ji-Hoon still become a great surgeon, or will the power struggle leave his dream in cardiac arrest?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Flower That Swallowed the Sun

description:
For 200 years, Amarzan the Great Sorcerer strived to become a god. So when he was told that he still lacked something, he chose to start over. Now, he has been reborn as Shuriah, one of the Brionia Empire's greatest beauties and Crown Prince Lenkaizer's maid. Despite trying to focus on finding what she lacked as Amarzan, Shuriah finds herself overcome with the urge to kill Lenkaizer whenever he shows her interest. Is she in danger, or is this just a new emotion she's never experienced before?

(Source: Tapas)

The talented and hardworking Bitt Geum learns her fiancé cheated—just a month before their wedding! Desperate and furious, she proposes to rookie developer Haneul to spite her ex, only to find out he’s the brother of her company's CEO. Just how will this chaotic office relationship turn out?

(Source: Manta)

Crazy school life continues, survive Kang Haram!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: I Tamed the Angsty Male Lead with My Fists

description:
When Duchess Delga Le Siegfried finds an abandoned boy named Asher, she takes him in so he can recover—but no good deed goes unpunished. As memories from her past life rush back to her, Delga realizes that Asher is destined to become a bloodthirsty killer. Between running the duchy and keeping her secret abilities in check, Delga has no patience for any of Asher’s mischievous schemes.

Can Delga find a way to stop him from going down the wrong path? Or will she be swallowed by his obsessive love?

(Source: Tapas)

Ju-In Jeon, a depressed 17-year-old, is offered a ticket to heaven in exchange for her body. But, 13 years later, she wakes up—not in paradise, but in her 30-year-old body… and in the middle of a scam. Stuck for 108 days while heaven's agent searches for the fraudster, Ju-In crosses paths with Do-Gwon Ju, another soul-scam victim in the same situation. But what happens when the souls who bought their bodies come back? Will they return to their miserable teenage lives, or find a way to reclaim their futures?

Editor's Note: This series contains themes and depictions of suicidal ideation that may be upsetting to some readers. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

General surgery resident Yoon Hae-Soo has always focused on paying off her father's debt and becoming a great surgeon. But after CEO Chae Ji-Seok enters the ER as a VIP patient, her world is completely turned upside down. Not only does he want her to be his only doctor, Ji-Seok wants to spend every second with her. Hae-Soo can't understand why a stranger would be so interested in her, but she also feels strangely attracted to him. Little does she know that this isn't their first time meeting...

(Source: Tapas)

Her appearance, it is a series of excitement and stimulation!

Dong-Ha, a repeat student, is stuck at home and wasting his days. Dong-Ha, who cannot stand it anymore, starts taking private lessons due to his parents' urging, and he finds out that the hired teacher is his first love from his childhood. And he starts to care about the beauty and heart of his first love, who is quite different from when he was young...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

In a world of secret benefactor and beneficiary relationships, the story of "Daddy-Long-Legs" continues with Andrea Yuriness stumbling upon a perplexing mystery. A serial killer is targeting young women, and the girls at Erta Academy are the most at risk! So she and her dormmates start a student-led investigation in order to protect all the girls on campus. But as someone with a secret benefactor herself, Andrea will soon realize that she has deeper ties to this case than she thought.

(Source: Tapas)
Note: Chapter count includes 10 side story chapters.

Despite his hard work, Lee Eunho finds himself laid off due to company downsizing. Before he can even consider what's next, ominous messages appear, claiming Earth has been bought out. Now, only survivors of life-or-death missions will make the cut, turning even friends into foes. As all hell breaks loose, humanity must decide between using one another to get ahead or working together as a team. Can Eunho survive Earth's sudden downsizing, or will the pressure to move up leave him in the dust?

(Source: Tapas)

The slave she thought was dead has returned—as a king. Now, he takes her as his concubine to destroy her kingdom and avenge his past.

"My love wounds him. His love condemns me."

(Source: Manta)

A ridiculous broadcast where they randomly assault weak students, “Loner Hunt.”

Hee-Jun, who enjoyed watching “Loner Hunt,” loses the person he cares most about to “Loner Hunt.” Furious, he teams up with his childhood friend and starts making a broadcast to fight against bullies...!

“Loner Hunt” is a refreshing revenge of bullies who burst their moon balloons!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Reborn as a villainess in a romance novel, Eudis Peregrine knows she’s destined to die at the hands of the tyrannical Emperor Theodore Waldemar. To avoid this cruel death, Eudis plans to stay far away. But after a drunken night at a masked ball, she wakes up in bed with none other than the emperor himself! Now, with the smitten Theodore proposing marriage, Eudis must navigate this unexpected plot twist. Can one night of romance change her predetermined fate, or is she bound to her tragic ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Min-Gyu, a pure-hearted man who has quietly loved his childhood friend Ji-Woo for longer than anyone else. Every time Ji-Woo laughs, grumbles, and approaches him nonchalantly, Min-Gyu's heart grows deeper little by little, but steadily. The problem is that the men Ji-Woo has been crazy about so far are always 'muscular beasts' who are the complete opposite of him. Fortunately, in reality, she has never given her heart to anyone, so Min-Gyu has stayed by her side, even if it means being her boyfriend. However, one peaceful autumn, his hopes are shattered.

"Min-Gyu... I think I've fallen in love."

Ji-Woo suddenly falls in love with Kang Tae-Min, the captain of the volleyball team! Min-Gyu feels the crisis of his life when he realizes that she might 'really' like someone for the first time. In order to protect Ji-Woo from Tae-Min, he tries to become the man that fits her ideal type...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: Only I Can Speak the Ancient Language of Magic

description:
Waking up in a fantasy novel set in an ancient magical world was confusing enough for Sisha. But on top of that, she happens to be the only person who could read and understand the old texts recovered from the secret library kept hidden for thousands of years… Furthermore, to Sisha's surprise, the ancient language of forbidden magic turned out to be none other than modern English! With the emperor now praising her ability to decipher the words of Alphabet, Sisha steps up from a mere sidekick to an incredible main lead--in a world where whatever she speaks in her mother tongue is a key to unlock the powerful magic.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Ten years ago, Yeon-Ju left Eun-Seong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Han-Byeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

(Source: WEBTOON)

On the day I struck it rich with crypto, I was suddenly transported into the game I had been playing the night before. To avoid the fate of being used and then killed by the villainess Cleora—a typical mid-game plotline—I betrayed her... only to be killed anyway.

But then, I returned to the day I first got possessed. This time, I gained a special ability: I can use the 2.2 billion won I made in real life as cash in the game’s shop. With a massive 2.2 billion won in cash to spend, can I survive to the end of the game this time?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Thirty years ago, Lynn embarked on a quest to destroy the Orb of Evil, but she was betrayed and sacrificed by her companions to seal the orb. Now, she has woken up in the body of a young girl, only to find out that she was framed as a traitor and is now remembered as such in history. To make matters worse, the child whose body she's borrowing appears to have been traumatized by years of abuse. Lynn is determined to set the record straight... But first, she'll avenge this little girl!

(Source: Tapas)

Gyeo-Ul has lucked into a marriage with a rich, handsome, and kind man. The catch? She has no idea how it happened. After an accident wipes out the past year of her memory, Gyeo-Ul finds herself living a life she doesn't recognize: Si-Hu Kang, her sworn enemy, is now her doting spouse, and he won't stop gushing over her.

“Wait, I have to share a bed with this guy? And kiss him, too?! Why does he keep saying he loves me?!”

Something about this marriage doesn’t add up.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Opportunity or crisis? U-Gyeong, as the new boss, is in charge of a team of incompetents. But worst of all is Gu Jeong-Ha, who has neither passion nor motivation. The only thing he knows how to do? Answer the phone! Will the new head of the brainteaser team be able to give work to the upstart who no-one dares to bother?

(Source: WEBTOONS, translated and edited)

Beom-Yun, a cursed prince, weds Chung-Hui, a lame, twice-wed woman used as a living talisman. The jaded prince finds himself consumed by love for this princess, who is nothing more than a pawn in a scramble for power. To protect her, he’ll seize the throne and drown the world in vengeance.

(Source: Manta, edited)

To protect her dual job, Ha-ru finds herself having to go out with Woo-hyeon, whom she's already dumped four times. He's handsome, rich, and works at the same company as her. This encounter will revive memories of a past that only he seems to know.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Deviless's Impression of a Princess

description:
How to catch a knight? Impersonate a princess! Lilith the Demon Queen longs to meet a knight like the ones she reads about in books. In order to lure one to her castle, she kidnaps a princess and waits. Much to her delight, the knight who shows up is exactly as she pictured him! She decides to disguise herself as the princess to capture his heart...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Our High School Music Genius is Paganini's Reincarnate

description:
They called him the Devil’s Violinist in another life, but now he’s just a student trying to blend in. As a reincarnation of Paganini, Juwon has spent years suppressing his extraordinary talent to live as an ordinary teenager. But when a twist of fate lands him in an arts high school, his silent strings begin to scream for attention. Surrounded by rivals and expectations, the genius who was once forced into silence must decide if he is ready to reclaim his throne. The legend has returned, and the world isn't ready for his encore.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yura is a huge fan of Jihyuk's live stream where he tries to survive in an apocalyptic game world, spending every last penny she has to buy him items. However, one day, she finds herself unexpectedly pulled into the game and actually meets Jihyuk! Despite having no skills or experience, Yura assists Jihyuk by purchasing items with her phone. Meanwhile, Jihyuk, who used to be a lone fighter, begins to enjoy Yura's company. Can they navigate this collapsing world together and make it out alive?

(Source: Tapas)

Hong Heejoo is a sign language interpreter who has become mute due to severe depression. She and her husband never exchanged a single conversation for the three years of their arranged marriage. One day, her life takes a harrowing turn when she's taken hostage. "Don't hang up! This isn't a phishing call...!" However, her husband, who was even worse than a stranger, coldly disconnected the call. "Call me when a body is found."

Enraged, Heejoo decides to strike back. She'll threaten her husband anonymously, no matter the cost. But there's a twist: her target is the notorious Blue House spokesperson, a man known for his biting sarcasm.

As the threats escalate, Heejoo begins to question her own sanity. Is this really the same man she married? And why does this twisted game feel so strangely exhilarating?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Blessed be the devout who remain chaste among the tainted. A pious young debutante of the Kingdom of Brandt, Elke Eberhardt prays each day as she vies for the sacred title of Pontifex, which grants authority over the nation’s faith. Unfortunately for Elke, fate has other, crueler plans—as she catches the eye of Sir Reiner Mikhel, a notorious womanizer who has seduced countless noblewomen in Brandt. Despite her firm resolve to remain virtuous, Elke finds herself increasingly drawn to the temptations of this dark, ambitious nobleman, whose seductive gaze conceals his true intentions.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: A Flower Blooms on the Wall

description:
“Of course I recognized you. You’re my first love.”

Living a life of being stalked by her first love, Dam Do is visited by her brother’s friend Yun Oh. No longer the boy next door who used to follow her around like a puppy, Yun is now a man, and he acts strangely aloof around her. While Dam has found herself resenting her first love, Yun is secretly quite excited to be around his first love once again. As the two become reacquainted after their time apart, they may be in for a lesson on what love really is.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Chosim Ireun Idol-eul Wihan Hoegwi Baekseo
title.native: 초심 잃은 아이돌을 위한 회귀 백서

description:
K-pop idol Yoon Eden has wasted away for years under a mediocre label with an incompetent CEO. He is disillusioned and on the verge of quitting when he's sent back in time to the day of his debut. Now, Eden is determined to use his songwriting talent to rewrite his career and gain some well-deserved fame. Despite his CEO still pushing cheesy songs and tacky concepts, can Eden, with the help of his group members, truly reignite his spark and become a sincerely dazzling idol?

(Source: Tapas)

A reader is magically transported into a BL novel called The Night of Hwangseong. She now inhabits the body of Lobelia Flore, the daughter of a noble family suffering from a rare illness. Lobelia discovers that the only way to avoid a painful death is to remain in close physical contact with Edric Dencart, the young, beautiful, and sickly duke. To do this, Lobelia disguises herself as a man named “Lobel” and commits herself to becoming the Duke of Dencart’s most trusted manservant.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

A cute guy with an angelic face? Check. A cold and aloof outsider with a cat? Check. A class full of vampires? Check... Wait, what? All her life, Seon-Ha Shin has lived in the shadow of her sister, Seong-Hye, who is one year older than her. Luckily, there is one thing Seon-Ha does better than her sister -- donating blood! When Seon-Ha gets special admission into a prestigious university as a blood donor, she finally starts to feel like the main character of her life. Little did she know she'd be surrounded by vampires!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: Youngest Daughter of the Ultimate Martial Master Namgung Family

description:
Hui-Ran used to be the disgrace of House Namgung, shunned by all, including her siblings. But after political intrigue destroys her family, Hui-Ran dies trying to avenge them. All seems lost until she reawakens in the past... as an adorable baby! But how can she help anyone in a baby’s body? And why are her siblings being so nice to her? Time has been reset—using her knowledge of the future, Hui-Ran must rewrite history and thwart the sinister dissidents who seek Namgung’s downfall.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Killed for being an elementalist but brought back by the Spirit of Death, Azelda Madison is determined to survive her second chance at life. After relentless training, she meets her betrothed, Duke Shade Karloss, and fights by his side as a mercenary for five years while hiding her true identity. Unwilling to repeat the loveless marriage of her past, Azelda proposes a contract marriage with the duke. But as she gradually uncovers a hidden side to Shade, can she continue to abide by its terms?

(Source: Tapas)

Loving yourself is never easy.

There are countless ways to diet. So why are there no ways to quit? An intimate, cheerful tale of growth about a woman who has long struggled with body image issues and eating disorders.

(Source: Manta)

I could kill you if I wanted.

Hale Windsor was a renowned hitman until he is betrayed and loses the love of his life. With nothing left to live for, he begins a war of revenge on the very organization he used to work for. That is, until he meets Marine, a girl who brings color back into his black and white existence.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Became a Childhood Friend of the Obsessive Sub Male Lead

description:
Born with memories of the novel How to Survive as an Ordinary Lady, Princess Rietta Lise is next in line for the throne of the Kingdom of Lise. But after being sold to the empire by her father, a king who lives in luxury and pleasure, she enters the ducal Mayer estate. Upon realizing that Noel, the duke’s second son, is the sub-male lead of the novel, she’ll try to repay the dukedom’s favor by making him the real male protagonist!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Was Just Taking Care of My Sick Father

description:
Evrielle Solgren is devastated by the death of her father. Living in the capital with her tutor, she didn’t even get to see him one last time before the north was sieged by monsters from beyond The Curtain. It was almost too much for a 14-year-old to bear...before she was killed and woke up in her five-year-old body. Now that she has been given this opportunity, Eve will do everything in her power to save her beloved father and stop The Northern Curtain from falling.

(Source: Tapas)

After transmigrating into the body of a terminally ill villainess, Ibellin decides to find a peaceful life and a happy ending instead. Rather than selling off the main villain, Raven, to get the expensive medicine needed to treat her illness, Ibellin decides to heal the boy and then quickly send him on his way. But when Raven's father comes to seek her out, Ibellin is given a choice she's never imagined before. Will she accept it, or will she decline in hopes of finding happiness elsewhere?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: No, I Only Charmed the Princess!

description:
As if dying from overwork doesn’t suck enough, imagine being reincarnated as a minor novel character who will also meet a pitiful end soon. With nothing to lose, Adelia makes the perilous journey to become the empire’s first white mage in 300 years. Why? To have the crown prince marry her so she can have the power to get revenge on her abusive family, of course! And once she becomes a member of the imperial family, Adelia can live happily receiving the love of her favorite character, Princess Ariana. But wait, she never asked for Crown Prince Lucian’s affection too...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Castle: Keeper of the Sacred Eye

description:
In modern-day Korea, the Imperial Family holds a secret duty of exorcizing "Imae,'' creatures that lurk within paintings to feed on the grief of humans. But such beings can only be detected by people like Jo Yu-Yeon who possess the Sacred Eye. Despite knowing that Crown Prince Geon needs her special vision, Yu-Yeon gets caught up in a deceptive marriage plan to make it seem like another woman has her ability instead. But no secret can be kept forever. What will become of Yu-Yeon once it's revealed that she is the keeper Geon has always been looking for?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes seven side story chapters.

title.english: Mistaken as the Monster Duke's Wife

description:
When Lia Dellis comes across a dying man in need of help, she never could have imagined a curse would drive him to attack her. That's why she hits him over the head with a rock! Feeling guilty, Lia nurses him back to health only to realize that he's Dillian Synaize, the ruthless monster duke. To make matters worse, Dillian has lost all his memories and inexplicably thinks Lia is his wife. Can Lia escape the grasp of this so-called monster before he remembers that she was the one who hit him?

(Source: Tapas)

In a time when frozen humans are thawed, Dongwon, a twenty-nine-year-old baseball failure, welcomes his nine-year-old brother who has just woken up. He wants Hyungwon, who has the same face, to go down a different path, but nine-year-old Hyungwon's dream is still to be Hanyang's fourth batter. Dongwon wants to make his brother give up his dream without hurting him, and Hyungwon is just happy playing baseball with Dongwon. Can this dream-like relationship last?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Keeping My Boss on a Tight Leash

description:
Tangled up in some hairy business.

Office worker Nahee is working late when she gets caught in the crossfire between her boss and a would-be assassin. She's dragged into the secret world of human-animal shapeshifters, and it turns out her boss imprinted on her?! The two can't stand being together but can no longer bear being apart!

(Source: Manta)

The tale of Princess Ines is a tragic one. Born a royal of the Zener Empire, she is reviled and neglected as a child born out of wedlock. To compound her misfortune, Ines is married off to Grand Duke Ryan of Eleanor, a renowned war hero of the Lezan Empire who fought against Zener. Ryan proves a stern and distant husband to Ines, and she soon determines that she must fight for a life of dignity – if not in Eleanor, then elsewhere. Thus begins a marriage of emotional reserve and regrets…

(Source: WEBTOONS)

From archenemies to fictional lovers!

Tae-Yeon is horrified when she finds herself co-teaching an after-school writing class with her college nemesis, Yong-Jin. Little does she realize that the worst is yet to come. They're in for a wild ride when they get sucked into a novel written by 8-year-olds, where absurdity becomes reality!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: No Retaliation from the Supporting Cast

description:
After being transported into a novel she read, Agrain tries to live a quiet life as a side character maid. But that changes when the novel’s timeline is suddenly altered and she finds herself working directly for the terrifying Duke Ingord. Agrain knows that the only way she can survive now is to do anything he asks...but what exactly does he want from her?

(Source: Tapas)

What could make a romance fantasy superfan happier than getting pulled into a fantasy world? But Daline Este’s dreams of being the protagonist in her story come crashing down when reality sinks in. She hasn’t been pulled into one of her favorite novels like she dreamed—instead, she's landed in a world on the cusp of crisis as several novels tangle together and threaten to tear it apart. Now, Daline must use her expertise to set the stories straight before her happy ending goes up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Tried to Live an Honest Life

description:
Grandma said that good things come to those who live honestly, but my life ended in some car accident. Luckily, I was given a second chance to live an upright life! And so I found myself in the body of Everdeen Usher, a woman who fled home to avoid marrying into a ducal house. Wait, I’m a noble?! Oh crap, my fiancé’s older brother is demanding I pay back the dowry my useless father took! With all the odds against me, can I live an honest life and reach a different ending this time?

(Source: Tapas)

I am the icon of absolute power, master of all, the ultimate necromancer king who controls death: Lord Karnak. But what’s the point of a life like this when I’m nothing but bones? Enjoying a gentle breeze, warm sunlight, human warmth, or even a decent meal are all out of the question! My loyal servant Baroth and I have tried vampirism and spiritual possession, but neither worked on ultimate transcendental beings like us. So perhaps being human again is the answer! Surely nothing will go wrong…

(Source: Tapas)

Sell me! I'll be the most expensive lady to obtain. While scheming to get out of an arranged marriage, Cesare runs into Adele, a shoeshine girl from the slums. The two make a 3-month deal to help Cesare elude marriage. However, Adele is so different from the women he's met before that he can't help but be drawn to her.

(Source: Manta)

Hui-Do is going through a tough high school life. She enjoys reading webtoons in her spare time and dreaming of living like a character. Then one day, she finds herself in a real webtoon. She has to complete a mission in the webtoon and get a reward in order to save her deceased mother... Will Hui-Do succeed?

(Source: Naver, translated)

“I will take care of you. I will do my best until you are happy.”

I was planning to find an investment company to expand my business, but the proposal sent to me and Jin Yi-young included information about 'contractual marriage'. The opponent is Koo Gyo-Heon, who is known for being an asshole. But it's not that bad of a deal. I thought they would just live as a show window couple, but this man. He keeps approaching me. Weren't we married by contract?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: From Acting Genius to Top Idol!

description:
Baek Hyeon sacrificed everything to become the best actor in the industry. So when he's about to die in a plane crash, he makes a desperate wish for another chance to live. Hyeon's plea is granted, but who said anything in life was free? Reborn as his younger self, Hyeon must first become a successful K-pop idol if he wants to be an actor again. Can Hyeon make it in the cutthroat world of fierce competition, demanding schedules, and fake smiles? Or will he fail and lose his second shot at fame?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Roel Linthea is a timid, fragile girl who has been mistreated by her adoptive family. She's shocked and worried when she's sent away to marry Asran Hycariel, the son of a powerful yet infamously cruel ducal family. But to her surprise, she soon learns that none of the rumors are true, and everyone there is nothing but kind. And strangely, Asran seems to have known her since a long time ago... Will Roel be able to find happiness with her loving in-laws, or will the past come back to haunt her?

(Source : Tapas)

The warrior Erquanna wakes in a casket and hears people making light of her death. When she shocks them by opening her eyes, she realizes she’s now in the frail body of Erne de Medina, a well-known dimwit from the empire. Erne made a deal with a demon (and died in the process) that Erquanna must now fulfill. She must fall in love with one of the three strongest men in the empire—and have them fall in love with her—before her time is up and her soul is taken as payment.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Strange Tales from the Moonlit House

description:
Following a tragic accident at age 7, high schooler Yu Dan has been able to see the supernatural with his divine eye. When he finds himself haunted by an ancient being called a misfortune anomaly, Dan is led to the Moonlit House. There, he meets fox spirit Master Baek, who says the only way to avoid misfortune is to transfer it to someone else. Dan is adamant to find another path, but can he banish the calamity in time before it pulls him further into this peculiar world of dangers and spirits?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: A Fairy-Tale Ending for a Fake

description:
Adopted into a ducal family, Odette Grizelle is merely a “fake” daughter, a stand-in for the duke’s long-lost real daughter. Bullied by her brothers and looked down on by the maids, life isn’t easy for Odette. So when the duke’s real daughter Beri is found, Odette thinks it's finally time to make her exit. But surprisingly, Beri is thrilled to have her as a sister, and Odette now sees she has more supporters than she thought. With their help, can this fake find a real-life fairy-tale ending?

(Source: Tapas)

Ahn Nok-Hui, who lived an ordinary life, turns out to have lucky super-powers?! Somehow, she ended up becoming the top student in a school filled with the super-powered students... See how Ahn Nok-Hui struggles to remain ordinary in an extraordinary high school.

(Souce: Naver, translated)

Roelle Chloe has never been able to feel emotions. Even during her past life, living as an outcast in the back alleys of the capital, the empire's most hated mage didn't shed a single tear. And dying at the hands of her father didn't improve her inability to feel empathy. But after being given a second chance at life after death, Roelle realizes that she might be able to use her magical gifts to change her bitter fate. From friendship to romance, and even family... Can Roelle use her blood magic for good while learning to love and be loved?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Villain Fiancé is in My Way of Happiness

description:
Thisbe was tired of being the Saintess of Prophecy from day one. Years after being reincarnated into a novel, she navigates a new timeline where, instead of being a murderous has-been Saintess, she chooses peace. And yet she somehow still ends up framed for murder--by her own fiancé, no less! Determined to prove her innocence, gain her freedom, navigate her love life (and maybe help save the world in the process), Thisbe will clear her name not as a Saintess, but as the main character!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Daughter of a deposed baron, Becky is sold by her father to the Archduchess Vernum. Arriving at her new masters, she becomes friends with Princess Liande, as beautiful as she is surly. But as the two young women grow inexorably closer, a question from Liande will cause trouble for Becky: “What would you say, if I were a man?”

(Source: WEBTOON, translated)

Does she have a screw loose?

In a dystopian era where people are divided by rank, Future High is the only chance to change your life. The wild freshman valedictorian I-Peul Cheon causes chaos within the school and brings about small yet meaningful changes when fleeting moments of brilliance intersect with harsh reality.

(Source: Manta, edited)

As a member of the HN Group's secretary pool, Seo Yu-Jin prides herself on being able to handle all sorts of difficult situations. One day, the company president himself gives Yu-Jin a new assignment, to become the personal assistant for Jin Tae-Oh, the president's younger brother. Yu-Jin doesn't know anything about the third-son of the Jin family, but she has a bad feeling about this…

"It won't be a hard job. Just keep him out of trouble."

Yu-Jin should've ran away when she heard those words, but the president offered her too much money to refuse! When she meets him at the airport, her first impression of him seems good… so they say he's like a wild beast? Now it's up to her to tame that wild, ruthless, but loyal animal!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

An unknown actress's life is ruined when she wakes up as Cha Yeryeon, the villainess of a daytime drama. Determined to avoid an antagonist's fate, Yeryeon works to nudge the story toward a different ending. But as her actions threaten to upend the lives of other characters, Yeryeon has to figure out how to get her satisfying story while also protecting the people she cares for. Will Yeryeon flip the script and change the drama for the better? Or will she be stuck playing the bad guy forever?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: We Got Ourselves Stuck Inside an Adult Fantasy Novel

description:
There’s only so much one can take of her friend squealing over yet another cliché romance fantasy novel. But the biggest cliché of all happens when Jiwon and Yein reincarnate with Sihyeon in the exact story their friend is so obsessed with! Though God has summoned them to this new world to save it from impending doom, the three women have other plans. Jiwon wishes to rebel against the imperial palace, Sihyeon gets romantically tied up with the crown prince, and Yein is busy literally tying up her new submissive boy toy…

(Source: Tappytoon)

The filthy gaze of my perverted boss crawls over me like he's defiling my whole body. My pent-up lust was overflowing enough to soak through from just a stare like that. This reckless escape to quench my thirst... Slowly, deeply, it dragged me into depravity.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Princess Siana quietly endured her parents' abuse for years, but when Crown Prince Rashid of the nearby empire conquers her kingdom and kills her entire family, she refuses to die without standing up for herself. Siana begs for her life, and Rashid allows her to be a maid at the palace, where she thrives in her simple life of service... until that new life is threatened by Rashid's interest in her. Can Siana finally enjoy the peace she deserves, or will Rashid's fascination disrupt it all?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: There's a Mouse in My House

description:
Let me warm you up tonight.

On a cold winter night, Hyeon-Su finds a stranger named Ji-Hyo injured and huddled just outside her home. When she kindly takes him in, he wishes to return the favor. Will they find comfort in the warmth of their intimate embrace, or will Ji-Hyo's past be too much to bear?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Long straight hair, a white dress, his first love—these three words linger faintly in Baek-gu's mind as he promptly passes out. When a mysterious woman appears at his doorstep amidst a pouring rainstorm, Baek-gu is shocked to his core. Not because she faintly reminds him of someone he knew long, long ago, but because he mistakes her for a ghost.
