There she meets a doctor by the name of Baek Kangwoo who has everything in his favor yet wants to give up his training. This is a love story blossoming in the emergency room where Chaerin struggles with her daily work and her love for Kangwoo.

title.english: The World is Money and Power

description:
Geon-U Dan has vowed to overthrow the status quo of the dysfunctional high school he recently transferred to, where rich and powerful third-generation chaebol heirs call the shots and gambling runs rampant. But does Geon-U have what it takes to beat the odds, defeat the Taekyeong Oh Family, and restore law and order to his high school?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Notes:
- Includes one extra chapter.
- Belongs to Blue String universe.

The royal palace is no place for fun and games—here, only the most cunning and powerful survive. After Soon-ock becomes queen consort thanks to the machinations of her scheming father and his allies, she finds herself in the middle of a bloody fight between the king and the crown prince. Despite her precarious position, Soon-ock is determined to survive and will do anything to ensure the safety of herself and her lover, Hyang-yi. She soon makes a deal that could either make her life heaven or hell. The only catch? Part of the plan involves using her beloved Hyang-yi. A gripping tale of conspiracy, lust, and desire set in the royal court of medieval Korea.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: An adaptation of the 2016 novel of the same name by Eun-Mi Hyeon.

From a thieving child to one who would shake the world. Rising to the title of Immortal Master, one of the Godly Twelve Stars, but ultimately betrayed. Now, he has been given a chance to change that, and create a better future- for both him, and the world. Based on the popular novel of the same name.

Miha has always felt like an outsider, even within his own family. Sohwa takes full advantage of that, forcing him to do his biddings. However, an incident takes place that helps Miha and Sohwa to reflect and figure out what they are feeling for each other.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

After losing all hope of finding love, Ha-eun doesn't see the point of carrying on...until one day, a mysterious being saves her life and promises to make her irresistible to any man. Its method is unorthodox to say the least, but it sure makes her feel good. 2nd Lezhin Comics Big Comic Contest Prize Winner.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The weather forecast didn't say it was going to rain but Lee Mokhwa knew it would, that's only one of the things he knew was going to happen. No, he can't see the future, he's actually stuck in a time loop, reliving December 24th endlessly. The only person besides himself who seems to be aware of the repeated time is Choi Gyun, the childhood friend he drifted apart from, but he's avoiding the topic. Gyun must know something he doesn't, he could even be the cause of the time loop, Mokhwa is determined to make him break the chain.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Her blood runs hot, and her temper is even hotter – even when it’s the cold of winter. To lift the flaming curse she’s carried since she was a little girl, high schooler Ember must find her cold equivalent… But finding a match whose blood runs as cold as her’s does hot isn’t going to be easy, especially when the only way to turn the powerful curse away is to KISS that person right on their frigid lips. High school dramas usually run hot-and-cold, but there’s never been a story as fun and fiery as Scorching Romance!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Marriage is not on her agenda! When a two-time mixed martial arts champion dies and wakes up in the body of the petite Lady Grace Rambler, she quickly decides to make the best of things -- to attract a so-called “unicorn man,” the rare kind of gentleman who’s modest, exciting, and handsome! But her dreams are crushed when she finds out Grace is set to marry Duke Aston Blade, a perverted and ugly old geezer… Or is he?! Not willing to risk it, she rejects the marriage and sticks to her guns. It’s either a unicorn man or bust!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Areum falls into the strange world Soltera after a car accident.There, she is mistaken for a vampire and gets sold to a duke's house by a slave trader. The master of the house that bought her is lord Millard, the one and only vampire in the world! Desperate to survive in any way, Areum becomes lord Millard's direct servant vowing to serve him as her master. When Areum tries to grow closer to lord Millard day by day, his attitude towards her starts changing all of a sudden...

(Source: NetComics)

After learning that her younger sister sacrificed herself for her, Shin-Joo dies in an accident after saving a child that reminded her of her sibling. She wishes that if there is a god, may he give her a life that she can spend for her younger sister, and her prayers are seemingly answered, she is resurrected as the Pope by the name of “Charles Hildegarde!” But before she even realizes what's happening, she is kissed by a man.

(Source: Copin Comics)

Yeo-ul has pop star-like looks but that hasn’t stopped him from being misunderstood his whole life. And with the school year finishing up, this summer break could be a lonely one. That is until one night a street cat follows Yeo-ul home. This persistent little guy won’t take no for an answer so Yeo-ul decides to take him in, adamant that it’ll be for one night only. However, after one little smooch, this kitty turns into a really buff - and really naked! - man. For Tater, the white cat, finding Yeo-ul is anything but a coincidence. And once Yeo-ul agrees to take care of him, this is his chance to pounce! But it turns out, being human isn’t as easy as it seems…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yiyoung is building a startup with his college friends. They get a chance to present their proposal to SJ Corporation, one of the leading companies in the country. But in the meeting room he sees Kang Daehyung, the extremely handsome company big shot that's so very much his type, and Yiyoung's heart starts to race...!

Can pretty-faced Yiyoung win both in love and his career?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seorim was working at a laboratory as a scientist, but…it turns out he’s not especially good at following directions. After exploding some very expensive equipment, his boss gives him the chance to make amends (read: pay him back) by working as a spy in a competitor’s lab. It’s a dream come true! Professor Gong is renowned as a genius innovator and he’s just hired Seorim to work in his lab. Part of his job is testing new products, but just what he’ll be testing in Professor Gong’s lab may be more surprising than the fact that he was hired at all.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Spin off of BL ‘The Voice Next Door’ - After meeting in college, Yoonsung’s sultry voice is what brought us together. Sure, being a long-time couple can get dull, but cheating on me?! It’s over and I’m out, moved to a new apartment. So why is my mortal enemy living downstrairs?!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kang Ji-hoon, an ordinary high school student who died in a painful accident, finds out in the underworld that he is actually a Water Spirit King mistakenly born as a human.

“Making water spirits? How do you do that?”

The adventures of Elqueeness, the Water Spirit King who was mistakenly born as a human!
The repeat test-taker Ha Beo-Deul becomes a shaman and meets the foul tempered lesser dragon, Gwangcheoli.

The top dog of Busan is moving to Seoul. Will he be able to take over the new city?

(Source: Toomics)

Oh no... my ex-boyfriend lives next door?! Excited to start a new chapter in her life as an adult, Hye-Jin gets caught off guard when she finds out that her first love Hae-Jun -- whom she dumped five years ago -- is her new next door neighbor and fellow classmate at the same university! Still dazed and confused about love and dating, will Hye-Jin learn how to navigate her relationships with certainty and confidence and not get sidetracked by what others think?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Jaime is looking for someone serious. Not like those cheap girls. Someone like his neighbor...

(Source: Toomics)

Despite cooking up mouth-watering entrées as a master chef, Kijun is still a vampire that thirsts for human blood. Lucky for him, the young girl who was his “first bite” has stumbled into his restaurant, and into his trap! Finally after 25 years Miro will be his to enjoy once again, but… her blood tastes terrible! What has she been eating?! Time for Chef Hong to put his culinary skills to good use: to lavish her with delicacies and prepare a most succulent meal for himself!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Cat hybrid Myunggu is sick of the lack of affection he doesn’t receive from his owner, Kyung, compared to the other pets in the neighborhood. When his recent attempt to kill himself ends in failure, he runs into the local dog that offers a way out of his current household, but is that really what Myunggu wants...?

«Hyung is pretty.»
Even after being warned not to, Hong Seo Woo, overdoes it and gets drunk at his club’s welcoming party. The next day, he wakes up in the clubroom and realizes that not only did he miss his morning class, but while he was asleep...he’s been holding hands with a stranger, who also happens to be a man — one of the club’s new recruits and Seo Woo’s junior, Baek Do Hyeon. Drawn into joining the club after seeing him, Do Hyeon plans on gaining Seo Woo’s affections, even if it is proving to be quite the challenge.

Sweet, adorable Narae. The girl next door that everyone loves! Except, she has just one little secret- she fantasizes about having sex with anyone and everyone! Men, women, BDSM, toys, you name it, it’s in there. Nothing is off limits for Narae. Now these fantasies are starting to get out of control and affect her dating (and social) life. With help from the mysterious shamaness Nokjoo and the influential Miss Miso, Narae will find a way to make these fantasies a reality and finally get herself a boyfriend.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, a devil appears to a student and proposes a game. She tempts him with one wish if he wins. But if he loses, she takes his soul. He begins a dangerous game with the dreaming devil in his desperation to save his sleeping sister.

Cha Jinwoo coincidentally met Oh Yoosung, a class friend of his little sister he went to pick up after she finished her SAT and he, his work. Jin Woo got into a car accident after dropping off his sister and giving a ride to Yoosung. After the accident, Jinwoo realises that he is somehow connected to Yoosung from his previous lives.

Nam Joo Won is a high school teacher with a phobia of students. On the first day of classes, Joo Won runs to the faculty bathroom to find shelter from his students but encounters the class delinquent, Lee Tae Gyum. Why won't this kid leave him alone?

Jae-Sin sees dead people, and Officer Han can sniff out evil. Literally. Their search for a missing friend leads them and professional stuntwoman Yu-Hyeon into a tangled web of vile cover-ups and twisted violence. Can they handle the overpowering stench of evil?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

“Please keep in mind. This shop is not responsible for any harm caused by the electronic device.”

A mystery horror about the strange electronics shop owner, ‘Yak’.

Ancient Egypt: to be able to reign in a world where women are nothing, she stole the identity of her brother, the prince. With such a lie, to reign or to love, it will be necessary to decide! When his tutor arrives in his life, the meeting is electric. He has a big advantage: he comes from the future and knows the whole history of the kingdom perfectly!

(Source: Delitoon, translated)

Notes: Includes one extra chapter.

Gem Makina, a senior student in the light of the day, is actually an illegal maker of love potions when hid under the veil of obscurity. One day, she discovers an unnamed book in the forbidden section of the library. As Gem experiments with a recipe for a "genuine" love potion, it turns out that what she created was not a love potion, but a fairy of love!

"The love potion is an interconnected string of chains in the galaxy, people always tend to have a suitable match for themselves."

A year later, Gem Makina, who has become a well known matchmaker and pharmacist in the royal palace, is commissioned by the King of Eurare to find a suitable match for the youngest prince, Capere. But there's a big problem with this handsome man. It's even more serious than being weak, fickle, and cheap...

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
Damwoon's sudden allergy to chlorine forces him to give up his swimming career, but when he develops an allergy to his best friend Haesoo, will he be able to give him up too?

For Yeonsu, writing is all there is to life. Her workaholic tendencies prevent her from properly eating, sleeping, exercising…until one day, she wakes up and finds herself in a hospital room. A clear warning from the doctor about her physical health and a desperation to come up with the plot of her next story forces Yeonsu to seek the help of Gyeol, a fellow patient. Falling in love with an athletic stranger may seem like the stuff of romance novels, but reality can often be crazier than fiction…

(Source: Lezhin US)

First. First lie, first kiss, first love. When Henry and Sam first met that summer long ago, Henry learned the power of first love. But…time goes on, people part, summer ends and so too did their blink of a relationship. All but a distant memory now, when Henry and Sam gradually become close again, Henry finds himself feeling those fiery emotions for the first time since that wistful summer.

(Source: Tapas)

For nine years, I have always been in first place throughout the entire school. I thought that once I entered high school, everything would stay the same. But, someone had actually taken my spot in first place! Unwilling to give up my spot, I switched up my appearance to make my rival fall into my love trap!

Cursed by God to live out nine wretched lifetimes as a human on Earth, Valentine has finally reached the ninth and final chapter of this long punishment. Reborn as a penniless kid living on the streets, "Lucien" must find a way to survive... But it seems even with eight lives' worth of experience, there are still mistakes to be made! In a tumultuous twist of destiny, could this miserable life lead to... a forbidden romance?

(Source: Tappytoon)

“Today, we die.” Four young women have gathered at a guesthouse to commit group suicide. Equipped with strong rope, a playlist, and apathy for life, Yeon and her friends seem to have a foolproof plan. Yet when they finally meet Death, Death rejects them and takes away their right to self-extermination. They may regain that right under one condition: they must retrieve someone who escaped Death at the same guesthouse years ago. The thing is, that person now lives in a prison.

(Source: Lezhin Comics)

title.romaji: Hwangjeneun Yeogi Iss-eo Gisaneun Toegeunhal Geoya
title.native: 황제는 여기 있어 기사는 퇴근할 거야

description:
"Sir Leon, please guard my bedside tonight."
"Give me a bonus. I'll just leave if you don't."

The guard leader Leon, who appreciates a good work-life balance, and Emperor Oso, who wants to spend all his time with Leon. Will these two ever escape their current employer-employee relationship?

"When you open your eyes in this world once more, you will fall in love with the human who possesses the other half of your heart."

The story of the sealed vampire who finally meets his destined partner!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Season 1 finished on April 2020 with 23 chapters and a prologue.

Kyu-Ho Je wants out. Hot, rich, and with a plan, he’s looking to get out of his family’s multinational mega corporation because, seriously, business is boring. He’ll need help to make more money quick - savvy money launderer Kang-Ha Nam (codename: Smurf) is perfect for the job! But it’s not easy keeping Kang-Ha close with paparazzi and family constantly on watch, and Kyu-Ho will need more than kidnapping and contracts to keep him in his grasp. Will he get more (and want more) than he bargained for?

(Source: Tapas)

The life of a K-pop star is a hard one, especially if you’re Choi Yuwon. Not only does he have to keep up with the grueling lifestyle of an idol, but he also needs to keep a vigilant eye on the troublemaker of INSECRET, Park Dojin. Dojin acts how he pleases, and Yuwon is the only person in the group who can keep him out of trouble. This arrangement seems to work just fine for the both of them, until one day, Dojin makes a fateful mistake…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 30 side stories and 2 Christmas special chapters.

Haejin is a buttoned-up office worker whose marriage is going stale. However, sparks are flying at the office: his boss and an attractive coworker have a secret bond, and Haejin himself keeps running into a cute intern. One day, Haejin discovers an anonymous 18+ advice forum where someone alludes to having a crush on him. Will he stay his usual path, or try taking the emergency stairs for once?

(Source: Lezhin US)

After being beaten up by bullies, high school senior Yi-Yeon Kang wakes up from a coma, only to find the world in ruins from an alien invasion. The streets around him are littered and empty, with bullies out looking for their next prey. As he navigates this new world, despite being too weak, he is determined to find and save his friend Young-Lin. Between bullies, aliens and this post-apocalyptic reality, he'll do all he can to survive... and to bring down those out to get him.

(Source: Tapas)

Chanbit Han: award winning actor, trendsetter, and all-around nice guy…at least on the surface. As his manager and best friend, Baekyung knows the real Chanbit. Sure, he’s kind and gentle but, in the bedroom, he’s anything but. When Chanbit was starting his career, he fell in love with Youngha Do, entrepreneur and Chanbit’s guide into the depths of BDSM. Now Youngha’s back and is the CEO of Chanbit’s entertainment agency. Torn between Youngha and Baekyung, will he follow his heart or his career?

(Source: Tapas)

No one wants to die a virgin, but for one poor girl, that’s exactly what happened. Now she’s stuck roaming the world as a sexy succubus, looking for a nice young virgin to ravish. And Song U-Rim, a handsome yet chaste college student, fits the bill perfectly. Let the seduction begin!

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

Once a promising announcer, Jaewoo is caught defending his beliefs and is reduced to a news junkie. Announcer Kang So-Yoon is Jaewoo's girlfriend and the goddess of the broadcasting company. She's Jaewoo's only hope to take back his previous job. Meanwhile, Park Won-Bin is trying to covet So-Yoon, threatening to expose her romantic relationship with Jaewoo.

Ayne le Poregrin has three "trophies" in her collection of men: a reluctant fiancé held hostage by his debts, a fickle assassin paid to be her lover, and a soulless pet dog won at a slave auction. But to suddenly wake up one day as this femme fatale is the worst possible surprise. As the villainess of the novel "The Fairy Garden," the new "Ayne" is fated to die a painful death at the hands of her very own trophies! To sidestep her grim future, she knows she'll need to break up with all three. As soon as she tries to say goodbye, however, each man becomes attached and won't leave her alone! Can Ayne turn their affections towards the story's heroine and save her own life in the process?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Sanghwa is a shy introvert with a longtime crush on his handsome friend Ryeohan, but then again, EVERYONE likes him. Feeling like he can’t compete for Ryeohan’s affections, Sanghwa dives into The Legend of Saga, an online game where he plays as “idealize.” He befriends “thegreatmirae,” a cute healer who clearly has a soft spot for Sangwha… and who just so happens to be a real-life gangster. Could this tough guy be the ideal lover Sanghwa’s been looking for after striking out in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

Even after fulfilling her dreams of becoming a magazine editor and living in Seoul, Go Su-A can't seem to shake the feeling that something is still missing. When a difficult day at work and an argument with her mother drives her to get a tattoo, Su-A bumps into the last person she expected to see: her first love, Baek Hu-Beom. This encounter rekindles old feelings and sparks questions about what happened between them nine years ago, but will Su-A be able to muster up the courage to ask them?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: Death Candle: The Hand of Death

description:
Please, help me die!

Sick of living, Mimi has tried numerous times to take her own life. Much to her dismay, she somehow always ends up surviving. But then she comes across a website called "Death Candle" and ends up signing a contract with a demon of death: if Mimi helps him collect souls, he'll help her die.

(Source: Manta)

Myeong-In, a student at a third-rate university, doesn't get much support or respect at home. But his true identity is a professional online gamer who is famous and rich, a star gamer nicknamed "God of Game".

Suddenly, three beauties intrude into his double-identity life. And Myeong-In learns a shocking truth from them: the elites of society play something called "Game of Gods". If you win, you receive superhuman abilities and powers, and you can basically rule the real world!
My first ever love disappeared 13 years ago... and came back as a vampire.

Guys like Woojin have it all: the looks, personality, and background to be popular. There’s no way Woojin would take interest in a nobody like Yunwoo, but Yunwoo ends up falling for Woojin and telling him how he feels. To Yunwoo's surprise, Woojin responds to the outburst with a risky suggestion of his own. Yunwoo can’t seem to say no to Woojin, but how long can they last?

(Source: Lezhin)

"Dokebi Cafe: Sacred Grounds for Those Who Wait!"

Gang-Eun has a recurring dream, in which she dies in the arms of a man on a battlefield. Somehow, misfortune seems to surround her when she has that dream.

One day, the Dokebi king opens a cafe in the neighborhood. Soon, the word gets out that people mysteriously meet lost relationships at the cafe. Gang-Eun starts working at that strange cafe and gets involved in various lost relationships. Then, she realizes that the man in her dream may be a lost relationship from her previous life...

(Source: NetComics)

How will Tyler survive his new job where he is the only man who also happens to have a little secret?

(Source: Toomics)

Two mutant misfits find love.

May Han is a mutant in a world where people are divided into five species: dogs, cats, rabbits, tigers, and foxes. May, despite being a rabbit, is abnormally tall, and has been bullied her entire life for being such a mutant. What will happen when she meets another mutant, Jun Kang? Will she be able to reconcile her traumatizing past and find love in this unforgiving world?

(Source: Manta)
Daily life of Baek Mi with her interest in food and cooking.

A lot of things happen in the office. You think lying low and just doing your work will do the trick, but there's always trouble stirring up somewhere.

(Source: Toomics)

Kiyo, a struggling young artist, suddenly finds himself pinned as the prime suspect in a serial murder case. And as if going to prison wasn't enough, he's thrown into an Alpha-only facility crawling with thirsty alphas who are all too eager to eat him up. Thanks to his mysterious new cellmate Iri, Kiyo is able to escape their clutches, but bigger problems await...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 special episodes and an epilogue.

Eun-Seol, who had wandered the battlefield living as a juvenile soldier, sets foot in the family as the daughter-in-law of Baek Empire's Imperial General, Ki Hae-Woon. No one expected to learn the truth that Baekwoon, the eldest son of Haewoon, has already become married. In addition, Hae-Woon declares that he will make her unborn child, who also doesn't exist yet, as the successor. And on a bright moonlit night, he came to visit her place!

The futures Evan sees with his ability were never wrong. Will that be the case this time, too?

(Source: Toomics)

What happens when the scariest kid in school asks you out on a date? Yoojung struggles to survive what may just be the worst day of her life.

(Source: YLAB)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

Hyuk is a happy-go-lucky college student who’s dating the girl of his dreams. But there’s one issue: when it’s showtime in the bedroom, he gets massive performance anxiety. Desperate to keep his girlfriend, Hyuk works up the courage to go see a urologist. He prepares for the worst, but his first prostate exam actually feels…amazing?! Thanks to one smooth Dr. Han and his masterful hands, Hyuk is now on the path to recovery through regular massage sessions! How lucky of him to have found such an attentive doctor, one who’ll even take him out for drinks to listen to his woes. But as the treatments unfold, Dr. Han has a way of slipping into Hyuk’s mind, not just his bum…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extras.
184 cm tall and known by the titles of “flower boy beauty” and all-around male fashion model is actually a girl!

They say third time’s a charm, but what Jaehong needs is a miracle. After failing the notorious college entrance exam twice, he’s determined to succeed and finally experience the ultimate campus life. However, he can’t do it alone. His new math tutor, Han Eunsung, looks like he’ll be Jaehong’s best ally. The thing is…Eunsung isn't actually Jaehong’s tutor! The misunderstanding gets cleared up quickly, but that doesn’t change the fact that Eunsung was the best tutor Jaehong’s ever had. Now Jaehong has a new objective: to persuade Eunsung to teach him. However, Eunsung doesn’t seem too keen...

(Source: Lezhin)

Find out what happens when a man is tangled up with a girl who only means trouble.

(Source: Toomics)

In a world divided into slaves (Spinels) and masters (Pels), Rowell is a young duke who refuses to abide by the established rules. His parents died defending the rights of Spinels, and he, too, has never bought or sold a slave in his life. Then one night, a runaway Spinel named Dev steals an heirloom pendant of Rowell’s and blackmails him into purchasing his services. Dev plans to use Rowell’s wealth and authority to find his lost family, so he does everything in his power to dominate the kindhearted Rowell. With years of bad blood between Pels and Spinels, will the two be able to see each other beyond their labels? Or will their differences be too great to overcome?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Forbidden romance on the high seas!

It was all smooth sailing for Lil Schweiz, a famous pirate captain, until some shocking news almost threw her overboard. The notorious Admiral Retiro, known for scalping and feeding his pirate captives to flesh-eating fish, is on his way... And he's coming for one thing only.

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Seaworld Game: Please Save My Husband
title.english: The Newlywed Game: How to Save My Husband

description:
Game notifications? Quests, and a magical item shop... inside a convenience store? After getting married, Bipa's life turns into a video game! Things were going great with her hot and attentive husband—until he has to head off to the frontlines of a war zone, leaving her alone to deal with her insufferable in-laws and terrified for her his safety. One day, she discovers a powerful but expensive item in the magic shop. Can she earn enough points to save her husband’s life?

(Source: Tapas)

It all happened so suddenly. I finally got to fulfill the fantasy I had with my wife's friend and right now? Nothing matters. All that remains is hunger and pleasure.

(Source: Toomics)

I got to see my neighbor's inside life by chance. What's happening to her? Why can't I take her off my mind?

(Source: Toomics)

I'm an in house lawyer, and it's my role to take care of the chairman's four daughters. But, wait. Why are they fighting over me?!

(Source: Toomics)

My girlfriend is a goddess, but she thinks of me as her slave. Just as I was getting tired of it, I meet her friend and experience something new!

(Source: Toomics)

When Henry Cuthbert asked for a worker to come help at his farm, he never expected a small, scrawny child to show up asking to be adopted! But little James swears to be a hard worker and grow up strong if Henry doesn't send him back to the orphanage. As the years pass and James grows older, the affection between the two grows stronger. Can these two men learn to heal from their dark pasts and care for one another?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The Awl is a story of ordinary folks struggling to be treated as humans.

Set in the latter half of the 2000s, against the backdrop of “Pureumi”, a fictional superstore chain in South Korea, the work unfolds with a focus on two protagonists: Yi Su-in, who has been instructed by the corporation to dismiss workers unjustly; and Gu Go-sin, a labor activist.

A man of principles, Su-in is someone who cannot restrain outspoken criticism and is constantly at odds with the world. Though he has quit a career in the armed forces to live quietly and chosen an ordinary job, he once again clashes against the world because the company has ordered him to drive out employees by force.

Aiding Su-in is Go-sin, a cool-headed and deft labor activist who runs a labor counseling center near the Pureumi chain. Unlike Su-in, who has difficulty getting along with people and sternly sticks to rules, he approaches others without hesitation and even resorts to extreme measures at times to accomplish goals.

Together, Su-in and Go-sin will oppose the manipulation and moral harassment to which the employees are cynically subjected. The process through which these two figures remind ordinary, diligent workers of their rights and bring change together will fire up readers.

Remarkable in mastery and brilliance, author Choi Gyu-seok (The Hellbound) depicts with finesse all the adventures of this shock of two worlds, and at the same time offers an amazing portrait of a complex Korean society, crossed by multiple tensions.

Proof that popular works can also be created based on social topics, The Awl has left an indelible mark on South Korean comics. Entertaining and moving at the same time, The Awl remains a monumental work in the nation’s comics, consummate in its artistry, while conveying an important social message.

(Source: Ablaze)

One year after I left, the girl I knew committed suicide. I'm going to get revenge on you all. Just wait.

(Source: Toomics)

Jun, who lives a perfect life. He was full of confidence that he would take first place this semester as well, but it got taken over by the over motivated Cha Si Won. Even on the day of the farewell party, Jun gets drunk and kisses Si Won. To cover the dark story, he takes a leave of absence and goes to the army. But after 2 years, Jun and Si Won have returned to school together. They seem to have a lot in common, they have the same classes, they continue to meet each other and they also have the same phone model. Jun shudders at the constant feeling of being associated with Si Won. He tries to relax his stress with the Phone Sex, but due to the accidental change of cell phones, Si Won discovers Jun's sexual preference (SM) ...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.
At our school, there's a new teacher, Suzy, and the perfect role-model of a teacher, Sunwoo. This is the story of two very different teachers with the last name Kim.
In the center of Samdochundong, a town famous of its ghost stories, the common tenants’ daily life gag.

Park Ja-gi dreams of future scenes, Kim Young-tak is a time-stopper, Jang Se-yoon can see the future 10 minutes later, Kang Min-hyeok can turn back time by 10 seconds, and detective Yang-sik. It is the story of ten days of desperate fighting at the risk of their own lives to prevent a tragedy and save people.

(Source: Aladin, translated)

"Why didn't you accept my bouquet?", she asked years later like it was the simplest thing. Chance brought Ju-Na back into Yun-Seo's life but things were much more complicated now. They were no longer in college where the only obstacle between them were the truth yet spoken. Luna was married with a child, what could Yun-Seo do? As Sae-Ha chases after Yun-Seo, Yun-Seo discovers even after all these years she'd still love Ju-Na at the drop of a hat. The three women navigate through their feelings for another, each desperate and yearning for a chance to be accepted.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Woken up from a date, he’s suddenly in a movie set? Wait, he’s been reborn as a baby martial artist! In the Jongnam Clan, which was once one of the 9 strongest clans, he receives the name “Gun-Chung” and uses the knowledge of his past life to learn the true meaning of martial arts. When your perspective is different, your martial arts changes. Armed with knowledge, Gun-Chung brings about a new age of martial arts!

The new school year brings with it a myriad of new encounters. Han-Seok’s first meeting with Ki-Un involves snow, an obese calico cat, and a lingering sweet scent. As it turns out, the two are now classmates, and Han-Seok finds himself slowly drawn to Ki-Un. Han-Seok wants to grow closer to Ki-Un, but he proves to be a tough nut to crack. He's amiable enough, but Ki-Un soon senses an invisible wall between him and his target. Will Han-Seok manage to charm his way through to Ki-Un's heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

A man finally gets his first job only to find out he was hired for a more discrete and rewarding job.

(Source: Toomics)

A long time ago, a traveler knocked on the door of an innocent young man's house and asked for a night's lodging.

If you let her in, you'll get eaten?! ♡

Have you ever wished you were special? Se-Gye Lee certainly doesn’t! She wants nothing more than to be ordinary, but her extraordinary strength keeps landing her in hot water, like the time she accidentally knocked down the wall separating her home from her neighbor’s. Her good-looking neighbor, Ju-Won, is surprisingly nice about it, but he has secrets of his own. Then Yeong, who granted Se-Gye her powers, comes back into her life. Se-Gye asks him to make her normal again, but why does it seem like her life’s about to become much less ordinary?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.english: The Correlation Between Love and Heat

description:
Ji Gwi, a lad who became a heated ghost after loving Queen Sun Duk one-sidedly. Eun Chong, a descendant of Ji Gwi, found that by touching the Hong Kong exchange student Hae Bum, his body temperature lowers. So seeking help -"If the type of touching changes the body temperature, shouldn't we progress this further?" Due to the very forward Hae Bum, Eun Chong's life becomes shaken.

Chapter count includes a prologue,14 side story chapters and one short special chapter within the final authors note.

A gay son and a lesbian daughter.
Jin and Rin are best friends, and they each have a secret - they are both gay. Life turns upside down when both of their households find out about their sexual orientation. How will they survive despite their parents knowing?

(Source: Manta)

Hyoju, who climbed up the ladder to the top 8 of an Audition program gets disqualified and joins the company of an enemy to her favorite judge, Tae-Seong. However, as she comes back to Tae-Seong after many events, rumors and odd vibes begin to spread...

Yoon Hee-Soo, is an illegitimate son of Dayoon Group, a leading conglomerate in Korea.

"From now on, I'll be in charge of your moral education."
"..."
"Nobody cares."

Hee-Soo struggles to escape Kang Joo-Chan, the secretary who controls him and monitors his every move. For the past 10 years, they have tamed each other and been together that way.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

How will Tyler survive his new job where he is the only man who also happens to have a little secret?

(Source: Toomics)

Sun-Hee's family seems to be a perfect, happy family.

One day, Sun-Hee confesses that she killed her friend, Kyung-Ho, but her mother's reaction is somewhat strange.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After Simon, the prince of the kindom of Ainz, lost his father and his entire family name due to the betrayal of a trusted aide, he was taken in by a knight as an adopted son. However, on one fateful day, the knight's entire family was annihilated and his sister became missing. In order to find his sister, Simon goes on a path of vengeance...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

There are people who own an object that shouldn’t exist in this world ‘OOPARTS’. They live in a border outside the world (Out), where many special stories are happening.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Living with 4 hot guys? She hates it. I-Rei and her mother become the center of attention when her mom wins a contest where a k-pop idol group comes to stay with them. Now I-Rei must deal with living with 4 extra family members and a love-struck mother.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

To battle the alarming suicide rate, the government initiates a suicide prevention program using AI robots. CHA-88K, a humanoid robot, is placed on Mapo Bridge, the nation's highest suicide spot. "Cha Cha" receives a lot of attention in the beginning, but is eventually considered a failure and funding for the programs stops. However, Cha Cha continues to watch over the bridge. Due to her ability to infinitely synchronize with other AI robots, she can observe the private lives of many humans. Cha Cha despairs over what she sees in human society and develops something similar to depression and lethargy. Ai, CEO of White Island Nursing Home, purchases the decrepit Cha Cha from the government, brings her to the nursing home, shakes her out of her stupor, and ultimately convinces her to become Earth's next "Mother." in a futuristic society where people have become cold and calculating machines and AI robots take over many services once performed by human beings, Cha Cha, Ai, and the other AI robots force us to examine what it means to be human.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
I already confessed to him, but he still treats me like a child...

A world where 11 Kings with absolute reign live protected by knights. Apprentice knight Hinta, together with his partner Kanut, venture on a journey to become appointed as formal knights. An action-packed fantasy story of two boys as they fight to become real knights!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Moon Moo-hui, who had no choice but to look at the world with a different eye from his childhood, unfolds a new world from the tip of his brush, who unexpectedly went out to Kang-Ho!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

“When I grow up, I wanna marry you, hyung!” When Woojin first heard Eunsoo, the little kid from next-door say this to him, he chalked it up to childish naivete. However, it turned out to be only the first of the many, many declarations of love Eunsoo would make to Woojin over the next few years. Cut to present day, although Eunsoo’s love for Woojin has remained unchanged, Woojin still thinks of him as the kid he used to babysit. Things start looking bad when neither side is ready to give. But Lady luck intervenes to break the stalemate! Woojin’s company is suddenly in need of a new illustrator and Eunsoo is the only perfect candidate available for the job! Excited at the prospect of working with Woojin, Eunsoo begins concocting plans, confident that a change of place will become the friction that will help Woojin see him in a new light. But Woojin is onto his shenanigans and has no intention of falling for his seductions! Only one question remains now: Will love bloom on the clock or will it fizzle and burn out?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Reading about Lariensa was an innocent pastime, but Song Yiseul never imagined becoming personally entangled in her story. When she wakes up in a fictional world as Lariensa’s best friend Marilyn, she quickly realizes that her favorite novel’s star desperately needs her protection. The thing is, Lariensa is just a little too sweet for her own good, which makes her an easy target for master manipulators like Sibel Noma Kahn. As Lariensa’s loyal friend, it’s up to Marilyn to save her from the boy who will one day ruin her life. But Marilyn’s desperate attempts to circumvent Sibel only seem to pique his devilish curiosity. With the antagonist now suddenly interested in her, Marilyn sets out to foil Sibel's sinister plot to use her to get to Lariensa.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Eun-Ha and Eun-Sang are twins. Although their looks are identical, their personalities are the complete opposite. Due to their clashing differences, Eun-Ha can't stand his older twin brother.

So far, Eun-Ha has never been on a date, let alone make friends, because of how scary he looks. When he decides a start fresh in college, he meets his ideal man, Han Yeo-Reum. But when he realizes his crush has been mistaking him for twin brother this whole time, he now has to come to a decision. Will he tell him the truth or continue pretending to be his brother?

(Source: Lezhin US)

There are 5 famous pretty boys at school. Their odd natures disagree with their good looks. Now that Jun-Oh is their target, what will happen to him?!

(Source: Webnovel)

Notes:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- One of the winners of the 8th Mr. Blue BL & Romance comic awards.

Yu-Jun and Geon-U have been a couple for 3 years. While Yu-Jun worries that Geon-U might have gotten tired of their time together, he looks for ways to spice up their relationship in colorful ways. A feast of a couple's sweet play!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I never asked for a sister-in-law. My mind is saying no, but my body just can't resist!

(Source: Toomics)
A boy lives two lives: a young leader in a magical world and a high-schooler in reality. And he’s determined to live in both! Dive into this action-packed martial art fusion comic!

What appeared to be a one-time encounter in Spain blossoms into romance when by-the-book CEO Jung Wooseok and free-thinking architect Han Yujin meet again in Korea. The two are drawn to each other, but there’s a catch: Yujin’s the winner of a high-profile architecture competition held by Wooseok’s company. When word gets out that these two are acquainted, will their love be able to survive the public’s scrutiny... and their families’ even harsher criticism?

Spin-off of K-drama “Encounter.”

(Source: Tapas)

Ga-Yeon knows what men want. She knows what it takes to fulfill their fantasies, and loves the power that comes with the conquest of even the most arrogant of men. Nothing can strip her of that confidence. Not even a sudden warp to a foreign land, and not even the fact that she has to become a random emperor’s concubine. Why would that faze her? The emperor Zeros is good looking, has a hot bod, and acts aloof. He’s just the kind of man that she’s used to dealing with. It won’t take too long for her to make him hers…or will it?

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

What is the fate of the heart-throbbing man Ju-Young Lim?

Note: This is a brand webtoon of the South Korean Ministry of Health and Welfare for a youth smoking prevention campaign created by Yaongyi.

Ever since he was young, Hee-Min has always liked his neighbour, Seon-Woo-hyung. Hee-Min had given up on Seon-Woo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, while Seon-Woo is searching for a roommate, Hee-Min is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of Hee-Min now is none other than his older brother, Yoo-Min!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

After being outed by his first love in high school, Juho has been struggling in his romantic endeavors ever since. One evening after a distasteful phone call with a cheating ex, Juho sees someone has been staring at him. Juho recognizes Kang Jaemin, an old high school classmate. Juho and Jaemin briefly catch up on each other's lives when Juho makes a surprising offer for Jaemin to stay the night at his place to which Jaemin agrees.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 side stories.

A wealthy man hires a maid to take care of his son who is currently in a coma. Something happens that night and soon, she is asked to leave the house. What could have possibly gone wrong?

(Source: Toomics)

"Unnie… I really like you." Those were the words that Fine Arts student, Shi-Bi tells Ye-Ju, her former teacher and current sunbae. Only having eyes for Ye-Ju, she blurts out a drunken confession, and the two of them later spend the night together, but a rumour that a girl named Jay is trying to approach Ye-Ju begins to circulate and reaches Shi-Bi's ears, which complicates her love life. A romance between two art students that get intoxicated with drunken love commences.

Nervous and excited, Sae-Beom, 20 years old, moves into a share-house, in spring before her first year in college. There she meets Hee-Joo, a roommate with a unique personality, and even a Choi Ra-Wook look-alike. It's a story about the lives of our enthusiastic, immature, 20 year old selves! Would you like to come to our share house full of the first love excitements?

Plonked right into the world of a novel she once read, Sophie simply wishes to live out the rest of her quiet life in the background. Who could ask for a better place than the sleepy village of Pellun? And it was wonderful, peaceful... until knights came in searching for Lady Amelia. The Amelia Cedric from the most powerful noble family in the Rohatin Empire? Wait, it can't be... I'm just an extra!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

What happens when a girl who wants to date but doesn't believe in love meets a guy who likes to flirt but thinks relationships are a drag? That's how it is for Na-Bi and Jae-Eon, two art students who meet in college and develop a strong connection -- inspired by butterflies. As they get to know each other and their relationship progresses, they'll face the early stages of attraction and the ups and downs of dating. This story will make you long to be in a relationship -- even when you know it won't be easy.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The young president of the Dibicci bank, Lawrence Dibicci, controls the economic world of the Cosimo Empire. One day, a girl named Rahui is thrown under his wings instead of her father's debt.

(Source: Copin Comics)

What are the odds of running into a one-night stand on the street?
Jitae can't muster the courage to tell his straight friend Kyunghoon that he's had a crush on him for a long time. Much to his dismay, Kyunghoon announces his engagement to his pregnant fiancée.
Shattered, Jitae has a one-night stand with a random guy he meets at a gay bar. As if congratulating a years-long crush on his wedding day isn't hard enough, Jitae runs into the one-night stand who happens to be the bride's brother! But Haejoon doesn't seem to want to remain a casual sex partner to Jitae. He comes on to Jitae with a hint of threat and an offer hard to refuse.
"Don't do it. Choose me, instead. I'll make you get over him."

(Source: NETCOMICS)

title.english: Puss in Suit, Pup in Tie

description:
Sunwoo looks like a harmless little puppy on the outside, but everyone in the office knows he's more of a feisty cat - sensitive and aloof, through and through. Hyunjin, on the other hand, is like a big friendly dog - always ready and oh-so-eager to befriend Sunwoo. After his fruitless efforts to avoid Hyunjin within the office, Sunwoo gives him an ultimatum that results in their unlikely new friendship. Rocky roads await the puss in suit and pup in tie!

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Orr was cursed after drawing a legendary sword from the ground which made him lose all emotions. On his way to defeat the Demon King, he had to stay at a village to resolve the cases many people simply vanishing. In that place, he met Mayim, a mountain deity who seemed to be connected to the abductions?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

Haewon, who suddenly had to find a new room, decided to live with his brother’s friend, Minjae, when the latter told him that he would give him a room. While Haewon kept wondering about his roommate’s attitude for no reason, he suddenly began to recall his forgotten highschool past.

On the first day at his new job, Myeong-Woo ends up being ordered to present his company’s new products as a door-to-door salesman. While doing his rounds, he meets what appears to be the snobby employee of a huge and very important company who turns him down. After drinking his sorrows away, Myeong-Woo somehow finds himself sleeping at the snob’s house and discovers the stranger’s dirty secret...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

The only pearl in the world that could turn Fox Fang into a human was accidentally swallowed by one of his classmates! In order to become human, the fox has to go great lengths to "provoke a man into bed". But who would have thought that he'd fall into the other man's trap?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Cute guy, Cha-Young! Cool guy, Kwon-Yul! And... some other dangerous ones?!

Cha-Young, who can see his dead mother's spirit, and Kwon-Yul, who can see ghosts but lies about it. One day, a dangerous (?) shaman appeared in front of them! Finding out that Cha-Young turns out to be surprisingly easily possessed by ghosts, the shaman decides to use him...!!

(Source: Kakao)

title.english: The Reason She Lives as a Villainess

description:
Some people would jump at the chance at a new life, but when Jeongyun wakes up after a terrible accident and finds that she has become Lecian Fucernien, a character of a cliche, romantic fantasy novel, it feels like she’s woken up inside a nightmare. Disappointed as she is, she quickly accepts her fate and decides to make the best of her new life. The good news is that Lecian's character has a happy ending, but the bad news is that she's supposed to die once to get it. Between foiling her abusive new father’s plans of committing treason, finding a way out of her engagement to the crown prince, and avoiding the strange duke who seems to be stalking her, Jeongyun has a very long to-do list. Will Jeongyun be able to adjust to her new life while figuring out a way to avoid dying a second time?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After a promising debut, Seohyun’s fallen out of the fashion world spotlight with his latest designs. His short career’s practically over as the industry writes him off. Yet even as people refuse to work with him, Hyowon Lee agrees to be his model. While this playboy troublemaker doesn't seem serious enough for Seohyun's liking, he does have a certain allure to him. Will Hyowon be more trouble than he’s worth or will their partnership give rise to something more tantalizing... and pleasurable?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one prologue, one epilogue, three extras and five side story chapters.

"Let's date until we graduate."

U-Hyeon has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Do-Ha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can U-Hyeon like someone other than his teacher?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Save room for the main course.
Hyunwook is a coward when it comes to his longtime crush Heesun, who suddenly announces that she’s getting married. He helps her plan her wedding at a restaurant called Secondo Piatto. There he meets Wonyoung, an old friend of Heesun’s fiancée. But why is Wonyoung crying on the day of the wedding?

(Source: Manta)

Her girlfriend, who she's been dating for seven years, is wallowing in bed with another girl, and her dream of debut has been shattered, so she doesn't have many expectations anymore. Suddenly, ray of hope appears in front of Ji-an; she receives an offer to appear in a program that highly appreciates Jian's self-composed song. Jian is excited about the opportunity to escape from her lover Yoo Won...

Eun-hyeon is the promising young CEO of RedFit, a vastly successful gaming company. But while he’s got the looks and the status, he’s also a chronic workaholic with a mean mouth, and his employees are always busy avoiding him. His secretary, Ms. Han, is the only one who seems to be capable of dealing with his insensible remarks... But even she has her limits. Having had enough of his tyranny, she storms inside his office ready to quit - completely oblivious to the words that would soon come out of her irritable boss’ mouth.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A fresh-faced new recruit finds out that his girlfriend is cheating on him, and the devastating news plunges the poor soldier into a sleepless craze. His constant jerking off to his ex-girlfriend alarms the other soldiers, and soon the entire unit is made aware of the situation. Then one day, an unexpected visitor shows up...!

(Source: Lezhin X)

"It takes more to satisfy me."

Dayoung has the looks, the talent, and the wealth to back everything up, but she desires only one thing - having her friend Jae-seung watch her as she embarks on her risque digressions. Whether it's in the library, on the school grounds, or at home, Dayoung calls Jae-seung whenever the mood strikes her. But how does Jae-seung feel about all this? Behind the thrill and the facade are the haunting traces of his past, ever so lasting as a burn.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Going on with our lives after having lost someone is always painful. What does it mean to move on without forgetting them? This is a story about survivors struggling to find happiness within their guilt and grief.

(Source: Manta)

One normal day, Jung's little brother Hoon goes missing. Jung sees her family fall into despair as the search for her brother drags on without any hope of him coming back. But one day Jung wakes up to 6 months ago, the day her brother went missing, She is the only one who remembers. Will she be able to change the course of time?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

After the loss of a loved one, Ji-Su is offered a helping hand from her late grandmother’s student, who provides her with a place to stay and takes her under her wing. Despite her wish to get along, Ji-Su gets off on the wrong foot with their only son, Ha-Jin, who mistakes her for a stalker after he encounters her on his doorstep. Will Ji-Su be able to resolve this misunderstanding and befriend Ha-Jin? Or will their relationship turn into something more?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Ever heard of an “alpha mate” before? It’s someone who’s paid to be an alpha’s sexual plaything during their rut. Or a person who’s used by a non-alpha who wants to present as an alpha. Which is why Se-Jun is not at all pleased when his childhood crush, Yeon-Woo, is brought in as his alpha mate in the hopes of turning Se-Jun into a true alpha. Here’s a secret: Se-Jun is already an alpha. With a contract between them and a secret that Se-Jun is determined to keep, will these two be able to make a true connection?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seungmin used to have a crush on his high school teacher. Maybe he still has some fantasies about her. So what? A fantasy is just a fantasy. High school was ages ago, and he has a girlfriend that’ll marry him in a few months. That’s his reality. But fantasy collides with reality when he meets his old high school teacher at a reunion and accidentally takes her phone instead of his own. The photos on that phone show him there’s more to Mrs. Jang than he’s ever dreamed about, and that he just might get to indulge in his old teenage fantasies after all...

(Source: Lezhin X)
Note: The work was cancelled after it was discovered that the artist had been tracing other people's art.

Ye-eun is a young high schooler who fantasizes about one day having the perfect first kiss with her crush. A practice kiss on her sister’s action figure, Bryk, turns her world upside down when it magically brings him to life. Bryk, a once-legendary and most definitely human knight, finds himself perplexed as to how he woke up as an action figure. Though he sets out to find the witch who he suspects is to blame, he quickly gets caught up in Ye-eun’s attempts to keep her sister happy and her crush interested. Bryk and Ye-eun vow to figure out what turned him into a doll and how to return him to his world as a human man. That is, of course, if he doesn’t get broken, eaten, or stolen first.

(Source: WEBTOON)

The world has lost its innocence, and it seems that I am the only one who hasn't... Can you resist the temptation of young, hot college girls?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A plastic surgeon who is even hated by his own patients because of his ugly looks goes over an entire body overhaul after being dumped by the love of his life, and his life is soon turned upside down.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Lee Si-Yeon and Lee Si-Eon are fraternal twins and lifelong enemies. Constantly at each other’s throats since a young age, these two have competed over everything with older twin sister, Si-Yeon, usually coming out on top. From stealing his toys to stealing his girlfriends, Si-Yeon has always taken everything her little brother, Si-Eon, called his own. That must have been what motivated him to try to and steal her object of interest, Seo Tae-Hyeon. Determined to turn the tables on his sister, Si-Eon bets Si-Yeon that he can get their classmate, Tae-Hyeon, to ask him out before she can. And so, the war for Tae-Hyeon’s love began. While gender preference would usually be a deciding factor, Tae-Hyeon has a traumatic secret that levels the playing field for the twins. Unless he can get over his painful past, it’s truly anyone’s game and the loser will have to quit school, leave home, and never show their face in front of the winner again. But, with everyone toying with each other’s emotions and prying deeper into their private lives, will anyone really come out a winner?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

She’s the perfect private tutor—smart, beautiful, and willing to offer more thanjust extra lessons. For her top-scoring students, the reward goes far beyond grades… and once you get a taste, you’ll do anything to stay at the top of the class.

(Source: Toomics)

"Had he been a hero in his past life or something...?"

"That's right. I once rescued this nation from destruction."

When Ja-In is kidnapped due to his family's massive debt, Un-Jo happens to walk by and save him from his kidnappers. From that day onwards, Ja-In's life is never the same...

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Yeon is a competent, popular medical officer at East Seven Center, a defense facility located on the outskirts of the city with a big secret.
When Woo Tae-ha, the youngest Lieutenant General in history, comes to the Center, Yeon finds him familiar although he cannot quite grasp why.
Yeon begins to remember his past with Woo although Woo does not seem to remember anything. With a mystery in their hands, Yeon and Woo find themselves attracted to each other.

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

Note: Includes 8 extra chapters

Ha-Joon, troubled by the news of his one-sided love's marriage, ends up having a one night stand, with his college senior, Tae-Hyuk. Ha-Joon thinks of it as a mistake and feels guilty but instead, Tae-Hyuk makes a suggestion on how to help Ha-Joon forget about Min-Seong...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

Three side stories arcs that have different pairings each of them.

Note: While this has it's own page on Lezhin, in BomToon it starts after chapter 51.

"Let's make the best chicken ever!!!"

Sang-Uk's father took all his severance pay and invested it into a chicken restaurant. However, within a few days of opening, his father had an accident, and suddenly running the store became Sang-Uk's responsibility, although he was a mere college student....

The taste of Sang-Uk's chicken, which he made for the first time in his life, is terrible! He tries his best to continue running the store, but he can't see a future for it...And therefore Sang-Uk is forced to ask for help from his greatest enemy, Hye-Ri, to help him find the best fried chicken recipe! Will he succeed?

(Source: Manyeo Comics, translated and edited)

Kang Jae-Hyuk was mesmerized the first time he heard Ha-Jin play violin. He was so invested in Ha-Jin's continued growth that he even sponsored him through his cultural foundation. As soon as Ha-Jin hit twenty, however, he confessed his feelings for Jae-Hyuk and disappeared. Seven years later, the two reunite, but Jae-Hyuk is heartbroken to find that Ha-Jin's love for violin has completely vanished.

(Source: Tapas)

Art instructor Dongho seems to be caught in a love triangle with college students, but what will the three learn about each other when the uniform comes off?

(Source: Toomics)

Ga-Eun is a junior in college who lives with her younger brother, a senior in high school. Ever since their parents' death, she has tried to stay strong and confident amidst juggling school and raising her brother. And after getting dumped by her boyfriend, dating is the last thing on her mind... until she gets involved with three of her brother’s friends. Which one will she choose? The cheeky, handsome childhood friend Doh-Wan? The calm, collected, and responsible class president Sang-Woo? Or the quiet and intimidating but kind-hearted Jun?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Recently something's really been doing a number on Su-Min. No medical test can seem to tell what it is, though. After several unsuccessful checkups, Su-Min walks home to find…his next-door neighbor drinking the blood of a random stranger! Su-Min’s thoroughly creeped out, but he soon becomes interested when the vampire claims that he can suck all of Su-Min’s pain away. What could possibly go wrong? It’ll be worth it if a small pain in his neck will rid him of this mysterious ailment, right? Right?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

No more unrequited love! The hottest rumor in Going High School is that if you put money in the old clothes collection bin and shout out your favorite person's name, it will tell you how the other person feels...!

Song A-Ram, who is only interested in grades and money instead of dating, is not swayed by such rumors. Then Jeong Jin-U, a popular guy at school, suddenly enters A-Ram's daily life. Now what is she supposed to do with a guy who doesn't know where he's going?

(Source: Naver, translated)

An ordinary housewife's life turns to hell after falling into the hands of a vicious loan shark.

(Source: Toptoon)

A master elementalist, Egret lived his entire life in the company of elemental spirits, having felt shunned by human society for his immense power. After his death, he is reborn as the young prince Judas, a social outcast bullied for his quietness and small frame. With his trusty spirits by his side, Egret enters the elite academy Ruvar-H, where he must make friends and turn Judas’ reputation around. But with danger from his past life following him, can this great sage make it in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

A paradise for all men. But is it really a festival for everyone there?

(Source: Toomics)

For as long as I can remember, I've been fascinated by violence. But the fixation turned out to be a disguised longing for pain, and in turn, my deepest, darkest secret. I can't let anyone find out, but I also can't help but wonder - will I ever find someone to quench my desires? Or will my fantasy remain unfulfilled... forever? What lies in the end of a pain-fueled revenge?!

Editor's Comment: This comic contains graphic depictions of rape and violence. Reader discretion is advised.

(Source: Lezhin US)

"Don't you remember me? I'm the wimp you used to bully back in college."

10 years ago, this man lost everything to the campus bullies. It's time to take his sweet revenge.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Even though Jeong-Soo is timid, he’s quite a bold guy. He works at a fried chicken restaurant with a sexy boss and a coworker who looks like a goddess. One day he found himself alone with his voluptous boss. Looks like he’s going to do some “overtime”.

No So-Ha lives as an ordinary boatman.
However, he is actually the successor of a legendary swordsmanship art.

The art of Seon Geun Gyeong, left behind by Qin Shi Huang himself! Now begins the fight for it.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Whatever she draws becomes reality.

Yeonjoo, the daughter of a famous cartoonist, always dreamed of following in her father’s footsteps. However, her lack of drawing skills ultimately leads her to leave the world of comics behind — until she suddenly finds herself in her father’s cartoon universe...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Lessons in Seduction with a Classy Duke

description:
Lillian didn't marry Arthur for love, but loveless unions are ubiquitous in high society. However, when Lillian is confronted with incriminating evidence that reveals her husband's twisted desires, she's forced to decide whether she really wants to leave. Little does Arthur know that his wife is more than willing to indulge his sick fantasies. And now, he's ready to make Lillian his, as long as she's prepared to submit. As the pair becomes entangled in a dangerous love affair that blurs the lines between passion and obsession, they must fend off intrusive reporters, feisty former flames, and incredibly nosy neighbors all determined to tear them apart. Just how far is Lillian willing to go to satisfy Arthur's depravity? Does she have what it takes to be the wife of the esteemed Duke Arthur Astrid?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Notes: Chapter count includes a prologue.

You’d think the ruler of the underworld would be more menacing than even a black bear.
But he has a secret and a cute hobby?!

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

title.romaji: Du Myeongui Eve: Byeoge Gachin Yeoja
title.english: The Two Eves : The Girl Trapped in the Wall

description:
What happens when a guy and a girl end up in an underground bunker together after the apocalypse? It seems like there’s only one inevitable answer when the Bongjoon finds himself locked in together with cute, curvy Hyun-mi for the rest of the foreseeable future. But things get complicated when sexy Nan-hee ends up joining them in the bunker with them. What happens when a guy ends up in an underground bunker with two busty babes? Bongjoon is about to find out the hard way!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo Hyeon-U is a member of an idol group that's about to debut. On the day of their profile photoshoot, an accident left a hideous scar on one side of his face, causing his dream of debuting to collapse. Fortunately, he became an idol trainer with the recommendation of his manager, but he still spent his shabby days in sorrow. One day, he got on a plane with the idol group in charge of going abroad, but an unexpected incident caused his plane to crash!!

When he woke up, realized that he has been transported to back when he was 19 years old; when he was preparing to join the debut team.

Seo Hyeon-U, an idol in the body of a 19-year old boy but who has been strengthened by his experience as a trainer. This is the story of his growth to become an idol once again!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

With the power of his right arm, the main character, Woo Su-Kwang, who has always been good at fighting and overpowers the best at each school he attends, is a legend among his high school peers. However, his wish is to live an ordinary life just like everyone else.

Then, by chance, he met the head teacher, Park Su-Ho, and it turns out that he was an exorcist. He said he would teach Su-Kwang how to control his right arm. The condition is that he joins the exorcism club.

(Source: Kakao, translated)
The king who came out and claimed the world with only two fists!

When Suh volunteered as a beta tester for a cutting-edge ultra VR game, he never imagined he'd be stuck there for the next 20 years. It was only after he finally died in the game he managed to "log off" from the game… only to realize five years have passed in real-life. Reality seemed a lot harsher than the game world he had left, as his family went broke having to pay his hospital bills all those years he lay in bed in a coma while stuck in the game. Pressed by loansharks, Suh decides to turn to what he does best... and logs back into the game, hoping to make enough money in the gaming world to convert it into real life currency and pay off the debt. To his pleasant surprise, Suh discovers that he gets to keep most of what he learned over 20 years of being stuck in the previous version of the game! This should be pretty easy... right?

(Source: Pocket Comics)
The special discipleship of Mu-Rim's best assassin, Gwi-Myeon-Dok, will begin.

A series of crimes based on fairytales.

A murderer by the alias “The Tale” is on the loose, and he uses fairytales to manipulate others into kidnapping and killing his victims for him. Five missing women. Five mysterious invitations. One party. Will the unlikely duo of elite detective and playful author be able to work around their differences to get to the bottom of the case?

(Source: Manta)

A poor young man has no choice but to work in construction for some extra cash. However, he didn't expect romance in a place like this!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Hana can see different future outcomes based on the choices that people make. But when she enters college and meets someone whose future she can't see, her life takes an unexpected turn. In order to avoid the worst possible future, will she be forced to make the worst choice?

Iju Han isn’t sure where her life went wrong. Once the heiress to a wealthy business magnate, she’s now an ordinary housewife whose main concerns are her nagging in-laws and household chores. Things take a much more tragic turn, however, when she finds her husband confessing his love to her stepsister. Devastated, she runs away, only to be hit by a car and killed. But when she opens her eyes, she finds that she’s awakened a year ago in the past, before her life went awry. Given a second chance at life, Iju vows revenge, determined to take back all that she’s lost.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Han-Seo is a college student who's in love with a handsome senior named Han Ji-Yun. One night they went to a mixer party, and Han-Seo smelled Han Ji-Yun's jacket when no one was there. He gets caught by Ji-Yun Yun, his crush's roommate, who wants to live at his place in exchange for keeping his secret!

(Source: INKR Comics, edited)

Childhood tragedy turned Lee Ju-Hyeok into an angry, omega-hating alpha. He has enemies, his partners can’t pleasure him, and he can’t remember the one dearest to him. However, his right-hand man, Kwon I-Hyeon, knows who he once was and chooses to stay by his side. But after an incident results in the two eloping, Ju-Hyeok’s urge to have I-Hyeon all for himself begins to grow. His demands are getting worse, and it’s only a matter of time before there’s nothing left of I-Hyeon… not even a scent.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one special chapter and six side story chapters.

I don’t want to work. Like at all. But I don’t have a choice. On an Earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Aliens live together, there is a never-ending series of incidents. This is the story of a man that’s had to work in secrecy for 800 years because he’ll die if he doesn’t.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Handmade Tales of the Handmaid

description:
An 89-year-old grandma passes away and wakes up in a totally different world as Grana, a teenage maid at Viscount Winston’s estate. Grana’s kind soul and her natural talents for needlework and other crafts quickly win the hearts of the Winstons and the other maids. But in this world, her skills seem somehow related to magic! As Grana makes fast friends with the young heir to the viscountcy and explores her unexpected abilities, what could possibly await her?

(Source: Tapas)

When Kyung-chan goes back to his hometown, he immediately gets tossed into living with Jinmi and Yoomi - the hot twins who need help running their restaurant. But things don’t look too bright for Kyung-chan, what with the restaurant in shambles and Jinmi constantly harassing him and teasing him for being a crook! Will Kyung-chan manage to make the twins warm up to him and save their failing restaurant?

(Source: Lezhin X)

Just after moving to a new apartment complex, Jeong-Tae meets his sexy next door neighbor, Yu-Mi. To his shock, he discovers she is an alien with an insatiable thirst for semen, and the two begin to enjoy secret sexual encounters. Complications soon arise when Yu-Mi’s husband comes back from his business trip, but while Jeong-Tae knows it’s wrong, he just can’t get the sexy alien next door out of his mind!

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

She has long lashes, radiant crimson eyes, and silver hair like an angel’s... but she’s no angel—she’s the villainess Syriana Malforte... and I’ve been isekaied into her body! The House of Malforte has many gifted mages, but none at the level of Duke Azester. My evil mother brainwashed him into falling in love with me, and I coldly used him until his final breath. But with this second chance, I vow to set him free and return him to a sound state of mind. But how? And my heart aches to know… will Az still love me once he’s free?

(Source: Tapas)

Can you fall in love with someone who is not your type? Especially the type you hate the most? Euntak, who has always dated small, pretty girls, falls in love at first sight with big, muscular Dojae. Apparently, Dojae figures it out from how Euntak is always making excuses to see him because he throws Euntak an unexpected offer: “Do you want to sleep with me? You like me.” It’s rude as hell, but Euntak can’t resist it. Will this careless affair evolve into a real relationship?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Geum-Ja Kim is the biggest (and only) fan of Kyle du Vilteon, a side character in the fantasy novel King Maker. Her never-ending search for Kyle content is forever changed when she dies while rereading the book… and somehow awakens in Kyle’s bedroom to a new life within the novel’s pages! She is then shocked to learn that Kyle can also hear her thoughts—luckily, only if she thinks of his name. Still, there’s no time for this fangirl to daydream because Kyle is doomed to die. Can she save the apple of her eye... and in the process, become his?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

Jae-Rin seems like a hip college girl, but she spends her days as a shut-in geeking over Hwi, the male lead of her favorite period drama “Hwaya.”

As part of a family intervention, her sister talks her into accepting a job as a TV extra. Upon arrival, Jae-Rin discovers that the set is for “Hwaya” but ruins the takes with her awkward movement. Worse comes to worst when she wanders off set and runs into Ahn, the actor playing Hwi. While Jae-Rin loves Hwi to death, she couldn’t care less about the egomaniacal star bringing him to life. Yet lo and behold, a near-fatal accident transports them into the drama! The once fictional world is now their reality. Jae-Rin must act out the role of Hwaya, the dragon maiden who saves her country from peril, without butchering her lines.

Can she put up with Ahn and pull off her role as the heroine in a world without outtakes?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Nam-Wook, of the clothing department, loses weight in the military and returns to school as a super-stud returning student. Nam-Wook, who barely returned to his school after an excruciating time in the military can’t cope with the sudden rise in his status. He inadvertently checks his smartphone and receives secret messages from a mysterious woman.

(Source: Toomics)

300 years ago, Saintess Maria was murdered for her magical powers, while her loyal knight, Avelron, was powerless to save her. But now, Maria has been reborn as a bright and happy young woman named Yeriel Hyem. Unaware of her true identity as a saintess, Yeriel is living a peaceful life with her beloved parents and younger brother. Things only seem to be looking up when she meets an enigmatic – and extremely handsome – man named Levnaor. But with his arrival comes mysterious events that Yeriel never expected… As things begin to unfold, can Yeriel continue to live her blissful life? Or will her tragic past come back to haunt her once-bright future?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The second in the “Sexcape Room” series!
Yu-Jin is the new guy at work with a boss who harps on him constantly. It’s not that Eun-Jae is a horrible boss; she simply catches Yu-Jin at his worst moments because his luck is horrible. In fact, he’s so unlucky that he ends up in a room that he can only escape if he has sex with Eun-Jae. Will Yu-Jin’s luck and his relationship with his boss improve as they try to break out together?

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

Born with the ability to change people’s moods, Lee Boknam was used to getting whatever he wanted. But when he inexplicably loses his powers at age 29, his flawless, comfortable life is turned upside down. The only clue is a mysterious letter from a woman named So Nagi. Desperate for answers, he tracks down Nagi in a rural town, where he learns that to prevent an early death, he must live an ordinary life. Now completely powerless, can Boknam adjust to life in the real world?

(Source: Tapas)

When the weak and unconfident Choi Yikyung first found out that he was a user, he thought he had finally hit the jackpot. In Yikyung’s mind, Necromancy seemed like the ultimate mix of cool and interesting. Back then, he had no idea that the Necromancer class was the weakest of them all! But as Yikyung enters the newly reopened Tower of Spirits in search of enhancement materials, he is sucked into a mysterious area of the dungeon where he encounters a frightening corpse. “Ding!” A quest window pops up, and it says… “You have made a pact with Seo Dawon, a vengeful spirit.” When tackling quests, it doesn’t hurt to have a companion or two, especially if one of them is the spirit of an ultra powerful and handsome young man. After all, “it’s dangerous to go alone”!

(Source : Tappytoon)

"I never imagined being here and doing this with you.”

Shim Woo-Jin was Kwon Kyung’s sunbae back in high school. 12 years later, they reunite at Woo-Jin's best friend’s wedding…who just so happens to also be Kyung's first love. Kyung always thought of Woo-Jin as his rival in the race for his best friend’s affection; but as the two of them find themselves reconnecting at an after-party all alone, their conversation isn’t the only things that grows deeper and deeper…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes prologue and one side story chapter.

Halloween. It might be a special day for some, but at the same time, it might be a meaningless day for others. Jin-Yeong, who lost his boyfriend, Eun-Chan, 3 years ago, spends his Halloween in the least special way possible. No wait, he was trying to spend it that way. So why did the dead Eun-Chan suddenly appear next to him after all this time?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

I have everything that I ever wanted. A big house, a nice job, and even a beautiful fiancée... However, ever since I ran into my first love, I would give it all up to be with her, even if it means cheating on my best friend...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

After losing his daughter Chaeyoon due to negligence, Cho Sunghyun plunges to his death and wakes up 10 years in the past!
