Vowing never to repeat his mistakes, Sunghyun gives up music to be a dad, driving his daughter to preschool and cooking for her. But what’s this? Chaeyoon plays piano without sheet music and sings with perfect pitch! Who would’ve thought she’d be a total prodigy?! Sunghyun is conflicted, though, given his trepidation about music… Should he let her play or press pause?

(Source: Tapas)

"Girls who exercise... really are different." Shortly after reuniting with his first love, he is invited to join a cycling club. However, what he didn't know is that the club only consists of the hottest girls!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

When Jae-Min couldn't find work, his friend persuaded him to work as a phone dealer. The cold calling got him to hang out with a bunch of women.

"Let's take our time and enjoy ourselves. Like adults."

(Source: DAYcomics)

The next-door student makes noise everyday, but one day, he asks a favor, "Ma'am, can you go out with me for a day?" I didn't know that one day would lead to this... And what is with this broadcast?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A former actress is determined to do anything to get back to the top, even if means going underground to the world of porn.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

As a fan of idol Ryu Seon-Jae, Im Sol was happy fangirling to her heart’s content. That is until one day, Seon-Jae is suddenly found dead. As she grieves, Sol discovers a curious pocket watch that takes her six years into the past. Before she knows it, Sol tracks down a teenage Seon-Jae, and the words “I freaking love you!” spill out. Now, he’s totally creeped out by her, but Sol must somehow win over Seon-Jae to stop history from repeating. With the clock ticking, can she save her future number one?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Walking in on your girlfriend cheating on you is tough. But when the cute girl next door offers to be your girlfriend for 3 weeks? And finish off all 17 fantasies on your bucket list? Well alright then. Maybe things aren't as bad as they seem.

(Source: DAYcomics)

“To me, you may not tell even a word of lie.”

Year five of the unified Chang Empire, San the emperor, who brought peace to the chaotic world, returns to Changchunsung, his home, in disguise. There he runs into Kang, a demigod cast out from heaven and living as a human, and senses a strong attraction. Kang tries to distance himself from San as in Chang, relationships between humans and demigods are forbidden, and he would be executed once his demigod identity was revealed. Unable to disobey the orders of the emperor, Kang decides instead to deceive San. What does San know, and what has Kang forgotten? Bound by a tremendous fate neither can refuse, their lives intertwine yet again.

(Source: NETCOMICS)

title.english: Flowers May Wither but You Remain

description:
At the ancestral estate of Glown Hall, plain and serious Helen Godwin is hired by the wealthy and powerful Somerset family to tutor the young master Henry. Among its dark and ancient halls, Helen hears whispers about a ghost, madness, and something more sinister the Somersets are hiding. It’s not long before she catches the eye of the womanizing Raymond, Henry’s older brother. Even though Helen isn’t the type Raymond usually goes for, something about her is too alluring for him to ignore…

(Source: Tapas)

If a stranger invits you to witness his sex experiment, what would you do? What if you were someone who was having sex problems after 10 years of marriage? Will your brain win out, or your dick?

(Source: DAYcomics)

After being involved in a car accident together, Hajin is asked by Sihyeon to take care of Sihyeon's younger sister after his death. Hajin never expected that to mean he would wake up in the hospital in Sihyeon's body instead of his own. Even worse, Sihyeon was an infamous idol who would do anything for money, had multiple sponsors, and was apparently about to abandon the boy band he was a part of to sign a new contract with a larger agency. At first, Hajin believes the public’s negative opinion about Sihyeon, but the more he learns about Sihyeon’s miserable circumstances, the more enraged he becomes. Determined to get revenge in Sihyeon’s stead, Hajin decides to reach out to an old acquaintance for help. However, the deeper he goes into his revenge plot, the more people he becomes entangled with...

(Source: Tappytoon)

A couple decides to move in together. That much sounds simple enough - except that it isn't when the whole apartment complex is crawling with zombies, werewolves, and succubi. He's a half-skeleton with a functioning lower body, while she's a full-on zombie, with mostly intact body parts. Still, you gotta watch out for the occasional nip- no, liver slip!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Everything in this beautiful mansion is full of mystery! "Never walk around after nine o'clock. Remember that."

(Source: Pocket Comics)

1. Migaebaryeongyeok (미개발영역) [Nire]
2. Hwanbureun An Dwaeyo! (환불은 안 돼요!) [Da-Sik]
3. Peach, Pitchi Tail (피치, 핏치 테일) [Yu-Je]
4. Magical ☆ Useless Gift (매지컬☆유즈리스 기프트) [Chaegu]
5. My Little Rabbit (마이 리틀 래빗) [Komello]

Is murdering to save lives justifiable?
Dr. Seo-U Han is targeted for revenge and ends up killing her attacker in self-defense. Her detective husband helps her dump the body and frame it as the work of a serial killer. The only problem? The real serial killer knows what they did, and is blackmailing them into committing more murders...

(Source: Manta, edited)

'I had a one night stand with the first person I met, but I got pregnant.'

Everytime this omega had a boyfriend, the relationship always ended up with him being cheated on and in the end, he even got crushed by hearing the words, “You are an omega, but I’m not attracted to you". Hae-Su, who was chugging alcohol while raging to his friend who comforted him, got wasted on a drug, and to make matters worse, his heat cycle started. Alpha Do-Geon, who was in the same pub, notices Hae-Su's condition and tries to help Haesoo and get him away from the place but he is seduced by Hae-Su's pheromones and they end up spending the night together.

In the morning, as soon as he wakes up, Hae-Su hastily ran away and finds out that he is pregnant 4 weeks later. Hae-Su decides to raise and make the child happy by himself. After 4 years, Hae-Su and Do-Geon are reunited...

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Jihoon’s always working. He needs to--there’s rent to pay, tuition to take care of, and hospital bills that need to be sorted out. His money problems don’t end when he gets into university, but he soon finds a way to pull himself up by his bootstraps. His part-time job at the girl’s dorm introduces him to a bunch of rich, spoiled, and sexy girls…all of whom want to have their way with him. Why would he say no? It’s his chance to climb up the social ladder, as well as sleeping with the most alluring girls in the school!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Office worker Mi-Rae just wants a happy life with her boyfriend. But how long can her dream last?

(Source: Toomics, edited)

title.english: The Boy Who Stole From the Fairy Lake

description:
My name is Hyosin Lee, and I just want to get one thing straight: I am not a thief! I ran away from home to escape my stifling household but ended up lost in the mountains where I found a pile of clothes. How was I supposed to know that they belonged to the very handsome half-fairy, San Baek? He has (reluctantly) let me stay with him because I was badly injured. He doesn’t talk much, but he’s kind and I like being with him… However, I know it won’t be long until my family finds me and when that happens… I’ll never be able to see San again!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 side story chapters

Jun-Gi is a short college student that dates Eun-Ju, a girl that is much taller than him. He is insecure about how she feels about him, but after a date he musters up the courage to invite her to spend the night with him. And that is when Eun-Ju finds out Jun-Gi's big secret. After a hot first time, their relationship improves and they spend many steamy nights together. Find out what naughty secrets Jun-Gi and some of the people around him are hiding in this romantic comedy.

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 1 special chapter.

It is 1866, the third year of King Go-Jong’s reign. It is also the second year Gyeom has been waiting for his lover, Jeong, who left to study literature. Finally, Jeong has come back after the two years. He tells Gyeom he can not afford to be happy in Joseon, and decides to leave for Qing (China)...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

After food critic Jiho’s first meeting with novelist Inwoo ends in disappointment, he vows never to work with him. That is until Inwoo offers to buy him dinner. It’s then that he learns that Inwoo is unable to experience one of life’s basic joys – taste – and needs someone to describe flavors to him for his next novel. The more they meet, the more Jiho finds himself being drawn to Inwoo... but why? Is it because he too harbors a secret of his own?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 10 side story chapters.

Six years ago, when Wu-Ju lost her father, she came across a kind-hearted alien in the mountains. Ever since then, she’s been an avid fan of aliens, but she pretends not to believe in their existence out of fear that her classmates will ostracize her. One day, Wu-Ju discovers a school club that meets her interests. She’s excited to finally share her passion for aliens with others, but she has no idea that this will be the beginning of her exciting romance with the student body president Hui-Mun, who has a secret of his own.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Hae-Jin's team is always at the bottom of the leaderboard. Mi-Ho, the new ace salesperson on Hae-Jin's team, is at odds with the inflexible Hae-Jin. "Team leader, you're too rigid". An ace saleswoman who sells every policy and a rigid team leader.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

One day, wallflower Kim Hye-Jin wakes up as her web novel counterpart, Maria, a maid who is ignored by... well, everyone. No one ever really notices her, as if she was a ghost, but Grand Duke Dietrich can't seem to take his eyes off her. Seeing his rival's interest in the girl, Prince Elias resolves to use her for his own advantage in the battle for the throne. As misunderstandings and mystery surrounding Maria grow, she's quickly going from invisible to intriguing to... potentially irresistible!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

He started writing erotic novels full of confidence, but his debut was a complete failure. However, when all hope seemed to be lost, he gets a chance to learn from the industry expert herself.

"Just do as I tell you. You need to know how a woman feels during sex!"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

I'll see you in court... I hope!

Yun-Shin Do is a young and compassionate lawyer who gets recruited by a corporate law firm. His boss, Se-Heon Kang, is a domineering partner who prioritizes paychecks and only looks out for himself. Will Yun-Shin be able to prove his worth in court and find a way to melt his boss's ice-cold heart?

(Source: Manta)

It’s only sleeping together while holding hands, nothing else. That’s what Shin Wooseo tells himself when a red ring that ties a person to their soulmate appears on his finger one day. Once two people get tied by the ring, they cannot fall asleep unless they’re physically together. However, his destined partner isn’t his long-term friend and secret crush, Kang Jiseok, but rather his older brother, Kang Jigeon! And so starts the tragedy of loving one brother but having to share beds with the other. Although, it might not entirely be a tragedy, as Kang Jigeon doesn’t seem so disappointed about being tied to his younger brother’s best friend…

(Source: Tappytoon)

“You may be rich, but that doesn’t mean you can just do whatever you want with others!” A young man with nothing to lose will do anything to rise to the top.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Hyeon is a talented young artist living in the Big Apple, though you'd never know it if you saw him cleaning hotel rooms or bussing tables at one of his many jobs. But despite his best efforts to keep his head down, trouble finds him when an invaluable item disappears from an important guest's room during one of his housekeeping shifts. Hyeon is then whisked into the depths of Room 605 where he meets Luwan, one of several people in a mysterious organization desperate to retrieve the missing item. While Hyeon is initially unable to contribute much to the search, Luwan finds himself drawn in by the young man's naïveté and wanting to give the sheltered artist a taste of the glamorous life. And as their encounters become more regular, Hyeon begins to see the roguishly charming Luwan as a muse.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seung-Won, who lost his memories in a car accident, possesses the body of Chu Sa-Hyeok, a supporting character in the novel "Jegal Unhwi". As soon as he opens his eyes, Seung-Won was having an affair with Ha Ji-Kwang, despite being completely oblivious to it and is under the impression that he is dreaming as he's on the verge of death. Somehow, he is unable to wake up from his dream and continues to live on as Chu Sa-Hyeok.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

title.english: Four Ways to Find a Wife

description:
It started with a chance encounter in a secluded garden. You know, your typical boy-meets-girl romance. So then, why does he keep chasing her down and asking to see her photos? And hold up—he’s advertising for a wife?! Jeong-Won just wants to survive her college years, but this business executive isn’t making it easy! She doesn’t have time for distractions between taking care of her siblings, working part-time, and studying for classes. But there’s another thing bothering her... who is the mysterious person leaving her notes?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Ever wonder what having sex with a werewolf would be like? How about a vampire? Well, Hyunee and Mina are two normal girls, but when things get hot and heavy they’re not afraid to let their animalistic sides come out! Driving their boyfriends crazy, there’s always another sex romp around the corner. Come along for the ride, where in each episode, you can see a different “monstrous” side of these hot girls and really see what “Her Nickname is…”!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Nam Gun-min has been having vivid, X-rated dreams almost every night for the past week. These aren’t your run of the mill, typical sexy dreams filled with hot women. No, these dreams keep featuring Jeong Hu, a close sunbae who Gun-min previously had zero sexual attraction to. Gun-min manages to wake up in the middle of one of these torturous dreams only to find real man at the end of his bed. To make matters worse, that man isn’t even Jeong Hu, but the strange underclassman he had just met earlier that night, only now he's dressed like a devil. Why does he look so....good?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

The first in the "Sexcape Room" series!
Eun-Hyuk finds himself in a room with his old crush and muse, Anna. Since the two parted on bad terms, the situation isn’t ideal. But if that isn’t bad enough, turns out that in order to get out of this room, they need to…have sex! With so much on the line, will the two be able to break out?

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

The four of us are friends, but do friends sleep with each other...?

(Source: Toomics)

The fourth in the “Sexcape Room” series!
Kang-San and Sophia are both hardcore gamers who’ve been warped into a strange room together. The catch? They must have sex within the allotted time or else they’ll lose the ability to use their ultimate in-game weapons! Without their power-ups, their dreams of becoming professional gaming streamers are toast. Will these two strangers be able to pull it off in time…?

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)
The fifth in the "Sexcape Room" series!

The third in the “Sexcape Room” series!
Eun-Sung and So-Ra are old childhood friends. They’re trapped in a room and are only allowed to leave if they have sex. However, another stipulation has complicated things further: If they don’t do it within three hours, Eun-Sung’s weiner will snap off! Will these lifelong friends bite the bullet and do the deed to break out or will Eun-Sung lose his schlong forever?

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

After years of abuse at the hands of those who covet her title as heir to one of the seven great families, Aileen Spade discovers that the red eye she was shamed into hiding all her life is really the source of her family’s great magical power. Ready to reclaim her strength, she enters the magic academy, where she quickly becomes popular with her peers, the protagonist, and… the prince! But when she’s fated to become the story’s tragic villain, will popularity be enough to turn her life around?

(Source: Tapas)

Dojin and Yeonwoo are in the same homeroom. Yeonwoo is the class rep and a bright, diligent kid. Dojin looks intimidating but he’s actually just misunderstood. For some odd reason, Dojin has been becoming more and more aware of this strange, sprightly kid in his class. As fate would have it, they bump into each other after school one day. Yeonwoo describes to Dojin his most pressing problem in life: he’s bored. Dojin makes Yeonwoo a promise that he’ll be the freshness and excitement in his life whenever he needs to feel something new. But when Dojin innocently grazes Yeonwoo, there seems to be an electric warmth that shocks him. As these two grow closer and closer, to what degree will their intimacy develop? What will this warmth between them become?

(Source: Lezhin)

My sister, Rain, is beautiful, smart, and nice. She's a perfect and lovely sister. But you'll never guess what I found in her diary.

(Source: Toomics)

It’s been a while since all androids have been outlawed. Soojung’s never been one for technology, let alone androids. So it’s a big surprise when her sister gets her a new job… and it’s to keep an eye on her illegal android. Soojung feels uncomfortable around him as it is. He’s weirdly too polite, has no emotion in his eyes, and he hasn’t even got a name. But what Soojung doesn’t know yet is that she’s going to change all that. And what’s more, this android is going to change her life too, in more ways than one…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

The story takes place in the world-famous online VR game, ‘Quest Hero’.

A famed player of Quest Hero, ‘Harang’ ends up being taken to another world by a mysterious black entity. No matter how much he tries, he can’t log out, and he’s even attacked. Not only can he feel pain, he meets the real ‘Yuta’ and not the NPC Yuta. Can Harang complete the ‘7 Quests’ and return home safely?

Thus begins the tale of the ‘Teenage Swordsman’ Harang, who fell into an unfamiliar world!

title.english: Love is an Illusion! - The Queen

description:
Free-spirited Alpha Do-Gyeom has finally decided to put her promiscuous past behind her and settle down. As a 39-year-old woman, however, her options for marriage partners have dwindled. Luckily she has her beleaguered Omega secretary, Seung-Ah, to do most of the work of finding a suitable match for her. It shouldn’t be a problem, even if Seung-Ah and Do-Gyeom have harbored secret feelings for each other for years. In fact, arranging Do-Gyeom’s marriage may just be the catalyst for the two of them to finally admit their attraction…unless another Alpha gets in the way!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side stories.

title.english: My Husband, My Sister, and I

description:
“I taste her on your lips.”

On the night of our fourth wedding anniversary, I witnessed my husband having an affair. "I love you," he told my twin sister as he laid on top of her. This can't just end easily with a divorce. No, I'll make them pay for this.

(Source: Manta)

Sean must find out Janey's secret, before his boss fires him!

(Source: Toomics)

By day, Cheong-Hyeon is the picture of professionalism: calm, composed, and the ideal boss. To his assistant Tae-in, he’s the definition of cool. But behind the scenes? Cheong-Hyeon is a full-blown BL otaku! One day, something unexpected happens: Tae-in starts to resemble the main character from Cheong-Hyeon’s favorite series a little too closely... As fantasy and reality begin to blur, Cheong-Hyeon finds himself falling - and feeling - hard for his real-life leading man.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes nine extra chapters.

One frigid December dawn, Song Yeon-woo meets an injured runaway alpha; inexplicably drawn toward his woodsy scent, he is compelled to help the young man. Despite his aversion to alphas due to trauma in his past, Yeon-woo somehow feels safe and welcomed in his presence. The two part in the moonlight, never to see one another again...but fate has other plans. Two years later, Yeon-woo has finally returned to the city to begin anew—still wary of alphas around him, he has built barriers in nearly every aspect of his life to keep himself safe. But when that a familiar scent begins to pierce through his boundaries, Yeon-woo is unable to stop himself from following them in pursuit of something thrilling...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seoul in the 1980s is an exciting place to be…that is, unless you’re Seong-Ho. His pushy father expects him to do nothing but study, so day in and out Seong-Ho buries himself in his books, oblivious to all the exciting new things happening in town. There’s one thing that’s been distracting him, though: these unidentifiable migraines that just won’t go away, no matter how many meds Seong-Ho takes. One day, after a particularly painful headache, he finds himself kissing a stranger. Horrified and appalled by his transgression, Seong-Ho immediately tries to erase that unfortunate happening from his memory. That would be the end of that, but…what if kissing is the only way to get rid of his migraines?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 side stories.

Jin-Seong has always had a crush on his next door neighbor, Yu-Ra, ever since they were kids. Due to unforeseen circumstances, they had to move in together and they practically became brothers. Jin-Seong eventually gave up the thought of ever becoming Yu-Ra’s lover because Yu-Ra would draw a line in the sand each time he tried to reveal his feelings. But one night, Yu-Ra’s behavior begins to change. He seems to be turning into a different person in the evening...someone with an insatiable lust for the physical… Jin-Seong has to admit, a side of him does enjoy his feelings being reciprocated, but this feels wrong and unsustainable. What’s gotten into Yu-Ra and is there something more sinister at play…?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes 25 side story episodes.

Taeyoung’s always treated girls like crap. But after waking up one day to find a “lady-hole” on his ribcage, he slowly starts to gain a deeper understanding of the female experience. And luckily (or not) his ex-girlfriend is on-hand to speed up the process. Join Lizzy as she drags Taeyoung on a depraved journey of sexual discovery…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su-Han still misses his ex-girlfriend Ju-Ri, who left him without saying goodbye. One day, Su-Han runs into Ju-Ri, who is now his boss's fiancé. What will be the fate of the three...?

(Source: DAYcomics)

If the sexy toys you ordered for “research” end up at your neighbor’s house, and your neighbor happens to be a gorgeous actor willing to help you test them out, well… It’d be a waste not to, right? Shy BL author, Eujae Lim, just wanted to live a quiet life, but Jinhoo Park wants to be his male lead.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three extra chapter.

Essie Ash can see how and when people will die. One day, she finds an injured man in her backyard and discovers that he is Prince Pell. To her shock, she notices that her parents' and other residents' death dates have moved up since Pell's arrival. Essie asks him to leave, hoping things will change, but changes her mind when Pell saves her from his brother's assassins. She soon decides to join him on his journey to the capital, but can't help but wonder why she's the cause of his future death...

(Source: Tapas)

Marianne Pon Cling, a beloved daughter of house Cling and the wife of marquess Chester, was betrayed and murdered by her husband one gloomy night because she knew about the marquess's plot against the emperor. When she was brought back to life, she decides to pay a visit to the emperor to report her husband's future coup, the emperor makes the offer that she can't refuse. "Be my fiancee and spy on marquess."

(Source: Pocket Comics)

When the daughter of the Erdona barony is forced to marry the infamous Duke Noel Felton, her loyal servant Grace McClean saves the day… by posing as the duke’s 99th bride-to-be! She’s doing her best to impress her fiancé by making him treats, rescuing a child, and even befriending the imperial princess! All seems well, until one day, Grace stumbles upon the duke’s journal and learns about his master plan... Will Grace survive her marriage? And what does the duke have in store for the empire?

(Source: Tapas)

Bizzare phenomena all over the continent struck fear in the mighty Guelle empire. A sacrifice must be made to appease the heavens. How convenient is it that the royal throne just put out an announcement that they're looking for a tribute bride of noble birth with a hefty sum of money as reward? Enter Valia Dean, who just overcame her second near-death experience as a destitute orphan. In order to save Karl, the senile mercenary who raised her in her late parents' absence, Valia volunteers to marry Marquess Shuden Gartt, whose reputation for massacre pales in frightfulness to the coldness of his gaze. Valia, hardened by misfortune, orphancy, starvation, and betrayal, accepts what seems to be certain death. Even in marriage, she will not love. It won't matter how handsome, rich, gentle, chivalrous, and caring he is, or how lovingly he behaves as her husband, right?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: What's Wrong With Your Online Life?

description:
As far as eligible bachelors go, most people would call Lee Ho-Jin a “real catch.” But like any young professional in the 21st century, he has a well-kept secret. Lee Ho-Jin (alias: Scholar10) is an insecure internet troll who prowls an Internet forum where people post the craziest everyday stories they can come up with. On the other side of town, a pretty but sheltered girl named Han Seo-Jeong is active on the same forum. When she’s online, Seo-Jeong adopts the persona of “Omo,” a vulgar and extroverted young man. Ho-Jin and Seo-Jeong, who are already bonded anonymously through the website, become intertwined in real life when they are paired up to potentially be married. When both parties have ulterior motives for their prospective marriage, can either one make their wish come true?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Ever find the one that got away? Ha-Rim and Eun-Ju are old high school classmates who never got to fulfill their desires of being with each other. After graduating, they went their separate ways. But one day, they bump into each other and old flames get rekindled. Things are about to get hot and heavy, but there’s just one thing. This stud has prioritized athletics above all else, meaning Eun-Ju will have to show him the ropes in bed. Will they experience the ultimate high-intensity bedroom “booty camp” or will Ha-Rim’s obsession with fitness get in the way of everything?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Gong Seok-Hyun is the boss of the Baekho Organization. Cha Moo-Young was its executive and has been loyal to the group since childhood. He was also Seok-Hyun's lover. But suddenly Moo-Young betrays the group and moves to the Viper Faction. Seok-Hyun thinks of finding him and killing him. But then changes his mind as he can’t give up on his beloved Moo-Young, so he secretly meets with him. As he deepens his relationship with him, he tries to find out the truth behind Moo-Young’s mysterious actions.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Peter starts working at a factory, where he finds more than just a job...

(Source: Toomics)

Cheon Muji-Chee, the only son of the Hebei thousand swords family and the grandson of King Kwon. Cheon Seong, the lazy young master of the heavenly swordsman. He wants to become an imperial scholar, but the world pushes him to the top.

“My dream is to become a scholar….
How long do I have to be like this?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Kyungho was an ordinary cook before being abducted and forced to fight off a demon invasion in another realm. Years later, he returns to his world, only to find it swarming with monsters. To make matters worse, he discovers that his mother and Earth's guardian deity, Carnis de Lupus, are dying. In order to save them and the world, Kyungho offers to serve Carnis revitalizing meals in return for healing his mother. But does Kyungho have what it takes to be both a hero and a cook?

(Source: Tapas)

As a lonely orphan and a corporate heir, the lives of Seo Yeon-Woo and Lee Seok-Heon couldn’t be any more different. Due to this, Yeon-Woo has been unable to refuse Seok-Heon’s advances to be his sex partner. But as Seok-Heon’s grandfather was the one to take Yeon-Woo in when she was orphaned, the guilt of sleeping with her savior’s grandson weighs heavily on her mind. She finally draws the line when Seok-Heon pulls out a wedding ring, professing that he’s willing to go against his family’s wishes and marry Yeon-Woo. No longer wanting to become a burden to those around her, Yeon-Woo decides to pack her bags and run far away. But just when everything seems okay, Yeon-Woo learns that she has an unexpected baby on the way…

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes a prologue.

“The emperor devours men,” the servants in the palace whisper. Han doesn’t believe them, until on his very first day of service he is dragged to the emperor’s bedchambers. Hunger and lust drives the tyranny that is rampant in the palace. Will Han be able to sate the tyrant and change him for the better?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rainier Cavalier is a handsome duke burdened with an enormous debt. Henrietta Cortez is a wealthy yet neglected heiress. When Rainier’s friend suggests that he “bride-kidnap” Henrietta as a means to relieve his financial woes, he does just that. However, he wasn’t expecting Henrietta to be so beautiful, nor was he expecting her to propose a marriage of convenience that would improve both their lives. Are these two merely business partners in this unusual arrangement? Or could deeper feelings blossom from a simple “marriage by capture?"

(Source: Tapas)

They call her a monster… but to this admiral, she’s a sacred descendant of the sea! Rudia Flang has been mistreated her whole life, so when the emperor arranges her marriage to Alexander Cilia, war hero and the youngest admiral in history, she cowers in fear at the thought of marrying a violent seaman. As this ocean voyage treks on, she’s met with benevolence from the Sercilian Island people who, unbeknownst to her, find the scales glistening on her body far from the marking of a monster...

(Source: Tapas)

The monsters take everything away from a boy and keep him captive as their food. He grits his teeth and seeks revenge, but human strength isn’t enough to beat the monsters. At that moment, a monster hunter appears…

Ju Hee-yeon, the newly crowned emperor of the powerful Jewon Empire, possesses unparalleled authority and control over everything…except for one persistent affliction: an unrelenting fever, borne from his condition to carry the powers of the dragon. As his fevers worsen and desperation takes hold, an unexpected remedy presents itself in the form of Yeo-heun, a half-goblin rumored to possess the ability to absorb and nullify others’ heat. Intrigued, Hee-yeon seeks solace in an enchanting night shared with Yeo-heun. However, the emperor soon finds himself captivated beyond his expectations by the goblin’s endearing charm. As time passes and Hee-yeon recognizes deeper feelings stirring within his own heart, he begins to question if his infatuation with Yeo-heun is truly only a consequence of the heat of the moment…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

After a decade of service, rescue worker Kim Soohyuk meets his demise while on duty. But just when everything seems like it's over, Soohyuk finds himself back in his rookie days! He's also got some new tricks up his sleeve, from mysterious pop-up windows to special abilities and even memories of his past life! And after a selfless act makes him a local hero, Soohyuk is determined to be better. This time, he intends to rescue everyone... especially the ones he failed to save before.

(Source: Tapas)

Yeon-Ju and Jae-Ho are business and sex partners. Their partnership is shaken by a blind date proposal sent by Jae-Ho's friend pretending to be Jae-Ho to Yeon-Ju.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

A college student, Wu-Suk decides to work out at a gym after getting dumped by a girl. One day, a hot girl with amazing body approaches him and tries to seduce him! "Hey, wanna grab a drink after workout?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Shi-hyuk truly had it all. He was good-looking and could get any woman he wanted. But all that changed when one night, he just couldn’t get it up! What’s going on down there?! Defeated, all Shi-hyuk can do is take his L for now. But then, at home, something strange has begun to happen. A weird sensation has started to come over him, like somebody is aggressively touching his junk…! Visibly aroused, Shi-hyuk can’t let his roommate, Hyunwoo, see him in such a vulnerable state. But wait, could it be? Those trick-or-treaters last Halloween… Was their “trick” a hex?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Clive's best friend is quite the catch. After a little incident, things seem to grow apart, but his friend has a secret crush on him!

(Source: Toomics)

Although Ilene Jung is a popular webtoon artist, she needs another job. A crappy desk job to be exact, one tyrannically controlled by the meanest manager in the world: Jim Kang. He insults her work, refuses to teach her, and even makes her miss an important appointment by forcing her work late on her very first day. To make things worse, when Jim applies to become an artist’s assistant, the artist turns out to be Ilene! In a begrudging twist of fate, she accepts him and the two enter a bizarre working relationship both at home and at the office. How long can it last? Why is Ilene working a desk job? And who’s the boss here anyways?!

(Source: Tapas)

Thousands years ago, she was a little tree fairy falling in love with the Water God. After that infructuous one-sided love, she opened a dessert shop and met many strange customers, each of whom shared a story...

The Yiqi who sees the other personal memories when they lock lips, falls in love with a time traveling prince. In order to retrieve his memories, the prince kisses her without hesitation. And the person in his memories looks exactly like Yiqia. Hurry and read this kissing-from-beginning-to-end manhua, an excellent time-travel story full of embarrassing and slightly masochistic scenes.
A couple enters a bookstore, but it turns out to be more than just your run-of-the-mill bookstore.

As a personal trainer, what Li Xiu has to do is get his members out of imperfection! Female star with low back pain? Come and get two private lessons, youthful vitality radiant! The female president has a stomachache? Come and go, take my private lessons. There are no imperfect women in this world, if there is, it is because they have not met me.

title.romaji: Xiao Jiejie Qianwan Bie Re Wo

description: Due to the betrayal of his close friend and girlfriend, college student Wang Ming sunk into the lowest point in his life. During the time he was at his lowest, he had many conflicts out of anger and a will to strike back with the campus belle who he was co-renting with. However, it was also at this time when he was accidentally drawn into a series of conspiracies and contacted the hidden witchcraft society behind modern society. After the evolving Gǔ insect 'Gold Silkworm Gǔ' treated him as its host, he became unceasingly stronger and each and every formidable enemy also continued to emerge from the depths....

The Gods created the Heavens, Hell, and the Human world, and the Gods also created Angels, but what if the Gods are wrong? You once said that as long as I live, we can meet again...I will wait forever, even in the depths of Hell, waiting for our love that is not blessed by the Gods.

In an attempt to save her senior whom she is secretly in love with, Su Mi approached Fu Yichen to seek his help. In a dramatic turn of events, Fu Yichen requested for her freedom and imprisoned her by his side in exchange for his help.

(Source: Webnovel)

Xu Zaoyue, who had just become a comic editor in charge of an artist for the first time, met an eccentric comic artist who looked like a duck. After starting into her eyes, it turned out to be an illusion. Later it she discovered that the ghost stories drawn by the artist were all based on real events, including her worldview. The spiritual world and the wheel of fate have drawn the two into an unknown journey…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

People have all sorts of mistaken impressions in life: their cell phones feels like it's vibrating, is someone is knocking on the door, or is someone following me...

But the most embarrassing mistake of all must be: I think he likes me!

For example, I thought that you had a crush on me, but I didn't expect you just wanted me for my body.

Another example: I finally have evidence that you have a crush on me, because I... But it turns out that even before I paid attention to you, you already liked me.

This is a collection of stories about people who think that they are secretly in love, but are actually quite obvious.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Li Chu transmigrated to Shilipo and became an ordinary Taoist. In this world filled with ghosts and demons, he was content to stay safe in Shilipo and live an ordinary life. Until one day he was forced to get involved with the wuxia world. And then he found out that you can solve most problems in this world with one slash of the sword. And if one slash won't do it, try two.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zhongzi Yu Shi Ri Shi Ye

description:
The story of "Ah Chu and You Xin", of witnessing certain death and uncertain love. Where sorrow and hope overlap, their feelings begin to bud.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.romaji: Bei Yaoguai Baowei De Wo Jian Daoliao Xiao Monü
title.native: 被妖怪包围的我捡到了小魔女

description:
The first apprentice is gentle and virtuous, the second apprentice is cool and dumb, the third apprentice is quirky, the fourth apprentice is lively and lovely… but they are trying to harm me so what should I do? Of course is to find an obedient and understanding girl, and let others regret life!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

An adaptation of the novel by Jin Yong.

When Chuang Wang seized Peking, the remaining generals of the Ming Dynasty surrendered and gave up their wealth as ransom, piling up a mountain of treasure. When Chuang Wang retreated from the capital, he sent his most trusted lieutenants to hide the treasure somewhere beyond the Great Wall, intending to use it eventually to raise an army for a comeback.

In the 45th year of the Qianlong Emperor (1780), three groups fought a fierce battle somewhere in Changbai Mountains over a treasure chest. The chest not only held clues about the location of Chuang Wang's treasure, it also revealed the past history of Chuang Wang's four lieutenants and the relationship between them. A complex tale that spanned generations.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

An 18th-tier actor from a fallen family signs a contract with a cold-faced CEO to pay off debts, only to find the deal involves posing as his fiancée and marrying him?! Expecting a lavish life as a trophy wife, she’s instead met with constant scheming and relentless challenges. External threats pile up, while internal troubles never cease—her own father and stepmother plot against her, and childhood sweethearts turn treacherous! Watch how Luo Jiayue navigates dangers, turns the tables, and transforms from a stand-in to the real deal!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

This sounds like a thrilling dystopian saga where a cataclysm turns the world into a wasteland. Some people find refuge in fortresses, others hide in the wilderness, and some transform into different beings due to radiation. The world is divided into two extremes: the elite possess advanced technology, using fortresses to isolate themselves from the chaos.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

In the Han Dynasty of Ancient China, there was a little county beside Han called Lou Lan. Lou Lan gave Han their prince and princess as a sign of friendship. But years later, they killed one of Han's peacemaker. The emporer of Han was very mad and wanted to kill the prince and the princess. But their childhood friend, also the royal protector of the empire gave them his gate pass and let them go. With that, the prince and the princess started their long journey back to Lou Lan...

(Source: Sherbet Lemon)

Are you single? Are you an otaku? Would you like to buy a "wife"? Do you fantasize about eating, having fun, shopping, and sleeping with her? Can you promise to take responsibility and love her for a lifetime? Would you use your life to pay for a contract? A fantasy that belongs only to you; a maid that belongs only to you.

title.english: Time to Save the World, Old-Timer!

description:
The 29-year-old uncle died of saving people, and then god on a whim gave him a chance to save the world.
Let him go to the primitive world and cultivate to become God.

The Doomsday War destroyed the original human civilization. The surviving people built a new city-state in the devastated land. In the city of ember, Duanmu Ye Yu joined the armed mercenary Hell Hunter. And there goes off his adventure in this doomed world.

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Chong Sheng Cheng Lianren De Siduitou Zenmeban
title.native: 重生成恋人的死对头怎么办

description:
Lu Xili had cancer and only had three months to live. He unexpectedly ran into his first love Chen Junge at the hospital. Lu thought the meeting was fate, but he saw that Chen already had a boyfriend. Three months after his sad death, Lu Xili was reborn into the body of his first love's boyfriend. That was when he discovered that they weren't a couple at all, but they were actually bitter rivals... the journey to get together with his love will be longer than he thought!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

An impetuous action brought a mysterious partner. He's clearly dangerous, but it's hard to not sink deeper and deeper... If lovers and enemies are destined to be, do they choose to turn against each other? Or do they sink deeper into the abyss?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and two extras.

Ping Zhang is a poor but smart man who sells noodles and is a candidate for the imperial exam. He impresses Vice-Minister Lan after showing off his skill and wit in solving cases and mysteries.

A mystery series where a poor man turns into a brilliant detective who faces difficult cases

(Source: INKR)

The story of the cold young master and the boy his family adopted, Ji Bie.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Arans, who had the best chance of taking the throne, was stabbed in the back by his most trusted subordinate, Volek, during the election campaign, and he was reduced from a high-ranking lord to Volek's concubine. However, Volek's betrayal was actually due to hypnosis by someone with ulterior motives, which magnified his desires and indulged his own means. But when he woke up, he found that he had hurt the person he loved the most and pulled him down from the altar with his own hands. In order to win back his lover, he begins to "chase his wife to the crematorium".

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: "Chase a wife to the crematorium" is an idiom meaning that someone who had once treated another badly before subsequently falling in love with them now has to endure all kinds of hardships in order to win them over.

title.romaji: Chuan Shuhou Yu Shi Zun Ersan Shi

description:
After transmigration, both the protagonist and his master's original personas have gone out the window!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In his past life, Wen Yu loved Ji Anning deeply, but his dominant and indomitable behavior made Ji Anning view him with fear and distrust. After Ji Anning accidentally fell from a building, Wen Yu took revenge for her and ended up being arrested.

Reborn, Ji Anning tries to avoid Wen Yu, fearing that he will repeat the same mistakes, but, little by little, she begins to recognize his sincerity as he insists on staying by her side. When he reaches his lowest point, she comforts him. In the end, the two, who have gone through great changes, join forces to face the storms of life and rewrite the destiny of this new life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.english: My Sister Is Out to Destroy the World

description:
What do I do? I think my sister is plotting to destroy the world! Recently, my sweet and adorable sister suddenly became strangely irritable and violent. According to my investigations, not only has my sister become involved in a murder, she is also possessed by a witch from a thousand years ago! Now, my sister seems to be plotting to destroy the world! What’s worse, my sister is trying to pin the blame on me. She even told me that the food in prison is delicious and that there is good company in there! What am I supposed to do as an ordinary person?!

(Source: Bilibili Comic)

On November 18, 2021, there was a baffling case of murder. The victim is a businessperson, and the killer is an artist. Caught in despair, the artist tries to kill herself, but the attempt fails…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

What? An innocent boy was forcibly kissed? And was dragged into the dispute for the “Arcane Netherstone”. The “Arcane Netherstone” is the key to unlocking humanity’s secrets and he has obtained some kind of special power from it, an ability that seems to allow him to live with any girl at will?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

You are a warrior, tactician, and general. Lead your troops to glory and your name will be known in infamy. Fail and watch as the sands of time destroy everything you built. Your time is close upon hand may you reign long.

When Liang Si Che was 17, he was chosen by the famous film director Cao Xiu Yuan to live with his son Cao Ye, in order to gain life experience and prepare him for a role in Cao's film. After 3 months of living together, the two teenagers became close, but only one person could star as the male lead. They both secretly planned give the opportunity to the other, but in the end, Cao Ye gave up the audition so Liang Si Che could fulfill his dream of becoming a famous actor. Soon after, Cao Ye fought with his father, but Liang Si Che did not support him, and due to a misunderstanding, Cao Ye decides to go abroad.

Ten years later, the two cross paths once again on a film set. Can the misunderstanding be resolved...?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Wo Jiang Mai Zang Zhong Shen

description:
After a brutal attack destroys the Demonic Sect, fifteen-year-old Lin Shouxi flees to a deserted city. There, he uncovers dark secrets from his past and his link to a mysterious calamity. As the Daoist Sect hunts for him and a powerful artifact, Lin faces new challenges that could change everything.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo De Shanghai You Yi Diandian Gao

description:
When the game world and merged with the blue Earth, a new era dawns. Zhou Yi was transmigrated to this world as a low-level rogue, but something wasn’t right about his skills. The Eye of Death: All damage is multiplied by five and becomes true damage? Now he's dealing 9999 with one flick of his knife? The Hand of God: Always successful at pick-pocketing., and you can even steal the monster's attributes and skills? Zhou Yi decides he won't just be an ordinary character anymore. See that boss-level monster? One-shot!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Born from humble beginnings and with only average talent, the young Luo Xiu's destiny is changed forever when he unexpectedly fuses with an ultimate treasure forged from the very essence of the laws of life and death. Now, with the legendary Wheel of Life and Death of the Myriad Realms hidden within him, he seizes control of reincarnation itself. He will forge his own supreme techniques, become a Great Emperor of his era, and stand proudly above all, past and present.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Yun Ge meets a boy in the desert, and they promised to reunite once she is in Chang'An. Years later, Yun Ge visits Chang'An, but the boy she met doesn't remember her or the promise. Though saddened that the boy doesn't remember her, she gets tangled in obstacles involving him.

(Source: INKR)

Lin Qingfeng, an ordinary college student, was once abandoned by Lin family as a nobody. In a supernatural event, he met Lin Zhaoxing, the top genius. When participating in the gatherings of heroes, Lin Zhaoxing accidentally died, and the soul was accidentally sucked into the body of Lin Qingfeng... In order to help Lin Zhaoxing reborn, he began an adventure in the foreign world...

(Source: WebComics)

Lin Xueer is a widow who is being protected by a man named Qin Mo, a martial artist. In the face of danger, Lin Xueer and Qin Mo escaped to the Ten Thousand Beast Forest. As the two are in the forest, they attract dangerous demons and Lin Xueer awakens a power within her!

(Source: INKR)

Meet Jerry and Lok. They are two young guys in their twenties, working in the competitive world of advertising in Hong Kong. Their "sport" of choice is chasing girls, keeping a score for each, constantly searching for that elusive 100%. Follow their journey filled with blood, sweat, tears, and laughter—even a mini marathon. The search for perfection has never been more fun!

(Source: Bamboo Press)

On 26 August 2008, Feel 100% won the Second International Manga Award.

A naked hunk appeared, out of nowhere, in my house... and he can control ice?! Thus, the money-minded female master now uses him as a moneymaking machine. They slowly fall in love with each other after being together, but the 'Snow Man' has a condition that makes him unable to love. How will they overcome this problem and will they find true love?

Note: Includes a prologue and 8 side stories.

Despite being a lowly palace eunuch, Bi Xie possesses the brilliance of a strategist who is able to assist the Emperor in reclaiming feudal lands, expelling the Huns and bringing peace to the nation. He soon garnered the loyal support of various ambitious and talented men by his side.

However, his motives are hidden deep underneath his impeccable façade as he is harboring a deep family grudge against the imperial family...

title.english: Our Young Master's Plans Are Infallible

description:
Jiang Qiu was trying to climb over a school wall to skip class when he fell and killed himself! A moment later he awakes and finds that he has transmigrated into the Daxu Dynasty as a young master of the Jiang family. His biological mother passed away when he was young while his stepmother and brother do whatever they please in the house. In order to escape his stepmother and brother's evil schemes, and to prove his own worth, he decides to work hard and forge his own path toward the peak of life. One day, he will become a winner of life itself...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Gebi Di Gege Hen Nan Zhui

description:
"Confess to my best friend?! NO!!"

Male model Xu Xui got sucked into the body of a young girl called Wu Xiaogu. In order to return to his own body, he must help Wu Xiaogu confess to her crush. But then he realizes that Xiaogu's crush is his very own best friend...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

As if it's not bad enough that I, the imperious CEO, has lost my memory, all because of that pretentious village girl. She even dares to pretend to be my wife! Well, if you say I'm your husband, I'm going to start acting like it!

(Source: Tencent, translated))

title.english: I Allow You to be with Me

description:
"Celebrity has-been Ji Tangtang robbed Xia Zhou of his manhood! How is the award-winning actor going to live it down?" That's a huge piece of breaking news that has shaken the entertainment industry! No, no, that's a rumor! Ji Tangtang, a washed-up celebrity whose name hasn't been on the public’s lips for years, goes viral after accidentally knocking Xia Zhou down...

(Source: WebComics)

It is history the usual Chinese schoolboy who will of destiny has appeared it is involved in war between the worlds. And all has begun that he has seen strange vision... Two monsters reminding a bird and a scorpion, battled with the friend the friend... Both the sky has darkened, and the earth shuddered... And here our hero wakes up and sees the boy with blue hair... Which sat on a roof of the house and sang to pigeons. But at the boy the secret... What for force it is hidden in him? Also what it for the clown? A smile at him is obvious not the kind...

Adapted from the novel of the same name by the famous web-novel author Wuzui. Wei Suo, a low-level small casual cultivator in Lingyue City, was unfortunately deceived during a transaction and obtained a broken low-level magic weapon. But in this broken magic weapon that is worthless, there is a spirit that has lived for tens of thousands of years. As a blessing in disguise, Wei Suo’s adventure journey begins...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Tang Xiaoxiao brokenhearted of her boyfriend. Oh, no, ex-boyfriend! On that rainy night, she was pestered by a super handsome man! It should be a romantic love story with the overwhelming president, but that wasn't what we thought.... he is a VAMPIRE! Worse still, he just regarded her as his mobile blood bag! Damn it! No way! Half a month later, Tang Xiaoxiao was tangled by the vampire again. This time, he is was a slightly gaunt. "Tang Xiaoxiao, you can't run away again!"

(Source: WebComics)

Lu QingQing helped a girl on the first day of school but unexpectedly brought troubles to herself. To help the girl, she provoked one of the four masters of Emperor High -- MuYi Chen and became the public enemy. Her schoolmates played pranks on her and bullied her. She tried to roll with punches but life really tore her apart. In the tug of war with Lu QingQing, she found out that he had changed his attitude towards her...

(Source: Webcomics)

The emotional entanglement between Lin ChenXiu, a video gamer captain, with a gloomy childhood, and Yu Moxiang, a dedicated and enthusiastic team player. The story begins with the two bravely fighting forward in an under-optimized team.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.english: Don't Mess with that Spicy Mother

description:
In Zhuang Ling's heart, Shu Bohang had always been his number one enemy. Bohang caused his family to fall apart, and he even kept him by his side using love as an excuse. He thought that no matter what came upon Shu Bohang, it was well deserved. He wouldn't sympathize, nor love him. But when Bohang passed away due to an accident, he found out that not everything is as it seems to be...

(Source: Webcomics)

Note: Chapter count includes 25 extras

Betrayed by her family five years ago, she lost her loved ones and her lover. But a genius baby was left with her. She vowed to revive her life, but didn't expect to meet the fateful man, Huo Tingchen. "We don't know each other!" "You stole my seed and wanna run away?" "Who stole your what?" Alas, her son is just a mini-version of this man, only cuter and smarter.

(Source: MangaToon)

When she was 3, he was 10; she called him brother. When she was 8, she was 17; she slept with him on the same bed. When she was 17, he was 24, and she threw a shoe on his face, calling him "dad of my baby"! "What!!!" Lixing Ji, 24, male, President of Ji's Group, afraid of nobody and nothing but the little devil girl who has tortured him for 14 years. Even worse, he started to feel something else towards her...

(Source: MangaToon)

title.romaji: Nuan Hun Liao Ren, Gushao Chong Qi Shangyin
title.native: 暖婚撩人，顾少宠妻上瘾

description:
Xia Weiyi's chivalrous dreamlover proposed to her obnoxious step-sister. In a pit of temper, Weiyi married her childhood sweetheart Gu Yiran - a decision she regretted to make immediately... "Gu Yiran, that was a mistake! I want a divorce!" "It's too late. Now that I've got a hold of you, I'll never let you go!" The girl who wanted to run away didn't expect that she would slowly fall into the sweep trap this scheming president wove.

(Source: Webcomics)

Youyan the bartender has been investigating and looking for the truth behind his parents’ death in "The Lab" but has found no clues. By chance, he meets external forensic doctor Chiyu, employed by the Investigation Bureau. As the two men get caught in an interracial murder scheme, they make it past the mutual suspicion and temptations to become partners and work their way towards the truth.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

What would happen when a man once in special forces met a rebellious girl? By accident, she became his only love. She lost everything overnight because of him and thus became his beloved person, coddling her all his life.

(Source: Webnovels)

One is an Alpha with delayed differentiation, the other is an Omega forced by life's circumstances. Both pretend to be tough, endure hardships, and still love each other!

Seven years ago, on a rainy night, Tang Zhong held a new backpack in his left hand and an umbrella in his right. Standing on the steps, he looked down at Yin Chen and said in a voice colder than the rain falling on them, "Let's not meet again in the future."

Seven years later, on the same rainy night, Tang Zhong appeared downstairs at Yin Chen's apartment building, soaked and disheveled, but he raised his face and smiled brightly: "Didn't you say that if I ever had nowhere else to go, I could come find you anytime?"

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Younger love interest, mutual unrequited love.
Yu Songnian looked at Shen Shu and said with a wry smile, "Marriage should still be with someone you like, right?"
Shen Shu: "Didn't expect you to be such a romantic. Aren't most people in our circle in business marriages?" He treated it as a transaction.
But in reality, Shen Shu felt like he had picked up a dirty little puppy. He would clean him up and restore him to his former beautiful self.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The game anchor that I have always admired and liked is actually my biggest enemy that I have hated since childhood?! And he has always had feelings for me?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Zongcai Daren Fei Wo Bu Ke

description:
Xiao Nuo agrees to take her cousin's place as a scapegoat to save her grandmother's life. She is sold to Mo Xijue, a handsome, young, and wealthy company president with a terrible temper. A fluffy romance following the relationship between a possessive CEO and a girl with a big secret!

(Source: INKR)

Storming out after finding out his boyfriend has another lover, celebrity Gu Kexin vents her anger by vandalizing his car. Unfortunately, she chose the wrong vehicle by mistake and faces the wealthy bachelor called the "prince". To add more bad luck, Gu Kexin's rival sets her up for a sex scandal to ruin her reputation by checking her in at an anonymous man's hotel room.
When Kexin's scandal had leaked out, she is confronted by media left and right. But amidst the commotion, a convoy of escorts barge into the hotel and a familiar face catches Kexin's attention. It's none other the "prince" himself, and it looks like he's ready to sweep Kexin off her feet as his official lover.

In Night Bus, a young woman wearing round glasses finds herself on an adventurous late night bus ride that constantly makes detours through increasingly fantastical landscapes. Meanwhile a young cartoonist returns home after art school and tries his hand at becoming a working artist while watching over his aging grandmother whose memory is deteriorating. Nostalgic leaps take us to an elementary school gymnasium that slowly morphs into a swamp and is raided by a giant catfish. Beetles, salamanders, and bug-eyed fish intrude upon the bus ride of the round-glasses woman as the night stretches on. Night Bus blends autobiography, horror, and fantasy into a vibrantly detailed surreal world that shows a distinct talent surveying his past.

Nature infringes upon the man-made world via gigantism and explosive abundance–the images in Night Bus are often unsettling, not aimed to horrify, but to upset the balance of modern life.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly)

title.english: My Financial Backer Is Only 5 Years Old

description:
Shiqian, a psychiatrist by profession, helps a friend to make up the number of people in her talent show, but she doesn't expect that because of her unique persona, she will soon be voted by her fans to make her debut! When Shiqian, who only wants to be lazy, is trying to find a way to get out of her debut, a five-year-old bully calls her mommy. A five-year-old bully called her mommy and threatened to adopt her?

(Source: Webnovel)

In ancient times, an evil dragon threatened to flood and drowned a certain village. Since then, every year, the villagers would sacrifice a bride to appease the dragon and ensure the peace and safety of the village. This year, it is the black dragon Yan Ming’s turn to enjoy the human sacrifice. However, he has no interest in human flesh and prefers a diet of fruits instead. But he was forced by his butler Xi Que to follow tradition and go to the village to receive the village's offering. Yan Ming was only going through the motions until he became intrigued by the strange, "mute" bride! She wasn’t afraid of him at all. In fact, she seems almost excited?! Whatever… let's take her home first!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Su Mianmian got married before she even graduated high school! Though her husband is a powerful businessman, there's a large age difference between them... and he already has a cute son! Thankfully, her husband has a great figure and pampers her endlessly, and he helps slap her stepmother and her biased father back to reality. How else could she be allowed to live her life~~~?

(Source: Webnovel)

Xiao Chiu dreams of becoming a great Chinese chef, always has the urge to cook food when she's in the kitchen, and cuts vegetables whenever she has a knife in her hands. Her passion for cooking was rewarded when she found a well-paying job - to be Lei's personal chef for a month. But Lei is arrogant, smokes, has a bad temper... and is very picky about food. He has a sensitive stomach and will throw up if something he ate does not agree with him. He also will not eat anything that doesn't suit his taste. What a hard-to-satisfy guy! Lei just happens to be her classmate, too! Poor Xiao Chiu! Even worse, after one month, having spent day and night together, they develop tangled feelings towards each other! Xiao Chiu feels confused. In seeing the one-month deadline approaching, she decides to run away. But, if she does not cook for him, Lei may get sick again... Xiao Chiu, what are you going to do?

(Source: Amazon)

In order to exact revenge, he turned into a dragon and vowed to kill everyone who betrayed him. But Master, he still wants to be your disciple in this lifetime.

(Source: Wecomics, edited)

Note: Chapter count contains 10 extra chapters.

Sparks fly when busy restaurateur Justin meets handsome waiter Jake at a themed “butler service” cafe. He relishes the idea of bossing someone around, and Jake’s service is excellent—he even saves Justin from a rogue wine bottle! Then it’s just one revelation after the other: They’re neighbors! Jake cooks like a master chef (and Justin will eat all his treats)!! And even a possible past encounter...! So will Justin pursue business or pleasure? Can he have Jake’s tasty cakes and eat them, too?

(Source: Tapas)

Azure Dragon, Ivory Tiger, Vermillion Bird, Ebony Tortoise: these are the four sacred beasts who brought about an eon of peace to a world engulfed by evil. Now, after thousands of years of tranquility, they have turned their backs on mankind and unleashed all manner of monsters. Losing his brave warrior mother to the Azure Dragon, betrayed by the very guardians who once protected him, young Roz and his friends stand guard, save lives, and fight for the future to become legends.

(Source: Tapas)

Rumor has it that the emperor and the prime minister are at odds with each other, and some people say that the prime minister got his position because he looks like the emperor's former lover. But is that the truth? One is a mean and seemingly aloof emperor, and the other is a weak prime minister who is excluded by others. One is chasing, and the other is escaping, but the social stigma stops them from moving forward. Can they relive the good old days of the past?

(Source: Webcomics)

title.english: A Diary Of My Sparrow-Like Boyfriend

description:
On my first day at work, I fell into the arms of my boss…
Assistant and has-been star team up to dominate the entertainment industry!
One is a harmless yet capable assistant, another is a grumpy but handsome no-longer-famous young celebrity. Two of them thoughtlessly form a boss-subordinate relationship. Lin Cheng Feng thought he was just Zhuo Bu Fan's assistant, while Zhuo Bu Fan considers him to be a substitute for a beloved pet, to be captured and pampered. This is the beginning of the Leopard male's observation diary on his little Sparrow...

(Source: Webcomics)

What, I transmigrated into a fox spirit? Stuck in the standard role as a foxy temptress! See how this fox cultivates herself into a goddess, and scoop up all the historically fine men along the way! But what's with this big-bad guy? He says that this baby fox eats too much and is going to get all fat and fleshy? How can he say things like that, foxes have feelings, too!! Let's see how the modern girl who transmigrated into the fox-spirit royalty will cultivate and upgrade herself to become top fox!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A cruel Royal Bodyguard of the Forbidden Forest vs the master of the Hidden Sect who plays dumb. The clash of the strong in a love-hate relationship. Body as chains and heart as a lock; I'll make you willingly submit to being my only prisoner.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Awakening again in the void, the first person I saw was you. I secretly resolved that this time I would crush that comical and pathetic plan, and this time I would save you... But who was I talking to?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The eccentric genius artist Fu Nian and the college lecturer Su Qiusheng suddenly find their realities overlapping. From then on, they're forced into a chaotic life of "cohabitation".

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Our famous star realized two facts that give him a headache: One, he is gay but that's not even the worst part; two, the guy he likes is being forced by his family to go on blind dates and that's terrible!

(Source: WebComics)

Leroy infiltrates a mysterious mobster gang as a federal spy, but his undercover mission takes an unexpected turn when he falls into a forbidden, three-year entanglement with the captivating heir, Manfred. Torn between love and duty, Leroy is forced into an impossible choice that shatters their worlds – killing Manfred’s father. A year later, a transformed Manfred returns, his thirst for vengeance threatening to engulf them all in chaos.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Chengwei Tuan Chong Hou, Wo Da Sha Sifang
title.native: 成为团宠后，我大杀四方

description:
Orla, an orphan raised in the arena. When she discovers that her companion beast, Dragan, has been captured by the king with plans to strip it away, she sets out on a daring escape with Dragan. Through a series of adventures, Orla steadily grows stronger and seeks vengeance for herself.

(Source: POCKETCOMICS)

Qi Xing, your average high schooler, stumbles across a mysterious seven-star disc. But this ain't no ordinary frisbee. Suddenly, the disc drags him into the "Disc World"— a mind-blowing realm where his crazy adventure kicks off.

Through a twist of fate, Qi Xing becomes a cultivator, a master of countless Daoist techniques.

As he unlocks the secrets of the Seven Star Disc, a hidden power within him— the Primordial Celestial Qi—begins to awaken. But with every revelation, he gets sucked deeper into a conspiracy surrounding the legendary "Path of Immortality" through which he uncovers the truth about achieving immortality in the World within the Disc…

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
Shi Guang and Xia Ling, one is a young staff and the other is a graduate student. For these two who are halfway into society, the new cohabitation life is both fresh and full of unknowns...

A soccer no-name has been reborn as the youngest son of soccer hero “Cha Seong-Gye”?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kaiser, the player once known as “The God” for dominating the number one spot on the rankings, has returned. The virtual reality game “God of Savior.” And the game that inspired it, “Demrock.” Kaiser, the player who once dominated the top spot and was known as “The God.” But he vanished without a word— and a year and six months have passed. And now, he attempts to log in once more.

“Would you like to log in to the game?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Overnight, following her father’s death, Judith found herself transformed into a baroness in debt. She realized she had been reincarnated into the very novel she had read in her past life. Determined to use the plot of the novel to pay off her debts, Judith enters the duke’s mansion as a contract daughter-in-law, where they need a fake wife for their missing son. She’ll pay off her debts and enjoy luxuries she’d never have in a lifetime. Let’s make the most of it, even if it’s just for a few months! But then— Her husband, who never returned in the novel, has come back?

“So you’re my wife. And you’re pregnant with my child.”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

"You'd better apologize before I sue you for sexual harassment."

Matthew has always worked harder than anyone else at his company, where most of the employees are women. Despite that, all he received from his coworkers was derision and ridicule. One day, after suffering humiliation from his female coworkers, he decides to seize an investment opportunity that comes his way, kick- starting a new and exciting chapter of his life.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Baek Sa-Rang, who feels comfortable eating, going to the movies, and drinking alone, is alone. Yoo Pyeong-Hwa, who longs to socialize with others, even at a loss. Love and Pyeong-Hwa, who have lived contrasting lives, meet each other and discover a new way of life. This is a realistic romance that's both more mature than you might think, yet more childish than you might think, yet relatable.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I'm going to tell you a story about a failed relationship. I didn't know it would turn out like this. But everyone has a story like this.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: How to Win over Your Crush

description:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled. That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand. A son. Disgust and irritation flare up all at once. A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place? But fine. It doesn’t matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know. If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world.

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I Saved the Villain with Money After the Ending

description:
Daphne Serenade Bukater, an ultra elite born with a silver spoon and dubbed Secradion’s Red Rose, remembers her past life and the tragic fate awaiting her. Reborn as the villainess of a popular novel, she knows how the story ends—with her death. To escape such a destiny, Daphne makes a bold choice—save Celestian, the brooding sub male lead destined for execution, and steer her life away from the path that leads to Romeo, the obsessive male lead and her former fiancé.

(Source: Tapas)

In a small town called Leo. Ruben, the wizard who isn’t just known for his title as the ‘Rising Star’ or for his powerful potions. He’s also beloved by the ladies in town for his gentle nature, charming looks, and single status. But one day, a rare creature suddenly rolls into his life. Ruben, thrilled by the thought of wealth and fame, even gives it a cute nickname: Squishy. But the next morning…

What he finds in his bed isn't squishy, but a beauty?!

"From now on, I’m calling you Squishy. If you don’t like it, remember your real name."

It's the worst, most chaotic rainy season ever, and I need some comfort right now!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

One rainy day when I was 22, I realized the name of my feelings for my sister.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

I'm here to protect the lady of the Ruslan household... through all dangers and perils.

(Source: Toomics)

Awakened from their eternal slumber, ancient beings now known as vampires rise from the frozen soil, driven by human greed and madness. Now in a battle for survival, humanity turns to forbidden experiments on their own bodies. But will they transcend their limits — or become the monsters they so fear?

(Source: Manta)

Despite her unquestioning loyalty to the emperor as his knight, Iona is left to die on the battlefield by her uncaring master. The last person she expects to come to her rescue in her final moments is her husband, Duke Leroy Hann, who was forced into a political marriage with her. Once she dies and wakes up as her past self, Iona decides to abandon the emperor and devote herself to making Leroy happy. Can she make this unlikely marriage work this time around, despite Leroy's distrust and the people determined to come between them...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In order to help the nine-tailed fox find the elixir of life, the fox demon 'Seoyo' sneaks into the palace. But who appears in front of Seoyo, who was wandering around looking for the magical herb? A girl called 'Elixir of Life'?! Seoyo, curious about the human elixir of life, begins to hover around her, and the two girls begin to open their hearts to each other...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

I want to be more than just friends.

After a chance encounter with a kind stranger, high schooler Hong finds herself lovestruck. She never expected her crush would transfer into the same homeroom class at their all-girls' school! Is this a dreaded straight-girl crush?! What's a girl to do when her feelings are mistaken for friendship?

(Source: Manta)

Song Joo-hee, who is unable to live her own life because she is busy paying off her family's debt, coincidentally meets Kang Se-ra, a rich girl who ran away from home, and they spend a night together. She is so charmed by her that she accepts her offer to live together...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Desperate to escape his hellish grandmother’s house, Hyeonwu scrapes together every penny he can to finally live on his own. But his dream of independence doesn’t last long. His cheap new apartment already has a terrifying long-term resident, a restless virgin ghost who refuses to leave. Just when Hyeonwu thinks he’ll have to move out, the ghost makes him an unexpected offer. If he helps fulfill her secret bucket list, she promises to peacefully move on to the afterlife and vacate the apartment. This chilling and charming story follows a broke young man and a mischievous ghost as they team up to tackle her final wishes, one haunting favor at a time.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Death is just the beginning for Gwon Jun.

After committing suicide, he doesn’t find himself in the afterlife but rather, in a cold, surgical room. He’s strapped to a table and there’s a figure staring down at him. Is this the person who saved his life? But why? Jun is not dead but he’s not exactly alive either… This strange state of being that Jun is in seems to be a part of some sort of research being done by the mysterious man who saved him. As the two of them live together in isolation, they both seem to be discovering odd things about each other. But eventually, something’s gotta give and the truth will be revealed. What answers will be found at the end of death…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The real world’s Lee Sung-Eum gets transported into the body of ‘Taeo Gaspell’, servant of the 8th tyrant Aira Phone Tarenterra, in the novel “Villain Hunters”. According to how the original novel goes, his fate is to be executed with the other evil ladies. However, since he knows everything that will happen in the novel, he decides to change his fate. Will he be able to tame those evil ladies and live through it till the end?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

What’s the chance of running into your first love again after twelve years? This is exactly what happens to Solhui after attending her frenemy’s bridal shower. What’s more? Her first love is having an affair with a married woman. But that’s not all. She meets him and the woman again when she starts a viola lesson with a new student.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sheldon, a popular webcomic creator, is drinking alone after his crush ignores him when he's approached by a man who looks exactly like one of his characters. Afterwards, he wakes up with a broken leg in a room eerily similar to his own. His kidnapper, Do-Hyuk, is a psychopath who truly believes he is that character and wants Sheldon to change the ending. Though Sheldon tries to manipulate the situation and escape, he winds up getting more deeply involved in a twisted love affair with Do-Hyuk. Will Sheldon be able to break free of their shared delusion and return to reality?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Attached at the hip for 20 years, Jiheon and Wooju are practically inseparable. There's definitely something simmering between them but Jiheon is an alpha and Wooju, just a beta. Not only that, but Wooju’s had his eyes on someone else lately, anyways. Ever the good friend, Jiheon makes an unexpected suggestion to Wooju in order to get the attention of the one he desires. But is there a layer of manipulation beneath this supposedly helpful gesture? What Jiheon feels is love, some might call…an obsession. And this obsession could lead to all sorts of trouble...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rafael Heinsworth might be the most adorable recruit Captain Dante has ever had. Sure, Dante likes him. Who wouldn’t like someone so beautiful and sweet?
