And if Rafael wants to profess his eternal love for Dante, that’s fine too. Dante doesn’t date his recruits. Even when they’re no longer recruits. Even when they’re in his bed most days. Dante will absolutely not budge on this, no matter how romantic or skillful Rafael becomes. Absolutely, probably… not.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

6 friends grew up together in a small alley. At night when everyone is asleep, YOON-HO makes a secret with a girl in the neighborhood.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Da-Im, who was bullied by bullies chanced upon a game that was in his old phone that would change his life. An unbalanced strategy RPG game where one grows by ordering bullies to do things and recruiting kind people! The ultimate goal of this RPG game is to eliminate school violence from the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

You just wait. I’ll find a boyfriend who’s WAY better than you! After being dumped by her hot ex-boyfriend of two years, Sia is on a mission to find the ultimate boyfriend to join her on her NewTube Channel. To her dismay, however, Minho, an overweight, nerdy otaku who gets bullied at school, asks her out. Should she accept him as her boyfriend? Can she succeed in transforming this dud into a superstud?

(Source: WEBTOON)

College graduate Gi-Un creates a hiking club with his friend Jae-U. After having a drink with the queen of the club Jin-Sol and the cute newcomer Da-Hee, Gi-Un blacks out...

“Don't you remember what you did last night?!”

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Jake and Judy have been besties forever, but now Jake wants something more... Is Judy on the same page though?

(Source: Toomics)

After being threatened by a wasp and breaking through his balcony wall, he finds himself facing his childhood friend in her underwear. Suddenly, he finds his life has a lot more women in it.

"Aren't you curious about my underwear too? I'll show you♡"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Linus Sweeney, who is in the spotlight wherever he goes with his handsome looks and a genius brain, and Peter Mack, a natural nerd who tenaciously digs into anything since he was young. Their contact was almost non-existent until Peter achieved the feat of hacking Caltech. Linus throws a party at a famous club to celebrate Peter's great achievement. Aside from his hacking skills, the nerdy Peter grabs Linus' attention.

Linus "kindly" takes care of Peter, who loses conscious due to the drugs and alcohol Linus had given him. The two begin seeing each other, spending most of their time together, and their relationship continues for three years. But one day, Linus ruthlessly turns his back on Peter without telling him why.

Eight years later, Peter, who has overcome the pain of a broken heart, has become a CIA agent. He is assigned to a mission which unexpectedly leads to meeting Linus once again at a mental hospital. Peter tries to control his feelings, but whenever he sees Linus approaching him and hears his whispered sweet words, his heart melts.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Waking up as the villainess destined for a gruesome death, Olivia de Versace only has two goals in mind: 1. Avoid the Imperial Palace at all costs, and 2. Marry her childhood crush and live her life in peace. With a newfound passion for both swordsmanship and commerce and romance in the air, Olivia is building her reputation as the new local girlboss. But… does all of this attention come at a price? Why are all of these men she’s trying to stay far away from flocking to her side?!

(Source: Tapas)

The year is 203X, and Earth is under attack. The enemy? Extraterrestrials. Park Hyunsung, a militia commander, valiantly lays down his life to take down the enemy base. One moment, he’s caught up in a malfunctioning teleportation device; the next… he’s in the body of Ian Alberon, a 15-year-old lord! Thrown into a world of monsters and magic, Hyunsung — now Ian — must figure out how to navigate his new surroundings. And to top it all off, it seems his enemies may be much closer than he thinks…

(Source: Tapas)

Yeo-Rin is a struggling writer who can’t seem to match the success of her previous work. Try as she might, she lacks the inspiration needed for her latest novel. That’s when In-Ha, the former soldier who inspired her best work, comes back into her life. He is still unabashedly blunt, she is still ridiculously stubborn, and they both still harbor feelings from that one night six years ago… In-Ha might be the key to unlocking Yeo-Rin’s next hit, but will it be a love story or just another tragedy?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

A genius cook that only cared about food and getting fat, however, he learns how to cook up women after losing weight.

"I'll have you tonight!!"

(Source: DAYcomics)
May my comfort reach you! A fantasy romance to heal your heart.

As the youngest member of hit idol group LoverU, Ryeojoon never suspected that a book gifted by a fan would be... riveting fan fiction starring himself and the other LoverU members! Drawn deeper into the mysterious world of fanfics, he just can't stop himself anymore... How long can this bookworm keep his not-so-innocent hobby a secret? Superstar turns superfan as Ryeojoon walks a dangerous line between idol and fanboy!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes a prologue.

Everyday life can be tough even at the best of times, and when you’re a witch, an aspiring nun, or a former child actor, it gets a lot tougher! All Bakha, Minhyeok, Sara, and Sanghyeop want to do is live like everyone else and follow their dreams, but they are constantly confronted with prejudice and discrimination from those they encounter. Will they be able to show the world that despite their differences, people are all the same deep down?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Craig has been thinking a lot about death lately. Working thirteen-hour shifts to pay off his father’s insurmountable debt, taking care of his little brother in between, exasperated and ready to collapse, Craig can’t help but wonder: would it be easier to end it all? It was just an ordinary day like this when Craig stumbled onto the scene of a bloody murder. Now Craig is on the run, pursued by a criminal organization’s most lethal member: Dean. In the hunt, however, the two soon find themselves chasing anything but death.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes three extras.

Hara meets a beautiful girl at a club one night, and goes home with her. After a sweet rendezvous, Go-Eun wakes the next morning to find Hara in her bed. Shocked, she kicks Hara out, because she has no recollection of sleeping with her. So who was Hara sleeping with? A story about Hara, Go-Eun and another ‘Go-Eun’!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A narrative comic that illustrates some of the most funniest and sexiest experiences in a way only our creator, Eunya, can.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
Kim Myung-Hyun's new story about a 20 year old woman. What does she want to do?

Eun-Seom is the transfer student everyone is talking about. With his striking blonde hair and the dangerous rumors that follow him, he’s impossible to miss. But Iseo, with a gentle nature, doesn’t judge people by their looks or rumors, and finds Eun-Seom rather interesting. When they are assigned seats next to each other, Iseo tries to be friendly, but Eun-Seom remains on high alert. However, between shared desks and stolen glances, a quiet bond begins to form.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Kang Seo-Rim dies from overwork, only to be reassigned as a grim reaper. Sick of taking lives, he stumbles upon Cupid at work and realizes there might be something better than death: love. After all, why reap souls when you could reap romance? Cupid, however, is far from thrilled about someone challenging his divine purpose, and before long, the two are locked in a strange dance of rivalry, irritation, and an attraction neither of them expected.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Dawson Group changed the world with their line of pheromone-regulating medications. The long line of alphas in the Dawson family has never failed to uphold that legacy—until now. Henry, the eldest son and successor, has a secret that could ruin his family’s reputation and bring down the company if it were ever to get out. He’s a beta, borrowing the alpha pheromones of his adopted brother, Raz. With so much at stake, will he be able to accept his illicit desires to keep this arrangement?

(Source: Tapas)

They joined for the money. The game will strip them bare. How far will they go to win?

(Source: Toomics)

Gods and demons wage a neverending battle with the mortal realm as their battlefield. As with most longstanding feuds, the reasons are no longer important--hatred is a way of life. But it is foretold that one would arise who could restore harmony between gods and demons. Enter Raenef...heir to a set of demon royalty, he is hardly courtly material. The demon king assigns Eclipse to be his tutor, to mold Raenef into proper demonic shape. The two begin a journey of discovery and are soon joined by a human knight and a god-blessed priest.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes the one-shot "Crystal Heart and Tera".

This 7-volume manga is about a young woman who after her family dies goes to a magician to wish them back. She ends up becoming his assistant until she makes a wish he can grant. How will she deal with his other costumers? And what about the most prized posession that is the cost of having the wish granted?

(Source: Korean-Manwha)

How far would you go to meet your favorite boy band? Kum-Ji was a little late getting under the spell of the chart-topping boy band DDL. Unable to join the DDL fan club, she almost gives up meeting her idols until she develops a cunning plan, becoming a top member of their rival fan club for a brand-new boy group, Yo-I (Chocolat). This way she can always be near Yo-I at all their concerts. Funnily enough, Yo-I always seems to play the same shows with DDL. It's almost the perfect plan, but it's really complicated being a super fan of one band when your heart lies with another.

(Source: Yen Press, edited)

title.romaji: Anuki: The Greatest Epic of a Young Boy
title.native: 아누키 The Greatest Epic of a Young Boy

description:
Anuki is a boy caught in a war between two countries. When he is small he is abandoned by his father so a princess could be saved. This event triggered amnesia so he doesn't remember his childhood before this event.
When he grows up he joins a flight mercenary unit to be trained as a pilot so he can help in the war, there he becomes the ace pilot.

In a time of chaos and war, a godforsaken era, twin sons are born to an emperor. But legend states that the son of the emperor shall be born a demon! But twins? Who is the demon, and who shall reign as emperor?

Chunchu is the story of a young man saved from death by his mother, banished by his people, hunted by his brother, and tortured by the demons within. Living and fighting with a low-born warrior tribe who can never trust him, Chunchu lives a life of blood and violence, every day a struggle to survive. But something mysterious lurks within his cold exterior, something that could be awakened by the touch of a woman.

(Source: Dark Horse)

"Born into a shaman family, Seon-Bi has inherited the power to see and communicate with spirits just like her grandmother, a notable shaman and savior of their little fishing village in the South Sea. Early on, she sees things like an imposter shaman being thrashed by a dragon of the deep, and doesn't understand that none of her schoolmates can see such things. Her powers make her the amorous target of hedonistic demons even as a child. Long shielded from the reality of her power, she finally learns the secret of her mother's death, and why her grandmother was never able to leave their village. Enter Seon-Bi's world in this mind-boggling psychological chiller!"

(Source: Netcomics, edited)

The Devil's Castle is a dark and somber place, until the good-hearted apprentice ASARELLA stumbles into this abode on a goodwill mission, against the wishes of her master, the Arch-Mage, ELIWHO. Things sour quickly, and soon Asarella is bound in a blood pact with The Devil. Little does she know that the mage harbors a secret love for her, which will only complicate her training to prepare her for the apocalyptic battle to come, and which sets up the most unusual love triangle of any place or time.

(Source: CPM)

In Chinese, ‘Mijeong’ means ‘pure beauty.’ In the cold city, young people’s lives cross and spark for brief moments in this remarkably drawn graphic novel; Wounded characters, squashed by the daily hard realities of urban living whose destinies take sudden unannounced turns but their inner flames shine bright and wild, even for a brief time. This engrossing collection of stories will transfix and move you deeply.

(Source: NBM)

Princess is a very straight forward and extremely sad series. This series is full of romance and politics. The background is an unknown medieval era where there are three countries. Among the three countries, there is an island country called "Ramira". The empire, Ramira, is where most of stories will unfold.

Volume 1
1. Sowoni Naerineun Nanal (소원이 내리는 나날, Days Wishes Fall) [Yun Ji-Un]
About the relationship between a father and a daughter.
2. Mun (문, The Door) [Kim Yeon-Ju]
The reminisces of a girl in the temporary care of a lord apparent.
3. Hohwan (호환, The Ravages of the Tiger) [Seomoon Da-Mi]
A girl seeks revenge and death through hunting a tiger.
4. Bameun Cheon Gaeui Nuneul Gajigo Itda (밤은 천 개의 눈을 가지고 있다, The Night has a Thousand Eyes) [Lee Hyeon-Suk]
The relationship between a boy, his girlfriend, and her cousin.
5. Appa Miwo♡ (아빠 미워♡, I Hate You, Dad ♡) [Lee Si-Yeong]
6. Mangjaga Jinaneun Gil (망자(亡者)가 지나는 길, The Road the Dead Pass By) [Park Eun-A]

Volume 2: "boy's love"
1) Dalbameun Wiheomcheonman! (달밤은 위험천만!) [Sim Hye-Jin]
2) GET REAL (GET REAL, GET REAL) [Na Ye-Ri]
3) Kkeuteomneun Bame Taeeonada (끝없는 밤에 태어나다, To Be Born In an Endless Night) [Lee Hyeon-Suk]
4) JARDIN DE CHOUETTE (JARDIN DE CHOUETTE [올빼미의 정원], JARDIN DE CHOUETTE) [Kang Hye-Jin]
5) Geureona… (그러나…, But...) [Lee Si-Yeong]
6) LUNCH (LUNCH, LUNCH) [Sin Yu-Ha]

Volume 3: "antiq+sad"

A noble man recalls the tragic story of a boy born out of wedlock and the supposed curse upon him because of his white eye. The cursed boy lives a harsh life and falls in love with someone forbidden to him. In the end the beast kills the one he cared most about.

Volume 4: "Older"
1) Yeomso Chineun Saramdeul (염소 치는 사람들, Shepherds) [Kwon Gyo-Jeong]
2) Sinbu (신부, Bride) [Aivan]
3) Hwanggeumnaseonui Gyeongno (황금나선의 경로) [Yu Si-Jin]
4) Dalkomhago Dalkomhadoda (달콤하고 달콤하도다, Sweet & Sweet) [Kim Se-Yeong]

6) Cheonnyeondo Dangsin Nuneneun (천년도 당신 눈에는, 1000 Years in Your Eyes) [Lim Ju-Yeon]

(Source: Daewon C.I., translated)

From Korea comes a collection of incisive observant short stories by a leading artist. Reading these thirteen exceptional stories is an experience similar to appreciating a touching poem or watching a series of stills from a silent movie. Combining the traits of different artistic genres, O has indeed created his own world of comic art. While eloquently presenting a universal human experience, O also brings a delightful and exotic insight into Korean society. Whereas Manwa (Korean comics) can be much more than we expect... For mature readers.

(Source: NBM Publishing)

In Korea, the deer is considered as the symbol of purity and innocence. Ria wishes she were a deer... Torn between her love for her protective brother and her desire to fend for herself, she'll need to learn how to make her own choices, as well as her brother will. Not only does Rin meets a girl who falls head over heels for him, but he also starts to feel growing an odd interest in guys...(Source: Shoujo Manga Maniac)

Auna is a girl forced into servitude to a petulant princess who presents her with a furry fox cub. Soon afterwards, Auna embarks upon the adventure of a lifetime when she learns that fox is really an adventurous boy trapped by a magical spell! Before she knows it, the pistol-packing teen and her unlikely ally journey into a fantasy realm unlike anything you've ever seen!

(Source: CPM)

JD lives a peaceful life with his grandfather on a small island, until bounty hunters show up looking for them! Will JD be able to put to use what his grandfather’s taught him to survive in a world of magical peril? And what is the nature of the Recast spell his grandfather’s cast on him?

(Source: Tokyopop)

Suyun's parents died when she was little. She is raised by a too-soft "Bro" and a money crazy sister that sends her to part time jobs by screaming each and every day. The only money she is allowed to have and spend is the money she earns; part of the money she earns, that is. So she works 24 hours a day- during morning she works as a student while during night she works as a par-time job girl. But she doesn't think that is enough... That is why she secretly works as "Guardian Angel", one who defeats those who have bullied the weaker. For a price, that is.

A threat has been made against young Prince Deporojue of Aden. Sent away for his own protection, he soon discovers the culprit is none other than the dangerously ambitious King himself. A stepfather and enemy to the Prince, this usurper looks to secure a permanent position on the throne by killing his stepson. But with the help of his late father's friends, the Prince fights for his rightful throne...and vengeance!

The original manhwa which inspired the NCsoft game Lineage!

The afterlife! Once someone goes in they can never make it out alive! Snow White journeyed to the spirit world with the pass to the spirit world her mom left her to find her dad’s spirit but…

“To lose my love, or to kill her, those are the two choices I’m faced with.”
The blood loving and cold, absolute devil, Pa Sun.

The one who wishes to protect Snow White’s happiness but must take her life, Tae San.
"I no longer have the right to be by your side, I love you.
Holding those feelings in my heart, I leave you for your sake."

Will our kind and lovely Snow White’s jealous sister Oori’s curse follow her to the afterlife…?

Gyeo-wool, an art student, is having having trouble drawing. One day, she bumps into a handsome guy and takes his notebook by mistake. The notebook had drawings with an art style she is not used to and tries to draw better than him. But, it turns out that the guy knows who she is...!

"A stabbed and tickling heart!! A heart that only beats for you!"
Even if it's a hurt love I will challenge again for that love!!
A love story that began with a deal. Who is going to be the winner of this deal?
Making a sweet love story of Ji Wan who doesn't believe in love and Hong Joo who is honest and foolish enough to love.

The impossible happens in 15th century Korea.

A princess who was disguised as her dead twin brother by her mother became king. Once her true gender is found out, the female king is sentenced to death by drinking a lethal dose of poison.

This story details the events of that forgotten king's life.

Some corrupted high-ranked officers within the palace are accusing the crown prince Sado of high treason and ask for his death! What will the Emperor do to save his son?


A fusion heroic historical about a crown prince in a wooden chest about to meet death, but actually turns out he has bigger influence and authority beyond imagination.<

The antics of two high school girls: Kim Peongyon and Choi Boa. Kim aka "Bias Girl", is a foul mouthed, overactive girl and idiot who weird and strange, bias ideas on people and things and Boa is smarter and saner of the two who plays the straight girl everytime Kim does anything stupid.

At age 9, Ryu decides to explore a house rumored to be haunted. Within the long and maze like corridors of the house, Ryu hears 5 words that will forever change his life: "What did you bring me?"

(Source: Tapas)
A young Emperor is cast out of his Empire by his uncle, who seizes the throne for himself. The young Emperor sets out to become the strongest among the living, and take back what is rightfully his...

Raya Famiira, princess of a small kingdom conquered by the Sultan. In reality, she is a modern doctoral candidate who was writing her thesis on Arabian Nights when she suddenly awakens inside the very tale she was studying. Being reborn as a princess should have been a stroke of luck. Instead, within three days of her possession, she is taken captive as a prisoner of war, thrust into the role of a doomed heroine fated for tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Meet my neighbor - a typical fantasy novelist, more than a little scatterbrained, likes to gossip, borrow things without asking, and play MMORPGs. Oh, and by the way, he's a dragon in disguise. Named Dragon Kim.

Yeah...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: chapter count includes 2 prologue chapters and 1 extra

Young Ma Go-Eun and her father are about to be evicted from the haunted house they've run throughout the years. But Go-Eun is not about to let the park owner demolish their haunted house and her memories of her childhood and her mother. She resolves to go to the United States to surpass trials and get a million dollar cash prize awarded to those who can survive a stay in Ghost Jack's House.

An orphan boy, named Murang, has always wanted to be a dragon rider - but people always assume the worst of him because he is a parentless. Always getting beat up for riding the village dragons, he is consistently looking for ways to climb his way into becoming a full-fledged dragon rider. Luckily, he finds an isolated dragon-egg. But would that be enough to change his life for the better? A story-tale of a dragon rider.

A medical student passionately falls in love with a fallen goddess during his volunteer abroad in Nepal, and he desperately tries to fight off destiny to save his love.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Short stories of boys in 10th dimensions.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
Märchen, saved from the brink of death avoids all training from his teacher. However, she comes up with another plan to make him stronger through making him read old tales.

The novice "succubus" Lilu aims for the strong spirit of dreamy boy Mong-gil, but the "Nightmare" announcer interrupts along the way and a triangular relationship in the dream takes place!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

By day, Ha-Rin is a sculptor and teacher. By night, she turns into the serial killer Sow who, along with her protege Soon-Hee, uses a chat app to ensnare men with sex. After the deed is done, the men are kidnapped and tortured to death, punishment for being adulterers or for using women as if they're objects. But Detective Kim and his team are on these murderers' trails - will the duo's reign of terror be stopped?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

What happens when the greatest martial artist of the Murim world meets a genius magician from a fantasy world?

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

I slept with my BFF’s brother?!

One night, Hani goes out to drink with her best friend's brother and wakes up... in bed with him? What happens when she becomes pregnant from her one night stand? Watch Hani's trials and tribulations as she tries to hide the truth about the real father.

(Source: Manta)

Shin Lee is the wealthy CEO of a company who should be able to get any woman he wants, but he has a problem: he can’t maintain an erection. Hyonggi is a charming deliveryman who will answer any call within a few minutes. The two cross paths when Hyonggi unexpectedly rescues Shin’s daughter from a dangerous situation, and Shin soon discovers that Hyonggi himself might just be the mystical solution to his penile dilemma!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Whatever her employer asks, Hee-Yeon, the maid, does it perfectly without any mistake. A beautiful yet twisted maid enters a complicated household. How far down the rabbit hole will Hee-Yeon go?

(Source: Lezhin)

The beautiful Chae Young Un is used to dating guys and breaking up with them shortly after, but when one day she encounters the enigmatic first year student, Jang Yeon Ho, beating up a guy who had just stolen her wallet, their lives become unmistakable intertwined. Unable to leave him alone, Chae Young finds herself worrying and taking care of him as Jang Yeon Ho attempts to drive himself further and further into destruction. Is it pity or love that makes Chae Young Un care about Jang Yeon Ho? She's not so sure, but whatever it may be, Chae Young refuses to leave his side.

Jang Yeon Ho is haunted by his past and Chae Young Un cannot leave him alone. And while Jang Yeon Ho tries to fend her kindness off, he slowly begins to find that living is a whole lot brighter with her by his side.

A story about broken people finding love and redemption.

For Park Ki-Yoong, someone who’s reached the peak of his sex drive, having an orgasm was the best joy of his life. After serving his compulsory military service, for two years, he is now about to be discharged from his duty, and into the civilian world. As the saying goes, patience will persevere, Park Ki-Yoong desperately aims to enjoy the free night with the girl he loves, whom awaits outside ut, what’s this dream? Whenever he has an orgasm, the time rewinds. Will he ever be able to shift himself away from the time rift?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Some women are just treasures. This girl is such a treasure, every guy who ever meets her wants to lock her away for their own personal use. Can she ever escape this dreadful fate? Or will she remain a slave for the rest of her life?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A sweet couple takes care of the girl next door. She's wild, hates her mom and likes spending time with them. But one day, the wife suddenly dies, leaving the lonely 40-year-old husband alone with the lonely girl. Will something happen between them?

(Source: DAYcomics)

A clumsy journalist, a successful congresswoman, and her assistant. A story between the 3 full of love and BDSM!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The male with the devil's name, Amon. In order to protect himself and the people around him, to gain back his memories, and in order to escape from hell, he must fight. The enemies that will come after him after having woken up from the dead, and the encounters with women that will leave him breathless. And of course, "Good luck this time around oppa♡" But wait, The condition of hell is...?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

My father left us a huge debt when he died and my mom abandoned me and my sister. The only way to pay off my father’s huge debt is do whatever they say... Can I overcome this and become a king?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The majority of men probably watched some sort of Japanese AV while growing up (some probably do even after they're adults!). This webcomic provides a real sneak peek into the AV industry with some added twists and drama!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A jobless loser is tasked with managing his mom's guest house for a month. All of the guests there are beautiful women. And our main character has a little surprise about him, once he gets drunk, he turns into a real chad!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Looks cute and sweet? Don't judge a book by its cover. Here's a story about the intricate, private details of a newlywed's sex life. Neither his first love, first kiss, nor first experience was with me, but he was my first everything. So how far have you gone?

(Source: Lezhin)

This story tells you the value and importance of family; it will also remind you of the happiness and sadness, joys and sorrows of childhood.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

A collection of arcs 4 to 5 chapters long where each arc features a man and his humorous sexual encounters with various women in uniform. There is a police officer, an airline hostess, a fire fighter, a nurse, etc.

Don't you ever wonder what girls say behind your back? They say they like you and love what you do for them, but do they really? You want to know how girls really think? Enter the chat room only allowed to ladies, "Honey Bed Talk".

(Source: Lezhin)

Beautfiul women are being targeted and horrifically killed by an unknown assailant. Cries for justice pour into the police department but the team assigned to case is nowhere close to catching the evasive killer. But suddenly a reclusive young man with a mysterious ability arrives to offer his assistance and he may hold the key to finding the answers the police so desperately seek.

(Source: Daum, translated)
Brilliant usage of modern media for antismoking campaign. Park Hyung Suk from Lookism makes an appearance.

In the summer of 2016, an unknown alien organism invades Earth and annihilates 20% of the human race in a span of one month. However, survivors of this virus were either transformed into a hideous creature called "Worms" or into super-humans called the "Heteros". The heteros form a protection agency called the "ISO" to fight the worms. Haru, a young hetero but also a mischievous trouble maker, wants to join this agency in the fight. But it's no easy road.

(Source: Lezhin)

A blunt but kind big brother and the bright and innocent A-Yeong live in apartment building 201, suite number 202. This is the story of the everyday life of these cute siblings and their unpredictable neighbors! Even today, with A-Yeong "All Day Jo A-Yeong"♡

After spending his entire life in all-male schools till high school, Mingu finally enters college. Making things more exciting is the fact that he's in the Food and Nutrition Department with a male to female ratio of 1 to 9! A virgin and single since birth, this is his opportunity to date girls and enjoy a romantic campus life. But one wrong lie during a drinking party turns his life upside down and now he's been branded as a sex beast all over the school!

(Source: Lezhin)

Gun-woo, who has never been involved with romance before in his life, falls down a rabbit-hole after losing a bet. "Wait, nobody told me that the owner of this shop was this handsome?!"

(Source: WebNovel)

Mok-Hwa is an unemployed young man who wants to commit suicide, but instead he finds himself signing up for swimming lessons. He eventually begins falling for his swim teacher, a beautiful man with a great body. But as they become closer, Mok-Hwa can't help feeling something's a little strange...

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Lezhin Comics was the publisher until March 12, 2018. The series moved to Ridibooks on July 31, 2019. Chapter count includes a prologue and 20 extra chapters.

Jia is an average girl who, along with the majority of her classmates, has fallen head over heels for Yoona, a girl so pretty she's practically the school's idol. They're on two totally different levels, but Jia can ignore her feelings no longer! But who is Yoona, really? Stay tuned to see what romance unfolds between these two!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Do-Hoon can’t find a reason to live. He hoped to get a fresh start at his new high school, but things are no different—the bullies make fun of his limp and no one wants to be his friend. Then one night, he runs into a classmate, A-Ji... Having seen something he shouldn’t, the two make a deal: A-Ji will protect him for the time being, but when he turns 20, Do-Hoon will have to pay up.

(Source: Lezhin)

Yeon Janghwa is a more or less average college student: she attends a pretty good university, is pretty good-looking, and has a nice boyfriend. Her twin sister, Hong-ryeon, on the other hand, is the opposite. Being the good sister she is, Janghwa sets out to help her twin sister... but at what price? The truth is in the details.

(Source: Lezhin)
The story of angels who don't behave like angels and devils who are kinder than them. A new romance begins!

Where artistry meets fantasy.

When his musician sister suddenly goes missing, wood sculptor Baek Beom is thrown into the world of Artificers, immortal beings that obtain magical abilities through mastery of their craft. Determined to get answers, he teams up with Gino, an Artificer searching for a way to turn back into a human.

(Source: Manta)

A thrilling yet flirtatious relationship between the perverted girl Lee-ni, who gets excited from the wicked stares of men, and Du-jun, who is insensitive to sexual stimulus due to his father, who is an AV director, has begun! While showing off her cleavage and exposing her underwear, Lee-ni’s pride is hurt when Du-jun isn’t aroused even after seeing her bare form. The end result becomes an approach through all sorts of perverted acts in an effort to encapsulate him… What will the seduction of a pervert end up tasting like?

Note: The series has been cancelled due to the manhwaga's sexual harassment towards a female colleague.

The school's fastest track star, Namsu. An old friend from the past, Hye-Yeon. Everyone's adorable sweetheart, Joy. High-school romance at it's best! The comic that made Pito one of the best in the GL genre.

(Source: Lezhin)

Middle school, year 2, Summer. The me who was unable to say “don’t go” or that “I liked you” to her in the past appeared before me 3 years later. The story of a boy and a girl confronting the time spent apart from each other.
7 deadly sins...7 murders. The tested and the testers... "I will always be watching you"

Right as Asmodeus was on the brink of being awakened, an obscene and devilish "Siren" has appeared. All who are seduced by this evil spirit will find themselves immersed in lust and end up getting destroyed. Meanwhile, a crusader known as "Bato" finds himself lost and struggling after losing all his comrades in a war that was influenced by evil. But as he finds himself seduced by the Siren...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

A village like fairytale. A meeting of a sixteen-year-old boy and a girl.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

As the country’s foreign gangs expand their businesses with an influx of funds, the National Intelligence Service counters by planning to take control, using another gang. It’s a plan putting policeman Kang Hyuk undercover in a gang war to capture all those involved. But the plan is falling apart… a Tong and Dokgo crossover!

Bo-Young is 28 years old and still struggling to finish college because she can’t afford the tuition. After being unceremoniously dumped by the boyfriend she had supported over the years, Bo-Young gets the chance to get herself out of her stagnant life when she accepts a position to pose as a high school student for a year. All she has to do is avoid getting caught.

(Source: Spottoon)

Inheriting a vast fortune overnight from a father he never knew, Nam Jaeho finds himself the unexpected master of a man completely devoted to him. Testing his loyalty becomes his latest hobby as he navigates this strange new reality, grappling with the complexities of power, submission, and the mysterious past that has brought them together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

1. CIRCLE OF LIFE - Jinsoo Bae / Jinjook Lim
2-4. S.D.C - JeongSeo
5. loop - Seongyeon Yu
6. JUSTITIA - Donggeun Joo
7-8. His Warmth (그대의 온도) - Danwoo
9-11. Last Old Man (라스트 올드맨) - Carnby Kim / Soohun
12. Your Memory (너의 기억) - Rangddo
13-14. Android, Me (안드로이드, 나) - Song-A Min
15-17. Earnest - Gyu-Sam Kim

The hero's the villain, and the villain is the hero! This is the story of the villain End, and his assistant Save.

(Source: Toomics)

After getting beaten up during a rainy night, he woke up to find himself in captivity. Then, a young man with a bright smile appears in front of him and offers him a “meal”. How will the strange relationship between these two continue?

The brighter the light, the deeper the darkness. As an evil smile blossoms, the angel's tears intensify. This is a story where deeper desires are made real if you have money, but it may not always be enough. One day a virgin is sacrificed.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

One man has three wives? What’s the deal with this greedy guy?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

On a beautiful day in City K, where everyone was gathered for the festivities of the annual cherry blossom festival, a woman starts her ruthless and vile revenge. She's sexy, cool, and outright violent! See how the merry cherry blossom festival becomes a rampant bloodbath!

(Source: Lezhin)

Eunsuk and Jung-gu have a complicated relationship. The easiest way to describe it would be "roommates." Of course, not all roommates have sex. And most of them don't visit bathhouses together. And only a small few of them have sex at bathhouses.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven side story chapters and two special side story chapters released in 2025.

Minjae Kim was the kind of guy who caught your eye. That’s where all the trouble began for Taehwa Lee. The two met in high school, hit it off and then some. All the rumors said that they were together. Intimate. Abuse, betrayal, lies and love, if that was the only truth, they wouldn’t be in this mess.

(Source: Tapas)

Note includes nine extra chapters.

My girlfriend always brought her little sister everywhere, even on our dates. Now we're married, and she's still living with us! And that little girl is now a 21-year old beauty...God why have you given me this test?

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Minho would never go out with another guy! Or so he thought, as surprising rumors about him and bookish class president Ha-Jun spread. How long will they last before they must admit to their school mates — and their feelings?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Have you ever noticed that someone you knew is no longer themselves? The subtle changes they show that indicate that they are no longer…human? Join hunter Ha-Te and the part-timer hunter Ji-Hyun on their adventure of hunting trolls to save the humanity!

Fellatio in the bathroom and a wild night of sex after clubbing? What more could anyone ask for? Well, a meal for starters. For a vampire like Bokhee, that'd be blood from a living human. Too bad he hooked up with Mariam, an undead demon. So, what do you get when you combine unquenchable thirst and deviant appetites?

A sexual fantasy of epic proportions from the creator of "The Baker on the First Floor."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 3 extras.

In a deserted alley travelled by few, is an antique shop. It has no sign, no name. It sells the usual items, but if you believe the rumors, this particular shop also sells undisclosed wish-granting items - for a price, of course. And buyers who fail to follow an item's directions for use will pay an especially high price.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes an epilogue.

After being placed in a different class from his usual group of friends, all Do Jihwan wants is to spend an uneventful and quiet year in school. That plan goes down in shambles upon meeting one Kang Chanyoung, a popular and up-to-beat guy who has no qualms in saying what’s on his mind.

Cho-eul and Ju-ah have been BFFs since childhood. In high school, they shared a kiss, but it was only because Cho-eul said she was bored. They’ve continued to be inseparable, but only as friends. Deep inside, Ju-ah wants things to be different and even Cho-eul senses - and toys with - this unspoken tension. So how close is too close? What would happen if besties crossed the fine line between friends... and desire?

(Source: Tapas)

Minhee used to be a world-famous piano prodigy until one mistake sent her life spiraling. Her confidence shaken, her family broken and her life in ruins, all she can do is hope for a chance to make things better. That's when she meets Eun Hyun, the neighborhood piano teacher whose life has been filled with tragedies of his own.

(Source: Lezhin)
I couldn't kill my target because he's too cute, so I became his girlfriend instead.

title.english: All That We Hope to Be

description:
Sometimes we just can't get out of a ditch; yet we still hope.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Old friends get together and share their stories about the lady in their life. From the way they tell it, it sounds like a fantasy, too good to be true.

(Source: Lezhin US)

14 years ago, a high school student committed suicide. The cause was depression. On the night this news was reported, four people wearing the same school uniform as the student who committed suicide secretly sneaked to the scene of the incident. 14 years later, what is the truth contained in the envelope of documents delivered to the detective with an unknown address?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

To expand this exciting office life with five sexy and mysterious female bosses together!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Joo Sungwan is working as a fake ghost in order to pay back for a broken laptop, but instead of scaring customers, Sungwan is the one being scared! Even worse, there’s an actual ghost living in the haunted house?! With his job on the line, Sungwan ends up in a dating contract with the ghost — in exchange for the ghost scaring visitors, Sungwan must give him three wishes and be his boyfriend.

Nam-Hui-Yun, a gangster, makes a proposal to Suh-Jin-Ah, a college student. She agrees to go out with Nam to settle her family's debt but neither of them realize what will happen ... The focus of the project is not only limited to these two, because there are other characters that will provide the plot with many emotions.

Gong U-Jin is a passionate salesman at Bubble Doll, a doll toy company for girls! You fell in love with a married man with a child you met by chance? Gong U-Jin and Lee Do-Hyeon's relationship develops due to successive coincidences.

① A married man
② The father of a child
③ A lot older
④ Straight, maybe?

Even though he can see the mountain he has to overcome, U-Jin can't control himself, he's still attracted to Lee Do-Hyeon... What will this couple's fate be?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

After being summoned into another world, the Goddess of Mercy wishes for him to be a hero. But can he really be the hero of Erostica...?

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

A mermaid falls in love with prince Lewen while trying to feed on his heart. She decides to spare him and to die herself. Cursed by another mermaid, the mysterious beauty winds up at Lewen's palace as a human. Unable to speak and express her love for him, she is taken in and renamed Merin by Lewen, who doesn't recognize her. Meanwhile, Lewen's older brother Lewinel, brings home his prospective queen, princess Irena of Ladivita, to restore his impoverished kingdom, Erenbur. But Lewinel, kind and well-mannered, doesn't realize that Lewen is planning malicious intrigues that could destroy everybody's future...

(Source: NETCOMICS)
A subtle, yet sweet four-channel comic of a blunt, passive man and a cynical, persistent woman.
Louann, working as a maid of the mansion, accidentally finds out the lady of the house's scary secret on her first day of work and she's now invited to a strange meal...

Ehwa grows up helping her widowed mother run the local tavern, watching as their customers - both neighbors and strangers - look down on her mother for her single lifestyle. Their social status isolates Ehwa and her mother from the rest of the people in their quiet country village. But as she gets older and sees her mother fall in love again, Ehwa slowly begins to open up to the possibility of love in her life.

Cha-Min is an A-list actor with a talent for reading lines — AND people’s thoughts. Mo-Gyum is an actor getting his career back on track after a mysterious accident left him scarred as a kid. The relentless Cha-Min can’t read scene-partner Mo-Gyum's thoughts at all, making him all the more intriguing... He can't get in his head, but that doesn’t stop him from trying to get inside his body. After all, they're just rehearsing the drama... The scenes heat up as the clothes come off between these two!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Choose one? Why not both? An average guy gets into a sexy, secretive relationship with two college girls who are so very different.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Includes 4 extra chapters.

To help Lady Selene avoid an unwanted marriage, the feisty maid Dian travels to the secluded Evenhart Castle in her stead and with her name! As she buys time for Selene, Dian seeks refuge with the Margrave, said to be a direct descendant of the legendary knight Sir Evenhart (Dian’s a BIG fan~). But even though he’s extraordinarily handsome, he’s as cold as ice. Somehow he agrees to let her stay a few days. Will her secrets (and his) be revealed? And could love blossom by the lake once again?

(Source: Tapas)

Not only is Charlotte becoming stronger, but Charlie is also changing...Each of them are missing something the other has... But will they be able to help each other out?

(Source: Toomics)

Rain awakens him in me. "don't be ashamed..." He knows all my desires, and I desire him more than anything in this world.

(Source: Toomics)

I suddenly started living with the most popular girl in school... But what does she want from me...?

(Source: Toomics)

I'm a sham online, but I can't believe someone actually believed in my lies... Were they serious about what they offered me...?!

(Source: Toomics)

My first love from high school suddenly disappeared… but 5 years later she comes to my store! What should I do...?

(Source: Toomics)

You are now the protagonist! The secret of the 15 minutes is revealed.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

With the appearance of the God Leto, there came justice. But all of that was a LIE.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
Wendy is a reclusive florist who doesn’t believe in love. That is until he came in, ready to destroy the walls caging her heart.

Rupia lives proudly as the daughter of a well-respected noble family. But to fulfill a prophetic oracle she and her friends, along with hundreds of other human females, will be offered up as brides for the Underworld’s demonic nobility. Upon meeting Edith, the alluring demon king himself, Rupia realizes her undesirable fate is to become his wife. With no time to mourn the life she left behind, she keeps her cool with an attitude of sheer optimism, all while maintaining a magical secret. As Rupia grows closer to Edith and uncovers the secrets of the Underworld realm, maybe being the demon king’s bride isn’t the nightmare she expected? Based on the hit novel.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 60 extra chapters.
A shipwreck, a mysterious island discovered by accident... It’s a fairyland with only women, and all beautiful women!!

8 years is a long time to have a crush. Doubly so if that crush is your own best friend. Han-gyeol is tired of his own heartsickness for his childhood friend Sooho, and he thinks that maybe it's about time for him to let go of these feelings. He's contemplating moving on, but there's something inside of him that can't help but cling to this crush. Will there be a reward waiting for Han-gyeol if he keeps holding on, or will it only end in heartbreak?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Without a stable job or home, Joo May lives recklessly, drifting from one lover's house to another. One day, May passes out, almost beaten to death by an ex-boyfriend he bumped into. When he wakes, he finds himself chained up in the house of Shin Jooin, the clean-cut man who apparently rescued him. But there's something off about Jooin, who treats May almost like a pet* Who is Jooin really, and what is he hiding?

(Source: TappyToon)

Seonho in an artist, who draws adult webcomics. It started as an easy way to make money, but it’s caused some unexpected side effects: he hasn’t been aroused for over two years! Exhausted, he hires an assistant. It’s just that, he didn’t expect him to be so cute! Muyeong is clean, talented, and apparently loaded so...why does he want to work under Seonho? Turns out, Muyeong is Seonho’s number one fan…

(Source: Tapas)

A mother, neglected by her family, finds herself in a sticky situation when she starts tutoring an adolescent boy...

(Source: Toomics)

A North Korean spy has infiltrated South Korea to find the math genius Donggu Park! Her mission? Seduce Donggu Park and bring him back to North Korea!

(Source: Toomics)

Lovelyn, a company where all the employees are underwear models... I thought this was my dream job, but why are these girls looking at me like that?

(Source: Toomics)

Sung-Jae is a diligent, clean-cut doctor who has lingering feelings for his first love from high school. Sung-Jae always finds Sa-in reappearing in his dreams just as his memories of him are about to fade. Then for the first time in 11 years, he shows up again in Sung-Jae’s life. However, Sa-In’s playfulness makes it hard to tell if he also has genuine feelings for Sung-Jae. Will this atypical encounter unfurl into romance?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Winner of the 1st Lezhin Comics BL Comic Contest.

Mature comic creator, Yuzu Woo, just wanted to move into her new apartment in peace. Too bad it’s haunted…by a handsome young ghost?! Taeil Jung is twenty-six, err…was anyways. He’s sweet, even if a bit of a ghastly goof but, to Yuzu, he’s just super spooky! She tries to ignore him but soon she finds him haunting not only her apartment, but her heart. They say the home is where the heart is, but does it count if your roommate is dead?

(Source: Tapas)

I casually joined an online club, but there's something covert and sexual about it. Somehow we're all connected to one another. Meet my "secret" neighbors!

(Source: Toomics)
Jae-Won has avoided dating after having a bad experience with relationships. But everything changes when he meets his childhood friend...

Mike gets a headache and sees a girl every single time he's with his girlfriend. Will he be able to find the cure for it?

(Source: Toomics)

A relationship that wasn't allowed...Even if we're not related by blood is it ok for two "siblings" to be together? No matter what society says...I still love you. A heartwarming tale of betrayal, lust, and whether it's ok to follow your heart.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After five years, things between Jiwon and her boyfriend are stable. Well, maybe stable is the wrong word. He's thoughtful, caring, and handsome... but the sex is horrible. Hanna, on the other hand, has a phonebook of one night stands... all of whom get detailed on her nightly blog. But, when these two meet, all bets are off.

The loner who was left to take care of business by himself comes by a strange videotape. The tape itself is "Beyond Imagination"!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Welcome to Cafe Dilemma, the solution to all your troubles. We will change your destiny...!

(Source: Toomics)

For the balance of mankind, our lives are being controlled by someone!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Taeyoung and Ami, young lovers from a peaceful lakeside town, grew up sharing dreams of fame and freedom. Taeyoung, son of actress Im Haedo, yearns to capture beauty from behind the camera, while Ami aspires to dazzle in front of it. But when Haedo’s film director boyfriend comes to town hunting for his next leading lady, the couple’s tranquility is shattered forever…

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Teach Me How to Please You

description:
From cooking skills to blowjob techniques, it’s Chang-nam’s job to make sure the robots at his training facility know how to act both in and outside the bedroom. But teaching these robots how to please their masters proves to be more complicated than programming a few commands…

(Source: Lezhin US)
Two siblings who were separated at a young age due to the death of their parents reunites again with many mysteries muddling their past.

After Jaehyun’s piano performance goes viral, world-renowned classical music professor, Kang Minwoo, takes him under his wing. This entails both a scholarship at a prestigious music school and... a sexual relationship outside of the classroom. Jaehyun hopes his special relationship with the professor will come with perks, such as an opportunity to study in Germany. But when the professor’s son, a piano prodigy, enters the picture, Jaehyun finds his plans thwarted.

(Source: Lezhin)
Ran, a high school female boxer, goes out into lawless territories of school bullies and school gangs to get revenge for her sexually assaulted younger sister.

The world is riddled with beasts and demons, however little do people know that a magical barrier is currently sealing away high-level demons. There are those who wish to break the barrier and bring about the end of the world, and those who wish to protect it and its inhabitants. A great battle with heroes, villains, demons and magic is about to begin and will determine the fate of the world.

Sol-A is a normal university student. Suddenly her boring student life is about to change when she takes in a cat named Hong-Jo. What kind of secret does her cat Hong-Jo have and what will happen to Sol-A's life because of it?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Left alone in front of the monastery during a troublesome time, Yub SeJun was thought to be a normal, abandoned baby. However, he had the power to change the world in the way he wanted. In the world, everyone followed the classical cultivation; however, SeJun follows his morals and creates a novel cultivation method. Can he become the new hero who will bring the world out of chaos?
A village hidden in the forest holds mysteries… But what happens when a foreign girl enters it?

By your side, even till death.

The boy, though born to a king, chose a path the whole world condemned. The girl, due to forces out of her control, was a pariah from the moment she was born. The stars align for this unlikely pair as their destinies entwine, and they form a bond that stands the test of time.

(Source: Manta)

Both of Evie's parents passed away when she was young. First her mother, then her father a few years later. Now, she's lost her stepmother leaving her, for the first time, truly alone. The only thing she has left to her is a letter from her stepmother addressed to Han Jung-hyuk, her mother's first love.
Delivering this letter will expose a side of her stepmother she never knew and reveal secrets that will make her question who her stepmother really was.

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, violent crimes detective Kang Jungwoo stumbles across a huge room full of cash and finds himself being hunted down by the rich and powerful. But exactly how far does this conspiracy go?

(Source: Toomics)

"This isn't the life that I wanted."

On the day of her wedding, Eunha, who has hidden the fact that she's a lesbian her entire life, decides to jump off a building and end her life, not wanting to devote her life to a person she can't love. Just as she leaps, she closes her eyes and wistfully reminiscences her first love whom she never told her feelings for... only to find herself 10 years back in high school when she opens her eyes. As she is reunited with her first love, will Eunha be able to turn back her ill-fated life?

The heiress of the Sungma Group, Na Mirae leads a relatively plush life. But after the death of her mother, the only thing that helps her get through the troubles of her household is art. Then she meets Ju Namyeob, a boy brimming with artistic talent, and the same love for art as herself. From two totally different worlds, they help each other fill the blank canvases of their lives. 2nd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest Winner.

(Source: Lezhin)

I never really thought she was pretty. I just thought she had a nice smile. So... how did I fall in love with my girlfriend's best friend?

(Source: Toomics)
Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

Mu Soh Wol opened his eyes 20 years later to stop the cults aiming to dominate the midlands. “Who are you...…!” The question of his defeated foes. But they received an answer that filled them with despair… “Mu So Wol...that is my name!” The legend of the War God, forgotten in time, has begun once more.

Even in death or rebirth… You won’t be able to get rid of me…

He ended his life because he was unable to accept the emperor, who had gone mad with obsession. But, after over a hundred years pass by… like fate or… fate playing some sick joke, he is born again, with his memories of his past fully intact. Even though he had made a vow to never see the emperor again, and had wished for nothing more than to have his memory wiped clean of him… Was he still unable to escape him even through death?! Despite his best efforts, he finds himself face-to-face with the reincarnation of the Emperor…

Note: The chapter count includes 5 extras.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Dai gets brutally bullied at school. One day, his mother gets killed. Although he may be weak, Dai seeks for revenge.

(Source: Toomics)

Now that webtoon artist Ji Won is 31, she's starting to lose hope of ever finding love. As fate would have it, she meets her first love at work, but there's one problem...he doesn't seem to remember her! Does he really not remember her? Or is he just pretending?

Noah prides herself in having many “more-than-friendship-but-less-than-love” type friends, but out of them Ji-Hoon Park is especially distant. So in her attempt to get closer to him, she gets drunk but accidentally gets physically friendlier instead. What a disaster. But, what's this? But after a drunken hookup, what's this? I'm loving his great body!!

(Source: Copin Comics)
What happened to this girl to change her so much?

Yoo-Wol is a sensitive and vulnerable musician scraping his way through college. While haunted by his family's nightmarish tragedies, he is hunted down by the loan shark Jung-won, who has been keeping him in a forced relationship. Yoo-Wol struggles with an urge to end his life, thinking he has finally reached his breaking point. Enter Yoon-Gyeol, a weirdo offering to help him out. The hotshot CEO claims to know his pain, and crazily enough, he seems madly in love with him! Yoo-Wol knows that kindness comes at a price. Will he accept Yoon-Gyeol’s offer and find the will to live?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

"Who could love someone like you?"

These few words spoken to Choi Hyun in high school have haunted him ever since. Unable to succeed in either his career or his relationships, Hyun sets all his hopes on one final job interview. But upon arriving at the office, he comes face to face with Kang Myungook, the source of his past trauma... Now on the same team, they'll have to work out their past issues first. Can the two heal old wounds or is this relationship destined to go down in flames?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a time not too far in the future, humanity will have achieved its goal of being immortal. But the younger generation conflicts with the older generation to obtain the right to grow up and succeed in their place. The fight rages on, with no clear hope for the young ones.

Who will win? Was war the only answer?

Jin, former leader of the South and stricken with amnesia, turns up after being gone. He is challenged at every turn to fight for his survival, all the while having doubts about the extreme situation.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
The story of a woman who gave birth to a child of God and a dokkaebi who loved her.

Princess Maeve lives in Aigina, a small country at the outskirts of the region. One day, she spends a night with Prince Carlin of Grango, and finds out that 'he' is in fact, a princess, not a prince...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Seoina, an art college student, freely has sex with her three male friends. One day, she suddenly declares that she has someone she wants to be with. What choices will Seiona's three friends make to deal with a future without her?

Omega Harim attacks a random stranger for money in the midst of his heat cycle. But the man he tries to attack is an Alpha and leader of a large organization. Believing that Harim was sent to kill him, the Alpha throws some heat cycle sedatives at him and warns him to not cause any more trouble. But then Harim foolishly steals the man's wallet and gets caught, after which he is forced to become the Alpha's maid…

(Source: Webnovel)

From the outside, Dr. Cha Hanjoo has the perfect life. He’s handsome, loaded, and the head of a famous dermatology clinic in Seoul’s richest neighborhood. If that wasn’t enough, he also has the perfect wife, Yeri. But beneath the veneer, cracks are beginning to form. Unable to satisfy Yeri’s sexual cravings, Hanjoo goes to inhuman lengths to please her. Who will get hurt in the process? Wounds heal, but the scar remains. And perfection never lasts forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 side stories.

Twenty-two-year old university student Ji-Ah dreams of becoming an CEO and living a happy and single life until she's 100 years old.

"Ji-Ah, I've set you up with the grandson of a Chaebol."

"Dad! What the hell are you talking about?"

She told herself that she would definitely reject him when they meet. But when she went, her super hot sunbae Yeon-Hoo was there?! And another chaebol's grandson, Seung-Ho appears?! Eventually, the three of them decided to live together in the same home so she could choose her fiance.

Then one day, Ji-Ah dreams of her wedding! As she looks up to the face of her groom... His face is... it's blurry!!!

(Source: Kakao)

Note: Includes a side story.

The relationship between a spirit forgotten in the times and a mysterious young man.
Hee-ji, a baby god who has escaped from his own land and adapted to the human world. Having trouble communicating with humans, one day, he meets a mysterious young man who understands him...

Do you know the history of millennial ginseng? According to legend, this plant with magical virtues could be reincarnated as a human by reaching the age of 1000 years. But she is a girl-plant, not easy to get used to the unpredictable daily life of men ... While she thought she had found her place, here she is accused ... of murder ?!

A village full of secrets.
A boy who can't escape.
And a girl who watches him.
Welcome to Franken's Village!

Daniel Winter, the werewolf, is on the run. The very person he's running away from is his past lover, Ian Summers, the dragon. Unconvinced by Daniel's disappearance, right after his proposal, Ian has made a vow to reclaim Danny's love once again, no matter what it takes.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Chapter count includes a prologue

Taesung, who was studying for exams with his girlfriend, decides to go to school at his brother's house in Seoul to focus on his studies. As he stayed with his younger brother and sister, Taesung was interested in his young and beautiful sister-in-law, and his sister-in-law, whose relationship with her husband was estranged, became more and more favorable to him....

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

It all began with a simple question. "What would you do if you had a perfect, safe opportunity... to cheat?"

(Source: Toomics)

From outside, Joyce has a loving family. However, after her father's death, everything changes to the worst. Her stepmother and her brothers start to abuse her. In the end, Joyce runs away and hides from them. She thought that was the end of it. But one night, her older step brother pays her a little visit with a proposition. He wants Joyce to seduce a prince charming. In order to do so, she must endure the harsh trainings to become a worthy of her target.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes Episode 0.

title.english: The Daughter of My First Love

description:
I had a first love, but I lost her... Years later, I saw her again...?! I couldn't help but want to find out who she was...

(Source: Toomics)

The story happens 6 months later after their graduation from the point of view of the girlfriend's ex-girlfriend!

Note: The series starts at My Girlfriend's Ex-boyfriend chapter 46.

The new boy group sensation “Poison” is out to conquer the K-Pop scene with their buff bodies and sexy charm. With a successful debut and thousands of eager fans, everything seems to be going well…or is it? As the group’s prim and proper leader, Sihyun should be dreaming of chart domination. But instead, his dreams are filled with fantasies about his groupmate, the sullen and mysterious Seong-eun. As the two spend more and more time together, they get caught up in a whirlwind of muddled passion and sweaty tension, both on and off the stage. Will they manage to keep things together? And will those dreams be fulfilled?

(Source: Lezhin)

Chapter count includes three special episodes and a prologue

Instead of borrowing the power of the earring and gaining strong strength, the people of Miao are suppressed by their side effects, the two families Aewol and Fan-Hwa who survived the crisis of extinction hundreds of years ago, both live quietly in the western part of the continent, serving as a guard for Dang Ju-Hwan. One day, 'Juno' a representative of the God of Yokai, descends to the ground and pronounces a 'trial' on the people of Miao. If they can't solve the mysterious ordeal, the two of them will disappear and the people of Miao will disappear from the earth..! Can Aewol and Fan-Hwa overcome this crisis? And why did the ordeal come to Miao?

A lifetime of hard work has finally paid off for Se-Rin. She's got a nice apartment, a promotion at work, but something's missing. A piece of her that she's pushed away for so long that when it comes back, it beats faster and throbs harder than she could've ever imagined. Flings are for students and teenagers. She may be all grown up, but that doesn't mean she's ready for her first scandal.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Winner of the 2nd Lezhin Comics Big Comic Contest.

I was Eun-Ho Sun’s biggest fan… And I never should’ve let her meet my boyfriend. I thanked my lucky stars when this mysterious author granted me the only interview she’d ever given in her illustrious career. She shared intense, off-the-record secrets with me. I even thought we could be friends. At first, it seemed like an invitation to her home would solidify our friendship, but she wound up in bed with my boyfriend. Will the woman I once idolized actually steal away the love of my life?!

(Source: Tapas)

A struggling cupid candidate Tae-Hwa goes through series of tests to finally become a cupid but his troubling past is holding him back. His test partner Dan-Baek, an elite student, dismisses Tae-Hwa for being a bad student but finds out the true story of Tae-Hwa and how he became a cupid candidate...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an extra.

No-eul is searching for the traitor in his organization, but finds only Gang-jin, a man who claims to just be a regular old vagrant. Intrigued by Gang-jin's cool demeanor even in the face of his threats, No-eul decides to keep him locked up for the time being. But there has to be more to Gang-jin than he is letting on... In the end, what secrets is he harboring and what are No-eul's true intentions?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eunsu is not happy that his mother’s new boyfriend has sons—a pair of twins at that. What was his mother thinking leaving out that important bit of information?! And when his mother tells him she might just marry the man, Eunsu is dead against it. But Eunsu’s trouble ensues when the twins are more than determined to win their new ‘hyung’ over and lend him a helping hand to change his mind. Will Eunsu give in and be bound to them in more-than-familial ties, or will he stay steadfast in his decision?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two side stories.

A the terrible murder surrounding a broadcast jockey involving the video editor-in-charge... What is the truth behind it?

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

How about talking to someone? Eating alone today? You never know what's going to happen!

(Source: Toomics)

My first love from 11 years ago has returned, but this time... I'll make sure she tells me how she feels!

(Source: Toomics)

Richard must use his body to save the world. But what if he's never used it before?

(Source: Toomics)

Sheila is such a great girl but if only she was more like my ex...

(Source: Toomics)

I woke up one night... to see that my pets have turned into humans!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Four different women with different taste in men meet on the last Tuesday of every month to share their stories.

(Source: Toomics)

Not all soulmates are meant to be.

Ho-Jun has always had a recurring dream that features the same girl. When a new coworker claims to be that girl and his soulmate, his world is turned upside down. As he starts regaining memories of what might have been his past life, something doesn’t feel right. Will he be able to piece together the truth? Are all soulmates really meant to be?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

I'm not here for love.

Si-Yun's been crushing hard on his high school tutor, U-Hyeon, and finally works up the courage to confess to him after graduation. U-Hyeon's answer? "Let's be friends with benefits." One night, Gyeong-Hu sees Si-Yun and U-Hyeon about to kiss outside a motel, stirring up something within him...

(Source: Manta, edited)

A cheeky office romance that erupts out of a slip of the tongue.

Shi-Won finds herself still reeling from the shock of being dumped by boyfriend number four. Her pride is on the floor from having to deal with the consistently emotionless and nitpicking manager Mr. Moon at the office. During a night out with her co-workers, she drunkenly calls him out. She ends up confessing her feelings and asking him out when all she had planned to do was apologize. Surprised by Mr. Moon’s acceptance of her invitation to go on a date… a secret office romance is ignited.

(Source: Netcomics)

The first time Hanbi visits an aquarium, she is mesmerized by the whale’s deep sense of yearning and sorrow. 10 years later, when she feels a similar intense connection to Sunwoo, she believes him to be the human form of that special whale. Smitten with love and pregnant with his child, Hanbi wants to make things official. Only, Sunwoo has no intention of settling down. Why would he, when there are other fish in the sea?

(Source: Lezhin)

Follow a bleak but honest tale of people from different backgrounds, all in their twenties.

(Source: Toomics)

Egregor is a story of four young heroes in a fantastic medieval universe in which a ruthless threat looms. Each of their destinies will be intertwined through their encounters and discoveries that they will make their lives. They will be guided to explore a mysterious world, filled with darkness.

A young blacksmith apprentice will have to discover these mysteries at the expense of everything he appreciates. Doomed to become a great hero, he must be careful not to be seduced by Evil and not end up embodying everything he hated...

Note: Reboot from the original Egregor manfra by Kaya Tachibana & Harumo Sanazaki (which was cancelled) based on Jay Skwar's original idea. The idea was later on picked up again and restarted as a manhwa by Jae-Hwan Kim in collaboration with Jay Skwar. This new version was first published on the Korean platforms Ridibooks and Naver Webtoons.

That day, they found a new world and thought that was a great thing for mankind. But fast forward, things turn out differently.

In a dystopian world, Crazy Dog, a biotic-mercenary, must fight humans transformed into monsters.

My wife's new job as a posing model requires more than just posing?

(Source: Toomics)

Kang In-Young, betrayed by his friend and his lover, is framed for murder and is thrown into prison. There he meets a fellow prisoner, an old man who used to be a petty thief. Turns out he stole a secret martial art from JeonJin sect, and to escape their pursuit, he intentionally broke the law to enter the prison and spent 30 years honing the secret martial skills. Tragically the old man catches a plague-like disease and is going to die… but after observing Kang, he decides to make him his heir and gives him the secret martial arts. 10 years after the old man's death he fully masters the secret art…

title.english: The Blue Guardian of the Princess

description:
The sickly Princess Yeong-Myung knew nothing of the violence and betrayal surrounding the royal court. Yet when the threat of a vile mythical beast and the machinations of the cruel Gaesi Kim loom large, she will do all she can to save her family from certain doom. Armed with only her wits and courage, Yeong-Myung must accept the aid of a stunning blue goblin who vows to be her loyal guardian. Can love win and save this unlikely pair from the vicious schemes that bedevil their every move?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

"Am I living in a webtoon right now?"

After joining a new company, he starts to notice something strange— his female superiors seem oddly familiar. Soon, he discovers the shocking truth hidden within their smartphones… their secret, intimate preferences revealed.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

A fun and sexy love story from the office! CEO Jungwon Han has it all--exceptional looks, high intellect, and great business sense. But all the advances from beautiful women don't move him in the slightest for he has a secret. What is his secret that he prefers a Renoir painting over a girlfriend?

(Source: Copin Comics)

Being the manager of a popular actress is not very fun. Hyojung is stuck on the sidelines running errands for Yeonkyung, the popular actress who also happens to be Hyojung's cousin. But Yeonkyung makes an interesting proposal: “Help me date Seungyun, Korea’s hottest star.” What will happen when Hyojung and Seungyoon begin a fake relationship to get back at Yeonkyung? They're just faking it, no emotions involved... right?

(Source: Manta)

A story of a man who falls in love with a married woman. Is infidelity true love?

(Source: Toomics)

Seon-ah is an ordinary office worker following a boring daily routine. One day during a workshop, she finds herself hiding in her team leader's closet and witnesses him masturbating while calling out her name...!

(Source: BomToon, translated)

College freshman Haeri is in her first relationship ever and is head-over-heels for her boyfriend, Rion. In fact, she can't help but fantasize about doing all sorts of lewd things with him... but why won't he get the hint? Follow this young campus couple on their first forays into the world of sex in this steamy college romance!

(Source: TappyToon)

Note: Includes 3 extra chapters.

Young, bumbling, and romantic, Daniel da Silva Rosa possesses a special gift: the ability to identify superheroes and supervillains on sight, even when they’re not in disguise! That’s how he stumbles into working as a low-level support agent at the International Federation of Super Heroes. But when Daniel’s love interest, the kind and sweet Wyatt, is exposed as a villain and arrested for murder and vigilante terrorism, Daniel must sleuth behind the scenes to suss out his beloved’s innocence.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

“Juan Seo” is a high school student who was born with just one eye. He has an uncanny feeling that someone is watching him every day at school. Even though he's scared to death, Juan can't help but be curious... Until one day, he learns of the "avian humanoids" and falls into a state of great confusion. In the midst of this blood curdling tension, the war of the avian humanoids is set in motion!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

My son was bullied by his classmates until he couldn't take it anymore... This is the story of my revenge against them all...

(Source: Toomics)

Detective Woojin Seo lives in an era where machines can prosecute criminals. Faced with Woojin’s murderous temper and obsession with bringing down the cartels, his supervisors place him under disciplinary probation and begin to rely on the machines to enact justice. But he’s given an opportunity to lift his suspension as an educational navigator to “Magnum,” a military-grade android, that people derogatorily refer to as “C.O.P.” or “Court of Puppet.” Will this unlikely pair have what it takes to defy the dark underbelly of this neon city?

(Source: Tapas)

Isaac was kicked out of his girlfriend's house on a dark and cold night. Suddenly, a man who introduces himself as her brother appears in front of him. Nowhere else to go, Isaac has no choice but to... move in with him?! This guy, Seo-Jun, might be a little full of himself but he's also rich and good-looking. Everything about Seo-Jun seems just perfect. But then what could be the reason he's showing interest in Isaac?.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

Tired from marriage, Kyung-Su goes on a trip with his best friend, Jung-Hyeok. On the road he encounters some fascinating girls and the more he refuses, the bigger his desire grows. And Kyung-Su's instincts starts to wake up in a dangerous encounter...

(Source: Toptoon, translated)

What would you do if you discovered that the third-rate story in your free daily newspaper was actually an account of someone’s murder? As Hae-Su Choi goes through his daily morning newspaper, “Rotary N,” to look for jobs, he stumbles across an ongoing serial thriller called “Epilogue.” At first glance it just seems like pulp fiction, but as the story progresses, the characters turn out to be real-life victims. Get ready for a series full of twists and turns, with murder around every corner.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

A not-so-beautiful love story between a woman and a pair of siblings caught in a complex love triangle.

During her monotonous days as a part-timer in a cafe, amateur photographer Hyeon-U meets a beautiful woman named Hui-Eun.

Secretly taking photos of the woman - who appears at the same time and sits in the same place - is the only thing that makes Hyeon-U’s world continue moving. However, after a week of her secret hobby, Hyeon-U’s eyes meet the woman’s across the viewfinder. What will happen to Hyeon-U now?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

The world has come to chaos. An unknown virus haunts every living soul, and one man is determined to reach his beloved before it's too late. His journey takes him closer and closer, but he faces adversity and strife.

That's when he faces reality. He sees the world around him. He sees a world faced with something more dangerous than the virus.

(Source: Tapas)

Gigantic wasps appear on school grounds and start devouring everyone. Han-Hui, Jong-Bin, Ju-Hyeon, A-Yeong, and Min-Ji run for their lives and safely hide inside food storage. Outside, however, all others turn into hybrids, one by one. Soon, a group of mysterious soldiers shows up and leaves them with syringes and weapons but no information. Now they realize that no help is coming and that there's something bigger behind this bug apocalypse. Will Han-Hui and her friends also turn into hybrids? Who are those soldiers? Against all odds, they must fight for their survival.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

To become a god in bed, all you need to do is accept female guests into your guest house!

(Source: Toomics)

The pathfinder searches for the "path" that grants wishes. It's great that Garam, an ordinary student leaves the world with impulsive thoughts but, When she comes back, the world became a ghost town where all the people and animals have disappeared.

To find her family and have the world back the way it was, she must find a “path”

You could be swept away by an avalanche in the mountains, Deep seas where it is difficult to breath, hellish labyrinths, and more.
