This is a series of hardships to find the paths that are in dangerous places.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

The day Se-Ul declares that she will stay single, three attractive men suddenly decide to pop into her life all at once. A man who matches her ideal type, a childhood friend she’s known for twenty years, and a man who checks off all the right boxes. Will Se-Ul be able to hold firm to her declaration of staying single?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

During the day he’s an administrative university assistant but by night, Shin Dowoon works as a demon hunter. Before him appears the promiscuous incubus in the form of a human student named Lee Hayoon. Hayoon offers a contract in return for letting Dowoon capture him. But because of the devil's tie-up play, Dowoon has no sympathy.

Will this rough play be enough to satisfy the demon?

Unstoppable girl meets immovable god.
Life is dull for Woonu, a god in exile and master of Hwawol Valley. One day, a young girl named Sowol crash lands on his mysterious, hidden part of the world in the hopes of finding the elixir of life to cure her dying sister. Will love blossom between this unlikely pair?

(Source: Manta)

Han-Sol, a part-timer at a convenience store reunites with a a handsome freak who appeared in front of him one day; the “Convenience Store Villain!” Here is the extraordinary love story between the two!

(Source: PeanuToon, translated)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

This story begins like any other, with a tragic death and reawakening in a new world. Kang Yerin, after being hit by a truck, wakes up as Ashley Lute, the 2nd daughter of a noble household. Without the burden of being the firstborn or the need to earn a living, “Ashley” expected to live worry-free. But, what should’ve been a cushy life in high society, soon turns into one life-threatening hassle after another. Pulled in every direction, she is forced to go on a quest to defeat the Demon King, forced to keep her heroic quest a secret, and forced to re-enroll at the academy she left behind years ago, making her a downright “fossil” compared to her peers. Trapped under her murderous older sister’s thumb and stuck between a sibling rivalry over the crown, Ashley can never seem to catch a break. In a twisted irony, how hard will Ashley Lute have to work to be able to live the easy life she’s always wanted?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

"Sometimes, your future gets decided by just one moment."

The whole kingdom of Jesús fell into a state of shock after hearing the news of Queen Mary Trizia’s Suicide. While everyone praised Mary Trizia for being an excellent queen, her older twin brother, Rafael Evans, was most suspicious of her death.

"It can only be you. No one else can save me other than you."

These words and the image of his sister screaming those words while approaching him bare-footed remained in his head. Rafael ventures out in search after his relatives for the first time in his life, to attend Mary’s funeral. But in the place where they found Mary’s body, Rafael finds a note…

“Lift up your face.”

Wanting to find Mary's killer, Rafael disguises himself as the new queen consort, Anne-Mary La Shore, and meets the king ‘Ivry.’

That moment marked the start of an unprecedented fate. The unexpected end of his sister who wasn’t like her younger self, and who he believed would find happiness…

What was the ‘hell’ that his sister dropped into? And what will change after Rafael and Ivry meet?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

With Earth’s future in jeopardy, the space colony run by UTS officials is paradise. Ace pilot Taeho’s a squadron leader for UTS, but after questioning their actions, he ends up on the scavenger crew of the Victory alongside rugged Tiger Park, sassy robot Updong, and fearless Captain Jang. They’re chasing dreams, working off debts, and pissing everyone off. Enter Dorothy… they take her in and now EVERYONE’S after them. Can they figure out this mess or is this a ticking time bomb about to explode?

(Source: Tapas)

A top secret K-pop romance!

Everyone knows that PAZE is the hottest idol group in Korea. But when one of the members gets injured, leader Haeun and main rapper Jaehyuk have to form a two-man unit in order to keep the group alive! But... why is Jaehyuk so happy about this situation?!

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

"I just want to tell him how I feel!"

Mi-Na has been planning on telling Yeo-Myung she likes him. But every time she goes to confess, something foils her plans. It turns out Yeo-Myung and Young-Woong, her best friend, were actually plotting to kill her. But why?!

(Source: Manta)

Getting struck by lightning, breaking a bone, failing examsㅡthese are the "accidents" that happen when one becomes friends with Jia. Bringing bad luck to people has been a condition of Jia's for as long as she can remember... until she meets Gun and Hyunㅡtwo mysterious brothers who happen to be wizards! With the help of magic, she's determined to ward off her curse no matter what. But does Jia realize what kind of sorcery she's actually getting herself into?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

“Please…hold me.”
“But, sir…”

Il-Yeon has left home to do a task at his father’s request. He has returned to a place he hasn’t been in ten years. My, how things have changed. And he can’t wait to see some familiar old faces again. But suddenly, one-night Il-Yeon is overwhelmed by a debilitating sickness. No, it can’t be…not here…not now… It’s that sickness that consumes his entire body with a burning fire that can only be treated by…the pleasure given by another. By chance or by fate, Il-Yeon stumbles upon the commoner, Ungae, and asks for his immediate assistance.
Il-Yeon has a duty to carry on the family line as a Yin being but he surrenders to his instincts and spends a dream-like night with Ungae. This is the tale of how Il-Yeon, the noble, and the mysterious Ungae, begin their unforgettable passion together.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Yeo-ho is a k-pop idol who’s struggling to financially support his younger siblings and keep his comatose mother alive. Desperate to make it big, he tries to make connections with the right people—but it all goes wrong when he finds himself on the brink of getting dragged into a drug scandal. The only person who can save him is the powerful representative of a conglomerate, Hyung-joo. To save his career, Yeo-ho must make Hyung-joo an offer that’ll change both of their lives…

(Source: Lezhin)

In the near-future, earth has become a wasteland due to a catastrophe called the Rit. Before and after the disaster, there are humans born with superpowers, called the "Amlita".

However, as time goes by, the conflict between Amrita and ordinary humans only grows... In the midst of the crisis of mankind, they meet Niko, a shy Amrita boy, and Riva, a girl with secrets. What unfolds next is the end of their adventure?! Crisis, a superpower action fantasy!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Lee Sang-Hee is a 25-year old ordinary college student who has a secret that he can't tell anyone. That he's 'Bedeuro', a porn star who made it to the headlines a few years ago. Sang-Hee buys up all of his own porn DVD just to hide his dark past. And one day, he got into an accident after getting into a strange man's car and meeting that man for a deal. Everything's going well, until he was left with no choice but to get back into porn with the guy involved in the accident to pay off his debts…

(Source: BomToon, translated)

The story of a martial arts novice impersonating a master.

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

A famous beauty influencer's secret.

B-Magic is the hottest beauty vlogger in the beauty industry. Everyone is always waiting for her next upload! Little do they know that B-Magic is trying to live a normal life as a high school boy? What secrets is she hiding? And will her classmates uncover her identity?

(Source: Manta)

Have you ever wondered if the person you like is dreaming about you? Teacher Yeoreum Han doesn’t have to guess -- she can make it happen, with her ability to walk into other people’s dreams. She can even link the dreams of two people together, and use this ability to play Cupid for her students. But her matchmaking goes awry when she enters the dream of Si-u Park -- a lucid dreamer, who realizes that Yeoreum is walking into his dream. Si-u and Yeoreum’s lives become intertwined after this incident, weaving a tangled web of love, friendship, and dreamers at Hanseo High.

(Source: WEBTOONS)
The ordinary lives of three boys take an unexpected turn when a talking chinchilla enters the stage!

First day as a landlord? Great. One of your tenants is your bully from high school? Not great. Well at least you can stand up for yourself now right? Oh you're still a coward? Sigh... This is truly the worst day ever.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

The new student is...a goblin?!

After surviving an accident, Ji-Yu is left with the ability to read memories, thoughts, and emotions left behind in various objects. She's been using her ability for the greater good, but after becoming the subject of unwanted attention, she's decided to stop...until Hwa-Yeong turns up at her school.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Princess Apollonia may seem weak and dim-witted, but the truth is, she’s not as clueless as she seems. She must keep up her act of ignorance to foil her cruel father’s political schemes and weave her way out of his arranged marriages. Her ultimate objective is to avenge the deaths of her mother and grandfather and shape her own destiny! With a few secret powers, a handful of trustworthy allies, and some schemes of her own... will Princess Apollonia successfully reclaim her throne as the rightful heir?

(Source: Tapas)

A trio of friends had a special agreement. They'd all have fun together but just stay friends. After a hiatus, they meet up again to find that those feelings aren't just simply bottled up...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jin-U is a struggling student who has to work several jobs. One day, he meets his best friend, Chan-Yeong and his girlfriend, Se-Jeong. Jin-U falls for Se-Jeong and breaks up with his girlfriend Yeo-Jin to be with her. However, Se-Jeong was not who she claimed to be...

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

The romance between the heroine who must die to go back and the hero who returns to stop her death Hero Arcane and Dana who is fated to die for heroine Stella. She must most faithfully live and die in order to go back to her own reality. But, why would the hero be so obsessed with me?! Also, is it just me or is it actually going way off the track...?! "I will never let you die because of me again, Dana!"

(Source: Lezhin)

Risbel Benedane is a top student at the paladin academy, Deravilael. He’s smart, agile, and hard-working. Everything was going well until Kendon swooped in and took his top spot. Risbel, as the son of the deputy commander of the paladins, cannot just sit there and pretend everything is fine. He summons the mare to go into Kendon’s dreams and mess with his mind. The mare accepts Risbel’s offer in return for his vitality. The plan seemed perfect. But wait, why is Kendon looking at me like that? Is he…blushing?

(Source: Lezhin)

4 friends meet up from time to time. 3 guys and 1 girl. You can guess what they do during these sessions. But one day, one of them decides that he is unsatisfied doing it so rarely. It'd be for the best if it was just the two of them...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Three girls born between my best friend and my first love. The eldest, she looks just like my first love. The second, she loves to flirt. And the third, young and innocent. My life will never be the same.

(Source: TOPTOON)

Baeksu’s brother has gone missing. In a manhunt to find him, Baeksu Kang encounters the night fishermen. Their prey isn’t fish, however -- it’s humans! Their favorite fishing spot? The Han River. Their last catch? Baeksu’s brother. Can Baeksu stay alive long enough to find out the secret behind his brother’s disappearance, or will the underground predators catch him first?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I dared to fall in love with him.
A lone house perched on the cliff of a miserable little island, and the man who was dethroned and exiled there. I watched him on behalf of my sickly father... and I dared to fall in love with him. Without even knowing what my fate entailed.

(Source: Manta)

Note: The Revised Version is completed with 74 chapters while the Mature Version is completed with 77 chapters. Chapter count includes 18 side story chapters.

Sangjin seems like your typical average joe working part-time at a convenience store. That is until you find out he lives with a human-eating monster. To keep the monster's appetite satisfied, he feeds the monster humans whom he deems to be trash of the world. One day, a girl named Jiwon, who believes the monster to be a god, decides to move in with the two. With the police closing in on Sangjin as the main suspect in the recent disappearances, how long will he be able to get away with this?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

I did it for the money...! But if I could turn back time, I would stop myself from entering that shop...!

(Source: Toomics)

Ji-Na, who has a mediocre talent, but is forced to play the violin as the only daughter of a big company. Gyeong-Mi, who had a genius talent, but was born as the daughter of a poor chauffeur and gave up on playing the piano. As Gyeong-Mi's father works as a driver for Ji-Na's family, the two meet and get closer through the link of music. Three years of puberty with music, they feel friendship and gradually love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a two-chapter epilogue.

Kiss more, win more!
Seung-A's a lifelong baseball fan, but she's on the verge of calling it quits. Her team, the Futures Victory, is on a notoriously long losing streak — until she kisses a fellow fan, and the Futures happen to win. Now back in the game, the two get intimate to push the Futures up the ranks...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes an epilogue and 3 extra chapters.

Chun-Sik Kim is the CEO of Novis Company, the company behind the VR RPG Novis World, but he has never played his own game before. After claiming that he could become a top ranker without paying any money at an update preview event, he starts Novis World with only his secretary and passion by his side. Will this old dog be able to learn new tricks and become the top ranker in Novis World?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Blessed with the ability to see and communicate with ghosts, Lady Julia Robinharts is always trying to make a quick buck off of her talents. For this self-employed entrepreneur, there is always money to be made in the industry of the supernatural. When Julia sells one of her talismans to a stranger who seemed to be weighed down by an apparition, she learns that kindness isn’t always repaid in coins, as the mysterious man asks to marry her in return. This man is actually Duke Leo Sirius Epesia, one of the most influential noblemen in the Floren Kingdom, and he seems to recognize her from 10 years ago. In the end, Julia is swayed into working as the duke’s personal ghostbuster, in exchange for a handsome reward. After all, what good is a loveless marriage compared to cold, hard cash?

(Source: TappyToon)

As far as Cha Dain’s concerned, orgasms are an urban myth. After yet another boyfriend accuses her of being terrible in bed, she and her friends find comfort in the arms of some handsome hosts at a karaoke bar. But Dain gets more than her money’s worth with one host, Han-hae, and their electric night of sex proves to be the answer to all her prayers. Their chemistry is undeniable, and after that night, fate has them running into each other around every corner. But constant miscommunications and reminders of where they first met make it surprisingly difficult for them to truly commit to this relationship. Can these lovers figure out how to put aside their egos and embrace something completely new?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Things are finally looking up for aspiring actress Bobae Lee, after her appearance on the hit matchmaking Reality TV show, “The Aftermath”. But when her co-star suddenly commits suicide, everything slowly begins to crumble as Bobae soon finds herself the new target of public hate. As she works to rebuild her career from the ground up, she quickly learns that fame can be a double-edged sword and that sometimes, the people closest to you can end up hurting you the most.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Jong-Hyeon is your average college student with a crush on a girl who’s dating somebody else. The fact that the guy she’s dating is a total jerk is just salt on the wound. Meanwhile, his classmate Seo-Jin happens to have a crush on that total jerk. After sharing drinks and sob stories, the two of them end up having sex. That’s not a big deal. The big deal is the scheme that Seo-Jin proposes to him to get their respective crushes to break up. It might be the worst idea ever, but it’s an offer that he can’t refuse…

(Source: Lezhin X, edited)

Does love really last forever?

College student Izzy Noh thinks her loving relationship with her boyfriend Minsu will last forever… until he cheats on her. To make things worse, they are not only in the same school, but in the same Game Developer Club. Izzy must now navigate handling the breakup, dealing with her feelings, and possibly opening up to another shot at love. Will Izzy and her friends from the Game Developer Club find true campus love?

(Source: Manta)

Ihn Kim is an explosive Taekwondo fighter who can throw brutal kicks, but his opponents don’t take him seriously because he’s held back by all the sparring rules. However, changes are coming in the Taekwondo world that just might give Ihn a fighting chance. Can Ihn beat the people who once mocked him and show everyone that his style of Taekwondo is no joke?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Eunjo is an ordinary office worker who lives by the personal mantra, “There’s always tomorrow!” She’s lazy, messy, and clueless when it comes to looking presentable. Her colleague Wan Jo is the polar opposite. He’s religious about self-care, and particular about his carefully constructed image. But they both have something in common: they’re constantly at war with their past and future selves.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.romaji: Dasi Hwangtaejanimgwa Sseom Tal Su Isseulkkayo?
title.english: Can I Get Back Into Love With the Crown Prince?
title.native: 다시 황태자님과 썸 탈 수 있을까요?

description:
Baek-Ah aspired to become an idol, the day when she could stand on stage came near. While rehearsing for their debut, the ground suddenly shakes, the wall collapses, and she enters a different world through the portal of the clock tower.

The time when Baek-Ah fell into a fairytale book was the time when she suddenly become engaged to Prince Philip. That is why the world in the fairy tale has become chaotic.

In fact, Kairos, the country of Princess Sua, was just a small country without a princess. Therefore, without the support of the empire, it was on the verge of collapse. Philip took special care of Kairos by his own authority and waited for Sua to wake up. However, when Baek-Ah wakes up, she fails to remember the world in the book and disappoints Philip. Disappointed, he even brings up the story of breaking up.

The imperial family held a ball. On the surface, it was a place to socialize with the princesses of the subordinate country, but in fact, it is a 'place of confrontation' to find a fiancée again.... King Anno of Kairos asks Baek-Ah to save the kingdom and pushes Baek-Ah, who has not yet understood the situation, to attend the imperial ball. Baek-Ah goes there with her maid, Lindsey.

In the atmosphere of the ballroom, which is like a survival program, Baek-Ah shows off hers kills, saying that if you are an idol, you have to catch everyone's eyes in other worlds, and wants to be seen by Philip again.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

After his sister’s sudden disappearance, Rowe is contacted by the police officer Mark. Giving little information about the situation, Mark says Rowe has to infiltrate Mother Earth (ME), a huge pharmaceutical company, in order to find the whereabouts of his sister. Rowe soon begins working there as a bodyguard, working close to Chairman A, a beautiful and mysterious man. Even though the situation is dangerous, there is a strange attraction between them, so strong that will lead them to a physical relationship. The more they get involved, the more Rowe can investigate the connection between ME and his sister’s disappearance, but his heart often wavers wanting to believe in A… It is the beginning of Rowe’s battle with himself to decide if he can trust Chairman A or not.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I was reborn as an extra character in a novel whose soul was sucked to death from the villain. If you were reincarnated, what would you do?

For eighteen years, I lived under various abuses as a s*ave for my family. Fortunately, before my parents forced me to be sold to the villain like in the original novel, I succeeded in running away. I spent a short but happy time with Momo, a stray dog I met in a rural village. But three months later, the pampered puppy disappeared! To make matters worse, I was captured by my family and was given to the villain.

The moment I was discouraged when I was about to die,

“Why are you so surprised? It’s me, Momo, your puppy.”

My beloved pet turned into a villain? And that villain is my “fated counterpart”?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Swept up in a housing swindle, Bi-Ya and Chang-Sik end up as unlikely roommates - but Bi-Ya has a secret that doesn't bode well for her tricky co-ed housing situation... When Chang-Sik wakes up one night to find her straddling him, completely naked, she admits to being able to see ghosts - needy, horny ones with very specific bodily needs. With ghosts flocking to their room every night, the two newly met strangers must figure out a way to fend them off!

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

A free voucher to a luxurious 5-star hotel! But soon people find out that this hotel is not an ordinary hotel. There seems to be a terrifying plot behind this event...

(Source: Toomics)

Serena and Mitch are both outcasts who fall for each other. Trapped in a dangerous situation, will they both be able to escape and find paradise?

(Source: Toomics)

"Why don’t we… give it a try?" I’ve known her for 7 years, and we do everything together. We watch porn, and she’s even spreading her legs in front of me! How long is this going to go on? Should I just cross the line?!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

A professional killer finds a cute pet sitting in front of his house. But there seems to be a secret behind that cute face...

(Source: Toomics)

Georgia 2066, in a world overrun by a zombie epidemic, Ryu Kai has always admired Croix. He thought that their paths would never cross, but suddenly he is assigned a mission with him !! The implications will be more than unexpected….

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: Master of the Wind and Moon

description:
During the Silla dynasty, both male and female courtesans fill the halls of Unru, a brothel located on a mysterious island shrouded in fog. It is here that two longtime friends, Yeol and Sa-Dam, begin to explore their feelings for one another. Enter Queen Jin-Seong, who has her eye on Yeol.

(Source: Manta)

27-year-old virgin Eun Chae-Yi becomes an overnight sensation when a Hollywood star kisses her at an airport in front of hundreds of fans and cameras. And if that isn’t enough, the next night, a handsome prince of a mysterious country woos her into an unforgettable one-night-stand. But when both these strangers insist that she is their lover from a past life, Chae-Yi must figure out what are memories and what are dreams, what is fate and what is fraud.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Years ago, Daniel Barton made a contract with a demon to survive. When he stole the demon’s name and fled, the creature vowed to hunt him down. Now, Daniel is a mediator for an organization keeping the existence of non-human creatures a secret. When a case involving the First Lady’s death brings him to Washington, Daniel reunites with Jesús Miller, the one whose name he stole. Though he has yet to be recognized, Daniel is worried that Jesús' growing interest in him may make escape impossible…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

Jun always wished to live freely, away from his father's meddling. He finally gets his own place and enjoys doing whatever he wants, without knowing that a strange girl lives there too!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

title.english: Talent Agent and the Threads of Fate

description:
Ever since former screenwriter, Injoon Kim, was nearly taken to the underworld by mistake, he has been able to see Threads of Fate—white where fortune awaits, and black where misfortune looms. This newfound ability quickly proves itself useful as Injoon becomes a manager in the entertainment industry and successfully saves the actress, Hye-ryung Yun, from a fatal accident. Will Injoon be able to use these Threads to his advantage and bring Hye-ryung to stardom?

(Source: Tapas)

The witch "Lyla" who studies pleasure, buys a rare red-eyed black wolf while looking for familiars so that she could further her research. Lyla brought the wolf home and fell asleep but then is attacked by a wolf who turned into a man! However, she is able to skilfully subdue the attack...

Join Lyla on her journey as she begins to establish the hierarchy for a bound, but still rebellious familiar!

Sisters Ju-eun and Hyejin grew up in absolute poverty. After their mother’s death, Hyejin accepts the offer to join their estranged father’s wealthy family. But when Hyejin turns out dead just three years later, Ju-eun is grief-stricken. She grabs at the chance to travel back in time and take her sister’s place where she meets the kind but mysterious Iho.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A few friends head to an island for beach relaxation and fun. But when night falls they realize that their boat has mysteriously disappeared. Can these sheltered bums survive on their own? A tale of mystery, violence, sex, and the true nature of humans.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After 3 years together, this couple has decided that they can't progress unless something changes. To improve their sex, they take the advice of some old friends and decide to make a list of their deepest, darkest sexual fantasies...

(Source: DAYcomics)

A famous but blunt doctor and a woman that promotes sketchy plastic surgeries meet. The meeting between these two causes their personalities and lives to change completely. A heartrending story about a man with no lies and a woman shrouded in them.

(Source: INKR)

Teaching assistant Han Bom from the art department starts dating her longtime crush and fellow teaching assistant Nam Hae-Seong from a different department. But she gets approached by a promising art student Lee Yun-O.

For some reason, Nam Hae-Seong starts to avoid Bom after they start dating while Lee Yun-O waits for her everyday, tells her he loves her everyday, hugs her tightly and tells her to come to him everyday.

The person I love, the person who loves me, and my spring orchard of flowers, wine and candlelight.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

One of Sanghoon's preschool students ruins his friend’s coat. He frantically goes to his tailor to get the coat fixed, only to find it closed. Running out of time, Sanghoon looks for another tailor, who happens to be Deokjin…

(Source: Lalatoon)

Ah-choo! Something about being around Jaehyun just gives Suyong the urge to sneeze. On the one hand, Suyong’s body seems to be rejecting Jaehyun’s mere presence but on the other…they can’t seem to keep their hands off of each other. Seems like these two are the definition of love-hate relationship. The plot is always the same in these stories. They end up getting into the same college, becoming roommates and then living happily ever after. Right? Well, not quite for our dynamic frenemy duo. Suyong’s sneezing fits end up ruining everything. He and good buddy Kim Norman have to matriculate a year later than planned. But a chance run-in on campus lands Suyong and Jaehyun back at each other’s throats. Or is it with their tongues down each other’s throats? Oh, and just who’s the top and who’s the bottom here? Something’s gotta give...and where does our little friend Normie fit into this topsy-turvy mess?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Min-soo's tasteless life changed when he found his favorite snack house. After heading inside, he realized that it wasn't just the food that looked tasty...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

title.english: Preventing the Making of a Tyrant

description:
In contrast to her past life in Korea, the storybook world Rayne Haatz inhabits is full of wonders—think dreamy powers, nobles inspired by card suits, and anthromorphs. There’s just one issue… her destiny in this world is to die! Luckily, it seems that someone wants her alive. In her fourth life, Rayne vows to stop her scheming family from giving Emperor Jaynen the dark nightmares that drive him mad and lead to her death. But after three deaths, has Rayne learned enough to change her fate? Or will her feelings for Jaynen complicate her plans?

(Source: Tapas)

Soon after losing her parents in a tragic car accident, Seol-Young meets her end, her death cleverly faked as a suicide by the murderer. She draws her last breath - cursing the Hong family for everything they'd done to make her life miserable - and wakes up in an entirely different world, with servants tending to her and addressing her as "My Lady." Now in her new body, Seol-Young must find a way to not only fend for herself in this hostile new world, but also cast her long-awaited revenge!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Silvia Lauren is the duchess of the Aswan estate and the wife of the bloodthirsty war addict, Duke Victor Aswan. She is also one-month pregnant with Victor’s first child. At least, that’s the facade she has created in order to secretly reside in the duke’s castle while he is away fighting in a war. But when Victor returns from battle much earlier than anticipated, Silvia fears that her intricate lies will all come to light. However, instead of throwing her out of his home right away, Victor decides to go along with her scheme and happily awaits the birth of his nonexistent child—and by happily, it’s more like threateningly. How long will Silvia be able to keep up with her lies and remain by the ruthless duke’s side?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Moa’s in a pinch. Her friends are asking about her nonexistent sex life, but she’d rather die than admit that she’s a virgin. In a hurry, she makes up a haphazard lie: yeah, she’s had sex before. With a really hot imaginary guy called Yura! Not only is he ripped, well-hung, but he also…happens to be very, very real. When faced with the real Yura, there’s only one thought in Moa’s mind. She needs to make her lie become a truth!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Widowed on the day of her wedding, Yeo-Hun has lived a lonely life all alone... Until one day she learns the taste of love.

(Source: Lalatoon, translated)

title.english: My Teacher Has Chosen My Husband Candidates

description:
Lena has been counting the days until she comes of age. This is all to finally confess her feelings to Nix, her teacher, so that he can become her husband instead of her guardian. But on her long-awaited birthday, Nix suddenly vanishes without a trace, and five years pass in the blink of an eye. Lena dutifully tends to Nix’s store while waiting for his return. Then one day, out of the blue, she receives an absurd letter from Nix that says he’ll be sending prospective husbands her way that he has carefully sought out and selected during his absence. All Lena wants is for Nix to come home, but surely it couldn’t hurt to play around with these candidates in the meantime, right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue and five side story chapters.

A courteous story compilation:

1. Ui Baldeunge Kiss-reul (의 발등에 키스를, Kiss the Queen’s Foot) by Seung-Ri Ma
2. Iltarui Mat (일탈의 맛, The Taste of Deviance) by nyx
3. Jimseung in Office (짐승 인 오피스, Best in the Office) by Kkorom and Neo Gul
4. Seobangnim (서방님, Hubby) by Manyong
5. Horangi Nanggunnim (호랑이 낭군님, My Tiger Husband) by Goyo and Huisu
6. Saeki (색희, Saekhee) by Yadamga

Mo-Yeon is filled with lewd curiosities, when she becomes fixated on the idea that she wants to imitate a porn video she saw. When she finds Do-Ha, her childhood friend... She goes to him to make a proposition.

(Source: Copin Comics, edited)

A prototypical B-grade guide, Kang Yoon-oh is content with his ordinary life as an average guide. That is until one day, an S-grade esper, Kim Hyuntae comes to him for guiding. After finding Yoon-oh’s guiding abilities extraordinary and exactly what he needed, Hyuntae eventually requests that he become his very own personal guide. Now, working for Hyuntae, Yoon-oh’s life is about to go from simple to special…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Rule #1: Don’t reveal your identity!

Sa-Rang may be a loner at work, but in the MMORPG game Black Star, she’s a charismatic hero! So when the toxic Black Peng steals her thunder as the strongest player, she begins to feel conflicted. Now the search is on — is Black Peng the new Art Director, Jeong-Hun? Or her childhood friend, Jun-Yeong?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

[PUBG UNIVERSE] When Leah finally returns to her small town after five years, she doesn’t find the warm welcome she’s expecting, as she opens the door to find her father’s corpse hanging from the ceiling. The police rule it a suicide, but the longer she stays in town, the more she suspects that it was anything but. In the middle of it all is a violent book her father was writing called Battlegrounds, which has half of its pages missing. But the townsfolk don’t appreciate Leah snooping around, and there’s no limit to what they’ll do to stop her from uncovering the truth.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Follow the sometimes whimsical and sometimes fiery journey of Seo-An, Cheong-Rok, and Cho-Yeon as they each strive to find love and romance in their lives in and out of the royal palace. A tale of loyalty, passion, and survival, Royal Love Records is a sensuous yet intense journey into a world where love is as dangerous as the throne itself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-An met His Majesty by chance on his way to the state exam. Having passed the exam, he is now a civil servant dressed like a concubine!? Seo-An's turbulent palace life begins!

A variety of pairings await you, such as king X civil servant, crown prince X military officer, and more! ♡

(Source: Wisdom House)

Note: Includes 6 extra chapters

title.english: How to Break Up in a Romance Simulation

description: Lee Young-Ah, a layoff expert at global company Rigveda, immerses herself in a love simulation game with her favorite character! But all the male lead targets are in a relationship with her, and her favorite character is far from being a fling. Unintentionally, Young-Ah comes up with an idea. Making use of the ability of a lay-off expert to break up with the male leads. Will Young-ah be able to make a safe separation and get her hands on her favorite character, Ren Brecht?

“Even now, when I think about it, my teeth grind, I was fooled.”

Yeon-Woo, who had a crush on Keith and became true lovers, will he be able to break the long chain of lies? A sweet and creepy spin-off of Kiss Me, Liar!
The journey of a pair of siblings, Dan-Yeong and Dan-Ri who seek revenge against the arch-nemesis of their parents.

High school mukbang streamer who specializes in spicy food.

One day, while looking at the necklace her mother gave her, she falls asleep. When she wakes up, she finds herself in the body of a poor girl, living in the Joseon Dynasty…

(Source: Copin Comics)

Commander Liza Mary of the Imperial Knights returns victorious to the Empire of Phaeton after a long war to subjugate an enemy kingdom. But little did she know that her beloved fiancé Illian would leave her for Flora, the princess of the fallen enemy kingdom… After drinking herself into a heartbroken stupor that night, Liza awakens to the modern world in the body of timid high-schooler, Do-Eun. Puzzled and confused, Liza seeks to find out what happened and return to her own world, aided by Do-Eun’s friends Ian and Lora, who look suspiciously like Illian and Flora!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

On a snowy day, a beautiful transfer student named Anna, joined the boarding school. With Anna's captivating beauty, she became the object of everyone's envy. While Colette, who was the opposite of Anna in every way, builds a delicate love-hate relationship with her. All of a sudden, Anna leaves the school. A long time passes before Colette reunites with Anna, at the place where she starts working as a tutor for a noble family...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

For Ju-Jeong, who lives in a harsh reality, alcohol is the only thing that keeps her going through tough times. One day, she happens to drink a Myeong Ju containing celestial spirits. Intertwined with the beer and soju spirits, incredible things begin to unfold in her life.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Outed in high school?!

In the middle of the night, high schooler Jung-Yoon sends a teary text to her ex-girlfriend in the hopes of winning her back. But much to her horror, she discovers that she's actually sent it to Do-Young, the most anti-social girl in her class! Will she be outed at school?!

(Source: Manta)

"You're the older sister — just let it go. Can't you even do that for her?"

Irene has always been living in the shadow of her ill and frail sister, Riel. She believed that she could and had to do everything for her family... until Riel stole everything from her.
After realizing that there is no place for her in her home and that she was never loved by her family, Irene decides to do her utmost to become independent, and in doing so, crosses paths with Noel Kristen, a man who has been subjected to a much similar fate...

"We may be able to save each other."

Note: This is a promotional one-shot.

Throughout history, humans have been at war with the Fallen, demonic creatures who were banished to live in the Barrens for their sins. One day, the king of the Fallen, Azazel, is captured by the imperial hunters led by General Mu Ryang. But contrary to the general’s initial beliefs, Azazel isn’t the cold-hearted monster the legends have made him out to be. In fact, he shows compassion for his fellow Fallen who have been ruthlessly hunted down by the humans, and even offers himself up in exchange for his people’s safety. After this eye-opening encounter, Mu Ryang begins to question who the sinners really are, and Azazel plans to use the general’s changing perspective to turn him against the crown prince, Jeong Jin, and put an end to centuries' worth of conflict.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Soon after starting out a new life on his own, a young man gets into an accident and ends up getting in trouble with the woman upstairs. However, she turned out to be a popular celebrity!

(Source: DAYcomics)

She has a perfect career and a perfect boyfriend. But why does she feel a little empty?

(Source: Toomics)

My paper tiger came to life!

A mother breathes life into an origami tiger. A cyborg detective stalks a serial killer. A world overrun by AI. Based on bestselling author Ken Liu's short stories, these four mesmerizing tales set in a world that's not quite ours explore themes of love, loss, and what it means to be human.

(Source: Manta)

1-5. Cheonsaengyeonbun (천생연분, The Perfect Match)
6-9. Simulacrum (시뮬라크럼, Simulacrum)

My paper tiger came to life!

A mother breathes life into an origami tiger. A cyborg detective stalks a serial killer. A world overrun by AI. Based on bestselling author Ken Liu's short stories, these four mesmerizing tales set in a world that's not quite ours explore themes of love, loss, and what it means to be human.

(Source: Manta)

1-6. Jongi Dongmurwon (종이 동물원, The Paper Menagerie)
7-15. Regular (레귤러, The Regular)

An assassin of the Murim Alliance that inherited the work of a Demonic Cult Leader.

He stands up after being down and out, and gets out into the Jianghu! This is the incredible Jianghu journey of the world’s best Assassin, Lee Gwang.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

When will the celebrity career of two-faced actress Min Seo-Hui end?

The popular movie actress Min Seo-Hui's pretty face and excellent acting skills are enough to win the public’s love.

Her shocking secret is that she is a lesbian who has numerous love affairs with fellow entertainers to staff members and even managers! Her agency, unable to tolerate Seo-Hui's numerous relationships, assigns Mi-So, the embodiment of normalcy, as her manager.

There is only one person who failed to succumb to Seo-Hui's advances - Dong-Gyeong, a junior from the theater club she attended during her pre-debut days, who now works as a film director. Reunited at a high school classmate’s funeral, Dong-Gyeong is still aloof. Seo-Hui, whose ego is hurt, takes the lead role in the film director’s independent film in order to seduce the woman she couldn't have…

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

title.english: Time to Call Off This Engagement

description:
Soojin is suddenly transported into the 18-year-old body of Leah, the second female lead in her favorite web novel. As a villainess reincarnate, her mission is to avoid a terrible ending. Soojin's only option is to break off the engagement... However, Devan, her egotistical fiancee is not making this easy, not one bit.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

A trio of siblings have to fend for themselves after their parents die. The older sister decides to take matters into her own and decides to earn some money through shady ways...

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Includes an epilogue

An unexpected ghostly romance.

Jae-Hee, who has been able to see ghosts his entire life, will do anything for money. So he doesn't miss an opportunity when he hears of Cheo-Yong, the ghost able to grant any and all sorts of fortunes. Instead, what he finds is a sleepwalking girl possessed by Cheo-Yong... What is this all about?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.
Note: Chapter count includes six side story chapters.

A beautiful girl dating simulation game as a webtoon! And one of the girls in the game looks just like the girl next door?!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Men and Women, their secret desires, brought together through a completely private messaging app!

(Source: Toomics)

Death is usually the end, but for Erik, it’s just the beginning. Though he can’t remember anything before he died, he remembers that he wants revenge and a reason why he was killed. Together with Moll, the mysterious girl who brought him back, the two embark on a journey to find out who they are and what circumstances put them in their current predicament.

(Source: Manta)

The teacher's assistant from my high school called me out of the blue... What does she want?

(Source: Toomics)

Han Kang, who has just been discharged from the military, meets a naked stranger, Kang Rae-In, at his older sister's house that he visited after a long time. Han Kang, who mistakes the adult Kang Rae-In for a high school student with nowhere to go, takes pity on him and invites him into his room, and the two suddenly start living together...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Myung-Ha, cast out by his family and forced to live a lonely life as a gravekeeper, is suddenly tasked by his father with a peculiar “errand.” What seemed like a simple task brings him to none other than the estate of Grand Prince Howon, Yi Sa-Hwon. In the blink of an eye, Myung-Ha goes from being a gravekeeper to the wife of the enigmatic prince. Alone in an unfamiliar place, the only warmth Myung-Ha can rely on comes from Sa-Hwon’s kindness. Yet that kindness proves dangerous to trust, for the Sa-Hwon of the night is an entirely different man...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

"A stranger changed my life."

While struggling to survive his troubled life with no one to rely on, Ji-Ho Kim stumbles into Woojung Yeon and follows him. "Favors are not free." Ji-Ho's way of seeing the world paints Woojung as an untrustworthy character, but Woo-Jung's continuous kindness finally begins to open Ji-Ho's heart.

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

A dizzying office love affair between an S-class esper and a B-class guide! Lee Jaeha, a B-class guide, had an office relationship with an esper at the same center for 3 years, but was recently done wrong. Despite breaking up with his lover, he finds himself forced to still guide him, and he applies for a transfer to a high-risk area. Surrounded by all kinds of rumors and stares, all he wants is a quiet and peaceful work life in the new center! However, Jaeha takes on the task of guiding Do Jiyoon, an S-class esper, on the verge of a rampage, and Jaeha’s work life is getting farther away from peaceful…!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Stuck in a game with a lousy hero? Me too!

Min-Jun, a normal office worker, wakes up inside the game he was reviewing for his friend. It's not his fault the trailer was so boring it put him to sleep! Bewildered, Min-Jun is tasked with summoning a hero to guide. The hero certainly looks strong, but he seems to be less useful than expected.

(Source: Manta, edited)

After barely waking up from a coma caused by a car accident, Lark is in despair when he learns he can no longer dance. Lark resents Sadin for the car accident and leaves the academy where he danced for years, resolving to start a new live. After a difficult day, Lark's ex-boyfriend Kwai comes to visit him.

But what? The car accident wasn't caused by Sadin?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Choi Gyutae is a French high schooler who comes to Korea as a transfer student. On his first day of class, he meets Lin Seok: a handsome student who just so happens to be in the same class. Lin Seok’s friendly disposition and irresistible charm leads Gyutae to fall head over heads the moment he lays eyes on him. However, on their way back home Seok says something that makes Gyutae lose all hope of the two of them ever dating: “Guys who don’t keep their virginity...should really just go die.” Taken aback by this unrealistic condition for love, Gyutae decides to settle for the two of them remaining platonic for the rest of their lives. Six years later, they’ve become good roommates and even better friends. But when Gyutae witnesses something that shocks him to his core, their relationship might be in danger. Will a misunderstanding cause their friendship to be dead in the water? Or will their relationship be able to survive the competition?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extras

Yona’s been dreaming of this day for seven years.
It’s his 18th birthday and he can finally sleep with Park Chang-il. What’s with the age restriction, you ask? Well, Chang-il is a neighborhood prostitute that Yona's been following around like a puppy for years, just waiting for this moment. But one look at Yona’s oddly big junk, and Chang-il has decided he needs to charge double for this little pervert. Will Yona, who has a thing for bad boys, finally be able to seal the deal? And will Chang-il treat this as just another business transaction or can Yona actually win him over…?

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: Love is like the Weather Forecast

description:
It’s all rainy days for Ban Dong-Wook. Haunted by ghosts, he is unable to fall asleep no matter what he does. But one night, with Lee Do-Hyun by his side, he is able to clear his mind and drift off into dreamworld. Dong-Wook is convinced he needs Do-Hyun, but the latter is scared to love him in return. Will the two be able to work through the storm and find sunny days ahead? Or is the hurricane that is love destined to tear them apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Gyu-Jin is special. He’s the only son of the legendary blue-eyed German shepherd family…and he’s a 26-year-old virgin. To carry on the family lineage, his parents organize an arranged marriage. However, Gyu-Jin cannot think of getting married to a stranger, let alone a female shepherd. He impulsively decides to ruin his parents’ scheming by preemptively announcing that he prefers smaller dogs. In order to cover up his lie, Gyu-Jin asks his childhood friend Young-Woon, a small breed, to act as his boyfriend in front of his parents. Young-Woon agrees under one condition: Gyu-Jin must act like he really has feelings for him! With such a strange demand, could Gyu-Jin be barking up the wrong tree?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters

Heewoon Kim dreams of a hot and steamy night with childhood friend and his long-time crush, Sunwoo Ahn, but lacks the courage to speak up and so devotes his time writing erotica instead. Coming from a wealthy family, Heewoon also has grand aspirations to sell his work off to Hollywood someday and he'll confess his love when that happens!

When one day, Heewoon witnesses Sunwoo, too busy to hang out, walking down the street with an unfamiliar girl and realizes his first crush is coming to an end. Heewoon falls asleep crying but wakes up in a dream world. And somehow he keeps ending up with Sunwoo...?

My erotica is becoming reality! Who knows?! I'll enjoy it!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Three dates to save the bookstore?!
Banished from the celestial realm for interfering in the fate of a mortal, Ju-Hee now lives a mortal life herself as the owner of a bookstore. When she suddenly receives an eviction notice, she visits her landlord to plead her case. But what will she do when he makes her a peculiar offer?

(Source: Manta)

In a world where gates suddenly appeared, Espers were like a national power. South Korea's representative S-Class Esper, Cha Jae-U, had a problem: after he gained his powers, he couldn't find a guide who had a high match rate with him.

Thus, it was mandated that all citizens must take the guide test.

"No way... I really hope this is not the case, but..."
"Haa..."
"...Is it Cha Jae-U?"

Hae-Yul took the test, thinking he might as well get it over with, and he set a record of an unprecedented 97.8% match rate with Cha Jae-U!

"So what? I'm a D-Class...!"

Cha Jae-U was an S-Class Esper who had never received proper guiding before and was on the verge of exploding, while Hae-Yul was a pathetic D-Class Guide. Wouldn't even something like going after a boss monster as soon as you select your character be a better choice than that? Hae-Yul was about to refuse, having lost all energy at the thought that he might die, but...

"If a guide for Esper Cha Jae-U doesn't appear, then he will be killed."
'...A-Are they insane?'

Just who was he worrying about, when he might die if he accepted? But after hearing that if he didn't become Cha Jae-U's guide, the Esper would die, Hae-Yul swallowed his tears and signed the contract.

"Um... I already did today's amount this morning..."
"That's it?"
"That's the best I can do..."

Afterward, Hae-Yul lived in one house with Cha Jae-U and a particle-sized amount of mana. He ended up guiding him once a day, but...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for a web novel of the same name.

Choi Su-Won is a genius actor who really loves acting. Suddenly his life being stormed by a bad actor, Cha Ho-Yeong! I can't believed that my role was stolen by an actor with such bad acting. So, I was out for a drink and I don't remember how both of us could be in the same room, naked! But, even though I hate him... He's so handsome...!!

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Jinwoo Kim, a university student with severe social anxiety, returns to school, determined to make new friends and overcome his conditions. But when his eyes meet Han Choi, the handsome and popular underclassman, he gags and runs out. Humiliated, Han vows to make Jinwoo fall for him. A seductive race between an introvert and prince charming... Who will be the winner?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extra chapters.

When his mother became the mistress of a wealthy chairman, Seon-Woo was forced into the role of a “perfect” son in a picture-perfect but hollow family. No matter how hard he tried, he could never measure up... Especially next to Seung-Wook, who seemed to have everything from the start. Their bond fractured, and they went their separate ways. Five years later, Seung-Wook returns from abroad, and their paths cross again. But instead of reconciliation, he offers Seon-Woo a dangerous proposition…one that crosses a line neither of them can ever take back.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The new manager of a K-pop idol group has been mistaken for a girl. Will he one day be able to reveal his secret?

(Source: Toomics)

Three years ago, the celestial empire came under attack by the demons. With his kind on the verge of extinction, the celestial being and emperor, Kasin, is tasked to go down to the human world and find a way to restore peace. After three years without much progress, he encounters Daran, a merchant who has disguised herself as a man to travel and sell medicinal herbs. Daran was born with the power to heal anyone with a single touch. This ability makes her the exact person Kasin needs on his quest. Although Kasin swears he has no interest in men and is only keeping Daran with him as an aide, the more time passes, the more he finds himself becoming attracted to the special merchant…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Joo Seungho’s ability to hyper-focus makes him a god in virtual reality games, until the day his brain becomes overloaded and he falls into a coma. Forbidden from playing VR games, he can only watch as the most hotly anticipated new RPG comes online. But when a new technology gives him a second chance to play, Seungho dares to return to the world of VR. In this ever-changing environment, can Seungho use his gift to stay one step ahead of the other players without putting himself back at risk?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes 20 side stories.
Note: Chapter count includes 5 extra chapters.

Ah-In, as the winner of the Kingdom Warrior Tournament, is tasked by the king with finding the missing princess. During his journey, he encounters various buxom beauties who are more than willing to help him however they can! In fact, most of them want to ravish him, including his childhood friend and companion, Garnet. Will Ah-In be able to complete his quest with so many girls vying for his attention?

(Source: Lezhin X)

My wife lost her sight due to an accident. Was surviving actually better or worse for her? Living with the sister-in-law is harder than I thought.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

JI-Hyun is a district attorney who got swept into a corruption scandal and demoted to a rural district. Adding insult to the injury, she is held against her will by the locals molesters. She tries to get away, but her body says it otherwise.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Jin-Tae was supposed to have a great time at college but because of a cruel girl named Da-Gyeong, his reputation is in the dumps. But one day, he discovers her weakness.

"Now how shall I get my revenge on her?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

After he loses his job and gets dumped by a former flame, Daniel longs to break away from the constant noise of the city. Little does he know that a sudden inheritance in the form of a countryside hotel could be just the quiet escape he needed. But as he works to breathe life into the old hotel, he quickly realizes that it's anything but ordinary. With ghosts supposedly lurking the halls, a mysterious wing that no one is allowed into, and secret dealings behind closed doors, Daniel has his work cut out for him. Still, he's determined to uncover the mysteries of Hotel Pharus, and with the help of a handsome and willing guest upstairs, he may get more than he bargained for. Will he find the answers he's looking for or come to realize that some secrets should stay buried?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes five epilogue chapters.

Jinha is an artist who specializes in glass art, but he has been struggling for years. He accepted his friend's mother as his student to teach his art, but her sexiness makes it difficult. While he is being distracted by his student's provocative actions, a plan is set in motion

(Source: INKR)

A sexy married woman visits a struggling hypnotherapy clinic. She mistakes JEONG-TAE for her husband under hypnosis, and even asks for sex. Using this power… He plans to get his first love back…!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

title.english: Are You Just Going To Watch?

description:
Sung-Jae, a young university professor, can only find peace in the staff bathroom. One day he hears moaning coming from the stall next to him, and sees his beautiful student doing it through a hole...

"Don't just watch... Come in"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Second-year resident Yoo Daon followed her heart and confessed her feelings to visiting professor Kang Juheon at his farewell party. It’s not like she’s gonna see him again, right? But little did she know that he’s decided to stay! Confused, embarrassed, and regretting the night before, Daon doesn’t know what to do. Can she survive the rest of her residency while working with her crush? And what made Juheon decide to stay? Plus… will her colleagues ever stop being so damn annoying?!

(Source: Tapas)

After Sebastian and Mia's house burns down, they move in with Carter and Emma. But things start to get heated.

Soonam’s always considered himself normal, albeit a bit sheltered. One day, Ron accepts a mysterious job interview where he gets scouted by Darren. The job? Be Darren's personal assistant, who just happens to be the world's most notorious villain. Xu Jiajia and Duan Xi have been bitter rivals for over a decade, yet once night falls, they tacitly maintain a casual sexual relationship. After a heated argument, their intimate encounter unexpectedly sends Xu Jiajia back in time to Duan Xi’s innocent youth. Seeing the young and naive Duan Xi, Xu Jiajia decides to first seduce her, then cast her aside, forcing her into complete submission! Possessing the soul of a 27-year-old, she faces the brooding, sensitive 20-year-old Duan Xi. What begins as revenge and teasing gradually reveals the other’s hidden vulnerability and pain…

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Lu Jiangxian died suddenly after pulling an all-nighter, but his lingering spirit attached itself to a cracked, bluish-gray bronze mirror and drifted into the vast and boundless world of cultivation. In the perilous and unpredictable Great Li Mountains, in a small village by the Meichi River, a minor clan discovered this mirror. Thus began the transmission of the Dao and the teaching of immortal arts, ushering in a sweeping epic of cultivation for the Li family of Wangyue.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

This is a world where various traffic signs and safety devices have taken on human form. In the wake of a natural disaster, the survivors established a base to rebuild their lives. To maintain public order among the remaining humans, “anthropomorphized” versions of various traffic signs and safety devices were created, and they go about their daily routines in this world...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Little witch Shidori predicts that Pavis is her fated lover and comes to the Royal Academy of Magic. However, under the influence of his father, Pavis hates the Demon Tribe and himself who shares the blood of the tribe. With the encouragement of Shidori, his view slowly changes…

(Source: Esthetique)

In China in the 1990s, the young Lin Xiaolu moves with her mother to the western Chinese city of Chengdu, a place where the sun rarely shines due to its location. The girl's parents are already divorced at this time. As a child of divorce and because of her cool way of dealing with this situation, she had previously been bullied and systematically marginalized in elementary school.

With the move, Xiaolu transfers to the secondary school. Due to her academic achievements, she only attends a secondary school with a focus on art and design. Her father despises this weakness. He also considers his daughter's preference for drawing and painting as a waste of time. Hearing the parental pressure, however, Xiaolu's grades do not increase.

The comparison with her cousin Ruirui, an exemplary student at a renowned school with excellent future prospects, does not stop either. After entering a new class community in Chengdu, she decides to enter a kind of self-isolation based on these past experiences. Thus she continuously ponders within her own fantastic and colorful world of thoughts. She also loves to dive into her comics regularly.

At the new school, Xiaolu spots an older student, one grade above her. Soon many thoughts turn to the boy named Han Che, who frequents a small store. As the story unfolds, the store becomes a recurring scene - filled with books, figures, and other curious antiques reminiscent of the owner's journeys. The middle-aged man called Hu Xu lives in a complicated relationship with the beautiful and successful Xiaoman, another important member of the ensemble.

By entering the sphere of this store, the young protagonist opens her center to other people in her life - her peers. While Xiaolu continues to observe the older Han Che from a distance, her circle of friends begins to grow. Together with Xie Siyao and Su Yan and their friends, she is part of an accepted clique. Her loneliness fades away and yet she remains insecure. A long way lies before the young girl.

In particular, the readers of this manhua are invited to accompany Xiaolu's youth and her personal environment in their ups and downs in six volumes, but also to think back to their own time of maturity. Reflecting on the contents of this series, philosophizing about it is another aspect that gives this series a special flair.

(Source: Manga Passion, translated)

Note: Contains chapter 30.5

He used to be the brightest superstar until a rumour was spread that he was a homosexual. Luckily, he got an opportunity to start his singing career again... as a young girl!

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Wo Bei Xianyi Ren Shua Pingle

description:
There's a serial killer in my WeChat Moments! There seems to be a mysterious large organization behind everything. The only one I can rely on is my buddy who sleeps on my lower bunk.

(Source: Webnovel)

The story depicts the tumultuous journey of Princess Yang Ajiu of the Sui Dynasty, and the boy Duo Ruo, who was forced to become a courtesan after his family's fall from grace. They will support each other through thick and thin, fighting against fate's travails.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A forceful top who doesn't dare face his true self, a passing bottom who has to be loved, and a guy's guy who'd rather die than become gay.

A story that would break anyone's heart... I'M JOKING! Don't go anywere!

This is a romance comic, and it may also be more than that!

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

Zhao Xun was electrocuted while playing a dating sim, and he was transmigrated into the game world with a Romance System, The system not only lets him see each girl's favorability rating, but also allows him to save-and-reload infinitely, and provides equipment to make him unbeatable at picking up girls. But just when he thought he had it made with the help of the system, the girl he picked up suddenly turned against him and tried to kill him. Fortunately, the heroine Lingyu The Blood-sworn, rushed to the scene and killed the crazed girl to allow Zhao Zhuan to escape…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Bei Baojun Jun Fu Qiangzhan Hou

description:
Elias, a fallen demon prince, is forced to marry the irascible human monarch, Lancer, to save his two sons, Thor and Los. Unexpectedly, on their wedding night, Thor accidentally swallows poison, triggering a taboo stemming from his hybrid human-demon identity. Elias, seeking to detoxify him, accidentally triggers a forbidden technique, allowing him and Thor to merge souls. Between his timid 16-year-old human-demon son and his beautiful and noble demon companion, can Lancer see through their disguises?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

When the homeboy Xia Ming drew an egg for cute pets, he thought he would also own a human-shaped cute pet that is desired by the whole world! He didn’t expect that he would hatch a group of trouble devils! But how can these cute pets who want to feed their master be so lovely...

(Source: WebComics)

Aqi (ah-chee), a boy with god-like strength, finally gets fed up with his fellow villagers are constantly relying on him to help them. So he leaves on an adventure to save the world! (but from what, we have yet to find out...) After quickly getting lost in the nearby forest, he finds a girl named Misu about to be eaten by the dangerous wildlife of the forest! Using his inhuman strength he saves her, and after finding out she can cook, he decides to bring her along on his adventures!

The Odin Mainland is separated into four counties, in each lives a group of soul masters protecting their county with their soul powers. The most powerful seven of them are known as Noble Lords. The story begins in the water origin, the Aslan Empire.
Qi Ling has been a busboy in an inn ever since he was young and subconsciously tamed a legendary soul beast Cang Xue Zhi Ya in a battle between soul masters. Yin Chen came on orders of the Silver Priests to take in him as his disciple. With his help, Qi Ling heads to the Grave of the Souls to seek his soul weapon, yet as he couldn’t sit still like how his lord instructed him, he enters the Grave of the Souls with Tianshu Youhua and Guishen Lianquan.
After his risky adventure in the Grave of the Souls, he was scolded by his lord. At the very same time, another conspiracy that has long been in the works within the Aslan Empire is gradually revealing itself.

In Si Ling's family, there is a saying that if you kiss your soulmate, you will be able to enter each other's dream. One day, Si Ling unexpectedly met the An family's young master, An Yunxiu, and accidentally gave him her first kiss. Who would have thought that Si Ling was the first girl who was able to touch An Yunxiu? It was a fate that was already set, and nobody can break it.

After Mu Wei'er was rescued from a drowning accident in the ocean, she realized she had lost her memory. Soon she was told by someone claiming to be her mother that she was getting engaged to Ji Chenfeng – a prominent military commander who refused to attend his own engagement party. But Mu Wei'er was not a pushover. She soon decided that a puppy would be present instead of Ji Chenfeng at the party...

(Source: WebComics)

Xu Mingchuang, a beautiful imperial physician afflicted with a worm curse, met Li Xiaojian, the Prince of Hejian, when they both pursued the same person. As rivals in love, Xu Mingchuang was surprised to discover that Li Xiaojian had been struck by the same worm curse. Later, due to an accidental disguise, Xu Mingchuang was forced to marry his rival, Li Xiaojian, and become the Princess of Hejian. Pretending to be a woman was fine, but what else could she do? She even had to bear children to carry on her rival's family line?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Wang Zheng, the veteran of the Special Forces is hire by the noble family, the Shangguan family, to protect its heiress Shangguan Shishi. The arrogant and willful lady is indeed a headache. While he is busy with kidnaps and murders, Wang Zheng has to teach this lady some lessons...
Anyway, who dares to piss me off must pay for what he has done!

(Source: MangaToon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

title.romaji: Dun Zhi Yongzhe Cheng Minglu: Shouyou - Si Ge Manhua
title.native: 盾之勇者成名录 手游 四格漫画

description: Short comics posted on the official Chinese The Rising of the Shield Hero Mobile Game blog

Hello everyone, I'm a cat butler. My masters are four cats with different personalities: the eldest brother Ahuang is obsessed with beauty, the second brother Huahua is the protector of the family, the third brother Bai used to be a stray and claims he can see mysterious creatures, and the youngest brother Xiaoxiao is a super foodie.

After moving into a new home, what kind of hilarious adventures await the cats!?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

After the death of the Emperor, the country of Li is plunged into civil war. In order to save his brother's forces from imminent defeat, Xueya, 7th prince of the realm, enters into a marriage with the feisty pirate princess Jin Bi Hui. Will her reinforcements arrive in time to turn the tide? Will this political marriage survive? What would Bi Hui do if she found out Xueya's heart belonged to another?

title.english: Er Long God and His Dog

description:
He’s a god, but somehow reincarnates into a girl for the task of removing the demon. He’s extremely powerful, but his dog even makes fun of him. How’s his adventure on earth gonna unravel?

(Source: MangaToon)

Qingyu Luo, a normal high school student, traveled to a nameless magic island due to an accident. It was said that hundred years ago, a legendary figure came to the island and successfully promoted to the demon realm. This legendary figure not only left behind a bunch of useful scrolls and treasures but also has four excellent disciples, who are still on the island protecting the treasures left behind...

(Source: Manga Rock)

The unknown interior designer, Hans Duan (22 years old), was involved in a criminal dispute as he designed the house for one of the members in that group. Unfortunately, he was persecuted as a murderer due to the case and sentenced to death. In the prison, he met a scientist from the government (Code name No.73) who asked him to take part in a human experiment. But the experiment failed and Hans died. His body was buried in a dump in the city. However, the experimental medicine left in his body leads to gene mutation. Hans is revived and changed into a female. What will happen on him (her)?

Amidst a world of monks and demons, good and evil, an ancient poltergeist and a young priest seek to repair a seal he accidentally broke. On the adventure to find the way of sealing, they will be constantly challenge the line between good and evil.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

The Marshal, Lu Li, started a new intergalactic era alongside his lover and military adviser, Xie Jianwei. The entire universe envied their steadfast love. It was only until one day, the Marshal had his personalities split. His personalities were unable to recall anything, and all wanted to monopolise Xie Jianwei. They were jealous to the point of wanted to get rid of "themselves". In order to cure his lover, Xie Jianwei entered each and every one of Lu Li's dreams to fuse his personalities together, which had been split earlier on. He didn't expect that in all the dreams, he would be engaging in a fanciful love with Lu Li...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Shi Zhouwu is the senior prefect of the Rentian Sect. He has devoted his life to the study of martial arts ever since he was young. He always took his studies seriously, never joking around or getting distracted, earning the respect of everyone around him. But during a martial arts tournament, he was triggered by seeing so many lovey-dovey couples all around him. He asked himself, "what's the point of winning the tournament, if I'm still alone in the end?" He became determined to go out to find a soul mate of his own…

(Source: iQiyi, translated)

Note: Winner of the 2019 iQiyi Golden Petal Award for Best Manhua Story.

Glaciers are melting, and the sea clans are invading. The Western gods rule over humanity, while the Huaxia people, without gods, become the target of everyone. Until a giant stone statue crosses the starry sky and crashes into the land of Jiuzhou, Zhao Feiyu comes through the void...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Ta Lai Le, Qing Bi Yan
title.english: Close Your Eyes Close to Me

description:
Jenny Jian didn’t know what she was getting into when she got hired as assistant to an elusive gentleman. His name: Simon Bo, famous professor, detective, the youngest criminologist in the world and also unbelievably attractive. Nine teenagers have gone missing and—according to Simon—it’s up to Jenny to help crack the case. But is the reclusive, logic-bound, Simon somehow a suspect himself? Or are her feelings clouding her judgment as she gets too close to the case and Simon?

(Source: Tapas)

In a busy and bustling city, history is soundlessly scattered throughout. Those legends that speak of rare treasures, lost in the flowing river of time. At this place, in this time, they are here--in an antique shop named "Ya She".

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Dive into a tale of identifying all kinds of medicine under the heavens and saving peerless beauties in the world. The disciple of the medicine king, Lin Feng, journeys away from the mountain on a mission. With his mastery of needles and medical skills, he becomes the personal physician of a group of beauties. Poking his head out from the throng of women, Lin Feng shouts, “Stop pushing! Form a line, and wait for your turn!”

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

If a thousand-year-old fox demon is your sixteenth birthday gift, will you accept it? Ling Xiangnuan, the young lady of a magic family, was accidentally apprenticed to the self-proclaimed "Demon King" Bai Mo. Will her ordinary life turn into a magic journey (love)?

(Source: Webnovel)

When his cheerful and optimistic younger brother passes away suddenly, Mu Siyang infiltrates his school to investigate the cause of his brother's death.

Shocking things come to light: his roommate was a friend with benefits; his rumored boyfriend wanted to kill him; all the customers at his part time job wanted him... What did my brother go through before he died?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Juliette Wright, an ordinary college girl, is abducted on the way to see her boyfriend in broad daylight. Tied up and bagged with another unfortunate victim, Juliette slowly tires out and falls asleep. After she wakes up, the other victim - a smart-looking young man, manages to untie them both and escape. What awaits Juliette back home though, is not a warm embrace from her boyfriend, but slut-shaming and the end of the relationship just because she fed the victim water with her mouth. However, Juliette will soon find out that her new boss, Darren Martin, is the victim whom she spent days with.

(Source: WebComics)

Many would choose the sweet fantasy of a novel over reality, but not Joo-in, who wakes up as Lydia in "Reaching for the Stars." Knowing the concubine was executed by the emperor for upsetting the heroine, the new "Lydia" holes up in her palace to avoid the couple. But after she meets Mar, a mysterious man who claims to be the emperor's runaway servant, Lydia is suddenly invited to the ball, threatened by a jealous concubine, and even bumps into the heroine! Though she has no idea what caused this domino effect, the catalyst is closer to her than she thinks...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Cali is on a quest to discover her identity and must travel to see the elf queen of Sorte, who left her at the convent as a baby. After hearing Duke Lycan Warren and his knights are traveling in that direction, she disguises herself as the deadly duke’s fiancée and ends up in a political marriage. Although Cali plans to run away eventually, she finds herself being drawn to Lycan as their hearts and bodies grow closer. Can the unlikely couple forge a true bond despite their secrets and lack of experience in love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

I am “Villainess Belita” from a romance fantasy novel. I’ve possessed the body of a character destined for a gruesome death—one who stalks the male lead, torments the female lead, and meets a tragic end. If I want to survive, there’s only one solution: call off the engagement with the male lead before the novel begins and leave this city. After meticulous planning, I succeeded in ending the engagement and secured a diamond mine as alimony.

…I thought I was finally safe— But then came the shocking news that the male and female leads had broken up. The male lead, who used to despise me, confesses his love, the female lead looks up to me like a savior, and the man who was originally destined to kill me is now flirting with me. Even a character who didn’t exist in the original story says he’ll risk his life for me. But even though the original story has turned into such a mess… what’s with this unfairness where only the events driving me to my death are still unfolding as planned? In this chaotic mess of the original story, will I… be able to survive?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Rai has been secretly crushing on her childhood friend Do-Gyeong for years. To hide her feelings, she pretends to be a die-hard fan of the K-pop group DIMPLE, especially of Neulchan, her "ultimate bias." It's all just fun and games to make Do-Gyeong a little jealous... until Neulchan suddenly transfers to her school. With her fake idol crush now a real part of her life, her friendship with Do-Gyeong starts to spiral. One fake crush, and one real crush—can Rai keep up the act, or is her secret about to come out?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

title.english: The One Who Never Leaves the Nest

description:
After his mother’s death, Gun-Woo moves in with his stepfather, Yi-Hyun—a man only fifteen years older, with whom he shares little more than a roof. Their relationship is distant, almost awkward, until Gun-Woo notices strange marks on Yi-Hyun’s body—too deliberate to ignore. A quiet curiosity takes root, and when he finds a vivid red rope hidden in Yi-Hyun’s room, he realizes there’s more to this man than he ever imagined.

The more he uncovers, the harder it is to look away.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Charari Naega Wangi Doeneun Ge Naeul Geon Gatda
title.native: 차라리 내가 왕이 되는 게 나을 것 같다

description:
Astarote is a young woman who is transported into a romance game that she loved. She takes on the role of the villain, who is married to Prince Cedric, her favorite character. However, she discovers that the end of the game is tragic for her, as she is accused of being an impostor and is executed by the king.

She tries to change her husband's destiny, making him become the new king, but in every route she ends up dying. Desperate, she decides to take radical action: she will become the queen and change the course of history. But to do so, she will have to face many obstacles, intrigues, enemies and secrets.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Chae Do-young has admired Seo Ki-hyeon on TV ever since childhood. When they reunite in high school, Ki-hyeon turns out to hide a sharp, calculating nature behind his gentle smile. The person he truly loves is his childhood friend Kim Ga-on — and to win that love, Ki-hyeon uses Do-young as a pawn. Even as she is used and hurt again and again, Do-young cannot stop her feelings for Ki-hyeon.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ravaged by a powerful demon that comes to him every night, Count Erwar del Diav has been enduring the pains and pleasures of their relationship in silence. His despair deepens when he learns this is the consequence of a curse placed on him by an unknown person. Meanwhile, Erwar’s powerful yet possessive friend, Grand Duke Kaijack, arrives at the Diav Estate to take Erwar back to the capital.
