Although he longs to escape the clutches of his friend and the demon, Erwar can do little to gain his freedom. And yet, everything is also not as it seems...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Despite possessing beauty that could guarantee her an easy life, Elizabeth was forced to forge her own path from a young age, living alone in the Forbidden Forest and selling strawberries to get by. But everything changes one day when a handsome duke appears before her. Although he is taken with Elizabeth, she isn’t exactly seen as marriage material by those in the Duke’s circle. Persistent, he invites her to work at his uncle’s mansion as a maid. It’s purely professional, what could go wrong!

(Source: Tapas)

Under the dazzling lights of the host bar "Kirin," Woo-Seung, who lives as a player, one day runs into the bar's owner, Tae-Jeong. Woo-Seung's bizarre behavior piques Tae-Jeong's curiosity, and Tae-Jeong begins toying with him, using money as bait.

"It tastes good. You...should subscribe."

However, unexpected feelings gradually creep into their relationship, and their fractured inner selves and secrets begin to slowly reveal themselves...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Seonghye wakes up in a room she does not recognize, surrounded by women she does not know. It is a torturous, malevolent prison, ironically called the Pureum Welfare Center. With no memory of how she got there, and using nothing but her wits, Seonghye must overcome hostile social dynamics, unknown dangers, and her own psychological roadblocks to rediscover her past and free herself from the Welfare Center.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

When Hwang Jin-Woo stumbles into a gay bar, he accidentally crosses paths with the seemingly cold and aloof Baek Woo-Seok. After a few too many drinks, Jin-Woo lets slip some embarrassing words, and one thing leads to another—they end up spending the night together. But what Jin-Woo thinks is a one-and-done deal, Woo-Seok seems to think is the start of something more! Jin-Woo needs to come up with a plan to break this off, and quick.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her first molt reveals red feathers symbolic of a curse, Lindsey Raniero of the Eagle Clan is shunned by her family and dies alone. She awakens in the past, only 7 years old. Wishing to escape her fate, Lindsey takes her bird form to run away and makes a deal with the rival Wolf Clan: She will wed their ailing heir and heal him with her clan's power in exchange for their protection. But surrounded by wolves and with her family now on her tail, can this little bird live to spread her wings?

(Source: Tapas)

Medical examiner and virgin Han Yeonu's suspects that his corpse is the victim of a homosexual serial killing. He tries to inform Cha Dohyeon, the district attorney in charge of the case, but in the process almost becomes a victim himself. Dohyeon offers Yeonu to stay with him as the killer is on the loose. While together, the two start unleashing the lust they'd suppressed ever since their first encounter, as Dohyeon takes the lead and Yeonu finds comfort in his arms.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes 13 side stories.

Aurora Fenryr Astrophotas, the Goddess of War, returns from the seven-year war to face the aftermath of her father’s mysterious illness and subsequent death as well as the four men vying for her hand in marriage. Her best friend’s lover, her loyal fan’s fiancé, a professor with a secret, and her ex-fiancé come before her, but will she find a husband in time? She yearns to return to the battlefield, but instead, she must evade bedchamber intruders, power-hungry nobles, the haunting illness, and most importantly… her own heart.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes the prologue.

Dahye is still haunted by the abuse she got from Yeonhwa. Fate has it, Dahye is able to carry out her revenge after so many years. In what ways will Dahye get her revenge, and will Yeonhwa be even affected by it?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Min-Seok, with only his high school degree, just got a job, which means that when his female team leader bullies him, he can't do anything about it. However, one app installed on his phone changed his life...

"You don't want me to make love. You want to be fucked, right?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Seonjoo was a guy–a GUY–chillin’ in South Korea until pizza-kun sent him to Shirley-Pleehen, a game-like world. Summoneds from all universes run amok, using their Systems to adventure in dungeons for cash. But Seonjoo was summoned by the dragon god himself… into a genderless angel?!@?! He’s a GUY, I swear!! Say hello to Shirley-Pleehen’s first-ever healer class—equipped with a fairy, blessed by a dragon, and comfortable with violence! This petty fighter isn’t your average angel.

(Source: Tapas)

"People become ugly when they're in love."

Those are the feelings both Yeon-Ji and her closest friend Mu-Re shared when it came to romance. Despite that, Yeonji risks their friendship by asking out Mu-Re before being brutally rejected. Cursing her former friend's name, she wakes up the next day with the ability to read a person's romantic feelings as though she were in a dating sim!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

One day, the future is captured by a camera picked up by accident?!

(Source: Daum Webtoon, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Sahee happens to witness a kiss between two of her guy friends, one of whom was her former crush. She's shocked and confused, which puts a strain on all their interactions. How will these relationships survive with everyone now living under one roof?!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Drank the Love Potion Instead of My Husband

description:
Rudbeckia has loved Arenfried for a long time and becomes his wife, only to find herself trapped in a cold, loveless marriage. Desperate for his affection, she slips a questionable "love potion" in his drink, but quickly gets caught. Following a disastrous misunderstanding, Rudbeckia panics and downs the potion herself, which leads to a series of feverish nights that change her relationship with Arenfried forever. Will this heated mistake be the key to saving their rocky marriage?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The dynamic and elite college life of a freshman who rolled up to an eco-friendly campus in their car.

"Pull over... I want to do it right here."

(Source: TOPTOON)

Fight or be killed, the dawn of a wretched revenge!

(Source: Toomics)

Weak-looking Hwasan doesn't seem to be a man that fights on the front lines. Instead, he is a brilliant man who passed the civil service examination twice due to his outstanding character. Furthermore, he is also respected for his close connections with various kings and officials. But his identity is none other than the only successor to the HwaSan sect. He usually stays in his room and reads. However, in the rare instances that he does use his body, it is only to clean the yard or do light exercises. One night, he shocked everyone by entering a conflict to save disciplines of the HwaSan sect and fought on the front lines. In that event, the ridge where the HwaSan sect was located burned to the ground, leaving their threshold destroyed. A bunch of fake masters appeared and massacred all of the disciples and even the young. In response, Hwasan displayed great combat skills to take them down and protect the disciples of the HwaSan sect. To find out the mastermind behind the attack and what their purpose was, Hwasan revealed his identity to the world. After hiding his identity for countless years, high-ranking officials and powerful forces began tearing each other apart, collapsed in front of him to make the Hwasan sect a powerful group
They have a plan to replace the whole town with a fake ones from Layers. Will the special class be able to stop them?

Through a combination of numerous injuries, a weak frame, and financial difficulties, the protagonist Lee Jinyong gave up on his path to being a baseball athlete and lived as a factory employee instead. One day, the spirit of Kim Jinho, the baseball hero who was hailed as a legend in Korea, as well as Lee Jinyong’s idol who passed away 10 years ago, appeared before him. At the same time, an unknown notice appeared, stating that the ‘Baseball Manager’ would start, and Lee Jinyong gained an ability that gave him the constitution of a pitcher, similar to a game avatar. He returns to the field to become .

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

One thing is for certain - if you exercise violence, that violence will return to you in any shape or form.

The man who bakes flour-based food and runs an eatery, has a darker past than anyone could ever guess.

...unless you see the name of his store.

Mia has a special talent which she didn’t know she had until recently. If she concentrates, she can transfer in another dimension called “Layers”. That dimension has no people except those that can transfer of course and... The monsters that lurk there! If you accidentally get trapped in “Layers” your only hope is... The Special Class!

Due to his lack of talent, Seonghyeon gave up acting and became a writer. Seonghyeon is a genius author with a natural talent for screenplays, but he still misses acting. Then one day, he got into a truck accident on set.

“If I’m born again, I have to act”, he promised and closed his eyes.

Seonghyeon returns 13 years back into the past to when he was 24 years old. And the method acting ability that goes into his scripts became the character itself! Okay, this life is about being reborn as a genius actor!

What’s at the end of a degenerate otaku’s career? The max level otaku, Yook Nara, set up an agency to train her obsession, Ohsu ❤️ Will she be able to raise her no-name actor, Ohsu, to stardom and win over his love?

(Source: Toomics, translated)

Beatriz is a duchess with a well-earned reputation for a deviant sex life. Well, she used to be a duchess. When she’s stabbed to death, she wakes up as Jae-young, an ordinary college student in modern times. With a whole new world at her disposal, Beatriz decides to enjoy herself. And there is so much to enjoy: modern technology, education she used to be barred from, and plenty of sex. As Jae-young, she’s going to conquer not only her new life, but also as many men and women as she wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Hwarang: Flower Knights of the Underworld

description:
Seventeen-year-old Junhwi Kang, who can see ghosts, loses his memory after an accident. After passing the grim reaper’s challenge to win another chance at life, he is thrust into the underworld to live as an intern Hwarang, or Flower Knight. Junhwi is assigned to partner up with Horan, a peace officer partner, as they take on a series of investigations under the supervision of Bihyeongrang. Magicians, monsters, and legendary figures come into play in the mythical underworld. But what will be revealed when Junhwi investigates the circumstances of his own fateful accident?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Gang-Chi Han is a failed student who couldn’t excel in any field. His GPA hits the bottom, ranking last among his classmates. His skills, whether it is soccer or computer games, are scorned by his peers. Whatever he does, he doesn’t seem to do well. But he lately comes to a realization that his punching power is out of this world. With a little help from his father, the Handsome Bum, he enters the First Branch of Heroes. Now, the villains must shiver under his might, but will they?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue chapter.

t's Ju-Ho Doh's first day of college, and it's like an unbreakable curse has been lifted at last. After a childhood of being overlooked and ignored, he's finally starting to make friends! But attracting attention is a dangerous game when hungry ghosts start to take notice. And if running from spirits wasn't enough, there's a strange man who just can't get enough of him. Will Ju-Ho be able to live a normal life? Or will he be devoured by those closest to him?

(Source: Tapas)

Kang Tae-gwu is a monster from the future, with the mission to eliminate Jung Eun-ji, the woman who grows up to be the famous Monster Slayer. In order to get close to her, Tae-gwu has disguised himself as a hero named Sunbae. Will Tae-gwu be able to kill the Monster Slayer of the past and change the future?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

After her mother’s death, Louise is left destitute with her only inheritance being a mysterious pearl. Unaware of its immense value as an imperial heirloom, Louise attempts to pawn it to fund her mother’s burial. However, Crown Prince Cauis, disguised as the Margrave of Burg ever since he was betrayed by Louise’s mother, manipulates Louise to have her pay for her dead mother’s sins. Trapped in a conspiracy of seduction, politics, and revenge, Louise must decide if she can trust Caius with both her heart and the Pearl of Albrecht.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.

Despite coming first in his exams at Raider Academy, Han Jung-Min lacked the talent to fulfill his dream of becoming a dungeon raider. Crestfallen, he takes a break from school and writes a novel about dungeon raiders instead. But once Jung-Min finishes, his story becomes a reality with new dungeons and monsters swarming in his home. Luckily for him, he has been granted a unique class and skills no one has ever heard of. Now, will Jung-Min finally become the raider he's always longed to be?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

title.english: He Is a High School Girl

description: Choi Kang-Bae is a famous high school hooligan feared by everyone. Nevertheless, he has a huge "sister complex", which urges him to protect her sister, whatever the price... Only, how does he plan to take care of her when she studies in a high school only for girls?

Lee Hyun, a lifelong single who could only dream of romance, was hopping from one part-time job to another just to pay off his debts and medical bills. One day, while delivering coffee as usual, he bumped into the famous model Si-An and suddenly found himself robbed of her first kiss!!

“Let’s make a deal.”

Not content with just stealing someone’s precious first kiss, Si-An abruptly proposes a contract relationship to Lee Hyun. But his true identity is... an incubus?! Will Lee Hyun, a virgin and lifelong single guy, manage to graduate from his virginity?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A mystery hangs over the remote island of Manwol. The locals have all perished after being turned into monsters in an experiment by the imperial army. But Geumran, a young deaf girl, inexplicably survives, recovering her hearing and gaining incredible strength. Though she kills all of the soldiers in cold blood, Geumran soon learns that the same fate that befell the villagers awaits her too. Finding those responsible for the experiments thus becomes her only hope for survival... and vengeance.

(Source: Tapas)

Notes:
- A spin-off webtoon of the Netflix original series “Gyeongseong Creature”. The worldview is the same, but the story and background are different.
- Chapter count includes Chapter 0.

Despite his kind face and good reputation, Ha-Yun's hobby are one-night stands. One day, he becomes captivated by Seo-Jin, a new member of his club, and decides to try sleeping with him. Contrary to his thuggish appearance, with his tanned skin, muscular build, and bright yellow hair, Seo-Jin is the epitome of innocence. Ha-Yun manages to break through his innocence and have a one-night stand with him, but the next day, he tries to sort things out...

"I agreed because I like you, hyung."

"This is my first time dating."

How can he get this out of his head...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

"You're going to fall to your death?"
"Huh?"
"I'd prefer you to live if possible. Because if you die, I'll die too."

Seo Hae-Won met a man on a bridge while drunk. He thought they'd accidentally spent a night together, but he told him he'd known Ji-Hun for a very long time. And that's all? At the edge of a cliff in his life, which had seemed so bleak, he nonchalantly reached out.

"What I want isn't your gratitude, Ji-Hun."
"So... are you saying we should date?"
"Dating won't do. That won't satisfy me. Love me. Just like I love you, Ji-Hun."

Hae-Won, seemingly stunned by the passionate confession of love from a stranger, simply added refreshingly.

"Shall we break it down into five stages?"
"... Stages?"
"Stage one is sex, stage two is kissing."

He'd already had sex and kissed. So what are the remaining stages three, four, and five? And, who on earth is that man in Seo Hae-Won?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Due to his master's scheme, Yi Gwol, Head Disciple of the Skysword Sect, was sent off to war. After 70 grueling years of military service, he's finally permitted to retire from his position as Grand Commander. Once he regains his youth through rejuvenescence, Yi Gwol secretly passes on several powerful swords to his junior disciples before starting his carefree life as a teahouse owner. But what began as a small gesture is about to cause a big conflict in the martial world...

(Source: Tapas)

Do gods play dice with the fate of entire cities?

Yul Choi’s city is suddenly transported to become a piece in a board game of the gods. Just when Yul thinks he can work together with people to overcome the monsters and challenges, he realizes he must become the city’s greatest villain to save the city. Can Yul rise to the demanding task of becoming the greatest and most villainous hero his city has ever seen?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

After a great hero sacrifices himself to defeat the nefarious Demon Lord, an angel grants his wish to be reborn with his memories intact. Now known as Hero Baek, he puts his memories to use and writes a web novel depicting the story of his past life. In time, he lands a job at an entertainment company, working for the genius and intimidating CEO, Yeon-Hwa Do. Unbeknownst to Hero, his new boss is none other than the reincarnation of the Demon Lord. When his web novel catches her attention, the two mortal enemies appear destined to collide once again.

(Source: WEBTOON)

To escape from a loan shark hunting him down, 23-year-old Heo Se runs straight into a mysterious and luxurious public bathhouse. After a strange twist of fate, he ends up working as a massage scrubber and has to fight to be the last scrubber standing. Let the battle to become the best scrubber... begin!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

As the ace heart surgeon of Seomoon Jaeil Hospital, Dr. Yoon Hae-Jun always puts her patients first. To give them even better care, she hopes to open a heart transplant center on the premises. But when one of her patients goes AWOL and saddles the hospital with his bills, the whole project is put in jeopardy. Her only hope? Become the fake girlfriend of the wealthy hospital chairman Seo Yi-Han! But as Dr. Yoon will soon learn, melting his frigid heart may be more difficult than operating on one!

(Source: Tapas)

After a decimating war against the androids they had built, humanity, though victorious, was forced to start living in shelters, isolated from the wastelands of the rest of the world, created by the damage the confrontation brought to the world.
Dr Gepetto, one of the brightest android creators of his time, died and left behind an inheritance of untold proportions, the only clue as to how to get it being a blue haired gynoid the old man had built and preserved for as long as possible even after his death.
The gynoid was reactivated, and she's attempting to escape the grasp of the new government. And a hunt for the inheritance begins.

Go Yoon-Oh, who had to give up his soccer career due to an unexpected accident, returns as a coach to help his former team, Wimbledon City FC, win the championship. Then one day, 'monster striker' Moon Tae-Won joins the team, but contrary to expectations, he fails to perform as well as he should and is particularly harsh towards Yoon-Oh. Yoon-Oh, who was trying to help him adjust, hears that Tae-Won's health is not good and visits his house... Tae-Won, who is drunk, throws a tantrum, saying that he thinks he will be good at soccer if they are physically intimate.

"If you kiss me, I will win the next game with a multi-goal score."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Kang Hyeon, who was ashamed of his poor family, cut off ties with those around him and studied desperately to achieve success, but eventually he realized that his ideals were wrong. To make matters worse, Hyeon, who has cancer, gets run over while trying to save someone who fell on the subway tracks, and returns to the past while listening to the melody of a symphony. Hyeon, who was determined not to live the same life as before, realizes that he has tremendous musical talent...

(Source: Naver, translated)

In a world filled with demons, only knights blessed with miracles can fight against their tyranny. During a moment of desperation, Magpie was given a miracle, the one and only flame that can kill demons. But that very flame turns its owner into a demon that thirsts for ashes…

“Put in the firewood, if you don’t want to turn into a handful of ashes.”

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

title.romaji: Bangguseong Assain Naega Pokgunege Cheonghon Badabeoryeotda
title.english: The Wallflower Who Was Proposed to by the Tyrant
title.native: 방구석 아싸인 내가 폭군에게 청혼 받아버렸다

description:
Jisu Kim inherited a peculiar power from her mother: the ability to see and hear ghosts. When an old spirit starts to meddle in her life, she gets transmigrated to a novel she recently read but barely remembers. Now she must live as Fluerty Bebenia, the daughter of a duke. Trapped in the body of a side character doomed to die, Fluerty must use her power to change the novel and ensure her survival. If that means having to marry the handsome, aloof Grand Duke Dever Noctis, then so be it!

(Source: Tapas)

For four years, Ji-In has been working as an actor in Korea. While on a photo shoot in Bangkok, a man approaches him, and for the first time, Ji-In gives in to his advances. Although the man’s expressions linger in his mind, he returns to Seoul pretending to be unaffected, as he always has. However, an unexpected reunion with the man shakes his calm exterior.

“I can be pushy sometimes. I’m just pretending to be patient because I don’t want you to dislike me.”

As the man’s persistence reveals more than his initial suave demeanor, Ji-In finds himself slowly drawn to him. This is a story about men making imperfect choices, seeking change for themselves and their loved ones, and discovering the best decisions amidst life's many options.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The world unfolded in my dream, It was the late Goguryeo period, And I became Yeon Nam-Saeng, son of Yeon Gaesomun. In reality, I am Kim Nam-Saeng...

(Source: Naver, translated)

The dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

(Source: Lezhin)

Jang Hui-Mun, who runs a cafe with his mother in the quiet countryside village of Sanbom, is troubled by his mother's sudden employment of a shabby man. Hui-Mun, constantly entangled with this slightly flawed man, resolves to kick him out, but strangely, his lower half finds himself drawn back to him...!

A slightly wild, slightly murderous romance begins!

(Source: Boomtoon, translated)

Tae-Jin, who lost motivation in everything and drifted away, receives an offer from Shin Sang-Yun, the former captain of the wrestling club at Dangyeong high school, and eventually compromises with reality and enters the world of fists.

And as he adjusts to that world, he gradually begins to feel that he is falling into the abyss...

The saddest story of the Dokgo series unfolds.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Divine Bells - they choose their own masters and they determine the status, prestige, and influence of the countries their masters rule. The presence or lack of these Bells also has great consequence in the lives of each country's royalty. In particular, the personal and political futures of King Hong-Ryeong seem doomed without a Bell, but at equally great peril if he obtains one.

But are the Divine Bells simple magical charms, deities of great powers, or something else altogether? And when the owner of three of the eight existing Divine Bells dies, leaving them to choose new owners, where will the resulting turmoil lead?

"Hey, Jeong-Il... Do as you wish."

I got entangled with several women as soon as I entered college. Starting from the boarding house's Ajumma to my friend's girlfriend... Is it really fine to enjoy such a happy campus life?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Born into a family of knights who protected the palace and the Myror family, Felice became the youngest court archmage with his exceptional talent. After Felice stole his position as court archmage, Aerith Myror, suffering from an inferiority complex and living in seclusion, eventually cursed himself with black magic. Upon being asked to lift a curse on his childhood friend, Felice seeks out Aerith, who tells him that sexual intercourse is necessary to lift the curse...

"Even archmages can't help but have vulgar nipples."

The backstabbing romance between the gloomy beauty and the sunny handsome man.

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Guard Kang Yu-Jin with immeasurable abilities pretends to be a zero with no abilities and manufactures guard drugs at a pharmaceutical company. He tries to live a normal, quiet life as an office worker... but he is in danger of being exposed as a guard due to the sudden appearance of the pretty crazy S-class psychic Daniel Miller.

Please... let me fire him!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Cat hybrid Yi-Jun has long harbored a crush on his senior from the same department, Kwon Na-Ra. Simply watching him from afar was enough to make Yi-Jun’s days at school feel happy and full. But when Na-Ra suddenly starts getting close to him, Yi-Jun can’t help but feel confused by the sudden change. Every time they’re together, Yi-Jun’s heart flutters uncontrollably, and just as their relationship seems to be moving forward—right at the moment they’re about to kiss—Na-Ra suddenly transforms into… a fat rat?!

“What the hell is this rodent?! Where’s my sunbae?!”

“W-wait, Yijoon! I can explain!”

“I hate lying rats the most!”

Can cat hybrid Yi-Jun and rat hybrid Na-Ra overcome their species gap—and the chaos that comes with it?

"Even if I eat poison three times a day instead of rice, I won't die?"

No matter how hard he tries, he won't die, the immortal saint. Finally succeeded in dying... I thought it was just a day, but he turned out to be a third-rate bodyguard of Han Gi-Ru in Shandong Province? But his powerful internal energy from the past is still dormant within him. The endless strife in the martial arts world, the secret struggles of the princes surrounding the throne, and the evil Taoist path acting secretly behind it all. The third-rate bodyguard Cheongpung stands against all this chaos.To make matters worse, enemies with whom he had a grudge from the past begin to show up one after another, and the confusion reaches its peak. Will he be able to regain the martial arts skills from his days as a saint and finally reach nirvana?

In 2025, the grand drama of the imperial palace that tears the martial arts world apart begins!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

One fateful day, Signatur Zegar's worst nightmare comes true when he unwittingly forges a pact with Minerva and Sui, two eccentric demonic swords donning a teenage girl guise. Setting forth on a quest to break the binding contract, Sig, along with his newfound companions, navigates through a web of conspiracies and unexpected challenges. As the journey unfolds, the pressing question remains: Can Sig break free from their bond, or is he destined to be forever entangled with these demonic blades?

(Source: Tapas)

Jinha is an Omega with an Alpha phobia and Tae-Oh is his boyfriend who hasn't awakened yet. Tae-Oh has tried many methods to awaken his Alpha traits, but something inside him is preventing it. While Jinha tries to be strong for Tae-Oh, shady figures lurk to take advantage of his phobia.

(Source: INKR)

Young yet old-fashioned Hojun becomes a team leader of a team of Gen Z employees. While he struggles to manage his picky and difficult team members, he ends up discovering their' secret pleasures...

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

It’s a classic setup gone wrong: the neglected boyfriend, the pining younger student, and a hidden exhibitionist streak. When Ji-Su decides to punish his boyfriend Hyeon-Oh by seducing his student Hyeon-Jae, he thinks he’s the one in control. He offers up his pierced body as a playground, only for Hyeon-Oh to walk in and join the fun. Caught in a web of obsession and sibling rivalry, Ji-Su realizes that his birthday wish for more love might have just come true in the most deviant way possible. The game is no longer about jealousy, it's about just how much Ji-Su can handle.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seeing life through someone else’s eyes seems appealing, but less so when it’s your own eye that was gouged out by a murderous serial killer. Fortunately for Dongsu Ha, he’s a Connect – an immortal being with supernatural healing ability. Thanks to this strange power, Dongsu is able to see through his stolen eye, which the killer is still using. Dongsu must use this connection and his newfound ability to track down his killer and recover his eye before more innocent people are hurt, but at what cost?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Riddled with student loans and debt, Han Jungwoo is dead broke. When he loses all hope of finding a proper job, Jungwoo agrees to participate in a clinical trial and swallows AF-12, a pill that gives him knowledge about chemistry and the ability to see chemical particles. The company that made AF-12 even offers to hire him for a large sum of money... if he can keep his condition a secret. With this last chance to turn his life around, will Jungwoo accept the offer despite the challenges?

(Source: Tapas)

After being betrayed by his ex-girlfriend and former coach, a former MMA fighter, Hyung Dojun, spirals into a life of aimless wandering. One day, he stumbles into a small eatery called Sticky & Sweet and finds himself surrounded by a new set of intriguing women. Hyang-Gee, the shop owner, struggles with debt. Hyunah, the head cook, is free-spirited and bold. Jinha, a regular customer, grows increasingly interested in him. Even Okjoo, a loan shark, gets involved in his life. One man, five women. The tension is thick. The chemistry is sizzling. But can this sticky & sweet atmosphere last?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Unpredictable superpowers suddenly arrived one day.

Wi Sang-U, a young teen with a bleak future acquires a useless power! But, will it really stay useless?

Do-Yun, who moved to a quiet village in the countryside, accidentally found a white fox collapsed on the road and brought it home, naming it Haru. That very night after bringing the fox home, Do-Yun dreams of having relations with a mysterious white-haired man. Startled awake, Do-Yun finds a small child sleeping soundly beside him...

“Could it be... you're Haru...?”

“Huh?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Hong Yi-Jeong, who is naturally sociable and loves people, one day happens to hear rumors about Ki Tae-Rim, the biggest outsider in his department. With thick glasses, messy hair, and a carelessly thrown-on plaid shirt, Tae-Rim looked like the textbook definition of an outsider. But when Lee Jung-Eun realized that everything he was wearing was designer brand, he resolved to avoid him at all costs—only to run into him at the opening ceremony… and find himself inexplicably drawn to him, constantly glancing his way.

“He’s such a pushover.”

Uncomfortable with Lee Jung-Eun’s kindness, Tae-Rim tries to tease him by seducing him after he notices his hickey. Captivated by Tae-Rim’s inexplicable charm, Lee Jung-Eun ends up spending the night with him…!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Si-Min So dominated the hapkido scene when she was a student. Seven years later, she comes back as a high school substitute teacher. She’s solely focused on becoming a full-time teacher when she crosses paths with Su-Gang Han, the school bully. Will Si-Min achieve her dream of snagging a full-time position despite Su-Gang’s efforts to bring her down?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Eulji So Moon has aged well and is now a grandfather. He orders his mischievous grandson to go on a joyful trip to Zhongyuan! To save the fallen Namgung family clan and help them spread their wings once more, Eulji Ho’s journey starts now!!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After discovering her boyfriend of three years was cheating, being forced into a blind date with a divorced man ten years her senior, and carrying the financial burden of her suffocatingly dependent family, Yoon Seol-Young finds herself trapped in a harsh reality.

Just when she wishes for a way out, Ki Tae-Hwan—an executive director of the Shinhwa Group, rumored to be gay due to his excessively private lifestyle—approaches her.

"Marry me. I’ll take you to a higher place."

In the blink of an eye, Seol-yYung goes from executive secretary to the daughter-in-law of the Shinhwa Group! But what is Tae-Hwan’s true purpose behind this sudden proposal of marriage…?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Kim Eun-Chong is the definition of a devoted church boy - in fact, his name literally means “Blessing.” But one heartbroken, drunken night of regret shatters his pristine reputation. He wakes up with a massive hangover and a scandalous secret - he slept with a man. Even worse, the mystery lover is one of his two best friends from church: Ju Hyeon-U or Shin Ian. Eun-Chong prays that he can bury his mistake forever…but then a blackmail text featuring explicit photos of that sinful night hits his phone. One of his best friends has now turned into his biggest enemy, and returning to his peaceful life of faith is nothing but a pipe dream unless he can catch him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lee Seo-Jun is a playboy whose hobby is changing partners every day. By chance, actor Yoon Ji-Han enters Seo-Jun’s life. Despite leaving each other with the worst first meeting and the worst first impression, Seo-Jun becomes intrigued by Ji-Han and starts hanging around him…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

What’s age when it comes to true love? For Seung-Oh, his age is becoming quite the concern. Twelve years older than his boyfriend, even the ten years they’ve already spent together seems to fade away in the shadows of his anxiety over aging. Hyeon-Woo, meanwhile, couldn’t care less that he’s dating a much older man. His most important concern is the clear change in his partner, and the effect it’s having on their sex life. Determined to show Seung-Oh that he’s just as desirable as ever, Hyeon-Woo embarks on an adventure of intimacy, sexuality, and affection. Because after all, when it comes to love, age is nothing but a number.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 side story chapters.

Can love transcend all boundaries? The 200-year long peace in Mokrin's island tribe is broken when the warlike Fiendbloods arrive to demand open borders. What's more, Eonyeong, the son of their chieftess, falls hopelessly in love with Mokrin. Now it's up to her — will she spurn his affection or marry him for the sake of her people?

(Source: Manta)

Note: The chapter count includes a prologue.

If there was a closet inside a closet, Joohwan would hide there. He's that desperate to hide that he's gay. Still, he's doing a pretty good job at hiding his sexual orientation, on his way to a promotion at his job, and has everything going great...right until he crosses paths with Sihyun during a major presentation for work. Unfortunately, Sihyun is devastatingly attractive. Perhaps attractive enough to drag Joohwan out of the closet...

(Source: Lezhin)

The pirate Ian, renowned throughout the land for his strength and beauty, has been captured?! But contrary to the king's order to capture him alive, no trace of the pirate could be found anywhere. Even Navy Captain Mikhail, the sole witness who claimed to have seen him and drowned at sea, was held responsible for failing to capture Ian and went into hiding...

Rumors spread that in the dark corner of a room somewhere within the Navy's villa, someone's moans could be heard every night...!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

After Vivian and Samuel got married, Samuel became a different man, saying that having a child would get in the way of their love. So when Vivian discovered she was pregnant, she erased herself from his memories, which inadvertently caused her to erase her own memory and shorten her lifespan. Now, seven years later, she needs to find her forgotten husband so that he can take care of their daughter after Vivian dies. But was forgetting Vivian enough to turn Samuel into a loving father?

(Source: Tapas)

Genesis weapons—Heroes of the war, or dangerous threats? In Tristan, humans and mechanical lifeforms called “cobas” live side by side. Three years ago, the war finally ended, brought down by the Genesis Weapons. Ode, once a Genesis Weapon himself, investigates the secrets of the M3 company, seeking memories of his life before becoming a weapon. When he discovers children being used in experiments to create others like the Genesis Weapons, he sets out on a journey to find the comrades who escaped with him and to uncover what M3 is after.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Once in Armian, Re-Manu XXXVII is awaiting her death. As it goes for years in history, the dying queen foretold the fate of her four daughters. Divination that would lead them toward their fate, and significance to determine the successor to rule Armian.
The beautiful Swarda is fated to marry a throne man of Persia. The smart and calm Aspasya will encounter a great leader of history.

But fate has its own plan to fool with their destiny. The first and the fourth daughter have their fates twisted, to heir the title of Re-Manu. But there wouldn't be a country with two leaders, one has to given way to another. And of course it won't be the cold-hearted and ambitious Manua to give up the crown, so then she decided to put her younger sister into exile.

Little Re-Syahrina has to start her journey to find a phoenix's feather to get back home, while the story is also concerned in Swarda's pain of being betrayed by her lover and sister, Aspasya relationship with a slave called Bahel, and the new Re-Manu that would sacrifice anything to fulfill her ambition, and her sisters aren't exception.

Roberta, a priestess of the church, is designated as the head priestess of a remote region in the northern edge—Dithmar. As the appointment came immediately after the disappearance of her predecessor, Roberta remained on guard and began to investigate Duke Ulrich of Dithmarschen. According to rumors, he has ruled over the region's lord for over 300 years, and even claimed to be an immortal... one who lives a life no human should be capable of possessing. Determined to uncover the truth, Roberta decides to trace his steps.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Summer, 1994. Seo-Jin is hiding from debt collectors in the middle of nowhere, facing a fate worse than bankruptcy: manual labor. When a sudden stomach ache leads to a messy disaster in a neighbor’s field, Seo-Jin is caught red-handed by the hulking owner, Cheol. Cheol helps Seo-Jin handle his spicy peppers by day, and Seo-Jin returns the favor by night. Seo-Jin thinks he’s just using the local hunk for "farm assistance," but this country boy’s heat might be too much to handle!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seo-Wu survives by selling information, living every day on edge. One day, a suspiciously friendly operative who leads with emotion instead of caution shows up at his door. Yi-Jin is clearly dangerous, probably even from a rival organization. And yet… they talk far too easily.

Between a high-strung informant and a disarmingly open operative, a risky connection forms... Is this pull part of the mission, or something dangerously real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Prince Cho Yi-Hyeon is forced to remain in the imperial palace of a foreign land for three long years. The emperor awaiting him, Tae Won, is rumored to be a merciless despot, yet he greets Yi-Hyeon with unexpected innocence and charm. But that gentleness doesn’t last. Beneath the smile lies obsession, and Tae Won’s growing fixation leaves Yi-Hyeon frightened and confused. Separated from his family and slowly losing himself, Yi-Hyeon begins to fade.

Can love - or survival - exist under an emperor’s twisted devotion, in a palace swallowed by a moonless night?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

Doh Min-Hyeok is living a nightmare disguised as a fantasy. Forced to play the role of a cold-blooded tyrant by a relentless System, he’s one skipped "brooding session" away from a death sentence. But the icy exterior starts to crack when he crosses paths with Lee Wu-Yeon. Wu-Yeon is the perfect "clumsy darling" trope, and more importantly, he’s a walking dead zone for the System’s influence. Min-Hyeok begins to pursue Wu-Heon with a desperate intensity, but as the lines between survival and genuine attraction blur, he has to wonder if he’s chasing a lifeline or a life sentence.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

“Want to sleep over?”

Choi Su-Hyeok, the movie star next door, goes full steam ahead from the very first meeting. As a result, Jeong Se-Yeon finds himself swept up in the whirlwind, unable to keep him bearings, and has lost count of how many movies he’s made that blur the line between romance and comedy.

A modern-day romance where a handsome guy meets an even more handsome guy, and both get swept up in the chaos of work and love!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

An ex-Kpop fan moves to Japan.

For Baek-Hui, who lives in a broken household with a cheating father and a depressed mother, fangirling over the popular K-pop star Tinkerbell was her only solace. But when she realizes that the image of Tinkerbell she had loved for so long was only a fantasy, Baek-Hui decides it’s time to live for herself, and suddenly moves to Japan. What adventures will she embark upon in her new life?

(Source: Manta, edited)
In a quiet village, Yeong Seol, an aristocrat, wakes from deep slumber, only to find a young man named Sun Jo-Yi trying to kidnap her.

11 platoon members on a DMZ search operation, closed GP… They shouldn't have gone there.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Agatha Nobilis, the sole heiress to the immensely wealthy Nobilis family, goddaughter of the Emperor of the Empire, and childhood friend of the Crown Prince, possessed everything: wealth, brains, power, fame, and beauty. Despite six marriages and divorces, she remained undeniably the continent's most desirable bride. Who would be her seventh husband? Amidst the public's curiosity, Agatha chose Marquis Enoch Aratus, a key figure in the Ten Years' War. Twenty years old, he was the head of a storied family with everything but wealth. He possessed both good looks and a remarkable personality.

"Just three things: protect me from assassins. Respect me as a wife. Build a separate mansion and live there."

"...I don't know what kind of married life you've had."

Embroiled in all sorts of infighting over her astronomical wealth, will Agatha Nobilis finally find a husband and lead a comfortable, ordinary life?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Almost overnight, Graciella Wasslet went from being a princess to being a criminal in exile. Now, she lives on an island with her trusty maid under the constant surveillance of her vengeful brother. When she encounters a rival empire’s prince, she hatches a plan to win his trust and start anew in his land. However, it seems that there may be a dark history behind his stay on the island, too. With the odds stacked against them, can these outcasts really escape to a better life?

(Source: Tapas)

Reclusive geek Woo-Chan, who yearns for tranquility after suffering the consequences from his brother's past with loan sharks, encounters a sweet but determined force: Na-Ri, the daughter of the loan shark company's CEO. Love-struck, Na-Ri persistently tries to seduce him, eventually moving in next door, but Woo-Chan repeatedly rejects her advances, clinging to his desire for peace. However, as Na-Ri's charm chips away at his defenses, Woo-Chan finds himself sucked into the allure of this unexpected connection, which sparks a series of events that will rock his quiet life forever... whether he likes it or not!

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

What's the probability of someone you have a crush on having a crush on you? What'll happen to these two secret lovers? Will they ever find out that they are, in fact, in love with each other?

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: 92 Chapters + Epilogue + 22 Extras
Note: Part of the 2023 Postype Winter Anthology (포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).

Moo-Gyum Kim, soccer superstar and troublemaker, takes a pay cut to join K-League's City Seoul, repaying a debt to his middle school teacher. There, he meets Ha-Joon Lee, a rookie coach who avoids him despite their shared past. Moo-Gyum soon uncovers Ha-Joon's strange secret.

(Source: Manta)

One cold winter day, Eun-Oh gets caught robbing a man who came into the mountains and gets beaten up. Eun-Oh cries and begs the man to spare his life, saying he'll do anything for him. But that very day, he's captured by the man and forced into slavery... Chae Yun-Sa, who finds the world repulsive, and Eun-Oh, who knows nothing about it. The story of how a coincidence on Mount Moak becomes inevitability. Their winter, spring, summer, fall, and back to winter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

An ex-boxing champion, starts to work as a private limo driver for escorts, and soon falls for his client, a high-end hooker. He has no idea that this would lead him right into the middle of a grand criminal scheme.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

“The higher you climb, the harder you fall. So let’s just stay level.”

Haetsal’s life motto has worked so far, so good... that is, until she discovers that the ancient god of lust and pleasure has moved in as her next-door neighbor. Although she has vowed to live a life of peace, free from all the risks and dangers of the modern world, she just might take her chances with this one.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Pandora is a bustling new planet where fiction merges with reality… and it’s on the brink of destruction! People everywhere signed contracts that unwittingly bind their souls with demons, causing mysterious calamities to ravage Pandora. Hector is a detective who brings misfortune wherever he goes, while Eustino is a vampire and priest on a quest. Together, they take it upon themselves to prevent the looming apocalypse. With each contract broken and power gained, will they defeat a nefarious cult’s doomsday scheme and help Pandora break free?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Saving a Mercenary Unit from Bankruptcy

description:
Ji-Hyeon, a business consultant from Korea, ends up stranded in another world. She is rescued by the members of the Nio Mercenary Corps, only to find out that the unit is on the verge of bankruptcy. A passionate professional, Ji-Hyeon cannot ignore their dismal financial state. To help the corps, and in hopes of returning home, she volunteers to serve as the corps’s financial officer. Turning around a struggling mercenary corps is no easy feat, but Ji-Hyeon and the corps members stick together through thick and thin. Her chance of going back home, however, remains elusive.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

To resurrect her dead mother, Lulutier is abused in a magic experiment by her father, which shortens her lifespan significantly. Now deemed useless, she's forced to marry an old count. Refusing to accept her fate, Lulutier kisses the priest officiating the wedding to call the marriage off. Much to her surprise, said priest turns out to be Captain Caintzel of the Holy Order, who offers to become her husband instead! But can this holy knight offer Lulutier the sanctuary she truly needs?

(Source: Tapas)

Freedom is all our heroine wants, but that isn't what she finds when she is summoned across worlds into the body of Lady Beatrice and is newly named "Regria." As a "divine being" who can purify the minds of "divine knights," Regria is expected to wed the Belligram Empire's Prince Rahich, who only sees her as a tool that will keep him from going insane. But when Beatrice's original soul finds Regria in a moment of danger, she tells her how she can be free: by untangling Rahich's twisted soul and making him kneel at her feet.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Ye-Seung, the alpha wolf, meets his long lost brother, in a rural village where he has gone to rest.

"My precious brother who was found after 10 years. Now we'll be together forever."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, 3 epilogues, and 23 extra chapters.

When Lee Cheong-Ha managed to score a stable job, it seemed she had finally gotten over the trauma of her past life as the young princess of Eophilt. That is until she walks into her new office to find her former knight standing next to the ex-lover who executed her… or, at least, they look like them. She resolves herself to put her memories behind her and adjust to working side-by-side with the living ghosts of her past. But, she realizes she's not the only one who remembers who they all used to be. Things only grow more complicated as office crushes are revealed, new members of the Kingdom of Eophilt appear around Seoul, and hiding their connection starts to bring up suspicions at work. Will Cheong-ha finally be freed from the mysteries of her past to live her best life in the present?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Bam Binee's dream job is the position of grade 7 civil servant of the Celestial Palace! Luckily for her, the Heavenly Emperor is seeking a wife through the Heavenly Empress Selection, an event that also allows talented ladies to become civil servants. Thus, Binee dives into the competition, meeting new friends and forming alliances at the Celestial Palace. But as the stakes get higher with each match, she begins to realize that fulfilling her dreams may come at too great a price...

(Source: Tapas)

There are no bad people who like high heels.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).
A young man moves to a college town where everything is not quite as it seems. A mysterious and very beautiful woman takes an interest in him, but what is the price of her beauty?

The prince of hell and the son of Hades, Ha Ji-wook (Haderius) appears in front Song Si-hoo, a student from the music department and names him as his bride. A reckless love story of the prince of hell that fell in love with a mortal!

title.english: Don't Call Javotte an Evil Stepsister

description:
Javotte Wincheston shoots a venomous glare at the men leering at Cinciarell in the ballroom. Yes, it’s true that she didn’t really care for her younger stepsister in the past. But ever since Cinciarell miraculously woke her up from a coma by body slamming her, Javotte has had a soft spot for her stepsister. Javotte is now determined to step up as House Wincheston's heir and become the true head of the household. With the help of her new, mysterious lover from the empire, she struggles to find ways to revive the dying family business. But her mother, who has always been so benevolent and caring, seems to have no intention of letting that happen. Will Javotte be able to restore the Wincheston name to its former glory and find out what sort of secrets her mother is hiding?

(Source: Tappytoon)

When rogue pirate Francis Drake comes face-to-face with Elizabeth I, Queen of England, it looks like the end of the line for his crew. But instead, the scoundrel and the sovereign join forces to take down the Spanish Armada, forming one of history's most unlikely alliances. As they work together, this money-crazy man and power-hungry woman find that there may be something else that makes their hearts race... But in the midst of political turmoil and impending war, does love stand a chance?

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where monsters appear and the climate changes rapidly, the only place that maintains the form of a nation is the 'Special City'. There is the infamous esper unit 'Baekgun' that is dispatched to kill monsters and absorb the outside population. Baekgun's esper Shin Hwa-Jin lives being ignored because of his origin and weak abilities. Then one day, when he hears that his twin brother, a guide, was exploited and killed by his teammates, he goes on a rampage, kills his team, and jumps off a cliff. However, when he opens his eyes, he is in the 'Library' village where he is hiding from the Special City. Shin Hwa-Jin, who lost his memory due to the shock of the jump, is saved by Tan, a man who leads the library. Tan, who lost his home and family in the Baekgun's attack, dislikes Shin Hwa-Jin who speaks the Special City dialect, but he gradually grows affectionate towards him as he loses his memory and acts innocently, naming him Hima. As he spends time with Tan and deepens his feelings and contact, Hima gradually regains his original abilities...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The story of the sidekick's journey to becoming a true hero!

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes 28 extra chapters.

Do Myeong (Soo) is caught breaking up with her lover by the precious young master Seol Hae-Jin (Gong), whom he has been protecting for a long time, and is subjected to strange, jealous harassment from Hae-Jin. "This is not right, I have the face to face the chairman and his wife..."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes prologue.

That song… It sounds like my brother’s unreleased track! Just before his untimely death, Su-In’s beloved older brother recorded an album dedicated to him – a final gift that was soon forgotten in a desk drawer. Years later, Su-In hears one of those tracks on TV, and it’s being claimed by his brother’s former bandmate. Now, Su-In must take the stage, beat the competition, and take back his brother’s songs… all through music.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

title.romaji: Gongjindan Meokgo Naui Alpha Sidae Sijakdwaetda
title.native: 공진단 먹고 나의 알파 시대 시작됐다

description:
Yeong-Ha is a talented practitioner of traditional Korean medicine, but ever since word got out that he’s an omega, business has been at an all-time low. Meanwhile, his teenage neighbor, Pureum, is also struggling to stay afloat in the midst of college entrance exams… and a devastating crush on his hot, older neighbor. But after one of Yeong-Ha’s energy-boosting tonics turns Pureum from a beta into an alpha, the doctor will have to take responsibility for this medical miracle… in ways he never imagined.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Having lost all his savings to a female con-artist, Han Taeil prepares to commit suicide. At that point, a mysterious man appears and extends a contract that takes Han Taeil back to his past. Given this seemingly golden opportunity, Taeil is excited to rectify his past. What he didn't know was that the contract came with a very crucial stipulation..

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

To Blanche, everything seemed hopeless. Until she realized it was all a game. One she made, to be exact. Now she has a goal: Become the villain's right-hand man! But wait. Why is she the one saving him...?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Eun Lee has had an eventful day. First, she won the lottery. Then, she was summoned to a mystical realm by the Demon King, Kaon Mahana Lord Moon Blood Rain, and was newly named Rue, princess of the demon realm. Eun demands to be returned to her original world so she can collect her winnings, but Kaon wonders if she has something to do with his late lover’s will. Eun surprises herself by adjusting to her new and unfamiliar life, but will she ever truly let go of her past and find happiness here?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Where the Golden Rose was Plucked

description:
Every rose has its thorn – even one so fair and bright as Karen Shanaire, a star ballerina in the Empire of Gloretta. Karen, who is secretly a spy for the enemy state of Qustia, must extract valuable intelligence from her latest target, Glorettan war hero and key arms manufacturer Duke Arcturus Kloen. Arcturus begins a relationship of convenience with Karen to ward off scandal, unaware that her intentions are anything but benign. Thus begins the deadliest dance of all: a ballet of love, death, and war.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Beyond the borders of the kingdom of Yarke, is the blighted land of Uren. Peasants and nobility listen with open ears as travelers recount tales of witchcraft under the moonlight. As tensions mount, the third prince of Yarke travels outside of his kingdom under a full moon only to encounter a beautiful woman. While the prince is charmed by her graceful appearance, she isn't all that he seems.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Past the grey desert and across the ocean lay the demon lands. Bloodthirsty and savage, they've waged war with the humans since anyone can remember. And seated on his throne, behind castle walls and royal guards, sits the demon king. At least, that's what everyone thinks. And if Merlin ever wants to see his brother again, he'd better make sure everyone goes on believing he's the demon king. Otherwise, who knows what the demons will do if they realize a human has been masquerading as their king?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Elijah just opened up a pet store where he also offers training. But will training dogs be the only thing on his agenda?

(Source: Toomics)

Laurencia Aztine did everything in her power to bring honor to her family and ensure her twin, Ercia, was happy. While trying to find out where everything went wrong, she wishes upon a mysterious door and wakes up in the past. Determined to keep her tragedy from repeating, Laurencia devises a grand plan to stay one step ahead of Ercia. With this second chance to change her fate, will Laurencia be able to find her own happiness and stop her traitorous sister's scheme?

(Source: Tapas)

Why, why is it always the black-haired guy who ends up as the male lead in romance fantasy novels? And why, why do I always fall for the brown-haired one?

Sub-male lead of Marriage Alliance: Baileon Biers. Childhood friend of the female lead, Princess Odette, and currently the Empire’s Chancellor. Naturally, he caught the eye of Reader No.1, who always falls for the brown-haired second lead.

How can a scholarly Chancellor possibly win against a cold-blooded, black-haired Northern Duke?! Every night, Reader No.1 cried out in despair— Only to suddenly find herself possessing the body of Marienne Didier, the Chancellor’s third aide in Marriage Alliance. Fine then! I’ll make my fave get his happy ending with my own hands! I’ll make Baileon the true male lead of Marriage Alliance!

"Ever thought about dyeing your hair? What do you think—black?"
"Why, all of a sudden, should I dye my hair black?"
"Because it’s the only way to end your long one-sided love, Sir Biers."

If hair color’s the problem, just dye it! If he lacks charisma, then we’ll practice! Operation: Act Like a Northern Bastard is a go. But.

"Walking away without looking back, speaking coldly while standing close... What even is this?"
"This is what will work on Her Highness the Fourth Princess."
"You’re saying Her Highness actually likes this kind of behavior?"
"Absolutely."
"This just makes me look like an overly aggressive jerk."

Though skeptical, Baileon goes along with Didier’s plan. But Odette remains unmoved, Baileon forces a bitter smile—And then the damn Northern Duke shows up. She may look like a soft cotton-candy bunny on the outside, But inside, Marienne Didier is a beast, dead-set on getting her favorite character his love story. Will she succeed?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Minkyu’s heart is pounding in his ears as he waits for Jung-yun, his dream girl, up on the roof of the school. Today, he got her number off the class contact list and finally mustered up the courage to text her. Now all he has to do is ask her out. Minkyu hears the door creak. Jung-yun’s here! Too embarrassed to look her in the eye, he blurts out his feelings for her and pops the question. “Okay,” a guy who is definitely not Jung-yun answers. Startled, Minkyu turns around to find Jung-hyun with an "h" blushing in front of him. Wait, wait, waaaait... Did he just ask out a dude? And did the dude just say yes? Does that mean he now has a 192 cm-tall, curtain-haired boyfriend? What the heck is going on?!

(Source: Lezhin)

Five different people are gathered in an abandoned hospital after getting a mysterious phone call, and the mastermind behind the curtains holds their families hostage. He orders them to figure out the one culprit who killed his brother... Or otherwise, they will all die.
The daily lives of Korean siblings everywhere!

Eun-Seol unexpectedly runs into her high school ex, U-Hyeon, after years of separation. Their reunion quickly becomes awkward, but after some drinks, the tension fades, and a drunken kiss leads to a night at a motel. The next morning, Eun-Seol panics, unable to remember the night. As she tries to move on, she’s confronted by her past when she runs into her ex. Will she overcome the past and rekindle things with U-Hyeon?

(Source: WEBTOON)

There’s only one thing that’s keeping Han Sekye alive: the blond man in his dreams. No matter how bad it gets, how lonely he is, he can count on the man to come meet him in his dreams and make it all okay. So what is he to do when the man suddenly stops coming? Sekye falls apart and for years, he struggles with depression living on in a world without the man. Then one day, Woo Yijun appears in front of him, looking just like the man in his dreams. And seeing that he is an aspiring actor, Sekye hires Yijun to act out for him the man from his dreams. Sekye knows that it isn’t the same, that this can’t go on, but he so needs the world that used to be his…

(Source: Lezhin US)

After finally escaping her unhappy marriage, Lorella is ready to enjoy a single life. Marriage certificate burned? Check. A gentle, handsome knight willing to help her in any way? Check. Everything seems to be going smoothly until a message suddenly appears before her eyes. “Dear Lorella Mayred, congratulations on becoming a heroine candidate!” If she fails to become the final heroine, she’ll be wiped from existence and the memories of everyone who knows her. Will Lorella be able to surpass her rivals and become the heroine of this world, all while being caught up in a love triangle?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seon-U Kang, a high school student, single-handedly takes down a group of illegal loan sharks who show up at his house. While being treated at the hospital, he encounters a mysterious man who offers him an invitation to a suspicious secret fighting tournament with a massive cash prize. The prize money is his only hope to save his family. Seon-U must survive in the combat ward at all costs! Will he be able to defeat all other fighters and become champion?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Ever feel like the legal system's punishment just isn't enough? Tae-Pil Kim knows that feeling better than anyone. Ever since he was slapped with ten years in prison for retaliating against two burglars who killed his wife and left his son in a coma, he stopped having faith in the kind of justice the judicial system could bring. But one day, he’s given the opportunity to become a Punisher-- a government-authorized vigilante who acts according to the Code of Hammurabi. The bad guys better watch out now, because Tae-Pil is determined to give them a taste of their own medicine…

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Su-Hyeon, a lifelong bachelor for 30 years, dies in a traffic accident and encounters a mysterious figure claiming to be ‘God’. ‘God’ offers him another chance at life, but in exchange, proposes he become an incubus, a non-human entity that survives by draining men's vitality...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

“Ah, so it’s you. The one that’s taken my place.”

Still keeping their true identities secret, Soo-Ha and Heli return to school as an official couple when suddenly a mysterious girl with Soo-Ha's face named Selen appears. Soo-Ha, with whom they have made countless memories together in the current, and Selen, with whom they share deep and fond memories from the past. As two people who never should have met collide, a dangerous and heartrending romance begins once more.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Eun-Ha Cheon was just an ordinary teenage girl until she woke up one day and discovered that she was not Eun-Ha Cheon anymore, but a witch named Blythe in a magical world. Fearful of prejudice and desirous of a quiet life, she hides the fact that she’s a witch, but this becomes tricky with the arrival of a beautiful fairy who won’t stop calling her a warrior. She doesn’t want to be a warrior or anyone’s hero. All she wants is an ordinary life… But as she learns more about her identity and her world, will she ultimately get what she wants?

(Source: Tapas)

Lady Sharen Tort Von Atrina, who was once Na-Ra Lee in South Korea, has transmigrated into the story of The Empress’s Extravagant Outing. In this fictional world, she must rewrite her fate and avoid death by helping her cousin, who is also the villainess, Carrel, become a better person. As Sharen begins to make progress in her new life, it seems as if Na-Ra’s soul is calling her back to Korea…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

The crazy princess and the barbarian of the North... Some would call it a perfect match, but neither is truly what they seem: Chloe was only branded as insane by her stepmother as part of a plan to assassinate her, and Callios is a fallen prince who cares deeply for his people. Chloe may have succumbed to her stepmother's schemes in her first life, but this time, she's determined to take revenge with the perfect ally at her side! Can these two make the empire pay for destroying their families?

(Source: Tapas)

"I wanted to meet you, master. Sincerely"

Liam is a challenger who is as good as pro gamers, and a virgin. One day his friend promises him that she will set him up with a girl if Liam helps her boost her score in Legends of League. When he was playing the game at internet cafe, he ends up having a real life PK. Unexpected lucky encounters lead to game-like events.

(Source: DAYcomics)

Do Kyunwoo is the black sheep of his renowned swordsman family. He cannot even catch a rabbit on his own. On his first day of fifth grade, he meets a tranfer student and recalls his past life. He had reincarnated into the world of a game he used to play called [Brave Hearts]. He was already frustrated that he had reincarnated as a loser, but on top of that, the transfer student is an intermediate/mid-tier boss who will destroy the world!

“Why are you being so nice to me?”

“Because I want to be friends with you.”

Do Kyunwoo’s plan is to become friends with the transfer student in order to prevent the end of the world! In order to survive in this new world and to reach an ending he desires. He becomes best friends with the mid level boss.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

What should I do for you to stop doing these kinds of things?

"You are wrong, Miss Haewon. Don't think of taming me , but think of tying the leash on me."

"It's not like you will stay still if I tie the leash on you."

"Huh? Do I look like that?"

Ah Dam smiled and asked.

"But Miss Haewon, you keep avoiding me."

That's why I even thought of just pounding on you.

"Please give me some love, Then I will listen to you well."

Ah Dam straightened his head and smiled at me.

"Hmmm? Miss Haewon?"

Ah Dam ' s eyes were filled with joy when he called out Haewon ' s name as if he was possessed by a passionate dream. Like an alpha who met his fateful partner.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: For the Princess Who Will Disappear

description:
You’re saying that I, a barmaid who grew up on the streets, might be the princess…?! After pawning off a necklace, Sasha finds herself embroiled in a game of politics and enters the Imperial Palace as the long-lost Princess Anastasia. The secretive romance between Sasha, a shrewd and daring back-alley-raised “princess,” and the stern Duke Lascan, fiancé to the missing princess who vows to stay by Sasha's side, unfolds!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Joo-Hyuk has spent a lifetime at the bottom of the societal food chain as a recessive alpha. That hasn’t stopped him from maintaining a peculiar relationship with the dominant omega at the top of the food chain, Yoo-Sung. For ten years, Joo-Hyuk finds himself longing for Yoo-Sung, who only comes to him when he needs to hide away from the world for a night. After spending ten years as Yoo-sung’s occasional sanctuary, Joo-Hyuk, sick of his one-sided pining, puts an end to their arrangement. But are they really destined to end there? Or is there something written in the stars for them?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

The Duke of Covington dies under mysterious circumstances, and with the arrival of her half-brother Lucius, Eloise, her sisters, and the Duchess lose everything overnight. Eloise sets out alone for Wayport to protect her family. But all that awaited her was a harsh reality and endless trials. At the depths of despair, she meets a man: the pirate Hawk. With his help, Eloise escapes the crisis and, concealing her identity and disguised as a man, infiltrates Hawk’s pirate ship. Drawing on the strategic skills honed as an heir apparent, Eloise resolves the ship’s problems. As Hawk grows attracted to her, he begins to feel confused by his own emotions. A relationship blossoms between the two on the free and dazzling sea. However, awaiting them at the end is a massive political struggle intertwined with the downfall of her family…

A romantic fantasy set on the sea where freedom, conspiracy, and love intertwine: *My Pirate Prince*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: An Email From My Dead Lover

description:
Hui-Su Lee was shocked to see an email from his boyfriend who died in a tragic accident a year ago. He told himself it was a prank, but the ghostly visits every night were impossible to explain. With no one else to turn to, he reached out to the internet and connected with I-Hyeon Baek. Once I-Hyeon realized the dangerous situation Hui-Su was in, he agreed to help. But nothing seems to be able to stop the ghost from coming each night, and it’s getting more and more violent with every visit…

(Source: Tapas, edited)

If only I could be the one to reach you...

After an ankle injury dashes Hoon’s hopes of becoming a basketball star, he begins to see a timer in the sky. He believes it’s a countdown to the day he dies, until he discovers one day that his classmate Haedam can see it too...

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Moon-Tak is unemployed and has been living at his girlfriend’s house for two years after being discharged from the military. At the club that he secretly visits, he learns the secret of his prospective sister-in-law, “Young-Ah,” and received a secret proposition. I thought everything was a secret between the two of us. Did my girlfriend find out? What’s the fate between the two families that get tangled up the more I try to solve it?

“Young master… We’re family now, so you’re going to keep that secret, right?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The truth behind.. farm animals?

The animals living on the farm of Sae-Min’s family are not what they seem. Although they put up an act of innocence in front of Sae-Min’s family, they are fully capable of deliberately committing horrifying acts. Told from the point of view of an extremely intelligent old cat, this is a thrilling tale of jealousy, manipulation, and murder.

(Source: Manta)

Two people in the catalogue department fall in love, get quickly married, and emigrate to another country, leaving their positions to be filled by new recruits “Bada Lee” and “Seomin Hyun.” While Bada manages song playlists, and Seomin hoards glasses cloths, the two are competing rivals.

(Source: Copincomics)

You, who in the manhwa that I draw, can we meet beyond this squared space that I created?

(Source: KToon, translated)

When Su-A met Jung for the first time, that’s when he knew he liked boys. As the founder of the famous band Attack, Jung was Su-A’s idol and more. Years later Su-A follows in his idol’s footsteps to become a star but, little did he expect his new manager to be Jung?! Terrified to reveal his true feelings, Su-A spirals deeper into depression and refuses to work until Jung begins working closer with him. He promises to keep training so long as Jung rewards him…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: From Season 3 (chapter 65) the series becomes Mature (R19), Season 1 and 2 are All-Age (R15) even on the full version. Chapter count includes 16 special episodes.

Dongbang-Mui, Son of The Deadly King, Dongbang-Go Jin who is called The War God. In the secret of his birth, he followed in his grandfather’s footsteps and became the lower rank guard of The Murim League. Together with the bounty hunter’s Ruthless Slashing Sword, The World Best Assassin’s Snake Fang Sword made of The Snake Poisonous Sharp Fang, and inside the love of Bicheonri- Ya Eul who possessed the Plum Flying Sword, he lifted his Blade of Wind and Thunder to the world.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Seo Minjae, who recently treated his hyperhidrosis at a mysterious clinic, now possesses a strange power no one can quite explain. To manage its lingering symptoms, he turns to the campus rehabilitation club, Care, for an affordable solution. To join, he must pass an initiation test: a one-on-one massage session in front of the club president. The catch? His massage partner is none other than Yoo Ara, a judo major who once slammed him into the ground after mistaking him for the campus pervert. Now, Minjae must use his mysterious power to pull off the ultimate act of persuasion.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Soohyun, who runs a popular ASMR channel, scouts some new recruits to help him film and produce videos. There’s Joonhyuk, an ASMR fan, Hyesoo, who has an amazing voice (but who only joins because he’s got a huge crush on Joonhyuk), and Chanyoung, who joins to protect (?) Joonhyuk from Hyesoo. From the creator of “Voice of Love” comes a new BL series full of budding romance and tingles!

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: The Cocky Brother Learns a Lesson

description:
Born into the prominent Lee family, Yeon has always enjoyed a privileged and comfortable life. However, his achievements and competence pale in comparison to his older adopted brother, Kangwoo. This disparity fuels Yeon's constant, barbed mockery toward him. While Kangwoo usually endures the insults in silence, Yeon finally pushes him too far with a particularly offensive remark. When Kangwoo unexpectedly extends an invitation to his bedroom, Yeon's sheer arrogance compels him to accept. What Yeon doesn't realize is that his big brother is about to deliver a very intense and unforgettable lesson.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yong Cheon-Sang, the young lord of the great House Yongcheon, is a free soul. His main joy in life is exploring the world. As such, when his father tries to marry him off to supposedly the most beautiful woman in Bukgyeong area, he’s not interested in settling down in the least. He steals everything he can carry from the carriage transporting the wedding gifts meant for his bride and sets out on another adventure. Little does he know that out of the gifts he steals, there is a certain item that is the key to reviving the demonic sect. Will Cheon-Sang be able to vanquish the dark forces pursuing him and thwart their plans of rising to power once again?

(Source: TappyToon, edited)

title.english: Is This Your First Time as a Death Metal Siren?

description:
Being a death-metal-singing RPG fangirl is a tough job, but someone’s gotta do it. Between part-timing at an adult toy store and struggling to get her death metal career off the ground, Se-Rin spends all of her remaining time romancing her favorite video game character, the paladin Alaistar Chiffon. Then one day, fantasy romances become reality when she awakens in the game's world as a siren! However, although there are plenty of good times to be had as a sexy siren, not everything is fun and games in this fantastical world…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seo-Yul Ji is a sex columnist with a secret—she’s still a virgin! She ends up befriending the popular actor Joo-Heon Kang, who agrees to provide her with a new viewpoint for her column. Her only condition is that they not sleep together. But as they grow closer, will she be able to resist his allure?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

In a ruined world where the dead rise as monsters, Johan survives in the outskirts by baking bread and bartering at the local village. One day, he’s chased by undead monsters back to his home, and he unleashes a blazing fire upon them… only to find two scorchingly hot men alive and well. Calion and Alexis, returned to their human selves, spend their time testing Johan’s limits on curing the undead… and the limits of what he can take into his delicious buns.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
Once upon a time, humans hunted witches... Now it's their turn!

When the author of Hero Lee’s favorite comic, Adventure King, starts killing off major characters and wraps it up with a huge letdown of an ending, he sells every book in disappointment. Right then, Hero receives a strange text from the author himself that all characters must endeavor to survive, and those who don't do not deserve a place in the story. After being asked if he would like to try it for himself, Hero wakes up inside the comic as Background Villain #3. Will he be able to survive the story and see it to the end?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The sequel to Blood Rain. It follows Lee Jung Woo and Kim Jong Ill.

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Ye-Seul’s arrival at her new school is anything but perfect. Not only does she make a terrible first impression, but she immediately becomes a target for bullying when the most popular girl in school, So-Hui, notices their strikingly similar appearance. Despite being bullied and harassed every single day, Ye-Seul is determined not to back down. She knows that she’s just as attractive as So-Hui… and that it’ll be a breeze to steal everything from her.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Namwoo, heartbroken after finding out his first love will be getting married, bumps into a stranger during a drunken night out! The stranger, Yeoreum, turns out to be a fellow teacher. The most challenging project in Namwoo’s life begins when their books switch.

Lee Su-in has lived a life full of hardship, with no family and barely enough to get by.
