One day, she's suddenly swept into a contract marriage with Cha Dojun: CEO of the powerful LN Group and her childhood acquaintance. Having secretly harbored feelings for him for years, Su-in thought just being his wife would be enough; but Dojun is cold, distant, and doesn’t even step foot into their newlywed home. When Su-in finally reaches her breaking point and decides to end the marriage, Dojun begins to change…little by little. Could the love she dreamed of finally begin to bloom?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hae-Seo Han is an ordinary, hard-working office worker whose main concerns revolve around being overlooked for promotions, smug colleagues, and workplace stress. That is, until she finds herself intertwined in a prophecy that will determine the fate of a fantasy world! In the realm of the Beiston Empire, Hae-Seo is seen as the oracle who will determine the next successor to the throne and bring peace to the country. Hoping to win Hae-Seo’s favor and become the next emperor, the three charming yet eccentric princes of Beiston cross over into Hae-Seo’s world to begin their lives together as housemates!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

All Joowon has ever wanted is a steady career outside of the spotlight. A single steamy night with an attractive stranger shouldn't derail that plan so thoroughly, except said attractive stranger is Aiden, an international top model. When they meet again on professional terms, Joowon is given a choice: have his steady career destroyed when Aiden turns down a contract with his company, or accept Aiden's offer to become sex partners until the contract period is over. And thus begins Joowon's ventures in bending over in more ways than one to meet Aiden’s demands...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Here are the key components of our story: two unusually beautiful boys (known only as Big Master and Small Master), an abandoned church, a blood-buying business, and a homeless young girl named Han-Su – who has unwittingly contracted herself to participate in said business. Big Master wants Han-Su out of the church as soon as possible, but it turns out that each of these characters needs something from each other. Big Master needs customers for blood (and Han-Su's blood asap); Small Master needs a link to the human world, and any way to aggravate Big Master (read: Han-Su); and Han-Su needs to keep away from Big Master long enough to stay in the church until she can afford her own place. It seems the boys might have a lot of time on their hands, but how long does Han-Su have to figure out what she’s gotten herself into?

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

“Guide, first we need to tie up this ill-mannered hand.”

SS-class Esper Pil Hyun-Seo, whose gentle face hides his contempt for all humanity. And S-class Guide Jeong U-Yeon, whose sense of justice is MAX whenever he sees injustice. Their ordinary first meeting unexpectedly derails with U-Yeon's unhesitating punch. After that incident, Hyun-Seo tries to keep U-Yeon by his side through a forced pair matching, and his curiosity gradually turns into obsession. U-Yeon tries to escape, while Hyun-Seo refuses to let go. Amidst their constant clashes, their wounds and true feelings slowly begin to surface, subtly altering their relationship.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

While running errands for his older sister, Nam Gungyang meets Li Siun, but things have become awkward between them. Although he succeeded in leaving just when the awkward atmosphere turned suffocating after uncomfortably saying hello to each other, it seems like his bag, which was full of certain types of samples, got switched.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Boss raids are an amazing opportunity for hunters. That’s why Gun-Woo Lee agreed right away when he was asked to join. An intense battle ensued, but Gun-Woo and his guild mates got the Boss’s health down to 30 percent. However, that triggered an effect, and now the Boss is about to explode in three minutes. Gun-Woo and his guild mates sense that they won’t be able to defeat the Boss in time, so they decide to escape. As they were about to get out, Gun-Woo was betrayed and trapped inside the dungeon…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Jijon City Jijon High School. Yeo Chan-Wook, the school's most tyrannical and unstoppable child, falls in love with his ideal type at first sight. But his ideal type is... Jijon High School's top otaku, Han Yu-Ri?! Because of his heavy-duty glasses, Chan-Wook can't recognize Yu-Ri. To make matters worse, the two become mentors and mentees as part of a school-based learning program. With detection a sure death, Yu-Ri's dangerous double life begins!

Will Yu-Ri be able to graduate safely without Chan-Wook discovering his identity?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Meet Noel, a part-time worker at a pet store who’s completely and utterly obsessed with puppies. Noel loves puppies so much that he decides to join a chat app to find a friend who likes them as much as he does. Just his luck, he manages to find "J," a user that seems to match Noel’s passion for cuddly creatures. After Noel decides to send J a collar as a gift, J suggests they meet in person. When J shows up wearing the collar around his own neck, it’s evident there has been some sort of misunderstanding between the two…

(Source: Lezhin US)

An exciting undercover operation between an Omega detective and a (former) Beta detective! Alpha younger man X Omega middle-aged man. Detective Ju Hyung-jJn, who has hidden his Omega identity his entire life, becomes partners with rookie detective Yun Yi-Hwan. One day, while treating his Beta-challenged partner Lee Hwan without caution, while working undercover together, something strange begins to waft in...?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Jang Han-Eul lives on his family's chicken farm in the countryside and the few friends he had moved away after graduation. Then a boy named Na-Mu comes from Seoul to visit his grandmother. Han-Eul is excited to make a new friend but is crestfallen when Na-Mu treats everyone kindly except him. Han-Eul wants them to be closer, but after Na-Mu drunkenly kisses him, Han-Eul becomes confused about what he actually wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes six Special Episodes and 14 Side Story chapters.

Esper Seo Kang, wants only pretty and handsome Guides to guide him. Later, he starts suffering from a lack of guiding. He's at the point where he'd rather go insane than be guided by someone whose looks don't suit his sexuality. U Tae-San, the Center's eccentric researcher, appears before Seo Kang with a disturbing proposal.

"I've got a nice body, why don't we find out if I can get you hard or not."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes six side story chapters.

Hwang A-Yeong is a classmate who lived next door to Hyeon-Su. She left Hyeon-Su in her second year of high school and went to the U.S. for studies. Hyeon-Su, who is now a college student, one day at home alone sees an underwear shopping mall called ‘Flirting’. Heart pounding, he witnesses an intimate affair between the a man and a woman in the house where A-Yeong lived! Hyeon-Su is so shocked that he freaks out. The next day, Hyeon-Su wakes up to see A-Yeong, who he’s dreamt of, as the boss of the underwear shopping mall! What’s more, she wants him to help with the business! In a confusing turn of events, among the staff in the underwear shopping mall, the woman who had an affair the previous day, recognizes Hyeon-Su. Things begin to take a strange turn…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
A hot demon appeared in my dream! What's a guy to do?

The story of Ilya, who lives purely for his lover Henrik, a genius in a steampunk world. Despite horrible nightmares, life goes on as usual until a stranger visits. As Henrik grows jealous and possessive, Ilya begins to grow a spine want to live for himself. Will he be able to follow his own heart?

Jin-Ha, an overworked developer, gets the worst news of his life—he’s a recessive Omega! He’s now extra sensitive to alphas, and the only thing that calms him is his boss Hyun-Joon’s pheromones. This is a nightmare, especially since Jin-Ha’s been stashing money in a “murder for hire” account to cope with how annoying Hyun-Joon is. As if that’s not enough, a creepy stalker starts showering him with pheromones. Now, Jin-Ha’s stuck under the protection of his infuriatingly handsome boss!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 12 extra chapters.

Nathaniel has lived all his life as the second son of a wealthy mafia family when his older brother (the newly appointed boss) strikes him with a shocking request: Nathaniel is to be sent as a hostage to a company, for the sake of the gang. The CEO of this company, Fabian, will lend his own strengths to the mafia, in exchange for Nathaniel’s body. Yet even as the two draw closer than ever, their hearts only seem to grow further apart...

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

Reina, a fallen noble's second daughter, works tirelessly to support her family and seeks their love. Yet her life takes an unexpected turn when her desperate parents marry her off to a viscount she's never met to avoid financial ruin. But though she expects a harder life, Reina finds unexpected solace when she is welcomed by her caring in-laws. And then there is Felix, her charming husband-to-be, who has admired Reina from afar. As Reina navigates her new life, can she heal from the past and find the love she's always longed for in her new family?

(Source: Tappytoon)

A runaway noble lady, now a maid at an inn.

Meryl Parte, the Count's only daughter, escapes an unwanted marriage and flees to Harp Island to keep a promise to her late mother. After a night at the rundown inn Dragondaily, she wakes up penniless and in bed with a mysterious man! He offers to help her, but only if she works as the inn's maid!

(Source: Manta)

Father always took good care of me when I was a child even while living with relative’s and moving from house to house. It's not that I don't understand why my father took care of me, but... I guess It's okay not to dig too deep, right? Because that’s what family is for.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

In-Woo has been liking Ha-Jun Kwak, who lives next door, since he was little. However, Ha-jun Kwak has a different vibe from In-Woo and is more popular, so they even play in different groups at school. The only connection between In-Woo and Ha-Jun is that they live next door. They were able to become friends because they lived next door, and their relationship continued, but once the college entrance exam is over and they become independent, this relationship will naturally end—In-Woo thinks so.

“I wish I could be a senior in high school my whole life.”

“That crazy kid.”

“Really… ”

However, on the day of the college entrance exam, a sudden scream and the sound of someone running away echo through the previously quiet hallway…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The True Celestial Demon of the Heavenly Demon God Clan was a menace, striking fear into his enemies. After an untimely demise, the True Celestial Demon finds himself reborn... as a baby? A baby in the care of the Kunlun School, at that! Jing Guang, as he's now called, is determined to become an even greater martial artist in this life, but something seems off about the Kunlun School's technique. Can Guang use his knowledge and experience to transcend the Kunlun School and his former self?

(Source: Tapas)

Trapped in a loveless marriage to Count Macleod, Evelyn survives neglect and humiliation, finding refuge in her art. Everything changes when her husband’s mistress arrives with her son, Jay. Stolen glances ignite a dangerous bond—one that could shatter Evelyn’s marriage and leave Jay entangled in his mother’s schemes.

(Source: Manta)

Hyeri Kang’s a screwup with a criminal record and crushing debt. After abducting a seemingly wealthy woman to pay off the loan sharks, she realizes that her victim is actually a cross-dressing man—and a serial killer fresh off his latest murder. The pair soon end up in a violent, sexual codependency that reveals a shared trauma and the grief that shattered both of their lives. Can they outrun the past and start over together? Or will karma catch them, destroying any chance of a future?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Adelia Gerard had lost everything. The man she loved was dead, and her home was reduced to ashes. The person responsible for her misery? Her fiancé and crown prince of the empire, Elkarion Yearis. Heartbroken, Adelia vowed to knock him off his throne, but unbeknownst to her, the gears of fate had already begun to turn, sending her unexpectedly back in time. Now 19 again with her world back to normal, will Adelia be able to save her loved ones and bring down the crown prince once and for all?

(Source: Tapas)

Aiden is a die-hard fan of the unknown band Chasm. Just before a show, he witnesses the band’s leader walk out right before his eyes, leaving the group on the brink of breaking up.

“Shit! How are we supposed to play without a bassist?”

“I, I’ll play bass!”

He was thrust into the role of Chasm’s bassist on the spot, but Aiden’s playing skills were nothing short of disastrous... Seth, already on edge from a breakup and financial struggles, acts recklessly toward Aiden, and the fate of the two of them and the band hangs in the balance.

“Hey, if you can’t play that song all the way through by next week, I’ll bite off your lips and fingers. Got it?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.english: Love is a Sport: Outfield Base Running

description:
Selected for the Olympic baseball team, Sae-Ram enters the athletes village only to reunite with his former youth teammate, Ji-Ho. Despite years of silence, they are assigned as roommates based on their history. Ji-Ho has always harbored a hidden interest in Sae-Ram and quickly seizes the opportunity. Under the guise of sports massages, his touch grows increasingly bold and intimate. Seeing a heated side of the man who once only teased him, Sae-Ram feels his heart begin to race. Is this just intense team bonding or the start of a dangerous game?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

Yu-Min Nam, a full time department store worker, begins to feel skeptical about her own life. She decides to quit her job due to a conflict with her manager. However, when she enters the manager's office. She comes face to face with the manager who has now turned into a monster. Yu-Min immediately runs away from the manager, but encounters another monster and faces danger once again. Outside the department store, a world experiencing doom had already begun unfolding.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Only I can see this grim reaper?!

Seo-U has just about had it with life. But when she's about to jump off a bridge, she's interrupted by a grim reaper nobody else can see. Not only that, the reaper wants her to stay alive for 3 more months! A woman who wants to die and a strange reaper — will Seo-U finally find a reason to live?

(Source: Manta, edited)

On a devastated Earth, the remnants of humanity dwell within the suffocating depths of underground bunkers, desperately preparing for a mass migration to a parallel universe. Su-Bin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Ki-Hyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Ki-Hyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It’s a miracle, Su-Bin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Ki-Hyeok’s vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Su-Bin’s spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Su-Bin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world.

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Ki-Hyeok’s fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Su-Bin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

You Who Illuminate My Darkness.

“Cheong-Jo, how could you leave me here all alone? Where on earth are you right now?”

Amid consecutive years of famine, when even a single meal a day is hard to come by, a mysterious middle-aged man approaches Cheong-Jo and offers her the position of a concubine. Determined to pay for her mother’s medicine and support her younger siblings, Cheong-Jo follows the stranger deep into the mountains. There, she meets the man who will be her husband, but... Do-Un, a man shrouded in secrets who wears a black mask, despises and humiliates Cheong-Jo.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Kim Minjun is your average 30-year-old office worker. Now that he’s older, Minjun is feeling the pressure to accomplish more in life, and he can't shake the feeling that something is missing amidst the monotonous routine of his 9-to-5 job. Out of nowhere, his ex-boyfriend Jinhwan shows up as a new co-worker, looking as handsome and charismatic as ever while Minjun feels like he hasn’t progressed at all since their breakup 10 years ago. Determined not to let an ex from a decade ago mess with his work life, Minjun just wants to carry on with business as usual. But it seems that Jinhwan has other plans in mind...

(Source: Lezhin)

title.romaji: Psycho na Akujo to Natte Fukushuu Shimasu
title.native: サイコな悪女となって復讐します

description:
In the grand empire of Tygen, Robellia's serene life takes a dark turn, catapulting her into a saga of vengeance. In a world of power and intrigue, she exposes hidden truths, navigating a tumultuous path between hero and villain. Armed with extraordinary magic, Robellia is steadfast in unveiling the obscured secrets of the empire and recovering her lost happiness.

(Source: PocketComics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

After her husband, Duke Arphad, and his knight sacrifice themselves for her, Princess Agnes flees King Sebastian's murderous conquest, only to be captured and suddenly sent three years back in time to her wedding night! Faced with reliving the past, Agnes is determined to save herself and the duke from the king's clutches. With nothing but a daring new scheme and a fierce resolve, can this formerly pampered princess rise up to become the Arphad family's royal savior?

(Source: Tapas)

A survivor of a ruined family, 'Louise Idiana' was living in hiding as a maid. Then one day, "So this is where you were, my lady." The slave she had sold, 'Sed Rufus', returned as a duke.

"No, I believe you've mistaken me for someone else, Your Grace."

A cold voice, unlike in the past, could be heard.

"I told you, I would never lose you again."

"As much as you have fallen, I have risen."

(Source: Naver, translated)

Oh Chang-seok, owner of Shinwoo Tech, the myth of a self-made man... He passed away at the early age of 50 and was reincarnated in the body of Oh Chang-seok, an unemployed young man with no specifications.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The sweetest tip to become a Grade 7 civil servant without exams! Get recruited by the National Intelligence Service during military service through recommendation..! So I ended up sitting at home in Dandong, China, the world's powder keg, assigned to monitor the Yalu River Bridge. But starting with that 5 million won night shift, major incidents involving multiple countries kept getting tangled up with me.

Sigh, I just want to make money without working... Huh? But wait, the mission actually got completed luckier than I thought?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Never again, Juhyun thinks. I’ll never fall for Shin Heeju again. But what do you know, he ends up running into Heeju again in college, his friend’s older brother whom he’s had a crush on for as long as he can remember. And this time Heeju’s all drunk and slamming his head against a telephone pole. And from what he drunkenly tells Juhyun… he’s just been turned down by another guy?! Juhyun knows he shouldn’t start, that he shouldn’t get his hopes up. He tells himself they’re just friends. But maybe, just maybe, this time will be different and he’ll get the only guy who he thinks is worth the wait.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: From season 2 this becomes Mature (R19), Season 1 is all-ages (R15).

“If I could go back in time, I wouldn’t have fallen in love with him.”

After returning to the past, her second marriage to her ex-husband was solely for the sake of her child. Unlike her previous life, where she had yearned for love, this second life—gained as if by a miracle— led her to choose marriage to him with the single-minded determination to reunite with her child.

“Just keep up the pretense of our marriage for exactly one year.”

The price she paid was to cooperate with him in uncovering the secret behind the incident from ten years ago, just as he wished. She thought they were just a couple in name only, bound by that contract…

“We don’t necessarily have to spend our wedding night together—”

“I want to.”

He was different from her past life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In 2009, a time when the analog and digital worlds were intertwining and colliding. In Busan during that time lived an ordinary high school sophomore named Eo-Jin, whose true identity was Lee Jeong-Dok, a famous figure on the internet. She was a well-known fanfiction writer for “Armageddon,” one of the top idol groups of 2009. Lee Jeong-Dok had been active while hiding her true identity from everyone. However, her identity was discovered by none other than Nam Ju-Yeon, the younger brother of Armageddon member Ji-Hyeok...

Nam Ju-Yeon uses this as leverage to blackmail her. Will Eo-Jin be able to keep her secret safe amidst Nam Ju-Yeon’s blackmail...?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Before starting a new job at a prestigious company, Yoo Juha happily jets off on a vacation with her girlfriend, Kim Minsung. But when people from Minsung's past show up and reveal that she used to be a genius hacker, Juha realizes she's being used as a pawn in a secret project planned by the company executives. In order to expose the scheme and protect Minsung, Juha joins hands with a mysterious duo who offer their help, but will the power of love be enough to win this battle of deception?

(Source: Tapas)

After more than ten years together, Seojin’s boyfriend walks out without warning, only to announce he’s engaged to her boss’s daughter. When her life feels completely dried out, a man appears and pulls her into a one-week summer romance she assumes will fade like a dream. But the real shock comes later: that same man is introduced as a CEO at her new job. A thrilling adult office romance between guarded secretary Hyeon Seojin and her bold, relentlessly straightforward new boss, Chae Juwan.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

In her final moments after being hit by a car, Yun Jae-I regrets never having been in a relationship. Fortunately for her, the god of the afterlife is really into returnee stories and has decided to turn back time for her! Jae-I now has 100 days in which to find a boyfriend if she wants to keep living. Maybe this will be the nudge she needs to confess to that cute regular at her cafe! Or, when her childhood friend returns from overseas, she might finally get the romance she's always dreamed of.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: The chapter count includes 3 extra chapters.

Duchess Alicia de Payharen’s world gets flipped upside down when her philandering husband hands her divorce documents. Luckily, she secures a large settlement to her advantage. As she sets out with her maid, Neri, Alicia uses her new capital to kickstart a bold new business idea. The trade? Jewelry! With tenacity and honed intellect, Alicia de Payharen vows to secure her spot as a business mogul. This ex-duchess has many obstacles to overcome to meet her goal, but she’s keeping her eyes on the prize and going for the gold!

(Source: Tapas)

Wi Mokhwa was given another chance at life. Her first life had been worse than hell, therefore, at her untimely death, life came flowing back into her.

At fifteen, she fell in love easily and believed Lee Gajun to be her destiny. There wouldn’t have been anything more perfect for eternity. However, facing death, Wi Mokhwa had to accept her cruel end. Her life at fifteen had been futile and was where her misery started.

Regretting her life, she was given another chance. This time she has Lee Jejun's sincere feelings to protect her and stand by her side. He was willing to be her light even inside a dark world. This life was not doomed to fail.

Revenge, salvation, and a miracle.This is her true life, the second life where it all begins again.

Mun Ga-Ya who suffered from childhood trauma. At the newly transferred school, he meets Cha Ae-Ri, the perfect model student and the beloved queen. Ga-Ya gradually falls in love with this dangerous and beautiful woman, and something inside that has been suppressed begins to awaken.

‘Can we be free in this hell?’

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: The chapter count includes an epilogue.

Dragons are considered the most sacred of all natural creatures. It's said that the dragon's Yeouiju can grant any wish. The fairy Seolha, who stumbles upon a dragon's offspring, welcomes it into her home, hoping it might grant her wish. However, the longer she spends with Yooseong, the more she finds herself drawn to him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

As high society's most eligible lady, Sierra Fernein did whatever it took to please her family, despite their flagrant disregard for her. But upon discovering she has only a month left to live, she decides to go on strike from being a prim and proper lady and live life on her own terms. Shedding the Fernein name, she declares war on anyone who dares get in her way, including her family and a few pesky admirers. But with just 30 days left, can Sierra finally enjoy the life of her dreams?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

Thirty-year-old Gang Nak-Kyeong is a boiler repairman by day and a dog-loving shelter volunteer in his free time. He’s more than happy to enjoy his simple, ordinary life until twenty-four-year old Nam Ji-Ha comes crashing into his life, calling him out for late night repairs and animal advice. Is Nak-Kyeong ready to let another stray into his heart, or will Ji-Ha have to keep searching for his forever home…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

Seong-Yul has spent years pining for his older brother’s friend, Seung-Won. But as a beta from a humble background, he knows a future with the elite alpha is impossible. When a sudden secondary gender manifestation turns Seong-Yul into an omega, his life spirals. Desperate for cash and heartbroken by news of Seung-Won’s engagement, he makes a reckless choice to enter the underground adult industry. His first night is a nightmare...until his very first client turns out to be Seung-Won himself.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Include one extra chapter.

Chloe thought Luke's revenge was just, as her own father had killed his father. That is why when she is brought back to the past, she decides to accept her tragic fate. But suddenly and unexpectedly, Luke's most trusted Knight approaches her.

"He won't be able to kill you, so escape as if you're dead."

She is convinced by Luke and decides to flee with him, thinking there will no longer be any obstacles as long as she fakes her own death, until...

"Your life belongs to me."

Chloe and Luke's paths cross again when they meet as the insomniac emperor and the pharmacist who concocts his sleeping pills. With a completely new identity, Chloe no longer looks the same, yet Luke is instinctively drawn to her. Will Chloe be able to escape death and become happy again?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Dick Maximilian came to Seoul with big dreams and a strong, jacked body to match. Ben Dover is a sweet and innocent young man, confused about his body's reaction to incredibly handsome and muscular men. He soon discovers his match at the men's bathhouse, where his wet, tight end is on display, luring in the equally naïve Dick. These sexy boys soon discover the pure joy and treat of man-meat in a steamy bathhouse with all the hot men pooling together for a wild, sweat-soaked sex ride!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Stuck in Class With the Crazy Male Leads

description:
Just when Hayeon thought her luck couldn't get worse, a freak accident lands her smack in the middle of the trashy romance novel she wrote back in high school. But this isn't some fun fantasy—it's a nightmare. From the calculating psychopath Sunwoo to the obsessive, love-starved Yihan and the terrifying stalker Chanseung, every one of these male leads is a walking disaster. Is this second chance the miracle Hayeon’s been waiting for, or will she regret ever writing this chaos into existence?

(Source: Tapas)

After working as an assistant writer for 6 years, Kim Jinwoo couldn't endure the mistreatment any longer. In the end, he boldly threw the script at his boss's face and resigned! The aftermath? Well, it's either the talk of the town among high schoolers during the girl group music bank commute or while watching it live... Here I am, being a legend with this story...

Suddenly, a status window appears before me, and a hilarious drama story pops up in my mind! Yeah! With this ability, I can debut as a drama writer too! But... the place to write is randomly assigned?!

Hayan, a high school student, finally gathers the courage to confess to her crush. But somehow her confession ends up in the hands of another student named Bakha, who is rumored to be a bully and a womanizer. Hayan desperately tries to hide that she confessed to the wrong person because she is terrified by the rumors. Meanwhile, Bakha starts to take an interest in her, and opens up to her in his own way. Will Hayan be able to escape him and confess to the right person this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: This work was suspended and removed from all platforms on September 16, 2023 after a plagiarism controversy emerged.

title.english: The Monkey King’s Journey to the Murim

description:
The Monkey King’s journey was over. But a new story begins with an impossible crime -- his master, Sanzang, has gone missing. His new mission is to dive into the Murim, a world where mortals and their martial arts rival the power of the gods and unravel this mystery. The threads of fate reveal not only allies, but foes from his past. The Great Sage, Heaven’s Equal has been unchained, but this new arduous journey may yet prove to be his most challenging yet...

(Source: WEBTOON)

At a formal marriage meeting, omega Seo-Ho drops a shocking bombshell... he’s pregnant. But there’s a twist: the father isn’t his fiancé, but a complete stranger he only met the night before. That stranger is Eun-Hyun, a wealthy alpha from a powerful family. With no time to backtrack, Seo-Ho is forced into a fake engagement with him, a contract bound by secrets, lies, and complicated emotions. As they navigate family expectations, public scrutiny, and their own tangled feelings, tension simmers between them. Can this accidental couple survive the chaos they’ve unleashed, or will their carefully built house of cards come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

What if you could undo your dark past? Chaebom Yu, a burned-out office worker, wakes up as her 17-year-old self, given a second chance to rewrite her life. She enters high school determined to avoid the mistakes that once haunted her. But the more she tries to fix things, the weirder her life becomes. Money starts slipping away, and strange boys keep showing up… Her “do-over” begins to feel just as messy as before! Can Chaebom truly escape her past, or is she just trading one chaotic life for another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

The transmigration that happened to others happened to me, too. I’m pretty sure I’m now a supporting character… but exactly which novel is this? When I opened my eyes, I was a widow with stepdaughters my own age, and not only that, I turned into a black swan every night due to a dark curse! Holding back my tears, I decided to take charge of my fate…wait, why should I? Why So Serious? A duchess during the day, a queen of the lake during the night – I have the best luck to be able to leisurely float around! Life should be lived unplanned! When I had just about decided to live my life like this, a white baby swan, one that was not in my no-plan life plan, came to me.

“Mommy, are you really my mommy?”

What, you were a person? And even the youngest sibling of the tyrant emperor?

“I’m not your mother! Can’t you tell by the different colors of our feathers?”

I’m a black swan, you’re a white swan! But why is she so crazy cute. Can our mother-daughter love endure the obsession and persecution of this child’s seven brothers, including the tyrant emperors?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ragnarök: A Requiem for the Forgotten is an official webcomic by GRAVITY that serves to further flesh out the story of Seyren Windsor and the other adventurers that met a tragic end by machinations of the Regenschirm Laboratory. The story takes place between Episode 10 and 11 of Ragnarok Online and encompasses a total of 16 episodes released on a weekly basis.

(Source: Ragnarok Wiki)

“I am from the afterlife.”

Lee Do-Jin, who needs a huge amount of money to pay for his younger brother’s medical expenses. He contacts her after being led by a suspicious business card he found by chance, and meets a strange silver-haired woman named Cha-Sa at the meeting place. She offers Do-Jin a job as an afterlife dispatch worker to stop the predator Mokdugi, who preys on the souls of humans who have accumulated evil deeds…

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Yongsaneun Ihon Hu Academy Jogyosuga Doeeossda
title.native: 용사는 이혼 후 아카데미 조교수가 되었다

description:
The warrior Kang Na-Ru, who became a NEET after his divorce, decides to become an academy professor to change. However, the students keep on pushing themselves onto him, even with the memories of divorce still fresh in his head…!

“I keep having lewd thoughts whenever I see you, Professor!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

As the world searches for the next great Witch of Wind, one mysterious student wishes to be left alone at the Winfred Academy of magic.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Yeo Chae-Woon, the top student in his department, constantly draws attention for his exceptional grades and striking looks. Unfortunately for him, that attention is nothing but a nuisance. When the new semester begins, an unknown stalker starts following him, turning his once-quiet campus life into a constant source of anxiety. Searching for a way out, Chae-Woon comes up with an unexpected idea. He approaches Bae Joo-Han, a classmate from the same department who has been persistently flirting with him, and makes a proposal. For a limited time, they will pretend to be lovers.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Remember the story of the Frog Prince? A little girl kisses a frog to get back her ball, and ends up with a frog for a husband! Only after she’s completely ignored and abused him does she realize the frog has changed into a handsome prince! Miyoul is a feisty high schooler whose only thoughts are of the hottest boy in school, Guelin. But her childhood friend, Heerack, who acts as her personal lackey, is deeply in love with her. Will Miyoul be able to see which is the frog and which is her true prince?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Three people cross time and space to find each other, and to try to change destiny. But with a powerful satellite, a secret code and the future police out hunting, one girl with amnesia, who may be the key to everything, must discover the true nature of her past ... and her friends.

(Source: Tokyopop)

Lang-bee knows the value of money. After her mother runs a vitamin drug scam and goes on the lam, Lang-bee is alone to fend for herself. Lang-bee repays the people scammed by her mom with the money she makes working for her fellow students. When she pursues her love interest in Dan Won, the rich, emotional heir to a corporate empire. Lang-bee competes against Yuka Lee, her nemesis, in the chase for Dan Won. Who will he choose?

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

In real life, Roto, Boromid and Ah-Dol are average kids with average problems, but in the virtual world of Lost Saga, they're heroes. They might even become legends...if they can stop bickering long enough to level up. Whether it's werewolves running rampant or a gorgeous pair of troublesome thieves, our boys must be ready for anything, because in Lost Saga nothing is what it seems and murder can happen with a click of a mouse.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Sun-hyuk's grandfather has passed away, and now he's left with tons of money that he should be able to spend. But there's a catch to this will. He inherits the money, but also a housekeeper, a housekeeper-in-training, a lawyer (former bum), a distant relative, and even a girl he doesn't even know!

This girl, Jae-young, is the start of all of his bad luck. First, Sun-hyuk's nametag and his car keys get stolen. Now, he's about to be charged for driving as an unlicensed minor and for bribery. How is he going to get out of this mess? Will his grandfather help him from heaven?

(Source: DramaQueen)

Joonha is a normal, healthy boy of sixteen who has cruised through life without too many problems. Imagine his surprise when a recent trip to the bathroom suddenly reveals that he's not normal at all! With a shriek of "Oh, my God!!!", he finds himself missing, well, something he never thought he could live without. The impact is too much for poor Joonha and he soon passes out. While in his half-conscious state, he overhears the incredible truth: his family is abnormal in the weirdest possible way. After puberty, their chromosomes undergo some kind of mutation, which converts their bodies into the opposite sex! Which means his father is really a woman who has been living as a man since the gene change took place. Now Joonha has to leave behind 16 years of life as a man and live as a woman. What will his childhood friend Jinhoo and the girl he has always liked, Heewon, say when they find out?!

(Source: Netcomics)

The desire for a normal teenage life haunts the overworked and underappreciated Mi-Roo. While most girls her age are carefree and boy-crazy, she is bound to the grueling gigs of student, homemaker and full-time babysitter to her siblings.

With a mother who's mostly missing-in-action and a twin brother who's best at doing nothing, Mi-Roo is trapped in a constant balancing act of housework and homework, leaving her zero time for romance and boys. But she's no superhero - it's going to take more than a little determination to stay in control of this whirlwind!

(synopsis from ADV)

The most beautiful face, the perfect body, and a sincere personality... that's what Hwang Hye-Min has. Naturally, she's the center of everyone's attention. Every boy in her school loves her, while every girl hates her out of jealousy. Every single day, she has to endure tortures and hardships from the girls. There is nothing more satisfying than getting them back. Well, except for one problem: her secret crush, Jeong-Yeon. Because of him, she has to hide her cynical and dark side and put an innocent face on daily.
For him, she has to endure all the jealousy and suffering.
Then one day, she found out that he dislikes her anyway!!
WHAT?!?
That's it! No more nice girl!
And her first victim of rage is a playboy she just met, Ma-Ha.

(Source: ICE Kunion)

Cute and charming, but not so bright, little Rika is training to become a real wizard. The first step is to find a magic staff. That can’t be too hard, can it? As Rika and Eugen journey deep into the forest in search of this wonderful staff, Rika gets lost encounters the dark sorcerer who kidnapped the princess! Will Rika be able to free the princess and become a real wizard?

(Source: Yen Press)

Lee Han-Ah used to be bullied in the 2nd grade for having a ''wide and flat'' butt by a boy in her primary school and has hated him ever since. Now, in high school she is the celebrated, legendary captain of Il-Hwa Girls High School and she is seeking out a pretty boy boyfriend. What happens when she meets the mellow and seemingly perfect Yoo-Min? (Source: Esthétique)

High school student Haae-Won (Alice) Song has just placed third in Cake Magazine’s manwha creator talent search. She’s the youngest winner in the history of the contest! Not only does she have her story published but she also gets the chance to work with one of her manwha idols (who has a surprise for her). And as if that wasn’t reward enough, she’s also reunited with the former teacher who inspired her winning story. What happens when personalities clash and hearts collide like something out of a comic book? Does art imitate life, or is it the other way around? [Ice Kunion/Yen Press]

Nabi has a talent for copying any piece of clothing she sees. Due to lack of money, she has given up her dream of becoming a great designer to help her mother with her imitations shop. During the Seoul Fashion Festival, Nabi meets Jehu, an over-excited guy who attends Baekje Art School. She will regain her confidence and try to enter this famous school... (Source: Shoujo Manga Maniac)

When Mara Shin’s dog Toto gets lost one fateful day, she goes in search for him along a yellow brick road and ends up in the wonderful land of Oz! Everyone starts calling her Dorothy, but these aren’t the cowardly lion, scarecrow and tin man adventures you remember! This fantastic fairy tale features familiar characters…but with a definite Asian twist! (Source: Korean Manwha)

The main character Hansul, a high school student in grade 10, has never had a boyfriend before in her life. She starts dating Sulgyo in order to buff at her teasing friends. However, as their relationship got more and more stiff, she starts arguing with him. The argument ends awkwardly, and a sweet romance starts when they begin to truly fall in love..

Seo Kyung is pitiful. Everyone thinks she is, especially after making the wrong "friends", she now has to prove that she does have a boyfriend. Of course she has one and apparently it's the most popular guy in school.

Ever since Shinhye was young, when she used to sit on a hill watching the night sky with her father, she has always admired the stars and dreamed of what is out there in the universe. But she never expected that her dreams-and nightmares-would come true. As a beautiful and intelligent 17-year-old, she attracts the attention of Donghoon, whose uncle works with the Ministry of Science. As it happens, Donghoon's uncle is in charge of finding a home for a visiting foreigner...who has ESP! The teenaged girl, Sarah, has left her home in America to get away from all the strange looks people give her because they don't understand her powers. Sarah is accompanied by her guardian, Redion, a handsome, long-haired young man who makes Shinhye forget all about Donghoon. The girls get off on the wrong foot when Sarah endangers Shinhye with her ESP tantrums...but they eventually become close friends. Shinhye has barely come to terms with the existence of ESP when a UFO lands near her home! The shocks just keep coming as she learns the truth about Sarah and Redion, who the aliens are after. Will Shinhye survive the alien invasion?

(Source: NetComics)

"I am a human, but a doll...
Feelings are not needed. Physically alive, but not mentally.
I am a painting trapped inside rusted frame.
The cold skin of a statue.
Life a stuffed bird-
killed and set for display
I wonder...
I wonder on whose display I will be put on..."

Suzette, a young girl, is regarded as a ‘living painting’ and comes from owner to owner. One day a young aristocrat, Ian McPolt buys her as a new item for his huge antics collection. But will Suzzete always be regarded as an item or will they develop some deeper feelings for each other?

(Source: Esthétique and Osuwari Team)

A heartfelt shoujo story about a young woman who loves animals but can’t seem to receive the same affection from animals. Haeju, the heroine, is cursed with the spirit of a tiger spirit which has sworn to protect her.

(Source: Infinity Studios)

When you’re dating a guy, the first thing you need to look at is his family’s material possessions. He has to be rich! Dating without money is like being in a desert without an oasis or having a mochi without the red bISBN filling. He must also be smart–class and etiquette are absolute must-haves. These are traits that will get handed down to your children, so be sure to read through his past report cards if you want this to be a successful long-term relationship!

Se-Lim Lee knew exactly what she wanted out of life and how to get it...until a month ago. After a horrific car accident, Se-Lim is left without her memory, and all she has is her old diary to help her retrieve the most important aspect of her life--her love interest. Four likely candidates come to her now blank mind--but why do all seem to hate her? Global manga-ka Sang-Eun Lee's hilarious romantic comedy reminds us there's one thing every relationship seems to forget about...
Hee Jin and Young Ho's parents get remarried. They start to live like a family. Will it last?

The lord of darkness has decided to wake up the Dragon God that will give him the necessary power to dominate the world. But the Dragon God doesn't like his intentions and decides to entrust the mission to find the element that will revive him to the human who holds his soul.

Because of a sin she committed in her past life, Princess Bell was born as a golden bell. In order get back her human appearance, she must find Prince Mu Kyul and tie their strings of fate back together. Will the reincarnated lovers be able to meet again?

After an accident and die, Ria becomes angels bring number 5623. She still can not forget things when alive day and night to remember Ban Ji Hwan - the earthly boyfriend. A year passed, that called Ria accidentally Ji Hwan in the e-book birth names those who will die in 100 days. Ria rush pray for the angels to be down for hearing aid Ji Hwan. Ria enters the Hae So, a girl and a bit shy ... boring life, contrary to the character of Ria permanently. How scandalous subject is crazy, fool ... and put pressure bullying from siblings with different fathers So Hae's mother, Ria bites that pass for all to be Ji Hwan. But to find out, then Ji Hwan Left Ria does not recognize...
When a fancy house is built, the rumors fly. But what is the truth behind the devil and the angel, or the mysterious boy?

Although Hye-Bin was smart enough to get into a prestigious private academy, her life has been marred by the fact that her mother used to be a famous porno actress. Having led a difficult life so far, Hye-Bin refuses to just sit there and take it, and no one who knows the secret about her now-legitimate-actress mother dare say anything about it. But Hye-Bin's one true purpose of coming to this academy was to find her childhood friend and love, Ryul, who had given her first kiss when they were little. Having seen Ryul declare on TV shows after becoming a child star that he was still waiting for Hye-Bin, she had been dreaming for this reunion ever since. But something is wrong with Ryul. The warm, friendly kid she remembers had been replaced by a cold, indifferent boy who is seemingly obsessed with the beautiful president of the art club. Worse, there seems to be a more complicated situation underneath as Hye-Bin realizes that she has entangled herself into something much more complex than she could imagine. Everyone wants to use Hye-Bin as their pawn in the game, but she won't have any of it!...

Power, body, charisma all together it shakes the mind. Provoked the gym teacher to seduce his nervous mind. The first kiss then, second kiss to seduce. Who is really the person that makes Chunja's heart thump? That person is...!!...
A college girl finds her ideal guy. There is just one problem though. The guy's younger than her. In fact, he's in high school!

Chyoo Lee Ning, jerk Eun Jeh, pretty handsome boy Yun Jun woo, if it’s like or just bullying the one year younger guy who confuses people... Hyun bin. Heh young, who believes that the strongest person can achieve love… This is a love story about different teens.

'Recently, the social evils have not disappeared yet and they are even contagious into the school' is what Soo Yung believes, little does she know that the 'accidental' first kiss on the school roof leaves her running/craving for more!

Prashian is an aristocratic line gifted with 500 years of life and special powers. Elan are "normal people" who live 100 years. In this place where these two "peoples" live together, there is a Litra Palia living in among them without knowing her own name. Following the orders of servants, she lives off the charity provided by the Prashian among the Elan. She is but a "pet".

(Source: Original Publisher, translated)

Life isn't that great when it's composed of a stubborn sister, single mom, and a dad that left you for someone else? If that's not enough, you meet a dwarf that's part of a famous boy band? Could this get any worse?!

She has no father to call dad. She has no siblings to call brother. A girl with hardly any siblings. The smiling angel Choi Mi So.
Even if I am lonely, I stopped crying when I turned 12. Becasue WooJin oppa came into my life. However, there is a secret behind her smile. She isnt close with her mother? But she is close with the love of her life, Woo Jin Oppa? Then what about her boss? Yu Ri? Why is my life so difficult and complicated? I'm only 17 years old!!

Gyul, the outcast of the entire school, who used to be unable to get away from dangers without Ri Rang's help becomes strong with a sword obtained at an antique shop?!

Hot-tempered, unruly fighter Woo Ri and
my best friend Gyul suddenly seems different?
My heart beats when I see Gyul!!
Without knowing my eyes turned to look at his lips, and I could feel myself blushing.
This is not a disease, is it?

My father died when I was small, and my mother was a first-ranked maid, who left me in the charge of my grandparents. The last time I met her was when she was 36.
Out of curiosity, I plunge into the world of maids. I wait on young master Rain, and study at the school for maids. And master Rain's brother.... he is.... what's my feeling for him anyway? Could it be love?

And just you wait, I will be Cinderella.

Kael (a.k.a. Ryu Shiho) was a menace in his angelic form, harassing other angels whenever he got the chance to. Therefore, the heavenly fathers decided to expel him to the human world, hoping that his behaviour would improve. But... They guessed wrong. His attitude didn't get any better at all, and to top it off, humans now call him "Lucifer" because of his evil deeds and his scary eyes. If he ever wants to see the doors of heaven open up to him again, he has to perform a hundred good deeds... Will this task prove to be impossible?

This is an SBS Drama Special. Kang Jin's Family moves to Sancheong with a past lingering over their shoulders. As they arrive in town, banners hanging over the streets are forbidding them from passing through the streets because of their luggage in the back of the trunk. Something about the banner really ticks off Kang Jin's Mom. As crazy as she is, what does she do? And what lies ahead in Sancheong? This is a tragic love story of sweet descendants.

Being beautiful is never easy, especially if you’re an eighteen-year-old boy like Gene who is constantly mistaken for a girl because of his delicate good looks. Gene is, in fact, anything but delicate. He is the ringleader of a group of tough kids in an all-boys school, and he’s quick to beat the living daylights out of anyone who even hints that he resembles a girl.

His life is about to take a shocking turn. When Gene stumbles upon strange happenings in the forest, he gets sucked into a world of vampire intrigue and sinister romance that he never knew existed. And he learns that he’s facing more than being turned into a vampire: like being turned into a girl?!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

A father who committed suicide on Yuh’s 16th birthday.
The boy she met during her sorrow; Mu Hyul
Ba-dump Ba-dump; a guy so breathtaking.
A proposal at a sky resort.
“I can do anything for you as long as it makes you smile. I’ll give you everything you want.”
All those to interrupt our love are so dead!

London, 1888 A.D. The entire city is consumed by fear of a serial killer known only as Jack the Ripper. He mutilates female prostitutes with extreme brutality. However, his victims hide a terrifying secret and Jack’s destiny is to continue hunting them down.

Junhee Lee is an average high school girl. She's pretty dense, you could say, and she's a tough girl willing to beat up anyone who ticks her off in one teensy second! She's the Jjang of her high school, but she didn't even know it. She had beaten the previous Jjang on the first day of school- but let's just say she thought the Jjang was a phony. He was just too weak! Junhee is obsessed with the boy band "OZ", and she's starstruck when she's faced with her favorite member! But her rival-in-love is a pop singer, and they must fight fight fight!

If it's singing he can do it, if it's sports he can do it, he's can do everything except studying.
Korea's ultimate pretty boy Lee Jehi Now,
he meets his childhood first love, and ultimate hardships are coming his way.
Oh~It's Seo YeonWoo Look at her turning the heads
Is she better than me? Huh?
Oi! Oi! Where are looking at!
How can you look at others with a guy like me in front of you!
I told you Don’t Cheat on Me!!!

A girl who would die for romance, Bora, fell in love with a beautiful cheating dog-seller one day. She tries to find him with only the information of his school, but fails miserably. Just as she was about to give up, Bora gets an offer to be a substitute for a daughter of a rich, prestigious family who looks just like herself. Dumbstruck, Bora rejects the offer, but changes her mind drastically when she saw that the daughter goes to the same school as her prince. Bora attends to school with a thumping heart, but as it happens, life just never gets easy!

Nan-Hui was sent off to the city to live with her mother and her nasty grandmother when she was caught smoking at her country school again. There she rescued the drunk and ungrateful, Gong-Myeong from the beatings of five boys. Angry that he did not appreciate her help, she stomped on his arm and ran off…not expecting to meet him again.

Gong-Myeong devised a plan with Nan-Hui after being heartbroken over losing a girl he loves to his half-brother, Baek Jae-Ha.

"We’re not going to really love each other. We’ll be a contract couple to get what we both want.”
The handsome bad boy, Cha Gong-Myeong & bad girl, Lee Nan-Hui are declared a couple of horror!

What will happen when Nan-Hui’s best friend, who is in love with her, comes to Seoul? Things get even more complicated when Gong-Myeong’s half-brother falls for Nan Hui.

Can this bad prince give this bad Cinderella her glass slipper? Will love blossom between these two bad personalities?

Shaolin Space, a place that's said to be where all martial arts in the universe originated from. And within this planet... a most sacred place among martial artists, Mt. Kunlun. And on top of that Mt. Kunlun, there's Kunlun Headquarters. And if you go down... a long way, inside a small run-down dumpling restaurant, our heroine lives.

Coffee! Passion! and Love!
Dive into the world of Coffee!

As a little boy, Si Mun, the grandson of a famous shaman, had the ability to see - and communicate with - ghosts. His grandmother gave him a talisman which temporarily rid him of this ability and erased his memories of any supernatural phenomena he had witnessed.

Years later, Si Mun is working a hectic, yet ordinary, job as a homicide detective in the Korean police force. His grandmother has since passed on - and the powers she sealed away appear to be reawakening...

The love story between a blind girl who lives in fairytales and a hard boiled boy who no longer believes.

After the accident, Ai Rin is no longer too sure. She cannot see, and she isn't even sure if her 'family' is her real one. She doesn't remember if she had any sisters or even an angry mother. While Lee Su's family was completely destroyed. His father is now drunk, and he doesn't have any money to pay for the surgery his little sister needs. He stopped believing in magic and fairytales long ago. But the two meet by chance, Ai Rin, a fairytale writer, and Lee Su, a hat seller.

Jin is a famous singer whose true identity is the legendary devil “Lord Perdien”. Even his son Miryu does not know that his father is the legendary devil. To protect his son, Jin fights.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The story follows Mr. Kwon, a man that relocates to the countryside to be a teacher just for the sake of it. This being the countryside, the classroom he's assigned to is really small, compromising of only five unique children, all with their unique personalities and struggles.

Even though he's nothing more than a gangster, Kwon does his best to get through to the children, and ends up doing all he can to help them and lead them to a better life, in their families, education and social lives.

(Source: MangaRock)

Mercenary Maruhan... the man who roams the darkness in the time of humanity's doom!

In the ancient era of the super-continent, where no border exists between the East and the West -- the race of Demonic Beasts begins an invasion against the human race, breaking the mutual non-aggression pact! And as humanity takes to the road to seek refuge, some gather to form the ultimate army for an attempt to kill King Rhode, the Chief of the Demonic Beasts... The intense story of one certain mercenary starts there!!
A world of supernatural where strong preys on weak. An Earth just not for humans.....and a strange ability!

After peace gets established between the world the devil king finds himself bored out of his mind basically every single day, as such he seeks entertainment, which often involves his subjects and comes at their expense.

Join the Demon King on his "small" adventures as he tries everything he can to temporarily cure his boredom.

A music practitioner with a dark past.

A young girl with the power to create illusions.

A meeting of fate.

title.romaji: Special Martial Arts Extreme Hell Private High School

description: A teenager decides to enroll in a Martial Arts High school so he can learn how to defend himself and not get bullied anymore. But the school he has chosen to enroll in is not like all other typical martial arts schools and he will soon be caught up by a surprise…!

Heters are humans who have gained superpowers. Each heter has super regenerative abilities and one additional power. Mi-Ru is a man who hunts heters, these hunters are known as Closers. It is clear that Mi-Ru has a past with heters and will stop at nothing to hunt them down.

Delinquency has become a major problem among the youth, especially the high school population. Taking the matter into their own hands, the government has created a special school just for these troubled youths. Kang Hae Hyo, a seemingly normal high school student who is bullied frequently, somehow ends up in the school! He's not sure he belongs there, but something him, and his past, may be discovered at this school...

The story of a girl with a hereditary fate and a nine-tailed fox trying to break free from a thousand-year curse.

(Source: Naver, translated)

They walk like ordinary people, they talk like ordinary people but in fact there is nothing ordinary about them since they can materialize an image they have on their mind... They call themselves Chachaoong which also means Shaman and they do not know how or when they came to this world. It is now a time for their current king to choose the future one and so he did by choosing Yu Jin an ordinary human...? Many of the Chachaoong can not tolerate a human ruling them and now the poor Yu Jin not knowing what suddenly hit him, is trying to avoid the Chachaoongs who are trying to kill him!

A wild, action-packed mystery-thriller that blends our world with the supernatural - shamans, demons, Triad and dragons.

Scroll-reading through Shaman by Highest S. Wave naturally feels like viewing an animated film. Each and every panel sequentially flows with darkly vivid artwork. Mix of gorgeous psychedelic colors produces a surreal experience that is truly unforgettable.   The overall art-style complements the mysterious tone of this fascinating story of Shamans. Jowi, the main protagonist, is immediately introduced as an abnormal character with regenerative healing powers. Since the strangled death of his sister 10 years ago, he struggles with visions that forces him to relive the horrific tragedy. Jowi discovers new evidence that she may still be alive, and he is faced with many complex obstacles on his path to uncovering the truth. One of those obstacles is "Odd-Eye," a popular hallucinogen that gives unworldly powers. This drug is a McGuffin that persists throughout the story.   

The overarching theme to keep in mind is the meaning of perfection versus imperfection. Some desire to become gods while others desire to become humans.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes a prologue.

The story of a slave, called Zion, set in a Middle Eastern setting, who is training to become a great necromancer, to be able to fight on even grounds with Knights, to have his long awaited revenge as a chosen child(1 of 4) of Kronos...he became a slave on his own accord to achieve his goal...
Now... what has God chosen for his fate?...or was it the Devil?
Follows the story of a girl who is followed by an aggressive Guardian Angel and a pacifist Demon who have made a bet about her. However she can actually see them.

Having witnessed her "secret" love killed by a murderer, the normally calm and cool headed police officer, Seolah, is determined to find the bastard and avenge her love's death...

(Source: Lezhin)
Children with special power forced to go to different school near Korea.

"4 Rang" is pronounced "Sa Rang" in korean which is the same pronunciation as "Love".
This series is regarding romantic interests among a group of close friends who have known each other from their high school days. 
(Source: Sura's Place)

Joseon Dynasty, a dynasty most known for its prosperous yet dangerous times... However, some of the history is not written in books... What happened to the life of a little girl living in the Joseon Dynasty?

Power struggles beneath the yellow sands, flames within the azure eyes.

(Source: Official Site, translated)

Gu Qingrang thinks it is bad enough that he had an accident and has lost his memory. What is worse, his husband files for divorce after seven years of marriage. When he just decides to say good riddance to his husband and move on, his ex does not want to leave him alone...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Wo Chengle Wu Ge Dalao De Zuzong
title.native: 我成了五个大佬的祖宗

description:
The queen of the blood clan who has been asleep for a thousand years is finally awake, and the first thing she does is to follow the trend and join the entertainment industry? She's far from being popular since she needs to make a movie star, billionaire, pro gamer, medicinal genius, and a young scientist her younglings?! Wait, there's also that tyrannical president who's somehow her mortal enemy in the past so how is she going to get away...

(Source: Webnovel)

10 years of unrequited love, 10 years of yearning, 10 years of waiting.
Was it all in vain?
Yan Zhi pulled out of Zhao Fei Ying's arms and stood in front of him.
He slowly striped his clothing.
One centimeter after one centimeter, he slowly revealed his untouched snow white skin in front of Zhao Fei Ying.

I, Leng Yan Zhi, here by vow------- to stay by my brother for as long as I live, until he is bored and tired of my existence.

Is it possible for the deeply passionate Leng Yan Zhi to receive his brother's love?

(Source: Uei Shiang, translated)

title.romaji: Guoshu? Pindao Buhui, Wo Zhi Hui Lei Fa!
title.english: The Taoist Master Who Summons Thunder
title.native: 国术？贫道不会，我只会雷法！

description:
Heron Quinn, who traversed into a parallel modern city, unexpectedly inherited the position of the current Taoist Master at Serenity Taoist Temple. Moreover, he was bound to the Taoist Master System, allowing him to receive rewards for completing daily tasks. Heron initially thought he could live a peaceful life, but to his surprise, he was forced to spar with a live streamer in traditional martial arts. As Heron raised his palm into the air, golden lightning transformed into a sword. He smiled and said, "I don't know traditional martial arts, but I do know a bit of the thunder technique."

(Source: Webnovel)

Kan Xing, a young man with no knowledge of Taoist arts, brings Lili, a gifted Taoist priestess, to a bizarre escape room to search for his missing sister. But the malevolent forces within the shop far exceed their wildest imaginings. Everything seems to suggest that behind the Taoist priest’s righteous facade lies a hidden side. For the first time, the two young people are confronted with the complexities of the human heart.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

While the family business bankrupted overnight and her boyfriend cheated at the same time, anger made her reach for the bottle. Hopelessly drunk, she forced someone she just met less than 3 days ago to marry her! Luckily, he is not so bad-looking and very nice - but he lied about his identity! He claimed that he was an assistant, but who knew that he was actually a billionaire! (Source: WebComics)

As a rabbit spirit, Xiao Mian has modest dreams: visit heaven, meet its super sexy king, and…become a god?! When the king of spirits, Liu Yan, makes a royal request for a wife, she sees an opening. But why would a king want a lowly spirit like her?

(Source: Tapas)

At a bar, Dong Ling, who is about to graduate from the police academy, meets Bai Ruowei, a cute and innocent-looking rich girl. These two unrelated women turn out to be inextricably linked to an old, unsolved case. Meanwhile, the playboy Zhao Zhi, who dislikes his fiancée Bai Ruowei, becomes more interested in her when he discovers that she might not be not as dumb as he thought...

(Souce: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Zhuansheng Shi Zuo Hei Lianhua: Zui Qi Yao Fuchou Qianyue
title.native: 转生誓做黑莲花：罪妻要复仇签约

description:
A trap meticulously set by her best friend turns Wang Shu from a blissful wife into a prisoner overnight. After dying wrongfully, she is reborn into the body of Su Ya—the depressed younger sister of her treacherous friend! Vowing revenge at any cost, she’s determined to make the mastermind behind it all pay dearly and restore her family’s fortune to reclaim her happiness!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Fabio Lee accidentally traversed space and time and entered the Origmax Realm... into the body of an idiot…(*sigh*). Time to give up? Never! Cultivating and leveling up, watch him complete his nirvana from an idiot to a martial art master and all the way to the peak of the Origmax Realm.

(Source: WebComics)

This is a world dominated by women, where heaven, earth, humans, gods, demons, and monsters coexist in the five realms. A thousand years ago, the suppressed demon race escaped into the world, causing widespread suffering. Qian Xiao, as the leader of all living beings, revived using Zhen Ling's flesh and blood to subdue the evil spirits. At the same time, he must abide by the taboos of not killing, not interfering, and not developing emotions...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A haughty man from the year 3362 x Third-rate joker streamer in 2019. Lin Shu, living solo since birth, has encountered a huge crisis in life. A pervert who claimed to be from the future snuck into his house, and wants to absorb his energy? His dream of starting a family and living a normal life is about to be crushed. How will he go on?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, an epilogue, and 2 extra chapters.

Yancheng transmigrated into the role of the new emperor in the novel. To escape the fate of being imprisoned and tormented by the governor of the Western Bureau, he attempted various methods of counterattack and escape. However, the conclusion kept looping back — he came to realize that he couldn't kill the governor, nor could he sever the emotional bond with him.

After much contemplation, Yancheng decided to take control himself. He pushed the governor onto the bed, stating, "No matter what I do, you will have to endure it." And the governor replied, "If Your Majesty wants me to endure it, then I can only... pretend to cooperate."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Fuxiao Zhi Shi You Feng Chui Guo

description:
A jinxed youth searches for luck.

A teenager who loathes himself because of a supernatural curse which brings misfortune to those around him embarks on a thrilling journey with his friend to solve the mystery of their strange powers.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Chapter count includes one bonus chapter.

The intertwined three spaces, the dangerous school campus, the blood-shed battlefields. From now on, from then on, even if you revived in this world, what could you change? What would you want to change? Countless monsters in the dark street when night falls and many lives have been devoured by inhuman creatures. How will he retrieve the situation and reverse everything to the beginning?

(Source: MangaToon)

Su Ruhui, a Class A wanted criminal of the Secret Sect, died tragically due to illness. When he woke up, he found that it was five years later and he had become the newlywed husband of Sang Chiyu, the first disciple of the Secret Sect. Sang Chiyu was Su Ruhui's mortal enemy and the most prestigious military officer of the Kunlun Secret Sect. The former favored child of heaven, for some unknown reason, had his right leg crippled and was covered with whip wounds, barely surviving.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

When humans beat the gods with wisdom, they invent a series of entertainment activities about gods. They catch the gods and let them fight each other. That's how the GBA competition has become a popular sport for all mankind. MC who hates the gods, is a god master of "God Capturer" group, participating in the capture and training of gods. Freedom or destruction? Where will the human beings to go?

(Source: WebComics)

The princess residing in the Tower of Luna, with her transcendent beauty, she possesses a myriad of gorgeous men in her palace. Her desire for power and authority is unrivaled and she will stop at nothing to obtain what she wants. In the face of rival armies, she utilizes her beauty, charm, and wisdom to defend her homeland while on her way to becoming the greatest leader this land has seen.

(Source: Webcomics)

title.romaji: Kuang Re BOSS, Chong Qi Qing Jiezhi!

description:
During an exquisite banquet, her fiance kneeled and asked for her sister's hand in marriage. She was stripped of her inheritance and became a pawn for the Xi family. Her heart hardened like steel, and she thrust a knife into her own chest to try and bury all of her anger and sorrow. Then, in the blink of an eye -- Mu Yuchen, the handsome, cold CEO of Shengshi Group who dominated City Z -- appeared before her. She asked: Mu Yuchen, will you marry me?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Da Yingxiong De Nüyou Chaoji Xiong

description:
An ordinary teenage boy with a fierce gaze but stiffens up with fear when faced with danger meets a super-girl and become a couple by chance. But for some reason, the world thinks he's the strongest one. This is a super-hero story of a paper tiger who relies on his girlfriend.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Kai Ju Bang Ding Shengnü Xitong

description:
Gu Beichen is a transmigrater whose body and soul have been tortured by an evil witch to the brink of death, when a mysterious system finally awakened. He will embark on a journey through myriad worlds. In each realm , he meets beautiful women, and after dramatic struggles, eventually forming close bonds with them. With the help of his female companions, Gu Beichen will bravely return to the original world to confront the witch.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Jiang Hao found himself reborn into the life of a common peasant, only to be sold off and conscripted into the Demonic Sect as a disciple. His ambition was simple: to engage in unobtrusive cultivation and steadily accumulate strength to survive this world. Yet, his goals were thwarted at every turn by a formidable Demoness whose power eclipsed his own, forcing him to endure ceaseless humiliation. Lacking a powerful patron to back him, Jiang Hao eventually garnered favor of the sect leader, allowing him to focus on his cultivation without further distractions. However, when he ascended to the role of chief disciple and finally met the stunning leader of the sect, he was left dumbfounded…

(Source: Webnovel)

For 1000 years, the men have understood the importance of the capacity and the economic stakes. Now, they live quietly thanks to an almost perfect social structure, and it is because of this way of life that physical faculties of the man do not evolve. They begin to deteriorate little by little. Park Iro and Anling are two newcomers with Southern Shaolin, one of the sections of martial arts of the most famous school of combat: the Monastery of Shaolin. The purpose of this school is to give rise to a new human race by developing to the maximum physical capacities of the students. As of the night of their arrival, an unknown force attacks the temple and awake Molitofu, a demon locked up 10 years before by the Luba general.

The famed thief Guidenhua infiltrated a brothel to steal a priceless treasure. But he ran into the infamous boss Lin Ange, and he was forced to 'sell his body' in the brothel! After a series of resentful conflicts, the relationship between them became more and more peculiar...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

A young man transmigrated to another world, and became a "princess"?! Forced to flee an arranged marriage, he was lucky enough to be rescued by a mysterious unicorn hunter! A fantastic adventure is about to begin. Will the young man successfully return to his home world? And what is the true nature of the mysterious unicorn hunter...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo You Yi Dao, Ke Zhan Tian Di

description:
Lin Dao, the Emperor of Heaven, in his pursuit of the Supreme Blade Heart technique, dissipated his cultivation to start anew. However, he was betrayed by Wang Xian'er, and his throne usurped. On the brink of death, Lin Dao reached enlightenment of the Supreme Blade, and he hid away his soul to lay dormant for thousands of years. When he reawakened, he reincarnated into the body of an overlooked disciple of the Heavenly Sword Sect. The unwanted disciple was sent to the Divine Blade Sect as a scapegoat sacrifice. Lin Dao took advantage of the opportunity, and established himself in the Divine Blade Sect as his base, meticulously preparing his revenge against Wang Xian'er. Subsequently, Lin Dao annihilated the Heavenly Sword Sect, defeated the Soul Annihilation Hall, and forcefully unified the three major continents. This forced the ones behind the conspiracy, the Azure Cloud Sect, to finally reveal themselves as the force that controlled Wang Xian'er. The final confrontation between two empires is about to began.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The heartbeat at the first moment we met, the trust when skin to skin, the story stars from these moments... The peaceful life of the doctor went to a unknown situation. But the embrace of this moment will be forever? The encounter was carefully designed by "the devil", but "the devil" cannot control his heart from now on... When the thin ice of love is broken, all good things changed into lies, where will they go...

(Source: Webcomics)

Wang Dabing accidentally picked up a cultivation system. From then on, a wicked cultivation school was born! Geniuses and geniuses were turned into waste material in front of him, and those who bullied him would naturally become a slag . The system comes up and shines! Alchemy draws the Fubu array refining machine learning test, as long as you complete the task, just sing along on the road of pretending to force! Super rewards allow you to hang on to everything. As for the system tasks, the class teacher who arrogantly acts wantonly, kisses the class flowers sought after by the school ... System, are you serious?

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

Wen Tian He had always thought that he would become an overbearing CEO. However, he turned out to be the overbearing CEO’s man.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 5 extras.

Zhou Luoyang reunited with Du Jing who left three years ago without saying goodbye. He found out that Du Jing was working a dangerous job as a private investigator. They accidentally obtained a watch with the Eye of Forseti which held the power to turn back time. They fell into the perpetual cycle of time… Endlessly revisiting their encounter and mutual relationship...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

With the help of a “loving butler”, she regained her confidence and re-pursued her dream boy... However, she didn’t know that this butler was not just a robot...

(Source: Webnovel, edited)

Soft and full, pudding-like touch... A 'sensational man' who became a masseuse only to touch a woman With a lot of young and solid Missy, you can fully fulfill your dreams in the new city of Westan!

"I don't think you can touch a body like yours, selflessly."

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Ji-Yun, who had always been second in her class, suddenly found herself in possession of a “lucky notebook.” While the notebook granted her the good fortune of becoming first in her class, it also completely disrupted her peaceful daily life. To focus on her studies, she must solve the strange problems it presents. Amidst all the chaos, love blossoms—even though it’s a romance Ji-Yun never asked for...!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Brienne, stripped of her title by her cousin and on the verge of being sold to an ugly, middle-aged nouveau riche, runs away disguised as a man, only to find herself in dire straits. The only job she can find is a butler position for the infamous Duke of Connaught!

"A whopping two gold pieces a week!"

It was too much to refuse. She tried her best to avoid Duke Connaught's notice and just save up enough money to escape, but "You're cute." For some reason, it seems the Duke has taken notice of her.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After the failure of her first love, Serin easily and quickly falls in love with any good-looking guy. Two days before her birthday, she gets dumped by her hot boyfriend, and her search for a man like the legendary unicorn continues. Little did she know, she'd meet a real unicorn on the virtual reality blind dating app called Random Target. Is this app the golden ticket to finding her true love?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Note: Chapter count include 3 side story chapters.

Once known as the ultimate killer, "Knife Rabbit" retired and lived a quiet life under the name of chef "Goya."
