One day, he senses an indescribable, enchanting scent from a girl named "Jin Seo-Nu" who visits his restaurant. Pursuing her are his former colleagues, former killers, and "natural enemies." These enemies, intent on completing their mission, and Goya, the chef, desperate to monopolize the scent, their desires and instincts surrounding the girl become intertwined.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Whether it be owning a pet pony, becoming a princess, or marrying Tom Cruise, every young girl has one dream or another. Dorothy, who’s just a regular middle school girl, has a drastic change in her dreams when one day she runs into Mistress Lilly, an accomplished witch who is looking for an apprentice. Sure, some girls would want to become a witch so that they could learn to make love potions, or own magical cats and rabbits that talk… but where’s the fun in that? Our cute heroine would answer this question by replying : “I’d want to become a witch to live out a romantic life that every girl wishes for… you know, like turning the world into a dark hellish cauldron, making everyone bow to me, and summoning cute zombies, tee hee hee~!”

Oh yes, and what kind of comedy would this be without having all the hyperactive crazy sub-characters that make the heroine seem like a senile old lady in comparison. First, you have Dorothy’s close friend Remi who doesn’t seem to understand you’re only supposed to take just 1 prozac pill a day. Then you have Lilly, the witch, who’s fashion sense would make Madonna and Britney Spears blush. And finally, we can’t forget about Dorothy’s main love interest, a cute boy who’s only problem is that he’s a werewolf who wants to eat her alive!

(Source: Infinity Studios)

“Freedom at last!”

After fifteen long years of secluded training, he finally descends the mountain, determined to reclaim the youth he feels he wasted. He vows to complete the ten great deeds promised to his master as swiftly as possible, then live the rest of his life in blissful leisure. Brimming with confidence, he takes his first steps into the world—only to find that nothing goes as planned. In a realm where betrayal and tears far outweigh righteousness and laughter, his journey toward becoming the world’s greatest warrior begins. Join him now on his path through this perilous martial world!

Arhin Avand is taking a big risk disguising herself as a man to be a knight — because if she's discovered, she'll be deemed a witch! But thankfully, the only person who sees through her disguise is Marquess Ludvig Vert, her new captain and the first man she ever kissed. Now, as they work together to carry out secret missions for the good of the empire, Arhin can't help but feel like he's giving her special treatment. Is the marquess's favoritism a good thing, or will it totally blow her cover?

(Source: Tapas)

Greta, a commoner, has spent her life believing that love means little without money or status. Shaped by her parents’ failed marriage and her father’s obsession with nobility, she sees marriage as the surest way to rise above her station. Edmund, a noble, believes the opposite. Having grown up watching his parents preserve their love despite hardship, he despises Greta’s view of love and ambition. When two people with completely opposing beliefs become entangled in the world of theater, will their convictions remain unchanged—or will it make them to question what they truly believe?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Korean scrapper representative, Kang Sung-Jae. He has an opportunity to become a legendary cook!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Always fighting, yet somehow friends, they ended up causing trouble. Do-Ha is an Alpha, Geo an Omega, yet they've been childhood friends since they were little. One day, a rut hits Do-Ha, and just then, Geo happens to drop by his house and runs into him...

With his memory of that night hazy due to the Rut, Do-Ha watches Geo retching and thinks. It seems he ended up on top of Geo, but seeing no sign of a condom...

“So... I'll... take responsibility...!!”

Please, just talk it out... No, Let's have a talk!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Hyunjoon, a retake student, explodes in inferiority complex after being tutored by his rival Nari. After pressing an unknown button that appeared in front of him, Nari begs Hyunjoon to give him sex education. The second short stories of the Relationship Reverse Button series!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Min-Chan has lived his whole life as part of the elite top 1%—an Alpha who always wins. Bored with his perfect life, he accepts a friend's invitation to join Fight Club, a brutal underground arena where only fighting skills matter. What starts as a casual thrill quickly escalates when Min-Chan begins competing himself—and winning easily, just like always. But just as victory starts to feel hollow, he faces an opponent he can't beat: Tae-Wook, a smaller, seemingly fragile Omega. Crushed by his first-ever defeat, Min-Chan is furious—and obsessed. He approaches Tae-Wook, only to be met with complete indifference, a blow to his pride he can't ignore. Then one night, fate strikes: Tae-Wook enters his heat cycle, and Min-Chan doesn’t miss his chance. Pride, instinct, and raw attraction collide—

In this fight, winning might mean losing everything Min-Chan thought he knew.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

When infamous mercenary Leopold Gregory gets falsely accused of murdering Hareid Bakadi, the last thing he expects is to wind up working for the dead man’s wife, Hena! He uses a fake name to further avoid detection and even winds up getting close to Hena’s son, Daniel. Leo intends to figure out who framed him, but along the way, he finds himself drawn to the mysterious lady of the house who still has no idea he’s a suspect in her husband’s murder. Will his search for the truth end up ruining what he’s built with Hena and Daniel?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Geon and Suo's Unholy Love Affair

description:
Geon is a strict top known as the “Sexergizer” who will only sleep with someone once. But his promiscuous life comes to a halt when his fed-up mom drags him to church, where he thoroughly gets his manhood exorcised! After four years of seeing no action down south, Geon seems doomed to live an impotent life... until a chance encounter with his high school crush, Suo, has his vigor soar back high to heaven! But it isn’t all up from here, as bottoming turns out to be Geon’s only solution to overcoming his (un)holy intervention and finding true love...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Lady Jacqueline Summerset loses everything after her father’s disappearance and her family’s bankruptcy. Accepting the need to begin anew, she becomes the thirteenth private tutor at the Preston estate. There, she clashes with the infamous Marquess of Preston, not just in temperament but in principle. Jacqueline believes a child should be taught with care, warmth, and love, while the Marquess insists strict discipline is the only way to shape a proper heir. As their opposing methods collide day after day, Jacqueline begins to glimpse the secrets the Marquess keeps hidden, and finds herself growing unexpectedly closer to the man who seems her complete opposite.

(Source: WEBTOON)

During a high school field trip… there was a terrible accident. When Paloma woke up two moons graced the night sky and, next thing you know, she’s surrounded by vampires who think she’s their goddess?! Worse yet, what will they do if they discover she’s not? Welcome to the Vampire Academy.

(Source: Tapas)

After two failed marriages, Titiána began her third chapter in life with the help of the mysterious owner of a bar she frequented.

“No more marriage in my life!”

Having declared she would never marry again after her two failed marriages, she vowed to build a successful flower shop and live as a fabulous single woman… but mysterious men keep approaching her.

“Let’s date, Nuna. No marriage.”

“I’m not as nice as Yuri. Just be my girl, okay?”

Will Titiana really go and do something crazy for the third time?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Am The Obsessive Emperor's Talented Pharmacist

description:
Hailey is an obscure palace pharmacist in the BL guideverse rofan novel "Ties of Obsession," which is what the reader vaguely recalls upon waking up in her body. Even without Hailey's memories, the new Hailey thwarts the evil head pharmacist's attempt on Emperor Damion's life and is rewarded with the position of his personal pharmacist. Although the contract Damion makes her sign is a lifelong one, it pays a crazy high salary, and her patient's handsome face is a nice perk. What Hailey doesn't foresee is Damion getting attached to her before meeting his gay lover from the original novel!

(Source: Tappytoon)

After a four year relationship, things are growing tense between Haru and Ji-Seo. They may have broken up, they may have broken hearts, but there’s one thing they can’t break: their lease! He starts writing a new novel with his own personal tastes he started an adult murim novel series full of milfs called “Colorful Warriors”. However, Colorful Warriors suddenly gained positive feedback and an enormous following. While feeling burdened by the unexpected reactions, Kang Yoo was accidentally transported into his own novel. In there, he meets the women he had always admired back in his world, learning to cultivate the “Art of the Snake,” which can only become stronger through yin and yang harmony(sex)…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

“Even after losing her memories, it’s still Jin Kyudo… What a cruel connection…”

Jin Kyudo, in his attempt to start a new life, reunites with his long-lost lover Shin Danbi at the company where he has just been hired. While Kyudo is completely flustered, Danbi remains eerily calm. The truth is, an accident erased every bit of their past together from her memory. Not wanting to hurt her twice, Kyudo tries to distance himself. But Danbi keeps getting drawn to the warmth and strange familiarity she feels from this strange man. This way, a tangled romance unfolds. Kyudo struggles in his attempt to let go, Danbi refuses to, and Ahn Choi weaves herself between them like a thread in a messy knot. Into the empty space left by lost memories, new emotions slowly soak in.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: Never SATISFIED WITH My Bunny Husband!

description:
Sierra Delight, the fierce heiress of the Black Panther clan, is forced into an arranged marriage with Luhan White, the heir of the Rabbit clan. Expecting a fragile, trembling husband she can easily intimidate into a divorce, Sierra enters the bridal chamber with low expectations. However, Luhan completely shatters her assumptions. While he remains perfectly innocent and docile during the day, he transforms into an unhinged, insatiable beast at night. Soon, Sierra realizes Luhan is nothing like the gentle bunny she anticipated.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Merman Trapped in My Lake

description:
Servaine Noxirel grew up hearing stories from her great-grandfather—tales of the grandeur their noble house once enjoyed and the madness and obsession that ran through their bloodline. The strangest story of all, however, was about his sickly young niece and the merman she owned—a boy whose beauty and allure inspired a possessiveness that kept him locked away in a tank. Despite bearing a striking resemblance to her namesake, Servaine dismisses everything as just a fairy tale. That is, until Servaine’s return to her ancestral manor dredges up Mel, the merman—who believes his Servaine has finally come back for him. But has he been waiting all this time out of love? Or for revenge…?

(Source: Ize Press)

Han-Byuk isn’t thrilled when his new neighbor turns out to be the cold, aloof Yeo-Min. After hearing Yeo-Min moaning through their too-thin apartment walls and having an awkward interaction the next day, Han-Byuk gets a glimpse of his neighbor with his guard down. He's shy. Cute, even. Han-Byuk decides to double his efforts to befriend his neighbor and, surprised by each other and themselves, they grow closer until the lines of their friendship blurs into something...more.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes one side story chapter.

title.english: How to Talk to My Crush

description:
Do-Hyeon is not a very noticeable guy on campus. Seung-Ju, his junior, happens to become close with Do-Hyeon by doing group projects together. But then Seung-Ju starts becoming curious about Do-Hyeon, who for some odd reason is blunt only with him.

In fact, Do-Hyeon has a secret crush on Seung-Ju, and his feelings are growing...

(Source: BookCube, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

Uriel will give anything to be with Rafflet Mogris, the commander of the Paladins, her savior, and... her master. For years, Uriel happily served as his maid until he left to enlist. Uriel waited for him for seven years before deciding to journey to be at his side in the capital. What the world doesn’t know is Uriel is more than just a maid. In a world riddled with monsters, she has the ability to foresee monster attacks in her dreams. If being with Rafflet means Uriel must join the fight, will her desires be enough to overcome her fears?

(Source: Tapas)

Ah, the headstrong Charlotte Augusta? She really doesn’t seem like an Augusta at all. There’s a reason she still has no suitors even after three seasons in society.

Charlotte Augusta, the third of the five sisters from the renowned Augusta family in British high society. Charlotte, who was treated like a black sheep among her beautiful sisters, causes a major scandal at a ball she attended—as usual—in search of a husband. And there, she meets a handsome man with a refined charm. Prince Leopold of the Kingdom of Holland, a handsome man visible only to Charlotte’s eyes, agrees to clean up the mess she made and help her find England’s finest suitor—in exchange for her help in locating his own body, the whereabouts of which are unknown.

“Don’t worry, Lady. You won’t lose out on anything. As you help me, you’ll end up meeting every single one of England’s most eligible bachelors.”

And so, as the two of them put their heads together every dawn when Leopold’s spirit awoke, the closer they got to their goal, the more confused they became by the feelings welling up toward each other…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“Did I steal this man's lover?”

Seo In-Ho wakes up in a world that he doesn’t recognize. He cannot speak, and can hardly move, but hears voices calling out for him…only, it’s by a name he doesn’t know. Realizing that he has possessed the body of Kacius of this nation’s royal guard. The only person he can rely on is Kacius’s former colleague and lover, Albretto Noe. Determined to not only be protected by, but to protect Albretto, In-Ho begins to fall deeper and deeper into the life of Kacius, until it becomes nigh impossible to differentiate who he truly is any longer…

(Source: Lezhin US)

I was caught by the evil Elves. What awaits me is a dreadful slave life that is far worse than death... But... What? It's an Elf's instinct to desire a strong male?! And 80 percent of Elves are women?! What will happen to me, Yushin Gilead, from now on?!

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Strength is the law, only with the most powerful force can we survive on the island of 58! I was framed and forced to be exiled to this dark island, how should I survive and find the murderer who framed me...

(Source: WEBTOONS, translated)

He stole a pair of panties and was caught by his aunt, but to his surprise, she starts undressing in front of him instead of scolding him.

“You can touch me all you want… It is a special lesson just for you…”

(Source: TOPTOON+)

White Eyebrows wants to dominate the world and for that he will need the power of a magical child!
But the child's guardian is none other than San-Goon, the powerful tiger who swore to protect the child by the will of his old master. Now, White Eyebrows will send his armies after them but it will be up to San-Goon to defend not only the child but the world from White Eyebrows's ambition!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Just when Yeonduk thought he was finally going to be free of his tormentor (and family friend and crush, might we add), Seo Skyler – coolest kid in school – saunters his way into the same classroom. Skyler might look blessed (his sister’s even in a girl group), but he’s got some family issues that only Yeonduk can understand. Yeonduk is more than just star-struck, though, and when Skyler starts acting nice and walking to school with him, he can’t help but hope there might finally be more between them.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kisub is Jinwoo's slacker friend - and secret crush. So when Kisub asks to crash at his place, his heart tingles to be near him everyday. But as the short stay turns into permanent mooch, how long can Jinwoo keep his true feelings under wraps and hold back from confessing?

(Source: TappyToon)

About a man who just come back from his military service, suddenly some monster attack his town and while he is try to apply his military knowledge to defeat the monster, he just find out that his sister is one of the six most powerful weapon on earth!

Source: Manga Updates

This book contains three separate and unusual stories set in alternate realities. The first story, "How Martians Conquer the Earth," tells the tale of a young woman struggling with the sudden death of the man she loves. Can anyone ever replace him? The second tale, "Is It Really Impossible?," makes you wonder if a man and a woman can truly be just friends, especially in a world where women are such a rare find. And the last of the three, "Science Fiction Story," is a sad tale about a girl who hates robots and the humanoid who serves her. The creator, who believes that the best privilege artists get is to "lie", creates a whole new world beyond your imagination.

(Source: Yen Press)

Deacon is a former warrior who once enjoyed a life of fame and honor, that is to say, before he went completely bankrupt. While Deacon rummages around to look for work, he runs into Lagabi: his long-time wizard friend and his secret crush. Knowing Deacon's situation, Lagabi decides to hire Deacon to assist him in his research projects that involve "special" experiments. Deacon enthusiastically accepts the offer, but the next thing he knows, he's being toyed by some slimy demonic tentacles! Turns out that this research assistant job wasn't exactly what Deacon had expected it to be. Now Deacon finds himself trapped in a cycle of pleasure, and he's willing to let his secret desires loose...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

My wrist was severed and my friend was murdered. To survive here, I must complete the quest.

(Source: Naver, translated)

As a skilled hacker, Gyeon Woo-Min is hired by a criminal organization to infiltrate Taeyoung Corporation and steal data. However, when the security system goes off, he's caught by no other than the CEO, Tae Beom-Hyun. Instead of calling the cops, Beom-Hyun offers him a deal that's little better than a slave contract. Left with no other choice, Woo-Min signs the contract and finds himself carrying out all sorts of risky and provocative errands ordered by Beom-Hyun.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

If you’re feeling worried or stressed this year, head over to “Your Favorite Character’s Advice Corner” right away! We’ll share witty or heartwarming solutions to help you out. Naver Webtoon hopes that in 2025, you’ll shake off all your worries and fill your life with nothing but happiness. ♥

(Source: Naver, translated)

26. Saehakgi Saechingu Sagwineun Beop (새학기 새친구 사귀는 법) [Hyeon-A Cho]

Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Locked Up by My Mad Dog

description:
After dying and being reborn as Elizabeth, a character from a dark fantasy novel, the new “Elizabeth” begins to navigate her new life. Set to be married to the empire’s crown prince, the new Elizabeth can’t believe her luck. But just as she’s getting ready for a life on easy street, the dark secrets of the previous “Elizabeth” begin to come to light. Learning that Elizabeth keeps a slave known as her “dog,” Elizabeth feels she should set him free. But little does she know that pulling on this thread will unravel far more than she could ever imagine.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A criminal psychologist is linked to a murder of a government official. A criminal profiler will conduct 10 interviews with the criminal psychologist to find the truth behind the serial murders. "Put together the pieces of the crime and one massive scene will reveal itself."

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

In an effort to escape the power struggle within the Heavenly Demon Sect, the protagonist Myeong-Un retreats to a life of seclusion. However, simply avoiding ambition for the throne is not enough to avert tragedy. Myeong-Un flees from the sect leader Myeong-Gak, who seeks fratricide, before meeting his demise. At the moment of his death, as his consciousness fades, he hears a voice. "Do you regret it? Do you wish to fight again?"" To his surprise, Myeong-Un, believed to be dead, opens his eyes once more....

(Source: WEBTOON)

The magic tree that grows in Tate's hometown always existed as a safeguard from evil entities and creatures. That is, until Tate came across a runaway slave and began nursing him back to health. Suddenly, this strange man's presence causes a chain of even stranger events to occur, including an attack on the town's magic tree!

(Source: Tapas)

Since being identified as a Guide at the age of five, Choi Tae-Hun has spent his life searching for his destined Esper, but has never found one. Now 28 years old, he unexpectedly meets his match at an autograph signing for top celebrity Ji Gwan-Yeong, after being persuaded to attend by his younger sibling. As they begin working together due to their unique connection, Tae-Hun struggles with the unexpected intensity of their bond. He insists that their relationship must remain professional, denying any romantic involvement, while Ji Gwan-Yeong remains confident and unfazed, teasingly suggesting that their connection will evolve into something more. Despite his reluctance, Tae-Hun finds himself increasingly drawn to Gwan-Yeong, leading to a complicated and tension-filled relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The second season of Sketch.

Note: Chapters 36-103.

“The hunt is over, so the hound must die.”

Belita, who became the consort of Emperor Kairos of Canavan to protect the Kingdom of Gores, loses everything—her husband, her child, her country—and is killed. But when she opens her eyes again, she finds herself back seven years in the past, and vows revenge against Emperor Kairos and Empress Drusilla, the root of all her suffering...

She finds herself in danger of being exposed as a rebel by the Empire's deposed Crown Prince, Aaron!

‘Can I make Aaron my first hunting dog?’

Will Belita succeed in taming Aaron and achieving her revenge? A perilous romance between Imperial forces and rebels!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ordinary civilian Howoo's day turns into a disaster movie when a giant monster ambushes his city. All he hopes for is a quick and painless death, so he's pleasantly surprised when he's whisked out of harm's way by celebrity esper Yool. When the charming esper moves in next door shortly after, Howoo feels like he's living in a romcom. Not only does Yool know Howoo's name, but he also shows an oddly friendly interest in him when he's just one of the many civilians he's saved. And for some reason, Howoo feels a tingling sensation whenever their hands touch...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Taerin, a high school student with spiritual abilities, one day learns the story of a ghost. Realizing that people are more dangerous than ghosts, Tae-rin decides to relieve her childhood friend Chang-woo and the ghosts' grievance...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Asha, the chieftain’s daughter, has a rather unusual concern these days. It all began when she accidentally felt Rou’s… well, that. Rou is her childhood friend, but what she discovered that day left a far stronger impression than she expected. It was surprisingly firm and far bigger than she had imagined. The memory keeps stirring her curiosity, yet Rou’s stoic and reserved nature makes it difficult for her to approach him. Then one day, with her father sidelined by a leg injury, Asha must take his place and deliver a trial to Rou, the tribe’s only candidate for the Duutuum. But the moment the two step into the Cave of Trials, a thunderous rumble shakes the cavern, and the entrance collapses, trapping them inside. Now, the only way out is to overcome the ultimate trial waiting for them in the depths of the cave.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Sakwol, who was of lowly status, was taken in by Grand Prince Sibaek, and became close to him as a servant and companion. Sakwol admired Sibaek and followed him, but one day he was suddenly abandoned. After that, a great upheaval occurred, and the world was in chaos due to ghosts, and the previous order and rules collapsed. Sakwol awakens as a strong 'guardian' and deals with ghosts, and the people follow him instead of the king. While eliminating the incompetent royal relatives, Sibaek is captured in front of Sakwol. "I make this Sibaek my slave." Sakwol's hatred shows its teeth.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.
Brow, a photographer, has a wonderful breath of fresh air come into his life.

A large man in the dark sky. A demon. Something in the shape of a bat. He was feared and worshipped by everyone for a long time, but now no one remembers him. He has been forgotten. But he still exists and watches over us. Today, twenty years after Baekjungnal, the long-awaited sacrifice of "him" is finally offered.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type Fall Anthology ([BL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 가을).

One day, Korean Kim Du-Jo wakes up in the desert. He was saved from dying of thirst, but when he came to his senses, he saw people carrying bricks from the labor yard to build the emperor's pyramid!

People say that when you travel through time, you gain mystical abilities: you can see the future, and hang out with beautiful women! Then why can't I have a sip of Coke? And why do I have to be whipped? It's been a long time since I've suffered so much.

Emperor Kun Kankan comes to inspect the construction site of his pyramid, was notices Du-Jo. What will Du-Jo's fate be, when he's caught by Kun Kankan, a sodomite who enjoys being humiliated by strong, rough, and rude men in private...?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Humanity devastated by the emergence of a virus with a 100% fatality rate, People waiting for a vaccine without even knowing the infection route... Where does this catastrophe end?!!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: High School Return of a Gangster

description:
A gangster dies saving a bullied teen — and wakes up in the boy’s body. Living the school life he always dreamed of, he vows revenge for the boy’s suffering. But when the boy's long-time crush begins to suspect he’s not who he says he is, things start to spiral...

(Source: Manta)

Lee Gi-Joo, sick and tired of his miserable outcast life, realizes he needs a girlfriend to escape it. But the girl he falls for at first sight just happens to be the daughter of a boxing gym owner. While trying to turn his life around by getting a girlfriend, Gi-Joo instead starts to fall for the true charm of boxing in the ring.

“Endurance doesn’t just come naturally!”

The story of an outcast fighting for a life turnaround through boxing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

The last guy you’d expect. The one suit that changes everything. Kim Jiwon grew up in the shadows with no parents, no guidance, and no future. To him, a hoodie is more than just clothing—it is armor against a world that never once gave him a chance. But when he’s pulled into a dangerous incident, something hidden inside him awakens. Now, recruited into Baekya, a covert spy organization that works in the shadows, Jiwon faces a world of secrets, suits, and silent wars. This isn’t just survival. It’s a battle to find the life—and the look—that finally fits.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After narrowly escaping the threat of the vampires, the werewolf boys try to settle down in a seaside village. They hope for a peaceful school life but instead meet Khan, a boy who has been branded as a devil and is bullied because of it. There's been a death in this quiet village, and with Khan's deep-rooted secret, the boys may be faced with yet another danger...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

“It doesn't have to be me...”

In the spring of his 18th year, An Ju-Ho had the name of his destined partner tattooed on his wrist. Whether it’s the power of fate or not, he keeps getting entangled with Yun Jae-Hui, the owner of that name. I didn’t care about fate, first love, or any of that nonsense, so why do I keep worrying about him and wondering about him? Is it because of the name on my wrist? Or is it just that…

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The third story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

The protagonist, Kim Geon-Pyo, was left with her soul stolen by a rookie grim reaper's mistake. From that day on, everything in the world hates her. Especially that grim reaper!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Woo-Yeon (27) has been dedicated to the company for 7 years, but is passed over for promotion because he is a high school graduate. He postpones cleaning with the excuse of working overtime, and his one-room apartment becomes a garbage dump. Woo-Yeon, who has become lethargic due to the fatigue and stress of the past, cannot get up from the garbage dump. Until a strange woman, Ha-Ra (28), comes and cleans the garbage dump... What is her true identity?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Women at Work: A Pinch of Love

description:
Ra-On is a top idol on professional hiatus after several scandals. During her time off, she’s tasked with training Ho-Rang, a member of a girl group on the verge of their debut. For reasons Ra-On cannot figure out, Ho-Rang is adamant on dropping out of her chance at stardom, and it’s up to Ra-On to get Ho-Rang’s singing and mindset back in the game. However, it isn’t easy to get Ho-Rang’s spirits and vocals high enough…until Ra-On discovers the perfect trick: pinching her in just the right place.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.

title.english: Surviving as an SSS-Class Alternate Character

description:
It is the year 203X, and Junwoo is a pro at "Over the Fantasy," a virtual reality game. One of his secret strategies is to keep an alternate character for extra inventory space to store his main characters' shiny items. But one unlucky day, a server error traps him inside the game—and as Dio, the classless alternate character! The situation seems dire, but he has an inventory teeming with SSS-class items to help him survive in this fantasy world. They should be enough to keep him going... Right?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Muhyeok and Naui: My Irresistible Neighbor

description:
Just because Naui’s next-door neighbor is tall, tattooed, and sexy as hell doesn’t give him the right to be loud all night! Naui can’t get any sleep because of the moaning and humping going on next door, and he can’t seem to confront his horny neighbor either. Will Naui ever get any rest, or will he find himself up all night in his neighbor’s bed instead?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

Kim Dojin is the manager of a convenience store in the other world he was suddenly pulled into. He was spending his days in a body that didn’t get aroused when… a virgin girl who came to his store revived his senses?!

“The taste of a clumsy virgin girl is the best!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Forensic Scientist Kim Junghoon lies dead in the National Forensic Service's autopsy room. He died full of regret after witnessing his work partner of 20 years, Kim Sangjin, distorted his very own autopsy report when he was still conscious and accused him of committing suicide. Right after he passed away, Kim Junghoon opened his eyes once more and found himself back in 2002 when he was still a rookie in the National Forensic Service. His final wish came true as he got himself one more chance to fix his past!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Jaden never expected to be caught up in the Olsen family's drama, but Philip, his old friend and secret crush, is terminally ill and wants to see his son, the boy Jaden once babysat, one last time. Jaden agrees to help, even though Harry refuses to face his father. Their reunion starts as a clash; Harry feels abandoned by Jaden all those years ago, but his feelings for him soon resurface. And Jaden begins questioning his own heart…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

I've been beaten and humilated all my life and I even lost my parents.

"Now it's your turn. Don't expect to get out of this easily."

(Source: DAYcomics)

Amidst a zombie apocalypse, Vin Yeom, an exterminator, finds a new purpose as an undertaker, specializing in funerals for the infected. Within the walls of the quarantine zone, he and his team navigate a treacherous world, providing solace to grieving families. Their company offers a unique but costly service that bridges the gap between life and death, allowing for one last goodbye. But in this world of death and despair, secrets linger, and the very loss that led Vin down this path may unearth a conspiracy that will shock the world and perhaps... help him find his way back.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Business student Ma Dongjae is cursed with only ever falling for ultra-straight dudes, so you can just imagine the luck he’s had with love. All he really wants is a relationship of his own, but his own poor taste keeps getting in the way! Finally, Dongjae is propositioned, but…it’s by a weirdo in the campus changing rooms. It doesn’t matter how sexy he is, Dongjae has to turn him down, obviously! That should be the end of it, but fate just loves messing with Dongjae, and so they end up not only sharing a class but also being assigned to work on the same project! The thing is, the cool and aloof man who introduces himself is nothing like the creep Dongjae met before. One minute he’s hot, the next minute he’s cold, and half the time he seems to forget they’ve ever even spoken. It’s almost like he’s two different people…

(Source: Lezhin)

Hell? Far from it. After all, isn't this what you wanted? After choosing to end his own life, Hui-Seo Yun awakens adrift on a wooden raft in a bleak, desolate ocean. Attacked by a monstrous creature that defies reality, he questions if it's a dream... but his instincts scream otherwise. Just when all seems lost, he is rescued by a mysterious woman who resembles a grim reaper. As he catches his breath, Hui-Seo asks: am I in hell?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Some people start off their possession stories on an epic journey of discovery and growth–but not the newly awakened Trixie Giuseppe. She’s not even five minutes into her novel but is already married to the biggest creep ever and disowned by her parents. Wishing to free herself from the shackles placed by her awful husband, Trixie takes a job as a servant at a remote estate. But she discovers too late that the “young master” she has to serve is the empire’s foolish prince, Leone Atarta. The novel’s author must’ve misspelled the word “feral” as Leone turns out to be much more of a beast than a simple beauty. And thus begins Trixie’s tale of trying to tame her new “dog” and make him the shining crown prince he’s meant to be.

(Source: Tappytoon)

After discovering he's an omega, Yoontae runs away when his mother tries to pimp him out. A seemingly kind man offers him food and shelter—then abuses him. With nowhere else to go, Yoontae ends up in the very life he tried to escape, trading sex for survival. He convinces himself love can be bought or borrowed, until an abusive relationship leaves him broken once more. When his ex attacks him in public, a stranger named Wooseok steps in. Is this the start of something real—or just another trap?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In high school, Cheol-Ho's obsessive behavior towards Jin-Tae led to a fateful comment: ""I'll consider it if you ever turn into a girl."" Years later, as adults, their paths cross again under shocking circumstances. Jin-Tae wakes up one day to find his body has inexplicably transformed. As they navigate this new and twisted dynamic, Jin-Tae must confront his transformed identity and the dangerous desires Cheol-Ho harbors. Will Jin-Tae find a way to reclaim control over his life, or will he be ensnared by Cheol-Ho's possessive grip?"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Dennis keeps getting dumped. He’s popular and sexy, but his girlfriends always fall for his classmate, Evan. They’re not the only ones charmed by Evans’s handsome face and thoughtful ways, though. Even Dennis is having a hard time remembering he hates Evan, and Evan seems way too flirty for a rival.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

Yeo-Reum Lee, a university student, unexpectedly reunites with her first love, Su-Yeong Ji, and his fiancée, Han-Gyeong Bae, the owner of the café where she works. Their relationship began in high school when Yeo-Reum's mother worked as a housekeeper at Su-Yeong's family home. After years of heartbreak, they meet again, but this time, Su-Yeong unknowingly drinks a potion that makes him fall in love with Yeo-Reum. With the potion's effects lasting one year, will their love become real, or will it fade once the potion wears off?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Hajin Park doesn’t have much beyond a pretty face. He’s jobless, lives with an annoying roommate who watches porn on max volume, and has modest aspirations of opening an online store. His sister will help him achieve his dreams on one condition: if he gets autographs from the famous all male idol group Eight Nine. When he finds mega pop star Hangyum Lee pleasuring himself in a bathroom stall, it’s not just Hajin’s memories of their past together that gets stirred. A twisted romance lacking anything but love begins.

(Webtoon Database)

Tae-In is from the street and labeled as an ex-convict. So far, his world has been a passive life centered around the gangster, Beom-Jae, whom he met in prison.
Then one day, Tae-In happened to witness a murder case, and meets Dan-U, the prosecutor in charge of the case. He loses consciousness from the overwhelming pheromones. Dan-U, who shows kindness to Tae-In, who seems mentally unstable, leaves a deep footprint in his life, which only Beom-Jae has done before...

Between a gangster and a prosecutor, a passionate omega ex-convict from the street.
Will he be able to escape from the shadows of misfortune?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

In the dead of night, you shed your skin, a husk of a thing, leaving you sticky, renewed… and repulsive. Everyone that lays eyes on you lunges towards you, their eyes full of disgust and intent to kill. You need to run. Nearly overnight, Tae-Su Im goes from a terminally ill family man to the most reviled existence on Earth. But it’s not just people’s perception of him that’s changed… it’s him. Something has turned him into a half-man, half-cockroach, and he needs to find out what—or who— did this to him before he gets squashed.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Step into the scandalous life of a private bodyguard, where hidden desires clash with professional boundaries.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: Mui, Alien of the Famous Pleasure Race

description:
Earth leaves a lot to be desired when Mui the Alien first arrives. She was promised a planet full of lustful women, only to end up learning humans are nothing but perpetual working machines. Just when Mui feels pressured to become a productive member of society herself, she meets Hayan, a timid recluse with an interesting way of relieving tension that Mui and her alien appendage can most definitely help with...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

"Would you mind showing me... masturbating?"

The owner, who became the temporary president of the alien club instead of a friend. Coco claims that she is an alien and demands masturbation.

"Sex is for people who love each other."
"Then how about loving me?"

The way alien(?) Coco and the temporary president owner love!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes three side story chapters.

In the early hours of the morning, art student Su-Yeon”witnesses a secret involving her classmate Yu-Shin in the studio.

“You… were a robot?”

Yu-Shin tries to shock Su-Yeon’s head with electricity but fails, and Su-Yeon faints on the spot. That night, Su-Yeon is dragged to Yu-Shin’s house. As her plans with her friend Jae-Hyun go awry, the fates of the three begin to slowly unravel…

A sweet and thrilling campus love triangle featuring young people whose paths keep crossing!

(Source: Naver, translated)

After giving up Taekwondo for over 10 years, Sohee, who lives like a hanryang, has only one interest... k-teen romance! I dream of a future where I will become a lover with 'Soo-hyeon', who is going well. but… One day, So-hee's cell phone syncs a photo that is presumed to be the future, and the boy who became her lover in the photo... It was Lee An-do, an unlucky classmate! can not believe it! There is no probability in this love affair! Even after that, So-hee is confused by the more and more pictures of the future... Will it flow according to the spoiled ending?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Cheon Woo-Jeong, who was looking for a high-paying short-term part-time job. While working as a cruise staff member, he met a passenger…

“Do you also interpret?”

“English and… a little Filipino.”

“Would you mind using your mouth for me and taking my money, Cheon Woo-Jeong?”

The man suggested. I needed money, and he said he needed my mouth. So the whole fault was mine for interpreting his words so literally.

“Just shut your upper mouth and open your lower mouth.”

“…Huh?”

“This is fun. Did you think I could do something great?”

“I think there’s some misunderstanding. You clearly said you needed an interpreter back then…”

“When did I?”

“You said that…”

“This is no fun, Cheon Woo-Jeong. It’s not enough to crawl on all fours and beg you to be nice to me.”

When I came to my senses, the ship was already drifting in an unexpected direction.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Si-Yeon had the rug pulled out from under her when she realized that everything in her life was a lie-- her parents are not her real parents, her fiancé not really her fiancé, and her cousin Eun-Hye is actually the birth daughter of this household. Si-Yeon is resigned to her misfortunes until Eun-Hye reveals to Si-Yeon that all of this was planned and orchestrated. Swallowing her tears of anguish, Si-Yeon makes a fateful wish that brings her 10 years into the past where she may be able to change everything... or can she?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

After dying in an accident, an ordinary woman wakes up next to her favorite fictional character, the handsome Duke Roan von Bannester. Not only that, but she's now Delisse, his villainous wife! In the novel, they divorce due to Delisse's abuse, but the new Delisse is set on changing this. To try and thaw Roan's infamously icy heart, she showers him with fangirlish affection. But while living together may be her dream come true, can Delisse successfully transition from fangirl to loving wife?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: The Greatest Heiress of the Empire

description:
Estelle's life shatters when her family, already resentful of her albinism, abandons her for Seria, who claims to be their real daughter. Left to wander in the cold, Estelle collapses, only to awaken in the care of the House Ballua, the empire's eternal guardians. Intent on leaving after recovery, she finds herself bound by the affections of the Balluas. Unexpectedly, an heirloom arrives from her presumed dead aunt - the lost treasure "Dragon's Tear." Now the heir to the prestigious Mercedes family and the center of everyone's attention, Estelle starts a new life.

(Source: Tappytoon)

“Don’t use the regretful male lead hashtag if the heroine doesn’t end up with a regretful male lead!” After wailing over the ending of my favorite novel, I wake up as Cornia, the heroine who kicks her regretful hubby to the curb for a new flame. The catch? My heart’s set on the regretful husband, Duke Ertein Belcita! But I’ll have to overcome several obstacles to stay married to Ertein. First up, let’s give those meddling villainous in-laws the boot. Watch out, world. Cornia’s rewriting her love life!

(Source: Tappytoon)

"You were originally the heartless one. The one who wanted to leave was you, and now you say you love me?!" Liang Zijin pulled Luo Xiangdong's shirt: "Since you came I won't miss it a second time." Luo Xiangdong turned the situation around, and kissed Liang Zijin. "Lian Zijin, you can't run away from me in this life."

title.romaji: Long Zai Lai Xi! Ma Mi Hen You La
title.english: Ma'am Your Offspring is 4 and a Half Now

description:
Five years ago, she left behind an egg, saying, "This is our son. When he grows up, I'll return to your side."

He thought she was pulling a joke, but several months later, the egg hatched. The boy looked in every way like a normal baby, except for the two tiny sparkling dragon horns on his head. The mother, on the other hand, did not fulfill her promise to return. In those five years she was missing, he almost went mad with grief, until the day his son brought home a woman. "Papa, you may not have a wife, but you'll have a daughter-in-law soon! This lady saved me, and I'm going to marry her!" the boy said. From then on, the father and son engaged in a fierce competition for the woman’s affection.

(Source: Webnovel)

Jane came to Hainan to relax after losing both her job and her boyfriend. She made the acquaintance of Tyler, a young CEO of an tech company and because she was embarrassed to say that she is unemployed, she told him that she is an employee of a real estate company without knowing the real owner was standing right next to her. But not only did he not expose her lie, but also told everyone that she was his assistant... In ten days in paradise, Jane made many wonderful experiences as an "assistant" and meanwhile, love has also quietly sprouted...

(Source: WebComics)

title.english: On the Tip of My Heart

description: That night, she was out there having fun, trying to erase the pain caused by her cheating boyfriend, but ended up having a one-night stand with a young successful CEO. “I’ll find you, damn girl, no matter what it takes!” But the boss wasn’t very happy about what she did the next morning. Five years later, she went home from abroad with her adorable twins. On her first day at work, she found the CEO kinda familiar… (Source: WebComics)

His father had suddenly disappeared, leaving the Ye family in ruins. His engagement got called off, leaving him humiliated, then enters a beautiful and arrogant daughter from a rich family, alongside a mysterious and beautiful assassin... Looks like there's a huge secret behind the seemingly ordinary high school that he attends, but what is it?

(Source: WebComics)

Ten years ago, Lin Su craftily orchestrated a scheme to bring about the downfall of the Huai Prince's household, and escaped to foreign lands to avoid retribution. By a twist of fate, the young man he met there turns out to be one of the victims of his elaborate revenge. Mu Yingfeng concealed his true identity to try to find out the truth behind the treasonous plot — but he never expected that the distinguished scholar he seduced would turn out to be the architect behind his father and brothers' deaths. Caught in a delicate dance of trial and manipulation, their lives and destinies become hopelessly intertwined.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Why is the college student having strange dreams all the time? Why are the people on the street ignoring the cries of a little girl? Is that mysterious Taoist priest for real, or a fraud? An accidental encounter, and a wild plant, will lead two people into danger… Ghost that can't be seen, a maze with no exit, a thousand-year old Taoist temple shrouded by supernatural incidents. Who is behind all of this? Who is the one whispering in your ear?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Se Xi Daxiaojie de Fei Zhai Yangcheng Jihua
title.native: 涩系大小姐的废宅养成计划

description:
What is the experience of a campus hottie chasing the campus geek? He Fengqi transformed from a dead fat geek into a handsome guy, but was rejected by the beauty! He accidentally discovered that the beauty likes the geek! How will the campus hottie chase her? Anxious and waiting for an answer! Why does the goddess have a unique taste? Is it human nature distorted or forced by life? Read to find out!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

[from Sherbet Lemon]
The story begins with a rich young lady named Mo Kai who is over the age of marrying but with with no proposed marriage. One day, she met a gentle scholar named Yi Nuo-Sheng and thought that she could woo him over without any troubles. But she later finds out that he already has someone in mind. All of the sudden comes a guy named Bei Tang-Yi who stops her plans. What will become of their story?

During the period when the Tang Dynasty was at its peak of success, imperial court general, Huangfu Duanhua, was whisked away into a series of bizarre and supernatural events after his friend accidentally stepped into a store owned by a Persian merchant. This then led to many incidents that were kept sealed by the empire for a thousand years…
Court disputes, strife in the royal family… As the wheels of the perilous history are set in motion, where will they lead? (Esthétique)

Ling Er's hand in marriage is the prize in the competition set up by her wealthy father, however, none of the men entered know her horrible secret. Our hero through a string of events, ends up falling out of the sky and miraculously beats out the competition in one swoop. Just when he thought everything was going to turn out great, he was stunned by the reality.

Love, trust and friendship are very important values but also very fragile. In the lives of Maggie, Annie, Edison and Nick they unknowingly become tools for pain. Denying love, creating lies and keeping secrets lead to unwanted results and to a battle between two girls that either may never win.
Cupid accidently hits himself with his own arrow and falls in love... But how can Cupid not know how to make her love him in return?

title.romaji: The History of the West Wing
title.english: The History of the West Wing

description:
Lavishly illustrated in full color and based on the classic Chinese play Xixiang Ji by Wang Shifu, The History of the West Wing tells of the illicit romance between the daughter of a Chinese government official and the roaming scholar who seeks to win her hand. But before he can turn his attentions to his ladylove, the young man must win the heart of her mother! When it seems even heroic deeds in the face of murderous bandits will not please the strict matriarch, the young man goes off to become a civil servant. Will he return in time to marry his true love?

(Source: Yen Press)

Bai Zhi-Wei is a girl born in a rich family. She was enjoying her life until one spring break, her father forced her to go study "Buddism" somewhere. When she refused this idea, she got “kidnapped” by her father’s man and was taken to a beautiful academy with only guys. Weirder still, why were all the guys wearing traditional clothes and who are the two guys that were fighting in the middle of the night? (Source: Sherbet Lemon)

title.romaji: Mo Zong Zhen De Bu Hao Hun

description:
Qin Yao, a disciple of the immortal sect, was seriously injured and fainted during a mission. When he woke up, he found that he was mistaken for a disciple of the demonic sect and was rescued. In order to survive, Qin Yao had to disguise himself as a demonic disciple and quietly seek a way to escape back to the immortal sect. However, it won't be that easy to blend in with the demonic sect!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The self-absorbed young nobleman Xi Menyun’s sister ran away from home. As a result, his mother arranged for him to take his sister’s place and marry Bei Tangxiao, her fiance. The foolish Xi Menyun decided to run away as well, but fate is a curious thing, as he ran straight into General Bei Tangxiao’s residence. When he fell into the water, the general reached out to save him, and they exchanged bodies!? This is how their wonderful fate unfolds...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

One day, a girl appeared out of nowhere claiming to be an exorcist and turning Liu Yanhui’s regular school life upside down. Ever since his troubles began to continuously plague him, his parents were critically injured by demons and even his childhood rival became an exorcist's target. Eventually, the city he has been living in is at risk due to his presence there… How will a young man with a demonic parasite growing in him survive this world?

The sorehead lady who lost her memory was sold to a rich merchant to become an ordinary rough servant girl. The handsome but sickly old master, the cheerful but careless young master and the piano player who is both enemy and friend with her... When she is entangled with them by fate, how will the story develop?

(Source: WebComics)

In the late years of the Western Zhou Dynasty, the fatuous ruler, King You of Zhou, is compelled by the seductive concubine Bao Si to set up a God Creation Tower that causes rampant acts of demons and a hellish time for the people. To end the tragic era, Han Ji is ordered by his master to eliminate demons and assist Zishang to defeat the King. However, they never expect that Bao Si is backed by the Immortal, Yuanming Holy Lord. The God Creation Tower is determined to be built. The world is once again in crisis... Cruel tyrants who fight in battles, powerful heroes across the nation, noble beauties that cannot be reached... Will they become the Gods they want to be?

title.romaji: You Liang Ge Baba Shi Zhong Shen Me Yang De Tiyan
title.native: 有两个爸爸是种什么样的体验

description:
The daily life of Duoduo and his two adopted dads.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

La forêt is an unpopular and poorly managed French restaurant which nobody cares about. Genius chefs plummeted overnight, and ace food critics suddenly disappeared one day. "We must always guard this important restaurant!" However, in La forêt, it seems that every cook has secrets and ghosts of different appearances suddenly appeared. Can we protect this beloved restaurant until the very end before it closes?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The story begins one night in H-county’s Dabazi Village, where a floating corpse was discovered. After the villagers reported it to the police, Old Zhong and Zhang Kai came out to handle the case. The corpse was handcuffed and brutally murdered. Nie Yun ordered Old Zhong and Zhang Kai to solve the case within seven days. However, during the process, two other policemen died on the job. And when the critical witness who linked everything together was finally found, he has already been dead for seven days.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The comic tells a series of strange and scary stories that Zhang Xiaonian and his classmates experience in high school. One night, Zhang Xiaonian suddenly met the revenge of the hanged ghost in the Internet cafe, and resolved the crisis by accident. Thus, Zhang Xiaonian's strange story wonderfully unfolded.

(Source: WebComics)

The work tells the story of the "Exorcist Iron Triangle" composed of Taoist heir Wang Xiaoer, policewoman Li Xue, and Red Fox from the fox demon clan, who solve various supernatural cases.

On a dark and windy night, horrific murders occurred one after another at the entrances of streets and alleys. The strange gnawed body parts and the female corpses that had been drained of their essence all showed people the cruelty of the criminals. After several investigations, the police officer Uncle Niu concluded that this series of cases was not caused by humans. However, when everyone was at a loss in the face of one unsolved case after another, a timid young man named Wang Xiaoer who came from the countryside to work in the city secretly assisted the police in solving various difficult cases. Unbeknownst to everyone, this ordinary boy hid the secret of the "Seven Killing Orders of Gods and Ghosts" by Yuan Tiangang, a Taoist genius from the Tang Dynasty ...

(Source: Baidu, translated)

It is said that when the lifespan of a human being come to its end, it is necessary to leave behind everything; family, friends, achievements, even love and meet black and white messengers who will lead them to the cycle of reincarnation. However, the infatuations and love in mind; engraved in the bone, how can it be so easy to give it up. When love has gone through the battle of time either it is it still flawless or the wreckage full of holes.

(Source: QQ, translated)

"The Tower" is a folk legend. It is said that those who find it can make a deal and gain entrance to the Tower. Xiang Yi, who has lost his memory, wakes up in the Tower and is greeted by a strange partner, Jiang Yuan. In this Tower game, a life-and-death team elimination match between "hostages" and "death row prisoners" is staged.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A classical favorite manga based on the book by Jin Yong. The story about Wai Siu Bo the boy who was brought up in the red light district and became the best friend of the emperor through lots of luck and a smart mouth.

(Source: Mangatraders)

One boy is worried about his cute and girlish appearance, and his masochistic friend loves to provoke him by constantly teasing him about his looks. What will happen between them?"

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Meng Shou Xia: Ji Jia Ji Yuan

description:
The story takes place on Earth nearly a thousand years in the future. Following a great war between artificial intelligence and humanity, monsters known as "Tai Sui" roam the land, drastically altering the natural environment and societal structures. Humans invented a series of new technologies related to "BOX"—boxes—and, using these boxes as partners, fiercely resisted their enemies. The elite individuals capable of "resonating" with their box partners are called Box Masters. Rokuma, a previously overlooked and unremarkable Box Master, is chosen by the little dinosaur box "Theo" to begin a mission to protect the city-state...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The young man may seem like a weak cornered rabbit, but he's actually hunting for tigers by pretending to be prey. As the fates would have it, that haughty girl is tougher than she looks! The dour and cynical boy wanders the world alone, his background full of mystery. As he gains new companions, will they break free from the bonds of fate?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

An intelligent and domineering woman encounters a carefree, flamboyant prince at a brothel. Initially, she thinks of it as nothing more than a chance meeting, but little did she know their fates would end up being so deeply intertwined...

"If you hold no love for me, then I will give up my love for you as well."

A romance story about love and loss set in ancient times.

3,000 years ago, the Emperor of Shang was a despot who caused great suffering for his people. The duke of the west Ji Chang's second son Ji Fa was born after a three-year pregnancy with portents of greatness. The emperor attempted to kill Ji Fa, forcing him to flee. Along the way, he cultivated powerful techniques and met powerful wuxia friends. After the death of his father and older brother, Ji Fa became the duke, and he raised the banner of revolution against the Emperor.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

Tae-Hyeok, the perfect, top-of-the-class senior who’s kind and friendly to everyone. But is there a crazy, unpredictable jerk hiding beneath that perfect facade? The only girl among his classmates who knows his secret. And the crazy, unpredictable jerk who’s becoming increasingly obsessed with her.

The slightly complicated college life of these two attractive students begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I'm pregnant."
"Jeong-Won, I'm an omega…?"

Ye Jeong-Won, who has been like a real sibling to Lee Gyeon-Woo since they were young, appears in front of Lee Gyeon-Woo. The two have a one-night stand at a freshman welcome party while drunk, and Jeong-Won reveals that he is pregnant. Gyeon-Woo, an omega, is flustered because he has no memory of that night, but soon comes to his senses and says that he will take responsibility for Jeong-Won and the child. However, Jeong-Won smiles meaningfully when Gyeon-Woo tells him to come into his house.

'But hyung, I wish we could be together even if we don't have a child. Because the pregnancy story is a lie.'

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

When hardworking student Wan ends up covering his father’s job at a wealthy estate, a run-in with the sprinklers leaves him soaked — and catches the eye of Jung-Hoo, the ruthless heir who’s never been denied anything. One look, and Wan’s fate veers off course.

(Source: Manta)
The world is dominated by bugs, the Dog Man at the beginning and end.

“Psyche,” the most beautiful woman in the world. When the praise heaped upon her began to threaten the gods' authority, Aphrodite ordered her son, Eros, to curse Psyche. Just as the god's arrow was about to strike her, Eros discovered Psyche's “secret.” Enchanted by her beauty, he made the mistake of letting the arrow pierce him. Eros becomes curious as to whether the power of the golden arrow would affect him as well. “Is this love I have bestowed upon her a lie, or the truth?” He tries to approach Psyche every night, but a man who lingers around her even during the day appears...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: How to Reject the Perfect Marriage

description:
Evangeline O’Hara has it all—wealth, privilege, and the most coveted engagement in the empire. But when tragedy strikes her family, the future duchess can no longer ignore certain truths. She is alone now, and this marriage won’t change that for the better. Duke Decarno von These has no doubts, as no other woman could be more perfect for the role. Things may be complicated now, but the conclusion is inevitable. Once they wed, the rest of these problems will vanish. Why should he think otherwise?

(Source: Tapas)

In her younger days, Lee Hui-Jung was a well-known star actress. However, her life took a dramatic turn when her affair with 'Yeon Seon-Gu,' a popular film director and the husband of her close friend 'Kim Myeong-Hui,' was exposed. Subsequently, she faced a series of scandals following her friend's suicide and a traffic accident involving Yeon Seon-Gu.
As a result, Lee Hui-Jung left the entertainment industry, and 12 years passed. She received a tempting casting offer for a new film and, after much contemplation, decided to make her comeback in the film industry. But what she didn't expect was that the lead actress in the film would turn out to be 'Yeon Ji-Na,' the daughter of Kim Myeong-Hui and Yeon Seon-Gu...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"How nice it would be if I could just sleep soundly for one day without thinking about anything."

Kim Ga-Hee, a nurse who is exhausted from her current life due to excessive work stress and who spends her days listless without a single person close to her, lost her memories of nearly five years due to a sudden accident. The problem is that she seems to have had a boyfriend.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The legendary hero who, as the chosen champion of the goddess, defeated the evil dragon and saved the Sanhosu Kingdom. However, what remained for her was neither honor nor wealth, but only dire poverty. In her attempt to earn money to rebuild her ruined village, she falls for the trickery of the disguised Demon Lord and ends up bound by magic handcuffs that seal away her powers…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

“I shouldn’t have confessed.”

Eun-Ju, an ordinary office worker, is caught by her new subordinate, Lee-Jun, trying to confess to her long-time crush on the team leader. Eun-Ju, who wants to clear up the misunderstanding, also reveals that she can’t confess…!

“Manager, can I tell you a secret of mine to be fair?”

The story of us who fail to confess.

(Source: Naver, translated)

“You kicked out my partner? Are you going to take my place?”

The long-standing unwritten rule of the Korean University Bb# band is not to accept members with alpha or omega traits. However, Ji-Hyeok, the band leader, is immediately attracted to the vocalist Myo-Jin and scouts him even though he is an alpha. Myo-Jin acts arrogantly, even dragging his omega partner into the band, but Ji-Hyeok kicks out his omega and offers to be his rut ​​partner…

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type Fall Anthology ([BL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 가을).

Remember when high school drama felt way more serious than it really was? Well, in Taeyang City, there’s a little more on the line than gossip and hurt feelings. It’s more about loose teeth and broken jaws! With every high school in town ruled by a gang of hard-knock delinquents, the top dogs fight for dominance and the elusive title of “Myeongwang,” the greatest high school fighter of them all. At first, transfer student Ujae wants nothing to do with this, but he is soon dragged back into gang life to settle a score with the notorious Sunrise gang…

(Source: WEBTOON)

“Because we’re family now.”

Junsu used an app to find sex partners in order to lose his virginity. Each sweet night ended as a one‑night stand… until those very partners appeared before him as members of his own family.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.english: My First XXX: My Friend Turned into a Succubus!

description:
Becoming an adult brings many new experiences, but having his first wet dream was not on Joo Seong-Min’s bucket list. What’s worse is that he dreams of getting down and dirty with a devilish version of his best friend, Seo Gyu-Ri. He could just brush it off as a random wild fantasy, but why does this dream feel a bit too close to reality...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
Someone who's gained a chance after losing his way, but the karma of his past won't let him go.

A boy reborn as Nox, an omega noble, finds himself surrounded by men bound to him through blood, duty, and pheromones. With a hateful half-brother, a duke’s son drawn to his scent, and a loyal servant who watches him too closely, every relationship is charged with tension. When his uncontrollable heat awakens, desire and power collide, pulling them all into a dangerous, irresistible web.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He finds a risqué video on a hard drive he thinks is his. She takes the blame to protect her friend—and pretends to be into it. But as they keep up the act, neither of them is prepared for how real it starts to feel.

(Source: Toomics)

Hee-Jin and Seung-Jo were inseparable best friends for fourteen years, but one night was all it took to end their friendship. A year later, they are strangers again, separated by unspoken love and unresolved misunderstandings. When their paths cross once more, will they be able to bridge the space between them?

(Source: Manta)

“I want a wife as gentle as a rabbit and a daughter as cute as a mongoose.”

On Christmas Eve, on my way home after making a wish to the mysterious Santa. But when I opened my eyes, I found myself in another world...?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ordinary married woman by day, magical girl by night? Taegon is indifferent to his perfect wife, ‘Sora’. Anyone would see her as an ideal woman, but because he loves the magical girl ‘Pink Lumina’, he neglects her. However, one day, he discovers Lumina’s true identity...

“My wife… is a magical girl?!”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

When a man who looks straight out of a fantasy novel stumbles into her home, chef Yujeong sends him packing—but not before feeding him. After all, he was hungry, and a chef should never ignore a guy in need of grub. But the man comes back day after day, with one request for Yujeong: “Help me save my world!” Fateful words that send this humble chef on an adventure for the ages!

(Source: Tapas)

Despite his musical success, Do-Geon finds himself moving into a shabby attic room. As he heads to the bathroom to try to shake off his gloom, what does he find on the toilet seat? A goldfish?! His cohabitation with the “Oranda” goldfish seemed to be going smoothly, but one night, Do-Geon woke up to find his back damp and a person flapping their legs right in front of him.

“Human, I feel weird.”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Sa Hyun-Woo is an employee at the “Healing Agency,” where he exorcises possessed individuals by fighting evil spirits with his bare hands in exchange for payment. While carrying out a job, he discovers a group of villains who are deliberately implanting evil spirits to plunge the world into chaos. Enraged by their tyranny, which destroys precious relationships, Sa Hyun-Woo embarks on a life-or-death struggle to uproot the source of this evil.

(Source: Naver, translated)

U-Jin’s first love is dead. Not that he’d be particularly overjoyed to reunite with the intense guy who stole his heart in highschool under more normal circumstances, mind you, but having to attend his funeral feels like a slap in the face to his already unresolved feelings. So, when he starts dreaming about the late Jae-Ha, U-Jin chalks it up to nothing more than his tumultuous emotions. Except, the dreams start taking a…sensual turn. So, when a mysterious man shows up to warn U-Jin of the dangers of getting involved with ghosts, U-Jin is left with a decision to make: just how much pleasure is worth the dangers of this spectrophilia…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Includes ten extras.

title.english: If You Can't Kill Me, Love Me

description:
In a kingdom scarred by a historical rebellion, Penny, an assassin masquerading as a servant, aims to break free from Queen Nyla's grasp by executing a perilous mission: the theft of the king's ring from Princess Cher, known as the wicked Princess of Death. Yet her intentions take a turn as she slowly becomes captivated by the princess. As their destinies become entwined, Penny grapples with a dilemma, torn between her pursuit of freedom and the unexpected connections she forges with Cher.

(Source: Tapas)

Princess Eunmyeong meets the scholar Seoyul, to whom she falls in love and gives herself to without any hesitation. So in order to get his attention, she went to Boryeong to see him on the pretext of taking blood. For some reason, Seoyul only pushes her away and she gets frustrated with him. But she didn't give up and expressed her feelings towards him.

"When no one believed in me, you were the only one who stood up for me."
"Become my benefactor."
"I will guarantee you wealth and glory."

Princess Eunmyeong, the most beautiful girl in Joseon. Will she be able to win the heart of the most intelligent man in Joseon?

Life with her handsome, caring boyfriend feels less perfect as every night becomes the same. Craving change, Mi-Ji follows a strange message on her TV. But what she gets isn’t just different—it’s him. Hyeon-U Lee. Only not quite the one she knows.

(Source: Manta)

A story of a lonely werewolf seeking love in a world full of lies.

(Source: Toomics)

Ever since she was a child, Winsty has hidden the fact that she’s a wizard. Her parents warned her to wait to use her abilities because her power was too much, and when a tragedy resulted in her parents’ deaths, Winsty was convinced her use of magic was the reason. Vulnerable and weak, her cousin Adelina supports her throughout her life, often “exerting” herself as the “head” of the family in Winsty’s stead. So, when Winsty is poisoned on her wedding day by her cousin, the shock is enormous. But something brings Winsty back to the moment just before the wedding. To enact her revenge and take back what is hers, she will enter into a contractual relationship with a duke from a rival family. Her journey to take down Adelina and bring honor back to her family also reveals a conspiracy that goes all the way to the emperor.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Baek-Dan, drowning in debt and running a tiny udon shop in the red-light district, meets Moo-Shin—a wealthy yet dangerous man who shatters her bleak routine. He might be her salvation… or her downfall.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters

It is the first freshman club retreat—the kind of night meant for excitement and budding romance. However, Kim Seon-Wu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he’s been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-Yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seon-Wu and Sang-Yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness.

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seon-Wu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-Yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seon-Wu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Bong-Seok isn’t exactly a “down-to-earth” guy. Born with a condition that causes him to float uncontrollably, Bong-Seok is forced to hide his power from his peers. But when classmate Jang Hee-Soo, who is hiding a violent past at her previous school, sees Bong-Seok floating one day, she promises to keep his secret if he keeps hers. As the two grow closer, Bong-Seok realizes he has more control over his power than he knew, and that those around him might have some supernatural secrets of their own…

(Source: Tapas)

In his school days, Baek Kiho was an easy target, overweight, quiet, and even cursed with a name that classmates mocked as “Piggy Ho.” Years of relentless bullying drove him to drop out, leaving only scars and shame behind. But time changes everything. Kiho shed the weight, changed his name to Heeseong, and built a new life where no one could recognize the boy he once was. Then fate delivers an unexpected blow: his first love, Cheon Bokyeong, reappears. The very same Bokyeong who once despised him now approaches warmly, unable to connect Heeseong with the outcast she knew in the past. Torn between the longing he still feels and the terror of exposing his past, Heeseong hides the truth and lets their fragile relationship grow. But secrets have a way of surfacing and for Heeseong, the fear of losing both love and dignity weighs heavier than ever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ji-in Yang is just an average otaku until a boy who looks exactly like her favorite anime character transfers to her class. Mireu Shin is overly friendly from the start, and she eats up the attention, much to the dismay of her longtime friend, Bongjun Choi, who begins expressing his feelings more openly. Even Dongsu Mun, her quiet academy comrade, wants to spend more time with her. To complicate things further, swimming sensation Hyeonu Gwon appears, acting like they’ve known each other for years. Suddenly, it feels like every guy in Ji-in’s life wants to keep her all to himself!

(Source: WEBTOON)

So-Hwa is a red fox with white hair, separated from her family and living alone in the mountains. One day, she comes across Do-Hwi, an injured and abandoned wild cat, and decides to take care of him. But little does she know that Do-Hwi is actually a fearsome tiger, reborn after a thousand years of life. Do-Hwi conceals his identity well, but as the years go by, he matures into quite the hunk and grows more and more attached to the beautiful fox. So-Hwa grows suspicious amidst frightening dreams of being chased by a tiger, not to mention making steamy hot love with him, and their relationship is about to take a drastic turn... for better or worse.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

After falling in love with his ex-professor living next door, Eun-Seong can no longer be satisfied with ordinary women. He knows it is wrong to do it with a married woman, but one thing leads to another...

"Do you... see me as a woman?"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

When the timid Winter accidentally sends Joo-Han a nude meant for her boyfriend, an unexpected connection is formed between them, eventually culminating in them living together.

Will this unlikely pair be able to live together in peace—and perhaps even love?

(Source: Manta)

After 13 years of friendship, things take a turn when Tae-Won's pants get pulled down in front of Jae-Kyung. She thought she knew him better than anyone until she saw his wild, dirty side. Now that they've crossed the line, what awaits them?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes four side story chapters.

In 1940, during a time of chaos, a man built a beautiful mansion on a remote island, Yeongchunhwa, solely for the sake of his wife whom he loved deeply. After a long time, the story of the couple involved in the mansion was forgotten, but one day, a mysterious 'manager' appeared and operated it as a lodging facility. He began inviting people who must love to the mansion, following the couple's souls...!

"Welcome to Yeongchunhwa, a secret mansion that will bring you endless imagination. Any form of love is possible here. Love and indulge to your heart's content. As long as the mansion allows."

A luxurious mansion and people who visit it for various reasons. Erotic stories for women drawn by various writers are unfolding now.

Third Short Story I've Loved You All Along: Do Han-Gyeol and Lee Sa-Rang win a free stay at the Yeongchunhwa Mansion through a university festival event. Though strangers, Sa-Rang's proactive attitude towards love soon leads them to the mansion.

“I like you... I've liked you since the moment we met...!”
