There, Han-Gyeol receives Sa-Rang's passionate confession. In truth, Han-Gyeol possesses the ability to hear the lies of anyone he touches. But strangely, Sa-Rang's lies remain inaudible. Every whisper of confession from her mouth holds not a shred of falsehood.

‘This can't be... What is this woman's true intention...?’

A woman pouring out her love and a man afraid to begin it. Where will this relationship lead?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

In a world where sex rules everything, 69 University is the best sex college in the country. Students here will become the leading talents of the country’s sex industry. Hidden behind the prestigious title, 69 University’s dirty side is a promiscuous campus life where the moaning never stops. …Will I be able to graduate safely?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

As the second daughter of the affluent Daeju Group family, Yoon Seung-ah should have a perfect life of luxury. However, the dismal truth is that she has experienced nothing but contempt and restriction simply for being an illegitimate child. Then, one day, in a strange twist of events, Seung-ah meets Ki Taejun from the KCT Group, who wants to strike up a deal in exchange for helping her regain her freedom and sense of self. And for the first time, she decides to give in to her impulses which sets in motion an array of complications and desires…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Not long after the vicious dragons hid their presence on the continent, Knight Commander Alexander is dispatched to investigate the sharp fall in tax revenue. Alexander gets lost in unfamiliar lands and runs into a man named Kline. But this man, as soon as he meets Alexander, starts calling out by his nickname and gets closer by acting friendly, saying that he has waited a long time. And under his half-worn cloak, Alex sees a dragon's horn?!

Kline knows how to use magic and Alexander becomes interested in recruiting him as a knight...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: Includes two side story chapters.

There is a barcode that tells information about a person?! If this is true, wouldn't it be possible to have all the women and riches in the world?!

(Source: DAYcomics)

A stowaway named Lee Sesang wakes up in the middle of the ocean, aboard a cargo ship. It has already been a month since he started living there, treated like a nuisance by the crew. Branded as an unwanted intruder, he barely speaks to anyone, except for Aeri, the ship’s cook. Aeri is the only one who doesn’t outright shun him, and so, Sesang begins helping out in the kitchen, trying to pull his weight. One day, as they find themselves alone in the kitchen, Aeri suddenly smirks and says:

"Do you even know how heavy they are? Wanna try lifting it?"

Soft and squishy. A naughty little prank begins in the quiet kitchen..

"Sesang, are you… really gonna touch them?”

(Source: Lezhin US)

Can spying on women’s naked bodies while bathing really be considered training…? Chwihwa Point, an acupuncture pressure point that ignites a woman’s lust. Even a mere slave can have any woman of the 8 provinces of Joseon, if they learn this technique!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

A young man finds himself consumed by an irresistible attraction—to his best friend's mother. With a face that defies age, a body sculpted to perfection, and a dangerously seductive aura, she stirs desires he can no longer ignore. From glimpses of lace peeking through to the teasing sway of her hips, every encounter fuels his fantasies. But when he asks her for private yoga lessons, will he be able to keep his composure… or will temptation push them both past the point of no return?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: Hungry Widow

description:
Cheong-Hwa is married off to a wealthy old man who starves her to "keep her figure trim." Once he dies, she's finally free to satisfy her raging hunger and eat to her heart's content. And now that she's been left alone with her pretty servant, Oh-Weol, food isn't the only thing Cheong-Hwa has a ravenous appetite for...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

Wi-Jeong left his hometown in agony after falling in love with his older brother’s fiancée, a secret he could never confess. Seven years later, he returns to Seorabeol and unexpectedly reunites with Jin-Hui, a boy he once knew but had long forgotten. As memories resurface, so does a promise from the past that Jin-Hui has never let go of.

"You said you would reward me if I waited patiently."

"Wi-Jeong, now...let’s become a real couple."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ambitious and exceptionally skilled, Gi Se-Na, the divorce specialist who became every rookie lawyer's role model! She endured hardships to proudly inherit her father's law firm, finally securing a partner position... Only to have some tiger-like bastard snatch it away. But that tiger-faced bastard is Ryu Kang-Hyeon, the senior who witnessed Se-Na's embarrassing past in her twenties? She has to successfully marry such a person to inherit the firm?

I have plenty of divorce experience, but I know nothing about romance!

The romance between the unpredictable, ambitious Se-Na and the inscrutable senior Kang-Hyeon begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Se-Jong, a middle school Korean language teacher, finds himself facing his former students, who are now parents. Back in their school days, these students liked Se-Jong, but even now as adults, they’re trying to win over their former teacher. Can Se-Jong resist the charms and advances of his past students?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Do-Yeon and Eun-Ha, who became a family due to their parents' remarriage, become strangers again due to their parents' divorce. When the two meet again after many years. Eun-Ha is obsessed with Do-Yeon, and Do-Yeon is burdened by his younger brother... What's even worse is that his feelings for Eun-Ha are not 'brotherly love'.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The world's best poker players are called 'sharks', and the most ruthless among them is known simply as Czar. Kim Yoon and a gang of thugs roam from house to house, seeking this legendary figure - despite rumors that no one ever returns from his domain. One day, a man in a red hoodie warns Yoon, "Sir, you'll die if you keep this up.” Ignoring the warning, Yoon leaves to gather money for a new game. Suddenly, he hears the chilling sound of bones smashing and bodies crushing. As the noise fades, Yoon finally comes face to face with Czar…but when he offers Yoon a chance to play, Yoon sees it as a golden opportunity and believes his life is about to change. "I'll try it."

(Source: Lezhin US)

Friday, humanity's only superhero with overwhelming power, has appeared! Earth faces a crisis of apocalypse due to a single hero. Is it Friday who will destroy humanity, or is it their own evil nature?

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I pray every day that this love dies, that I may love you only until today, and that tomorrow this love will be dead."

Thalia Roem Gürta, the ill-fated princess born of an affair. She grows up distorted amidst indifferent parents, hostile half-siblings, and servants who despise her. Thalia has protected herself by raising her thorns against everyone who approaches. Yet, even she becomes defenseless in the presence of one person. He is none other than the Prince of the East, Varkas Raedgo Sheerkan. Forced to be perfect as a retainer of the imperial court and the heir to the Grand Duke, he grew up with most of his emotions numb under discipline bordering on abuse. A man who exists solely for the honor and duty of his family. To keep a promise made to the late Empress, he enters into a marriage with Thalia's half-sister, Ayla, and Thalia, engulfed in despair, slowly falls apart. However, her love, destined for death, faces an unexpected turning point....

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

He is a dark beast worthy of his name who’ll do anything for money. This is what Isabella Barret is told about Lion Black, the man she must marry while in disguise as his actual fiancée, Violet Lancaster. As dangerous as this gamble is, if Isabella manages to fool Lion until their one-year marriage contract is over, she’ll be freed of yet another contract that has kept her shackled for the past five years. But to Isabella’s surprise, she isn’t the only one putting up a fake act in the relationship, as Lion’s heart might not be as cruel as his reputation suggests. And what’s more, the longer Isabella looks at him, the more she begins to see in him a precious old friend who presumably died years ago…

(Source: TappyToon)

On the day he turned twenty, Patrick received word that he was to return as the family's official heir. He returned to the mansion with a fluttering heart, but the house was eerily quiet. One night, exhausted and asleep, Patrick was awakened by someone's kiss... Before his eyes stood Ebel Moltun, the picture of a perfect gentleman.

“Patrick, have you been well?”

Despite the affectionate tone, Patrick soon finds himself imprisoned by this unknown man...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

“Let the monster devour you.”

At the shaman’s shrine he visited to lift a mysterious curse, Hae-Gang meets Yeon-Ho, a fox spirit who will devour the monster dwelling within him. Yeon-Ho, who needs spiritual energy to become a gumiho, agrees to take Hae-Gang’s vital energy in exchange for protecting him from the serpent’s curse…

“Now, it’s time to eat.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Orphaned at a young age, Yu Yoohui has always had the worst luck, even dying at a young age from a rare disease. But then, she awakens in the Joseon dynasty during the cruel reign of Lee Yoon, the most ruthless king in history. Now trapped in the body of a lowly servant, Yoohui is forced to serve the infamous tyrant, but nothing is as it seems within the palace, with secrets, lies, and dangerous desires running rampant. Can Yoohui survive the king's wrath and change the course of history, or will the bloody past consume her?

(Source: Lezhin US)

"A romantic campus love story about a gay soccer star and his regained first love!"

The campus soccer star Hyunho runs into his first love Gyul at the university. Back then in middle school, Gyul saw Hyunho as a friend and never learned about his feelings. Hyunho, still in love with the withdrawn Gyul, lends him a helping hand. Because Gyul's aunt is taking advantage of him, Gyul has to support his younger brother. To thank Hyunho, Gyul helps him navigate university assignments. What starts out as a caring friendship, soon flourishes into a romantic relationship. But then, Hyunho receives an offer to play abroad in the major league. Will Hyunho and Gyul be able to overcome this hardship, too?

(Source: Netcomics)

What if your soul could leave your body and possess people -- or even animals? Thanks to an incident in the past, that’s what happens to Marshall Lidiance every time she passes out or falls asleep. No one knows her little secret, but things become problematic for Marshall when she gets absorbed into a teddy bear owned by the icy-cold Duke Ludvillian! Will Marshall be able to figure out what caused the soul absorption while still keeping it a secret from everyone?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Han Tae-Yang was out on a rare vacation, enjoying a drink, when he received a message from his junior colleague, who was also on leave. He’d been dumped by his girlfriend. At those words, Han Tae-Yang rushed over to where his junior, Cha U-Jin, was without a moment’s hesitation. He didn’t know it then. He had no idea that this junior would be the first to take advantage of him.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: The Guardian Dragon and the Fake Princess

description:
Seria was born as an ordinary serf, but her extraordinary beauty makes her an outcast in her village. Growing up without any friends, she meets a young guardian dragon, names him Sizrelia, and forms a deep bond with him. But because guardian dragons are symbols of the imperial family's legitimacy, the emperor must hide the fact that a mere serf can form a pact with a guardian dragon by making Seria an imperial princess! But even with Siz by her side, can she handle life as a fake princess?

(Source: Tapas)

Cho Yeon, a shaman-in-training, climbs a haunted mountain where seven women have gone up and been returned with no memory. She meets a mischievous, hopelessly horny ghost who’s more interested in romance than haunting. Unable to seal him, they strike a deal: he helps her gather spiritual energy, and she’ll help him avoid becoming a vengeful spirit. But every time he aids her, they must get intimate. When a mysterious man appears knowing her past, Yeon’s journey becomes even more complicated.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The protagonist, Na Seon-Uk, was born with the heart of a tiger. He was a troublemaker, but at the request of his parents, he hid his strength and transferred to Gukyang High School, located in a remote area that he thought would be quiet. However, it was a place where various old-fashioned cultures and dangerous people gathered. Seon-Uk, who wanted to graduate quietly, couldn’t help but feel his hot blood and began educating people!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Once a cancer patient, Inhan Kang starts a new life as the great warrior Karma after falling through a mana hole.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: The Handsome Male Lead Won't Let Me Log Out

description:
The development of "Marigold in a Box", a virtual reality game, is stopped after an unfortunate accident. Sun-ah can't help but be sad and disappointed as the manager of the development team. She decides to log on to the game as a farewell... But she can't customize her character? She can't even log out?! She is forced into becoming the protagonist of the game, Cloe Marigold. What choice does she have? She just has to kill herself and reach the 'dead ending' in the game. Then, she'll be free! However, due to interfering NPC characters, she always fails. She almost makes it out once... but she doesn't. Now, there's only one way to get out. She must beat the game.

(Source: PocketComics)

Determined to escape her fate in the novel of being sold off to a loathsome man by her father, Beatrice Arosha runs off to the second male lead, Duke Ruslan Etenas, and proposes a contract marriage. After he immediately agrees, Beatrice moves into Etenas Castle, built on a sealed spirit gate and staffed by ghosts! But as she grows closer to the duke and experiences visions of the original Beatrice, she begins to realize the haunted castle may not be the strangest thing about her marriage…

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: What Happens if a Driver Is Unmarried

description:
Hardy works as a proxy driver of magic carriages until a shady request sends him to the wedding of Hysterion's infamous young heir. Forced to crash the ceremony, Hardy is stunned when Abel Hysterion, the center of every scandal, points straight at him and declares, "Here comes my bride."

(Source: Manta)

Jin-Hyuk, blessed with the ability to sense non-human beings thanks to his shaman father, is astonished when Doey, a playful and curious fairy, falls in love with him and begins to visit his dreams. What starts as innocent and harmless fun quickly evolves into intimate encounters, blurring the boundaries between dreams and reality. As their bond deepens, Jin-Hyuk's initial uncertainty turns into an insatiable longing for Doey's enchanting presence. Together, they embark on a whimsical romantic journey, navigating the complexities of love in a dreamscape as fresh as milk and as sweet as cream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kang Su-Ji, the righteous crusader famed in high school for her intolerance of injustice. After marrying and returning to her hometown, she encounters Baek Hui-Do, her senior from her school days, as her neighbor. Yet for some reason, he displays blatant hostility toward her...

A precarious reunion romance between a woman who cannot tolerate injustice and a man who cannot tolerate her.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Choi Woo-Ju, who has been imagining his first love for a long time because he couldn't forget it, suddenly sees his first love, Yu Hye-Sung, in front of him after 8 years. Hye-Sung expresses his interest in Woo-Ju's being a band member, and this gives Woo-Ju a chance to realize his imagination that he has always had...

The moment the stage lights turn on, all the truth is revealed?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Su-Yeong, a man who lost his dreams in an unexpected accident, embarks on a cruise with his younger sister, Hui-Su. However, a mysterious virus spreads throughout the island, and monsters that take human heads attack. The protagonist is separated from his sister, and the only escape is the vast ocean. Will Su-Yeong be able to find his sister and safely escape the cruise?

(Source: Naver, translated)

What’s a little fondling between best friends? After accidentally grasping Baek-Gyung’s silky smooth sack, Jeong-Min can’t get the sensation out of his head. To him, the obvious solution is to create increasingly absurd situations where his hands might get to hold his friend’s luscious goods. Meanwhile, Baek-Gyung is enjoying Jeong-Min’s attention in a way he can’t quite pin down, but he’s sure there’s a legitimate, wholesome reason their relationship is suddenly so...intimate.

(Source: Tapas)

Hui-Woon has what he thinks is an innocent little obsession, following (some would call it stalking) his fellow classmate Seo Kang-Woo around. Pure curiosity is all it is. Plus, Kang-Woo is super popular and good-looking and this is just for fun. But when things don’t go according to plan and Hui-Woon gets caught red-handed, his life is about to change forever…

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

“A deaf athlete competing in the general division?”

Nam Geon, who quit taekwondo due to bullying by his senior, and Kang Ito, a prodigious athlete who cannot hear. Can these two scarred boys make it back to the top?

(Source: Naver, translated)

A cram school dormitory in the height of summer. Before Gwang-Tae, who has turned his back on the world and is just getting by, appears Bo-Ae, a girl who longs to exist in this world. Amid the stifling heat in a corner of the dormitory, Gwang-Tae’s stagnant life begins to stir with the arrival of Bo-Ae.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Bill Bark, the blacksmith who forged the Hero’s Sword, is content with his ordinary daily life. However, as unrest begins to rise throughout the kingdom, it starts to shake even his life, and as the situation worsens, he is drawn deep into a series of uncontrollable events.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ten years into his career. Eui-Hyeon is an unknown actor who takes on any role given to him without complaint. One cold autumn night, after enduring another grueling shoot without a single word of complaint as usual, Eui-Hyeon happens to meet the world-famous star Cha Il-Ju.

“That's right. You're Eui-Hyeon, aren't you?”

Top star Cha Il-Ju, an issue-maker since his debut, felt like someone from another world to Eui-Hyeon, even though they were both actors. It was clearly meant to be just a fleeting encounter...

“If you're free, wanna grab a drink?”
“I don't waste effort on people I'm not interested in either.”

Cha Il-Ju's unhesitating approach gradually begins to shift Eui-Hyeon's world. A precious person who comes to him first, without needing any special effort. A benefactor who recognized his unwavering passion and relentless effort, even after years of obscurity.

“It'll be fine. I promise I won't get greedy.”

But the feelings that had begun to stir were steadily changing, contrary to Eui-Hyeon's resolve.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

When Kim Tae-Wun sneaks onto a film set to find his twin sister - an avid fan and fansite master of idol-turned-actor Lee Hae-Seo - he ends up running right into the star himself. The problem? Hae-Seo just happens to be in the middle of an uncontrollable rut cycle. In a whirlwind of chaos, Tae-Woon helps him through it, only to bolt like Cinderella at midnight. Now, with no idea who his mysterious savior was, Hae-Seo takes to social media to track him down… and Tae-Wun’s quiet life is about to get very, very noisy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: The Demon Princess's First Love

description:
As a child, Lulu the demon princess yearns for the love described in novels from the human world, but is scorned by the heartless demons around her. So she searches for love in the human world and meets Ha-Yeon, a cheerful girl who offers to draw her. Lulu instantly falls for Ha-Yeon’s supportive nature and artistic passion, which prompts her to seek her out again as an adult ten years later. Although Ha-Yeon is now a disillusioned ex-artist who barely remembers Lulu, the demon princess is determined to make her first love come true, no matter what!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.
Note: Includes four extra chapters.

Everything Jae-Chan did was driven by his selfish one-sided obsession over his partner esper, Woo-Jin. It's only in his dying moments after a dangerous mission that he regrets getting in the way of Woo-Jin's happiness. So when he's sent six years into the past by an unexpected supernatural event, Jae-Chan decides to use his knowledge of the future and his guide powers to help Woo-Jin from behind the scenes. But the more Jae-Chan tries to distance himself from Woo-Jin, the less the esper will leave him alone! Can Jae-Chan truly give up on Woo-Jin and succeed at his selfless mission?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Back in high school, there was always a peculiar and subtle tension between Yoo-Sung and Gun-Ha. After losing contact with Gun-Ha, Yoo-Sung moved on, becoming an actor and trying to put the past behind him. However, when a stalker begins threatening Yoo-Sung, his agency brings in Gun-Ha as his personal bodyguard to protect their star. Now, Yoo-Sung is forced to confront Gun-Ha, along with the lingering past and unresolved emotions that still hang between them...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The Tyrant of the Apocalypse Returns

description:
As Hellgates open across the globe, humanity falls, bringing with it the death of Goong Nam’s family. On the edge of a cliff, he loses hold of his beloved daughter’s hand as she falls straight into the jaws of a fiend. He wishes to reach out one more time with his shattered arm and grab her hand. He wishes to turn back time. These wishes can be granted, but for a price: completing a legendary quest by offering the heads of 666,666 high-ranking demons. Thus begins Goong’s unrelenting, blood-soaked battle, filled with chaos and an unyielding love for his family.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

This exciting story involves the landing of a nuclear missile, code named “Nuclear Warhead,” in the North. Nuclear Warhead’s’ 69th mission is to subjugate a wealthy South Korean family’s daughter! However, due to an accident during his mission, he unexpectedly loses his memory.

“How do I use this enormous weapon to win over the hearts of South Korean women? What was it again?”

He finds himself wondering now. Will he be able to finish his mission successfully?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Eunho, the strongest in the yokai realm!
He gained the chance to become a human being after losing the woman he loved and killing countless yokai.
After passing the gate of reincarnation by accumulating merit for a thousand years to abandon his immortal body…

He became a human being, held a sword, and learned martial arts for the first time.
But this is very… easy?

(Source: Kakao Entertainment Corp., translated)

Thirteen. Thirteen weeks, and it would all be over… Lee Seo-dan is on the verge of resignation. Having reported his seniors at Raewon for internal corruption, he has been ostracized by all those around him. With no one to turn to, Seo-dan figures it would just be better to leave altogether - until he is presented with an opportunity for redemption. Han Juwon has been called many things by those around him: “Workaholic.” “Tyrant.” “Demon.” All titles earned for his reputation as one of Raewon’s toughest, yes, but also as the best in the business. So when the desperate Seo-dan turns to Juwon for a chance at salvation, the latter is initially hesitant. Yet he senses something in Seo-dan that could be of use…something manageable, malleable, and most importantly - manipulable. With a single utterance, Juwon is about to change Seo-dan’s life forever: “If you’re truly desperate, prove it.”

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Nae Choeaeneun Agyeogyeongae: Another Revolution Story

description:
A woman is reincarnated as the main character Rae Taylor in her favorite otome game Revolution. Given all the princes to romance, Rae's true favorite isn't any of them, but rather… the villainous lady Claire François! Leaving behind her cold and lonely past life, she will become the heroine of Revolution and adore Claire François to her heart's content! Will Rae be able to befriend and save Claire, using all of her wits and game knowledge of Revolution?

“No matter what happens, I will protect Lady Claire!”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ha-Ru has a secret. She has the ability to go back to a fixed point in time every time she gets married. One moment, Ha-Ru is standing at the altar. But suddenly, she’s back on the subway on her way to work. But this secret of hers turns out to be not so secret after all. O-Neul, who has the same ability, meets her and tells her that she and O-Neul are both players in a dating simulation game. Will they be able to see the game to its end by getting married to their main storyline characters and escape from the time loop?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

As a child, A-Rin is adopted by the wealthy Chairman Moon, but is shunned by his family. Although her adoptive mother, Anna, hates her guts, her snooty remarks only make A-Rin's attachment to her stronger. When A-Rin grows up and discovers her ability to turn men into her minions by kissing them, she comes up with the devious plan to hold her brothers hostage and get what she wants from Anna. What results is a scandalous power struggle that threatens to topple the Moon Family's legacy! Will A-Rin succeed in taking over the family that once treated her like dirt?

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: This comic contains suggestions of incest. Reader discretion is advised.

When his partner was murdered and the killer went free, Yoonseok took justice into his own hands. Now he's the pawn of a prosecutor who sends him into danger, his body sexually violated by criminals as a way to gather information. He's little more than a husk, hoping for death, when he begins investigating the gangster Baek Gitae, whose violent sadism triggers something in Yoonseok. Is he seeking out the gangster's sexual aggression as a way to escape his pain? Or is he beginning to enjoy it?

(Source: Tapas)

Seoul, 2055. Civilization is on the rise, but individuals are falling behind. Ha-Neul, a young man, struggles to make ends meet while paying off his mother’s medical bills. One day, fate came knocking on his door.

(Source: Naver, translated)

"I want to marry a cute! Adorable! And affectionate herbivore!”

Sun Yoo-jin found out he's engaged at the Soo-In Harmony Party. Going off to cool his anger, Yoo-jin accidentally saves Ha-joon from getting bullied. As it turns out, Yoo-jin’s fiancé is Joon. And Yoo-jin, who likes his cute appearance, thinks he and Joon are destined to be.

Later on, Yoo-jin, who was waiting for his cute Joon who went to America to study abroad, gets approached by an unfamiliar man who claims to be Joon…!

“You’re Joon?! This engagement is a scam!”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Yuchang is a boy that lives with the problem of being way too handsome that nobody can relate to! Having been born with such pure beauty, Yuchang undergoes a project to become a dork.

(From: Copin Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes one prologue

Yun-Seul’s life has been ruined by her ties to a criminal organization. She succeeds in kidnapping Seong Jae-Ha, the daughter of a powerful boss. The two engage in a psychological battle, each treating the other as a lowlife, and after a physical struggle, Yoon-Seul subdues Jae-Ha with a stun gun. Yoon-Seul uses a body search as an excuse to strip Jae-Ha of her clothes, successfully humiliating her, but…

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Ex-convict Park Mok-Hwa wants nothing more than to keep his head low and stay out of anything that has to do with his past. However, his new-found tranquility as a florist is shattered by the appearance of Kim Nak-won, corrupt cop and unabashed hedonist. Nak-Won is sure that Mok-Hwa’s the key to cracking an important case, and he’ll do anything to get the taciturn man to talk. The best way to make someone confess is to cause them pain, and Nak-Won thinks he knows just what’ll hurt Mok-Hwa the most. But despite Nak-Won’s best efforts, Mok-Hwa continues to stay silent. It’s not often that life doesn’t go the way Nak-Won wants it to, so his obsession with Mok-Hwa only grows stronger...

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Dawn of the God of War

description:
Yu Geon is just a normal teenager, were it not for the fact that he's dying from a disease that gives him excruciating pain but also blesses him with supernatural strength. And despite his best efforts to focus on his illness and avoid the troublesome criminals and delinquents at his school, he has no choice but to intervene when their schemes cause a classmate to get kidnapped. Sick of their behavior, Geon decides to put an end to their crimes... even if it's the last thing he ever does.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Having finally fled her troubled past, Hae-Joo enrolled late into the Film & Theater Department, hoping for a fresh start in college. She envisioned a future brimming with promise, but soon realizes she can't outrun her past forever. Caught between her childhood friend and her rekindled first love, Hae-Joo wrestles with conflicting emotions. Eun-Seok, her longtime friend, proposes a fake dating scheme to mask his own feelings and shield her from Jay's advances.

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

Known for loving nothing but pretty faces, Kang Ji-Heon never imagined falling for someone he couldn’t recognize. When he drunkenly confesses to an unknown junior, Ji-Heon insists it was a mistake, only to be undone by Kwon Jeong-Hae’s sincere tears. What starts as a reluctant relationship soon blurs into something genuine.

Was it really just a misunderstanding… or the beginning of a love neither of them expected?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Eun-Ha is struggling to balance multiple jobs and drowning in debt when she runs into her ex. It's been years, but Won-Seo drops a bomb: the two never actually ended things. Eun-Ha is shaken by her words, but walks away. When eviction looms, Won-Seo offers a lifeline laced with history. Torn by pride and buried feelings, Eun-Ha takes the bait.

(Source: Manta)

title.english: The Succubus Wants to Be Naughty

description:
Cho-A is a succubus who sneaks into the human world with the hope of collecting enough life force to become human herself. Just when she reels in her first victim to consume, she becomes the one in trouble, as she ends up in the clutches of an archangel named Sa-Bin. But instead of immediately sending Cho-A back to the demon world, Sa-Bin offers to give the starved succubus exactly what she needs...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

They dreamed of having a great time just the two of them but there was a guy who manages the pension.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Hae-Na has been struggling to balance life and school ever since her father disappeared after winning the lottery. But one day, the appearance of some eccentric but attractive guys shakes up her world: Chae-Bin Do, a popular cute guy at school and a goblin, Yamagami Onisuke, a Japanese demon known as an Oni, and Wolfgang Lucifer Junior, a wolf-boy. They ask Hae-Na to be their bride and claim to have met her father: will she trust them? Where will these relationships lead her?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jaime finds himself alone in the world after his grandmother passes, and so does Percy. So when Jaime moves to a new neighborhood, Percy makes sure to follow the only thing he has left in the world... Only Jaime doesn’t know who Percy is. The two soon learn that their lives are even more intertwined than either ever knew. Along the way, they meet Jessica, the erotic thriller novelist with three cats, and Noland, a former colleague of Jaime’s who apparently dropped out. And after meeting Jessica’s cats, Percy learns he has a special gift: he speaks Yumyum, the language of Yummies (aka hoomans).

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: I'm the Tutor of the Twin Highnesses

description:
Sara Popo was a highly-regarded elementary school teacher in her past life. Reborn into a new world, she becomes a sought-after tutor for aristocratic children. Her unique methods quickly earn her praise--and the Emperor’s attention. He asks Sara to tutor his notorious twin siblings, infamous for their wild pranks. While a daunting challenge, she can’t refuse the Emperor’s generous offer.Winning over the twins might be her specialty, but can she handle the Emperor’s irresistible charm too?

(Source: Tapas)

This is the 562nd time I've killed this guy. Hundreds of years ago, Dong-Yi was forced into immortality by the monster 'Shin-Young'. Every time, he looks for a chance to get revenge on Shin-Young, but it's nearly impossible to kill the immortal, so they live together in a strange state of near-death. However, one day, after killing Shin-Young, who always gets on his nerves, Shin-Young, who he should have returned alive with a smile, doesn't return...

Dong-Yi goes out to look for him with an anxious heart, but when he meets Shin-Young again, he strangely seems to have lost his memories of him...?

"If you forget me, how am I supposed to get revenge...!"

The era of the anonymous hero has ended, and the world's protectors - the Magical Girls - now live their lives in near celebrity status. But it turns out these protectors are really school bullies in their everyday lives. One day, a new, never-before-seen Magical Girl appears with a proclamation of war against the original Magical Girls! With imagery reminiscent to your favorite planetary protectors, Miss Guillotine promises nostalgic visuals with a dark premise.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue, epilogue, 22 side stories, and a side story prologue.

A hopeless low-level orc warrior in an old RPG game finds his life turned around when he marries a beautiful elf and has a son who, unlike him, is incredibly handsome and a high-level warrior. As the orc tries to raise him as the ‘boss mob,’ his son runs away from home only to face a breathtaking journey in the wild world of games. He now must go after his son before his entire world spirals out of control.

(Source: Spotoon)

title.english: Please Spice Up My Life, Darling

description:
What Do-Hyun lacks in character, he makes up for with his looks and wealth. After cutting his studies abroad short, he returns to Korea, relying on his fortune as a safety net. Life feels predictable—until a call from his real estate agent brings him to his building, Ye-Yeon. To his dismay, Do-Hyun finds himself trapped in an elevator with a strikingly handsome man who, much to his surprise, seems completely unimpressed when Do-Hyun casually reveals that he owns the building. The encounter leaves Do-Hyun both baffled and intrigued. Unable to shake the memory of the mysterious Jeong Hyun, who turns out to work in his building, Do-Hyun begins to pursue him. What starts as an infuriating elevator mishap soon spirals into a series of unpredictable run-ins in the most unlikely places. As the tension between them grows, a barrage of witty banter and undeniable chemistry keeps pulling them closer together.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

Seung-Tae, the executive with a gangster past whom everyone fears. His loyal secretary, Su-Ho, has secretly harbored a crush on Seung-Tae for a long time. One day, Su-Ho is summoned by Seung-Tae and receives a suggestive request.

“Su-Ho, hit me just once.”

Seung-Tae lies face-down on a chair, taking the blows to his buttocks, while Su-Ho grows increasingly aroused. The tension in the office continues to rise...

“Executive, are you satisfied with this?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

I'm falling for the servant of my lady's enemy!

Lady Ersetta refuses to marry the man her father has chosen for her and asks her maid Farmé to meet him in her stead. But Lord Ligieri, her hated enemy, sends his servant Angelo to cover for him as well! Turns out, Angelo is oddly charming and Farmé can't get him out of her head!

(Source: Manta, edited)

Ishino would like to say he’s your average drug dealer. He’d really love that. Unfortunately for him, he also regularly goes into heat for some mysterious reason, and this kickstarts his maybe-strings-attached relationship with infamous mafia boss Nemeth. And that’s just the first mafia boss who wants a piece of him. What is going on with Ishino’s strange ability to attract dangerous figureheads, and just how much of his dignity will survive this?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kang Jihan’s perfect gay life comes crashing down after drunkenly making out with Moon Heeseop, the nerdiest loser in his major. Though Jihan has sworn off dating, Heeseop begins following him everywhere, thinking their kiss has made them boyfriends. And Jihan isn’t faring any better with his casual partner of one year, Ji Jinyeong, who keeps wanting something more. With two obsessive guys begging for his love, Jihan could just cut things off with them both. If only they weren’t so packing where it counts, especially the nerd! But maybe Jihan can make a three-way work...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Struggling to make ends meet, Kang-I works endless part-time jobs until one evening at a high-profile party leads to a reckless one-night encounter with a rude chaebol heir who mistakes him for someone else. Planning to enjoy it once and walk away, Kang-i is stunned to realize the man is actually his childhood friend, the one he parted from on bitter terms years ago. This time, the past refuses to stay buried, and what was meant to be a fleeting reunion turns into an intense game of obsession, desire, and feelings neither of them ever resolved.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Have you ever had sex?

As soon as he becomes an adult, Sung-Hyun spends the night with his childhood friend Ji-Won at his request. Sung-Hyun, who has been secretly in love with Ji-Won, tries to make things work out with him, but Ji-Won sleeps with other people as if nothing happened. Then one day, he discovers a rough mark on Ji-Won's body...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

A serial killer is staging corpses as “self-destruction art” and selling them to the ultra-wealthy for tens of millions. When failed artist Suchan Kim recognizes the concept as his own—stolen from an exhibition the world laughed into oblivion—his obsession with proving this mutates into something darker: a hunger for the recognition he never received. In a world where spectacle is worth more than life, will Suchan expose the killer, or become part of the masterpiece?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Saintess Returns to the Emperor

description:
After being betrayed by her lover, Riella decides to end it all, only to be saved by Emperor Herrhan. Without ever getting to thank him, she sneaks away to start her life anew. But soon, she finds herself on the brink of death once more when she’s wrongfully framed for trying to assassinate the emperor. Fortunately, Herrhan comes to her rescue yet again, and this time, Riella will be able to repay him in an even bigger way than she imagined. As it turns out, she is the empire’s sole saintess who has the power to heal the cursed ruler...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Hwang Cheol-Su, son of Hwang Ju-Seung, the second-generation heir of a prominent conglomerate in South Korea. Though born into an enviable family, his mother (Seo Jeong-Suk) is notoriously possessive, leaving him a mama's boy with no friends—a reputation that follows him even to university. Only Na Hye-Seong approaches Cheol-Su without hesitation. Whenever Hye-Seong visits his home, Cheol-Su senses his mother's obsession waning. Hwang Ju-Seung, who had never once touched Jeong-Suk since their marriage, begins sleeping with her after meeting Hye-Seong, claiming she “smells like a woman.” Then there are Hye-Seong's inscrutable actions. As their lives become increasingly stained by desire and lust, they begin hurtling toward ruin.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Cha Kang-Hyeon, Ga-Yeong’s blood relative and arch-nemesis who has been meddling in her love life since she was a child. For some reason, she has a bad feeling that this latest crush is going to fall apart because of Cha Kang-Hyeon, so she goes to a supposedly reputable tarot shop and buys a suspicious bracelet…

Why have I turned into Cha Kang-Hyeon?

(Source: Naver, translated)
A love story of a struggling crush. Can Minho’s love be achieved?

Born the cherished daughter of a noble family, Won’s life shatters when a sudden tragedy leaves her on the brink of being sold off as a courtesan. To make matters worse, the man behind her family’s downfall is none other than the father of her childhood friend, Wanhyeok. Just as she resigns herself to losing everything, Wanhyeok steps forward…paying the price of her freedom with his own two hands. Torn between a desire for revenge and love, does Won have what it takes to avenge her family’s name?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Upbeat witch doctor Kina Witchwood receives an ominous prophecy: she will face her execution in six months, but not before encountering three men--one she cannot refuse, one she cannot persuade, and one to whom she will vow her life. Though she tries to defy fate, she soon finds herself appointed as the emperor's personal physician and thrust into the heart of the imperial palace's trecherous political intrigues.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Former national archer Hwang Jung-Ho was forced to retire after an injury turned his shoulder into a hypersensitive weakness. Avoiding touch and attention, he now lives quietly as a delivery driver. That is, until a delivery brings him face to face with rising archery star Kang Jun-Hyuk—who grabs Jung-Ho’s shoulder and triggers an overwhelming reaction.

“If this is because of me... I’ll take help you...!”

What kind of “help” is Jun-Hyuk offering—and can Jung-Ho resist him?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

66 million years ago, a martial arts world where dinosaurs wield martial arts. Amidst the chaos following the Heavenly Demon's Rebellion, the young Triceratops boy Byeokroea, having lost his master, embarks on an adventure to uncover hidden martial arts and the truth about the Heavenly Demon. Facing a colossal conspiracy and the secret of a great catastrophe, he becomes the last hope of the dinosaur martial arts world.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hit by a drunk driver and bedridden ever since, Um Tae-Sung now only knows the cruel reality of pitying gazes, medical fees, and being half-paralyzed. His only escape is reading his favorite web novel, "The Mage That Devours the World," but when the last chapter ends with the hero destroying everything, Tae-Sung realizes happy endings don't exist. That is until he wakes up one day as Mord, an extra from the novel! Now, he’s determined to create the happy ending he’s always dreamed of.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

There is nothing more entertaining than making women realize their fetish and breaking those pretending to be innocent!

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: Do or Die: Girls Get Along Great

description:
When Pat-Ji discovers that her new stepfather is cheating on her mother, she develops a secret loathing for both him and his biological daughter, Kong-Ji. Unfortunately, as a red-blooded lesbian, Pat-Ji also feels a strong attraction to her stepsister. Driven by both hatred and desire, Pat-Ji ends up harassing Kong-Ji despite the latter’s efforts to form a friendly bond between them. Perhaps that’s why karma comes for her hard in the form of a mysterious warning: Pat-Ji will die in 3 days… unless she has sex with a man.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.

Jaerim Lee, a student in film studies major, needed a way to quiet down the rumors that he's into guys. Gaeun Cha, a student in screenwriting major, needed to get away from the dorky senior who was always hitting on her. The two of them begin a contractual relationship to solve their problems, but as they get to know each other, Gaeun starts to fall for Jaerim’s charm little by little...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Beneath the grand Alvard manor, a chained beast named Desi lives in darkness. Unable to ignore his daily torment, Celi secretly feeds him and slowly earns his trust. When the count orders his death, she sets him free—but Desi refuses to leave her, and their forbidden, hidden life together begins.

(Source: Manta)
Note: Part of Metatoon's Sinbuncha Danpyeonseon (신분차 단편선) Collection.

After nine miserable years of marriage, Erin de Brissia is thrilled when her husband, Duke Raymond Von Lebensberg, accuses her of infidelity as an excuse to be with his own lover. After signing the divorce papers, she uses the recipes from her late mother to open a dessert cafe and receives rave reviews. But when her ex-husband and his lover get wind of this, they’re set on sabotage. Will Erin ever be able to taste the sweetness of success, or is this divorcée doomed to disaster?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

There’s nothing more beautiful and dangerous than you. Eugene doesn’t have time to finish his homework since he spends the night trying to find Juan who is only attracted to strangers looking for a good time. Juan, who is used to sleeping with strangers that he doesn’t even know, has a smile that overwhelms Eugene. Eugene, who can’t stand his smile anymore, has a goal to wipe that filthy smile off his face.

My boyfriend announced his marriage to me. And that too... to another woman. That's how our four-year relationship crumbled in an instant. To make matters worse, he proposed she become his mistress. Do-Eun refused and they broke up. Later, while on a business trip to Hawaii, Do-Eun met a man with exotic looks named Ian on the beach. Feeling overwhelmed by the intensity of their relationship, Do-Eun continued seeing him under a pseudonym.

“Mo...Ana. My name is Moana.”

They spent passionate nights together, neither knowing the other's name or age, considering it a fleeting encounter destined to be just a memory of Hawaii. Until he reappeared.

“Long time no see, Moana. Or should I call you Director Eun Do-Eun now?”

(Source: Naver, translated)

Undercover cop Im Sae-Byeok has one job: use his baby-faced charm to infiltrate a university and get close to Ma Leo, the elusive grandson of a notorious gang boss. But on day one, he gets blackout drunk and wakes up next to a mystery man he definitely doesn’t remember. Things only get messier when he discovers he’ll be living under the same roof as both Leo and Leo’s overly clingy best friend, Son Yi-Gang. With cockblocks, close calls, and suspiciously attractive housemates at every turn, Sae-Byeok’s mission quickly spirals into chaos. Operation Leo might just be his wildest assignment yet.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The third and final season of Aporia.

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

During his school days, Gio accidentally discovered a rock band called Aurora, which became his muse. Inspired by them, he pursued a career in music and became a skilled composer. However, Aurora couldn’t survive in the overwhelming digital music market and eventually disappeared. Gio could never forget the voice of Aurora’s vocalist—until one day, a mysterious man named Seon-Gyu appeared before him. Their first encounter was suspicious, but through his best friend Hee-Seop, Gio learned an astonishing fact: Seon-Gyu’s voice resembled that of Aurora’s vocalist.

"Hyung, please, just sing once!"

"No."

All he wanted was to hear a single note—why was it so difficult?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.english: V-Card Raider: Collecting the Male Leads

description:
Drunk after her latest heartbreak, lazy game addict Sylvia buys a mysterious game called V-Card Raider. However, before she even gets to play, she dies of alcohol poisoning and finds herself transported into the game world. There, she is told by a god that she is on the fast track to hell unless she sleeps with the main characters, collects the seeds of the World Tree, and saves the game universe! Is there a catch? Who cares?! Who wouldn't want to enter heaven by committing the sin of lust?

(Source: Tapas)

Lim Bonha, the youngest daughter of the Y Corp family, has it all—looks, wealth, and charm. But for the past 14 years, she’s been hopelessly in love with her first crush, Lee Eunho. Now, as a confident and stunning young woman, Bonha is determined to put an end to her one-sided love. She’s ready to make him hers, no matter what. The only problem? Eunho still sees her as the little girl from 14 years ago. But for this relentless heiress, that’s just a minor obstacle.

"Would you marry me, Eunho? And just so you know, the only acceptable answer is Yes!"

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Years after losing Matthew, the friend he secretly adored, retired soldier Jaden still battles lingering PTSD. Hoping to clear his head, he drops everything and sets off on an unplanned adventure. His travels lead him to a charming town where he meets Diego, a man who looks astonishingly like Matthew. At first unsettled, Jayden soon finds himself drawn to Diego’s warm, lively spirit. As they grow closer, Jayden begins to rediscover joy, laughter, and maybe even love. Could this unexpected encounter be the fresh start he’s long needed and the chance to finally heal his heart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

On his daughter’s wedding day, a father dies and mysteriously reincarnates as the family dog in her new home. As he adjusts to his canine form, he uncovers a shocking secret: his seemingly perfect son-in-law might be unfaithful. With keen senses and newfound determination, this papa dog must protect his daughter from betrayal. Can he save her from heartache without revealing his true identity?

(Source: WEBTOON)

After school, I used to live alone in a ghost club. Then one day, a female band came in. "Can we use it together?" It suddenly started a loud noise.) life. It's a bit clumsy, so it's a story of a more sparkling youth's campus band!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

To survive as someone from a lowly background I, as a doctor, had to abandon my pride If I had to bark, I barked, if I had to beg, I beggedIs this the outcome of the weak?!When frustration and anger brimmed in both eyes Facing death in a traffic accident, But when I opened my eyes again, I found myself back as an intern…!On the outside, a novice doctor in their 20s, but on the inside, a top-tier thoracic surgeon.The revenge and healing drama of Max Level Doctor Kim Yoon Chan begins.‘From now on, I will take control of every situation!’

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Sohyun knows all about the grind. She's dedicated herself to crawling up the corporate ladder by any means necessary, but a girl's got to blow off steam sometimes! Speaks fly when Sohyun meets a handsome stranger during after work drinks, and their resulting one-night stand scratches an itch. But will it remain just one night?

(Source: Manta)

In-Chul miraculously gets a second chance with his long-time crush when he goes back in time. However his efforts to get close to his crush bring unexpected consequences: The women at his office started to take an interest in him.

"Don't keep me waiting... Or do you want me to do it for you?"

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Soo-Yeon wants to marry her boyfriend of 6 years, Jung-Hyun, but everyone around her opposes her marriage to Jung-Hyun, who is selfish and only thinks about himself.

"Why do you want to marry me?"

Soo-Yeon asks Jung-Hyun, hoping to confirm his feelings, and he gives an unexpected answer.

"My father is retiring soon, so I need to give back the wedding money he gave me before."

What!? That's why you want to marry me!? Her mind is confused for a moment, but she gets entangled with her successor, Do-Kyung...

(Source: Naver, translated)

This world has been destroyed. All because of Won Jeong-Hyun, the world’s number one. He is humanity’s greatest hero and its worst traitor …Or so I thought?

“…If only the last person standing hadn’t been you.”

He saved me just before the world ended, then died. And to stop the conspiracy, I suddenly found myself sent back in time! As the youngest S-rank Hunter at the age of 8!

Alright then, I’ll fulfill Won Jeong-Hyun’s wish in his place. Starting today, I’m taking over the mission to save the world!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ha Si-Yeon, 30, who retired from being a popular idol and is now an actress, suddenly has a crush on Han Eun-Gyeol, a small business male idol. She, who was always used to being loved, now has a crush! Will she be able to keep her true identity a secret idol fan until the end? A heart-pounding secret idol fan romance!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Miji’s life is a comedy of errors: exploding headphones, train accidents, the works. Her theory? She's cursed. Her solution? Summoning a powerful demon. But the price for breaking the curse is her future partner's life! A fantastic deal, Miji thinks. Who needs love anyway? Right?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Tangled Up With a Tiny Male Lead

description:
Marley is a half-baked witch struggling to make ends meet in the northern forest. When she captures a rare fairy named Prim, she plans to harvest his expensive "essence" and sell it for money. Unfortunately, Prim has never felt the urge to mate and doesn't know how to produce this ingredient, so Marley literally takes matters into her own hands. As they're navigating this awkward "extraction" process, a health scare and a desperate wish turn their transactional relationship into something much more intimate...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Five years have passed since he left his beloved hometown for the city. With no one to depend on, Mihail wanders everywhere, ultimately unable to settle down anywhere and returns home. A remote mountain village where even a cart won't take him. Upon arriving in the village, he visits the cabin of his childhood friend, shepherd Caleb, and greets him warmly. However, all he gets in return is a warning to get out of the village immediately. Mihail tries to win Caleb's heart and settle down in his long-awaited return home, but things aren't as easy as he thought...

Lee Jeong-Yeon lost everything the day his lover died saving a stranger. A stranger none other than, Ki Seo-Hyeok, the boy Jeong-Yeon once taught. Drowning in grief and haunted by the unfairness of his loss, Jeong-Yeon seeks out the Seo-Hyeok, driven by a desperate need to see the life that was bought with his lover's blood. But as Seo-Hyeok begins to fill the empty spaces in Jeong-Yeon's life, the mourning teacher realizes that some debts are paid in ways more dangerous than death.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Finding the perfect guy isn’t easy, but looks like Eunseo just hit the jackpot. Seung-hyuk’s a handsome, hot hunk with a pretty face that anyone would fall in love with. How could you resist someone like that, especially if they feel so much like Mr. Right? Well, as with any good thing, there is a small catch. Apparently, Seung-hyuk is a friend’s ex-boyfriend. Not just any friend, but Eunseo’s new roommate, Minjae. What a fix. Eunseo wants to keep on meeting this hottie, but hurting his friend’s feelings isn’t right, right? Even if the hottie lives next door and they literally run into each other all the time? Right?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Sun-Hee is intrigued by the arrival of the indifferent new girl from Seoul and wants to befriend her. Eun-Byeol puts up a cold exterior and ignores Sun-Hee, who attempts to make friends! When the two finally become friends, Sun-Hee soon starts to question her own feelings for Eun-Byeol

(Source: INKR, edited)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

After another soul-crushing day at the office, Chae-Su wakes up inside the world of Campfire Friends, a cartoon he used to watch as a child. As he spends more time with his colorful woodland pals every night, he begins to regain his lost childhood innocence. But behind their cheery kindness hides a chilling secret...

(Source: WEBTOON)

Soyo, a demon fox, sneaks into the palace to steals a man’s affection. While searching for the world’s best Yang energy, she meets prince Ahan. Soyo tries to seduce him, but her true identity is discovered, and instead, she becomes aroused by his touch…

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

It's love at first sight for Karel when he sees the bedraggled but beautiful Sasya during his travels. Although Karel offers him food and lodging, Sasya slips away without leaving any hints about his identity. But fate pulls them back together when Karel finds a photo of Sasya in a Russian duke's home, and tracks him down in Paris. Once he learns Sasya is a talented ballerino who fled Russia under difficult circumstances, Karel takes him in with the help of his wealthy friend, Julian. However, Sasya knows Julian's sponsorship offer only stands as long as Karel stays interested in him...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes nine side story chapters.

Welcome to the mythical planet of Pieta, where beings of various species and statuses mingle and come together. Tune in to the stories of a flirty paladin who falls for a shy dryad at first sight, an herbalist who is rescued from a creep by a handsome dragon, and more. Five nights of fantastical romances and spicy action await!

(Source: Tappytoon)

My friend who always cheats on his girl and his girl who says yes to anyone who asks her out. What's going on?!

(Source: Toomics)

"Face your destiny."

In the alternate realm of the Otherworld—filled with creatures and Earth's catastrophes—an ancient warrior, a human summoned long ago into the realm, is determined to bring it all to an end. Fueled by the resentment of an unknown past, this journey unravels hidden identities, embarks on undercover missions, faces death trials, navigates through betrayals, and wades through bloodbaths. What do the shadows conceal, and what destiny awaits in the heart of the unknown?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Jun-Ho finds a job in a company run by his first love and her daughter. He can't keep his hands to himself when his crush lets her guard down...

"I ended up doing it... With a boy who is as young as my daughter..."

(Source: DAYcomics)

The Jeokun Mountains, the immediate border between the Demon Tribe and the Alien Federation. It is the final strategic point where training and actual combat take place simultaneously. The Federation forces are searching for the ten Transcendents revealed in the Book of Prophecy and reclaiming their lost territories, conducting repeated conscription and selection processes. However, more terrifying than the war with the Demon Tribe were the absurdities and harsh treatment of military life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Armonia has lived alongside monsters all her life. They've raised, protected, and loved her since she was a toddler. So when she heard about a monster hunt that would threaten her monster friends, she saw no other choice but to try and stop it. But to do that, she can no longer avoid interacting with humans. Now, she's on her way to meet the leader of the monster hunt, Kansler Hydeh, in hopes of changing his mind. And if he doesn't listen to her as well as monsters do, Armonia will make him!

It's been three years since Yeong-in and Seonghyeok parted ways. So why is Seonghyeok approaching her now -- gentler, and more intense than ever? Will their reunion end differently than before? Can they fill the emptiness in each other's hearts?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

They say freshman romance can make or break college life. So it was for Min Kim, whose heart was shattered two years ago by beautiful upperclassman Bora Kwon. Min re-enters college after his military service hoping for a fresh start, but as luck would have it, his old flame has also just returned from a long leave of absence. As he struggles to bury lingering feelings and move on with his life, Min encounters Jina Bae, the firecracker-next-door who begins to find a place in his heart.

(Source: WEBTOON)

While watching the famous Serengeti “Three Colors” sunset at a bar, Ian, a former military soldier, met Lucy, a man who looked somewhat familiar. Ian was swept away by his charm, and invited Lucy to his room.

I feel comfortable with Lucy’s beautiful smile and gentle touch, but can I do it with a man that I just met three hours ago? Maybe...

“Are you going to put it in me?”

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

When Hae-Il drowns saving a boy at sea, his final thought is of Pa-Do, the childhood crush he could never forget. Instead of sinking into darkness, however, Hae-Il wakes up with an impossible second chance. But this new life is far from perfect—Pa-Do is cold and distant, and Hae-Il's body dissolves into seafoam with every sting of rejection.

(Source: Manta, edited)

The twists and turns of fate never cease. In the River of Oblivion, the red spider lily whose flowers and leaves share the same root yet never meet has become a messenger. Will she be able to unravel the secrets of every soul and set them free?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

What would you do if you felt trapped in a world of illusions and falsehoods? A young boy leaps from a high bridge, sensing the distant call of another world. Where exactly is he headed? If 23 seconds is the key, then I will press on! Even if what lies ahead is...

A wondrous interweaving of reality and illusion, a choice that transcends the boundaries of the world, in search of the truth I seek!

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

Note: Winner of the Golden Dragon Award for Best Story.

"Loser" Run Dong suddenly turns into a handsome young lad. He unveils the truth about a new species of "Green Men" invading his school. Though he is gradually mutating, determinations are made to protect his own family, friends and most of all, his beloved girl.

(Source: WebNovel)

"Once you enter the nine songs, you're no longer human."

A romance between a mysterious assassin and a blood-thirsty hunter.

(Source: Manman Manhua, translated)

Su Xiao was once an impoverished god of the heavens, but because he accidentally burned down the marriage predestined by the tree of fate, he has no choice but to descend to the mortal world and reincarnate for ten lifetimes to join together 9,990 marriages. In the tenth world, he is just an common beggar. Unexpectedly the world’s number one Sect, ZiChen Zhenren took him in under his wing, causing many people to sob endlessly. And this lifetime, he once again is in a pure Yang body. In secret, a dark pair of eyes unconsciously watches over him.

title.romaji: Zongcai Shuo Wo Shi Zhu Duiyou
title.english: The CEO Says I'm a Noob

description:
Ji Bai feels as though his life has become tumultuous ever since he was forced into a contract by the system and began working on missions through various worlds. Not only does he run into the company's CEO in every single world, he's also tricked into getting registered at the civil office with the CEO without him knowing. What's worse is the CEO accuses him of being the noob that dragging the team down?! What did he do to deserve such terrible treatment?! He should punish the CEO by making him kneel on durians!

(Source: Webnovel)

When a terrible disaster struck their school, Zong Luofeng was out sick and avoided the worst. But his best friend Lu Yun and secret crush Chen Yao both died in the incident. He was feeling down on himself when he was suddenly pulled into a time loop! Returned to the time before the tragedy, seeing everyone alive again… can he change the ending this time?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Cute and plucky disciple x gloomy and jaded master. See how the newbie "Lucky Sasa" will play out in the game world of "Yuan"!

"Come on, master, let's go grind some quests for new loot," Sasa says.
"Damn it, when can I finally be rid of this dumb disciple," Yizhe asks himself.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Sang Shang thinks he's the best, brimming with youthful vim and vigor, but what's his life's meaning? He wants to live a wonderful life, but how should he start? After making a ridiculous decision, he meets the right person. After opening his eyes, he and a little egret's life were forever bound. The little egret is a bird who lives life bravely, perhaps Sang Shang will find his life's meaning by moving forward with him?

Legend has it that when the three princes of the Feng Country returned to fight for the throne, they brought back a stunning juvenile named Shan Yue. Shan Yue soon became a prey among the princes. And the conspiracy hidden in him, has also lifted off the tip of the iceberg. Vengeance, schemes, imperial power, heart-tormenting, what kind of future will Shan Yue be heading towards?

With the fall of the Hanging Gardens, the mighty Celica returned to the mortal realm. Her triumphant journey, crushing all in her path, began. But is that truly the case? A side story completely different from the game's plot—the overlord Celica has finally arrived after a difficult struggle!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Shuang Shi Liange: Longwang De Tishen Chong Fei
title.native: 双世恋歌：龙王的替身宠妃

description:
The dragon clan rule this sealing continent. Rumor has it that Ye, the king of dragon clan, is bloodthirsty cruelty. However, he bestows a human slave as his concubine, pampering her for all sorts of things. She thought she had met someone worth entrusting her life to. She thought he was truly special to her, but it turned out to be just a reflection in the mirror, a substitute for someone else...

(Source: Mangatoon)

Wenji survived the hellish training to finally become a shadow guard to serve his royal highness, who Wenji had been infatuated with, thinking about him day and night. But his highness has already forgotten him and left him in the dust... All things through the looking glass, and his highness didn't seem to be the man Weiji remembered, "But I still want to be by his Highness's side, please stop pushing me away..."

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Ping Sheng Xiang Jian Ji Mei Kai

description:
He was a prince who was extremely clever and scheming. But he was born sinister and ruthless, playing with people in the palm of his hand. And he, a young carpenter, was obsessed by all the ingenious things. He seemed to be a nerd, but he was unique and the best of the best. They were like jade, made into a perfect match for each other. The life of these two brilliant people was abruptly intertwined.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

This year the cultivation realm isn't having much of a good time, either. Everyone's under a ton of pressure; A bit of bipolar over here, a little pre-ascention anxiety over there, even the elders are going schitzophrenic due to all the intense training! A modern psychologist gets transmigrated to the most depressing of all sects into the body of Xun Cai, the senior disciple whose body yin and yang are all sorts of 'wrong', and begins to treat the OCD Brother Lin Cong and his fellow disciples. And so, filled with love, the daily life of a chilled out cultivator begins!

A mundane office worker was thrown into a BL novel and became the main character, the coldhearted master! He just wanted to live his life in peace, but it turned out that every single character has unusual feelings for this Master?! What happened to falling in love with the protagonist?!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

In order to get revenge, Qiuxi Cheng, who has been missing for ten years, came to his childhood friend, Shangguan Zhixin to be his counselor. Originally, he wanted to take advantage of their childhood friendship to get rid of Shangguan's two brothers. However, he thought too much, and Shangguan was too straightforward, and they were not in the same channel at all. Qiuxi Cheng used all kinds of ways but he couldn't kill him at all...

(Source: Tencent, translated)

When surgeon Su Kai Ji is suddenly transmigrated into the past, the first thing he notices is he is dressed in wedding clothes and being sent to the palace to be a consort?

On the wedding night, the emperor faces the beauty in front of him, and when he touches the flat chest underneath the bride's clothes, he feels his anger rise.

Emperor: I actually married a man?!
Su Kai Ji: Marry? I would never be the one on the bottom.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Badao Zongcai?  Bu Cun Zai De!

description:
You thought this was a traditional overbearing-boss story? No! We are not the same! Never mind the unexpected transmigration, but I ended up in an overbearing-boss story. I'm not even the boss, but the male support instead?! Never mind being a support character, but I have to follow the plot by helping the male and female main characters get together? What kind of lousy system is this? The worst part is that I'm starting to have special feelings for the male lead...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

In the urban suspense series of stories, behind a series of thrilling incidents, justice and evil are being watched, how does the punisher under the mask start to act?

(Source: INKR)

The Crown Prince fell from his horse off a cliff and disappeared without a trace. After losing his memory, he was picked up and secretly hidden away by his younger brother, Prince Ke, right under everyone's noses. Yet this ambitious "good brother" was actually one of the masterminds behind the Crown Prince’s fall. While storms brewed in the court and people lived in fear, within Prince Ke’s residence, passions ran wild night after night. The muddleheaded amnesiac Crown Prince became Prince Ke’s beloved pet — until his memory returned and he finally remembered everything.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The Demon of War, Tang Xiao, failed to preserve the secret technique. The seal of the curse was scattered all over the world ... Mu Xiaolou, who was born with an ugly birthmark, Tang Yinjiu is the new mysterious guest of the mountain. Due to the "curse", the fate of the two colluded.

In order to protect the secret technique, the war demon Tang Xiao sealed the it with a secret spell and scattered it throughout the world...

Mu Xiaolou, a servant born with an ugly birthmark, and Tang Yinjiu, the mysterious new guest at the villa, find themselves entwined by fate because of the secret spell.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated and edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 9 extras.

title.romaji: Hei Hua Da Lao Xunyang Zhinan
[Kuai Chuan] Hei Yueguang Xi Bai Jihua

title.english: Peculiar Tales Of Swords And Blades

description:
In the late Five Dynasties period, Li Congjia (Li Yu), the sixth son of the Li clan in the Southern Tang has been making big plans for a long time. On the surface, he seems to be always indulging in poetry and song, hanging out in bars and brothels. But in fact, he has secretly cultivating a group of talented followers in preparation to contest the kingdom, while manipulating the Tangjiabao in the Shu kingdom, the assassin guild led by Chu Hanfei, the former duke of the State of Chu. Three major forces have emerged, and all three are focused on finding the ancient book "Pushback Diagram." Meanwhile, Zhao Kuangyin, the grand general of the Houzhou, is also carefully plotting out his grand plan to unite the kingdoms.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The Mist Summit is rumored to be inhabited by an ancient sect that practices magic. The clan is made up of a group of uncontacted people related by the ties of blood. When a boy coincidentally skis his way into the Mist Summit, his wonderful journey begins.

(Source: WebComics)

The miracle-working doctor George died during saving people in his previous life. The cat fairy he saved felt deeply grateful to him, and followed him for generations. Even after his nine tails were broken, the cat fairy still wanted to snuggle up to him. You know, I like nothing but you in the world.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bao Jin Wo de Xiao Bai Long

description:
Su Yaoyao, a girl who loves dreaming and fantasies, suddenly met her ancient self one day, and her life has undergone an unexpected big reversal! what? She was forced to marry right after crossing?
In the mysterious tomb, who is the handsome man who is sleeping in the ice and is so handsome?
Shuttle millennium miss, and he finally found her!

(Source: Chinese publisher, translated)

title.romaji: Jiang Shao Yao Buyao Jia Guolai
title.english: Childe Jiang, Would You Marry Me?

description:
My dad says that if I'm still unmarried after 25, I won’t get my inheritance? Well, my dad really makes trouble for me, his own daughter!—Let's see how the CEO, a pet lover, flirts with the medical examiner. In this contract marriage, who will fall in love first? The CEO has lots of pets: a teacup poodle, a crested dog...and even an alpaca?

(Source: WebNovel)

title.romaji: Wu Jia Zongcai: Ni Laopo You Pao Le!
title.native: 误嫁总裁：你老婆又跑了！

description:
Three years of marriage. She was sincere in her self-righteousness, and in the end only got him a ruthless divorce agreement. Jiang said year by year, Su Xiangnan, I have never loved you. The truth is finally settled, she said that forgiveness is easy, but love is not easy. Because of this encounter, she has exhausted all her luck.

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

When the most ideal man becomes his private bodyguard, he can't help but being domineering while drooling over him! Wants to get him but dare not to show his true feeling. What can he do?

(Source: WebComics)

A Regent who’s cold on the outside but passionate on the inside x A Chancellor who is unable to be open about his pain and suffering.

The two of them used to be lovers who promised their futures to each other, but they fell victim to the schemes of an evil scoundrel. When they meet again, they are on opposing sides. The Regent is bitter about the past betrayal of the Chancellor, and the Chancellor is being threatened to keep silent about the truth. When the two of them start working together again, the Regent swears to make the Chancellor pay. But beneath the hatred and grudges are two hearts that truly love each other. Will they be able to clear up their misunderstanding and walk towards the future hand-in-hand?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Ian Wilson, the CEO of Wilson Corporation, was unjustly accused of murder after his company’s artificial intelligence robots were involved in murder incidents. While making his escape from arrest, he met Colin, his new staff, who was then being dragged into the case. As they set out to find out the truth, they discovered a series of old events, and to their surprise, everyone around them seemed to be connected to the hidden truth…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

title.romaji: Hey, Hen Gaoxing Jian Dao Ni

description:
When straight-A student Yushan takes in the rich kid Yifan – who was thrown out of the family home to learn how to make his own living, she has no idea that she and the younger guy are going to connect and spark chemistry.

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Bei Bingtai Didi Siyi Suoyao Hou
title.native: 被病态弟弟肆意索要后

description:
In his previous life, Yu An pretended to be stupid and obedient, changed his surname and gave up his position, and tried every means to please his brother, but he did not expect that he would be killed by his brother in the end. In his new life, Yu An looked at the well-dressed Fu Mingyi, and in addition to taking away everything from him, he also wanted to make him fall into the blood taboo that he had always hated, and lure him into ruin with his own body!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A noble lady was murdered by disembowelment, and a ghost rumor spread throughout the capital. The Emperor Shun was furious and ordered the Ministry of Justice to solve the case within a month, and ordered the Imperial Preceptor to help. Ye Qinghan, the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Justice, had always disliked the Imperial Preceptor's deceitful behavior, but he had no choice but to work with him to solve the case. However, the more he investigated the case, the more connections he made. Behind the case, besides the main culprit, there was also a great injustice that wiped out an entire family of loyal officials, as well as a struggle for the throne. Beneath the seemingly perfect appearance of the Imperial Preceptor, there was also a face covered in scars that Ye Qinghan had long admired.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A gene-altered assassin with the ability to transform into a bobcat faces off against a mysterious two-faced gentleman who appears to act with no rhyme or reason. But why does this man seem so familiar?

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

Liren has gotten one more chance at life, and this time he can't fail both his empire and lover.

(Source: Toomics)

title.romaji: Wo Jian Shi Liulang Mao Bian Cheng Renle?
title.native: 我捡的流浪猫变成人了？

description:
Qin You is a handsome livestreamer who one day picks up a cute little kitten on the street. However, he didn't know that he actually picked up a demon than can turn into a human! Qin You has fragmented memories of his past, and somehow the little kitten he picked up is involved.

(Source: INKR)

Growth is taking place inadvertently and quietly when Li Chuan, Gu Cheng and the others are frolicking around and making trouble out of nothing, whether in the tree shade on the playground, or at the basketball court on campus.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: My Lord Tricks Me Into Love

title.romaji: Wo He Ta De Nanyou Beiyong Mao
title.native: 我和她的男友 备用猫

description:
When the ex-girlfriend is threatening to kill herself and you have a hesitant and irresolute boyfriend, you end up in an "abnormal" love triangle relationship. The hardest part is that only I have to shoulder all the pain - me, the "other woman" in this Love Triangle. Tolerance and understanding, should these two be this painful? Until that person who is the reason for all my tears shows up...

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.romaji: Shechu Monu Tan Lian'ai Zhen Nan

description:
May is a workaholic office lady who is in secret a modern day witch and tries to have a normal life. Due to her magic, she meets a delinquent named Sean who dreams of dominating the neighborhood. Follow the unlikely love story filled with laughs and magic of an office witch and a rebellious man.

(Source: INKR)

title.romaji: Ni Shifu Wo Ren Sha Qian Duo

description:
The master stood at attention and saluted: Now that you are my disciple, you must obey me. Tell me, what is our ancestor’s top motto? Milk tea crisp: Master, it’s just you and I in this sect.
