Where’s the ancestor? Master stood at attention and saluted: How, how dare you! Just answer me! Milk tea crisp: ... Beat the hell out of Yue Jianchun and that son of a b*tch!!!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

The phoenix will return from Nirvana and rise up to you once again, my dear Highness.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Pei Shang Wo, Zhuan Le Ta

description:
Li Yue, who is determined to retain control on Chaoyue Corporation, and Jiang Yuqi, who is determined to use Chaoyue Corporation as his stepping stone in returning to Pudao. The two have irreconcilable conflicts with each other as they use each other and try to oppress the other, which resulted in them developing feelings for each other. In the end, they once again support each other to get through difficulties as one to successfully retain Chaoyue Corporation.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Siblings, unrelated by blood and acquainted in the face of animosity, are about to embark into one hell of a forbidden romance.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

It turns out the world around us is actually an imaginary world created by the Mother Goddess Nuwa using an artifact called Scroll of the Realm. That means outside the bounds of our universe lies a magical world.

(Source: WebComics)

In this world that everyone pays attention to face, will anything go well as long as you're good-looking? Ai Xiaoyu is a girl who looks fashionable but shy inside, what will happen when she meet a two-faced novelist? An hilarious and sweet love story began...

(Source: WebComics)

Although it is a supernatural show, there is my Prince Charming, Fan Chuan! Go on, don't be afraid the ghost! But - why do I be in a group with a man called Huang Yexue?! What's the meaning of my life if not being close to my Prince Charming! And... There really are ghosts!" - From the spiritual girl Xia Xiaoman's wailing!!

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Zhu Zai Wo Gebi Di Na Jiahuo

description:
A story about a bunch of people who make their apartment a happy shared place while living different lives.

(Source: WebComics)

Gu Yun returned to his hometown in order to fulfill his father's last wish. During an assassination attempt from the Lucas family, he ran into a childhood friend Lu Yihan. One thing led to another and Gu Yun found himself entangled with Lu Yihan. After over coming all the hardships , the two become close confidants.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one extra.

Those who wield powers that defy the skies and shatter the earth—arts that move mountains and drain seas—are known to the world as Cultivators. This is an adventure set in their world. Formidable foes, demonic beasts, ancient ruins, and grudges passed down through generations of cultivators… All will unfold, one by one, in this realm where strength defines destiny.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

A princess of the Western Regions, raped by invaders, gave birth to a prince. She died while fleeing to save her son, leaving behind a will for revenge. The prince, stranded on the frontier as a beggar, later joined a slave troop, befriended a long-haired young man, and fell in love with him. The prince, seeking revenge, sought to win over the people and observe the situation. Upon learning his origins, the young man decided to help him. The prince became a handyman slave, seeking to gain the trust of the powerful and assassinate the king at a palace banquet, avenging the destruction of his kingdom and the murder of his mother.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The coming-of-age story of a kitten who finds herself in the middle of a dog clan!

Hong-Seol, a cat-human hybrid, was abandoned by her parents because she couldn’t use her inner energy. After a miserable death, she opens her eyes to find herself back at the moment just before she died.

"You are the child I’ve been searching for. Would you like to learn martial arts from me?"

With nowhere else to go, Hong-Seol is approached by the formidable “dog” shu-in clan, the Grand Patriarch of the Namgung Clan, who extends a helping hand. To survive, Hong-Seol enters the Namgung Clan.

“If they find out I’m a cat shu-in, I’ll be kicked out for sure!”

Whether they know of Hong-Seol’s daily struggle to walk on thin ice or not, these dogs come to visit her every day, wagging their tails. Except for one: the prickly eldest dog, Namgung Baek.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

The world suddenly fell asleep?! Only 'Yujin' (the female protagonist) can move in this stopped time... Feeling scared, she went to her childhood friend 'Hyunwoo''s house. The door was open... and his penis, not wearing underwear, was erect. 'Wait, was he masturbating...?' Though she was momentarily flustered, seeing his erect penis, she couldn't control her lust and inserted it just like that! When 'Hyunwoo' ejaculates, he wakes up?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"Just stay alive, young master."

Sora has descended from the mountains to guard the sickly Jungha. The two have a set of rules to guide them: One, Sora decides what is considered an emergency. Two, Jungha must listen to Sora in an emergency. Three, Jungha must not bully Sora. Will they be able to stick to them?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue and 3 side stories

After working hard for revenge all his life, he became a lawyer with a 97% success rate. Now all that's left is to take revenge on that bastard, 'Smile', who killed his mother, but he ended up dying at the hands of that bastard...

"Prosecutor Jang Hyun-Soo!"
What? He's possessed by that bastard Jang Hyun-Soo? Is it a twist of fate? No, is God giving him one more chance?
"Smile, I'll definitely get revenge on you!"

(Source: Naver, translated)

Naver Webtoon has already celebrated its 20th anniversary! What works have graced Naver Webtoon over the years? To explore the path, legendary and rookie gag writers have joined forces...

"The Sound of Your Heart" writer Jo Seok introduces 10 masterpieces from the first 10 years of the webtoon, while "The Ki Sisters" writer Beombae introduces 10 masterpieces from the second 10 years of the webtoon.

This special collaboration celebrates Naver Webtoon's 20th anniversary.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

After humanity triumphs over the dangerous gates, a fragile peace is restored, yet the immense powers of espers become a dangerous double-edged sword. At the heart of this turmoil is Esper Zero, Michael, teetering on the edge of destruction. Enter Adam, a retired soldier haunted by the fractured bonds between espers and their guides. In a bold act of redemption, Adam offers Michael a second chance and a new identity: "Eve," symbolizing a fresh start and a spark of hope. But is peace truly possible for a person created for war…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rookie director Lee Suh-Rim is at his wit’s end. Lee Su-Noh, the hottest star around, joined Suh-Rim’s project but keeps skipping production meetings. Soon, the whole production might fall apart before it can begin. Out of options, Suh-Rim decides to cash in on a secret only he knows about the actor. Years ago, he paid Su-Noh for something special... something that Su-Noh has not yet delivered. So now, Su-Noh owes him... with 50% interest. Will this leverage help Suh-Rim? Or will it be the final nail?

(Source: Tapas)

Baek Han-Il, a third-year student in the Department of Business Administration at Korea University. As he lives his life preoccupied with realistic problems, he lacks content to write on his resume. In order to participate in a contest, he creates a club on his own, and when the department's bombshell, Ryu Ji-Oh, joins the club, Han-Il's mind becomes complicated...

"Senior, were you only interested in your body from the beginning? Even in the club and the contest?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Maknae of the girl idol group "Europa", Shine, gained a burst of popularity after a double nosebleed on a live stage.

For a moment, she was excited about her future success, but she quickly learns that her body has changed since that day.

Along with Chan Seon, member of boy group "Awaken", they dig into the suspicious things happening around them and find themselves involved in dangerous situations.

But they're in too deep. Will they be able to maintain their idol status until the end in a bloody and chaotic daily life...?

(Source: Naver, translated)

On the cusp of calamity, the dead have risen! Corpses that have long grown cold return to steal warmth from the living, and the natural order dangles by a single thread of fate—a pair of lovelorn enemies tethered intrinsically by ice and fire. Together, Selena and Millard may yet salvage an era that’s torn between bitter frost and scorching flame. They must enter the enigmatic Magic Tower with only one another to rely on, knowing they may never return…

(Source: Tapas)

Sang-Jun, a talentless idol trainee, wished to transfer to a new entertainment company. Then, the day he asked his director about it, Sang-Jun received a book which unlocks access to a "talent library", allowing him to quickly learn various skills.

With this book and his newfound "talents", Sang-Jun is going to become a top star!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Set against the backdrop of a wintry Seoul, Winter Breeze tells a story of second chances, hope, and the unexpected warmth that can bloom even in the coldest seasons. Two years after their fleeting encounter at Seoul Station, Hae-Na is reunited with Do-Hwa at a newly opened photo studio tucked away in her quiet neighborhood, and finds herself drawn to the mysterious photographer she hasn’t been able to forget. Is their reunion merely coincidence, or is it the beginning of something meant to be?

(Source: WEBTOON)
This is the story of two people living out their campus romance, the returning transfer student Min who has a though time with love and the department legend Joon who's scared of romance.

Hong Yeo-Ul is just an ordinary high school boy… who attracts every guy he meets! And it’s all because he’s possessed by a highly seductive fox demon called a maegu! The only way for him to be freed from this creature is to either undergo a ridiculously expensive exorcism… or succeed in dating a guy who won’t fall for him. Unfortunately, Gu Hae-Jun, the only person who fits that bill, isn't the least bit interested in dating anyone! Will Yeo-Ul be able to win Hae-Jun over?!

(Source: Tapas)

My first love, Ju A-Rin, whom I met again after five years. Why has she changed so much?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kwon Sehyeon is both an alpha and omega who enters the beta dorm at his university to hide his unusual trait. Since his omega side awakened late and is unstable, he needs to avoid alphas at all costs. But as it turns out, his kind roommate and old friend, Seo Junhoo, also entered the beta dorm hiding the fact that he is an alpha. Once he learns the truth, Sehyeon knows he should change rooms and stay away from Junhoo. However, an unexpected heat cycle has the two friends crossing the point of no return...

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: There Are No Bad Dogs in the World

description:
Hyunchul Kang is a carefree college student, down for casual hookups with anyone that catches his eye–even if they’re his brother’s roommate, Hyunho Ki. Even if Hyunho already has a crush on Hyunchul’s brother. Trouble is, Hyunchul can’t help but wonder if Hyunho sees him as a stand-in for his brother. It shouldn’t matter, considering there are no feelings involved, but it’s sure starting to…

(Source: Tapas)
Note: The first story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

title.english: Be the Good to My Bad

description:
All the world’s a stage – and that includes Lee Hyesung’s love life! A former child star, Hyesung exited the limelight after a traumatic incident left him unable to continue. But he is thrust back into the public eye when a fateful trip to Hawaii leads him to get caught up in dating rumors with A-list actor Shin Yoo-il: the nation’s bad boy with looks that deserve a standing ovation. Though there is seemingly nothing between them at first, the two decide to pursue things further in the interest of their careers; after all, all press is good press, right? But when business mixes with pleasure, Hyesung and Yoo-il’s method acting begins to blur the lines between fantasy and reality. Will the two find their happy ending together? Or are they destined to star in a real-world tragedy…?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Contains five side story chapters

After completing his residency, Seol-Won opened an ophthalmology clinic in his hometown of Seosan. While visiting home, he decided to spend the holiday at a mountain villa with old friends from his hometown. However, his friends had to postpone their visit to the villa until the next day, leaving Seol-Won to spend the night alone at the villa. What woke Seol-Won from his sleep was the sound of an unfamiliar intruder. Filled with fear, Seol-Won tried contacting his friends and the police, but...

"I'm really sorry. We can't get the car in right now."

"Caller! Due to heavy snowfall, access to the mountain is currently difficult!"

...He was isolated. And that too, alone with the unfamiliar intruder, Alpha Gu-Ju.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yoon is a broke student working tirelessly to turn his life around and get through medical school. Though they're estranged, Yoon can’t look away when his father’s debts catch up to him. In exchange for his father’s life, Yoon agrees to work for the gang after he graduates, losing all freedom outside of his classes. With all that time together, Yoon can’t help but get to know Tae-Beom. And he hates to admit it, but the attraction he feels for the boss might go beyond just pheromones…

(Source: Tapas)

Note Includes one extra chapter.

Nine years with my girlfriend and counting... (?) Is she the one for me? Or...

(Source: Toomics)
Note: The fourth story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

title.english: The Wolf of the Full Moon

description:
As the daughter of the premier of Joseon, Han Wolyeong had a happy life. That is, until her father's political enemies killed her clan and took her prisoner—enter Doheon, a mysterious god who saves her and confesses his love. Now, Wolyeong and Doheon are set to spend 30 nights of passion with each other to fulfill their destiny and get a wish from the heavens. But with Wolyeong's enemies still searching for her, is she truly safe? Or will her happiness be destroyed once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae(純愛) Danpyeonseon (순애(純愛) 단편선) Collection.

The small town farmer life is all Gi-Tae has known his whole life. He’s never been into mystery, intrigue, or complications. But all of that appears in the form of his newly hired helper Hae-Un—who is absolutely useless at farming. But Hae-Un’s true talents lay somewhere else. Mainly in the bed…if only they could actually get into a bed, somehow.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

With her followers decimated by other churches, Granchia, the goddess of rightful revenge, is on the brink of destruction. Restricted and bound to human form, she must protect and support her one last true believer...or cease to exist. Can she find a way to gather her servants and muster enough power to avenge the wrongs done to her believer and his family? Or will her enemies succeed in their mission to destroy her last follower, dooming her to oblivion?

(Source: Tapas)

Attacked by a hostile enemy planet, Rie lost her home and her dearest friend, Road. Seeking refuge on a curious blue planet, Rie will rise again...as an alien idol on Earth!

(Source: Tapas)

Seconds before you self exit you hear that your divorced father has passed away, leaving you an unimaginable amount of money. But once you get to his funeral who he left behind, you realize that money isn't the only thing you can take...

(Source: Toomics)

The action fantasy series, which took three years of preparation, will focus on the boys of South Korean idol group, B2ST, discovering new supernatural powers and their adventures on saving the world as new superheros.

In the comic, Doojoon is a soccer star with amazing athletic abilities, Hyunseung is a dancer who possesses the power of teleportation and a “4D” personality, Junhyung is a quiet introvert with the ability to mind read, Yoseob creates illusions with his singing voice, Kikwang has the power of telekineses, and maknae Dongwoon is a college student with a perfect photographic memory.

Kikwang and Junhyung’s characters in particular will be involved in a love triangle as they go after the same woman, while Doojoon and Junhyung will be roommates and rivals.

Due to his massive dick, YONG-MIN gets dumped every time he tries to have sex.
"Please accept me as your disciple!"
After learning from the sex master, he sets his eyes on the arrogant head nurse, YE-HYUN...
"I've never seen anything like this!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

The Kingdom of Terossa is home to the discriminated Hoans, physically modified super soldiers. Rezaric, commander and the strongest Hoan, leads the kingdom to victory in the recent war, only to be sentenced to death. But when he accepts his fate, he's saved by the frail Princess Delmore and brought to her lab, where she promises to aid his escape. There, Rezaric learns more about his savior and even discovers a dangerous truth that will change his life and Terossa forever...

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: I Don't Want to be Loved

description:
After losing her child and catching her husband in a compromising position with her half-sister Leticia, Leannan takes her own life rather than continue living miserably. But instead of dying, she wakes up the day before Leticia comes to live with her family. Determined to prevent a repeat of her past, she comes up with a plan to get rid of all the obstacles... starting with her cunning sister and her cold husband. Will Leannan succeed and live happily, or will she drown in misery once more?

(Source: Tapas)

Han-Kyeol, a busybody studying to become a cop, is completely drawn to a part-timer Ji-Hoon at the newly opened dessert shop these days. He only tries to help Ji-Hoon who is the clumsiest on the face of the earth at the beginning. Nevertheless, Han-Kyeol becomes mesmerized by Ji-Hoon’s sweet, gorgeous face hiding behind the glasses and entirely falls for it. Keeping horrible scars on his body, probably from being bullied, Ji-Hoon seems vulnerable to Han-Kyeol. Ji-Hoon always thanks him for his help with a beaming smile that makes Han-Kyeol’s heart race out of control. Hank-Keol tries to convince himself and everyone else that it is only for the sake of humanity, but is that really the case? Fate has made two people from opposite poles run into each other! Let’s fall in love in the “right” relationship!

(Source: Netcomics, edited)

Ahn Somi is the queen of The Garden of Eden, a secret BDSM club where anything goes. Taking advantage of the twisted desires of men who have wronged her in the past, she uses their perversions to inflict pain instead of pleasure. As this tantalizing tale of risqué revenge unfolds, Somi will do whatever it takes to show that if you play with karma, it will always come back to bite - or whip - you in the end.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Archimond, the strongest necromancer who once plunged the continent into terror, had lost his life to the sword of the hero Berkel Reinland. And 200 years later, he was reborn as a baby of a certain sword clan and spoke his very first words:

“Guardians of darkness, my servants, my soldiers—heed my command!”

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shortly after becoming empress in her second life, Raviel Sutton realizes she desperately needs a slave, er... husband. Her brother Edwin Sutton, aka "the lunatic," takes matters into his own hands and comes up with a scheme that basically assures Raviel ends up with the dashing Duke Haven Derhardt. As Raviel battles attempts on her life and political intrigue, she must hide the knowledge of her past life from the two men dearest to her⁠—although they seem to have plenty of secrets of their own.

(Source: Tapas)

On the Day of Judgment, monsters from other dimensions invaded earth. Thirty-two years later, humans with special abilities called hunters fight the monsters to keep humanity safe. They train in an online game called “Lost City”—but the best player, Jinsoo Kwon a.k.a. “Unknown,” is no hunter. He only plays the game to earn money for his sister’s medical bills. But when a guild recruits Jinsoo to be a hunter in return for medicine, it’s an offer he can’t refuse. It’s time for this fighting legend to protect his home and his family!

(Source: Tapas)

After being orphaned at the tender age of 7, poor Diana had little choice but to slave away as a maid to survive. But her fortune takes a turn when she encounters a mysterious mage who introduces himself as her mother's friend. He gifts her better clothes, a beautiful house, and even her mother's inheritance. All that's left is for Diana to spend her days living happily... until another chance meeting with a certain individual reveals a family secret that will change her life forever.

(Source: Tapas)

Chan-Hee is a fierce gangster who is unexpectedly hit with wisdom tooth pain after beating up a rival gang. When she goes to a dental clinic to get it removed, she falls head-over-heels for Ha-Jin, the beautiful dentist who happens to be on the night shift. Although Ha-Jin rejects Chan-Hee when she asks her on a date, it doesn't stop Chan-Hee from bringing her fancy lunches and gifts to woo her. One thing leads to another and they hook up at the clinic, but can their new relationship last when they're from two completely different worlds?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's and Lezhin's Jeonmunjing Ungni Danpyeonseon (전문직 웅니 단편선) Collection.

Just as I was getting used to a novel where I’d been possessed by an unstoppable will to survive, an unusual little kid rolled into my life. It was hard enough just to make ends meet, but I couldn’t turn away from those cute little eyes, so I raised him with all my care.

“I’m going to marry you. Sign the marriage registration form for me.”

“Later, later~ If you still feel the same way when you’re all grown up, then write your name down.”

Since minors aren’t even eligible to file, I just signed it as a joke, but they say the marriage registration was accepted? And on top of that, the true identity of the little one in my house… is the Emperor?! I got tricked by the scheming male lead’s disguise and ended up getting married!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

A normal afternoon, the ring suddenly appeared in the middle of the classroom. If you want to live, you have to get on the ring and kill your classmates. The brutal slaughter game that tests your fighting power begins now!

title.english: Love Me Like You Owe Me

description:
In order to pay off his mother’s crushing debt, Woo Min-Jo finds himself delivering coffee in high heels to a construction firm run by the notorious gangster, Chu Gio. What starts as a misfortune spirals into a bizarre fate, as Gio quickly takes an interest in Min-Jo. And before he knows it, Min-Jo goes from a broke errand boy to the unlikely “bride” of a thug...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

What do you think you're doing with that axe?! When the stag god, Cheongyeon, is rescued from a hunter by a woodsman named Mooksan, he knows Mooksan is just what he's missing up in heaven. But little does Cheongyeon know, Mooksan is no ordinary woodsman...

(Source: Manta)

title.english: I Have Never Abandoned the Tyrant

description:
I transmigrated…twice. As Rari, I doted on Thierry so that I wouldn’t die at his hands later. But I was murdered anyway and, seven years later, I woke up as Princess Alicia Ashtad. Thierry became a ruthless tyrant in that time and, when he shows up in Ashtad Kingdom, I agree to leave with him to protect it. Now in Thierry’s palace, I must conceal my past life and, worse, someone wants me dead…again! Thierry may be the least of my worries.

(Source: Tapas)

"Listen carefully, I'm a bit of a pervert."
"What?"
“So I want Hyung to do as I tell you.”

One day, Do Jaewon of the popular idol group "Majors" saw Cheon Eunho, a member of the same group, masturbating using his video. Realizing that Eunho has a crush on him, Jaewon starts a sexual relationship with him out of curiosity. However, before he knows it, he becomes more and more sincere...

What will be the end of the scandal between the two 'Cherry Dolls', who just began to know each other?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Help! An incubus that died a virgin has possessed me!

Exorcist Palmoon Han gets a call from a man in distress. His new client, Dun-gab, has a few options to free himself from the demon, but none of them seem adequate. To help his client, Palmoon makes Dun-gab an offer he can't turn down. How will this offer help Dun-gab gain freedom from the incubus?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 side story chapters.

Just when her crush was about to express his feelings for her, our FL is warped away into the world of an unknown webnovel. Stuck as a noble lady with a suspicious suitor who wants her life, and a mystery savior who looks a little too familiar... Death-threats, protective MLs, and a dark secret that surrounds the FL's new life! I don't care anymore! Take me back home!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

One day, Jeong-Woo can't sleep because he sees a ghost that appears every morning at 3 a.m. and bites his fingernails. Tormented by sleep deprivation and fear, Jeong-Woo tries to figure out when this phenomenon began, and is reminded of an incident that occurred after a drinking party with his childhood friend, Hee-Won.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Once upon a time in the northern mountains, there lived beings with great powers. The most powerful were the Imae. Their chief decided to share their power with the weakest beings, the Foxes. They made a blood pact that was supposed to benefit both sides, but the Imae would always have the upperhand. The foxes decided to leave the mountains and have been hiding ever since. If I don’t use my powers in front of an Imae, I’ll be just fine, but now guess what happened…?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 21 extra chapters.

Mission: Break the Curse of Your Favorite Idol with Your Own Body!

A voice actor who secretly adores the virtual YouTuber “Yu-Won.” The real Yu-Won suddenly bursts into the voice actor’s home! “Jeong-Han,” Yu-Won’s true identity, claims to be in a ghostly state! To become a normal person, he must receive love… But he has to release that love through physical contact?! That’s a total win-win, isn’t it…?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: How the Grand Duchess Returns to Her Tower

description:
Leicia is a famed genius mage who rules over the magic tower. However, when her own pupil betrays her, Leicia’s soul wakes up in the body of Grand Duchess Priscilla Eckhart. Unfortunately, Priscilla’s body cannot wield magic, so Leicia needs to take the long way around to getting her body back and restoring the Grand Duchess’s soul as well. The odd complication is Calix Eckhart, who is intent on finding out who is in his wife’s body, even if it means hiding his own identity to do so. Will this tag-team succeed in restoring their original lives?

(Source: Tappytoon)

There is a land where elves and wizards roam, where warriors and demon kings clash for the fate of the world—and the name of this fantastical land is none other than… Seoul, South Korea?! Sent by magic from his fantasy world to modern Seoul along with his party of colorful heroes, will former warrior and very ordinary student Hui-Won be able to gather his party and save it from the “evils” of the Demon King?

(Source: WEBTOON)

I was always a good person. And with a smile on my face, I ran the country into the ground. Wasting a 500 trillion won budget to chase approval ratings plunged South Korea into its second IMF crisis. His life as the president who ruined the country over, Lee Seong-jun finds himself 30 years in the past. He returns to find a budget proposal—riddled with dirty tricks, corruption, and blatant self-interest—being pushed through the Ministry of Economy and Finance.

"I have to block all of these budget proposals, even if I'm vilified for it. It's the only way to save this country."

The dirty tricks, political strategies, and media manipulation I learned over years in politics... I will use every last one to become the gatekeeper of the nation's coffers.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Though single for seven years, Jung Ji-Soo is more than happy with her four precious friends: three vibrators and a dildo. But the morning after Ji-Soo takes her hot coworker, Han Se-Hyun, home after a company dinner, she's horrified to see him holding friend number one—a bullet vibrator! Yet instead of leaving, Se-Hyun is set on satisfying Ji-Soo's thirst by giving her what her friends can’t, and the two begin seeing each other. It seems Se-Hyun, however, wants to be more than just her fifth friend…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapter.

When Jae-Jeong Sin’s dad rents out part of their house, he loses his favorite room, and gains a grudge. The tenants? A single mom and her daughter, A-Rin Woo. Things spiral when Jae-Jeong discovers their parents are having an affair. And, turns out, A-Rin just learned about their affair too. Bound by this dirty secret, Jae-Jeong and A-Rin grow closer, even as resentment simmers. As secrets pile up and tensions rise at school, the two form a dangerous pact: if their parents won’t stop the affair, they will.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

On-Ha, who has never left the palace. She has always been interested in sex, but is dumbfounded when she is told that she must marry a child who will soon be seven years old, unlike herself who is already an adult. On-Ha wants to experience various things before marriage, and a book falls in front of her, and from it jumps the nine-tailed fox Ain and the yellow-haired goblin Cheongrin.

"Release our seal, and I will grant you what you wish."

As she dates the monsters under the pretext of seeing the world, On-Ha begins to feel a strange thrill towards Ain and Cheongrin...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

1-8. Alpha Dog Gildeurigi (알파독 길들이기) [Gyogwan]
9-18.Marriage Blue (메리지블루) [Pachi]
19-27. Chojja Sagikkun, Gom Jabatda! (초짜 사기꾼, 곰 잡았다!) [Naepilmyeong]
28-32. Geojinmarui Jinghu (거짓말의 징후) [Mobingeo]

title.romaji: Geureoke, Geu Goemulgwa Du Beon Gyeolhonhaetda
title.native: 그렇게, 그 괴물과 두 번 결혼했다

description:
Dianna Brienne frees the abused slave of her estate, Guiscard Lodbrog, only for him to return years later as a vengeful king who repays her compassion with a cruel, humiliating marriage that ends in her tragic death. But fate grants a second chance. Thrown back in time to her twelfth birthday, Dianna must now protect the very boy destined to become her monster before his hatred toward his masters grows deadly. In this life, Dianna won’t be his victim. She will face her future tormentor head-on to rewrite their bloody ending and find a better future together.

(Source: Tappytoon)

After a year of dating, Russian mafia boss Vasily Kaminsky and money launderer Yoon Yuno face an unexpected crisis when Vasily is injured, losing all but his memories from when he was 18. Reverting to the cold, ruthless man he once was, Vasily denies their relationship and cruelly pushes Yuno away. Heartbroken, Yuno contemplates walking away for good. But despite his harsh words, Vasily begins to cling to Yuno. Now, Yuno faces an impossible choice: leave before Vasily’s memories return, or stay and risk his heart for a love that might no longer exist.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes the prologue.

title.english: A Breath in the End of Verdure

description:
After a cosmic accident lands her in another world, Jiwoo Seo is resigned to living as a whole new person. She has spent the past five years purging her new world of demonic energy as Akarna, a being who must sacrifice her blood and her freedom for the empire. But when the man she loves gets engaged to someone else, Jiwoo flees from her gilded cage. Rescued by a stranger from a clan of beautiful, otherworldly men, they concoct a plan to keep her safe—by having her marry them all.

(Source: Tapas)

Min-Seong became a landlord at just twenty. When he visits the house to check on it, he's shocked to find three gorgeous sisters already living there. What starts as a simple arrangement slowly turns into something far more dangerous... and irresistible.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Julitan is a cook who's never left his tiny fishing village. That is until one day, when he slices open the belly of a giant fish and finds a mysterious lady sleeping inside, cradling a giant sword. Julitan bestows her with the name Carnelian, only to accidentally awaken a powerful "sille" being. But Carnelian the sille soon discovers her new tamer and master Sir Julitan is no match for her superior power. Now the two must embark on a long quest to find this fierce sille dragon's true knight!

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: MASTER, MAY I TURN YOU ON?

description:
Three people working in the AI department of a global corporation get to test out the company's latest product... However, they didn't expect to spend 30 days with an android that looks exactly like a human!

"Are you having trouble getting hard?"

"I wanna have sex too! Buy me a pussy!"

"You have ingrown toenails(?)"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Choi Ha-Ram, your typical high schooler, decides to buy a necklace on a whim, however, unknown to both her and the ghost of Yu Ga-On, whoever wears it is able to see Yu Ga-On, who seems to have no recollection of his past. What are the circumstances behind his death? What is his connection to the necklace? And just who is the mysterious yet familiar new neighbor of hers?

Jeong-Jin married a woman who has a daughter. He feels happy with his new family, but he can't take his eyes off his step-daughter who dresses too lightly.

"What is wrong with me...? She is still my daughter...!!"

(Source: TOPTOON+, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra story

Cornelius, who started dressing as a woman at the age of 12 at the request of his mother, falls in love with Cleve whom he met at a party that he participated in. Even though Cornelius disliked it, he ended up dressing as a woman until the age of 19 as a way to meet Cleve... Can Cornelius, who has continued to meet Cleve disguised as a woman, confess his true identity to him?

Even the most casual of comments can leave some people with profound scars. One cruel sentence has left Jae-Ha with a chronic fear of talking to strangers, while another remark has turned Yeong-U into a recluse. A little bit of coincidence and a pinch of nosiness bring the two boys together, marking the beginning of an unlikely friendship. Together, they try to face their demons head on. All they need to do to move on is to take everything one step at a time. One small step, that’s all it’ll take. One small step to start.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jim and Hanna have been best friends since they were kids. Will it last even when living in the same apartment?

(Source: Toomics)

I can't escape his piercing blue eyes...

Soon to be wed, Princess Rosetta embarks on the final journey of her freedom. During the trip the party are saved by a strange woman. But when it turns out her injured savior is also due to be wed, Rosetta volunteers to help the ceremony proceed. Little does she know her world is about to change.

(Source: Manta)

Perpetually the lowest-ranked salesman, Giseok faces termination due to poor performance. His only way out? Becoming the top salesperson. Desperate, he turns to pillow deals, the ultimate sales taboo. Can he overcome temptation, jealousy, and office politics to rise to the top?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Falling star to superstar!

Forced to give up on his dream of becoming an idol, Yoo-Sung laments having to spend the rest of his days working as his crush's manager. That is, until he wakes up as a trainee! How did he go back to the past? What are these mysterious skill bars only he can see? Could they be the key to success?

(Source: Manta)

Jae-Hyeon's life was ruined by his stepmother, the woman who drove his mother to death and later caused his father's downfall. Consumed by hatred and forbidden desire, he takes revenge on her, only to die in a tragic accident. But fate has other plans... Awakening 25 years in the past, before his family’s destruction began, Jae-Hyeon must change the course of his life. Will he break free from his past, or repeat the same twisted destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Assistant Manager Kim Minwoo is struggling because of his female team leader, who is always harsh and cold towards him. One day, he unexpectedly presses an unknown button, and the team leader’s cold demeanor changes 180 degrees…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Bae Songwoo is in a one-sided love with his longtime friend, Kim Sangjin. Living his life hiding his feelings, one day Bae Songwoo finds a suspicious book in his house, and written inside is Kim Sangjin's life story.
But Bae Songwoo is just a passing extra...?!
As he tries to ignore the book, Bae Songwoo soon realises that everything is going as written...

In a world where implanted neural chips allow investigators to interrogate suspects through their own memories, detectives Kim Jin-Yeong and Seo Ji-Su prefer the old-fashioned method of chasing criminals on foot. Officially, they are colleagues-turned-lovers who divorced years ago; but off the record, they continue to seek each other out after work, haunted by a tangled relationship that neither has fully let go of. Then, one chilling Christmas night, Jin-Yeong disappears without a word. Exactly one year later on Christmas Eve, he returns and stands before Ji-Su as if nothing had happened. Where has he been, and what truth hides behind the silence of that missing year...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ryu Dan-woo, an ordinary college student, gets "chosen" (?) by a young demon he meets on the street. The demon follows him into his apartment without permission and settles in, and from that day on, Dan-woo's once-ordinary life goes completely awry. In order to return to his normal life, he begins searching for clues to dimensional magic together with his college classmate Siduk and the witch Jueun…

(Source: Naver, translated)

A sex partner was born overnight. And he was so damn handsome. Ji Eun-Yeon, an omega with a unique constitution who can't sense pheromones, gets dumped by his cheating lover who calls him a "fake omega." Eun-Yeon blacks out after drinking alcohol in a fit of anger. When he comes to, there's something hot and thick between his buttocks. The next day, after spending a hot night with a handsome man he's never seen before, he finds out that he's his high school classmate, Alpha Cha Eui-Sol.

"Do you want to keep seeing me? I really liked it."

(Souce: Lezhin, translated)

Yang So-Yeon, the top student in the liberal arts department who always made mistakes on mock exams and failed to get a perfect score, has been annoyed by Kim Jun-Su, the top student in the science department who has been getting perfect scores on mock exams since her first year. On the long-awaited first mock exam of her third year of high school, So-Yeon becomes anxious and approaches Jun-Su...

Will an unexpected meeting begin?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Hwan returns to college after completing his military service, and runs into a mess involving his first love, his ex and even a freshman. His life soon becomes a total chaos between the girls who are out to get him!

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Aiden ends up working with his favorite novelist, but when he meets him, things start to take a different turn...

(Source: Toomics)

On Suyoung is working as an officer of the Royal Pharmacy, and when he finds out about the emperor's plan to behead the king for the treason charges, he feels sympathetic and gives the anesthetic potion to the king to lessen the pain. And during the execution, the king thanks Suyoung and curses the emperor as he dies. The next day, Sooyoung wakes up in a strange place and realizes that he is living in the emperor's body! Shivering with fear, Suyoung hurries to the Royal Pharmacy and finds the emperor in his body. And from that point and on, a spectacular drama takes over the palace.

"I like that sunbae who looks good in glasses!!!"

Sungbin, who has a glasses fetish, has a one-sided crush on his sunbae, Ahn Gyunghoon, who looks good in glasses. Gyunghoon mistakes Sungbin to be a stalker as he suspiciously lingers around him.

The moment Gyunghoon throws Sungbin out, a drunk Sungbin confesses his feelings. To Sungbin who clings onto him saying he likes sunbae who looks good in glasses, Gyunghoon gives a headbutt but...

Nalanda, a country where mermaids lived in the sea once upon a time. Yeon-Ji, who has been dreaming of mermaids since she was little, entered as an intern at the Nalanda History Research Institute to prove the existence of mermaids. She meets the team leader Hae-Rang who looks like a mermaid.

Yeon-Ki, who wants to look good in front of Hae-Rang, tries her best, but Hae-Rang keeps being cold...

(Source: BOMTOON, translated) (Note: Chapter count includes three side stories.)

People were gathered at a rural hotel for a business orientation, but they were given an unexpected welcome.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: A Knight Addicted to Adult Novels

description:
Rosaline is a strong and noble imperial knight whose glowing reputation ironically makes her unapproachable. Therefore, she secretly turns to adult novels to satisfy her less noble urges. When Rosaline is captured by an enemy tribe on a mission, a part of her is excited about being stripped down and degraded by her captors like the heroine in her favorite novel. And her merciless punishment arrives in the form of Attila, the fierce tribe chief who seems hellbent on getting revenge...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

Two new girls move into a quiet town, but with everything there's more than meets the eye to this place.

(Source: Toomics)

Seo Do-Young, a former scout for the professional baseball team the Unicorns, finds herself unemployed after the team disbands due to poor performance. When a mysterious app called [High School Baseball Tycoon] appears before her, she decides to use it to transform Cheongil High School, which was at the bottom of the rankings, into the nation’s strongest team.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In the demon-plagued kingdom of Jinyeok, a child named Ryujin is born. Upon seeing him, a passing exorcist utters a warning: “Beware of fire.” Yet by the time Ryujin is grown, the evil spirts have robbed him of all he holds dear. As his home stands engulfed in flames, the exorcist reappears, telling Ryujin to head for the Exorcism Academy. Here he will learn how to combat the demons that torment him. But on the way, he runs into the mysterious Imae. Henceforth, their bodies and souls become entwined… For Imae is his intense and unrelenting fate.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 2 extra stories.

Areum Ham can’t believe that one night of drinking to forget meant forgetting everything. But when Bumyeong Baek, soccer star and childhood friend, demands to know what they did the night before, one thing slowly becomes clear: neither of them remembers if things ended with a kiss. But just when she thinks things are complicated enough, he has another demand lined up for her.

Since when was he interested in more? Does she feel the same way, or has this tiger set his sights on the wrong prey?

(Source: Tapas)
Cha Do-Yoon, who feels inferior to his sister, and the unknown who appeared as a substitute for his sister who went to save the fantasy world, fall in love with each other.

Burned out from work, Yeon-Seul’s long-awaited vacation takes a disastrous turn when she finds herself stranded on an island. Her only company? A maddeningly handsome stranger, infuriating as he is irresistible–but with survival forcing them together, sparks fly and an impulsive marriage marked by a night neither can forget transforms their relationship into something rather intimate. But as rescue brings an end to their rendezvous, Yeon-Seul reluctantly resigns herself to the end of her castaway romance–except her island husband doesn’t want to, their love story far from over.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Yoo-Chan is a young man who can't get over his boyfriend from high school, who was his first love. Since then, Yoo-Chan dated people that resembled his ex, but every time the relationship failed. When Yoo-Chan spends a night with Nam-Hyun, whom he thought was the opposite of his ex, he gets a surprise!

(Source: INKR Comics, edited)

Kei, a boxer who suffers from a past trauma, decides to leave the championship behind and walk the path of corruption...

(Source: Toomics, translated)

Note: Includes a prologue and an epilogue.

Yeoeul Baek, a humble C-class guide, desires nothing more than a quiet life with a stable income. But her plans are turned upside down when an extraordinary 89% match with Yi-Hyeon Han—the world's most powerful S-class esper—forces her into a full-time role she never expected. Now, Yeoeul must navigate a world where her once ordinary life is anything but…

(Source: Manta)

title.english: This is a Work of Fiction

description:
Seong-In spent his life drawing webtoons that mocked women… until a fatal accident forced him to walk a mile in their heels. Waking up as a young woman, Seong-In thinks he’s unlocked "Life on Easy Mode," but the illusion quickly shatters. From dodging the predatory advances of a "respected" instructor to facing an marriage ultimatum from a conservative father, Seong-In must navigate a world he once ridiculed. Can Seong-In learn to reconcile the fantasy of a world catering to women and the reality of the exhausting life women face on a daily basis?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yul, the manager of the interdimensional dump truck office, accidentally kills an innocent man named Kwon Yu-Jun. In order to make amends, Yul enters a romance fantasy novel where Yu-Jun is the villainess and tries to send her back to her original world. However, due to various complications, Yul becomes trapped in the novel. With the office staff scattered and no knowledge of the novel's plot, Yul desperately searches for a way out. But, Yu-Jun, who is now pretending to be a noble lady in the new world, causes Yul a headache.

Kyung-soo's spent the past three years trying to forget about one traumatic night. It isn't until he meets Dong-hyuk that he gets a full night's sleep. One night without the nightmare of being tied down by a room full of men under the watchful eyes of Yule.

(Source: Lezhin)

The pure fool + pervert Lim Tae-O dreams of a loving relationship. Because he's gay, he is estranged from his parents and at odds with his friends. Even the men he's dated can't overcome Tae-O's obsession, so he's been dumped many times. Thinking it's his last chance, he wants to finds a roommate to be his FWB... But then he meets Choi Hyeon, a roommate who suits Tae-O's taste more than he could have imagined! Like fate, he falls in love at first sight.

The strange co-habitation of Tae-O, who needs love, and Choi Hyeon, who needs attention. ♥
Can this love be successful?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A bleak future where people have forgotten the most precious thing of all: “family.” This is the story of protagonists whose very bodies have become detached from their humanity due to a long war, as they regain their humanity through a series of events.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The three kingdoms, the era where heroes flocked in order to defeat the world. The best-armed follicles got lost in history due to a momentary mistake. The last moments of life…

“Give me one more chance, I promise I’ll defeat the world!”

When I opened my eyes, the follicle was in its twenties. It went back in time, with its tumultuous spirit beginning to unfold!

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Ju-Heon is abducted by a stranger who refuses to explain anything, insisting he must remember the truth on his own. Overnight, his life is stolen from him, leaving him trapped in a room with only his captor’s voice, touch, and rules to anchor him. Terror slowly warps into a twisted dependence, and even as he demands to know why this is happening, he can’t stop reaching for the very man who tore his world apart.

(Source: Lezhin US)

What lies in worlds beyond our own? Is it a bright light and then… nothingness? Or is it another land populated with gorgeous beauty and eldritch horror beyond our recognition? General Hwee-un falls in battle, leaving behind his unspoken love and a life unlived and awakens in a… forest? Malevolent spirits and demons vie for his life until a handsome goblin whisks him away to the Goblin Village and into the court of the Goblin King. Whatever life may exist in the beyond, death is only the beginning.

(Source: Lezhin US)

No romantic relationships! Nam-Hyuk is forced to enroll in SEUM Academy, one of the most prestigious cram schools, and live in the dorms there, where dating is strictly off-limits. But seeing a nurse having sex with a student makes him think the rules can be bent a bit. Will Nam-Hyuk be able to keep his nose in the books and pass the university entrance exam?

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: The Cursed Attendant of the Duke's Castle

description:
When Serenity Theophano rescues an elderly man on the streets, she is inflicted with a deadly curse, solvable only in a limited time. Desperate, she delves into books for a cure until she encounters the cold Duke Aaron Lorang, after which the curse's brand miraculously disappears! Forced to remain close to the duke as an attendant, Serenity navigates his deep mistrust and suspicion of her. Initially planning to use him to escape her curse, she unexpectedly becomes entangled in a new predicament—the duke's growing obsession with her. With time running out, can Serenity untangle the curse binding her fate?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The genius astronomer 'Woo Joo-Hyeok' dies. 15 years later, his resurrection android 'Ryu Seong-Woo' is created. Ryu Seong-Woo, who possesses Woo Joo-Hyeok's face and memories, loves Woo Joo-Hyeok's wife 'Ryu Byeol', but Ryu Byeol rejects him as just a robot... A twisted love story between a pianist who can no longer play the piano due to the trauma of losing her husband, and an android who lives forever despite being lifeless.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yumi, a seemingly average high school girl, is destined to become the wife of and child bearer for Evil. As soon as her first menstrual episodes begin, all sorts of villainous cretins show up in the hopes of providing the seed for wickedness itself. In response, the forces of Good, a Buddhist priest, the Catholic church, and their attendant holy warriors rush to provide protection for the now-pregnable Yumi. But she reaches out to another warrior, a young punk freshman heartthrob who literally beats off the female population of the school with a stick. But when he sees Yumi in a vision, this cool-as-ice thug melts ... and the adventure begins ...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Eunju is a timid, slightly gloomy twenty-year-old with a secret she can never tell anyone. Whenever she holds hands with a man, her body reacts far more intensely than it should. Her quiet life takes a sharp turn when her sunbae Hyeyeong, a self-proclaimed expert in “adult matters,” discovers Eunju’s secret. From that moment on, Hyeyoung decides to take Eunju under her wing, and the two embark into a wild world neither of them came prepared for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

"I just wanted to be a student... where did it all go wrong?"

(Source: Toomics)

He's now a private tutor for his old crush's daughter... tension, flirtation, and messy misreads set the room on fire.

(Source: Toomics)

A society where class is determined from birth, where the strong prey on the weak. Among them, Hwang Ji-Hwan, a rabbit classified as the lowest class and weakest, is treated like trash by society, scraping by through gambling and scams. One day, while pulling off a scam as usual, Ji-Hwan becomes entangled with the fox organization at the apex of this survival-of-the-fittest hierarchy and finds his life threatened.

“He's mine, so you guys can get lost.”

At that moment, the fox Jang Wi-Ran, whom he had slept with by chance three years prior, appears and rescues Ji-Hwan...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The strongest weapon ordered from the future has arrived.

Kim Jun, director of the Agency for Defense Development. In 2024, after a terrorist attack, he meets a tragic end while protecting the South Korean military secret, the ADD chip. However, upon regaining consciousness, he finds himself presented with an unexpected opportunity. He is reborn in the body of his friend Jeon Hyeon-Seung, who died in 1998! Using the ADD chip implanted in his body, Kim Jun gains access to future technologies.

"If you give me the chance... I'll create it for you within three months."

Use future technology to create the ultimate weapon to overcome the IMF crisis!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

If you're born with an ugly face, you have to know where to fit in and where to leave out, and be able to discern what's acceptable and what's not. Noeul considered himself fortunate to have been born with that kind of discernment.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Ichigar, the king, returns to the city without his Guardian. During an investigation following an assassination attempt, he notices Eli, a slave. Despite Eli’s protests, he orders him to be his personal Guardian. As Eli tries to find a way out of his duties, this only attracts the king’s attention.

(Source: Manta)

When Wu-Shin moves into his new place, the last person he expects to run into is Jae-Hyeok, the same guy who made his school days a living hell. Out of work and behind on rent, Jae-Hyeok ends up crashing at Wu-Shin’s apartment, turning his peaceful new start into pure chaos. Instead of the terrifying bully from his memories, Wu-Shin now finds a lazy freeloader who trashes the house and drives him up the wall. But the Jae-Hyeok he remembers wasn’t always like this; he used to shine so brightly it hurt to look. What could have happened to turn him into such a mess, and can Wu-Shin survive living under the same roof as the one man he swore he’d never see again?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Yesol Kim has a celebrity crush. Okay, an obsession, but who doesn’t fantasize about getting intimate with movie stars? It didn’t mean anything was out of the ordinary—at least, not until a succubus interrupted her fantasies to tell her she could make men do whatever she wanted in the pursuit of some naughty fun. It couldn’t possibly have been more than a dream... But she doesn’t have anything to lose by testing it out either, does she? And if it is real, just how far can she take this power?

(Source: Tapas)

Seula has endured a long-standing crush, thinking that being friends would be enough. But when she learns Areum has accepted her boyfriend’s proposal, she breaks down. To soothe her torn heart, she gets drunk and calls her, confessing her feelings. The next day, she wakes up naked next to Areum’s sister, Daun! When Seula begins to piece the pieces of what happened together, she begs Daum to keep this a secret from Areum, to which Daum agrees under one condition…

“Want to keep having a good time together?”

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Driven by a desperate need for money, two college students volunteer to step into Lezhin's darkest sanctuary. Awaiting them is a Doctor whose 'Medical Exams' are as thorough as they are deviant. From physicals and stimulation to various 'treatments', no desire is left unexplored. Surrender to your deepest cravings at the Lezhin Secret Club. All are welcome to witness the corruption.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Bimilkeulleom Danpyeonseon (비밀클럽 단편선) Collection.

The school's three most popular guys are actually someone's exasperating brothers—and someone who loathes attention at that! Haejoo craves a life of mundanity and obscurity, but she's plagued by her three jaw-droppingly handsome brothers who stand out even when they're doing nothing more exciting than breathing. At school, she goes to great lengths to hide the fact that they're related, but what happens when she finally gets busted? Will Haejoo be able to achieve the quiet life she seeks despite being stuck in a school with her three older brothers?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Who Cares if it's a Lie?

description:
They live comfortably on small lies, because, really… who cares if it’s a lie?

(Source: Toomics)

Rotieh Panderion has been entrusted with an important task: She must create "Nectar," an immortality-granting elixir. In return, she will be granted a position among the world's deities. After toiling away for a hundred lifetimes, she's had enough hard work and decides to go on strike! But her latest reincarnation is a poor, illegitimate princess accused of attempted murder. Now, Rotieh must clear her name and restore her lost wealth, but that's easier said than done when she doesn't wanna work!

(Source: Tapas)

When country bumpkin Kang Bong-Soo lands a new office job in the big city, he falls in love at first sight with Yoo Ji-Won, the refined and sophisticated deputy manager in a neighboring department. After initially resigning to silently pine for Ji-Won, Bong-Soo unwittingly spots him making out with a man at a gay club and decides to confess his true feelings. When Bong-Soo’s plans to form an emotional connection go awry as Ji-Won responds with a naughty proposition, the innocent and naïve Bongsoo is caught completely off guard. How will Bong-Soo handle the sudden onset of sexy workplace flirting?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 36 extra chapters.

Jinsoo lives in a boarding house, away from his parents. Luckily for him, he’s got two hot housemates to keep him company, who are more like family than family. But as more and more guests start filling the boarding house, Jinsoo’s life is about to get a whole lot harder - in more ways than one!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: Odd Relations: An Eye for an Eye

description:
After their troubled teen years together, Won-Seo thinks he'll never see his adopted brother, Joo-Hyeon, again. So his life is thrown off balance when Joo-Hyeon suddenly returns to Korea as an adult and shows up at Won-Seo's door. Not only does he act suspiciously playful around Won-Seo, but he even seduces him on his first day back, triggering Won-Seo's repressed feelings of lust and obsession. Even as their bodies mix, there's a question lingering in the air: What could Joo-Hyeon want with Won-Seo after all these years?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Jung-Woo, a kind-hearted soul, follows an injured pigeon he once helped to a hidden spot behind his school. There, he discovers his ideal type: Hae-In, peacefully napping with an angelic presence. Instantly captivated, Jung-Woo feels destined to be with Hae-In and approaches him—only to learn that Hae-In’s type is the opposite of who he is: a ruthless “insane top.” Eight years later, they meet again at a bookstore. A fierce showdown begins between Jung-Woo, determined to prove he’s become the “insane top” of Hae-In’s dreams, and Hae-In, intent on bringing back the sweet man he once fell in love with.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

"I won't date anyone until I make it."

Gerald started work as the assistant to one of the most successful adult webtoon artists. He doesn't want to date anyone, but women keep throwing themselves at him!

(Source: DAYcomics)

Luce, the devil more infamously known as Lucifer, plans a wager with God over the pure-souled Elijah. But when Elijah finds out who he really is and asks him not to give up, Luce becomes his guardian instead — waiting for the day they'll strike a deal that could damn a soul... or change a devil forever.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes two side story chapters.

To clear a debt that isn't his, Han Seong-eun enters a high-stakes contract marriage with Cha Jinwook, a blind billionaire and dominant alpha. The rules are humiliating: Seong-eun must undergo a nightly "physical inspection" to prove his fidelity, yet sex is strictly forbidden outside of their cycles. With a pregnancy clause looming and his husband remaining ice-cold, Seong-eun is trapped in a stalemate. That is, until his brother-in-law, Cha Jinhyeong, moves in. Jinhyeong is bold, dangerous, and more than willing to "help" Seong-eun fulfill his marital duties. In a house full of secrets, Seong-eun is about to learn that playing the brothers against each other is a very dangerous game.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

"I thought I was doomed to endless despair."

Ylledia, an immortal, "trapped" by eternity, feels helpless witnessing her loved ones perish. Her deep sorrow intensifies when she has to let go of the only other immortal in the world. Yet, just as she's losing all hope, a vibrant, golden-haired mortal named Dennis enters her life, suggesting they "link up". The moment Ylledia meets Dennis, a glimmer of hope for the world is rekindled within her. Could this boy be the key to saving the world? Fueled by the newfound hope over their magical connection, Ylledia commits to saving the world once again.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

After his parents remarry, Na-Rim finds himself harboring a forbidden crush on his new stepbrother, Se-Wun. One day, he overhears Se-Wun’s “ideal type” is someone who knows their way around the bedroom - which causes Na-Rim, who doesn’t even have any experience with love or relationships, to panic. Hoping he can teach himself, he impulsively buys a box of sex toys. But when his friend Tae-Hyeon discovers them during a visit, he’s baffled by Na-Rim’s plan…only to make an outrageous offer instead: “Why not practice with me?” Does practice really make perfect, or is Na-Rim’s hope for some action a lost cause?

(Source: Lezhin US)

The hidden dangerous secrets of five stories. Let’s meet them now.

(Source: Mr. Blue, Translated)

1. Peach's Favorite Toy (피치스 페이버릿 토이즈) [Ye-Ju]
2. Catching Shooting Star (캐칭 슈팅스타) [Pyoryu]
3. Love Finger (러브 핑거) [4E]
4. Love Maid (러브 메이드) [Yu-Ri Sin]
5. Bigeopajiman Gwaenchana (비겁하지만 괜찮아) [SAD]

In the year of 2056, androids are a natural presence within China, with their uses ranging from companionship to battle. Enter Xiao Hu, aka XBT-512087, an android made from cutting-edge technology. When he’s assigned to Ling Teng Yun’s military unit, tensions rise while Major Ling deals with his PTSD regarding androids, Xiao Hu uncovers national secrets, and the two of them discover that their relationship is more than what they could have expected from a human military officer and his android assistant.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Rookie actor Lee Yu-myeong was cast in star director Park Jae-jin’s movie ‘Let Me Shine’. As a former swimmer, he had never achieved what he wanted on time in his life. After he gave up his dream of becoming a child actor, he took up swimming, and by the time he quit his career, he was an actor again. The same was true in his love life. Now that he has given up his unrequited love for Park Jae-jin, he can now roll around in the same bed with him.

“You will definitely win a prize this time.” Moreover, the amazing Park Jae-jin is making a boastful speech with his eyes sparkling towards himself.

(Souce: Lezhin, translated)

In the icy lands of the North, the duke battles nightly with an uncontrollable desire that consumes him. Seeking respite, he meets a mysterious wizard who proposes a pact: to quell his urges, the duke must give up his essence for the wizard's research. But just how far are these two willing to go to help one another?

(Source: Lezhin)

Yoon Hee-Woo is blessed with a slim build, a pretty face, and an irresistible charm. There’s just one problem: despite being the toppiest top in the history of tops, everyone insists on treating him like a bottom! His sex life? A tragic comedy of mistaken positions. But one day, fate (or maybe just some shady tech) gifts him a mysterious hypnosis app… Watch out big guys with bigger egos - Yoon Hee-Woo is on the prowl. Bottoms up!

(Source: Lezhin US)

It all starts beneath a treadmill with a suspicious stain that definitely does not belong there. Yonggeun Fitness is one of the most popular personal training gyms in Seongwang-gu District, and its night class in particular is so sought after that male members compete fiercely to get in. When the building’s owner, Seon Bin, discovers a strange residue left behind after one of these late night sessions, he begins to investigate what really goes on after hours in Seongwang-gu. What he uncovers is far from ordinary training. The so called night class turns out to be a secret hotspot where workouts are merely a cover for something far more indecent. Furious that such shameless behavior is happening under his roof, Seon Bin vows to put an end to it no matter what it takes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lee Kyung-Suk, a mother who spent her entire life sacrificing herself for her family. She was the very embodiment of devotion, yet her son, Seo Min-Uk, never once said “thank you.” Living in regret after his mother’s passing, Min-Uk is transported back to the day the family tragedy began—as his maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho—through an unbelievable miracle. His maternal uncle, Lee Dong-Ho. He left after trampling on the family’s dreams and hopes, devouring the family’s entire fortune and bringing everything crashing down. Back in the past, Min-Uk resolves to set things right, but he is confronted by doubts that grow deeper by the day.

“If only our family could escape this rain falling upon the world, would that truly be enough to satisfy us?”

Will his choice to save the past truly make his mother happy? A tale of sacrifice, regret, and redemption begins now!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Dan-i, a Jurchen girl who was saved by General Gyeol Seo during a bandit attack, has to serve tea for him in his house in Hanyang. However, she has to hide her true identity and pretend to be from Joseon, due to the rumors that the general slaughters Jurchen people, regardless of gender or age. Gyeol on the other hand, cannot drink clear water because of a tragic incident that happened when he was young, and has a lot of enemies who want to kill him. Can Dan-i and Gyeol Seo survive against all odds?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes three extra chapter.

As the unfortunate red-hair baby, Tilias is saved at the brink of her death by the beautiful yet penniless Linden family. Reborn as a baby, she's unable to speak or express her gratitude to the Linden family, but that's when she discovers that she sees weather signs on top of people's heads! After countless experiments, she realizes that the weather signs depict people's love affairs. She uses her special ability to read other people's love affairs to her advantage and return the love she received.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

When Oh Jae-Yeol, the president of Hwarang, a criminal organization in Korea’s nationwide district, died in a mysterious accident, internal divisions began as a result of a struggle for succession. The black society, who did not miss the gap, came in to take the place of the Hwarang, causing great chaos. The executives of each region of the Hwarang begin to seize power by developing their own ambitions as they begin to deal with the black society. As a result of the black society, civilian victims begin to appear, but the police and politicians who have already been taken over by the black society and divisions turn away from the victims. Meanwhile, when the mother of Baek-Han Yu, a former special forces unit, tries to drive her black society out of her neighborhood, she is murdered by the black society. Hearing the news, he can’t contain his anger and begins to take revenge against them.

Jae-Yoon Kang has finally decided to find a new place to live because he just can't keep up with the noise. But little did he know, it was quite challenging to find the perfect place in his budget. His last hope is Young-Han Seo, competent realtor with the looks. When Mr. perfect is helping for studio apartment hunt, Jae-Yoon realizes that he's more interested in him than the property hunting. Now, Jae-Yoon is ready to attract Young-Han's attention, by any means necessary.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 3 side stories.

title.english: Saved by the Powerless Little Lady

description:
Although she was born into the renowned House Arachne, poor Riersha is shunned by her family for not having powers like them. But when a previously loyal aide betrays House Arachne, she learns her family was actually trying to protect her all along...! Once she dies by the aide's sword, Riersha wakes up in the past as a four-year-old and discovers that she does have a special power, although she's not quite sure what it does. Now, little Riersha must save her family by getting the traitorous aide on her side and using her mysterious power to protect them...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.

title.english: The Beast of Bahal Never Misses its Prey

description:
Jarn comes to the capital to search for his missing aunt - and somehow ends up employed at the estate of the mysterious Duke Ordin. His job? Feeding the unidentified “monster” locked in the basement. Uh, sure. Things take a sharper turn when he accidentally sleeps with the Duke, and now Jarn’s juggling monster-sitting, sneaking around for clues about his aunt, and…discovering some very unexpected pleasures as a late-blooming virgin. Between horny dukes and basement creatures, Yarn’s hands are both metaphorically and physically full, and he has no idea what truths are waiting for him at the end of it all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Song has had problems down there for some time now. His best friend Mike, comes up with an event to solve this problem once and for all…

(Source: Toomics)

Zhang Yuan ascends through cultivation, only to arrive in a bizarre and terrifying world. Above the nine heavens lurk horrifying immortal Buddhas and gods, while mortals below are raised like livestock… Strange and deadly “anomalies” infest the land, and cultivators who are neither fully human nor ghost cling desperately to survival… Can this world still have a future? Zhang Yuan doesn’t care. All he wants is to ascend once more and return to the Immortal Realm. But… can he truly go back?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Wu Wei Xian Shi Deng Bainian
title.english: I've Waited for the Fairy Teacher for Hundreds of Years

description:
I'll wait for you for as long as forever.

Fairy Teacher Xing Li is on a mission to seal an evil relic when he falls into the Mortal Realm and loses his memory. Nuo Qing, his self-proclaimed disciple, takes him home. But only when an old friend visits does Xing Li realize that Nuo Qing has been waiting hundreds of years for him?

(Source: Manta)

Five years ago, his older brother mysteriously vanished after defeating a hidden boss in the game World of the Immortal King. While the rest of the family gave up the search, he remained convinced that his brother’s disappearance is connected to the game somehow. For five years, he relentlessly challenged the same boss again and again. On his 17,860th attempt, he finally defeated the stage - and was immediately invited to cross over into the game world by a mysterious guide.

There, he learns that his only chance to bring his brother back is by completing the Immortal King’s Trial. Willing to risk everything to reach his goal, he soon discovers that the so-called trial is nothing more than a deceptive scheme - a trap from which no one has ever escaped.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Cheng Yi Nuo was badly framed by her sister. She did not want to give in to fate. She wanted to rely on her intelligence to be an entertainment reporter. She did not expect to shoot on the first mission to her boss?

One is an intelligent AI that can satisfy all the fantasies about a perfect partner, and the other is the former first love of Ye Yunchen. If this is a matter of choice, most people know how to choose. However, when these two appeared in front of Ye Yunchen at the same time, it made him fall into a tangle...

(Source: Mangatoon)

Born on June 6th of 2013, Maji Meow is a white Taiwanese kitten born from a swelling hot piece of white jade peanut toast from 2gether restaurant. This is about its cute and funny daily life.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

title.romaji: Langya Bang Zhi Feng Qi Chang Lin

description:
A fantastical slice-of-life story about all the birds from Chinese legend, living as humans in the modern day.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

An arrogant young man with supernatural powers and a seductive fox-spirit work together to save the youkai tribes.

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

Sonia Syland, the only princess of Syland Empire, fell ill and died in her youth. Be pitied by goddess, she reborn to 10 years ago and lived her life again. In her second life, she found that there was a great conspiracy behind her painful death. The beloved father and brothers, who is the one that framed her? In this new life, Sonia made up her mind to live...

(Source: Web Comics)

Chu Yu had eternal resurrecting ability because of a magical jade. From the moment she realised that, the surroundings in the forbidden palace began to be dangerous. It was her grandmother who gave the jade to her, saying she must not leave it. However, she didn't expect that jade can save her from death.

(Source: Mangatoon)
A story about two hamsters?!

You Xi is composed of fragmented “moments” or “events.” They may be easily overlooked or fleeting: a moment of reverie, a snowflake melting away, overlapping dreams, the alternating of night and day, or the waxing and waning of the moon. They may fill one’s heart with joy, or leave one feeling wistful: a book, clouds drifting freely, a room all to oneself, an ice cream encountered by chance on a rainy or snowy day, or an unexpected turn of events…

The little white man and the man in the hat live in solitude and tranquility within their respective worlds, offering both subtle contrasts and romantic, magnificent echoes.

(Source: Douban, machine translated)

A disabled inspector finds himself caught in the schemes of a beautiful yet cunning courtesan. Unable to live without the blood of the courtesan, he is forced to take notice of the young beauty. And so begins a love-hate story between two men that's rooted in blood and tragedy.

(Source: INKR)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 11 extras.

Yo-Na believes a “Power Top” is the key to his happiness. He’s suppressed his gangster nature for years, posing as a delicate flower to catch "the one." When he sees the handsome, masculine Ro-Hyun at a dessert shop, he thinks he’s hit the jackpot. Unfortunately, Ro-Hyun is actually the sweetest, gentlest soul on earth. Now, Yo-Na is on a mission of blood, sweat, and tears to man up this sweet cinnamon roll. It’s a hilarious battle of wills as a fake flower tries to force a fake hunk to grow some balls.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

“This is all Dad's fault!!”

The year is 2026. Kang-Kwon, who takes after his father, is a frail 159 cm tall and weighs just 51 kg. After being bullied at school every day, he falls from the rooftop. In 1996, Kang-Kwon wakes up in the body of his uncle, Choi Kang-Kwon, who stands 188 cm tall and weighs 71 kg. Dad’s best friend. But contrary to expectations, Uncle Choi Kang-Kwon was actually a total loser who got bullied...

Now taller but still a loser, (Choi) Kang-kwon’s very difficult (?) high school life in 1996 begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: The Emperor is HARD to Please!

description:
Wealth, power, glory. Emperor Eric Dyk has it all... except his "Dyk" refuses to get up for some reason! Unfortunately, he must choose a wife to produce an heir, or the empire he toiled to unite will collapse. Then, Eric's prayers are answered in the form of Cindy, a foul-mouthed spunky young maid who can somehow get him stiff with sheer abuse. After some convincing, Cindy joins hands with Eric to discover the issue behind his dysfunction. Will they be able to find the cure to this hard situation, or will the empire be doomed to a permanent dry spell?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Seung-Yeon is popular for her pretty face, tall stature, and unique aura. she works at a Pc cafe, where she gets cheap self-esteem from the men who show her favour, who are favourable to her. Now in her fourth year, she knows she should be focusing on her studies, but Seung-Yeon can't quit her job at the café easily...

(Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

title.romaji: Masinneun Se Kki - Just The Two Of Us
title.native: 맛있는 세 끼 - 저스트 더 투 오브 어스

description:
Dr. Cha Soo-Hyuk is a pediatric trauma surgeon who grew up in America after being adopted. Now he's back in Korea in search of his birth parents, but from the nosy strangers to the spicy food, he's having a really tough time! Then one day, he runs into Lee Yoo-Na, the owner of "Mouthwatering Meals" who has a fear of men. In an attempt to overcome her trauma, she cooks for him, and her food matches his tastes perfectly. Now, he only eats what she cooks for him, for all three meals of the day!

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Both R15 and R19 versions are the same up to chapter 39.

title.romaji: Psycho-na Koushaku wa Diana-nomi wo Kyou Aisu
title.native: サイコな公爵はダイアナのみを狂愛す

description:
The Duke just kidnapped her — but little does he know, this is all going exactly according to her plan… When Diana initially lets herself get kidnapped by a bloodthirsty duke from an enemy empire, it's to avoid a certain death that will reduce her character's significance to nothing. Although the duke doesn't realize that she's enjoying her captivity, he's also not as ignorant as Diana thinks. How far is she willing to go to keep this story plot line exactly where she wants it to be?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.

One day before receiving a massive sum of 19.5 billion won, the protagonist, An Ji-Heon, is murdered by hitmen. When he opens his eyes again, he instinctively realizes that something he’s only ever seen in movies is happening to him.

A time travel journey that goes backward one day at a time! When he wakes up, it’s not tomorrow—it’s yesterday. But the novelty wears off quickly. With 19.5 billion won just within reach, Ji-Heon, who finds himself drifting further away from it with each passing day, resolves to escape this phenomenon by any means necessary, regardless of whether it’s time travel or not.
