“I can’t just sit here and turn into a newborn baby. I’m getting my 19.5 billion won back, no matter what!!”

The protagonist, An Ji-Heon’s, blood, sweat, and tears-filled journey to escape ‘The Minus’ begins.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

I found myself possessed by the body of “Villainous Supporting Character No. 1,” who gets executed just for making a snide remark to the female lead, who seemed close to the male lead.

“I’m just Villainous Supporting Character No. 1 anyway. If I don’t do it, someone else will.”

With that in mind, I tried my best not to get involved with any of the characters in the original story, and the story ended without incident. But then, the secondary male lead from the original story came looking for me.

“By any chance, are you interested in a contract marriage?”

He asked, waving a contract in front of me with the sweetest expression on his face.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: My Fantasies Are Cumming to Life?!

description:
Park Seojin is the very picture of a ladylike woman. She’s elegant, modest, and works harder than anyone at her successful job at a large corporation. Or, at least that’s the image of herself that Seojin has carefully crafted in order to indulge in her actual hobbies: reading hardcore smut! In reality, Seojin is just your average 'otaku,' fangirling and obsessing over steamy romance novels every night. Lately, her new obsession has been the one man in her life who remotely resembles a male lead in her romance novels - her boss, Yoon Taehyun! However, Seojin knows that her fantasies are destined to stay just that - fantasies. They're employee and boss, and nothing could change that. But when Yoon Taehyun discovers a crack in her perfectly curated persona, could their relationship potentially change into something else?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: Her Ladyship Objects to this Marriage!

description:
Lady Kyriel, the strong-willed commandant of the Alteion Empire, does not want to get married. However, when she finds herself in an arranged union, she is surprised to find that it is with a cordial but mysterious sorcerer named Idwin. He somehow checks all her boxes—the boxes she made sure were impossible to check. Kyriel’s unbreakable vow and Idwin’s inescapable fate take them on a journey to their higher purpose—one that involves the past and future of empires and churches..

(Source: Tapas)

Feeling down? Stop by Cunimaru – a cozy shop where souls waiting for reincarnation gather to reminisce about their happiest memories. Savor a warm cup of tea and join Ji-Un Lee, Cunimaru’s new owner, as she embarks on a journey of healing, both for herself and her new friends, while unraveling the mysteries of this whimsical afterlife retreat.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

One year after the end of the zombie outbreak that swept through Korea, Doyoung, who lost her younger brother to a zombie, one day accidentally meets Jion, a student who closely resembles the zombie that bit her brother.

A friendship full of suspicion between two people that continues in a risky manner. Can this relationship last?

(source: Lezhin, translated)

One winter evening brings Se-Won and college senior Woo-Hyun together — and a night of passion leaves the omega with a secret child. Six years later, Woo-Hyun returns, unaware of the truth. As old feelings resurface, Se-Won must protect his son... even if it means pushing away the alpha he never forgot.

(Source: Manta)

Prince Flynn of Albion is adored for his charm and good looks-but the endless dating rumors? Not so much. Tired of the gossip, he proposes a bold idea to his secretary, Drew: pretend to date him to control the narrative. It’s all for show…until Drew starts seeing Flynn in a different light. Can a staged romance turn into something real?

(Source: Lezhin US)

“I don't need your help, so get lost, you bastard.”

Jelim, who had suffered another defeat in his second-ever Champions League final, was once again embroiled in rumors of a rift after rudely brushing off Aaron, the opposing team's striker and his former youth teammate, who had reached out to him. Since they really didn’t get along, it was more accurate to say they were actually at odds rather than just rumors of a rift. Anyway, since they were in different leagues, I didn’t give it a second thought.

“Let’s do better from now on, Jelim.”

That is, until a month later, when Aaron decided to join the same club as me. It’s shitty enough just to be on the same team as the guy who just screwed me over in the last final, but on top of that, he’s my ex-boyfriend from way back when. And we broke up in the worst possible way.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Gwak Chang-Hyeok, the homeroom teacher with a poor reputation among students. Je Yil-Ro, who has a fetish for ‘dirty personalities and glasses,’ develops a peculiar interest in him. Then, Je Yil-Ro witnesses Gwak Chang-Hyeok talking to his girlfriend with an unusually gentle expression. That moment ignites a flame within Je Yil-Ro's twisted desires. After that, half out of curiosity and half for fun, he devises a plan to approach Gwak Chang-Hyeok...

When boiling a frog, you must use low heat. That way, the frog doesn't realize it's being boiled alive, and you can gobble it up in one bite.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

“Hey, do you know me?”

“How the hell would I know you?”

A tall, pretty-faced guy who’d just appeared in front of Do Geon-U, a man who’d led a rough life, suddenly started hitting on him right to his face. As he lay there, overwhelmed by this persistent guy who’d followed him all the way to a hotel room, the face of that kid, whose lips had drooped like a rain-soaked puppy under the streetlights in early summer, overlapped with his own.

“Why are you having sex with some other guy after drinking the booze I bought you?”

Only then did Do Geon-U realize it. He had lived his life forgetting that he had been that kid’s first love back when he was young—that little midge flitting around the orange glow that night.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
Note: Part of Luscent's Segyejipchakjeonjip Danpyeonseon (세계집착전집 단편선) Collection.

As the 13th Imperial Prince and the last in line to the throne, Kilad was happy to live outside the palace as Captain of the Imperial Border Guards. With his childhood friend Alkina, Kilad had made it his life's mission to defend the World Tree that grows in Noble, a territory of the Drakuntus Empire. However, Kilad's life takes an unexpected turn when his older brother, Elliott, is assassinated. To everyone's surprise, Elliott had named Kilad as his successor to the Drakuntus throne.The 13th Imperial Prince must now lead the empire while protecting his life and the lives of those he holds dear.

(Source: Manta)
Note: Part of Luscent's Segyejipchakjeonjip Danpyeonseon (세계집착전집 단편선) Collection.

The strongest god in the world craves just one thing: the thrill of a real fight. Tired of being unbeatable, Mu – god of Earth – possesses the body of a weak high schooler to relive the joy of combat. But when his divine form is sealed by his enemy, Mu must grow stronger in his new mortal body to fight back. Can fists alone satisfy a god’s hunger... or will his obsession be his downfall?

(Source: WEBTOON)
Note: Part of Luscent's Segyejipchakjeonjip Danpyeonseon (세계집착전집 단편선) Collection.

Sanwoo is spending his summer employed as a custodian of an old house, where his lonely days are filled with nothing but manual labor and reflections on the past. One day, however, Sunwoo’s solitude is interrupted by the arrival of Eunjae, the handsome young heir of the house. As old memories and feelings come flooding back, slowly the two boys slip into a steamy summer passion. But when another visitor comes looking for Eunjae, that’s when things really begin to heat up…

(Source: Lezhin) Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

The simplest of choices can shape our lives forever. Returning to college after a break, Kwon Yoonho decides to take a pottery class. But what he doesn’t know is that his instructor will be Lee Suyeon: a professor with a reputation for favoritism whom all the students go out of their way to avoid. Yet from the moment Yoonho lays eyes on his new teacher, he recognizes the same quality of isolation and solemnity that has been ever-present in his own life. The two begin to mold a deeper connection as their lives become intertwined; but when Suyeon’s ex-boyfriend – and first love – Choi Gyeol makes a sudden appearance, an unbridled sense of jealousy and possessiveness becomes impossible for Yoonho to ignore. Will this unexpected interruption cause the foundations of their love to shatter? And if it does, who will be left to pick up the pieces...?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Haunted by guilt, detective Jeong Hae-Il flees his past in Daegu, seeking refuge in his hometown of Seoul. But the city isn't as forgiving as he'd hoped. Soon, he's forced to confront the ghosts of his trauma when he crosses paths with his old flame, Jun-Seon, now tangled up in a dangerous new drug. Just when things couldn't get more complicated, a mysterious ally named Han-Gyeol emerges from the shadows—but can Hae-Il really trust him? In a city filled with secrets, can any of them overcome the odds?

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Includes six extra chapters.

'Cherry' is forced to go on a trip to Paris following a travel app due to her sister's threats. In a completely new place, he encounters his very familiar rival, 'Lemon'.

'Cherry' tries to ignore 'Lemon', which makes him angry, and accidentally meets his partner 'Peach', and is drawn to 'Peach' who perfectly matches her ideal type...

The three become partners at the same time due to an error in the travel app of 'Lemon', 'Cherry', and 'Peach' as ​​if they interfered with the love of 'Cherry'!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

title.english: The Secret Life of Professor Ha

description:
Jaeyoung is a young, promising professor of Business at K University. A long-time favorite among students for his excellent lectures and kindness, it seems like he has everything a man would wish for. But even he had a little secret - Jaeyoung is a big-time otaku of magical girl animes. Then one day, a student of his, Saewoong, finds him holding a dakimakura, effectively exposing Jaeyoung's otaku lifestyle. Desperate to keep his double life a secret, Jaeyoung agrees on a deal with Saewoong that would shake his life...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: The chapter count includes 11 extras.

In a world with supernatural abilities, those with powers can be registered as “special humans” and are assigned missions shrouded in mystery. Hoyeon, one such person, lives a seemingly ordinary life as a college student while keeping his powers a secret from those around him. When he begins a new job as a tutor at the Special Human Resource Administration, he meets Moonsung, an agent who just so happens to be taking his class. A simple teacher-student relationship, there’s nothing more to it - that is, until a single touch from Moonsung causes Hoyeon’s powers to spiral out of control. As their connection deepens, Moonsung soon realizes there’s more to his tutor than meets the eye…but will he be able to unravel the mystery of the connection between the two of them?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hangyeom, who was an ordinary college student, has the ability to have lucid dreams as he wishes for some reason and dreams of sharing a relationship with his unrequited love partner, Lee Jun.

At the same time, the contents of his dream were shared with Jun Lee, and Jun Lee was confused about his identity and encountered him at the bar where he worked. Later, after learning that he was attending the same college, Lee Joon wondered about the relationship between his dream and a man, and suggested to make a relationship with himself...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Hyejun, a feisty female bodyguard, is hired by the young Jaehyun, but when she walks into his house, it’s full of… more guards. But instead of protecting him, they're keeping him there. To hide her true identity as his personal guard, she goes undercover by pretending to be his girlfriend. One day, their undeniable attraction pulls them together to share a kiss. Now, as the lie seeps into their reality, having a strictly professional relationship is becoming less of an option.

(Source: Tapas)

For all his life, Lee Dan has often found himself abandoned. It began with being left in a box outside as a baby and most recently when his boyfriend and roommate cheated on him. While feeling lost on the streets, he is picked up by Yeo Jeongheon, who allows Dan to stay at his place for as long as he requires. Since Jeongheon is an alpha, his intentions of bringing home Dan, an omega, seem obvious. But when Dan offers to repay him with his body, Jeongheon firmly rejects him and instead tries to care to his every need. This confuses Dan as the only alphas he’s encountered are ones who tried to take advantage of him. Perhaps Jeongheon has some other hidden motives, or he actually could be the sweetest alpha Dan has ever met…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 20 extra chapters.

Ji Seo-Jun is someone who has been by my side for most of my life, from birth all the way through high school. But being good friends with such a handsome guy caused all sorts of trouble for me, Mun Da-Yul, at school. I swore to myself that I wouldn't put up with it anymore. But… after getting drunk one night, I found myself waking up the next morning naked in bed in a strange hotel room, sleeping next to Ji Seo-Jun! Can our friendship of 29 years still be saved?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Secretary Han has been working for the same family for years, so he watched the young master of the house grow up and has always doted on him. But now his beloved young master has taken a special interest in him. Unable to say no to his beautiful young master, they start a steamy sexual relationship. However, Secretary Han is in for an unexpected surprise because his master is going to show him what it’s really like to be under him.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Due to his phobia of women, Inhwee has never dated anyone in his life, despite lying about being a "relationship expert" to everyone at school. So when Jeongwon comes to him and asks for "kissing lessons," Inhwee reluctantly agrees. But why do Jeongwon's "lessons" keep getting more specific and intimate? And why does Inhwee find himself actually aroused? While Inhwee spends more time with Jeongwon trying to figure all of this out, he is terrified his friends might get suspicious. As long as he keeps up his macho act, no one is going to catch on... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes four extra chapters,

Ancient Egypt... where the pharaoh Cairo, the son of the sun god, resides. Perfect face, perfect physique, endless treasure of silver and gold ? but still, Cairo has worries. Life for him is simply an endless cycle of death and resurrection and he's getting bored of it. And so, he wants to find out the meaning of life. He wants to find a purpose! This is where the ever helpful Imhotep steps in, to suggest that the Pharaoh should, then, try going on a blind date!

A shy freshman girl has a crush on a charming sophomore in her class. She dreams of a relationship with him, but when he starts talking to her anonymously as "Anonymous7," she discovers his hidden promiscuous side. What happens when her innocent crush meets reality?

(Source: Toomics)

At 29, Eun-Seong is told she’ll die by autumn. She skips chemo, quits her job, leaves her mother’s house, and dyes her hair for the first time in her life. Then, on a whim, she adds one last thing: a night with a stranger who prefers no-strings-attached encounters. She decides to stay with him until autumn—when her time runs out.

(Source: Manta)

My boss is thoughtful, and his wife is gentle and beautiful, but I'm committing embezzlement under their noses. While doing so, I ended up sleeping with my boss's wife against my will.

"D-Do you really think he'll like this?"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Su-Min O, a student who has been studying to get into a prestigious university, is concentrating on studying and aiming for gold for the final college entrance exam… But his sexy next door neighbor is his tutor?!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Seo Jeong-In, the second son of a wealthy judge's family, fails to get into the university his father wants, unlike his older brother. Consequently, he ends up in a dormitory at a rural cram school catering to upper-class students. Having been aware of his sexual identity from an early age, Jeong-In has been enjoying a free-spirited and indulgent gay lifestyle. However, things turn for the worse when his dorm roommate, Seung-Hyun, captures footage of Jeong-In in a sticky situation with his friend Han Min-Woo using a hidden camera installed in their room...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

How can one ever be satisfied with just one? That's Haru's life motto. As usual, he lures a younger guy who enters his strike zone and devours him whole. Not bad for a hetero guy being his first~ he thinks for a split second, Did this guy just eat me up??!!

The more he thinks about it, the more infuriating it gets—that big-dicked, handsome, cute, infuriating bastard! He happens to run into him again in a college liberal arts class, but this time he claims not to know him... His speech and behavior are completely different. Is this some kind of concept thing...?

What...? He's a twin...? That's a lie, right...?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Rule one of harboring a secret crush: never get your hopes up. Especially if your crush is the nicest person you’ve ever seen. Yeon-U’s kind, thoughtful, and gentle—everything that Gyu-Yeong wants his significant other to be. The problem is that Yeon-U’s nice to everyone, not just Gyu-Yeong. Gyu-Yeong knows that he’s not special to Yeon-U, but sometimes he wants to give in to the little voice in his heart. Maybe all of this does mean something, maybe Yeon-U thinks that he’s special, maybe Gyu-Yeong will be allowed to build his hopes up, just this once.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Season 2 is rated R19.

During a chance meeting, Princess Asché shares an unforgettable kiss with Ethan, the second prince of a nearby empire. Years later, Asché’s brother arranges a marriage that will force her to become the Emperor’s ninth wife. Rather than suffer in a loveless union, Asché poisons her brother, and is imprisoned in the palace for her crime. But as revolution stirs, Ethan, now an anti-imperial rebel, suddenly reappears in her bedroom, and a steamy romance fraught with political implications begins.

(Source: Tapas)

Choi Jae-Won was living a carefree life abroad, surrounded by playful alphas and chasing nothing but pleasure. But when his father lures him back to Korea, he’s blindsided by a wedding—his own. The groom turns out to be Yang Joon-Hee, a childhood friend who’s grown into everything Jae-Won’s ever wanted. And before he can make sense of it, the vows are already said. Joon-Hee insists they once made a promise. Jae-Won doesn’t remember it... but something in him starts to respond anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

“Every night, when the bell strikes 13 times, he comes to me…”

Father Gabriel has lived with the guilt that he was responsible for the death of his friend, Saliou. One day, Albertini, a mysterious philanthropist with a cold, magnetic gaze, offers him salvation. In return, Gabriel must offer himself—his body, his blood, his very soul—to satisfy Albertini’s vampiric lust. Lost in this temptation, Gabriel reunites with Saliou, who has his own dark secrets... as a werewolf during the full moon.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Wolves and foxes have been living with humans to breed. There's a rule that they cannot hang out or fall in love with each other since they are rivals when it comes to breeding. But wolf Han Sirang and fox Kim Ho are attracted to each other and break that rule by secretly continuing their dangerous relationship...

Winner of the 5th MrBlue Comic Contest

After being hit by a car, Im Jinhyuk spends a long time in a coma, only to magically awaken in the past, the day before things all began to go downhill for his family. While unconscious, Jinhyuk lived as the almighty Heavenly Demon, Chunma, and now that he's back in the modern world, he's brought Chunma's abilities back with him! Determined to ensure a different fate for himself and his family, Jinhyuk uses his powers to master his father's recipes and help make their bakery the best in town!

(Source: Tapas)

Mo-Ah, the daughter of a fresh fruit shaved ice shop, who always helps her father's shop every summer. She thought this summer would go by like any other— but the moment she sees the new part-timer her father brought in, all her expectations melt away like shaved ice.

"You work here too, sister? You're awesome!"

A playful voice, a face with a sly smile. The troublesome delinquent Park Si-Heon that she bumped into on the last day of school was right in front of her! The guy she hoped to never see again came in as a part-timer this summer. The two people who had a shaky start clashing every day at the shop—

words colder than shaved ice and emotions hotter than the sun start to mix in the shop.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Tae-Ju, the youngest son of the GG Group, a conglomerate with a long history. Living in a family that forces crazyness, he is called 'the epitome of crazy and in fact loves cute dolls and sweet desserts. However, such a shameful taste is a secret that he must take to the grave! As the day approaches when he will represent the family, he knows better than anyone that he will have to put it all down someday. Tae-Ju, who consoles himself that this is really the last time, hires a new secretary, Eun-Na, under the pretense of researching a new business, and urges her to accompany him on his dessert cafe tour disguised as work. However, Eun-Na begins to misunderstand his actions in a completely different way...

A boss who hides his taste, and a secretary who has misunderstandings. A strange tension begins to flow between the two!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A story about a man in the friend-zone. All brave men of culture know the feeling. But when the girl he loves suddenly breaks up with her boyfriend, he realizes the friend zone is more penetrable than he thought.

(Source: TOPTOON+)

Note: Chapter count includes 8 side stories.

This story, which has been passed down for a long time, is a story from heaven. A long, long time ago, there were six rulers in Heaven. Each ruler had their own role to perform for the harmony of the world. 

The Ruler of Darkness had the power to draw anything and erase anything. The Ruler of Light knitted light to shine on the Earth. The Ruler of Flames danced to create eternal flames. The Ruler of Water brewed alchohol and showered water on the Earth. The Ruler of the Earth plowed the fields to enrich everything. The Ruler of the Wind played the flute to generate the winds.

Each of the rulers had supreme power, yet they could not do everything themselves. Therefore each of the rulers had many spirits as servants. Amongst these servants, those with superior talents became the beloved sons & daughters of the rulers. This story is about the son of the Ruler of the Wind, GYON-WOO. And the daughter of the Ruler of Light, JIK-NYU.

After starving for several months, I picked up and ate unknown food in a temple I had entered to beg at, and when I opened my eyes again... A man called the devil who will destroy the world was in front of me.

"If you ate it, you should be responsible for what happens?"

I ate the source of his power, so he spit out strange words about taking responsibility. I have to get away from this madman before he splits my stomach!

"Body contact is the most effective way to exchange power between humans. The most effective method is to sleep together..."

"Ah, this is reasonable. It can't be helped. It's good. One by one, step by step, shall we try it? Starting with sleeping together."

I couldn't ask him why it would be one by one, step by step. I felt like I would be eaten up just by his black eyes. Are you... Are you actually a villain who destroys the world with your beauty?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: The Incubus, the Saintess, and the Scumbag

description:
Saintess Serylta is tasked by God to marry the crown prince and continue the holy bloodline within the empire. Just before her wedding, a mysterious client hires two incubi to sabotage her divine mission. But Serylta is hardly a pure worker of God in the bedroom, as she quickly dominates them both with her “holy powers,” turning them into her submissive pets. And obeying their new master, the incubi reveal the perverted truth behind the scumbag who hired them...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Grayson Miller’s life goal is to find his soulmate. A fortune-teller told him that his destiny lies with “someone with a big heart who’s connected to fire.” Then, Grayson lost consciousness after accidentally encountering an Extreme Omega firefighter in the midst of a blaze! When Grayson entered the fire station to find him, he got into a huge fight with firefighter Dane and ended up getting entangled with him...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Ye-Won Han, a career woman who is honest and takes the lead in company work more than anyone else. In fact, she has a secret that she cannot tell anyone, and it is that she reveals it more than anyone else! Ye-Won, who has fun when she plays and maintains and manages her reputation as a perfect career woman at work, is faced with a crisis. Choi Eun-Ho, who she slept with last night, has joined a different team. Will Ye-Won be able to protect her reputation?

(Source: BookCube, translated)

Nectrella, a necromancer of Kastuul's bloodline, has taken his lover captive. To reclaim her, the berserker Thane throws himself into a desperate, life-or-death battle.

(Source: Naver, translated)

One day, dull office worker Yura gains the power to enchant others, and with it, she sets out to bend the corporate world to her will.

(Source: Toomics)

With a racing heart, Jinho makes his way to Room 609, where Yunsoo is waiting for him. Yunsoo, the dreamy, blond, green-eyed stud he’s had a crush on since forever. If he’s lucky, he'll get to kiss him. If he's really lucky, he'll get to blow him. And one day, he’ll get to go all the way... Deep down, Jinho knows being secret f-buddies isn’t what he truly wants. But what can he do to turn a crush into something more?

(Source: Lezhin)

The "Heavenly Demon", a legend born only once in ten thousand years.
Two geniuses have emerged in the same era. Among them, who is the true Heavenly Demon? Will they stand together as allies, or face off as sworn enemies?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Tokkiya, Oneul Bamen Muneul Yeoreo Dwo
title.english: Bunny, Leave the Door Open Tonight
title.native: 토끼야, 오늘 밤엔 문을 열어 둬

description:
Chesterville’s resident romance novelist, Sweetpea Rabbithole, knows how to write desire—but she’s never tasted it. Determined to change that, she sets out to find someone who can show her what she’s been missing. But when her childhood friend Edward learns of her plan, he's determined to be her first and only lesson. With a mask, a mysterious identity, and a master plan to show her he can be more than the little boy she grew up with, will these friends finally realize what was there all along?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunae Danpyeonseon (순애 단편선) Collection.

Delivery’s here~ A second-year rider specializing in fight deliveries, highschooler or older. One day, he receives an offer for a huge-paying job… but the client seems anything but ordinary.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Dr. Lee Sun-Woo is one of the nation's finest scientists, who dreams of a world where every human (including men) can conceive a child. Unfortunately, he eventually has to shut down his project. During his now ample free time, he happens to run into an old crush, a friend's older brother, Eun-Gyo. In any other world, this situation may be normal, but not when Sun-Woo's (extremely vocalized) desire is for Eun-Gyo's sperm!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Larry is a comic senile old man, tending to his daily life. He needs plenty of help, but where could he possibly find it?

(Source: Toomics)

A new coach is appointed to the basketball team of Jisang High School, one of the weakest in the country.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In “The Tale of the Land of Velpera,” Elizabeth Lily is said to be the most brilliant sorceress of the century. But in real life, little Ellie is abused and enslaved for her ability to summon demons. That is until she's rescued by the powerful sorcerer Ashelotte Vayne, Elizabeth’s sworn enemy in the story! Now, this unlikely pair must work together so that Ellie can overcome the dark forces which threaten her and fulfill her destiny as the one and only Elizabeth Lily!

(Source: Tapas)

Ye-Ju, an ordinary alpha college student, is cast into another world—mistaken for a slave and claimed by a nobleman. But the task awaiting him is not labor. As the nobleman’s true nature begins to surface, Ye-Ju finds himself trapped between desire, danger, and a longing to return home.

(Source: Manta)

Five years have passed since a blameless infant was spared from a demonstration, saved by her parents' self-sacrifice. Yet what should have ended the religious hysteria has instead fueled a new wave of feverish cult practices by the ever-growing Arrowhead. As society teeters on the brink of further chaos and long-dead sinners inexplicably begin returning to life, the government steps in behind the scenes to tip the scales.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Kim Tae-Sik is a young man who would much rather spend his time at internet cafes, playing games, than going to work and filling out papers. After getting fired from his job, he ends up seeing a mouse cursor and follows it, leading him to a group of delinquents who earlier beat him up. Seeing how the cursor changes to a knife shape, Kim Tae-Sik decides to fight the delinquents head on and ends up winning.

From there on, he chooses to follow the mouse cursor and wherever it leads him, as he believes that it has all the answers and keys to his purpose in life.

A pair of girl prodigies rival each other from middle school to their senior year in high school. The delicate balance is broken when one catches up to the other in piano skill. The rivalry then turns into obsession.

Lee Chan left without a word, and Seo-Ho was left alone without even having time to ask why. Now that they’ve met again as adults, Seo-Ho finds himself torn once more. Seo-Ho tries to avoid bringing up the past, and Lee Chan, in the end, can’t bring himself to say anything. Even now that they’ve reunited, there are still so many things left unsaid between them.

“Seo-Ho, being left alone feels really lonely. Did you feel this way too?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Baek Dong-hee, a high school student who once pursued his dream of being the best b-boy in the world, but lost his dreams and hopes due to an accident. One day, he meets Kwon Jin-i, a girl who works out with a bare body, and his life, which had stopped, begins to move again.

After Tiarosetti learns from her Guide that sacrificing herself to save the male lead, Lexion Spero, and following the plot is the only way to return to her world, she desperately carries out her role. But confusion strikes when she wakes up where her story starts, and Lexion saves her before he should. The Guide states she's now the main character, and Lexion isn't the male lead! Can Tiarosetti find her way home, or will Lexion's inconsistent behavior shackle her to his world forever?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: How to Put Your Savior on the Throne

description:
When Ines is sent back in time, she vows revenge on the man who betrayed her. But just as she’s consumed by vengeance, she crosses paths with Carson — the man who once saved her life in her previous timeline. Drawn together, they find that saving each other may be the key to healing themselves.

(Source: Manta)

Alpha Yeon In-Jun and Omega Kwon Se-In fell in love in high school but remained friends. However, that changes when Choi Jae-Kyung steals Se-In away by imprinting on him while In-Jun is studying abroad. But when In-Jun and Jae-Kyung get into a car accident, In-Jun wakes up in the other alpha's body! He slowly learns of Jae-Kyung's schemes to take advantage of Se-In's family connections and does his best to protect his omega. Will In-Jun and Se-In get their happily ever after, or has Jae-Kyung damaged their relationship beyond repair?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra.

"Congratulations on being born."

Once I opened my eyes, I was in a cold laboratory. I wasn't born because I wasn't human, I was created, but she still celebrates it nevertheless.

I learned how to live by drinking coffee together, smelling the scent, hearing the sound of decoration shaking due to the wind, and becoming close to the rabbit who often came to visit the garden.

However...

"Actually, in a week from now, I'm going to die."

She, who neither complains about pain or reveals her pain, is calm, but why does my heart hurt so much? I was also a person who could shed tears.

"Why did you create me? Why did you make me like you?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Se-Rin, the cold and aloof ice queen, and Jin-Hyung, an ordinary college student. They seem perfectly normal in front of others, but when they’re together, they turn into complete fools.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Melvin is a complete loser whose life suddenly turns into a dating sim game. Will he rise to the challenge to become the Lord of the Harem?

(Source: Toomics)

I suddenly woke up in the body of Melinia, a supporting character and the first love of Male Lead A from Azuli's Magnificent Misfortune. Since I know how this tragic tale ends, I decided to do what I can to stop the ultimate destruction of the kingdom from the male leads. But the more I try to fix things, I can't help but notice that the storyline seems to veer farther away from what I read. Will this plan of mine work? Or will it just cause more harm than the original?

(Source: Tapas)

For most, kumdo is just a hobby. Practitioners are there to entertain and Si-ho Ye is the best entertainer of them all. Quicker, more agile, and more experienced than most, he was a force to be reckoned with in the kumdo world. Si-ho was content living his life as the best at something that barely mattered until the day his sister died. Convinced she was murdered and determined to take revenge, Si-ho sets out to show the dark underbelly of Korea why swordsmen were once revered…and feared.

(Source: Tapas)

Jacqueline, a girl who had to survive in the abandoned lands at the border of three nations. Her world consisted of only one thing: her younger brother. But one day, the moment her brother awoke as a “Special Human,” Jacqueline was forced to hand him over to the state in the name of “protection.” Having lost everything, she was then saddled with yet another burden by “Margo,” the very person who had taken her brother away and served as his guardian. An unknown young new-born, “Demi.” And as time passed, Demi and Jacqueline reunited as if by fate...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

In the past, Tae-Hee dreamed of the entertainment industry while watching the famous actor Hwa-Won. However, the object of his admiration that he met after debuting as an idol was quite different from his expectations. Seeing the disappointing appearance of Hwa-Won, who had fallen into a period of boredom and stagnation, Tae-Hee inadvertently made a remark that crossed the line, saying, "The Hwa-Won I've seen wasn't like this." This remark soon ignites their relationship...!

"Tae-Hee, you've never had sex, right? There's nothing you can do. A junior who is lacking has no choice but to be educated by a senior."

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
Mothers who love their children join the club. However, there are many bad and greedy moms in the club.

In a special forces unit made up of nothing but monsters in human form, Aaron Myer stands out: pretty-faced, sharp-tongued, and quietly harboring a crush on his reliable team leader, Dan Marcus. When Aaron accidentally witnesses Dan being harshly punished by a notorious superior, concern pushes him to visit Dan later that night with a simple excuse. What he finds isn’t the broken man he expected, but something far more...intriguing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Gunbu Danpyeonseon (군부 단편선) Collection.

title.english: My First XXX: Fan In Denial

description:
Geon-Woo is a bodyguard who works on the security team for the idol group Magnum. He doesn’t really have any complaints about his job, except for one person who keeps getting on his nerves: Do-Yoon. Throughout his career in the industry, Geon-Woo has never met a more irritating idol who seems ungrateful to his fans. Do-Yoon is simply a brat with a pretty face, in Geon-Woo’s opinion, which is why he never intended to get mixed up with Do-Yoon in any personal way… So how did they end up in bed together?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Cheot XX Danpyeonseon (첫XX단편선) Collection.
Note: Part of Metatoon's Yongmang Danpyeonseon (욕망 단편선) Collection.

Kim Seojoon, a freshman college student leading a normal daily life, awoke one day to find himself transported into a fantasy world straight out of a webtoon or web novel or something like that. As he began to get excited about potentially having the role of a male lead character, a shocking event unfolded before his eyes—a murder of an imperial family. Consequently, Kim Seojoon found himself imprisoned in the world's prison, Gehenna. Will he be able to navigate the treacherous paths of this unfamiliar world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

The industry’s top headhunter launches a survival project, leading five job-hunting underdogs! The “moment of truth," where you force your cover letter past the application cutoff and shatter the interviewer’s rigid mindset with your image! Can we really pull this off? What is the true story of these human resources (HR) professionals that unfolds beyond the doors of employment? The story of a mysterious headhunter and job seekers on the brink of despair!

(Source: Justoon, translated)

Those who can draw a Mind Sword are called "Warriors." Ellon sets off on a journey to become one, but the warriors he dreamed of turn out to be nothing more than brutal killing machines. Will Ellon overcome this harsh reality and become a true warrior?

(Source: Naver, translated)

The Murim’s public enemy, the Slaughterer Demon Monarch, Yeom Se-Ak! It’s been a hundred years since he was trapped in Mount Hua after being captured by the Sword God, Han Ho. He waited all these years for his chance to seek revenge…

The long period of time caused this incident to be forgotten by the world, and eventually, even the Yeom Se-Ak was forgotten. However...

“Sir, what is your name…?”
A coincidental meeting, and the name of an archenemy that he said unwittingly, “H-Han Ho.”

At the end of a vain journey, an unexpected path branches out. The ultimate demon that’s in Mount Hua, Yeom Se-Ak’s choice!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: I Wish I Could Have Two Beds

description:
Their Royal Majesties Julia and Endymion married as children and grew up together as the best of friends. As their coming-of-age ceremony approaches, Julia begins searching for a concubine for her husband, oblivious to his feelings for her. Sharing the same bed these days is a bit awkward, and Julia has enough to process. She couldn’t possibly feel that way about her husband... could she? A jaded ex, shifting alliances, and magic aren’t helping matters either!

(Source: Tapas)

“Dark World,” the game I, a thirty-year-old salaryman, had devoted my entire youth to.

“What the fuck is this…”

When I opened my eyes, Dark World had become my reality. The pouring rain, dripping hot blood, and a cold blade. At the moment of my impending death, I came into this familiar world.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

There is no need to state the simple truth in large sentences. I am the greatest in the world.

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Wu-Ju’s first meeting with Do-Yeong ended in anger. Their reunion came with fear. And suddenly living under the same roof? Total chaos. But with Do-Yeong barging into his life so boldly and shamelessly, Wu-Ju’s carefully guarded world - built on worrying about others’ opinions and pining after his hopeless crush, Hyeon-Wu- starts to crumble in the most unexpected ways. And before he knows it, Wu-Ju just might be falling for the very storm that turned his life upside down…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Sa-Ha is a sexually frustrated office worker who constantly drools over her uptight but hot boss, Isaac. When Isaac catches her napping in the supply closet, Sa-Ha tries to walk out but trips and lands right on Isaac's crotch! Both of them are mortified and agree to forget this ever happened. However, Isaac pulls Sa-Ha aside soon after and says he could hear her perverted thoughts about him since the closet incident! But instead of feeling shame, the mischievous Sa-Ha pounces on this opportunity, saying she might stop having perverted thoughts about Isaac if he just sleeps with her once...

(Source: Tappytoon)

I want to be like the great swordsman! A child born from the secret art of apostasy, Jang Seol becomes the disciple of Hwangbo Cheolseung, the swordsman who was once the confidant of the leader of the martial arts world, and begins to take his first steps as a martial artist. He has one ability...

This child can read the memories of iron.

Jang Seol grows stronger with each weapon that passes through his hands. He throws himself into the chaotic world of martial arts to find the 'Ten Great Records of the Martial Arts World', known as the legend of martial arts!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Dalsu, the son of God, has been kicked out of the afterworld and sent to Earth on a mission: find out what makes humans truly happy. Teamed up with his friend Lisa, who happens to be an angel and talented chef, the two start a food delivery service. Because what could make humans happier than delivery food? Only when the happiness meter on his motorcycle hits 100% will he be allowed to return. Will Dalsu be able to make it back to the heavens?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

In a future devastated by war and desertification... is unexpectedly, a flower shop!

Note: Chapter count includes 3 prologues, one per season of the manhwa.

The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”

Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.

"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”

From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.

“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”

What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Nerd Man Algo Boni Pokgunira Hamnida
title.english: The Nerd is Actually a Tyrant

description:
Before her accident, Lucette was a young woman living in modern-day Korea. So why did she wake up in the body of a little girl living in the remote outskirts of the Vladin Empire? That was the setting of the ultra-violent webnovel she was reading when she was hit by a truck! But since things have come to this, Lucette might as well get her hustle on, far away from the dangerous capital. At least, that's what she thought before befriending a brilliant but mysterious boy named Lev. What will happen as their growing bond unveils a life-threatening secret?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Archduke Gabriel de Luzia is cursed. Since his seventh bride died in a tragic accident, he's become an outcast and has stayed holed up in his castle. His only companions there are his loyal servants, until the day a young woman comes wandering right through the castle's protective magical barrier! Having traveled all the way from her village, Marianne has a favor to ask of Gabriel, but nothing comes for free in this world, and what the archduke asks of her in return could put her life at stake!

(Source: Tapas)

"So, what do you think about my brother?"

One day, out of nowhere, a charming princess appeared in the life of Claire, the mistreated protagonist of an unknown author's work. Princess Yuri, without any prior connection, unexpectedly proposed that Claire marry her brother—known as the empire's most eligible bachelor. Overwhelmed by the princess's stubbornness, which not even the emperor could sway, Claire found herself in a contract engagement with the second prince.

"I just want you to play along until Princess Yuri is satisfied. I'll make sure you're compensated accordingly."

As Claire waited for the contract to end, Prince Raymond began to approach her. Why would someone who is only tied to her by a contract...?

"I don't want to let you go. I feel like locking you away so you can't leave."

For Claire, who fears both giving and receiving love, the wave of affection from her potential in-laws has only just begun.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Cho Seung-Hun, a first-year employee, has just started working in the HR department of a game company. Together with his devilish boss, who takes human form, he helps the company grow rapidly…

What is the devil’s true goal behind this growth, and what choice will the human make once he realizes it?

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

The tiger I saved as a child suddenly appeared as two companions?! And they say we three must sleep together for their souls to become one again?

"Our wife is truly clumsy, trapping her husband between her legs like this-"

"You wanted to touch it, didn't you...? A man's body."

Living as newlyweds with two divine beings who pounce on me at all hours - can my heart really endure this?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Assistant Manager Kim, you punk! You get in my car every morning. You're trash that sexually harrasses me all the time, even though we're the same gender. I accidentally kissed him once. What's happening? Why's my body responding to Kim's molestation? Have I finally gone crazy?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

The main character, No Seona, impulsively picks up a snake on her way home from work. However, it turns out that the snake is actually a member of the Suin Clan.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Kim Pyeong-Beom is an ordinary person who lives a common life, but one day an alien with the appearance of a teddy bear lands in his room! From that moment on, he will accept that intercultural exchange with BR, the fifth prince of Planet KKRY… But how will he end up becoming the prince's sex education manager too?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

High priest Sia awaits her peaceful death after leading a life devoted to helping other people. Instead of finding herself next to Lord Pleon the God, she finds herself in the body of Elena, a woman known to be wicked.
While adjusting to her new body and new life as a universally hated figure, Sia continues to encounter men she had acquainted during her day as a high priest. What's even more surprising is that those men seem to get increasingly obsessed with her.

"I am no longer the high priest on whom everyone depended, so why are these men still getting obsessed with me?!"

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Every princess in Nak-Rang Kingdom is fated to be married off as a political tool the moment she comes of age, and Princess Sol is no exception. Seeing her older sister die after being used the same way leaves her feeling alone and helpless. That is when a mysterious medium tells her that what she desires most awaits her outside the palace. As fate would have it, Sol finds a frail boy named Mi-Ru at the slave market and feels compelled to save him. Though Mi-Ru quickly becomes Sol's only refuge, it won't be easy to protect him from her evil brother's clutches...

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

Note: As of July 19th, 2023, this work has been re-serialized in full color.

Seung-Ju has had a long-standing crush on Jun-Hyuk, the student council president. One summer day, just as he was suffering from the pangs of unrequited love, the person who appeared before him was none other than Jun-Hyuk’s younger brother, Je-Hyun. Seung-Ju, who had a crush on his older brother, and Je-Hyun, who approached him. Will Seung-Ju ever be able to escape this agonizing unrequited love?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

26-year-old university student Gong Woo-Jin accidentally receives a package meant for his rather loud neighbor. When Woo-Jin goes to return the package to its rightful owner, he finds Yoon Yoonoh in a compromising situation... What awaits Woo-Jin and Yoonoh in the future?

Note: The chapter count includes 2 side stories and 4 special chapters.

A secret experiment on serial killers conducted in the woods? What could possibly go wrong? Follow one young researcher’s descent into madness and self-doubt as she attempts to escape a locked facility with ten bloodthirsty murderers. Will she make it out with her humanity intact?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A girl who can see ghosts. “Baekjeok,” a ghost who has followed her from the past, speaks of love, yet his gaze is fixed on someone else.

As I become the prey of love, I gradually lose myself.

A romantic thriller where the boundaries of self are distorted, caught between affection and obsession.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Genius artist Si-Uk was always lonely—friends envied him and adults tried to take advantage of him. If there was even one person who understood and hugged him, Si-Uk was ready to give them everything. And, eventually, Si-Uk met two men who understood him: Ryu Sin-U, a perfect man who seems to have never felt lonely; and Song Ji-Sin, who has tried harder than anyone else to avoid being lonely. The two men engage in a war of nerves to take over Si-Uk's heart, but the most dangerous man among the three is Lee Si-Uk...?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras.

Lee In-Woo will do anything for his family - no matter the consequences. After learning about a potential plot to leak sensitive information, In-Woo travels back to Korea to track his brother’s last known location. His search leads him to Dr. Kang Do-Woon, a doctor with connections In-Woo is dying to get his hands on. But, as the two grow closer, both of them fall deeper and deeper into a tangled web of deceit and mystery that neither of them could have anticipated... Chasing this rainbow is bound to lead to something much less pleasant than a pot of gold.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her parents' death, Lady Vanessa is left with only two things—a mountain of debt and a marriage. Her greedy uncle is all too willing to sell her off as a fresh bride to an aging earl. To escape this arranged fate, she needs a scandal. A truly horrible, ruinous scandal.

(Source: Manta)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

Once upon a time, there was a poor girl who spent all her time and energy helping her blind father. She was beautiful and kind, and she always wore a beautiful smile. Unfortunately, disaster struck her life. She decided to sacrifice herself to the Sea Lord in response to a promise. One cloudy day, she threw herself into the depths of the sea, praying to the god of the sea to save her father...

It seems like the tale should end here, and the girl would die. But suddenly, as in any fairytale, a miracle happens: our heroine wakes up in the arms of a handsome boy... From the future! Who is he? Is this a bad dream, or the finger of fate?!

Note: Based on the traditional Korean fairy tale Sim Cheong Jeon (심청전,The Tale of Sim Cheong).

The Ki men can get pregnant if they fall asleep with a person while holding hands. Terry unwillingly saves Mike and passes out while holding hands. Is he pregnant?

(Source: Toomics)

Boy-girl best friendships are hard. Will Taehyun and Jikyung's survive their stormy journey?

(Source: Toomics)

No friends, no motivation, no special talents. Wounds, grievances, and a sense of lack. Cheon-Hui and Jun-Hwi, the school’s resident outcasts, join forces to start a club. But this club…

“No popular kids allowed.”

(Source: Naver, translated)

The neglected grandson of a wealthy CEO, Sooha has a dark past that has resulted in a split personality. Sooha as himself can be cranky and distrustful, but his alter ego, Ray, is quite violent. This isn’t without good reason: the CEO has been orchestrating attacks on Sooha/Ray in order to find an invaluable jewel Ray has hidden. As part of his plan to find the gem, the CEO hires Soohyun to pretend to be Sooha’s bodyguard. Yet the more Sooha and Soohyun spend time with each other, the more both let down their guard…

(Source: Lezhin)

If you thought life on earth was hard, then try purgatory. What lengths would you go to fight for a life of guaranteed riches and success? These souls might have once forsaken their lives, but now, they’ll fight tooth and nail to return to life. Who will win the survival competition to gain the prize of being revived?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

S-class Esper Eunhyeon is forced into a rural transfer and paired with a male Guide, Jaewoo. Bored and biding time until he can return, he's shocked to find Jaewoo tangled up with another Esper. Could there be more to this “dull” partner than meets the eye?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes a prologue.

A story about a couple that ends in tragedy. She, who was born to the wife of a king, vowed not to be a trapped butterfly again. When I opened my eyes, fate came again, "Later we will meet again as a man and a woman then you must be my woman and I will never let you go again" said the man.

Note: The chapter count includes an extra story that is 7 chapters.

Raymon has it all: perfect looks, a prestigious family, and unrivaled abilities in the workplace. But beneath his flawless exterior lies a chaotic love life, with a string of unsatisfying, fleeting encounters. His search for the perfect partner ends when a janitor named Winter seemingly saves him from a stalker's attack. Drawn to Winter’s striking looks and submissive nature, Raymon proposes a FWB situation, to which Winter eagerly agrees. At first, their relationship seems ideal, but Raymon soon realizes the terrifying truth - Winter has been his stalker all along. Now trapped in a deadly game, Raymon finds himself pretending to love Winter in a desperate bid to survive. Winter, unhinged and obsessively devoted, will stop at nothing - even murder - to keep Raymon all to himself. And so begins a dangerous, seductive battle of control, where love and dominance blur into a deadly obsession.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

title.english: Legend of the Thousand Year Tiger

description:
A tiger-hating hunter, a human-loving tiger, and a possessed tax collector walk into a historical webtoon. This thrilling yet passionate tale follows these three entities as they defy the food chain and challenge the order of nature.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Son Je-Wan was a rising star in the broadcasting world until he suddenly lost the ability to recognize faces. The loss forces him to rebuild his career as a freelancer and for three long years, every face was a blur. One day, he finally recognizes someone, Lee Jin, an assistant writer at a TV station he'd bumped into before having face blindness... whose name is also written on Je-Wan's body! Determined to reclaim his place at the top, Je-Wan proposes a contractual relationship with Jin, but things soon spiral far beyond what either of them expected...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jun-Ho, a perennial nerd, becomes friends with the kind and handsome Do-Yul, who takes classes in the same college. Jun-Ho falls in love with the affectionate and angelic Do-Yul. However, Do-Yul has a twin brother, Do-Ha, who is a brat, and Do-Ha begins to interfere with Jun-Ho and Do-Yul's relationship. When things don't go his way, Do-Ha disguises himself as Do-Yul and tramples on Jun-Ho's feelings, and even reveals his and his brother's secrets...

A love triangle romance between a man with multiple personalities who loves his own personality and a man who falls in love with two of those personalities.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Jo Jingoo, leading a hopeless life, starts working part-time at a women’s aesthetic shop through his aunt’s connections. Wealthy wives and arrogant female coworkers look down on him– until one day, he gains a unique power: his massage techniques can instantly turn women on.

(Source: Toomics, translated)

Despite the constant mistreatment, Ethan still considers himself lucky to be dating Helen, his gorgeous girlfriend. However, his repressed masculinity surfaces every night when a different side of him awakens.

(Source: Toomics)

Minji may seem like an ordinary girl, but she has a secret no one knows—she’s living a double life. By day, she’s an awkward, introverted outcast, but by night, she transforms into Eunha, a stunning social butterfly. Her secret life takes an unexpected turn when a mysterious man known as "Black" approaches her with an offer:

"If you want to become a member of our secret club, you must pass a test. You must sleep with two men you are already acquainted with."

Determined to enter the exclusive club, Minji sheds her shy persona and steps into her Eunha identity, seducing everyone from a childhood friend to a sunbae at her college—even her landlord. But will Minji— or rather, Eunha— succeed in gaining entry, or will her carefully constructed double life come crashing down?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A life of kindness, and it all came to an end. If given another chance, will I live the same way?

(Source: Toomics)

During his innocent and ignorant high school days, Suyeong had a very awkward first kiss with his first love, Chaeri. Before he could resolve the misunderstanding, Chaeri transferred to another school, and years passed by, with his first love buried in his heart. After completing his military service, Suyeong goes to an opening party and encounters Chaeri, who had come in as a transfer student. He is swayed by Chaeri’s advances and realizes he’s in for a surprise…

”What would you do if I gave you a chance to make up for it?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

When Noah, a struggling web novelist, finds himself in an unexpected marriage with Jane, one of three sisters who once tormented him, his life takes a chaotic turn. As Jane is sent overseas for work, her empty home becomes a playground for her two sisters— Lisa, a sultry divorcee, and Emily, a bold college student. The odd cohabitation stirs unexpected emotions as Noah is torn between Jane’s provocative allure and Emily’s carefree spirit. As old feelings resurface and new temptations arise, Noah is caught in a tangled web of desire, guilt, and forbidden attraction. Will he find clarity amidst the chaos, or will he be forever trapped between the two sisters?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

An ex-boxer’s condition makes him irresistible to women, turning his boxing gym into the stage for intense encounters.

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: A Girl I Used to Know

description:
Melanie is a family friend who used to live with Sam since his childhood, who he had a crush on. After moving out of Sam's family home, Melanie returns one day as a married woman.

(Source: Toomics)

Tired of my life, I decided to end things. But when I woke up, I was in the body of a successful good-looking dude... What the...

(Source: Toomics)

Memories of a rainy day... the day my life came to a halt. And on a rainy day... my life may take a turn...

(Source: Toomics)

‘Dolsoe’, a trusted servant known for his unusual physique and loyal nature, witnesses a scene late at night that he absolutely shouldn’t have, involving him in a situation far beyond his control…!

“Ma’am, would it be okay if I acted boldly once more?”

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

“You’re just a manager… Who do you think you are, acting all cool?”

Wanting to see his favorite BJ Seoyeon himself, Kwon Seojun becomes her manager. But contrary to his imaginations, he faces repeating power trips and violence, and everyday is painful. He then becomes her antifan, posting hate comments on her. Then one day… The Favorability Boost app opens. But the app’s mission… is to XX Seoyeon?

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Seung-Jo gets involved in a struggle for the rights between mobs and hides out in a small town out in the country.

"Why shouldn't I cause trouble here? No one here knows me anyway."

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Hwang-soo’s gambling problem cost him everything, including his house and his farm. With the family on the verge of becoming homeless, Hwang-soo’s wife Mijah and daughter Danbi ask Dooshik, a wealthy man, for his help. But it turns out that the man they thought was a philanthropist, was actually someone quite villainous. After forcing her to sign a contract, Mijah finds out Dooshik was the one who had coerced the family into losing everything. Can Mijah and Danbi get their house back? Why did Dooshik target Hwang-soo in the first place? And will everyone's greed for money and lust for sex eventually catch up to them...?

(Source: Lezhin X)

One stupid decision cost me my dream, but it also led me to this four-story heaven... Maybe living with my wife's family isn't so bad after all! Because no matter what people say... I'm the man of the house.

(Source: Toomics)

Minseok, deputy manager of LS Cinema's marketing department, is good at social life and works hard, but he strangely finds himself constantly clashing with Jung Soo-hee, a married manager. Despite their daily conflicts, Minseok finds himself falling for Soo-hee due to her beautiful appearance and surprisingly warm side. Soo-hee also acts cold towards Minseok like a tsundere, but she secretly has feelings for the handsome and charming Minseok. Then one day, Minseok and Soo-hee go on a business trip to a local cinema alone, and their affair begins...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Travelers come to a village in search of fairies.

(Source: MegKF)

In a strange future where gifted, "hybrid" humans police the planet, Mina is a likeable tomboy with growing psychic powers. When a young boy falls into a coma after gazing into her eyes, it's clear that there's more to Mina than her pretty looks. This young boy, Hinchang, grows up to be quite a daredevil, and his awkward, secret love for Mina fuels his protective fire when mysterious men arrive, bringing the violence of the "hybrid" world with them!

(Source: Dark Horse)

Eden Jang's often been mistaken for a foreigner or a Korean who's lived abroad due to his appearance. One day, on his way to school in a new neighborhood he's just moved to, a 10-year-old Eden is confronted by foreigners who seem to think he's just like them. But being also lost and tired, he gets flustered and goes into a state of panic. It's then when a total stranger, Sarang, shows up and saves him. Coincidentally, Sarang lives next door to Eden, and the two become close like real brothers. To Eden, Sarang is the older brother-like figure he looks up to. He tags along Sarang wherever he goes, just like a puppy would its owner. But as Eden grows older, he realizes his feelings for Sarang were far more than just brotherly love. Unable to suppress his feelings any further, Eden ends up kissing Sarang on a live internet channel when he's drunk. The dynamics between the two change, and Eden becomes bolder, making sure Sarang knows how he feels. Will Sarang reciprocate his love? Is Eden merely like a younger brother to Sarang, or does he also have feelings for who?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Since their school days, Ki Tae-Hwa and Lee Yea-Ju have been known as inseparable friends. But after Tae-Swa loses his girlfriend because of Yea-Ju, he creates distance between them, using his enlistment as an excuse. After his discharge, they meet again at a drinking party. Yea-Ju confesses that he has remained single, quietly enduring the loneliness left by Tae-Hwa’s absence. Unable to turn away, Tae-Hwa lets himself drift into a moment he never intended, telling himself it is only temporary. As he moves forward, hoping to return to the friendship they once had, he begins to question whether that is truly what he wants.

(Source: Lezhin US)

“I've been seeing ghosts since I was a kid. And only male ghosts, at that.”

Young Jae-Yeong has a secret. It’s that he enjoys reading BL manga with his “ghost brothers.” When his father finds out, Jae-Yeong is forced to leave his neighborhood and begins attending shamanistic rituals. Eventually, he succeeds in making the ghosts disappear, but due to repeated school transfers and spiritual rituals, Jae-Yeong becomes physically and emotionally exhausted, feeling empty inside. When Jae-Yeong returns to his neighborhood, he is greeted by Do-Ha. Do-Ha, who used to be a timid younger brother who cried at the drop of a hat, had grown tall enough to look down on Jae-Yeong. But the joy is short-lived, as Do-Ha begins to gradually disrupt Jae-Yeong’s daily life.

“Hyung, my feelings for you… have never faded.”

Do-Ha keeps bringing back memories of a past Jae-Yeong had tried to forget. Is Do-Ha Jae-Yeong’s salvation, or his trial?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The eleventh story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

"I didn't write it!"

Popular idol Jung Ha-Jin's school violence revelations explode. The world, with detailed information seemingly gleaned from her memories, points to victim Min-Ji as the "author." The mysterious author is stealing my memories and strangling the perpetrator. Is this the perfect revenge for me? Or is this another trap?

(Source: Naver, translated)

High school student Kang Jae-Yeong’s biggest worry is how to get by on just one meal a day. His secret is sneaking off to a free meal center to fill his stomach. That day, Kang Jae-Yeong stopped by the meal center to eat, only to accidentally witness two students from a nearby prestigious high school kissing. The problem is that they’re both boys. Caught in an embarrassing moment, Yeon Min-Gyeol angrily demands that a stunned Kang Jae-Yeong keep his secret in exchange for money. After their disastrous first encounter, the two keep running into each other for some reason. Although Yeon Min-Gyeol gets on his nerves, their meetings continue—meetings that are hard to refuse.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The twelfth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

Lois, an ordinary girl, has a secret. A secret she's not embarrassed about, but one she wants no one to find out about...

(Source: Toomics)

A sudden arrival of letter to her one fine day. By the request of the letter, the witch Bessi Ale returns to her homeland, Veyron Empire after having left it 16 years ago.

After becoming the newly appointed manager of the National Library which was on the brink of closure, she has a premonition that she will be entangled with the secret that's kept hidden in the imperial palace.......

"From now on, I promise to be by your side."

"You are special to me. More special to me than anyone else in the world."

A small spark appears in the curious relationship she has with the knight Justin, who experienced a terrible ill-fated relationship in the past. Amidst all that, Bessi comes closer to revealing the truth that could shake the whole empire.

In the world where only women are able to use magic, shows how the super powerful witch Bessi survives as the manager of the library!"

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

On the surface, he’s always smiling. But no one knows. That Jung Chae-Min is attracted to men instead of women. And that at home, instead of laughter, his wounds are piling up. Early summer of his sophomore year. That’s when transfer student Ian appeared before Chae-Min. A sullen guy who, despite his pretty face, is blunt and doesn’t get close to anyone. A creepy guy who glares at me every time he turn his head. Then one day, Chae-Min discovers Ian’s secret. Strangely enough, as Chae-Min shares this secret with Ian, he begins to feel a growing sense of liberation.

“I’ll help you fit in with everyone. The fact that you’re different. I don’t mind it.”

“You’re not the only one who’s strange. I’m strange too.”

Now, Chae-Min doesn’t mind Ian’s gaze. He begins to enjoy spending time with Ian. But Ian becomes particularly sensitive to Chae-Min’s wounds and even appears in his dreams:

“The smell of blood always seeps out of you. That’s why, from the very beginning… it bothered me.”

“Strangely… I can’t stand the scent you give off.”

The edge of light, where darkness and light flow together. The two boys standing at the boundary began to seep into each other’s worlds. And so, their summer began.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The thirteen story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

What would you do if your life was taken over by an R-rated dating simulation game? That’s a question Gowoon never imagined he’d have to answer, but it’s happening to him whether he likes it or not. Somehow, a virtual reality dating sim has invaded his real life, and now he has three men vying for his attention—and his body. Gowoon would prefer none of them, thank you very much, but the game won’t stop…unless, perhaps, he were to clear it. Maybe the only way out is through. And there’s only one way to find out…

(Source: Lezhin)

Chapter count includes a prologue.

Kang Eui-Jun wakes up in the hospital after an accident, having lost his memory. The only person by his side is Eun Jae-Hyeon, who introduces himself as his boyfriend. Amidst his confusion and resistance, Eui-Jun gradually opens his heart to Jae-Hyeon’s tender care. But something feels off. Whenever he asks about the past, Jae-Hyeon subtly changes the subject, and at every crucial moment, he evades the question.

What is Eun Jae-Hyeon hiding? And what truth remains in his erased memories?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The ninth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

Tae-Rim, a high school student on the cusp of adulthood, is pondering her future. She laments that she has led such an ordinary life and fears she is destined for a mundane, uneventful existence. Tae-Rim has a friend named Seon-Ho who seems somehow special and mysterious. Seon-Ho, who appears to be good at everything, is kind but difficult to get close to. When Tae-Rim accidentally discovers Seon-Ho’s secret, she becomes entangled in his family history. As she works to resolve the situation, she reflects on and experiences friendship, career choices, family, and love, and in the process, she grows as a person.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

What kind of marriage is this at eighteen?!

Kim Yong-Man, the Dragon King’s daughter who fled from the Dragon Palace to the human world to escape an arranged marriage, enters high school with the goal of becoming the top student in the school. But Shim Hae-Su, the current top student sitting right next to Yong-Man, doesn’t seem too thrilled about the arrival of a rival...

Why do these two, who are already too busy studying, keep getting tangled up with each other?! A romance (?) about improving grades featuring an 18-year-old boy and girl.

(Source: Naver, translated)
Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

The Trauma Center series returns! Uncover the gripping prequel to Trauma Center: Golden Hour and follow the emotional journey of Dr. Ganghyeok Baek. Every scar, every choice, every life saved... his story starts here. Witness the making of a medical legend as he takes his first steps into the chaos and courage of trauma care.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Princess Arbella Camulita believed she was destined for greatness since she was the empire's most powerful magician. But her hopes are destroyed after a dream reveals that she will become a monster and die due to being jealous of her half-sister, Judith, who will become the heroine and have a happy ending. Determined to prevent this awful end, Arbella decides to get close to Judith instead. Can this princess beat fate and prove that she's not the monster the future says she'll be?

(Source: Tapas)

It all started back in high school. Shinwoo is caught in a compromising position by his crush, Taesoo. And Taesoo doesn’t react well: “You’re dirty!” “You whore!” Cut to seven years later, and those insults have left a mark. Shinwoo can only get off on hardcore humiliation, the nastier the better. His clean-cut hunk of a boyfriend tries hard to satisfy those desires… but there’s something missing. Until Shinwoo attends his high school reunion, that is, and his first love comes back to bite him…

Astria leads a peaceful life as the keeper of the eternal haven.
Until one day, a man on the brink of death shows up. The man turns out to be Duke Earhart, the most handsome and youngest swordmaster in the empire. Astria manages to save the dying Duke with her magic, But the healing magic is only maintained in close proximity…

After listening to Earhart’s pleas, she decides to follow him into the human world.
With her accidental introduction as a Duchess, Astria slowly adjusts to her new life.
Will Astria be able to find true love and break the curse?!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

“A kiss… Why are you kissing??!!!”

Middle schooler Han Si-U is happily dating her boyfriend, Park Geon-U. One day, his next-door neighbor, elementary schooler No Jae-Min, catches Si-U and Geon-U kissing. Shocked, Jae-Min starts following Si-U around from that day on, yelling at him to break up with him…!

Where did that cute little kid go who used to follow him around saying he liked her big brother? Why is only this little demon left? The bickering daily life of Si-U, who’s annoyed by Jae-Min meddling in his relationship, and Jae-Min, who’s possessed by rage because he doesn’t want his big brother taken away!

“What the hell are you two gross homos doing in broad daylight?!!!”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The tenth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

A fiery married couple dives into the streaming world when the wife, a rising VTuber, makes her husband her manager. Between chaotic broadcasts and suspicious fans, his secret past with a top streamer slowly comes to light…

(Source: Toomics)

On the surface, life flows through a series of mundane daily routines and ordinary social connections. Yet, beneath this veneer of normalcy lies a hidden world of unspoken desires and strictly forbidden emotions. What begins as a mere accident ignites an uncontrollable spark that quickly rages out of hand. The magnetic attraction between them, once a subtle pull, now spirals into a deeper, more intoxicating pursuit of pure pleasure.

A single, misguided choice has birthed a taboo relationship that defies all social boundaries. As the stakes rise, the characters find themselves sinking further into a treacherous mire of ecstasy from which there is no escape. The path back to their former lives has been utterly severed, leaving them to drown in the very sensations they once feared. This is a story of the thin line between restraint and the point of no return.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The world is divided into two: the ‘Moon Kingdom’ where humans live, and the ‘Sun Kingdom’ where demons dwell. Estelle, a knight of the Moon Kingdom, loses her family in a demon attack. Entangled with a strange demon girl, she is even given a terminal diagnosis. To survive, she must journey to the tower in the north. A timid knight girl, a slave boy, and a demon king turned ghost. The story of three who embark on an adventure to find life.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Her long-time boyfriend and her best friend’s infidelity. Lee Bom loses both love and friendship due to their betrayal. Just as the 50 million won her ex-boyfriend borrowed vanishes, a suspicious man named Baek Do-Hyeok appears.

“You know, when what you’ve let slip through your fingers seems to shine brighter, you end up looking back for it.”

Baek Do-Hyeok proposes that she win back her ex-boyfriend Park U-Sung’s heart to get the money back. And so begins a precarious fake relationship. But is there a hidden agenda behind this relationship from the very beginning..?

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.romaji: Nami Doen Namdongsaengi Nampyeoni Doeryeo Handa
title.native: 남이 된 남동생이 남편이 되려 한다

description:
My mother’s remarriage gave me a younger brother. I happily tried to bond with him; no matter how badly he behaved, I persisted. Will my efforts ever pay off?

As we grew closer, Millian left to go to war, leaving me with a piece of letter.

It has been five years since. Millian comes back and I find out that he has been expelled from our family. He is no longer Millian Edmore Rachel, he is now Millian Taylor and he is going to be my husband.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated and edited)

The year is 2001. At Yujung High School, known as a gathering place for troublemakers, a bloody battle rages daily between students vying for the top spot and the Disciplinary Committee trying to stop them. Amidst this chaos, there is one sanctuary where peace can be found... the school’s very own paradise: the “infirmary.” Having toppled the previous leader, Jang Jin-Tae, the Tiger, became the school’s new boss. Just when it seemed he had finally taken over the infirmary and secured absolute power, a suspicious-looking, womanizing transfer student, Sin Jong-U, was already casually occupying the space.

“Who… are you?”

Jin-Tae boldly ordered Jong-U to get out of the infirmary. But all he got in return was a sharp slap from Jong-U. Having fallen from the top spot to second place in just 13 minutes, Jin-Tae challenges Jong-U once again to reclaim the infirmary and his position as the top dog, but Jong-U seems to have some other ulterior motive...?

The Playboy Transfer Student X The Bulldozer School Leader A full-on school-based romantic comedy where bodies collide and hearts clash, The Battle for the Infirmary Bed!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The fifth story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.

title.english: I'm Engaged to an Obsessive Male Lead

description:
One day, Veillyn Orlando comes to the realization that she's been living the last 21 years as a side character in a BL novel and is fated to die in one year!
