In light of this, Veillyn decides to escape her abusive family and live out the rest of her days in peace. However, her only way out is getting engaged to the male lead of the novel, Jellard Lieseltein. He seems like the perfect candidate for a contractual engagement because he's into men, meaning there's no risk of them actually falling in love with each other... But as the two spend more time together, Jellard seems to be falling for Veillyn. Will Veillyn be able to navigate her growing feelings for Jellard while keeping her inevitable death a secret?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After years of training, Kim Ryeo-Dam finally made his idol debut. Though not the most popular member of his group, he had his own reason for staying: a quiet, persistent crush on his teammate, Cha Jin-Won. One night, alone at home, Ryeo-Dam stumbled upon a spicy fanfic featuring himself and Jin-Won. The story stirred something in him, and he slipped into the bathroom for a moment of release. But just as he emerged, flustered and breathless, he came face to face with Jin-Won, who had returned early and seen everything. Jin-Won didn’t get angry. Instead, he teased, his voice laced with curiosity and something unreadable. Ryeo-Dam’s mind raced to recover, but before he could stop himself, the words tumbled out.

“What if we tried it... for real?”

Regret hit him the second the words left his mouth. But Jin-Won didn’t laugh or step back. He simply leaned in and pressed a soft kiss to Ryeo-Dam’s cheek. And what brushed against Ryeo-Dam’s thigh wasn’t just Jin-Won’s leg. He was hard.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three side story chapters.

Eunkyung's homelife is... boring, to say the least. With no job, no kids and a distant husband, she's beginning to feel depressed. Things start looking up when her hunky young nephew moves in, but having all that extra testosterone in the house proves stressful! To relieve her tension, Eunkyung decides to take up yoga - only to find out her nephew is the instructor! She's got a lot to learn, and he's a very thorough instructor. Who knew yoga was so hands-on?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Rumor has it that Chae Ha-Rin is sleeping with her boss, Director Moon Jung-Hoo. Then one steamy night, she does. Ha-Rin wants their relationship to stay physical, but Jung-Hoo keeps confessing. He insists that Ha-Rin loves him as well as his body... and she's afraid he might be right! Still, Ha-Rin's not willing to let Jung-Hoo make promises he can't keep. Can Jung-Hoo convince Ha-Rin to build something pure from their indecent romance? Or will she prove they're nothing more than another office scandal?

(Source: Tapas)

Abandoned as an infant, Yongsheng has always been an outsider. When his peaceful existence is shattered, he's thrust into a world of shadows and secrets. Armed with newfound abilities and guided by a mysterious mentor, he joins a clandestine organization known as the Nie Slayers. As he uncovers the truth about his past and the forces that threaten humanity, Yongsheng must decide how far he is willing to go to protect those he loves.

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Qing Wen E Wang Zhi Hua

description:
Xia Hexuan accidentally lost his sight at the age of 10, but miraculously regained it one day when he turned 19. He always felt as if he had forgotten something important. One day, he was pulled into a game called 'Pandora's Prison,' where the system told him that if he could collect three shards of hope, he could grant one wish. To recover his lost memories, Xia Hexuan began his journey into the game.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

This is the story of an unlucky guy and a dark, domineering CEO living like wild men in the mountains. It includes elements of mystery, family drama, raunchy jokes, and crime.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Warrior Ulysses is sent back in time 50 years to save the world, but finds himself entangled with the very person he’s supposed to protect. A decorative heir to the throne x a dutiful warrior from the future

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

title.romaji: Jiali Laile Wei Dao Chang Daren

description:
A young Taoist who claims to be Mr. Taoist shows up at an ordinary man's house. He is actually the God of Mountain, who cadging meals and drinks and making it as his own place. He keeps on pushing too far​ but feels boring at the same time... While the ordinary man is a SOHO who's engaged in drawing horny pictures, but something seems to be hidden in his body...

(Source: Manga Toon)

Let me think it over. I have to have a blind date first.

(Source: WeComics)

title.romaji: Mingri Fangzhou Zhongmo Di: Dai Zhan

description:
Hapless teenager Chu Ming Yang has had a loser's luck since birth. Obviously his studies weren't great, but on the day of the exams he got food poisoning, and put as his preference a school that doesn't exist?!

On the day of enrollment, he not only meets a 'Death god', but is also forced by the death god to 'jump in front of a train' as an 'intense' way of entering the school...

On the first day of orientation, Yang Yang receives a shocking lesson!

But also due to this, it is the start of his new life...

I became a cat when stopping one from being abused? And I had to live with this "animal shaman" who made me a cat! I must put up with it for the sake of turning back into a human! Meow!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Teng, originally a beautiful flower god, thoroughly became malicious in this world. The heroine who died in a car accident, her body is occupied by another girl, all this is a trap for Teng? It turns out that in previous life, Ivy is Teng's rival. Yan, the man who was fought for by two women in the past life, tracking Teng to this life, can he prevent the tragedy?

(Source: WebComics)

Note: Includes a prologue.

title.romaji: Ruo Qi Xiaocao Zhui Ai Ji
title.english: Weak Pretty School Boy's Love Story

description:
Lin Ran, a man with a more beautiful face than women’s, is so timid that even cockroaches can scare him into scream, and his physical strength is also close to zero; meanwhile when he meets the heroic campus girl bully, will it be the journey of a girl bully master and a pretty boy apprentice, or the official opening of a school pretty boy's courtship diary?

(Source: Webnovel)

The Demon Lord, Mu Yexun, was injured in battle against the Saint, losing his arm. With the Saint's help, he used a ten thousand year old Crystal to create another arm. He never could've imagined, however, that the arm would possess spiritual intelligence and run amok, causing endless troubles.

The Demon Lord and his right hand started living together with different objectives in mind -- and unexpectely, they slowly develop feelings for each other. However, the Crystal is hiding an unimaginable secret...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Nan Shen De Te Bie Ai Hao

description:
Queen Muse, a tech wiz with no experience in love, developed a game to learn about dating skills – by using real-life data to create virtual characters for players to seduce. Who knew that Muse's favorite idol Tang Jingting, turns out to be a masochist in-game! What’s even more shocking is that the real-life Tang Jingting actually found Muse, opened his mouth, and called her “master.” He even admitted that he was the character that she was trying to seduce in the game!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

About three thousand years ago, chaos consumed the three realms. The gods, demons and humans were in war. Disaster was everywhere. Thousands of years later, aura became scarce in the human realm.

Bai You, a bottle spirit, led a difficult life. Still, he was ambitious—to stick himself onto others, consume their aura, and reach the peak of his life as a demon! In a fateful encounter, he bumped into Yu Jing, a human who happened to emit an incredibly strong aura. Ever since then, Bai You set his eyes only on Yu Jing!

Featured BL, a mysterious boss and a talkative spirit bottle.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, edited)

The elite private tutor, Min Jiangxi, who is good at "pretending", managed to clinch the CEO Qin Zhan as a client. He, who hates women flocking towards him, warns that "he simply lacks a tutor, not a girlfriend". As he instructed, she is courteous and distant, never crossing the boundaries. But one year later, a drunk Qin Zhan states that "I won’t force you to like me, so don’t force me to not like you. I can’t do it". Can she, who doesn’t believe in love, find it with him?

Opposite forces team up for justice!
The leader of the Martial Arts world has teamed up with the leader of a Demonic Cult to investigate a shocking murder. They must find the truth quickly, or face the worst punishment imaginable ⁠— marrying eachother? ⁠— No, something much worse than that.

(Source: Manta)

“Bam! It was nothing short of a catastrophic entrance.”

A single car that suddenly barreled in was enough to turn Ju Han-Nan’s daily life upside down in an instant. What he found amidst the perilous accident was a man bound head to toe. The man he had saved on the spur of the moment.. Huh? Far from crying, he wore a carefree expression and acted suspiciously.

This guy... what is he? This man, who exuded a dangerous aura... You’re saying he’s dating my sister? And now he wants to live with us?! You’re lying!!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

The main character, stressed out from dieting and studying and decided to read the fantasy novel I Want to Be Ugly for Just One Day. She thought she would live a happy life as the daughter of a countess in the book, but the story turned out to be incredibly tedious... Our protagonist will try her best to change the original to make herself the happiest in the world, to protect her beloved family... Chubby will change history!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ji-An, an S-rank guide in Korea who isn't compatible with any espers, people gifted with superpowers, finds herself on a strange continent one day. There, she meets Duke Wisrode, an esper she can finally guide. However, her excitement is short-lived when she discovers that she is the only guide in this land, which is full of espers, and the duke wishes to keep her to himself. Will Ji-An be able to find her way back to her own dimension safely? Or will she be stuck here as the lone guide forever?

(Source: Tapas)

Nari is living her best life as a beautiful, wealthy university student on the prowl for hotties with her best friend, Miyeon. The pair live by Miyeon’s golden rule: don’t sleep with anyone at school. But Nari is having trouble abiding… When she accidentally hooks up with a junior from her university, the damage is done, right? What’s the harm in doing it again with another guy… or two? It was a silly rule anyway, right?

(Source: Tapas)

Yeokdeok Yeong-Sun, who yearns for independence activist "Bigak Kim Do-Hun," lives her life longingly! One day, a man suddenly appears in Bigak's house, recreated in a museum, and reveals himself to be Kim Do-Hun... and that she's the only one who can see, touch, and hear him?!

A sweet romance between the man who "lives" in the museum and the woman who "manages" it.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Fifteen years ago, Eun-Seol was accused of attempting to murder her co-star, Yi-Hyeok. Her career ended and she hasn’t known peace since, all because her mother made her take the fall for her brother so he could keep acting. In present time, Yi-Hyeok is trying to find a way to displease his grandfather in order to change his inheritance and decides to approach Eun-Seol with an offer for a fake relationship. All they have to do is be convincing… so convincing that even they may start believing it.

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

“Stop whining, it’s annoying.”

The sudden change and betrayal of her husband, who had been a son-in-law by marriage. Artia, slowly wearing down in the duke’s mansion where she had no allies, threw herself into the lake, and the moment she opened her eyes again, she was transformed into a different person. Having finally shaken up high society and succeeded in a miraculous divorce, Artia begins to casually look for a second husband at the insistence of the family elders…

“After going through such a difficult divorce, why are you already looking for a husband?”

For some reason, the Second Prince Kilian, famous as the “Mad Prince", keeps hovering around her!

Will Artia be able to welcome her second husband safely?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

"This child is not my daughter."

Ariel was born in the Marquis family, where she was abused and abandoned. She ended up with a miserable death after a life of endless misfortune. Then she woke up, and she was nine years old again. In order to not repeat her miserable life, Ariel decides to have a contractual marriage with the son of the grand duke, Lakarter, who is famous for blood and madness.

"What are all these keys for?"

The housekeeper glanced at the keys and laughed.

"These keys are for the treasury of the grand duke’s family."

She can use all of them as she pleases because they are all hers.

(Source: Kakao, translated and edited)

Note: This is a promotional oneshot for the web novel of the same name.

When Ju-ah entered the work force, she was expecting her days to be hard and long…but much to her surprise (and pleasure), that’s not the only thing! Surrounded by three hot bosses who know what they’re doing both in the office and bedroom, this rookie’s first job is bound to be much more unique than most!

(Source: Lezhin US)

A new student named Kim Ji-An, a loner, transfers to Sujeong High School. But he's actually a total nerd. And he's a girl..!! Ji-An's parents are worried about her being a troublemaker who's been dated by a guy in the past, so they only want to send her to an all-girls high school, but Ji-An wants to go to an engineering school. In the end, she goes to an engineering school on the condition that she dresses as a boy and has a quiet school life. It's already noisy!! -_-^

(Source: Naver, translated)

“I want to kiss you, Prosecutor.”

It’s early June, when the wisteria blossoms adorn the walls and the air is filled with the scent of wisteria flowers. A romance filled with the scent of summer between Seung-Ju, a man of few words who has arrived in the vibrantly colorful town of Neunghwa-ri, and Na-Kyung, a woman as bright and dazzling as sunlight.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.romaji: Oppa Chingudeuri Ireoke Keul Ri Eopseo
title.native: 오빠 친구들이 이렇게 클 리 없어

description:
"What would it feel like to be surrounded by muscles and have your bare skin pressed against me?"

Since I was young, I've preferred to spend time alone in my room. Unlike my friends who have just become adults and are busy going to clubs, going out, and having fun. However, of course, being an introvert doesn't mean I don't have desires. That's right. My taste was to have sex with several people at once. On the premise that they were good-looking men! I enjoyed sending dirty jokes through messages on the Internet, a dream that I couldn't achieve in reality. This life of hiding behind anonymity and enjoying it alone was so perfect...

"If I knew you were going to reveal it like this, we would've done it for you a long time."
"That's what I'm saying. We didn't have to fight among ourselves."
"No way...!"
"So, you did a lot of it alone while watching your oppas?"

I was wondering what kind of crazy people they were to send me pictures with such big things on their bodies, and it turned out they were my brother's friends who had been bothering me the other day!!

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

When Park Ha discovers three strange men sitting in her new place, she would have never guessed one of them was the Crown Prince. As Park Ha tries to navigate her new life in Seoul, she discovers bits of her secret childhood and how she came to be separated from her family. Meanwhile, 300 years earlier, the Crown Prince is desperate to find out answers to his wife's mysterious death. Before he does, cosmic forces intervene and he's switched with someone who looks just like him from 300-years-later Seoul. The ultimate crossover between Joseon and Seoul fueled by mystery ensues when the two meet.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

“You are under arrest as a suspect in the murder of Han Jong-In.”

I just went to see my grandfather, but why? Before the shock could even subside, Seo-Hui found out about her husband and cousin’s affair.

“From now on, I’m going to take what I want. Everything, including yours.”

Everything felt unreal, and the moment her eyes closed… she was transported back to 10 years in the past!? When Seo-Hui woke up again, she saw a college classroom. As she watched her cousin speaking to her in a hateful manner, Seo-Hui made a resolution.

“I won’t let you do whatever you want.”

She was going to live a different life. To do that, she had to delete her ex-husband first.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: Hot-to-Go Bakery: How to Tame a Wolf

description:
Chan-Woo's neighbors are all nervous when a scary wolf named Eun-Jae moves into their villa. Being a friendly big dog, Chan-Woo tries to be a good neighbor to the cold and gruff wolf, even giving him cream puffs from his favorite bakery. But when Eun-Jae goes into heat for the first time, Chan-Woo's about to get stuffed with a different kind of cream for trying too hard to help...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Min-ah's father left her with nothing but debt before she even became an adult. As she worked as a golf course caddy, paying off the debt day by day, a group of old men appeared, claiming to be her father's old friends.

"You're only 22, still so young, but already so commendable."

"Ah, mister, wait, just a moment."

"Ugh, wh-what are you doing...!!" "What do you think I'm doing?"

"I'm trying to get back the money your father never paid me, even if it's just this."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Imagine Lee Sangyeo's surprise when she wakes up one day inside her favorite novel... and her horror when she realizes she's in the body of the adorable heroine's evil sister-in-law, Aylee Brydon! Knowing that the story will end terribly if nothing changes, Aylee is determined to save the heroine at all costs. However, her complete character reversal leads to problems in high society and causes friction with her cold fiancé, Duke Van Drave. At this rate, Aylee might be the one who needs saving!

(Source: Tapas)

A businesswoman who is in her thirties, Yu-Gyeong Seo. She’s in a relationship that seems to be sinking every second. One day, her younger brother’s friend, I-Jun Gwon, abruptly comes into her life physically and mentally, starting an odd cohabitation. I-Jun Gwon, although he is the perfect house husband material, good at all kinds of house chores, he seems to dislike treating Yu-Gyeong as a senior. Why does he care for her so much? Why does he not like to treat her as Nuna? Well, maybe this cohabitation is rather impure.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Suah is a petite, red-haired designer who leads a drama-free life… until one morning, she wakes up tied to a chair. The man scowling down at her is none other than her roommate’s scary older brother, Seung-hyun, the owner of the apartment she’s been living in rent-free for the past eight years. He gives her one week to pack her bags and move out. Panicked Suah tries to plead and beg, but the coldhearted Seung-hyun’s got the upper hand. That is, until he runs into Suah at work. Turns out she’s not only an essential member of the new team he put together, but also one of the best employees he’s ever worked with. Like it or not, the two are stuck with each other for the foreseeable future… Can Suah convince Seung-hyun to let her stay? And how will Seung-hyun keep things professional with the woman he wants to kick out of his house?

(Source: Tappytoon)

After six years of life as an author, Yoon Seri hits a new hurdle: writer's block. Determined to overcome it, she sets her sights on a new genre, R-rated literature, only to find that her lack of experience is holding her back. Her search for a sexual sensei leads her to Lee Siyoon, a man willing to show her the ropes in more ways than one. But after her first taste of sexual liberty, she finds she can’t stop thinking about it. After unexpectedly reuniting with her childhood friend-turned-neighbor, Seri realizes there might be more than one way to break this writer’s block after all…

(Source: Lezhin US)

“That chubby dude will never know what he’s in for.”

Hye-Sung happened to eavesdrop on a conversation amongst his boyfriend’s classmates. But does that mean Hye-Sung’s fashion design major boyfriend, Jung-Won, will eventually move on to skinnier pastures? He can’t let that happen! Hye-Sung is determined to lose weight and keep his lover. If only he knew that Jung-Won actually loves him exactly the way he is…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Spring is in the air, the flowers are blooming…and the freshmen are thirsting. It’s the start of the semester, and everyone’s dreaming of the perfect campus life. But college isn’t all sunshine and cherry blossoms. It’s also packed with scandalous hookups, secret flings, and outrageous rumors that spread faster than midterm anxiety. From the library to the lecture halls, these tantilising tales are being whispered behind every closed dorm door. Want to find out what really goes down on campus?

(Source: Lezhin US)

A succubus has granted me a second chance at life. Each time I sleep with a new girl, she tells me a crucial future event that could change my fate.

(Source: Toomics)

A strange catastrophe has struck the world, turning people into slimes. Min-Ha secretly takes her sister, who has turned into a slime, and sets out on a journey. Their destination is the one place her sister had always longed to visit. Along the way, as she encounters people who still hold memories of her sister, Min-Ha begins to confront the unfamiliar truths about the sister she once loved.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I brought the slowest couple in the universe together and finally got them engaged, but they called the engagement off on the day of the ceremony itself! I was reborn as the male lead’s younger sister in a fantasy romance novel. But the female lead’s older brother, Aiberg Rafaello, has a severe sister complex and would not let go of his sister. So, how do I make him stop obsessing over his sister? Find him a love interest.

“What kind of person do you like, your grace?”

“I like someone with blazing-red hair and eyes like the flame, a lady who never stands down for anybody. Speaking of which… I’d say you match the description.”

I was only trying to save the lead characters’ engagement. How did I end up flirting with the female lead’s brother?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Hera is a dom who’s always looking for something “new.” It’s not until she gets introduced to Club Oasis that she finally finds her heaven on Earth: a BDSM club where anyone can make their wildest fantasies come true. This is a place where Hera can finally experience pleasure beyond what she’s ever imagined. But is she ready to go far beyond her comfort zone?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Although he never wanted to see him again, S Class Esper Seo Leehyeon ends up meeting Jin Taewoo during his Guide matching test. In the past, they were each other's closest friend but their relationship fractured and broke due to a peculiar event. In an unexpected and unpleasant reunion, Jin Taewoo becomes Seo Leehyeon's exclusive Guide, due to their high compatibility. This guy, who's acting like he's taking revenge for the past, often gets on his nerves, and an aggressive guiding begins...

"No matter how many times you reject me, you were meant to end up falling into my clutches."

Can the Esper really escape from the Guide's revenge?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Deep in the mountains, where few people venture, Nak-Bin lives alone with his shaman mother. Unlike Nak-Bin, who longs to venture out into the world, his mother always dissuades him. It is precisely because of the immense shamanic power Nak-Bin possesses. She only wishes for her son to live an ordinary life. Despite her efforts, one day, Nak-Bin's power erupts uncontrollably. Nak-Bin summons the gods one after another. His mother desperately fights the gods, but is ultimately overwhelmed by their overwhelming power. Just as a mighty ancient god is about to kill his mother, young Nak-Bin steps forward to block the god.

The god, impressed by his purity and courage, withdraws while simultaneously delivering an ominous prophecy to Nak-Bin. He is the chosen shaman of the ‘Primordial God’, a being who might bring about the world's destruction.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Yu Bom has never cared for sweet boys her age. What stirs her is the fantasy of rugged older men, those with tanned skin, rough hands, and the raw masculinity of a hard life etched into their bodies. The construction site, filled with men who embody everything she craves, becomes the perfect stage for her secret desires. But fantasies have a way of bleeding into reality, and Yu Bom is about to step into a world that blurs the line between imagination and temptation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Ryu brothers, Ryu Hyeon and Ryu On, raised in the same room, the same house, the same time. Ryu Hyeon, praised by the world as the noble and perfect eldest son, is in fact neither man nor woman, bearing a ‘defect’ in his body. To carry on the line, he receives seed from unknown men. One day, Lord Yun, their father, reveals his secret plan to Hyeon: to conceive a child with his own brother, Ryu On.

"How could you bear the seed of a mongrel? Receive superior seed to produce something superior."

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: Don't Mess With My Duke Dubless!

description:
Duke Dubless has been scorned by all who meet him: the villainess, the protagonist, even the author of his story. But when a woman from the real world transmigrates into the novel as the duke's sworn knight, she swears to protect her favorite character from any and all threats be they physical or emotional. Can Jane make good on her knightly duties and protect her fave from attacks on all sides?

(Source: Tapas)

It’s not easy to be a broke college student who also happens to a bit of a pushover. Scratch that; it’s damn hard. So when Henry receives an offer to make some easy cash, he caves in quickly. The offer? To impersonate his roommate, Felix, and go to addiction counseling in his stead. So Henry joins group counseling and meets Elliot. The most attractive, seductive man Henry has ever seen…who also happens to be a sex addict. Things are about to get a lot harder than Henry bargained for.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Yeon-Ho is a military officer who uses his supernatural abilities to protect the people from various demon-like beasts. Although the abilities he possesses are extraordinary, his energy gets thrown into a frenzy upon exceedingly long usage, and he loses consciousness if he isn't purified right after subduing those ferocious beasts.

Yet, upon opening his eyes the next morning, he realizes that his frenzied energy had unbelievably disappeared after having sexual intercourse with someone while unconscious!

Having suspicions that the Purifier, Hae-Jin, who has only ever been overtly concerned about his clan's authority and influence, couldn't have possibly purified him, Yeon-Ho pretends to lose consciousness once again... Only to grab hold of Hae-Ryung, the Purifier who enters his room for purification, and who is clearly a stranger but possesses an oddly familiar aura.

"Who... are you?"

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

A streak of blue wind blows in Mount Hua, known as Chung Pung. Chung Pung, a disciple of the Mount Hua faction, experienced great sorrow after losing his master, Shun Hyun. However, during the mission to retrieve the Four Divine Swords, he encounters individuals who become his allies and comrades. Chung Pung's footsteps are like a raging storm that races through the world, and following him, a new wind blows in Mount Hua, like a single gust of wind.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After waking up in the hospital, Shin Cheon-gi discovers that he’s lost all his memories. He can’t recall his family, his job, or even his name. But what he does remember is a steamy hot night he spent with a woman who had a heart-shaped mark in a rather…private area of her body. Cheon-gi has a feeling that this mysterious woman holds the answers to his missing memories, and he’s determined to find her - no matter how many women he has to sleep with!

(Source: Lezhin X)

Back in high school, Hyeon Ji-Woo was the ace of the legendary Seongeon High baseball team—and secretly dating his younger teammate, Choi Seon-Ho. But their sweet first love came to an abrupt end when Seon-Ho suddenly left for the U.S., breaking up with Ji-Woo without warning. Fast forward 10 years: Ji-Woo has buried all his desires and emotions under a mountain of work, living a quiet, no-nonsense life… until Seon-Ho shows up again. Not as a successful returnee or old flame, but as a temp worker—causing a scene with a bottle of whiskey in hand! Cue the chaos: awkward reunions, unresolved tension, and one very confused adult trying not to fall all over again. He was Ji-Woo’s first love, first heartbreak… and possibly, his newest headache.

Is this a second chance at love—or just a second round of disaster?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

Ma Sung Jun does part-time job at animal adoption cafe. One day, after finishing his shift and going home, he finds a lost dog of mysterious species. In usual cases, he likes cats more than dogs, but for some reason he takes the dog home. He calls the dog Tani and leaves his home to get things he needs to take care of Tani. When he comes home he finds Tani is no longer a dog?

Song Jeong-Won is an active member of the BDSM community, offering guidance and advice to newcomers. One day, he comes across a distressing post from Kang Hoseob, a beginner who has fallen into the hands of an abusive dom and is seeking help. Realizing that Hoseob lacks even the most basic knowledge of BDSM, Jeong-Won steps in—not just to rescue him but to personally guide him as his temporary dom.

"Master, I'll be good...I promise."

Jeong-Won takes on the challenge, but can he truly teach Hoseob the foundations of trust, consent, and desire before it's too late?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lady Lilian Isilot, while being one of many young ladies of high society, is known for her beauty and composure. In the Arman Kingdom, women with thin arms and legs who dress well and have mild manners are more likely to marry into prestigious families. This is why Lilian, who comes across as poised and reserved, is an ideal role model for other noble ladies despite being unmarried. So when the holy lord, Luth, appears before her and warns her of approaching evil and that she is to be his chosen warrior, Lilian quickly declines. But upon realizing that she has no choice in the matter and that saving the world will land her a kind, sexy, and hot blond husband she only sees in Wananet Flixenchil’s novels, Lilian decides to accept the mantle of warrior and lead a double life!

(Source: Tappytoon)

He was the hero who brought down the Heretic Cult that drove the Murim world to ruin. The protagonist was killed due to the betrayal of the seven emperors because he was too strong and they didn't want him to be a hero. He was reborn as Baek Gong, a crippled person who was in despair.

It's only been 30 years since my last life.

"So my enemies are still alive?"

This is his Revenge and his final journey!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Vincent, the agent of destiny, and Rue, the guardian, deliver presents to children around the world. These presents, known as 'the box of destiny' affect people's lives differently depending on the person's choice. The rule is that the agents must not interfere with the fate that the box brings, however, the warm-hearted Vincent often finds himself breaking the rules. One day, Detective Argio, who's been investigating a 30-year-old kidnapping case, meets Vincent, who looks strangely similar to a culprit he used to know. As Argio tries to uncover the mysteries behind Vincent, a new case of a missing child occurs and the evidences keep pointing towards Vincent as the prime suspect...

(Source: Copin Comics)

The curtain rises. Bastian Klauwitz and Odette von Dyssen begin their act for the empire, playing the perfectly enamored couple who are engaged to be married. But beneath the facade, the two are only playing the part as a means to their separate objectives. What they don’t realize yet is that they may be more alike at heart than they seem… In a maze of misunderstandings, secrets, and revenge, will Bastian and Odette be each other’s salvation or destruction?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Shan, who was born weak, was born in the family of Dragon Master Alterion and was a concern of his family. One day he found a dragon egg in the forest and became the master of the dragon.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Seong-Ho, a former boxer, develops his spiritual sight by chance, and because of the hallucinations he keeps seeing, he ends up quitting boxing. And then he becomes a YouTuber who experiences abandoned houses...

Hello, subscribers! This is Ghost Punch-✩ Today, I came to experience an abandoned house at XX o'clock, and I feel a strange energy here, so I'm going to try to talk to him.

"Hello, are you there? If you have anything to say, just say it and I'll listen."

"...... I love you, I love you Seong-Ho."

The bachelor ghost(?) in the abandoned house follows Seong-Ho around, and his ordinary daily life becomes more and more noisy.

"Get out! You ghost!"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

“Stop... Please stop... Aaah. Someone’s hand keeps touching me...”

“Junhee” is the nice, kind coffee shop owner. After the shop’s part-time worker, “Woosung”, sees her get groped, he's awakened to his new sexual desire and slowly starts breaking her walls.

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

title.english: I Want to Prey on You

description:
Ordered into a political marriage with a northern tribe, Princess Eun-Woo wanders out in distress and encounters a massive tiger with an injured paw. As she treats the tiger’s wound, she tells the tiger that he may “eat her” out of despair. Baek Hwi, the king of the tiger clan, is lost for words but is ignited with a different kind of hunger. Unable to forget her, the tiger king begins relentlessly pursuing Eun-Woo, determined to make her his mate…

(Source: Tappytoon)

I sacrificed my precious vacation to attend a pop-up event of a certain modern fantasy I loved so much. And on that very day, I got transported into that fantasy world. As none other than a newly hired employee at a renowned major corporation! A dream workplace with tons of benefits, a high salary, and kind, competent supervisors. Using my knowledge of the world, I quickly climb the corporate ladder!

But am I happy, you ask? Please, let me go back home.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Nam Min-Seong, who lives by the motto “Men are gold,” gets hit with a Frappuccino during his first meeting with Geon-Hyeok, whom he met on a dating app, and is then told to leave by Geon-Hyeok, an executive, while out with his running crew. Confused and humiliated, Min-Seong starts to get angry...

"He said he liked me on the app, so why is this jerk treating me like this?"

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Catherine, the daughter of a count and a psychic, discovers that La Noire, a fortune teller who can even predict death, is actually poisoning people to do so. She also discovers that her husband is plotting to use La Noire's poison to poison herself and her father. Will Catherine be able to eliminate the witch's poison and exact revenge on her husband, Jerome?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Part of YLAB's Gold String universe.

title.english: My Evil Husband is Obsessed With the Wrong Person

description:
Getting reincarnated into the world of a novel is never easy, but possessing a doomed bride on her way down the aisle to marry a murderous emperor is just unfair! Now, the newly reincarnated Angelica has no choice but to learn to survive the whims of her new husband, Emperor Ranielo… Well, at least until he falls for his fated love interest and she can slip away unnoticed. But as the days pass, Ranielo’s interest in her only grows. Can this tyrant be tamed, or will Angelica find that some destinies can’t be unwritten?

(Source: Tappytoon)

The world was transformed into a world where many people were turned into cannibalistic monsters due to an unknown virus, and the screams of the dying were swallowed up by the cries of the monsters. Kim Jong-Do, a boy who had lived a dark life because he was not paid attention to by those around him due to his innate lack of presence, survived the apocalypse because he was not paid attention to by the monsters either, and for some reason, Kim Jong-Do was able to communicate with several monsters. While he was trying to relieve his loneliness a little by communicating with the monsters, he met Jo-Myeong, a female student from his high school class, by chance. Unlike the indifference of those around him, she was one of the few people who took interest in Kim Jong-Do, and in this way, Kim Jong-Do's 'sense of non-existence' began to shake.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Eun-gil Gong’s used to seeing her name in the news. As volleyball’s problem child, she’s seen it all, but the world discussing her upcoming marriage to Hahyeon Seo, eldest son of JaeKyung and owner of her former team, is another matter... Especially since Hahyeon only offered the contract marriage to clean up the rumors about Mina—his sister and Eun-gil’s only fan—being gay. Between the money and helping Mina, it was easy to accept, but one question remains: What’s he getting out of this?

(Source: Tapas)

A growth fantasy where the protagonist, possessed by a character-raising game, turns the weakest Demon King into the strongest!

I had been raising a character in the character-raising simulation game "Evil Queen Maker" with the utmost care, only for the final villain to suddenly make her his bride. When I sent a lengthy complaint about the ending…

“Then go ahead and create a better ending yourself,” and I ended up possessed by the game’s “Evil Queen Maker”! To escape this game, I have to raise the Demon King and see the ending. But the Demon King I have to raise, Seere,” is only 7 years old. The weakest character in the entire world. Caught up in war and intrigue, as Seere grows older, he starts worrying only about how to gain the attention and affection of his teacher, Nahen.

“How do you even raise a kid?”

A parenting fantasy where the protagonist raises Seere to become the strongest Demon King.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ari is a headless grim reaper who has been guiding souls to the afterlife for hundreds of years. She has always felt unseen and unloved because no one can see her face. That all changes when she encounters Ucheol, a popular actor who can see her head and agrees to help her search for it. Will Ari find her missing head and reclaim her identity, finally freeing herself from a lifetime of loneliness?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

One ruler...One schemer...and...One assassin

The kingdom of Juushin is suffering at the hands of a cruel emperor. In order to stop his father's rule of tyranny, the crown prince will enlist the aid of a legendary assassin with reasons of her own for wanting the emperor dead.

When Shin Yiyeon, CEO of Sini Entertainment, chances across Yeo Taejin, she’s convinced she’s struck gold. With his perfect visuals and aloof personality, Taejin practically oozes star potential. Little does Yiyeon know, however… Taejin is actually the CEO of Jin Entertainment, Sini’s rival company! Intrigued by Yiyeon’s ability to spot talent, Taejin infiltrates Sini to find out the key to her success. Will he succeed in stealing her secrets? Or will it be his heart that is stolen instead…?

(Source: Tapas)

Surh Jung-woo developed Gynophobia because of his trauma when he was younger. Even as a college student he is still afraid of woman, but Yoon hae-soo is a angel like existence for Jung-woo because of his fear. He starts dating after thinking he could trust Hae-soo, but while putting everything he has on line for her he falls into debt and gets cornered. After he gets betrayed by Hae-soo the person to save him is the most beautiful girl of this college, and the famous professor Pi Eun-na. What is this beautiful teacher after, and why did she help jung-woo?

"Only the true hero can take down the Demon Lord." Well, Presidio Cage has already accomplished that... numerous times. He can catch the Demon Lord with his bare hands, but every time he does, he's sent to the beginning of the game again. Although he knows all the tips and tricks, he doesn't know how to escape this endless loop. In order to switch things up, Cage summons a "new" hero to defeat the enemy in his stead. Now, he's ready to create the ultimate newbie and finally get back home!

(Source: Tapas)

Talented office worker Ha-Gong Park’s life takes an unexpected turn when Jin Woon, a former friend who confessed his feelings for him years ago, joins the company. As their mutual attraction rekindles, Ha-Gong begins to notice that Woon keeps avoiding any physical contact. Frustrated and confused, Ha-Gong decides to visit Woon’s home late at night—only to see a stranger leaving Woon’s place...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

Stop the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, a group seeking to rule the world through demons!

Late at night, in a noisy gambling house, a ruffian bets on the family's stolen sword. The legendary Seven-Star Sword, said to control demons, is revealed. Moments later, the Sinwolmun's disciple, Sacheonpaehwang, appears from nowhere. The gambling house is devastated, corpses strewn about. Since that day, the martial arts world has been plagued by a series of gruesome and brutal incidents. The Inryungjo, a martial arts investigation agency specializing in arresting unsolved cases, is dispatched to the scene of these unsolved cases. Recognizing the emergence of a vast dark force, they hunt down its source. Meanwhile, Hui-Yeon, disguised as a man and joining the Inryungjo to avenge her family, is caught on the first day by the group's leader, Beom-Yeop. However, for some reason, Beom-Yeop forces Hui-yeon to remain in the Inryungjo.

Can the Inryungjo prevent the resurgence of the Sinwolmun, once thought lost to legend?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

What would you do for $500k? As a struggling actress, I agreed to play the part of Doting Fiancée to Jeekyung Lee, a charming, handsome heir to a Korean conglomerate—the perfect husband! Except, he’s gay. Eh, it’s fine! The only problem is... (cue ominous music) Jeehan, Jeekyung’s younger brother. That jerk may have the looks of a leading man, but he’s determined to show I’m the wrong girl for Jeekyung! It’s gonna take the performance of my life to win him over. Hah! I’m ready for my Oscar!

(Source: Tapas)

Seoyeon and Geonha once had a loveless marriage of convenience for their families’ business ambitions. Or at least, they believed it was loveless. When Seoyeon leaves Geonha for another man, Geonha finds himself wallowing in lingering bitterness and resentment. Meanwhile, Seoyeon is living a new life abroad with her young son Junu, until everything changes when Geonha seeks her out on behalf of his ailing grandmother, a wealthy businesswoman who cared deeply for Seoyeon. As the two re-enter into a pretend marriage, this time to appease Geonha’s grandmother, they discover lingering feelings that had been buried in the past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The Evil Cinderella Needs a Villain

description:
The villainess is getting married to the villain?!

Lily, a former villainess was killed by the man she loved. She was punished for her evil deeds, but when she woke up, she looked the same as before but was a supporting character in a novel.

"While I'm being abused by my stepmother every day, I'm also engaged to a trashy man?!"

Determined to reflect on her past mistakes and live a good life this time, she enters into a contract marriage with the future villain of the story in order to change his fate and leave her stepmother and two stepsisters behind.

"I do not need love to live a good life!"

The (now good) life of a former villainess who became the supporting character of a novel!

Demon.

Though it signifies the devil, Satan, and all evil in the world, here it's just a stable, high-paying, popular job. Woo-Hyuk, a convenience store part-timer struggling daily to pass the Incubus exam, held only once a year, one day receives a startling proposal from Si-Woon, his long-time, ever-helpful friend...

“You want to pass the incubus exam that badly? Then practice with me.”

A sex class begins for incubus exam prep... It feels good, but between friends... Is this okay...?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

To make a living, handsome Gangyoo hires himself out to lonely women in desperate need of a pretend boyfriend. But when his newest client is a prickly man named Soohyun, the job has never been so hard. Little does Gangyoo know that his own seedy past will catch up to bite him… and Soohyun harbors a dark secret of his own.

(Source: TappyToon)

title.english: The Little Lady Tames the Leads

description:
I was reincarnated as the young lady of a Marquis. Emir Sharon, who has no significance in the novel and her goal is to live a peaceful life! I met the main characters of the original novel as kids in the imperial kindergarten, which I'm currently attending too. I can't believe that I'm meeting all the main characters! I was happy for a while but somehow, everyone doesn't seem to be so happy with me. But I can't miss the opportunity to build a strong connection with the future protagonists. Emir Sharon is on her quest to getting close to the main characters finally begins. And when I finally come to my senses, I'm in a situation where everyone is keeping each other on check just to take the seat right next to me.

What am I going to do with these kids who already glued themselves to me?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Notes: The chapter count includes a special episode.

For years, Ju Seong-Min has lived in the shadow of his late father’s memory, treating the man’s legacy as his only gospel. But his isolated world is shattered when Baek Yo-Han, the stepbrother he hasn’t seen in years, suddenly reappears. But Yo-Han doesn’t come seeking a family reunion; he comes bearing ugly truths that threaten to dismantle everything Seong-Min believed about his father. As the cracks in his reality widen, Seong-Min finds himself trapped in a house with a man who hates him as much as he desires him. In this house of sins, the only thing more dangerous than the truth is the person telling it.

(Source: Lezhin US)

“Scramble Love,” a massive hit Japanese romance comedy manga that has sold over 10 million copies. I’ve channeled the spirit of Kim Yu-Seong, a minor extra in that manga I’ve never even read. But wait, turns out this guy is a hardcore otaku who even does cosplay, right? To live a comfortable life free from suspicion, I’ll play the part of an otaku extra and devour every romance comedy out there. But why do all the heroine clichés kick in whenever I’m with you? And not just one, but multiple? This is a real problem!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Si-Woo has a first love from the past that comes to mind whenever the rainy season comes.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Summer Anthology ([GL] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 여름).

Hector’s renowned father, a celebrated sculptor, dies just before unveiling his magnum opus - Minor: David. While reviewing his late father's estate, Hector stumbles upon a mysterious villa - inside, he finds a young man named Enoch...someone he's never seen nor even heard of. The moment Hector lays eyes on him, he realizes that Enoch was the very muse for his father's masterpiece. Driven to madness, Enoch must escape his grasp through a mad game of hide and seek, or face the beast that lies within the nature of man.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in english.

Lee Hwan, the protagonist of a web novel, receives a once-in-a-lifetime offer from a god: help said god create his web novel in return for a wish. After agreeing to this deal, Hwan is thrown into a modern world filled with fantasy elements, new technology, and martial artists. All he needs to do is follow the plotline the author set out for him, except... there is no concrete plotline! With such a plot hole, can Hwan manage to come up with a story detailed and cool enough to appease its creator?

(Source: Tapas)

Jae-Ui and Mu-Yeong, used to be in the same club but grew apart until they unexpectedly crossed paths nearly ten years after graduation. During their college days, Mu-Yeong had always admired his senior, Jae-Ui, harboring feelings that went unnoticed. Now, as adults, Mu-Yeong is excited to reconnect and warmly approaches Jae-Ui. However, Jae-Ui doesn’t share the same enthusiasm. Instead of welcoming their reunion, he seems distant and reluctant to engage in conversation. Despite Jae-Ui’s cold demeanor, Mu-Yeong persistently tries to bridge the gap between them. But as their interactions continue, Jae-Ui reveals a deeply personal and painful secret, one that explains his reluctance to reconnect. As the past resurfaces and hidden emotions come to light, their relationship takes an unexpected turn, leaving Mu-Yeong to question whether some distances are truly impossible to overcome.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Note: Part of Lezhin's SS Short Story Collection (SS 단편선) or the Depraved Collection in English.

Hello, I’m a B-list hero, Heart-Eye-Girl. I’m called “Heart Eyes” amongst the villains. My ability? The more excited I get, the stronger I become… yes, in a shamefully inappropriate way. My ability is really too much to handle~ I’ve been hiding it behind the idea of being forcibly toyed by bad guys and then beating them up! But recently, I’ve been feeling so crazy… Now even the bad guys ignore me and pick on the bigger heroes and prey on them… They then send me a bunch of pictures of chili peppers saying I have been kicked to the side… It makes me feel like “Will I be okay with this?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Rositte is a "reincarnated one," someone who recalls their past life from another world, but is framed for the murder of Duke Luchiaden. She goes back in time right before his death to save him and is shocked when he says she might be the emperor's lost daughter, foretold to be the last reincarnated one! However, Carina, another reincarnated one, insists she's the true daughter. Will Rositte be able to uncover the truth about her origins, or will Carina be crowned as imperial princess instead?

(Source: Tapas)

Mansuk, a low-born slave, was abandoned in the mountains right after birth, supposedly for stealing the energy of the Samsin Halmae (goddess of childbirth). Fortunately, he was picked up by a peddler and wandered through the eight provinces of Joseon. Thanks to his natural eloquence and quick wit, Mansuk achieved great success as both a righteous hero and a swindler. Believing that 'a swindler starves if he becomes famous,' he prepares for his last big score. His final goal is to steal the blue and white porcelain belonging to Lord Park, Hanyang's wealthiest man. However, he fails and is caught. Under Lord Park's command, he becomes a 'fake eunuch' and infiltrates the palace – as the exclusive eunuch for Queen Gyeongye, who is said to be even scarier than the King!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Raised with a strict upbringing as the son of a pastor, Kim Petros has always lived his life by the book - the Holy Book that is! Resolving to set off on his own path in search of independence, he makes the decision to pursue priesthood. But as the long years he spends in priestly training drag on, and he finds himself in need of a hobby to help pass the time, he decides to step outside his comfort zone and buy a secondhand gaming console. Petros is soon to find, however, that he’s getting much more than he bargained for when the seller, a spirited young woman and his polar opposite, mistakenly brings an adult toy. Could this mysterious woman have just the cure for his boredom, or will she prove to be his ruin instead?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of RIDI's Yongyongjukgetji Danpyeonseon (용용죽겠지 단편선) Collection.

A world where there are "superpowers," a new race of humans who surpass human abilities, and "guides" who can control their rampage. Betty, a guide, hides her identity and lives in a small town in America. One day, James, a super-powered hero, transfers to Betty's school to find the villain "Dave." Betty avoids James but continues to become involved with him. And to make matters worse, while trying to stop her best friend's rampage of superpowers, she is forced to use her guide abilities... It turns out that her friend is not an ordinary superpower, but a villain. It was Dave! Betty is caught between a villain and a hero, and her life, which she wanted to live normally, begins to spiral.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: My Husband Ascended as the Chosen One

description:
"How could you be so self-centered? You have a wife and child!"

Shirley's husband, George, flees to the capital on his own, saying that he'd return one day as the chosen one. Left all alone, she decides to raise her son, Brandon, on her own and forget about her scoundrel husband. But life is always full of surprises. Shirley had to learn it the hard way, when her irresponsible husband returned to her with pride as the chosen one.

"Forget about my past mistake and come live with me, for Brandon's sake..."

Being forced to accept George's offer, Shirley forgives her husband and moves to the capital city with her son. After all, Brandon's happiness is all she cares about.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

With a pure mind and innocent heart, Xuan Jin-Yu has lived a diligent life as a mother for her daughter Song-Yan. Even her encounter with the vengeful Mr. Spirit, a soul possessing a broken sword, cannot shake her entirely. But when Jin-Yu’s husband sells Song-Yan to make money for gambling, Jin-Yu is forced to work alongside Mr. Spirit to find her daughter. Will Xuan Jin-Yu be able to use martial arts to save the day? Or will the dark thoughts from the malicious spirit consume her mind?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Anita has had a crush on the duke's son, Lanslo, since they were little. When her family's business fails and her father goes missing, Lanslo is the only person she can lean on for help. Since Anita is currently a penniless commoner, Lanslo offers to marry her to ensure her safety and well-being. Despite Anita's love being unrequited, the couple have an amicable married life... until Lanslo finds a new lover. Now Anita knows it's time for her to back off and let Lanslo be happy... or is it?

(Source: Tappytoon)

When news anchor Eun-Seong Kang meets the enigmatic Woo-Jin Jeong, an unexpected connection pulls them into each other’s orbit. He’s a man trapped in a life that never ends; she chases meaning in fleeting moments. Their encounter feels less like coincidence — and more like fate.

(Source: Manta)

A martial artist who was reincarnated as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace, grasping the blade of vengeance.

In a time of war, "Seonhwayun" had the power. He gathered his agenda, Confucian scholars, and six colleagues to purge the corrupt emperor and nobles, and establish an empire where the people would not starve. He placed Confucian scholars on the throne, and gave his six colleagues the positions of the Six Kings of the World to support Confucian scholars. However, Confucian scholars and the Six Kings of the World, who were afraid of the rising status of the Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholars, joined forces to kill Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar. Did the gods accept Confucian scholar's resentment? Confucian scholar Confucian scholar Confucian scholar reincarnates as the Four Guardians of the Sun Palace and sharpens his sword of revenge.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Jung Taeyoon, a member of a popular K-pop idol group, is stepping into the world of acting after six years since his debut. While he's adored by fans everywhere, Taeyoon has a secret: he's the ultimate fanboy of another actor, Yoo Eunjae. Taeyoon's room is practically a shrine to Eunjae, filled with his merchandise. Finally, at the first table-read for a new movie he's set to star in, Taeyoon's dream comes true as he gets the chance to meet Eunjae in person for the very first time...

(Source: Lezhin US)

Hae-Jin and Ki-Hyeok met at the same taekwondo dojo when they were children. They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin’s expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: The first story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.
The second season of Yakuza in Love.

A girl who dreams one day, a woman who loves one day. Now she lives as the mother of two children. Her dreams were broken by reality, and the memories of her love were too short to comfort her life. Her ordinary life, or her... "The Great".

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

“Send me a DM at lunch. Pick the most secluded spot you know.”

Jeong-Han was enjoying his peaceful life as a high school teacher until he and the new student teacher, Chae-Rin, came to share their dirty secrets

(Source: DAYcomics)

title.english: The Youngest Disciple of the Hwasan Sect

description:
Biyeon always hoped to be a baby in a romance fantasy webtoon and live idly if she were ever reborn. So she's shocked when she gets her wish... but as an infant in the world of martial arts! Nevertheless, despite brutal training and harsh realities, Biyeon tries her best to form new relationships and become a true member of the Hwasan Sect. With the knowledge from her past life and the support of Hwasan disciples, can Biyeon rise to the top and find the life she dreamed of in this world?

(Source: Tapas)

Im Da-Jun became the leader of the runaway family after being kicked out of his house. Yeon-Woo, who he took in by chance, ends up in a knife assault in Yeonsu-gu, Incheon. The one who stopped Yeon-Woo from getting his revenge against the chaebol chairman was Yun Ga-Min, whose dream is to become a good student. Meanwhile, Na Hwa-Jin takes an interest and watches over them...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Belongs to Blue String universe.

Yana Jeong, a typical girl, runs into a strange man who’s out of breath during one of her part-time jobs. Little did she know that this was Kai Shim, the son of the CEO of a large jewelry corporation called Inoroo, who also happens to be a merman. Yana coincidentally runs in Kai again when she ends up working as a waitress at his birthday party, where a series of accidents lead to the two of them meeting each other again. Will Yana be able to keep up with these unexpected events happening one after another?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Little Bong-Gu and his mother come from their island home to Seoul to find his father, in the capital to make money but unheard from during the past six months. On the subway, they see an old beggar, who later joins the little girl Bong-Gu plays with while mother uses the phone.

Jae-Hyeon, an ordinary college student, has been suffering from unpleasant dreams recently. A very unpleasant dream where a giant 'red snake' appears and stares at him or squeezes his body to the point where he can't breathe. The day after having the dream, he always gets a headache that feels like he's going to burst, but when he goes to the hospital, they tell him that there's nothing wrong with his body. Then one day, Jae-Hyeon, who was on his way to his studio apartment, collapses on the street and receives help from Soo-Yeon, a senior he's not close with. From that day on, Soo-Yeon actively approaches him, saying he wants to be close with him, but Jae-Hyeon can't bring himself to push him away...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Soon will be the imminent marriage to senior high school student Shin Hae Soo?! Her partner is her sharp tongued teach, Choi Hyuk Jun?

The sweet love story after an arranged marriage of a clumsy couple with a 12 year age gap, Hae Soo and Hyuk Jun.

Dal-Ho is a sex therapist. One day, his best friend asks him a favor to reignite his wife's sexual desire. So begins an intense, eye-opening therapy session for the couple's sex life...

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

Being the only wingless princess of Tilmun, Seraphine led a lonely and miserable life among winged royals. After being killed by her own father, she wakes up 500 years later as Lady Seraphine, a young noblewoman infamous for her rare condition and wild behavior. This time, she has wings, but they are draining her mana and killing her. As more secrets surface and people from her past appear, will Seraphine finally find peace? Or will she merely remain a villainess cursed with wings?

(Source: Tapas)
A portrayal of the life of Che Guevara, from his childhood in Argentina to his capture and execution in La Higuera, Bolivia.

She’s got the perfect guy, she’s just graduated, and she’s about to go on vacation! Kaitlyn’s life was perfect… until it wasn’t. After getting dumped and finding out she has no place to stay, Kaitlyn is forced to crash at the Dune Scape, a dilapidated motel owned by her childhood crush and her brother’s best friend, Cole Thomas! Will sparks fly between the two of them? Or will Cole’s loyalty to her brother doom their relationship before it even begins?

(Source: Tapas)

As old feelings resurface and tension builds, the path to a reunion seems possible—but it won't come without its challenges.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Chae-Na, who plays the unpopular Clover in [Magical Lucky Stars], the group that protects Madeleine Village. She feels weak and inadequate as a hero, so she lives inconspicuously and endures being an unpopular member. She feels uncomfortable and awkward being in the spotlight. However, there is someone who falls in love with her at first sight after seeing her kindness! It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan.

"I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!"

She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is... After hearing the heart-fluttering words that she doesn't know anything about you and wants to get to know you more, she eventually runs away.

"There's no way such a cool person would like someone like me. There must be some kind of mistake!"

A heart-fluttering story of a super popular hero and an unpopular magical girl who accepts his confession.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Jae-Si, a legendary first-team idol leader who has fallen into mannerism, and Tae-Hwi, a five-year veteran idol leader who dreams of having a fan meeting just once. The two participate in the bizarre survival variety show "Special Mission! Man's Challenge!" Only the final one who passes the five stages will ascend to the honorable throne and get what they want...

A desperate "erotic" variety show like you've never seen before! Starting right now in a fiery heat!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.
Note: Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.

For some reason, no more boys are being born, and humanity faces an apocalyptic crisis. Amidst rampant trafficking of boys and the establishment of shelters to protect them, people continue living in their own ways. Jessica, an actress popular for her sophisticated image, has Valentine, the boss of a human trafficking cartel, as her sponsor. One day, Jin, who claims to be her younger brother, appears before her—a woman who lacked nothing and felt no regret...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Haram and Hanul are brother and sister with nobody to rely on but each other. They are also Yin, beings who blur the lines of gender and are shunned by society despite being the only ones capable of giving birth to the blessed Yang. One day, Hanul leaves with a promise to come back soon. But as six months pass without a word, Haram sets out to find him, with the unexpected help of a Yang named Chong Yun...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

The secret behind the ever-evolving “Love Chair Lab” lies in the dedication of its employees, who throw themselves into their work with full devotion!

“Ah! Mmph! Hanjun… You’re going in so deep, it feels incredible.”

“Goya’s fucking amazing at biting too. The moment I step into the office, I can’t wait to dive right into you, you know?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

The story of a passionate doctor, Yoon Ji-soo, who finds happiness by meeting Yoo Kang, a man who knows how to enjoy life.

(Source: Daum, translated)

One day, the protagonist wakes up in the body of Charlotte, a gentle healer living in a world of magic and nobility. Her new life seems peaceful, until she discovers that Charlotte had just accepted a suspicious commission: to create a love potion. The problem? Charlotte isn’t a witch, just a misunderstood herbalist mistaken for one. And before she can figure out who requested the potion, the Crown Prince himself shows up at her door. Convinced he’s the mysterious client, Charlotte panics. If she refuses now, she might lose her head for disobedience! So she decides to fake it till she makes it, brewing potions by instinct and stumbling into one awkward royal encounter after another. But the more she tries to survive, the more tangled her fate becomes with his.

“Wait… isn’t this one of those classic romance clichés?”

Apparently, it’s now her life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The Anti-Monster Force -- a group of hardened mercenaries contracted by the military to combat monsters. It’s not quite where Regan, an ordinary young factory worker, expected to find himself, but a drunken night out with his friend leads him to sign an enlistment form. Before he can blink, he’s through boot camp and the newest member of the AMF. Despite being assigned all kinds of grueling and humiliating tasks as the newbie, Regan does his best to fulfill his duty and protect humanity from fearsome monsters!

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Chae Eun-A, the youngest granddaughter of a wealthy conglomerate family, has it all: looks, money, and brains. Just as she turned twenty and thought a bright future lay ahead of her—they want her to get married?! Losing her credit card and the marriage itself are bad enough, but why does her fiancé have to be her ex-boyfriend, who’s practically her sworn enemy?! A secret campus life as newlyweds to defend her marriage (or rather, her credit card)!

(Source: Naver, translated)

The only son of a prestigious count family and a child born to bring glory to the family. Esther's life was so lonely, having suffered abuse and being forced into her fate as the next head of the family by her parents. Then, a new gardener, 'Jeong-Won', appeared in front of her. Unlike the servants who turned away from Esther for fear of angering their master, Jeong-Won was the only one who took care of Esther's wounds. Esther fell helplessly for Jeong-Won, who resembled pure kindness, and fell in love with him... Ten years later, Jeong-Won says he is leaving him and returning to his hometown.

"Don't go." "If you go, I will kill your entire family."

Will Esther's long-standing love be able to reach Jeong-Won?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Hardcore BL Danpyeonseon (하드코어 BL 단편선) Collection.

The bewitching wife of my former classmate, and her daughter who is growing more and more into a mature woman... Yeong-Jin starts to work as a private tutor at his high school friend Darren's house. Upon finding out about the secrets of the mansion, he starts an uncontrollable relationship with the ladies of the mansion.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

A YouTuber with 700,000 subscribers proposed a collaboration to me, the youngest of the family. But wait... The contract conditions are 10:0?!

Kwon Ji-Ah, who is attracted to Gu-Chan, and our oldest Gu-Chan, who needs more money! Their impromptu yet ticklish and thrilling scheme, the couple YouTuber Channel Name: Gu-Chan Ji-Ah

We... Can we overcome countless obstacles to achieve our respective goals and become true 'couple YouTubers'?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Mujik is a lowly programmer at a video game company. He regularly gets chewed out by his boss and constantly works overtime. But one day a bug in the virtual reality game he plays makes all the female NPCs fall in love with him. What’s more, the game even rewards him with the ability to charm women…in real life?! Mujik’s office is full of hotties and now he’s gonna make the most of his leveled-up charisma. It’s his game he’s playing now, so let a player play…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Taeyang doesn’t believe in love—not after the wounds left by his past relationships. Ha Hyeon, a sultry and enigmatic adult webtoon artist, has spent her life dodging judgment and misconceptions about her work. When fate throws them together in an open chatroom meet-up, the chemistry is undeniable, and by the end of the night, they find themselves tangled in heated passion. But secrets don’t stay hidden for long. Ha Hyeon’s irresistible allure catches the attention of the entire chatroom, and soon, whispers spread. Not all curiosity is innocent—some have dangerous intentions. As intrigue and obsession begin to swirl, Taeyang realizes their encounter was anything but a one-time affair.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Born seeing ghosts, Jong-Eon grew up in a world of shadows. His grim reality flips when he pairs up for a college project with Hye-Seong, a cheerful underclassman who somehow acts as a literal human ghost repellent. Desperate for a peaceful life, Jong-eon starts following Hye-Seong everywhere to keep the spirits at bay. But when he gets caught red-handed, Jong-Eon panics and blurts out the first excuse he can think of: he’s hopelessly in love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

When Seong-Gi Kim, a physical therapy major freshman, touches women's bodies with the manual therapy he learned from his grandfather, all women fall for his touch and crave more. Then, on the first day of the orientation, his hands touch an egoistic professor Yeong-Hui Han, which becomes the first step to creating his harem.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.romaji: Bukbu Daegong Buin, Chuwoseo Mot Hagetseumnida
title.native: 북부 대공 부인, 추워서 못 하겠습니다

description:
I, someone who has an almost pathological hatred of the cold, somehow ended up transmigrating into the body of the Grand Duchess of the North. But of all places, why the freezing North?! Desperate to escape what feels like certain death by freezing, I try to run away, but every single attempt is foiled by the Grand Duke, who relentlessly brings me back.

“Run away as much as you want. I’ll just catch you every single time.”

In the original story, I’m pretty sure this couple was supposed to end on bad terms—so why is he so obsessed with me? I’m telling you, I can’t survive here in this freezing cold! (Source: Naver Webtoon, translated)

title.english: This Isn't What I Signed Up For

description:
The day of Hae-Seo's interview spirals into disaster—soaked in coffee, harassed, his ex on the panel, and some sleazy, too. He only wanted a fresh start, but instead, he collides with Gong-Woo. Marked by an Alpha before he can settle in, he now has to decide if he'll spend the night with Gong-Woo to undo the mark!

(Source: Manta)

After dying unexpectedly, Chu Xiu discovers that he has transmigrated into the game world of The Great Jianghu, taking the body the eventual final boss — the leader of the Kunlun Sect! Reborn into a new life, will Chu Xiu walk the pre-destined path of a boss villain, or will he rewrite history, and forge his own legend that will sear the martial world in demonic flames?

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)

Jian Le, a powerhouse manhua artist, had never missed a day of work. And yet recently, she'd been dragging her feet on deadlines and releasing fewer pages... A deadly artist's block had her in its grip!

Faced with the platform's release pace and metrics demands, her editor, Ren Qinghe, started getting on her case. That included the proposal of a way to appeal to a wider audience... In a fury, Jian Le announced a hiatus. Her good friend Mo Caicai suggested that she take the time to experience life, such as through throwing herself headfirst into a relationship. It was then that a new resident on the floor below her caught her eye. But she couldn't have foreseen what this attraction would lead to...

(Source: Baiheverse)

Any part of a person can feel pain and carry memories. Remembered, but never touched.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Let's Take the Train Together, Shall We?
title.english: Let's Take the Train Together, Shall We?

description:
When your mundane routine of taking the train to work suddenly turns both interesting and troubling (?!) after meeting a certain someone.

Source: MU

title.romaji: Ei? Jian Dao Yige Xiao Jiangshi

description:
I suddenly got involved with a cute little zombie and asked to take him home!!!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 149 extras.

Xiao Yu, who just graduated from university, was cheated out of an offer from a big company, and by chance came to a company called "Luo Feng Life Management Consulting" to do technical development. Although the colleagues in this small company are enthusiastic, something seems wrong. The boss is a handsome man with 2.8 meter aura, but he was so angry while playing web games during work hours that he had a fight with some elementary school students...

Xiao Yu thought he had joined an unreliable and fraudulent company, but he didn't expect that the staff were not living people, and he was the only living person in this company!!

It's over, I have to use my strength to get along well with the boss, otherwise I will be punished to being a prostitute in my next life! !

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Note: Adapted from the web novel Xin Shiji, Xin Shiji (新世纪， 新冥界)

One is a beautiful chef with supreme talent in cooking who can recognise all kinds of herbs and meats and has extremely sharp senses except vision, while the other is a young man from an aristocratic family with great martial arts skills but great ambitions that cannot be realized. The two of them meet over food, and start a fantasy life working together to solve conspiracies.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

A dutiful supervisor who always follows the rules, a disobedient crook who breaks the rules, and on top of it all, a mysterious man destined to rule! What's going to happen when these three men clash?

(Source: Webnovel)

title.english: My Childhood Sweetheart Is A Star

description:
The 16 years long puppy love relationship has already blurred its boundary between family affection and love. It was thought to be eternal companion and take the romantic path in this lifetime…However, an unexpected encounter made hers him enter the fashion entertainment circle, looking at he stepping into the dazzling and sparkling new world, the celebrity path is long and full of obstacles, are they going to eventually part or stay together without any regret? Also, how will the upcoming fashionable domineering woman and the celebrity queen entangle him, and how will he choose…

(Source: Webnovel)

It is a story about a demon spirit stick who wants to die but cannot, and a semi-obscure male star friend who is having a hard time becoming popular again. They each get what they want from him, but they discover that there is someone else who is eyeing them.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Shen Yan, an unknown actor, joins the cast of "Dark Tide" without receiving any payment because he secretly loves film star Lu Ci. On and off screen, he hides his surging feelings, while Lu Ci sees through his thoughts and gently protects him. Faced with pressure from his company to create hype, Shen Yan stays true to his heart and resolutely breaks off the project, finally receiving a heartfelt confession from Lu Ci. This desperate, unrequited love story ends happily in mutual pursuit, a bittersweet and incredibly captivating tale!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Hun Qing Dangyang: Lu Xiansheng, Zhui Qi Qing Paidui
title.english: Rippling Marriage: The Way To Your Heart
title.native: 婚情荡漾：陆先生，追妻请排队

description:
The craziest thing Stella has ever done is crawling into Uncle Luk's bed. Leon Luk thought it was just an accident, but Stella posts their intimate video online. The woman who fears nothing dares to challenge powerful Leon! "Stella, you will pay for what you've done!"

(Source: WebComics)

Chen Xiao is an ordinary high school student, yet his true identity is the guardian of “Will” and “Desire,” protecting the secrets of the night. He is Yagami, revered by all spirits. But when this role is inherited by a high schooler who hates trouble, how will he choose to live each day as he endures the constant harassment from ‘Will’ and “Desire”?

(Source: KuaiKan, translated)

title.romaji: Wo de Huan Shou Keyi Wuxian Jinhua
title.native: 我的幻兽可以无限进化

description:
The Continent of Blydell is crawling with mysterious creatures with the ability to physically transform themselves into weapons, suits of armor, and tools, which makes them mankind's best friends. Together, they help fusion beast tamers defend their home and accomplish things beyond their limits. A young tamer and his beast friends take on a great adventure. As he works his way up, he discovers a huge secret!

(Source: WebComics)

Inspector General of the Special Division, has been hunting the serial killer Zero for years, and her pursuit has become an obsession. But who could have known that Jiang Tan, the brilliant doctor who is always by Xia Zhi’s side and enjoys her complete trust, is actually Zero’s other face.
