When her lover turns out to be two-faced, both an angel and a devil stand before her… Genius Doctor: “I need to use bodily fluids to control your mind and calm your hormonal activity. I’ll need to take a deep sample. I’m a doctor—surely the Inspector General won’t think too much of it?” Serial Killer: “The hormones the Inspector General is secreting—is it because I’m making you happy? I’m so glad~”

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The fish circle the bait beneath calm waters of a lake. Inside the club, Jiang Rang follows Qingzhou's invisible "fishing line" into a private room. Qingzhou plays prey, but he's the hunter. As passion ignites, a hidden camera rolls and intimate sounds reach a third listener. Blood fades in the dark water. Who's really the catch in this deadly game of seduction?

She was forced to sell her body to save her ill mother. In the end, she still lost her mom. Just when she was immersed in grief and pain, she discovered that she was accidentally pregnant. She had to work in the entertainment industry to survive but she ran into the father of her child...who is the CEO of the company?!

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

While out begging at the tender age of ten, Momo was snatched by child traffickers and hidden away on a storage vessel. But luckily, he met up with Qiao Boqi, who had arrived to apprehend those traffickers; the two bonding instantly. Qiao Boqi then brought Momo back to his private residence and bestowed the young one with the new name "Qiao Ying (影: Shadow)". Thus, Momo—as Qiao Ying—began his new life as Qiao Boqi's adopted younger brother. But sometime later, Qiao Ying will become dragged into a spiraling struggle with the Prince of Yan...

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

"This school is full of evil spirits" was the first thing Nightmare Tang said when she arrived at the school. She is a young psychic who fiddles around and wards off evil spirits for a living. After setting up the P.R.C., she recruits two other members through despicable means, and the three of them begin an unusual school life with multiple paranormal encounters.

(Source: Webnovel)

Two men from different walks of life meet after they stumble upon a strange murder. Though three years pass, they inevitably become drawn together again to begin the hunt anew. A game of cat and mouse between men that isn't just filled with tension, but also daring passion!

(Source: INKR)

Lori, a top-rated idol, was held hostage by a mysterious beast on a stormy day. The police rushed to the beach to "rescue" Lori, but he chose to end his life by jumping into the sea with the beast. The gorgeous boy was then reborn with resentment. 16-year-old Lori and his classmate, Ivan, are selected as idol trainees of an entertainment company. However, Lori's life goal is no longer simply debuting with his partner and becoming popular. He vows to change the tragic fate of his previous life, even if that means being in grave danger...

(Source: WebComics)

Ye Xi was an ordinary girl, nothing special. She wasn't the worst at anything, but she was never the best either. She was as invisible as air, practically invisible. Until she met Li Zhao… Li Zhao had her own goals; she wanted to become a top fashion designer. From a young age, every step she took was a step closer to her dream. “Clothing can not only change a person's temperament, but also give them boundless confidence,” this saying inspired Ye Xi to embark on her own fashion design journey. She wondered, what kind of transformation could this path bring her? Fortunately, she wasn't alone on this journey. She gained two good friends: the sweet-looking, dramatic Bai Xiaotao and the academically gifted Sun Zhiya. This is the story of a group of girls who met through fashion and are pursuing their dreams, occasionally interspersed with some lighthearted and silly everyday moments!

title.romaji: Tie Jian Chunqiu Zhi Ba Yue Shiwu
Dang Wenrou de Ta bei Po Jiele Zha Mao Juben
title.native: 当温柔的他被迫接了炸毛剧本

description:
Wen Wan graduated at the top of his acting class, hoping to grab a kind-wife role, raising kids and doing housework, but he ended up in a power bottom role instead. That's not what he was trained to do!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The demon prince led the his brothers to the human world to carry out the "successor test". He forced Wen Xi'er who was just beginning to fall in love, to have a love affair with her. The domineering prince frequently becomes jealous and uses various seductive tricks for showing his charm. Can the cute human girl tame the scheming demon prince and reap a thrilling but interesting sweet first love?

(Source: WebComics)

A bossy CEO gets reincarnated as a busker and runs into our innocent main character. Coincidentally, the company where the main character works at belongs to the CEO's family. What will happen to them now?

(Source: Tencent, translated)

"If you're going to say you're sorry, act like you really mean it. Didn't you say you'll do anything?" Han Zaizhou arrogantly told the man who was trying to apologize. Lu Heliu wasn't expecting forgiveness, but if he could do something to ease the other man's pain, he is willing to do whatever it takes.

"Anything you want."

"Then you'll do whatever I want. Until I am satisfied."

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Since the Great Voyage era, Europeans in East Asia has become more and more active. In the second half of the 19 century, China opened its ports, the Formosa located in south-east become a hot spot base on its geopolitical position. People come here to adventure, to visit, to do missionary work, to do business and to go sightseeing...
This is the advanture of Formosa at the end of the century, one Europe's romance and searching, following the footsteps of Thomas and Dodo from where they started.
(Source: pubmatch)

Yin Chai, an ordinary commuter, "died" in an accident. To return his soul to flesh, he has to accept the trials of Yama and become a qualified Hell Officer! After a series of missions, he comes to realize that his death wasn't an accident…

(Source: Webnovel)

Based on game DNF, the story tells the legends of the planet Arad. Great warriors come and go, as their stories unfold. Each may seem to be an independent tale, but their fates are intertwined, as they guard Arad through the past, present and future of the world. No matter if we fight alone or side by side, we will fight with the true heart of a warrior!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The minor immortal Hua Yu who lives in the Ninth Kingdom along the Cloud River, gave up immortality and descended to the mortal realm in search of her beloved. Getting to know him again, starting as strangers, becoming familiar, then adventuring together until finally, that fateful moment when he will remember. Will that cold face be able to sense the feelings in the maiden's heart?

(Source: QQ, translated)

Do-Gwon, the protagonist, returned to school in Seoul as a native. Girls from the rural provinces start to gather around him to learn the 'Seoul dialect'.

"They said students from Seoul are known for having sex."

These girls seem to have some misunderstanding about Seoul!

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Eun Seo-U, once a promising shooting star in his school days, had to give up his athletic career after suffering an eye injury in a traffic accident and ended up working as a police officer in his hometown. One day, amid a string of trivial complaints and reports, he hears the sound of a shower running in a house where no one should be... Mistaking the sound for a burglar, he swings a frying pan—only to hit his ex-boyfriend, Yeon Ha-Neul, who is standing there naked?! Unlike Seo-U, who had pushed him away out of guilt over the accident, Ha-Neul approaches him again as if nothing had happened.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

A simple clerk and customer routine becomes a rhythm neither wants to lose. In-Ha’s concern becomes habit, and Jae-On waits for it like breath. Convinced a beta cannot draw an alpha’s eye, he uses a pill that mimics omega traits. Affection grows, but so does the strain of a bond built on pretense.

(Source: Manta)

Rosalyn poured her heart and soul into her family's business, making it the wealthiest trading company in the empire... but her ungrateful father refuses to let her inherit it! Instead, he pawns her off to the bankrupt royal family, offering her hand in marriage to Prince Robien and even agreeing to settle their debts in exchange for a noble title. Now, Rosalyn is hell-bent on leveraging her new status to take over her family's business. But life at the palace is cruel. Hated by the people and the queen for her commoner status, Rosalyn can't trust a single person to help her. And yet, Robien continues to rescue Rosalyn when she needs it most. Despite her wariness to rely on him, she can't help but confide in him as time goes on. Can she truly count on Robien to help her reclaim what is rightfully hers?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Chapter count includes 9 side-story chapters.

Milaya de Lua is plagued by nightmares about her ancestor, Queen Gloria. But one day, her nightmares become reality when she is attacked by an assassin and wakes up 100 years in the past as the queen herself! Gloria has left her with a message and a mission: she must restore the Wish Stone to turn back time and prevent the kingdom from plunging into despair. Aided by the queen’s diary and a duke who knows her secret, will Milaya be able to save the kingdom and herself?

(Source: Tapas)
Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

After giving up everything and going against his parents' wishes to pursue his dream of becoming a concert pianist, Lee Siyoon is met with a crippling end to his short-lived career when a car accident leaves his right hand immobile. Finding no reason left to live, he attempts to end his meaningless life. But, instead of meeting his maker, he awakens in the company of a large group of Russian servants. Thrown into this new life as Russian heiress, Tatiana Yuryevna Belchenova, there is one thing that's still familiar, the piano. Unable to give up his dream, Siyoon decides to embrace being Tatiana and attends the most prestigious classical music school in Russia. But, with Tatiana's body refusing to cooperate with Siyoon's mind, will he manage to make it to the top this time? To make matters worse, he's surrounded by some surprisingly tough competition and they're all still just teenagers! Confronted with Tatiana's dark secrets, family and classmates who despised the old Tatiana, and teenage boys who are overly interested in the new one, Siyoon has a long road ahead of him.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Male lead, why do you propose to the villainess and not the heroine?

Having the strongest man in the empire as father, the most beautiful woman as mother and three arrogant brothers; there were beauty, power and irreducible wealth no matter how much you use it. I came to possess the villainess who had everything in the novel: Ciel Valentine.

In the original story, the heroine was the adopted sister of Ciel. In the original story, Ciel had an unrequited love for the prince who chose her sister. Blinded by jealousy, Ciel bullied the heroine and so was executed in the hands of the male lead prince.

In the original story, jealousy along with tormenting others caused her to get beheaded by the prince. Thus, I tried to get my sister and the male lead together... But male lead, why are you proposing to me?

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Note: Promotional prologue of the homonym webnovel.

Magister Byeokho cooked up quite the plan–dress his son, Peony, as a woman and marry him off to the man he’d been poisoning for years. But Emperor Gyeok saw through Peony’s attempts at feminine charm. Despite his initial disdain, love blossomed between them. However, as years passed, Gyeok’s attention shifted to state affairs, leaving Peony feeling neglected. Fed up with palace life, Peony plotted his escape. New adventures await and maybe… a little romance with a masked stranger?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: chapter count includes an epilogue.

Once there was an emperor’s vassal who journeyed abroad to discover the secret of immortality. A lifetime went by, and the emperor and empire fell to dust. The vassal, now known as Chief, returns to the realm, bringing with him a boy of mysterious origin and immense power named Asura. In this unfamiliar world, Chief and Asura must reckon with peril and unrest among martial arts sects ruled by the nefarious Fort Sovereign. One thing, however, is for certain: the realm will never be the same.

(Source: WEBTOON)

A genuine pure gag romance battle about a rich high school girl who volunteers to drive a convenience store bread shuttle just to see her.

(source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

Han Seo grew up hearing that he was worthless unless he came in first. Just as he was being consumed by the realization that no matter how hard he tried, he could never satisfy his father, he encountered an extraordinary killer on an ordinary commute home. In a panic, he even kicked the man in the groin before running off, but the killer tracked him down to his home and introduced himself as a creature from the alien planet “Agape.” What’s more, he claims that Han Seo himself is a “flowerpot” for the alien race, and that a “seed” has been planted inside his body...

“Do you know the easiest way to germinate the seed? It’s pleasure.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

In the Trebian Empire’s mines, Aren and Toa led a life of harsh labor for 10 years. It was Aren’s dream to escape the mines together with his younger twin sister, Toa. However, it did not come into fruition. Toa ended her life through suicide. Losing the motivation to live without his sister, Aren commits to ending his own life. However, a mysterious figure nicknamed ‘Deed’ appears before him. Deed claims there is a method to revive Toa if Aren makes a contract with Deed…?

Born into privilege and raised like a princess, Oh Ro-Ji looks spoiled on the outside, but underneath the theatrics is someone painfully soft-hearted. To live a “normal” life, she’s spent years pretending to be the perfect girlfriend, forcing herself through a relationship that finally ends when her hopelessly bad-in-bed boyfriend pushes her past her limit. One night, Ro-Ji wanders into a women-only bar…and locks eyes with Lee Jin. Instant attraction. A spark she’s never felt before. And when Jin shows her what real desire feels like, Ro-Ji discovers a world of pleasure that she can only share with her.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Best friends for 17 years, Yeoreum and Noeul always kept things platonic—despite Noeul’s not-so-secret crush. But one impulsive birthday wish crosses a line they can’t uncross. Now Noeul’s acting like nothing happened, while Yeoreum is slowly losing it. Can their friendship survive the fallout, or is this the summer that changes everything?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Talent doesn't always run in the family.

In an age ruled by science, there remain almighty witches with mythical powers. However, Diana ended up lacking any of her mother's witchly talent. In fact, ever since she began training at the age of 7, her only goal was to reunite with her sister. But life never turns out how we want, does it?

(Source: Manta)

Jihyuk doesn’t do boyfriends, only one-night stands. So, when he’s on the prowl one night for someone to warm his bed…he gets punched in the face instead. The reason? He’s a beta and if you haven’t heard, betas aren’t exactly in demand right now. While he’s nursing his wound in the bathroom, someone falls out of one of the stalls. It is an alpha and one clearly in rut. Jihyuk is about to call the ambulance when the alpha tells him there’s only one thing he needs: a beta. Well, that can be easily arranged. But is Jihyuk prepared to get down and dirty to help the mysterious alpha? And why does the alpha look so familiar? But more importantly, will this one-night shenanigans end at that or will this force Jihyuk to break his own rules?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seon-U Lee, an omega, has agreed to carry a child for Beom Yoo, an alpha from a powerful crime family. Have the baby, take the money, and get out of Beom’s life. Sound simple, right? But behind Beom’s tough exterior is just another softie looking for love. Good food, walks on the beach, and steamy encounters—how could Seon-U not fall for him? However, not everyone in Beom’s family is excited about this budding relationship. Will Beom be able to keep Seon-U safe?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.

What if an ordinary office worker suddenly becomes the main character of an erotic manga!? Ian, an ordinary office worker who has been single for a long time and has voluntarily become a nerd, suddenly starts getting involved in all kinds of lewd(?) incidents and accidents, and his coworker Aaron, who has always been displeased with him, and his always smiling, kind junior Noah, start feeling strangely stimulated by Ian's meaningless actions...

The comical, erotic, and romantic story of an ordinary office worker trapped in the world of an erotic manga and the two men surrounding him begins now.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes 11 side story chapters.

Born of an illegitimate emperor and his cunning concubine, Luana oddly inherits the true imperial family's traits: blonde hair and blue eyes. After 8 long years of her wicked mother's abuse, she foresees an even bleaker fate in a dream: her death at 18 by her mother's hand. Determined to alter destiny, she looks for the true empress, crossing paths with her half-brother, Crown Prince Loudon, who reviles Luana's family. Can she defy fate, survive, and grasp the life she's meant for?

(Source: Tapas)

The wizard Elma Ruskan has a beloved lover and disciple, Muska. Facing his final exam at the Wizards' Association this year due to unstable magic, Muska proposes to Elma, offering to live together in another country after the exam. Elma hesitates, and Muska asks him to answer after the exam, heading to the capital. However, all he receives in return is his cold left arm. Muska dies mysteriously, and his body disintegrates into various magical artifacts, which are then scattered. Elma makes a pact with Malo in exchange for half of his soul and half of his internal organs, hoping to reclaim the body of his lover, who has become a magical artifact.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Kim Ju-ah just wanted to get to work on time, but one wrong turn onto her favorite baseball team's bus leaves her trapped. The "Home Team" is muscular, hungry, and has zero boundaries. Before Ju-ah can even apologize, she’s pinned down by the very athletes she cheers for, forced to listen to their filthy promises to ruin her for any other man. In the back of the bus, Ju-ah is about to find out exactly how much "stamina" professional ballplayers really have.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Hwangjewa Bimil Yeonae Junginde Naneun Geugeol Molla
title.native: 황제와 비밀 연애 중인데 나는 그걸 몰라

description:
My Perfect Boyfriend Was Actually a Tyrannical Emperor?

In a romance novel where a war-obsessed tyrant falls in love with a sun-like saintly heroine, Carolina is reincarnated as an extra with absolutely no connection to the original plot. For Lina, an ordinary working girl who cares more about whether she has to work late tomorrow than about the romance of the century, her mundane daily life is turned upside down when, one day, a boyfriend with dazzling good looks appears as if by fate...

...I had no idea back then.

“...Lina. Are you planning to eat the emperor and run?”

That the cutest, most lovable boyfriend in the world was actually the Emperor!

A secret romance born of a misunderstanding, Lina’s heartbreaking efforts to protect her boyfriend from the cruel Emperor (?)! A sweet yet dangerous romance inside the imperial palace between a clueless girl and a straight-talking Emperor!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

For years, Seo-Hee has had a crush on Ji-Ho, a childhood friend who is more like an older brother. One day, she tries to make Ji-Ho fall for her through a hypnotic spell, and he goes along with it to keep her from leaving. But how long will he be able to keep up the act?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Part-timer, “Jooin Gong”, must face an eyesore regular at the café he works at. Always dressed in rags, nuisance of a customer, “Seojin Baek”, wastes his time at the coffee shop, smoking as much as he pleases. To Jooin’s surprise, Seojin turns out to be a famous webtoon author, the one who wrote Jooin’s favorite webtoon! Out of curiosity, Jooin tries taking a peek at Seojin’s tablet PC, only to break it by accident. Rather than asking for the money to replace his PC, Seojin offers Jooin a different part-time job instead…

(Source: Copin Comics)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Yeong-won, who once again failed to secure a full professorship, gets drunk in a fit of rage and ends up sleeping with Ui-hyeon, her closest friend. Yeong-won soon discovers that she can only escape the pressure of her professorship when having sex. She then spends a passionate night with her colleague, Louis, who suggests that Yeong-won use Ui-hyeon for a...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

"Why don't we ------ ?"

Jung Dahoon laughed out loud at a joke his longtime friend Gu Junhee made. However, Junhee had a strange expression on his face. After that day, their relationship, which was nothing more than steady friends, began to drift in a different direction. Can they be more than just friends?

A soft and endlessly sweet BL of one's youth starts now~ ♡♡

(Source: Bookcube, translated)

Note: includes 1 extra chapter.
Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

Jerome looks normal but learns he has a unique ability once he starts working and uses it to his advantage.

(Source: Toomics)

Hard-pressed to find good luck in this universe, Sun Woo-Joo gives up on his dream of becoming an idol in favor of living a normal life. That is, until he finds himself waking up from a car accident on his exam day! But as luck would have it, Woo-Joo can now copy any move exactly as he sees it, and his two left feet that kept him from debuting are now moving to the beat! With this newfound skill, will Woo-Joo be able to turn things around and become the star that shines the brightest on stage?

(Source: Tapas)

Someone's tattooing me in my sleep. On the night of his birthday, Xin, the sole heir of the powerful Zhou family, reunites with Lau, his clan guardian, and confides in him about the mysterious tattoo forming on his back. Lau begrudgingly sets off to investigate this strange phenomenon, but what secrets will he uncover along the way?

(Source: Manta)

title.english: Do or Die: You Got a Tentacle Too?!

description:
Childhood friends Nam-Ju and Yeo-Ju find themselves stuck in a dungeon, where the only way to escape is to lose their virginity to each other. They’re hesitant at first, until they end up spawning a tentacle monster to help get things started. And get started they do when Nam-Ju sees something squirming in Yeo-Ju’s pants that simply leaves her saying, “You got a tentacle too?!”

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of RIDI's Sengmotjung Danpyeonseon (섹못죽 단편선) Collection.

Kian dreamed of building a new life with his girlfriend, but fate had other plans for him.

(Source: Toomics)

"Anyone but this man — absolutely not! So why is he so needlessly beautiful and kind?"

Yoon-Ji suddenly finds herself inside the world of a novel she was writing.The pen name [Marie], which only she knew, is now the name everyone calls her. Now living as a beautiful young woman, she dreams of experiencing a sweet romance, but of all people, she ends up entangled with the second prince Henrique, a man destined for ruin!

"Have I piqued your interest or something?"

Where did it all go wrong?

A full-fledged survival romance in another world begins!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title.english: My Favorite Novel Has a Weird Epilogue

description:
Fencing champ Rina is on cloud nine after winning gold at the Olympics, but is pulled down to earth when she wakes up as an extra in her favorite novel. Though she thinks she'll have a front-row seat to the hero and heroine's romance, Rina learns that it's been 25 years since they both tragically died. On top of that, their son, Leo, is being treated like a traitor by the very royal family his parents fought to protect! Fueled by her fangirl determination, Rina raises her sword to clear Leo's name and give him the happy ending he deserves.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: The Fake Saintess Awaits Her Exit

description:
I've already died once, I won't die again! I've been reincarnated as Evelina, a saint in a fantasy novel who has lost her powers. The only problem is, this wicked saint is supposed to meet her end by burning at the stake! To escape her fate, I must use my powers of seduction to win over the three men who drove me to my demise!

(Source: Manta)

title.english: To Die or To Fall In Love

description:
Isabella Woodville has always lived in her sister’s shadow, but her life takes a dark turn when she witnesses a murder at a masquerade ball. Targeted by a masked serial killer after receiving the notorious black invitation, she’s kidnapped and brought to a cursed estate. The twisted wager? Fall in love with him within 15 days, and she dies. Resist, and she survives. Caught in a deadly game of love and survival, Isabella must navigate the line between reality and the seductive fantasy she’s been thrown into.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Top Idol and school bully switched bodies?!

Hong Joo-Ah, a school bully who is bullied every day at school. Yo-Han, a top idol loved by the entire nation. Joo-Ah envies the life of a beloved idol, while Yo-Han envies the life of a normal, free person. One day, their bodies are switched!

A spectacular body-swapping romance, Sasangdol!

(Source: Naver, translated and edited)

Lee Ja-Hyeon, a new secretary at a law firm, is intrigued by the contradictory nature of lawyer Jung Min-Seok, who, despite his outward appearance, harbors violent tendencies and secretive hobbies, and decides to get closer to him...

“I can handle pain pretty well.”

“It’s not really my place to say this, but... you have some strange tastes too, Ja-Hyeon.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.english: My Hot Harem Has Turned Cold On Me!

description:
What happens when you finally hit 100% for a character’s route in an otome game? You’d marry him, right? Wrong! Joo-ah isn’t here to commit to just one man. Ever since she woke up as the main character of an otome game, she’s been grinding her way through all four male leads–both in bed and with the game’s likeability scores. Now that she’s hit the finish line, Joo-ah is ready to settle down with her harem of hotties… But wait, why are they starting to give her the cold shoulder? The game might not be over just yet!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Yang Kye-Soo and Yun Myeong-Tae are meant to be. Or at least, that’s what Kye-Soo had always thought. With Myeong-Tae following him around and practically begging for his attention since elementary school, how could he ever get the wrong idea? So when the burly boy babbles off a list of qualities for his ideal boyfriend, Kye-Soo is left shocked and stunned - because not one of them applies to him! In order to become the man of Myeong-Tae’s dreams, Kye-Soo enlists the help of the campus’s captain of charm, the sexily seductive Kang Shin-Joo. With Shin-Joo’s guidance, Kye-Soo will do his best to learn the tricks of the trade and reel Myeong-Tae in hook, line, and sinker!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.romaji: Angnyeo Eonnireul Guhareo On Yonggamhan Gangajiimnida
title.native: 악녀 언니를 구하러 온 용감한 강아지입니다

description:
When Coco dies after five happy years with her owner Chloe, she thinks her tail-wagging days are over. But Coco can't bear to stay in the afterlife as she watches Chloe's world crumble. Taking pity on her, the Puppy God grants Coco's wish to return. Now, she's a human child who gets adopted into Chloe's family. Unfortunately, she discovers that reaching Chloe's heart is harder than any trick she's ever learned. Can she fetch the joy Chloe has lost, or has their bond slipped away like a leash?

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: Can I Rate Your Body, Too?

description:
Min-Hyeok is a dessert influencer who always finishes his day by ordering a comforting, fiery-hot bowl of kimchijjim. On a night with heavy rain, delivery complications present Min-Hyeok with an unexpected opportunity when the owner of his favorite kimchijjim spot offers to drive the food over himself. Hooked by the owner's surprisingly charming voice, Min-Hyeok hatches a plan to lure this mysterious, helpful man right into his apartment. Will this rainy night be a recipe for a steamy romance, or will the spice come back to bite Min-Hyeok?

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: OOTD: Return to Me, That's Mine!

description:
Ordinary office worker Hae-Seo has remained a fanboy of a certain singer for a decade. During his overseas trip to attend a concert, he runs into Sae-Hyeon, a bodyguard, while preventing a malicious incident. Amidst the chaos, he leaves his prized fan merchandise with Sae-Hyeon. Hae-Seo is resigned to never seeing it again… only to have Sae-Hyeon show up at his hotel door. Hae-Seo is eager to have his merch returned to him, but there’s something familiar about this man. Will Sae-Hyeon not only bring back his beloved merch, but some nostalgic memories as well?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

Joo-Yeon calls off her engagement and is taking back her wedding invitations at work when her ex-boyfriend, Yoo-Hyeon, strolls in and introduces himself as the new director. As if this situation isn't mortifying enough, he tells her no other woman could get him aroused ever since she dumped him and that she should take responsibility. Despite his crude proposal, Joo-Yeon can't help being drawn to her first love and recalling their happy memories together the more their bodies mix. She knows the obstacles that caused their breakup are still there, but could the second time be the charm?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In order to save her ill father, Yoo Yeon-Woo makes a dangerous deal to deceive the members of the esteemed Tae-Seong Group. Her task is to pretend to be her estranged twin sister, who disappeared just before her marriage to Tae-Seong’s youngest son, Cha Ki-Tae. Yeon-Woo only needs to keep up the act for six months, but in the fifth month, she is found out at the worst time possible: right after refusing to get intimate with her sister’s man. When asked for forgiveness, Ki-Tae offers her a simple solution.

“Just make it up to me with your body, Yeon-Woo.”

(Source: Tappytoon)

A 34-year-old single man, Cheol-Su, who has never had a proper conversation with the opposite sex, receives a mysterious box while spending Christmas alone like any other. However... what jumps out of it is none other than a large man wearing a maid outfit?! The man, who introduces himself as a companion robot, not only calls Cheol-Su 'master' out of the blue, but also offers to take care of not only housework but also erotic services...

Wait a minute, but why are you good at all these things(!)?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Late spring. The streets of Hongseong were soaked and bustling under the weight of the season. Exhausted and emotionally drained under her parents’ contempt and coldness, Seo-Hee crosses paths by chance with a notorious playboy known for his promiscuity.

"Ah... I didn’t mean to take it this far."
"Guess I’ll be staying the night."

A man who freely drifts between tenderness and rudeness. A man who treats people like fleeting amusements. A man who scoffs at the idea of a beautiful fairytale, calling it a hollow illusion , Joo Tae-Baek. Wrapped in brilliance and danger, he crashes into Seo-Hee like a violent wave, shaking her to her core.

"Okay. I’ll keep your secret."
"...You mean it?"
"Sure, if you let me rock your world once, nice and loud."

A dirty fling. A fleeting rush. "No need to overthink it." She thought if she let herself be consumed by him, even a false love might be better than nothing. And so, she willingly threw herself into the fire, a lighthearted affair that was anything but; Was she out of her mind? Who the hell taught her that this was how you seduce a man?

"So... we’re done now, right?"

Seo-Hee tilted her head slightly toward the completely dazed Tae-Baek.

"I need to be gone before midnight."

So then... Who really got burned in the end?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Irene Song had transmigrated inside a novel and became the villainous daughter of a duke. However, the Duke, who was unaware of this fact, simply thought she had amnesia and sends her off to marry the second prince of Rennes Empire. Little did she know that the second prince was cursed by an evil wizard and turned him into a dog during the day and could only turn back to a human at night. What’s worse, she even named it “Tofu” after she found it wandering in the Imperial Palace. Who would have known it was her own husband!

(Source: Naver, translated)

A young charming man has some fun with his dad's mistress and gets kicked out of the family mansion in the countryside. He isn't too excited to move until he comes across the maids in the house.

(Source: Toomics)

After enduring their respective hardships—Young-Woo due to his special powers and Su-Han from his thirst for revenge—the two finally overcome their struggles and misunderstandings to find peace. As they enjoy a sweet, laughter-filled newlywed life, a few small, unexpected incidents interrupt their peace.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

You don't know me. Got it?

After a rough three years in middle school, Doeun decides to return to her hometown and attend high school there for some peace and quiet. But with her old besties now the hottest, most popular guys in school, that might be harder than she thought. Why can't everyone just leave her alone?!

(Source: Manta)

On a rainy night, Yu-Seong wakes up alone amidst a pile of trash. Unable to remember who he is or where he came from, he begins a new life at Café NOAH. As Yu-Seong spends his days in a state of peaceful yet precarious existence, Kim U-Hyeon, the owner of a hardware store, appears before him. Observing Yu-Seong’s every move with a gaze that is seemingly indifferent yet piercing, U-Hyeon exudes a dangerous aura. Yu-Seong assumes their encounter is merely a passing connection, but when U-Hyeon rescues him from an attack, he makes an unexpected remark.

“We’ve met before, haven’t we? Don’t you remember?”

“Want to be friends?”

Yu-Seong, indifferent to his own wounds, and U-Hyeon, who relentlessly probes that tremor. What will the two of them face at the end of this night?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Yi Myun lives with his father. Though he possesses memories of his childhood just like everyone else, there are times when he feels like a stranger in his own home, in his own skin. He has no friends at school, and his father is alternately too cold or too loving to be entirely normal.

What, really, is going on here, and why do random people who sometimes meet Yi Myun on the streets seem to know him as someone else?

Source: Manga Updates

One day before her wedding, Ji-Yu finds her cheating boyfriend and calls off the engagement. She vents her grief by destroying her newlywed home and then meets the man living downstairs who's complaining about the noise. Then, drunkenly, she makes an impulsive offer...

"Will you hug me?"

"If you keep going, I won't stop."

The man's long fingers dug into her hair and their lips pressed together.

"From now on, don't miss a single thing and remember everything. I'll get mad if you say you don't remember because you're drunk."

She thought it was just a fleeting impulse. But why was he here?

"I'm Cha Jae-Wook. Take care."

The man downstairs, flirting in a sexy suit at the company she'd moved to to avoid her ex-boyfriend, starts flirting with Ji-Yu...

"Assistant Manager Yu Ji-Yu. Let's have an office romance."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

With a sharp mind but missing a few screws, the new student Bae Geum-joo decides to join the club after encountering Jang Han-wool. However, as their bond deepens, the shadows of the past start to grip Geum-joo's evolving emotions. Instead of seeking pure love, she yearns for possession, and rather than mere excitement, she relentlessly pursues unwavering certainty. What does Geum-joo truly desire? Experience the bittersweet and spicy flavor of "Rotten Pink Law" (without going overboard!).

Jun-Ung, an unemployed college graduate, slips into a coma when he accidentally falls off of a bridge. While he's in a comatose state, he gets an offer from the crisis response team of the underworld company Flashback to temporarily join their team. If he accepts this offer, he could wake up early from the coma and even get rid of the karma from his past life that’s been holding him back from getting jobs! He’s got nothing better to do tomorrow, so it’s a beautiful day to save lives… with these grim reapers!!

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
Note: Part of Metatoon's Sunjeong Danpyeonseon (순정 단편선) Collection.

Gunmu Cha’s final mission is to steal a precious diamond. While gathering intel at a club, he saves Teo Yeon from getting blackmailed. But what business does he have with a rich kid who’s always at the center of drama? Gunmu needs to avoid getting involved with Teo for the sake of the mission, but their natural chemistry leads to one steamy encounter after another. As the secrets keep building between them, who will get burned first?

(Source: Tapas)
From the moment this tall guy appeared in his life, nothing was the same again...

After a life of family abuse and betrayal, Lumina Lanchoux, a supernatural Leggion being, is saved from the brink of death by her half-brother Endymion. Just then, her healing powers awaken, and she is discovered by Duke Hart, the most powerful living Leggion. He sends her back in time to age 12 with the mission of saving his son Karajan from death by his own superpowers. Under the care of House Hart, Lumina is set for a peaceful second life. That is until she learns of the duke's deadly secret.

(Source: Tapas)

A woman wakes up in a hospital with no memory of who she is. She doesn’t even recognize herself in the mirror. She hit her head while falling down the stairs and suffers from temporary amnesia. As she gets to know herself, she is disappointed to find out that her handsome husband doesn’t even want to touch her and her career as an influencer is falling apart because she is suspected of murder. But it turns out she is living the life of her twin, Hae-Mi.

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

I became a disciple of the strongest!

Chaos began to invade the world. One day, a gate suddenly appeared in the world, and monsters poured out. Humanity stood on the brink of destruction. The world of martial arts, "Eun," the world of magic and knights, "Einheart," and the world of the demons, "Gehenna," were connected, and superhumans swept away the monsters. However, they were not righteous saviors. They persecuted the newly created "players" of Earth under the law of the strong. Lee Ro-Woon sought to bring peace to the world by coordinating the players with superhumans from other worlds. Due to the betrayal of his colleagues and the superhumans from other worlds who disliked his actions, Lee Ro-Woon lost everything, becoming a wreck and falling into the abyss. Just when he was about to give up, he was transported to a sealed world as a vessel of chaos, where he encountered three absolute powers. Lee Ro-Woon became the disciple of the Three Kings and reigned supreme over all!

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Mocked for having top-tier talent but the worst looks, Yeppeum Kim falls into despair, betrayed by those she trusted and robbed of everything she worked for. But then, a seeming miracle transforms her into someone breathtakingly beautiful. In the following days, she watches a dreamlike new life unfold before her eyes. Fame, attention, and endless praise are intoxicating, but something feels off. Soon, she realizes this beauty isn’t a blessing. It is a curse.

(Source: WEBTOON)

When Eilec wakes up in the past after slaughtering everyone who played a part in his beloved wife's death, he knows the best way to avoid making the same mistakes would be to let Rose go. Despite this, Eilec is determined to change the future with her by his side, as he can't imagine a life without her. But when Rose regains her memories and sees that Eilec has dragged her into the hellish world of nobles and their political scheming for the second time, he realizes he has made a grave mistake. The hatred and resentment that burns in her eyes are almost as hot as the fire that killed her in the past. Will Rose find it in herself to forgive her husband, or will she burn everything to ashes, including him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In the near future, the education system has evolved into a military competition between youths over the domination of others. The stakes are high here: the winner takes all from the loser. Schools are now mobile buildings that host their students, which are able to summon weapons of varying power and shape to battle each other. Mabaram starts from the bottom in this system and won't let his school, Metro, go down without a fight. He will have to pair up with an unexpected transfer student to assimilate other schools in order to reach the tallest heights of the rankings.

After being framed by an unknown source and getting killed by the chairman of his own gang, Kwon Noah, Ryu Jean finds himself transported two years back in time. With the knowledge of his impending death, Jean sets out to uncover the truth behind his betrayal and alter the course of events that led to his demise. However, his task is not an easy one as he must navigate through the dangerous world of the warring gangs and try to prevent history from repeating itself. Will Ryu Jean's second chance prove to be the golden opportunity he needs to rewrite his destiny?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count contains 8 side stories.

The boy in your class you have a crush on turns out to be a butler at a butler cafe! Bang Go-Woon's struggle to win his heart with 999% sweet desserts!

A romantic comedy combining sweet desserts and innocent love.

(Source: Naver, translated)

The story of a man who brings good luck and those who get carried away. Jung WonHo, an office worker who spent a normal day, accidentally saves Ji TaeWoo from a car accident. WonHo is attracted to TaeWoo, who saw the accident as a chance to approach him, and now the two are getting closer...

Legend says that a being stronger than any other, a being feared by both angels and demons, a being completely OVER THE TOP (aka OTT) will be awakened in the near future. But our average high school boy Jae-Ik doesn’t care much for this legend... until he turns 19 and members of Heaven and Hell desperately attempt to win him over. Will our soon-to-be fearsome (and uninterested) OTT be able to pick a side? Well, we'll see once the dust of the recruiting war settles.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Ji-An and Han Jeong-Won, best friends since their school days. The two naturally developed into lovers as adults, but Ji-An realizes at some point that the future she thought would always be happy is not the girl she knows...

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

Dinner with friends takes a turn when Yeon-Ji’s coldhearted college ex shows up. After all those years, Hwa-Jo wants to try again… and to date like they used to. Should Yeon-Ji give it a second chance, when all Hwa-Jo did was leave her broken and humiliated? And why is Hwa-Jo reaching out now, just as their old college friend, Mo-Ju, has returned from abroad? The timing’s peculiar, but something’s different about Hwa-Jo. Will the two rekindle a broken love? Or will dark secrets of the past stand in their way?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: The prologue included in the English version in Tapas is exclusive of that version and will not be taken into account for the total chapter count once the series is over.

Taeho, a top, has a wet dream about being on the bottom! To get rid of the restless state this put him in, he decides that he needs a relationship. Following his friend into a club, he meets a guy with a nice body, just like in that dream.

"But... why am I beneath him again?!"

title.english: Love is a Sport: Victory, Gold Hunters!

description:
Sun-Woo is an Olympic gold medalist and Korea’s pride in air shooting. He has everything under control until fencing rookie Seong-Han asks for a handshake to “borrow his winning energy.” After that, Seong-Han takes gold, and Sun-Woo crashes spectacularly. Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. What begins as a heated rivalry between two athletes quickly turns into something far more dangerous. In the Olympic Village, competition is not the only thing raising the tension.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.

A few generations ago, a mysterious phenomenon occurred. Humans now die after 1.5 billion heartbeats; half the heart rate they originally had. Schools began teaching students how to control their emotions and regularly performed heart rate tests. No one is allowed to use more than the number assigned per week.

The story of two girls who chose to love regardless of their finite heartbeats.
Youngjin joined a Role-playing Game so he could talk to his crush. Who would’ve thought that he’d be his crush’s in-game lover? How long would he keep up the pretense?

Tae Jeong-Ha and Baek Ho-Su, who have been friends for over ten years, have been living together for a year, but Ho-Su tells Jeong-Ha, who seems to have no feelings for him, that he wants to break up. However, Ho-Su had forgotten that he and Jeong-Ha used to be a campus couple! From the day after they broke up, he feels uncomfortable seeing Jeong-Ha everywhere he goes on campus, but the more he tries to end their relationship, the more entangled they become. Will they ever be able to break up completely?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Three different couples, three unique love stories—each beginning in their own unexpected way.

Song Kichan & An Hyejin
A battle of pride started by a petty argument. Wait… did they just accidentally start dating?! A classic friends-to-lovers romance.

Seo Kijun & Shin Ahyoung
After passing out after a night of drinking, Kijun wakes up with more than one gap in his memory. First, how did he get home? And second, why is one of his classmates lying in bed with him? What happened last night?!

Ha Taewook & Yang Hyein
An exciting first date! And what better to bring two young lovebirds closer together than a cafe pager? A heartwarming love story between a girl with an explosive libido and a pure-hearted boy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

When Cheong-gyeong is stranded on Mount Baekdu in the cold, he's rescued by Baek Beom, the tiger spirit that rules over the mountain. It is only right for Cheong-gyeong's memories of the supernatural to be erased and he be sent back to the human world, but Baek Beom finds himself unable to let Cheong-gyeong go. They end up spending an entire season together before Baek Beom is forced to erase Cheong-gyeong's memories and let him return to his life amongst humanity. And thus their story ends...or it may just be the beginning, right when Cheong-gyung meets a mysteriously familiar figure amidst his ordinary life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After her third divorce, my mom kept changing through lovers and even keeps asking me for money. I couldn’t understand my mom and didn’t wish to live that way either.

I believed that an ideal relationship and family that mothers dream of, doesn’t exist.

But why… Why did you have to appear in my life again and make me unnecessarily hopeful?

Flora was born to become the main character, and 'I' will always stand behind her. Being sacrificed or beaten with wretched words didn’t matter if it made Flora shine every time. Because I thought that a role was just a role.

But Flora, I have to kill you and end this play now.

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

When Theo is tasked with closing a drug deal, he encounters a man named Eric, and the ghosts of his past come knocking. Theo feigns ignorance, but Eric seeks retribution. As the two dance between forgetting and remembering, could they stumble their way into reconciliation? Or perhaps this could be the dawn of a brand new feeling…

(Source: Lezhin US)

O-Yeong Ji is a survivor! Growing up as an orphan, life wasn’t easy for her. To make matters worse, she narrowly escaped a brutal attack at her orphanage. The only reason O-Yeong’s life was spared was that she was saved by a mysterious man. Years later, she is barely scraping a living as a hospital custodian. So when she is offered a job as a live-in assistant for Logan Lee, one of the most prestigious (and handsome!) surgeons at the hospital, she gladly accepts! Little does she know… her new boss is her savior from the orphanage!

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes four side stories.

Han Tae-Oh’s return to Korea was supposed to be a brief, somber visit to bury his father. Instead, he finds himself trapped in a web of suspicion centered on Yun Gyeong-Seo, the man who stayed behind to serve his family while Tae-Oh was away. Gossip whispers of Gyeong-Seo’s involvement in his father’s decline, and the more Tae-Oh investigates, the less he recognizes his former first love. Within the walls of the sprawling mansion, Tae-Oh begins to piece together a fragmented past, uncovering a cycle of revenge that has been decades in the making. Every truth he unearths brings him closer to a terrifying realization: the person he wants to trust most may be the one who has everything to lose.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Im So-Ri, a genius voice actor who had enjoyed immense popularity with the public thanks to his star-quality looks and melodious voice, developed a fetish where he becomes aroused only by specific sounds after suffering trauma from a certain incident. Having degenerated into a person with a dark personality and perverted tendencies, he would occasionally engage in secret arousal games in public. One day, while doing just that, he discovered that the man standing behind him on the subway had the most stimulating voice he had ever heard...

“So-Ri, show me how you react to my voice.”

“You only get turned on by me, right?”

This man has an angelically beautiful face and a gentle yet somehow intense aura. His gaze and tone suggest he’s known me for a long time... it’s suspicious.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Money can’t buy happiness, but without it, you’re a slave to poverty.

(Source: Toomics)

“You treated me like some loser! Do you know how that feels?”

He's been abused and exploited by women all his life, but one day, he is given the powers of 'body restraint' by a mysterious being...

"Please, help me!! I can't move my body at all!!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it’s time to make a splash!

(Source: WEBTOON)

I know what you did that day. Do you want to turn yourself in, or take off your clothes…?

(Source: Toomics)

Years ago, vampire Im Su-I immersed herself in the human world and found true love that quenched her thirst for blood. Fast forward to the present, she is now the mother of three very handsome boys; the reliable oldest, Seung-Hyeon, the playboy CEO, Yu-Seong, and the trouble-maker youngest, Hyeo-Seong. Although they are half-human, they still have some vampire traits that are hard to shake off. Will these boys be able to find happiness amongst the humans, as their mother did?

(Source: Tapas, edited)

Seven stories. Seven sparks. One crime each time.

From pickpocketing to voyeurism, the boys in this BL omnibus break more than just laws. A smooth-talking scammer, an obsessive stalker, and a shameless cyberbully drag the objects of their desires into a world where danger fuels lust and every dirty secret is a turn-on. When one crosses the line, the other’s already hungry for more. These stories prove that the hottest crimes are the ones you don’t get caught for. After all, bad boys are irresistible.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Satan is a first year student at Demon High, but he looks too pretty for a demon with his blue eyes and shiny white hair. Can Satan overcome his physical appearance to become a true demon or are we asking the wrong question?

(Source: Tapas, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

Kim Ju-Won was forcibly dragged into this world by the system and became a hero. After five years of hard work, he finally succeeded in defeating the Demon King, but due to a breakdown in the transmission device, he was unable to return to Earth for the next ten days. Ju-Won, who was trying to organize his life in this world for the rest of his time, collapses due to accumulated fatigue and is admitted to a hospital in the city… He meets the nurses Catty and Miyo, and a patient with a familiar face from the next room…

Ten days until I return to Earth, happy times with them are about to begin in a small hospital room.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Be careful what you wish for. Orphaned at a young age, Jinheon goes to the woods each day to pray for one thing: a family to love and call his own. So, when he discovers an abandoned infant in that very same forest, he believes it a gift from the heavenly lord himself and names the boy Ju-eun: God’s grace. Not long after, Ju-eun is adopted and goes on to live a happy life with his new parents…until they die in a tragic accident. Distraught and without hope, Ju-eun is prepared to take his own life when Jinheon reappears and offers to show him what it truly means to be loved. But is familial love really all Jinheon wants to offer Ju-eun? Or is it something deeper…and much, much darker?

(Source: Lezhin)

title.english: Risky Scandal, Such a Young Mom

description:
Soo-han, who happened to be boarding at a close friend's house. But... even if my friend's mom is pretty, she's so pretty?!

(Source: Lezhin X)

In the imperial palace, where only the chosen ones can live, we could not escape and were imprisoned forever. What is kindness and what is goodness? What is a sin and who is a beast?

Can I survive in this imperial palace full of greed and fear, among those who bear arms?

Based around the politics of the imperial family, a smouldering imperial palace survival drama.

(Source: Kakao Webtoons, translated)

Women drawing swords under the guise of royal concubines. Can I survive in this imperial palace full of greed and fear?

(Source: Kakao Webtoons, translated)

What would you do if your e-girl was a boy? Find out Hee-Jae's reaction!

One year ago, I was a world-class player in the game Arcana. However, everything I built up was destroyed by Hee-Jae Shin as easily as a sandcastle. I sold my account at a high price and decided to never set foot in the game again... Even if I quit now, it doesn't mean I quit for good though, right? One year later, I made a new account just like following a homing instinct.

The Grand Mage comes back as a young girl!

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.
<i>Note: Includes two extra chapters.<i>

Hyojoo can't wait to finish school and graduate into adulthood. Gunta, her annoying brother on paper, knows she has a past that still haunts her. They may live under one roof, but share nothing else - until summer break arrives with a rush of charming possibilities and new faces. Love or lies, Hyojoo may have to choose...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Includes prologue and a two chapter side story.

Spring is the season of cherry blossoms and pink petals falling to the ground… But one of those petals lands on Melody and colors her whole world pink. She falls in love at first sight with a worker at a café, but just when she gathers enough courage to confess, he disappears... and reappears at the most unexpected place and time. Is this the long arm of coincidence? Or is it fate?

(Source: Spottoon)

Every person in this world changes, it could be anything like their desires or personalities. What if behind a person smiles hides a dark malice or depression? How will someone react to it if that person had the ability to see their hidden façade? This is the story of a girl who can see the ever changing form of humanity as she dives into the mysterious realms of the unknown and real life.

Can you form a life-changing bond with somebody overnight? It’s a question Sejoon has never imagined he’d have to ask himself, but here he is. He’s spent his entire life as an omega with an innate disgust for alphas, which has only grown since he was forced into prostitution by his own cousin. Yet when he accidentally spends a passionate night with Taeheon, a gruff but thoughtful alpha, they immediately form a bond that’s deeper than anything either of them have experienced before. But is this connection meant to last for only an instant? Or will it last for a lifetime?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lee Yu-Min began his career with an unwavering determination to succeed. While practicing for an important year-end awards ceremony, he witnesses his leader, Han Se-Gye, committing murder. Although he blackmails him into keeping it a secret for the sake of the group, Se-Gye showers him with even more aggressive physical affection than before, leaving Yu-Min both flustered and deeply confused...

“I must be losing my mind… Why is my heart racing for a murderer?!”

A ruthless killer or the affectionate leader and older brother of the team— which of these is Se-Gye’s true self?

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Gang-U Choi is an ordinary high school student who likes video games. One day, he hears that his favorite game store is going out of business. When he visits the shop one last time, the store owner hands him a QR code for a mobile game. Gang-U starts up the game out of curiosity, but something feels off…. His mission is to drink 3 glasses of water?! When he decides to ignore the mission, he suddenly receives a penalty in real life! As the missions get more dangerous, will Gang-U be able to protect his reality?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Tae-Beom, the campus custodian, is a self-proclaimed expert at spotting - and "handling" - the sexually inexperienced. With a 100% success rate and dashing good looks, he sets his sights on Chae-Yi, a hunky physical education student who seems like the perfect target. But when his usual charms lead to a hilariously dramatic breakdown instead of a smooth conquest, Tae-Beom realizes he’s met his match. Now, the hunter becomes the pursuer as Tae-Beom chases the elusive Chae-Yi to protect his flawless reputation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Seong-Eun has always walked home alone from Galaxy Academy... that is until she met Gu-Bong! Now, the two of them spend 30 minutes walking home together once a week. This 30-minute walk home becomes an exciting time for both of them as their friendship grows... into a budding romance?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)

Chun Woo-Hyeon, a top South Korean star, is on the verge of losing his career due to endless scandals. To save his reputation, his manager suggests a strategic dating scandal. But who would be the perfect partner? That’s when Baek Seondo, Woo-Hyeon’s long-lost friend—and former secret admirer—unexpectedly reappears. Now a photographer, Seondo lives far from the glamorous entertainment world. Woo-Hyeon, unfazed by their past, casually proposes, “How about a fake relationship with me?”

Seondo immediately refuses, but Woo-Hyeon’s persistence and his own unresolved feelings make him reconsider. As their contracted romance blurs the lines between pretense and reality, old wounds resurface, and hidden emotions begin to unravel. Seondo swore he wouldn’t fall for Woo-Hyeon again—but can he really resist the one person he’s always loved? And what happens when Woo-Hyeon realizes he might not want this to stay just an act?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapter.

Seungwoo's preferences shift depending on the situation he's in as well as his partner. He's a sadist one day and a masochist another. In his various relationships, he slowly discovers his own hidden desires by restricting himself and others, while also freeing them too…

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

“What's the point of being a Sword God in a past life?”

I don't know why, but I remembered my past life when I was a child. Could that be the reason I really enjoyed the virtual reality games I happened to play? However, a congenital issue eventually prevented me from accessing virtual reality, and it took seven years for a solution to finally appear.

“The capsule costs one hundred million won.”

That's expensive.

“Actually, have you heard of LEOS?”

League of Streaming? A streamer tournament? Why bring that up?

“The grand prize there is this very capsule. What do you think? Do you want to give it a shot?”

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Bul-Do Jeong was once a legend of the Korean underworld. But after a decade in prison, he walks free into a world that no longer plays by the old rules. The streets are run by a new wave of criminals known as the “MZ Gang” who are louder, flashier, and far more reckless. Though he intended to leave his past behind, he’s pushed to the edge when the youngbloods hurt those around him. Now, it’s time the city remembered who ruled these streets.

(Source: WEBTOON)

Reaching for the Stars!

When his friend Byeol confesses that he likes someone else, Junseo is more confused than ever about his own feelings. While lost in thought, he's suddenly dragged off by a new "Mr. Byeol" to the oddest club on campus. Can this new star finally put a twinkle in Junseo's eye?

(Source: Manta)
I wanted to kiss the team leader I met for the first time today!

Seven enlistments. Infinite service. Zero discharge. Kim Jae-hwan, a lowly private, has been trapped in a never-ending military time loop, forced to relive his conscription over and over again. No matter what he does, he always ends up back at square one—Private, Day 1. The only clue to breaking the cycle? A mysterious line in his military diary: “It was truly the perfect military life.” Now, in his 7th round of enlistment, Jae-hwan is ready to do whatever it takes— follow every order, befriend every superior, survive every absurdity— to finally write those cursed words… and escape. But in a place where logic is warped and sanity is optional, can one soldier truly find the perfect military life?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Shin Hyuk, the Korean leader of the elite special forces unit "55," composed of the world's best black agents, is devastated when his younger sister, Soo Min, who dreamed of becoming an idol trainee, is murdered in South America. The world tries to cover up the truth. Abandoning everything to investigate his sister's death, Shin Hyuk uncovers that the international drug cartel "XICA" is a likely culprit. In pursuit of revenge, he deliberately approaches the global K-pop star Yoo Chae-won, whom they originally targeted, as her bodyguard. Ultimately, he plunges into Brazil's deadly favela, a land where even the gods have turned their backs...

(Source: Naver, translated)

When Hyun-Woo’s reckless brother wrecks an expensive car, Hyun-Woo scrambles to find money to clean up the mess. Jae-Yoon, his current boss and once his quiet admirer, steps in and offers to cover the debt for him. A single misunderstanding twists their intentions, pulling the two men into a complicated and unexpected new phase of their relationship.

(Source: Lezhin US)

During the day, he's an elite high school teacher and by night, he's a sexy and charming man with his sights set on other men. Ian Woo managed to lead the perfect double life. That is, until he meets Dohyun Kye, the grandson of the head of the school board. After seeing his secret double life in person, Dohyun approaches Ian with a proposition. But things are only going to get worse for Ian. It's dominate or be dominated in this war for survival!

(Source: NetComics)

Note: Chapter count includes 6 extras.

Shin Eui-Jeong had been relieving the stress he faced at work and at home by partying hard at gay clubs. That day, Eui-Jeong went to the club to blow off some steam as usual, where he met Kwon Cha-Kyung, a man with the muscular build and handsome face he was looking for, but...

“You slut, you like this?”

Oh, I picked a crazy son of a bitch...

What are the odds that a one-night stand is a thug who just got out of prison? Realizing that Cha-Kyung is a dangerous man, Eui-Jeong tries desperately to escape this danger, but it seems being the mistress of a thug just suits him...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
Note: The ninth story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.

What started as a blind date takes a dark turn when Hayes finds out his date is a mob boss. Now, he’s trapped in a dangerous relationship he can’t escape.

(Source: Toomics)

Lee Chan, who started living with his best friend Ban Hwi-Seo on the condition that he watch over his sleepwalking. At night, Hwi-Seo calls himself Do Yu-Shin and lusts after his body, causing Lee Chan to fall into a confusing yet stimulating relationship...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Ha-Yoon Gong has just landed a huge gig on a major movie set. He’s forgotten and pushed around, but what he faces on set is nothing compared to the clients he sees as a host at a gay bar. Although Ha-Yoon feels his future is bleak, he powers through. But, working alone one day on set, Ha-Yoon is approached by the star actor, Ian Kwon--the first to use Ha-Yoon’s name and pay him any mind. As the two grow closer, Ha-Yoon starts to believe maybe he does deserve good things.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Jay, who lives day to day by having one-night stands with different people every day and then running away with their belongings, luckily one day, succeeds in having a one-night stand with Eugene, who seems wealthy. After spending a passionate night together, he steals Eugene's belongings while he's sleeping and runs away, but someone calls him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note:
- Chapter count includes a prologue.
- Part of Lezhin's Gwanggong Collection (광공단편선). A gwanggong (광공, hanja: 狂攻) character is obsessed with the object of their desire, similar to the Japanese "yandere". Scanlations have erroneously translated this to "GwangGong Apartment/Industrial Complex", which may have caused confusion.

title.english: The Tale of a Fox's Love

description:
Yeon is a powerful gumiho with a distrust for love and an even bigger distrust towards humans, but what will happen when she gets involved with Dong-i, a poor painter who defies all her expectations of human nature? Will Yeon finally get the happy ending she deserves, or will she pay the price for falling in love with a mortal?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Han Ho Jun decided to take a modelling career because he admired Li Tae In. Li Tae In... a skilled top model, and an unparalleled beauty, but was rumoured to have a nasty personality. But then, Ho Jun accidentally met Ho Jun's eyes during a rehearsal and they kept running into each other after that. Were those meetings just some coincidences?

(Source: Random Fujoshis)

Na Hui-Ju, a 19-year-old girl that was bullied at school was reborn as 'Aileen de Sheia', a dragon. She's happy to feel the strong power that no one has experienced and to feel the love and kindness of the people around me for the first time.

As some make their every effort to get ahold of her, some also make their every effort to get rid of her.

(Source: Kakao, translated)

Noah makes a decent living as an immortal. Hiring off his body as a human shield to high-paying clients has earned him a comfortable enough life. The only real drawback to his supernatural ability is that whoever is near him after he returns to life inexplicably falls in love with him. He's already explained that to Allen, his new employer, but he strangely doesn't seem phased by Noah's warnings...

(Source: Tapas)

When monsters show up, espers rise as heroes. But to Do-Yeong, they're nothing but glorified weapons. However, when Do-Yeong is dragged into the United Esper-Guide Force Command, he is declared the perfect guide for the two most powerful espers alive: brothers Kang-Joon and Yi-Joon. Thrust into a love triangle shaped by power and survival, Do-Yeong has to choose who and what he's willing to endure.

(Source: Tappytoon)

A strange and mysterious boy who became a guardian angel to a girl born with an unfortunate fate. Family discord, bullying at school, failure to enter college, and even a broken heart... Sena's series of misfortunes eventually led her to make an extreme choice. It is then that she gains hope for a new life thanks to her guardian angel who appears before her. Even after her new life, she is tormented by the same nightmares every day due to her unforgettable pain, but she lives proudly, taking advantage of her own abilities, which she thought were a curse, and goes to the university she was looking forward to, where she meets her ex-boyfriend. The moment she falls into despair, her guardian angel appears again.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Ji-Min’s new goal in life is to get her hands on her crush’s underwear, but not for the reason you might think! She has been advised by her fortune teller that she’ll have a chance with him if she manages to stick a charm on his underwear. But how’s she supposed to do that when even just looking at him makes her tongue-tied? Luckily, Ji-Min has a plan, but will things go the way she wants, or will she end up making her crush hate her before she even gets a chance to use the charm?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Anton, the heir to the Arnault family, has finally come of age. As is customary for nobles, he is given access to the Cyrene Salon, a cafe filled with pleasure…and secrecy. After just one unforgettable evening with Arwin, the parlor’s “number one," the normally reserved Anton has soon become filled with lust and curiosity. Who is Arwin? How did he come to such a place? What is his connection to the head of the Arnault family? But most importantly, why can’t Anton get enough of him? Find all the answers in this erotic drama by the creator of “My Mother’s Lover.”

(Source: Lezhin)

After a failed marriage, Camilla returns to the grand estate where she once worked as a maid—only to find that Mika Aberdeen, the young master she used to care for, has grown into a flirtatious playboy, constantly surrounded by women. He teases her relentlessly, igniting a desire in her to turn the tables and toy with him instead. But just as she’s about to strike, she stumbles upon a shocking secret—Mika is still a virgin?! As Camilla finds herself caught in a whirlwind of teasing and temptation, things take an even messier turn when her ex-boyfriend, Felix, suddenly returns to the estate…

(Source: Lezhin US)

One day, the owner of the divine universe makes a wager with Mephistopheles, a being from “the other side.” Their wager was to see whether a special soul born on earth would grow up to become a servant that follows the divine path or the wicked one. In present time, mid-19th century Prussia, Martin, an aspiring novelist meets a mysterious Elysse Wagner at a countryside inn. Together, they end up embarking on a journey to find an ominous group that claims to know a way to bring the dead back to life. Only, there is more to Elysse than Martin could’ve ever imagined…

(Source: Tappytoon)

Tired of high society life in the capital, Ellia Green leaves for the port city of Charlestone at the request of her childhood friend, Tobias. There, she must find Tobias' reclusive older brother Dan, the Duke of Winselton, but he is nowhere to be seen. Instead, she finds a curious young boy, Eddy, an elaborate disguise the duke uses with his magic powers. Ellia soon ends up doting on cute little Eddy, but as the duke's feelings for Ellia grow, he wonders if he can ever reveal his true identity.

(Source: Tapas)

After Quinn Solomon’s grandfather – the most powerful Blade Emperor in Continent’s End – was executed on charges of treason against the Empire, his descendants faced uncertain futures. Separated from his family, Quinn was sold into cruel slavery and used as a test subject for dangerous experiments, sinking to the lowest form of human existence imaginable. That is, until he awakened the taboo Dark Demon force of Bloodline Remembrance! Having suddenly inherited the unique powers and skills of his deceased relatives, Quinn’s journey takes a sudden turn. Fighting for his family, he now embarks on the road of revenge against the entire Empire!

(Source: WebComics)

Taichu Realm is where people's souls belong after death. The terrain is complex and the cities are numerous. They are ruled by emperors and generals who have awakened the spirits of the gods. Qin Xi and Fang Qian entered the Taichu Realm by mistake, but occasionally they met Raksha and invaded them. Bearing the legend of Tianzong, they had high hopes from the Five Divisions and practiced the spirit of the martial arts. However, with the passage of time, they gradually discovered that there was a greater danger behind Raksha ’s attack.

"That scheming boss is my ex-boyfriend?!"

What will happen when she meets her first love again...

It's a story about urban romance happening in the office. Intoxicated, Xiao Aiai "shared a bed" with the President of Student Union in her high school, and he’s also the General Manager of a company who constantly helped her in the dark. A romance story full of twists between a scheming, domineering president and a simple stubborn office lady.

(Source: Webcomics)

She had remade herself from a tomboy into a goddess. But an unfortunate encounter with the delinquent boy ruined her reputation. His bold outfits and constant flirting makes him seem like a bad guy, but in reality his intentions are pure and honest. Slowly her dislike turn into love... Have you ever liked bad boys?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

There are special creatures that live in the modern Forbidden City. By day, they're the idols of the Forbidden City, and a simple yawn can earn the squeals of the crowd! By night, they're the protectors of the Forbidden City who watch over the restoration of cultural relics! While they could've lived day to day on their cute appearances alone, they've chosen to bear the burden of preserving culture and safeguarding relics. They're the Forbidden City's Impurrial Cats!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

The rich heir Xiong Yang suddenly found himself transmigrated to an ancient era while in the middle of a football match! He thought he could just inherit his father's fortune like in his original life, but it turns out he has taken over the body of a no-good wastrel! He accidentally got involved with the Emperor himself, and he thought that he might be able to get a job as a minor official and make a little money and live a good life in a prosperous kingdom. But instead he was forced to help overcome many challenges, and as he works to change the fate of the kingdom to avoid ruin, he becomes determined to accomplish great things and leave a legacy for future generations.

(Source: MKZhan, translated)

A girl who is cheated by a jerk man, in the middle of the night, accidentally discovers that the president who can see through people's hearts is a monster?! Whenever she gets along with the president, the memory fragments in her mind will slowly piece together! Why is she the only one the CEO can't read? Who is the mysterious mermaid in the dream? Turns out the truth is...

(Source: WebComics)

When these words reach your eyes, the planet’s redemption game has already begun. Players traverse one strange world after another, fighting for the faint hope of reclaiming their homeland, while those who fall become mere onlookers. Gifted with the power to rewind upon death, Su Ming’an stands as the legendary “The Number One Player”, the strongest pillar of humanity, the torchbearer in its darkest age. Within this deadly maze, can he guide humankind toward its brightest future?

(Source: Webnovel)

The story revolves around Ye Chen, a billionaire who married into the family three years ago, only to be kicked out of his home after his wife's betrayal. After the divorce, his ex-wife and mother-in-law's attitudes undergo a dramatic change. His wife begs for another chance, while his mother-in-law is even willing to do housework and cook just to get him back home.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Her ex-fiancé, Count Charles Pembroke, became entangled with a commoner’s daughter, and high society eagerly awaited her public collapse. But no one anticipated that she would be the one to end the engagement first. After the separation, her former fiancé abruptly regretted his choices. Even more unexpectedly, the Empire’s Crown Prince began to step into her life.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

The young Xiao Pu was renowned locally for his talent, while the traveling merchant Lang Shisan was a master of both martial arts and scholarship, with a free-spirited and dashing demeanor. Their paths crossed at the Zichuan County Magistrate’s Office, just as the magistrate’s residence was being haunted. With one skilled in the arts and the other in martial arts, one calm and the other dynamic, the pair complemented each other’s strengths and weaknesses during the investigation, unexpectedly solving the mystery. After the case, inspired by Lang Shisan, Xiao Pu resolved to join him on his journey. Together, they slayed demons and vanquished evil, drawing on Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio from The Painted Skin and Nie Xiaoqian to explore how young women navigate love, family, and friendship.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

If we say that a city is a huge ecosystem, the people living in it are an important part of the food chain. Well, I, Jiang Ming, will be the top of the food chain starting today.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

That little eunuch named Ji Xiang, you succeeded in attracting my royal attention!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Season 1: 25 chapters + 5 extras
Season 2: 66 chapters + 2 extras
Season 3: Prologue + 38 chapters + 1 extra

The story begins on the third millennium of the fifth continent. Two-hundred-thousand years after the time of Bai Wunan, the world is ruled by three gods, five countries, and seventy-two clans. Until one day, a mysterious man descended from the heavens. He doesn't know where he's from or why he's here, he only knows his name is Fei Li because it was printed on his forehead. The man with the strange name, what is his purpose here, will he bring new hope and bright future to the continent, or…

(Source: Ocean Comics, translated)
