A young lady of the prime minister family, enduring for 8 years. Finally, at one day she was bestowed empress, Phoenix of the country! But life is unpredictable. Her husband loved her stepsister, deposed her as Empress and even forced her son into death. In that Cold Palace, she was forced to drink poisonous wine. So in the next lifetime, she made a promise to never do good deeds and help others, to never step into the palace and to never become the Empress!

The poor prince and the handsome guards! The overbearing bandit and the pretty scholar boy! Do you want to get close to them?

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

title.romaji: Ta Yu Ta de Elie Wanxiao

description:
Will lovers who have been in love for many years really be defeated by time? When fate brings the third people to them, is there any chance for them to make a promise to each other?

(Source: WebComics)

In the year 2018, a multiplayer survival shooting game became very popular, with over 50 million players at any given moment.

Within this game is a player... "King". The man, the myth, the legend. Unrivaled and undefeated!!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Su Chen found himself transported into a parallel world where he was part of a cast that included six celebrities that would be appearing for a mystery thriller variety show.
During the show, the cast found themselves being hunted as real fugitives for the production crew of this show wished to show its viewers the thrill and suspense of being pursued.
Watch how Su Chen makes full use of his 144 IQ intelligence and prevail!

(Source: Webnovel)

ZHONG Xiaohui's (Little seal) mother is seriously ill. To save her, her daughter needs a fortune she does not have. Luckily LAN Dongcheng (Winter morning), the young and rich hospital director, offers her a mean to earn the necessary money. Why would he do that? Does he have an ulterior motive? And could it have something to do with the butterfly tattoo on her ankle? It looks a lot like the one embroidered on Dongcheng's handchief…
Love and betrayal are waiting to be discovered in this new Chinese saga!
(Paraphrased from Xiao Pan).

As the successor of the God of Flame, Princess Thatcher just can't keep her fiery temper under control! And after a particularly bad incident involving the enemy Dragon Clan, she's exiled from her Kingdom of Rong. She can return if she journeys to the far north and finds a legendary sword that can soothe her wrath... however, the Dragon Clan is scheming something spectacularly sinister, and they need to destroy Thatcher before she reaches the sword. But this spunky young princess won't go down without a fight, and she'll set the entire world ablaze if she has to! < br>
79 chapters + prologue

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Please Be Gentle, My Bossy Uncle

description:
The killer queen has got a chance to live her life again, but two things scare her… One is when master Jue flirts with her. He is so hot that she has no idea how to turn him down! The other is master Jue's huge cannon. The moment she gets close, the fuse is blown. "Little uncle, we are both decent people. Please don't flirt with me!" But Wei Hanjue simply twitches his lips and says: "Guess thats not how I define myself.” An Yun:…

(Source: Webnovel)

After losing a bet to his friend, Taofen had to cross-dress as a punishment. What he didn’t see coming was that his friend secretly streamed him and the footage went viral on the internet...

(Source: WebComics)

title.romaji: Ni Zaibu Li Wo, Wo Jiu Hei Huale
title.english: If You Continue to Ignore Me, I'll Turn Into A Villain
title.native: 你再不理我，我就黑化了

description:
Seemingly-innocent-but-actually-calculating boy vs. cold straight guy

Bai Jinyi knows perfectly well that as a typical straight guy, Zhang Zucong cannot tell good girls from cunning ones. As a matter of fact, he loves girls who look harmless but fake. To win Zhang Zucong's love, Bai Jinyi has to hide his true self and pretend to be one of those girls...

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Adapted from the web novel Ni Zaibu Wan Wo Jiu Hei Huale (你再不弯我就黑化了).
Just like mushrooms that grow as a log rots, memories collect as life goes on. Even though you might not remember anything right now, they are still there. And will eventually be remembered.

The year is 1887 in the rolling hills of the French countryside. The estate of Viscount de Rougemerle gently basks in its verdant glory, a beacon in the twilight years of the aristocracy. With the return of the viscount’s wayward son Cameron, however, the tranquility of this stately home threatens to shatter into scandal. It falls upon Edgar O’Grady, an Irish butler in service of the Rougemerles, to maintain decorum in the household, all the while protecting his childhood friend June and his master’s daughter Lady Victoria, as each furtive glance gleams the emerald green of envy…

(Source: WEBTOON)

"No, I refuse to die this time!"

Juliet is on a mission to find that one happy ending in the loop of tragedies woven into the very fabric of her character and the world around her. From swords to tomatoes, everything in this universe seems to be a death trap designed to create the perfect Shakespearean tragedy. Only her beloved cousin, Tybalt, comes to her aid upon noticing the time loops. Juliet wants her universe back, and Tybalt wants the real Juliet back. And now, they must work together for Juliet to find her true love in Romeo so they can both get what they want…

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Ael, a mermaid with a kind and upright personality, meets the lost mermaid Ort one day while swimming in the sea and takes him in. The young Ort grew up well under Ael's care, but his obsession with Ael became so strong that he continued to hover around Ael even after becoming an adult... Unable to stand by any longer, Ael tries to persuade Ort to become independent, but Ort is furious that Ael, whom he thought of as his companion, is trying to send him far away. In the end, Ort makes Ael feel firsthand how precious he is to him... Ael is gradually losing his body and mind to Ort, who was like a son and younger brother to him, and Ort does not want to let him go. What will be the end of their relationship?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Gyeon-Wu, who worked hard plowing the fields of the heavenly world, meets Jiknyeo, who came out for a walk, and falls in love. They fall for her charms and get married in just one year. Gyeon-Wu sucked Jiknyeo every single day with incredible energy. Tired of the physical pain from sex and the mental pain of not being able to do the work of plowing the fields that he loved so much, he decides to get a divorce. But will this divorce be possible?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Jeollaeyahandonghwa (전래야한동화) Collection.

title.romaji: Tensei Akujo wa Waga Michi wo Iku
title.native: 転生悪女は我が道を行く

description:
I am a successful woman in her 30's excelling at her career. But I guess the tables turn when life seems too perfect. It is just my luck that I woke up as Camilla Elchasis, a character in my favorite novel whose life is filled with trouble. After possessing Camilla's body, I first need to get rid of my ridiculous fiancé and his mistress who are fooling around in my house. I must also deal with my half-sister and father who wish to kill me. Meanwhile, why is Duke Caliet so obsessed with me?

"You started it, so I'll finish it."

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

One day, the disgraced child actress Sara Gwon takes her own life, only to wake up… ten years in the past? Except now, she is successful, radiant, and adored by all. What happened? How did she go from public enemy number one to national sweetheart? And more importantly, can her fate truly be rewritten this time?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Night after night, a mysterious woman runs through Yoongun’s dreams. So when he happens to catch a glimpse of her in the flesh, he devises an intricate plan to lure her into his arms, determined to bring his subconscious fantasies to life. In a twist of fate, Kyu-young is searching for a way to nurse her broken heart when Yoongun makes his timely entrance. Seizing the opportunity, Yoongun proposes a tempting solution to Kyu-young’s heartache. He suggests becoming her rebound, a tool for revenge against her unfaithful ex-fiancé. Seduced by this irresistible offer, Kyu-young’s life takes an unexpected turn. Will he be her unwitting destroyer or an unexpected savior?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 19 extra chapters.

Ju-Gyeong is a powerhouse Chief Producer who has never felt a single spark of true love. But her life shatters when a rogue celestial’s forbidden arrow strikes her by mistake. Consumed by a supernatural fever, she stumbles into the arms of Hyeon-U. One look at him is all it takes for the curse to ignite, forcing a desperate confession to a total stranger. Now, Ju-Gyeong must navigate a cutthroat industry and a vengeful executive director. In a world where a cold heart leads to a cold grave, can she turn a forced obsession into a love worth living for?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Life is all about taking the easy way for Seokwoo, who feels zero guilt over robbing thousands of players as "Luke" in the VR game, Argus. Just when he's leveled up to a master criminal, however, he gets caught and is sentenced to life in prison! Luckily, Luke discovers the will of the vanquished Night King in his cell, which lets him start the game over in exchange for getting revenge on the king's enemies. Though his level and stats have been reset, it's only a matter of time before Argus' infamous thief steals his way back to the top!

(Source: Tappytoon)

“Wake up.” These are the words Sora Han hears right before her heart stops and then begins to beat again. The first and only person in the world to successfully have a plant heart transplant, Sora has felt an inexplicable pull to go to outer space ever since her operation. At 25 years old, she finally gets the chance. But why does everything on the planet she travels to seem familiar? Sora learns more about herself on this journey than she could have ever imagined.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Everyone has memories of their first love. For Dong-Ha, however, his first love only ended in regret. In high school, Dong-Ha’s feelings were reciprocated by his crush Sung-Wu, but Dong-Ha avoided his first love for fear for losing his friends if they found out about his sexuality. It wasn’t until later that he tried to express his true feelings, but by then Sung-Wu had disappeared from his life. As Dong-Ha remains remorseful of hurting his first love, One day he receives a package from Sung-Wu. Inside is a novel titled, “Memories of Sorrow from Gyeongseong.” After reading the book, Dong-Ha finds himself sucked into its fictional world. And there he meets novel’s version of Sung-Wu. This time, Dong-Ha vows to never lose his first love again… Two lovers reunited during the Japanese occupied Korea, will they be able to find each other this time?

(Source: Lezhin)

Rent-free living? What's the catch?

When her mom gets a new boyfriend, 19-year-old Su-Hyun decides to move out. In a stroke of luck, her college classmate Yu-Jin offers for her to move in for free, no strings attached. But Yu-Jin has a hidden motive... Will her secret affect their dynamic as roommates?

(Source: Manta, edited)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue

“I wanted you, and it’s not like I actually dislike you, but I can’t stand being treated this way.”

Min Jeong-Ha was adopted as the youngest son of a shamanic family that has been sought out by political and business tycoons for generations. Having grown up as the sole recipient of the attention and affection of his older brother, Min Ji-Han, who is three years his senior and possesses both a steady, gentle disposition and business acumen. Jeong-Ha suddenly becomes a thorn in the family’s side the moment he enters college. Behind Jeong-Ha’s sudden change lies the truth he has just discovered: he was adopted to serve as a scapegoat for the Min family… Filled with rage at the betrayal of being used by the very people he believed were his family, Jeong-Ha pushes Ji-Han away. Faced with Jeong-Ha’s sudden change in attitude, Ji-Han tries to force him to comply and attempts to get rid of the “problem” to win him back… But in trying to escape his brother’s disastrous obsession, has he instead brought upon himself an even worse disaster?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Convenience store part-timer Hanul places an order for 10 condoms for the handsome Hee-Jin who always comes to buy condoms. But... only 100 condoms arrived? He faces the risk of having to pay millions of won in compensation due to an ordering error, so he asks Hee-Jin, who happened to visit, to buy condoms for him. However, instead of buying condoms for him, Hee-Jin suggests to Hanul that they share all the condoms...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

A monstrous creature suddenly appears in the midst of an ordinary day, and around it, the students begin to transform into monsters one by one. Ordinariness is completely shattered, and rescue seems impossible. The students band together and survive in their own unique ways.

(Source: Naver, translated)

I possessed someone in a depraved adult BL novel and met the young obsessive male lead (Top). After being bullied by the bottom for years, he turns to a darker path in his adulthood and becomes the crown prince, indulging in imprisonment, obsession and all sorts of heinous adult past-times. Hmm… Then if the bottom never bullied the top, it would have a happy ending, right?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is the promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Late one evening, a large sum of money was transferred into her account.

“Any questions about the transfer? Talk to the bank directly! That's all I'm saying!”

There was no way he could just give it back. It wasn't that he wanted to pocket someone else's money—that's just how the world works these days. Did you think I'd fall for voice phishing? But the moment the shadowy group stormed into her home, Song-Yul realized something was terribly wrong. One man stood out distinctly from the rest. Model-like tall stature and striking features. Even his loosely worn suit seemed charming, such was the intensity of his presence. He delivered his demand to her in a cold voice.

“One hundred million.”
“Yes? Yes?”
“I'll give you 100 million won if you stay locked up like a corpse for a year.”

A year of confinement for 100 million won? It's far more dangerous than expected, and far sweeter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Wonhyo, the great magician who saved the world. It has been a full ten years since he went missing. Ara, who had always looked up to Wonhyo, encounters him now transformed into a drunken vagabond. What could have happened to Wonhyo over the past ten years? Will Wonhyo truly be able to rise again as the great magician he once was?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ji-Han Han, a normal university student who lived an ordinary life, got into a work accident and already said goodbye to his life, but suddenly he got a chance from an unknown god to resurrect in another world!

"Can I see the level and skills?"

"Use your skills to level up. Distribute stats and use items."

"Am I in another world as a playable character?"

 Ji-Han Han came to the fantasy world with the powers of a playable character. Now he will play under the name of Rudin in another world!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Yeon-Hwa dreams of mingling with a snake every night. She started having that dream on the day she saved a snake that was about to die. Then, Yeon-Hwa is captured by the villagers and offered as a sacrifice to the snake god Mu-Gae. Yeon-Hwa pleads with the snake god, saying she wants to live, but Mu-Gae immediately realizes that she is the Yeon-Hwa who saved him.

“I want to be with you, Yeon-Hwa. I want to touch you.”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: First story of RIDI's Dopamine Danpyeonseon (도파민 단편선) Collection.

Oliver "Livy" Oyle isn't the brightest bulb in the aristocracy, but he knows beauty when he sees it. When the mysterious Diesel joins the household staff, Livy is convinced he’s found his soulmate. He’s so blinded by Diesel's gorgeous face that he ignores the maid's massive shoulders and sharp tongue. Little does he know, Diesel is actually the exiled Prince Canol, a man sworn to destroy his family. Between Livy’s clumsy advances and Canol’s secret agenda, the Oyle estate is about to become the stage for a very confusing, very steamy comedy of errors.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Jun-Won is a perfectly ordinary office worker who values routine and predictability above all else. Because of this, he finds himself constantly aggravated by Yi-Jae, a fellow colleague who joined the company at the exact same time. From their work ethics to their basic personalities, Yi-Jae is the complete polar opposite of Jun-Won, making his very presence a daily source of intense frustration.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A Russian mafia boss is attacked in an assassination attempt. This betrayal, driven by a power grab within the organization, brings the entire crime syndicate to the brink of collapse. Ovcharka Boris stands before the blood of his closest friend and makes his choice: revenge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Da Seulgi is a timid female college student who becomes a [libertine/philanderer] when she drinks alcohol. She heard a rumor that you’d have to participate in company dinners to get good grades in a compulsory liberal art class with the College of Physical Education. To maintain her top rank, Seulgi was forced to go to the drinking party and kept silent in her seat amidst the noisy environment, catching the eye of ‘Oh Bora’, a popular student from the college of physical education. Bora asks her why she didn’t touch her glass and she quickly answers in surprise.

“Ah, I’m a lightweight!”
“What? Did you say ‘nice’? Awe~some! You should’ve said so before!”

She misunderstood, getting caught in the atmosphere of the college students. She got drunk and… seduced Bora who was helping her in her drunken state! A give & take love comedy between an introverted timid nerd, Seulgi and a confident extrovert, Bora.

(Source: Peanutoon, translate)

All Isaac the beta wants is to live a normal life as a slightly unskilled florist and leave his turbulent past behind. That dream quickly goes out the window, however, when the infamous arms dealer Felix waltzes into his shop and takes a liking to him. It just so happens that Isaac's family needs protection from a mysterious enemy, and luckily, Felix is more than willing to provide it in return for Isaac's body. The more Felix falls for the reserved florist, the more he wants to unlock his many secrets. And as things heat up in the bedroom, Isaac finds it harder to resist the handsome alpha and his powerful pheromones. Meanwhile, the secret about their shared past hangs in the air like a ticking timebomb...

(Source: Tappytoon)

For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

A blind date guy has appeared who is extraordinary from the moment he shows up! From tattoos visible all over his body to bizarre behavior that defies expectations and common sense! An unpredictable, cheerful, and lively romance between two people that begins with a blind date.

(Source: Naver, translated)

In a world where vampires exist, a special undercover agency keeps the rest of society safe by hunting them down. Agent “First” Shin is the best of the best. The only problem is he keeps losing partners, so he’s decided to stick to working solo. However, his manager has other plans, and a recruit is assigned to him. The new guy just won’t leave him alone, yet annoyed as he is, First also can’t ignore his model-like new partner. Is it his potential as a partner... or something else?

(Source: Tapas)

The Fourth Heavenly Demon, who was also known as the Heavenly Enlightened Warrior, a match for ten thousand enemies, and the Sacred Saint of the Sun and Moon Cult, found himself in an unexpected predicament. During the unification of Jianghu, a mishap occurred with the Soul Splitting Grand Art, resulting in his soul being mistakenly transferred into the body of the 14-year-old son of Mount Hua's Shadowless Sword Warrior.

Tsk, what is this miserable body...

Doesn't matter. I am the Invincible of the East, and all the martial arts in the world are in my head. I will unify the Jianghu once again!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

After 15 years undercover, he’s killed before exposing the crime boss. But fate rewinds him to 2005. With a second chance, he embraces the role of villain to take down the syndicate from within.

(Source: Toomics)

The druid Theophilus has been reincarnated into the body of Si-Hyeon, an ordinary office worker. In the rural village where Si-Hyeon came to recuperate after dying from overwork, Theophilus begins a life of healing using his druidic powers.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Bouquet? Check. Ring? Check. And most importantly, looking good? Check!
10 minutes before Jeong I-Jun, landlord and part of the family gang, confesses to the handsome and lovely Master of Boram Taekwondo, my sweetie Beom Su-Hyeok... Why am I so dizzy...?
What's with these short and chubby limbs?! ...I've become a baby?!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Choi Hee-in, who was relegated to the bottom of the class the moment she entered science high school. In a science high school teeming with madness and strangeness, will she be able to find her talent and survive!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Jin-Hyeok can't accept the sudden death of his boyfriend, Do-Seong, who passed away in a tragic accident two months ago. One night, he writes a letter to Do-Seong before falling asleep...and wakes up to find him standing right in front of him.

A heartfelt and mysterious story unfolds as Jin-Hyeok tries to hold on to the love he thought he'd lost forever.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Bomtoon’s and Lezhin’s Saekgwi Danpyeonseon (색귀 단편선) Short Story Collection or Dirty Demon Collection in English.

A producer who wanted to succeed as a singer, but had no talent. Death came on the day he thought was his last chance, but the gods of music did not turn away from him. If the gods of music do not abandon you, can you really do it? Change began with the gods of music.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

What if this incredibly hot guy becomes my boyfriend...?

Now that he's a college student, Taein's interest is solely focused on getting a pretty girlfriend. In reality, he not only gets a confession of love from a dude, Green, but he just can't get rid of him! After searching for ways to get rid of him, Taein and his friends find one solution, which is to date the most popular guy in his university: Soohyuk Yoo. Taein finally approaches Soohyuk without realizing the two of them are getting closer than he had expected...

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Do-Ah is secretly dating Seong-U, the most popular guy on campus. But Seong-U has a hidden secret. When she becomes entangled with Eun-Ho, who knows the truth, Do-Ah’s relationship begins to falter. A campus romance entangled with conflicting desires!

(Source: Naver, translated)

“You’re telling me a ghost possessed you and punched me in the chest?”

After seeing that his favorite junior, Mugeol, was possessed by a ghost, Ha-Jun decided to secretly perform an exorcism on him. But performing an exorcism requires physical contact…

I was secretly in love with him and had decided to back off on my own, so why is he coming closer to me!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I achieved my cozy life of a seventh-grade civil servant through a lot of hardships and nights of blacking out, so I was looking forward to the weekends where I could relax and have fun, but that night…

Is this Baek Rijin, the main character of the novel?

When I returned to my senses, I discovered I was in the novel I was reading. Did a seventh-grade civil servant like me became the spoiled young master of the great Jaegal family?! A side character, who has received excessive investments and love since he was young, and now going through a stormy period of his life… The spoiled young master of the Jaegal Family, whom the Blood Demon Cult would annihilate ten years later!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.english: A Murderous Affair at 19 Sunset Street

description:
A man is found murdered in an apartment at 19 Sunset Street. The prime suspect is Leon Devonport, the victim's lover, and all evidence found on the scene of the death seem to point to him. In order to prove his innocence, Leon seeks out Benjamin Wolf, a once-famous detective who has now retired from murder cases due to an incident in his past. Benjamin had long stepped away from murder cases, but at Leon's desperate request, with a bit of flirting, he reluctantly takes the case and begins to investigate. As the investigation progresses, Benjamin uncovers hidden truths behind the case and the complex relationships between all parties involved. What is the truth hidden behind this "murder?" What is Leon hiding from Benjamin?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kang Tae-Hwa’s first crush came to him like a fever. And ten years later, that fever is still running high when he reunites with his once privileged and untouchable love, Moon Cheong-Hyeon. But the tables have turned now, as Tae-Hwa has gone from being a poor street kid to the gangster boss of his own money-lending business, and Cheong-Hyeon is his latest customer. Cheong-Hyeon knows the violent and foulmouthed Tae-Hwa is no good for him, but he is drawn back to him anyway. And hearing this, Tae-Hwa becomes determined not to lose his first love a second time...

(Source: Tappytoon)

A man against love, and a woman in need for money... Is this love real or fake?!

(Source: Toomics)

Ju Yeon-Ho, who works as a tutor at a cram school. An Ji-Hye,a student he met during private lessons four years ago, has returned—completely transformed!?

A nerve-wracking living arrangement that began unexpectedly due to circumstances… Gone are the days of her diligence and intelligence, Ji-Hye has turned into a complete airhead!

Can the immature Ji-Hye grow into a “mature adult”?

(Source: Naver, translated)

When did I first get caught up in this game that sets off a downward spiral? Strange things begin to happen to the unapproachable genius boy.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Seo Ha-Jun, an alpha, is always the center of attention and the subject of endless rumors in his department. The morning after getting completely drunk, he wakes up to a shocking pain in his lower body and the scent of an Omega. And the person responsible? None other than Oh Yun-U, an Omega surrounded by all kinds of unsettling rumors?! Refusing to accept that he was taken advantage of—especially by that Oh Yun-U— Ha-Jun decides to confront him... "Don't tell me you forgot about last night? Especially after leaving such a clear mark."
(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title.english: Wait... I’m An Apex Alpha In Another World?!

description:
Yoo Tae-Gun, the proud underboss of the Blossom Boar Gang, falls unconscious in a fight, only to find himself in a whole new world. While he falls for the beautiful prince Abelian at first sight, there are problems to be solved. For starters, what the hell is an alpha and omega? Second, what does it mean that he’s an apex alpha?

(Source: Lezhin US)

For the grave sins of pride and insatiable greed, the majestic God of Winter is stripped of his divinity and cast down to the mortal realm as a cruel punishment. Stranded in a weak, fragile human body, he is desperate to reclaim his rightful place among the heavens. However, the path to restoring his godly status is paved with a singular, horrific condition: he must consume the living heart of the person he loves most.

As the fallen deity navigates the foreign emotions of mortality, he unexpectedly finds himself falling deeply in love, binding his fate to a human soul. Now, trapped in a agonizing paradox, Cheong-Hwi must choose between his eternal ambition and his newfound devotion to his lover, Gaeddong. To become a god once more, he must destroy his own salvation by plunging his love into a cold, bloody tragedy.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Abandoned at birth, Ba-Ri is a young girl with a mind-reading aversion. Cursed by the world, she comes to believe herself a monster. Then, the monster hunter Mu Ure appears before her.

"You are not a monster. I need you."

The moment she believes those words, her destiny awakens. The path connecting the afterlife and the human world, her journey to becoming a god, begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

After a recent divorce, Seung-Gyu takes in an abandoned human–animal hybrid lingering outside his home, unable to ignore the quiet loneliness they share. As they begin living together, Seung-Gyu names him Samsam and tries to care for him properly, but their gentle cohabitation soon deepens into an intimate bond.

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a world where dungeons have opened and some people awaken as hunters, South Korea offers an unusual deal—become a hunter and serve for ten years, and your siblings will be exempt from military service. This leads to a strange trend of wealthy families adopting children to shield their own. Yeon-woo was adopted under such circumstances, becoming a hunter to protect his younger brother, Jeong-woo. Now, five years into his service, when an unknown dungeon opens near Jeong-woo's university, Yeon-woo volunteers for a dangerous mission, ready to risk everything to protect his brother—even his life.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Nam Eun-ho, a college student living alone with his younger sister, has lived a life of extreme misfortune, beginning with a childhood car accident. Eun-ho's sole goal is to live an ordinary life, remaining unnoticed. Then, one day, a campus goddess, unexpectedly entangled with him, strikes him with a sudden urge! Is this a stroke of luck, or the start of yet another misfortune?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: Where Did All the Men Go?

description:
David wakes up in an alternate reality where men are in short supply and the government is prepared to take extreme measures to solve the birth rate crisis.

(Source: Toomics)

A prosecutor-turned-royal must race against the clock to solve a string of serial murders… before she becomes the next victim! When an overworked criminal justice employee is suddenly reborn into a novel as the rebellious Princess Charlotte, she also finds herself engaged to the handsome Duke Adler. However, there’s one big problem: according to the novel’s synopsis, Charlotte is doomed to be killed on her wedding night, and the duke is the prime suspect. Now this princess must go undercover to capture the culprit behind the series of sinister crimes… and maybe capture some hearts along the way!

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

As the top esper of a secret organization, Rick dreams of a peaceful future after meeting his destined guide. However, upon meeting Beliel, his eccentric and unpredictable nature makes Rick reluctant to embrace the guiding bond meant to bring them together. With the connection between them strained, can these two opposites truly find harmony—or will they continue to drift apart?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Kim Si-Seup, a man whose destiny is to fight with the forces of the otherworld for the rest of his life. He was rumored to be a prodigy when he was a child, but fate wasn’t on his side. The artist that he visited to find out the identity of the woman that appeared in his dreams every night only said things that he couldn’t understand… “The world is not everything you see. Maybe there’s another world we don’t know about…”

As he lives in this world, he realizes the existence of another world. He’s a man who struggled pitifully in order to protect the life and way of this world. The story of Kim Si-Seup begins! This is a crossover fantasy historical manhwa happening between Joseon and Seoul!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
Sae-mi is a cute girl with a small body, but she also hides a very big secret. She's the strongest girl on Earth!! Can she keep her identity a secret and confess to her crush, Yeong-min!

Seo-Byeol, a girl from an island village, grew up alongside her childhood friend Min-Jae, who was born with innate talent for painting. Through him, she developed an interest and dream for art. Eventually, the two moved to the capital together and enrolled in an art high school. While preparing for art school entrance exams, Seo-Byeol feels inferior to Min-Jae, and the sibling-like bond between them begins to crack.

It's the summer of their senior year, when they should be focusing intensely. Seo-Byeol faces a crisis: her family's financial troubles force her to give up everything and return to the island...

“Come to my place, Oh Seo-Byeol.”

After much deliberation, Seo-Byeol accepts Min-Jae's offer, and their secret cohabitation begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Joo-Ho, who became human from an abandoned zoo tiger; Hee-Heon, who possesses a mystical power that turned Joo-Ho into a human; the two who spent their childhood together like brothers are separated due to Hee-Heon's mistake. Then one day, 10 years later, Joo-Ho receives an urgent call from Hee-Heon.

"We need to meet right now. The spell is wearing off."

The two meet again. There, Joo-Ho hears a rather shocking method to reinforce the spell.

"You have to... do it with me for 100 days."

Will Joo-Ho be able to survive the 100 days like this and become a whole person?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

The young master of flames, Yeom-Ju, carries a rare blue fire—one that once scorched the heart of his beloved teacher, Ban-Ui, the very man who first taught him what love meant. Ban-Ui, cursed with immortality as punishment for sins in a past life, cannot die no matter how deeply he longs for release. Wracked with guilt over Yeom-Ju’s pain, he disappears without a trace, hoping distance will lessen the burden for them both. But Yeom-Ju, unwilling to let go, chooses to walk through his own personal hell to find him again. Years of longing, suffering, and searching finally lead him to Ban-Ui once more. Even now, the fire within Yeom-Ju still burns only for him. But will Ban-Ui allow himself to be found… or is the wound between them too deep to heal?

Some flames never fade. Some love never dies.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ash, a student at the esteemed Seytan Academy, has been cheating on his exams by copying the answers off his classmate Judah in exchange for “special favors.” One day he receives a text message from Isaac, another classmate who recently started flirting with him. The message contains photographic evidence of Ash's cheating. Faced with no other choice, Ash is forced to comply with Isaac's demands, straining his already complicated relationship with Judah, who at the same times begins to suspect something is amiss. Ash finds himself trapped between Isaac's blackmail and Judah's growing jealousy. Determined to protect his reputation and mend the broken trust, Ash must find a way to break free from this web of deception...

(Source: Lezhin US)

In a society where shapeshifters and humans coexist, Kim Ga-Il faces even more prejudice and hatred as a fox shapeshifter. After falling for a gangster he spent a night with while drunk, Ga-Il discovers that he is actually Kang Shin, a model student and senior in the Shapeshifter Research Department. Fascinated by this cool yet sexy senior, Ga-Il eventually decides to become the subject of Shin's research...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

For indie band vocalist Hoyeong, music is everything—his passion, his life, his identity. But when the charismatic CEO of a famous fashion label, Lee Yijun, approaches him with an unexpected offer to model for his brand, Hoyeong’s world is turned upside down. As their creative worlds of music and fashion collide, Ho-Young finds himself drawn into a whirlwind of emotions, desires, and unexpected connections that challenge everything he thought he knew about himself. In the tension between fame and authenticity, will Hoyeong be able to find his true voice?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Piljoo poured his life into supporting Taejoon. Growing up as orphans, all their firsts were together. So when Taejoon announces he’s marrying a woman—in the middle of sex—Piljoo is devastated. Taejoon’s convinced marrying rich will finally bring them safety and stability, but Piljoo breaks in the face of his lover’s betrayal. When he meets rich, sexy Seungpyoo, maybe it’s time Piljoo finally does something for himself.

(Source: Tapas)

title.english: OOTD: He Might Not Be My Husband

description:
Before going off to war, Penelope's father marries her off to a man named Ulric so she can legally inherit his assets in the event of his death. Frustrated with this decision, Penelope doesn't even look at her husband's face at the altar, nor when he leaves for the battlefield along with her father. When Ulric comes home years later, he turns out to be a kind and caring husband, but he seems different from how he portrayed himself in his letters. Is he really the same man Penelope married? If not, who on earth could he be...?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of CNC Revolution's OOTD Danpyeonseon (OOTD 단편선) Collection.

U-Yeon is a reclusive web fiction writer. Her mundane life is changed forever when Princess Charlize Rod Crosel, a minor character in one of her bestselling web fictions, decides to take destiny into her own hands by kidnapping U-Yeon and bringing her into the fictional world. Will U-Yeon and Charlize be given the opportunity to change the future and find their happy ending?

(Source: POCKET COMICS, edited)

title.romaji: Banjihaui Namjaneun Nae Bange Gamgeumdoeeo Itda
title.native: 반지하의 남자는 내 방에 감금되어 있다

description:
Gae-Seok leads an ordinary office life, but that life is the product of his obsessive efforts... His efforts to live a normal life are threatened by the thumping noises coming from downstairs every night. He's sleep-deprived and hyper-sensitive, making mistakes at work. To Gae-Seok, whose sole goal is to portray "ordinariness," the thumping noises are a life-threatening time bomb. Eventually, Gae-Seok descends to his semi-basement room to complain about the noise. As his protests intensify, he opens the door to find a mysterious man with a strangely friendly demeanor. He ignores Gae-Seok's protests, goes up to Gae-Seok's house, and ties his ankles to the windowsill...

The man who locked himself in Gae-Seok's room. What is his motive? And what was the source of the thumping noises echoing from the semi-basement?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Lionel, raised in a violent and suffocating home, finds his first real affection when he meets Arthur, an immortal merman living in human form within an old castle. But Lionel’s family is obsessed with a legend that promises eternal life through the body of a merman, and they set their sights on Arthur. Torn between love and the chains of his family, Lionel must decide whom he will protect.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.english: The 9th Class Swordmaster: Blade of Truth

description:
Adopted by the powerful Macgovern family after the death of his entire tribe, Karyl becomes the empire's greatest swordmaster who leads his men to victory in the Oracle War. But on the final battlefield, Emperor Olivurn betrays him and dooms the nation. Determined to find the cause of this treachery, Karyl travels back in time and commits himself to learning skills he never had in order to uncover the truth. Will he succeed? Or will Olivurn's trickery outsmart him again?

(Source: Tapas)

Alpha Han Woo-Yeon's only goal is to find the love of his life, omega Ji Eon-Hyeong, marry him, and spend the rest of their days in blissful happiness. When they finally cross paths again, eight years later, it feels like fate since Eon-Hyeong has also been waiting for their reunion. But there’s one major problem... The delicate omega he remembers is gone, and in his place is a big, strong, strapping alpha who towers over Woo-Yeon. Can true love overcome such an unexpected twist of fate? Or is Woo-Yeon destined to lose his first love forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

In the Eden Brozue Empire, the peace of the nation is guarded by a saint named Bethcherian. But who could have thought the next Bethcherian would be a five-year-old girl from the slums? Despite facing doubts and cold looks from narrow-minded people who refuse to accept someone from a humble background as their saint, the newest Bethcherian tries hard to adapt to her new life. Armed with determination, can this young saint successfully become the empire's proud guardian?

(Source: Tapas)

As life gets harder, Ian endures by turning off his emotions.His father's violence and debt-ridden family... Misfortune continued and his body became increasingly numb. Ian, who has become numb to pain, accidentally passes an illegal fighting scene and receives an offer. "If you join the game, I'll give you all the money on this floor." His survival period of surviving in the illegal fighting arena begins!

(Source: Naver, translated)
Just the extraordinarily unfortunate life of a high school boy... but misfortune isn't all that's extraordinary about him.

If you make tiny cuts on the skin and apply ink into that area... it becomes a tattoo - a lasting mark that won't disappear even after the wounds heal. Isn't love similar?

(Source: BOMTOON, translated)

Only a handful of restaurants have the honor of being awarded a Michelin Star. Does our up and coming chef have the courage and the skills to overcome all obstacles? Rivalries and Romance, are they an obstacle or a catalyst to become the first chef to receive a Michelin Star in Korea?

(Source: Tapastic)

Hee-Jin Yoon, former crown prince and current king of Yeon, seems to have everything. While he can no longer claim the imperial throne, he can’t be robbed of the achievements that brought him there. If he has any regrets, it is that he left his fiancée behind, never to be seen again. Ordered to wed, he quickly finds he has more questions than answers. Why marry now? Who ordered his wife to assassinate him? Why does she seem so familiar? And what happened to her memory?

(Source: Tapas)
In her campus life, full of ups and downs, she may have a magnificent appearance, but in reality, she has the most timid personality.

U-Jin Cha wants his backpacking trip through Europe to be exciting—and maybe even a little bit spicy! Instead, his hotel reservation gets canceled, and it’s pouring rain. To make matters worse, the only person around to help him is Seung-Hyeok, his year-long crush he’s trying to forget! Despite U-Jin’s initial reluctance, one night as Seung-Hyeok’s roommate turns into another... and another. This definitely isn’t the trip U-Jin had in mind, but he’s starting to wonder, is it really that bad?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 24 side story chapters.

Born and raised in a family that everyone envies, brothers Cho Kyu-Bin (Su) and Cho Eun-Bin (Gong) are so bad that they haven't had a proper conversation with each other for over 10 years. Then one day, Eun-Bin suffers from memory loss and regresses to the age of elementary school due to an unexpected accident. Kyu-Bin takes responsibility for the accident and decides to take care of Eun-Bin. When Eun-Bin was having a hard time dealing with his younger sibling who was acting like an adult, crying and clinging to him, Eun-Bin secretly visits Kyu-Bin's room late at night. "Hyung, my dick hurts." Kyu-Bin looks at his younger sibling who is sobbing without knowing what an erection is or how to relieve that desire through masturbation, and ends up having sex with him half-heartedly. Gyu-Bin realizes his mistake, but thinks, “I’ll just play around with it until his memories come back. Anyway, once his memories come back, that kid will be embarrassed and won’t be able to tell anyone.” and ends up falling into a swamp from which he can no longer get out…

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

In a world where animal hybrids represent the ultimate elite, Kim Cheol-Su is content living vicariously through his favorite simulation game, "Wooly Woods". But his digital hobby becomes a chaotic reality when he finds an abandoned hybrid kitten on his doorstep that looks exactly like his in-game companion. Cheol-Su takes the little one in for temporary protection, but as Na-Bi starts calling him "Daddy" and hits an unexpected growth spurt, the responsibilities of a hybrid owner get a lot more hands-on.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Park Hwi-Rim has the biggest crush on his team lead...until the tables turn.

(Source: Toomics, edited)

Note: Includes five side stories.

Yoon Hyunwoo is a pharmaceutical salesman with a secret craving. By day, a diligent office worker, by night, a dom... or so he wishes. Unfortunately, his girlfriend, Soojin, has no interest in BDSM. Worse yet, she’s his top client, so breaking up is out of the question. Frustrated and seeking release, Hyunwoo turns to an app to find a willing sub. What starts as harmless online flirting soon leads to a meeting—and the surprise of his life. His chat partner is none other than his cold, no-nonsense boss, Park Gaeun. As their late-night sessions grow more intense, the lines between dominance and submission, work and pleasure, begin to blur beyond control.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Cornelia Meitner’s husband is dead. She should be celebrating her newfound freedom, but with no heir to inherit the Marquis title, she’s at risk of losing her estate and the community of staff-turned-friends. To protect her lifestyle, she has only one option: get pregnant as soon as possible. Luckily, a few eligible bachelors are visiting for Marquis Meitner’s funeral, including a dashing young doctor, a lascivious poet, and a callous duke. Who will come out on top in this game of seduction?

(Source: Tapas)

Two weeks after the disaster at the Global Science Base in Antarctica. The US national research icebreaker 'Pontus' carried eight survivors of the science base disaster: Donghwan Cha, Sayaka, Nozomi, Ri Meirin, Wang Gaochang, Lee Sang-hyun, Kim Kyung-han, and Jeong Se- in, along with the only surviving infected person, Cheon Ki-wook, while heading for the Pacific Ocean while heading for the New York Harbor. Another terrible tragedy begins in the middle.

(Source: Naver Series, translated)

Note: Includes 1 extra chapter.

As an unexpected descendant of a cursed family of mermaids, Eun-Woo's only hope of survival is to never fall in love. For years this was easy enough, until one day he's forced to confront his childhood friend and first kiss, Tae-Ho. But why has he come back, toying with Eun-Woo's heart? Can Eun-Woo resist Tae-Ho's pull or will he succumb to his hidden feelings, and ultimately, disaster?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes eight extras.

There is one open secret in the influential Redhill family. Polan, the heir to Redhill, suffers from severe mysophobia and refuses to have any physical contact with women. While Gawain was worrying about his son, Etti, a mere servant, offered to help.

“I’m sure I’d be the perfect partner for the young master’s nighttime lessons...”

The opening nestled beneath his manhood was unmistakably that of a woman—

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

People know me as the High School Devil. I moved schools and changed my name to start a new life, but things keep getting in the way…

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and an epilogue.

Seoul, a second-year medical student at Korea University, was relieving academic stress in a secretive way he couldn't tell anyone about—

“Huh, hmm... right here feels so good...”

...masturbating his prostate while listening to sticky slime ASMR in his single dorm room. But when the dorm undergoes remodeling, he suddenly becomes roommates with Jin-Hu, a physical education major. His alone time vanishes, and Seoul's pent-up frustration reaches its limit....

“From now on, you're my dildo.”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Eun-Seol Jeong and Yu-Sin Ma have been inseparable since they were children, but lately, something has shifted. Returning from his army service, Yu-Sin is often sought after by girls in Eun-Seol’s orbit, all while he has been quietly shielding Eun-Seol from guys interested in her. When their families go on vacation together, Eun-Seol and Yu-Sin find the boundary of their friendship tested. Together, they’ll have to decide – what if their relationship was never just friendship?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Da-Eun Jeong and Jong-U Yun are the sole known survivors of two killing rampages perpetrated by a mysterious gang. Many years later, an investigation into a possible copycat crime forces them to revisit their trauma. Da-Eun becomes determined once again to find her boyfriend, Gyu-Heon Shim, who went missing after the murders they witnessed. Meanwhile, Jong-u is plagued by the ghost of “Room 203,” his former neighbor who came within inches of killing him. His sick brother Jong-Seok was his only reason for living, but with Jong-Seok now dead, will he help DaEeun? And will Gyu-Heon ever be found?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Blood ties bind, but vengeance severs, and in the heart of a heartless man, a fire ignites. Pil-Du Kang, a prosecutor born into a legacy of corruption, uncovers his family's harrowing involvement in his mother’s murder. Now, a chilling vendetta awakens the monster within, drawing out the primordial urge he has long sought to contain. Will he rely on the law to be his ally on this treacherous path, or will he become the judge, jury, and executioner?

(Source: WEBTOON)
Are we playing hide and seek? Who's hiding this time? Am I the seeker? Follow this topsy-turvy journey, with mind-bending plot points, and places where you'll scream "Found you!"

In a world of blood and chemicals, Jin-Seong's only weapon is his intellect and a massive lie. Spared only because he claimed to be a Beta, he's dragged into the territory ruled by Yi-Jae, the merciless leader of Nyx. As attachment forms, Jin-Seong's secret threatens to cost him everything.

(Source: Manta)

title.romaji: Sumeo Boneun BL Teukgang: Egypt Pharaoh Sungbaeui Giwon - Pharaoh Balgarak Ppara Yo
title.native: 숨어 보는 BL 특강 : 이집트 파라오 숭배의 기원 ~파라오 발가락 빨아요~

description:
Sin-Bi, a piano prodigy, has been harmonizing with Tae-Ui, a genius boy soprano, for a long time. One day, Tae-Ui suddenly leaves to study abroad, and Sin-Bi, a piano prodigy who returns to being an ordinary student, begins a competition challenge after a dramatic reunion of two high school students five years later.

(Source: Naver, translated)

As the son of a wealthy CEO and a recessive omega, Jeong-Won is constantly being pressured by his father to get married and prove his worth. But everything changes when his adoptive alpha brother, Yeong-Won, returns to Korea and declares that he was raised to be Jeong-Won's husband. Soon after, Jeong-Won's obsession with Yeong-Won leads to the pair forming a deep bond that defies their family ties...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes six extra chapters.

Two men who were in love for years but broke up because Jeonghan wanted to end things. Kangwoo wants to get back together, but Jeonghan refuses. Meanwhile, Gyu-tae, the owner of the studio where they both work at is only affectionate towards Jeonghan…an ex-boyfriend and a suspicious date. Is it possible… Can Jeonghan ever be happy?

(Source: Webnovel)

Born a natural-born alpha with a silver spoon in his mouth, Hui-Won had been living a carefree, debauched life that was the envy of all. Escaping his father’s gaze, who wanted him to take over the family business, he flees to a small village, where he meets a handsome young man named Yi-Ji. Contrary to Hui-Won’s expectations of seducing Yi-Ji for a steamy night, Yi-Ji brings his dog food and a leash himself, introducing himself as the “director of a dogfighting training camp”…

“I thought you were some kind of mutt, but you’re just a dog in heat, aren’t you?”

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

title.english: Even Though the Duchess Wants To

description:
Lariela was living an idyllic life until an ashwood box arrived at her doorstep brimming with gold--a gift from high society’s most eligible bachelor, Duke Elmano. High-ranked, well-bred and, best of all, incredibly handsome, Lariela knows that she’s in for a whole new life when he asks for her hand. But even more than the pressures of the imperial court's inner circles, it’s the Duke himself that surprises her most—when he leaves her cold and untouched on their wedding night.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes 10 extra chapters.

'If a direct purchase comes in, hit it unconditionally.'

Even with the incredible ability to read other people's thoughts Kim Ji-Seop ended his career as an unremarkable pitcher. But a second chance came to him. The best talent at the club front desk, Act 2 of Kim Ji-Seop’s baseball life begins!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
Note: Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

“I really can’t hold back anymore.” With those words, a pair of hot, alcohol-scented lips suddenly claimed mine— before I could even gather my thoughts, my dazed lips were swallowed up. ‘Uh, this is a little…’ …No, this is completely wrong! Sasha finds herself possessed inside a romance-fantasy novel where the main plot revolves around the power struggles between nobles and royals. But the moment that story becomes her reality— the genre changes entirely. It was supposed to be a wholesome, all-ages story, one where the protagonists didn’t even share their first kiss until around chapter 100... “…Why does it feel like the genre here is way too different?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Gitaek always dreamed of being in a relationship with someone who’s his ideal preference: caring, thoughtful and has a good body. After being absent for a while, he goes to his club’s meeting room and finds a new student—Jungwoo—who fits this preference and ends up confessing to Jungwoo while he’s drunk. Jungwoo is touched and a little flustered by the first confession he has ever received but, while getting to know each other, Jungwoo finds out that Gitaek’s drinking habit is confessing…

Can the two have a happy ending after an unintended push and pull?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

Baek Heon, the ruthless CEO of the criminal syndicate Yusu, finds himself under investigation by prosecutor Seol Ji-Hun for allegedly plotting to assassinate a congressman. Inside the interrogation room, Baek Heon becomes instantly captivated by Ji-Hun and makes a chilling decision. If he’s going to hell, he’s taking this good-looking prosecutor down with him. Ji-Hun’s life is soon upended. Framed for crimes he didn’t commit, he ends up behind bars, his once-promising future shattered. But Baek Heon isn’t done yet. For a man who confesses his deepest desire is to ruin a prosecutor, he’s more than ready to drag Ji-Hun into his world of obsession and poison—and Ji-Hun might just be daring enough to see how far he’ll fall.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The world's sexiest AV star and the world's most timid beta male, who has only had imaginary girlfriends, meet in real life! Fate and destiny intertwine, as they end up becoming roommates. Here comes the love adventure between the AV star and the beta male!

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.

title.english: Magic School Girl: Spare No Villains

description:
Garin, an ordinary high-school girl, is given magical powers that can help fight all kinds of “villains” around her. The catch? The magic transformation is nothing short of mortifying to the teenager. But do not judge a book by its cover! With the power vested in her thanks to a peculiar god’s random blessing, Garin and her gang free humanity from the evil plot to villainize the world–and hopefully boost her grades along the way.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Ju-ho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeon-Wu. As his father’s cruelty deepens and Hyeon-Wu’s obsessive behavior grows more disturbing, Ju-Ho’s spirit begins to break. Then one day, he meets Su-Hyeok, a kind and gentle man who offers the warmth and comfort Ju-Ho has never known. For the first time, Ju-Ho finds himself relying on someone outside his family, falling into a fragile love that feels almost like salvation. But as he clings to Su-Hyeok, Hyeon-Wu’s fixation only festers. Years later, even as adults, Ju-Ho finds that the grip of his family’s twisted love and his own buried wounds are far from healed, and one lingering kiss may awaken everything he’s tried to forget.

(Source: Lezhin US)

On his very first day at the Grace estate, newly hired butler Obetheron is caught off guard. Quiet, withdrawn, and cruelly ignored by both her family and the staff due to her frail body, Lady Emma is nothing like the noble beauty he's heard about. Moved by her loneliness, Obetheron remains devoted, resisting temptation and serving her with sincere care. Emma, in turn, begins to notice the gentle strength behind his loyalty...and one day, she makes a bold request: “Would you do anything - not for the House of Grace, but for me?” A slow-burning romance between a forgotten noblewoman and the butler who sees her for who she truly is, how will their forbidden love unfold?

(Source: Lezhin US)

He saw his crush ♡♡ing…? Chan ends up seeing his crush Yeonho ♡♡ing his colleague in the pharmacy. Shocked, Chan wants to resign but then ends up going for drinks with Yeonho - and when he wakes up in the morning he’s lying naked (?) in bed with Yeonho…?!

I can see the titles of the Female Leads. In a world brimming with regressors, reincarnators, and transmigrators, May is none of them. She’s just an ordinary, painfully ordinary, native of a romance-fantasy novel. No past-life memories, no transmigrator missions, no reincarnator powers. A 100% pure extra. Yet May possesses one bizarre, unparalleled ability, she can see the titles of the novels the Female Leads come from. Not just brief titles, but massive, spoiler-filled ones that practically reveal the entire plot. May kept that ability hidden and lived quietly. Until a romance-fantasy Female Lead named Seol Eun-chae possessed her beloved younger sister’s body. Desperate to bring her sister back, May searches for a way, and learns a shocking truth from a chance encounter with a mysterious 'Master'. "There is only one way to drive out a transmigrator. Steal the Male Lead she’s destined for." ...Hold on. Seol Eun-chae’s male lead is WHO? The tyrant with a 0.000001% romance success rate, Rihaim Elivton?! Countless Female Leads tried, and failed, to win him over, only to be cast out of their possessed bodies. A mere extra, no regression, no cheat, no reincarnation, can she seduce Rihaim? To reclaim her sister, May makes up her mind, she will shake the tyrant’s heart.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Ruby sets out to find the Black Wolf Clan to rescue the kidnapped rabbit clan. After wandering the snowy mountains for days and growing hungry, Ruby discovers a carrot.

“A delicious carrot, I’ll enjoy this! Mmm—”

“Aaaargh!”

Every time she licks the dry carrot with her tongue, it keeps getting bigger…? The true identity of the carrot she’s happily biting into… is that of Ivan, the leader of the Black Wolf Clan’s… private parts?!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Guide Heo Yoon-Jae thought he was done with the field after losing his esper to a brutal rampage, but fate seems to have other plans. On a trip to the Guiding Center for a one-day commission, Yoon-Jae finds himself faced with Woo Sang-Hyuk, an A-rank esper with a god complex and a reputation for blowing through guides like tissues. But Yoon-Jae isn't just any old guide, and he refuses to let an uppity young esper call the shots. Once Sang-Hyuk gets a taste of real guiding, he'll be putty in the palm of Yoon-Jae's hand. Or so he hopes, anyway.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After striking a deal with the wealthy and powerful Edwin, Lai is tasked with an impossible mission. He must fool Prince Hector by posing as his rumored lover Ellen, to whom he bears a remarkable resemblance. But life in the palace isn't as easy as it sounds, as Lai is immediately subject to all kinds of harassment and hostility. What could Edwin possibly have in mind as the mastermind behind the scheme? Where is the real Ellen, and what exactly is his relationship with Hector? And now, with Lai in the picture - how will all these things come to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)

An U-Yeong is a 20-year-old who wants to have a wonderful relationship. He starts dating the senior he has dreamed of, just like he wanted. But... why is he always gasping for breath with a stranger every time they happen to meet?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

A college dinner. A drunken early morning with friends. It was a day no different from any other day, but when I opened my eyes, I found myself being delivered to me by a man.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

For nine long years, the dynamic between them remained completely unchanged: Choi Yeong-Hyeon was the ruthless, unpredictable delinquent, and Lee Min-Woo was his submissive, personal toy. No matter how volatile Yeong-Hyeon’s moods became or how cruelly he pushed boundaries, Min-Woo always obeyed with a gentle, compliant smile. This toxic game, which had steadily consumed their youth since middle school, finally reached its breaking point.

Deciding he had grown bored of the arrangement, Yeong-Hyeon abruptly declared an end to their twisted relationship. However, he gravely overlooked a crucial piece of the puzzle. The realization hits him too late when he wakes up bound and trapped inside a locked, unfamiliar room. Staring into the eyes of his supposedly docile captive, a terrified Yeong-Hyeon is forced to face a horrifying truth: he was never the master of this game. In reality, he was Min-Woo’s personal toy all along.

(Source: Lezhin US)

An overweight 300-pound otaku was suddenly blessed with a System, and he thought that would let him change his life. But the System was cursed so that he has eat a crazy amount of food every day to stay alive. Furthermore, he also found out that the System made him the queen of a race of alien bugs. Bugs are bad enough, but why does he have to be a queen! Does he really have to follow the System's orders? And destroy the Earth?

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Chen Boqiao was once imprisoned for committing multiple crimes: treason, the murder of his father, and more... After his unexpected escape, he receives a secret request from an old classmate, Zhang Jue. What is his ultimate goal?

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Arnold and Ah Qiu are down-on-their-luck freelance couriers, barely getting by in their rickety spaceship. Everything changes when they take on a mysterious, high-stakes job that promises a massive payout. Now, these two slackers find themselves at the center of a galaxy-spanning conflict, connecting powerful empires and clashing ideologies.

(Source: Bilibili Comics, translated)

To save his empress, the emperor dives deep into the thousand year lake without thinking about his own safety. In the lake, he trickes a Xuan Long who was abandoned by his tribe to go to the palace, and coaxed the Xuan Long to give him his heart.

As a result of the frequent courting of the emperor, the Xuan Long sincerely fell in love with him. But in the end, he was put to death by the emperor, and disappeared like ashes after giving birth to a dragon.

At this moment, the emperor recovered the memories of his past life and realised that the person he killed was his lover, the one who he had been searching for for thousands of years.

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Zhang Rui, a transfer student with a dream of becoming a comic book writer, is looking forward to finding a best friend...and a girlfriend! "Ye Xiangfang," a student in the other class who is also very good at drawing cartoons, appears to be able to fulfil his wish. But wait... This wish was shattered far too soon!

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a two-part prologue.

The advent of demons and other foul beings during the twilight of the last age ushered in an era of carnage and destruction that ravaged the lands everywhere.
Wuxin was expelled from Mount Longhu where his long wandering journey began.
Despite knowing that he should keep to the code of not giving help without receiving proper compensation in return, Wuxin often himself compelled to jump into people's aid out of his own kindness.

(Source: Webnovel)

There are three genders in this world: ABO. Hitman Mo Jiawen received a mission to assassinate the talented researcher, Shao Yuanfan. However, in contact with Shao Yuanfan, he found out that this person has an unknown past, and their past is unexpectedly related to him in countless ways…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

title.romaji: Fenghuang Cuo: Zhuan Chong Qi Fei
title.english: The Wronged Phoenix: Unwavering Love for a Disgraced Concubine

description:
"How much money could a woman’s face be worth?"

She was once queen. But when her face becomes partially disfigured in an accident, an imperial decree demotes Dongfang Ningxing to concubine. Not only that, but her younger sister takes her place as the new queen, while Dongfang Ningxing gets married off to the cold and brutal Prince Xueqin. And this second marriage is not a happy one, ending only in her death. Lucky for Dongfang Ningxing, her spirit is unwilling to fade away... it’s not her time yet! She still has work to do! So, Dongfang Ningxing gets a second chance. And this time, Dongfang Ningxing is ready. She must hone amazing talents, be the most beautiful in all the land, and must outmatch even the heavens! Will she succeed??

(Source: Comikey)

Yu Chen lost his sister, whom he depended on, in a fire five years ago. Due to his unrequited love, and the pain of losing his family, Yuchen grew into an introverted and reticent teenager.

During a camping activity, Yu Chen agrees to Gu Huai's request to pretend to be his lover, and so begins a wonderful journey with Gu Huai...

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)

Transmigrating into the Tang Dynasty as Prince Li Zhi, the future Emperor Gaozong of Tang. I plan to expand the Tang territory all the way to Europe. What? This is the world of Journey to the West? To obtain scriptures? Forget about that; I’ll expand the Tang territory to Mount Ling. Either submit or face annihilation. Let me show you how the Tang becomes a giant Tang! Tang Seng: I spent over a decade on my pilgrimage and still haven’t left the borders of the Tang Dynasty.

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Shen Wei Lan died for deeply loving Fu Su Mian in her last life. Now she born again and swore that she would stay far away from him! But why?! She racks her brains to stay far away from him, but he who hates her in the last life becomes strongly possessive! He claims arbitrarily, "You are mine forever! You have no where to go!"

(Source: WebComics)

He was the proud Wolf King, the darling of destiny. Yet, at a funeral, he dropped to his knees, begging for one last glimpse of the one he loved. A whirlwind romance turned sour, twisting a young lover into a stranger, their three-year marriage a hollow echo. Only in devastating loss did regret truly sink its fangs into him... But now, with a second chance, he's sworn an unbreakable oath: This time, he'll protect his beloved, no matter the cost.

(Source: WebComics)

This is the story about a cat and his dog-disciple, and their adventures across 720-million different worlds. This is a story about the conflict between light and darkness, peace and power, freedom and control. This is a long-winded story that is a confused jumble of action, whimsy, comedy, sci-fi, magic, and fantasy. This is the legend of Shadow Cat.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

The all-knowing Yuan Qiqi possesses all the secrets of the world, but he forgot his own past. In the "Buddha Killed People" incident at Yuchan Temple, Yuan Qiqi met up with constable Chu Zhong, and together they solved one murder case after another... They became a golden pair. In the course of investigating murders, the pieces of his memory were slowly being put together, and Yuan Qiqi's identity was gradually revealed...

(Source: Webnovel)

title.romaji: Jujue Baojun Zhuan Chong: Xiongmeng Wangfei
title.native: 拒绝暴君专宠：凶猛王妃

description:
As a talented agent, she failed to make a successful time-travel during her first task in which she dropped onto the bed of a tyrant and broke his sex. Knocked out, she regarded the man as a man-whore and paid him for their sex. Obviously she went too far. However, tyrants are for torturing, money for spending kungfu for teasing and beauty for seduction.

(Source: MangaToon)

In the chaos era caused by wars, people were living miserably except one small town which was unreasonably prosperous. Thus, many people were taking risks in search of the secret behind the prosperity. A girl from poor villages with her family's testament and the fate of her village finally sneaked into the small town and discovered that the secret of the town's prosperity was the King of Koi with trapped in the dungeon. After several efforts, she rescued the King of Koi and set foot on the road of escape.

(Source: Manga Toon)

The small border town of Santa Anna, Mexico is no stranger to violence. The gruesome death of a local gang member on the outskirts of town further heightens tensions. So when a mysterious stranger arrives in town shortly thereafter, the locals become leery—who is this man and what is his background?

Losing memories after a confession?! A crossdressing boy and his crush are cursed to never fall deep in love, and are forced to repeat their confession over and over. What is the antidote to love? Can there be miracles in true love?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

Strange stories from around the world.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Unable to endure the abuse at his orphanage, Tae-Ju murders the director and flees with nothing. Desperate to end his life, he stumbles upon a church of the Hwasin Faith to confess his sins before dying. It is there that Tae-Ju discovers his true identity: a god of death. In his new life as a god, Tae-Ju is joined by Jeong-Hu, a god-hating elder of Hwasin. Together, they navigate their complex destinies and unravel the mysteries of their divine roles.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

After centuries of war, the Avian and Serpent races agree to a tentative peace and joint training of cadets. Instructor Sahwahyun, an admired Avian war hero, maintains a strict composure that keeps all students at bay—except Yahyul, an unassuming Serpent cadet harboring hidden depths beneath his stoic shell. As their paths intertwine through subtle encounters, a halting bond forms that soon blossoms beyond mere camaraderie into something deeper that defies the boundaries between their races.

(Source: Tapas)

In a world where one's secondary gender determines everything, social status is set from birth. Inu, an alpha from a low-income family, is desperate to secure a future among the elite. To guarantee his success, he resorts to abusing pheromone enhancers…but when the side effects temporarily turn him into an omega, his carefully laid plans spiral out of control. So when Hae-Yeong, a former classmate and a dominant omega from a powerful family, Hae-Young makes an unexpected proposal to cure him of his new-found issue, he has no choice but to consider it. Faced with a deal that could change his fate, Inu must decide how far he is willing to go to rewrite his destiny.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

Dian is a writer who struggles to make a living. One day, a famous singer, Eda, shows up and asks for the return of the blue leather described in Dian's novel. Dian, a fan of Eda, tries to return the leather she returned when she rejected his proposal, but hears that her fiance has already left on a journey with the leather and the pain of heartbreak.

When they are about to part ways, her aunt, who is urging her to get married, comes and suffocates Dian... Dian sees Eda's hand reaching out to her like a sip of oxygen, and she takes her hand to go on a journey together to find the leather.

Dian, who wants to succeed as a writer despite being a woman, and Eda, who is obsessed with leather and the sea. As the nights they spend together grow longer, the two begin to fall in love with each other's stories and eyes...

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

“Life Cry” is the most popular game in the world—an immersive fantasy realm filled with monsters, mages, and mercenaries. For the average gamer, it is the perfect escape from reality. But for Lime, this game is a bit closer to reality than fantasy, not only because he’s a dark gamer exploiting the game’s mechanics to pay his bills, but also because of the uncanny life-like emotions and reactions of the NPCs he meets. As Lime digs deeper into the game, he realizes there may be more to “Life Cry" than meets the eye.

(Source: Tapas)

Ko I-Deum is a total shut in who knows how to do one thing, and one thing only: write passionate BL smut. There’s just one small problem: I-Deum is a complete and total virgin. To try and stimulate his brain (among other things), I-Deum takes to…well, “taking care of himself” in front of the window, imagining all sorts of sensual scenarios to jumpstart his creative juices. Sure, there may be an apartment right across from him, but nobody’s lived there for years…until now! Mid self-love session, he looks up to see a man staring at him from across the street - and not just any man, but the bisexual icon and surely soon-to-be celeb, acting major Kwon Jae-Yi. Some might say their situation is a little too close for comfort…but maybe it’s just the right distance for something more.

(Source: Lezhin US)
Ten years ago a close friend of Su Hyeok disappeared without a trace after the tragic death of a classmate. But suddenly he show up again, as if nothing had happened. What secret hides the past?

title.english: I Created a Harem by Accident!

description:
In a hardcore adult novel full of wicked villains and frustrating situations, Selena Crawford is the female lead who suffers endlessly. When a nameless actress wakes up as Selena, she is determined to use her wit and acting skills to stay away from the male lead and change her fate. But as she struggles to do so, it seems that even more possible love interests are drawn to her. Can she cleverly avoid the male lead and kick out the villains? Or will she just end up in a bigger mess?

(Source: Tapas)

My first love, whom I thought was dead, has returned.

Curtis, who was killed when his entire family was wiped out by my father’s scheme, now stands before me, seeking revenge.

“Go ahead and beg, Roxana. Who knows? Maybe if you flirt with me using that pretty face of yours, I’ll spare your life.”

He teased my neck with the blood-soaked tip of his sword, spewing out his icy sarcasm.

'My father’s sins have finally come to kill me.'

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

What if you could go back and do things all over again? That’s exactly the opportunity that Princess Annette has received. In a previous life, she was embroiled in controversy. Set to wed the crown prince, Annette’s life was looking rosy. But rumors and scandals followed that ruined her life. In the end, she ended up marrying the bastard son of the emperor, Raphael. Two black sheep of their respective families together in a bitter arranged marriage. Left weak and frail from her life’s trials and tribulations, she prays to any god who will listen, that if given one more chance, she’d fix everything. Well, Annette’s wish has been granted. Reborn, five years in the past, on the day before her wedding, she can now relive her life and make things right. But will Annette fall into the same traps as before or will this be her royal redemption?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 2 side stories.

Lora, a maid serving the vampire Carmilla, wants to go to Walpurgis Night, the festival where the Philosopher's Stone, said to grant any wish, is located... An unfamiliar yet heartwarming fantasy GL manga presented by author Unni!

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Originally self-published on the author's Aladin account. Was published by Ridibooks on 2026-05-09.

19th century America isn't exactly the best place for a half-Asian child and her alcoholic single father. While the daughter struggles to make sense of the world, her father finds comfort in isolating himself. And of course, they fight. Against each other. With fists.

(Source: Lezhin)

Note: 2nd Lezhin Comics World Comic Contest Winner.

title.english: Matched with My Bully on Random Chat

description:
Do-Hyeon thinks the girl he matched with might be the same one who used to torment him. But this time, he's the one holding the power, and with it, he plans to bring down his old bully, her friend... and even her family.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.romaji: Naega Jjijilhan Geon Jeonbu Ne Tasiya
title.native: 내가 찌질한 건 전부 네 탓이야

description:
Unemployed, unemployed, cyberstalking in the corner of the house, leaving malicious comments, Chae Seo-Geum. He ends up meeting the artist Kim Tae-In who he was obsessed with, at the police station after he sues him. He is nervous for a moment because it is his first time visiting the police station, but his heart flutters when he sees Tae-In's face. In the end, Seo-Geum crosses the line with Tae-In again as he leaves the police station as soon as he finishes his investigation..!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

Baek Shiwon is swole but always getting himself injured. Oh well, at least this physical therapist is hella cute… But wait, this person is a man! Still, something about him is so attractive, let’s just see where this goes… Things are looking promising until a certain someone that Shiwon is all too familiar with enters the picture…but Shiwon won’t back down without a fight. In the end, who will end up as perfect body partners?

(Source: Lezhin)

Seong-Ha seeks a big man to fulfill his desires. At a freshman retreat, he meets Mu-Beom — a big guy with glasses that make his eyes tiny. Impervious to seduction and a total square, Mu-Beom puzzles Seong-Ha. Seong-Ha hates alphas, and Mu-Beom has a thing for pheromones. How will this odd pair turn out?

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
