Eunho is on the verge of receiving an academic warning due to Seoyoung, his childhood friend's, excessive pranks. Facing the threat of losing his allowance and tuition, Eunho decides to operate a (fake) couple YouTube channel with Seoyoung to earn money. Their first content: 'What happens when you spend a night with your female friend'! They fall asleep together, insisting nothing will happen... but...

“Since it's come to this, should we…?”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Jo A-yeong is a university student who is a celebrity on social media, but who worries about other people's opinions. She meets Kwak Ju-Hyeon, an underground rapper who doesn't care what others think of her. The two become friends and later girlfriends, facing various challenges and adventures in university life.

Note:
-Originally self-published on the author's Postype. Was published by KakaoPage on 2023-03-09.
- Include two extra chapters.

Seo-Hyung knows that Ha-Min and Woo-Jin are dating, but wants to confirm his feelings for Ha-Min. Sol catches him trying to kiss a sleeping Ha-Min during a drinking party. Sol's Confucianism explodes and scolds Seo-Hyung, driving him to the brink of a kiss...! Seeing Seo-Hyung trembling, he advises him that he is too young to know his feelings, but Seo-Hyung's reaction is strange?!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

Note: Includes five side story chapters.

title.english: Ladies at Her Service: Giving You My All

description:
Hershe is a brave hero who saves Princess Mel when she's kidnapped and taken to the demon world. Once the king assigns Hershe to Mel as her bodyguard, they fall in love. But because their kingdom is weak, Mel is fated to be married off to a powerful emperor and treated like a hostage. So Hershe sets out on the king's orders to bring back the demon king's sword and bolster the kingdom's military power. Although Hershe is determined to save Mel, can she thwart the demon king's mind games that try to use her desires against her?.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Ridi's Jujonggwangye GL Danpyeonseon (주종관계 GL 단편선) Collection.

Young Hwa-Rim, having freed Jin, a serpent god sealed away by a shaman, has her body taken over by him, and the shaman sacrifices her own life to save Hwa-Rim. Years later, now a high school student, Hwa-Rim lives in hiding, constantly on the run from Jin, who is still relentlessly searching for her. One day, Bong-Gil, a classmate of hers, is possessed by Jin, and Jin attempts to use Bong-Gil to track down Hwa-Rim...

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: This series serves as a prequel to the 2024 film Exhuma (파묘).

Dohyun was always awkward when it came to women. He wanted to be smooth with them, just like his friend Jiwon. However, the belated awakening of his lust starts to disrupt his everyday life.

"Oppa... I didn't know you were like this. You're such a pervert..."

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

After years of friendship and one reckless night, Hae-In ghosted A-list actor Woo-Hyun. Three years later, she’s the writer of his new drama—and his dirty secret living one floor away. As the lines between script and reality blur, can they navigate friendship, romance, and the mess of mixing work with personal life?

(Source: Manta)

Cha-Eun spent high school hiding a secret—one that the most popular boy in class, Hae-Kang, discovered. What began as leverage turned into something neither expected, until a bitter fight shattered it. Eight years later they’re coworkers, but Hae-Kang still looks at her like the past isn’t over.

(Source: Manta)

“Did you know that your father is a monster?”

Young Kane is an orphan boy who doesn’t have a penny to his name. He has to resort to petty theft just to get some bread to eat. But out of nowhere appears a mysterious man, Shane White, who promises to take him in and become his adoptive father. Together, they go to the remote island where Shane and his other adopted children live. But this whole thing is definitely odd enough to raise Kane’s suspicions… Still, perhaps finally having a family and living on this idyllic island is enough to overcome all that. Even so, Kane can’t help but wonder just who this Shane is and what his actual intentions are…

(Source: Lezhin US)

Su Da-Won, a freshman who can see the ancestral spirits by everyone’s side. All she wanted was a normal college life. But then, the enigmatic president of the occult club, Sa Da-Ham, appeared before her. For some reason, she can’t see anything about him?! On top of that, even the spirit she worships warns her to stay away from him...

Is it fate, or a trap?

A spine-tingling yet heartwarming romantic tale of two young people!

(Source: Naver, translated)

title.english: A Beginner's Guide to Hiding Zombies

description:
After a carriage accident leaves her family in (literal) pieces, Emily Walker is desperate to bring her brothers and twin sister back. With the help of a demon cat named Lev and a dabble in dark magic, she succeeds — but something isn’t right. The Walker siblings are cold, weak, and, well... dead. Now that her siblings are zombies, Emily faces a new challenge: keeping House Walker’s secret safe from the evils that await. How can she hold her family together when it seems destined to fall apart?

(Source: Tapas)

Tae-Oh, who had secretly loved Hae-San since elementary school, worked tirelessly to raise his college entrance exam scores by two levels. He finally enrolled at the same university as Hae-San, determined to confess his feelings once he became a confident adult. At the freshman welcome party, Tae-Oh bumped into Hae-San as if by chance and impulsively confessed. The two began dating as if by accident. Now, Tae-Oh is utterly intoxicated with the joy of finally being able to do all the XX things he'd only ever imagined! But can he really subdue Hae-San, who claims his ideal type is someone devoted and pure, with all these XX acts?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: A Marriage Contract With My Two Husbands

description:
Roselaine married Grand Duke Melchior, the best knight in the Empire. He said it’s because, “I want to save you.” Roselaine can only respond, “You don’t know anything about me.”

A man who wants to save her life, save her family, pay off her debts, and even marry her? They say there’s no such thing as a favor without any strings attached, so why would he go this far for someone he doesn’t even know?

“Because you look like someone I knew.” Roselaine evidently looks just like Melchior’s first love.

While depressed because she thinks she is only a stand-in for his first love, Roselaine takes in Julian, who looks exactly like her husband’s childhood self, as her disciple. But then Julien asks, “Please divorce him and marry me, Roselaine.”

What happens if she marries both men?

(Source: Manta)

Gifted violinist Moon Haewon has been avoiding deep connections after his mother's tragic death. But his life takes a turn when his only friend Taeshin commits suicide, leaving Haewon guilt-ridden for ignoring his calls. At a police interview, Haewon encounters Hyeon Wujin, a special prosecutor and the subject of Taeshin's unrequited love. Haewon's life spirals further as he's drawn into an assault case, and he seeks Wujin's help. Their interactions intensify, with Wujin challenging Haewon's emotional barriers. Swayed by Wujin, Haewon confronts a tangle of guilt, passion, and fear of true connection.

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Once an Assassin, Now a Royal Nanny

description:
A year after her lover stabs her in the back, legendary assassin Kyla Angel wakes up in the body of Rachel Brown, a nanny tasked with caring for a neglected prince and princess. Knowing the man who betrayed her is still out there, Kyla must bide her time before she can sneak out of the palace and get revenge. But in the meantime, she must face her deadliest challenge yet: childcare. Now it's up to Kyla to figure out how to soothe a crying toddler with hands meant for throwing daggers and slitting throats...

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: This work was pre-released in English before releasing in Korean.

Staying alive is a new form of entertainment.

When Do-Kyung, disillusioned by the harshness of life, finally resolves to call it quits, a bored demon, Hwamyung, appears before her with a particular offer. Will Do-Kyung, having entered into a contract with the Demon of Disillusionment, be able to flip her disastrous life upside down?

(Source: Manta)

Once the poster couple for office romance, Dawon and Taehyeon seemed unstoppable on their march to the altar. But when Taehyeon cheats on his fiancé with another coworker at K&C, Yujeong, their fairytale begins to unravel. Just when Dawon thinks all is lost, hope emerges from the most unexpected place, the office (again), and with the most unexpected person--her boss, Junhu, known as K&C’s most eligible bachelor and the quintessential dreamboat! Could this twist of fate turn Dawon’s heartbreak into a fresh start?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

At the end of a grueling day, a sudden pain struck—and I found myself transmigrated into the fantasy novel "Dark Header!" But out of all people… I became the depraved Seventh Prince, doomed to be miserably executed three years later?! From this point on, there’s only one goal: lie low until the original protagonist appears, and then quietly escape the empire. However, the events of the original story began unfolding far earlier than expected. As I move between the imperial palace and the slums... a covert effort to contain the fallout begins.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Park Si-on has the body of a 29-year-old and the mind of a 9-year-old; he is a savant who is on the autism spectrum. With his innate genius like two sides of the same coin, he enters a university hospital as a pediatric surgery resident. The prejudice of being a doctor with autism and the battle for power in the hospital gets more and more dangerous...! Will he ever be able to become a real doctor?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Childhood friends and first loves, Hwi is moving away. Seol gathers the courage to confess his feelings, and the two share their first and last date together, tinged with the bittersweet melancholy of the inevitable changes that comes with the passing of time.

(Source: shortz, translated)

Ryu Ho-Kyung and Baek Hee-Won, who are like enemies, are trapped in a suspicious cave one day. To make matters worse, the cave is filled with a sexual scent, and if things continue this way, their danjeon is in danger of being destroyed.......

“Let’s just solve it among ourselves. We just need to calm down anyway.”

“You crazy bastard! Come to your senses, Ryu Ho-Kyung!”

“Hee-Won, relax a bit. Be nice. I’m just doing this to make you feel better.”

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

An argument, a fall, and a lie. Determined to save her loveless marriage, Yeonhwa impulsively fakes memory loss to buy herself some time. After all, who would insist on divorcing someone with a brain injury? But now, not only is her ice-cold husband suddenly warm and caring, he’s telling her that they’ve always shared a bed -- even though she knows they’ve never even kissed! How long can she hold him at bay? Does she even want to? And maybe more to the point, who’s playing who, here?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Sucked into the game, starter gamer Yoo Sung-sik decided to make the most of his advantage to survive in the world where a huge war was reserved. The advantage was the privilege of the player and the vast knowledge of the game.

title.english: Master of the Martial Arts Library

description:
As an inept martial artist and a bastard son of the great Ha Clan, Ha Sochan had no choice but to become a vagabond. But his wretched life takes a turn when a mission brings him to the Martial Arts Library, a place filled with the secret techniques of the martial world. There, Sochan is accidentally bound to the library and sent back to when he was 12 years old. Now armed with the library's martial knowledge, he vows to make a name for himself in not only his clan but also the world!

(Source: Tapas)

Beloved idol Yoon-Jae Ahn, renowned for his impeccable charm and striking appearance, secures a coveted spot on a popular variety show, boosting his solo career. Just as he’s savoring success, his forgotten past resurfaces, threatening his celebrity status. Can Yoon-Jae shield his career from the looming secrets? With stakes at their highest, will his charm and unwavering determination prove sufficient to conquer the ghosts of his past?

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Seo-Ha has spent two years working as a secretary for the cold Do-Hyeon, the director of a conglomerate, while harboring a secret, unrequited love for him. But when a canceled flight strands them together for one unexpected night, everything changes. What begins as a secret fling quickly spirals into something far more complicated when Do-Hyeon’s powerful family starts arranging his marriage to another woman, and Seo-Ha discovers that she is pregnant. Will Seo-Ha be able to win Do-Hyeon’s heart, or will she lose him to another woman forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

Lewis, a masochist and passionate omega with cross-dressing tendencies, suffers from the trauma of being raped during his college days. Though he lost much—including being disowned by his family and suffering deep psychological wounds—from that rape, he lives on as a paid doctor, unbroken. Then one day, the bastard Camillo, the one who raped him and sent his once-promising life spiraling into ruin, is found injured, collapsed near his home?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

In order to get revenge on his ex-boyfriend, Ha-Neul starts seeing his ex’s-boyfriend's younger brother, Hyeon-Seong. As a co-pilot, Hyeon-Seong meets frequently with Ha-Neul, who runs a flower shop nearby the airport. Then one day, Ha-Neul receives a call from his ex-boyfriend.

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

After proposing to his girlfriend, Do-Jin wakes up the next morning in a strange house with no memory of how he got there. When he asks about his fiancée, her brother Ju-Yeon gives him a chilling answer: “She’s dead.” But Do-Jin can tell immediately that Ju-Yeon is hiding something. Stranger still, Do-Jin has been having vivid, recurring dreams in which he and Ju-Yeon share a bond that goes far beyond a typical in-law relationship. As he digs deeper, the secrets Ju-Yeon reveal will turn Do-Jin’s entire understanding of his love and his life on its head.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: The chapter count includes 4 extra chapters.

36-year-old single Heo Jae-Young promises a future with Sung Yoon-Woo, whom she met at a wedding, and decides to end her relationship with Sung Ha-Neul, a sex worker she had been seeing. However, the person Yoon-Woo introduced as his son was none other than Ha-Neul. After the marriage that proceeded without a hitch, the three of them live together. Jae-Young, who usually enjoys rougher sex, feels regretful about sleeping with the cautious Yoon-Woo. Ha-Neul, who senses Jae-Young's worries, makes an unexpected suggestion...

"Dad, you still don't know how to make Jae-Young feel, do you?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

I possessed an errand child who brought meals to the male protagonist who was captured as a test subject at the lab. If the experiment was successful and the male protagonist gained power, the lab would be engulfed in flames. So I tried to run away before that, but I felt bad for the male protagonist who was suffering from the cruel experiment. So I secretly took care of various things while avoiding the researchers' eyes.

"Come to think of it, what's your name?"
"I don't have a name..."
"You make me one."
"Huh?"

I somehow became a little close to the male protagonist. "Are you going to abandon me? Don't do that."
"Ah... but-"
"Anis, do you mind if I'm wrong?"
"Ugh... No. No, I don't."
"Then stay by my side."

However, the only one who can cure him who is suffering from the side effects of the experiment is the original female protagonist.

I tried to help him and leave secretly so that he could find his partner...

"You promised not to abandon me. But, was it all a lie?”
With the burning laboratory in the background, Emilien smiled with cold eyes.
“A good child should keep his promises.”

The temperature of the hand touching my cheek is cold. The red eyes close as if they are going to engulf me.
“Answer, aren’t you going to tell me?”
...What should I do?
I think I missed my chance to run away.

(Source: NaverSeries, translated)

Today's high school's entrance ceremony!

Even after middle school, 'Da-Joon' is still popular. But 'Si-Yoon' feels a strange sense of incompatibility with him...

One day, when Si-Yoon happens to go to Da-Joon's place, what he sees is... his violent side?!

(Source: MrBlue, translated)

Ours, a small idol group with talent but low recognition, recruits visual member X to enter the music charts. With X's appearance, Ours explodes in popularity! They are truly at the peak of their career. However, X dies in an unexpected accident... The protagonist, Luan, who can control corpses, must use his powers to protect his position as a top idol!

(Source: Naver, translated)

Chic Si-Yeon and bubbly Yu-Ra couldn’t be any more different, but after a whiff of lavender scented clothes and an unexpected encounter at Dahan Art Academy, they become inseparable best friends. Now that they’re adults stepping into the real world, Si-Yeon and Yu-Ra start exploring exciting new opportunities and pursuing their artistic passions. But when they start catching each other at bad timings and misunderstandings start to accumulate, their friendship is put to the test. Will Si-Yeon and Yu-Ra be able to keep up with their own personal lives and maintain their friendship intact?

(Source: WEBTOONS, edited)
Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Viola, living alone in a remote countryside, accidentally rescues and treats a badly wounded man named Caliban. The two feel an inexplicable attraction accompanied by a sweet scent, leading to a passionate first night together... Afterwards, Caliban suddenly vanishes without a trace. Left alone, unaware of Caliban's whereabouts, Viola leaves her hometown to seek work as a maid. In the basement of her new workplace, she discovers Caliban, imprisoned in the form of a beast...

A tale of fated love disguised as chance—between the ‘Calibans’, a monstrous clan with latent beastly instincts, and Viola, the half-human who alone can calm them.

(Source: Naver, translated)

They say you always meet your worst enemies at military reserve training. When Yong-Taek runs into Wu-Chang in the training center’s restroom, he tries to offer a sincere apology for their messy high school past. But Wu-Chang hasn't changed a bit, throwing insults and mocking Yong-Taek’s family until something finally snaps. Yong-Taek decides it’s time for a different kind of "discipline." He never hated Wu-Chang; he just realized that sometimes, the only way to show love is through a very firm, very hard lesson.

(Source: Lezhin US)

He is living the happiest life on campus with his perfect girlfriend, Bom. But when his ex-girlfriend and childhood friend comes in, things start getting out of control!

"But I have a girlfriend!!"

Will be able to save his current relationship?

(Source: DAYcomics)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

After living through an unspeakably traumatic childhood, Naeyeong refuses to even touch another human being. But things start to change the day Jin enters his cold, isolated world, bringing in a familiar warmth that Naeyeong had been stripped of along with his innocence. Unfortunately, Naeyeong still drowns within the ghosts of his past and is out for revenge against all those who submerged his life into suffocating darkness. He knows that with what he’s planning, he’s no good for Jin. And yet, is it even possible to stay away from the man who allows him to breathe again?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Bongseo and his mom's friend, Miran, a single mother, are instantly attracted to each other, and so begins their risky, clandestine affair.

(Source: Toomics)

The year 2045 is the era of flourishing plants.

Parasite flowers mutated humanity into monsters in an instant. Only a few survived and constructed the underground 'City,' but they oppress and suppress the remaining humans as they please. Can 'Ga-Ram' find his brother Ga-On in this chaotic world?

(Source: Naver, translated)

Ever wondered what popular folktales would be like if more men were involved?! The answer is: perfectly queer! Classic folktales from around the world take on a whole new hunky spin when boy loves boy. From Korean fables like "The Tale of Chunhyang" to more well-known fairy tales like "Snow White," you'll never read the originals the same way again.

(Source: TappyToon)

title.romaji: Geu Guide-Uga Jipchakgwanggongui Pumeseo Beoseonaneun Bangbeop
title.english: How to Escape the Clutches of an Obsessive Top
title.native: 그 가이드가 집착광공의 품에서 벗어나는 방법

description:
Yeon-Soo wakes up as a doomed, bratty guide in "The Guide's Abyss." He avoids Seung-Hyuk, an S-rank esper, but one accident later, they’re involved. His careful plans are ruined, and though he pulls away, Seung-hyuk sticks to him more. Will Yeon-Soo survive, or will Seung-Hyuk's possessiveness prevail?

(Source: Manta)

Sleepless nights, haunting dreams, and a desperate wish bring college student Choi Woo-hyuk face-to-face with an unexpected visitor—an impossibly handsome incubus who claims to have been summoned by his own desires. But when fantasy and reality blur, Woo-hyuk’s restless nights take a steamy, surreal turn he never saw coming!

(Source: Lezhin US)

Woman-crazed Zermen recruits companions to climb a newly discovered lustful dungeon. The dungeon is overflowing with indecent, damp plants and monsters. While enjoying all sorts of pleasures along the way, she continues her ascent day after day in hopes of nestling at the side of the sexy dynamite Demon King who lives at the very top!

Mistakes can be corrected later, but misunderstandings may never be resolved. A friend from the past that I ran into on SNS by chance. A relationship that was really close, but ended irreversibly due to a huge misunderstanding. But I, never said anything like that. But I… Couldn’t say anything.

(source: Comico Korea, translated)

After eight - or has it been nine? - years of unrequited love for Seo I-Do, Gyeon-Woo has finally had enough of this endless one-sided relationship and decides to take drastic action. He secretly snaps photos of Ido cheating and uses them for blackmail. All Gyeon-Woo wants is just one night with Ido. Their night of passion went as planned, but as Gyeon-Woo turns over in bed, he finds a new guy lying beside him… As Gyeon-Woo is forced to reckon with his new reality, what shape will his love for Ido take on?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 11 extra chapters.

For Choi Sungwon, nothing is more important than being recognized by his mother. Of course, the fact that his mother is the CEO of a major corporation doesn't exactly make things easy. All his life, Sungwon has known that he has certain expectations he must follow: dress well, be polite, and most importantly...be an alpha. Cruelly born a beta, Sungwon spends his days living a lie, presenting himself as the hardworking, accomplished, recessive alpha he wishes he could be. But once he meets college student-slash-bartender Park Hansol, things start to change... What if he's tired of pretending the be the perfect alpha? Perhaps he just wants a simply, happy relationship. But if there's one thing Sungwon knows, it's that there's nothing more cruel than unconditional kindness...

There’s nothing really special about Seojin. Sure, he grew up with people associated with the supernatural side of life, but he’s just your average guy. Until one day, he finds himself cursed by a girl who kills herself in front of him. The only person who can help him is the head of the House of Serpents: Yoon-hee—who also happens to be Seojin’s ex. As they try to break the curse together, it turns out Seojin is hiding more than anybody can imagine...which might be the death of him. Are Seojin and Yoon-hee bound to fail, or are they bound for more than they ever expected?

(Source: Lezhin US)
Note: Chapter count includes a prologue.
The second season of Into the Horizon

“Marry me!”

As children, Pija-Hyun and Do-Woon promised to marry each other. But after hearing from his mother that two men couldn't marry, Pija-Hyun resolved to let go of his feelings for Do-Woon. Years later, while pursuing ordinary relationships, Pija-Hyun kept getting dumped by his girlfriends for strange reasons. He eventually discovered that all his failed romances were due to Do-Woon's sabotage...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Copywriter Seon Jaewon has been losing his mind over a rival social media account that keeps parodying his creative ads. He’s ready to kill whoever is behind it, but not before he’s “killed” in bed by his hot neighbor, Lee Hyeonjin. After an impulsive first night together, the two men quickly hit it off, and Jaewon feels like he might finally see some sparks fly in his loveless life. Well, as long as this perfect man doesn’t turn out to be his worst enemy or anything. But what are the chances of that... right?

(Source: Tappytoon)

I survived ten years in another world. But all that awaited me upon my return was betrayal and death. The moment I opened my eyes again, I was no longer human—I had become a goblin.

(Source: Naver, translated)

“Fuck the hero.”

“Of course… Wait, what?"

A normal (?) office worker who’s fine after jacking off fifteen times in a row was summoned to another world. Who he met up with was not a goddess, but a demon lord? Plus, if he wants to return to his original world, he has to make the hero fall, something even the demon lord couldn’t do?!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

One night, a mysterious viewer named “Santa” drops over ten million won on Sunny (real name Sun Ikyung) in a single stream. The shock is real, the thrill is undeniable… and the donor’s identity is a total mystery. What Sunny doesn’t know? Santa is no stranger. As the extravagant donations continue, and Santa’s teasing, suggestive requests get bolder, Sunny realizes he doesn’t mind the attention at all. Caught between three potential suitors and one very rich secret admirer, Sunny sets out to uncover the truth: Who is the “Santa” showering him with money, and...is he boyfriend material?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Moon Geun-Young has the worst luck imaginable, relying entirely on fortune apps to navigate life. His world takes an unexpected turn when he meets Team Leader Kang Joon-Suk, a man blessed with incredible luck.
Every time Geun-Young tries to get intimate, strange interruptions seem to arise. However, with Joonsuk, he finds himself having surprisingly enjoyable nights... that is, until he learns.... "Who knew he was married?"
Will Geun-Young be able to resist the subtle temptations of Kang Joon-Suk, who keeps inching closer—even at work?

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)

Violetta, striving to support her sister after losing their parents, encounters Theobald, an enigmatic aristocrat who irrevocably alters her life. Taking on the role as Theobald's maid, Violetta navigates treacherous waters filled with political intrigue and forbidden desires. As Violetta and Theobald's relationship deepens amidst a backdrop of betrayal and manipulation, Violetta grapples with her conflicting loyalties and the moral ambiguity of her role as both confidante and pawn in a dangerous game.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Jeong Da-Um is a beta. There’s nothing wrong with that, per se, but it’s what drives him to quit his job as an idol to become a manager at an entertainment agency. There, he’s determined to live an ordinary life, but that’s pretty hard to do when you become the manager of Lee Yeon, an actor with a large fan following and an even larger reputation as a prickly alpha. When Yeon goes into an unexpected rut, Da-Um’s life very quickly starts getting out of the ordinary...

(Source: Lezhin US)

There are two kinds of people in this world: those who choose, and those who are chosen. But most people make mistakes because they don't know which side they belong to.

"Do I look easy to you just because I've been staying quiet?"

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Damian is a powerful duke with a demihuman condition that makes him averse to human scents. So when he sees Kanna—a girl sold into slavery by her own family—at an auction, he cannot resist buying her. Will this attraction grow into love, or remain a mere carnal instinct?

(Source: Manta)

Go Insung did not pass onto hell or heaven after suddenly dying, but instead onto a dungeon. A place in between the afterlife world and the living world. It’s a dungeon with a broadcasting system. While being watched by the numerous dead of the afterlife, Go Insung has to clear the dungeon with the other challengers in order to escape.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

A message board for all things anal! welcome to the Proctology Anonymous Board. Here, some things are just too painful to share without anonymity.

But when I showed up, they gave me a scrap of fabric that couldn’t even pass for a uniform… and told me to massage between someone’s legs. Can a famous soccer player really get away with this kind of behavior? And what’s up with the three-person session when I was told it’d be one-on-one? Isn’t that false advertising?

Turns out there’s another version of him.

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

After her ex-boyfriend dumps her to marry the boss's daughter, Cha Eun-Seo swears off love and gets a job at a rival company for a fresh start. But her plan goes awry when she has a one-night stand with her new sexy CEO, Lee Won-Woo! Eun-Seo runs from the hotel, leaving behind a heel that Won-Woo uses to find her. She wants nothing to do with him, but his interest in her only grows. With such a fervent suitor, can Eun-Weo stay away from love? Or can Won-Woo bring her the happy ending she wanted?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Chapter count includes ten side story chapters.

title.english: Dr. V and His Three Lovers

description:
Devastated by his lover Henry's sudden death, Victor gets drunk and steals his coffin from his grave. The last thing he remembers is bringing it back to his lab before blacking out. But when Victor wakes up, he's confronted by three men who claim that he revived them from the dead using Henry's head, heart, and crown jewels! Although none of them are Henry, all of them are drawn to Victor in different ways... Can Victor's three new lovers fill the hole in his life that Henry left behind?

(Source: Tappytoon)

In a twist and turn of events during a school trip to a rural, northernmost province of South Korea, Se-yeon and her classmates find themselves stranded on a remote island off the coast of North Korea. Extreme circumstances drive the youngsters to take extreme measures to survive. Who will live on, and who will fall victim to the harsh reality surrounding them?

This series contains mature themes and depictions of bullying, self-harm and suicide, and graphic violence. Viewer discretion is advised.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

Sun-Woo, the breadwinner of a poor family, is the breadwinner. Despite his drive to excel at anything, his body constantly makes mistakes. Then one day, while working part-time at a moving company, Sun-Woo accidentally breaks a jewelry box belonging to Hui-Jin, the owner of a sex toy company. Unable to repay the debt, he declares he'll do anything, no matter what. Hui-Jin, in response to Sun-Woo's words, suggests he review sex toys, and as the situation escalates, Sun-Woo begins to understand his own desires.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Includes 13 extra chapters.

7 years ago, Ki-Tae fell for actor Shin-Woo by chance and became obsessed with him. After stalking him alone for several years, he won the lottery and planned to kidnap Shin-Woo with the money he earned. He hid his real name and got a job as a manager, getting closer step by step, and finally kidnapped Shin-Woo and brought him back...

"Did you think I wouldn't know? Mr. Byun Ki-Tae?"

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

High schooler Gyu-Bin Ji, a psychic who can read minds, meets Byeol Yu, a mysterious new classmate. The twist? Byeol is actually a human-hating alien in disguise, sent to decide humanity’s fate! As unexpected sparks fly between them, Gyu-Bin must win Byeol's heart—and save Earth! Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)

The third prince, Rainier, whom the Mermaid King loves the most. Obsessed with the desire to become human and see beautiful flower fields, he goes to the deep sea magician Baller, and the magician offers to use his energy to turn him into a human... But the tummy is full of turmoil. This is the human body the prince wanted. Can he trust him, who somehow gives off an ominous aura?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

title.romaji: Haksaenghoejangui Sumgyeojin Eommuneun Yeohagudeurui Seongjeok Hyangsangimnida
title.native: 학생회장의 숨겨진 업무는 여학우들의 성(性)적 향상입니다

description:
As soon as U-Ju becomes the student council president, all the female students who were supposed to help him resign. By chance, he discovers a tablet in a warehouse that can control women, and uses the power of the tablet to take revenge... [Fuck all the female students by command.]

(Source: TOPTOON, translated)

Lian, a thirty-year-old who runs a perfume business in the US. While looking for an assistant, she meets Eun-Seo who is studying abroad in the US. From the first time they meet, the much younger woman who flirts with him is funny, but they go to a hotel together. However, at the hotel, Eun-Seo reveals an unexpected secret and slowly strangles Lian, who is terrified.

How will the fatal yet inescapable relationship between Lian and Eun-Seo develop?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Lee Shin-Hui has always juggled odd jobs to support his ailing brother, but when he accidentally shatters a mysterious marble, he's dragged into a demonic realm! Just as all hope seems lost, he's rescued by a powerful dokkaebi named Ohwi, who demands Shin-Hui's soul qi to satisfy his own hunger. Trapped in a dangerous world and bound to Ohwi's desires, can Shin-Hui find a way back home, or is he doomed to become Ohwi's personal soul qi vessel forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Doesn’t every child dream of a world without grown-ups? But when a deadly virus wipes out everyone over the age of twenty, reality proves to be far more sinister than a childhood fantasy. By the time No-Eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey to find "Utopia," a rumored safe haven said to hold the cure for the virus. But this so-called "Utopia" may not be what it seems...

(Source: WEBTOON)

One day, Cha-Seo, who is unemployed, receives a scouting offer from the director of a kindergarten called "Loop". What will Cha-Seo's day-to-day life be like at the centre for children who have been victims of abuse in their past lives?

(Source: Manhwakyung, translated)

Since my best friend died, every night in my dreams three men kill me. The man I fell in love with, the man who cooperated with me, and the man who hated me. From one day, the people in my dreams begin to appear in reality... Indeed, which of these three men killed me?

(Source: Naver; translated)

Emperor Exceltrion brought the world to destruction with his cruel anger. Of all people, I became that emperor!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Note: This is a one shot prologue for the web novel of the same name.
Note: Includes four extra chapters.

A group of high school friends have a tradition that they continue to honour even as adults: an annual Christmas gift exchange. Nam Yoontae is handsome, popular, easy-going, and the womaniser of the group. Nerdy, bespectacled Seong Chan, who only ended up with a gang of boys his polar opposite because they needed his help getting through exams, has been harbouring a secret crush for the other man since their schooldays.

Seong Chan dutifully attends the gift exchange every year for one reason, and one reason only: to have Yoontae receive his gift. But this Christmas, it seems that something even more shocking it about to happen.

Badly scarred by a boat accident that claimed her parents, Yu-Wol has so far avoided the attention of the patrons who frequent the courtesan house that owns her. When a deadly incident puts her life at risk, the enigmatic Tae-Woon offers her a lifeline, but will it prove to be her salvation… or her ruin?

(Source: Manta)

I did wish upon a mysterious painting to live a new life, but I didn't think that'd mean becoming Viola, a villain bound to die for copying her friend Robina's art and stealing her lovers! Still, I've got one good chance at survival if I stay away from Robina's men and use a different art style... if not for the fact that Robina now wants me to seduce Duke Depheloa, the male lead who's destined to kill me! But can I still turn this story around and get the happy ending Viola never had?

(Source: Tapas)

A dark and handsome stranger appears on You Jin’s doorstep one day, claiming to be a childhood friend that’s contracted a mysterious and potentially fatal disease – the reason You Jin doesn’t recognize him. Being the long-lost childhood friend that he is, he asks You Jin to help fulfill his dying wish. But can You Jin trust this beautiful stranger?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

Once saved as a child by a boy who appeared like a flame, Jang Do-Ha reunites with his savior and confesses his love. But Kang Tae-Jun knows the truth. Do-Ha’s feelings are not love. He has returned for one reason only, revenge.

(Source: Lezhin US)

I don’t want to work. Like at all. But I don’t have a choice. On an Earth where Humans, Elves, Orcs, Trolls, Dragons, and Aliens live together, there is a never-ending series of incidents. This is the story of a man who's been working in secret for 800 years because he’ll die if he doesn’t.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

I became a side character who was the younger sister of the male lead in a martial arts novel. Not only that, but I was sold off to the demonic cult for my family's sake where I met the young master, Hyuk Dojin.

He would asked me everyday if I wanted anything from him and my response would simply be a no. However, despite my answers, he would gift me many things like sending money to my family, buying me jewels, and giving me ivory from the southern lands and silk clothing. Whenever he asked if I wanted anything else, I would only shake my head in response.

Normally, he would understand and turn away, but today, he gazed at me vacantly. When I approached him, asking what was wrong, he laid his head on my shoulder lifelessly.

"Why do you lie to me every time?"

He lifted his hand slowly and grabbed my wrist.

"Why won't you tell me..."

He spoke desperately, as though he would fall apart at any moment.

"...to save you?"

Note: This is a promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.

Cedric Mondrich and Aurora Roman married for mutual convenience, agreeing to live as nothing more than friends. Aurora thought he would never see her as a woman… or so she believed. After their wedding, she begins to dream of sharing intimate nights with Cedric, leaving her caught between the boundaries of reality and illusion. Are these just dreams, or could they be something more? Once again, she closes her eyes, completely unaware of the truth.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Erofan Short Story Collection (에~로판 단편선) or the Steamy Collection in English.

A world of magic, science, and love.

After the tragic death of her sister, April is sold off by her father for just three pieces of silver. With no one to turn to, she's soon purchased by a duchess and begins working at her castle. But everything changes once she catches the eye of her new master...

(Source: Manta)

It’s bad enough that Team Leader Jeong-Hyun Baek has a thing for his omega subordinate, but when that subordinate is all tangled up with Jeong-Hyun’s beta boss? This love affair can’t possibly end well…

(Source: Tapas)

Obsessed lab hermit Han Woo-Jin has a scandalous secret: his passion for science is literal. When he hits a breakthrough, his body reacts with an uncontrollable, physical intensity that has earned him the nickname Mad Woo-Jin. Driven by cold logic, he treks to Deokmu Mountain to debunk rumors of a gold-granting goblin. Instead, he finds Baekbaek, a breathtaking god of wealth. Forget the gold, Woo-Jin has found the ultimate specimen...and he’s ready to experiment until they both reach their limit.

(Source: Lezhin US)

U-Geon has always been fascinated with amusement parks, but his work is miserable, getting looked down on by his childhood friend, Cho-I, every day. However, his life changes when he gets his hands on a magical tarot card that gives him the power to control any girl he wants.

(Source: DAYcomics, edited)

title.english: Beta Off Not Dating: Side Story

description:
The crown prince, known as the great wizard, is actually a fake with no power, and behind him is the real great wizard Moa who is with him as a maid. Moa used magic on the crown prince's behalf, not caring about her weakened body due to her love for him her whole life, but in the end, when her body broke down, all she got in return was a terrible betrayal. Just before she dies, in her hazy consciousness, someone extends a helping hand to Moa and proposes revenge on the crown prince...

Moa's revenge drama against the crown prince.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

Lee Hyuk’s a medical student at a good university, but his goals are more artistic. So he decides to chase his dreams by stealing his sister’s money and running away from home! He lands himself a teaching job and a place to stay, and everything is going great until he discovers his landlord is his student and school delinquent, Lee Biru. Hyuk may be the adult, but he has no real life experience. Biru, on the other hand, is independent, and more than capable of fending for himself. A coming-of-age story about two men who hate each other, but are exactly what each other needs.

(Source: Lezhin)

“I missed you so much, and I want to feel every part of you"

I thought I would be together with my first love forever, but I was wrong... Now I'm with her again after so many years, and she hasn't changed at all!

"Stay with me! I can't lose you again!"

(Source: DAYcomics)

After helping the Four Warriors put the evil dragon Aktale back to sleep, Cornelia thought she would be honored as a hero, but she was gravely mistaken. Though she helped lead the warriors to victory, no one recognized her efforts, since she was a commoner. Even the warriors themselves did not stand by her side. After regretting giving her all to help the empire, she leaves the capital to start anew, but just as she is settling into her new life, the evil dragon awakens again...

(Source: Tapas)
